A talailih mianona liata pakiasa ta, a hmia lâta, “Pakhu paneih teh u” tahpa ta awh lymâ ei ta. Cha hawhna chata Phiraoh ta Zawsi cha Izi râh zydua chô liata biehneituhpa ta a tao haw.
Phiraoh ta Zawsi hnohta, “Kei he Phiraoh ei châ. Nâma bie leipa ta ahy hmah Izi râh chhôh zydua liata ama ku tlyma, ama phei tlyma, ama hy awpa châ vei,” tah ta.
Phiraoh ta Zawsi cha a moh Zaphenâpania bi ta, Ôni khih theihthaipa Pawtipherâ sawchanônô Asenâ cha a lapinô ta pahneisa ta. Zawsi cha Izi râh chahryh ta.
Zawsi cha Izi bei Phiraoh chakaona rai liata â ngia nota kô sythôhpa a châ. Zawsi cha Phiraoh hmiakô tawhta pua ta, Izi râh zydua chahryh ta.
Kô pha kô, kô sari chhôh chhaohlei ta kôvei thata papua ta.
Izi râh liata kô pha kô, kô sari chhôh zydua Zawsi ta sâh pahmaoh ta, sâhzy cha khihpizy liata sohpakhy ta. Cha hawhna chata a chheipâh lyu liata sâhzy cha khihpi to liata sohpakhy lymâ ta.
Zawsi ta sâh cha a hluh thei chaipa ta, tilaipi liata sadi zie ta pahmaoh ta, a panua chhao panua khao veih ei. A hluh tu hapa vâta panua tiah awpa châ khao vei.
Chakâhna a vaw tlô hlâta Zawsi ta sawchapaw pano sa ta, âmo cha Ôni theihthaipa Pawtipherâ sawchanô Asenâ ta Zawsi châta a sapazy ama châ.
Zawsi ta, “Khazohpa ta ei rairuna zydua nata ei paw o eina pamysa haw,” tah ta, a sawchapaw uhtheipa moh cha Manase a bi.
“Khazohpa ta ei riethei taona râh liata ei chipathla a papôh haw,” tah ta, a panona moh cha Epharai a bi.
Kô pha kô, kô sari Izi râh liata a tlôpa cha vaw chhâ ta.
Chakâh kô, kô sari cha, Zawsi ta a reipa hawh tlai ta, vaw tlô pathao ta. Râh to liata chakâhna tlô ta, Izi râh chhôh zydua liata deikua sâh y ta.
Izi râh zydua ta ama nodi ta, chyhsazy ta Phiraoh hnohta nie awpa hiah ei ta. Phiraoh ta Izi chyhsa zydua hnohta, “Zawsi lâ vawh u la, a cha chhopa maih tao muh vy,” tah ta.
Khizaw zydua liata chakâhna vaw tlô ta, Izi râh liata chhao chakâh mozoh tlô ta. Zawsi ta sawvâ zydua pahy ta, Izi mo hnohta zuah lymâ ta.
Khizaw zydua liata chakâh mozoh a tlôpa vâta, Zawsi tawhta sâh chalei awpa ta, râh to tawhta Izi râh lâ vaw pangai ei ta.
Zakaw cha Izi râh liata sâh a y tahpa a pahno nahta, a sawchapawzy hnohta, “Khazia namâ mo thlâh haw?” tah ta.
“Pachâ teh u, Izi râh liata sâh a y tahpa ei thei. Cha lâ cha zu u la, cha liata eima châta sâh za chalei teh u. Chatanachata thi leipa aw pi ta, eima hroh aw,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Zawsi unawh pahrawhzy cha, sâh chalei awpa ta Izi râh lâ zu ei ta.
Zawsi pilâhpa Benzami deikua cha, Zakaw ta, “Hmo pha leipa â tyh pathlei aw na,” tah ta, a unawhzy hnohta pasiesa vei.
Kâna râh liata chakâhna a tlôpa vâta, Izarei sawchapawzy cha, sâh chalei awpa ta a siepazy hry liata sie hra ei ta.
Zawsi cha Izi râh ryureituhpa châ ta, cha râh liata chyhsa zydua hnohta sâh a zuahtuhpa a châ. Zawsi unawhzy cha za tlô ei ta, ama hmia alei lâ a bôhpa ta ano cha a naoh ei ta.

Zawsi ta a unawhzy a hmô nahta, âmo cha pahno thlâh ha ta, châhrasala hmia pahno leipa hawhta ama chô liata a tao ta, reih chahrâhpa ta âmo cha bie a chho ta. Ama hnohta, “Khataih tawhta a vypa ma nama châ?” tah ta. Âmo ta, “Sâh chalei awpa ta Kâna râh tawhta â zupa eima châ,” tah ei ta.
Zawsi ta a unawhzy cha pahno thlâh ha ta, âmo deikua ta ano cha pahno khao veih ei.
Zawsi ta âmo kyh liata mâ a sapazy kha a kaw thei heih ta, ama hnohta, “Mohparutuhpazy nama châ. Râh ruapa mo awpa ta namâ vy,” tah ta.
Âmo ta a hnohta, “Châ vei, ei zibeipa, châ chakaotuhpazy he sâh chalei awpa ta a vypa eima châ.
Eima zydua heta chyhsa pakha saw châ pi ta, chyhsa dopa eima châ. Châ chakaotuhpazy he mohparutuhpazy châ ma pi,” tah ei ta.
Ano ta ama hnohta, “Châ vei, râh ruapa mo awpa ta a vypa tlai nama châ,” tah ta.

Âmo ta, “Keimo, châ chakaotuhpazy pi he, unawh pahrawh hleino châ pi ta, Kâna râh liata a ypa chyhsa pakha saw eima châ. Eima seihnai chaipa cha tahmâ eima paw hnohta y ta, pakha deikua cha y khao vei,” tah ei ta.
Zawsi ta ama hnohta, “Nama hnohta ei reipa hawh tlai kha a châ, mohparutuhpazy nama châ.
Hetana heta pasiapa nama châ aw: Nama seihnai chaipa cha he lâ namâ zâ chhi vei khiahta cha, Phiraoh hrona reipa ta ei reih, he su tawhta pua aw veih ei chi.

Nâmo liata biedopa a y ma, y vei ma, nama bie pasia nawpa ta, he liata patâhpa ta nama y chhôh ta, nama hry liata pakha tuah u la, nama unawhpa cha kaw dy mawh sy. Cha hawhta nama tao vei khiahta cha, Phiraoh hrona reipa ta ei reih, mohparutuhpazy nama châ tlai, ei cha tah aw ei,” tah ta.
Ama zydua ta noh thôh patâh ta.
A noh thôhna noh liata, Zawsi ta ama hnohta, “Khazohpa chi tlôh na ta, chavâta hetana heta tao u la nama hroh aw:
Chyhsa dopa nama châ khiahta cha, nama unawh hry liata pakha namâ tâhna liana heta a tâh chy aw ta, ahropazy deikua cha sie aw ei chi ta, nama chhôhkhazy chakâhpa châta sâh cha phaoh aw ei chi ta,
nama unawh seihnai chaipa cha kei lâ nama zâ chhi aw. Chatanachata nama bie cha pasiapa châ aw ta, thi aw veih ei chi,” tah ta. Cha hawhna chata tao ei ta.

Âmo nata âmo a chhohia ei ta, “Eima unawhpa chô liata eima hmotaopa vâta thailei eima châ ha tlai he zaw. Ngiachhie miah â haw ngâ nota a palôh nôpozie kha hmô thlâh ha pi ta, châhrasala eima nathlie khoh leipa kha. Chavâta he nôpona heta miah a tla thlu hih,” tah ei ta.
Rubena ta âmo cha a chhy ta, “Hawtipa chô liata hmo parao lei awpa ta cha chho veih ei na mâ? Nama nathlie khoh leipa kha. Chavâta a thisaih phuh lapa a châ ha tlai hih,” tah ta.
Ama likah liata reih palietuhpa a ypa vâta, ama biereipa cha Zawsi ta a thei tahpa pahno leipa ei ta.
Zawsi cha âmo tawhta pua ta, arulâta kei cha ta. Âmo lâ a vy heih ta, âmo cha bie a chho ta. Simeôna cha ama hry tawhta ânano ta a chhi ta, ama mohmô ta chahry ta.
Zawsi ta ama sykhaozy biena taih sâh ryhpa awpa nata ama tâkâzy ama sykhao liata khôpa khai awpa nata lâpi liata ama nie awpazy pie awpa ta biepie ta. Cha hawhna chata taopa ei ta.
Ama sâh cha ama alâzy paphaosa ei ta, sie ha ei ta.
Riebu liata ama hry liata pakha ta alâ lao pie awpa ta a sykhao pahy ta, a tâkâ kha a sykhao paka liata a vaw y thlâh hapa hmô ta.

A unawhzy hnohta, “Ei tâkâ eina pakua ha ei, moh tua u, ei sykhao paka liata a y thlâh hih,” tah ta. Thata a pahlaw ei ta, a chalyupa ta a moh chyu ei ta, “Eima chô liata Khazohpa hmotaopa he khâpa ma a châ tly?” tah ei ta.
Kâna râh liata ama paw Zakaw kô ama tlô nahta, ama chô liata hmo a tlôpa zydua cha chho ei ta, a hnohta
“Râh ryureituhpa chyhsa ta reih chahrâh kawpa ta bie miah a chho ta, râh mohparutuhpa ta miah rao ta.
Keimo ta a hnohta, ‘Chyhsa dopa eima châ, mohparutuhpa châ cheita ma pi.
Unawh pahrawh hleino châ pi ta, eima paw sawchapawzy eima châ khai. Pakha deikua cha y khao vei, eima seihnai chaipa cha tahmâ Kâna râh liata eima paw hnohta a y,’ tah pi ta.
Râh ryureituhpa chyhsa chata eima hnohta, ‘Hetana heta chyhsa dopa nama châ tahpa ei pahno aw: Nama unawh pakha ei hnohta siesai u la, nama chhôhkha chakâhpazy châta sâh phaoh u la, sie muh vy.

Nama unawh seihnai chaipa cha kei lâ a zâ chhi aw ei chi ta, chatanachata mohparutuhpa châ leipa ei chi ta, chyhsa dopa tlai nama châ tahpa ei pahno aw. Chatawhcha nama unawhpa he cha pie heih aw ei na ta, he râh liata sôh zy nama palie aw,’ miah a tah,” tah ei ta.
Ama sykhao liata sâhzy cha bô ei ta, ama tâkâ sô chyu cha ama sykhao liata vaw y thlâh ha ta. Tâkâ sôzy ama hmô nahta, âmo chhao, ama paw chhao, chi ngaita ei ta.

Ama paw Zakaw ta ama hnohta, “Sawzy pahlei awpa ta eina tao lymâ ei chi he. Zawsi y khao leipa ta, Simeôna chhao y khao hra vei. Tahmâ Benzami taih chhao a chhi a chhuah heih ei chi ta, hmo pha leipa sai ta eina tla thlu lymâ,” tah ta.
Rubena ta a paw hnohta, “Benzami he nâ lâ ei vaw liekhei heih leipa khiahta cha, ei sawchapaw panozy he thie lah vâ chi. Ano cha ei ku liata soh la, nâ lâ ei vaw liekhei heih aw,” tah ta.

Châhrasala Zakaw ta, “Ei sawchapawpa he nama hnohta a zu aw vei, a unawhpa thi ha ta, ano deita he hroh ta, nama siena lâpi liata hmo pha leipa a zâ tyh pathlei khiahta cha, ei luh pawhpa he pachârôhpa ta Athihkhih lâ nama pasiesa aw,” tah ta.
Cha râh liata chakâh mozohna cha tlô lymâ ta.
Izi râh tawhta ama kaw phaopa sâh ama nie khai nahta, ama paw ta ama hnohta, “Sie heih u la, sâh a chyhta chhâ eima châta za chalei heih teh u,” tah ta.
Zudâh ta a hnohta, “Cha chyhsa chata, ‘Nama unawhpa nama hnohta â hlao leipa khiahta la, ei hmia na hmô aw veih ei chi’ tahpa ta zikyu liahsa miah a râ ha ta.
Eima unawhpa he eima hnohta na pasiesa khiahta cha, sâh cha eima cha za chaleipa aw.
Na pasiesa leipa khiahta cha, zu aw ma pi, cha chyhsa chata eima hnohta, ‘Nama unawhpa nama hnohta â hlao leipa khiahta la, ei hmia na hmô aw veih ei chi,’ miah tah ha tlôh ta,” tah ta.
Izarei ta, “Khazia unawh hropa nama hneipa kyh zy taih chhopa ta, ei chô liata hmo pha lei ngaitapa nama tao?” tah ta.

Âmo ta, “‘Cha chyhsa chata, nama paw cha a hroh ma? Unawh hropa nama hnei ma?’ tahpa ta keimo thâtih nata eima chhôhkha thâtih zy a sia kawpa ta miah hiahri ta. Bie miah a hiahripazy eimâ chhypa châ ta, ‘Nama unawhpa cha a zâ chhi teh u,’ a tah awpa kheihta eima pahno aw?” tah ei ta.
Zudâh ta a paw Izarei hnohta, “Hawtipa he ei hnohta pasiesa la, thyu aw pi ta, eima sie aw. Chatanachata keimo nata nâ nata eima sawtazy he thi leipa aw pi ta, eima hroh thei aw.

Â boh nawpa ta, kei he a vyuhpa ta sokhâhpa châ aw na ta, a hrona ei ku tawhta nâ hnaw aw. Ano cha nâ lâ a vaw liekhei heih leipa ta, na hmiakô liata ei paduasa heih leipa khiahta cha, keima ta chhâzaw ta a maoh ei phaoh aw.
Pahawhpasâh leipa sih la cha, ei no eimâ kaw lie ha bâ awpa tlai,” tah ta.

Ama paw Izarei ta ama hnohta, “Cha hawhta a châ khiahta cha, hetana heta tao muh vy: He râh liata theilâpa pahâh chaipazy he a chyhta sai ta nama sykhaozy liata pasâ u la, cha chyhsa châta kuhria, thochathli thohna, kheihti, ropahâhpa, myrâ, theilâ hyhkua châpa nata kuasâh theizy phaopa muh vy.
Tâkâ a lie no ta a phao u la, nama sykhao paka liata tâkâ a cha pakua hapazy chhao kha phaoh ha muh vy, my pathleipa a châ ngyu aw.
Nama unawhpa chhao cha a chhi u la, thyu u la, cha chyhsa lâ cha sie heih teh u.

Khazohpa Atotaotheipa ta, cha chyhsa hmiakô liata cha ngiachhie ei sala, cha chyhsa chata nama unawhpa pakha nata Benzami he nama hnohta kaw pasiesa mawh sy! Kei deikua cha, ei sawzy ei pahlei hapa chhao ta, ei pahleipa châ lah vâ,” tah ta.
Chatanachata kuhriazy cha phaoh ei ta, tâkâ chhao a lie no ta phaoh ei ta. Thyu ei ta, Benzami a chhipa ta Izi râh lâ cha zu ei ta, Zawsi hmiakô liata zâ duah ei ta.
Ama hnohta Benzami â hlaopa Zawsi ta a hmô nahta, a o avaotuhpa hnohta, “Hao chyhsazy hao o chhôh lâ a chhi la, sa thie la, chhoh teh. Hao chyhsazy hao ei hnohta nohchhô pati ama nie aw,” tah ta.
Cha chyhsa chata Zawsi biepiepa hawhta tao ta, chyhsazy cha Zawsi o lâ a chhi ta.

Zawsi o lâ a chhipa ama châpa vâta chi kaw ei ta, “Eimâ zu tua nota, eima sykhao liata tâkâ miah a pakuapazy vâ khata miah â chhi hih. Miah a tei nawpa ryhpaohna tluapa ta, miah thyuhnao ta, sei ta miah patupa ta, eima alâzy a la khai â chhuah hih,” tah ei ta.
Zawsi o avaotuhpa kiapâh lâ vawh ei ta, chhikao thaby liata bie a chho ei ta,
“Pâpuh, sâh chalei awpa ta eimâ zu tua no kha,
riebu eima tlô nahta eima sykhaozy pahy pi ta, eima sykhao chyu liata eima tâkâzy cha â kipa ta vaw y thlâh ha ta, chavâta eima vaw phaoh pakhua haw.
Sâh chalei nawpa ta tâkâ hropa chhao eima vaw phaoh. Eima tâkâ kha ahy ma eima sykhao liata a soh tahpa pahno ma pi,” tah ei ta.

Ano ta, “Thlalôhpa ta y teh u, chi khuh vy. Nâmo Khazohpa nata nama paw Khazohpa ta nama sykhaozy liata hmosôhpa a cha pie ei chuh. Nama tâkâ kha ei vaw hmô haw,” tah ta. Simeôna cha âmo lâ vaw papua ta.
Zawsi o avaotuhpa ta âmo cha Zawsi o chhôh lâ a chhi ta, âmo cha ti pie ta, ama pheizy a si ei ta, ama alâzy châta sahroh laozy pie ta.
Cha liata pati ama nie awpa ama pahnopa vâta, nohchhô ta Zawsi â vy daihti liata pie awpa ta ama kuhriazy a chhuanoh chhielie ei ta.
Zawsi â vaw di nahta, ama kuhriazy o chhôh lâ cheipa ei ta, alei lâ a bôhpa ta ano cha a naoh ei ta.
Zawsi ta ama thâtih hiahri ta, “Nama paw a thâtih nama reipa pawpipa kha a tlâh no a châ ma? A hroh thlâh chy ma?” tah ta.
Âmo ta, “Châ chakaotuhpa eima paw cha a tlâh no a châ, a hroh thlâh chy,” tah ei ta. Ama luh a bôhpa ta, ano cha a naoh ei ta.

Zawsi cha mohmia pasaih ta, a unawhpa Benzami, a nô sawchapawpa kei hmô ta, “Kha kha nama unawh seihnai chaipa a thâtih eina chhopa ei chi kha a châ ma?” tah ta. A hnohta, “Ei sawchapawpa, Khazohpa ta cha ngiachhie mawh sy!” tah ta.
Zawsi cha a unawhpa a hmô thlâhpa cha thata a ngiahma ta, cha nawpa su tlua para ta, a chhôhpadâhpa lâ a ngia ta, cha liata cha ta.
A hmia a pahlie ta, vaw pua heih ta, a palôh a pachyusapa ta, “Pati nie tao teh u,” tah ta.

Ano châta ânano ta, âmo sahlao châta ânano ta, Izi chyhsa ano a nielâhpazy châta ânano ta pati cha tao ei ta. A chhâpa cha Izi chyhsazy ta Hebrai chyhsazy cha pati phiah la lâh leipa ei ta, cha hawhta taopa cha Izi chyhsazy châta pasichhihpa a châpa vâta a châ.
A uhthei chaipa tawhta pathao ta, a seihnai chaipa taih ta, ama uhthei châna apazinazie hawhta, Zawsi hmiakô liata a tyuh ei ta. Noâhpa ta a moh raihrie ei ta.
Ama nie vyuhzy cha Zawsi tlâhkhai tawhta rai ei ta, Benzami vyuh cha mohropazy vyuh hlâta a lie pangawh ta a hluh via. Chatanachata niepa ta doh ei ta, Zawsi hnohta a ly ngaitapa ta y ei ta.
Chatawhcha Zawsi ta a o avaotuhpa biepie ta, “Ama sykhaozy kha ama phao theipa hawh chyu ta sâh ta pabie la, ama tâkâ kha ama sykhao paka chyu liata soh la,
ei tâkâ nyu kha ama seihnai chaipa sykhao paka liata, a sâh mâ tâkâ chhao khata khô mah y,” tah ta. Zawsi reipa hawhta tao ta.
Khih a deipa nahta, chyhsazy cha ama alâzy chhaota pasiesa ei ta.
Khih tawhta pua ei ta, lâhlapi ama sie hlâta, Zawsi ta a o avaotuhpa hnohta, “Thyu la, chyhsazy kha a kei chadai teh. Na pha ti ei ta, ama hnohta, ‘Khazia hmo phapa hmo chhiepa ta viari nama thô?
Kha nyu kha ei zibeipa Kresawhti dona nata a pachaona nyu mah a châ tâh. Nama hmotaopa a pha lei ngaita,’ tah mah y,” tah ta.
Âmo cha a kei pha nahta, cha biezy cha ama hnohta reih ta.
Âmo ta a hnohta, “Khazia ei zibeipa ta cha hawhpa biezy cha a reih thlâh ha tly? Châ chakaotuhpazy he, cha hawhpa hmo a tao thlâh ha awpa chi châ ma pi.
Eima sykhao paka liata tâkâ eima hmôpazy chhao kha, Kâna râh tawhta nâma lâta eima za phao pakhua hapa kha. Kheihta ma na zibeipa o liata tâkâ tlyma, ngôh tlyma eima paru thei aw?
Châ chakaotuhpazy hry liana heta, cha hmo na hmôna chyhsa cha thi mawh sy. Keimo chhao ei zibeipa chakaotuhpa ta eima y aw,” tah ei ta.
Ano ta, “Nama bie hawhta châ mawh sy. Cha hmo ei hmôna chyhsa cha nâ chakaotuhpa ta y tlai aw ta, ahropazy deikua cha thaileina a hnei leipa nama châ aw,” tah ta.
Ama sykhaozy cha alei liata thlai pachhô ei ta, ama sykhao chyu pahy ei ta.
Ama uhthei chaipa tawhta a thaopa ta, ama seihnai chaipa taihta tlua ta, nyu cha Benzami sykhao liata hmô ta.
Chapata nahta, ama chysiazy hrie ei ta, ama alâ chyu liata ama hmozy khaih ei ta, khihpi lâ a lie ei ta.
Zudâh nata a unawhzy cha Zawsi o kei tlô ei ta, ano cha o liata vaw y thlâh ha ta, a hmiakô liata alei liata a byu ei ta.
Zawsi ta ama hnohta, “Khâpa hmo nama tao haw? Kei hawhpa chyhsa heta cha pachao chhao a thai tahpa pahno veih ei chi mâ?” tah ta.

Zudâh ta, “Ei zibeipa hnohta khâpa eima cha chho aw? Khâpa eima reih aw? Kheihawhta ma eimâ reipasia thei aw? Khazohpa ta châ chakaotuhpazy moleina a hmô hapa a châ. Keimo chhao, a ku liata nyu ama hmôpa chhao, ei zibeipa chakaotuhpazy eima châ,” tah ta.
Zawsi ta, “Cha hawh ngâsâ ta la tao aw va na. A ku liata nyu ama hmôpa deita he nâ chakaotuhpa ta a y aw. Nâmo cha thlalôhpa ta nama paw lâ sie muh vy,” tah ta.

Zudâh ta Zawsi cha a kei hnia ta, “Hy ei zibeipa, nâ cha Phiraoh tlupa châ chi ta, ngiachhiepa ta ei zibeipa nah theina liata châ chakaotuhpa he bie kawh kha na pareisa la, châ chakaotuhpa chô liata na pathi rie ia khah sy.
Ei zibeipa ta châ chakaotuhpazy he, ‘Paw nama hnei ma, unawh nama hnei ma?’ tahpa ta miah hiahri chi ta.

Keimo ta ei zibeipa hnohta, ‘Paw hnei pi ta, ano cha pawpi kaw bâ ta, a pawpi tawhta a sapa unawh hawtipa pakha eima hnei. Ano unawhpa cha thi ha ta, ano nô ta a sapa liata ano deita hroh ta, a paw ta ano cha a dao ngaita,’ tahpa ta cha chho pi ta.
Nâ ta châ chakaotuhpazy hnohta, ‘Ano cha ei hmô thei nawpa ta kei lâ a zâ chhi teh u,’ miah tah chi ta.
Keimo ta ei zibeipa hnohta, ‘Hawtipa cha a paw siesai thei aw vei, a paw a siesai khiahta cha a paw cha a thi thlâh ha aw,’ cha tah pi ta.
Nâ ta châ chakaotuhpazy hnohta, ‘Nama seihnai chaipa cha nama hnohta â zu hra vei khiahta cha, ei hmia hmô khao aw veih ei chi,’ miah tah chi ta.
Châ chakaotuhpa ei paw kô eima tlô nahta, ei zibeipa biezy cha chho pi ta.
Eima paw ta, ‘Sie heih u la, eima châta sâh a chyhta chhâ za chalei heih teh u,’ tah ta.

Keimo ta, ‘Zu thei aw ma pi. Eima unawh seihnai chaipa eima hnohta â hlao hra khiahta deikua cha, eima zu heih aw. Eima unawh seihnai chaipa eima hnohta â hlao vei khiahta cha, cha chyhsa hmia hmô thei khao aw ma pi,’ tah pi ta.
Châ chakaotuhpa ei paw ta eima hnohta, ‘Ei lapinô ta sawchapaw pano eina sapa tahpa nama pahno.
Pakha cha kei tawhta sie ta, “Chaphie khaipa ta a y ha tlai cha zaw,” tah na ta, cha rakha tawhta ano cha hmô khao va na.
Chavâta he pakhapa chhao he, kei tawhta a chhi u la, hmo pha leipa a zâ tyh pathlei khiahta cha, ei luh pawhpa he pachârôhpa ta Athihkhih lâ nama pasiesa aw,’ tah ta.
Chavâta châ chakaotuhpa ei paw kô ei tlô tita, hawtipa he eima hnohta â hlao vei khiahta cha, a hrona cha hawtipa hrona nata khâchâ â zao hapa vâta,
hawtipa he eima hnohta â hlao leipa a pahnopa nahta, a thi thlâh ha aw. Chatanachata châ chakaotuhpazy heta, châ chakaotuhpa eima paw luh pawhpa cha pachârôhpa ta Athihkhih lâ eima pasiesa aw.

Châ chakaotuhpa heta ei paw hnohta, ‘Hawtipa he nâ lâ ei kaw chhi heih leipa khiahta cha, ei paw hmiakô liata chhâzaw ta a maoh ei phaoh aw,’ tahpa ta hawtipa a boh nawpa ta ei paw liata ei hrona ei sokhâh hapa a châ.
Chavâta ngiachhiepa ta châ chakaotuhpa he hawtipa vyuhpa ta ei zibeipa chakaotuhpa ta na paysa la, hawtipa he cha a unawhzy hnohta rie paliesa mah y.
Hawtipa ei hnohta a sie leipa khiahta cha, kheihta ma ei paw lâ ei khy ngâh aw? Ei paw chô liata chhiena a tlô awpa cha moh ngâh va na,” tah ta.

Zawsi cha a kiapâh liata a duahpa zydua hmiakô liata â oh thei khao leipa ta, “Chyhsa zydua kei tawhta papua khai teh u,” tahpa ta awh ta. Zawsi ta a unawhzy â pahnosa nota, a kiapâh liata ahy hmah y veih ei.
Zawsi cha aoh tlili ta cha ta. Izi chyhsazy ta a chapa pyu cha thei ei ta, Phiraoh chhôhkha chhao ta thei ei ta.
Zawsi ta a unawhzy hnohta, “Zawsi kha ei châ. Ei paw cha a hroh thlâh ha chy ma?” tah ta. Châhrasala a unawhzy ta a chhy thei veih ei. A hmiakô liata ama vaw y thlâh hapa cha ama nô a po ngaita.
Zawsi ta a unawhzy hnohta, “Ngiachhiepa ta nâ vaw hnia teh u,” tah ta. Amâ vaw hnia nahta, ama hnohta, “Nama unawhpa Zawsi, Izi râh lâ nama zua hapa kha ei châ.
He râh lâ eina zuapa vâ ei chi ta nama pachârôh leipa sala, nâmosasyh â hao hra khuh vy. Hrona pabohsa awpa ta, Khazohpa ta nama hmia lâta eina vaw tuapa a châ.
Kô no râh liata chakâhna tlô ha ta, kô pangawh a y thlâh ha chy. Cha daihti chhôh ta lei paliena nata sâh hriana rai y aw vei.
Nama châta chipathlazy alei chô liata cha pahlôhpa awpa nata pachhana rônahpa ta nama hronazy pabohsa awpa ta, Khazohpa ta nama hmia lâta eina vaw tuapa a châ.
He liata nâ vaw tuahtuhpa cha nâmo châ veih ei chi, Khazohpa a châ. Khazohpa ta Phiraoh châta paw ta na tao ta, a chhôhkha zydua châta zibeipa nata Izi râh zydua chô liata ryureituhpa ta eina tao.
Chavâta tahmâ a chatliepa ta ei paw lâ khy u la, a hnohta, ‘Na sawchapawpa Zawsi ta hetana heta a tah: Khazohpa ta Izi râh zydua chô liata ryureituhpa ta na tao ta, kei lâ a zu la, za hawh khah y.
Kôse râh liata y aw chi ta, na sawzy nata na samohzy, na mietaku zawzy, na viahchao hrizy nata na hneipa zydua chhaota ei kiapâh liata nama y aw.
Cha liata kei ta ei cha chyh aw. Chataleipatala chakâh nawpa daihti kô pangawh y chy tlôh ta, nâ nata na chhôhkhazy nata na hneipa zydua rietheipa ta nama y pathlei aw na,’ kaw tah muh vy.
Tahmâ nâmo mo nata ei unawhpa Benzami mo tlai ta, nama hnohta bie a reihpa he keima tlai ei châ tahpa nama hmô haw.
Izi râh liata ei rônahna zydua nata hmo nama hmôpa kyh zydua he ei paw kaw chho aw ei chi ta, ei paw cha a chatliepa ta he râh lâ he zâ chhi muh vy,” tah ta.
A unawhpa Benzami cha a pyhpa ta cha ta, Benzami chhao Zawsi cha a pyhpa ta cha hra ta.
A unawh zydua a pahnâ ta, cha thlu chyu ta. Cha khai tawhta a unawhzy ta Zawsi cha bie a chho ei ta.
Phiraoh o liata a ypazy ta, “Zawsi unawhzy ama za tlô” tahpa vaw thei ei ta. Cha thâtih chata Phiraoh nata a chakaotuhpazy palysa kaw ta.
Phiraoh ta Zawsi hnohta, “Na unawhzy cha hetana heta tao awpa ta chho mah y: ‘Nama alâzy sâh paphaosapa ta, Kâna râh lâ a lie u la,
nama paw nata nama chhôhkhazy a zâ chhi muh vy. Kei lâ a zu aw ei chi ta, Izi râh liata râh pha chaipa cha pie aw ei na ta, cha râh thaw cha nama nie aw.’
Hetana heta na chho pâ aw ei: ‘Nama hawti chyhpazy châta nata nama lapinôzy châta Izi râh tawhna heta talailihzy a chhi aw ei chi ta, nama paw cha a zâ chhi u la, a zu muh vy.
Nama hmobaohzy kyh liata a tymâ khuh vy. Izi râh zydua liata hmo phapazy he nama eih a châ,’ na tah aw ei,” tah ta.
Cha hawhna chata Izarei sawzy ta tao ei ta. Phiraoh biepiepa hawhta, Zawsi ta âmo cha talailihzy pie ta, lâpi liata nie awpa chhao pie hra ta.
Ama zydua ta chysia a patly awpazy pie ta. Benzami chhochhi cha tâkâ sekel za thôh nata chysia a patly awpa zo pangawh a pie.
A paw châta Izi râh liata hmo phapazy a phaoh awpa alâ tôhpa pô hrawh nata sâh, viahchhâ nata lâpi liata a paw nie awpa a phaoh awpa alâ panô pô hrawh paphao ta.
A unawhzy cha pasiesa ta, ama hnohta, “Lâpi liata a hryuh khuh vy,” tah ta.
Zawsi unawhzy cha Izi râh tawhta khy ei ta, Kâna râh liata ama paw Zakaw kô kaw tlô ei ta.
A hnohta, “Zawsi kha hroh thlâh ha ta, Izi râh zydua chô liata ryureituhpa a châ,” tahpa ta chho ei ta. Zakaw cha a pahlaw ta, ama biereipa cha zo leipa ta.
Châhrasala Zawsi ta ama hnohta bie a reipa zydua chho ei ta, a kia awpa talailihzy Zawsi ta a paphaopa a hmô nahta, ama paw Zakaw cha palôh thadâhpa ta y ha ta.
Izarei ta, “Â daih na, ei sawchapawpa Zawsi cha a hroh thlâh ha na. Zu aw na ta, ei thi hlâta ano cha ei za hmô aw,” tah ta.
Izarei cha a hneipa zydua chhaota a thao ta, Besebâ tlô ta, a paw Aisika Khazohpa lâ atheihnazy hlâ ta.
Khazohpa ta zâ ta a mâ lâta Izarei cha bie chho ta, “Zakaw, Zakaw,” tah ta. Ano ta, “He liata ei y,” tah ta.
Ano ta, “Kei he Khazohpa, na paw Aisika Khazohpa ei châ. Izi râh lâta zu awpa chi khah y. Cha liata phopi rônahpa ta ei cha tao aw.
Na hnohta Izi râh lâ a zu aw na ta, ei châ kaw chhi pakhua heih aw. Na thi tita Zawsi ta a ku ta na mokhaoh a cha pabiehpa aw,” tah ta.
Zakaw cha Besebâ tawhta pua ta. Izarei sawchapawzy ta ama paw Zakaw nata ama hawtizy nata ama lapinôzy cha, Phiraoh ta ano phao nawpa ta talailih a kaw paphaopazy ta phaoh ei ta.
Zakaw nata a pathla zydua cha Kâna râh liata ama hneipa ama sahroh nata hmobaohzy a phaopa ta, Izi râh lâ zu ei ta.
A sawchapawzy, a sawchapawzy liata a samohzy, a sawchanôzy nata a sawchapawzy sawchanôzy a chhi ta, a pathla zydua a hnohta Izi râh lâ â ngiakhei ha ei.
He he Izarei pathla, Izi râh a ngiapa Zakaw nata a sawchapawzy moh a châ: Rubena cha Zakaw sawchapaw uhtheipa châ ta,
Rubena sawchapawzy cha Hanô, Pâluh, Hezrô nata Kâmi zy ama châ.
Simeôna sawchapawzy cha Zemua, Zami, Ôha, Zaki, Zôha nata Kâna zuah chô liata a sawchapawpa Sawla zy ama châ.
Livai sawchapawzy cha Kesao, Kôhâ nata Merâri zy ama châ.
Zudâh sawchapawzy cha Erâ, Ônâ, Selah, Pereza nata Zerâ zy ama châ. Erâ nata Ônâ deikua cha Kâna râh liata ama thi haw. Pereza sawchapawzy cha Hezrô nata Hâmu ama châ.
Iskâra sawchapawzy cha Tola, Puvâ, Iôbâ nata Simrô zy ama châ.
Zebulawna sawchapawzy cha Seredâ, Elôni nata Zale zy ama châ.
Chazy cha Liah ta Pâdâ-Aramia liata Zakaw châta a sapa sawchapawzy châ ei ta, a sawchanô Dinâ chhaota, a sawchapawzy nata a sawchanôzy cha ama zydua ta sythôh nata pathôh ama châ.
Kâdâ sawchapawzy cha Ziphiô, Hâkei, Suni, Ezbaw, Eri, Arôdi nata Areli zy ama châ.
Asera sawchapawzy cha Imnâ, Isvâ, Isvi nata Beriah zy châ ei ta, ama sietanô cha Serâ a châ. Beriah sawchapawpa Hebe nata Malki ama châ.
Chazy cha Lâbâ ta a sawchanô Liah a piepa Zilpâ sawchapawzy châ ei ta, Zilpâ ta Zakaw châta âmo cha sa ta, ama zydua ta pahrawh hlei charu ama châ.
Zakaw lapinô Râkheli sawchapawzy cha Zawsi nata Benzami ama châ.
Zawsi ta Izi râh liata sawchapaw pano, Manase nata Epharai sa ta, âmo cha Ôni khih theihthaipa Pawtipherâ sawchanô Asenâ ta Zawsi châta a sapazy ama châ.
Benzami sawchapawzy cha Belâ, Bekhe, Asabe, Kerâ, Nâmâ, Ehi, Rôsâ, Mupi, Hupi nata Ardâ zy ama châ.
Chazy cha Zakaw ta Râkheli chô liata a sapa Râkheli sawchapawzy châ ei ta, ama zydua ta pahrawh hlei palih ama châ.
Dânâ sawchapawpa cha Husi a châ.
Nâthalai sawchapawzy cha Zahaze, Kuni, Zeze nata Sile zy ama châ.
Chazy cha Lâbâ ta a sawchanô Râkheli a piepa Bilhâ sawchapawzy châ ei ta, Bilhâ ta Zakaw châta âmo cha sa ta, ama zydua ta pasari ama châ.
Zakaw sawchapawzy lapinôzy rei leipa ta, Zakaw hnohta Izi râh a ngia hrapa, ano chipathlazy cha ama zydua ta sycharu nata pacharu ama châ.
Zawsi ta Izi râh liata sawchapaw pano sa ta, chatanachata Zakaw chhôhkha Izi râh lâ a ngiapazy cha ama zydua ta sysari ama châ.
Zawsi ta Kôse lâpi a vaw chho thei nawpa ta, Zakaw ta Zudâh cha Zawsi lâ pasiesa chhielie ta. Chatanachata Kôse râh cha a ngia ei ta.
Zawsi cha a talailih a chhuanoh ta, a paw a hmô awpa ta Kôse lâ khy ta. A hnohta a pahnosa ta, a pyhpahly ta, vâropi tlai cha thlu ta.
Izarei ta Zawsi hnohta, “Ahrohpa ta y chi ta, na hmia ei hmô hapa vâta, tahmâ cha thi awpa chhao ei mâ haw,” tah ta.
Zawsi ta a unawhzy nata a paw chhôhkhazy hnohta, “Khy aw na ta, Phiraoh chho aw na ta, a hnohta, ‘Kâna râh liata a ypa ei unawhzy nata ei paw chhôhkhazy kha kei lâ amâ zu haw.
Chapawzy cha mietaku vaituhpazy châ ei ta, sahrohzy vaih tyh ei ta, chavâta mietaku zawzy, viahchao hrizy nata ama hneipa zydua amâ vaw phao khai haw,’ tahpa ta reih aw na ta.
Phiraoh ta cha aw aw ei ta, ‘Khâpa rai nama hria tyh?’ a cha tah khiah ei ta cha,

nâmo ta, ‘Na seizy he eima hawtita tawhta tahmâ taihta, miah pathlatuhpazy hawhta, sahroh vaituhpazy eima châ’ nama tah aw. Chatanachata Kôse râh liata nama pahrâ thei aw, mietaku vaituhpazy cha Izi chyhsazy châta pasichhihpa châ tlôh ei ta,” tah ta.

Zawsi ta Phiraoh chho ta, a hnohta, “Ei paw nata ei unawhzy cha ama mietaku zawzy, ama viahchao hri zy nata ama hneipa zydua chhaota Kâna râh tawhta ama za tlô haw, tahmâ Kôse râh liata ama y,” tah ta.
A unawhzy hry tawhta papangawh a chhi ta, âmo cha Phiraoh hmiakô liata paduasa ta.
Phiraoh ta Zawsi unawhzy hnohta, “Khâpa rai nama hria tyh?” tah ta. Âmo ta Phiraoh hnohta, “Châ chakaotuhpazy he miah pathlatuhpazy hawhta mietaku vaituhpazy eima châ,” tah ei ta.

Phiraoh cha chho via ei ta, “Kâna râh liata chakâh mozohpa vâta, châ chakaotuhpazy mietaku zawzy châta sibie hrohpa y khao leipa ta, chavâta he râh liata y chy awpa ta eimâ zu. Ngiachhiepa ta châ chakaotuhpazy he Kôse râh liata miah paysa mah y,” tah ei ta.
Phiraoh ta Zawsi hnohta, “Na paw nata na unawhzy nâ lâ a zu ha ei ta,

Izi râh cha â hôh thlâh ha mâh tâh. Na paw nata na unawhzy cha râh pha chaipa liata pahrâsa mah y. Kôse râh liata pahrâ mawh ei sy. Ama hry liata a tao thei awpa chyhsa na pahno khiah ei ta cha, ei sahroh chô liata hyutuhpa ta na tao aw ei,” tah ta.
Zawsi ta a paw Zakaw cha a chhi ta, Phiraoh hmiakô liata paduasa ta, Zakaw ta Phiraoh cha byhnâ awpa ta.
Phiraoh ta Zakaw hnohta, “Kô khazie na châ haw?” tah ta.
Zakaw ta Phiraoh hnohta, “Ei khitlyna kôzy cha kô 130 a châ. Ei hro chhôh kôzy cha chyhta ta, riethei â chhih kaw. Nâ pathlatuhpazy khitlyna nohzy liata ama hro chhôh kôzy a kho vei,” tah ta.
Zakaw ta Phiraoh cha byhnâ awpa ta, Phiraoh hmiakô tawhta pua ha ta.
Zawsi ta a paw nata a unawhzy châta yna su paryh ta. Phiraoh biepiepa hawhta, Izi râh liata râh pha chaipa, Râmese râh chhôh liata, ama ryuto châta râh pie ta.
Zawsi ta a paw nata a unawhzy nata a paw chhôhkha zydua cha, ama chhôhkha maluh hawhta nie awpa a pie lymâ ei.
Chakâh mozohpa vâta râh to liata nie awpa y khao leipa ta. Chakâhna vâta Izi râh nata Kâna râhzy chhao cha panao ha ta.
Zawsi ta sâh chaleina mâ châta ama vaw cheipa, Izi râh nata Kâna râh liata tâkâ a ypa zydua pahmaoh ta. Zawsi ta tâkâ cha Phiraoh hnohta a pangia lymâ.
Izi râh nata Kâna râh liata tâkâ zydua a chhâ nahta, Izi chyhsa zydua cha Zawsi hnohta a vy ei ta, “Nie awpa miah pie teh. Khazia na mohmô ta eima thi aw? Eima tâkâ a chhâ haw,” tah ei ta.
Zawsi ta ama hnohta, “Nama sahrohzy vaw cheih teh u. Tâkâ a chhâ ha khiahta cha, nama sahroh mâ châta sâh ei cha pie aw ei,” tah ta.

Chatanachata ama sahrohzy cha Zawsi lâ a chhi ei ta, Zawsi ta ama arâzy, mietaku zawzy, viahchao hrizy nata alâzy mâ châta âmo cha sâh pie lymâ ta. Cha kô liata, ama sahroh zydua mâ châta âmo cha sâh pie ta.

Cha kô châhdi ta, kô a vaw thieh heihpa liata, Zawsi lâ a vy heih ei ta, a hnohta, “Eima tâkâ zydua eima hmâh khai hanazie ei zibeipa phih aw ma pi. Sahroh zawzy chhao ei zibeipa eih a châ khai haw. Eima pôhpa nata eima râh dei leipa ta cha, ei zibeipa mohmô liata khâpa hmah y khao vei.

Khazia na mohmô liata keimo nata eima râh he eima thi aw? Keimo nata eima râh he sâh ta miah chalei teh. Keimo nata eima râh he Phiraoh chakaotuhpa ta eima y aw. Thi leipa ta eima hroh thei nawpa nata râh he roryhrapa ta a y lei nawpa ta, sâh chi miah pie mah y,” tah ei ta.
Chatanachata Zawsi ta Izi râh zydua Phiraoh châta chalei ta. Chakâh mozoh a tlô thlupa vâ ei ta, Izi chyhsa zydua ta ama lyuzy zuah lymâ ei ta, râh cha Phiraoh eih a vaw châ khai haw.
Râhsawzy cha Izi râhri hiakha lâ chhâna nata hiakha lâ chhâna tawhta khihpizy lâta Zawsi ta a pasie lymâ ei.
Theihthaipazy râh deita chalei leipa a châ. A chhâpa cha, theihthaipazy cha Phiraoh tawhta lymâ a daopa châ ei ta, Phiraoh ta lymâ a piepa ei cha ama niepa vâta, ama râh zuah byuh vei.
Zawsi ta zawpi hnohta, “Pachâ teh u, tanoh he nâmo nata nama râh Phiraoh châta cha chalei khai ha ei na ta. He liata nama châta sâh chi a y, alei liata cheih teh u.

Sâh hria daihti liata, Phiraoh châta su pangawh su kha lymâ pie aw ei chi ta, su palih nâmo eih a châ aw. Cha cha lyu liata cheih heih awpa châta zy, nâmo nata nama chhôhkhazy nie awpa châta zy, nama hawtizy nie awpa châta zy a châ aw,” tah ta.
Âmo ta, “Eima hrona miah pachha ha chi ta, ei zibeipa ngiachhiena miah patosa la, Phiraoh chakaotuhpazy eima châ aw,” tah ei ta.
Phiraoh ta su pangawh liata su kha a hmô lymâ awpa kyh cha, Zawsi ta Izi râh ryhpa châta tao ta, cha cha tanoh taihta hmâpa châ ta, theihthaipazy râh deita Phiraoh râh lâta a lie leipa a châ.
Izarei cha Izi râh Kôse liata pahrâ ta. Cha liata ryuzy pachô ei ta, chi hluhpi pathlapa ta thata pôh ei ta.
Zakaw cha Izi râh liata kô hrawh hlei sari y ta. Zakaw noh nata daihtizy, a hro chhôh kôzy cha, kô 147 a châ.

Izarei cha a thi nawpa daihti â hnia nahta, a sawchapawpa Zawsi aw ta, a hnohta, “Na modypa ei châ khiahta cha, ngiachhiepa ta na ku kha ei byhpi ry liata vaw chahraoh la, ei chô liata nôphapa nata âdopa ta tao awpa ta bie nâ taih mah y. Izi râh liana he rie na pabu cheita khah y.
Nâ pathlatuhpazy hnohta ei mô tita, Izi râh tawhna heta na phaoh la, nâ pathlatuhpazy pabuna su liata na pabu mah y,” tah ta. Zawsi ta, “Na reipa hawhta ei tao aw,” tah ta.
Izarei ta, “Bie nâ taih teh,” tah ta, Zawsi ta bie a taih ta. Cha khai tawhta Izarei cha a rakhô luh chô liata a bôh ta.
Cha hnôhlâ ta Zawsi cha, “Na paw tlâh vei,” tahpa chho ei ta. A sawchapawpa pano, Manase nata Epharai a hnohta a chhi ta.
Zakaw hnohta, “Na sawchapawpa Zawsi nâ lâ â vy,” tahpa ta chho ei ta. Izarei cha a pasaipa ta rakhô liata a kaw tyuh ta.
Zakaw ta Zawsi hnohta, “Kâna râh Luzi khih liata ei y nota, Khazohpa Atotaotheipa ta ei hnohta a vaw luah ta, byhnâ na awpa ta,
ei hnohta, ‘Pachâ teh, chi hluhpi cha pathlasa aw na ta, ei cha papôh aw. Phopi hluhpi ta cha tao aw na ta, na hnôhlâ ta na pathla hnohta, he râh he chhâzaw ryuto châta ei pie aw,’ na tah ta.
Na yna Izi râh lâ ei zu hlâta, Izi râh liata na sapa na sawchapaw panozy cha keima eih ama châ. Rubena nata Simeôna hawh tlai ta, Epharai nata Manase cha keima eih ama châ aw.
Âmo hnôhlâ ta saw na hneipazy deikua cha, nâma eih châ aw ei ta, ama unawhzy moh ta ryuto râh piepa ama châ aw.

Keima kyh liata cha, Pâdâ tawhta ei vaw sie no kha, Râkheli cha lâpi liata Kâna râh liata na thisai ha ta. Epharâ khih tlô nawpa a hla kaw chy ta, chavâta Râkheli cha Epharâ lâpi liata ei pabu. Epharâ cha Bethlehe a châ,” tah ta.
Izarei ta Zawsi sawchapawzy cha moh ta, “Hezy he ahyzy ma ama châ?” tah ta.
Zawsi ta a paw hnohta, “Hezy he Khazohpa ta he liata eina piepa ei sawchapawzy ama châ,” tah ta. Zakaw ta, “Ngiachhiepa ta âmo kha kei lâ a vykhei teh, byhnâ ei awpa aw ei,” tah ta.
Izarei cha a pawpi hapa vâta a mo zoh ha ta, chavâta hmô thei khao vei. Zawsi ta a sawchapawzy cha vaw pahnia ta, Izarei ta âmo cha a pahnâpa ta, a pyh ta.
Izarei ta Zawsi hnohta, “Na hmia hmô awpa hnabeiseih khao leipa na ta, châhrasala Khazohpa ta na pathlazy hmia taih chhao eina pahmôsa ha hih,” tah ta.
Zawsi ta a sawchapawzy cha a paw pakhu likawh tawhta pasie ta, alei lâ a bôh ta, a paw cha a naoh ta.
Zawsi ta a sawchapawzy cha ama pano ta chaao ta, Epharai cha a ku chachâh lâta chaaopa ta Izarei ku chavei lâ paduasa ta, Manase cha a ku chavei lâta chaaopa ta Izarei ku chachâh lâ a paduasa.

Châhrasala Izarei ta a bâh vâhchapia raruah ta, Manase cha sawchapaw uhtheipa a châ tarawpa ta, a chachâh lâ ku pazawh ta a seihnai viapa Epharai luh chahnao ta, a chavei lâ ku ta Manase luh chahnao ta.
Zawsi cha byhnâ awpa ta, “Nâ pathlatuhpa Abarahâ nata Aisika zy ta A hmiakô liata ama y tyhpa Khazohpa, Ei hroh chhôh zydua ta na vaih ta, Tanoh taihta nâ vaituhpa Khazohpa,

Hmo pha leipa zydua tawhta nâ chatlaituhpa Vâlyuhchâpa ta, Hawtizy he byhnâ pie sala, Âmo liata ei moh phaoh lymâpa châ mawh sy. Nâ pathlatuhpa Abarahâ nata Aisika zy moh chhao, Phaoh lymâpa châ sala; Alei chô liata thata vaw pôh mawh ei sy,” tah ta.
Zawsi cha a paw ta a chachâh lâ ku ta Epharai luh a chahnaopa a hmô nahta, a palôh châ khao leipa ta, a paw ku cha Epharai luh tawhta Manase luh lâta pasie awpa ta chalo ta.
Zawsi ta a paw hnohta, “Ei pâ, kha hawhta châ vei, Manase he sawchapaw uhtheipa a châ, chavâta na ku chachâh lâ kha ano luh liata pahnieh mah y,” tah ta.

Châhrasala a paw ta khoh leipa ta, “Ei pahno na, ei sawchapawpa y, ei pahno na. Manase chhao phopi miakha vaw châ hra aw ta, a vaw rônah hra aw. Châhrasala a nawhta he ano hlâta rônah via aw ta, a chipathla cha phopi hluhpi a vaw châ aw,” tah ta.

Cha noh ta Zakaw ta Epharai nata Manase cha byhnâ awpa ta, “‘Epharai nata Manase hawhta, Khazohpa ta cha tao mawh sy,’ tahpa ta, Nama moh reipa ta, Izarei sawzy ta byhnâ ama aw tyh aw,” tah ta. Chatanachata Epharai cha Manase hmia lâta a paysa haw.
Chatawhcha Izarei ta Zawsi hnohta, “Pachâ teh, kei cha thi daihmâ ha na ta, châhrasala Khazohpa nama hnohta y aw ta, châ pathlatuhpazy râh lâ a châ chhi heih aw ei.
Cha dei châ vei, nâ cha na unawhzy tovyuh hlâta tovyuh miakha ta hluh viapa ta cha pie na ta, ei zaozi nata ei libaw ta Amawri mo ku tawhta ei lapa râh cha nâ ei cha pie,” tah ta.
Zakaw ta a sawchapawzy aw ta, “Na vaw chadô teh u, noh hnôhlâ ta nama chô liata hmo a vaw tlô awpazy ei cha chho aw ei,” tah ta, hetana heta a chho ei:
“Nâmo, Zakaw sawchapawzy saih u, A hmaohpa ta nathlie u la, Nama paw Izarei bie nathlie teh u.
“Rubena, nâ cha ei sawchapaw uhtheipa châ chi ta, Ei hmotaotheina na châ; Ei thatlôna thei hmiatuapa châ chi ta, Zachhih chaipa nata biehnei chaipa na châ.
Châhrasala ti hawhta a i leipa na châ; Na paw rakhô kiah chi ta, Na papuapaleipa vâta, Chônôchaina to khao aw va chi. Ei rakhô a kiapa kha!
“Simeôna nata Livai cha unawh châ ei ta, Ama zaozizy cha thachahra hmâna chaihraizy a châ.
Ama ryureina liata ei thlahpa a hlao leipa aw ta, Ama pakhypi liata ei rônahna a hlao aw vei. Hiehâhpa ta chyhsa thie ei ta, Khotlâ ta viahchao tôhpazy ama chhawh.
Ama pathichhiena cha chhiesapa ta y mawh sy, A tah tu pâ haw; Ama hiehâhna chhao chhiesapa ta y mawh sy, A ru tu pâ haw. Zakaw liata pachhaihpazaoh aw ei na ta, Izarei liata ei hiepatla aw ei.
“Zudâh, nâ cha na unawhzy ta cha reithai aw ei ta, Na ku ta na chariahzy rao patu aw ta, Na paw sawchapawzy na hmiakô liata amâ bôh aw.

Zudâh cha chakeibarôhneipa taw châ ta, Hy ei sawchapawpa, Sa taipa tawhta a laiseihpa na châ. Zudâh cha a bôh ta, Chakeibarôhneipa hawhta a byu ta, Chakeibarôhneipa panô hawhta â byu tyh; Ahy a pathyu ngâh aw?
Ryureina chôchahrei ta Zudâh puasai leipa aw ta, Ryureituhpa chôchahrei a pheizy likawh tawhta pua aw vei. Reithaina a hnohta vaw tlô aw ta, Phopizy ta a bie ama zyh aw.
A alâ taw kre zôh liata hraih aw ta, Kre zôh phapa liata a alâ taw a hraih aw. A chysiazy kresawhti liata pasu aw ta, A pohzy kre thisaih liata a ny aw.
A mokhaohzy kresawhti hlâta dô via aw ta, A hâhzy sâhpiti hlâta a dieh via aw.
“Zebulawna cha tilaipi kiah liata pahrâ aw ta, Balyh pahâna raphyu châ aw ta, Sidaw taihta a râhri a tlô aw.
“Iskâra cha alâ tôhpa chahrapa châ ta, Mietaku zaw hry liata â byu.
Apahâna su a phapa ta pahno ta, Râh chhao khochhihpa a châzie a hmô. Hmo phao awpa ta a ngiatlâh za pahnai ta, Rai pahriasa raruahna liata sei ta a y.
“Dânâ Izarei phopi miakha ta a duah aw ta, A phopi chô liata ryureituhpa a châ aw.
Dânâ cha lâpi liata parih châ aw ta, Lâthlôh liata vâzi a châ aw; Arâ ngavâhmaothy liata pachu aw ta, Arâ a kiahpa â die lâta a patlasatuhpa a châ aw.
“Hy Abeipa, na pachhana ei hâ thlâh haw!
“Kâdâ cha chariahpazy ta siehnao aw ei ta, Châhrasala ama ngavâhmaothy liata a tu aw ei.
“Asera cha a niedo pha aw ta, Abei pati pahâhpazy a papua aw.
“Nâthalai cha sasu pazopa châ ta, Taw pha a pataw lymâ aw.
“Zawsi cha kre zôh pathei khoh ngaitapa châ ta, Tihnawh kiah liata a pathei khoh ngaitapa a châ; Thokhy khô lâ taihta a chiahzy â zawh.
Libaw kathaipazy ta thata a dyuh ei ta, Ano cha ka ei ta thata amâ hao.
Châhrasala Zakaw Khazohpa Thatlôpa ku ta, Vaituhpa Izarei Lôpanô baona ta, A libaw pachyu ta, A bâh thapatlôpa ta a y.
Châ bao awpa na paw Khazohpa vâta, Byhnâ châ pie awpa Atotaotheipa vâta, Chô lâ vâ byhnâzy to aw chi ta, A ry lâta ti athupa byhnâzy topa ta, Sâhpi nata chhi byhnâzy na to aw.
Na paw byhnâzy cha nâ pathlatuhpazy byhnâ khô ta, Chhâzaw tlâhthlôhzy chhâna taihta a tlô. Chazy cha Zawsi luh liata y aw ta, A unawhzy tawhta pananopa khi liata a y aw.
“Benzami cha changie zohpa châ ta, My ta sa taipa nie aw ta, Zâlâ ta hraopa sôh a rai aw,” tah ta.
Cha zydua cha Izarei pho hrawh hleinozy châ ei ta, chazy cha byhnâ a awpa no ei ta ama paw biereipazy a châ. Byhnâ ama to awpa lymâ hawhta byhnâ a awpa ei.
Zakaw ta âmo cha ryu a hi ta, ama hnohta, “Ei chiheihzy hnohta pahlyhpa ta ei y daihmâ haw. Hiti chyhsa Epharaw lyu liata a ypa lôpu liata na pabu muh vy.
Abarahâ ta thlâ su châta hnei awpa ta, Hiti chyhsa Epharaw lôpu a lyu chhaota a chaleipa, Kâna râh Mamre kiapâh ta a ypa Mâkâpelâ lyu liata lôpu tlai liana kha na pabu muh vy.
Cha liata Abarahâ nata a lapinô Sârâ pabu ei ta, cha liata Aisika nata a lapinô Rebekâ pabu ei ta, cha liata Liah ei pabu.
Cha liata lyu nata lôpu zy cha Hiti mo tawhta chaleipa a châ,” tah ta.
Zakaw cha a sawchapawzy ryu â hi khai nahta, rakhô lâ a phei khaih ta, a thlahpa pathlie ta, a chiheihzy hnohta pahlyhpa ta y ha ta.
Zawsi cha a paw hmia a khu thlu ta, cha ta, a pahnâ ta.
Zawsi ta a chakaotuhpa dawhtyzy hnohta a paw ri cha thu thei leipa ta tao awpa ta biepie ta. Dawhtyzy ta Izarei ri cha thu thei leipa ta tao ei ta.
Noh sypalih chhôh tao ei ta, thu thei leipa ta tao awpa ta, noh cha zie cha ama hryuh tyhpa rai a châ. Izi mo ta Zakaw châta noh sysari mâchhiesa ei ta.
Ama mâchhiesana nohzy a chhâ tawhta, Zawsi ta Phiraoh chhôhkha hnohta, “Nama modypa ei châ khiahta cha, ngiachhiepa ta Phiraoh nakhaoh theina liata, hetana heta na chhopa muh vy.

Ei paw ta ei hnohta, ‘Pachâ teh, thi daihmâ ha na ta, Kâna râh liata thlâ ei chao chiehpa liata, cha lia tlai ta na pabu mah y,’ tahpa ta bie na pataihsa ha ta. Chavâta ngiachhiepa ta khy aw sah la, ei paw cha kaw pabu aw na ta, ei zâ lie heih aw,” tah ta.
Phiraoh ta Zawsi hnohta, “Bie a cha pataihsa hapa hawhna chata khy la, na paw cha kaw pabu mah y,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Zawsi cha a paw pabu awpa ta khy ta, Phiraoh chakaotuhpa zydua, a o liata machâzy nata Izi râh machâ zydua chhao a hnohta khy ei ta,
Zawsi chhôhkha zydua, a unawhzy nata a paw chhôhkhazy chhao a hnohta khy khai ei ta. Ama hawtizy, ama mietaku zawzy nata ama viahchao hrizy deita Kôse râh liata ama siesai.
Talailihzy nata arâ a kiahpazy chhao a hnohta khy ei ta, py lai ngaitapa ama châ.
Zawdâh haosâ liata Atadâ sawhri tlô ei ta, cha liata chaphôtuna vâsâh chhih ngaitapa ta thata chakhei ei ta, cha liata a paw mâchhiesana châta noh sari hmâh ta.

Cha râh liata a pahrâpa Kâna mo ta Atadâ sawhri liata mâchhiesapa cha ama hmô nahta, “He he Izi mo mâchhiesana ru ngaitapa a châ hih,” tah ei ta. Chavâta cha su cha a moh Abelamizarai ama bi. Cha su cha Zawdâh haosâ liata a ypa a châ.
A sawchapawzy ta a bie ryuhipa hawhta taopa ei ta.
Kâna râh lâ phaoh ei ta, Abarahâ ta thlâ su châta hnei awpa ta, Hiti chyhsa Epharaw liata a lyu chhaota a chaleipa, Kâna râh Mamre kiapâh ta a ypa Mâkâpelâ lyu lôpu liata pabu ei ta.
A paw a pabu khai tawhta, Zawsi cha a unawhzy nata a paw pabu awpa ta a hnohta a khypa zydua chhaota Izi râh lâ a zâ lie ta.
Ama paw a thi hapa ama hmô nahta, Zawsi unawhzy ta, “Zawsi ta miah a hao aw ta, a chô liata hmo pha leipa eima taopa zydua kha viari miah a thô bâ aw,” tah ei ta.
Zawsi lâ chyhsa tuah ei ta, a hnohta, “Na paw ta a thi chy ta,

‘Na unawhzy paraona nata ama moleina zy a ngiahthai mah y, na chô liata hmo ama parao haw, tahpa ta Zawsi nama chho aw,’ miah tah ta. Chavâta tahmâ na paw Zakaw Khazohpa chakaotuhpazy paraona cha rie a ngiahthai mah y,” tah ei ta. Cha hawhta a hnohta bie ama reipa a thei nahta, Zawsi cha cha ta.
A unawhzy cha vawh ei ta, a hmiakô liata a bôh ei ta, “Moh teh, châ chakaotuhpazy eima châ,” tah ei ta.
Zawsi ta ama hnohta, “Chi khah u, kei he Khazohpa duahmo liata â duahpa ma ei châ?

Nâmo ta la ei chô liata hmo pha leipa tao a chhuah ei chi ta, châhrasala Khazohpa ta kha hmo kha hmo phapa châta tlao â chhuahpa a châ. Tanoh ta hmo a ypa hawhna heta, chyhsa hrona hluhpi pachhapa a châ thei nawpa ta, Khazoh hmochhuahpa a châ.
Chavâta chi khuh vy. Nâmo nata nama hawtizy ei cha mohôh lymâ aw ei,” tah ta. A unawhzy cha ama thlah palôhpa ta, reikah phapa ta âmo cha bie a chho ta.
Zawsi cha a paw chhôhkha chhaota Izi râh liata pahrâ lymâ ta. Zawsi cha kô 110 hroh ta.
Zawsi cha Epharai sawzy chhâ thôhna taihta hmô ta, Manase sawchapawpa Mâkhi sawzy chhao Zawsi byh chô liata a pihpa ama châ.

Zawsi ta a unawhzy hnohta, “Kei cha thi daihmâ ha na ta, châhrasala Khazohpa ta cha vaw tly aw ei ta. Khazohpa ta he râh tawhta châ chhi papua aw ei ta, Abarahâ, Aisika nata Zakaw zy hnohta bie â taihpa râh lâ a châ chhi aw ei,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Zawsi ta Izarei sawzy bie pataihsa ta, ama hnohta, “Khazohpa ta cha vaw tly tlai aw ei ta, he su tawhna heta ei ruzy phaoh ha muh vy,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Zawsi cha, kô 110 uhtheipa ta thi ta, thu thei leipa ta tao ei ta, Izi râh liata ri byh liata ama paso haw.
Hezy he Zakaw hnohta Izi râh lâ ama chhôhkha chhaota a siepa Izarei sawchapawzy moh a châ.
Chazy cha Rubena, Simeôna, Livai nata Zudâh;
Iskâra, Zebulawna nata Benzami;
Dânâ nata Nâthalai, Kâdâ nata Asera zy ama châ.
Zakaw pathla zydua cha manôh sysari châ ei ta, Zawsi deikua cha Izi râh liata a vaw y chhielie haw.
Zawsi nata a unawh zydua nata cha chhâ sahlao zydua cha thi ha ei ta.
Izarei sawzy cha chi hluhpi pathlapa ta, thata pôh ei ta. Pôh via rili ei ta, ama thatlô ngaita ta, Izi râh cha âmo sai ta bie thlâh ha ei ta.
Zawsi a pahno leipa, bei thiehpa Izi râh liata vaw pua ta.
A phopi hnohta, “Pachâ teh u, Izarei sawzy he keimo hlâta hluh viapa ta, ama tha chhao a tlô via ha bâ hih.

A vy teh u, so kawpa ta ama chô liata hmo tao ei suh u. Chataleipatala vaw pôh via lymâ aw ei ta, adyuhna vaw y mawh sala, eima chariahpazy a baipa ta, miah a dyuh aw ei ta, Izi râh tawhta ama pua pathlei aw na,” tah ta.
Chavâta ama phao thata pahri ta, ama rie pathei awpa ta, raihria hyutuhpazy âmo châta rao ei ta. Pithô nata Râmese khihpizy cha Phiraoh châta Sawvâ khihpi ta padua ei ta.
Châhrasala ama rie ama pathei via nahta, pôh via rilipa ta su to liata a hiepatla via rili ei ta. Chavâta Izi mo ta Izarei sawzy cha chihuh pathao ha ei ta.
Chatanachata Izi mo ta Izarei sawzy cha riethei ngaitapa ta rai ama pahriasa lymâ.
Raihria ru ngaitapa, alô khaipa nata alei raopa raizy nata lyu liata rai to pahriasapa ta ama hro rie thata pathei ei ta, ama raihria zydua liata riethei ngaitapa ta ama pahriasa lymâ.
Izi bei ta Hebrai nawhpaytuhpazy biepie ta, pakha moh cha Sipharâ châ ta, ahropa moh cha Puah a châ.
Izi bei ta ama hnohta, “Hebrai chanôzy nawh nama pay tita, nawh yna rakhô liata moh u la, sawchapaw a châ khiahta cha, thie aw ei chi ta, sawchanô a châ khiah deikua cha, pahlôh awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Châhrasala nawhpaytuhpazy cha Khazohpa a chipa ama châpa vâta, Izi bei biepiepa hawhta tao leipa ei ta, sawchapawzy chhao ama pahlôh lymâ.
Izi bei ta nawhpaytuhpazy cha aw ta, ama hnohta, “Khazia cha hawhpa hmozy cha tao ei chi ta, sawchapawzy nama pahlôh lymâ?” tah ta.
Nawhpaytuhpazy ta Phiraoh hnohta, “Hebrai chanôzy cha Izi chanôzy hawhta châ veih ei. Âmo cha ama nawh y naota ta, nawhpaytuhpazy ama tlô hlâta nawh amâ vaw chhaih hmâ ha tyh,” tah ei ta.
Chavâta Khazohpa ta nawhpaytuhpazy cha phana ta mohôh ta. Izarei phopi cha pôh via lymâ ei ta ama thatlô via rili ta.
Nawhpaytuhpazy chhao Khazohpa a chipa ama châpa vâta, Khazohpa ta chhôhkhazy a paduapa hra ei.
Chatawcha Phiraoh ta a phopi zydua hnohta, “Hebrai sawchapaw a pihpa maih Nile chavah liata thy lymâ aw ei chi ta, sawchanô deikua nama pahlôh aw,” tahpa ta biepie ta.
Livai chi hry liata chapaw pakha ta Livai chanô a lapinô ta hnei ta.
Chanô cha saw phaoh ta, sawchapaw sa ta, hawsaih khochhih kawpa a châpa a nô ta hmô ta, thla thôh nyu ta.

Châhrasala nyu ngâ thlâh ha thei khao leipa ta. A nô ta maitanô balyh tao ta, beihlei nata tho chathli ta byh cha pachawh khâh ta, a chhôh liata hawti cha pazia ta, chavah kiah liata râbuhzy hry liata soh ta.
A chô liata khâpa hmo ma a tlô aw tahpa pahno awpa ta, a sietanô cha a duah ta lâpaw tawhta sai ta.

Cha nota, Phiraoh sawchanô cha a ngai a si awpa ta chavah lâ zu ta, a chakaotuhpa laihsazy cha chavah ngiahkâ chheipâh liata a hlaihlâ ei ta. Phiraoh sawchanô ta râbuhzy hry liata maitanô balyh cha hmô ta, a chakaotuhpa laihsa pakha tuah ta kei palasa ta.
Maitanô balyh cha pahy ta, hawti a cha ngâ kawpa hmô ta. A ngiachhie ngaita ta, “He hawti he Hebrai saw a châ hih,” tah ta.
Hawsaih sietanô ta Phiraoh sawchanô hnohta, “Hawsaih châ hâpa awpa Hebrai chanô nawh hâtuhpa cha awpa aw sah y?” tah ta.
Phiraoh sawchanô ta a hnohta, “Kei aw teh,” tah ta. Laihsa cha vawh ta, hawsaih nô kei aw ta.
Phiraoh sawchanô ta a hnohta, “Hawsaih he a chhi la, na kei mohôhpa mah y. Na hlao awpazy ei cha pie aw,” tah ta. Chanô chata hawsaih cha la ta, sâhpi pazysa ta.
Hawtipa cha a kaw lai nahta, Phiraoh sawchanô lâ kei pie ta, a sawchapaw ta â la haw. Phiraoh sawchanô ta, “Ti tawhta ei thaopa a châpa vâta,” tah ta, a moh Mawsi a bi.
Mawsi cha vaw pitloh ta, noh kha cha, a unawhzy yna lâ vawh ta, ama raihria phaohrizie zy kei hmô ta. Izi chyhsa pakha ta a unawhpa Hebrai chyhsa pakha a tu ngâpa hmô ta.
Mohmia pasaih ta, ahy hmah y veih ei tahpa a pahno nahta, Izi chyhsa cha tusao ta, sadi liata nyu ta.
A mylâ ta kei pua heih ta, Hebrai chyhsa pano amâ tu ngâpa hmô ta. A do lei viapa hnohta, “Khazia na chiheihpa na tu thlâh haw?” tah ta.

Ano ta, “Eima chô liata ryureituhpa nata hyutuhpa ta ahy ma châ tao? Izi chyhsa na thiepa hawhna khata ma thie einâ chhuah chi?” tah ta. Mawsi cha a palôh liata, “Kha hmo kha chyhsa ta ama pahno ha tlai cha zaw,” tahpa ta pachâ ta, chi ngaita ta.
Phiraoh ta cha thâtih cha a pahno nahta, Mawsi cha thie a chhuah ta. Châhrasala Mawsi cha Phiraoh hmiakô tawhta a râ ta, Midia râh liata kei y ta. Noh kha cha tikhaoh kiapâh liata a tyuh ta.
Midia râh theihthaipa cha sawchanô pasari hnei ta, ti vaw thaih ei ta, ama paw mietaku zaw padosa awpa ta ti châkizy pabie ei ta.
Mietaku vaituhpazy a vy ei ta, ama mietakuzy cha topa ha ei ta. Mawsi vaw thyu ta, laihsazy cha pachha ta, ama mietaku zaw cha ti padosa ta.
Ama paw Rue lâ amâ vaw di nahta, ama paw ta, “Kheihtazieta tanoh cha nama vaw tlô patoh kaw dia?” tah ta.
Âmo ta, “Izi chyhsa pakha ta mietaku vaituhpazy ku tawhta miah a pachha. Cha dei châ vei, ti miah thaipa ta, mietaku zaw ti a padosa,” tah ei ta.
Ama paw ta a sawchanôzy hnohta, “Ano cha khataih liata a y? Khazia namâ vysai thlâh haw? Kei aw u la, pati vaw nie mawh sy,” tah ta.
Cha chyhsa hnohta y awpa cha Mawsi ta paryhsa ta. Rue ta a sawchanô Zipôrâ cha Mawsi pie ta.
Zipôrâ cha sawchapaw sa ta, Mawsi ta, “Râh hropa liata mapaihpa ta ei y” tah ta, a moh Kesao a bi.
Daihti vâropi a châ tawhta, Izi bei cha thi ha ta. Izarei sawzy cha ama seichâna vâta a hrô ei ta, baotuhpa aw ei ta. Ama seichâna tawhta pachha awpa ta ama awna ao cha Khazohpa kô kaw tlô ta.
Khazohpa ta amâ hrôpa pyu cha thei ta, Abarahâ, Aisika nata Zakaw zy hnohta a biehrai kha Khazohpa ta a thei thlâh ha ta.
Khazohpa ta Izarei sawzy cha moh ta, âmo cha pachâ kaw ta.
Mawsi cha a puhpa Zetharô, Midia râh theihthaipa mietaku zaw vaih ta, mietaku zaw cha râhchawhpa notla lâ chhâ ta haoh laih ta, Khazohpa tlâh Hôribâ kei tlô ta.
Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa ta meipaleih ta a hnohta a vaw luah ta, meipaleih cha thobuh hry tawhta kaw pua ta, kei moh ta, thobuh liata meipaleih ia ta, a thobuh deikua cha kâ leipa ta.
Mawsi ta, “Kei tleihnao aw na ta, hao hmo noâhchhihpa hao ei kei moh tua rai aw, kheihtazieta ma thobuh hao a kâ vei tly,” tah ta.
Mo awpa ta a kei tleipa cha Abeipa ta a hmô nahta, Khazohpa ta thobuh hry tawhta vaw aw ta, “Mawsi, Mawsi!” tah ta. Mawsi ta, “He liata ei y,” tah ta.
Khazohpa ta, “A vaw hnia kha, na pheikyzy kha pahluh teh, nâ duana alei kha su pathaihpa a châ,” tah ta.
Khazohpa ta, “Kei he, châ pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa ei châ, Abarahâ Khazohpa, Aisika Khazohpa nata Zakaw Khazohpa ei châ,” tah ta. Khazohpa cha a moh ngâh leipa vâta, Mawsi cha a hmia nyu ta.
Abeipa ta, “Izi râh liata ei phopi a ypazy riethei taozie hmô na ta, ama raihria hyutuhpazy vâta ama awhna ao chhao thei na ta, ama pachârôhnazy ei pahno.

Chavâta Izi mo ku tawhta âmo cha pachhapa ta, cha râh tawhta puakhei ta, râh phapa nata kawhpa, sâhpiti nata kheihti lona râh, Kâna mo, Hiti mo, Amawri mo, Perizi mo, Hivi mo nata Zebu mozy yna su lâ a chhi awpa ei ta ei zu haw.
Pachâ teh, Izarei sawzy awhpa ao ta ei kô na kaw daih ha ta, cha dei châ leipa ta, Izi mo ta âmo ama tlybaina chhao ei hmô haw.
Chavâta tahmâ a vy teh, ei phopi Izarei sawzy Izi tawhta a chhi papua awpa ta Phiraoh lâ ei cha tuah aw,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta Khazohpa hnohta, “Phiraoh lâ zu ta, Izarei sawzy Izi râh tawhta a chhi papua awpa ta, kei he ahy ma ei châ tly?” tah ta.

Khazohpa ta, “Na hnohta ei y aw. Keima tuapa tlai na châ tahpa, he he nâma châta ngiana a châ aw: Izi râh tawhta phopi na kaw puakhei ti ei ta, he tlâh liana tlai heta Khazohpa nama chakao aw,” tah ta.

Châhrasala Mawsi ta Khazohpa hnohta, “Izarei sawzy lâ cha zu aw sah la, ama hnohta, ‘Châ pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa ta nâmo lâ eina vaw tuah,’ tah aw sah la, âmo ta ei hnohta, ‘A moh ahy maw?’ vaw tah ei sala, kheihta ei chhy aw ei?” tah ta.
Khazohpa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Kei he Zehôvâh ei châ. Izarei sawzy hnohta, ‘Zehôvâh ta nâmo lâ eina vaw tuah,’ na tah aw,” tah ta.

Khazohpa ta Mawsi hnohta reih via heih ta, “Izarei sawzy chho la ama hnohta, ‘Zehôvâh, châ pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa, Abarahâ Khazohpa, Aisika Khazohpa nata Zakaw Khazohpa ta nâmo lâ eina vaw tuah,’ na tah aw. He he ei tlyzaw moh châ ta, chhâ zydua ta einâ thei thlâh nawpa moh a châ.

Sie la, Izarei machâzy awpakhy la, ama hnohta, ‘Zehôvâh, châ pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa, Abarahâ Khazohpa, Aisika Khazohpa nata Zakaw Khazohpa ei hnohta a vaw luah ta, hetana heta a tah: Cha vaw tly ei na ta, Izi râh liata nama chô liata ama hmotaopazy ei hmô haw.

Chavâta Izi râh pasataona tawhta châ chhi papuapa ta, Kâna mo, Hiti mo, Amawri mo, Perizi mo, Hivi mo nata Zebu mozy râh, sâhpiti nata kheihti lona râh lâ châ chhi awpa ei ta, bie ei châ taih ei,’ tahpa ta.

Chatanachata na bie ama nathlie aw. Nâ nata Izarei machâzy Izi bei lâ vawh aw ei chi ta, a hnohta, ‘Zehôvâh, Hebraizy Khazohpa ta miah vaw tly ta, chavâta noh thôh lâsie râhchawhpa liata Zehôvâh eima Khazohpa lâta atheihna eima hlâ thei nawpa ta, ngiachhiepa ta miah pasiesa mah y,’ nama tah aw.
Châhrasala ku thatlôpa ta a pataosa leipa ta cha, Izi bei ta cha pasiesa aw veih ei tahpa ei pahno.
Chavâta ei ku pazawh aw na ta, Izi râh cha a chhôh liata hmonoâhpa ei tao awpa zydua ta hrie aw na ta, cha khai tawhta a cha pasiesa aw ei.
Izarei phopi he Izi mo hmiakô liata ngiachhiena pahlaosa aw ei na ta, nama sie tita aruapa ta sie aw veih ei chi.

Chanô maihta ama opazy nata ama o liata a pahrâpa zydua tawhta tâkâ nata ngôh a tobinazy nata chysiazy hiah aw ei ta, nama sawchapawzy nata nama sawchanôzy pakysa aw ei chi ta, cha hawhna chata Izi mo cha nama hrao aw,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta a chhy ta, “Na zo aw veih ei, ei ao na nathlie hra aw veih ei, ‘ Abeipa na hnohta a luah vei,’ ama tah thlâh ha aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta a hnohta, “Na ku liata a ypa kha khâpa a châ?” tah ta. Ano ta, “Chôchahrei,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta, “Alei liata thy teh,” tah ta. Alei liata thy ta, parih lâta a vaw lie ta, Mawsi ta parih cha a râsai ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Na ku ta kei paza la, a chaolahmei liata patu teh,” tah ta. A ku ta kei paza ta, patu ta, a ku liana chata chôchahrei lâta a vaw lie ha ta.
Abeipa ta, “Kha hmo kha Abeipa, âmo pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa, Abarahâ Khazohpa, Aisika Khazohpa nata Zakaw Khazohpa cha, na hnohta â vaw luah tlai tahpa ama zo thei nawpa châta a châ,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta a hnohta, “Na ku ta na chachôhna hria teh,” tah heih ta. A ku ta a chachôhna cha hria ta, a ku a la nahta, a ku cha dâhaw hawhta ngyuhpa ta vaw phawh ha ta.
Abeipa ta, “Na ku ta na chachôhna kha hria heih teh,” tah ta. A chachôhna cha hria heih ta, a ku cha a chachôhna tawhta a la nahta, a sapa hropazy hawhta vaw y pathi ha ta.
Abeipa ta, “Cha zo leipa ei sala, ngiana hmiatuapa kha amâ py khoh vei khiahta cha, ngiana hnôhlâtapa chhâ he cha ama zo aw.

Ngiana mianopazy he zo leipa ei sala, na bie ama nathlie vei khiahta cha, Nile chavah ti za la aw chi ta, alei hipa liata bao aw chi ta, chavah tawhta ti na za lapa cha alei hipa liata thisaih lâta â vaw lie aw,” tah ta.

Châhrasala Mawsi ta Abeipa hnohta, “Hy ei Beipa, kei la pakah paleih thaipa châ leipa na ta, khahlâ tawhta nata châ chakaotuhpa hnohta bie na reih tawhna chhao heta, kahchôleiâpa nata reikah sôpa châ tlôh na ta,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta a hnohta, “Ahy ma chyhsapa pakah he a tao? Reih pathlie thei leipazy, nahpâpazy, mopavâpazy nata mochaopazy chhao he, ahy taopa ma a châ? Kei Abeipa ta ei taopa châ vei ma?
Chavâta tahmâ sie teh, na pakah liata y aw na ta, na rei awpa ei cha pachu lymâ aw,” tah ta.
Châhrasala Mawsi ta, “Hy ei Beipa, ngiachhiepa ta chyhsa hropa tuah thlâh ha mah y,” tah ta.

Abeipa cha Mawsi chô liata a pathi ia ta, a hnohta, “Na unawhpa Arawna, Livai chi y vei mâ? Ano cha bierei a thai kaw tahpa ei pahno. Moh teh, cha vaw dy awpa ta â vy huh. A cha hmô tita a palôh a tlâh ngaita aw.
A hnohta bie reih aw chi ta, a pakah liata bie na soh lymâ aw. Nâma pakah nata ano pakah liata y aw na ta, nama tao awpa ei cha pachu lymâ aw ei.
Ano ta nâma vyuhpa ta zawpi lâ bie reih aw ta, nâma châta pakah châ aw ta, nâ cha ano châta Khazohpa hawhta na châ aw.
Chôchahrei he a chaba aw chi ta, he hmâpa heta hmonoâhpazy na tao aw,” tah ta.

Mawsi cha a puhpa Zetharô lâ a lie ta, a hnohta, “Izi râh liata ei unawh a ypazy ama hroh ma tahpa pahno awpa ta, ngiachhiepa ta âmo lâ na pasiesa mah y,” tah ta. Zetharô ta Mawsi hnohta, “Thlalôhpa ta sie mah y,” tah ta.
Mawsi cha Midia râh liata a y thlâh ha nota, Abeipa ta a hnohta, “Sie la, Izi râh lâ kua mah y. Thie châ chhuahpazy kha ama thi khai haw,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Mawsi cha a lapinô nata a sawchapawzy a chhi ta, âmo cha alâ chô liata pakiasa ta, Khazohpa chôchahrei a chabapa ta, Izi râh lâ cha kua ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Izi râh lâ na kua tita, hmonoâhpa tao theina ei cha piepa zydua kha, Phiraoh hmiakô liata tao tlai mah y. Châhrasala a palôh kuh pachhasa aw na ta, phopi cha pasiesa aw vei.
Chatawhcha Phiraoh hnohta, ‘ Abeipa ta hetana heta a tah: Izarei cha ei sawchapawpa, ei sawchapaw uhtheipa a châ.

Ei sawchapawpa ta eina chakao thei nawpa ta, ano cha pasiesa mah y, cha tah na ta, a sie awpa na pasai vei khiahta cha, pachâ teh, na sawchapawpa, na sawchapaw uhtheipa tlai ei thie aw,’ tahpa ta na chho aw,” tah ta.
Lâpi liata riebu liata, Abeipa ta Mawsi cha a tyh ta, thie a chhuah ta.
Zipôrâ ta pachielô chaizôh la ta, a sawchapaw chopaw tai ta, cha chata Mawsi phei kei hriana ta, “Ei châta thisaih a palopa myuhneituhpa na vaw châ tlai he!” tah ta.
Chatanachata Khazohpa ta Mawsi cha pahlôh ta, chopawtaipa vâna chata Zipôrâ ta, “Thisaih a palopa myuhneituhpa na châ” a tahpa a châ.
Abeipa ta Arawna hnohta, “Mawsi dy awpa ta râhchawhpa lâ sie teh,” tah ta. Arawna cha sie ta, Khazohpa tlâh liata Mawsi a kei tyh ta, a pahnâ ta.
Mawsi ta Abeipa ta a tuana chhâpa bie zydua nata hmonoâhpa tao awpa ta bie a piepa zydua Arawna chho ta.
Chatawhcha Mawsi nata Arawna cha sie ei ta, Izarei machâ zydua awpakhy ei ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta a reipa bie zydua Arawna ta reih pachhuah ta, zawpi mohmô ta hmonoâhpazy tao ta.
Izarei phopi ta ama biereipa cha zo ei ta, Abeipa ta Izarei sawzy za tly ta, ama pasataonazy a za hmô haw tahpa ama thei nahta, ama luh a bôhpa ta Abeipa cha a chhy ei ta.

Cha khai tawhta, Mawsi nata Arawna cha vawh ei ta, Phiraoh hnohta, “Zehôvâh, Izarei Khazohpa ta, ‘Râhchawhpa liata ei châta kyhchhi ama tao thei nawpa ta, ei phopi pasiesa teh,’ a cha tah,” tah ei ta.
Phiraoh ta, “ Abeipa cha ahy maw? A bie zyh ta, Izarei cha ei pasiesa awpa cha ahy ma a châ? Abeipa cha pahno va na, Izarei chhao pasiesa aw va na,” tah ta.

Âmo ta, “Hebraizy Khazohpa ta miah za tly ha ta, chavâta Khazohpa lâ eimâ theih thei nawpa ta, ngiachhiepa ta noh thôh lâsie râhchawhpa lâ miah pasiesa mah y. Chataleipatala potlana ta tlyma, zaozi ta tlyma, miah a hrie pathlei aw,” tah ei ta.
Izi bei ta ama hnohta “Nâmo, Mawsi nata Arawna, khazia zawpizy cha ama raihria tawhta nama la papua? Nama rai kei hria molo teh u,” tah ta.
Phiraoh ta, “Moh teh u, he phopi he a râh phopi hlâta hluh via ha bâ ei ta, ama raihriazy tlao nama chalihsa haw,” tah ta.
Cha noh tlai chata Phiraoh ta raihria hyutuhpazy nata vaituhpazy hnohta,
“Leiraopa tao nawpa ta sawphao nama pie tyhpa hawhna khata nama pie awpa châ khao vei. Âmo tlai ta sie aw ei ta, sawphao amâ pakhy pâ aw.

Leiraopa deikua cha, ama tao tyhpa zie a hnaw pazao aw ei chi ta, nama pachyh via awpa châ vei, thathipa ama châ hih. Chavâta awh ei ta, ‘Eima Khazohpa lâ eimâ theih thei nawpa ta, miah pasiesa teh,’ ama tahpa a châ.
Chyhsazy he rai ru viapa ta pavipa châ ei sala, cha raizy liata ngosiah ei sala, haipa bie rei awpazy ama pachâ khao leina hâh ta,” tahpa ta biepie ta.
Raihria hyutuhpazy nata vaituhpazy cha pua ei ta, Izarei phopi hnohta, “Phiraoh ta hetana heta a tah: ‘Sawphao cha pie khao aw veih ei na.
Nâmo tlai ta sie aw ei chi ta, sawphao tlua aw ei chi ta, nama hmôna su tawhta nama vaw paly aw. Nama rai deikua cha pachyh viapa châ aw vei,’ a tah,” tah ei ta.
Chatanachata Izarei sawzy cha Izi râh zydua liata a khie ei ta, sawphao vyuhpa ta sâhkô chuahmi pakhy laih ei ta.
Raihria hyutuhpazy ta, “Sawphao y nota noh kha ta nama hriapa zie kha nama patlô lymâ awpa a châ” tah ei ta, âmo cha tophi ei ta.
Phiraoh raihria hyutuhpazy ta, Izarei sawzy hry liata raihria vaituhpa ta ama raopazy cha tu ei ta, “Khazia leiraopa nama tao tyhpa zie zâhnia nata tanoh nama tao vei?” tah ei ta.
Izarei saw raihria vaituhpazy cha Phiraoh lâ vawh ei ta, a hnohta, “Khazia châ chakaotuhpazy he, he hawhta miah na tao?

Châ chakaotuhpazy he sawphao rai miah pie khao leipa ei ta, chatanachôta ‘Leiraopa tao teh u,’ miah ama tah. Moh tua, châ chakaotuhpazy he miah tu ei ta, châhrasala na chyhsazy thaileipa a châ,” tahpa ta ama nôpona bie tlôkhei ei ta.
Châhrasala Phiraoh ta, “Thathipa nama châ, thathipa nama châ, chavâta ‘ Abeipa lâ eimâ theih thei nawpa ta, miah pasiesa teh,’ nama tahpa a châ.
Tahmâ vawh u la, rai kei hria teh u. Sawphao piepa châ aw veih ei chi. Châhrasala leiraopa tao awpa taihpa zie nama tao pyly awpa a châ,” tah ta.
“Noh kha ta nama hria awpa, nama leiraopa tao awpa zie pachyh via hlei aw veih ei chi,” tahpa bie ama thei nahta, raihria vaituhpa Izarei sawzy cha, ama topa a chhiezie pahno ei ta.
Phiraoh tawhta ama pua nahta, âmo a vaw hâ thlâh hapa Mawsi nata Arawna cha a tyh ei ta,

ama hnohta, “ Abeipa ta cha moh ei sala, cha pachia mawh ei sy. Phiraoh nata a chakaotuhpazy mohmô liata roh chhiepa ta miah tao ei chi ta, miah thie awpa ta ama ku liata zaozi nama chabasa ha hih,” tah ei ta.
Mawsi cha Abeipa lâ a heih ta, a hnohta, “Hy Abeipa, khazia ma he phopi chô liata hmo pha leipa na tao tly? Khâpa vâta ma eina tuah chi?
Na moh ta bie rei awpa ta Phiraoh lâ ei vy rakha tawhta, Phiraoh ta he phopi chô liata moleina hmo tao ta, nâ hra ta na phopi he pachha tlôh chi va,” tah ta.

Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Tahmâ cha Phiraoh chô liata ei tao awpa na hmô bâ aw. Ei ku thatlôpa a hmôpa vâta, Izarei sawzy pasiesa aw ta; ei ku thatlôpa a hmôpa vâta, a râh tawhta a papua aw ei,” tah ta.
Khazohpa ta Mawsi cha bie a chho ta, a hnohta, “Kei he Zehôvâh ei châ.
Abarahâ, Aisika nata Zakaw zy hnohta Khazohpa Atotaotheipa ta a vaw luah na ta, ei moh Zehôvâh ta deikua cha ama hnohta a pahnosa va na.
Khichhaipa châpa ta ama vaw pahrâna Kâna râh cha âmo pie awpa ta ama hnohta bie hraih na ta.
Cha dei châ vei, Izi mo ta sei ta ama hraipa Izarei sawzy a hrôpa thei na ta, ei biehrai ei thei thlâh haw.

Chavâta Izarei sawzy hnohta, ‘Zehôvâh ta hetana heta a tah: Kei he Zehôvâh ei châ. Izi mo ta phaohri ama cha pavina ry tawhta cha thaoh papuapa ta, ama sei châna tawhta cha pachha aw ei na ta, bâh pazawhpa nata pachiana rônahpa ta ei cha chatlai aw ei.
Ei phopi châta cha hnei aw ei na ta, nama Khazohpa ei châ aw. Chatanachata kei he Izi mo ta phaohri ama cha pavina tawhta châ thaoh papuatuhpa Zehôvâh nama Khazohpa ei châ tahpa nama pahno aw.

Abarahâ, Aisika nata Zakaw zy hnohta pie awpa ta ei ku chaluahpa ta bie ei taihpa râh lâ châ chhi aw ei na ta, cha râh cha nama ryuto châta ei cha pie aw ei, kei he Zehôvâh ei châ,’ tahpa ta chho mah y,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta Izarei sawzy hnohta cha hawhna chata reih ta, châhrasala ama palôh a chhâ kawpa vâ nata ama seichâna ru ngaitapa zy vâta Mawsi bie cha thei thai khao veih ei.
Chatawhcha Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Vawh la, Izi bei Phiraoh hnohta, Izarei sawzy cha a râh tawhta papuasa awpa ta kei chho teh,” tah ta.

Châhrasala Mawsi ta Abeipa hnohta, “Pachâ teh, Izarei sawzy hmahta eina nathlie khoh leipa khiah ei ta cha, Phiraoh chhochhi ta cha keima kahchôleiâpa biereipa cha kheihta ma a nathlie khoh aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi nata Arawna cha bie a chho ta, Izarei sawzy chô liata nata Phiraoh chô liata biehnei awpa nata Izarei sawzy Izi râh tawhta a chhi papua awpa ta âmo cha biepie ta.
Hezy he Mawsi nata Arawna pathlatuhpa chhôhkha luhpazy ama châ: Izarei sawchapaw uhtheipa Rubena sawchapawzy cha Hanô, Pâluh, Hezrô nata Kâmi zy châ ei ta, chazy cha Rubena phozy ama châ.
Simeôna sawchapawzy cha Zemua, Zami, Ôhâ, Zaki, Zôhâ nata Kâna zuah liata a sawchapaw Sawla zy châ ei ta, chazy cha Simeôna phozy ama châ.
Hezy he ama thyutôna a laichadaipa ta Livai sawchapawzy moh châ ta, chazy cha Kesao, Kôhâ nata Merâri zy ama châ. Livai hro chhôh kôzy cha, kô 137 a châ.
Kesao sawchapawzy cha, ama pho zipa ta, Libani nata Simei ama châ.
Kôhâ sawchapawzy cha Amrâ, Izah, Hebraw nata Uzie zy châ ei ta, Kôhâ hro chhôh kôzy cha, kô 133 a châ.
Merâri sawchapawzy cha Mâhli nata Musi ama châ. Hezy he ama thyutôna a laichadaipa ta Livai phozy ama châ.
Amrâ ta a paw sietanô Zôkebe cha lapinô ta hnei ta, ano ta Arawna nata Mawsi sapa ta, Amrâ hro chhôh kôzy cha, kô 137 a châ.
Izah sawchapawzy cha Kôrâ, Nephe nata Zikari zy ama châ.
Uzie sawchapawzy cha Misela, Elzaphâ nata Sithari zy ama châ.
Arawna ta Aminadâ sawchanô, Nâsô sietanô Elisebâ cha lapinô ta hnei ta, ano ta Nâdâ, Abihu, Eliaza nata Ithamâ zy a sapa ei.
Kôrâ sawchapawzy cha Asi, Elkânâ nata Abiasa zy châ ei ta, chazy cha Kôrâ phozy cha ama châ.
Arawna sawchapawpa Eliaza ta Putie sawchanôzy hry liata pakha lapinô ta hnei ta, ano ta Phinehâ sapa ta. Chazy cha ama pho tawhta a laichadaipa ta, Livai chizy pathlatuh thabypazy ama châ.
Âmo cha Abeipa ta, “Izarei sawzy cha ama py yzie lymâ hawhta Izi râh tawhta a chhi papua teh u,” tahpa ta a chhopa Arawna nata Mawsi kha ama châ.
Cha Mawsi nata Arawna cha, Izarei sawzy Izi râh tawhta a chhi papua awpa ta, Izi bei Phiraoh a chhotuhpa ama châ.
Abeipa ta Izi râh liata Mawsi bie a chho nona khata,
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Kei he Abeipa ei châ. Na hnohta ei reipa zydua Izi bei Phiraoh chho mah y,” tah ta.
Châhrasala Mawsi ta Abeipa hnohta, “Kei he kahchôleiâpa châ tlôh na ta, keima hawhpa biereipa cha Phiraoh ta kheihta ma a nathlie khoh aw?” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Pachâ teh, Phiraoh hmiakô liata Khazohpa hawhta cha tao na ta, na unawhpa Arawna cha na hrohsopa a châ aw.
Bie ei cha piepa zydua reih aw chi ta, na unawhpa Arawna ta Phiraoh hnohta Izarei sawzy a râh tawhta pasiesa awpa ta a chho aw.
Ngiana nata hmonoâhpazy Izi râh liata ei papôhsapa chhao ta, Phiraoh palôh cha a kuh ei pachhasa ha aw.
Chavâta Phiraoh ta cha nathlie aw veih ei. Chatanachata Izi râh chô liata ei ku pahnieh aw na ta, pachiana rônahpa ta ei pheisaihzy, ei phopi Izarei sawzy he Izi râh tawhta ei chhi papua aw ei.
Izi râh chô liata ei ku pazawhpa ta, Izarei sawzy ama hry tawhta ei chhi papua tita, Izi mo ta kei he Abeipa ei châ tahpa ama pahno aw,” tah ta.
Mawsi nata Arawna ta cha hawhna cha ta tao ei ta, Abeipa ta âmo bie a piepa hawh tlai ta tao ei ta.
Phiraoh hnohta bie ama rei nota, Mawsi cha kô sychariepa châ ta, Arawna cha kô sycharie nata kô thôhpa a châ.
Abeipa ta Mawsi nata Arawna hnohta,
“Phiraoh ta, ‘Hmonoâhpa tao teh u,’ a cha tah khiah ei ta cha, Mawsi ta Arawna hnohta, ‘Na chôchahrei kha la la, Phiraoh hmiakô liata kei thy teh, parih lâta â vaw lie aw,’ na tah aw,” tah ta.
Mawsi nata Arawna cha Phiraoh lâ a kei ngia ei ta, Abeipa ta bie a piepa hawhta tao ei ta. Arawna ta a chôchahrei cha Phiraoh nata a chakaotuhpazy hmiakô liata kei thy ta, parih lâta a vaw lie ta.
Phiraoh chhao ta chyhsa sopazy nata dyuthaipazy aw hra ta, Izi râh liata moliethaipazy chhao chata ama dyu hmâpa ta, cha hawhna tlai chata tao hra ei ta.
Ama chôchahrei thy chyu ei ta, parih lâta a vaw lie ei ta. Châhrasala Arawna chôchahrei ta âmo chôchahreizy cha palâ khai ha ta.
Chatanachôta Phiraoh palôh cha kuhchhâpa ta y ta, Abeipa ta a rei hapa hawhta, ama bie nathlie khoh vei.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Phiraoh palôh cha kuh pachhasapa ta y ta, Izarei phopi pasiesa khoh vei.
Ti lâ a zu nota pachhai awpa ta, Phiraoh lâ mydi ta vawh la, chôchahrei parih lâta a liepa kha na ku liata a chabapa ta, ano a hmô awpa ta Nile chavah kiah liata a kei duah mah y.

Chatawhcha a hnohta, ‘Zehôvâh, Hebraizy Khazohpa ta, he bie he cha chho awpa ta nâ lâta eina vaw tuah: “Râhchawhpa liata eina chakao thei nawpa ei ta, ei phopi pasiesa teh,” cha tah na ta. Châhrasala tahmâ taihta nathlie khoh va chi.
Chavâta Abeipa ta hetana heta a tah: Kei he Abeipa ei châ tahpa ei hmotaopa liata na pahno aw: Moh teh, ei ku liata chôchahrei heta Nile chavah tizy tu aw na ta, thisaih lâta amâ lie aw.
Nile chavah liata ngazy thi aw ei ta, chavah cha thu aw ta, Izi mo ta Nile chavah ti doh khoh khao aw veih ei,’ na tah aw,” tah ta.

Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Arawna hnohta, ‘Na chôchahrei chaba la, Izi râh tizy, ama chavahzy, ama vahtiepazy, ama tipozy nata ama ti pa-ona zydua chô liata na ku pazawh teh. Chatanachata tizy cha thisaih lâta a lie aw ei ta, Izi râh zydua liata thisaih a y aw. Tho hmobaohzy chhôh liata nata alô hmobaohzy chhôh liata chhao thisaih a y aw,’ tahpa ta chho mah y,” tah ta.

Mawsi nata Arawna ta Abeipa biepiepa hawhta tao ei ta. Arawna ta a chôchahrei cha chalo ta, Phiraoh mohmô liata nata ano a chakaotuhpazy mohmô liata Nile chavah ti cha tu ta, Nile chavah ti zydua cha thisaih lâta â lie khai haw.
Chavah liata ngazy thi ei ta, chavah cha thu ta, Izi mo ta chavah ti cha doh thei khao veih ei. Izi râh zydua cha thisaih ta a bie khai haw.
Châhrasala Izi râh liata moliethaipazy ta ama dyu hmâpa ta, cha hawhta tao hra ei ta. Chavâta Phiraoh palôh cha kuhchhapa ta y ta, Abeipa ta a rei hapa hawhta, ama bie nathlie khoh vei.
Phiraoh cha kua ta, a o lâ a di ta, cha hmo cha a pachâ chhao pachâ khao vei.
Nile chavah ti ama do thei khao leipa vâta, ti do awpa tluapa ta, Izi chyhsa zydua ta Nile chavah kiahzy chao ei ta.
Abeipa ta Nile chavah a tu tawhta noh sari châ ha ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Phiraoh lâ a kei ngia la, a hnohta, ‘ Abeipa ta hetana heta a tah: Eina chakao thei nawpa ei ta, ei phopi pasiesa teh.
Ama sie awpa na pasai vei khiahta cha, pachâ teh, na râh zydua uphawh ta ei hrie aw.

Nile chavah cha uphawh ta bie aw ta, uphawhzy cha kaw pua aw ei ta, na o chhôh liata zy, nâ ziana chhôhpadâhpa liata zy, na rakhô chô liata zy, châ chakaotuhpazy nata na zawpi o chhôh liata zy, na lômathu nata na viahchhâ neihna beikoh chhôh liata zy amâ ngia khai aw.
Uphawhzy chata nâ nata na phopi nata châ chakaotuhpazy chô liata ama kiah aw,’ tah ma y,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Arawna chho la, a hnohta, ‘Na chôchahrei chaba la, chavahzy, vahtiepazy nata tipozy chô liata na ku pazawh la, Izi râh liata uphawh pakiasa teh,’ tah mah y,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Arawna ta Izi râh liata tizy chô liata a ku pazawh ta, uphawhzy kaw pua ei ta, Izi râh ama bie khai haw.
Châhrasala moliethaipazy ta ama dyu hmâpa ta, cha hawhna tlai chata tao hra ei ta, Izi râh chô liata uphawhzy pakiasa hra ei ta.

Phiraoh ta Mawsi nata Arawna cha aw ta, ama hnohta “Kei tawhta nata ei phopi tawhta uphawhzy he la khai ha awpa ta Abeipa lâ hiah teh u. Abeipa lâ amâ theih thei nawpa ta Izarei phopi cha ei pasiesa aw ei,” tah ta.

Mawsi ta Phiraoh hnohta, “Nâ ta palyupalihna tlao to mah y. Uphawhzy cha nâma tawhta nata na ozy tawhta pahleipadia khaipa ta, Nile chavah lia deita paysa awpa ta, nâ nata châ chakaotuhpazy nata na phopi châta khati ta ma ei cha hiapa aw ei?” tah ta.
Phiraoh ta, “Mylâ sy,” tah ta. Mawsi ta, “Na bie hawhta châ mawh sy. Chatanachata Abeipa eima Khazohpa hawhpa he ahy hmah y veih ei tahpa na pahno aw.
Uphawhzy ta nâ nata na ozy nata châ chakaotuhpazy nata na phopi puasai aw ei ta, Nile chavah lia deita ama y aw,” tah ta.
Mawsi nata Arawna cha Phiraoh tawhta pua ei ta, Abeipa ta Phiraoh chô liata uphawhzy a vaw patlôsapa kyh liata, Mawsi ta Abeipa lâ hiah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi bie hawhta tao ta. Uphawhzy cha o chhôh liata zy, tlyhmia liata zy nata lyuzy liata thi lymâ ei ta.
Pakhy ei ta a su su ta pathlu ei ta, a râh duata a thu khai haw.
Châhrasala Phiraoh ta huhiehna a vaw ypa a hmô nahta, a palôh kuh a pachha ta, Abeipa ta a rei hapa hawhta, ama bie nathlie khoh heih vei.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Arawna chho la, a hnohta, ‘Izi râh dohlei zydua thlohmia lâta paliesa awpa ta, na chôchahrei kha hy la, alei liata dohlei kha tu teh,’ tahpa ta chho mah y,” tah ta.

Cha hawhna chata tao ei ta. Arawna ta a chôchahrei chabapa ta a ku hy ta, alei liata dohlei tu ta. Thlohmiazy ta chyhsapa nata sazy thata by ta, Izi râh zydua liata alei dohlei zydua thlohmia lâta amâ vaw lie khai haw.
Moliethaipazy ta ama dyu hmâpa ta thlohmia papua hra awpa a chhuah ei ta, châhrasala tao thei veih ei. Thlohmiazy ta chyhsapa nata sazy cha thata by ta.
Moliethaipazy ta Phiraoh hnohta, “Khazohpa kudy a châ hih,” tah ei ta. Châhrasala Phiraoh cha a palôh kuh pachhasa ta, Abeipa ta a rei hapa hawhta, ama bie nathlie khoh vei.

Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Mydi kari ta thyu la, Phiraoh cha ti lâ a zupa pachhaipa ta a hmiakô liata a kei duah la, a hnohta, ‘ Abeipa ta hetana heta a tah: Eina chakao thei nawpa ei ta, ei phopi pasiesa teh.

Ei phopi na pasiesa leipa khiahta cha, pachâ teh, na chô liata zy, châ chakaotuhpazy chô liata zy, na phopi chô liata nata na o chhôh zy liata mathyupazy a pôpi ta vaw tuah aw na ta, Izi mo ozy nata ama pahrâna alei cha mathyupa ta a bie khai aw.
Ei phopi pahrâna Kôse râh deikua cha, cha noh liata panano aw na ta, cha liata mathyupa rai y aw vei. Chatanachata kei he alei chô liata a ypa Abeipa ei châ tahpa na pahno aw.
Ei phopi nata na phopi pananona tao aw na ta, he ngiana he mylâ a vaw y aw,’ tahpa ta na chho aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta cha hawhna chata tao ta. Phiraoh o liata nata a chakaotuhpazy o liata mathyupa hluhpi, a pôpi ta a ngia ei ta, cha mathyupa pôpi chata Izi râh liata râh zydua ama parao khai haw.
Phiraoh ta Mawsi nata Arawna cha aw ta, ama hnohta, “Sie u la, he râh chhôh liana heta nama Khazohpa lâ cha a kei theih teh u,” tah ta.

Châhrasala Mawsi ta, “Cha hawhta tao awpa cha a do aw vei. Abeipa eima Khazohpa lâta atheihna eima hlâ awpazy cha, Izi mo châta ânapa hmozy châ tlôh ta, chavâta Izi mo châta ânapa hmozy hmâpa ta ama mohmô liata eimâ theih khiahta cha, alô ta miah vawh aw veih ei mâ?
Noh thôh lâsie râhchawhpa lâ sie aw pi ta, bie miah a piepa hawh tlai ta, Abeipa eima Khazohpa lâ eimâ theih aw,” tah ta.
Phiraoh ta, “Râhchawhpa liata Abeipa nama Khazohpa lâta namâ theih thei nawpa ta, cha pasiesa aw ei na ta, lâ hlapi taih deikua nama sie awpa châ vei, na hiapa teh u,” tah ta.

Mawsi ta, “Moh teh, nâ tawhta pua aw na ta, mathyupa pôpi heta Phiraoh nata a chakaotuhpazy nata a phopi mylâ ama puasai thei nawpa ta, Abeipa lâ cha ei hiah aw. Phiraoh deikua ta, chyhsa dôvei khao leipa sala, Abeipa lâ a theih awpa ta Izarei phopi ama sie awpa pasai leipa ta y cheita khao khah sy,” tah ta.
Mawsi cha Phiraoh tawhta pua ta, Abeipa lâ thlahchhâ ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi bie hawhta tao ta, mathyupa pôpi cha Phiraoh tawhta nata a chakaotuhpazy tawhta nata a phopi tawhta papai ta, sâkha hmah a ngua khao vei.
Châhrasala cha daihti liana chhao chata, Phiraoh cha a palôh kuh pachhasa heih ta, Izarei phopi ama sie awpa pasaih pyly vei.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Phiraoh lâ vawh la, a hnohta, ‘Zehôvâh, Hebraizy Khazohpa ta hetana heta a tah: Eina chakao thei nawpa ei ta, ei phopi pasiesa teh.
Ama sie awpa pasai leipa ta na patu ngâ thlâh khiah ei ta cha,
moh teh, Abeipa ku ta lyu liata na sahrohzy chô liata potlana ru ngaitapa patlathlusa aw ta, arâzy, alâzy, râraoseihpazy, viahchao hrizy nata mietaku zawzy ama thi khai aw.
Châhrasala Abeipa ta Izarei sawzy sahrohzy nata Izi mo sahrohzy ananona tao aw ta, Izarei sawzy eih cha pô kha hmah thi aw vei,’ tahpa ta chho mah y,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta a daihti rao ta, “Cha hmo cha Abeipa ta he râh liata mylâ a tao aw,” tah ta.
A mylâ ta Abeipa ta cha hmo cha tao ta, Izi mo sahroh zydua thi khai ta, Izarei sawzy sahroh deikua cha, pô kha hmah thi vei.
Phiraoh ta chyhsa tuah ta, Izarei sawzy sahroh cha pô kha hmah a thi leipa pahno ta. Châhrasala Phiraoh palôh cha kuh pachhasapa ta y ta, Izarei phopi ama sie awpa pasaih pyly vei.
Abeipa ta Mawsi nata Arawna hnohta, “Patisana mei liata buchâh kei phâ u la, Phiraoh mohmô liata Mawsi ta avâ lâ hie mawh sy.
Buchâh cha Izi râh zydua chô liata buchâh dipa lâta a vaw lie aw ta, Izi râh chhôh zydua liata chyhsa nata sazy kheihluh pathlasa aw ta, ama padaoh aw,” tah ta.

Chatanachata patisana mei liata buchâh cha la ei ta, Phiraoh hmiakô liata a kei duah ei ta, Mawsi ta avâ lâ hie ta, kheihluh lâta a vaw lie ta, chyhsa nata sazy cha kheihluh ta thlapa ta padaoh khai ha ei ta.
Izi mo zydua kheihluh ta thla khai ha ei ta, moliethaipazy chhao a thla ha hrapa vâ ei ta, ama kheihluh vâna chata moliethaipazy cha Mawsi hmiakô liata a duah thei khao veih ei.
Châhrasala Abeipa ta Phiraoh palôh kuh pachhasa ta, Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta a rei hapa hawhta, ama bie nathlie khoh vei.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Mydi kari ta thyu la, Phiraoh hmiakô liata a kei duah la, a hnohta, ‘Zehôvâh, Hebraizy Khazohpa ta hetana heta a tah: Eina chakao thei nawpa ei ta, ei phopi pasiesa teh.

Tahmâ liana heta la na chô liata nata châ chakaotuhpazy chô liata nata na phopi chô liata potlana ta ei hrie nawpa zydua ei vaw patlôsa bâ aw. Chatanachata khizaw zydua liata keima hawhpa he ahy hmah y veih ei tahpa na pahno aw.
Ei ku pazawhpa ta, potlana hri ta nâ nata na phopi cha tupa ta, khizaw tawhta ei cha pahleipadia bâ awpa ei a châ taraw.
Châhrasala ei hmotaotheina cha pahmôsapa ta, khizaw zydua liata ei moh pathâhsapa a châ thei nawpa ta ei cha paduapa a châ.
Chatanachôta ei phopi chô liata nâmasasyh a cheihchalo chi ta, âmo cha pasiesa khoh va chi.
Moh teh, mylâ tahmâ daihti liata, Izi râh â vaw dua tua noh tawhta tahmâ taihta a y beih leipa pareih ru ngaitapa ei patlasa aw.

Chavâta tahmâ chyhsa tuah la, na sahroh nata lyu liata na hneipa zydua amâ boh thei nawpa ta pasysa para mah y. A o liata a sy leipa chyhsa to nata lyu liata sa to cha pareih ta daih aw ei ta ama thi aw,’ tahpa ta na chho aw,” tah ta.
Phiraoh chakaotuhpazy hry liata Abeipa bie a chipazy ta ama seizy nata ama sahrohzy cha o chhôh lâ pangia para ei ta.
Abeipa bie a papeisa leipazy deikua cha, ama seizy nata ama sahrohzy lyu liata paysa ei ta.

Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Izi râh chhôh zydua liata pareih tla sala, chyhsa chô liata zy, sa chô liata zy, Izi râh lyu liata chicheipa to chô liata zy pareih patlasa awpa ta, na ku avâ lâ pazawh teh,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta a chôchahrei avâ lâ pazawh ta, chatawhcha Abeipa ta tôkalôhpa nata pareih za tuah ta, alei liata pachie mei za tla ta. Abeipa ta Izi râh chô liata pareih thata patlasa ta.
Pareih ru ngaitapa tla ta, pareih hry liata pachie mei â zaopa ta chateih ta, Izi phopi â vaw dua tawhta cha tlu ta pareih rupa Izi râh liata tla beih vei.
Pareih chata Izi râh lyurâh liata chyhsapa nata sa zydua daih ta. Pareih chata lyu liata chicheipa zydua nata tho zydua a thlie khai haw.
Izarei sawzy yna Kôse râh liata deikua cha, pareih tla vei.
Phiraoh ta Mawsi nata Arawna cha paawsa ta, ama hnohta, “Tahmâ la ei vaw molei ha tlai na. Abeipa cha a do ta, kei nata ei phopi tlai he moleipa cha eima châ.
Abeipa lâ hiah teh u. Khazohpa tôkalôhpa nata pareihzy he â daih ha bâ na. Ei cha pasiesa bâ aw ei, y khao aw veih ei chi,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta a hnohta, “Khih tawhta ei puapata nahta, Abeipa lâ ei ku ei pazawh aw. Tôkalôhpa a chalih aw ta, pareih chhao tla khao aw vei. Chatanachata leilô he Abeipa eih a châ tahpa na pahno aw.
Châhrasala nâ nata châ chakaotuhpazy cha Zehôvâh Khazohpa chi mâh veih ei chi tahpa ei pahno,” tah ta.
Bâli sâh chhi daihti châ ta, pala paw pabyuh daihti a châpa vâta, pareih ta pala nata bâli sâhzy a parao khai haw.
Âtâ sâh nata rai sâh deikua, amâ daih hapa vâta pareih ta parao vei.
Mawsi cha Phiraoh tawhta a pasiepa ta khihpi khôtho lâ pua ta, Abeipa lâ a ku pazawh ta. Chatanachata tôkalôhpa nata pareih cha a chalih ei ta, avâ chhao alei chô liata â vaw hia haw.
Châhrasala Phiraoh ta vâsua nata pareih nata tôkalôhpa zy amâ chalih hapa a hmô nahta, molei ha heih ta, ano nata a chakaotuhpazy ama kuh amâ pachhasa ha heih.
Phiraoh palôh cha kuh pachhasapa ta y ta, Abeipa ta Mawsi hmâpa ta a reipa hawhna tlai khata, Izarei sawzy pasiesa khoh vei.
Chatawhcha Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Phiraoh lâ a kei ngia teh. Kei tawhta ngianazy ama hry liata ei chaluah thei nawpa ta, ano palôh nata a chakaotuhpazy palôh kuh ei pachhasa haw.

Chatanachata na sawchapawpa nata na samohpa nah theina liata Izi râh chô liata ei hmotaoziezy nata ama hry liata hmonoâhpa ei taopazy he chho aw chi ta, kei he Abeipa ei châ tahpa nama pahno thei aw,” tah ta.
