Mawsi nata Arawna cha Phiraoh lâ a kei ngia ei ta, a hnohta, “Zehôvâh, Hebraizy Khazohpa ta hetana heta a tah: ‘Khachâ ma ei hmiakô liata a panawh khoh leipa ta na y aw? Eina chakao thei nawpa ei ta, ei phopi pasiesa bâ teh.
Ei phopi na pasiesa vei khiah ei ta cha, pachâ teh, na râh chô liata khawsuzy mylâ vaw patlôsa aw na ta,
alei chô bie khai aw ei ta, ahy hmahta alei rai hmô thei khao aw vei ei. Pareih ta a daih laibâhpa zydua nie khai aw ei ta, lyu liata a pyuhpa nama thokô zydua ama nie khai aw.

Nâma ozy nata châ chakaotuhpa zydua o nata Izi mo o zydua ama bie khai aw. Châ pathlatuhpazy nata âmo a pathlatuhpazy chhao ta khizaw liata ama vaw y pathao noh tawhta tanoh taihta cha hawhpa cha hmô beih veih ei,’” tahpa ta chho ei ta. Chatawhcha Mawsi cha a palie ta, Phiraoh tawhta pua ha ta.

Phiraoh chakaotuhpazy ta a hnohta, “Kha chyhsa kha khachâ ma eima châta khoheih a châ aw tly? Abeipa ama Khazohpa cha ama chakao thei nawpa ta, chyhsazy cha pasiesa thlâh ha bâ teh, Izi râh paraopa a châ hapa he pahno to va chi mâ?” tah ei ta.
Mawsi nata Arawna cha Phiraoh lâ a chhi heih ei ta, Phiraoh ta ama hnohta, “Sie u la, Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha kei chakao muh vy. Ahyzy tlai ma a sie aw ei?” tah ta.

Mawsi ta, “ Abeipa châta kyhchhina eima tao awpa châ tlôh ta, chavâta eima zydua ta hawti machâ ta eima sie aw. Eima sawchapawzy, eima sawchanôzy, eima mietaku zawzy nata eima viahchao hrizy chhaota eima sie aw,” tah ta.
Phiraoh ta ama hnohta, “Nâmo nata nama hawtizy ei cha pasiesa tlai khiah ei ta cha, Abeipa cha nama hnohta y mawh sy! A pachâ teh u, hmo moleipa tao namâ chhuah hih.
Châ bao va! Nâmo, chapawzy sie u la, Abeipa cha kei chakao teh u. Cha cha nama khopa tlai a châ khawh,” tah ta. Chatanachata Mawsi nata Arawna cha Phiraoh mohmô tawhta papua ha ei ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Izi râh liata khawsuzy vaw tlô ei sala, pareih ta a daih bâhpa, râh liata chicheipa zydua ama nie khai ha nawpa ta, Izi râh chô liata na ku pazawh teh,” tah ta.

Mawsi ta Izi râh chô liata a chôchahrei pazawh ta, cha noh cha noh y ta nata zâkhihdei ta, Abeipa ta Izi râh chô liata nochhi thlih vaw pathlisa ta. Mydi a vaw châ nahta, nochhi thlih ta khawsuzy vaw phaoh ta.
Izi râh zydua cha khawsu ta bie ta, râh chhôh su to liata a choh ei ta, ama hluhzie cha, cha hawhta khawsu hluhpa cha kha hlâta y beih leipa ta, y beih khao aw vei.

Râh zydua bie khai ei ta, râh zydua a vyh khai haw. Pareih ta a daih laibâhpa, râh liata chicheipa to nata theilâpa zydua nie khai ei ta, Izi râh zydua lyu liata hmo hrohpa rai, tho chhao, chicheipa chhao, y khao vei.
Chatawhcha Phiraoh ta Mawsi nata Arawna cha a chatliepa ta aw ta, ama hnohta, “ Abeipa nama Khazohpa chô liata nata nâmo chô liata hmo ei parao haw.
Chavâta tahmâ ei châ haw ei, he ei khata ngâlâh he ei moleina rie nâ ngiahthai u la, he thina he kei tawhta na lapa awpa ta Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha na hiapa teh u,” tah ta.
Mawsi cha Phiraoh tawhta pua ta, Abeipa lâ hiah ta.
Abeipa ta thlih cha notla thlih ru ngaitapa lâta paliesa ta, cha chata khawsuzy cha phaoh ta, Tilaipi Saihpa lâ phaoh pathlah ta, Izi râh chhôh zydua liata khawsu sâkha hmah y khao vei.
Châhrasala Abeipa ta Phiraoh cha a palôh kuh pachhasa ta, chavâta Izarei sawzy cha pasiesa khoh khao vei.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnoh ta, “Izi râh he zohna ta khu sala, zoh kaluhpa ry liata ama pathâ hôlôna hâh ta, avâ lâ na ku pazawh teh,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta a ku avâ lâ pazawh ta, chatanachata Izi râh chhôh zydua noh thôh chhôh zoh kaluh ha ta.
Â hmô thei khao leipa ei ta, noh thôh chhôh ama yna su tawhta a pasie thei tlâ khao veih ei. Izarei sawzy deikua cha, ama yna chyu liata khaihna ama hnei khai.

Phiraoh ta Mawsi cha aw ta, a hnohta, “Sie u la, Abeipa cha kei chakao muh vy. Nama hawtizy chhao nama hnohta sie hra ei sala, nama mietaku zawzy nata nama viahchao hrizy deikua cha a ngua mawh ei sy,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta, “ Abeipa eima Khazohpa lâ eimâ theih nawpa ta, atheihna awpazy nata raopa hlâna awpazy eima ku liata miah na pie awpa a châ.

Eima sahrohzy eima hnohta ama sie hra awpa a châ. Sahrohzy hry liatapa he Abeipa eima Khazohpa chakao nawpa ta eima hmâ awpa châ tlôh ta, a su eima tlô hlâta cha, khâpa ta ma Abeipa eima chakao aw tahpa ei pahno leipa vâta, sahroh pô kha hmah eima siesai awpa châ vei,” tah ta.
Châhrasala Abeipa ta Phiraoh cha a palôh kuh pachhasa ta, âmo cha pasiesa khoh khao vei.
Phiraoh ta Mawsi hnohta, “Kei tawhta pua teh. A chado la, ei hmia rai vaw hmô khao khah y. Ei hmia na hmô noh cha, na thi noh a châ aw,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta, “Na reih pasu kaw, na hmia cha hmô beih khao aw va na,” tah ta.

Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Phiraoh chô liata nata Izi râh chô liata potlana miakha patlôsa via aw na ta, cha khai tawhta la a cha pasiesa ha aw ei. A cha pasiesa daidao ei ta la, tlokhuh ta a cha to papua ha aw ei.
Tahmâ zawpi theina liata bie kei reih teh. A chanô chapaw ta ama opazy liata tâkâ atobina nata ngôh atobinazy hiah khai mawh ei sy,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Izarei phopi cha Izi mo hmiakô liata ngiachhiena pahlaosa ta. Cha dei châ vei, Mawsi cha Izi râh liata Phiraoh chakaotuhpazy pachâzie nata zawpi pachâzie liata chyhsa rônah ngaitapa châ ta.
Mawsi ta, “ Abeipa ta hetana heta a tah: ‘Zâ cho rachhôh liata Izi râh zydua vaw chahryh aw na ta,

Izi râh liata sawchapaw uhtheipa zydua ama thi khai aw. Beidyuchhai liata a tyuhpa Phiraoh sawchapaw uhtheipa tawhta sâh chariehna thaby liata a ypa seichanô sawchapaw uhtheipa taihta ama thi khai aw. Sahroh chapawpa a pataw tuapa zydua chhao ama thi khai aw.
Izi râh chhôh zydua liata chana ru ngaitapa y aw ta, cha hawhta chana rupa rai y beih leipa ta, y beih khao aw vei.
Izarei sawzy deikua cha, chyhsapa chô liata chhao, sa chô liata chhao, i hmahta nga aw veih ei. Chatanachata Abeipa ta Izi nata Izarei likah a panano tlai tahpa nama pahno aw.’

Châ chakaotuhpa zydua he ei hnohta a zu aw ei ta, ei hmiakô liata a bôhpa ta, ‘Nâ nata châ zituhpa chyhsa zydua he pua teh u,’ tah aw ei ta, cha khai tawhta ei pua aw,” tah ta. Chatanachata Phiraoh tawhtapa cha hiehâh ngaitapa ta pua ha ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Ei hmotao noâhpazy Izi râh liana heta papôhsapa ta a y thei nawpa ta, Phiraoh ta nama bie a pyh aw vei,” tah ta.
Cha hmonoâhpa zydua cha Mawsi nata Arawna ta Phiraoh hmiakô liata tao ei ta. Châhrasala Abeipa ta Phiraoh cha a palôh kuh pachhasa ta, Izarei sawzy cha a râh tawhta papuasa khoh vei.
Abeipa ta Mawsi nata Arawna cha Izi râh liata bie a chho ta, ama hnohta,
“He thla he nâmo châta thlazy rei pathaona châ aw ta, kô a thaona thla a châ aw.
Izarei zawpi zydua hnohta chho u la, he thla noh hrawhna noh liata thie awpa ta, chyhsa to ama chhôhkha lymâ hawhta, chhôhkha miakha ta mietakutaw pô kha amâ so chyu awpa a châ.
Mietakutaw pô kha thie awpa ta chhôhkha maluh a chyh tu khiahta cha, â hnia chaipa a opapa maluh mopa ta, ama dyh no ta mietakutaw pô kha amâ hly aw.
Nama mietakutaw cha seina a hnei leipa, a chapawpa kô khapa a châ awpa châ ta, mietaku hry liatapa tlyma, mie hry liatapa tlyma namâ so thei.
He thlâpâ noh hrawh hleipalihna noh taih soh aw ei chi ta, cha khai tawhta Izarei zawpi pôhpakhypa ta zâlâ a zoh chy ta ama thie aw.
“Mietakutaw thisaih cha la aw ei ta, ama nie nawpa o liata ochhi tôh miano liata nata ochhi tlâh zy liata ama hnia aw.
A sa cha, cha zâ ta mei liata rao aw ei ta, viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa nata âhna khapa a hmiepa ta ama nie aw.
Aheipa ta nama nie awpa châ leipa ta, ti ta nama pasyu awpa châ hra vei. A luh nata a phei duata nata a chhôhri chhaota nama rao khai awpa a châ.
Mydi taih khâpa hmah nama so awpa châ leipa ta, mydi taih a ypa cha mei liata nama rao khai awpa a châ.
Hetana heta nama nie aw: Nama chaisaih pa-ipa ta, pheiky a ky aw ei chi ta, chôchahrei a chhyna chôta, a para ngaitapa ta nama nie aw. Cha cha Abeipa zawpakhô a châ.
Cha zâ ta Izi râh zydua chahryh aw na ta, Izi râh liata sawchapaw uhtheipa zydua, chyhsapa chhao, sa chhao, thie khai aw ei na ta, Izi râh liata khazoh zydua ei pachia aw ei. Kei he Abeipa ei châ.

Thisaih cha nâmo châta nama yna o ngiana châ aw ta, thisaih ei hmô khiahta cha, ei châ zaw pakhô ha aw ei. Chatanachata Izi râh ei tu tita, nâmo chô lia deikua cha, châ pahleipadia awpa khâpa hri hmah vaw tlô aw vei.

“He noh he nâmo châta atheithlâhna noh châ aw ta, Abeipa châta kyhchhi noh ta nama chay tyh awpa a châ. Nama chhâ zydua liata, he noh he kyhchhi noh ta nama chay tyh awpa châ ta, cha cha chhâzaw châta bieraopa ta a y awpa a châ.

Noh sari chhôh viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa nama nie awpa a châ. Noh khana noh ta, nama o chhôh tawhta thinô nama pathai khai ha awpa châ ta, ahy rai noh kha noh tawhta noh sari noh taihta viahchhâ thinô pahlaopa a niepa maih cha, cha chyhsa cha Izarei tawhta chhawh pathlahpa a châ aw.

Noh khana noh ta pakhypi pathaihpa hmâh aw ei chi ta, a noh sarina noh ta pakhypi pathaihpa a y heih aw. Chyhsa to nie awpa châta nama hriapa dei leipa cha, cha daihti chhôh cha khâpa rai hmah nama hria awpa châ vei.

Cha noh lia tlai ta nama zawpizy Izi râh tawhta ei kaw chhi papuapa vâ ei ta, viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa kyhchhi nama chay tyh awpa a châ. Cha noh cha nama chhâ zydua liata nama chay tyh awpa châ ta, cha cha nama châta chhâzaw bieraopa ta a y awpa a châ.
Thla khana, noh hrawh hleipalihna noh zâlâ tawhta noh kih nata noh khana noh zâlâ taihta, viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa cha nama nie awpa a châ.
Noh sari chhôh nama o chhôh liata thinô rai a y awpa châ vei. Ahy rai thinô pahlaopa a niepa chyhsa cha, chihropa chhao, a râh chyhsa chhao, Izarei zawpi tawhta chhawh pathlahpa a châ aw.
Cha daihti chhôh liata thinô pahlaopa khâpa hmah nama nie awpa châ leipa ta, nama pahrâna su zydua liata viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa nama nie awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Mawsi ta Izarei machâ zydua aw ta, ama hnohta, “Vawh u la, nama chhôhkha maluh chyu hawhta mietakutawzy a kei tlyh u la, zawpakhô mietakutaw cha thie teh u.

Hisaw ty la aw ei chi ta, rahô liata thisaih liata ny aw ei chi ta, rahô liata thisaih cha ochhi tlâh liata nata ochhi tôh miano liata nama hnia aw. Khihdei hlâlei cha, ahy hmah ama ochhi tawhta ama pua awpa châ vei.

Abeipa ta Izi mo thie awpa ta vaw chahryh aw ta, ochhi tlâh nata ochhi tôh miano liata thisaih hniapa a hmô tita, Abeipa ta ochhi cha a zaw pakhô aw ta, pahleipadiatuhpa cha nâmo thie awpa ta nama o liata pangiasa aw vei.
“Nâmo nata nama pathlazy châta chhâzaw bieraopa y thlâh ha awpa ta, he kyhchhi he nama tao tyh awpa a châ.
Abeipa ta bie â taihpa hawhta râh a cha pie awpa ei nama tlô tita, he chakaona he nama pazao lymâ awpa a châ.
Nama sawzy ta, ‘He chakaona he khâpa ma a yzie?’ tahpa ta ama cha hiahri tita,

nâmo ta, ‘He he Abeipa Zawpakhô atheihna a châ. Abeipa ta Izi mo a thie nota, Izi râh liata Izarei sawzy o cha a zawpakhô ta, eima ozy a pahlôhpa atheithlâhna châta ei tao tyhpa a châ,’ nama tah aw,” tah ta. Chatawhcha zawpizy cha ama luh a bôhpa ta Abeipa a chhy ei ta.
Izarei sawzy cha sie ei ta, Abeipa ta Mawsi nata Arawna bie a piepa hawhta kei tao ei ta.

Chatanachata zâcho a vaw châ nahta, Abeipa ta Izi râh liata sawtuapa zydua, Phiraoh sawchapaw uhtheipa beidyuchhai liata a tyuhpa tawhta a tâhpa sawchapaw uhtheipa patâhna o liata a ypa taihta thie ta, sahroh a pataw tuapa zydua chhao a thi khai haw.
Phiraoh nata a chakaotuhpa zydua nata Izi mo zydua cha azo ta thyu ei ta. Athipa pakha hmah y leina o rai a y leipa vâta, Izi râh liata thata chana y ta.

Phiraoh ta Mawsi nata Arawna cha azo ta aw ta, ama hnohta, “Thyu u la, nâmo pano nata Izarei phopi cha, ei phopi hry tawhna heta pua teh u. Sie u la, nama reipa hawhna khata, Abeipa cha kei chakao teh u.
Nama reipa hawhna khata, nama mietaku zawzy nata nama viahchao hrizy cha a chhi u la, sie teh u. Kei chhao he byhnâ na awpa teh u!” tah ta.
Izi mo ta, “Eima thi khai dâhdei aw he zaw,” tah ei ta, Izarei sawzy cha Izi râh tawhta a chatliepa ta pua awpa ta a haw ei ta.
Izarei sawzy ta ama viahchhâ nyhpazy cha, thinô ama pahlao hlâta la ei ta, ama viahchhâ nyhna beihkohzy ama poh ta pahlypa ta, ama ngiatlâh liata baih ei ta.
Mawsi bie hawhta taopa ta, Izarei sawzy ta Izi mo cha tâkâ atobina nata ngôh atobinazy nata chysiazy hiah ei ta.
Abeipa ta Izarei sawzy cha Izi mo ngiachhiena pahlaosa ta, Izi mo ta ama hiapa maih pie lymâ ei ta, cha hawhna chata Izi mo cha hrao ei ta.
Izarei sawzy cha Râmese khih tawhta Sukô lâ pangaipa ta sie ei ta, chanô nata hawtizy rei leipa ta, chapaw pitlohpa sai ta 600,000 phei ta ama sie.
Chihropa hluhpi nata sahroh hluhpi, mietaku zawzy nata viahchao hrizy chhao ama hnohta ama sie hra.

Izi râh tawhta ama puakheipa viahdie nyhpa hmâpa ta, viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipazy cha tao ei ta. Izi râh tawhta tophipa châ ei ta, ama hâ hmâ lei awpa vâta, thinô pahlao leipa viahchhâ dei leipa ta cha, lâpi liata ama nie awpa a tao hmâ veih ei.
Izarei sawzy Izi râh liata ama pahrâ chhôh cha, kô 430 a châ.
Kô 430 chhâna liata, cha noh lia tlai ta, Abeipa pheisaih zydua cha Izi râh tawhta ama pua khai haw.
Cha zâ cha Izi râh tawhta âmo papua awpa ta Abeipa ta a mokhâh zâ a châpa vâta, Izarei sawzy chhao ta, cha zâ cha Abeipa palyupalihpa ta chay zâ châta chhâ zydua ta ama hmâh tyh awpa a châ.
Abeipa ta Mawsi nata Arawna hnohta, “He he zawpakhô bieraopa a châ: Chihropazy ta Zawpakhô Kyhchhi pati ama nie hra awpa châ vei.
Tâkâ ta chaleipa sei deikua cha, a chopaw na tai khai tawhta a nie thei aw.
Chihropa nata hriahlaopazy ta ama nie awpa châ vei.
O kha liata nie awpa châ ta, a sa kheihawhpa hmahta o tawhta khôtho lâ na puakhei awpa châ leipa ta, a rupa kheihawhpa hmahta na thlie awpa châ vei.
Cha biepiepazy cha, Izarei zawpi zydua ta ama zyh awpa a châ.

Chihropa nama hry liata a pahrâpa ta Abeipa Zawpakhô a chay khoh hra khiahta cha, a hnohta a ypa chapaw zydua chopaw tai khai tua awpa châ ta, cha khai tawhta a vaw hnia aw ta, a chay hra aw. Chatanachata ano cha râh liata a pihpa hawhta pachâpa a châ aw. Chopaw tai leipa chyhsa deikua cha a nie awpa châ vei.
A râh chyhsa nata chihropa nama hry liata a pahrâpazy cha, ryhpa miakha ry liata ama y khai awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi nata Arawna hnohta bie a piepa hawh tlai ta, Izarei saw zydua ta tao ei ta.
Chatanachata cha noh lia tlai chata, Abeipa ta Izarei sawzy cha, a py py ta Izi râh tawhta â chhi papua ha ei.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Sawtuapa zydua kei châta na panano awpa a châ. Izarei sawzy hry liata chhi a pahy tuapa sawchapaw uhtheipa nata sahroh chapawpa a pataw tua chaipa maih kei eih a châ,” tah ta.

Mawsi ta zawpi hnohta, “He noh, Izi râh seichâna tawhta nama kaw puana noh he khâ a thei thlâh ha muh vy. Abeipa ta ku thatlôpa ta Izi râh tawhta a châ chhi papua ei. Chavâta thinô pahlaopa viahchhâ nama nie awpa châ vei.
Tanoh, Abi thla liata nama pua hih.

Abeipa ta nâmo cha pie awpa ta châ pathlatuhpazy hnohta bie â vaw taihpa Kâna mo, Hiti mo, Amawri mo, Hivi mo nata Zebu mozy pahrâna râh, sâhpiti nata kheihti lona râh a cha tlôkhei ti ei ta, he thla liana heta, he chakaona he nama hmâ tyh awpa a châ.
Noh sari chhôh viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa nie aw ei chi ta, a noh sarina noh cha Abeipa châta kyhchhi noh a châ aw.
Noh sari chhôh viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa nie awpa châ ta, thinô pahlaopa khâpa hmah nâmo liata a y awpa châ leipa ta, nama râh chhôh zydua liata thinô hmô awpa a y awpa châ vei.
Cha noh liata, nama sawzy hnohta, ‘Izi râh tawhta eima kaw pua nota Abeipa ta eima châta a taopa zydua vâta, he hmo he eima taopa a châ,’ nama tah aw.

Zawpakhô kyhchhi nama hmâ tyh awpa cha, Abeipa ryhpa nama pakah liata a y thlâh ha thei nawpa ta, ngiana châta nama ku liata a ky ei chi ta, atheithlâhna châta nama mo nata mo likawh liata nama sopa hawhta a châ aw. Abeipa ta ku thatlôpa ta Izi râh tawhta a châ chhi papua ei hih.
Chavâta he bieraopa he, kô chareih a daihti liata nama chay tyh awpa a châ.
“ Abeipa ta nâmo nata châ pathlatuhpazy bie a châ taihpa hawh ei ta, Kâna mo râh cha tlôkheipa ta, cha râh cha a cha pie ti ei ta,
chhi a pahy tuapa maih cha Abeipa châta nama panano lymâ awpa a châ. Nama sahroh a pataw tuapa a chapawpa maih cha Abeipa châta a châ aw.

Alâ a pataw tuapa a chapawpa deikua cha mietakutaw ta nama chatlai awpa châ ta, nama chatlai khoh vei khiahta cha, a rao nama thlie awpa a châ. Nama sawzy hry liata sawchapaw uhtheipa maih cha nama chatlai awpa a châ.
Noh hro ta nama sawzy ta, ‘He kyhchhi he khâpa ma a yzie?’ tahpa ta ama cha hiahri tita, ama hnohta, ‘ Abeipa ta ku thatlôpa ta Izi râh seichâna tawhta miah â chhi papuapa pamosana a châ.

Phiraoh ta palôh lai kawpa ta eima sie awpa a pasai lei no kha, Abeipa ta Izi râh liata sawchapaw uhtheipa zydua, chyhsapa sawchapaw uhtheipa nata sahroh chapawpa a pataw tuapa maih a thie khai ha ei. Chavâta a chapawpa chhi a pahy tuapa zydua cha Abeipa lâta atheihna ta hlâ pi ta, eima sawchapaw uhtheipa zydua deikua cha eima chatlai,’ nama tah aw.
Cha hmo ngiana cha nama ku liata y aw ta, nama mo nata mo likawh liata khiriena ta a y awpa a châ, Abeipa ta ku thatlôpa ta Izi râh tawhta miah â chhi papua ha hih,” tah ta.

Phiraoh ta Izarei sawzy a pasiesa no kha, Philistinâ râh lâpi lâ a hnia via taraw ta, châhrasala Khazohpa ta, “Adyuhna amâ tyh tita, a ngiapachhipa ta Izi râh lâ ama kua pathlei aw na,” a tahpa vâta âmo cha, cha lâ tawhta a chhi vei.
Khazohpa ta Izarei sawzy cha râhchawhpa siepahliepa ta Tilaipi Saihpa lâta tlao â chhi ei. Chatanachata Izarei sawzy cha, chariah chhaichhi a tobipa ta, Izi râh tawhta ama pua haw.

Zawsi ta Izarei sawzy hnohta, “Khazohpa ta cha za tly thlyu aw ei ta, ei ruzy he, he su tawhta nama phaoh ha awpa a châ,” tahpa ta liahsa bie a pataihsa hapa hawh ei ta, Mawsi ta Zawsi ruzy cha phaoh ta.
Sukô su tawhta pua ei ta, râhchawhpa chhâna Ethâmâ su liata a rie ei ta.
Ama hmia lâta Abeipa sie ta, chhô nah zâ ta ama sie thei nawpa ta, chhô daihti liata meihdo tôh ta âmo cha a chhi ta, zâ daihti liata âmo pakhaih awpa ta mei tôh ta â chhi ei.
Nohchhô ta meihdo tôh, zâ ta mei tôh ta Izarei phopi cha siesai beih vei.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Izarei sawzy cha a lie ei sala, Mikadô nata tilaipi likawh Pihahirô liata a rie awpa ta chho mah y. Tilaipi kiah liata Bâlâzephô dady liata namâ rie awpa a châ.
Chatanachata Phiraoh ta Izarei sawzy cha, ‘Râhchawhpa liata viavi ei ta, râhchawhpa liata amâ tâh haw,’ tahpa ta pachâ aw ta.

Phiraoh palôh kuh pachhasa aw na ta, âmo cha a chadai aw ta, Phiraoh nata a pheisaih zydua hmâpa ta palyupalihna ei hlao aw. Chatanachata Izi mo ta kei he Abeipa ei châ tahpa ama pahno aw,” tah ta. Izarei sawzy ta cha hawhna chata tao ei ta.

Chyhsazy amâ râ khai haw tahpa Izi bei ama chho nahta, âmo kyh liata Phiraoh nata a chakaotuhpazy palôh anano ha heih ta, “Izarei sawzy miah ama chakao haipa tlai ta eima pasiesa thlâh hapa kha, kheihtazie ta kha hawhta a taopa ma eima châ tly?” tah ei ta.
Chatanachata Phiraoh cha a talailihzy pachhuahpanoh ta, a pheisaihzy a chhi ta.
Talailih pha chaipa za charu a tlyh ta, Izi râh liata talailih hropa zydua nata pheisaih hyutuhpazy a chhi khai ta.
Abeipa ta Izi bei Phiraoh palôh kuh pachhasa ta, chatanachata chhôhmohpa ta a sie haipa Izarei sawzy cha a chadai ta.

Izi mo ta Izarei sawzy cha a chadai ei ta, Phiraoh arâ zydua, a talailih zydua, arâ a kiahpa zydua nata pheisaih zydua ta âmo cha a chadai ei ta, Bâlâzephô dady Pihahirô kiapâh, tilaipi kiah liata ama riehmo liata kei pha ei ta.
Phiraoh â vaw hnia nahta, Izarei sawzy ta kei sai ei ta, Izi mo ta âmo lâ pangaipa ta ama vaw sie haipa ama hmô nahta, chi ngaita ei ta. Izarei sawzy ta Abeipa awsao ei ta.
Mawsi hnohta, “Izi râh liata thlâ a y leipa vâta ma, râhchawhpa liata thi awpa ta miah nâ vaw chhi? Khazia he hawhta miah tao awpa ta Izi râh tawhta miah na vaw puakhei?

He kyh liata, ‘Miah patypamâ hlei khah y, Izi mo he eima chakao molo aw,’ tahpa ta Izi râh liata eima cha chho hapa kha châ vei ma? Râhchawhpa liata thi awpa hlâta cha, Izi mo kha vaw chakao molo thlâh ha sih la, a pha via awpa tlai,” tah ei ta.
Mawsi ta Izarei phopi hnohta, “Chi khah u, â ipa ta a duah u la, Abeipa pachhana tanoh a vaw tlô awpa mokhâh teh u. Tanoh ta Izi chyhsa nama hmôpazy he chhâzaw ta hmô heih khao aw veih ei chi.
Abeipa ta a châ dyuhpa aw ei. Nâmo deikua cha a thlih thlâh ha teh u,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Khazia eina awsao chi? Izarei sawzy kha hmia lâ sie lymâ awpa ta chho teh.
Na chôchahrei kha hy la, tilaipi chô liata na ku pazawh la, tilaipi kha pachhaih mah y. Chatanachata Izarei sawzy cha tilaipi chhôh alei hipa liata ama sie aw.
Pachâ teh, Izi mo palôh kuh pachhasa aw na ta, Izarei sawzy a chadai aw ei ta, chatanachata Phiraoh nata a pheisaih zydua nata a talailihzy nata arâ a kiahpazy hmâpa ta palyupalihna ei hlao aw.
Phiraoh nata a talailihzy nata arâ a kiahpazy hmâpa ta palyupalihna ei hlao tita, Izi mo ta kei he Abeipa ei châ tahpa ama pahno aw,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Izarei sawzy ama hmia lâta a chhihtha laihpa Khazohpa vâlyuhchâpa cha, ama hnôh lâ a pasie ta, meihdo tôh chhao ama hmia lâ tawhta a pasiepa ta ama hnôh lâta a duahpa ta,

Izi pheisaihzy nata Izarei pheisaihzy likawh liata vaw tla ta. Meihdo nata zohna vaw y ta, zâ chhôh zydua meihdo ta hia kha lâ zohna paysapa ta, hia kha la khaihna paysa ta, zâ chhôh zydua ta hia kha lâ tawhta hia kha lâ a hnia thei veih ei.

Mawsi ta tilaipi chô liata a ku pazawh ta, Abeipa ta azozâkhihdei ta nochhi thlih ru ngaitapa vaw pathlisa ta, tizy hnoh lâ a sy ei ta, tilaipi cha alei hipa lâta pachâsa ta. Chatanachata tizy cha a pachhaih ta.
Izarei sawzy cha tilaipi chhôh alei hipa liata sie ei ta, tizy cha ama chachâh lâ nata ama chavei lâta âmo châta pâhchhô hawhta vaw y ta.
Izi mo ta Izarei sawzy cha a chadai ei ta, Phiraoh arâ zydua, a talailihzy nata arâ a kiahpazy cha tilaipi chhôh lâ a ngia ei ta.
Khih a vaw dei nahta, Abeipa ta Izi pheisaihzy cha mei tôh nata meihdo tôh tawhta za moh ta, Izi pheisaihzy cha tymâpa ta paysa ta.
Abeipa ta ama talailih pheizy a thlo hapa vâta sie thei khao leipa ei ta. Izi mo ta, “Izarei mo hmiakô tawhna heta a râ ha ei suh u, Abeipa ta âmo chhâh a châ ta Izi mo â dyuh ha hih,” tah ei ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Ti vaw loh pakhua sala, Izi mo nata ama talailihzy nata arâ a kiahpazy vao khai ha awpa ta, tilaipi chô liata na ku vaw pazawh teh,” tah ta.

Mawsi ta tilaipi chô liata a ku pazawh ta, khih a vaw dei nahta, tilaipi cha a y tyhpa hawhta vaw y ha heih ta. Izi mo cha a râ ei ta, châhrasala Abeipa ta âmo cha tilaipi chhôh liata a thy khai ha ei.
Tizy vaw loh pakhua ei ta, talailihzy nata arâ a kiahpazy nata Izarei mo a chadaituhpa Phiraoh pheisaih zydua cha, ti ta vao ei ta, pakha hmah a hrohpa y veih ei.
Izarei sawzy deikua cha, tilaipi chhôh alei hipa liata sie ei ta, tizy cha ama chachâh lâ nata ama chavei lâta âmo châta pâhchhô châ ha ta.
Cha hawhna chata Abeipa ta Izarei sawzy cha, cha noh liata Izi mo ku tawhta a pachha ha ei. Izarei sawzy ta Izi mo cha thiruapa ta tilaipi kiah liata hmô ei ta.

Abeipa ta Izi mo chô liata hmotaotheina rônah ngaitapa a hmâpa cha Izarei sawzy ta hmô ei ta, chavâta Izarei phopi ta Abeipa cha chi ngaita ei ta, chatanachata Abeipa nata a chakaotuhpa Mawsi cha a ngiapâ ha ei ta.
Chatawhcha Mawsi nata Izarei sawzy cha Abeipa palyupalihpa ta he hla he sa ei ta. “ Abeipa lâ hla ei sa aw, Rônahpa ta pahnie ta, Arâ nata a kiahtuhpa tilaipi chhôh lâ a thy hapa vâta.
Abeipa cha ei thatlôna nata ei hla châ ta, Ano cha ei pachhana a vaw châ haw; Ei Khazohpa châ ta, Ano cha ei reithai aw; Nâ pathlatuhpa Khazohpa châ ta, Ei palyupalih aw.
Zehôvâh cha chariah a dyuhpa pasaipha châ ta, A moh Zehôvâh a châ.
“Phiraoh talailihzy nata a pheisaihzy tilaipi liata thy ta, A pheisaih hyutuh pha chaipazy Tilaipi Saihpa liata ama tlasao khai haw.
Ti athupa ta âmo cha vao ta, Alô hawhta ti ry lâ amâ ngua haw.
Hy Abeipa, na ku chachâh lâ liata hmotaotheina rônahpa y ta, Hy Abeipa, na ku chachâh lâta khakhaipa a chaphie khai haw.
Nâ beina rônahna ta châ dyuhtuhpazy thy pathlah chi ta, Na hiehâhna papua chi ta, Sawphao hawhta a kâ khai ha ei.
Na hnapasu hu ta tizy toh ta, Pâhchhô hawhta tipaua a duah ta, Tizy tilaipi liah liata â patlo khai haw.
Chariahpa ta, ‘A chadai aw na ta, ei pha aw, Hraona sôh rai aw na ta, Âmo vâta lôhrâtlôpa ta ei y aw; Ei zaozi phia aw na ta, Ei ku ta âmo cha a pahleipadia aw,’ tah ta.
Na hu ta thlih vaw pathlisa chi ta, Tilaipi ta âmo cha vao ta, Kylô hawhta tilihpi liata amâ ngua haw.
“Hy Abeipa, khazohzy hry liata Nâ hawhpa he ahy ma a y? Pathaihna liata beichaipa châ chi ta, Rônahna liata zachhihpa na châ; Hmonoâhpazy a taotuhpa châ chi ta, Nâ hawhpa he ahy ma a y?
Na ku chachâh lâ pazawh chi ta, Alei ta âmo cha a palâ khai haw.
“Na kyhpachâna tleih leipa ta phopi na chatlaipa cha a chhi chi ta, Na thatlôna ta na yna su pathaihpa lâ nâ chhi ei.
Phopizy ta thei ei ta, amâ chalyu; Philistia mo thlazohpa ta ama y.
Edômâ beizy chihuhpa ta y ei ta, Môabâ pasaiphazy amâ chalyu; Kâna mo zydua chipa ta ama zao khai haw.
Hy Abeipa, na phopi ama khô khai hlâlei cha, Na chaleipa phopi ama khô hlâlei cha, China nata ngiarohna ta Izi mo tla thlu ta, Na bâh thatlôna vâta alô hawhta amâ chalih.
Na phopi cha a chhi aw chi ta, Na ryuto tlâh liata na loh ei; Hy Abeipa, na pahrâna châta na taopa su liata âmo cha loh aw chi ta, Na ku ta a paduapa supathaihpa lia tlai ta na loh aw ei.
Abeipa cha tlyzaw ta ryu a reih aw.”

Phiraoh arâzy, talailihzy nata arâ a kiahpazy tilaipi chhôh lâ amâ ngia khai nahta, Abeipa ta tilaipi tizy cha vaw pakuasa ta, âmo cha a vao ha ei. Izarei sawzy deikua cha, tilaipi chhôh alei hipa liata ama sie.
Chatawhcha hrohsonô Miria, Arawna sietanô cha khohtaw chaba ta, chanô zydua ta khohtaw nata lâna chôta ano cha pazi ei ta.
Miria ta, “ Abeipa lâ hla sa teh u, Rônahpa ta pahnie ta; Arâ nata a kiahtuhpazy Tilaipi lâ a thy ha ei,” tahpa ta hla ta a chhihtha.
Mawsi ta Izarei sawzy cha Tilaipi Saihpa tawhta puakhei ta, Surâ râhchawhpa lâ pangaipa ta sie ei ta. Râhchawhpa liata noh thôh sie ei ta, ti rai hmô leipa ei ta.
Marâh su kei tlô ei ta, Marâh su liata tizy cha a khapa vâta doh thei leipa ei ta. Chavâta a moh chhao Marâh bipa ta a châ.
Zawpi ta, “Khâpa ma eima doh aw?” tahpa ta, Mawsi chô liata paphôh ei ta.

Mawsi ta Abeipa awsao ta, Abeipa ta tho miakha vaw pahmô ta, cha cha ti liata za thy ta, chatanachata ti cha vaw pahâh ha ta. Cha liata Abeipa ta âmo châta bieraopa nata biepiepa taopa ta, cha liata âmo cha pasia ta,

ama hnohta, “ Abeipa Khazohpa ao pakhâta ta nathliepa ta, a mohmô liata hmo dopa taopa ta, a biepiepazy nathliepa ta, a bieraopazy na zyh khiahta cha, Izi mo chô liata hri ei patlôsapazy kha, na chô liata kheihawhpa hmah patlôsa aw va na, Kei he Zehôvâh Râfâ ei châ,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Elima su tlô ei ta, cha liata tihnawh hnawh hrawh hleino nata thiahrâ kô kô sysari y ta, cha su liata chavah kiahzy liata riehmo paryh ei ta.

Elima su tawhta pua ei ta, Izarei zawpi zydua ta Sini râhchawhpa vaw tlô ei ta, cha cha Elima nata Sinai likawh ta a ypa châ ta, Izi râh ama puasai tawhta thla nona noh hrawh hleipangawhna noh ta cha su cha ama vaw tlô.
Râhchawhpa liana chata Izarei zawpi zydua ta Mawsi nata Arawna chô liata paphôh ei ta.

Izarei sawzy ta ama hnohta, “Izi râh liata sa beih kiah liata a tyuh pi ta, viahchhâ eima rih biena taihta eima nie no khata Abeipa ku ta vaw thi ha sih la a pha via awpa tlai. Zawpi zydua he nodipa ta miah thie awpa ta râhchawhpa lâ miah namâ vaw chhi he zaw,” tah ei ta.

Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Pachâ teh, nama châta avâ tawhta viahchhâ pasuasa aw na ta, zawpizy pua aw ei ta, noh kha châta ama tovyuh a daihpa ta noh chareih amâ huah lymâ aw. Cha liana chata ei ryhpa ama zyh ma, zyh vei ma tahpa ei pasia aw ei.
Noh charu noh liata deikua cha, noh chareih ta amâ huapa lie no ta a huah aw ei ta, nie awpa châta amâ patohpatia tyh aw,” tah ta.
Mawsi nata Arawna ta Izarei saw zydua hnohta, “ Abeipa ta a chô liata nama paphôhnazy kha thei ta, chavâta zâlâ ta Abeipa cha Izi râh tawhta châ chhi papuatuhpa tlai a châ tahpa pahno aw ei chi ta,
my ta Abeipa rônahna nama hmô aw. Keimo he khâpa ma eima châ tly, eima chô liata nama paphôhpa he?” tah ei ta.

Mawsi ta, “ Abeipa ta a chô liata nama paphôhnazy a theipa vâta, zâlâ ta sa nie awpa cha piepa ta, my ta viahchhâ rih biena taih a cha pie ti ei ta, ano cha Abeipa a châ tlai tahpa nama pahno aw. Keimo he khâpa ma eima châ tly? Keimo chô liata a paphôhpa châ leipa ei chi ta, Abeipa chô liata a paphôhpa tlao nama châ,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Mawsi ta Arawna hnohta, “Izarei zawpi zydua hnohta, ‘ Abeipa hmiakô lâ a vaw hnia teh u, nama paphôhnazy a thei haw,’ tahpa ta kei chho teh,” tah ta.
Arawna ta Izarei zawpi hnohta bie a rei hai nota, râhchawhpa lâ sai ei ta, Abeipa rônahna meihdo liata a vaw lâ ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,

“Izarei sawzy paphôhna ei thei haw. Chavâta ama hnohta, ‘Zâlâ sa nie aw ei chi ta, mylâ viahchhâ rih biena taih nama nie aw. Chatanachata kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa ei châ tahpa nama pahno aw,’ tahpa ta chho mah y,” tah ta.
Zâlâ ta ama riehmo biena taihta mamo a vaw zaw ei ta, a mylâ ta ama riehmo chheipâh liata diati thata tla ta.
Diati a hi nahta, râhchawhpa alei chô liata chhâmeih papa a lyupa hmo chyhpata, dâhaw tlaw tiepa vaw y hôlô ta.

Cha cha Izarei sawzy ta ama hmô nahta, khâpa ma a châ tahpa ama pahno leipa vâta, “He he khâpa ma a châ tly?” tahpa ta âmo nata âmo a hiahri ei ta. Mawsi ta ama hnohta, “He he viahchhâ a châ, Abeipa ta nama nie awpa a cha piepa ei a châ hih.

He he Abeipa ta, ‘Chyhsa to ta ama nie khi chyu ta a huah ei sala, chyhsa pakha châta saikhua hmo kha lymâ ta a huahpa ta, nama poh o liata chyhsa a ypa zie lymâ hawhta namâ huah awpa a châ,’ tahpa ta bie a piepa kha a châ,” tah ta.
Izarei sawzy ta cha hawhna chata tao ei ta, thokha a hluh via a huah ei ta, thokha a chyh via amâ huah.
Saikhua ta ama panua nahta deikua cha, a hluh via a huahpa ta laibâhpa hnei leipa ta, a chyh via a huahpa ta a phahla hlei vei. Chyhsa to ama nie khi chyu ta amâ huah khai.
Mawsi ta ama hnohta, “Ahy hmahta mylâ châta a khai khuh vy,” tah ta.
Châhrasala Mawsi bie cha nathlie khoh leipa ei ta. Thokha ta a mylâ châta a so ei ta, alôpa vaw y ta, a roh thata chhie ta, Mawsi cha ama chô liata a hiehâh kaw ta.
Chavâta my chareih chyhsa to ama nie khi chyu lymâ ta a huah tyh ei ta, noh a vaw sa nahta deikua cha, alei liata mânâzy cha a zao khai ha tyh.
A noh charuna noh ta viahchhâ cha a lie no ta, chyhsa pakha châta saikhua hmo no lymâ ta a huah ei ta. Zawpi ryureituhpazy ta, cha hmo cha Mawsi chho ei ta.

Mawsi ta, “He he Abeipa biepiepa a châ: ‘Mylâ cha a pahâna noh, noh ziehpa, Abeipa châta Pahânoh pathaihpa a châ aw. Chavâta pakâh awpazy cha pakâh u la, chho awpazy chhoh u la, a laibâhpa zydua mylâ châta namâ so aw,’” tah ta.
Mawsi biepiepa hawhta a mylâ taihta soh ei ta, châhrasala a roh chhie leipa ta alôpa chhao thla hra vei.
Mawsi ta, “Tanoh cha he he nie teh u, tanoh cha Abeipa châta Pahânoh a châ hih. Tanoh la alei liata a tlapa hmô aw veih ei chi.
Noh charu chhôh a huah tyh aw ei chi ta, a noh sarina noh deikua cha Pahânoh châ ta, a hua awpa y khao aw vei,” tah ta.
Chyhsa thokha cha noh sarina noh ta a huah awpa ta pua ei ta, châhrasala a hua awpa rai hmô veih ei.
Chatawhcha Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Khachâ ma ei biepiepazy nata ei ryhpazy he a py khoh leipa ta nama y aw?

Pachâ teh u, Abeipa ta Pahânoh cha pie ei ta, chavâta noh charuna noh ta, noh no a khi awpa viahchhâ a cha pie ei. Chyhsa to âmo su chyu liata y khai mawh ei sy. Noh sarina noh cha ahy hmahta a yna su tawhta khô pua cheita khah sy,” tah ta.
Chatanachata noh sarina noh liata cha Izarei phopi amâ pahâ khai haw.
Izarei pathlazy ta viahchhâ cha a moh mânâ bi ei ta. Mânâ cha sysadi chi hawhta dieh ta, a pahânazie cha kheihti pahlaopa viahchhâ hawhta a châ.

Mawsi ta, “He he Abeipa biepiepa a châ: ‘Nama chhâ vaw y lymâ awpa châta mânâ he saikhua hmo kha la u la namâ so awpa a châ. Chatanachata Izi râh tawhta ei châ chhi papua nona ei ta, râhchawhpa liata nâmo ei cha pasana viahchhâ kha âmo chhao ta ama vaw hmô thei hra aw,’” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Mawsi ta Arawna hnohta, “Beih miakha la la, mânâ khôna saikhua kha a chhôh liata khô la, nama chhâ zydua ta chhy lymâ awpa ta Abeipa hmiakô liata soh mah y,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi bie a piepa hawhna chata, Arawna ta saikhua khôna beih cha Biehrai Byh hmiakô liata soh ta.
Izarei sawzy ta ama pahrâ nawpa râh ama tlô hlâlei cha, kô sypalih chhôh râhchawhpa liata mânâ nie ei ta, Kâna râhri ama tlô hlâlei cha mânâ ama nie lymâ.
Saikhua hmo kha cha kachu su hrawh su kha a châ.
Izarei zawpizy cha Sini râhchawhpa tawhta pua heih ei ta, Abeipa biepiepa hawhta a paty paty ta riehmo taopa ta sie lymâ ei ta, Rephidi liata a rie ei ta, cha liata zawpi châta ti do awpa y leipa ta.
Chavâta zawpi ta Mawsi cha a hryuh ei ta, “Ti do awpa miah pie teh,” tah ei ta. Mawsi ta ama hnohta, “Khazia einâ hryuh ei chi, khazia Abeipa nama pasia,” tah ta.

Zawpizy cha ama dâhphi ngaita ta, Mawsi chô liata paphôh ei ta, a hnohta, “Khazia keimo nata eima sawzy nata eima sahrohzy he dâhphipa ta miah thie awpa ta Izi râh tawhta miah nâ kaw chhi papua?” tah ei ta.
Mawsi cha Abeipa pado ta, a hnohta, “He chyhsazy heta alô ta na vawhsao awpa a mâ thlâh ha bâ ei ta, kheihta ei tao aw ei?” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Zawpizy hmia lâta sie la, Izarei machâ thokha na hnohta a chhi la, Nile chavah na tuna chôchahrei kha na ku liata chabapa ta sie mah y.

Hôribâ liata lôpanô chô liata na hmiakô liata a vaw duah aw na ta, lôpanô cha tu aw chi ta, cha tawhta zawpi do awpa ti a vaw pua aw,” tah ta. Mawsi ta Izarei machâzy mohmô liata cha hawhna chata tao ta.
Izarei sawzy paphôhna vâta nata, “Eima hry liata Abeipa a y ma, y vei ma?” tahpa ta Abeipa ama pasiapa vâta, cha su cha a moh Mâsâ nata Meribâ a bi.
Chatawhcha Amale mo a vy ei ta, Izarei mo cha Rephidi liata a vaw dyuh ei ta.
Mawsi ta Zawsua hnohta, “Eima hry tawhta chapaw thokha a tlyh la, pua u la, Amale mo a kei dyuh teh u. Khazohpa chôchahrei chabapa ta, mylâ tlâh laki liata ei vaw duah aw,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta a chhopa hawhta, Zawsua ta Amale mo cha a dyuh ta. Cha nota Mawsi, Arawna nata Hurâ zy cha tlâh laki lâ kiah ei ta.
Mawsi ta a ku a pazawh chhôh cha Izarei mo ta pahnie lymâ ei ta, a ku a pathliah nahta, Amale mo ta ama pahnie ha tyh.

Châhrasala Mawsi kuzy cha vaw si ha ta, chavâta alô la ei ta, a kiapâh liata soh ei ta, cha liata a tyuh ta. Arawna nata Hurâ ta a ku cha dei ei ta, pakha ta hiakha la dei ta, pakha ta hia kha lâ a dei. Cha hawhna chata noh tlana taihta a kuzy cha a pazawh ualua ta pazawh thlâh ha ta.
Chatanachata Zawsua ta Amale nata a sahlaozy cha zaozi ta a pahnie ha ei.

Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “He bie he a theih thlâh ha awpa ta, châbu liata roh la, Zawsua nah theina liata reih mah y. Amale mo he avâ ry liata ama y hra tahpa chyhsa ta ama pahno khao leina taihta ei pahleipadia khai aw ei,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Mawsi ta maisâh tao ta, a moh Zehôvâh Nisi a bi.
Mawsi ta, “Amale cha Abeipa beidyuchhai chô liata a ku a hypa vâta, chhâ a vaw y lymâ awpa zydua liata Abeipa ta â dyuh lymâ aw,” tah ta.
Khazohpa ta a phopi Izarei sawzy nata Mawsi chô liata a hmotaopa zydua nata Abeipa ta Izarei sawzy Izi râh tawhta â kaw chhi papuazie zy cha, Midia theihthaipa, Mawsi puhpa Zetharô ta vaw thei ta.
Mawsi ta a lapinô Zipôrâ cha o lâ padisa chy ta, Mawsi puhpa Zetharô ta Zipôrâ cha,
a sawchapaw panozy chhaota a o liata paysa ta. A sawchapaw pakhapa cha, Mawsi ta, “Chyhsa râh liata khichhaipa ta ei y,”tah ta a moh Kesao a bipa kha châ ta,
ahropa cha, “Nâ pathlatuhpa Khazohpa cha nâ baotuhpa a châ, Phiraoh zaozi tawhta eina pachha haw,” tah ta, a moh Elieze a bipa kha a châ.
Mawsi puhpa Zetharô cha, Mawsi lapinô nata a sawchapawzy chhaota râhchawhpa liata Khazohpa tlâh liata Mawsi riehmo lâ vawh ta.
Mawsi hnohta, “Kei, na puhpa Zetharô, na lapinô nata na sawchapaw panozy chhaota nâ lâ ei vy hai,” tahpa ta bieta ta.
Mawsi cha a puhpa dy awpa ta pua ta, a bôh ta, a pahnâ ta. Thâtihzy a hiahri raihrie ei ta, poh o chhôh lâ a ngia ei ta.
Izarei mo vâta Abeipa ta Phiraoh nata Izi mo chô liata a taopa zydua zy, lâpi liata rairuna amâ tyhpa zydua zy, Abeipa ta Izarei sawzy a pachhazie zy, Mawsi ta a puhpa cha chho ta.
Abeipa ta Izarei sawzy chô liata hmo phapa a taopa zydua vâta nata Izi mo ku tawhta Izarei sawzy a pachha hapa vâ ei ta, Zetharô cha a ly ngaita ta.
Zetharô ta, “Izi mo ku tawhta nata Phiraoh ku tawhta nâma châ pachhatuhpa nata Izarei sawzy Izi mo ku tawhta a pachhatuhpa Abeipa cha reithaipa ta y mawh sy!
Tahmâ la Abeipa he khazoh zydua hlâta rônah viapa a châzie ei pahno haw. Izarei phopi chô liata a palai ngaitapazy chô liata a hmotaozie tawhta â lâ haw,” tah ta.
Mawsi puhpa Zetharô cha raopa hlâna nata Khazohpa lâta atheihnazy vaw cheih ta, Mawsi puhpa hnohta Khazohpa hmiakô liata viahchhâ nie awpa ta, Arawna nata Izarei machâ zydua a vy ei ta.
A mylâ ta Mawsi cha zawpi biepeipazy pachia awpa ta a tyuh ta, zawpizy cha my tawhta zâlâ taihta Mawsi chadôpa ta a duah ei ta.

Mawsi puhpa ta zawpi châta Mawsi hmotaopa zydua a hmô nahta, a hnohta, “Zawpi châta khâpa hmo ma na taopa ei? Khazia nâma dei ta a tyuh chi ta, my tawhta zâlâ taihta chyhsa zydua na kiapâh liata amâ duah thlâh haw?” tah ta.
Mawsi ta a puhpa hnohta, “Zawpizy he Khazohpa a saohiah awpa ta kei lâ a vypa ama châ.
Biepeipa ama hnei tita, kei lâ a vykhei ei ta, kei ta ama likah bie cha pachiapa ei na ta, Khazohpa bieraopa nata a ryhpazy ei pahnosa tyh ei,” tah ta.
A puhpa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Na hmotaozie he pha vei.
Nâ nata na hnohta a ypa zawpizy he nama tha namâ pachhâ khai pathlei aw. He raihria he na châta a hri tu ha ta, nâma dei ta hria khai thei aw va chi.
Ei bie nathlie mah y, ryh ei cha raokhei aw. Na hnohta Khazohpa y mawh sy! Zawpi vyuhpa ta Khazohpa hmiakô liata nâ a duah aw chi ta, biepeipazy cha Khazohpa lâ na tlôkhei tyh aw.
Bieraopazy nata ryhpazy âmo pachu aw chi ta, ama lâpi a chhih awpa nata ama tao awpazy na pahmô lymâ aw ei.

Cha thota, chyhsa hmâ tlâhpa, Khazohpa a chipa, ngâchhihpa nata avyuhna a haopa chyhsazy zawpi hry tawhta a tlyh aw chi ta, âmo cha sâh kha chô liata hyutuhpa ta zy, za kha chô liata hyutuhpa ta zy, sypangawh chô liata hyutuhpa ta zy, pahrawh chô liata hyutuhpazy ta na rao aw ei.

Âmo chata zawpizy cha pachia aw ei ta, bie ru viapa maih nâ lâ vaw tlôkhei aw ei ta, bie chynawhpazy cha âmo ta ama pachia lymâ aw. Chatanachata na châta nao via aw ta, na phaohri ama cha chapawh ha aw.
Cha hawhta tao awpa ta Khazohpa ta bie cha pie ta, cha hawhta na tao khiahta cha, tlyuh aw chi ta, zawpi zydua chhao he, thlalôhpa ta ama o lâ amâ di thei aw,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta a puhpa biereipa cha a pyh ta, a reipa zydua hawhta tao khai ta.

Mawsi ta Izarei saw zydua hry tawhta hmâ tlâhpa chyhsazy a tlyh ta, âmo cha Izarei phopi hyutuhpazy ta tao ta, a sâh chô liata hyutuhpa ta zy, a za chô liata hyutuhpa ta zy, sypangawh chô liata hyutuhpa ta zy nata pahrawh chô liata hyutuhpa zy ta a rao ei.
Âmo chata zawpi cha pachia ei ta, bie rupa maih Mawsi lâ tlôkhei ei ta, bie chynawhpa deikua cha, âmo ta ama pachia lymâ.
Chatawhcha Mawsi ta a puhpa cha pathlie ta, a puhpa Zetharô cha a râh lâ a lie lilaw ha heih ta.
Izarei sawzy Izi râh tawhta ama pua tawhta a thla thôhna, cha noh liana tlai chata Sinai râhchawhpa tlô ei ta.
Rephidi tawhta pua ei ta, Sinai râhchawhpa tlô ei ta, râhchawhpa liana cha riehmo paryh ei ta. Izarei mo cha, cha liata tlâh thaby liata riehmo paryh ei ta.
Mawsi cha Khazohpa lâ khy ta, Abeipa ta tlâh tawhta bie a vaw chho ta, a hnohta, “Zakaw chhôhkhazy hnohta hetana heta reih la, Izarei sawzy hnohta hetana heta chho mah y:
‘Izi mo chô liata ei hmotaozie nata pahmôhpi mathlaw ta cha phaoh ei na ta, kei lâta ei châ chhipa ei kha nâmo tlai ta nama hmôpa kha a châ.
Chavâta tahmâ pakhâta ta ei bie nathliepa ta, ei biehrai nama zyh khiahta cha, khizaw phopi zydua hry liata ei ryuto eihpa nama châ aw, khizaw zydua he kei eih châ tlôh ta.
Chatanachata ei châta theihthaipa khinarâh châ aw ei chi ta, phopi pathaihpa nama châ aw.’ Chazy cha Izarei sawzy hnohta na rei awpa biezy cha a châ,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Mawsi cha zu ta, Izarei phopi machâzy awpakhy ta, Abeipa ta bie a piepa zydua ama hmiakô liata reih ta.
Zawpi zydua ta, “ Abeipa reipa zydua cha eima tao lymâ aw,” tahpa ta â raohpa ta a chhy ei ta. Mawsi ta zawpi biereipazy cha Abeipa chho ta.

Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Pachâ teh, bie ei cha chho tita zawpi ta ama thei thei nawpa nata chhâzaw ta ama cha zo thei nawpa ta, meihdo chhakaluhpa hry liata nâ lâ ei vy aw,” tah ta. Chatawhcha Mawsi ta zawpi bie reipazy cha Abeipa chho ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Zawpi lâ vawh la, âmo cha tanoh nata mylâ kei pathaisa mah y. Ama chysiazy pasu ei sala,
a noh thôhna noh châta a pachyh mawh ei sy. A noh thôhna noh ta chyhsa zydua mohmô ta Sinai Tlâh liata Abeipa a za chô aw.
Zawpi châta râhri pakhâh aw chi ta, ama hnohta, ‘A chado teh u. Tlâh lâ kiah leipa u la, râhri chhao hria cheita khuh vy. Ahy rai tlâh a hriapa maih cha thie thlyu awpa a châ.

Ku ta thie awpa châ leipa ta, alô ta vaw sao awpa a châ. A châ vei khiahta cha, li ta kasao awpa a châ. Sa rai, chyhsapa rai, a hroh awpa châ vei. Chiahmie a paro tita, tlâh lâ amâ khy awpa a châ,’ tahpa ta na chho aw ei,” tah ta.
Mawsi cha tlâh tawhta zawpi lâ zu ta, zawpi cha pathaisa ta. Ama chysiazy pasu ei ta.
Mawsi ta zawpi hnohta, “A noh thôhna noh châta a pachyh teh u, chanô rai namâ hnia awpa châ vei,” tah ta.

A noh thôhna noh my ta tôkalôh a vaw thua ta, dôhlazy vaw pathlie ta, tlâh chô liata meihdo chhakaluhpa a vaw chhoh ta, chiahmie paro ngaitapa vaw paro ta, riehmo liata a ypa chyhsa zydua cha a chalyu ei ta.
Mawsi ta zawpizy cha Khazohpa a tyh awpa ta riehmo tawhta a chhi papua ta. Zawpizy cha tlâh thaby liata a duah ei ta.
Abeipa ta Sinai Tlâh liata mei ta a za chôpa vâta, tlâh cha meikhuh ta pahly khai ha ta. Cha meikhuh cha patina meikhuh hawh tlai ta avâ lâ kiah ta, a tlâh duata thata a chalyu ta.
Chiahmie pyu cha paro via rili ta. Chatawhcha Mawsi ta bie vaw reih ta, Khazohpa ao ta a vaw chhy ta.
Abeipa cha Sinai Tlâh laki liata za chô ta. Abeipa ta Mawsi cha tlâh laki lâ khy awpa ta aw ta, chatanachata Mawsi cha khy ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Zu la, zawpi khu zikyu zâ râ mah y. Chataleipatala Abeipa hmia hmô a chhuahpa ta vaw chatôh aw ei ta, chyhsa hluhpi ama leidia pathlei aw.
Abeipa a hnia tyhpa theihthaipazy chhao a pathai hra mawh ei sy. Chataleipatala Abeipa ta âmo chhao a pahleipadia pathlei aw ei,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta Abeipa hnohta, nâma tlai ta, “Zawpi cha Sinai Tlâh lâ a khy thei aw veih ei, ‘Tlâh thaby liata râhri pakhâh u la, pathaisa teh u,’ tahpa ta zikyu miah nâ râ ha kha zaw,” tah ta.

Abeipa ta a hnohta, “Zu la, na hnohta Arawna a kaw chhi la, a khy heih mah y. Theihthaipazy nata zawpizy deikua cha, Abeipa lâ a vy awpa ta ama vaw chatôh pathlah awpa châ vei. Chataleipatala Abeipa ta âmo a chatôh pathlah pathlei aw ei,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Mawsi cha zawpi lâ zu ta, cha biezy cha âmo za chho ta.
Chatawhcha Khazohpa ta he biezy he reih ta.
“Kei he Abeipa na Khazohpa, Izi râh, seichâna o tawhta châ chhi papuatuhpa ei châ.
“Keima leipa ta khazoh hropazy na hnei awpa châ vei.

“Na châta nothlahpa khazoh na tao awpa châ vei. Chô lâ avâ liatapa a lyupa tlyma, ry lâ alei liatapa a lyupa tlyma, alei ry lâta ti liatapa a lyupa tlyma, kheihawhpa nothlahpa khazoh hmah na châta na tao awpa châ vei.

Chazy cha nâ chhy awpa châ leipa ta, na chakao awpa châ hra vei. Kei Abeipa na Khazohpa he, Khazoh hiatlia pasapa châ na ta, pawzy paraona vâta sawzy a hrie tyhpa ei châ. Nâ haotuhpazy cha chhâ thôhna nata chhâ palihna taihta a hrie tyhpa châ na ta,
kyh na pachâ ta, ei biepiepazy a zyhtuhpa sâh hluhpizy chô liata deikua cha, ngiachhiena a palâsa tyhpa ei châ.
“ Abeipa na Khazohpa moh na reih thlâhthli awpa châ vei. Abeipa ta a moh a reih thlâhthlipa cha thailei a pachâsa aw.
“Pahânoh a thei thlâh ha aw chi ta, na pathaisa awpa a châ.
Noh charu chhôh rai hria aw chi ta, na rai zydua na hria aw.

A noh sarina noh deikua cha, Abeipa na Khazohpa châta Pahânoh a châ. Cha noh liata cha, nâ chhao, na sawchapaw chhao, na sawchanô chhao, na seichapaw chhao, na seichanô chhao, na sahroh nata na o liata chihropa a ypazy ta khâpa rai hmah nama hria awpa châ vei.
Noh charu chhôh ta Abeipa ta avâ nata alei, tilaipi nata a chhôh liata a ypa zydua tao ta, noh sarina noh cha â pahâpa vâta, Abeipa ta Pahânoh cha byhnâ pie ta a pathaisa.
“Na nô nata na paw palyupalih teh. Chatanachata Abeipa na Khazohpa ta râh a cha piepa liata na hro a pareih aw.
Liany na chei awpa châ vei.
Nâ phei awpa châ vei.
Na paru awpa châ vei.
Haipa ta na vaih na leih awpa châ vei.

“Na vaih o na uahva awpa châ vei. Na vaih lapinô na uahva awpa châ leipa ta, a seichapaw tlyma, a seichanô tlyma, a viahchao tôhpa tlyma, a alâ tlyma, na vaih hmo kheihawhpa rai na uahva awpa châ vei,” tah ta.
Chyhsa zydua ta tôkalôhpa, dôhla, chiahmie pyu nata tlâh liata meikhuh zy cha ama hmô nahta, chipa ta a chalyu ei ta, lâhlapi liata a duah ei ta.
Mawsi hnohta, “Nâ ta eima hnohta bie vaw reih la, eima nathlie aw. Khazohpa eima hnohta bie pareisa khao khah y. Chataleipatala eima thi pathlei aw na,” tah ei ta.
Mawsi ta zawpi hnohta, “Chi khuh vy. Cha pasia awpa ei ta Khazohpa â vy hih. Nama molei lei nawpa ta, Khazohpa china nâmo liata y mawh sy,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta Khazohpa yna meihdo chha kaluhpa cha a kei hnia ta, zawpizy deikua cha lâhlapi liata a duah ei ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Izarei sawzy hnohta hetana heta reih teh: ‘Vârâh tawhta bie ei cha zâ chhopa ei kha, nâmo tlai ta nama hmô haw.
Keima leipa ta khazoh hropazy nama hnei awpa châ vei. Tâkâ khazohzy tlyma, ngôh khazohzy tlyma, nâmo châta nama tao awpa châ vei.

Keima châta alei maisâh tao aw chi ta, cha chô liana chata nâma châta raopa atheihnazy nata aryhna atheihnazy châta na mietakuzy nata na viahchaozy na hlâ tyh aw. Ei moh a thei thlâh ha nawpa ta ei raona su maih liata na hnohta a vy aw na ta, byhnâ ei cha awpa tyh aw.
Alô maisâh eina taopa khiah chi ta cha, alô khaipa ta na tao awpa châ vei. Alô khaipa ta na tao khiahta cha, na chhaichhi na hmâpa ta maisâh cha a papuapalei aw.
Maisâh chô liata na thluahruana â lâ lei nawpa ta, chhâhchabi tlypa ta ei maisâh lâ na kia awpa châ vei.’
“Hezy he ama châta ryhpa na tao awpazy a châ.
Hebrai chyhsa sei ta na chalei khiahta cha, kô charu cha chakao aw ta, a kô sari kô liata, chatlaina ty y leipa ta a pua awpa a châ.
Ano dei ta a vaw ngiapa a châ khiahta cha, ano dei ta pua aw ta, lapinô chhao ta a vaw ngiapa a châ khiahta cha, a lapinô chhao a hnohta a pua hra aw.
A zibeipa ta lapinô hiapa sala, sawchapawzy nata sawchanôzy a sapa khiahta cha, a lapi nata sawzy cha a zibeipa eih châ aw ei ta, ano dei ta a pua aw.
Châhrasala sei chata, ‘Ei lapi nata ei sawzy he kyhpachâ ngaita ei na ta, pua aw va na,’ tah sala, bie siapa a reih ha khiahta cha,
a zibeipa ta Khazohpa lâ â chhi aw. Ochhi liata tlyma, ochhi tôh liata tlyma paduasapa ta, a zibeipa ta thua pazaopa ta a nakao vieh aw ta, chatanachata a zibeipa cha chhâzaw ta a chakao aw.
“Chyhsa ta a sawchanô sei ta a zuah khiahta cha, seichapawzy puazie hawhta ano cha pua aw vei.

A zibeipa ta ano cha a lapinô châta hnei sala, châhrasala a zibeipa ta a khoh khao vei khiahta cha, ano cha chatlai awpa ta a paryhsa awpa a châ. A seichanô a dôveipa vâta, chihropa hnohta zua theina biehneina a chô liata hnei vei.
A sawchapaw lapinô châta â tlyh khiahta cha, seichanô cha a sawchanô hawhta a moh awpa a châ.
Lapinô hropa a hnei heihpa chhao ta, lapinô ta a hneipa seichanô châna chata a nie awpa pati nata a chysia nata nôvah likah akaona zy a pachyh via awpa châ vei.
Cha hmo miathôhpazy cha a taopa leipa khiahta cha, sôh ta a chatlai byuh leipa ta a pua thei aw.
“Chyhsa tu ta a thiepa cha, ano chhao thie thlyu awpa a châ.
Thie a chhuahpa ta â byhpa vâta châ leipa ta, Khazohpa ta ano ku liata thi awpa ta a raopa a châ ha khiahta deikua cha, a thietuhpa châta â râ nawpa su ei raopa aw.

Châhrasala chyhsa ta achhuahna hneipa ta a vaih chô liata ku pathla sala, piehpiepa ta a vaih cha a thie khiahta cha, cha chyhsa cha abohna tluapa ta ei maisâh lâ â râpa chhao ta, cha tawhta la papua aw chi ta, a thi awpa a châ.
“A nô tlyma, a paw tlyma a tupa cha, thie awpa a châ.
“Chyhsapa a parupa cha, a zuah hapa chhao ta nata ano ku liata a y nota hmôpa a châpa chhao ta, cha chyhsa cha thie thlyu awpa a châ.
“A nô chô liata tlyma, a paw chô liata tlyma chhie a sapa cha, thie thlyu awpa a châ.
“Chyhsa a hryuh ei sala, pakha ta â tulâhpa cha alô ta tlyma, a kutô ta tlyma a chô sala, thi leipa ta, châhrasala a rakhô liata a ziakheina taihta châ sala,

vaw thyu heih theipa ta, chôchahrei a chhypa ta a sie thei heih khiahta cha, a chôtuhpa cha pathaih aw ta, a hmahphaopa vâta a daihti a pahleipa vyuhpa thô aw ta, a tlâh pasiana taihta a mohôh awpa a châ.
“Chyhsa ta a seichapaw tlyma, a seichanô tlyma, chôchahrei ta tu sala, ano ku liata a thi khiahta cha, cha chyhsa cha hrie thlyu awpa a châ.
Châhrasala sei cha noh kha khai tawhta tlyma, noh no khai tawhta tlyma a kaw thyu heih thei khiahta cha, sei cha a sôh a châpa vâta, cha chyhsa cha hrie awpa châ vei.

“Chyhsa amâ tu nota, chanô nawh hneipa tu pathlei ha ei sala, a nawh rao sala, pasana hropa deikua a y leipa khiahta cha, chanô vahpa ta a pacheisa awpa zie reih aw ta, ryureituhpazy paryhsapa hawhta a cheih awpa a châ.
Raona hropa a y khiahta deikua cha, hrona vyuhpa ta hrona,
mo vyuhpa ta mo, hâh vyuhpa ta hâh, ku vyuhpa ta ku, phei vyuhpa ta phei,
mei kâpa vyuhpa ta mei kâpa, hmah vyuhpa ta hmah, tu vyuhpa ta tupa ta na hrie awpa a châ.
“Chyhsa ta a seichapaw mo liata tlyma, a seichanô mo liata tlyma tu sala, a mo a parao khiahta cha, a mo a parao hapa vâta, sei cha a papua awpa a châ.
A seichapaw hâh tlyma, a seichanô hâh tlyma a palaosa khiahta cha, a hâh a palaosapa vâta, sei cha a papua awpa a châ.
“Viahchao tôhpa ta chapaw tlyma, chanô tlyma a daihsao khiahta cha, cha viahchao tôhpa cha alô ta vawhsao thlyu awpa châ ta, a sa nie awpa châ vei. Viahchao tôhpa hneituhpa deikua a pathaih aw.

Châhrasala viahchao tôhpa cha, cha hlâ tawhta chyhsa a vaw daih tyhpa châ sala, a hneituhpa chhao zikyu a râ hapa châ ta, châhrasala hraikhôh leipa ta, chapaw tlyma, chanô tlyma a daihsao khiahta cha, cha viahchao tôhpa cha alô ta vawhsao awpa châ ta, a hneituhpa chhao thie awpa a châ.
Ama chatlaisa khiahta cha, a luh ty chei awpa tupa zie a pie awpa a châ.
Chapaw hawti tlyma, chanô hawti tlyma, a daihsao khiahta cha, cha pachiazie hawhna chata a chô liata pachia awpa a châ.
Viahchao tôhpa ta seichapaw tlyma, seichanô tlyma a daihsao khiahta cha, viahchao hneituhpa ta seizy zibeipa hnohta tâkâ sekel sythôh pie aw ta, viahchao tôhpa cha alô ta vawhsao awpa a châ.
“Chyhsa ta khaohtlô chhiehruh pahy sala tlyma, chyhsa ta khaohtlô chao ta chhiehruh leipa sala tlyma, viahchao tôhpa tlyma, alâ tlyma, cha khaohtlô liata a tla khiahta cha,
khaohtlô hneituhpa ta a thô awpa a châ. Sahroh hneituhpa hnohta tâkâ pie aw ta, sahroh thipa cha ano ta a to aw.
“Chyhsa viahchao tôhpa ta chyhsa hropa viahchao tôhpa a daihsao khiahta cha, viahchao tôhpa hrohpa cha zuah aw ei ta, a ty amâ rai aw. Viahchao tôhpa a thipa chhao amâ rai aw.

Viahchao tôhpa chata, cha hlâ tawh chhao ta vaw daih tyh ta, châhrasala hneituhpa ta a hraikhôh leipa khiahta cha, viahchao tôhpa vyuhpa ta viahchao tôhpa lilaw pie aw ta, sahroh thipa cha ano ta a to aw.

“Chyhsa ta viahchao tôhpa tlyma, mietaku tlyma paru sala, a thie khiahta tlyma, a zuah khiahta tlyma, viahchao tôhpa pô kha vyuhpa ta viahchao tôhpa pô pangawh thô aw ta, mietaku pô kha vyuhpa ta mietaku pô palih a thô aw.
“Parutuhpa cha chyhsa o a ngiapa ta a paru hai nota hmôpa châ sala, tusaopa a châ khiahta cha, a tusaotuhpa chô liata thisaih maoh y aw vei.

Noh a chhi tawhta tusaopa a châ khiahta deikua cha, a thisaih maoh a y aw. Parutuhpa cha a hmo parupazy a thô awpa châ ta, khâpa hmah a hnei vei khiahta cha, a parupa thô nawpa ta ano zuah awpa a châ.
“Parupa viahchao tôhpa tlyma, alâ tlyma, mietaku tlyma, parutuhpa ku liata ahrohpa ta hmôpa a châ khiahta cha, a lie no ta a thô awpa a châ.

“Chyhsa ta chyhsa hropa lyu liata tlyma, kre sadô liata tlyma, a sahroh lao a pabâsa raruah khiahta tlyma, a sahroh pathliepa ta chyhsa lyu a pabâsa khiahta cha, ano lyu pha chaipa nata ano kre sadô pha chaipazy ta a thô awpa a châ.
“Chyhsa ta mei pakâ sala, ahloh buhzy lâta kâ laihpa ta, sapiahzy tlyma, sâh a duahpa tlyma, lyu tlyma, a kâ khiahta cha, mei pakâtuhpa ta a mâ zydua a thô thlyu awpa a châ.
“Chyhsa ta a tâkâ tlyma, a hmo tlyma, a vaih pavaosa sala, cha o tawhta chyhsa ta paru sala, parutuhpa cha hmôpa a châ khiahta cha, a lie no ta a thô awpa a châ.
Parutuhpa hmôpa a châ vei khiahta cha, parupa sôh avaotuhpa o hneituhpa cha Khazohpa a hnia aw ta, a vaih hmo cha ano ku ta a la nata la lei pasiapa a châ aw.

“Parupa hmo maih, viahchao tôhpa tlyma, alâ tlyma, mietaku tlyma, chysia tlyma, hmo leipa khâpa rai, chyhsa ta, ‘He he kei eih a châ,’ a tah khiahta cha, ama pano likah biepeipa cha, Khazohpa hnohta tlôkheipa châ aw ta, Khazohpa ta thailei a pachâsapa ta a lie no ta a vaih cha a thô awpa a châ.

“Chyhsa ta alâ tlyma, viahchao tôhpa tlyma, mietaku tlyma, sahroh kheihawhpa rai, a vaih pamokhâhsa sala, athipa ta tlyma, hmahphaopa ta tlyma, hraopa ta tlyma vaw y sala, a hmôpa ama y vei khiahta cha,

a mokhâhtuhpa cha a vaih sahroh a hria nata hria lei pasia nawpa ta, Abeipa moh reipa ta ama pano likah liata chhie a sakhâh aw ei ta, hneituhpa ta chhie amâ sakhâhna bie hawhta a pyh aw ta, mokhâhtuhpa ta thô aw vei.
A parupa tlai a châ khiahta deikua cha, hneituhpa hnohta a thô awpa a châ.
Sa ta a taipa a châ khiahta cha, pasia nawpa ta sa zômeihpa vaw cheih aw ta, sa taipa sahroh vyuhpa cha thô aw vei.
“Chyhsa ta a vaih sahroh a hlâh sala, hmaphaohpa ta tlyma, athipa ta tlyma vaw y sala, cha nota sahroh hneituhpa â hlao vei khiahta cha, a thô thlyu awpa a châ.
Hneituhpa â hlao khiahta deikua cha, thô aw vei. A mâ hneipa ta a hlâpa a châ khiahta cha, â hlâna mâ nata sahroh pahleipa mâ panâhpa a châ aw.
“Chyhsa ta lapinô châta a pahawh leipa laihsa reipasao sala, â ziakhei khiahta cha, nômâ pie aw ta, a lapinô ta a hnei thlyu awpa a châ.
Chanô paw ta a pahneisa khoh ngâsâ leipa khiahta cha, laihsa kôpazy nômâ zie sôh a pie pyly awpa a châ.
“Dyuthaipa chanô na pahlôh awpa châ vei.
“Sahroh a ziakheipa cha thie thlyu awpa a châ.
“ Abeipa lâta châ leipa ta, khazoh hropa lâta atheihna a hlâpa cha, pahleipadia awpa a châ.
“Chihropa chô liata adoleipa ta na tao awpa châ leipa ta, ano cha na tlybai awpa châ hra vei. Nâmo chhao Izi râh liata chihropa nama châ hrapa kha.
Nôhmei nata hârazy ama rie nama pathei awpa châ vei.
Ama rie pathei u la, eina awsao khiah ei ta cha, ama awna ao thei aw na ta,
ei pathi thata ia aw ta, zaozi ta ei cha thie aw ei. Chatanachata nama lapinôzy nôhmei châ aw ei ta, nama sawzy hârapa ta ama y aw.
“Ei phopi chyhsa na kiapâh liata a ypa dyhchhiepa hnohta na sôh na pahmâsa khiahta cha, sôh dyu a pacheisapa chyhsa hawhta a pachâ leipa la, apôhna na haw awpa châ vei.
“Na vaih poh sôhkâ ta na lapa khiahta cha, noh tla hlâta na pie heih awpa a châ.
A chhâpa cha, cha poh cha a bu awpa a hnei chhôhpa, a pôhpa liata â bu awpa poh châ ta, khâpa a bupa ta ma â mô aw? Kei cha ngiachhiena a hneipa châ tlôh na ta, chavâta eina awsao tita ei thei aw.
“Khazohpa na rei pachhie awpa châ leipa ta, na phopi ryureituhpa chô liata bie pha leipa na reih awpa châ vei.
“Na kôvei tawhta nata na kresawhti saohpazy tawhta hlâ awpazy na pahawhpasâh awpa châ vei. Na sawchapawzy hry liata a pih tua chaipa cha, kei eina pie aw chi.
Cha hawhna chata, na viahchao tôhpazy nata na mietakuzy chhao na tao aw. Noh sari chhôh a panô hnohta y aw ta, a noh chariena noh ta kei lâta na vaw hlâ aw.
“Ei chyhsa pathaihpa nama châ awpa a châ. Chavâta lyurâhpa liata arie ta a taipa sa nama nie awpa châ vei. Cha hawhpa cha i nama thy awpa a châ.
“Bie pathâhpa doleipa na rei pachhuah awpa châ vei. Pahnokheituhpa haiphiahpa châ awpa ta, moleipa hry liata nâ hlao awpa châ vei.
Hmo moleipa taona liata zawpi na zi awpa châ leipa ta, biepeipa pachiana liata bie pahnotuhpa ta nâ dua tita, ryureina dopa tleisai awpa ta zawpi na zi awpa châ vei.
“Dyhchhiepa ta biepeipa hnei sala, dyhchhiepa a châpa vâta na khokhei via awpa châ vei.
“Na khakhaipa viahchao tôhpa a leipa tlyma, alâ a leipa tlyma na hmô khiahta cha, ano lâ nâ chhi ha awpa a châ.
Châ haotuhpa alâ cha a hmophao ta vipa ta, â hluah thlâh hapa na hmô khiahta cha, na siesai awpa châ vei. A hmophao pathlâpa aw chi ta, alâ cha na padua ha awpa a châ.
“Dyhchhiepa cha a biepeipa pachiana liata â dona na chhu awpa châ vei.
Moleipa cha thai ei pachâsa lei awpa vâta, haipa bie ta chyhsa na leih awpa châ leipa ta, paraona a hnei leipa nata mosiapa na thie awpa châ vei.
Panaopapana na la awpa châ vei. Panaopapana ta mo pavâpa mo pachaosa ta, mosiapa cha biedopa tawhta a patleisa tyh.
“Mapaihpa na tlybai awpa châ vei. Nâmo chhao Izi râh liata mapaihpa châ ei chi ta, mapaihpa châpa palôh rietheizie nama pahno.
“Kô charu chhôh na lyu liata chi cheih aw chi ta, a kôvei na pakhy aw.

A kô sarina kô liata deikua cha, lyu cha pahâsa aw chi ta, pachihpa ta na paysa aw. Chatanachata na chiheihzy hry liata dyhchhiepazy ta nie aw ei ta, ama la bâhpazy cha lyurâhpa sazy ta ama nie aw. Cha hawhna chata na kre sadô nata na ôli sadô chhao na tao aw.

“Noh charu chhôh na rai hria aw chi ta, a noh sarina noh deikua cha, nâ pahâ tyh awpa a châ. Chatanachata na viahchao tôhpa nata alâ zy chhao a pahâ aw ei ta, na o liata a pihpa sei nata na hnohta a ypa chihropa zy ama tha a dâh hra aw.
Nama hnohta ei reipa zydua he pachâ u la, khazoh hropazy moh rai reih leipa u la, na pakah tawhta a pua rai ta pua khah sy.
“Kô kha ta ei thôh kei châta kyhchhi na tao tyh awpa a châ.

Viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa kyhchhi na tao awpa châ ta, bie ei cha piepa hawhta, noh sari chhôh viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa na nie awpa a châ. Kyhchhi cha Abi thla daihti raopa liata na tao tyh aw, cha daihti liata Izi râh tawhta na kaw puapa vâta. Ahy hmah ku ruapa ta ei hmiakô liata namâ vaw luah awpa châ vei.
Lyu liata na tupa, na hriapasana thei hmiatua chaipa Sâhhria Kyhchhi na tao tyh awpa a châ. Kô châh vaw di ta, lyu liata na hriapasana theizy na pakhy khai tawhta, Peihtla Kyhchhi na tao awpa a châ.
Chapaw zydua ta kô kha ta ei thôh Zehôvâh Khazohpa hmiakô liata amâ luah tyh awpa a châ.
“Atheihna sa thisaih eina hlâ ti chi ta, viahchhâ thinô pahlaopa chhaota na hlâ awpa châ leipa ta, ei kyhchhi thaw chhao a mylâ taihta a y awpa châ vei.
“Na lyu liata chicheipa a daih tua chaipazy hry liata a pha chaipazy cha, Abeipa na Khazohpa o liata na hlâ awpa a châ. “Mietaw sa cha a panô sâhpiti ta na chho awpa châ vei.
“Moh teh, lâpi liata châ vaih awpa nata su ei chhuahdypa châ tlôkhei awpa ta, na hmia lâta vâlyuhchâpa ei pasiesa.
Na nah pachôhpa ta, a bie nathlie la, ano cha chakhia khah y. Ei moh ano liata y tlôh ta, chavâta nama paraonazy a ngiahthai aw vei.
“Châhrasala a bie pakhâta ta nathliepa ta, ei reipa zydua na tao khiahta cha, na chariahpazy châta chariahpa châ aw na ta, na khakhaipazy châta khakhaipa ei châ aw.
“Ei vâlyuhchâpa na hmia lâta sie aw ta, Amawri mo, Hiti mo, Perizi mo, Kâna mo, Hivi mo nata Zebu mozy yna lâ châ chhi aw ta, âmo cha ei pahleipadia aw ei.

Ama khazohzy hmiakô liata a bôhpa ta nâ chhy awpa châ leipa ta, âmo na chakao awpa châ hra vei. Ama taopazy hawhta na tao hra awpa châ leipa ta, tlokhuh na pahleipadia khai ha awpa ei châ ta, ama panana tôhzy na phy pachhô khai ha awpa a châ.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa nama chakao awpa a châ. Chatanachata nama viahchhâ nata ti zy byhnâ pie aw na ta, nama hry tawhta hriiah ei papai aw.
Na râh liata nawh raona y leipa aw ta, chanô chohpa chhao y aw veih ei. Na chhâ palona taihta ei cha pahrosa aw.
Na hmia lâta ei chichhihna pasiesa aw na ta, na tlô awpa liata phopi zydua ama nô papo aw na ta, na khakhaipa zydua na hmiakô tawhta ei parâpaisa aw ei.
Na hmia lâta kheipangiah tuah aw na ta, cha chata Hivi mo, Kâna mo nata Hiti mozy na hmia lâta â chadai aw ei.
Kô kha chhôh ta âmo cha na hmiakô tawhta papua khai aw veih ei na, chataleipatala râh cha roryhrapa ta y aw ta, râhsazy na châta a vaw hluh tu pathlei aw.
Nama maluh pôhpa ta, râh liata a pahrâ khi nama y hlâlei cha, a chyh chyhta ta ei cha papuapa aw ei.

Tilaipi Saihpa tawhta Philistinâ mo tilaipi taihta nata râhchawhpa tawhta Ufrâti chavah taihta na râhri châta ei cha taopa aw. Cha râh liata a pahrâpazy cha, na ku liata cha pie aw na ta, âmo cha na hmiakô tawhta na papua awpa a châ.
Ama hnohta bie na hraih awpa châ leipa ta, ama khazohzy hnohta bie na hraih awpa châ hra vei.
Na râh chhôh liata ama pahrâ awpa châ vei. Chataleipatala ei chô liata cha pamoleisa aw ei ta, ama khazohzy na chakao tlai khiahta cha, na châta khoheih a châ aw,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Nâma, Arawna, Nâdâ, Abihu nata Izarei machâ sysari Abeipa lâ a khy u la, lâhla tawhta a vaw chhy muh vy.
Mawsi dei ta Abeipa lâ a vaw hnia aw ta, ahropazy cha amâ vaw hnia awpa châ vei, zawpizy chhao a hnohta amâ khy awpa châ vei,” tah ta.
Mawsi cha zu ta, Abeipa bie zydua nata ryhpa zydua cha zawpi hnohta za chho ta, chyhsa zydua ta, “ Abeipa reipa zydua cha eima tao aw,” tahpa ta â raohpa ta a chhy ei ta.
Mawsi ta Abeipa bie zydua cha roh khai ta, a mylâ my ta thyu ta, tlâh thaby liata maisâh tao ta, Izarei chi hrawh hleino moh ta lôbô miahrawh hleino bô ta.
Izarei sawzy hry ta satliazy tuah ta, âmo ta Abeipa lâ raopa hlâna hlâ ei ta, aryhna hlâna châta viahchao tôhpa ta a theih ei ta.
Mawsi ta thisaih â khophie la ta, biebuh liata patlai ta, ahropa cha maisâh liata thia ta.
Biehrai Châbu la ta, zawpi theina liata reih ta, zawpizy ta, “ Abeipa reipa zydua tao aw pi ta, eima zyh aw,” tah ei ta.
Mawsi ta thisaih la ta, zawpizy chô liata thia ta, ama hnohta, “Moh teh u, he he biehrai thisaih a châ. Abeipa ta he bie zydua hmâpa ta nama hnohta bie a hraih haw,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Mawsi nata Arawna, Nâdâ, Abihu nata Izarei machâ sysarizy cha khy ei ta,
Izarei Khazohpa cha hmô ei ta. A phei ry cha saphai lôsôhpa paryhpa hawhta châ ta, a pathaihzie cha avâ pathaihpa hawhta pathaih ta.
Khazohpa hmô ei ta, niepa ta doh ei ta. Châhrasala Khazohpa ta Izarei hyutuhpazy chô liata a ku pathla vei.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Tlâh lâ a khy la, cha liata na vaw hâ mah y. Chatanachata zawpizy na pachu awpa lôphiapa liata ryhpa nata biepiepa ei ropazy ei cha pie aw,” tah ta.
Mawsi nata ano baotuhpa Zawsua cha thyu ei ta, Mawsi cha Khazohpa tlâh lâ khy ta.

Mawsi ta machâzy hnohta, “Nâmo lâ eimâ vy heih hlâlei cha, he liana heta miah vaw hâ thlâh ha muh vy. Moh teh u, Arawna nata Hurâ nama hnohta ama y hih. Chavâta biepeipa a hneipa cha âmo hnohta a tlôkhei aw,” tah ta.
Mawsi cha tlâh lâ khy ta, tlâh cha meihdo ta vaw pahly khai ha ta.
Abeipa rônahna ta Sinai Tlâh cha vaw khu ta, meihdo ta tlâh cha noh charu chhôh khu ta, a noh sarina noh ta Khazohpa ta meihdo hry tawhta Mawsi cha vaw aw ta.
Abeipa rônahna a vaw luahpa cha, Izarei sawzy mohmô liata, tlâh laki liata mei a kâpa a lyu.
Mawsi cha meihdo hry liata a kei ngia ta, tlâh lâ kiah ta, tlâh liana cha noh sypalih nata zâ sypalih y ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi bie a chho heih ta,
“Izarei sawzy hnohta bie reih la, thyuna sôh na hlâ awpa ta âmo cha chho mah y. Pie khohna palôh hneipa ta a piepazy tawhta keima châta thyuna sôh nama la awpa a châ.
Hezy he âmo tawhta nama la awpa thyunazy cha a châ: Chazy cha ngôh, tâkâ, dawh,
pala nohpa, saihdôhpa, saihlawpa, pala rih dipa, mie hmi,
mietaku vo pasaihpa, tilaipi siahrâ vo, akeisia tho,
meiôh châta sathaw, sathaw athupa nata ropahâh châta rao awpa liata hmâ awpa ia-ôzy,
ephaw nata chachôhna vyhphao liata kiky zei nawpa ta beri lô nata lôsôhpazy a châ.
Supathaihpa na taopa mawh ei sy, chatanachata ama hry liata ei pahrâ aw.
Achhyna byureih nata a chhôh liata hmobaoh zydua cha, a nothlahpa ei cha pahmôpa hawhna heta nama tao awpa a châ.
“Akeisia tho ta Biehrai Byh tao aw ei ta, a doh lâ dy no nata khophie, a hâ lâ dy kha nata khophie kawh aw ta, â sâhna lâ dy kha nata khophie a châ aw.
Ngôh suapa ta pahu aw chi ta, a chhôh lâ chhao khôtho lâ chhao pahu khai aw chi ta, ngôh ta a tlâh na pakyu aw.
Biehrai Byh châna chata ngôh tiaki miapalih leih aw chi ta, a phei miapalih liata pataoh aw chi ta, tiaki miano hiakha lâ pataoh awpa châ ta, tiaki miano hiakha lâ na pataoh aw.
A lâzy châta Akeisia tho hmâh aw chi ta, ngôh ta na pahu awpa a châ.
Byh a sy nawpa ta byh kâ lâta tiakizy liata a lâzy na chahraoh aw.
A lâzy cha Byh tiakizy liata â pataoh thlâh ha awpa châ ta, phia awpa rai châ vei.
Byh chhôh liana chata biehrai ei cha pie awpa cha na khô awpa a châ.
Ngôh suapa ta zawngiahna dyuchhai tao aw chi ta, a doh lâ dy no nata khophie seih aw ta, a hâ lâ dy kha nata khophie a kawh aw.
Ngôh ta cherubi miano daih aw chi ta, zawngiahna dyuchhai nata pazaopa ta, a kâ chavei chachâh ta a y awpa a châ.

Cherubi miakha cha zawngiahna dyuchhai hiakha lâ pai liata pataoh aw chi ta, cherubi hropa cha hiakha lâ chhâna liata pataohpa ta, zawngiahna dyuchhai nata pazaopa ta dyuchhai kâ chavei chachâh ta cherubi miano na tao aw.
Cherubizy cha zawngiahna dyuchhai lâ a heih aw ei ta, hmia amâ chhy aw. Ama mathlawzy â sâhpa ta pakai aw ei ta, ama mathlawzy ta zawngiahna dyuchhai cha ama khu aw.
Zawngiahna dyuchhai cha Byh chô liata patyuh aw chi ta, biehrai ei cha pie awpa cha byh chhôh liata na khô aw.
Cha liata châ tyh tyh aw na ta, Izarei sawzy hnohta bie ei pie awpa zydua cha, biehrai byh chô liata zawngiahna dyuchhai liata cherubi mianozy likawh tawhna chata ei cha chho tyh aw.
“Akeisia tho ta tlâhkhai tao aw chi ta, a doh lâ dy no, a hâ lâ dy kha, â sâhna lâ dy kha nata khophie a châ aw.
Cha cha ngôh suapa ta pahu aw chi ta, ngôh ta a tlâh na pakyu aw.
Pazah tie phiapa ta a tlâh pakyu aw chi ta, a tlâh chhao cha ngôh ta na pakyu aw.
Tlâhkhai châta ngôh tiaki miapalih tao aw chi ta, tiakizy cha tlâhkhai kizy liata a ypa tlâhkhai phei miapalihzy liata na pataoh aw.
Tlâhkhai a sy tita a lâ chahraoh nawpa ta, tiakizy cha pakyuna liata pataoh awpa a châ.
A lâzy akeisia tho ta tao aw chi ta, ngôh ta pahu aw chi ta, chazy hmâpa ta tlâhkhai cha a sy tyh awpa a châ.
Tlâhkhai beikohzy, ukâzy, beihraizy nata dopa hlâna patlai nawpa biebuhzy cha ngôh suapa ta na tao awpa a châ.
Tlâhkhai liana chata khatino rai ta ypâna viahchhâ ei hmiakô liata na soh awpa a châ.
“Ngôh suapa ta meiôh tôh tao aw chi ta, meiôh tôh cha a daih ta daih awpa châ ta, a tôh thaby, a tôh, a nyuzy, a paw ngaihkaruzy, a pawzy â pazao khaipa ta tao awpa a châ.
A kâ chavei chachâh ta a chiah miacharu pachiah aw ta, meiôh tôh kâ hiakha lâ a chiah miathôh y aw ta, meiôh tôh kâ hiakha lâ a chiah miathôh a y aw.

Hiakha lâ chhâh chiah liata kuasâh paw pabyuhpa a lyupa nyu miathôh, a paw ngaihkaru nata a paw a hneipa tao aw chi ta, a hiakha lâ chhâh chiah liata chhao kuasâh paw pabyuhpa a lyupa nyu miathôh, a paw ngaihkaru nata a paw a hneipa tao aw chi ta, cha hawh lymâ chata meiôh tôh tawhta a puapa chiah miacharu châta na tao awpa a châ.
Meiôh tôh liata kuasâh paw pabyuhpa a lyupa nyu miapalih, a paw ngaihkaru nata a paw a hneipazy a y awpa a châ.

A chiah miano ry liata a paw ngaihkaru miakha y aw ta, a chiah hropa miano ry liata a paw ngaihkaru miakha y aw ta, a chiah hropa miano ry liata a paw ngaihkaru miakha y hra aw ta, cha hawh lymâ chata meiôh tôh tawhta a puapa a chiah miacharu châta tao khai awpa a châ.
A paw ngaihkaru nata a chiahzy cha meiôh tôh nata â pazao khai awpa châ ta, ngôh suapa ta hmaohkha ta daih khoh khai awpa a châ.
Meiôh miasari tao aw chi ta, meiôh tôh liata soh aw chi ta, chatanachata a dady suzy a pakhaih aw.
A chaikiezy nata meipaoh sonazy chhao, ngôh suapa ta na tao aw.
Meiôh tôh nata a chhaichhi zydua tao nawpa ta ngôh suapa talent miakha na hmâ awpa a châ.
Tlâh liata a taozie awpa ei cha pahmôpa hawhna tlai khata, na tao awpa a châ.

“Pohraipa miahrawh ta a chô khupa achhyna byureih na sa awpa a châ. Pohraipa cha pala rih dipa pabaohpa nata pala nohpa, saihdôhpa nata saihlawpazy ta taopa châ aw ta, zôthaipazy ta zô pha ngaitapa ta ama taopa cherubi nothlahpazy pachohsa awpa a châ.
Pohraipa maih cha a doh lâ dy kih nata dy charie, a hâ lâ dy palih châ aw ta, pohraipa zydua cha amâ kho khai awpa a châ.
Pohraipa miapangawh pazao aw chi ta, pohraipa hropa miapangawh na pazao hra aw.
Pohraipa pazaopa miakhana liata pohraipa chhâna pai liata nali nohpazy tao aw chi ta, cha hawhna chata, pohraipa pazaopa mianona liata pohraipa chhâna pai liata a nalizy na tao hra aw.
Pohraipa pazaopa miakhana liata a nali sypangawh thla aw chi ta, cha hawhna chata, pohraipa pazaopa mianona pai liata a nali sypangawh na thla hra aw. Cha nalizy cha â dadypa ta ama y awpa a châ.
Ngôh ta taopa hraina sypangawh tao aw chi ta, hrainazy chata pohraipazy cha hrai pakaoh aw chi ta, chatanachata achhyna byureih tlohpa a vaw châ ha aw.
“Achhyna byureih chôkhu poh o châta mie hmi pohraipazy tao aw chi ta, pohraipa miahrawh hleikha na tao aw.
Pohraipa maih cha a doh lâ dy sythôh, a hâ lâ dy palih châ aw ta, pohraipa miahrawh hleikhazy cha â kho khai awpa a châ.
Pohraipa miapangawh pazaopa nata pohraipa miacharu pazaopa tao aw chi ta, pohraipa miacharuna cha patho aw chi ta, poh o laihmia lâ na padaih aw.
Pohraipa pazaopa miakhana liata pohraipa chhâna pai liata a nali sypangawh thla aw chi ta, pohraipa pazaopa mianona liata pohraipa chhâna pai liata chhao a nali sypangawh na thla aw.
“Dawh ta taopa hraina sypangawh tao aw chi ta, hrainazy cha pohraipa nalizy liata chahraoh aw chi ta, chatanachata poh o cha a pazao khai aw ta, poh o tlohpa a vaw châ aw.
Achhyna byureih ohmia, ohnôh nata okâ lâzy khuna châta pathliah awpa ta, poh o pohraipa paizy palai awpa châ ta, achhyna byureih ohnôh lâ liata pohraipa khophie pathliah awpa a châ.
Poh o pohraipa a doh lâ dy kha lymâ ta hiakha lâ nata hiakha lâ a pai palaipa cha, achhyna byureih khu nawpa ta achhyna byureih okâ chavei chachâh ta pathliah awpa a châ.
Mietaku tôhpa vo pasaihpa hmâpa ta poh o chôkhu tao aw chi ta, tilaipi siahrâ vo ta a chô khu pachhuahna na tao aw.
“Achhyna byureih pâhchhô cha akeisia thophiazy hmâpa ta â tôh lâta na chhôh awpa a châ.
Thophia cha a doh lâ dy hrawh seih aw ta, a hâ lâ dy kha nata khophie a kawh aw.
Pazao nawpa ta thophia zydua a ngaih miano chyu hnei aw ta, cha hawhna chata achhyna byureih pâhchhô thophia zydua cha na tao khai aw.
Achhyna byureih pâhchhô tao aw chi ta, chho lâ daih châta thophia phia kih na tao aw.

A ngaih miano pangaih nawpa ta thophia phia kha ry liata patyuna miano lymâ tao aw chi ta, thophia hropazy ry liata chhao a ngaih miano pangaih nawpa ta patyuna miano lymâ ta tao hrapa ta, thophia phia kih ry liata tâkâ ta taopa patyuna sypalih na tao aw.
Achhyna byureih kâ hiakha lâ, maw lâ daih châta thophia phia kih tao aw chi ta,
thophia phia kha ry liata patyuna miano y aw ta, thophia hropazy ry liata chhao patyuna miano lymâ hneipa ta, thophia phia kih châna chata tâkâ ta taopa patyuna sypalih na tao aw.
Achhyna byureih hnôh lâ, notla daih lâ châta thophia phia charu tao aw chi ta,
achhyna byureih hnôh lâta a ki chhânazy châta thophia phia no na tao aw.
Cha thophia phia no cha a thaby tawhta a pawhmao taih pakyupa ta, a nali hmiatua chaipa tlôna taih pakyu awpa châ ta, cha hawhna chata a miano ta tao awpa a châ. Cha cha ki no châta a châ aw.

Chatanachata thophia phia charie y aw ta, amâ bô nawpa ta tâkâ ta taopa patyuna miahrawh hleicharu a y aw. Thophia phia kha ry liata abôna miano y aw ta, thophia hropazy ry liata chhao abôna miano lymâ a y aw.
“Akeisia tho ta pâhchhô tlâhzy tao aw chi ta, achhyna byureih kâ hiakha lâ pâhchhô phiazy paryh nawpa ta tlâh pangawh,
achhyna byureih kâ hiakha lâ pâhchhô phiazy paryh nawpa ta tlâh pangawh, achhyna byureih hnôh lâ notla daih lâta pâhchhô phiazy paryh nawpa ta tlâh pangawh na tao aw.
Pâhchhô khophie liata a liah tlâh pakhâhpa châ aw ta, cha chata pâhchhô phia hiakha lâ chhâna tawhta hiakha lâ chhâna taihta a lâ ta a hrei aw.
Pâhchhô phiazy cha ngôh ta pahu aw chi ta, a tlâhzy hrei pakhâh nawpa châta ngôh tiakizy tao aw chi ta, a tlâhzy cha ngôh ta na pahu aw.
Tlâh chô liata ei cha pahmôpa hawhna tlai khata, achhyna byureih cha na sa awpa a châ.
“Pohraipa cha pala nohpa, saihdôhpa nata saihlawpazy nata pala rih dipa pabaohpazy hmâpa ta tao aw chi ta, cha liata zôpha kawpa ta taopa cherubi nothlahpazy na pachohsa aw.
Cha cha ngôh ta pahupa akeisia tho tôh miapalih liata na parai aw. A baina cha ngôh ta tao awpa châ ta, a tôh cha tâkâ ta taopa patyuna miapalih liata patyuh awpa a châ.
Pohraipa cha bainazy liata baih aw chi ta, biehrai byh cha pohraipa chhôh liata soh aw chi ta, chatanachata cha pohraipa cha nama châta su pathaihpa nata su pathaih chaipa pachhaihna a châ aw.
Su pathaih chaipa liata biehrai byh chô liata zawngiahna dyuchhai na soh aw.
Pohraipa khôtho liata tlâhkhai patyuh aw chi ta, achhyna byureih chho lâ daih tlâhkhai dady liata meiôh sona tôh padua aw chi ta, tlâhkhai cha maw lâ chhâh ta na soh aw.
“Poh o chhikao châta pohraipa tao aw chi ta, pala rih dipa pabaohpazy, pala nohpa, saihdôhpa nata saihlawpazy ta pohraipa cha kiky zei awpa a châ.

Pohraipa tôh châta akeisia tho tôh pangawh tao aw chi ta, chazy cha ngôh ta pahu aw chi ta, a bainazy ngôh ta taopa châ aw ta, a tôhzy patyuna châta dawh ta taopa patyuna miapangawh na leih awpa a châ.
“Akeisia tho ta maisâh, a doh lâ dy pangawh a seihpa nata a hâ lâ dy pangawh a kawhpa na tao aw. Maisâh cha ki palih hnei aw ta, dy thôh â sâh aw.
Maisâh chaki miah palih liata a kizy tao aw chi ta, cha a kizy cha maisâh nata â pazao khai awpa châ ta, dawh ta na pahu aw.
Maisâh buchâh thyna beihzy, buchâh linazy, rahôzy, sa thaona thuakuzy nata mei lanazy tao aw chi ta, maisâh chhaichhi zydua cha dawh ta na tao khai aw.
Maisâh châta dawh sao tao aw chi ta, sao chô lâ a ki mia palihzy liata dawh nali miapalih na pataoh aw.
Dawh sao cha maisâh kiah ry lâ, maisâh khophie liata na phaw aw.
Akeisia tho ta maisâh lâzy tao aw chi ta, dawh ta na pahu aw.
A lâzy cha maisâh tiakizy liata chahraoh aw chi ta, maisâh cha a sy a byuh tita, a kâ chavei chachâh ta a lâzy chahraohpa ta a sypa a châ aw.
Maisâh cha thophia ta dôhpa ta a chhôh pakaopa ta tao aw chi ta, tlâh liata ei cha pahmôpa hawhna tlai khata na tao aw.
“Achhyna byureih dôhpachhôh tlyhmia tao aw chi ta, tlyhmia chho lâ chhâh cha pala rih dipa pabaohpa ta taopa pohraipa dy za kha a seihpa ta na chhôh aw.
Pohraipa tôh kih nata a patyuna miakih dawh ta taopa châ aw ta, a tôh liata bainazy nata a patusanazy deikua cha tâkâ ta taopa a châ aw.

Cha hawhna chata dôhpachhôh tlyhmia maw lâ chhâh chhao pala rih dipa pabaohpa ta taopa pohraipa dy za kha a seihpa ta chhôh aw chi ta, pohraipa châta a tôh miakih y aw ta, a tôhzy patyu nawpa ta dawh ta taopa patyuna miakih y hra aw ta, a tôh liata bainazy nata patusanazy deikua tâkâ ta taopa a châ aw.
Dôhpachhôh tlyhmia notla lâ chhâh cha dy sypangawh a kawhpa pohraipa ta chhôhpa châ aw ta, a tôh miahrawh nata a patyuna miahrawh a y aw.
Dôhpachhôh tlyhmia nochhi lâ chhâh chhao dy sypangawh a kawh hra aw.
Chhikao hiakha lâta pohraipa parai awpazy cha dy hrawh hleipangawh seih aw ta, a tôh miathôh nata a patyuna miathôh a y aw.
Chhikao hiakha lâta pohraipa parai awpazy chhao dy hrawh hleipangawh seih aw ta, a tôh miathôh nata a patyuna miathôh a y hra aw.

Dôhpachhôh tlyhmia chhikao pohraipa cha dy kih seih aw ta, pala rih dipa pabaohpazy, pala nohpazy, saihdôhpazy nata saihlawpazy ta pohraipa cha kiky tao awpa châ ta, a tôh miapalih nata a patyuna miapalih a y awpa a châ.
Dôhpachhôh tlyhmia dôhna tôh zydua tâkâ ta a patusana tao khai awpa châ ta, a bainazy tâkâ châ aw ta, a patyunazy cha dawh a châ aw.

Chatanachata tlyhmia dôhna cha a doh lâ dy za kha seih aw ta, a hâ lâ dy sypangawh kawh aw ta, a sâhna lâ dy pangawh a châ aw. Pala rih dipa pabaohpa pohraipa ta dôhpa châ aw ta, a patyunazy cha dawh a châ aw.
Chakaona to châta hmâ awpa achhyna byureih chhaichhi zydua, a patusana zydua nata tlyhmia dôhna patusana zydua cha dawh ta tao khai awpa a châ.
“Meiôh cha khâ a khaih thei nawpa ta rao awpa châ ta, khaihna châta saohpa ôli thaw pasohpa nâ lâta vaw chei awpa ta Izarei sawzy bie na pie aw.

Ahmaohna poh o liata Biehrai Byh pohraipa khôtho liata, Arawna nata a sawchapawzy ta meiôh cha Abeipa hmiakô liata zâlâ tawhta my taihta ama pakhaih tyh awpa a châ. Cha cha Izarei saw chhâ vaw y lymâ awpazy châta chhâzaw bieraopa a châ aw.

“Na unawhpa Arawna cha, a sawchapawzy chhaota, Izarei sawzy hry tawhta pananopa ta na hnohta a chhi aw chi ta, chatanachata Arawna nata a sawchapaw Nâdâ, Abihu, Eliaza nata Ithamâ zy cha ei theihthaipa rai hriapa ta eina chakao aw ei.
Na unawhpa Arawna châta a rônah nawpa nata â ngia nawpa ta chysia pathaihpa na taopa aw.
Sona thlahpa ta ei pabiepa zôthaipa zydua hnohta Arawna chysia taopa awpa ta chho aw chi ta, chatanachata Arawna cha pathaisapa ta y aw ta, kei châta theihthaipa chakaona rai a hria thei aw.

Hezy he zôthaipazy ta chysia ama tao awpazy cha a châ: Chachôhna vyhphao, ephaw, viahkao pasipa, chôtho chapaipa, lakhu nata chaisaihna zy. Kei châta theihthaipa chakaona rai ama hria thei nawpa ta, zôthaipazy ta na unawhpa Arawna nata a sawchapawzy châta chysia pathaihpazy ama taopa aw.
Ngôh, pala nohpa, saihdôhpa, saihlawpa nata pala rih dipa pabaohpazy hmâpa ta theihthaipa chysia cha ama tao aw.
“Ephaw tao aw ei ta, cha cha ngôh, pala saihdôhpa nata saihlawpa nata pala rih dipa pabaohpazy hmâpa ta zôpha kawpa ta ama tao aw.
Ephaw cha a luh pawhmaozy liata a ngiatlâh ri miano y aw ta, cha chata a hmia lâ nata a hnôh lâ a pazao aw.
Zôpha kawpa ta sapa chaisaihna a chô liata y aw ta, ephaw nata sapati awpa châ ta, cha cha ngôh, pala nohpa, saihdôhpa, saihlawpa nata pala rih dipa pabaohpazy ta sa awpa a châ.
Chatawhcha awnisi lô miano la aw chi ta, cha liana chata Izarei sawzy moh roh aw chi ta,
ama pina kô â pazinazie hawhta alô miakha liata pacharu moh, alô hropa liata pacharu moh na roh aw.
Lôsôhpa daih thaipa ta moh chahnaona a taopa hawhta, Izarei saw pahrawh hleinozy moh cha, alô miano liana chata roh aw chi ta, ngôh patusana liata na pangaih aw.

Alô mianozy cha ephaw ngiatlâh rizy liata bai aw chi ta, cha cha Izarei sawzy atheithlâhna alôzy châ aw ei ta, chatanachata Abeipa hmiakô liata atheithlâhna châta Arawna ta Izarei saw pahrawh hleino mohzy cha a ngiatlâh kârano ta a phaoh tyh aw.
A patusanazy ngôh ta tao aw chi ta,
ngôh suapa bâlia ri no chaori hawhta charih aw chi ta, cha bâlia charipazy cha patusana liata na pazao aw.

“Pachiana chachôhna vyhphao tao aw chi ta, cha cha zôthaipazy ta zôpha kawpa ta ama tao aw. Ephaw taozie hawhta, ngôh, pala nohpa, saihdôhpa, saihlawpa nata pala rih dipa pabaohpazy hmâpa ta na tao aw.
Chachôhna vyhphao cha ki palih hnei aw ta, pathopa ta tao awpa châ ta, a doh lâ kha kha, a hâ lâ kha kha ta patho awpa a châ.
Cha liata lôsôhpazy tlâh palih ta patlâh aw chi ta, tlâh khana cha sadôni, tôpazi nata kabuni lôzy châ aw ta,
tlâh nona cha emyrâ, saphirâ nata lônah zy châ aw ta,
tlâh thôhna cha zaki, akate nata amethi lôzy châ aw ta,
tlâh palihna cha beri, awnisi nata zaspi lôzy a châ aw. Chazy cha ngôh patusana liata pangaih awpa a châ.

Lôsôhpa miahrawh hleino y aw ta, chazy cha Izarei saw pahrawh hleinozy moh lymâ hawhta ama moh bipa a châ aw. Lôsôhpa miahrawh hleinozy cha moh chahnaona hawhta tao chyu awpa châ ta, lôsôhpa miakha chô liata Izarei chi hrawh hleino hry liata chi kha moh pachohsa lymâpa a châ aw.
Chachôhna vyhphao chô liata ngôh suapa ta taopa bâlia, chaori hawhta charipazy na tao aw.
Chachôhna vyhphao châta ngôh tiaki miano tao aw chi ta, cha tiaki miano cha chachôhna vyhphao pai chavei chachâh liata na pataoh aw.
Ngôh bâlia miano cha chachôhna vyhphao pai chavei chachâh liata tiaki miano liata na buh aw.
Bâlia charipa pawhmao raihrie cha patusana miano liata pazao aw chi ta, chazy cha ephaw hmia lâta a ngiatlâh rizy liata na buh aw.
Ngôh tiaki miano tao aw chi ta, chazy cha chachôhna vyhphao ry lâ liata ephaw a daihpa lâta a pai chavei chachâh liata na pataoh aw.

Ngôh tiaki hropa miano tao aw chi ta, chazy cha ephaw hmia lâta a ngiatlâh rizy thaby liata na pataoh aw. Cha ngôh tiakizy cha zôpha kawpa ta sapa ephaw chaisaihna chô lâta â pazaona kiapâh liata a y awpa a châ.

Chachôhna vyhphao tiakizy cha ephaw tiakizy nata pala nohpa charipa ta chahry pabaohpa châ aw ta, chatanachata chachôhna vyhphao cha zôpha kawpa ta sapa ephaw chaisaihna chô lâta y aw ta, ephaw liata â ipa ta â bai aw.
