Chatanachata Arawna cha su pathaihpa lâ a vaw tita, pachiana chachôhna vyhphao liata ropa Izarei sawzy moh cha a pathipalôh liata y aw ta, atheithlâhna châta Abeipa hmiakô liata a tlôkhei tyh aw.

Pachiana chachôhna vyhphao liata Uri nata Thumi soh aw chi ta, Abeipa hmiakô lâ Arawna a vaw tita, cha cha a pathipalôh liata y aw ta, chatanachata Izarei sawzy pachiana cha Arawna ta a pathipalôh liata khatino rai ta a theipa ta, Abeipa hmiakô liata â dua tyh awpa a châ.
“Ephaw ry lâta a ky awpa viahkao pasipa cha a nohpa sai ta na tao aw.
Luh chahraoh nawpa ta a liah liata a khaoh y aw ta, cha khaoh cha â hrie lei nawpa ta viahkao rao meipa hawhta a kiah na mei awpa a châ.
A pai liata pawmikarânâ nothlahpa nohpa, saihdôhpa nata saihlawpa zy tao aw chi ta, chazy cha viahkao pasipa kiah padôpa ta y aw ei ta, ama likawh liata ngôh lailô tawtawzy na pataoh aw.
Viahkao pasipa pai liata ngôh lailô nata pawmikarânâ zy cha, ngôh lailô miakha nata pawmikarânâ miakha lymâ ta i-âhpa ta na pataoh aw.
Arawna ta chakaona a hnei tita viahkao pasipa cha a ky tyh aw ta, Abeipa hmiakô su pathaihpa liata â ngia tita nata a pua tita a pyu thei theipa châ aw ta, chatanachata thi aw vei.
“Ngôh suapa dawhrâ tao aw chi ta, cha liata ‘ Abeipa châta Pathaihpa,’ tahpa bie cha moh chahnaona taozie hawhta taopa ta, na pachohsa aw.
Cha cha theihthaipa lakhu liata pala nohpa charipa ta rie aw chi ta, theihthaipa lakhu hmia lâ liata na bai aw.

Cha cha Arawna khi liata y aw ta, Izarei sawzy ta ama hmopiepa pathaihpa châta ama hlâ awpa hmo pathaihpazy liata moleina a ypazy cha, Arawna ta phaoh khai aw ta, Abeipa hmiakô liata a ly tlâh ama châ thei nawpa ta, Arawna khi liata khâ a y thlâh ha awpa a châ.
“Chôtho cha pala rih dipa ta a chei a ngia ngaitapa ta tao aw chi ta, theihthaipa lakhu chhao pala rih dipa ta tao hra aw chi ta, chaisaihna cha kiky pakyupa ta na tao aw.
“Cha hawhna chata Arawna sawchapawzy châta chôtho, chaisaihna nata lakhuzy taopa aw chi ta, cha cha ama rônahna nata amâ ngiana châta a châ aw.
Cha chysiazy cha na unawhpa Arawna nata a sawchapawzy pakysa aw chi ta, theihthaipa rai hriapa ta eina chakao thei nawpa ei ta, âmo cha sathawthupa ta, chahnao aw chi ta, na pathaisa aw ei.
Ama sapa thluahruana khu nawpa ta, âmo châta pala rih dipa chaopasy taopa aw chi ta, chaopasy cha chai tawhta byhhmia taih a pasi awpa a châ.

Cha chysiazy cha Arawna nata a sawchapawzy ta ahmaohna poh o liata amâ ngia tita nata su pathaihpa liata chakao awpa ta maisâh amâ hnia tita, amâ ky tyh aw. Chataleipatala thailei châ aw ei ta, ama thi pathlei aw. Cha cha Arawna nata a pathlazy châta chhâzaw bieraopa a châ aw.

“Arawna nata a sawchapawzy ta theihthaipa rai hriapa ta eina chakao thei nawpa ei ta, âmo cha pathaisa awpa châ ta, ama chô liata hetana heta na tao awpa a châ. Viahchao tôh dawpa pô kha nata mietaku tôhpa seina hnei leipa pô no la aw chi ta,
viahdie dipa hmâpa ta viahchhâ puahpa thinô pahlao leipa, sathaw pahlaopa viahchhâ thlôhpa thinô pahlao leipa nata sathaw hniapa viahchhâ apapa thinô pahlao leipazy na tao aw.
Chazy cha hrâbyh miakha liata khô aw chi ta, viahchao tôhpa nata mietaku tôhpa pô no chhao chata viahchhâ hrâbyh cha na vaw cheih aw.
Arawna nata a sawchapawzy cha ahmaohna poh o chhikao lâ a vaw chhi aw chi ta, âmo cha ti ta na pasi aw ei.
Chatawhcha chysiazy la aw chi ta, Arawna cha chôtho, ephaw poh, ephaw nata chachôhna vyhphaozy pakysa aw chi ta, zôpha kawpa ta sapa ephaw chaisaihna ta a chai na saih aw.
A luh liata lakhu pakhu aw chi ta, lakhu chô liana cha lakho pathaihpa na pakho aw.
Sathawthuna châta taopa sathaw la aw chi ta, a luh liata bao aw chi ta, sathaw na thu aw.
Chatawhcha a sawchapawzy a vaw chhi aw chi ta, chôtho na paky aw ei.

Arawna nata a sawchapawzy cha chaisaihna ta ama chai saih aw chi ta, lakhu pakhu aw chi ta, chatanachata theihthaipa châna cha chhâzaw ta âmo eih châ awpa ta bieraopa ta chahnaopa a châ aw. Cha hawhna chata Arawna nata a sawchapawzy cha na chahnao aw ei.
“Ahmaohna poh o hmia liata viahchao tôhpa vaw cheih aw chi ta, Arawna nata a sawchapawzy ta viahchao tôhpa luh chô liata ama ku ama pahnieh aw.
Chatawhcha ahmaohna poh o chhikao thaby liata Abeipa hmiakô ta viahchao tôhpa cha na thie aw.
Viahchao tôhpa thisaih cha la aw chi ta, maisâh kizy liata na kuparo ta hnia aw chi ta, thisaih laibâhpazy cha maisâh thaby liata na patlai khai aw.
A rihhri thaw zydua la aw chi ta, a pathi a pahlypa thaw nata a lôpo miano nata a thaw a pahlypazy chhaota maisâh liata na rao khai aw.
Viahchao tôhpa sa, a vo nata a iezy deikua cha, riehmo khôtho liata na rao awpa a châ. Cha cha moleina hlâna a châ.
“Mietaku tôhpa pô kha vaw cheih aw chi ta, Arawna nata a sawchapawzy ta mietaku tôhpa luh chô liata ama ku ama pahnieh aw.
Mietaku tôhpa cha thie aw chi ta, a thisaih la aw chi ta, maisâh kâ zydua liata na thia aw.
Mietaku tôhpa cha pachhaih aw chi ta, a chhôrih nata a pheizy pasi aw chi ta, chazy cha a satlozy nata a luh chhaota na pahlyh khai aw.
Mietaku tôhpa cha a zydua ta maisâh liata rao aw chi ta, cha cha Abeipa châta raopa hlâna châ ta, Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpa ropahâhpa a châ.
“Mietaku tôhpa hropa a vaw chhi heih aw chi ta, Arawna nata a sawchapawzy ta mietaku tôhpa luh chô liata ama ku ama pahnieh aw.

Mietaku tôhpa cha thie aw chi ta, a thisaih la aw chi ta, Arawna nakao chachâh lâ pai liata zy, a sawchapawzy nakao chachâh lâ pai liata zy, ama ku chachâh lâ kupi liata zy, ama phei chachâh lâ pheipi liata zy na hnia aw. Thisaih laibâhpazy cha maisâh kâ zydua liata na thia aw.

Maisâh chô liata thisaih nata sathawthuna châta taopa sathaw la aw chi ta, Arawna nata a chysiazy liata nata a hnohta a ypa a sawchapawzy nata ama chysiazy liata na thia aw. Chatanachata ano nata a chysiazy nata a hnohta a ypa a sawchapawzy nata ama chysiazy cha pathaisapa a châ ha aw.
“Cha cha chahnaona mietaku tôhpa châ ta, a thawzy, a lahmei thawhpazy, a rihhri thawzy, a pathi a pahlypa thawzy, a lôpo miano nata a pahlypa thawzy nata a byh chachâh lâ la aw chi ta,
Abeipa hmiakô liata a ypa viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa hrâbyh tawhta viahchhâ puahpa miakha, sathaw pahlaopa viahchhâ thlôhpa miakha nata viahchhâ apapa miakha la hra aw chi ta,
cha zydua cha Arawna ku nata a sawchapawzy ku liata soh aw chi ta, chaluahpa hlâna châta Abeipa hmiakô liata na chaluah aw.
Cha khai tawhta ama ku tawhta la aw chi ta, maisâh liata raopa hlâna chô liata na rao aw. Cha cha Abeipa hmiakô liata ropahâhpa châ ta, Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpa a châ.
“Arawna chahnaona mietaku tôhpa cha a palôh la aw chi ta, chaluahpa hlâna châta Abeipa hmiakô liata na chaluah aw. Cha cha na tovyuh a châ aw.
Chaluahpa hlâna châta chaluah hapa, Arawna nata a sawchapawzy chahnaona mietaku tôhpa palôh nata chalopa hlâna châta chalo hapa phei cha na pathaisa awpa a châ.

A phei cha Arawna nata a sawchapawzy ta Izarei sawzy tawhta chhâzaw ta ama to awpa a châ. Cha cha chalopa hlâna a châ. Aryhna hlâna atheihnazy tawhta Izarei sawzy ta ama hlâ awpa chalopa hlâna châ ta, Abeipa lâta ama hmohlâpa a châ aw.
“Arawna chysia pathaihpazy cha a sawchapawzy ta to pachhuah lymâ aw ei ta, cha chysia pathaihpazy a tobina chôta sathawthupa nata chahnaopa ama châ aw.
Theihthaipa châ awpa ta ano a thlatuhpa a sawchapaw ta, su pathaihpa liata chakaona rai hria awpa ta ahmaohna poh o liata â ngia tita, chysia pathaihpazy cha noh sari chhôh â tobi aw.
“Chahnaona châta hmâpa mietaku tôhpa cha la aw chi ta, su pathaihpa liata a sa pasyuh aw chi ta,
Arawna nata a sawchapawzy ta mietaku tôhpa sa nata hrâbyh liata viahchhâzy cha ahmaohna poh o chhikao thaby liata ama nie aw.
Âmo chahnaona nata pathaisana châta aryhna hmohlâpazy cha nie aw ei ta, hmo pathaihpa a châpa vâta, khôtho chyhsa ta a nie awpa châ vei.
Chahnaona sa tlyma, viahchhâ tlyma, a mylâ taihta a laibâhpa a y khiahta cha, a laibâhpa cha mei ta na rao awpa a châ. Hmo pathaihpa a châpa vâta nie awpa châ vei.
“Bie ei cha piepa zydua hawhna khata Arawna nata a sawchapawzy chô liata tao aw chi ta, âmo chahnao awpa ta noh sari chhôh na panano tua awpa ei a châ.
Aryhna tao nawpa ta moleina hlâna atheihna châta viahchao tôhpa noh chareih ta na hlâ aw. Maisâh cha aryhna taopa ta pathaisa aw chi ta, a pathaih thei nawpa ta sathaw na thu aw.
Noh sari chhôh aryhna taopa ta maisâh cha pathaisa aw chi ta, chatanachata maisâh cha hmo pathaih chaipa vaw châ aw ta, maisâh a hriapa maih ama pathaih lymâ aw.
“Maisâh chô liata hmo na hlâ awpa cha, he he a châ: Noh chareih ta kô kha uhtheipa mietakutaw pô no lymâ na hlâ aw.
Mietakutaw pô kha my ta hlâ aw chi ta, mietakutaw hropa zâlâ ta na hlâ tyh aw.
Mietakutaw pô kha hlâna liata viahdie dipa kachu su hrawh su kha nata sathaw saohpa chhiehraôh ôh kha pahlao aw chi ta, dopa hlâna châta kresawhti chhiehroôh ôh kha na pahlao aw.
Mietakutaw hropa cha zâlâ ta hlâ aw chi ta, my ta niepa hlâna taozie hawhta nata dopa hlâna taozie hawhta tao aw chi ta, cha cha Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpa ropahâhpa a châ aw.
Cha cha nama chhâ zydua ta ahmaohna poh o chhikao thaby liata Abeipa hmiakô ta khâ nama hlâ tyh awpa raopa hlâna châ aw ta, cha liata châ tyh aw na ta, bie ei châ chho tyh aw.
Cha liata Izarei sawzy chhao a tyh tyh hra aw ei na ta, chatanachata poh o cha ei rônahna ta pathaisapa a châ aw.
Ahmaohna poh o nata maisâhzy pathaisa aw na ta, Arawna nata a sawchapawzy chhao, theihthaipa rai hriapa ta eina chakao thei nawpa ei ta ei pathaisa hra aw ei.
Izarei sawzy hry liata pahrâ aw na ta, ama Khazohpa ei châ aw.
Ama hry liata ei pahrâ thei nawpa ta, kei he Izi râh tawhta âmo a kaw chhi papuatuhpa Abeipa ama Khazohpa ei châ tahpa ama pahno aw. Kei he Abeipa ama Khazohpa ei châ.
“Ropahâhpa rao nawpa maisâh tao aw chi ta, akeisia tho ta na tao aw.
A doh lâ dy kha seih aw ta, a hâ lâ dy kha kawh aw ta, ki palih a hnei aw. Dy no a sâh aw ta, a kizy cha maisâh nata â pazao khai awpa a châ.
A chôzy, a kâzy nata a kizy ngôh suapa ta pahu aw chi ta, a kiahzy ngôh pakyupa ta na padô aw.
Maisâh asyna lâhrei chahraoh nawpa ta, maisâh kiah ry a kâ chavei chachâh ta ngôh tiakizy na pataoh aw.
Akeisia tho ta a lâhreizy cha tao aw chi ta, ngôh ta na pahu aw.
Maisâh cha Biehrai byh chô lâta pohraipa hmiakô, Biehrai byh chô lâta Zawngiahna Dyuchhai hmiakô liata ei châ tyh nawpa su liata na patyu aw.
Arawna ta maisâh chô liata ropahâhpa rao tyh aw ta, my chareih ta meiôhzy a patohpatia tita a rao tyh aw.
Zâlâ ta meiôhzy a pakhaih tita chhao ropahâhpa cha rao tyh aw ta, chatanachata nama chhâ zydua châta Abeipa hmiakô liata ropahâhpa a châ lymâ aw.
Cha liata ropahâhpa hropa tlyma, raopa hlâna tlyma, niepa hlâna tlyma nama hlâ awpa châ leipa ta, dopa hlâna chhao a chô liata nama bao awpa châ vei.

Arawna ta kô kha ta ei kha maisâh kizy chô liata aryhna a tao tyh aw. Molei chatlaina thisaih hmâpa ta aryhna cha, kô kha ta ei kha, nama chhâ zydua liata tao tyh awpa a châ. Cha cha Abeipa châta hmo pathaih ngaitapa a châ,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,

“Izarei sawzy maluhpi na rei tita, ama maluh na reipa chyhsazy chata ama hrona chatlaina hmopiepa Abeipa lâ ama hlâ awpa a châ. Chatanachata ama maluh na rei tita, ama hry liata hri vaw tlô leipa ta a y aw.

Maluhpi reina liata pahlaopa maihta, hezy he Abeipa lâ ama hlâ aw: Su pathaihpa liata hmâpa sekel khophie ama pie awpa a châ. Sekel tlaw kha liata kerâ mia kih y ta, sekel khophie cha Abeipa lâta hmohlâpa a châ aw.
Maluh reipazy hry liata a hlaopa kô kih tawhta a chô lâ maihta Abeipa lâta hmohlâpa cha ama pie awpa a châ.
Nama hrona chatlai nawpa ta Abeipa lâ hmo nama hlâ tita, chyhsa hneirôhpa ta sekel khophie hlâta hluh via a pie awpa châ leipa ta, dyhchhiepa chhao ta sekel khophie hlâta chyh via a pie awpa châ vei.

Hrona chatlaina sôh cha Izarei sawzy tawhta la aw chi ta, ahmaohna poh o liata chakaona rai hria nawpa châta na pie aw. Chatanachata nama hrona chatlai nawpa ta nama piepa a châzie Izarei sawzy ta Abeipa hmiakô liata namâ thei thlâhna a châ aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“A si nawpa ta dawh rahô tao aw chi ta, a patyuna dawh chhaota na tao aw. Cha cha ahmaohna poh o nata maisâh likawh liata patyu aw chi ta, a chhôh liata ti na soh aw.
Cha cha Arawna nata a sawchapawzy ku nata phei a si nawpa a châ aw.

Ahmaohna poh o chhôh lâ amâ ngia tita, ama thi lei nawpa ta, ti ta amâ si awpa châ ta, Abeipa lâta mei ta raopa hmohlâpa chakaona rai hria awpa ta maisâh amâ hnia tita chhao, ama thi lei nawpa ta, ti ta amâ si awpa a châ.
Ama thi lei nawpa ta ama ku nata pheizy amâ si tyh awpa a châ. Cha cha ano nata a pathlazy nata ama chhâ zydua châta chhâzaw bieraopa a châ aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Ropahâhpa pahâh chaipazy a tlyh la, Achhyna o sekel reizie ta, deiryh ti sekel 500 a hripa, cha khophie ta lôiasoh ropahâhpa sekel 250 a hripa, basuh ropahâhpa sekel 250 a hripa,
lôiasoh chihropa sekel 500 a hripa nata ôli thaw chhiehroôh ôh kha la aw chi ta,
chazy hmâpa ta ropahâhpa taotuhpa taozie hawhta sathaw pathaihpa na tao aw. Cha cha sathawthuna liata hmâ awpa sathaw pathaihpa a châ aw.
Cha ropahâhpa chata apakhyna poh o, Biehrai Byh,
tlâhkhai nata a hmobaoh zydua, meiôh tôh nata a hmobaohzy, ropahâhpa maisâh,
raopa hlâna maisâh nata a hmobaoh zydua, rahô nata a patyunazy na hnia khai aw.
Chazy cha hmo pathaih ngaitapa ama châ thei nawpa ta pathaisa aw chi ta, cha hmozy a hriapa maih cha ama pathaih lymâ aw.
Kei châta theihthaipa chakaona rai hriapa ta eina chakao thei nawpa ei ta, Arawna nata a sawchapawzy cha sathawthupa ta na pathaisa aw ei.
Chatawhcha Izarei sawzy hnohta, ‘He he nama chhâ zydua châta sathaw pathaihpa a châ aw.
Chyhsa pôhpa liata hry awpa châ leipa ta, he sathaw taozie hawhna heta sathaw hropa tao awpa châ hra vei. He sathaw he cha pathaih ta, nama châta hmo pathaihpa a châ.
He sathaw taozie hawhta sathaw hropa a taopa nata theihthaipa a châ leipa chô liata a hmâhpa cha, a phopi tawhta chhawh pathlahpa a châ aw,’ tah mah y,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Ropahâhpa pahâh ngaitapa stâti, ônichâ nata kâbanu zy cha deiryh pasoh ngaitapa chhaota khopathliahna â khopa sai ta la aw chi ta,
cha cha ropahâhpa taotuhpa taozie hawhta taopa ta, alôh mia aw chi ta, ropahâhpa pasohpa nata pathaih ngaitapa na tao aw.
Thokha a dipa ta charo aw chi ta, ei châ vaw tyh nawpa ahmaohna poh o chhôh liata Biehrai Byh hmiakô liata na soh aw. Cha cha nama châta hmo pathaih ngaitapa a châ aw.
Cha ropahâhpa, a tao nawpazie ta na tao awpa cha, nâmo châta namâ tao awpa châ leipa ta, Abeipa châta hmo pathaihpa ta namâ pyh awpa a châ.
Ahy rai ano châta ropahâh chakhyhpa hawhta a hmâhpa cha, a phopi tawhta chhawh pathlahpa a châ aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Pachâ teh, Zudâh chi Hurâ sawchapawpa Uri sawchapawpa Bezale cha a moh tlai ta aw na ta,
ano cha sona, novâhna, pahnona nata zôthaina tozy hnei awpa ta Khazohpa Thlahpa ta ei pabie.
Ngôh, tâkâ nata dawh chhaichhizy â ngia ngaitapa ta daih thaina zôthaina zy,
lôsôhpazy daih ta pangaih thaina zy, tho khie thaina nata kuzô thaina to hnei awpa ta, Khazohpa Thlahpa ta ei pabie.
A hnohta a hria awpa ta, Dânâ chi Ahisamâ sawchapawpa Ôhôliaba ei rao. Tao awpa bie ei cha piepa zydua ama tao thei nawpa ta, novâhpa zydua palôh liata sona soh na ta,
ahmaohna poh o, Biehrai Byh nata a chô liata zawngiahna dyuchhai, poh o chhôh liata hmobaoh zydua,
tlâhkhai nata a hmobaohzy, ngôh suapa ta taopa meiôh tôh hmobaohzy, ropahâhpa maisâh,
raopa hlâna maisâh nata a hmobaoh zydua, rahô nata a patyuna,
theihthaipa chakaona rai ama hria nawpa ta chysia a ngia ngaitapa ta sapa theihthaipa Arawna chysia pathaihpa nata a sawchapawzy chysia,

sathaw pathaihpa nata Su Pathaihpa châta ropahâhpa pahâh ngaitapazy ama tao thei nawpa ta, zôthaipa zydua hnohta sona ei pie ei. Tao awpa ta bie ei cha piepa zydua hawhna khata ama tao awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,

“Izarei sawzy hnohta hetana heta reih teh, ‘Ei Pahânohzy nama chay awpa a châ. Cha cha nama chhâ zydua châta kei nata nâmo likah ta ngiana châ aw ta, chatanachata kei he Zehôvâh Mekâdiske ei châ tahpa nama pahno aw.

Pahânoh cha nama châta noh pathaihpa a châpa vâta nama chay awpa a châ. Pahânoh a papuapaleipa maih cha thie thlyu awpa châ ta, cha noh liata raihria kheihawhpa rai a hriapa chyhsa cha, a phopi tawhta chhawh pathlahpa a châ aw.
Noh charu chhôh rai hria aw ei chi ta, a noh sarina noh cha a pahâ nawpa Pahânoh zachhihpa châ ta, Abeipa châta noh pathaihpa a châ. Ahy rai Pahânoh ta rai a hriapa cha thie thlyu awpa a châ.
Chavâta Izarei sawzy ta Pahânoh cha ama chay awpa châ ta, chhâzaw biehrai ta hneipa ta, ama chhâ zydua ta ama chay awpa a châ.
Noh charu chhôh Abeipa ta avâ nata alei tao ta, a noh sarina noh cha a pahâpa ta a hu â pahnopa vâta, Pahânoh cha kei nata Izarei sawzy azaona ngiana a châ zôzaw aw,’ tah mah y,” tah ta.
Khazohpa ta Mawsi cha Sinai Tlâh liata bie â chho khai nahta, Khazohpa kudy ta ropa biehrai lôphia mianozy cha Mawsi hnohta pie ta.

Mawsi cha tlâh tawhta charâ ta a za chô leipa zawpi ta ama pahno nahta, Arawna lâta zawpi a hmaohpakhy ei ta, a hnohta, “Thyu la, eima hmia lâta a sie awpa khazoh miah taopa teh. Kha Mawsi, Izi râh tawhta miah a kaw chhi papuatuhpa chyhsa kha, khâpa hmo ma a chô liata a tlô tahpa pahno khao ma pi hih,” tah ei ta.
Arawna ta ama hnohta, “Nama lapinôzy, nama sawchapawzy nata nama sawchanôzy ta ama nakao liata amâ bapa ngôh rahyzy pahluh u la, kei lâ vaw chei teh u,” tah ta.
Chatanachata zawpi zydua ta ama nakao liata amâ bapa ngôh rahyzy cha pahluh ei ta, Arawna lâ vaw cheih ei ta.

Arawna ta ngôh rahy ama vaw piepazy cha la ta, viahchaotaw nothlahpa leih ta, ngôh daina chhaichhi hmâpa ta â ngia kawpa ta daih ta. Zawpi ta, “Hy Izarei, he he Izi râh tawhta châ kaw chhi papuatuhpa na khazoh a châ hih” tah ei ta.
Cha cha Arawna ta a hmô nahta, viahchaotaw nothlahpa hmiakô liata maisâh tao ta. Arawna ta tlâh awh ta, “Mylâ cha Abeipa châta kyhchhi a y aw,” tah ta.
A mylâ mydi kari ta thyu ei ta, raopa hlânazy hlâpa ta, aryhna hlânazy vaw cheih ei ta. Niedo awpa ta zawpi a tyuh ei ta, cha khai tawhta a palypauasa awpa ta thyu ei ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Zu teh, na phopi Izi râh tawhta nâ kaw chhi papuapazy âmosasyh ta amâ parao ha khuh.

Ei biepiepazy thlai tleisaipa ta, viahchaotaw nothlahpa a tao ei ta, cha cha amâ chhy. Ano lâ a theih ei ta, ‘Hy Izarei, he he Izi râh tawhta châ kaw chhi papuatuhpa na khazoh a châ hih!’ ama tah,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “He phopi he moh thlâh ha ei na ta, phopi chhoru ngaitapa ama châ.
Chavâta na patypamâ khao mâh khah y, ei pathi iana ta âmo kâ sala, ei pahleipadia khai hana hâh ei ta. Chatanachata nâ cha phopi rônahpa ta ei cha tao aw,” tah ta.

Châhrasala Mawsi ta Abeipa a Khazohpa cha a haw ta, a hnohta, “Hy Abeipa, hmotaotheina rônahpa nata ku thatlôpa ta Izi râh tawhta nâ kaw chhi papuapa na phopi chô liata khazia ma cha tlu po ta na hie a hâh tly?

Izi mo ta, ‘Izarei sawzy cha tlâhzy liata thie ta, alei chô tawhta âmo pamuapa ta, ama chô liata chhiena patlôsa awpa ta, Khazohpa ta â chhi papua ei,’ ama cha tah aw mâh tâh? Na hiehâhna ru ngaitapa cha padia la, na palôh panano la, na phopi chô liata chhiena patlôsa nâ chhuahpa cha, rie patlôsa khah y.

Châ chakaotuhpa Abarahâ, Aisika nata Izarei hnohta, ‘Avâ liata Awhsi zie ta na pathlazy papôh aw na ta, pie awpa ta bie ei vaw taihpa râh zydua kha na pathlazy pie aw na ta, chhâzaw ryuto châta ama hnei aw,’ tahpa ta nâma tlai ta bie nâ vaw taih hapazy kha rie a thei mah y,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Abeipa cha a palôh panano ta, a phopi chô liata chhiena patlôsa awpa bie a reipa cha a pathleih haw.
Mawsi cha tlâh tawhta zâ lie ta, biehrai lôphia miano a ku liata chabapa ta za chô ta. Lôphiazy cha kârano ta ropa châ ta, a hmia nata a hnôh ta ropa a châ.
Lôphiazy cha Khazohpa taopa châ ta, bieropazy chhao Khazohpa ropa châ ta, lôphiazy liata khiepa ta ropa a châ.
Zawsua ta zawpi awpa pyu a thei nahta, Mawsi hnohta, “Riehmo liata adyuhna pyu a y,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta, “Cha pyu cha pahniena pyu châ leipa ta, Pahniepazy chana ao châ hra vei, Hla sapa pyu tlao ei thei,” tah ta.
Mawsi cha riehmo kiapâh a kei tlô nahta, viahchaotaw nothlahpa nata ama lâpazy hmô ta. Mawsi cha a hiehâh ngaita ta, a ku liata lôphiazy cha tlâh thaby liata thy ta, kei khai ha ta.
Viahchaotaw nothlahpa ama taopa cha la ta, mei ta rao ta, a dina taihta charo ta, a paohpa ti liata hie ta, Izarei sawzy padosa ta.
Mawsi ta Arawna hnohta, “He phopi heta na chô liata khâpa ma tao ei ta, he hawhpa hmo molei ngaitapa he ama chô liata na patlôsa?” tah ta.
Arawna ta, “Ei zibeipa a pathi ia khah sy. He phopi he pahno chi ta, moleina lâ a heihpa ama châ tahpa na pahno.
Âmo ta ei hnohta, ‘Eima hmia lâta a sie awpa khazoh miah taopa teh. Izi râh tawhta miah a kaw chhi papuatuhpa Mawsi chô liata khâpa hmo ma a tlô tahpa pahno khao ma pi,’ vaw tah ei ta.
Kei ta ama hnohta, ‘Ngôh a hneipa maihta pahluh mawh ei sy,’ tah na ta. Na vaw pie ei ta, cha cha mei liata phôh na ta, chatanachata he viahchaotaw nothlahpa he a vaw pua thlâh haw!” tah ta.
Zawpi âmo kho ta ama ypa Mawsi ta hmô ta. Arawna ta ama chariahpazy mohmô ta mohnao chhihpa ta yna taihta âmo kho ta a paysapa a châ.
Mawsi cha riehmo chhikao liata a duah ta, “ Abeipa chhâh a châpa maih kei lâ a vy teh u,” tah ta. Livai sawchapaw zydua ano lâ vawh ei ta.

Mawsi ta ama hnohta, “Zehôvâh, Izarei Khazohpa ta hetana heta a tah: ‘Chyhsa to nama zaozi phia u la, riehmo chhikao to liata a ngia u la, nama unawhzy, nama ylâhpazy, nama vaihzy thie teh u,’” tah ta.
Livai sawchapawzy ta Mawsi bie hawhta tao ei ta, cha noh liata chyhsa sâh thôh rachhôh ama thi.
Mawsi ta, “Tanoh he Abeipa châta a panano teh u. Chyhsa to ta ama sawchapawzy nata ama unawhzy a dyuh ha ei ta, chavâta tanoh he Abeipa ta byhnâ a cha pie aw ei,” tah ta.
A mylâ ta Mawsi ta zawpi hnohta, “Moleina lai ngaitapa nama tao haw. Tahmâ he Abeipa lâ khy aw na ta, nama moleina chatlaina ei tao thei aw tly ma,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Mawsi cha Abeipa lâ khy heih ta, a hnohta, “He phopi heta moleina lai ngaitapa ama tao haw. Ngôh khazoh amâ tao.
Ngiachhiepa ta ama moleinazy rie a ngiahthai mah y. Nâ ngiahthai thei leipa khiahta cha, na châbu liata na ropa tawhna khata na thy ha mah y,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Ahy rai ei chô liata hmo a paraopa maih ei châbu tawhta ei thy aw.
Tahmâ zu la, phopi cha, sie nawpa ei cha chhopa su lâ a chhi mah y. Ei vâlyuhchâpa ta hmia a châ sahpa aw. Chatahrasala ei cha vaw tly ti ei ta cha, ama moleina vâta ei hrie pyly aw ei,” tah ta.
Chatanachata viahchaotaw nothlahpa ama taopa vâta, Arawna taopa nothlahpa vâna tlai khata, Abeipa ta Izarei phopi cha potlana ta a hrie haw.

Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Izi râh tawhta nâ kaw chhi papuapazy chhao khata, he su tawhta pua u la, Abarahâ, Aisika nata Zakaw hnohta, ‘Na pathlazy hnohta ei pie aw,’ tahpa ta bie ei vaw taihpa râh lâ khy teh u.
Ei vâlyuhchâpa nama hmia lâta tuah aw na ta, Kâna mo, Amawri mo, Hiti mo, Perizi mo, Hivi mo nata Zebu mozy ei papua aw ei.

Sâhpiti nata kheihti lona râh lâ cha khy teh u. Kei deikua cha, nama hnohta a khy hra aw va na. Chataleipatala phopi chhoru ngaitapa châ ei chi ta, lâpi liata ei cha pahleipadia pathlei aw ei na,” tah ta.
Cha bie pachâchhiechhih ngaitapa cha zawpi ta ama thei nahta, cha ei ta, ama sôhthihzy a tobi tlâ khao leipa ei ta.

A chhâpa cha, Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Izarei sawzy chho teh, ‘Phopi chhoru ngaitapa nama châ. Chavâta nama hnohta buakhata chhao ei sie hra khiahta cha, ei cha pahleipadia khai thlâh ha aw ei. Tahmâ nama sôhthihzy kha pahluh khai teh u, chatanachata nama chô liata ei tao awpa ei pahno aw,’” a vaw tah hapa vâta a châ.
Chavâta Izarei sawzy ta ama sôhthihzy cha Hôribâ tlâh liata ama pahluh khai haw.

Mawsi ta poh o puakheipa ta, riehmo khôtho lâ, riehmo tawhta â hlapa liata parai tyh ta. Cha cha a moh ta ahmaohna poh o bi ta. Abeipa a pado khohpa maihta riehmo khôtho lâta ahmaohna poh o lâ cha ama pangai tyh.
Mawsi ta poh o lâ a vaw nahta, zawpi zydua thyu ei ta, ama poh o chhikao chyu liata a duah ei ta, poh o chhôh lâ â ngia hlâlei Mawsi cha ama sai thlâh ha tyh.
Mawsi ta poh o chhôh lâ â ngiapata nahta, meihdo tôh thlai za chô ta, poh o chhikao liata a vaw duah ta, Abeipa ta Mawsi cha bie â vaw chho tyh.
Pôh o chhikao liata meihdo tôh a duahpa cha zawpi zydua ta ama hmô nahta, zawpi zydua cha thyu ei ta, ama poh o chhikao chyu liata amâ chhy tyh.

Cha hawhna chata, chyhsa ta a viasa bie â chhopa hawhta, Abeipa ta Mawsi cha hmiadaisâ ta bie â chho tyh. Cha khai tawhta Mawsi cha riehmo lâ a lie tyh ta, a chakaotuhpa thyutliapa Nunâ sawchapawpa Zawsua deikua cha poh o puasai beih vei.

Mawsi ta Abeipa hnohta, “Nâ ta ei hnohta, ‘He phopi he a chhi teh,’ tah chi ta, châhrasala nâ sielâh awpa chyhsa na chho tlôh leipa chi ta. Cha leipa chhao ta, ‘Na moh ta cha pahno na ta, nâ chhao ei modypa ta na y hra,’ na tah chi ta.
Na mo ei dy khiahta cha, ngiachhiepa ta na lâpizy na pahmô mah y. Chatanachata cha pahno aw na ta, na modypa ta ei y lymâ thei aw. He phopi he na phopi ama châpa rie a thei mah y,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta, “Ei ypâna nama hnohta sie aw ta, ei cha pahâsa aw ei,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta Abeipa hnohta, “Na ypâna cha eima hnohta a sie leipa khiahta cha, he tawhna heta miah pasiesa khah y.

Kei nata na phopi he, na mo dypa ta eima y tahpa kheihta chyhsa ta ama pahno thei aw? Miah ypâ chi ta, eima hnohta na siena liana chata vei ma, kei nata na phopi he alei chô liata phopi hropa zydua nata eimâ nanona cha â lâ aw vei?” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Ei modypa ta y chi ta, na moh ta ei cha pahnopa na châpa vâta, na reipa chhao cha ei tao aw,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta, “Ngiachhiepa ta na rônahna na pahmô mah y,” tah ta.

Abeipa ta, “Ei phana zydua na hmiakô liata vaw pasiesa aw na ta, ei moh Zehôvâh cha na hmiakô liata ei phuah aw. Ei ngiachhie awpa chyhsa cha ngiachhie aw na ta, zawh ei ngiah awpa chyhsa cha zawh ei ngiah aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta, “Chyhsa ta eina hmô khiahta cha a hroh lei awpa vâta, ei hmia cha hmô thei aw va chi,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta, “Moh teh, ei kiapâh liata lôpanô a y hih. Cha liata a duah aw chi ta,
ei rônahna ta a cha vaw chapia tita, lôpanô keina liata cha nyu aw na ta, ei cha sie pakhô hlâlei cha, ei ku ta ei cha chhôkhâh aw.
Ei ku cha la heih aw na ta, ei hnôhky hmô aw chi ta, ei hmia deikua hmô aw va chi,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Lôphia hmiatuapazy hawhpa kha miano khai heih la, cha lôphiazy liana chata lôphia hmiatuapa na pakei hapazy liata biezy kha ei roh heih aw.
Mylâ my a vaw mâ la, Sinai tlâh lâ mydi ta a khy la, tlâh laki liata ei hmiakô liata a vaw duah mah y.

Na hnohta pakha hmah amâ khy awpa châ leipa ta, tlâh zydua liata chyhsa pakha hmah ama y awpa châ vei. Mietaku zawzy nata viahchao hrizy chhao tlâh dady liata ama lao ama bâ awpa châ hra vei,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Mawsi ta hmiatuapa hawhta lôphia miano khai ta, mydi kari ta thyu ta, Abeipa ta bie a piepa hawhta Sinai tlâh lâ khy ta, lôphia mianozy cha a ku ta chaba ta.
Abeipa cha meihdo hry liata a zu ta, Mawsi kiapâh liata a vaw duah ta, a moh cha Abeipa a châ tahpa ta phuah ta.
Abeipa cha Mawsi hmiakô liata vaw sie ta, “ Abeipa, Abeipa, zawngiahna nata ngiachhiena Khazohpa, hiehâh rupa, kyhpachâna nata ngâchhihna ta a biepa,

chyhsa sâh hluhpi chô liata ngiachhiena palâsa ta, taopasina nata paraona nata moleinazy a ngiahthai ta, thailei a châpazy deikua hrie leipa ta a pakhôsa leipa, pawzy hmoparaona cha saw nata samoh sahlâhzy chô liata patlôsa ta, chhâ thôhna nata chhâ palihna taihta a patlôsapa,” tahpa ta a phuah ta.
Mawsi cha alei lâ thlai a bôh ta, Abeipa cha a chhy ta.

Mawsi ta, “Tahmâ na modypa ei châ khiahta cha, Hy Abeipa, ngiachhiepa ta Abeipa cha eima hnohta sie hra mawh sy. Phopi chhorupa châ hrei sih la, eima paraona nata eima moleinazy miah a ngiahthai la, na ryuto châta miah hnei mah y,” tah ta.

Abeipa ta, “Pachâ teh, bie ei hrai hih. Na phopi hmiakô liata hmonoâhpa ei tao aw. Cha cha khizaw zydua nata kheihawhpa phopi hry lia hmahta tao beih leipa a châ. Na chô liata ei tao awpa hmo cha rarôh y ngaitapa a châpa vâta, na pahrâlâhpa phopi zydua ta Abeipa raihria ama hmô aw.
“Tanoh ta bie ei cha piepa he zyh mah y. Amawri mo, Kâna mo, Hiti mo, Perizi mo, Hivi mo nata Zebu mozy cha na mohmô liata ei papua aw ei.
Na sie nawpa râh liata a pahrâpazy hnohta biehrai tao lei awpa ta a vaih mah y. Chataleipatala nama hry liata khoheih ama châ pathlei aw.
Ama maisâhzy pacho aw ei chi ta, ama lôbôzy pakei khaipa ta, ama Aseri tôhzy nama chhawh pachhô khai awpa a châ.
Khazoh hropa rai namâ chhy awpa châ vei. Abeipa cha a moh Hiatlia châ ta, a hiatlia pasa kawpa Khazohpa a châ.

Cha râh liata a pahrâpazy hnohta biehrai tao lei awpa ta a vaih teh u. Chataleipatala ama khazohzy liata sihryhpa ta, ama khazohzy lâta amâ theih tita, cha hrua aw ei ta, amâ theihna sa nama nie pathlei aw na.
Cha leipa chhao ta, nama sawchapawzy châta ama sawchanôzy hnei aw ei chi ta, ama sawchanôzy ta ama khazohzy liata sihryh aw ei ta, nama sawchapawzy chhao ama khazohzy liata ama pasihryhsa pathlei aw.
“Thua ta leihpa nothlahpa khazohzy na tao awpa châ vei.

“Viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa kyhchhi na chay awpa a châ. Bie ei cha piepa hawhna khata, Abi thla daihti raopa liata noh sari chhôh viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa na nie awpa a châ, Abi thla liata Izi râh tawhta na kaw puapa vâta.
Chhi a pahy tua chaipa maih keima eih a châ. Na sahroh a pataw tuapa a chapawpa zydua, viahchao chhao, mietaku chhao, kei eih a châ khai.

Alâ a pataw tuapa cha mietakutaw ta na chatlai aw. Na chatlai khoh vei khiahta cha, a rao na thlie pachhô awpa a châ. Na sawchapaw uhtheipa zydua cha na chatlai awpa a châ. Ei hmiakô liata ahy hmahta ku ruapa ta namâ vy awpa châ vei.
“Noh charu chhôh rai hria aw chi ta, a noh sarina noh deikua cha nâ pahâ aw. Leipalie daihti nata sâh hria daihti hmahta châ hra sala, nâ pahâ awpa a châ.
Hâta Kyhchhi chay aw chi ta, cha cha sâh hria a daih tua chaipa kyhchhi a châ. Kô châhdi sâh pakhy khai tawhta Peihtla Kyhchhi chhao na chay tyh aw.
Chapaw zydua kô kha ta ei thôh Abeipa Khazoh, Izarei Khazohpa hmiakô liata amâ lâ tyh awpa a châ.
Phopizy na hmiakô tawhta papua aw na ta, na râhrizy ei pakawh awpa vâta, kô kha ta ei thôh Abeipa na Khazohpa hmiakô liata a lâ awpa ta nâ khy chhôh ta, na râh cha ahy hmahta uahva thei aw veih ei.
“Atheihna sa thisaih eina hlâ ti chi ta, viahchhâ thinô pahlaopa chhaota na vaw hlâ awpa châ leipa ta, Zawpakhô Kyhchhi atheihna chhao a mylâ taihta a y awpa châ vei.
Na lyu liata chicheipa a daih tua chaipazy hry liata a pha chaipazy cha, Abeipa na Khazohpa o liata na hlâ awpa a châ. Mietaw sa cha a panô sâhpiti ta na chho awpa châ vei,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “He biezy he roh teh. He biezy hmâpa heta, nâ nata Izarei hnohta bie ei hraih haw,” tah ta.
Mawsi cha, cha liata Abeipa hnohta noh sypalih nata zâ sypalih y ta, pati rai nie leipa ta, ti chhao doh vei. Chatanachata Abeipa ta Biepiepa Miahrawh biehrai biezy cha lôphiazy liata roh ta.
Mawsi cha biehrai lôphia miano a ku ta chabapa ta Sinai Tlâh tawhta za chô ta. Tlâh tawhta a za chô nota, Abeipa bie â chhopa vâta, a hmia a khaih hapa a pahno leipa ta.
Arawna nata Izarei saw zydua ta Mawsi hmia khaihpa ama hmô nahta, a hnia ngâh leipa ei ta.
Mawsi ta âmo cha aw ta, Arawna nata zawpi ryureituhpa zydua cha ano lâ a lie ei ta, Mawsi ta âmo cha bie a chho ta.
Cha khai tawhta Izarei saw zydua ta a vaw hnia ei ta, Abeipa ta Sinai Tlâh liata a chhopa bie zydua cha, biepiepa châta âmo pie pachhuah ta.
Ama hnohta bie a rei khai nahta, Mawsi cha hmiakhuna ta a hmia a khu ta.
Abeipa bie a chho awpa ta a hmiakô liata â ngia nahta deikua cha, a pua heih hlâlei a hmiakhuna cha hlai tyh ta. A kaw pua nahta, a hnohta biepiepa cha Izarei sawzy hnohta a reih pachhuah tyh.
Izarei sawzy ta Mawsi hmia moh ei ta, a khaih ha tyh. Chavâta Mawsi cha Khazohpa bie a chho awpa ta â ngia heih hlâlei hmiakhuna ta a hmia cha a khu heih tyh.
Mawsi ta Izarei zawpi zydua pahmaoh ta, ama hnohta, “He biezy he Abeipa ta tao awpa ta a cha piepa ei a châ.
Noh charu chhôh rai hria awpa châ ta, a noh sarina noh deikua cha, nama châta noh pathaihpa, Abeipa châta a pahâ nawpa Pahânoh zachhihpa a châ aw. Ahy rai cha noh ta rai a hriapa cha thie awpa a châ.
Pahânoh cha nama pahrâna su zydua liata mei rai nama patih awpa châ vei,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta Izarei zawpi zydua hnohta, “He he Abeipa biepiepa a châ.
Nama hry tawhta Abeipa châta thyuna vaw cheih teh u. Abeipa châta thyuna pie khohna palôh a hneipa maihta thyuna cha vaw cheih ei sala, ngôhzy, tâkâzy, dawhzy;
pala nohpa, saihdôhpa nata saihlawpazy, pala rih dipa pabaohpazy, mie hmizy;
mietaku tôhpa vo pasaihpazy, tilaipi siahrâ vozy, akeisia thozy;
khaihna châta sathaw zy, sathaw pathaihpa châta nata ropahâhpa raopa châta ia-ôzy;
ephaw nata chachôhna vyhphao kiky pakyu nawpa ta beri lôzy nata lôsôhpazy vaw cheih mawh ei sy.
“Nama hry liata zôthaipa zydua a vy ei sala, Abeipa ta bie a piepa zydua tao mawh ei sy:
Achhyna byureih nata a poh o nata a khuna zy, a patusanazy, a thophiazy, a tlâhzy, a tôhzy, a patyunazy;
Biehrai Byh nata a lâhreizy, zawngiahna dyuchhai nata khuna pohraipa;
tlâhkhai nata a lâhreizy, a chhaichhi zydua nata ypâna viahchhâ;
khaihna châta meiôh tôh nata a hmobaoh zydua, a meiôhzy nata khaihna châta sathaw;
ropahâhpa maisâh nata a lâhreizy, sathawthuna sathaw, ropahâhpa pahâh ngaitapa nata achhyna byureih chhikao liata parai awpa chhikao pohraipa;
raopa hlâna maisâh nata a dawh sao, a lâhreizy, a hmobaoh zydua nata rahô nata a patyuna;
dôhpachhôh tlyhmia pohraipazy nata a tôhzy, a patyunazy nata dôhpachhôh tlyhmia kaohrai pohraipa;
achhyna byureih khaipânazy, dôhpachhôh tlyhmia dôhna khaipânazy, a chaorizy;

Su Pathaihpa liata chakao nawpa ta â ngia ngaitapa ta sapa chysiazy, theihthaipa chakaona rai hria nawpa châta theihthaipa Arawna chysia pathaihpa nata a sawchapawzy chysia ama vaw cheih awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Izarei zawpi zydua cha Mawsi mohmô tawhta pua ei ta.
Palôh thathyupa nata pie khohna palôh a hneipa maih a vy ei ta, ahmaohna poh o nata a chakaona nata chysia pathaihpazy tao nawpa ta hmâ awpa ta Abeipa lâ thyuna vaw cheih ei ta.

A chanô chapaw ta, a palôh liata khona a hneipa maih a vy ei ta, lâkyuzy, rahyzy, moh chahnaona kusadizy, pachhihzy, ngôh ta taopa sôh nata thih to vaw cheih ei ta, chyhsa zydua ta Abeipa lâ ngôhzy hlâ ei ta.
Pala nohpazy, saihdôhpazy, saihlawpazy, pala rih dipazy, mie hmizy, mietaku tôhpa vo pasaihpa nata tilaipi siahrâ vo a hneipa maihta vaw cheih ei ta.
Tâkâ nata dawh zy a thyu theipa ta Abeipa châta thyunazy vaw cheih ei ta. Khâpa chhaichhi châ chhâ ta hmâh awpa ta, akeisia tho a hneipa zydua ta vaw cheih hra ei ta.
Chanô zôthaipa sahlao zydua ta ama ku ta pala pahieh ei ta, pala nohpazy, saihdôhpazy, saihlawpazy nata pala rih dipa ama pahiehpazy vaw cheih ei ta.
Chanô palôh thathyupa zydua ta ama zôthaina hmâpa ta mie hmi pahieh ei ta.
Ryureituhpazy ta beri lôsôhpazy nata ephaw nata chachôhna vyhphao liata kiky pakyu awpa lôsôhpazy vaw cheih ei ta.
Ia-ôzy nata khaihna châta hmâ awpa nata sathawthuna nata ropahâhpa châta hmâ awpa sathawzy vaw cheih hra ei ta.
Chatanachata Izarei saw zydua, a chanô chapaw ta, ama palôh liata pie khohna a hneipa maihta, Abeipa ta tao awpa ta Mawsi ku liata bie a piepa zydua tao nawpa ta lôhthai thyuna vaw cheih ei ta.
Mawsi ta Izarei sawzy hnohta, “Pachâ teh u, Abeipa ta Zudâh chi Hurâ sawchapawpa Uri sawchapawpa Bezale cha a moh tlai ta aw ta.
Ano cha sona, novâhna, pahnona nata zôthaina tozy hnei awpa ta Khazohpa Thlahpa ta pabie ta.
Ngôh, tâkâ nata dawh chhaichhizy â ngia ngaitapa ta daih thaina zôthaina piepa ta,
lôsôhpazy daih ta pangaih thaina nata tho khie thaina nata kuzô thaina to hnei awpa ta a aw.
Bezale nata Dânâ chi Ahisamâ sawchapaw Ôhôliaba cha ama pano ta chyhsazy pachu thaina sona pie ta.

Âmo cha rai zydua hria thai awpa ta palôh sona ta pabie ta, tho nata lô khie thaina, phorâ thaina, pala nohpa, saihdôhpa, saihlawpa nata pala rih dipa pabaohpazy ta kiky zei thaina nata poh sa thaina zy ama hnohta pie ta, rai to hria thaina nata zôthaina ta a tobi ei.”

Chatawhcha Mawsi ta, “Supathaihpa liata rai to hria thai nawpa ta Abeipa ta sona nata novâhna a piepa Bezale, Ôhôliaba nata chyhsa zôthaipa zydua ta Abeipa biepiepa zydua ama hria awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta Bezale, Ôhôliaba nata Abeipa ta ama palôh liata sona a piepa zôthaipa zydua nata palôh thathyuna a hneipa maih aw ta.
Izarei sawzy ta supathaihpa châta rai hria nawpa ta ama vaw thyupa zydua Mawsi tawhta la lymâ ei ta. My chareih ta lôhthai thyunazy Mawsi hnohta vaw hlâ pazao lymâ ei ta.
Zôthaipazy ta âmo rai siesaipa ta supathaihpa rai tlao ama hria lymâ.
“ Abeipa ta tao awpa ta bie a piepazy tao nawpa châta â ngiahpa khô lâ taihta chyhsazy ta hmo ama vaw hlâ,” tahpa ta Mawsi cha chho ei ta.

Chavâta Mawsi ta biepie ta, “A chanô chapaw ta supathaihpa châta thyuna vaw pie khao khah ei sy,” tahpa ta ama riehmo zydua liata tlâh paawsa ta. Cha hawhna chata zawpizy cha ama thyuna chalihsapa a châ.
Thyuna ama hmôpazy tawhta rai zydua hria nawpa châta â daihpa dei châ leipa ta, a hluhna lâ tlao a châ.

Raihriatuhpazy hry liata zôthaipa zydua ta achhyna byureih cha pohraipa miahrawh a hneipa ta tao ei ta. Cha pohraipazy cha pala rih dipa pabaohpa nata pala nohpa, saihdôhpa nata saihlawpa zy hmâpa ta taopa châ ta, zôthaipazy ta zôpha kawpa ta ama taopa cherubi nothlahpazy pachohsapa a châ.
Pohraipa maih cha a doh lâ dy kih nata dy charie, a hâ lâ dy palih châ ta, pohraipa zydua amâ kho khai.
Zôthaipa ta pohraipa miapangawh pazao ta, pohraipa hropa chhao miapangawh ta pazaopa ta tao ta.
Pohraipa pazaopa miakhana liata pohraipa chhâna pai liata a nali nohpazy tao ta, cha hawhna chata pohraipa pazaopa mianona liata pohraipa chhâna pai liata tao hra ta.
Pohraipa pazaopa miakhana pai liata a nali sypangawh tao ta, pohraipa pazaopa mianona pai liata a nali sypangawh tao hra ta, cha nalizy cha â dadypa ta sopa ama châ.
Ngôh ta taopa hraina sypangawh tao ta, hrainazy chata pohraipazy cha hrai pakaoh ta, chatanachata achhyna byureih tlohpa vaw châ ha ta.
Achhyna byureih chôkhu poh o châta mie hmi pohraipazy tao ta, pohraipa miahrawh hleikha a tao.
Pohraipa maih cha a doh lâ dy sythôh, a hâ lâ dy palih châ ta, pohraipa miahrawh hleikhazy cha â kho khai.
Pohraipa miapangawh pazao ta, pohraipa miacharu pazao hra ta.
Pohraipa pazaopa miakhana liata pohraipa chhâna pai liata a nali sypangawh tao ta, pohraipa pazaopa mianona liata pohraipa chhâna pai liata chhao, a nali sypangawh thla ta.
Poh o tlohpa a vaw châ thei nawpa ta, dawh ta taopa hraina sypangawh tao ta.
Mietaku tôhpa vo pasaihpa hmâpa ta poh o chôkhu tao ta, tilaipi siahrâ vo ta a chô khu pachhuahna a tao.
Achhyna byureih pâhchhô cha akeisia thophiazy hmâpa ta â tôh lâta chhôh ta.
Thophia cha a doh lâ dy hrawh seih ta, a hâ lâ dy kha nata khophie a kawh.
Pazao nawpa ta, thophia zydua a ngaih miano chyu hnei ta, cha hawhna chata achhyna byureih pâhchhô thophia zydua cha tao ta.
Cha hawhna chata achhyna byureih pâhchhô cha tao ta, chho lâ daih châta thophia phia kih a tao.

A ngaih miano pangaih nawpa ta, thophia phia kha ry liata patyuna miano lymâ tao ta, thophia hropazy ry liata chhao, a ngaih miano pangaih nawpa ta patyuna miano lymâ tao hra ta, thophia phia kih ry liata tâkâ ta taopa patyuna sypalih a tao.
Achhyna byureih kâ hiakha lâ, maw lâ daih châta thophia phia kih tao ta.
Thophia phia kha ry liata patyuna miano tao ta, thophia hropazy ry liata chhao patyuna miano lymâ taopa ta, thophia phia kih châta tâkâ ta taopa patyuna sypalih a tao.
Achhyna byureih hnôh lâ, notla daih lâ châta thophia phia charu tao ta,
achhyna byureih hnôh lâta a ki chhânazy châta thophia phia no tao hra ta.
Thophia phia no cha a thaby tawhta a pawhmao taih ta, a nali hmiatua chaipa tlôna taihta pakyu ta, cha hawhna chata ki no liata tao raihrie ta.
Thophia phia charie y ta, amâ tyu nawpa ta tâkâ ta taopa patyuna miahrawh hleicharu y ta, thophia phia kha ry liata patyuna miano lymâ a tao.
Akeisia tho ta pâhchhô tlâhzy tao ta, achhyna byureih kâ hiakha lâ pâhchhô phiazy paryh nawpa ta tlâh pangawh,
achhyna byureih kâ hiakha lâ pâhchhô phiazy paryh nawpa ta tlâh pangawh, achhyna byureih hnôh lâ notla daih lâta pâhchhô phiazy paryh nawpa ta tlâh pangawh tao ta.
Pâhchhô khophie liata a liah tlâh pakhâh ta, cha chata pâhchhô phia hiakha lâ chhâna tawhta hiakha lâ chhâna taihta a lâ hrei ta.
Pâhchhô phiazy cha ngôh ta pahu ta, a tlâhzy hrei pakhâh nawpa châta ngôh tiakizy tao ta, a tlâhzy cha ngôh ta pahu ta.
Pohraipa cha pala nohpa, saihdôhpa nata saihlawpazy nata pala rih dipa pabaohpazy hmâpa ta tao ta, cha liata zôpha kawpa ta taopa cherubi nothlahpazy pachohsa ta.
Cha châna chata akeisia tho tôh miapalih tao ta, chazy cha ngôh ta pahu ta, a bainazy ngôh ta tao ta, amâ tyuna châta tâkâ ta taopa patyuna miapalih leih ta.
Poh o chhikao châta pohraipa tao ta, cha cha pala rih dipa pabaohpa nata pala nohpa, saihdôhpa nata saihlawpazy ta kiky zeipa ta taopa a châ.
A baina chhaopa chhikao pohraipa tôh miapangawh tao ta, a tôh lubyuhpazy nata a patusanazy cha ngôh ta pahu ta, a patyuna miapangawh deikua cha dawh a châ.
Bezale ta akeisia tho ta Biehrai Byh tao ta, a doh lâ dy no nata khophie seih ta, a hâ lâ dy kha nata khophie kawh ta, â sâhna lâ dy kha nata khophie a châ.
A chhôh nata khôtho lâ ngôh suapa ta pahu ta, ngôh ta a tlâh a pakyu.
A phei miapalih liata pataoh awpa ngôh tiaki miapalih leih ta, tiaki miano hiakha lâ châta châ ta, tiaki miano hiakha lâ châta a châ.
Akeisia tho ta a lâzy tao ta, chazy cha ngôh ta pahu ta,
Byh a sy nawpa ta a kâ lâta tiakizy liata a lâzy a chahraoh.
Ngôh suapa ta zawngiahna dyuchhai tao ta, a doh lâ dy no nata khophie seih ta, a hâ lâ dy kha nata khophie a kawh.
Cherubi miano ngôh ta tao ta, zawngiahna dyuchhai a kâ chavei chachâh liata a daih ta daihpa ta a tao.
Cherubi miakha zawngiahna dyuchhai hiakha lâ pai liata pataoh ta, cherubi hropa hiakha lâ pai liata pataoh ta, zawngiahna dyuchhai nata pazaopa ta dyuchhai kâ chavei chachâh ta cherubi miano a tao.
Cherubizy cha zawngiahna dyuchhai lâ a heihpa ta, ama hmia a chhy ei ta, ama mathlawzy â sâhpa ta pakai ei ta, zawngiahna dyuchhai cha ama mathlaw ta ama khu.
Akeisia tho ta tlâhkhai tao ta, a doh lâ dy no seih ta, a hâ lâ dy kha kawh ta, a sâhna lâ dy kha nata khophie a châ.
Cha cha ngôh suapa ta pahu ta, ngôh ta a tlâh a pakyu.
Pazah tie phiapa ta a tlâh tao ta, a tlâh â dôna taihta ngôh ta a pakyu.
Tlâhkhai châta ngôh tiaki miapalih leih ta, tiakizy cha tlâhkhai ki phei palih liata pataoh ta.
Tlâhkhai a sy tita a lâ chahraoh nawpa ta, tiakizy cha pakyuna liata pataoh ta.
A lâzy akeisia tho ta tao ta, ngôh ta pahu ta.
Tlâhkhai hmobaoh, beikohzy, ukâzy, biebuhzy nata dopa hlâna patlai nawpa beihraizy ngôh suapa ta tao ta.
Ngôh suapa ta meiôh tôh tao ta. A tôh thaby, a tôh, a nyuzy, a paw ngaihchakuazy nata a pawzy a pazao khaipa ta a tao.
A kâ chavei chachâh ta a chiah miacharu pachiah ta, meiôh tôh kâ hiakha lâ a chiah miathôh y ta, meiôh tôh kâ hiakha lâ a chiah miathôh y hra ta.

Hiakha lâ chhâh chiah liata kuasâh paw pabyuhpa a lyupa nyu miathôh, a paw ngaihkaru nata a paw a hneipa tao ta, hiakha lâ chhâh chiah liata chhao kuasâh paw pabyuhpa a lyupa nyu miathôh, a paw ngaihkaru nata a paw a hneipa tao hra ta. Cha hawh lymâ chata meiôh tôh tawhta a puapa chiah miacharu châta tao ta.
Meiôh tôh liata kuasâh paw pabyuhpa a lyupa nyu miapalih, a paw ngaihkaru nata a paw a hneipazy y ta.

A chiah miano ry liata a paw ngaihkaru miakha y ta, a chiah hropa miano ry liata a paw ngaihkaru miakha y ta, a chiah hropa miano ry liata a paw ngaihkaru miakha y hra ta, cha hawh lymâ chata, meiôh tôh tawhta a puapa a chiah miacharu châta tao khai ta.
A paw ngaihkaru nata a chiahzy cha meiôh tôh nata a pazao khai ta, ngôh suapa ta hmaohkha ta daih khoh khaipa a châ.
Meiôh miasari tao ta, a chaikiezy nata meipaoh sonazy ngôh suapa ta tao ta.
Ngôh suapa talent miakha hmâpa ta meiôh tôh nata a chhaichhi zydua a tao.

Ropahâhpa rao nawpa ta maisâh ki palihpa akeisia tho ta tao ta, a doh lâ dy kha seih ta, a hâ lâ dy kha a kawh. Maisâh cha ki palih hneipa ta taopa châ ta, â sâhna lâ dy no a châ. Maisâh ki palih liata a kizy taopa châ ta, maisâh nata pazaopa ta taopa a châ.
A chôzy, a kâzy nata a kizy ngôh suapa ta pahu ta, a kiahzy ngôh pakyupa ta a padô.
Maisâh asyna lâhrei chahraoh nawpa ta, maisâh kiah ry a kâ chavei chachâh ta ngôh tiakizy a pataoh.
Akeisia tho ta a lâhreizy cha tao ta, ngôh ta a pahu.
Sathawthuna châta sathaw pathaihpa nata ropahâhpa pasohpa tao ta, ropahâhpa a tao thaipazy taozie hawh tlai ta a tao.
Akeisia tho ta raopa hlâna maisâh, a doh lâ dy pangawh a seihpa nata a hâ lâ dy pangawh a kawhpa tao ta. Maisâh cha ki palih hneipa ta taopa châ ta, â sâhna lâ cha dy thôh a châ.
Maisâh chaki miah palih liata a kizy tao ta, a kizy cha maisâh nata pazaopa ta taopa châ ta, dawh ta a pahu.
Maisâh chhaichhi zydua, beihzy, buchâh linazy, rahôzy, sa thaona thuakuzy, mei lanazy dawh ta tao ta.
Maisâh châta dawh sao tao ta, sao cha maisâh kiah ry lâ, maisâh khophie liata phaw ta.
A lâzy chahraoh nawpa ta dawh sao sona ki palih liata pataoh awpa tiaki miapalih leih ta.
A lâzy cha akeisia tho ta tao ta, dawh ta pahu ta.
A sy nawpa ta a kâ chavei chachâh ta a lâzy chahraoh ta, maisâh cha thophia ta dôhpa ta a chhôh pakaopa ta tao ta.
Ahmaohna poh o chhikao liata chakaotuhpa chanôzy thlalâ hmâpa ta rahô nata a patyuna dawh ta tao ta.
Achhyna byureih dôhpachhôh tlyhmia tao ta, tlyhmia chho lâ chhâh cha pala rih dipa pabaohpa ta taopa pohraipa dy za kha a seihpa ta chhôh ta.
Pohraipa tôh kih nata a patyuna miakih dawh ta tao ta, a tôh liata bainazy nata patusanazy deikua cha tâkâ ta taopa a châ.

Cha hawhna chata dôhpachhôh tlyhmia maw lâ chhâh chhao pala rih dipa pabaohpa ta taopa pohraipa dy za kha a seihpa ta chhôh ta. Pohraipa tôh kih nata a patyuna miakih dawh ta tao ta, a tôh liata bainazy nata patusanazy deikua tâkâ ta taopa a châ.
Dôhpachhôh tlyhmia notla lâ chhâh cha dy sypangawh a kawhpa pohraipa ta chhôh ta, a tôh miahrawh nata a patyuna miahrawh y ta, a tôh liata bainazy nata patusanazy cha tâkâ ta taopa a châ.
Dôhpachhôh tlyhmia nochhi lâ chhâh chhao dy sypangawh a kawh.
Chhikao hiakha lâta pohraipa parai awpazy cha dy hrawh hleipangawh seih ta, a tôh miathôh nata a patyuna miathôh a y.

Cha hawhna chata chhikao hiakha lâ chhao taopa a châ. Achhyna byureih dôhpachhôh tlyhmia chhikao kâ chavei chachâh pohraipazy cha dy hrawh hleipangawh seih ta, a tôh miathôh nata a patyuna miathôh a y.
Achhyna byureih dôhpachhôh tlyhmia liata pohraipa zydua cha pala rih dipa pabaohpa ta taopa sai a châ.

A tôh patyunazy dawh châ ta, a tôh liata a bainazy nata a patusanazy cha tâkâ châ ta, a lubyuhpazy tâkâ ta pahupa a châ. Achhyna byureih dôhpachhôh tlyhmia tôh zydua cha, tâkâ tlâhzy ta patusapa a châ.

Achhyna byureih dôhpachhôh tlyhmia chhikao liata pohraipa cha, poh kiky thai ngaitapa ta pakyupa châ ta, pala rih dipa pabaohpa zy, pala nohpa, saihdôhpa nata saihlawpa zy ta taopa a châ. A doh lâ dy kih seih ta, â sâhna lâ cha achhyna byureih dôhpachhôh tlyhmia pohraipazy nata pakhopa ta dy pangawh ta taopa a châ.
A tôh miapalih y ta, a tôhzy patyuna miapalih y ta, dawh ta taopa a châ. A tôhzy liata a bainazy cha tâkâ ta taopa châ ta, a lubyuhpazy nata a patusanazy chhao tâkâ ta pahupa a châ.
Achhyna byureih nata a tlyhmia dôhna khaipâna zydua cha dawh sai a châ.

Hezy biehrai byureih tahpa ta moh bi hrapa achhyna byureih sana nata a chhaichhizy châta thyunazy a châ. Chazy cha Mawsi biepiepa hawhta, theihthaipa Arawna sawchapawpa Ithamâ chhihthana ry liata Livai chizy ta ama ropa a châ.
Zudâh chi Hurâ sawchapawpa Uri sawchapawpa Bezale ta Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta tao awpa ta bie a piepa zydua cha tao khai ta.
A hnohta tho nata lô a khie thaipa zôthai ngaitapa, pala nohpa, saihdôhpa nata saihlawpa nata pala rih dipa pabaohpazy hmâpa ta kiky a thaipa Dânâ chi Ahisamâ sawchapawpa Ôhôliaba ta hria ta.
Supathaihpa châta hmâ awpa ngôh thyuna zydua cha, supathaihpa liata hmâpa sekel reizie ta reipa ta, talent miakih nata miachaki nata sekel za sari nata sythôh a châ.
Supathaihpa liata hmâpa sekel reizie ta reipa ta, maluh reipazy hry liata a hlaopa zawpi ta tâkâ ama thyupa zydua cha, talent za kha nata sekel 1,775 a châ.
Kô kih tawhta a chô lâ maluh reipa chapaw 603,550 ta bekâ miakha chyu thyu ei ta. Bekâ miakha cha supathaihpa liata hmâpa sekel reizie ta reipa ta sekel khophie a châ.

Supathaihpa tôh patyuna nata pohraina tôh patyunazy châta leih awpa ta tâkâ talent za kha hmâpa châ ta, a tôh patyuna miakha leih nawpa ta talent miakha lymâ ta hmâpa ta, a tôh patyuna za kha leih nawpa ta talent za kha hmâpa a châ.
Sekel 1,775 hmâpa ta, a tôh liata a bainazy tao ta, a lubyuhpa zy cha tâkâ ta pahu ta, a patusanazy a tao.
Dawh ama thyupa zydua cha talent sysari nata sekel 2,400 a châ.
Chazy hmâpa ta ahmaohna poh o chhikao tôh patyunazy, dawh maisâh, dawh sao nata maisâh liata chhaichhi zydua,
achhyna byureih dôhpachhôh tlyhmia dôhna tôh patyunazy, achhyna byureih chhikao tôh patyunazy, achhyna byureih khaipâna zydua nata achhyna byureih tlyhmia dôhna khaipâna zydua a tao khai.

Su Pathaihpa liata chakao nawpa ta, pala nohpa, saihdôhpa nata saihlawpazy hmâpa ta chysia ngia ngaitapazy tao ei ta. Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa hawhta, Arawna châta chysia pathaihpazy tao ei ta.
Ngôh, pala nohpa, saihdôhpa, saihlawpa nata pala rih dipa pabaohpazy hmâpa ta ephaw tao ta.
Pala nohpa, saihdôhpa, saihlawpa nata pala rih dipazy cha zôpha kawpa ta a kiky pakyu nawpa ta, ngôh cha â pa kadiepa ta paphiapa ta, a ri ta pachhaih ei ta.
Theihthaipa viahkao châta a ngiatlâh rizy tao ei ta, cha chata viahkao luh pawhmao liata, viahkao hmia lâ nata a hnôh lâ pazao ei ta.

Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa hawhta, viahkao chô liata, viahkao lyupa ta, viahkao nata pazaopa ta chaisaihna tao ei ta, ngôh, palâ nohpa, saihdôhpa, saihlawpa nata pala rih dipa pabaohpazy hmâpa ta, zôpha kawpa ta sapa a châ.
Awnisi lôsôhpazy pachhuahpanoh ei ta, chazy cha ngôh ta taopa patusana liata pangaih ei ta, moh chahnaona taozie hawhta taopa ta, cha liata Izarei sawzy moh roh ei ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa hawhta, cha moh rona lôsôhpazy cha Izarei sawzy atheithlâhna alôzy châta ephaw ngiatlâh rizy liata bai ta.
Ephaw taozie hawhta chachôhna vyhphao tao ta, ngôh, pala nohpa, saihdôhpa, saihlawpa nata pala rih dipa pabaohpazy hmâpa ta zôpha kawpa ta tao ta.
Chachôhna vyhphao cha ki palih hnei ta, pathopa ta taopa châ ta, a doh lâ kha kha, a hâ lâ kha kha ta pathopa ta taopa a châ.
Cha liata lôsôhpazy tlâh palih ta patlâh ei ta, tlâh khana cha sadôni, tôpazi nata kabuni lôzy châ ta,
tlâh nona cha emyrâ, saphirâ nata lônah zy châ ta,
tlâh thôhna cha zaki, akate nata amethi lôzy châ ta,
tlâh palihna cha beri, awnisi nata zaspi lôzy a châ. Chazy cha ngôh patusana liata pangaihpa a châ.

Lôsôhpa miahrawh hleino y ta, chazy cha Izarei saw pahrawh hleino moh lymâ hawhta ama moh bipa a châ. Lôsôhpa miahrawh hleino cha moh chahnaona hawhta tao chyupa châ ta, lôsôhpa miakha chô liata Izarei chi hrawh hleino hry liata chi kha moh pachohsa lymâpa a châ.
Chachôhna vyhphao chô liata ngôh suapa ta taopa bâlia chaori hawhta charipazy tao ei ta,
ngôh patusana nata ngôh tiaki miano tao ei ta, cha tiaki miano cha chachôhna vyhphao pai chavei chachâh ta pataoh ei ta.
Ngôh bâlia miano cha chachôhna vyhphao pai chavei chachâh ta tiaki miano liata buh ei ta.
Bâlia charipa pawhmao raihrie cha patusana miano liata pazao ei ta, chazy cha ephaw hmia lâta a ngiatlâh rizy liata buh ei ta.
Ngôh tiaki miano tao ei ta, chazy cha chachôhna vyhphao ry lâ liata ephaw â daihpa lâta a pai chavei chachâh liata pataoh ei ta.

Ngôh tiaki hropa miano tao ei ta, chazy cha ephaw hmia lâta a ngiatlâh rizy thaby liata pataoh ei ta, cha ngôh tiakizy cha zôpha kawpa ta sapa ephaw chaisaihna chô lâta â pazaona kiapâh liata pataoh ei ta.

Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa hawhta, chachôhna vyhphao tiakizy cha ephaw tiakizy nata pala nohpa charipa ta chahry pabaoh ei ta, chatanachata chachôhna vyhphao cha zôpha kawpa ta sapa ephaw chaisaihna chô lâta y ta, ephaw liata â ipa ta a bai ta.
Ephaw ry lâta a ky awpa viahkao pasipa cha a nohpa sai ta sa ta.
Viahkao pasipa liana cha viahkao rao khaoh paaw ta, cha khaoh cha â hrie thei lei nawpa ta a kiah mei ta.
Viahkao paizy liata pawmikarânâ nothlahpa cha pala nohpa, saihdôhpa, saihlawpa nata pala rih dipa pabaohpazy hmâpa ta tao ei ta.
Ngôh suapa lailô tawtawzy tao ei ta, cha lailôzy cha viahkao pasipa a dôpa ta, viahkao pasipa pai liata pawmikarânâ likawhzy liata soh ei ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa hawhta, chakao nawpa viahkao pasipa cha, lailô miakha nata pawmikarânâ miakha lymâ ta i-âhpa ta, viahkao pasipa pai padôpa ta tao ei ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa hawhta, Arawna nata a sawchapawzy châta pala rih dipa ta sapa chôthozy tao ei ta.
Pala rih dipa ta taopa lakhu, pala rih dipa ta taopa luhkhunazy nata pala rih dipa pabaohpa ta taopa chaopasyzy tao hra ei ta.
Pala rih dipa pabaohpa nata pala nohpa, saihdôhpa nata saihlawpazy hmâpa ta kiky pakyupa chaisaihnazy ama tao.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa hawhta, ngôh suapa lakho pathaihpa tao ei ta, cha liata “ Abeipa châta Pathaihpa,” tahpa bie moh chahnaona taozie ta taopa ta pachohsa ei ta.
Cha cha theihthaipa lakhu liata pala nohpa charipa ta hraih pa-ipa ta ama bai.
Chatanachata ahmaohna poh o liata achhyna byureih raihria zydua cha palohpa châ ta, Abeipa ta tao awpa ta Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa zydua hawhta Izarei sawzy ta tao ei ta.
Mawsi lâta achhyna byureih cha a vykhei ei ta, poh o nata a chhaichhi zydua, a bainazy, a thophiazy, a tlâhzy, a tôhzy, a patyuna zy;
mietaku tôhpa vo pasaihpa ta taopa khuna, tilaipi siahrâ vo ta taopa khuna, chhôkhâhna pohraipa;
Biehrai Byh nata a lâhreizy, zawngiahna dyuchhai;
tlâhkhai nata a chhaichhi zydua nata ypâna viahchhâ;
ngôh suapa ta taopa meiôh tôh nata meiôhzy, a hmobaoh zydua nata pakhaih nawpa sathaw;
ngôh maisâh, sathawthuna châta sathaw, ropahâhpazy, poh o chhikao pohraipa;
dawh maisâh nata a dawh sao, a lâzy, a hmobaoh zydua, rahô nata a patyuna;

dôhpachhôh tlyhmia dôhna pohraipazy nata a tôhzy, a patyunazy, dôhpachhôh tlyhmia chhikao pohraipa, a chaorizy, a khaipânazy, achhyna byureih nata ahmaohna poh o liata chakaona rai hria nawpa chhaichhi zydua;
Su Pathaihpa liata chakaona rai hria nawpa ta chysia sapa, theihthaipa Arawna châta chysia pathaihpazy nata a sawchapawzy ta theihthaipa rai ama hria nota amâ ky awpa chysiazy taopa a châ.
Chatanachata Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa zydua hawhta Izarei sawzy ta ama tao khai.
Mawsi ta raihria zydua cha moh ta, Abeipa biepiepa hawhta paloh khaipa a châpa hmô ta, chatanachata Mawsi ta âmo cha byhnâ a awpa ei.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Thla khana noh khana noh liata ahmaohna poh o achhyna byureih na padua awpa a châ.
A chhôh liata Biehrai Byh soh aw chi ta, Byh cha pohraipa ta na chhôkhâh aw.
Tlâhkhai a ngiakhei aw chi ta, a chô liata hmo so awpazy soh khai aw chi ta, meiôh tôh a ngiakhei aw chi ta, a meiôhzy na patyuh aw.
Ropahâhpa raona ngôh maisâh Biehrai Byh hmiakô liata soh aw chi ta, achhyna byureih chhikao liata pohraipa na parai aw.
Ahmaohna poh o achhyna byureih chhikao hmiakô liata raopa hlâna maisâh na patyuh aw.
Ahmaohna poh o nata maisâh likawh liata rahô patyuh aw chi ta, cha liata ti na soh awpa a châ.
Achhyna byureih padôpa ta dôhpachhôh tlyhmia tao aw chi ta, dôhpachhôh tlyhmia chhikao liata pohraipa na parai aw.
Chatawhcha sathawthuna châta sathaw la aw chi ta, achhyna byureih nata a chhôh liata a ypa zydua thu aw chi ta, na pathaisa aw. Chatanachata achhyna byureih hmobaohzy cha ama vaw pathaih ha aw.
Raopa hlâna maisâh nata a hmobaoh zydua sathawthu aw chi ta, maisâh pathaisa aw chi ta, chatanachata hmo pathaih chaipa a vaw châ aw.
Rahô nata a patyuna chhao sathawthu aw chi ta, na pathaisa aw.
Arawna nata a sawchapawzy ahmaohna poh o chhikao thaby liata a vaw chhi aw chi ta, ti ta na pasi aw ei.
Arawna cha chysia pathaihpazy pakysa aw chi ta, sathawthu aw chi ta, na pathaisa aw. Chatanachata theihthaipa rai hriapa ta eina chakao thei aw.
A sawchapawzy chhao a vaw chhi aw chi ta, chôtho na paky aw ei.

Theihthaipa rai hriapa ta eina chakao thei nawpa ei ta, ama paw sathaw na thupa hawhta âmo chhao sathaw na thu hra aw. Sathawthupa ama châpa cha, ama chhâ zydua ta theihthaipa ama châ lymâ nawpa châta a châ aw,” tah ta.
Cha hawhna chata Mawsi ta tao ta, Abeipa ta tao awpa ta bie a piepa zydua hawhta tao khai ta.
Chatanachata a kô nona thla hmiatua chaipa thla, noh khana noh liata achhyna byureih cha paduapa a châ.
Mawsi ta achhyna byureih cha padua ta, a patyunazy paryh ta, a thophiazy padua ta, a tlâhzy chahraoh ta, a tôhzy padua ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa hawhta, achhyna byureih chô liata poh o parai ta, cha poh o chô cha a khuna ta khu ta.
Biehrai la ta, Byh chhôh liata khô ta, Byh cha a lâzy hrei ta, Byh chô liata zawngiahna dyuchhai soh ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa hawhta, Byh cha achhyna byureih chhôh lâ a ngiakhei ta, khuna pohraipa parai ta, Biehrai Byh cha khu ta.
Ahmaohna poh o chhôh liata tlâhkhai patyuh ta. Cha cha achhyna byureih maw lâchhâh, khuna poh khôtho liata a ypa a châ.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa hawhta, viahchhâ cha Abeipa hmiakô ta tlâhkhai liata yzie hnei kawpa ta soh ta.
Ahmaohna poh o achhyna byureih chho lâchhâh tlâhkhai dady liata meiôh tôh soh ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa hawhta, meiôhzy cha Abeipa hmiakô liata soh ta.
Ahmaohna poh o pohraipa hmia lâta ngôh maisâh soh ta,
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa hawhta, a chô liata ropahâhpa pahâh ngaitapa rao ta.
Achhyna byureih chhikao pohraipa parai ta.
Ahmaohna poh o achhyna byureih chhikao hmiakô liata raopa hlâna maisâh patyuh ta, Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa hawhta, a chô liata raopa hlâna nata niepa hlânazy hlâ ta.
Ahmaohna poh o nata maisâh likawh liata rahô patyuh ta, a si nawpa ti patlai ta.
Cha liata Mawsi nata Arawna nata a sawchapawzy ama ku nata ama pheizy a si ei ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa hawhta, ahmaohna poh o liata amâ ngia chy nata maisâh thaby lâta ama vaw chy maihta amâ si tyh.
Achhyna byureih nata maisâh padôpa ta dôhpachhôh tlyhmia tao ta, dôhpachhôh tlyhmia chhikao pohraipa parai ta. Cha hawhna chata Mawsi ta raihria cha a patlô haw.
Chatawhcha ahmaohna poh o cha meihdo ta vaw pahly ta, achhyna byureih cha Abeipa rônahna ta bie ha ta.
Cha hawhta meihdo a vaw chhoh ta, Abeipa rônahna ta achhyna byureih a bie hapa vâta, Mawsi cha ahmaohna poh o chhôh lâ a ngia thei khao vei.
Ama sie laihna liata, achhyna byureih chô liata meihdo papaipa a châ nahta, Izarei sawzy cha a pasie tyh ei ta.
Meihdo papaipa a châ vei khiahta cha, papaipa a châ hlâlei a pasie leipa ta ama y tyh.
Abeipa meihdo cha nohchhô ta achhyna byureih chô liata a chhoh ta, cha liata zâ ta mei vaw y ta, ama sie laihna zydua liata, Izarei pathlazy ta meihdo nata mei cha ama hmô laih lymâ.
Abeipa ta Mawsi aw ta, ahmaohna poh o tawhta bie a vaw chho ta, a hnohta,
“Izarei sawzy chho la, ama hnohta hetana heta reih teh: Nama hry liata ahy rai ta Abeipa lâta hmo nama hlâ tita, viahchao hri nata mietaku zaw tawhta sahroh nama hlâ awpa a châ.

“A hmohlâpa cha viahchao hri tawhta raopa hlâna a châ khiahta cha, a chapawpa seina hnei leipa a hlâ awpa a châ. A hmohlâpa cha Abeipa hmiakô liata a pyhpa a châ thei nawpa ta, ahmaohna poh o chhikao thaby liata a hlâ awpa a châ.
Raopa hlâna luh chô liata a ku pahnieh aw ta, chatanachata ano chatlaina châta raopa hlâna cha ano vyuhpa ta a pyhpa a châ aw.
Viahchao tôhpa cha Abeipa hmiakô liata thie aw ta, Arawna sawchapaw theihthaipazy ta a thisaih hlâ aw ei ta, ahmaohna poh o chhikao liata maisâh kâ zydua liata thisaih ama thia aw.
Chatawhcha raopa hlâna sahroh cha a vo hlaih aw ta, a pachhaih aw.
Theihthaipa Arawna sawchapawzy ta maisâh chô liata mei patih aw ei ta, mei chô liata tho ama pacho aw.
Arawna sawchapaw theihthaipazy ta sa cha, a luh nata a thaw chhaota a vyuh vyuh ta paziah aw ei ta, chazy cha maisâh mei tho chô liata ama soh aw.
A chhôrihzy nata a pheizy deikua cha, ti ta a pasi tua awpa a châ. Theihthaipa ta sa cha a zydua ta maisâh liata a rao aw. Cha cha ropahâhpa châta Abeipa lâta raopa hlâna, mei ta hmohlâpa a châ.
“Raopa hlâna châta a hlâ awpa cha mietaku zaw hry liata mietaku tlyma, mie tlyma a châ khiahta cha, a chapawpa seina hnei leipa a hlâ awpa a châ.
Maisâh kâ maw lâchhâh ta Abeipa hmiakô liata thie aw ta, Arawna sawchapaw theihthaipazy ta maisâh kâ zydua liata a thisaih ama thia aw.
A sa cha a hlâtuhpa ta pachhaih aw ta, theihthaipa ta a luh nata a thaw chhaota maisâh mei tho chô liata a soh aw.
A chhôrihzy nata a pheizy deikua cha, ti ta a pasi tua awpa a châ. Theihthaipa ta a zydua ta hlâ aw ta, maisâh liata a rao aw. Cha cha ropahâhpa châta Abeipa lâta raopa hlâna, mei ta hmohlâpa a châ.
“ Abeipa lâta raopa hlâna ta a hlâ awpa cha pavaw hry tawhta a châ khiahta cha, vachhuh tlyma, pivaw taw tlyma a hlâ awpa a châ.
Theihthaipa ta maisâh lâ cheih aw ta, a rao chamieh pachhô aw ta, a thisaih cha maisâh kâ liata pathlaoh aw ta, maisâh chô liata a rao aw.
A hmi chhaota a daoh hlaih aw ta, maisâh kiapâh nochhi lâchhâh ta buchâh thyna su liata a thy aw.

A mathlawzy chamieh pachhô aw ta, a pachhaih deikua pachhaih pathlah awpa châ vei. Hmohlâpa cha theihthaipa ta maisâh mei tho chô liata a rao aw. Cha cha ropahâhpa châta Abeipa lâta raopa hlâna, mei ta hmohlâpa a châ.
“Chyhsa ta Abeipa lâ niepa hlâna a hlâ tita, viahdie dipa a hlâ awpa a châ. Sathaw bao aw ta, a chô liata deiryh soh aw ta,

Arawna sawchapaw theihthaipazy lâ a vawkhei aw. Theihthaipa ta viahdie dipa cha a sathaw nata a deiryh zydua chhaota, pazah kha la aw ta, cha cha atheithlâhna hmo a châ aw. Niepa zydua hlâ khaipa a châzie a thei thlâh ha nawpa ta maisâh liata a rao aw. Cha cha ropahâhpa châta Abeipa lâta raopa hlâna, mei ta hmohlâpa a châ.
Niepa hlâna laibâhpazy cha Arawna nata a sawchapawzy châta a châ aw. Cha cha Abeipa lâta mei ta hlâpazy hry liata hmo pathaih chaipa a châ.

“Viahchhâ taona beih ta viahchhâ taopa niepa hlâna na hlâ tita, viahdie dipa nata sathaw pahlaopa ta taopa thinô pahlao leipa viahchhâ pakâhpa tlyma, sathaw hniapa thinô pahlao leipa viahchhâ apapa tlyma na hlâ awpa a châ.
“Na hmohlâpa cha lômathu liata pakâhpa a châ khiahta cha, thinô pahlao leipa viahdie dipa cha sathaw pahlaopa ta na tao awpa a châ.
Patlaw aw chi ta, sathaw na bao aw. Cha cha niepa hlâna a châ.
“Na hmohlâpa cha ukâ ta chateipa niepa hlâna a châ khiahta cha, viahdie dipa sathaw pahlaopa ta tao awpa a châ.
“Cha hmozy ta taopa niepa hlâna cha Abeipa lâ vaw cheih aw chi ta, theihthaipa hnohta pie aw chi ta, ano ta maisâh lâ a vawkhei aw.
Niepa hlâna tawhna chata theihthaipa ta atheithlâhna hmo la aw ta, maisâh liata a rao aw. Cha cha ropahâhpa châta Abeipa lâta raopa hlâna, mei ta hmohlâpa a châ.
Niepa hlâna laibâhpazy cha Arawna nata a sawchapawzy châta a châ aw. Cha cha Abeipa lâta mei ta hlâpazy hry liata hmo pathaih chaipa a châ.
“ Abeipa lâta mei ta hlâpa châta thinô nata kheihtizy na rao awpa a châ leipa vâta, Abeipa hnohta na hlâ awpa niepa hlânazy cha thinô pahlaopa ta tao awpa châ vei.
Niepa hlânazy cha thei hmiatuapa hlâpa hawhta Abeipa lâta hlâ aw chi ta, maisâh liata ropahâhpa hlâna châta deikua hmâ awpa châ vei.
Niepa hlâna zydua alôh mia khai aw chi ta, na Khazohpa biehrai alôh cha, niepa hlâna liata iah leipa ta a y awpa châ vei. Na hmohlâpa zydua liata alôh na hlâ pâ lymâ awpa a châ.
“Thei hmiatuapa tawhta niepa hlâna Abeipa lâta na hlâ khiahta cha, sâh suh a daih tuachaipazy hry tawhta tai aw chi ta, cha cha mei liata zawh aw chi ta, tly aw chi ta, a sâh cha na hlâ awpa a châ.
Sathaw bao aw chi ta, a chô liata deiryh na soh aw. Cha cha niepa hlâna a châ.
Theihthaipa ta sâh tly chiehpa cha, sathaw nata deiryh zydua chhaota atheithlâhna châta a rao aw. Cha cha Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpa a châ.
“Chyhsa hmohlâpa cha aryhna hlâna châta atheihna châ sala, viahchao hri tawhta a hlâ khiahta cha, a chapawpa tlyma, a chanôpa tlyma hlâ thei ta, Abeipa hmiakô liata seina hnei leipa a hlâ awpa a châ.
A hmohlâpa luh chô liata a ku pahnieh aw ta, ahmaohna poh o chhikao thaby liata thie aw ta, Arawna sawchapaw theihthaipazy ta maisâh kâ zydua liata a thisaih ama thia aw.
Aryhna hlâna châta atheihna cha Abeipa lâta mei ta hlâ aw ta, a rihhri nata a chhôrih liata thaw zydua nata
a patoh kiapâh liata a lôpo miano nata a lôpo a pahlypa thawzy nata a pathi a pahlypa thawzy cha, a lôpozy chhaota la aw ta, a hlâ aw.
Chazy cha Arawna sawchapawzy ta maisâh liata raopa hlâna mei tho chô liata ama rao aw. Cha cha ropahâhpa châta Abeipa lâta raopa hlâna, mei ta hmohlâpa a châ.
Chyhsa ta aryhna hlâna atheihna châta Abeipa lâta a hlâpa cha, mietaku zaw tawhta a châ khiahta cha, a chapawpa tlyma, a chanôpa tlyma hlâ thei ta, seina hnei leipa a hlâ awpa a châ.
A hmohlâpa châta mietakutaw a cheih khiahta cha, Abeipa hmiakô liata hetana heta a hlâ aw:
A hmohlâpa luh chô liata a ku pahnieh aw ta, ahmaohna poh o tlyhmia liata thie aw ta, Arawna sawchapawzy ta maisâh kâ zydua liata a thisaih ama thia aw.
Cha hawhna chata aryhna hlâna atheihna châta mei ta hmohlâpa cha Abeipa lâ a hlâ aw. Abeipa lâta a thawzy a hlâ aw. A lahmei thawhpa a ky ru tlôna taihta lapazy, a rihhrizy, a chhôrih liata thawzy,
a lôpo miano nata a patoh kiapâh liata a lôpo a pahlypa thawzy nata a pathi a pahlypa thawzy cha a lôpozy chhaota la aw ta, a hlâ aw.
Chazy cha theihthaipa ta maisâh liata a rao aw. Cha cha Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpa niepa hlâna a châ.
A hmohlâpa cha mie a châ khiahta cha, Abeipa hmiakô liata hetana heta a hlâ aw:
A luh chô liata a ku pahnieh aw ta, ahmaohna poh o tlyhmia liata thie aw ta, Arawna sawchapawzy ta maisâh kâ zydua liata a thisaih ama thia aw.
Chatawhcha a hmohlâpa cha mei ta Abeipa lâ a hlâ aw. A rihhrizy, a chhôrih thawzy,
a lôpo miano nata a patoh kiapâh liata a lôpo a pahlypa thawzy nata a pathi a pahlypa thawzy cha a lôpozy chhaota la aw ta, a hlâ aw.
Chazy cha theihthaipa ta maisâh liata a rao aw. Cha cha ropahâhpa châta mei ta hmohlâpa niepa hlâna a châ. A thaw zydua Abeipa eih a châ.
“Thaw tlyma, thisaih tlyma, nama nie awpa châ vei tahpa cha, nama pahrâna maih liata nama chhâ zydua châta chhâzaw bieraopa a châ aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi chho ta, a hnohta,
“Izarei sawzy hetana heta chho teh: Abeipa ta tao lei awpa ta bie a piepa kheihawhpa tlyma chyhsa ta taopa ta molei pathlei ha sala,

moleina a taotuhpa cha sathawthupa theihthaipa a châpa vâta, Izarei phopi chô liata thaileichâna a patlôsa awpa a châ khiahta cha, a moleina chatlai nawpa ta, viahchao tôh dawpa seina hnei leipa cha, moleina hlâna châta Abeipa lâ a hlâ awpa a châ.
Viahchao tôhpa cha ahmaohna poh o chhikao thaby liata Abeipa hmiakô ta a vaw chhi aw ta, viahchao tôhpa luh chô liata a ku pahnieh aw ta, Abeipa hmiakô liata viahchao tôhpa cha a thie aw.
Sathawthupa theihthaipa ta viahchao tôhpa thisaih cha la aw ta, ahmaohna poh o lâ â ngiakhei aw.
Theihthaipa ta thisaih liata a kudy ny aw ta, thisaih cha supathaihpa pohraipa hmia liata Abeipa hmiakô ta ei sari a thia aw.

Theihthaipa ta thisaih cha la heih aw ta, ahmaohna poh o chhôh liata ropahâhpa maisâh kizy liata Abeipa hmiakô ta hnia aw ta, viahchao tôhpa thisaih laibâhpa zydua cha, ahmaohna poh o chhikao liata raopa hlâna maisâh thaby liata a patlai khai aw.
Moleina hlâna viahchao tôhpa thaw zydua la aw ta, a rihhrizy, a chhôrih thawzy,
a lôpo miano nata a patoh kiapâh liata a lôpo a pahlypa thawzy nata a pathi a pahlypa thawzy cha a lôpozy chhaota la aw ta,
aryhna hlâna viahchao tôhpa thawzy lapa hawhta a la aw. Chazy cha theihthaipa ta raopa hlâna maisâh liata a rao aw.
Viahchao tôhpa vo nata a sapa zydua cha, a luh nata a phei, a chhôrih nata a iezy chhaota,
a pôhpa duata riehmo khôtho lâta buchâh thyna su sithaipa lâ siekhei aw ta, tho ta a rao aw. Viahchao tôhpa sa cha buchâh thyna liata rao awpa a châ.
“Izarei phopi pôhpalôhpa ta Abeipa ta tao lei awpa ta bie a piepa kheihawhpa tlyma taopa ta ama molei pathlei khiahta cha, zawpi tawhta nyupa a châpa chhao ta, thailei ama châ pyly aw.
Moleina hmo ama taopa cha pahnopa a châ khiahta cha, moleina hlâna châta zawpi ta viahchao tôh dawpa ama hlâ awpa châ ta, cha cha ahmaohna poh o tlyhmia liata amâ vaw chhi awpa a châ.
Zawpi chhituhpa machâzy ta viahchao tôhpa luh chô liata Abeipa hmiakô ta ama ku pahnieh aw ei ta, viahchao tôhpa cha Abeipa hmiakô liata ama thie aw.
Sathawthupa theihthaipa ta viahchao tôhpa thisaih cha la aw ta, ahmaohna poh o lâ â ngiakhei aw.
Theihthaipa ta thisaih liata a kudy ny aw ta, pohraipa hmia liata Abeipa hmiakô ta ei sari a thia aw.

Thisaih la heih aw ta, ahmaohna poh o chhôh liata ropahâhpa maisâh kizy liata Abeipa hmiakô ta hnia aw ta, viahchao tôhpa thisaih laibâhpa zydua cha ahmaohna poh o chhikao liata raopa hlâna maisâh thaby liata a patlai khai aw.
A thaw zydua la aw ta, maisâh liata a rao aw.

Cha hawhna chata viahchao tôhpa cha hlâ aw ta, theihthaipa châta moleina hlâna viahchao tôhpa taozie hawhta a tao aw. Cha hawhna chata theihthaipa ta zawpi châta chatlaina tao aw ta, a ngiahthaipa ama châ aw.
Viahchao tôhpa cha riehmo khôtho lâ phaoh aw ta, viahchao tôhpa hmiatuapa a raopa hawhna khata a rao aw. Cha cha zawpi châta moleina hlâna a châ.
“Ryureituhpa ta Abeipa a Khazohpa ta tao lei awpa ta bie a piepa kheihawhpa tlyma taopa ta a molei pathlei khiahta cha, thailei a châ aw.
Moleina hmo a taopa cha â vaw pahno nahta, hmohlâpa châta mie tôhpa seina hnei leipa a hlâ awpa a châ.
Mie luh chô liata a ku pahnieh aw ta, raopa hlâna thie tyhna liata Abeipa hmiakô ta a thie aw. Cha cha moleina hlâna a châ.
Theihthaipa ta moleina hlâna thisaih cha a kudy ta la aw ta, raopa hlâna maisâh kizy liata hnia aw ta, thisaih laibâhpazy cha raopa hlâna maisâh thaby liata a patlai khai aw.
A thaw zydua cha, aryhna hlâna châta atheihna thaw hawhta maisâh liata rao aw ta, theihthaipa ta a moleina châta chatlaina taopa aw ta, chatanachata a ngiahthaipa a châ aw.
“Vâtlâh hry liata chyhsa pakha ta Abeipa ta tao lei awpa ta bie a piepa kheihawhpa tlyma taopa ta a molei pathlei ha khiahta cha, thailei a châ aw.
Moleina hmo a taopa cha â vaw pahno nahta, a moleina chatlai nawpa ta hmohlâpa châta mie chanôpa seina hnei leipa a hlâ awpa a châ.
Moleina hlâna sa luh chô liata a ku pahnieh aw ta, moleina hlâna cha raopa hlâna su liata a thie aw.
Theihthaipa ta a kudy ta a thisaih la aw ta, raopa hlâna maisâh kizy liata hnia aw ta, thisaih laibâhpazy cha raopa hlâna maisâh thaby liata a patlai khai aw.

A thaw zydua cha, aryhna hlâna châta atheihna thaw lapa hawhta la khai aw ta, theihthaipa ta Abeipa châta ropahâhpa châta maisâh liata a rao aw. Theihthaipa ta chatlaina taopa aw ta, chatanachata a ngiahthaipa a châ aw.
“Moleina hlâna châta mietakutaw hlâ awpa a vaw cheih khiahta cha, a chanôpa seina hnei leipa a vaw cheih awpa a châ.
Moleina hlâna sa luh chô liata a ku pahnieh aw ta, raopa hlâna ama thiena su liata moleina hlâna châta a thie aw.
Theihthaipa ta raopa hlâna thisaih cha a kudy ta la aw ta, raopa hlâna maisâh kizy liata hnia aw ta, thisaih laibâhpazy cha raopa hlâna maisâh thaby liata a patlai khai aw.

A thaw zydua cha, aryhna hlâna châta atheihna mietakutaw thaw lapa hawhta la aw ta, theihthaipa ta maisâh liata Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpa chô liata rao aw ta, moleina hmo a taopa ty thô nawpa ta, theihthaipa ta chatlaina taopa aw ta, chatanachata a ngiahthaipa a châ aw.
“Khihtlâh tymâna kyh liata, mo ta hmôpa ta tlyma, nah ta theipa ta tlyma, chyhsa ta bie pahnotuhpa châ sala, a rei khoh leipa khiahta cha, hmo a paraopa châ ta, a hmoparaona maoh a phaoh aw.

“Chyhsa ta hmo pathaih leipa, râhsa pathaih leipa athipa tlyma, osa pathaih leipa athipa tlyma, alyhpasa pathaih leipa athipa tlyma a hria khiahta cha, pahno leipa ta a hriapa a châpa chhao ta, pathaih leipa châ ha ta, thailei a châ aw.
“Chyhsa ta chyhsa pathaih leina a hria khiahta cha, pathaih leina a tlôkheipa hmo kheihawhpa rai châ sala, pahno leipa ta a hriapa a châpa chhaota, a pahno tita thailei a châ pyly aw.

“Chyhsa ta hmo chhiepa tao awpa tlyma, hmo phapa tao awpa tlyma, a hmao ta naosia kawpa ta bie â taih khiahta cha, kheihawhpa bietai rai châ sala, pahno leipa ta a taopa a châpa chhaota, a pahno tita thailei a châ pyly aw.
“Chazy hry liata miakha liata chhao thailei a châpa chyhsa cha, a moleina phuah aw ta,
a moleina chatlai nawpa ta mietaku zaw hry tawhta mietakutaw chanôpa tlyma, mie chanôpa tlyma, moleina hlâna châta Abeipa lâ hlâ aw ta, theihthaipa ta a moleina chatlaina a taopa aw.

“Mietakutaw a pachâ thei leipa khiahta cha, a moleina chatlai nawpa ta vachhuh pô no tlyma, pivawtaw pô no tlyma Abeipa lâ a hlâ awpa a châ. Pô kha moleina hlâna châta châ aw ta, ahropa cha raopa hlâna châta a châ aw.
Theihthaipa lâ cheih aw ta, theihthaipa ta moleina hlâna hlâ tua aw ta, a luh thaby liata a rao a chamieh aw. Chamieh pachhô awpa deikua châ vei.
Moleina hlâna thisaih cha maisâh kâ liata thia aw ta, thisaih laibâhpazy cha maisâh thaby liata palosa khai awpa a châ. Cha cha moleina hlâna a châ.
Ahropa cha raopa hlâna châta hlâ aw ta, raopa hlâna taozie hawhta hlâ awpa a châ. Theihthaipa ta a moleina chatlaina taopa aw ta, chatanachata a ngiahthaipa a châ aw.

“Vachhuh pô no tlyma, pivawtaw pô no tlyma a pachâ thei leipa khiahta cha, a moleina chatlai nawpa ta, moleina hlâna châta viahdie di ngaitapa kachu su hrawh su kha a hlâ awpa a châ. Moleina hlâna a châpa vâta, sathaw a bao awpa châ leipa ta, a chô liata deiryh a soh awpa châ hra vei.
Theihthaipa lâ cheih aw ta, theihthaipa ta atheithlâhna hmo châta pazah kha la aw ta, maisâh chô liata Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpa chô liata a rao aw. Cha cha moleina hlâna cha a châ.

Cha hmozy hry liata kheihawhpa tlyma a parao hapa kyh liata, theihthaipa ta chatlaina taopa aw ta, chatanachata a ngiahthaipa a châ aw. A laibâhpazy cha, niepa hlâna taozie hawhta, theihthaipa châta a châ aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi chho ta, a hnohta,

“Chyhsa ta hmo paraopa ta Abeipa hmo pathaihpazy chô liata a molei pathlei khiahta cha, a moleina ty thô nawpa ta, mietaku zaw hry tawhta mietaku tôhpa seina hnei leipa Abeipa lâ a hlâ awpa a châ. Supathaihpa tâkâ reizie ta reipa ta, mietaku tôhpa mâ dopa cha a tâkâ ta cheih pâ aw ta, thaileichâna hlâna châta a hlâ aw.

Hmo pathaihpa chô liata â doleipa ta a taopa cha thô aw ta, su pangawh su kha baichha aw ta, theihthaipa a pie aw. Theihthaipa ta thaileichâna hlâna mietaku tôhpa ta chatlaina taopa aw ta, chatanachata a ngiahthaipa a châ aw.
“ Abeipa ta tao lei awpa ta bie a piepa kheihawhpa tlyma chyhsa ta tao sala a molei khiahta cha, pahno leipa ta a tao pathleipa a châpa chhao ta, thaileichâ pyly aw ta, a paraona maoh a phaoh aw.

Mietaku zaw hry tawhta mietaku tôhpa seina hnei leipa cha, a mâ dopa chhaota, thaileichâna hlâna châta theihthaipa lâ cheih aw ta, pahno leipa ta a tao pathleipa kyh liata theihthaipa ta chatlaina taopa aw ta, chatanachata a ngiahthaipa a châ aw.
Abeipa hmiakô liata thailei a châ ha tlaipa vâta, cha cha a thaileichâna hlâna a châ,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi chho ta, a hnohta,

“Chyhsa ta Abeipa châta a ngâchhihna pahleipa ta, chyhsa sôh â vaopa kyh liata zy, chyhsa hnohta pie awpa bie â taihpa kyh liata zy, a parupa kyh liata zy, â doleipa ta a vaih chô liata taopa ta tlyma, a vaih tlybai raruahpa ta tlyma, hmo a parao khiahta cha;
cha leipa chhao ta, chyhsa hmo pahleipa a huah sala, haipa ta bie a taihpa ta â do leipa ta a reih khiahta tlyma, cha hmozy hry liata kheihawhpa tlyma taopa ta a molei khiahta cha,

hetana heta tao awpa a châ: Molei ha tlai sala, thailei a châ khiahta cha, parupa ta a lapa hmozy, tlybaipa ta a lapa hmozy, a ku liata sôh pavaosapazy, chyhsa hmo pahleipa â huapazy cha a thô khai awpa a châ.
Haipa ta bie â taihpa hmo zydua â kipa ta thô khai aw ta, thailei a châna noh liata, hneituhpa hnohta su pangawh su kha a baichha aw.
A moleina ty thô nawpa ta Abeipa lâ hmo a hlâ awpa châ ta, mietaku zaw hry tawhta mietaku tôhpa seina hnei leipa cha, a mâ dopa sôh chhaota, theihthaipa lâ a cheih awpa a châ.
Theihthaipa ta Abeipa hmiakô liata chatlaina taopa aw ta, chatanachata a hmotaopa vâta a thaileichâna cha a ngiahthaipa a châ aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi chho ta, a hnohta,

“Arawna nata a sawchapawzy hnohta hetana heta biepie teh: He he raopa hlâna taozie awpa ryhpa a châ: Raopa hlâna cha maisâh chô liata mei liata azozâkhihdei ta y aw ta, a mylâ taihta a y aw. Maisâh liata mei cha a ia ngâ thlâh awpa a châ.
Theihthaipa ta pala rih dipa ta taopa chysia a tobi aw ta, a sapa khu nawpa ta pala rih dipa ta taopa chaopasy a pasy aw ta, maisâh liata raopa hlâna meipaohzy cha la aw ta, maisâh kâ liata a soh aw.
Chatawhcha a chysia cha pahluh aw ta, chysia hropa a tao aw ta, buchâhzy cha riehmo khôtho su sithaipa lâ a siekhei aw.
Maisâh liata mei cha a ia ngâ thlâh awpa châ ta, a thi awpa châ vei. Theihthaipa ta a my chareih ta tho ti aw ta, a chô liata raopa hlâna soh aw ta, cha liata aryhna hlâna thawzy a rao tyh aw.
Maisâh liata mei a ia ngâ thlâh ha awpa a châ, a thi awpa châ vei.
“He he niepa hlâna taozie awpa ryhpa a châ: Arawna sawchapawzy ta maisâh hmia liata Abeipa hmiakô ta ama hlâ tyh aw.

Hlâtuhpa ta niepa hlâna liatapa viahdie dipa pazah kha nata sathaw nata niepa hlâna chô liata deiryh zydua la aw ta, cha cha atheithlâhna hmo châta maisâh liata a rao aw. Cha cha Abeipa châta ropahâh ngaitapa a châ.
A laibâhpazy cha Arawna nata a sawchapawzy ta nie aw ei ta, ahmaohna poh o tlyhmia su pathaihpa liata thinô pahlao leipa ta ama nie awpa a châ.
Viahchhâ cha thinô pahlaopa ta tao awpa châ vei. Cha cha kei lâta mei ta hmohlâpa tawhta ama tovyuh awpa ta ei piepa châ ta, moleina hlâna nata thaileichâna hlânazy hawhta hmo pathaih ngaitapa a châ.

Arawna pathla chapaw zydua ta nie aw ei ta, cha cha Abeipa lâta raopa hmohlâpa tawhta nama pathla zydua ta chhâzaw châta ama tovyuh a châ aw. Cha niepa hlânazy a hriapa maih cha ama pathaih aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi chho ta, a hnohta,

“He he Arawna nata a sawchapawzy ta sathawthupa ama châ noh ta Abeipa lâ ama hlâ awpa hmohlâpa a châ: Niepa hlâna viahdie dipa tawhta kachu su hrawh su kha, my ta â khophie, zâ ta â khophie ama hlâ tyh aw.

Viahdie cha sathaw nata pahlaopa ta, pakâhna lômathu liata pakâh awpa a châ. Pakâh khai tawhta a vaw ngiakhei aw chi ta, viahchhâ pakâhpa cha a tlawh ta pachhaihpa ta Abeipa châta ropahâhpa niepa hlâna ta na hlâ aw.
Arawna sawchapawzy hry tawhta ano a thla awpa sathawthupa theihthaipa ta niepa hlâna cha a hlâ aw. Cha cha Abeipa tovyuh châ zôzaw aw ta, a zydua ta rao khai awpa a châ.
Theihthaipa ta niepa hlâna châta a hlâpa zydua cha rao khai awpa a châ. Nie cheita awpa châ vei,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi chho ta, a hnohta,

“Arawna nata a sawchapawzy chho la, ama hnohta hetana heta reih teh: He he moleina hlâna taozie awpa ryhpa a châ: Raopa hlâna thie tyhna liata, moleina hlâna chhao Abeipa hmiakô ta thie awpa a châ. Cha cha hmo pathaih ngaitapa a châ.
Moleina hlâna châta a hlâtuhpa theihthaipa ta nie aw ta, ahmaohna poh o dôhpachhôh tlyhmia su pathaihpa liata nie awpa a châ.
Atheihna sa a hriapa maih cha ama pathaih aw. Kheihawhpa chysia lia rai ta thisaih ta â pie khiahta cha, thisaih ta a kiapa chysiazy cha su pathaihpa liata na pasu awpa a châ.
Atheihna sa chhona alei beih cha pakei ha awpa châ ta, dawhbeih ta chhopa a châ khiahta deikua cha, a pathaih ngaitapa ta chata ta ti ta pasi awpa a châ.
Theihthaipa chhôhkha laita chapaw zydua ta atheihna sa cha ama nie aw. Cha cha hmo pathaih ngaitapa a châ.
Su Pathaihpa liata chatlaina tao nawpa ta, ahmaohna poh o liata a thisaih ama vaw cheipa sa, moleina hlâna châta atheihna sa deikua cha, nie awpa châ vei. Mei ta rao awpa a châ.
“He he thaileichâna hlâna taozie awpa ryhpa châ ta, hmo pathaih ngaitapa a châ:
Raopa hlâna thie tyhna liata thaileichâna hlâna chhao thie awpa châ ta, maisâh kâ zydua liata a thisaih thia awpa a châ.
A thaw zydua hlâ khai awpa châ ta, a lahmei thawhpazy, a rihhrizy,
a lôpo miano nata a patoh kiapâh liata a lôpo a pahlypa thawzy nata a pathi a pahlypa thawzy cha, a lôpozy chhaota la aw ta,
cha cha theihthaipa ta Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpa châta maisâh chô liata a rao aw. Cha cha thaileichâna hlâna a châ.
Theihthaipa chhôhkha liata chapaw zydua ta nie aw ei ta, su pathaihpa liata nie awpa a châ. Cha cha hmo pathaih ngaitapa a châ.
Thaileichâna hlâna cha moleina hlâna nata a lyu ta, taozie miakha a châ. A sazy cha chatlaina a taotuhpa theihthaipa tovyuh a châ aw.
