Chyhsa châta raopa hlâna a hlâtuhpa theihthaipa ta, raopa hlâna ta a hlâpa sa vo cha a to aw.
Viahchhâ taona beih liata taopa niepa hlâna to nata ukâ nata lômathu liata chateipa nata pakâhpa niepa hlâna zydua cha, a hlâtuhpa theihthaipa châta a châ aw.
Niepa hlâna châta hlâpa zydua cha, sathaw pahlaopa tlyma, ahipa tlyma, Arawna sawchapaw zydua ta â khopa ta amâ rai aw.
“He he chyhsa ta Abeipa lâta aryhna hlâna a hlânazie awpa ryhpa a châ:

Alyna biereina châta a hlâ khiahta cha, thinô pahlao leipa ta sathaw pahlaopa viahchhâ pakâhpazy, sathaw hniapa thinô pahlao leipa viahchhâ apapazy nata viahdie dipa ta taopa sathaw ta nyhpa viahchhâ pakâhpazy cha, atheihna hlâna sa a hlâna liata a hlâ pâ awpa a châ.
Alyna biereina châta aryhna hlâna atheihnazy liata deikua cha, viahchhâ thinô pahlaopa a hlâ aw.
Hmohlâpa to tawhta viahchhâ tlâ kha sai hmosaipiepa châta Abeipa lâ hlâ aw ta, maisâh liata aryhna hlâna thisaih a thiatuhpa theihthaipa châta a châ aw.
Alyna biereina châta aryhna hlâna atheihna sa cha, a hlâ noh ta nie khai ha awpa a châ. A mylâ my taihta khâpa hmah a pahlôh awpa châ vei.
Â theihna hlâna cha bietai hlâna tlyma, lôhthai hlâna tlyma a châ khiahta deikua cha, atheihna a hlâ noh ta nie awpa châ ta, nie laipa cha a mylâ ta nie theipa a châ.
A noh thôhna noh taihta a ypa atheihna sa deikua cha, mei ta rao khai awpa a châ.

Aryhna hlâna châta atheihna sa kheihawhpa rai, a noh thôhna noh ta ama nie khiahta cha, atheihna cha a pyhpa châ aw vei. Hlâtuhpa chhao hmo a hlâpa hawhta pachâpa châ aw vei. Hmo pathaih leipa châ aw ta, a niepa maihta a hmo paraona maoh ama phaoh aw.
“Hmo pathaih leipa kheihawhpa rai a hriapa sa cha, nie awpa châ vei. Mei ta rao awpa a châ. Sa hropazy deikua cha, chyhsa pathaihpazy ta ama nie thei.
Pathaih leina chôta Abeipa lâta hlâpa aryhna hlâna atheihna sa a niepa cha, a phopi tawhta chhawh pathlahpa a châ aw.

Hmo pathaih leipa kheihawhpa rai, chyhsa pathaih leipa tlyma, sa pathaih leipa tlyma, hmo pathaih leipa pasichhihpa tlyma, chyhsa ta hria sala, chatanachôta Abeipa lâta aryhna hlâna atheihna sa a nie khiahta cha, cha chyhsa cha a phopi tawhta chhawh pathlahpa a châ aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi chho ta, a hnohta,
“Izarei sawzy chho la, ama hnohta hetana heta reih teh: Viahchao thaw tlyma, mietaku thaw tlyma, mie thaw tlyma nama nie awpa châ vei.
Sa thiruapa thaw nata sahrâhpa ta a taipa thaw cha, a hmâ nawpa hropazy liata hmâ theipa châ ta, a nie deikua nama nie cheita awpa châ vei.
Ahy rai Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpa sa thaw a niepa cha, a phopi tawhta chhawh pathlahpa a châ aw.
Cha hleikhô ta, nama pahrâna lia maihta, kheihawhpa thisaih rai, pavaw thisaih tlyma, sa thisaih tlyma, nama nie cheita awpa châ vei.
Ahy rai thisaih a niepa cha, a phopi tawhta chhawh pathlahpa a châ aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi chho ta, a hnohta,
“Izarei sawzy chho la, ama hnohta hetana heta reih teh: Abeipa lâta aryhna hlâna a hlâpa maihta, a hlâ awpa tawhta thokha cha, atheihna châta Abeipa lâta a hlâ awpa a châ.
Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpa cha ano ku tlai ta cheih aw ta, a thaw chhao a palôh duata cheih aw ta, chatanachata a palôh cha chaluahpa hlâna ta Abeipa hmiakô liata a chaluah aw.
Theihthaipa ta a thaw cha mei ta maisâh liata rao aw ta, a palôh deikua cha, Arawna nata a sawchapawzy châta a châ aw.
Aryhna hlâna atheihna sa phei chachâh lâ cha, chalopa hlâna châta theihthaipa nama pie awpa a châ.
Arawna sawchapawzy hry liata aryhna hlâna thisaih nata thaw a hlâtuhpa ta, a tovyuh châta a phei chachâh lâ cha â la aw.

Izarei sawzy aryhna hlâna atheihna sazy tawhta a palôh chaluahpazy nata a phei chalopazy la na ta, theihthaipa Arawna nata a sawchapawzy hnohta ei pie. Cha cha Izarei sawzy tawhta chhâzaw ta ama tovyuh a châ aw,” tah ta.
Cha cha Abeipa châta theihthaipa chakaona rai hria awpa ta, Arawna nata a sawchapawzy raopa ama châ noh tawhta, Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpazy tawhta ama tovyuh châta panano eihpa a châ.
Cha cha Izarei sawzy ta theihthaipazy ama pie tyh awpa ta Abeipa ta biepie ta, sathawthupa ama châ noh tawhta ama chhâ zydua liata chhâzaw ta ama tovyuh a châ aw.
Chazy cha raopa hlâna, niepa hlâna, moleina hlâna, thaileichâna hlâna, chahnaona hlâna nata aryhna hlâna atheihna taoziezy a châ.
Ama hmohlâpazy Abeipa lâta vaw cheih awpa ta, Abeipa ta Sinai râhchawhpa liata Izarei sawzy bie a pie noh ta, Sinai Tlâh liata Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa a châ.
Abeipa ta Mawsi chho ta, a hnohta,
“Arawna kha a sawchapawzy chhaota a chhi la, chysiazy, sathaw pathaihpa, moleina hlâna viahchao tôhpa, mietaku tôhpa pô no nata viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa hrâbyh hmo kha cheih la,
zawpi zydua cha ahmaohna poh o chhikao chheipâh liata kei pahmaoh teh,” tah ta.
Mawsi cha Abeipa biepiepa hawhta tao ta, zawpi zydua cha ahmaohna poh o chhikao chheipâh liata ypakhy ei ta.
Mawsi ta zawpi hnohta, “He he tao awpa ta Abeipa biepiepa a châ,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta Arawna nata a sawchapawzy cha a vaw chhi ta, ti ta ama ngai pasi ta.
Arawna cha chôtho paky ta, chaisaihna pasaih ta, poh pabu ta, ephaw paky thlu ta, zôpha kawpa ta sapa ephaw chaisaihna ta a chai saih ta, cha chata ephaw cha a pôhpa nata saih pa-i ta.
Cha khai tawhta chachôhna vyhphao paky ta, chachôhna vyhphao liana cha Uri nata Thumi khô ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa hawhta, a luh liata lakhu pakhu ta, lakhu hmia lâ liata ngôh lakho pathaihpa pakho ta.
Chatawhcha Mawsi ta sathaw pathaihpa la ta, achhyna byureih nata a chhôh liata hmo a ypa zydua thupa ta pathaisa ta.
Maisâh chô liata sathaw ei sari thia ta, maisâh nata a hmobaoh zydua, rahô nata a patyunazy sathawthupa ta pathaisa ta.
Arawna luh liata sathaw pathaihpa bao ta, cha hawhna chata Arawna cha pathaisapa ta panano ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa hawhta, Mawsi ta Arawna sawchapawzy a vaw chhi ta, chôtho pakysapa ta, chaisaihna pasaih ta, khuthozy a pakhu ei.
Chatawhcha moleina hlâna viahchao tôhpa a vaw chhi ta, Arawna nata a sawchapawzy ta moleina hlâna viahchao tôhpa luh chô liata ama ku pahnieh ei ta.

Mawsi ta viahchao tôhpa cha thie ta, a thisaih la ta, a kudy ta maisâh kizy hniapa ta, maisâh cha pathaisa ta, thisaih laibâhpazy cha maisâh thaby liata patlai ta. Chatanachata maisâh châta chatlaina tao ta, maisâh cha a pathaisa.
Mawsi ta a rihhri thaw zydua, a pathi a pahlypa thaw nata a lôpo miano nata a thawzy la ta, maisâh liata rao ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa hawhta, viahchao tôhpa vo, a sapa nata a ie deikua cha, riehmo khôtho liata rao khaipa a châ.
Cha khai tawhta raopa hlâna mietaku tôhpa cha hlâ ta. Arawna nata a sawchapawzy ta mietaku tôhpa luh chô liata ama ku pahnieh ei ta.
Mawsi ta mietaku tôhpa cha thie ta, maisâh kâ zydua liata a thisaih thia ta.
Mietaku tôhpa cha pachhaih ta, a luh nata a sapa pachhaihpazy nata a thawzy rao ta.

Mawsi ta mietaku tôhpa chhôrih nata pheizy cha ti ta pasi ta, mietaku tôhpa cha a zydua ta maisâh liata rao ta. Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa hawhta, cha cha ropahâhpa châta raopa hlâna, Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpa a châ.
Chatawhcha mietaku tôhpa hropa, chahnaona mietaku tôhpa hlâ heih ta. Arawna nata a sawchapawzy ta mietaku tôhpa luh chô liata ama ku pahnieh ei ta.
Mawsi ta mietaku tôhpa cha thie ta, a thisaih la ta, Arawna nakao chachâh lâ pawhmao nata a chachâh lâ kupi nata pheipi zy liata hnia ta.
Cha hawhna chata Mawsi ta Arawna sawchapawzy chhao a chhi ta, ama nakao chachâh lâ pawhmao nata ama chachâh lâ kupi nata pheipi liazy ta thisaih hnia ta. Thisaih cha maisâh kâ zydua thia ta.
Chatawhcha mietaku tôhpa thaw, a lahmei thawhpa, a rihhri thaw, a pathi a pahlypa thaw, a lôpo miano nata a thawzy nata a phei chachâh lâ la ta.

Abeipa hmiakô liata a ypa viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa hrâbyh tawhta viahchhâ pakâhpa miakha, sathaw pahlaopa viahchhâ puahpa miakha nata viahchhâ apapa miakha la ta, a thaw nata a phei chachâh lâ chô liata soh ta.
Cha zydua cha Arawna nata a sawchapawzy ku liata soh ta, âmo ta chaluahpa hlâna châta Abeipa hmiakô liata chaluah ei ta.
Cha khai tawhta Mawsi ta ama ku tawhta la ta, maisâh liata raopa hlâna chô liata rao ta. Cha cha ropahâhpa châta chahnaona hlâna, Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpa a châ.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa hawhta, Mawsi ta a palôh la ta, chaluahpa hlâna châta Abeipa hmiakô liata chaluah ta. Cha cha chahnaona mietaku tôhpa tawhta Mawsi tovyuh a châ.

Mawsi ta sathaw pathaihpa nata maisâh liata thisaihzy la ta, Arawna nata a chysiazy thia ta, a sawchapawzy nata a ama chysiazy chhao thia hra ta. Cha hawhna chata Arawna nata a chysiazy cha pathaisa ta, a sawchapawzy nata ama chysiazy chhao a hnohta pathaisapa a châ hra.

Mawsi ta Arawna nata a sawchapawzy hnohta, “Sa cha ahmaohna poh o chhikao liata chhoh u la, ‘Arawna nata a sawchapawzy ta ama nie awpa a châ,’ tahpa ta bie ei piepa hawhna khata, chahnaona hlâna hrâbyh liata viahchhâ chhaota, cha su liata nie teh u.
Sa nata viahchhâ nie laibâhpazy cha mei ta nama rao awpa a châ.
Nâmo chahnao awpa ta noh sari byuh ta, chavâta chahnaona nohzy nama châta â ki hlâlei cha, noh sari chhôh ahmaohna poh o chhikao tawhta nama pua awpa châ vei.
Tanoh ta taopa hawhna heta, nama châta chatlaina tao awpa ta Abeipa ta bie a pie.
Ahmaohna poh o chhikao liata noh sari chhôh chhô nah zâ ta y aw ei chi ta, nama thi lei nawpa ta, Abeipa biepiepa cha nama zyh awpa a châ. Cha cha ei hnohta biepiepa a châ,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Abeipa ta Mawsi hmâpa ta bie a piepa zydua cha Arawna nata a sawchapawzy ta tao khai ei ta.
A noh chariena noh ta, Mawsi ta Arawna nata a sawchapawzy nata Izarei machâzy aw ta,
Arawna hnohta, “Moleina hlâna châta viahchao tôh dawpa nata raopa hlâna châta mietaku tôhpa, seina hnei leipa raihrie a chhi la, Abeipa hmiakô liata hlâ mah y.
Izarei sawzy chho la, ama hnohta, ‘Moleina hlâna châta mie tôhpa nata raopa hlâna châta viahchaotaw nata mietakutaw kô khapa raihrie, seina a hnei leipazy cheih u la,

Abeipa hmiakô liata aryhna hlâna atheihna châta viahchao tôhpa nata mietaku tôhpa cheih hra u la, sathaw pahlaopa niepa hlâna chhao cheih u la, Abeipa lâ hlâ teh u. Tanoh he nama hnohta Abeipa â vaw luah aw,’ tah mah y,” tah ta.
Mawsi biepiepa hawhta, hmo hlâ awpazy cha ahmaohna poh o tlyhmia liata vaw cheih ei ta, zawpi zydua ta a kei hniapa ta, Abeipa hmiakô liata a duah ei ta.
Mawsi ta, “ Abeipa rônahna nama hnohta â vaw luah thei nawpa ta, hetana heta tao awpa ta Abeipa ta bie a cha pie ei,” tah ta.

Chatawhcha Mawsi ta Arawna hnohta, “Maisâh a vaw hnia la, na moleina hlâna nata na raopa hlânazy vaw hlâ la, nâma châta nata zawpi châta chatlaina tao teh. Abeipa biepiepa hawhta, zawpi vyuhpa ta hmohlâpa hlâ la, ama châta chatlaina tao teh,” tah ta.
Arawna ta maisâh cha a kei hnia ta, ano châta moleina hlâna viahchaotaw cha thie ta.
Arawna sawchapawzy ta thisaih kei pie ei ta, thisaih liana cha a kudy ny ta, maisâh kizy liata hnia ta, thisaih laibâhpa cha maisâh thaby liata patlai ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa hawhta, moleina hlâna thaw nata a lôpozy nata a pathi a pahlypa thawzy cha, maisâh chô liata rao ta.
A sapa nata a vo deikua cha, riehmo khôtho liata mei ta rao ta.
Arawna ta raopa hlâna cha thie ta, a sawchapawzy ta a thisaih vaw pie ei ta, maisâh kâ zydua liata thia ta.
Raopa hlâna sa cha a tlo tlo ta a luh chhaota vaw pie ei ta, maisâh liata rao ta.
A chhôrihzy nata a pheizy pasi ta, maisâh liata raopa hlâna chô liata rao ta.
Cha khai tawhta zawpizy hmohlâpa cha hlâ ta. Zawpi châta moleina hlâna mie cha a chhi ta, thie ta, a hmiatuapa hawhna khata, moleina hlâna châta hlâ ta.
Raopa hlâna chhao cheih ta, a taozie awpa ryhpa raopa hawhta hlâ ta.
Cha khai tawhta niepa hlâna cheih ta, cha tawhtapa cha pazah kha la ta, maisâh liata rao ta, cha cha mydi ta raopa hlâna hleikhô ta hlâ baichhipa a châ.
Chatawhcha zawpi châta aryhna hlâna atheihna viahchao tôhpa nata mietaku tôhpa thie ta. Arawna sawchapawzy ta a thisaih vaw pie ei ta, maisâh kâ zydua liata thia ta.
Viahchao tôhpa thaw nata mietaku tôhpa thaw, a lahmei thawhpa, a rihhri, a lôpo nata a pathi a pahlypa thawzy vaw pie ei ta.
A thawzy cha a palôh chô liata soh ei ta, maisâh liata rao ta.
Mawsi biepiepa hawhta, a palôh nata a phei chachâh lâ cha, Arawna ta chaluahpa hlâna châta Abeipa hmiakô liata chaluah ta.
Arawna ta zawpi lâ a ku pazawh ta, âmo cha byhnâ awpa ta, moleina hlâna, raopa hlâna nata aryhna hlânazy a hlâ khai tawhta za chô ta.
Mawsi nata Arawna cha ahmaohna poh o liata a kei ngia ei ta, vaw pua heih ei ta, zawpi châta byhnâ aw ei ta. Abeipa rônahna chyhsa zydua chô liata a vaw luah ta.
Abeipa tawhta mei vaw pua ta, maisâh liata raopa hlâna nata thawzy cha vaw kâ ta. Cha cha zawpi zydua ta ama hmô nahta, thata awh ei ta, â khu lâta pao ei ta.

Arawna sawchapawpa Nâdâ nata Abihu ta ropahâhpa ama raona byh la chyu ei ta, a chhôh liata mei soh ei ta, ropahâhpa mia ei ta, Abeipa ta âmo bie a pie leipa mei hropa hmâpa ta Abeipa hmiakô liata hlâ ei ta.
Abeipa tawhta mei vaw pua ta, âmo cha kâsao ta, Abeipa hmiakô liata thi ha ei ta.

Chatanachata Mawsi ta Arawna hnohta, “He he Abeipa ta, Nâ hniatuhpazy hry liata Pathaihpa ta a luah aw na ta, Chyhsa zydua hmiakô liata Palyupalihpa ta ei y aw, A tahpa kha a châ hih,” tah ta. Arawna cha a chalih thlâh ha ta.
Mawsi ta Arawna paw unawhpa Uzie sawchapaw Misela nata Elzaphâ aw ta, ama hnohta, “A vaw hnia u la, nama unawhzy he su pathaihpa tawhna heta a sy u la, riehmo khôtho lâ puakhei teh u,” tah ta.
Mawsi reipa hawhta a vaw hnia ei ta, ama viahkao ta âmo cha a sy ei ta, riehmo khôtho lâ ama puakhei haw.

Mawsi ta Arawna nata a sawchapaw Eliaza nata Ithamâ zy hnohta, “Nama sâ pathliah leipa u la, nama chysiazy hrie hra khuh vy. Chataleipatala thi aw ei chi ta, zawpi zydua chô liata Abeipa hiehâhna a vaw tlô pathlei aw na. Nama chiheih Izarei chhôhkha zydua deikua ta, Abeipa ta mei ta a pakâsao hapazy cha chakhei mawh ei sy.
Abeipa sathaw pathaihpa nama chô liata y ta, chavâta ahmaohna poh o chhikao tawhta nama pua awpa châ vei, chataleipatala nama thi pathlei aw na,” tah ta. Mawsi bie hawhna chata tao ei ta.
Abeipa ta Arawna hnohta,

“Nâ tlyma, na hnohta a ypa na sawchapawzy tlyma, ahmaohna poh o chhôh lâ namâ ngia tita, kresawhti tlyma, sahma thatlôpa tlyma nama doh awpa châ vei. Chataleipatala nama thi pathlei aw. Cha cha nama chhâ zydua châta chhâzaw ryhpa a châ aw.
Hmo ziehchhôhpa nata hmo vâtlâhpa panano aw ei chi ta, hmo pathaih leipa nata pathaihpa nama panano awpa a châ.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hmâpa ta Izarei sawzy hnohta bieraopa a reipa zydua cha, âmo nama pachu lymâ awpa a châ,” tah ta.

Chatawhcha Mawsi ta Arawna nata a sawchapaw a hrohpa Eliaza nata Ithamâ hnohta, “ Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpa niepa hlâna laibâhpazy la u la, hmo pathaih ngaitapa a châpa vâta, thinô pahlao leipa ta maisâh kiapâh liata nie teh u.
Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpa tawhta nâ nata na sawchapawzy tovyuh a châpa vâta, su pathaihpa liata nama nie awpa a châ. Cha hawhta tao awpa ta biepiepa ei châ.

A palôh chaluahpa nata a phei chachâh lâ chalopa cha, nâ nata na hnohta a ypa na sawchapawzy nata sawchanôzy ta su pathaihpa liata nama nie aw. Cha cha Izarei sawzy châta aryhna hlâna atheihnazy tawhta, nâ nata na sawzy tovyuh châta raopazy a châ.

A phei chalo awpa nata a palôh chaluah awpazy cha, chaluahpa hlâna châta Abeipa hmiakô liata chaluahpa a châ thei nawpa ta, mei ta hlâ awpa a thawzy chhaota ama vaw cheih aw. Abeipa biepiepa hawhta, cha cha nâ nata na sawchapawzy châta chhâzaw ta nama tovyuh a châ aw,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta moleina hlâna châta hlâpa mie thâtih cha pakhâta ta patluah ta, rao hapa a châpa pahno ta. Chavâta Arawna sawchapaw a hrohpa Eliaza nata Ithamâ chô liata a hiehâh kaw ta, ama hnohta,

“Khazia moleina hlâna sa cha, supathaihpa su liata nama nie vei? Cha cha hmo pathaih ngaitapa châ ta, zawpi thaileichâna phaoh ta, Khazohpa hmiakô liata âmo châta chatlaina tao nawpa ta nama hnohta piepa châ vei ma?
Ei biepiepa hawhta, supathaihpa chhôh liata nama nie tlai awpa châ ta, châhrasala supathaihpa chhôh lâ a thisaih a ngiakhei veih ei chi,” tah ta.

Arawna ta Mawsi hnohta, “Pachâ teh, tanoh he ama moleina hlâna nata ama raopa hlâna Abeipa hmiakô liata hlâ ei ta, cha nota, kha hawhpa hmo kha ei chô liata vaw tlô ta, chavâta tanoh he moleina hlâna nie aw sah la, Abeipa mohmô ta hmo phapa a châ aw ma?” tah ta.
Cha bie cha a thei nahta Mawsi cha a palôh tlâh ha ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi nata Arawna chho ta, ama hnohta,
“Izarei sawzy hetana heta chho teh u: Hezy he alei chô liata hrona a hneipa sa zydua hry tawhta nama nie thei awpazy a châ:
Sazy hry liata a chakie pachiah ta, a chakie miano ta â pachhaihpa ta, thie a chaeihpa maih nama nie thei aw.
Thie chaeihpa ta a chakie a pachhaih hra sala, hezy deikua cha nama nie awpa châ vei: Râraoseihpa cha a thie chaeih hra sala, a chakie â pachhaih leipa vâta, nama châta pathaih leipa a châ.
Tlâh pazupi chhao a thie chaeih ta, châhrasala a chakie â pachhaih leipa vâta nama châta pathaih leipa a châ.
Pazupi chhao a thie chaeih ta, châhrasala a chakie â pachhaih leipa vâta, nama châta pathaih leipa a châ.
Vao he a chakie cha pachiah ta, a chakie miano ta a pachhaih ta, châhrasala a thie a chaeih leipa vâta, nama châta pathaih leipa a châ.
A sa nama nie awpa châ leipa ta, a thiruapa chhao nama hria awpa châ vei. Nama châta pathaih leipa a châ.
“Ti liata a pahrâpa zydua hry liata hezy he nama nie thei aw. Tilaipi liata tlyma, chavah liata tlyma, ti liata a pahrâpa, mathlaw nata phuhlu a hneipa maih nama nie thei aw.
Tilaipi nata chavah liata a pahrâpa zydua nata ti liata hmohrohneipa a ypa zydua hry liata mathlaw nata phuhlu a hnei leipa maih cha, nama châta pasichhihpa a châ.
Chazy cha nama châta pasichhihpa ta nama pachâ awpa châ ta, ama sa nama nie awpa châ leipa ta, a thiruapazy chhao nama pasi ngaita awpa a châ.
Ti liata a ypa mathlaw nata phuhlu a hnei leipa maih nama châta pasichhihpa a châ.
“Pavaw hry liata, hezy he nama pasi ngaita awpa châ ta, nama nie awpa châ vei, pasichhihpa ama châ: Pahmôhpi, vâkhieh kâhhmi hneipa, tilaipi pahmôhpi,
hmôchhih, riarâtaoh chi to,
raawh chi to,
vawpô, valâtla, nârâ seihhaohpa, pahmôh chyhpa chi to,
vaku chyhpa, tyhphy nga a niepa, tutahlupa,
vaku râhpa, ti pavaw hmaotô laipa, vâkhieh sa thiruapa a niepa,
varâh keihseihpa, riasi chi to, nôpinô nata pazu tâbalâpa zy cha nama nie awpa châ vei.
“Lôvâpa mathlaw hnei ta, phei palih ta a siepa zydua nama châta pasichhihpa a châ.
Mathlaw hnei ta, phei palih ta a siepa chi hry liata, alei liata a chapie nawpa ta ama phei chô lâta byhpi a pazaopa zydua deikua nama nie thei.
Khawsu chi to, khawsu hmi leipa chi to, chiacharipa chi to nata khawthlôhraihpa chi to chhao nama nie thei.
Mathlaw ta a zaw ta, phei palih a hneipa lôvâ hropa zydua deikua, nama châta pasichhihpa a châ khai.
“Hezy vâna heta pathaih leipa nama châ aw: Ahy rai sa pathaih leipa thiruapa a hriapa cha, zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw.
Ahy rai cha hawhpa sa thiruapa a phaohpa cha, a chysiazy pasu aw ta, zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw.

Sa a chakie pachiah ta, châhrasala a chakie miano ta a pachhaih leipa nata thie a chaeih leipa chi maih cha, nama châta pathaih leipa châ ta, ahy rai cha hawhpa sa thiruapa a hriapa cha pathaih leipa a châ aw.
Phei palih ta a siepa sa hry liata phei pazah ta a siepa maih cha nama châta pathaih leipa châ ta, cha hawhpa sa thiruapa a hriapa cha zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw.
Cha hawhpa sa thiruapa a phaohpa cha a chysiazy pasu aw ta, zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw. Chazy cha nama châta hmo pathaih leipa a châ.
“Alei liata alyhpasa chizy hry liata, Zabih, siahloh, sawsâ chi to,
taokieh, tisadâh, ohâpa, tlypahniapa nata kauapa zy cha nama châta a pathaih leipa a châ.
Chazy cha alyhpasa zydua hry liata nama châta pathaih leipazy châ ta, ahy rai cha hawhpa sa thiruapa a hriapa cha zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw.

Alyhpasa pathaih leipa thiruapa ta a tla thlupa hmobaoh chhao pathaih leipa a châ aw. Tho hmobaoh tlyma, chysia tlyma, savo tlyma, sykhao tlyma, kheihawhpa châta hmâpa hmobaoh rai châ sala, ti liata pachie awpa châ ta, zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw. Cha khai tawhta a pathaih aw.
Alyhpasa thiruapa ta alei beih chhôh liata a tla khiahta cha, beih chhôh liata a ypa zydua pathaih leipa châ aw ta, beih cha nama pakei ha awpa a châ.
Nie thei awpa niedo kheihawhpa rai, cha beih liata ti ta a hria hapa cha pathaih leipa a châ aw. Dopa chi zydua chhao, cha hawhpa beih chhôh liata a ypa cha pathaih leipa a châ aw.

Hmo khâpa rai, cha hawhpa sa thiruapa ta a tla thlupa cha pathaih leipa a châ lymâ aw. Viahchhâ taona beih tlyma, beih kheihawhpa rai châ sala, a tlawh ta pakeichheih khai awpa a châ. Pathaih leipa châ ha ta, nama châta pathaih leipa a châ lymâ aw.
Tihnawh tlyma, tikhaoh tlyma deikua cha, pathaih leipa ta y leipa aw ta, a chhôh liata alyhpasa thiruapa a hriapa deikua pathaih leipa a châ aw.
Chikao chei awpa kheihawhpa rai, alyhpasa thiruapa ta a tla thlu khiahta cha, pathaih leipa châ aw vei.
Alyhpasa thiruapa ta a tla thlupa chikao cha, ti liata pachie chiehpa a châ khiahta deikua cha, nama châta pathaih leipa a châ.
“A sa nama nie theipa chi kheihawhpa tlyma thi sala, cha sa thiruapa a hriapa cha, zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw.
Cha thiruapa sa a niepa cha, a chysiazy pasu aw ta, zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw. Sa thiruapa a phaohpa chhao, a chysiazy pasu aw ta, zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw.
“Alei chô liata alyhpasa chi zydua pasichhihpa châ ei ta, nie awpa châ vei.
A py ta a lyhpa chi tlyma, phei palih ta a siepa chi tlyma, phei hluhpi a hneipa chi tlyma, alei chô liata a lyhpa chi zydua cha pasichhihpa châ ei ta, nama nie awpa châ vei.
Alyhpasa vâta nâmosasyh pasichhihpa ta namâ tao awpa châ leipa ta, âmo vâta nâmosasyh a papuapaleipa ta, pathaih leipa ta nama y awpa châ vei.
Kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa ei châ. Kei pathaih tlôh na ta, chavâta a pathai u la, pathaihpa ta y teh u. Alei chô liata alyhpasa kheihawhpa ta hmah namâ papuapalei awpa châ vei.
Kei he nama Khazohpa châ awpa ta Izi râh tawhta châ kaw chhi papuatuhpa Abeipa ei châ. Kei pathaih tlôh na ta, chavâta nâmo chhao nama pathaih awpa a châ.
“Chazy cha sa nata pavaw nata ti liata a pahrâpa hmohrohneipa to nata alei liata alyhpasa chi tozy kyh liata ryhpa a châ.
Pathaihpa nata pathaih leipa panano awpa châ ta, hmohrohneipa nie theipa nata hmohrohneipa nie lei awpa chi chhao panano awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,

“Izarei sawzy chho la, ama hnohta hetana heta reih teh: Chanô ta saw phaoh sala, sawchapaw a sa khiahta cha, noh sari chhôh nawhkhutlô aw ta, chanô hnopasu daihti liata pathaih leipa hawhta pathaih leipa a châ aw.
A noh chariena noh ta, hawtipa cha a chopaw vo tai awpa a châ.
Noh sythôh nata noh thôh chhôh a sawsana thi lohpa tawhta pathaina tao awpa châ ta, pathaina noh â ki hlâlei cha, hmo pathaihpa a hria awpa châ leipa ta, supathaihpa liata â ngia awpa châ vei.
Sawchanô a sa khiahta cha, hnopasu daihti liata pathaih leipa hawhta, hâta ei no chhôh nawhkhutlô aw ta, noh sycharu nata noh charu chhôh a sawsana thi lohpa tawhta pathaina tao awpa a châ.

“Sawchapaw vâta tlyma, sawchanô vâta tlyma, â pathaina noh â ki nahta, raopa hlâna châta mietakutaw kô khapa nata moleina hlâna châta pivaw taw tlyma vachhuh tlyma, ahmaohna poh o chhikao liata theihthaipa lâta a cheih awpa a châ.
Theihthaipa ta Abeipa hmiakô liata hlâ aw ta, chatlaina taopa aw ta, chatanachata a thi lona tawhta a pathaih aw. Cha cha saw a sapa chanô, chapaw a sapa tlyma, chanô a sapa tlyma châta ryhpa a châ.

Mietakutaw a hnei thei leipa khiahta cha, vachhuh pô no tlyma, pivaw taw pô no tlyma cheih aw ta, pô kha cha raopa hlâna châta châ aw ta, ahropa cha moleina hlâna châta a châ aw. Theihthaipa ta chatlaina taopa aw ta, chatanachata a pathaih aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi nata Arawna chho ta, ama hnohta,

“Chyhsa ta a pôhpa vo thlohpa tlyma, hmahchaku tlyma, pakheihpa tlyma hnei sala, phawhpa hri a châ awpa hawhta a pôhpa vo liata â lâ khiahta cha, theihthaipa Arawna lâ tlyma, a sawchapawzy hry liata theihthaipa pakha lâ tlyma a chhi awpa a châ.

Theihthaipa ta a pôhpa vo liata hri cha moh aw ta, hri yna liata hmi cha pawh sala, hri yna cha a pôhpa vo hlâta a thu viapa ta â lâ khiahta cha, phawhpa hri châ ta, theihthaipa ta ano cha moh aw ta, chyhsa pathaih leipa a châ tahpa a phuah aw.
A pôhpa vo pakheihpa cha vaw râh ta, a vo hlâta a thu viapa ta a lâ leipa sala, a hmi a pawh leipa khiahta cha, hri ohtuhpa cha theihthaipa ta noh sari chhôh ânano ta a khawhlôh aw.
A noh sarina noh ta, theihthaipa ta moh heih aw ta, a hri cha a ualua ta hmô sala, a kawh via leipa khiahta cha, theihthaipa ta noh sari ânano ta a khawhlôh via chy aw.

A noh sarina noh ta, theihthaipa ta ano cha moh heih aw ta, pakheihpa cha lei laihpa ta, a vo liata a kawh laih leipa khiahta cha, theihthaipa ta ano cha pathaihpa ta a phuah aw. A hri ohpa cha riatha rakhapa châ ta, a chysiazy pasu aw ta, pathaihpa a châ aw.
Pathaisa awpa ta theihthaipa â pamosa khai tawhta, riatha cha a vo liata a kawh lymâ khiahta deikua cha, theihthaipa â pamosa heih awpa a châ.
Theihthaipa ta moh aw ta, riatha cha a vo liata a kawh lymâpa a hmô khiahta cha, theihthaipa ta ano cha pathaih leipa a châ tahpa a phuah aw. Cha cha phawhpa hri a châ.
“Chyhsa ta phawhpa hri a oh khiahta cha, theihthaipa lâ a chhi awpa a châ.
Theihthaipa ta moh aw ta, a vo thloh sala, cha chata a hmi papawhpa ta, a thlohpa liata a sapa â kaw palie khiahta cha,
phawhpa hri pakâhpâpa a vo liata a ypa châ ta, theihthaipa ta ano cha pathaih leipa a châ tahpa a phuah aw. Pathaih leipa a châpa â lâ hapa vâta, ânano ta khawhlôh byuh aw vei.
A vo râhpa cha kawh laih sala, theihthaipa hmô theipa rakha liata, hri ohtuhpa cha a vo zydua, a luh tawhta a phei taihta vo râhpa ta a bu khiahta cha,
theihthaipa ta moh aw ta, vo râhpa ta a pôhpa zydua a bu khiahta cha, hri ohtuhpa cha a pathaih tahpa a phuah aw. A pôhpa duata a râh khai hapa vâta pathaihpa a châ.
A sapa â kaw palie khiahta deikua cha, pathaih leipa a châ aw.
Theihthaipa ta sapa a paliepa cha moh aw ta, cha chyhsa cha pathaih leipa a châ tahpa a phuah aw. Sapa a paliepa cha pathaih leipa, phawhpa hri a châ.
Sapa a paliepa cha vaw pha ha sala, a vaw râh heih khiahta cha, theihthaipa lâ a pangai heih awpa a châ.
Theihthaipa ta ano cha moh aw ta, hri cha a râh khiahta cha, theihthaipa ta hri ohtuhpa cha a pathaih tahpa a phuah aw. A pathaih hapa a châ.
“Pôhpa vo liata kheihluh thla ta, tlâh ha ta,
kheihluh yna su liata a râhpa ta a thlohpa tlyma, a saih tôlôhpa ta a pakheihpa tlyma a y khiahta cha, theihthaipa pamosa awpa a châ.
Theihthaipa ta moh aw ta, vo hlâta a thu viapa ta a lâpa ta, a hmi a pawh khiahta cha, theihthaipa ta ano cha pathaih leipa ta a phuah aw. Phawhpa hri châ ta, kheihluh liata a vaw puapa a châ.
Theihthaipa ta moh ta, hmi pawhpa y leipa sala, vo hlâta a thu via leipa ta, hmah cha a chawh laih khiahta cha, theihthaipa ta noh sari ânano ta a khawhlôh aw.
Hmah cha vo liata a kawh laih khiahta deikua cha, theihthaipa ta ano cha pathaih leipa ta a phuah aw. Cha cha hri chhiepa a châ.
A saih tôlôhpa ta a pakheihpa cha, a yna ualua liata y sala, a kawh via leipa khiahta cha, kheihluh hmahdawpa dei châ ta, theihthaipa ta ano cha pathaihpa ta a phuah aw.
“Pôhpa vo liata mei kâna y sala, mei kâna sapa a paliepa cha a saih tôlôhpa ta tlyma, a râhpa ta tlyma a pakheih khiahta cha,

theihthaipa ta moh aw ta, a pakheihpa liata hmi cha pawh sala, vo hlâta a thu viapa ta â lâ khiahta cha, phawhpa châ ta, mei kâpa liata â vaw luahpa a châ. Theihthaipa ta ano cha pathaih leipa ta a phuah aw. Cha cha phawhpa hri a châ.
Châhrasala theihthaipa ta moh ta, pakheihpa liata hmi pawhpa y leipa sala, mei kâna hmah cha vo hlâta a thu via leipa ta, a chawh ha khiahta cha, theihthaipa ta noh sari chhôh ânano ta a khawhlôh aw.
Theihthaipa ta noh sarina noh ta moh aw ta, hmah cha vo liata a kawh lymâ khiahta cha, theihthaipa ta ano cha pathaih leipa ta a phuah aw. Cha cha phawhpa hri a châ.

Pakheihpa cha a yna ualua liata ypa ta, vo liata kawh laih leipa sala, a chawh laih khiahta cha, mei kâna thlohpa châ ta, theihthaipa ta ano cha a pathaih tahpa a phuah aw. Cha cha mei kâpa hmahdawpa dei a châ.
“Chapaw tlyma, chanô tlyma ta, a luh liata tlyma, a kâh liata tlyma hri a hnei khiahta cha,

theihthaipa ta hri cha moh aw ta, vo hlâta a thu viapa ta a lâ sala, hmi di maihpa a y khiahta cha, theihthaipa ta ano cha pathaih leipa ta a phuah aw. Pathapa hri châ ta, luh nata kâh liata phawhpa hri a châ.
Theihthaipa ta pathapa hri cha moh aw ta, vo hlâta a thu via leipa ta a lâ sala, hmi vyhpa a y leipa khiahta cha, theihthaipa ta pathapa hri a hneituhpa cha noh sari chhôh ânano ta a khawhlôh aw.
A noh sarina noh ta, theihthaipa ta hri cha moh aw ta, pathapa hri cha kawh leipa sala, hmi maihpa y leipa ta, pathapa hri cha vo hlâta â thu via leipa khiahta cha,
a kâhhmi a ngyu aw ta, pathapa hri yna hmi deikua cha a ngyu awpa châ vei. Theihthaipa ta pathapa hri a hneipa cha noh sari ânano ta a khawhlôh via aw.

A noh sarina noh ta, theihthaipa ta pathapa hri cha moh heih aw ta, pathapa hri cha vo liata kawh leipa sala, vo hlâta a thu viapa ta â lâ leipa khiahta cha, theihthaipa ta ano cha pathaihpa ta a phuah aw. A chysiazy pasu aw ta, chatanachata a pathaih aw.
Pathaisapa a châ khai tawhta, pathapa hri a vo liata a kawh laih khiahta cha,
theihthaipa ta a moh heih awpa a châ. Pathapa hri cha vo liata a kawh laih khiahta cha, hmi maihpa a y ma tahpa theihthaipa ta a mo awpa byuh vei. Pathaih leipa a châ.
Pathapa hri cha a yna ualua liata a ypa ta hmô sala, hmi vyhpa a kaw thao khiahta deikua cha, pathapa hri cha a tlâh hapa châ ta, a pathaih hapa a châ. Theihthaipa ta ano cha pathaihpa ta a phuah aw.
“Chapaw tlyma, chanô tlyma, a pôhpa vo liata pakheihpa y sala, pakheihpa cha a râhpa a châ khiahta cha,
theihthaipa ta moh aw ta, a pôhpa vo liata pakheihpa cha phiephuh râhpâh dei a châ khiahta cha, pakheih chakhyhpa vo liata a vaw puapa châ ta, ano cha a pathaih.
“Chyhsa a sâ a py khai ha khiahta cha, luh pôlôpa châ ta, châhrasala pathaihpa a châ.
A khi sâ a py khai ha khiahta cha, khi tlyhpa châ ta, châhrasala pathaihpa a châ.
A luh pôlôpa liata tlyma, a khi tlyhpa liata tlyma, pakheihpa saih tôlôhpa a kaw pua khiahta cha, a luh pôlôpa liata tlyma, a khi tlyhpa liata tlyma phawhpa hri a vaw puapa a châ.
Theihthaipa ta moh aw ta, a luh pôlôpa liata tlyma, a khi tlyhpa liata tlyma hri a kaw puapa cha, pôhpa vo liata phawhpa a vaw lâpa hawhta saih tôlôhpa ta a kaw pua khiahta cha,
chyhsa phawhpa châ ta, pathaih leipa a châ. A luh liata a hri a ypa châ ta, theihthaipa ta ano cha pathaih leipa ta a phuah thlyu awpa a châ.
“Phawhpa hri a ohpa cha chysia a hriepa a ky aw ta, a sâ pathliah aw ta, a hmao chô lâ khu aw ta, ‘Pathaih leipa, pathaih leipa,’ tahpa ta a awh awpa a châ.
Hri a oh chhôh zydua pathaih leipa a châ. A pathaih leipa vâta, ânano ta y aw ta, a y nawpa su cha riehmo khôtho lâ a châ aw.
“Sahmi chysia liata tlyma, pala rih dipa chysia liata tlyma, chysia liata phawhpa hri a kia khiahta cha,
sahmi chysia nata pala rih dipa chysiazy sana thaitôh nata thaipheih liata zy, savo nata savo ta taopa hmobaoh liata zy,

phawhpa hri y sala, cha hri cha chysia liata tlyma, savo liata tlyma, thaitôh liata tlyma, thaipheih liata tlyma, savo ta taopa hmobaoh liata tlyma, a rôh hrohpâpa ta tlyma, saihpâpa ta tlyma ta â vaw lâ khiahta cha, phawhpa hri châ ta, theihthaipa pamosa awpa a châ.
Theihthaipa ta hri cha moh aw ta, hri kiapa hmo cha noh sari chhôh ânano ta a khawhlôh aw.

A noh sarina noh ta, hri cha moh aw ta, chysia liata tlyma, thaitôh liata tlyma, thaipheih liata tlyma, savo liata tlyma, savo cha kheihawhpa châ rai ta hmâpa a châpa chhao ta, a kawh lymâ khiahta cha, hri cha phawhpa hri a paka theipa châ ta, pathaih leipa a châ.

Chysia tlyma, sahmi pala tlyma, pala rih dipa tlyma, thaitôh tlyma, thaipheih tlyma, savo ta taopa hmobaoh kheihawhpa tlyma, phawhpa hri ta a kiapa maih cha, mei ta rao awpa a châ. Phawhpa hri cha a kawh theipa chi a châpa vâta, mei ta rao thlyu awpa a châ.
“Theihthaipa ta moh aw ta, hri cha chysia liata tlyma, thaitôh liata tlyma, thaipheih liata tlyma, savo ta taopa hmobaoh liata tlyma, a kawh laih leipa khiahta cha,
theihthaipa ta hri kiana hmo cha pasi awpa ta bie pie aw ta, noh sari ânano ta a khawhlôh via heih aw.

Hri ta a kiapa hmo cha, pasi khaipa a châ tawhta, theihthaipa ta moh heih aw ta, phawhpa hri ta a chhôh lâ tlyma, a chô lâ tlyma rai kia ha sala, hri cha a kawh leipa chhao ta, a rôh â nano leipa khiahta cha, pathaih leipa châ ta, mei ta na rao awpa a châ.

“Theihthaipa ta moh ta, hri yna cha pasi khaipa a châ tawhta, a rôh a lei khiahta cha, hri yna su cha chysia tawhta tlyma, savo tawhta tlyma, thaitôh tawhta tlyma, thaipheih tawhta tlyma a hrie pathlah awpa a châ.

Hri cha chysia liata tlyma, thaitôh liata tlyma, thaipheih liata tlyma, savo ta taopa hmobaoh liata tlyma â vaw luah heih khiahta cha, a paka hapa châ ta, hri ta a kiapa hmo cha mei ta na rao awpa a châ.
Chysia tlyma, thaitôh tlyma, thaipheih tlyma, savo ta taopa hmobaoh tlyma, na pasi khai tawhta hri ta a paisai khiahta cha, a einona ta pasi heih awpa châ ta, chatanachata a vaw pathaih aw.”

“Cha cha sahmi chysia liata tlyma, pala rih dipa chysia liata tlyma, thaitôh liata tlyma, thaipheih liata tlyma, savo ta taopa hmobaoh liata tlyma, phawhpa hri a y tita, a pathaih nata pathaih lei phuah nawpa ryhpa a châ,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi chho ta, a hnohta,
“He he phawhpa a pathaih noh ta taozie awpa ryhpa a châ: Phawhpa cha theihthaipa lâ a chhi awpa a châ.
Theihthaipa cha riehmo khôtho lâ pua aw ta, phawhpa cha moh aw ta, phawhpa chô liata phawhpa hri cha a tlâh ha khiahta cha,
theihthaipa ta pathaisa awpa phawhpa châta pavaw pathaihpa a hrohpa ta pô no, sidy tho, pala saihlawpa nata hisaw zy cheipa awpa ta bie a pie aw.
Theihthaipa ta pavaw pô kha cha alei beih chhôh liata chavah ti pasohpa chô liata thie awpa ta bie a pie aw.
Pavaw hrohpa cha la aw ta, sidy tho nata pala saihlawpa nata hisaw zy chhaota cheih aw ta, chavah ti chô liata thiepa pavaw thisaih liata a ny aw.
Phawhpa hri tawhta pathaisa awpa cha, pavaw thisaih ta ei sari thia aw ta, ano cha pathaihpa ta phuah aw ta, pavaw hrohpa cha lyurâhpa lâ a pathlie aw.

“Pathaisa awpa chyhsa cha a chysiazy pasu aw ta, a hmi zydua a ngyu aw ta, ti ta a ngai a si aw ta, a pathaih ha aw. Cha khai tawhta riehmo lâ a ngia thei aw ta, châhrasala a poh o khôtho liata noh sari a y chy awpa a châ.

A noh sarina noh ta a luh sâ zydua, a kâhhmi nata a hmaohmi zydua nata a mokhitlâh hmi zydua â ngyu aw. A hmi zydua â ngyu khai awpa a châ. A chysiazy pasupa ta, ti ta a ngai a si aw ta, chatanachata a pathaih ha aw.

“A noh chariena noh ta mietakutaw chapawpa seina hnei leipa pô no, mietakutaw chanôpa kô khapa seina hnei leipa pô kha nata niepa hlâna châta viahdie dipa sathaw pahlaopa kachu su hrawh su thôh nata sathaw chhiehraôh ôh kha a hlâ aw.
A pathaisatuhpa theihthaipa ta a pathaisa awpa chyhsa nata cha hmozy cha ahmaohna poh o chhikao liata Abeipa hmiakô ta a soh aw.
Theihthaipa ta mietakutaw chapawpa pô kha cha sathaw byh chhaota la aw ta, thaileichâna hlâna châta hlâ aw ta, chaluahpa hlâna châta Abeipa hmiakô liata a chaluah aw.

Moleina hlâna nata raopa hlâna ama thie tyhna su, supathaihpa liata mietakutaw chapawpa cha a thie aw. Moleina hlâna cha theihthaipa tovyuh a châpa hawhta, thaileichâna hlâna chhao theihthaipa tovyuh a châ hra. Cha cha pathaih ngaitapa a châ.
Theihthaipa ta thaileichâna hlâna thisaih cha la aw ta, a pathaisa awpa nakao chachâh lâ pawhmao nata a chachâh lâ kupi nata pheipi zy liata a hnia aw.
Theihthaipa ta sathaw ôh liata sathaw chyhta a chavei lâ kupazah liata bô aw ta,
cha liata a chachâh lâ kudy ny aw ta, a kudy ta Abeipa hmiakô liata ei sari a thia aw.

Theihthaipa ta a ku liata sathaw laibâhpazy cha a pathaisa awpa nakao chachâh lâ pawhmao nata a chachâh lâ kupi nata pheipi zy liata a hnia aw. Chazy cha thaileichâna hlâna thisaih a thiapa chô liata a hnia thlu aw.
Chatawhcha theihthaipa ta a ku liata sathaw laibâhpazy cha a pathaisa awpa luh liata hnia aw ta, Abeipa hmiakô liata chatlaina a taopa aw.
“Theihthaipa ta moleina hlâna hlâ aw ta, a pathaih leina tawhta pathaisa awpa châta chatlaina taopa aw ta, cha khai tawhta raopa hlâna a thie aw.
Theihthaipa ta raopa hlâna nata niepa hlâna cha maisâh liata a hlâ aw. Cha hawhna chata theihthaipa ta chatlaina taopa aw ta, a vaw pathaih ha aw.

“Dyhchhiepa châ sala, a hneina ta a tloh leipa khiahta cha, mietaku chapawpa pô kha cheih aw ta, ano châta chatlaina tao nawpa ta, thaileichâna hlâna châta chaluahpa a châ aw. Niepa hlâna châta viahdie dipa sathaw pahlaopa kachu su hrawh su kha nata sathaw chhiehraôh ôh kha cheih aw ta,
vachhuh pô no tlyma, pivawtaw pô no tlyma, a hnei viapa thithaw cheih hra aw ta, pô kha cha moleina hlâna châta châ aw ta, ahropa cha raopa hlâna châta a châ aw.
“Chazy cha, phawhpa ta ano pathaisa nawpa ta, a noh chariena noh ta, theihthaipa lâ a cheih awpazy châ ta, ahmaohna poh o chhikao liata Abeipa hmiakô ta a cheih awpa a châ.
Theihthaipa ta thaileichâna hlâna mietakutaw nata sathaw chhiehra ôh kha la aw ta, chaluahpa hlâna châta Abeipa hmiakô liata a chaluah aw.

Cha khai tawhta theihthaipa ta thaileichâna hlâna mietakutaw cha a thie aw. Thaileichâna hlâna thisaih cha la aw ta, a pathaisa awpa nakao chachâh lâ pawhmao nata a chachâh lâ kupi nata pheipi zy liata a hnia aw.
Chatawhcha theihthaipa ta sathaw chyhta a chavei lâta kupazah liata bô aw ta,
a ku chavei lâta sathaw cha, a ku chachâh lâta kudy ta Abeipa hmiakô liata ei sari a thia aw.
Theihthaipa ta a ku liata sathaw cha a pathaisa awpa nakao chachâh lâ pawhmao nata a chachâh lâ kupi nata pheipi zy liata thaileichâna hlâna thisaih a hniana su chô liata a hnia thlu aw.
Theihthaipa ta a ku liata sathaw laibâhpazy cha a pathaisa awpa luh liata thu aw ta, Abeipa hmiakô liata chatlaina a taopa aw.
Vachhuhzy tlyma, pivawtawzy tlyma, a hneipa thithaw theihthaipa ta hlâ aw ta,
moleina hlâna châta pô kha hlâ aw ta, raopa hlâna châta pô kha, niepa hlâna chhaota hlâ aw ta, pathaisa awpa châta Abeipa hmiakô liata chatlaina a taopa aw.
Cha cha phawhpa hri pathaisana hmohlâpa ryhpa hawhta a tao thei leipazy châta pathaisana ryhpa a châ,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi nata Arawna chho ta, ama hnohta,
“Nama ryuto châta Kâna râh ei cha piepa ei namâ ngia tita, nama ryuto râh liata kheihawhpa o lia rai ta phawhpa hri ei soh khiahta cha,
o hneituhpa ta theihthaipa lâ vawh aw ta, ‘Ei o liata hri a lyupa a ypa hawhta ei pahno,’ tahpa ta a chho aw.

O chhôh liata hmo a ypa zydua pathaih leipa a châ pathlei lei nawpa ta, theihthaipa ta hri moh awpa ta â ngia hlâta, o cha parua awpa ta bie a pie aw. Cha khai tawhta o moh awpa ta theihthaipa cha â ngia aw.
Hri cha moh aw ta, hri chata a rôh hrohpâpa ta tlyma, saihpâpa ta tlyma, pâhchhô nie sala, pâhchhô hlâta a thu viapa ta â lâ khiahta cha,
theihthaipa cha o tawhta chhikao lâ pua aw ta, o cha noh sari a khaw aw.
A noh sarina noh ta, theihthaipa cha a vy heih aw ta, moh aw ta, hri cha pâhchhô liata a kawh laih khiahta cha,
hri yna pâhchhô alôzy la ta, khihpi khôtho lâ su sithai leipa liata thy awpa ta bie a pie aw.
Theihthaipa ta o chhôh zydua pahaosa khai aw ta, ama haona paohpazy cha khihpi khôtho lâ su sithai leipa liata ama patlai khai aw.
Alô hropazy la aw ei ta, alô ama thy hapa suzy liata soh aw ei ta, beihlei hropa la aw ei ta, o cha ama pamih pathi aw.
“Alôzy thy khai tawh chhao ta nata o cha hao khaipa ta pamih pathi khaipa a châ tawh chhao ta, o liata hri a vaw pua heih khiahta cha,
theihthaipa ta a ngia aw ta, a moh heih aw. Hri cha o liata a kawh via laih khiahta cha, a kawh theipa phawhpa hri o liata a ypa châ ta, o cha pathaih leipa a châ.
O cha phiepa châ aw ta, alôzy, thozy nata pachawh pâna beihlei zydua cha khihpi khôtho liata su sithai leipa lâ paly awpa a châ.
Cha o khaw chhôh ta a ngiapa maih zâlâ taih pathaih leipa ama châ aw.
Cha o liata a riepa maih cha ama chysiazy pasu aw ei ta, cha o liata pati a niepazy chhao ama chysiazy ama pasu awpa a châ.
“Theihthaipa ta moh awpa ta a vy ta, hri cha o pamih pathipa a châ tawhta a kawh via laih leipa khiahta cha, theihthaipa ta o cha pathaihpa ta a phuah aw. Hri cha a pai hapa a châ.
O pathaisa nawpa ta pavaw pô no, sidy tho, pala saihlawpa nata hisaw cheih aw ta,
pavaw pô kha cha alei beih chhôh liata chavah ti pathaihpa chô liata a thie aw.
Sidy tho, hisaw, pala saihlawpa nata pavaw hrohpa cha la aw ta, pavaw thiepa thisaih nata pahlaopa chavah ti liata ny aw ta, o cha ei sari a thia aw.
Chatanachata o cha pavaw thisaih, chavah ti, pavaw hrohpa, sidy tho, hisaw nata pala saihlawpa zy ta a pathaisa aw.
Pavaw hrohpa cha khihpi tawhta lyurâhpa lâ pathlie aw ta, cha hawhna chata o châta chatlaina taopa aw ta, o cha a vaw pathaih ha aw,” tah ta.
Cha cha phawhpa hri chi to nata riatha kyh liata ryhpa a châ.
Chysia liata phawhpa a ypa nata o liata a ypa,
a byuhpa, riatha nata pabôpa zy kyh liata,
pathaih leipa nata pathaihpa pahno nawpa ryhpa a châ. Cha cha phawhpa hri kyh liata ryhpa a châ.
Abeipa ta Mawsi nata Arawna chho ta, ama hnohta,
“Izarei sawzy chho u la, ama hnohta hetana heta reih teh u: Chapaw ahy rai a chapaw châna tawhta hniah a pua khiahta cha, hniah cha pathaih leipa a châ.
He he chapaw châna tawhta hniah a puapa vâta pathaih leina ryhpa a châ: Hniah cha a pua pazao ngâ thlâh ha tlyma, â chalih ha tlyma, pathaih leipa a châ khai.
Hniah hneipa aziana rakhô cha pathaih leipa châ aw ta, â tyuna chhao pathaih leipa a châ aw.
A rakhô a hriapa cha a chysiazy pasu aw ta, ti liata a ngai a si aw ta, zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw.
Hniah hneipa atyuna liata a tyuhpa cha a chysiazy pasu aw ta, ti liata a ngai a si aw ta, zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw.
Hniah hneipa pôhpa a hriapa cha a chysiazy pasu aw ta, ti liata a ngai a si aw ta, zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw.
Hniah hneipa ta chyhsa pathaihpa pachih ta a pachhao khiahta cha, chyhsa pathaihpa cha a chysiazy pasu aw ta, ti liata a ngai a si aw ta, zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw.
Hniah hneipa chyhsa kiana kypadia cha pathaih leipa a châ aw.
Hniah hneipa chyhsa ry lâta a ypa hmo a hriapa cha zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw. Cha hmozy a phaohpa cha a chysiazy pasu aw ta, ti liata a ngai a si aw ta, zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw.
Hniah hneipa ta ti liata a ku a si ha tua leipa ta a hriapa chyhsa cha, a chysiazy pasu aw ta, ti liata a ngai a si aw ta, zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw.
Hniah hneipa ta a hriapa alei beih cha pakei awpa châ ta, tho hmobaoh zydua deikua, ti liata pasi khai awpa a châ.
“Hniah hneipa cha a hniah tawhta a pathaih ha khiahta cha, ano pathaisana châta noh sari hmâh aw ta, a chysiazy pasu aw ta, chavah ti liata a ngai a si aw ta, chatanachata a pathaih ha aw.
A noh chariena noh ta, vachhuh pô no tlyma, pivawtaw pô no tlyma cheipa ta Abeipa hmiakô lâ vawh aw ta, ahmaohna poh o chhikao liata theihthaipa a hlâ aw.
Theihthaipa ta moleina hlâna châta pô kha, raopa hlâna châta pô kha hlâ aw ta, a hniah lopa châta Abeipa hmiakô liata chatlaina a taopa aw.
“Chapaw ahy rai a baoti a pua khiahta cha, a pôhpa duata ti liata a ngai a si aw ta, zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw.
Baoti ta a kiapa chysia nata vo zydua ti liata pasupa ta pasi khai awpa châ ta, zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw.
Chapaw ta chanô a ziakhei sala, a baoti a papua khiahta cha, ama pano ta ti liata ama ngai a si aw ei ta, zâlâ taih pathaih leipa ama châ aw.

“Chanô ta a chanô châna tawhta a puapa hnei sala, a puapa cha thi a châ khiahta cha, chanô hnopasupa vâta noh sari chhôh pathaih leipa châ aw ta, ahy rai ano a hriapa cha zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw.
A pathaih lei chhôh ta â ziana maih cha pathaih leipa châ aw ta, â tyuna maih chhao pathai leipa a châ aw.
A rakhô a hriapa cha a chysiazy pasu aw ta, ti liata a ngai a si aw ta, zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw.
Â tyuna a hriapa chhao a chysiazy pasu aw ta, ti liata a ngai a si aw ta, zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw.
Rakhô liata hmo a ypa nata â tyuna liata hmo a ypa a hriapa cha zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw.
Chapaw ta ano cha a ziakhei sala, a chanô thi lopa pathaih leina cha â hlao khiahta cha, cha chapaw cha noh sari chhôh pathaih leipa châ aw ta, â ziana rakhô maih pathaih leipa a châ aw.

“Chanô a hnopasu daihti tyhpa châ leipa ta, noh hluhpi hnopasupa ta ypa ta tlyma, a chanô hnopasu daihti tyhpa hlâta noh hluh via ta hno a pasu khiahta tlyma cha, a chanô hnopasu daihti tyhpa chhôh ta a pathaih leina yzie hawhna khata a hno pasu chhôh zydua a y hra aw, pathaih leipa a châ.

A hnopasu chhôh zydua ta â ziana rakhô maih cha, a chanô hnopasu pathaih leina daihti tyhpa liata a rakhô hawhta châ aw ta, â tyuna maih chhao, a chanô hnopasu pathaih leina daihti tyhpa liata a pathaih leipa hawhta pathaih leipa a châ aw.
Ahy rai cha hmozy a hriapa cha pathaih leipa châ aw ta, a chysiazy pasu aw ta, ti liata a ngai a si aw ta, zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw.
“Chanô cha a hnopasupa tawhta a pathaih ha khiahta cha, pathaisana châta noh sari hmâh aw ta, cha khai tawhta a pathaih aw.
A noh chariena noh ta, vachhuh pô no tlyma, pivawtaw pô no tlyma cheih aw ta, theihthaipa hnohta ahmaohna poh o chhikao liata a hlâ aw.
Theihthaipa ta moleina hlâna châta pô kha, raopa hlâna châta pô kha hlâ aw ta, hnopasupa vâta a pathaih leina châta Abeipa hmiakô liata chatlaina a taopa aw.
“Cha hawhna chata Izarei sawzy cha ama pathaih leinazy tawhta na panano awpa ei a châ. Chataleipatala ama pathaih leina vâta, ama hry liata ei achhyna byureih papuapalei aw ei ta, ama thi pathlei aw.
“Cha cha a chapaw châna tawhta hniah a lohpa nata a baoti a puapa vâta pathaih leipa a châ hapa chapaw châta ryhpa châ ta,

chanô hnopasupa vâta a pathaih leipa châta ryhpa a châ hra. Chapaw chhao, chanô chhao, a chapaw châna nata a chanô châna tawhta a puapa a hneipa zydua châta ryhpa châ ta, chanô hnopasu chhôh ta a ziakheipa chapaw châta ryhpa a châ,” tah ta.
Arawna sawchapaw pano ta mei pathaih leipa hmâpa ta Abeipa lâta ropahâhpa ama hlâpa vâta ama thi tawhta Abeipa ta Mawsi cha bie a chho ta.

Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Na unawhpa Arawna chho teh. A khona daihti maihta Byh chô liata patyupa zawngiahna dyuchhai hmiakô liata pohraipa chhôh Su Pathaihpa lâ â ngia awpa châ vei. Zawngiahna dyuchhai chô liata meihdo hry liata a vaw luah tlôh aw na ta, chavâta a thi pathlei aw.
Arawna cha Su Pathaihpa lâ â ngia tita, moleina hlâna châta viahchao tôh dawpa nata raopa hlâna châta mietaku tôhpa chhaota â ngia awpa a châ.

Pala rih dipa viahkao pathaihpa a ky aw ta, a sapa khu nawpa ta pala rih dipa chaopasy â pasy aw. Pala rih dipa chaisaihna a saih aw ta, pala rih dipa lakhu â khu aw. Chazy cha chysia pathaihpa a châ. Ti liata a ngai a si tua aw ta, cha khai tawhta chysiazy cha â tobi aw.
Izarei zawpi tawhta moleina hlâna châta mie tôhpa pô no nata raopa hlâna châta mietaku tôhpa pô kha a la aw.
“Arawna ta ano moleina hlâna châta viahchao tôhpa hlâ aw ta, ano nata a chhôhkha châta chatlaina a tao aw.
Mie pô no a chhi aw ta, ahmaohna poh o chhikao liata Abeipa hmiakô ta a soh aw.
Arawna ta mie pô no chhichâ nawpa cha nuby a daopa ta â tlyh aw. Nuby miakhapa liata ‘ Abeipa châta’ tahpa roh aw ta, nuby hropa liata ‘Azaze châta’ tahpa a roh aw.
Abeipa châta a tlupa mie cha Arawna ta la aw ta, moleina hlâna châta a hlâ aw.
Azaze châta a tlupa mie cha, chatlaina tao nawpa ta râhchawhpa lâ pathlie awpa ta, Abeipa hmiakô liata ahrohpa ta a soh aw.
“Arawna ta ano châta moleina hlâna viahchao tôhpa cheih aw ta, ano nata a chhôhkhazy châta chatlaina tao aw ta, ano châta moleina hlâna viahchao tôhpa cha a thie aw.
Chatawhcha mei-ia ta a biepa meilana beikoh cha, maisâh tawhta Abeipa hmiakô liata la aw ta, ropahâhpa pahâh ngaitapa, a dipa ta phypa kupazah miano chhaota, pohraipa chhôh lâ â ngiakhei aw.
Ropahâhpa cha Abeipa hmiakô ta mei liata mia aw ta, ropahâhpa khuh ta Biehrai Byh chô liata zawgiahna dyuchhai cha pahly aw ta, chatanachata thina a tyh aw vei.
Viahchao tôhpa thisaih la aw ta, a kudy ta zawngiahna dyuchhai nochhi lâchhâh thia aw ta, zawngiahna dyuchhai hmia lâ chhao, a kudy ta thisaih cha ei sari a thia aw.

“Cha khai tawhta zawpi châta moleina hlâna mie thie aw ta, pohraipa chhôh lâ a thisaih â ngiakhei aw. Viahchao tôhpa thisaih a taopa hawhna khata, mie thisaih chhao cha tao aw ta, zawngiahna dyuchhai chô liata nata zawngiahna dyuchhai hmiakô liata a thia aw.

Chatanachata Izarei sawzy pathaih leinazy, ama paraonazy nata ama moleina zydua vâta Su Pathaihpa châta chatlaina a tao aw. Cha hawhna chata, ama pathaih leinazy hry liata ama hnohta a ypa ahmaohna poh o châta chhao a tao aw.

Chatlaina tao awpa ta Su Pathaihpa lâ â ngiana daihti tawhta, ano nata a chhôhkha nata Izarei zawpi châta chatlaina tao ta, a vaw pua heih hlâlei cha, ahy hmahta ahmaohna poh o chhôh liata ama y awpa châ vei.
Cha khai tawhta, Abeipa hmiakô liata maisâh lâ pangai aw ta, maisâh châta chatlaina a taopa aw. Viahchao tôhpa thisaih nata mie thisaihzy la aw ta, maisâh kizy liata â dôna taihta a hnia aw.
Maisâh cha a kudy ta thisaih ei sari thia aw ta, a pathaisa aw. Cha hawhna chata maisâh cha Izarei sawzy pathaih leinazy tawhta a pathaisa aw.
“Su Pathaihpa, ahmaohna poh o nata maisâh zy châta chatlaina a tao khai tawhta, mie hrohpa cha a hlâ aw.

Arawna ta mie hrohpa luh chô liata a ku kârano pahnieh aw ta, Izarei sawzy paraona, tao pasina nata moleina zydua mie chô liata palâhâh aw ta, chazy cha mie luh chô liata a soh khai aw. Mie cha rao eihpa chyhsa ku liata pie aw ta, râhchawhpa lâ a kei pathliesa aw.
Mie cha râhchawhpa liata pathlie aw ta, chatanachata ama paraona zydua cha mie ta chyhsa y leina râh lâ a siekhei ha aw.
“Chatawhcha Arawna cha ahmaohna poh o liata a ngia aw ta, Su Pathaihpa lâ â ngia nota pala rih dipa chysia â taopazy pahluh aw ta, cha liata a siesai aw.

Su pathaihpa liata ti ta a ngai a si aw ta, a chysia â tao heih aw. Cha khai tawhta vaw pua aw ta, ano châta raopa hlâna nata zawpi châta raopa hlâna hlâ aw ta, ano nata zawpi châta chatlaina a tao aw.
Moleina hlâna thaw cha maisâh liata a rao aw.
“Azaze châta mie a pathlietuhpa chhao a chysia pasu aw ta, ti liata a ngai a si aw ta, cha khai tawhta riehmo lâ â di aw.

Chatlaina tao nawpa ta Su Pathaihpa liata ama thisaih a ngiakheipa moleina hlâna viahchao tôhpa nata moleina hlâna mie cha, riehmo khôtho lâ puakhei awpa châ ta, ama vozy, ama sapazy nata ama iezy mei ta rao awpa a châ.
Mei ta a raotuhpa cha a chysia pasu aw ta, ti liata a ngai a si aw ta, cha khai tawhta riehmo lâ â di aw.
“He he nama châta chhâzaw bieraopa a châ aw: Thla sarina noh hrawhna noh liata a paky aw ei chi ta, a râh chyhsa chhao, chihropa nama hry ta a pahrâpa chhao, khâpa rai hmahta nama hria awpa châ vei.
Cha noh liata, nâmo pathaisa awpa ta nama chatlaina taopa châ aw ta, chatanachata Abeipa hmiakô liata nama moleina zydua tawhta nama pathaih aw.
Cha cha nama châta Pahânoh zachhihpa châ ta, namâ paky awpa noh a châ. Cha cha chhâzaw châta bieraopa a châ.
Theihthaipa, a paw su a thla awpa ta sathawthupa nata pananopa ta pala rih dipa chysia pathaihpa a tobi aw ta, chatlaina a tao aw.
Supathaihpa, ahmaohna poh o nata maisâh zy châta chatlaina tao aw ta, theihthaipazy nata zawpi châta chhao chatlaina a tao aw.
Izarei sawzy moleina zydua vâta ama châta kô kha ta ei kha chatlaina tao tyh awpa cha, nama châta chhâzaw bieraopa a châ aw,” tah ta. Chatanachata Abeipa ta Mawsi bie a piepa hawhta Arawna ta tao ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Arawna nata a sawchapawzy nata Izarei saw zydua chho la, ama hnohta hetana heta reih teh. He he Abeipa biepiepa a châ:
Izarei pathla ahy rai viahchao tôhpa tlyma, mietakutaw tlyma, mie tlyma, riehmo liata tlyma, riehmo khôtho lâ tlyma thie sala,

Abeipa achhyna byureih hmiakô liata Abeipa lâta hmohlâpa ta hlâ awpa ta, ahmaohna poh o chhikao liata a vaw cheih leipa cha, thisaih a palopa ta pachâpa châ aw ta, a chô liata thisaih maoh a y aw. Cha chyhsa cha a phopi tawhta chhawh pathlahpa a châ aw.

Izarei sawzy ta lyurâhpa liata atheihna ama hlâ tyhpazy kha, Abeipa lâta hlâ awpa ta, ahmaohna poh o chhikao liata theihthaipa lâta cheipa ta, aryhna hlâna atheihna châta Abeipa lâta ama hlâ thei nawpa ta, he ryhpa he taopa a châ.
Theihthaipa ta ahmaohna poh o chhikao liata Abeipa maisâh chô liata thisaih thia aw ta, a thaw cha Abeipa châta ropahâhpa châta a rao aw.
Amâ phei tyhna mie tôhpa khazohzy lâta atheihnazy ama hlâ awpa châ khao vei. Cha cha ama chhâ zydua châta chhâzaw bieraopa a châ aw.
“Ama hnohta hetana heta reih via teh: Izarei pathla ahy tlyma, chihropa ama hry liata a pahrâpa ahy tlyma, raopa hlâna tlyma, atheihna tlyma hlâ sala,
Abeipa lâta hlâ awpa ta ahmaohna poh o chhikao liata a vaw cheih leipa khiahta cha, cha chyhsa cha a phopi tawhta chhawh pathlahpa a châ aw.

“Izarei pathla ahy tlyma, chihropa ama hry liata a pahrâpa ahy tlyma, thisaih kheihawhpa rai a niepa maih cha, cha thisaih a nietuhpa cha hiehâhpa ta moh aw na ta, a phopi tawhta ei chhawh pathlah aw.
Sapa hrona cha thisaih liata y ta, cha cha nama hronazy chatlai nawpa ta, maisâh liata ei cha pie ei. Thisaih cha hrona châ ta, hrona chatlaina a tao theituhpa cha thisaih a châ.
Chavâta Izarei sawzy hnohta, ‘Nama hry liata ahy hmahta thisaih nama nie awpa châ leipa ta, chihropa nama hry liata a pahrâpa ahy hmahta thisaih ama nie awpa châ vei,’ ei tahpa a châ.
“Izarei saw tlyma, chihropa ama hry liata a pahrâpa tlyma, râh a khie sala, sa tlyma, pavaw tlyma, nie theipa chi a vaw phaoh khiahta cha, a thisaih palo aw ta, dohlei ta a khu awpa a châ.

Hmohrohneipa to hrona cha a thisaih a châ. A thisaih cha a hrona a châ. Chavâta Izarei sawzy hnohta, ‘Kheihawhpa sa thisaih hmah nama nie awpa châ vei. Hmohrohneipa to hrona cha a thisaih châ tlôh ta, chavâta thisaih a niepa cha chhawh pathlahpa a châ aw,’ tahpa ta ei chho ei.

“Ano kho ta a thipa tlyma, sa taipa tlyma a niepa cha, a râh chyhsa chhao, chihropa chhao, a chysiazy pasu aw ta, ti liata a ngai a si aw ta, zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw. Cha khai tawhta a pathaih aw.
A chysiazy pasu leipa sala, a ngai â si vei khiahta cha, a paraona maoh a phaoh aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Izarei sawzy chho la, ama hnohta hetana heta reih teh: Kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa ei châ.

Nama vaw pahrâna Izi râh liata ama taozie hawhna khata nama tao awpa châ leipa ta, ei cha tlôkhei awpa su Kâna râh liata ama taozie hawhta nama tao awpa châ hra vei. Ama bieraopazy nama zyh awpa châ vei.
Ei ryhpazy a pyh aw ei chi ta, ei bieraopazy zyhpa ta, ei lâpi namâ chhih awpa a châ. Kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa ei châ.
“Ei bieraopazy nata ei ryhpazy nama zyh awpa châ ta, chazy cha chyhsa ta a tao khiahta cha, chazy vâna chata a hroh aw: Kei he Abeipa ei châ.
“Ahy hmahta nama chhôhkha sipazy a hniapa ta, ama hno ty ta, ama thluahruana palâpa ta namâ ziakhei awpa châ vei. Kei he Abeipa ei châ.
“Na nô hno typa ta na paw thluahruana na palâ awpa châ vei. Na nô hno typa cha na paw dua thliapa a châ. Ano cha na nô châ ta, a hno na ty awpa châ vei.
“Na paw lapinô hno na ty awpa châ vei. Cha cha na paw dua thliapa a châ.
“Na sietanô hno na ty awpa châ vei. Na paw sawchanô rai châ sala, na nô sawchanô rai châ sala, o kha liata na pilâhpa chhao, o hro lâta a pihpa chhao, a hno rai na ty awpa châ vei.
“Na sawchapaw lâta na samohnô hno tlyma, na sawchanô lâta na samohnô hno tlyma na ty awpa châ vei. Âmo thluahruana palâpa cha nâma thluahruana palâpa a châ.
“Na paw lapinô sawchanô, o kha liata na laiseih khohpa hno na ty awpa châ vei. Ano cha na sietanô a châ.
“Na paw sietanô hno na ty awpa châ vei. Ano cha na paw chhôhkha sipa a châ.
“Na nô narônô hno na ty awpa châ vei. Ano cha na nô chhôhkha sipa a châ.
“Na paw unawhpa thluahruana na palâ awpa a châ leipa vâta, a lapinô nâ hnia awpa rai châ vei. Ano cha na nô a châ.
“Na myuhnô hno na ty awpa châ vei. Na sawchapawpa lapinô châ ta, a thluahruana na palâ awpa châ vei.
“Na unawhpa lapinô hno na ty awpa châ vei. Cha cha na unawhpa thluahruana palâpa a châ.

“Chanô nata a sawchanô cha, ama pano ta ama hno na ty awpa châ vei. A sawchapawpa sawchanô tlyma, a sawchanônô sawchanô tlyma hneipa ta ama thluahruana na palâ awpa châ vei. Chhôhkha sipazy châ ei ta, cha hawhta taopa cha moleina a châ.
“Na lapinô hro chhôh ta, a narônô cha na lapinô châta hneipa ta, a hno na ty awpa châ vei.
“Chanô a hnopasu pathaih lei daihti liata a hniapa ta a hno na ty awpa châ vei.
“Na vaih lapinô a ziakheipa ta, ano vâta nâ papuapalei awpa châ vei.
“Na saw ahy hmahta atheihna ta Môleka lâ na hlâ awpa châ vei. Cha hawhta hmo taopa ta na Khazohpa moh na papuapalei awpa châ vei. Kei he Abeipa ei châ.
“Chanô a ziakheipa hawhta chapaw nâ ziakhei awpa châ vei. Pasichhihpa a châ.
“Sahroh ykheipa ta nâ papuapalei awpa châ vei. Chanô chhao sahroh hmia liata a duahpa ta â paykheisa awpa châ vei. Cha cha molei khuachhuapa a châ.
“Cha hawhpa hmozy taopa ta, nâmosasyh a papuapalei khah u. Cha hmozy ama taopa vâta, nama hmiakô liata ei papua laihpa phopizy kha amâ papuapalei hapa a châ.
Cha vâna chata râh chhao papuapaleipa ta y ta, ama hmo paraona vâta hrie ei na ta, râh ta a chhôh liata a pahrâpazy a pali ha ei.
Nâmo deikua cha, a râh chyhsa chhao, chihropa nama hry liata a pahrâpazy chhao, ei bieraopazy nata ei ryhpazy nama zyh awpa châ ta, cha hmo pasichhihpa kheihawhpa hmahta nama tao awpa châ vei.
Cha hmo pasichhihpa zydua cha, he râh liata nâmo hlâta a vaw pahrâ tuapa phopi ta tao ei ta, chavâta râh cha papuapaleipa ta a y hapa a châ.
Nâmo chhao, râh nama papuapalei khiahta cha, nâmo hlâta a vaw y tuapa phopi hawhna khata râh ta a cha pali hra aw ei.
Cha hmo pasichhihpa kheihawhpa rai a taopazy cha ama phopi tawhta chhawh pathlahpa ama châ aw.

Chavâta hmo pasichhihpa phoryhpa, nâmo y hlâta he râh liata a vaw y tuapa phopizy ta ama taopazy kha nama tao hra lei nawpa ta, ei biepiepa he zyh u la, cha hmozy liata a papuapalei khuh vy. Kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa ei châ,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Izarei zawpi zydua chho la, ama hnohta hetana heta reih teh: Kei Abeipa nama Khazohpa he pathaih tlôh na ta, chavâta nâmo chhao nama pathaih awpa a châ.
Nama nô nata nama paw nama za chyu awpa châ ta, ei Pahânohzy nama chay awpa a châ. Kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa ei châ.
Nothlahpa khazoh lâ a heih leipa u la, thua ta leihpa nothlahpa khazohzy a tao khuh vy. Kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa ei châ.
“ Abeipa lâta aryhna hlâna atheihna namâ hlâ tita, a pyhpa nama châ thei nawpa ta nama hlâ awpa a châ.
Nama hlâna noh nata a mylâ ta nie awpa châ ta, noh thôhna noh taihta a y khiahta cha, mei ta rao awpa a châ.
Noh thôhna noh ta niepa a châ khiahta cha, pathaih leipa châ ta, a pyhpa châ aw vei.
A niepa cha Abeipa hmo pathaihpa a papuapaleipa vâta, a hmo paraona maoh phaoh aw ta, cha chyhsa cha a phopi tawhta chhawh pathlahpa a châ aw.
“Nama râh liata sâh nama hria tita, nama lyu chhâna taihta nama hria khai awpa châ leipa ta, a kâmo chhao nama thoh awpa châ vei.
Nama kre sadô kâmo nama thoh awpa châ leipa ta, nama kre sadô liata kre zôpa namâ huah awpa châ vei. Dyhchhiepa nata chihropazy châta nama pahlôh awpa a châ. Kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa ei châ.
“Nama paru awpa châ leipa ta, dôveipa ta hmo nama tao awpa châ hra leipa ta, haipa bie namâ chho raihrie awpa châ vei.
Ei moh ta haipa ta bie a taihpa ta, na Khazohpa moh na papuapalei awpa châ vei. Kei he Abeipa ei châ.
“Na vaih na tlybai awpa châ leipa ta, ano cha na hrao awpa châ vei. Raihriatuhpazy hlao pie leipa ta, azozâkhihdei nâ vao awpa châ vei.
“Nahpâpa chhie na sapa awpa châ leipa ta, mochaopa hmiakô liata chapiasana na so awpa châ vei. Na Khazohpa na chi awpa a châ. Kei he Abeipa ei châ.
“Ryureina liata â doleipa ta nama pachia awpa châ vei. Dyhchhiepa na khokhei via awpa châ leipa ta, chyhsa hmotaotheipa hmia na mo via awpa châ hra vei. Siana ta na vaih na pachia awpa a châ.
Chyhsa kyh reipa ta na chiheihzy hry liata nâ khie awpa châ leipa ta, na vaih hrona châta chichhihpa bie nâ duakhei awpa châ vei. Kei he Abeipa ei châ.
“Na palôh ta na unawhpa nâ hao awpa châ leipa ta, a thaileichâna liata nâ hlao hra lei nawpa ta, na vaih cha na chhorei awpa a châ.
Phuh na la awpa châ vei. Na chiheihzy chhyh thai leipa ta na y awpa châ leipa ta, nâma kyh nâ pachâpa hawhta na vaih kyh na pachâ awpa a châ. Kei he Abeipa ei châ.

“Ei bieraopazy na zyh awpa a châ. Sahroh chi hropa nata chi hropa chi na pathlasa awpa châ leipa ta, na lyu liata chi miano na chei pakaoh awpa châ hra leipa ta, pala chihropa miano sa pahlaopa chysia nâ tobi awpa châ vei.

“Chyhsa ta a seichanô a ziakhei sala, cha seichanô cha a pahawh hapa châ sala, châhrasala chatlai mâh leipa nata khotalaina pie mâh leipa a châ khiahta cha, hriepa châ aw ei ta, seichanô cha khotalaina pie mâh leipa a châpa vâta, ama pano ta thie awpa deikua châ vei.
Chapaw ta a thaileichâna hlâna châta Abeipa lâta hlâ awpa mietaku tôhpa ahmaohna poh o chhikao liata â vaw chhi aw.
Chapaw moleina chatlai nawpa ta, theihthaipa ta thaileichâna hlâna mietaku tôhpa hlâ aw ta, Abeipa hmiakô liata chatlaina a taopa aw. Chatanachata a moleina cha a ngiahthaipa a châ aw.

“Kâna râh a ngia aw ei chi ta, nie awpa châta tho chi to nama loh tita, a theilâpa cha nie lei awpa chi ta nama pachâ chy awpa a châ. Nama châta kô thôh chhôh nie leipa chi a châ aw. Nie cheita awpa châ vei.
Tho thei zydua cha a kô palihna liata pathaih khai aw ta, Abeipa reithaina châta hlâ awpa a châ.
A kô pangawhna kô ta a theilâpazy nama nie thei aw. Chatanachata theilâpa kôzy cha nama châta a pathei hluh via lymâ aw. Kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa ei châ.
“A thisaih chhaota khâpa hmah nama nie awpa châ vei. Dyuzy nama tao awpa châ leipa ta, pachaopazy nama hmâ awpa châ vei.
Na siahli padôpa ta na luh nâ ngyu awpa châ leipa ta, na kâhhmi paizy na tai awpa châ vei.
Athihpa châta nama pôhpa nama â awpa châ leipa ta, nama pôhpa nama chapai awpa châ vei. Kei he Abeipa ei châ.
“Na sawchanô cha âzuahnô ta taopa ta na papuapalei awpa châ vei. Chataleipatala râh cha âzuahnô râh ta vaw châ aw ta, moleina ta a bie pathlei aw.
Ei Pahânohzy chay aw ei chi ta, ei supathaihpa nama chiza awpa a châ. Kei he Abeipa ei châ.
“Peihthaipa tlyma, ahripa lâta pachaothaipa tlyma pangai leipa u la, chazy liata a papuapalei awpa ta âmo cha tlua hra khah u. Kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa ei châ.
“Luh pawhpa hmiakô liata nâ duah tyh awpa châ ta, machâpa hmia za aw chi ta, Khazohpa na chi awpa a châ. Kei he Abeipa ei châ.
“Chihropa nama râh liata khih a sapa ama y khiahta cha, a chô liata â doleipa ta nama tao awpa châ vei.

Chihropa nama hnohta khih a sapa cha, nama râh chyhsa pakha hawhta nama pachâ awpa châ ta, nâma kyh nâ pachâpa hawhta a kyh na pachâ awpa a châ. Nâmo chhao Izi râh liata chihropa nama châpa kha a thei thlâh ha teh u. Kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa ei châ.”
“Pachiana kyh liata zy, a seihna thliena liata zy, â hrina khopathliahna liata zy, panuana liata zy â doleipa ta nama tao awpa châ vei.
Khopathliahna dopa, khopathliahna lô dopa, kachu dopa, chhiehraôh dopa nama hmâ awpa a châ. Kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa, Izi râh tawhta châ chhi papuatuhpa ei kha ei châ.
Chavâta ei bieraopa zydua nata ei ryhpa zydua a pyh aw ei chi ta, nama zyh awpa a châ. Kei he Abeipa ei châ,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,

“Izarei sawzy hetana heta chho heih teh: Izarei saw tlyma, Izarei râh liata a pahrâpa chihropa tlyma, a saw Môleka lâta a piepa cha thie thlyu awpa châ ta, râh chyhsa zawpi ta alô ta vawhsao awpa a châ.
Kei tlai chhao ta, cha chyhsa cha a heihnao aw na ta, a saw Môleka lâ piepa ta, ei supathaihpa cha pathaih leipa ta tao ta, ei moh pathaihpa a papuapaleipa vâta, a phopi tawhta ei chhawh pathlah aw.
A saw Môleka lâta a hlâpa cha, râhsaw zawpi ta pahno lei a pachâ ei sala, ama thie vei khiahta cha,
cha chyhsa nata a phoheihzy cha keima tlai ta a heihnao aw ei na ta, ano chhao, Môleka lâ â zuana kyh liata ano a pazituhpa zydua chhao, ama phopi tawhta ei chhawh pathlah aw ei.
“Apeihpazy nata ahripa lâta pachaona a taopazy pangaipa ta, âmo pazipa ta a sihryhpa cha, cha chyhsa cha a heihnao aw na ta, a phopi tawhta ei chhawh pathlah aw.
Chavâta a pathai u la, pathaihpa ta y teh u. Kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa châ tlôh na ta.
Ei bieraopazy a pyh u la, zyh teh u. Kei he Abeipa, nâmo châ pathaisatuhpa ei châ.
A nô tlyma, a paw tlyma, chhie a sapa cha thie thlyu awpa a châ. A nô tlyma, a paw tlyma chhie a sapa vâta, a thisaih maoh a phaoh aw.
“Ahy rai chyhsa lapinô liata tlyma, a vaih lapinô liata tlyma â phei khiahta cha, apheipaw nata apheinô cha ama pano ta thie thlyu awpa a châ.
A paw lapinô a ziakheipa cha, a paw dua a thliapa châ ta, ama pano ta thie thlyu awpa a châ. Ama thisaih maoh ama phaoh aw.
Chyhsa ta a myuhnô â ziakhei khiahta cha, ama pano ta thie thlyu awpa a châ. Molei chotlua a chohpa châ ei ta, ama thisaih maoh ama phaoh aw.
Chyhsa ta chanô a ziakheipa hawhta chapaw â ziakhei khiahta cha, ama pano ta hmo pasichhih ngaitapa a taopa châ ei ta, thie thlyu awpa ama châ. Ama thisaih maoh ama phaoh aw.
Chyhsa ta chanô nata a nô lapinô ta a hnei pakaoh khiah ei ta cha, molei ngaitapa châ ta, nama hry liata moleina a y lei nawpa ta, cha chyhsa nata chanôzy cha mei ta raosao awpa a châ.
Chyhsa ta sahroh a ykhei khiahta cha, cha chyhsa cha thie thlyu awpa châ ta, sahroh chhao cha nama thie awpa a châ.
Chanô ta sahroh â paykheisa khiahta cha, chanô nata sahroh cha na thie awpa a châ. Thie thlyu awpa ama châ, ama thisaih maoh ama phaoh aw.

“Chyhsa ta a sietanô, a paw sawchanô tlyma, a nô sawchanônô tlyma hneipa ta, a sietanô thluahruana hmôpa ta, a sietanô chhao ta a rilâhpa thluahruana a hmô khiahta cha, nozachhih ngaitapa châ ta, ama phopi chyhsazy mohmô liata pahleipadia awpa ama châ. A sietanô thluahruana a palâpa châ ta, a paraona maoh a phaoh aw.

Chyhsa ta chanô hnopasu daihti liata a ziakheipa ta a thluahruana a palâ khiahta cha, a chanô thihnawh thluahruana a palâpa châ ta, chanô chhao ta a thihnawh a palâpa châ ta, ama pano ta ama phopi tawhta chhawh pathlahpa ama châ aw.
Na nô narônô hno tlyma, na paw sietanô hno tlyma, na ty awpa châ vei. Chhôhkha sipa hnotypa châ ta, ama pano ta ama hmo paraona maoh ama phaoh aw.
Chyhsa ta a paw unawhpa lapinô â ziakhei khiahta cha, a paw unawhpa dua thliapa châ ta, ama pano ta ama moleina maoh ama phaoh aw. Saw hnei leipa ta ama thi aw.
Chyhsa ta a unawhpa lapinô a hnei khiahta cha, hmo pathaih leipa a châ. A unawhpa dua a thliapa châ ta, saw hnei leipa ta ama thi aw.
“Chavâta ei bieraopa zydua nata ei ryhpa zydua a pyh aw ei chi ta, nama zyh awpa a châ. Chatanachata pahrâ nawpa ta ei cha tlôkheina râh ta cha pali aw veih ei.
Nama hmia lâta ei papua hapa phopi taoziezy nama zi awpa châ vei. Cha hmo zydua cha tao tyh ei ta, chavâta ei pasi ngaita ei.

Nâmo hnohta deikua cha, ‘Ama râh, sâhpiti nata kheihti lona râh cha, ryu ta to aw ei chi ta, nama hnei awpa ta ei cha pie aw ei,’ tahpa ta bie ei châ taih ei. Kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa, phopizy hry tawhta nâmo châ pananotuhpa ei châ.

Chavâta sa pathaihpa nata pathaih leipa, pavaw pathaihpa nata pathaih leipa nama panano awpa a châ. Sa tlyma, pavaw tlyma, alei liata alyhpasa tlyma, nama châta pathaih leipa ta ei pananopazy niepa ta, nama hrona cha pasichhihpa ta nama tao awpa châ vei.
Ei châta nama pathaih awpa a châ. Kei, Abeipa he pathaih tlôh na ta, kei eih châ awpa ta, phopizy hry tawhta ei cha panano ei.
“Chapaw rai, chanô rai, peihthaipa nata ahripa lâta pachaona a taopa cha thie thlyu awpa châ ta, alô ta vawhsao awpa a châ. Ama thisaih maoh ama phaoh aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Arawna sawchapaw theihthaipazy chho la, ama hnohta hetana heta reih teh: Theihthaipa cha, a chiheihzy hry liata athihpa vâta â papuapalei awpa châ vei.
A chhôhkha sipa, a nô tlyma, a paw tlyma, a sawchapaw tlyma, a sawchanô tlyma, a unawhpa tlyma,
a sietanô laihsa kôpa tlyma tah leipa ta cha, athihpa vâta â papuapalei awpa châ vei. Dyhchâ leipa a sietanô laihsa kôpa vâta deikua cha â papuapalei thei aw.
Theihthaipa cha a chiheihzy hry liata pawhrâh chaipa a châpa vâta, pathaih leipa ta a taopa ta, â papuapalei awpa châ vei.
Theihthaipazy cha luh pôlôpa ta ama sâ amâ ngyu awpa châ leipa ta, ama kâhhmi kâ lâ ama tai awpa châ hra leipa ta, ama pôhpa ama â awpa châ vei.

Ama Khazohpa châta ama pathaih awpa châ ta, ama Khazohpa moh ama papuapalei awpa châ vei. Khazohpa tovyuh a niepa châ ei ta, Abeipa lâta hmohlâpazy mei ta a hlâ tyhpa ama châpa vâta, ama pathaih awpa a châ.
Theihthaipa cha a Khazohpa châta chyhsa pathaihpa a châpa vâta, âzuahnô tlyma, chanô papuapalei hapa tlyma ama hnei awpa châ vei. A vahpa nata a chhaihpa chanô chhao ama hnei awpa châ vei.

Na Khazohpa viahchhâ a hlâpa a châpa vâta, na châta chyhsa pathaihpa ta na rao awpa a châ. Kei, Abeipa nâmo cha pathaisatuhpa he pathaih tlôh na ta, chavâta theihthaipa cha chyhsa pathaihpa ta na pachâ awpa a châ.
Theihthaipa sawchanô ta a zuah sala, â papuapalei khiahta cha, a paw a papuapaleipa châ ta, mei ta raosao awpa a châ.

“Theihthai beichaipa châ awpa ta a unawhzy hry tawhta panano hapa nata, a luh liata sathaw pathaihpa bao hapa nata theihthaipa chysia a tobi awpa ta panano hapa cha, a sâ a pathliah awpa châ leipa ta, a chysiazy a hrie awpa châ vei.
Athihpa ri yna liata â ngia awpa châ leipa ta, a nô tlyma, a paw tlyma vâta chhao â papuapalei awpa châ vei.
A Khazohpa ta a pananona sathawthuna a chô liata y tlôh ta, chavâta supathaihpa tawhta a pua awpa châ vei. Chataleipatala a Khazohpa supathaihpa a papuapalei pathlei aw. Kei he Abeipa ei châ.
“Theihthaipa cha lapinô châta laihsa kôpa a hnei awpa a châ.
Nôhmei tlyma, a vahpa nata a chhaihpa tlyma, chanô papuapalei hapa tlyma, âzuahnô tlyma a hnei awpa châ vei. Ano chiheih laihsa kôpa lapinô ta a hnei awpa a châ.
Chatanachata a pathlazy cha a chiheihzy hry liata papuapalei leipa ta a y aw. Kei he Abeipa ano pathaisatuhpa cha ei châ,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Arawna chho la, a hnohta hetana heta reih teh: ‘Chhâ vaw y lymâ awpa liata, na pathlazy hry liata a khaihly leipa cha, a Khazohpa viahchhâ hlâ awpa ta â hnia awpa châ vei.
A khaihly leipa maih, mochaopa, pheisypa, hmia pizie doleipa, ku phei seih tupa,
phei tliepa, ku tliepa,
zôh kopa, heih a kho leipa mataw tupa, mo liata adoleina a hneipa, hmahchaku a hneipa, thachhâpa nata tihmô keipazy cha, ama Khazohpa viahchhâ hlâ awpa ta amâ hnia awpa châ vei.
Theihthaipa Arawna pathla a khaihly leipa cha Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpa hlâ awpa ta â hnia awpa châ vei. A khaihly leipa a châpa vâta, a Khazohpa viahchhâ hlâ awpa ta â hnia awpa châ vei.
A Khazohpa viahchhâ pathaih chaipa nata hmo pathaihpazy cha a nie thei khai aw.

A khaihly leipa a châpa vâta, pohraipa deikua siepahlie thei leipa aw ta, ei supathaihpazy a papuapalei lei nawpa ta, maisâh kiapâh lâ vawh thei aw vei. Kei he Abeipa âmo pathaisatuhpa ei châ,’” tah ta.
Cha hawhna chata Mawsi ta Arawna nata a sawchapawzy nata Izarei saw zydua hnohta reih ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Arawna nata a sawchapawzy chho la, ei moh pathaihpa ama papuapalei lei nawpa ta, Izarei sawzy ta hmo pathaihpa kei lâta ama hlâpa tawhta a panano awpa ta âmo cha chho teh. Kei he Abeipa ei châ.

Ama hnohta hetana heta reih teh: Nama chhâ zydua liata, nama pathla ahy rai ta pathaih leina hneina chôta, Izarei sawzy ta Abeipa lâta ama hlâpa, hmohlâpa pathaihpa â hnia khiahta cha, cha theihthaipa cha ei hmiakô tawhta chhawh pathlahpa a châ aw. Kei he Abeipa ei châ.
Arawna pathla ahy rai phawhpa tlyma, hniah lohpa tlyma a châ khiahta cha, a pathaih hlâlei hmo pathaihpazy a nie awpa châ vei. Athihpa a hriapa, a baoti a puapa,
alyhpasa pathaih leipa a hriapa nata pathaih leina paka theipa a hneipa chyhsa hriapa zy vâta â papuapaleipa theihthaipa cha,
zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw. Ti liata a ngai â si ha tua leipa ta cha, hmo pathaihpazy a nie awpa châ vei.
Noh a tla nahta pathaih aw ta, cha khai tawhta hmo pathaihpazy a nie thei aw, chazy cha ano nie awpa a châpa vâta.
Theihthaipa cha, ano kho ta a thipa sa tlyma, sahrâhpa ta a taipa tlyma niepa ta â papuapalei awpa châ vei. Kei he Abeipa ei châ.
Chavâta ei biepiepazy amâ pyh awpa a châ. Chataleipatala ei hmo pathaihpa ama papuapaleipa vâta ama moleina maoh phaoh aw ei ta, ama thi pathlei aw. Kei he Abeipa âmo pathaisatuhpa ei châ.
“Chyhsa zawrâpa ta hmo pathaihpa a nie awpa châ leipa ta, theihthaipa khichhai chihropa nata theihthaipa rai hriatuhpazy chhao, hmo pathaihpa ama nie awpa châ vei.
Theihthaipa ta ano sôh ta a chaleipa sei deikua cha, hmo pathaihpa a nie thei aw. Theihthaipa o liata a pihpa chhao, theihthaipa pati a nie thei aw.
Theihthaipa sawchanô ta chyhsa zawrâpa a hnei khiahta cha, hmohlâpa pathaihpazy a nie awpa châ vei.

Theihthaipa sawchanô a nôhmeipa tlyma, a vahpa ta a mapa tlyma, saw hnei leipa ta a paw o lâ a kua khiahta deikua cha, a laihsa no hawhta a paw pati a nie heih thei aw. Chyhsa zawrâpa deikua theihthaipa pati pathaihpa a nie awpa châ vei.
Chyhsa ta pahno leipa ta hmo pathaihpa a nie pathlei ha khiahta cha, a mâ su pangawh su kha baichha aw ta, hmo pathaihpa cha theihthaipa hnohta a pie aw.
Theihthaipazy ta Izarei sawzy Abeipa lâta hmohlâpa pathaihpazy ama papuapalei awpa châ vei.
Chataleipatala hmo pathaihpazy niepa ta ama thaileichâna maoh ama phaoh pathlei aw. Kei he Abeipa âmo pathaisatuhpa ei châ,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,

“Arawna nata a sawchapawzy nata Izarei saw zydua chho la, ama hnohta hetana heta reih teh: Izarei pathla tlyma, Izarei râh liata a ypa chihropa tlyma, a hmohlâpa a vaw chei tita, ama bietai hmohlâpa rai châ sala, lôhthai hmohlâpa rai châ sala, raopa hlâna châta Abeipa lâta ama vaw cheipa maih cha,
nama hlâpa a pyhpa a châ thei nawpa ta, viahchao tlyma, mietaku tlyma, mie tlyma, a chapawpa seina hnei leipa nama hlâ awpa a châ.
Seina a hneipa rai nama hlâ awpa châ vei. Cha hawhpa cha nama châta a pyh tlâh châ aw vei.

Ahy rai a bietai patlô nawpa ta Abeipa lâta aryhna hlâna châta tlyma, lôhthai hmohlâpa châta tlyma, atheihna a hlâ tita, a py tlâh a châ thei nawpa ta, viahchao hri tawhta tlyma, mietaku zaw tawhta tlyma, seina hnei leipa a hlâ awpa a châ. Sahroh cha seina rai a hnei awpa châ vei.
Sahroh mochaopazy, ru tliepazy, asypazy, hmahphaohpazy, hmahchaku a hneipazy nata thachhâpazy Abeipa lâta nama hlâ awpa châ vei. Maisâh liata niepa hlâna châta Abeipa lâ nama pie awpa châ hra vei.

Lôhthai hmohlâpa châta viahchao tôhpa tlyma, mietakutaw tlyma, kuphei seih tupa tlyma, chyu tupa tlyma hlâ thei aw ei chi ta, bietai patlô nawpa ta hmohlâpa châta deikua, cha hawpa cha a pyhpa châ aw vei.
Sahroh a tihmô thi dôpa tlyma, chhuhchheihpa tlyma, pakeipa tlyma, hri lyupa tlyma, Abeipa lâta nama hlâ awpa châ vei. Cha hawhpa hmo cha nama râh liata nama tao awpa châ vei.
Cha hawhpa sahrohzy cha chihropa tawhta lapa ta, nama Khazohpa nie awpa ta nama hlâ awpa châ vei. Raona âmo liata y ta, seina ama hneipa vâta, nama châta a pyhpa châ aw vei,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi chho ta, a hnohta,
“Viahchao tôhpa tlyma, mietaku tlyma, mie tlyma a pataw nahta, a panô hnohta noh sari y aw ta, a noh chariena noh tawhta, Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpa châta a pyh theipa a châ aw.
Viahchao panô tlyma, mietaku panô tlyma, a taw chhaota noh kha ta nama thie awpa châ vei.
Abeipa lâta alyna biereina atheihna nama hlâ tita, a pyh tlâh châ awpa ta atheihna cha nama hlâ awpa a châ.
Namâ theihna noh ta nie khai ha awpa châ ta, a mylâ my taihta khâpa hmah nama so awpa châ vei. Kei he Abeipa ei châ.
“Ei biepiepazy he zyhpa ta nama tao awpa a châ. Kei he Abeipa ei châ.
Izarei sawzy hry liata pathaisapa ta ei y thei nawpa ta, ei moh pathaihpa nama papuapalei awpa châ vei. Kei he Abeipa nâmo châ pathaisatuhpa châ na ta,
nama Khazohpa châ awpa ta Izi râh tawhta châ chhi papuatuhpa ei châ. Kei he Abeipa ei châ,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Izarei sawzy chho la, ama hnohta hetana heta reih teh: Hezy he Abeipa châta kyhchhi raopa, pakhypi pathaihpa ta nama phuah awpa châ ta, chazy cha keima raopa kyhchhizy a châ.

“Noh charu chhôh rai hria awpa châ ta, a noh sarina noh deikua cha apahâna zachhihpa Pahânoh, pakhypi pathaihpa noh a châ aw. Khâpa rai hmah nama hria awpa châ vei. Cha cha nama pahrâna maih liata Abeipa châta Pahânoh a châ.
“Hezy he Abeipa châta kyhchhi raopa, pakhypi pathaihpa châ ta, hmâh awpa ta a daihti raopa liata nama phuah tyh awpa a châ:
Thla khana, noh hrawh hleipalihna noh zâlâ a zoh chy daihti cha Abeipa Zawpakhô kyhchhi a châ.
Cha thla pyly liata, noh hrawh hleipangawhna noh cha Abeipa châta viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa kyhchhi châ ta, noh sari chhôh viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa nama nie awpa a châ.
A noh khana noh ta pakhypi pathaihpa hmâh aw ei chi ta, rai rupa nama hria awpa châ vei.
Noh sari chhôh mei ta hmohlâpa Abeipa lâta nama hlâ awpa châ ta, a noh sarina noh cha pakhypi pathaihpa châ ta, rai rupa nama hria awpa châ vei,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,

“Izarei sawzy chho la, ama hnohta hetana heta reih teh: Râh ei cha piepa ei tlô aw ei chi ta, a kôvei sâh nama hria tita, nama sâh a daih tuapazy tawhta sapiah miakha theihthaipa lâ nama vaw cheih awpa a châ.
A pyhpa nama châ thei nawpa ta, theihthaipa ta sapiah cha a chaluah aw. Pahânoh mylâ ta Abeipa hmiakô liata a chaluah awpa a châ.
Sapiah nama chaluah noh ta, mietakutaw chapawpa kô khapa, seina hnei leipa cha, raopa hlâna ta Abeipa lâta nama hlâ aw.

Niepa hlâna viahdie dipa sathaw pahlaopa kachu su hrawh su no hlâ pâ awpa châ ta, cha cha ropahâhpa châta Abeipa lâta mei ta raopa hmohlâpa a châ aw. Dopa hlâna châta kresawhti chhiehraôh ôh palih hlâ pâ hra awpa a châ.

Nama Khazohpa lâta nama hlâna noh a tlô hlâlei cha, chi thiehpa viahchhâ tlyma, raopa tlyma, a suh tlyma, nama nie awpa châ vei. Cha cha nama chhâ zydua châta nama pahrâna zydua liata chhâzaw bieraopa a châ aw.
“Pahânoh mylâ ta chaluahpa hlâna sapiah nama vaw chei noh tawhta reih aw ei chi ta, Pahânoh ei sari a tloh awpa a châ.
Pahânoh ei sarina my taihta noh sypangawh reih aw ei chi ta, niepa hlâna sâh thiehpa cha Abeipa lâ nama hlâ aw.
Chaluahpa hlâna ta Abeipa lâ thei hmiatuapazy hlâ awpa ta, nama pahrâna suzy tawhta, viahchhâ tlâ no nata viahdie dipa thinô pahlaopa ta taopa kachu su hrawh su no nama cheih awpa a châ.

Viahchhâ hlâ nota, mietakutaw kô khapa seina hnei leipa pô sari, viahchao tôh dawpa pô kha nata mietaku tôhpa pô no nama hlâ awpa a châ. Chazy cha Abeipa lâta raopa hlâna châ aw ta, ama niepa hlâna nata ama dopa hlânazy chhaota Abeipa lâta raopa hlâna ropahâh ngaitapa a châ aw.
Moleina hlâna châta mie tôhpa pô kha nata aryhna hlâna atheihna châta mietakutaw chapawpa kô khapa pô no nama hlâ aw.
Theihthaipa ta thei hmiatuapa viahchhâ cha, mietakutaw pô no chhaota, chaluahpa hlâna ta Abeipa hmiakô liata a chaluah aw. Chazy cha Abeipa châta pathaihpa châ ta, theihthaipa tovyuh a châ aw.
Cha noh lia tlai ta nama châta pakhypi pathaihpa phuah aw ei chi ta, rai rupa khâpa hmah nama hria awpa châ vei. Cha cha nama chhâ zydua châta nama pahrâna zydua liata chhâzaw bieraopa a châ aw.

“Nama lyu liata sâh nama hria tita, nama lyu chaki chakô taihta nama hria khai awpa châ leipa ta, kâmo chhao nama thoh awpa châ vei. Dyhchhiepa nata chihropazy châta nama pahlôh awpa a châ. Kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa ei châ,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,

“Izarei sawzy chho la, ama hnohta hetana heta reih teh: Thla sarina, cha thla noh khana noh cha nama châta apahâna zachhihpa noh châ ta, chiahmie tôpa ta atheithlâhna noh ta phuah aw ei chi ta, pakhypi pathaihpa hmâna noh a châ aw.
Rai rupa nama hria awpa châ leipa ta, Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpa nama hlâ awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi chho ta, a hnohta,
“Thla sarina noh hrawhna noh cha Chatlaina Noh châ ta, nama châta pakhypi pathaihpa châ aw ta, a paky aw ei chi ta, Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpa nama hlâ awpa a châ.
Cha noh cha, chatlaina noh châ ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa hmiakô liata nama châta chatlaina taona noh a châpa vâta, khâpa rai hmah nama hria awpa châ vei.
Cha noh liata a paky leipa cha, a phopi tawhta chhawh pathlahpa a châ aw.
Ahy rai châ sala, cha noh liata rai kheihawhpa rai a hriapa cha, a phopi tawhta ei pahleipadia aw.
Khâpa rai hmahta nama hria awpa châ vei. Cha cha nama chhâ zydua châta nama pahrâna zydua liata chhâzaw bieraopa a châ aw.
Cha noh cha nama châta a pahâ nawpa Pahânoh zachhihpa châ aw ta, namâ pakyna noh a châ aw. Cha thla, noh chakina noh zâlâ tawhta zâlâ heihpa taih cha Pahânoh ta nama chay awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi chho ta, a hnohta,
“Izarei sawzy chho la, ama hnohta hetana heta reih teh: He thla sarina, noh hrawh hleipangawhna noh he, Abeipa lâta noh sari chhôh Byureih Kyhchhi hmâna nohzy a châ.
A noh khana cha pakhypi pathaihpa châ aw ta, rai rupa nama hria awpa châ vei.
