Noh sari chhôh Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpa hlâ aw ei chi ta, a noh chariena noh cha nama châta pakhypi pathaihpa châ aw ta, Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpa nama hlâ awpa a châ. Cha cha pakhypi pathaihpa châ ta, rai rupa nama hria awpa châ vei.

“Hezy he Abeipa châta kyhchhi raopazy châ ta, pakhypi pathaihpa daihti liata nama phuah awpazy a châ: Raopa hlânazy, niepa hlânazy, atheihnazy nata dopa hlânazy cha a noh raopa chyu liata hlâ awpa châ ta, Abeipa lâta mei ta raopa hmohlâpazy nama hlâ nawpa kyhchhi daihtizy a châ.
Chazy cha Abeipa Pahânohzy liata pie awpa nama hmosaipiepazy, nama bietai zydua nata nama lôhthai hmopiepa zydua khô lâta Abeipa lâta nama pie awpazy a châ.

“A thla sarina, noh hrawh hleipangawhna noh, nama lyu liata kôveizy nama hria khai tawhta, Abeipa kyhchhi noh sari chhôh hmâh aw ei chi ta, a noh khana noh cha apahâna noh zachhihpa châ aw ta, a noh chariena noh chhao apahâna noh zachhihpa a châ aw.
A noh khana noh ta tho phapa theizy, thiahrâ kuahzy, thochiah buh phapa nata chavah liata râbuhzy a chaba aw ei chi ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa hmiakô liata noh sari chhôh thaphapa ta nama y aw.
Cha cha Abeipa lâta kyhchhi châta kô chareih noh sari chhôh nama chay tyh awpa châ ta, nama chhâ zydua châta chhâzaw bieraopa a châ aw. Thla sarina liata nama chay tyh awpa a châ.
Byureih liata noh sari chhôh y aw ei chi ta, a râh chyhsa Izarei saw zydua cha byureihzy liata pahrâ khai awpa a châ.
Chatanachata nama chhâ vaw y lymâ awpazy ta, Izarei sawzy Izi râh tawhta ei chhi papua nota byureih liata ei paysapa ei ama pahno thei aw. Kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa ei châ,” tah ta.
Cha hawhna chata Mawsi ta Abeipa kyhchhi daihti raopazy cha Izarei sawzy hnohta phuah ta.
Khazohpa ta Mawsi chho ta, a hnohta,
“Meiôh cha khâ a khaih thei nawpa ta, ôli thaw saohpa pasohpa nâ lâta vaw cheih awpa ta Izarei sawzy hetana heta biepie teh:

Ahmaohna poh o liata Biehrai Byh pohraipa khôtho liata, meiôh cha zâlâ tawhta my taihta Abeipa hmiakô liata pakhaih tyh awpa ta, Arawna ta soh tyh mawh sy. Cha cha nama chhâ vaw y lymâ awpazy châta chhâzaw bieraopa a châ aw.
Meiôhzy cha ngôh suapa ta taopa meiôh sona chô liata Abeipa hmiakô ta khaih pazao awpa ta Arawna ta a soh tyh aw.
“Viahdie dipa la aw chi ta, cha chata viahchhâ tlâ hrawh hleino na tao aw. Viahchhâ tlâ kha châta viahdie kachu su hrawh su no lymâ hmâ awpa a châ.
Abeipa hmiakô liata tlâhkhai pathaihpa chô liata tlâh no ta paziah aw chi ta, tlâh kha liata viahchhâ tlâ charu lymâ ta na paziah aw.
Viahchhâ chô liana cha, a tlâh no liata deiryh pasoh ngaitapa soh aw chi ta, cha cha viahchhâ vyuhpa ta atheithlâhna hmo châta châ aw ta, Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpa a châ aw.
Pahânoh maihta Arawna ta viahchhâ cha Abeipa hmiakô liata soh lymâ aw ta, cha cha Izarei sawzy tawhta ama chhâzaw biehrai châta ama piepa a châ aw.
Cha cha Arawna nata a sawchapawzy tovyuh châ aw ta, Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpazy tawhta chhâzaw châta ama tovyuh pathaihpa a châpa vâta, su pathaihpa liata ama nie awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Chyhsa pakha, a nô Izarei chyhsa, a paw Izi chyhsa cha, Izarei sawzy yna lâ vawh ta. Cha Izarei chanô sawchapawpa nata Izarei chyhsa pakha cha riehmo liata a tu ei ta.
Izarei chanô sawchapawpa chata Moh reipachhiepa ta chhie sa ta. Mawsi lâ a chhi ei ta, a nô moh cha Selômi châ ta, ano cha Dânâ chi Dibri sawchanô a châ.
Abeipa pakah tawhta bie a puapa hâpa ta patâhna liata khô chy ei ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Chhiesatuhpa kha riehmo khôtho lâ a chhi u la, a biereipa a theipa zydua ta a luh liata ama ku pahnieh ei sala, zawpi zydua ta alô ta vawh mawh ei sy.
Izarei sawzy chho la, ama hnohta, ahy rai a Khazohpa chhie a sapa cha, a moleina maoh a phaoh aw.
Abeipa moh a reipachhiepa cha thie thlyu awpa châ ta, zawpi zydua ta alô ta ama vawh awpa a châ. Chihropa chhao, a râh chyhsa chhao, Moh a reipachhie khiahta cha thie awpa a châ.
“Thina taihta chyhsa chô liata ku a pathlapa cha thie thlyu awpa a châ.
Thina taihta sahroh chô liata ku a pathlapa cha thô aw ta, sahroh vyuhpa ta sahroh a thô aw.
Chyhsa ta a vaih hmah a paphao khiahta cha, a taopa hawhta a chô liata tao hra awpa a châ.
Ru tliepa vyuhpa ta ru tliepa, mo vyuhpa ta mo, hâh vyuhpa ta hâh châ aw ta, chyhsa hmah a paphaopa hawhta, ano chhao hmah paphao awpa a châ.
Sahroh a thiepa cha thô aw ta, chyhsa a thiepa cha ano chhao thie awpa a châ.
Chihropazy châta nata a râh chyhsazy châta ryhpa â lyupa ta nama hnei awpa a châ. Kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa ei châ,” tah ta.
Cha hawhna chata Mawsi ta Izarei sawzy cha chho ta, chhiesatuhpa cha riehmo khôtho lâ a chhi ei ta, Mawsi hnohta Abeipa biepiepa hawhta Izarei sawzy ta tao ei ta, alô ta ama vawhsao haw.
Abeipa ta Sinai Tlâh liata Mawsi hnohta,
“Izarei sawzy chho la, ama hnohta hetana heta reih teh: Râh ei cha piepa ei nama tlô tita, râh ta Abeipa châta Pahânoh a chay hra awpa a châ.
Na lyu liata kô charu chhôh chi cheih aw chi ta, na kre sadô chhao kô charu chhôh a chiah chhawhpa ta panyusa aw chi ta, a theizy na hria aw.
A kô sarina kô deikua cha râh châta apahâna noh pathaihpa, Abeipa châta Pahânoh châ aw ta, na lyu liata chi na chei awpa châ leipa ta, na kre sadô chhao a chiah chhawhpa ta na panyusa awpa châ vei.
Na sâh sawhlipa na hria awpa châ leipa ta, na mohôh leipa kre thei chhao na lyu awpa châ vei. Cha cha râh châta apahâna pathaihpa kô a châ aw.
Râh â pahâ kô ta chicheipa a patheipazy cha nama nie chhyhpa châta a châ aw. Nâ nata na seichapaw nata na seichanôzy, châ hriahlaopazy, na hnohta a ypa chihropazy,
na viahchao hri nata na râh liata sahrohzy châta châ aw ta, lyu nata sadô liata a patheipa zydua cha, nie chhyhpa châta a châ aw.
“Chatawhcha a pahâ kô kô sari reipati aw chi ta, kô sari cha su sari ta papôhsapa châ aw ta, chatanachata a pahâ kô kô sari cha kô sypalih nata kô chaki a châ aw.
Cha tawhta thla sarina, noh hrawhna noh ta chiahmie paro ngaitapa ta patôsa aw chi ta, nama râh zydua liata chiahmie tôpa ta chatlaina noh nama phuah aw.

Kô sypangawhna a ly aw ei chi ta, râh pôhpalôh liata a pahrâpa zydua hnohta khotalaina nama phuah aw. Cha cha nama châta zubili châ aw ta, chyhsa to nama râh chyu lâta kua aw ei chi ta, mo to nama chhôhkha chyu lâ namâ lie aw.
Kô sypangawhna cha nama châta zubili châ aw ta, chi cheih leipa aw ei chi ta, a sawhlipa chhao la leipa aw ei chi ta, kre zôh mohôh leipa liata kre thei chhao nama lyu awpa châ vei.
Zubili kô châ ta, nama châta a pathaih awpa a châ. Lyurâhpa liata a pyuhpazy deita nama nie awpa a châ.
“Cha zubili kô liata chyhsa to âmo râh chyu ama hnei heih aw.
“Na vaih hnohta râh na zua khiahta tlyma, na vaih râh na chalei khiahta tlyma, namâ dôvei awpa châ vei.
Zubili tawhta reipatipa ta, a kô ziepa lymâ hawhta na vaih hnohta râh mâ pie aw chi ta, chi chei nawpa kô zie reipatipa ta, na vaih ta na hnohta râh a zuah awpa a châ.
A kô hluhna zie lymâ ta a mâ papôh aw chi ta, a kô chyhna zie lymâ ta a mâ na pahnai aw. Chi chei nawpa kô ziepa a laichadaipa ta na hnohta a zua awpa a châ.
Namâ dôvei awpa châ vei. Kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa châ tlôh na ta, na Khazohpa cha na chi awpa a châ.
“Chavâta ei bieraopazy zyhpa ta, ei ryhpazy a pyh u la, chazy cha nama tao awpa a châ. Chatanachata râh liata thlalôhpa ta nama pahrâ aw.
Râh ta a thei pathei aw ta, lôhrâtlôpa ta nie aw ei chi ta, thlalôhpa ta nama y aw.
‘A kô sarina kô liata khâpa eima nie aw? Chi cheih tlôh leipa pi ta, chavâta sâh eima hria awpa y aw vei’ nama tah thei.
A kô charuna kô liata ei byhnâ nama chô liata patlôsa aw na ta, kô thôh a daih awpa ta kô a veih aw.
A kô chariena kô ta chi cheih aw ei chi ta, sâh hlôpa nama pachôpazy nie aw ei chi ta, kô chakina taih, sâh thiehpa â daih heih hlâlei sâh hlôpa nama nie aw.
“Râh cha nama zuah pathlah awpa châ vei. Râh cha kei eih châ ta, nâmo cha khichhaipa nata khitlyhpa, ei râh liata a pahrâ chypa dei nama châ.
Râh nama chaleipa zydua cha, râh hneituhpa ta a chatlai pakhua awpa nama pasaih awpa a châ.
“Na unawhpa a dyh vaw chhie sala, a râh thokha a zuah khiahta cha, a heinawh a hnia chaipa ta a unawhpa zuapa râh cha a chatlai awpa a châ.
Chyhsa ahy tlyma cha, a râh a chatlaipa awpa hnei leipa sala, châhrasala vaw hneirôhpa ta, chatlaina khi sôh a hnei khiahta cha,

a zuana kô tawhta a laichadaipa ta, râh ta kôvei a papua thei awpa zie reipatipa châ aw ta, râh a zuana mâ zie a tloh leipa khiahta cha, râh a chaleituhpa hnohta a mâ pakua aw ta, a râh cha a hnei heih aw.
Chatlai pakhua heih awpa ta a hneina ta â daih vei khiahta deikua cha, râh a zua hapa cha chaleituhpa ku liata zubili kô taih y aw ta, zubili kô ta râh cha pua aw ta, a râh cha a hnei heih aw.
“Thokhy a hneipa khihpi liata chyhsa ta a o a zuah khiahta cha, a zua tawhta kô kha chhôh ta a chatlai heih thei aw. Kô kha bohloh chhôh chatlai theina daihti a hnei aw.
Kô kha chhôh ta a chatlai thei leipa khiahta cha, thokhy hneipa khihpi liata a o cha, chaleituhpa ta hnei pathlah aw ta, a pathlazy ta ama hnei lymâ aw. Zubili liata chhao pua khao aw vei.
Thokhy a hnei leipa khitawzy liata ozy deikua cha, râh liata lyu hawhta pachâpa châ aw ta, chatlai theipa a châ aw. Zubili liata chhao a pua thei aw.
Livai chizy deikua cha, Livai khihpizy liata o ama hneipazy khatino rai ta ama chatlai thei aw.

Livai chi ta a o zuah sala, chatlai pakhua awpa a khoh khiahta cha, Livai khihpizy liata ozy cha Livai chizy ta Izarei sawzy hry liata olyu ama hnei chhôhpa a châpa vâta, Livai khihpi liata o zuapa cha Zubili liata a pua awpa a châ.
Livai khihpizy chheipâh liata lyuzy deikua cha, chhâzaw châta ama ryuto râh a châpa vâta, zuah theipa châ aw vei.
“Na unawhpa a dyh vaw chhie sala, a châ vaw chhai khiahta cha, na deichhy awpa a châ. Khichhaipa nata khitlyhpa na deichhypa hawhta, na hnohta na paysa aw.
Apôhna tlyma, âthôhna tlyma, ano tawhta na la awpa châ vei. Na Khazohpa chi mah y, chatanachata na unawhpa cha na hnohta a y thei aw.
Apôhna chhaota na sôh dyu na pacheisa awpa châ leipa ta, athôhna tluapa ta niedo na pie awpa châ vei.
Kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa, Kâna râh cha pie awpa nata nama Khazohpa châ awpa ta, Izi râh tawhta châ chhi papuatuhpa ei châ.
“Na unawhpa a dyh vaw chhie sala, na hnohta sei ta â zuah khiahta cha, sei hawhta na tao awpa châ vei.
Hriahlaopa hawhta nata khichhaipa hawhta na hnohta a y awpa a châ. Zubili kô taihta a cha chakao aw.
Cha khai tawhta, a sawzy chhaota nâ tawhta pua aw ta, a chiheih lâ kua aw ta, a pathlatuhpazy râh liata a pahrâ heih aw.
Âmo cha Izi râh tawhta ei chhi papuapa, nâ chakaotuhpazy châ ei ta, sei zuapa hawhta zuah awpa châ veih ei.
Nôchhiepa ta a chô liata ryu na rei awpa châ vei. Na Khazohpa na chi awpa a châ.
Seichapaw nata seichanôzy nama hnei khoh khiahta cha, nama chheipâh râhzy tawhta nama chalei awpa a châ.
Nama hry liata a pahrâpa chihropazy nata nama râh liata a pihpa ama chiheihzy hry tawhta chhao chalei thei aw chi ta, âmo cha na hmohneipa ama châ aw.

Âmo cha, châ vaw pazi awpa nama sawzy châta ama chhâzaw ryuto nata hmohneipa ta tao aw ei chi ta, ama phopi tawhta sei nama hnei lymâ aw. Nama unawhpa Izarei sawzy chô liata deikua, nôchhiepa ta ryu nama rei awpa châ vei.

“Chihropa tlyma, khichhaipa nama hry liata a pahrâpa tlyma, vaw hneirôh sala, a kiapâh liata na unawhpa a dyh vaw chhie sala, na unawhpa chata chihropa hnohta tlyma, khichhaipa nama hry liata a pahrâpa hnohta tlyma, chihropa pathla chhôhkhapa hnohta tlyma, sei ta â zuah khiahta cha,
zuapa a châ khai tawh chhao ta chatlai heih theipa a châ aw. A unawhzy hry liatapa ta a chatlai aw.

A paw unawhpa tlyma, a paw unawhpa sawchapaw tlyma ta chatlai thei aw ta, a chiheihzy hry liata a heinawh a hniapa chhao ta a chatlai thei aw. Ano chhao ta, a vaw hneirôh khiahta cha, anosasyh ta â chatlai thei aw.

Ano nata chaleituhpa ta, sei ta â zuana kô tawhta zubili taih reipati aw ei ta, chatlai nawpa mâ cha a kô ziepa hawhta châ aw ta, hriahlaopa ta cha daihti chhôh ta a hlao awpa zie hawhta a laichadaipa a châ aw.
Kô hluhpi a byuh chy khiahta cha, chaleituhpa ta â phuhpa ta chatlaina mâ a pakua aw.
Zubili kô tlô nawpa ta kô chyhta dei a y khiahta deikua cha, a laichadai aw ei ta, kô a y chypa zie hawhta chatlaina mâ cha a pakua awpa a châ.
Kô kha lymâ châta pahriasapa hriatuhpa hawhta a hnohta a y awpa a châ. Na mohmô liata nôchhiepa ta a chô liata ryu a rei awpa châ vei.
Cha hawhna chata chatlaipa a châ leipa chhao ta, zubili kô liata cha, a sawzy chhaota a pua awpa a châ.
Izarei sawzy cha kei nâ chakaopazy châ ei ta, Izi râh tawhta ei chhi papuapa nâ chakaotuhpazy ama châ. Kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa ei châ.

“Khazoh nothlahpa namâ tao awpa châ leipa ta, nothlahpa tao chhyhpa tlyma, lôbô tlyma, nama bô awpa châ hra leipa ta, a naoh awpa ta nama râh liata nothlahpa hawhta taopa alô nama bô awpa châ vei, kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa châ tlôh na ta.
Ei Pahânohzy chay aw ei chi ta, ei supathaihpa nama chiza awpa a châ. Kei he Abeipa ei châ.
“Ei bieraopazy zipa ta, ei biepiepazy zyhpa ta nama tao khiahta cha,
avâzy a daihti ta cha pasuasapa aw ei na ta, chhaohlei ta kôvei papua aw ta, lyu liata thozy ta thei ama pathei aw.

Nama sawhri liata sâh ta kre thei lyuna daihti taih a daih aw ta, kre thei nama lyupa ta chi cheina daihti taih a daih aw ta, nama viahchhâ lôhrâtlôpa ta nie aw ei chi ta, nama râh liata thlalôh ngaitapa ta nama pahrâ aw.
Râh cha thlalôhpa ta paysa aw na ta, a zia aw ei chi ta, ahy hmahta cha pachisa aw veih ei. Sahrâhpazy râh tawhta to khai aw na ta, zaozi ta nama râh chahryh aw vei.
Nama chariahzy a chadai aw ei chi ta, nama hmiakô liata zaozi ta ama pao aw.
Papangawh ta za kha a chadai aw ei chi ta, za kha ta thy kha a chadai aw ei chi ta, nama chariahpazy nama hmiakô liata zaozi ta ama pao aw.
Nâmo lâ a vaw heih aw na ta, chi hluhpi cha pathlasapa ta, cha papôh aw ei na ta, nama hnohta ei biehrai ei pa-i aw.
Bohpi nama pasopa sâh hlôpazy nie aw ei chi ta, sâh thiehpa so nawpa ta sâh hlôpazy nama patly aw.
Nama hry liata ei byureih soh aw na ta, ei hro ta châ hao aw veih ei.
Nama hry liata y aw na ta, nama Khazohpa châ aw na ta, ei phopi nama châ aw.
Kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa, Izi mo sei nama châ khao lei awpa ta, Izi râh tawhta nâmo châ chhi papuatuhpa ei châ. Nama raopakyzy thlie pachhô na ta, â patlâpa ta ei cha pasiesa ei.
“Ei bie nathlie leipa ta, he biepiepa zydua he tao leipa u la,
ei bieraopazy zyh khoh leipa ta, nama hro ta ei ryureinazy a hao u la, ei biepiepa zydua tao leipa ta, ei biehrai nama parao khiahta deikua cha,

kei chhao ta nama chô liata he hmozy he ei tao aw: Nama chô liata hmo chichhihpa patlôsa aw na ta, nama mo pazohsa ta, nama hrona a pahlei theipa chaohpa hri nata chasipazy ei chareisa aw. Hraoleipa ta chi cheih aw ei chi ta, nama chariahpazy nie awpa a châ aw.
Châ heihnao aw ei na ta, nama chariahpazy hmiakô liata nama nawh aw. Châ haotuhpazy ta nama chô liata ryureih aw ei ta, ahy hmahta châ chadai leipa ta namâ râpai aw.
Chatanachôta ei bie nama nathlie vei khiahta cha, nama moleinazy vâta ei sari ei cha hrie via aw ei.
Nama thatlôna namâ palaikheipa thlie pachhô aw na ta, nama chô lâta avâzy cha thua hawhta tao aw na ta, nama ry lâta alei dawh hawhta ei tao aw.
Nama tha pahryuh thlâhthli aw ei chi ta, nama râh ta kôvei papua leipa aw ta, râh liata thozy ta thei pathei aw veih ei.
“Ei kho leinazie ta ypa ta, ei bie nama nathlie vei khiahta cha, nama moleinazy hawh lymâ ta potlana a lie sari ta nama chô liata ei patlôsa aw.
Sahrâhpazy nama hry liata vaw tuah aw na ta, cha chata nama sawzy cha lapa aw ei ta, nama sahrohzy ama cha siepa aw. Maluh chyhta ta cha tao aw ei na ta, nama lâpizy cha dâh karopa ta a y aw.
“Chatanachôta ei chhoreina a pyh hlei leipa ta, ei kho leizie ta khâ nama y khiahta cha,
kei chhao nâmo kho leizie ta y aw na ta, keima tlai ta nama moleinazy vâta a lie sari ta ei cha hrie aw ei.
Nama chô liata zaozi chareisa aw na ta, cha chata biehrai phuh la aw ta, nama khihpizy liata pahmaoh pakhypa ta nama y aw. Nama hry liata hri chareisa aw na ta, chariahpa ku liata hlâpa nama châ aw.

Nama viahchhâ lana lâpi ei chhie pachhô tita cha, chanô pahrawh ta viahchhâ taona beih miakha liata nama viahchhâ tao aw ei ta, nama viahchhâ cha khopathliahpa ta ama cha pie heih aw. Nie aw ei chi ta, nama rih bie hlei aw vei.
“Chatanachôta ei bie nathlie hlei leipa ta, ei kho leizie ta khâ nama y khiahta cha,
kei chhao hiehâhpa ta nama kho leizie ta y aw na ta, nama moleinazy vâta a lie sari ta ei cha hrie aw ei.
Nama sawchapawzy sa nie aw ei chi ta, nama sawchanôzy sa nama nie aw.
Nama su sâhpazy parao aw na ta, nama noh khazoh nothlahpazy papao aw na ta, nama khazoh nothlahpazy ri chô liata nâmo ri ei pacho aw. Ei hro ta a châ hao aw ei.
Nama khihpizy cha khirypa ta tao aw na ta, nama supathaihpazy roryhrapa ta ei tao aw. Nama ropahâhpazy pahnâ khao aw va na.
Râh cha keima tlai ta roryhrapa ta tao aw na ta, cha liata a pahrâpa nama chariahpazy taihta noâh ama tah aw.
Phopizy hry liata cha hiepatla aw ei na ta, ei zaozi phiapa ta ei cha chadai aw ei. Chatanachata nama râh cha roryhrapa ta y aw ta, nama khihpizy cha khirypa ama vaw châ aw.
“Râh roryhrapa ta a y chhôh zydua nata nâmo nama chariahpa râh liata nama y chhôh zydua cha, râh ta Pahânohzy a hmâh aw. Chatanachata râh cha a pahâ aw ta, a Pahânohzy liata â ly aw.
Râh cha roryhrapa ta a y chhôh zydua â pahâ aw. Râh liata nama pahrâ chhôh ta nama Pahânohzy liata â pahâ leina vyuhpa ta â pahâ aw.

Nama hry liata laibâhpazy cha, ama chariahpazy râh liata palôh thazeipa ta ei paysa aw ei. Chhohna raohpa tlapa pyu ta âmo cha a chadai aw ta, zaozi tawhta a râpa hawhta a râpai aw ei ta, ahy ta hmahta amâ chadai leipa chhao ta ama pao aw.
Ahy ta hmahta amâ chadai leipa chhao ta, zaozi ta amâ chadaipa hawhta âmo nata âmo amâ chapia aw. Nama chariahpazy hmiakô liata a duah awpa ta thatlôna rai hnei aw veih ei chi.
Phopizy hry liata leidia aw ei chi ta, nama chariahpazy râh ta a cha nie khai aw ei.
Nama hry liata laibâhpazy chhao, ama paraona vâta nama chariahpazy râh liata ama leidia aw. Âmo paraona vâ dei châ vei, ama pathlatuhpazy paraona vâta ama pathlatuhpazy hawhta ama leidia aw.
“Châhrasala ei chô liata ama paraona nata ama pathlatuhpazy paraonazy a phuahpa ta, ei kho leizie ta ama ypazy a phuah ei sala,

ama paraonazy vâta ama kho leizie ta hmo tao na ta, ama chariahpazy râh lâta ei chhipa ei kha pahnopa ta, ama pathipalôh chopawtaileipa a panawh ei sala, ama hmo paraona tawhta a taopathi amâ chhuah khiahta cha,
Zakaw nata Aisika nata Abarahâ zy hnohta ei biehraizy kha a thei aw na ta, râh cha ei thei thlâh ha aw.

Châhrasala râh cha siesaipa ta y aw ta, âmo y leipa ta roryhrapa ta a y chhôh ta a Pahânohzy a hmâh aw. Ei ryhpazy zyh khoh leipa ei ta, ama hro ta ei bieraopazy â haopa vâta, ama paraona vâta hriena cha amâ tyh awpa a châ.

Chatahrasala ama chariahpazy râh liata ama y no chhao ta, âmo pahleipadia awpa nata ama hnohta ei biehrai parao awpa ta, âmo cha thy leipa aw ei na ta, a hao hra aw veih ei na, kei he Abeipa ama Khazohpa châ tlôh na ta.
Ama Khazohpa châ awpa ta, phopizy mohmô ta Izi râh tawhta ei chhi papuapa ama pathlatuhpazy hnohta ei biehrai kha, âmo vâna heta ei thei thlâh ha aw. Kei he Abeipa ei châ,” tah ta.
Chazy cha Abeipa ta Mawsi hmâpa ta Ano nata Izarei sawzy likah ta Sinai tlâh liata a taopa bieraopazy, pachianazy nata ryhpazy a châ.
Abeipa ta Mawsi chho ta, a hnohta,
“Izarei sawzy chho la, ama hnohta hetana heta reih teh: Chyhsa ta Abeipa lâta chyhsapa hlâ awpa ta bie a siapa ta a taih sala, chyhsapa vyuhpa ta â phuhpa ta sôh pie awpa a châ khiahta cha,
chapaw a châ khiahta cha, kô kihpa tawhta kô sycharupa taih cha, supathaihpa tâkâ reizie ta a mâ tâkâ sekel sypangawh a châ aw.
Chanô a châ khiahta cha, sekel sythôh a châ aw.
Kô pangawhpa tawhta kô kihpa taih a châ khiahta cha, chapaw mâ sekel tlaw kih, chanô mâ sekel tlaw hrawh a châ aw.
Thla khapa tawhta kô pangawhpa taih a châ khiahta cha, chapaw mâ tâkâ sekel tlaw pangawh, chanô mâ tâkâ sekel tlaw thôh a châ aw.
Kô sycharu tawhta chô lâ a châ khiahta cha, chapaw mâ sekel tlaw hrawh hlei pangawh, chanô mâ sekel tlaw hrawh a châ aw.

Dyhchhiepa châ sala a mâ na tupa zie a pie thei lei awpa a châ khiahta cha, theihthaipa lâ a chhi awpa châ ta, theihthaipa ta a mâ tu aw ta, bie a taihtuhpa tao theinazie hawhta theihthaipa ta a mâ a tu aw.
“ Abeipa lâ hlâ awpa ta bie â taihpa cha, sahroh a châ khiahta cha, Abeipa lâta a hlâpa zydua cha a pathaih haw.

A panano awpa châ khao vei. A chhiepa vyuhpa ta a phapa ta tlyma, a phapa vyuhpa ta a chhiepa ta tlyma a ri awpa châ hra vei. Sahroh lilaw ta a ri khiahta cha, a pô no ta, a ripa chhao, a rina chhao pathaihpa ama vaw châ ha aw.
Sahroh pathaih leipa Abeipa lâta hlâ lei awpa chi a châ khiahta cha, sahroh cha theihthaipa hmiakô liata a soh awpa a châ.
Theihthaipa ta a phana nata a pha leinazie hawhta, â phuhpa ta a mâ tu aw ta, a mâ cha theihthaipa ta a tunazie hawhta a châ aw.
A chatlai heih awpa khiahta deikua cha, a mâ tupa zie su pangawh su kha a baichha awpa a châ.
“Chyhsa ta hmohlâ pathaihpa châta Abeipa lâta a o a hlâ khiahta cha, a phana nata a pha leinazie hawhta, theihthaipa ta a mâ tu aw ta, theihthaipa ta a mâ a tupa hawhta a châ aw.
A hlâtuhpa ta a o cha a chatlai khoh khiahta cha, a mâ tupa zie su pangawh su kha baichha aw ta, chatanachata ano eih a châ heih aw.
“Chyhsa ta a lyu thokha Abeipa châta a hlâ khiahta cha, chi a tla thei awpa zie lymâ hawhta, a mâ tu awpa a châ. Bâli sâh bai kha tu theina lyu cha tâkâ sekel sypangawh a châ aw.
A lyu cha zubili kô ta hlâpa a châ khiahta cha, a mâ tupa hawhta a châ aw.
Zubili khai tawhta a hlâ khiahta deikua cha, zubili tlô heih nawpa kô a ypa zie hawhta theihthaipa ta a mâ tu aw ta, a pie awpa zie pachyh viapa a châ aw.
A hlâtuhpa ta a chatlai khoh khiahta cha, a mâ tupa zie su pangawh su kha baichha aw ta, ano eih a châ heih aw.
Lyu cha a chatlai khoh vei tlyma, mohropa hnohta a zuah hapa tlyma a châ khiahta cha, chatlai heih theipa châ khao aw vei.
Lyu cha Zubili kô liata papuapa a châ tita, hlâ hapa lyu hawhta Abeipa châta pathaihpa châ aw ta, theihthaipa eih a châ aw.
Chyhsa ta ano râh a châ leipa, a chaleipa lyu Abeipa lâta a hlâ khiahta cha,
theihthaipa ta zubili kô taihta a mâ awpa zie tu aw ta, a tupa hawhta, cha noh lia tlai ta Abeipa lâta hmo pathaihpa châta a hlâ awpa a châ.
Zubili kô liata, lyu cha a chaleina chyhsa, a râh hneituhpa hnohta a pakua aw.
A mâ tupa zydua cha supathaihpa tâkâ reizie ta châ khai aw ta, sekel tlaw kha cha kerâ miakih a châ aw.
“Sahroh a pataw tuapa deikua cha, Abeipa eih a châ chhielie hapa vâta, chyhsa ta a hlâ awpa châ vei. Viahchao tôhpa tlyma, mietaku tlyma, a pataw tuapa maih cha Abeipa eih a châ.
Sahroh pathaih leipa a châ khiahta cha, a mâ tupa zie ta a chatlai awpa châ ta, a mâ su pangawh su kha a baichha awpa a cha. Chatlaipa a châ vei khiahta cha, a mâ tupa zie ta zuah awpa a châ.

“Chyhsa ta a hmohneipa Abeipa lâta a hlâ hapa, chyhsapa tlyma, sahroh tlyma, râh tlyma cha zuah awpa châ leipa ta, chatlai awpa châ hra vei. Hlâ hapa hmo zydua cha, Abeipa châta pathaih ngaitapa a châ khai.
Pahleipadia awpa ta hlâ hapa chyhsa cha chatlai awpa châ vei. Thie thlyu awpa a châ.
“Râh tawhta a puapa su hrawh su kha zydua, alei tawhta sâh nata tho theilâpa zydua Abeipa eih châ khai ta, Abeipa châta pathaihpa a châ.
Chyhsa ta a su hrawh su kha hry liata a kheihawhpa rai a chatlai khiahta cha, a mâ su pangawh su kha a baichha awpa a châ.
Viahchao hri nata mietaku zaw hry liata su hrawh su kha, chôchahrei ry liata â ngiapa, a pô hrawhna lymâ cha Abeipa châta pathaihpa a châ aw.
A pha nata pha lei a pasia awpa châ leipa ta, a ri awpa châ hra vei. A ri raruah khiahta cha, a pô no ta, a ripa chhao, a rina chhao, pathaihpa châ aw ei ta, chatlai theipa châ aw vei,” tah ta.
Chazy cha Sinai Tlâh liata Izarei sawzy châta Abeipa ta Mawsi a piepa biepiepazy a châ.
Izi râh ama puasai tawhta kô nona, thla nona, noh khana noh ta, Sinai râhchawhpa liata ahmaohna poh o liata Abeipa ta Mawsi bie a chho ta, a hnohta,
“Izarei sawzy maluhpi reih la, a pho pho ta nata a chhôh chhôh ta chapaw maluh zydua paki teh.
Kô kih tawhta chô lâ Izarei saw adyuhna lâ sie thei awpa zydua cha, nâ nata Arawna ta a hlao hlao ta ama maluh nama reih khai awpa a châ.
Chi kha tawhta pakha lymâ ta, chi hyutuhpazy ta ama cha bao aw.
Hezy he châ bao awpa mohzy a châ: Rubena chi tawhta Seidia sawchapawpa Elizu;
Simeôna chi tawhta Zurisadai sawchapawpa Selumie;
Zudâh chi tawhta Aminadâ sawchapawpa Nâsaw;
Iskâra chi tawhta Zuâ sawchapawpa Nethane;
Zebulawna chi tawhta Helô sawchapawpa Eliabâ;
Zawsi pathla Epharai chi tawhta Amihu sawchapawpa Elisâmâ, Manase chi tawhta Pedazu sawchapawpa Kâmalia;
Benzami chi tawhta Kidiôni sawchapawpa Abidanâ;
Dânâ chi tawhta Amisadai sawchapawpa Ahieze;
Asera chi tawhta Okarâ sawchapawpa Pâkie;
Kâdâ chi tawhta Due sawchapawpa Eliasaphâ;
Nâthalai chi tawhta Enâ sawchapawpa Ahirâ.
“Âmo cha zawpizy hry tawhta atlypazy châ ei ta, âmo pathlatuhpa chi liata hyutuhpa, Izarei pho luhpazy ama châ,” tah ta.
Mawsi nata Arawna ta ama moh reipa sahlaozy cha a chhi ei ta,

thla nona noh khana noh ta zawpi zydua awpakhy khai ei ta, a pho pho ta nata a chhôh chhôh ta ama pathlatuhpazy moh reih lymâ ei ta, ama moh hluhna zie ta, kô kih tawhta chô lâ zydua ama maluh reih khaipa a châ.
Abeipa biepiepa hawhta, Mawsi ta Izarei sawzy maluh cha Sinai râhchawhpa liata reih ta.
Izarei sawchapaw uhtheipa Rubena pathlazy ama chhâ yzie hawhta, a pho pho ta nata a chhôh chhôh ta moh pakipa châ ta, kô kih tawhta chô lâ adyuhna lâ sie thei awpa zydua cha,
Rubena pathla tawhta 46,500 ama châ.
Simeôna pathlazy ama chhâ yzie hawhta, a pho pho ta nata a chhôh chhôh ta moh pakipa châ ta, kô kih tawhta chô lâ adyuhna lâ sie thei awpa zydua cha,
Simeôna pathla tawhta 59,300 ama châ.
Kâdâ pathlazy ama chhâ yzie hawhta, a pho pho ta nata a chhôh chhôh ta moh pakipa châ ta, kô kih tawhta chô lâ adyuhna lâ sie thei awpa zydua cha,
Kâdâ pathla tawhta 45,650 ama châ.
Zudâh pathlazy ama chhâ yzie hawhta, a pho pho ta nata a chhôh chhôh ta moh pakipa châ ta, kô kih tawhta chô lâ adyuhna lâ sie thei awpa zydua cha,
Zudâh pathla tawhta 74,600 ama châ.
Iskâra pathlazy ama chhâ yzie hawhta, a pho pho ta nata a chhôh chhôh ta moh pakipa châ ta, kô kih tawhta chô lâ adyuhna lâ sie thei awpa zydua cha,
Iskâra pathla tawhta 54,400 ama châ.
Zebulawna pathlazy ama chhâ yzie hawhta, a pho pho ta nata a chhôh chhôh ta moh pakipa châ ta, kô kih tawhta chô lâ adyuhna lâ sie thei awpa zydua cha,
Zebulawna pathla tawhta 57,400 ama châ.
Zawsi pathla tawhta Epharai pathlazy ama chhâ yzie hawhta, a pho pho ta nata a chhôh chhôh ta moh pakipa châ ta, kô kih tawhta chô lâ adyuhna lâ sie thei awpa zydua cha,
Epharai pathla tawhta 40,500 ama châ.
Manase pathlazy ama chhâ yzie hawhta, a pho pho ta nata a chhôh chhôh ta moh pakipa châ ta, kô kih tawhta chô lâ adyuhna lâ sie thei awpa zydua cha,
Manase pathla tawhta 32,200 ama châ.
Benzami pathlazy ama chhâ yzie hawhta, a pho pho ta nata a chhôh chhôh ta moh pakipa châ ta, kô kih tawhta chô lâ adyuhna lâ sie thei awpa zydua cha,
Benzami pathla tawhta 35,400 ama châ.
Dânâ pathlazy ama chhâ yzie hawhta, a pho pho ta nata a chhôh chhôh ta moh pakipa châ ta, kô kih tawhta chô lâ adyuhna lâ sie thei awpa zydua cha,
Dânâ pathla tawhta 62,700 ama châ.
Asera pathlazy ama chhâ yzie hawhta, a pho pho ta nata a chhôh chhôh ta moh pakipa châ ta, kô kih tawhta chô lâ adyuhna lâ sie thei awpa zydua cha,
Asera pathla tawhta 41,500 ama châ.
Nâthalai pathlazy ama chhâ yzie hawhta, a pho pho ta nata a chhôh chhôh ta moh pakipa châ ta, kô kih tawhta chô lâ adyuhna lâ sie thei awpa zydua cha,
Nâthalai pathla tawhta 53,400 ama châ.
Chazy cha ama maluh rei theipa, Mawsi nata Arawna ta Izarei chi hrawh hleinozy vyuhpa ta atlypa hyutuhpazy chhaota ama reipa maluh a châ.
Chatanachata Izarei saw kô kih tawhta chô lâ, Izarei pheisaih châpa ta adyuhna lâ sie thei awpa zydua maluh cha reih ei ta,
ama zydua ta 603,550 ama châ.
Livai chi deikua cha, âmo chi eih ta Izarei saw hry liata rei hrapa châ veih ei.
A chhâpa cha Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Livai chi deikua cha ama maluh reih leipa aw chi ta, Izarei sawzy hry liata ama maluh na pahlao awpa châ vei.

Livai pathlazy cha Biehrai byureih mohôhtuhpa nata a hmobaoh zydua nata cha liata hmo a ypa zydua a mohôhtuhpa ta na rao awpa ei a châ. Achhyna byureih nata a hmobaoh zydua a sy tyh aw ei ta, mohôh aw ei ta, achhyna byureih kiapâh liata a rie aw ei ta, ama ypâ tyh aw.

Achhyna byureih pasie awpa a châ khiahta cha, Livai pathlazy ta phie aw ei ta, achhyna byureih parai awpa a châ tita chhao, Livai pathlazy ta ama parai tyh aw. Chyhsa zawrâpa ta achhyna byureih â hnia khiahta cha thie awpa a châ.
Izarei sawzy cha a py py ta, âmo riehmo chyu liata nata âmo pheisaih py su chyu liata ama poh o ama rai aw.

Livai pathlazy deikua cha, Izarei zawpi chô liata hiehâhna a vaw tlô lei nawpa ta, Biehrai byureih chheipâh liata ama poh o ama rai aw. Livai pathlazy cha Biehrai byureih mohôhtuhpa ama châ aw,” tahpa ta a rei hapa vâta a châ.
Cha hawhna chata Izarei sawzy ta tao ei ta, Abeipa ta Mawsi bie a piepa hawhta a zydua ta tao ei ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi nata Arawna hnohta hetana heta chho ta:
“Izarei sawzy ta ama chhôhkha ngiana poh chaluah chyupa ta, ahmaohna poh o nata a hnia tu leipa ta ahmaohna poh o chadôpa ta, a py py ta ama poh o ama rai aw.
“Noh vaw chhina nochhi lâta poh o a rai awpazy cha Zudâh py châ aw ei ta, a py py ta poh o rai aw ei ta, Zudâh pathlazy hyutuhpa cha Aminadâ sawchapawpa Nâsaw châ aw ta,
pheisaih 74,600 a hnei aw.
A pazipa ta poh o a rai awpazy cha Iskâra chi châ aw ei ta, Iskâra pathlazy hyutuhpa cha Zuâ sawchapawpa Nethane châ aw ta,
pheisaih 54,400 a hnei aw.
Zebulawna pathlazy hyutuhpa cha Helawnâ sawchapawpa Eliabâ châ aw ta,
pheisaih 57,400 a hnei aw.
Zudâh py liata sopa pheisaih py nanopazy cha, ama zydua ta 186,400 ama châ. Âmo ta hmia amâ sah lymâ aw.
“Chho lâta Rubena py y aw ei ta, Rubena pathlazy hyutuhpa cha Seidia sawchapawpa Elizu châ aw ta,
pheisaih 46,500 a hnei aw.
A pazipa ta poh o a rai awpa cha Simeôna chi ama châ aw. Simeôna pathlazy hyutuhpa cha Zurisadai sawchapawpa Selumie châ aw ta,
pheisaih 59,300 a hnei aw.
Cha khai tawhta Kâdâ chi ta pazi aw ei ta, Kâdâ pathlazy hyutuhpa cha Rue sawchapawpa Eliasaphâ châ aw ta,
pheisaih 45,600 a hnei aw.
Rubena py liata sopa pheisaih py nanopazy cha, ama zydua ta 151,450 ama châ. Âmo cha a py nona ta ama sie aw.
“Ahmaohna poh o nata Livai pathlazy poh ozy a liah liata y aw ta, ama sie tita, ahmaohna poh o nata Livai pathlazy cha a liah liata ama sie aw. Chyhsa to ama su chyu liata ypa ta ama sie aw.
“Notla lâta Epharai py y aw ei ta, Epharai pathlazy hyutuhpa cha Amihu sawchapawpa Elisâmâ châ aw ta,
pheisaih 40,500 a hnei aw.
A pazipa ta Manase chi y aw ei ta, Manase pathlazy hyutuhpa cha Pedazu sawchapawpa Kâmalia châ aw ta,
pheisaih 32,200 a hnei aw.
Cha khai tawhta Benzami chi ta pazi aw ei ta, Benzami pathlazy hyutuhpa cha Kidiôni sawchapawpa Abidanâ châ aw ta,
pheisaih 35,400 a hnei aw.
Epharai py liata sopa pheisaih py nanopazy cha, ama zydua ta 108,100 ama châ. Âmo cha py thôhna ta a sie awpa ama châ.
“Maw lâta Dânâ py y aw ei ta, Dânâ pathlazy hyutuhpa cha Amisadai sawchapawpa Ahieze châ aw ta,
pheisaih 62,700 a hnei aw.
A pazipa ta poh o a rai awpa cha, Asera chi châ aw ei ta, Asera pathlazy hyutuhpa cha Okarâ sawchapawpa Pâkie châ aw ta,
pheisaih 41,500 a hnei aw.
Cha khai tawhta Nâthalai chi ta pazi aw ei ta, Nâthalai pathlazy hyutuhpa cha Enâ sawchapawpa Ahirâ châ aw ta,
pheisaih 53,400 a hnei aw.
Dânâ py liata sopa pheisaih py nanopazy cha, ama zydua ta 157,600 ama châ. Âmo cha a py py ta a hnôh chai ta a sie awpazy ama châ,” tah ta.
Chazy cha Izarei sawzy maluh ama chhôhkha chyu ta reipazy cha châ ei ta, a py py ta reipa ta ama zydua ta 603,550 ama châ.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa hawhta, Livai chi deikua cha Izarei sawzy hry liata rei pâpa châ veih ei.
Cha hawhna chata Abeipa ta Mawsi bie a piepa zydua cha Izarei sawzy ta tao ei ta, a py py ta riehmo paryh ei ta, a pho pho ta nata a chhôh chhôh ta puapa ta ama sie lymâ.
Hezy he Abeipa ta Sinai Tlâh liata Mawsi bie â chho nota, Arawna nata Mawsi pathla a ypazy ama châ.
Hezy he Arawna sawchapawzy moh a châ: Sawchapaw uhtheipa cha Nâdâ châ ta, a pazipazy cha Abihu, Eliaza nata Ithamâ zy ama châ.
Chazy cha Arawna sawchapawzy moh châ ta, âmo cha sathawthupa theihthaipazy châ ei ta, theihthaipa chakaona rai hria awpa ta chahnaopazy ama châ.

Nâdâ nata Abihu cha, mei ta hlâlei awpa chi Sinai râhchawhpa liata Abeipa hmiakô ta ama hlâ nota, Abeipa hmiakô liata thi ha ei ta, saw hnei veih ei. Chavâta ama paw Arawna hro chhôh cha, Eliaza nata Ithamâ ta theihthaipa chakaona rai ama hria lymâ.
Abeipa ta Mawsi chho ta,
“Livai chizy a vaw chhi la, theihthaipa Arawna ama chakao thei nawpa ta âmo cha a hmiakô liata paysa mah y.
Âmo ta theihthaipa Arawna nata zawpi zydua chakaona rai ahmaohna poh o hmiakô liata hria aw ei ta, achhyna byureih chakaona rai ama hria aw.
Ahmaohna poh o hmobaoh zydua a vao aw ei ta, achhyna byureih chakaona rai hriapa ta Izarei sawzy ama mohôh aw.
Livai pathlazy cha Arawna nata a sawchapawzy hnohta na pie aw ei. Âmo cha Izarei sawzy hry tawhta Arawna hnohta pie khaipa ama châ.

Arawna nata a sawchapawzy cha theihthaipa châta rao aw chi ta, ama theihthai châna ama pazao lymâ aw. Khôtho chyhsa ta theihthaipa chakaona rai hria awpa ta achhyna byureih â hnia khiahta cha, thie awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi chho ta,
“Pachâ teh, Livai pathlazy cha Izarei sawzy hry liata chhi a pahy tuapa sawchapaw uhtheipazy vyuhpa ta Izarei sawzy tawhta ei lapazy ama châ. Chavâta Livai pathlazy cha kei eih ama châ aw.

Sawchapaw uhtheipa zydua cha kei eih ama châ. Izi râh liata sawchapaw uhtheipa zydua ei thie khai nona khata, Izarei sawzy hry liata sawchapaw uhtheipazy deikua cha, chyhsapa chhao sahroh chhao, ei châta ei pathaisa ei. Chavâta kei eih ama châ aw. Kei he Abeipa ei châ,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Sinai râhchawhpa liata Mawsi hnohta,
“Livai pathlazy a pho pho ta nata a chhôh chhôh ta ama maluh reih la, chapaw thla kha tawhta chô lâ zydua reih khai mah y,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Mawsi ta Abeipa bie hawhta, a hnohta biepiepa hawh tlai ta, ama maluh cha reih ta.
Hezy he Livai sawchapawzy moh a châ: Kesao, Kôhâ nata Merâri.
Hezy he ama pho ta a laichadaipa ta Kesao sawchapawzy moh a cha: Libni nata Simei.
Kôhâ sawchapawzy cha ama pho ta a laichadaipa ta Amrâ, Iza, Hebraw nata Uzie zy ama châ.
Merâri sawchapawzy cha, ama pho ta a laichadaipa ta, Mâhli nata Musi zy ama châ. Chazy cha a chhôh chhôh ta a laichadaipa ta Livai phozy ama châ.
Kesao cha Libni pho nata Simei phozy pathlatuhpa châ ta, hezy he Kesao pathlazy ama châ.
Chapaw thla kha tawhta chô lâ maluh reipa zydua 7,500 ama châ.
Kesao phozy cha achhyna byureih hnôh lâta notla baih lâta ama poh o rai aw ei ta,
Kesao pathlazy hyutuhpa cha Lâe sawchapawpa Eliasaphâ a châ aw.
Kesao sawchapawzy ta ahmaohna poh o liata ama mohôh awpazy cha, achhyna byureih, poh o nata khuna pohzy, ahmaohna poh o chhikao pohraipazy,

dôhpachhôh tlyhmia pohraipazy, achhyna byureih kiapâh liata dôhpachhôh tlyhmia chhikao nata maisâh chadôpa ta pohraipazy nata chaorizy châ aw ta, chazy nata a zaokhipa chakaona rai zydua chhao ama hria khai aw.
Kôhâ cha Amirâ pho zy, Izah pho zy, Hebraw pho nata Uzie phozy pathlatuhpa châ ta, hezy he Kôhâ pathlazy ama châ.
Chapaw thla kha tawhta chô lâ maluh zydua 8,600 châ ei ta, âmo cha su pathaihpa mohôhtuhpa ama châ aw.
Kôhâ sawchapawzy tawhta pho a puapazy cha achhyna byureih chho lâ chhâh ta ama poh o rai aw ei ta,
Kôhâ pathla phozy hyutuhpa cha Uzie sawchapawpa Elizaphâ a châ aw.

Ama mohôh awpazy cha Biehrai Byh, tlâhkhai, meiôh sona, maisâh, supathaihpa liata theihthaipa chakaona chhaichhizy nata pohraipa zy châ aw ta, chazy nata a zaokhipa chakaona rai zydua ama mohôh khai aw.
Theihthaipa Arawna sawchapawpa Eliaza cha Livai chi hyutuhpazy hyutuhpa châ aw ta, supathaihpa mohôhtuhpazy mohôhtuhpa a châ aw.
Merâri cha Mâhli pho nata Musi phozy pathlatuhpa châ ta, hezy he Merâri pathlazy ama châ.
Chapaw thla kha tawhta chô lâ maluh reipa zydua 6,200 ama châ.
Merâri pathlazy hyutuhpa cha Abihai sawchapawpa Zurie châ aw ta, âmo cha achhyna byureih maw lâ chhâh ta ama poh o ama parai aw.
Merâri sawchapawzy ta ama mohôh awpazy cha achhyna byureih thophiazy, a tlâhzy, a tôhzy, a patyunazy nata chazy châta a chhaichhi zydua châ aw ta, chazy nata a zaokhipa chakaona zydua ama mohôh aw.
Tlyhmia dôhna tôhzy, a patyunazy, a khaipânazy nata a chaorizy chhao ama mohôh aw.

Nochhi lâ chhâh ta achhyna byureih hmia lâ, ahmaohna poh o laihmia lâta noh vaw chhi tyhna dady ta poh o a parai awpa cha, Mawsi nata Arawna nata a sawchapawzy châ aw ei ta, âmo ta supathaihpa mohôh aw ei ta, Izarei sawzy ama mohôh aw. Khôtho chyhsa theihthaipa chakaona rai hria awpa ta achhyna byureih a hniapa maih cha thiepa a châ aw.
Abeipa biepiepa hawhta, Mawsi nata Arawna ta Livai chizy cha a chhôh chhôh ta ama maluh reih ei ta, chapaw thla kha tawhta chô lâ ama reipa zydua cha 22,000 ama châ.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Izarei sawzy hry liata sawchapaw uhtheipa thla kha tawhta chô lâ zydua reih la, ama moh roh khai teh.
Izarei pathla sawchapaw uhtheipazy vyuhpa ta Livai pathlazy na lapa aw chi ta, Izarei sawzy sahroh pataw tuapazy vyuhpa ta Livai sahrohzy eina lapa aw chi. Kei he Abeipa ei châ,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta Abeipa biepiepa hawhta Izarei sawzy hry liata sawchapaw uhtheipa zydua reih ta.
Thla kha tawhta chô lâ sawchapaw uhtheipa zydua maluh, ama moh paziahpa tlai ta reipa zydua cha, 22,273 ama châ.
Abeipa ta Mawsi chho ta,
“Izarei pathla sawchapaw uhtheipazy vyuhpa ta Livai pathlazy la la, ama sahroh vyuhpa ta Livai pathlazy sahroh la mah y. Livai pathlazy cha kei eih ama châ aw. Kei he Abeipa ei châ.
Izarei sawzy hry liata sawchapaw uhtheipazy maluh cha Livai chi maluh hlâta 273 ta a hluh viapa vâta, âmo chatlai nawpa ta,
pakha châta sekel tlaw pangawh lymâ la aw chi ta, sekel reizie cha supathaihpa sekel reizie châ aw ta, kerâ miakih ta sekel tlaw kha reizie hawhta a châ aw.
Izarei saw hluh viapazy chatlaina sôh cha Arawna nata a sawchapawzy na pie aw ei,” tah ta.
Livai chi maluh ta a chatlai theipa hlâta hluh viapa sawchapaw uhtheipazy chatlaina sôh cha Mawsi ta la ta.
Supathaihpa tâkâ reizie ta reipa ta, Izarei sawchapaw uhtheipazy chatlaina sôh sekel 1,365 pakhy ta.
Abeipa bie hawhta, Abeipa ta Mawsi bie a piepa hawh tlai ta, Mawsi ta chatlaina sôh cha Arawna nata a sawchapawzy hnohta hlâ ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi nata Arawna chho ta,
“Livai pathlazy hry liata Kôhâ pathlazy cha, a pho pho ta nata a chhôh chhôh ta ama maluh reih u la,
kô sythôh tawhta chô lâ kô sypangawh taih, ahmaohna poh o liata chakaona rai a hria thei awpa maluh zydua nama reih khai awpa a châ.
Hezy he ahmaohna poh o liata Kôhâ sawchapawzy hria awpa, hmo pathaih chaipazy mohôhna chakaona rai a châ.
“Riehmo a pasie awpa a châna maihta Arawna nata a sawchapawzy a ngia aw ei ta, pohraipa pathla aw ei ta, cha chata Biehrai Byh ama khu aw.
Cha cha tilaipi viahchao vo ta khu pachhuah aw ei ta, cha chô liata poh nohpa ta khu aw ei ta, a lâzy ama chahraoh aw.

“Ypâna viahchhâ tlâhkhai chô liata poh nohpa phaw aw ei ta, cha chô liata beikohzy, phiahthlazy, biebuhzy nata dopa hlâna patlai nawpa nyuzy soh aw ei ta, chiepadâh leipa ta viahchhâ so tyhpa chhao tlâhkhai chô liata a y awpa a châ.
Chazy cha poh nohsaihpa ta khu aw ei ta, tilaipi viahchao vo ta khu pachhuah aw ei ta, a lâzy ama chahraoh aw.
“Khaihna a pie awpa meiôh sona tôhzy, a meiôhzy, a chaikiezy, meipaoh sonazy nata sathaw ôh zydua poh nohpa ta ama khu khai aw.
Cha cha nata a chhaichhi zydua cha tilaipi viahchao vo ta taopa khuna poh ta chaty aw ei ta, asyna lâzy chô liata ama soh aw.
“Ngôh maisâh chô liata poh nohpa phaw aw ei ta, tilaipi viahchao vo ta khu aw ei ta, a lâzy ama chahraoh aw.
Supathaihpa liata hmâpa chakaona hmobaoh zydua la aw ei ta, poh nohpa ta chaty aw ei ta, tilaipi viahchao vo ta khu aw ei ta, asyna lâ chô liata ama soh aw.
Maisâh liata meipaoh hru aw ei ta, a chô liata poh nohpa ama phaw aw.

Cha chô liata maisâh liata chakaona châta hmâpa hmobaoh zydua soh aw ei ta, mei lanazy, sa thaona thuakuzy, buchâh linazy, rahôzy, maisâh hmobaoh zydua cha soh aw ei ta, chazy cha tilaipi viahchao vo ta khu aw ei ta, a lâzy ama chahraoh aw.

“Arawna nata a sawchapawzy ta supathaihpa nata supathaihpa hmobaoh zydua ama khu khai tawhta, riehmo a pasie awpa a châ tita, Kôhâ pathlazy ta supathaihpa nata a hmobaohzy cha amâ sy tyh aw. Hmo pathaihpazy deikua ama hria awpa châ vei. Chataleipatala ama thi pathlei aw. Chazy cha Kôhâ sawchapawzy ta ahmaohna poh o liata ama chakaona rai hria awpazy a châ.

“Theihthaipa Arawna sawchapawpa Eliaza mohôh awpazy cha meiôh pakhaih nawpa sathaw, ropahâhpa, a daihtita ta niepa hlâna tao tyhpa nata sathaw pathaihpa zy châ aw ta, achhyna byureih nata a chhôh liata hmo a ypa zydua nata supathaihpa nata a hmobaohzy chhao a mohôh aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi nata Arawna hnohta,
“Kôhâ pathla chi nata phozy Livai chi tawhta chhawh pathlahpa ta ama y awpa châ vei.

Chavâta hmo pathaih chaipazy amâ hnia nota thi leipa ta ama y thei nawpa ta, hetana heta âmo châta ryh nama rao aw: Arawna nata a sawchapawzy ta supathaihpa lâ a ngia aw ei ta, Kôhâ chizy hria awpa nata maophaohnazy ama rai aw.
Khupa hmo pathaihpazy moh awpa ta deikua amâ ngia awpa châ vei. Chataleipatala ama thi pathlei aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi chho ta,
“Kesao pathlazy chhao a pho pho ta nata a chhôh chhôh ta ama maluh reih teh.
Kô sythôh tawhta a chô lâ kô sypangawh taih, ahmaohna poh o liata chakaona rai a hria thei awpa maluh zydua na reih khai awpa a châ.
Kesao pathlazy hria awpa cha chakaona nata hmo phaona lâ a châ aw.
Achhyna byureih nata ahmaohna poh o pohraipazy, a khuna poh nata a khu pachhuahna tilaipi viahchao vo nata ahmaohna poh o chhikao pohraipa,

dôhpachhôh tlyhmia pohraipazy, achhyna byureih kiapâh liata dôhpachhôh tlyhmia chhikao nata maisâh chadô pohraipazy nata chaorizy phaoh aw ei ta, chazy nata a zaokhipa chakaona rai zydua ama hria khai aw.

Kesao pathlazy raihria awpa zydua cha, ama phao awpa nata ama hria awpa kyh zydua liata, Arawna nata a sawchapawzy biehneina ry liata a y khai aw. Hmo ama phao awpa zydua liata maophaohna chaba awpa ta, Arawna nata a sawchapawzy na rao aw ei.
Chazy cha ahmaohna poh o liata Kesao chi nata phozy chakaona rai hria awpa châ ta, theihthaipa Arawna sawchapawpa Ithamâ chhihthana ry liata ama hria aw.
“Merâri pathlazy maluh chhao a pho pho ta nata a chhôh chhôh ta reih aw chi ta,
kô sythôh tawhta chô lâ kô sypangawh taih, ahmaohna poh o liata chakaona rai a hria thei awpa maluh zydua na reih khai awpa a châ.
Hezy he ahmaohna poh o liata chakaona rai hria awpa ta ama hnohta maophaohna piepa a châ: Achhyna byureih thophiazy, thophia tlâhzy, thophia tôhzy nata thophia patyunazy,
dôhpachhôh tlyhmia dôhna tôhzy, a patyunazy, a khaipânazy, a chaorizy, a chhaichhi zydua nata a hmobaoh hropa zydua phaoh aw ei ta, ama phao awpazy cha ama moh ta na rai tyh aw ei.
Chazy cha ahmaohna poh o liata Merâri chi nata phozy chakaona rai hria awpa châ ta, theihthaipa Arawna sawchapawpa Ithamâ chhihthana ry liata ama hria aw,” tah ta.
Kôhâ pathlazy maluh cha, Mawsi nata Arawna nata zawpi hyutuhpazy ta a pho pho ta nata a chhôh chhôh ta reih ei ta,
kô sythôh tawhta chô lâ kô sypangawh taih, ahmaohna poh o liata chakaona rai a hria thei awpa,
a pho pho ta reipa Kôhâ pathla maluh cha 2,750 a châ.
Chazy cha, Abeipa ta Mawsi hmâpa ta bie a piepa hawhta, ahmaohna poh o liata chakaona rai a hriapa Kôhâ pathlazy maluh, Mawsi nata Arawna ta ama reipazy a châ.
Kesao pathlazy maluh chhao a pho pho ta nata a chhôh chhôh ta reipa châ ta,
kô sythôh tawhta chô lâ kô sypangawh taih, ahmaohna poh o liata chakaona rai a hria thei awpa,
a pho pho ta nata a chhôh chhôh ta reipa Kesao pathla maluh cha 2,630 ama châ.
Chazy cha, Abeipa biepiepa hawhta, ahmaohna poh o liata chakaona rai a hriapa Kesao pathlazy maluh, Mawsi nata Arawna ta ama reipazy a châ.
Merâri pathlazy maluh chhao a pho pho ta nata a chhôh chhôh ta reipa châ ta,
kô sythôhpa tawhta a chô lâ kô sypangawhpa taih, ahmaohna poh o liata chakaona rai a hria thei awpa,
a pho pho ta reipa Merâri pathla maluh cha 3,200 ama châ
Chazy cha, Abeipa ta Mawsi hmâpa ta bie a piepa hawhta, ahmaohna poh o liata chakaona rai a hriapa Merâri pathlazy maluh, Mawsi nata Arawna ta ama reipazy a châ.
Livai chi maluh zydua cha, Mawsi nata Arawna nata Izarei hyutuhpazy ta a pho pho ta nata a chhôh chhôh ta reih ei ta,
kô sythôh tawhta chô lâ kô sypangawh taih, ahmaohna poh o liata chakaona rai a hria thei awpa nata ahmaohna poh o hmobaoh a phaoh thei awpa,
Livai chi maluh rei theipa cha 8,580 a châ.
Mawsi hmâpa ta Abeipa biepiepa hawhta, chyhsa to chakaona raihria awpa nata hmo phao awpa zy rao khaipa a châ. Chatanachata Abeipa ta Mawsi bie a piepa hawhta, Livai chi maluh cha rei khaipa a châ.
Abeipa ta Mawsi chho ta,
“Izarei sawzy chho la, ama hnohta hetana heta reih teh: Phawhpa tlyma, thihniah lohpa tlyma, athihpa vâta tlyma, pathaih leipa zydua riehmo tawhta papua khai awpa a châ.
Ama hry liata ei pahrâna ama riehmo ama papuapalei lei nawpa ta, chapaw chhao, chanô chhao, riehmo tawhta papua khai awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Izarei sawzy ta cha hawhna chata tao ei ta, pathaih leipazy cha riehmo khôtho lâ paysa ei ta, Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta a reipa hawh tlai ta Izarei sawzy ta tao ei ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,

“Izarei sawzy chho la ama hnohta hetana heta reih teh: Chapaw tlyma, chanô tlyma, chyhsazy hmo parao tyhpa kheihawhpa tlyma paraopa ta, Abeipa chô liata ngâchhih leipa ta y sala, thailei a châ khiahta cha,
moleina hmo a taopa cha phuah aw ta, a hmo paraona mâ â kipa ta a thô aw. Cha thota, a paraopa mâ su pangawh su kha baichha aw ta, a hmo a paraopa chyhsa hnohta a pie aw.

Hmo paraona ty thô awpa chyhsa cha thi ha sala, a ryu a to awpa ama y vei khiahta deikua cha, moleina ty thôna sôh cha Abeipa eih châ aw ta, a molei chatlaina taona mietaku tôhpa chhaota theihthaipa hnohta a pie aw.
Theihthaipa lâta ama cheipa Izarei sawzy hmohlâpa pathaihpa zydua cha theihthaipa eih a châ aw.
Hmohlâpa pathaihpazy cha a hlâtuhpa eih châ ta, theihthaipa hnohta a piepazy deikua cha theihthaipa eih a châ,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Izarei sawzy chho la ama hnohta hetana heta reih teh: Chyhsa lapinô ta lâpi doleipa lâ tleipa ta, a vahpa châta ngâchhih leipa sala;

chapaw hropa ta ano cha a ziakheipa ta, chanô cha anosasyh ta â papuapalei hapa chhao ta, arulâta hmotaopa châ ta, a tao hai nota ku patupa a châ leipa vâta a pahnopa y leipa ei ta, chavâta a vahpa ta pahno leipa sala;

châhrasala a vahpa ta hiatliana palôh hneipa ta, a lapinô cha â papuapalei hapa vâ tlai ta a ngâ khao leipa châ sala tlyma, â papuapalei leipa chhao ta, hiatliana palôh vâta a lapinô cha a ngâ khao leipa khiahta cha,

a lapinô cha theihthaipa hnohta a chhi aw ta, a lapinô châta hmo hlâ awpa bâli sâh kachu su hrawh su kha a cheipa aw. Hiatliana niepa hlâna châ ta, paraona atheithlâhna niepa hlâna a châpa vâta, bâli sâh cha sathaw a bao awpa châ leipa ta, deiryh chhao a chô liata a soh awpa châ vei.
“Theihthaipa ta chanô cha a chhi aw ta, Abeipa hmiakô liata a paduasa aw.
Theihthaipa ta alei beih chhôh liata ti pathaihpa ryh aw ta, achhyna byureih siphiah liata buchadoh la aw ta, ti liata a mia aw.

Theihthaipa ta chanô cha Abeipa hmiakô liata paduasa aw ta, a sâ pathliahsa aw ta, atheithlâhna niepa hlâna cha a ku liata a chabasa aw. Cha cha hiatliana niepa hlâna châ ta, theihthaipa ta chhiesana a patlôsapa ti khapa a ku liata â chaba aw.

Chatawhcha theihthaipa ta chanô cha bie pataihsa aw ta, a hnohta, ‘Nâ vahpa ry liata na y thlâh ha nota chapaw hropa ahy hmahta ama châ ziakhei leipa khiahta nata pathaih leipa ta na y leipa khiahta cha, he ti khapa, chhiesana a patlôsapa heta na chô liata biehnei aw vei.
Ngâchhih leipa ta y chi ta, na vahpa ry liata na y thlâh ha nota, na vahpa a châ leipa chapaw ta châ ziakheipa ta, nâ papuapalei ha khiahta deikua cha,’

he liana heta theihthaipa ta chanô cha chhiesana bietai pahneisa aw ta, a hnohta, ‘ Abeipa ta na phopi hry liata chhiesapa nata dythapa ta cha tao mawh sy. Na byhpi pazaohsa sala, na py pathlohsa mawh sy.
He chhiesana a patlôsapa ti he na py chhôh lâ a ngia sala, na py pathlohsapa ta, na byhpi a pazaohsa mawh sy,’ tah aw ta, chanô ta, ‘Amen, Amen,’ a tah aw.
“Cha khai tawhta theihthaipa ta chhiesana biezy cha châbu liata roh aw ta, ti khapa liata pachie aw ta,
chhiesana a patlôsapa ti khapa cha chanô a padosa aw. Chhiesana a patlôsapa ti cha a py chhôh lâ a ngia aw ta, pasana thata a tao aw.
Theihthaipa ta hiatliana niepa hlâna cha chanô ku tawhta la aw ta, niepa hlâna cha Abeipa hmiakô liata chaluah aw ta, maisâh lâ â vy khei aw.
Theihthaipa ta atheithlâhna hmo châta niepa hlâna cha pazah kha la aw ta, maisâh liata rao aw ta, cha khai tawhta ti cha chanô a padosa aw.

Ti a padosa khai tawhta hetana heta a vaw y aw: A papuapaleipa ta, a vahpa châta ngâchhih leipa ta a y ha tlai khiahta cha, chhiesana a patlôsapa ti cha a chhôh lâ a ngia aw ta, thata vaw pasa aw ta, a py vaw thloh aw ta, a byhpi a vaw zaoh aw. Chatanachata chanô cha a phopi hry liata chhiesapa ta a y aw.
Chanô cha a papuapalei leipa sala, a pathaih khiahta cha, a chô liata khâpa hmah tlô leipa aw ta, chi chhao a pathla thei aw.
“Cha cha hiatliana kyh liata ryhpa cha châ ta, lapinô ta a vahpa ry liata a y thlâh ha nota, ngâchhih leipa ta â papuapaleina kyh liata ryhpa a châ.
Chapaw ta hiatliana vaw hnei ta, a lapinô chô liata a hiatlia tita, theihthaipa ta chanô cha Abeipa hmiakô liata paduasa aw ta, cha ryhpa zydua hawhna chata a chô liata a tao aw.
Chapaw cha paraona tawhta pathaih aw ta, chanô deikua cha a paraona maoh a phaoh aw,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Izarei sawzy chho la ama hnohta hetana heta reih teh: Chapaw tlyma, chanô tlyma ta Abeipa châta panano eihpa Nâzarai chyhsa châ awpa ta bietai a ipa a tao khiahta cha,
kresawhti nata paritheipazy â taih awpa a châ. Kresawhti thaopa nata hmo thaopa tizy a doh awpa châ leipa ta, kre ti a doh awpa châ hra leipa ta, kre thei hrohpa nata chawhpazy a nie awpa châ vei.
Nâzarai a châ chhôh zydua cha kre zôh tawhta a puapa kheihawhpa rai a nie awpa châ leipa ta, kre hmô nata a hyh zy chhao a nie awpa châ vei.
“Nâzarai châ awpa ta bie â taih chhôh zydua a luh â ngyu awpa châ vei. Abeipa châta â pananona noh â ki hlâlei a pathaih awpa châ ta, a luh sâ â paseih awpa a châ.
“ Abeipa châta â panano chhôh zydua athihpa ri â hnia awpa châ vei.
Khazohpa châta â pananona a luh liata a ypa vâta, a paw tlyma, a nô tlyma, a unawhpa tlyma, a sietanô tlyma ama thipa chhao ta, ama ri a hniapa ta â papuapalei awpa châ vei.
Â panano chhôh zydua Abeipa châta pathaihpa a châ aw.
“Chyhsa ta eikhapi ta a kiapâh liata thi sala, â pananona luh a papuapalei khiahta cha, ano pathaisana noh, a noh sarina noh ta a luh â ngyu awpa a châ.
A noh chariena noh ta theihthaipa hnohta vachhuh pô no tlyma, pivaw pô no tlyma ahmaohna poh o chhikao liata vaw cheih aw ta,
theihthaipa ta pô kha moleina hlâna châta hlâ aw ta, ahropa raopa hlâna ta a hlâ aw. Cha hawhna chata athihpa ri vâta a moleina cha chatlaina taopa aw ta, cha noh lia tlai ta a luh cha a pathaisa aw.

Thaileichâna hlâna châta mietakutaw chapawpa kô khapa cheih aw ta, Nâzarai a châna nohzy Abeipa lâta a pazao heih aw. Â pananona papuapaleipa a châ hapa vâta, hmialâ ta â pananona nohzy reipa châ khao aw vei.
“He he Nâzarai chyhsa châta ryhpa, â pananona noh â ki tita tao awpa a châ. Ahmaohna poh o chhikao liata a chhipa châ aw ta,

Abeipa lâta a hmohlâpa a hlâ aw. Raopa hlâna châta mietakutaw chapawpa kô khapa seina hnei leipa pô kha, moleina hlâna châta mietakutaw chanôpa kô khapa seina hnei leipa pô kha, aryhna hlâna châta mietaku tôhpa seina hnei leipa pô kha a hlâ aw.

Niepa hlâna nata dopa hlânazy chhao hlâ aw ta, cha liata thinô pahlao leipa viahchhâ nata viahdie dipa sathaw pahlaopa ta pakâhpa viahchhâzy nata thinô pahlao leipa viahchhâ apapa sathaw hniapa zy hrâbyh hmo kha a hlâ aw.
Theihthaipa ta chazy cha Abeipa hmiakô lâ cheih aw ta, moleina hlâna nata raopa hlâna cha a hlâpa aw.
Thinô pahlao leipa viahchhâ hrâbyh chhaota mietaku tôhpa cha aryhna hlâna ta Abeipa lâ hlâ aw ta, amâ chakaihpa niepa hlâna nata dopa hlânazy chhao theihthaipa ta a hlâ aw.
Nâzarai chyhsa ta â pananona luh cha ahmaohna poh o chhikao liata ngyu aw ta, â pananona luh liata a sâ la aw ta, aryhna hlâna atheihna ry liata mei liata a phôh aw.

Nâzarai chyhsa ta â pananona luh â ngyuh khai tawhta, theihthaipa ta mietaku tôhpa palaih pasyu chiehpa la aw ta, hrâbyh liata thinô pahlao leipa viahchhâ tlâ kha nata thinô pahlao leipa viahchhâ apapa tlâ kha la aw ta, Nâzarai chyhsa ku liata a chabasa aw.

Theihthaipa ta chazy cha chaluahpa hlâna ta Abeipa hmiakô liata a chaluah aw. Chaluahpa palôh nata chalopa phei cha theihthaipa tovyuh pathaihpa a châ. Cha khai tawhta Nâzarai cha kresawhti a doh thei aw.

“Chazy cha Nâzarai chyhsa châta ryhpa a châ. A hneina ta tloh sala, Nâzarai bietai a lapa hleikhô ta, Abeipa lâta hmohlâpa pie awpa bie â taih chhi khiahta cha, a bietai a patlô awpa châ ta, cha cha Nâzarai chyhsa tao awpa ryhpa hleikhô ta a tao chhi awpazy a châ,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Arawna nata a sawchapawzy chho teh, Izarei sawzy châta hetana heta byhnâ aw awpa a châ,” tah ta:
“ Abeipa ta byhnâ cha pie ei sala, Cha vaih lymâ mawh ei sy!
Abeipa ta a hmia nama chô liata pakhaihsa sala, Cha ngiachhie mawh ei sy!
Abeipa ta nâmo lâ a vaw heih sala, Thlalôhna cha pie mawh ei sy!”
“Cha hawhna chata Izarei sawzy chô liata ei moh paysa aw ei ta, kei ta âmo cha byhnâ ei pie aw ei,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta achhyna byureih a padua khai nahta, a hmobaoh zydua chhaota sathawthupa ta pathaisa ta. Maisâh nata a beiphiah zydua chhao sathawthupa ta a pathaisa.
Chatawhcha Izarei chhituhpazy ta hmohlâpa hlâ ei ta. Âmo cha Izarei chi nata pho maluh reipazy chô liata chhituhpazy ama châ.

Abeipa hmiakô liata ama hmohlâpazy vaw cheih ei ta. Chhituhpa pano liata talailih chô khupa miakha lymâ nata chhituhpa pakha ta viahchao tôhpa pô kha lymâ ta, talailih mia charu nata viahchao tôhpa pô hrawh hleino achhyna byureih hmiakô liata ama hlâ.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Ama hmohlâpazy kha a hlâh mah y. Ahmaohna poh o raihria châta ama phahnai aw. Livai pathlazy hnohta ama chakaona raihria yzie lymâ hawhta hmâ awpa ta na pie aw ei,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta talailih nata viahchao tôhpazy cha la ta, Livai pathlazy pie ta.
Kesao pathlazy hnohta ama raihria yzie lymâ hawhta, talailih miano nata viahchao tôhpa pô palih pie ta.
Merâri pathlazy hnohta ama raihria yzie lymâ hawhta, talailih miapalih nata viahchao tôhpa pô charie pie ta. Âmo cha theihthaipa Arawna sawchapawpa Ithamâ chhihthana ry liata a sie awpa ama châ.
Kôhâ pathlazy deikua cha, hmo pathaihpazy mohôhna chakaona raihria ama tovyuh châ ta, hmo pathaihpazy a sy awpa ama châpa vâta, talailih nata viahchao tôhpazy pie vei.
Maisâh sathawthu noh liata, chhituhpazy ta maisâh hlâna châta hmohlâpazy hlâ ei ta. Chhituhpazy ta ama hmohlâpazy cha maisâh hmiakô liata ama hlâ.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Noh kha ta chhituhpa pakha lymâ ta Maisâh hlâna châta ama hmohlâpazy ama hlâ awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Noh khana noh liata hmohlâpa a hlâpa cha, Zudâh chi Aminadâ sawchapawpa Nasô a châ.
A hmohlâpa cha supathaihpa sekel reizie ta reipa ta, niepa hlâna châta sathaw pahlaopa viahdie dipa ta pabiepa tâkâ beikoh sekel 130 a hripa miakha nata tâkâ biebuh sekel sysari a hripa miakha;
ropahâhpa ta pabiepa ngôh phiahthla sekel miahrawh a hripa miakha;
raopa hlâna châta viahchao tôh dawpa pô kha, mietaku tôhpa pô kha, mietakutaw chapawpa kô khapa pô kha;
moleina hlâna châta mie tôhpa pô kha;

aryhna hlâna atheihna châta viahchao tôhpa pô no, mietaku tôhpa pô pangawh, mie tôhpa pô pangawh nata mietakutaw chapawpa kô khapa pô pangawh a châ. Chazy cha Aminadâ sawchapawpa Nasô hmohlâpazy a châ.
Noh nona liata Iskâra chi chhituhpa Zuâ sawchapawpa Nethane ta hlâ ta.

ropahâhpa ta pabiepa ngôh phiahthla sekel miahrawh a hripa miakha;

moleina hlâna châta mie tôhpa pô kha;

Noh chariena liata Manase pathlazy chhituhpa Pedazu sawchapawpa Kâmalia ta hlâ ta.

moleina hlâna châta mie tôhpa pô kha;

Noh chakina liata Benzami pathlazy chhituhpa Kidiôni sawchapawpa Abidanâ ta hlâ ta.

Noh hrawhna liata Dânâ pathlazy chhituhpa Amisadai sawchapawpa Ahieze ta hlâ ta.

ropahâhpa ta pabiepa ngôh phiahthla sekel miahrawh a hripa miakha;

Noh hrawh hleikhana liata Asera pathlazy chhituhpa Okarâ sawchapawpa Pâkie ta hlâ ta.

ropahâhpa ta pabiepa ngôh phiahthla sekel miahrawh a hripa miakha;

moleina hlâna châta mie tôhpa pô kha;

aryhna hlâna atheihna châta viahchao tôhpa pô no, mietaku tôhpa pô pangawh, mie tôhpa pô pangawh nata mietakutaw chapawpa kô khapa pô pangawh a châ. Chazy cha Okarâ sawchapawpa Pâkie hmohlâpazy cha a châ.
Noh hrawh hleinona liata Nâthalai pathlazy chhituhpa Enâ sawchapawpa Ahirâ ta hlâ ta.
A hmohlâpa cha supathaihpa sekel reizie ta reipa ta, niepa hlâna châta sathaw pahlaopa viahdie dipa ta pabiepa tâkâ beikoh sekel 130 a hripa miakha nata tâkâ biebuh sekel sysari a hripa miakha;
ropahâhpa ta pabiepa ngôh phiahthla sekel miahrawh a hripa miakha;
raopa hlâna châta viahchao tôh dawpa pô kha, mietaku tôhpa pô kha, mietakutaw chapawpa kô khapa pô kha;
moleina hlâna châta mie tôhpa pô kha;
aryhna hlâna atheihna châta viahchao tôhpa pô no, mietaku tôhpa pô pangawh, mie tôhpa pô pangawh nata mietakutaw chapawpa kô khapa pô pangawh a châ. Chazy cha Enâ sawchapawpa Ahirâ hmohlâpazy a châ.
Hezy he maisâh sathawthu noh liata Izarei chhituhpazy ta maisâh châta ama hmohlâpazy a châ: Tâkâ beikoh mia hrawh hleino, tâkâ biebuh mia hrawh hleino, ngôh phiahthla mia hrawh hleino ama hlâ.
Tâkâ beikoh cha sekel 130 a hri ta, biebuh cha sekel sysari â hri. Tâkâ hmobaoh zydua cha supathaihpa sekel reizie ta reipa ta, sekel 2,400 a châ.
Ropahâhpa ta pabiepa ngôh phiahthla mia hrawh hleino cha, supathaihpa sekel reizie ta reipa ta, sekel miahrawh a hripa sai châ ta, ngôh phiahthlazy cha a zydua ta sekel 120 a châ.

Niepa hlâna chhaota hlâpa raopa hlâna zydua cha, viahchao tôhpa pô hrawh hleino, mietaku tôhpa pô hrawh hleino nata mietakutaw chapawpa kô khapa pô hrawh hleino châ ta, moleina hlâna atheihna châta mie tôhpa pô hrawh hleino hlâpa a châ.

Aryhna hlâna atheihna châta hmohlâpa cha a zydua ta viahchao tôhpa pô kih nata pô palih, mietaku tôhpa sycharu, mie tôhpa sycharu nata mietakutaw chapawpa kô khapa sycharu a châ. Chazy cha maisâh sathawthupa a châ khai tawhta maisâh hlâna hmopiepazy a châ.

Mawsi cha Abeipa bie a chho awpa ta ahmaohna poh o chhôh lâ â ngia nahta, Biehrai Byh chô liata a ypa zawngiahna dyuchhai chô lâta cherubi miano likawh tawhta ano bie a vaw chhopa ao thei ta. Abeipa ta Mawsi cha bie a chho ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Arawna chho la, a hnohta, ‘meiôhzy na pakhaih tita, meiôh miasari ta meiôh tôh hmia lâ a khaih awpa a châ,’ tah teh,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi bie a piepa hawhta Arawna ta tao ta, meiôhzy cha meiôh tôh hmialâ ta pakhaih ta.
He he ngôh ta daipa meiôh tôh taozie a châ. A tôh thaby tawhta a pawzy taihta daipa ta taopa châ ta, Abeipa ta a taozie awpa Mawsi a pahmôsapa hawh tlai ta, meiôh tôh cha taopa a châ.
Abeipa ta Mawsi chho ta,
“Izarei sawzy hry tawhta Livai pathlazy panano la, âmo cha pathaisa mah y.
Âmo pathaisa awpa ta, hetana heta ama chô liata na tao aw: Ama chô liata pathaisana ti thia aw chi ta, ama pôhpa hmi zydua a ngyu aw ei ta, ama chysiazy pasu aw ei ta, amâ pathai aw.
Chatawhcha viahchao tôh dawpa pô kha, niepa hlâna viahdie dipa sathaw pahlaopa chhaota a chhi aw ei ta, moleina hlâna châta viahchao tôh dawpa pô kha nâ chhi pâ aw.
Livai pathlazy cha ahmaohna poh o hmiakô lâ a chhi aw chi ta, Izarei zawpi zydua na awpakhy aw ei.
Livai pathlazy cha Abeipa hmiakô lâ a chhi aw chi ta, Izarei sawzy ta Livai pathlazy chô liata ama ku ama pahnieh aw.
Arawna ta Livai pathlazy cha, Izarei sawzy tawhta chaluahpa hlâna ta Abeipa hmiakô liata hlâ aw ta, chatanachata Abeipa chakaona rai ama hria thei aw.
Livai pathlazy ta viahchao tôhpazy luh liata ama ku pahnieh aw ei ta, âmo châta chatlaina tao nawpa ta, moleina hlâna châta pô kha hlâ aw chi ta, raopa hlâna ta pô kha na hlâ aw.
Livai pathlazy cha Arawna nata a sawchapawzy hmiakô liata paduasa aw chi ta, Abeipa lâta chaluahpa hlâna ta na chaluah aw ei.
Cha hawhna chata Izarei sawzy hry tawhta Livai pathlazy cha panano aw chi ta, Livai pathlazy cha kei eih ama châ aw.
Âmo cha pathaisapa ta chaluahpa hlâna ta na chaluah khai tawh ei ta, Livai pathlazy cha chakaona rai hria awpa ta ahmaohna poh o liata amâ ngia aw.
Âmo cha Izarei sawzy hry tawhta kei lâta tlokhuh hlâpa châ ei ta, chhi a pahypa, Izarei pathlazy sawchapaw uhtheipa zydua vyuhpa ta kei eih châ awpa ta ei la ei.

Izarei sawzy hry liata sawchapaw uhtheipa zydua cha, chyhsapa chhao, sahroh chhao, kei eih ama châ. Izi râh liata sawchapaw uhtheipa zydua ei thie khai nota, âmo cha kei châta ei pathaisapazy ama châ.
Chavâta Izarei sawzy hry liata sawchapaw uhtheipa zydua vyuhpa ta, Livai pathlazy cha kei eih ta ei la ei.

Izarei sawzy châta ahmaohna poh o liata chakaona rai hria awpa nata Izarei sawzy ta supathaihpa amâ hnia tita ama hry liata potlana a y lei nawpa ta chatlaina taopa awpa ta, Izarei sawzy hry tawhta Livai pathlazy cha Arawna nata a sawchapawzy hnohta hmosaipiepa ta ei pie ei,” tah ta.
Cha hawhna chata Mawsi nata Arawna nata Izarei zawpi zydua ta Livai pathlazy chô liata tao ei ta. Livai pathlazy kyh liata Abeipa ta Mawsi bie a piepa hawhta, Izarei sawzy ta ama chô liata ama tao.
Livai pathlazy cha ama moleina tawhta a pathai ei ta, ama chysiazy pasu ei ta, Arawna ta âmo cha chaluahpa hlâna ta Abeipa hmiakô liata hlâ ta, âmo pathaisa nawpa ta Arawna ta chatlaina a taopa ei.

Cha khai tawhta Livai pathlazy cha Arawna nata a sawchapawzy hmiakô liata chakaona rai hria awpa ta ahmaohna poh o chhôh lâ a ngia ei ta, Livai pathlazy kyh liata Abeipa ta Mawsi bie a piepa hawhta ama chô liata ama tao.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“He he Livai pathlazy zyh awpa ryhpa a châ. Kô kih nata kô pangawh tawhta chô lâ Livai pathlazy ta ahmaohna poh o liata chakaona rai hria awpa ta amâ ngia aw.
Kô sypangawh tawhta cha chakaona rai amâ pahâsai awpa châ ta, ama chakao awpa châ khao vei.
Ahmaohna poh o mohôhna kyh liata ama unawhzy rai bao tyh aw ei ta, chakaona rai deikua cha hria khao aw veih ei. Cha hawhna chata Livai pathlazy cha ama raihria awpa na raopa aw ei,” tah ta.
Izi râh ama puasai tawhta kô nona thla khana liata, Abeipa ta Sinai râhchawhpa liata Mawsi bie a chho ta, a hnohta,
“Izarei sawzy ta daihti raopa liata zawpakhô kyhchhi ama hnei tyh awpa a châ.
He thla noh hrawh hleipalihna noh zâlâ nohtla daihti he, daihti raopa châta hnei aw ei chi ta, zawpakhô bieraopa nata ryhpa zydua hawhta nama chay tyh aw,” tah ta.
Cha hawhna chata Mawsi ta Izarei sawzy cha zawpakhô kyhchhi chay awpa ta chho ta.
Chatanachata thla khana noh hrawh hleipalih noh zâlâ nohtla daihti liata, Sinai râhchawhpa liata zawpakhô kyhchhi cha chay ei ta. Abeipa ta Mawsi bie a piepa zydua hawhta Izarei sawzy ta ama tao.
Thokha deikua cha athihpa ri vâta pathaih leipa châ ha ei ta, cha noh liata zawpakhô kyhchhi chay thei veih ei. Chavâta cha noh liata Mawsi nata Arawna hmiakô liata a vy ei ta,
Mawsi hnohta, “Athihpa ri vâta pathaih leipa châ ha pi ta, châhrasala khazia daihti raopa liata Izarei sawzy hry liata Abeipa lâta hmohlâpa eima hlâ hra awpa cha pakhâpa ta eima y?” tah ei ta.
Mawsi ta ama hnohta, “Vaw hâ chy teh u, nâmo kyh liata Abeipa ta kheihta ma bie a pie aw tahpa ei nathlie ha tua aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,

“Izarei sawzy hnohta hetana heta chho teh: Nâmo tlyma, nama pathlazy hry liata ahy tlyma, athihpa ri vâta pathaih leipa nata khitlyhpazy ama y khiahta cha, Abeipa zawpakhô kyhchhi ama chay hra awpa a châ.
Thla nona, noh hrawh hleipalihna noh zâlâ nohtla daihti liata chay aw ei ta, viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa nata âhnalasi khapazy chhaota ama nie awpa a châ.
A mylâ my taihta khâpa hmah ama pahlôh awpa châ leipa ta, a rupa rai ama thlie awpa châ vei. Zawpakhô kyhchhi liata tao awpa raopa zydua hawhta ama chay awpa a châ.

Chyhsa pathaihpa châ ta, khitlyna hnei tlôh leipa ta, zawpakhô kyhchhi a chay leipa khiahta deikua cha, cha chyhsa cha a phopi tawhta chhawh pathlahpa a châ aw. Daihti raopa liata Abeipa lâta hmohlâpa a hlâ leipa vâta, cha chyhsa cha a moleina maoh a phaoh aw.

Chihropa chyhsa nama hnohta a pahrâpa ta Abeipa zawpakhô kyhchhi a chay khoh hra khiahta cha, zawpakhô kyhchhi bieraopa nata ryhpa hawhta a chay hra aw. A râh chyhsa nata chihropazy châta ryhpa miakha nama hnei awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Achhyna byureih padua noh ta, pahnokheina poh o achhyna byureih cha meihdo ta vaw pahly ta. Zâlâ tawhta my taihta achhyna byureih chô liata mei hawhta a vaw luah ta.
Cha hawhna chata y thlâh ha tyh ta. Nohchhô ta meihdo ta pahly ta, azo ta mei hawhta a luah ta.
Meihdo ta poh o â pasâhsai nahta, Izarei sawzy cha a pasie ei ta, meihdo â duana su liata Izarei sawzy cha a rie tyh ei ta.
Abeipa biepiepa ta Izarei sawzy cha sie lymâ ei ta, Abeipa biepiepa ta a rie ei ta, achhyna byureih chô liata meihdo â chhoh chhôh zydua cha amâ rie thlâh ha tyh.
Meihdo ta achhyna byureih chô liata noh hluhpi a ypa chhao ta, Izarei sawzy cha Abeipa bie zyh ei ta a pasie veih ei.
A châh ta meihdo cha achhyna byureih chô liata noh chyhta dei y ta, chatanachata Abeipa biepiepa hawhta a rie ei ta, Abeipa biepiepa hawhta ama sie tyh.
A châh ta meihdo cha zâlâ tawhta my taihta y ta, my ta meihdo â pasâh nahta sie ei ta, chhô nah zâ ta meihdo â chhoh ha khiahta cha, meihdo â pasâh nahta ama sie tyh.

Achhyna byureih chô liata meihdo cha noh no tlyma, thla kha tlyma, kô kha tlyma rai y sala, cha liata â chhoh ngâ thlâh ha khiahta cha, Izarei sawzy cha riehmo liata y thlâh ha ei ta, sie veih ei. Meihdo â pasâh nahta ama sie tyh.
Abeipa biepiepa ta a rie ei ta, Abeipa biepiepa ta sie ei ta, Mawsi hmâpa ta Abeipa biepiepa hawhta, Abeipa bie cha ama zyh lymâ.
Abeipa ta hetana heta Mawsi chho ta.
“Tâkâ chiahmie miano tao teh. Daipa ta tao aw chi ta, zawpi awpakhyna châta nata pasiesana châta na hmâh aw.
Chiahmie cha a miano ta tôpa a châ tita, zawpi zydua cha ahmaohna poh o chhikao kiapâh liata na hmiakô liata amâ vaw pakhy khai awpa a châ.
Chiahmie miakha deita tôpa a châ khiahta cha, chhituhpazy, Izarei chizy hyutuhpazy deita na hmiakô liata amâ vaw hmaoh aw.
Zikyurâna chiahmie a chyuta ta tôpa a châ khiahta cha, nochhi lâta poh o a raipazy ama pua aw.
Zikyurâna chiahmie a einona tôpa a châ khiahta cha, chho lâta poh o a raipazy ama pua aw. Sie awpa daihti maihta zikyurâna chiahmie tô tyh awpa a châ.
Zawpi apakhy nawpa châta tôpa a châ khiahta cha, chiahmie cha a pasi pi ta tô awpa châ ta, zikyurâna chiahmie hawhta a chyuta ta tô awpa châ vei.
“Arawna sawchapawpa theihthaipazy ta chiahmie cha ama tô awpa a châ. He he nama chhâ zydua châta ryhpa ta nama hnei lymâ awpa a châ.

Nama râh liata khakhaipa châ tlybaipazy a dyuh awpa ta nama sie tita, zikyurâna chiahmiezy nama tô awpa a châ. Chatanachata Abeipa nama Khazohpa hmiakô liata a thei thlâh hapa ta y aw ei chi ta, nama khakhaipazy tawhta pachhapa nama châ aw.

Nama thaphana noh liata zy, nama kyhchhi daihti raopa liata zy, nama thla thiehpa liata zy, nama raopa hlâna nata nama aryhna hlâna atheihna liata zy chiahmie nama tô awpa a châ. Hezy he nâmo châta nama Khazohpa hmiakô liata atheithlâhna châta a châ aw: Kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa ei châ.”
Kô nona, thla nona, cha thla noh kih noh ta meihdo cha pahnokheina byureih chô tawhta a pasâh ha ta.
Izarei sawzy cha Sinai râhchawhpa tawhta a py py ta sie ei ta, meihdo cha Pârâ râhchawhpa liata a duah ta.
Mawsi hmâpa ta Abeipa biepiepa hawhta a ei khana châta amâ pasiena a châ.
A hmiatua chaipa ta Zudâh py liata a ypazy a py py ta pua ei ta, ama hyutuhpa cha Aminadâ sawchapawpa Nasô a châ.
Iskâra chi hyutuhpa cha Zuâ sawchapawpa Nethane a châ.
Zebulawna chi hyutuhpa cha Helô sawchapawpa Eliabâ a châ.
Cha khai tawhta achhyna byureih phie ei ta, Kesao sawchapawzy nata Merâri sawchapawzy ta achhyna byureih cha a sy ei ta, ama sie.
Chatawhcha Rubena py liata a ypazy a py py ta pua ei ta, ama hyutuhpa cha Seidia sawchapawpa Elizu a châ.
Simeôna chi hyutuhpa cha Zurisadai sawchapawpa Selumie a châ.
Kâdâ chi hyutuhpa cha Due sawchapawpa Eliasaphâ a châ.
Chatawhcha Kôhâ pathlazy ta hmobaoh pathaihpazy a sypa ta pua ei ta, zawpi ama tlô hlâta achhyna byureih cha padua khaipa a châ.
Cha khai tawhta Epharai py liata a ypazy a py py ta pua ei ta, ama hyutuhpa cha Amihu sawchapawpa Elisâmâ a châ.
Manase chi hyutuhpa cha Pedazu sawchapawpa Kâmalia a châ.
Benzami chi hyutuhpa cha Kidiôni sawchapawpa Abidanâ a châ.
A hnôh chaipa ta Dânâ py liata a ypazy a py py ta pua ei ta, ama hyutuhpa cha Amisadai sawchapawpa Ahieze a châ.
Asera chi hyutuhpa cha Ôkarâ sawchapawpa Pâkie a châ.
Nâthalai chi hyutuhpa cha Enâ sawchapawpa Ahirâ a châ.
Cha hawhna chata Izarei sawzy cha a py py ta pua ei ta, ama sie lymâ.

Mawsi puhpa Midia chyhsa Rue sawchapawpa Hôbâ hnohta Mawsi ta, “ Abeipa ta, ‘Ei cha pie aw ei,’ a tahpa su lâ eima pangai hai. Abeipa ta Izarei sawzy châta hmo phapa bie a taih ha ta, chavâta eima hnohta vaw sie hra teh, a pha ngaitapa ta na chô liata eima tao aw,” tah ta.
Hôbâ ta Mawsi hnohta, “Vaw sie aw va na, ei râh nata ei chiheihzy lâ tlao ei lie aw,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta, “Rie miah siesai khah y. Râhchawhpa liata riehmo eima tao nawpa su a pahnopa châ chi ta, eima châta mokhaoh na châ aw.
Eima hnohta na sie hra khiahta cha, Abeipa ta eima chô liata hmopha a taopa hawhta na chô liata eima tao hra aw,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Abeipa tlâh tawhta pua ei ta, noh thôh lâsie taih sie ei ta. Amâ pahâ nawpa su tlua awpa ta, Abeipa Biehrai Byh cha noh thôh chhôh ama hmia lâta sie ta.
Ama riehmo tawhta ama pua nahta, Abeipa meihdo cha nohchhô ta ama chô liata y ta.
Byh a puana maihta Mawsi ta, “Hy Abeipa, vaw thyu mah y; Na chariahpazy papaipa ta y ei sala, Châ haotuhpazy na hmiakô tawhta a râpai mawh ei sy,” tah ta.
Byh â pahâna maihta, “Hy Abeipa, vaw kua la, Izarei saw thysâh hluhpi lâ vaw kua heih mah y,” a tah tyh.

Zawpi ta rairuna amâ tyhpazy vâta Abeipa theina liata paphôh ei ta. Cha cha Abeipa ta a thei nahta, a hiehâh ta. Chatanachata Abeipa mei ama hry liata vaw pua ta, ama riehmo chaki liata su thokhazy vaw kâ ta.
Zawpi ta Mawsi awsao ei ta, Mawsi ta Abeipa lâ thlahchhâ ta, chatanachata mei cha dia ha ta.
Abeipa mei ama hry liata a vaw puapa vâta, cha su moh cha Tâberâ bipa a châ.
Ama hnohta a sie hrapa chihropazy ta sa nie khona thata vaw hnei ei ta. Izarei mo chhao cha sa vâpa ta cha ei ta, “Sa eima nie byuh rimâ cha!
Izi râh liata ngasa a mâ leipa ta eima nie tyhpazy, atheizy, bokaihzy, khâchhao hrohpazy, khâchhao saihpa nata khâchhao râhpazy eima vâ rimâ cha!
Tahmâ cha eima tha chhao a chhâ khai ha hih. He mânâ dei leipa heta eima hmô hropa y tlôh va,” tah ei ta.
Mânâ cha sysadi chi hawhta y ta, â lânazie cha kre thei chawhpa a lyu.

Cha cha zawpi ta a huah ei ta, charona liata charopa ta, sôkhaoh liata daih ei ta, cha khai tawhta beih liata chhoh ei ta, viahchhâ ta ama tao. A pahânazie cha viahdie sathaw pahlaopa ta taopa viahchhâ hawhta a châ.
Riehmo liata zâ ta diati a za tla nahta, mânâ chhao diati chô liata a za tla tyh hra.
Zawpizy a chhôh chhôh ta ama poh o chhikao chyu liata ama chapa Mawsi ta pahno ta. Abeipa cha thata a hiehâh ta, chavâta Mawsi cha a nôpo ngaita ta.
Mawsi ta Abeipa hnohta, “Khazia châ chakaotuhpa chô liata hmo pha leipa na tao? Kheihawhpa liata ma na mody leipa ta y na ta, he zawpi zydua phaohri he ei chô liata na pahnieh tly?

He zawpi zydua he ei phaopa ma ama châ? Ei sapazy ma ama châ? Khazia nawh apyhpa ta sâhpi a bâhpa hawsaih â pyhpa hawhta, âmo cha ei kalachhôh liata a pyh laih ta, ama pathlatuhpazy hnohta bie nâ taihpa râh lâ siekhei awpa ta eina chho chi?
He zawpi zydua pie awpa heta khataih liata sa ma ei hnei aw? ‘Eima nie awpa sa miah pie teh,’ tahpa ta cha ei ta, eina patypamâ ngâ thlâh ha ei hih.
He zawpi zydua he kei dei ta phaoh thei veih ei na. Ei phao awpa he â hri tu haw.
He hawhta eina tao awpa chi khiahta cha, na ngiachhie la, â ryh na tah khiahta cha, na thie lâlao thlâh ha la, nôpo pachârôhna a tyh awpa na pakhôkhâhsa mah y,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Izarei machâzy hry tawhta machâ nata chhituhpa ta na pahnopa sysari na awpakhypa la, âmo cha ahmaohna poh o lâ a vaw chhi la, cha liata na hnohta a duah mawh ei sy.

Za chô aw na ta, cha liata bie ei châ vaw chho aw. Nâ liata thlahpa a ypa kha la aw na ta, ama chô liata ei soh aw. Chatanachata zawpi phaohri cha, cha phaokhei aw ei ta, nâ dei ta phaoh khao aw va chi.

Zawpi hnohta, ‘Mylâ châta a pathai teh u, sa cha nama nie aw. Abeipa theina liata, “Sa nie awpa ahy ma miah a pie aw? Izi râh liana kha eima phasa viapa tlai,” tahpa ta cha ei chi ta. Chavâta Abeipa ta sa cha pie aw ei ta, nama nie aw.
Noh kha tlyma, noh no tlyma, noh pangawh tlyma, noh hrawh tlyma, noh kih tlyma dei nie aw veih ei chi.

Nama hry liata a ypa Abeipa dythapa ta, chana chôta Abeipa hmiakô liata paphôh ei chi ta, “Khazia ma Izi râh tawhta eima kaw pua tly?” nama tahpa vâta, thla kha chhôh tlai, aina taih nata apalithluna taihta nama nie aw,’ tahpa ta na chho aw ei,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta a chhy ta, “Ei sielâhpa zawpi phei ta sie theipazy he chyhsa 600,000 châ ei ta, ‘Thla kha chhôh nie awpa sa ei pie aw ei’ tah chi ta.
Mietaku zaw nata sahroh zawzy thie khaipa chhao ta, ama châta â daih aw ma? Tilaipi nga zydua patu khaipa hmah châ sala, ama châta â daih aw ma?” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “ Abeipa cha a ku a chyuta ma? Ei bie hawhta na chô liata a vaw tlô nata tlô lei na pahno aw,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Mawsi cha pua ta, Abeipa bie cha zawpizy chho ta. Zawpi chhituhpa machâ sysarizy cha aw ta, poh o chadôpa ta paduasa ta.

Abeipa cha meihdo hry liata a zu ta, Mawsi cha bie a chho ta, ano liata thlahpa cha la ta, machâ sysarizy chô liata soh ta. Thlahpa ama chô liata a ypa nahta, machâzy cha hrohsona bie phuah ei ta. Châhrasala cha hawhta tao pazao ngâ thlâh ha veih ei.

Riehmo liata machâ pano a ngua ei ta, pakhapa moh cha Eldâ châ ta, a hropa moh cha Medâ a châ. Thlahpa cha âmo chô liata chhao y ta. Âmo cha machâ sysari atlyhpazy hry liata a hlao ei ta, châhrasala ahmaohna poh o lâ vawh leipa ta, riehmo liata hrohsona bie tlao phuah ei ta.
Satlia pakha a kei râ ta, Mawsi hnohta, “Eldâ nata Medâ ta riehmo liata hrohsona bie ama phuah,” tah ta.
Nunâ sawchapawpa Zawsua, a thyutlia daihti tawhta Mawsi chakaotuhpa ta, “Ei zibeipa Mawsi, âmo cha pakhâ mah y,” tah ta.

Châhrasala Mawsi ta a hnohta, “Ei chhâh a châpa ta hiatliapa ma na châ tly? Kei la Abeipa chyhsa zydua hrohsopa châ khai ei sala, Abeipa ta a Thlahpa ama chô liata soh khai sala tahpa tlao ei khoh,” tah ta.
Cha khai tawhta Mawsi nata Izarei machâzy cha riehmo lâ a di ha ei ta.

Chatawhcha Abeipa tawhta thlih vaw pathli ta, tilaipi tawhta mamozy vaw phaoh ta, riehmo chheipâh liata vaw patlasa ta, riehmo hiakha lâ noh kha sie nata hiakha lâ noh kha sie zydua cha mamozy ta dy no chhapa ta bie ei ta.

Zawpizy cha pua ei ta, noh y nata zâkhihdei mamozy cha a huah ei ta, a mylâ chhao noh y ta a huah ei ta. A huah chyh chaipa hmahta kaichhieh mia hrawh tlai a huah ta, riehmo chheipâh liata pachawh chyu ei ta.

Sa cha nie ei ta, châhrasala sa cha ama palâ hlâta, ama hâh nata hâh likawh liata a y thlâh ha chy nota, Abeipa hiehâhna zawpi chô liata vaw tlô ta, Abeipa ta potlana rarôh y ngaitapa ta chyhsa hluhpi a thie ha ei.
Chavâta cha su moh cha Kibarôhâtavâ bipa a châ, chyhsa zohpazy cha liata pabupa ama châpa vâta.
Kibarôhâtavâ tawhta zawpizy cha Hazerô pangaipa ta sie ei ta, Hazerô liata y chy ei ta.
Miria nata Arawna ta Mawsi cha Kusi zuah lapinô ta a hneipa vâta reipachhie ei ta.
“Mawsi hnoh dei ta ma Abeipa ta bie a reih? Keimo hnohta chhao reih hra vei mâ?” tah ei ta. Cha cha Abeipa ta thei ta.
Mawsi cha chyhsa nônai ngaitapa châ ta, alei chô liata chyhsa zydua hry liata nônai chaipa a châ.
Abeipa ta Mawsi nata Arawna nata Miria zy cha bie thlai a chho ta, ama hnohta, “Nama pathôh ta vaw pua u la, ahmaohna poh o lâ a vy teh u,” tah ta. Ama pathôh ta vaw pua ei ta.
Abeipa cha ameih tôh liata za chô ta, poh o chhikao liata a vaw duah ta, Arawna nata Miria cha aw ta, ama pano ta hmia lâ vaw pua ei ta.
Abeipa ta, “Ei bie nathlie teh u: Nama hry liata hrohsopa a y khiahta cha, kei, Abeipa ta aluahna ta a hnohta a pahnosa na ta, mâ lâta bie ei chho tyh.
Nâ chakaotuhpa Mawsi deikua cha, cha hawhta châ vei. Ano cha ei o liata ngâchhihpa a châ.

Ano cha pakah ta bie a chho na ta, bie nyupa y leipa ta, a siapa ta bie ei chho tyh. Abeipa pizie chhao a hmô. Cha hawhta a châ tlôh khiahta cha, khazia nâ chakaotuhpa Mawsi reipachhiepa cha nama chi vei?” tah ta.
Chavâta Abeipa cha ama chô liata a pathi ia ta, a sie haw.
Poh o chô tawhta meihdo â pasie nahta, pachâ tua u, Miria cha vaw phawh ta, dâhaw hawhta a vaw râh haw. Arawna ta Miria cha moh ta, phawhpa vaw châ thlâh ha ta.
Arawna ta Mawsi hnohta, “Hy ei zibeipa, eima moleina vâta rie miah hrie khah y, hru ngaitapa ta tao pi ta, eima vaw molei haw.
Miria he thiruapa ta a pihpa hawsaih, a nô chhi tawhta a vaw pua nota a sapa khophie a y khao leipa hawhta rie châ khah sy,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta Abeipa awsao ta, “Hy Khazohpa, Miria he ngiachhiepa ta patlâh mah y, ngiachhiepa ta,” tah ta.

Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “A paw ta a hmia liata a pachih pachhao sala, noh sari chhôh nozapa ta y aw vei ma? Riehmo khôtho lâ noh sari chhôh ânano ta khawhlôhpa ta y sala, cha khai tawhta a vaw ngiakhei heihpa châ mawh sy,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Miria cha noh sari chhôh khôtho liata khawhlôhpa châ ta, Miria a vaw ngiakhei heihpa a châ hlâlei cha, zawpi chhao a pasie veih ei.
Cha khai tawhta zawpizy cha Hazerô tawhta pua ei ta, Pârâ râhchawhpa liata riehmo paryh ei ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Izarei sawzy ei piepa Kâna râh mohparu awpa ta chyhsa tuah teh. Ama pathlatuhpa chizy tawhta chyhsa pakha chyu, ama hry liata chhituhpa pakha lymâ ta na tuah aw ei,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta, Abeipa bie piepa hawhta, âmo cha Pârâ râhchawhpa tawhta pasiesa ta. Ama zydua ta Izarei pathla chhituhpa ama châ.
Hezy he ama moh a châ: Rubena chi tawhta Zaku sawchapawpa Samua;
Simeôna chi tawhta Hôri sawchapawpa Saphâta;
Zudâh chi tawhta Zephune sawchapawpa Kâlebâ,
Iskâra chi tawhta Zawsi sawchapawpa Ikâ;
Epharai chi tawhta Nunâ sawchapawpa Hôsia;
Benzami chi tawhta Râphu sawchapawpa Pâti;
Zebulawna chi tawhta Sôdi sawchapawpa Kâdie;
Zawsi pathla Manase chi tawhta Susi sawchapawpa Kâdi;
Dânâ chi tawhta Kemâli sawchapawpa Amie;
Asera chi tawhta Mikaila sawchapawpa Sethu;
Nâthalai chi tawhta Vôphasi sawchapawpa Nâbi;
Kâdâ chi tawhta Mâkhi sawchapawpa Keu.
Âmo cha râh mohparu awpa ta Mawsi ta a tuapazy ama châ. Nunâ sawchapawpa Hôsia cha Mawsi ta Zawsua tahpa ta a moh a bi.
Âmo sahlao cha Mawsi ta Kâna râh mohparu awpa ta tuah ta, ama hnohta, “Chho lâ râh Neke lâta siepa ta, tlâh râh lâta kiah aw ei chi ta,
râh cha kheihawhpa ma a châ tahpa zy, cha liata a pahrâpa chyhsazy cha thatlôpa ma, thatlô leipa ma ama châ tahpa zy, ama chyh ma ama hluh ma tahpa zy;
ama yna râh cha a pha ma, a chhie ma tahpa zy; kheihawhpa khihzy liata ma ama pahrâ, poh o khihzy ma, thokhy hneipa khihzy ma tahpa zy;

râh cha kôvei a pha ma, pha vei ma tahpa zy, a râh chhôh liata thozy a y ma, y vei ma tahpa zy nama kaw moh aw. Riahphapa ta y u la, cha râh liata theilâpazy za phaoh muh vy,” tah ta. Cha daihti cha Kre thei hmiatuapa hmoh daihti châ ta.
Chatanachata pua ei ta, râh cha Zini râhchawhpa tawhta Lebô-hâmâ kiapâh ta Rehô taihta moh khai ei ta.
Neke lâta khy ei ta, Hebraw tlô ei ta, cha liata Anâki pathla Ahimâ mo, Sesai mo nata Tâmai mozy y ei ta. Hebraw cha Izi râh liata Zawâ â dua hlâta kô sari liata padua hapa a châ.
Chatawhcha Eskaw Saikao tlô ei ta, cha liata kre thei sao kha, a chiah duata chhawh ei ta, chyhsa pano ta alâ ta zâ sy ei ta. Pawmikarânâ nata theiku chhao za phaoh ei ta.
Izarei sawzy ta cha liata kre sao ama chhawhpa vâta, cha su cha Eskaw Saikao bipa a châ.
Râh cha noh sypalih ama mohparu khai tawhta a zâ lie ei ta.
Pârâ râhchawhpa Kâdesâ liata Mawsi nata Arawna nata Izarei zawpi zydua yna vaw tlô ei ta. Mawsi nata Arawna nata zawpi zydua hnohta bie vaw phaoh ei ta, a râh theilâpazy chhao pahmô ei ta.
Mawsi hnohta, “Miah na tuana râh cha tlô pi ta, sâhpiti nata kheihti lona râh a vaw châ tlai. He he a râh liata theilâpa a châ.
