Râh liata phopi a pahrâpazy deikua cha, phopi thatlô ngaitapa châ ei ta, khihpizy chhao thokhy a hneipa, khih lai ngaitapazy a châ. Anâki pathlazy chhao, cha liata eima hmô.
Amale mo chho lâ râh liata pahrâ ei ta, Hiti mo, Zebu mo nata Amawri mozy cha tlâh râh liata pahrâ ei ta, Kâna mo cha tilaipi kiah nata Zawdâh kao zy liata ama pahrâ,” tah ei ta.
Kâlebâ ta zawpi cha Mawsi hmiakô liata chalihsa ta, “Khy para sih la, râh cha kaw la ei suh u, eima pahnie aw,” tah ta.
Châhrasala a sielâhpazy ta “Cha phopi cha, keimo hlâta ama thatlô via ta, chavâta a kaw dyuh thei awpa châ ma pi,” tah ei ta.

Izarei sawzy hnohta râh ama kaw mohparupa kyh thâtih chhiepa za tlôkhei ei ta, zawpi hnohta, “Râh eima kaw mohparupa cha a chhôh liata a pahrâpazy a palâ khai hapa châ ta, a râh liata pahrâpa eima hmôpazy cha mo pahreihpazy ama châ.

Cha liata Nephili mo pahreihpazy hmô pi ta, Anâki pathlazy cha Nephili tawhta a puapazy ama châ. Keimo cha khawsu hawh dei ta a hmô pi ta, âmo chhao ta khawsu hawh dei ta miah ama hmô hra,” tah ei ta.
Cha zâ cha ahmaohpakhypa zydua ta ao paro ngaitapa ta awh ei ta, zawpizy cha aoh tlili ta ama cha.

Izarei saw zydua ta Mawsi nata Arawna chô liata paphôh ei ta, ama hnohta, “Izi râh liana kha vaw thi ha sih la a pha via awpa tlai, cha leipa chhao ta, he râhchawhpa liana heta thi sih la tlao a pha via aw!
Khazia ma zaozi ta thi awpa ta Abeipa ta he râh lâ he miah â chhi tly? Eima lapi sawzy he patupa ta y aw ei ta, Izi râh lâ kua awpa eima châta pha via vei ma?” tah ei ta.
Chatanachata a chhohia ei ta, “Chhituhpa rao sih la, Izi râh lâ kua ha ei suh u,” tah ei ta.
Mawsi nata Arawna cha Izarei zawpi pôhpakhypa zydua hmiakô liana cha â khu lâta pao ei ta.
Chatawhcha râh mohparutuhpazy hry liata a hlao hrapa Nunâ sawchapawpa Zawsua nata Zephune sawchapawpa Kâlebâ cha ama chysia hrie ei ta,
Izarei zawpi zydua hnohta, “Mohparu awpa ta eima chahryhpa râh cha râh pha ngaitapa a châ.
Eima chô liata Abeipa â ly khiahta cha, cha râh lâ cha miah a chhi aw ta, miah a pie aw, sâhpiti nata kheihti lona râh cha.

Abeipa chô liata a ty leipa u la, cha râh liata chyhsazy cha chi hra khah u, âmo cha eima châta viahchhâ hawh deita ama châ; amâ bohna cha âmo tawhta la hapa châ ta, Abeipa eima hnohta a y mâh tâh, âmo cha chi khah u,” tah ei ta.
Châhrasala zawpi pôhpakhypazy chata Zawsua nata Kâlebâ cha alô ta vaw awpa ta pahrua ei ta. Abeipa rônahna cha Izarei saw zydua hnohta ahmaohna poh o liata a zâ luah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “He chyhsazy heta khachâ ma eina mohnao aw ei? Ama hry liata ngiana hmonoâhpazy ei taona chôta khachâ ma na ngâ leipa ta ama y aw?
Hri ta hrie aw ei na ta, ei pamua aw ei; chatanachata nâma liana heta âmo hlâta rônah viapa nata thatlô viapa phopi ei padua aw,” tah ta.
Châhrasala Mawsi ta Abeipa hnohta, “Cha kyh cha Izi mo ta ama pahno pathlei aw, he zawpizy he ama hry tawhta na hmotaotheina ta nâ chhi papuapazy châ tlôh ei ta.

Izi mo ta he râh liata a pahrâpazy he chho aw ei ta, pha aw vei. He râh liata a pahrâpazy heta nâ Abeipa cha Izarei sawzy hry liata na y tahpa pahno tlôh ei ta. Nâ, Abeipa cha hmiachhypa ta cha hmô ha ei ta, na meihdo cha Izarei sawzy chô liata a duah ta, nohchhô ta meihdo tôh ta, zâ ta mei tôh ta ama hmia lâta na sie tyhpa chhao ama pahno.
Chavâta he zawpizy he chyhsa pakha thiepa hawhta na thie khai thlâh ha khiahta cha, na moh pathâhpa a theipa phopizy ta,
‘ Abeipa ta he zawpizy he ama hnohta pie awpa ta bie â taihpa râh lâ a tlôkhei thei leipa vâ ei ta, râhchawhpa liata a thie ha ei,’ ama tah pathlei aw.
Chavâta tahmâ he Abeipa hmotaotheina cha rônahpa ta y mawh sy, nâma tlai ta,

‘ Abeipa cha hiehâhna kyh liata nainôsôpa châ ta, kyhpachâna hnei hluh ngaita ta, moleina nata hmoparaonazy a ngiahthai theipa a châ. Thailei a châpazy deikua cha, hrie leipa ta y beih vei. Pawzy hmoparaona ty sawzy chô liata patlôsa ta, chhâ thôhna nata chhâ palihna taihta a patlôsapa a châ,’ tahpa ta vaw reih ha chi ta.

Na kyhpachâna rônah ngaitapa vâta, he chyhsazy hmoparaona he ngiachhiepa ta a ngiahthai la, Izi râh tawhta tahmâ taihta nâ ngiahthai lymâpa hawhta, he chyhsazy hmoparaona he a ngiahthai mah y,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta, “Na bie hawhta ei ngiahthai ei.
Châhrasala ei hrona reipa ta ei reih; leilô zydua he Abeipa rônahna ta a bie aw.
Izi râh nata râhchawhpa liata ei rônahna nata ei hmonoâhpa taopazy hmô ha ei ta, chatana chôta ei bie a zyh leipa chyhsa zydua heta, ei hrawh tlai na pasia ei ta, ei ao nathlie veih ei.
Âmo pathlatuhpazy hnohta bie ei taihpa râh cha hmô aw veih ei; nâ mohnaopazy chhao hmô hra aw veih ei.
Nâ chakaotuhpa Kâlebâ deikua he cha palôh nanopa phaoh ta, tlokhuh ta eina pazipa vâta, ano he cha a pangaipa râh tlôkhei aw na ta, a pathlazy ta râh cha ama hnei aw.
Amale mo nata Kâna mozy saikao byzy liata pahrâ tlôh ei ta, chavâta nâmo cha mylâ a lie u la, Tilaipi Saihpa lâpi lâ tawhta râhchawhpa lâ a ngia teh u,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi nata Arawna hnohta,
“He zawpi moleipa, ei chô liata a paphôh ngâ thlâh hapazy he, khachâ ma ei chhyh thai aw ei? Izarei sawzy paphôhna, ei chô liata ama paphôhnazy he ei thei haw.
Chavâta ama hnohta, ‘Ei hrona reipa ta ei reih, ei nah theina liata nama reipa hawh tlai ta, kei chhao ta nama chô liata ei tao hra aw:
he râhchawhpa liana he nama rizy pao aw ta, maluhpi nama reina liata kô kih tawhta chô lâ chyhsa, ei chô liata a paphôhpa zydua nama pao khai aw.
Bâh pazawhpa tlai ta nama pahrâ nawpa tao awpa ta bie ei châ taihpa ei râh cha, Zephune sawchapawpa Kâlebâ nata Nunâ sawchapawpa Zawsua tah leipa ta cha ahy hmah a ngia aw veih ei chi.
Anodeikuacha patupa ta ama y aw nama tahpa nama sawzy he a chhi aw ei na ta, âmo heta nama dythapa râh cha ama pahrâ aw.
Nâmo deikua cha he râhchawhpa liana heta nama rizy a pao aw.
Nama sawzy cha kô sypalih râhchawhpa liata viavi aw ei ta, nâmo ngâchhih leina vâta pasa ama tao aw, râhchawhpa liata nama rizy a pao khaina taih ta.
Râh nama mohparuna noh ziepa noh sypalih kha, noh kha vyuhpa ta kô kha lymâ ta, nama paraona vâta kô sypalih pasa nama tao aw; chatanachata ei ly leizie nama pahno aw.

Kei Abeipa heta ei reih: he zawpi moleipa, keima nâ dyuh awpa ta a hmaohpakhypazy chô liana heta, he hmo he tao tlai aw na ta, he râhchawhpa liana heta leidia aw ei ta, he liata ama thi aw,’ tahpa ta chho teh u,” tah ta.
Chatanachata râh mohparu awpa ta Mawsi ta a tuapazy a zâ lie ei ta, râh thâtih a chhiena lâta a reihpa, Mawsi chô liata Zawpi a paphôhsatuhpa,
râh thâtih a chhiena lâta a vaw tlôkheituhpazy chô liata potlana tlô ta, Abeipa hmiakô liata thi khai ha ei ta.
Râh mohparu awpa ta a siepazy hry liata Nunâ sawchapawpa Zawsua nata Zephune sawchapawpa Kâlebâ deikua cha pahlôhpa ama châ.
Mawsi ta cha biezy cha Izarei saw zydua chho ta, zawpizy cha pachârôhpa ta mâchhiesa ei ta.
Chatanachata mydi ta thyu ei ta, tlâh laki lâ khy ei ta, Mawsi hnohta, “Moh teh, eimâ khy hih, Abeipa ta bie miah â taihpa su lâ cha eima khy aw, eima vaw molei haw,” tah ei ta.
Mawsi ta, “Khazia Abeipa biepiepa nama parao, nama hlaotloh khao aw vei.
Khy hlei khah u, nama hry liata Abeipa y khao tlôh leipa ta, nama chariahzy ta ama cha thie khai pathlei aw.
Nama hmia liata Amale mo nata Kâna mozy y ei ta, zaozi ta nama pao aw; Abeipa nama tleisai hapa vâta, nama hnohta Abeipa y khao aw vei,” tah ta.
Châhrasala Abeipa Biehrai Byh nata Mawsi cha riehmo tawhta ama pua leipa chhao ta, tlâh râh lâ cha khy raruah a chhuah ei ta.
Chatanachata tlâh râh liata a pahrâpa Amale mo nata Kâna mozy cha a zu ei ta, âmo cha thie ei ta, Hômâ tlâh taihta a chadai ei ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Izarei sawzy chho la, ama hnohta hetana heta reih teh: Nama pahrâ nawpa râh ei cha piepa ei tlô aw ei chi ta,

Abeipa châta ropahâhpa tao nawpa ta, Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpa raopa hlâna tlyma, bietai patlô nawpa ta atheihna tlyma, lôhthai hmohlâpa tlyma, nama châta kyhchhi raopazy liata hmohlâpa tlyma nama hlâ tita, viahchao hri tawhta tlyma, mietaku zaw tawhta tlyma nama hlâ awpa a châ.
Abeipa lâta hmohlâpa a cheihpa maihta, niepa hlâna hlâ aw ta, cha cha viahdie dipa kachu su hrawh su kha nata sathaw chhiehraôh ôh kha pahlaopa a châ aw.
Raopa hlâta ta tlyma, atheihna châta tlyma hlâ awpa mietakutaw pô kha liata, dopa hlâna châta kresawhti ôh kha lymâ na hlâ awpa a châ.
Mietaku tôhpa pô kha hlâ awpa liata niepa hlâna châta na hlâ awpa cha, viahdie dipa kachu su hrawh su no nata sathaw chhiehraôh ôh kha nata khophie pahlaopa a châ aw.
Dopa hlâna châta kresawhti chhiehraôh ôh kha nata khophie na hlâ aw. Cha cha Abeipa châta ropahâhpa a châ.
Raopa hlâna châta tlyma, bietai patlô nawpa ta atheihna châta tlyma, aryhna hlâna châta tlyma, Abeipa lâta viahchao tôhpa na hlâ khiahta cha,
viahchao tôhpa na hlâ nona chata, viahdie dipa kachu su hrawh su thôh nata sathaw ôh no pahlaopa niepa hlâna na hlâ pâ aw.
Dopa hlâna châta kresawhti chhiehraôh ôh no na hlâ aw. Cha cha mei ta hmohlâpa châ ta, Abeipa châta ropahâhpa a châ.
“Cha hawhna chata viahchao tôhpa, mietaku tôhpa, mietakutaw nata mietaw zy hlâna maihta tao awpa a châ.
Sahroh nama hlâ awpa nata aziepa reipatipa ta, nama hlâ awpa ta â chakaihpa niepa hlâna nata dopa hlânazy nama hlâ khai aw.
Izarei râh liata a pihpa zydua ta, cha hawhna chata mei ta hmohlâpa ama hlâ awpa a châ. Cha cha Abeipa châta ropahâhpa a châ.
Chihropa chyhsa nama hnohta a pahrâpa tlyma, chhâ hluhpi nama hnohta a ypazy tlyma ta, Abeipa châta ropahâhpa, mei ta hmohlâpa a hlâ khoh khiahta cha, nâmo taozie hawhta a tao hra awpa a châ.

Nâmo nata nama hnohta chihropa a pahrâpazy ta bieraopa miakha a hly aw ei chi ta, cha cha chhâ vaw y lymâ awpa châta chhâzaw bieraopa a châ aw. Abeipa hmiakô liata cha, nâmo nata chihropazy namâ lyu khai aw.
Nâmo nata nama hnohta chihropa a pahrâpazy ta ryhpa miakha nata bieraopa miakha namâ hly aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Izarei sawzy chho la, ama hnohta hetana heta reih teh: Ei cha siekheina râh kei tlô aw ei chi ta,
cha râh viahchhâ nama nie tita, Abeipa tovyuh tao aw ei chi ta nama hlâ aw.
Viahchhâ nama nyh tua chaipa tawhta tlâ kha panano aw ei chi ta, chaluahpa hlâna ta nama hlâ aw. Sawhri liatapa chaluahpa hlâna ta nama hlâ tyhpa hawhta nama hlâ aw.
Nama chhâ zydua liata, viahchhâ nama nyh tua chaipa tawhta Abeipa tovyuh nama pie lymâ awpa a châ.
“Châhrasala molei pathleina vâta, Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta a reipa biepiepazy zyh leipa ta,
Mawsi hmâpa ta Abeipa ta bie a cha piepazy ei cha, bie a cha pie noh tawh ei ta nama chhâ vaw y lymâ awpa zydua liata,

tao pathleipa châ sala, zawpi pahno leipa a châ khiahta cha, viahchao hri hry tawhta viahchao tôh dawpa pô kha raopa hlâna châta zawpi ta ama hlâ aw. Cha cha Abeipa châta ropahâhpa a châ. Â chakaihpa niepa hlâna nata dopa hlâna chhao taozietyhpa hawhta hlâ aw ei ta, moleina hlâna châta mie tôhpa pô kha ama hlâ aw.

Chatawhcha theihthaipa ta Izarei zawpi zydua châta chatlaina tao aw ta, tao pathleipa châ ta, ama tao pathleipa châta Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpa hlâ ei ta, Abeipa hmiakô liata moleina hlâna ama hlâ hapa vâta, a ngiahthaipa ama châ aw.
Izarei zawpi zydua nata ama hry liata chihropa a pahrâpazy chhao, zawpi tao pathleina liata amâ hlao khaipa vâta, ngiahthaipa ama châ aw.
“Chyhsa ta pahno leipa ta hmo a parao khiahta cha, moleina hlâna châta mie chanôpa kô khapa pô kha a hlâ aw.
Pahno leina vâta a molei pathleipa châna chata, theihthaipa ta Abeipa hmiakô liata chatlaina taopa aw ta, a ngiahthaipa a châ aw.
Pahno leina vâta moleina kyh liata, a râh chyhsa Izarei sawzy nata chihropa ama hry liata a pahrâpazy châta ryhpa miakha a hly awpa a châ.

Moleina a châ tahpa pahno thlâh hana chôta a molei raruahpa deikua cha, a râh chyhsa a châpa chhao ta, chihropa a châpa chhao ta, Abeipa a reipachhiepa châ ta, cha chyhsa cha a phopi tawhta chhawh pathlahpa a châ aw.
Abeipa bie khâpasaw ta reih leipa ta, a biepiepa a paraopa vâta, cha chyhsa cha chhawh pathlahpa châ aw ta, a paraona maoh a phaoh aw,” tah ta.
Izarei sawzy râhchawhpa liata ama y nota, chyhsa pakha cha Pahânoh ta tho a pakhypa hmô ei ta.
Tho a pakhypa a hmôtuhpazy ta ano cha Mawsi nata Arawna nata zawpizy lâ a vaw chhi ei ta.
A chô liata kheihta tao awpa ma tahpa pachiapa a châ mâh leipa vâta patâhna o liata khô chy ei ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Cha chyhsa cha thie awpa a châ. Zawpi zydua ta riehmo khôtho liata alô ta ama vawhsao awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi bie a piepa hawhta, zawpi zydua ta ano cha riehmo khôtho lâ a chhi ei ta, alô ta ama vawhsao haw.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,

“Izarei sawzy chho la, ama hnohta hetana heta reih teh: Ama chhâ vaw y lymâ awpa zydua liata, ama chysia paizy pangiasana ama tao awpa châ ta, chysia pai ki to liata pala ri nohpa ama pataoh khai awpa a châ.

Chysia pai pangiasana cha moh tyh aw ei chi ta, Abeipa biepiepa zydua a theipa ta nama zyh lymâ nawpa châta châ aw ta, chatanachata nama palôh nata nama mo ta a khopa lâ sie leipa aw ei chi ta, nama sihryh tyhna lâ tlei leipa ta nama y thei aw.
Ei biepiepa zydua a theipa ta zyh aw ei chi ta, nama Khazohpa châta pathaihpa nama châ aw.
Kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa, nama Khazohpa châ awpa ta Izi râh tawhta châ chhi papuatuhpa ei châ. Kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa ei châ,” tah ta.

Kôrâ, Dâthâ, Abirâ nata Ôni zy ta py tao ei ta. Kôrâ cha Izah sawchapawpa châ ta, Izah cha Kôhâ sawchapawpa châ ta, Kôhâ cha Livai sawchapawpa a châ. Dâthâ nata Abirâ cha Rubena pathla hry liata Eliabâ sawchapawzy châ ei ta, Ôni chhao Rubena pathla hry liata Pele sawchapawpa a châ.
Âmo chata Mawsi a dyuh ei ta. Ama py liata Izarei sawzy hry liata zawpi chhituhpa nata ryureituhpa châta a tlyhpa chyhsa moh phapa 250 amâ hlao.

Mawsi nata Arawna chakhia awpa ta a awpakhy ei ta, ama hnohta, “Nama tah tu ha bâ! Zawpi pôhpakhypa sahlao he pathaih ei ta, ama zydua ta ama pathaih khai. Abeipa chhao ama hry liata a y. Khazia Abeipa chyhsa pôhpakhypa hlâta chônô viapa ta namâ tao?” tah ei ta.
Cha cha Mawsi ta a thei nahta, â khu lâta pao ta,

Kôrâ nata a sahlaozy hnohta, “Mylâ my ta Abeipa ta ahy ma ano eih a châ tahpa a pasia aw. Ahy ma a pathaih tahpa pasia aw ta, a pathaihpa ta ano a hnia thei aw ta, Abeipa ta â tlyhpa tlai chata Abeipa cha â hnia thei aw.
Hetana nama tao aw: Nâmo, Kôrâ nata a sahlao zydua ta ropahâhpa raona biebuh a chei aw ei chi ta,
cha liata mylâ Abeipa hmiakô liata mei soh aw ei chi ta, mei chô liata ropahâhpa nama soh aw. Abeipa ta â tlyhpa cha pathaihpa a châ aw. Nâmo, Livai pathlazy saih u, nama tah tu ha bâ!” tah ta.
Mawsi ta Kôrâ hnohta, “Nâmo, Livai pathlazy saih u, nathlie teh u:

Izarei Khazohpa ta nâmo cha Izarei zawpi hry tawhta cha panano ei ta, ano a hnia awpa ta a cha rao ei. Abeipa achhyna byureih liata chakao ta, zawpi hmiakô liata a duah ta zawpi chakao awpa ta a châ tlyhpa ei he, hmo chyhpa ta ma nama pachâ?
Nâ nata na unawh Livai pathla zydua cha ano kiapâh liata y awpa ta a cha rao ei. Khazia theihthaipa châ awpa taihta namâ chhuhrao?
Nâ nata na sahlao zydua Abeipa a dyuh awpa ta namâ hmaohpakhypa a châ hih. Arawna cha khâpa hmo ma tao ta, a chô liata nama paphôh?” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Mawsi ta Eliabâ sawchapawpa Dâthâ nata Abirâ cha paawsa ta, âmo ta, “A khy aw ma pi.
Râhchawhpa liata miah thie awpa ta, sâhpiti nata kheihti lona râh tawhta miah na kaw puakheipa he hmo chyhpa ma a châ? Tahmâ eima chô liata bei ta nâ tao heih.

Cha dei châ vei, sâhpiti nata kheihti lona râh lâ miah tlôkhei leipa chi ta, lyuzy nata kre sadôzy eima ryuto châta miah pie hra va chi. He chyhsazy he ama mo taihta thaoh awpa ma nâ chhuah? A khy aw ma pi,” tah ei ta.
Mawsi cha a hiehâh ngaita ta, Abeipa hnohta, “Ama hmohlâpa a pyh khah y. Âmo tawhta alâ pô kha hmah la leipa na ta, ama hry liata pakha hmah pasasa beih va na,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta Kôrâ hnohta, “Mylâ nâ nata na sahlao zydua, nâ chhao, âmo chhao, Arawna chhao, Abeipa hmiakô liata namâ luah awpa a châ.

Ama ropahâhpa raona biebuh chaba chyu ei sala, a chhôh liata ropahâhpa soh ei sala, Abeipa hmiakô liata vaw cheih mawh ei sy. Ropahâhpa raona biebuh cha a zydua ta 250 châ aw ta, nâ chhao, Arawna chhao, chyhsa to ama ropahâhpa raona biebuh amâ chei chyu aw,” tah ta.

Chatanachata chyhsa to ama ropahâhpa raona biebuh a chei chyu ei ta, a chhôh liata mei soh ei ta, mei chô liata ropahâhpa soh ei ta, Mawsi nata Arawna hnohta ahmaohna poh o chhikao liata a kei duah ei ta.
Kôrâ ta zawpi zydua cha Mawsi nata Arawna chakhia awpa ta ahmaohna poh o chhikao liata pahmaoh ta. Zawpi zydua hnohta Abeipa rônahna a vaw luah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi nata Arawna hnohta,
“Kha zawpi hry tawhna khata a panano teh u, âmo kha thlai ei pahleipadia aw ei,” tah ta.
Mawsi nata Arawna cha â khu lâta pao ei ta, “Hy Khazohpa, sapa zydua thlahpa Khazohpa y, chyhsa pakha moleipa vâta zawpi zydua chô liata na pathi a ia aw mâ?” tah ei ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Zawpizy kha Kôrâ, Dâthâ nata Abirâ zy riehmo a hneisai khai ha awpa ta chho teh,” tah ta.
Mawsi cha thyu ta, Dâthâ nata Abirâ yna lâ vawh ta, Izarei machâzy ta ano cha zi ei ta.
Zawpi hnohta, “He chyhsa moleipazy poh o tawhna heta pua teh u. Ama hneipa chhao khâpa hmah hria khuh vy. Chataleipatala ama moleina zydua vâta pahleipadiapa nama châ pathlei aw,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Kôrâ, Dâthâ nata Abirâ zy pahrâna su tawhta pua ei ta. Dâthâ nata Abirâ cha kaw pua ei ta, ama lapinôzy, ama sawchapawzy, ama hawtizy chhaota ama poh o chhikao liata a duah ei ta.
Mawsi ta, “He liana heta Abeipa ta he raizy he hria awpa ta eina tuah tahpa pahno aw ei chi ta, keima kho ta ei taopa a châ leizie nama pahno aw.
He chyhsazy he pihthi ta thi ei sala, chyhsa to chô liata a tlô tyhpa hawhta ama chô liata a vaw tlô khiahta cha, kei he Khazohpa ta eina tuah leipa a châ aw.

Abeipa ta hmo thiehpa taopa ta, alei ta a pakah âpa ta, âmo nata ama hneipa zydua palâ khaipa ta, a hrohpa ta Athihkhih lâ amâ ngia khiahta deikua cha, he chyhsazy heta Abeipa ama mohnao tahpa nama pahno aw,” tah ta.
Cha bie zydua cha Mawsi ta a rei khaipata nahta, ama ry liata chhaohlei a vaw patlaw ta.
Alei ta a pakah vaw â ta, ama ozy nata Kôrâ chyhsa zydua nata ama hneipa zydua a palâ khai haw.
Âmo nata ama hneipa zydua ahrohpa ta Athihkhih lâ a ngia ei ta, alei ta âmo cha a pabieh khâh ta, zawpi hry tawhta ama leidia haw.
Ama awhsâhpa pyu vâta, ama chheipâh liata Izarei saw zydua cha, “Alei ta miah a palâ pathlei aw,” tah ei ta, amâ râpai khai haw.
Chatawhcha Abeipa tawhta mei vaw pua ta, ropahâhpa a hlâ haipa chyhsa 250 cha a kâsao khai ha ei.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Ropahâhpa raona biebuhzy kha mei a kâ haipa tawhta la awpa ta, theihthaipa Arawna sawchapawpa Eliaza kha chho teh. Hmo pathaihpa vaw châ ha ei ta, chavâta a meiheizy kha hiezâh khai ha mah y.

Ama hrona pahleina taihta a moleipa chyhsazy ropahâhpa raona biebuh châ ta, maisâh khuna châta a phiapa ta daihpa châ mawh sy. Abeipa hmiakô liata hlâ hapa a châpa vâta, pathaihpa ama vaw châ haw. Cha cha Izarei sawzy châta ngiana a châ aw,” tah ta.
Mei ta a kâsaopa sahlaozy ta ama vaw cheipa, ropahâhpa raona dawh biebuhzy cha Theihthaipa Eliaza ta la ta, maisâh khuna châta a phiapa ta padaisa ta.

Abeipa ta Mawsi hmâpa ta Eliaza hnohta a reipa hawhta, cha cha Izarei sawzy zikyurâna châta taopa a châ. Arawna pathla a châ leipa chyhsa ahy hmahta Abeipa hmiakô liata ropahâhpa rao awpa ta amâ hnia awpa châ vei. A tao raruahpa cha, Kôrâ nata a sahlaozy hawhta ama châ aw.
A mylâ ta, Izarei zawpi zydua ta Mawsi nata Arawna chô liata, “ Abeipa phopi chyhsazy nama thie” tahpa ta paphôh ei ta.
Mawsi nata Arawna chakhiapa ta zawpi amâ hmaoh hai nota, ahmaohna poh o lâ a kei heih ei ta, meihdo ta ahmaohna poh o cha vaw khu ta, Abeipa rônahna a vaw luah ta.
Mawsi nata Arawna cha ahmaohna poh o hmia lâ vawh ei ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Zawpizy he thlai ei pahleipadia aw ei. Chavâta ama hry tawhta a hnei teh u,” tah ta. Chatawhcha Mawsi nata Arawna cha â khu lâta pao ei ta.

Mawsi ta Arawna hnohta, “Ropahâhpa raona na biebuh kha la la, a chô liata maisâh liata mei kha soh la, ropahâhpa mia la, zawpi lâ a râkhei para la, âmo châta chatlaina tao teh. Abeipa tawhta hiehâhna pua ha ta, potlana â thao haw,” tah ta.
Arawna ta Mawsi reipa hawhta, ropahâhpa raona biebuh cha la ta, ahmaohpakhypa sahlao lâ a râ ta, potlana cha zawpi hry liata vaw tlô hmâ ha ta. Ropahâhpa rao ta, zawpi châta chatlaina tao ta.
Athihpa nata ahrohpa likawh liata a kei duah ta, chatanachata potlana cha pai ha ta.
Kôrâ vâta athipazy hleikhô ta, potlana vâta a thipa zydua cha 14,700 ama châ.
Potlana a pai tawhta, Arawna cha ahmaohna poh o chhikao liata Mawsi lâta kua heih ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,

“Izarei sawzy hetana heta chho teh: Izarei chi hrawh hleino chhituhpazy tawhta, chi kha tawhta chôchahrei miakha lymâ ta, chôchahrei mia hrawh hleino la aw chi ta, ama chôchahrei chyu liata ama moh na roh khai aw.
Livai chi chôchahrei liata Arawna moh na roh aw. Cha hawhna chata chi chhituhpazy châta chôchahrei miakha chyu a y aw.
Chazy cha ahmaohna poh o liata eimâ hmô tyhna Biehrai Byh hmiakô liata na soh aw.
Ei tlyhpa chyhsa chôchahrei cha a chhyh kaw thao aw ta, chatanachata Izarei sawzy paphôhna, na chô liata ama paphôhna cha ei padia aw,” tah ta.

Cha hawhna chata Mawsi ta Izarei sawzy cha chho ta. Ama chhituhpazy ta chôchahreizy a hnohta vaw pie ei ta, chhituhpa pakha ta chôchahrei miakha lymâ ta, ama chi yzie hawhta chôchahrei mia hrawh hleino pie ei ta. Arawna chôchahrei chhao ama chôchahreizy hry liata â hlao hra.
Mawsi ta chôchahreizy cha Biehrai Byh poh o chhôh liata Abeipa hmiakô ta soh ta.
A mylâ ta Mawsi cha Biehrai Byh poh o lâ vawh ta, Livai chi Arawna chôchahrei cha a chhyh kaw thao ta, a pawzy pabyuh ta, a pawzy pakaipa ta, kuasâh thei hmohpazy a patheipa hmô ta.
Mawsi ta chôchahrei zydua cha Abeipa hmiakô tawhta Izarei sawzy lâ pua khei ta, moh ei ta, chyhsazy ta ama chôchahrei chyu a la ei ta.

Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Arawna chôchahrei kha Biehrai Byh hmiakô liata soh pathi teh. Chyhsa chakhia hmâhpa sawzy ama châ tahpa ngiana châta châ aw ta, chatanachata eina chakhiana ei cha padia aw chi ta, thi aw veih ei,” tah ta.
Cha hawh chata Mawsi ta tao ta, Abeipa ta bie a piepa hawh tlai ta a tao.
Izarei sawzy ta Mawsi hnohta, “Moh teh, eima leidia ha hih! Paraopa châ pi ta, eima zydua ta paraopa eima châ ha hih.
Ahy rai Abeipa achhyna byureih a vaw hniapa maih ama thi lymâ aw he zaw! Eima zydua ta thi khai dâhdei khiah pi maw?” tah ei ta.

Abeipa ta Arawna hnohta, “Nâ nata na sawchapawzy nata na paw chhôhkhazy ta supathaihpa liata paraona maoh phaoh aw ei chi ta, nâ nata na sawchapawzy ta nama theihthaina raihria kyh liata paraona maoh nama phaoh aw.
Nama hnohta chakao awpa ta Livai chi, na paw chipathla nama unawhzy a vaw chhi aw ei chi ta, Biehrai Byh poh o hmiakô liata nama chakao nota ama cha bao tyh aw.
Na raihria cha bao aw ei ta, poh o liata rai zydua ama hria aw. Supathaihpa hmobaoh nata maisâh deikua amâ hnia awpa châ vei. Chataleipatala âmo chhao, nâmo chhao, nama thi pathlei aw.
Chakaona rai na hriana liata a hlao hra aw ei ta, ahmaohna poh o mohôhna rai ama hria aw. Poh o rai zydua âmo hria awpa châ ta, chihropazy ta ama châ hnia awpa châ vei.
Izarei sawzy chô liata hiehâhna a y khao lei nawpa ta, nâmo ta supathaihpa nata maisâh liata maophaohna zydua cha nama chaba khai aw.

Pachâ teh u, kei tlai ta nama unawhpa Livai pathlazy cha Izarei sawzy hry tawhta a tlyh ei na ta, ahmaohna poh o liata chakaona rai hria awpa ta, âmo cha Khazohpa lâta hmosaipiepa châta nama hnohta ei cha pie ei.

Nâ nata na hnohta a ypa na sawchapawzy ta maisâh nata pohraipa chhôh liata theihthaina rai hria awpa zydua hria thei aw ei chi ta, nama chakao aw. Theihthaipa chakaona raihria cha, hmosaipiepa ta nama hnohta cha pie ei na ta, chihropa a vaw hniapa maih cha thie awpa ama châ,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Arawna hnohta, “Moh teh, Izarei sawzy ta chalopa hlâna ta kei lâta hmohlâpa pathaihpa ama hlâpa zydua nâ nata na sawchapawzy châta chhâzaw tovyuh ta ei cha pie ei.

Mei ta rao leipa hmohlâpa pathaihpazy cha na tovyuh a châ aw. Ama hmohlâpa to na tovyuh châ aw ta, ama niepa hlânazy, ama moleina hlânazy nata ama thaileichâna hlânazy cha nâ nata na sawzy châta nama tovyuh hmo pathaihpa a châ aw.
Su pathaih chaipa liata nie aw chi ta, chapaw zydua ta ama nie thei aw. Na châta hmo pathaihpa a châ.

“Hezy chhao na tovyuh a châ: Ama chalopa hlâna hmopiepa nata Izarei sawzy chaluahpa hlâna zydua cha, nâ nata na hnohta a ypa na sawchapawzy nata na sawchanôzy hnohta chhâzaw ta nama tovyuh châta ei cha pie ei. Na o liata chyhsa pathaihpa maihta ama nie thei aw.
Abeipa lâta ama hlâpa sathaw pha chaipa, kresawhti pha chaipa, sâh pha chaipa nata thei hmiatua chaipazy ei cha pie.
Ama râh liata a ypa zydua hry liata theilâpa a hmoh tua chaipa, Abeipa châta ama vaw cheipa cha, nâ eih châ aw ta, na o liata chyhsa pathaihpa zydua ta ama nie thei aw.
Izarei râh liata hmohlâpa zydua nâ eih a châ aw.

Chhi a pahypa, chyhsapa chhao, sahroh chhao, Abeipa lâta ama hlâpa maih nâ eih a châ aw. Chyhsapa sawchapaw uhtheipa deikua chatlai aw chi ta, sahroh pathaih leipa a pataw tua chaipa chhao na chatlai aw.
Chatlai awpazy cha thla kha a châ nahta, supathaihpa sekel reizie ta reipa ta, sekel tlaw pangawh ta na chatlai aw ei. Sekel tlaw kha cha kerâ miakih a châ.

Viahchao a pataw tuapa, mietaku a pataw tuapa nata mie a pataw tuapazy deikua cha, pathaihpa ama châpa vâta na chatlai awpa châ vei. Ama thisaih maisâh liata thia aw chi ta, mei ta hmohlâpa châta ama thawzy mei ta na rao aw. Cha cha Abeipa châta ropahâhpa a châ aw.
Chaluahpa hlâna palôh nata phei chachâh lâ cha na tovyuh a châpa hawhta, sa pathaihpa a pataw tuapa atheihna sazy chhao na tovyuh a châ aw.

Izarei sawzy ta chalopa hlâna ta Abeipa lâta ama hlâpa hmo pathaihpa zydua cha, nâ nata na sawchapawzy nata na sawchanôzy hnohta chhâzaw ta nama tovyuh châta ei cha pie ei. Cha cha nâ nata na hnohta a ypa na sawchapawzy nata na sawchanôzy châta, Abeipa hmiakô liata chhâzaw alôh biehrai a châ aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Arawna hnohta, “Ama râh liata ryuto hnei leipa aw chi ta, ama hry liata tovyuh hnei hra aw va chi. Izarei sawzy hry ta na tovyuh nata na ryuto cha kei he ei châ.
Ahmaohna poh o liata chakaona rai ama hriana lymâ châta, Izarei râh liata su hrawh su kha zydua Livai chizy hnohta ama ryuto châta ei pie ei.
Tahmâ tawhta cha, Izarei sawzy ta ahmaohna poh o amâ hnia awpa châ khao vei. Chataleipatala ama moleina ty phaohpa ta ama thi pathlei aw.

Ahmaohna poh o chakaona rai cha, Livai pathlazy ta hria aw ei ta, ama paraona maoh âmo ta ama phaoh aw. He he nama chhâ zydua châta bieraopa a châ aw: Livai pathlazy cha Izarei sawzy hry liata ryuto hnei aw veih ei.

Izarei sawzy ta su hrawh su kha Abeipa lâta chalopa hlâna ta ama hlâpa cha, Livai pathlazy hnohta ama ryuto châta ei pie. Chavâta ama hnohta ‘Izarei sawzy hry liata ryuto hnei aw veih ei’ ei tahpa a châ,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi chho ta,

“Cha dei châ leipa ta, Livai pathlazy chho la, ama hnohta, ‘Nama ryuto châta Izarei sawzy su hrawh su kha ei cha piepa ei âmo tawhta nama dao tita, cha su hrawh su khapa tawhta su hrawh su kha Abeipa lâ nama hlâ pachhuah heih awpa a châ.
Cha hmohlâpa cha, sawhri liata sâh nata kresawhti saohna tawhta kresawhti a puapa hawhta nama châta pachâpa a châ aw.

Cha hawhna chata Izarei sawzy tawhta su hrawh su kha nama topa zydua tawhta Abeipa lâta nama pie pachhuah awpa châ ta, cha su hrawh su kha tawhta Abeipa tovyuh nama pananopa cha theihthaipa Arawna nama pie aw.
Nama hnohta hmopiepa zydua tawhta a pha chaipa nata a pathaih chaipazy cha Abeipa tovyuh châta nama hlâ lymâ aw.

Chavâta Livai pathlazy hnohta hetana heta na tah aw: “Nama daopa tawhta a pha chaipa nama hlâ tita, cha cha Livai pathlazy châta sawhri liata kôvei phana ta pachâpa châ aw ta, kresawhti saohna liata kôvei phana ta pachâpa a châ aw.
Cha cha ahmaohna poh o liata nama hriana lymâ châ ta, nâmo nata nama chhôhkhazy ta khataih su lia rai ta nama nie thei aw.

A pha chaipa nama hlâ khiahta cha, su hrawh su kha kyh liata moleina maoh phaoh leipa aw ei chi ta, Izarei sawzy hmohlâpa pathaihpa papuapalei hra leipa aw ei chi ta, thi aw veih ei chi,” tah mah y,’” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi nata Arawna hnohta,
“He he Abeipa biepiepa ryhpa bieraopazy a châ: Izarei sawzy hnohta viahchao zeinô saihpa, pihpasina hnei leipa, seina hnei leipa nata raopaky a kyh beih leipa nâ lâ a vaw chhi awpa ta chho teh.
Viahchao zeinô cha theihthaipa Eliaza pie aw chi ta, riehmo khôtho lâ a chhipa châ aw ta, theihthaipa hmiakô liata thie awpa a châ.
Theihthaipa Eliaza ta a kudy ta a thisaih la aw ta, ahmaohna poh o hmia lâta ei sari a thia aw.
Cha khai tawhta viahchao zeinô cha a mohmô liata rao awpa châ ta, a vo, a sapa, a thisaih nata a ie zy rao khai ha awpa a châ.
Theihthaipa ta sidy tho, hisaw nata pala nohsaihpa la aw ta, viahchao zeinô raona mei liata a phôh aw.
Theihthaipa cha a chysiazy pasu aw ta, ti liata a ngai a si aw ta, cha khai tawhta riehmo lâ â di aw. Châhrasala theihthaipa cha zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw.
A raotuhpa chhao ti ta a chysiazy pasu aw ta, ti liata a ngai a si aw ta, zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ hra aw.

Chyhsa pathaihpa pakha ta viahchao zeinô raona paoh cha la aw ta, riehmo khôtho liata su sithaipa liata a soh aw. Cha cha Izarei zawpizy châta apathaina ti ta hmâ awpa ta paso awpa châ ta, moleina tawhta pathaisana châta a châ aw.
Viahchao zeinô raona paoh a pakhytuhpa chhao a chysiazy pasu aw ta, zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw. Cha cha Izarei sawzy nata chihropa ama hnohta a pahrâpazy châta chhâzaw bieraopa a châ aw.
“Athihpa ri a hriapa maih noh sari chhôh pathaih leipa a châ aw.
Noh thôhna noh nata noh sarina noh liata apathaina ti ta a pathai aw ta, chatanachata a pathaih aw. Noh thôhna noh nata a noh sarina noh liata â pathai vei khiahta deikua cha, pathaih aw vei.

Athihpa ri a hriapa maih, kheihawhpa chyhsa ri rai châ sala, â pathai vei khiahta cha, Abeipa achhyna byureih a papuapaleipa châ ta, cha chyhsa cha Izarei tawhta chhawh pathlahpa a châ aw. Apathaina ti a chô liata thiapa a châ leipa vâta, pathaih leipa châ ta, a pathaih leina a chô liata a y thlâh ha chypa a châ.
“He he poh o liata athipa ama y tita ryhpa awpa a châ: Poh o liata a ngiapa nata poh o chhôh liata a ypa maih noh sari chhôh pathaih leipa ama châ aw.
Hmobaoh a pahypa, a chhiehru ta chhiehruh leipa maih pathaih leipa a châ hra.
Ahy rai lyurâhpa liata zaozi ta thiepa tlyma, pihthi ta a thipa tlyma, chyhsa rupa tlyma, thlâ tlyma a hriapa maih cha, noh sari chhôh pathaih leipa a châ aw.
Pathaih leipa châna chata raopa hlâna meipaoh la aw ei ta, beih liata soh aw ei ta, chavah ti pathaihpa ama bao aw.

Chyhsa pathaihpa ta hisaw la aw ta, ti liata ny aw ta, poh o nata hmobaoh zydua chô liata nata a chhôh liata a ypa chyhsazy chô liata a thia aw. Rupa tlyma, thiepa ri tlyma, athihpa ri tlyma, thlâ tlyma a hriapazy chô liata a thia hra aw.

Chyhsa pathaihpa ta chyhsa pathaih leipa chô liata, apathaina ti cha noh thôhna noh nata noh sarina nohzy liata thia aw ta, noh sarina noh ta a pathaisa aw. A chysiazy pasu aw ta, ti liata a ngai a si aw ta, zâlâ ta a vaw pathaih ha aw.

“Chyhsa pathaih leipa cha â pathai leipa khiahta cha, cha chyhsa cha Abeipa supathaihpa a papuapaleipa a châpa vâta, zawpi tawhta chhawh pathlahpa a châ aw. Apathaina ti ta thiapa a châ leipa vâta pathaih leipa a châ.
He he ama châta chhâzaw bieraopa a châ aw: Apathaina ti a thiatuhpa maih a chysiazy pasu aw ta, apathaina ti a hriapa cha zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw.
Chyhsa pathaih leipa ta hmo a hriapa maih pathaih leipa châ aw ta, cha hmo pathaih leipa a hriapa cha zâlâ taih pathaih leipa a châ aw,” tah ta.
Izarei sawzy cha, thla khana liata ama zydua ta Zini râhchawhpa tlô ei ta. Zawpizy cha Kâdesâ liata y ei ta. Cha liata Miria thi ta, cha liata ama pabu.
Zawpi châta ti y leipa ta. Chavâta Mawsi nata Arawna chakhia awpa ta zawpi a hmaohpakhy ei ta.
Zawpi ta Mawsi cha a hryuh ei ta, a hnohta, “ Abeipa hmiakô liata eima unawhzy ama thi nona khata, keimo chhao vaw thi ha hra sih la a pha via awpa tlai!
Khazia Abeipa chyhsa zawpizy he, keimo nata eima sahrohzy chhaota thi khai awpa ta, he râhchawhpa lâ he miah nâ vaw chhi?
Khâpa vâta ma Izi râh tawhta miah kaw puakhei chi ta, he râh pha leipa lâ he miah nâ kaw chhi? Sâhzy, theikuzy, kre zôhzy, pawmikarânâzy y leina su châ ta, ti do awpa chhao y vei,” tah ei ta.
Mawsi nata Arawna cha zawpi mohmô tawhta pua ei ta, ahmaohna poh o chhikao lâ vawh ei ta, cha liata â khu lâta pao ei ta. Abeipa rônahna ama hnohta a vaw luah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,

“Chôchahrei la la, nâ nata na unawhpa Arawna ta zawpizy pahmaoh u la, ti papua awpa ta, ama mohmô liata lôpanô chho mah y. Lôpanô tawhta ti a puapa cha âmo lâ cheih aw chi ta, zawpi nata ama sahrohzy cha ti do awpa na pie aw ei,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta bie a piepa hawhta, Mawsi ta chôchahrei cha Abeipa hmiakô tawhta la ta.
Mawsi nata Arawna ta zawpizy cha lôpanô hmiakô liata pahmaoh ei ta. Mawsi ta ama hnohta, “Nâmo, chhorupa saih u, tahmâ nathlie teh u, he lôpanô tawhna heta ma ti eima cha thaipa aw?” tah ta.
Mawsi cha a ku hy ta, a chôchahrei ta lôpanô cha ei no tu ta. Ti thata vaw pua ta, zawpi nata ama sahrohzy ta ti cha doh ei ta.

Châhrasala Abeipa ta Mawsi nata Arawna hnohta, “Na ngâ leipa ei chi ta, ei pathaihna hawhta Izarei sawzy mohmô liata eina palyupalih leipa vâ ei chi ta, he zawpizy he âmo ei piepa râh tlôkhei aw veih ei chi,” tah ta.
Cha cha Meribâ tizy châ ta, cha liata Izarei sawzy ta Abeipa a hryuh ei ta, Abeipa ta ti hmâpa ta ama hry liata â palyupalihna su a châ.
Mawsi ta Kâdesâ tawhta Edômâ bei lâ lyuhchâpa tuah ta, “Na unawhpa Izarei ta hetana heta a tah: Eima chô liata rairuna a tlôpa zydua na pahno khai.
Miah pathlatuhpazy Izi râh lâ zu ei ta, Izi râh liata bohpi pahrâ pi ta, Izi mo ta keimo nata miah pathlatuhpazy miah ama taochhiezie kha na pahno.
Abeipa pado pi ta, ano ta eima ao thei ta, vâlyuhchâpa vaw tuah ta, Izi râh tawhta miah â chhi papua haw. Tahmâ he na râh kiah liata Kâdesâ khihpi liata eima y.

Ngiachhiepa ta na râh siepahlie awpa miah pasai mah y. Lyu tlyma, kre sadô tlyma, siepahlie leipa aw pi ta, tikhaoh tizy doh hra aw ma pi. Abei Lâlai liata sie aw pi ta, na râh eima khô hlâlei cha, chachâh lâ tlyma, chavei lâ tlyma tlei aw ma pi,” tah ta.
Châhrasala Edômâ ta a hnohta, “Ei râh na siepahlie awpa châ vei. Na siepahlie khiahta cha, zaozi chhaota vaw thyu aw na ta, ei châ dyuh aw,” tah ta.

Izarei sawzy ta Edômâ hnohta, “Lâlai a chhih aw pi ta, keimo nata eima sahrohzy ta na ti eima doh khiahta cha, a mâ eima cha pie aw. Hmo hropa khâpa hmah tao aw ma pi. Phei ta siepahlie awpa rie miah pasaih mah y,” tah ei ta.
Ano ta, “Siepahlie aw veih ei chi,” tah ta. Chatanachata Edômâ cha Izarei sawzy a dyuh awpa ta pheisaih thatlôpa hluhpi chhaota vaw pua ta.
Edômâ ta Izarei cha a râh siepahlie awpa a pasai leipa vâta, Izarei cha Edômâ tawhta a lie ha ta.
Izarei sawzy cha, ama zydua ta Kâdesâ tawhta pua ei ta, Hôri Tlâh kei tlô ei ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi nata Arawna cha Edômâ râhri khô liata a ypa Hôri Tlâh liata bie a chho ta, ama hnohta,
“Arawna cha a chiheihzy hnohta pahlyhpa a châ aw. Meribâ tizy liata ei biepiepa namâ dyuhpa vâna khata, Izarei sawzy ei piepa râh liata a ngia aw vei.
Arawna nata a sawchapawpa Eliaza kha a chhi la, Hôri Tlâh lâ khykhei teh.
Arawna chysiazy kha pahluh la, a sawchapawpa Eliaza paky mah y. Arawna cha a chiheihzy hnohta pahlyhpa châ aw ta, cha liata a thi aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa biepiepa hawhta Mawsi ta tao ta. Zawpi zydua mohmô ta Hôri Tlâh lâ cha khy ei ta.
Mawsi ta Arawna chysiazy cha pahluh ta, a sawchapawpa Eliaza paky ta. Chatanachata Arawna cha tlâh laki liata thi ha ta. Mawsi nata Eliaza cha tlâh tawhta za chô ei ta.
Arawna a thi haw tahpa zawpi ta ama pahno nahta, Izarei pathla zydua ta noh sythôh mâchhiesa ei ta.
Neke liata a pahrâpa Kâna chyhsa Aradâ bei ta Izarei cha Athari lâpi lâ tawhta a vaw sie tahpa thei ta. Aradâ bei ta Izarei cha a dyuh ta, Izarei saw thokha sei ta patu ta.
Chatawhcha Izarei ta Abeipa lâta bietai tao ta, “He phopi he ei ku liata eina pie khiah chi ta cha, ama khihpizy tlokhuh ei pahleipadia khai aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Izarei ao cha thei ta, Kâna mo cha a ku liata pie ta. Chatanachata a chyhsazy nata ama khihpizy cha tlokhuh ama pahleipadia khai haw. Chavâta cha su moh cha Hômâ bipa a châ.
Izarei sawzy cha Hôri Tlâh tawhta pua ei ta, Edômâ râh chahrihpa ta Tilaipi Saihpa pangaina lâpi lâta chahlô ei ta. Zawpizy cha lâpi liata ama palôh chhâ kaw ta.

Zawpizy ta Khazohpa nata Mawsi chakhiapa ta bie reih ei ta, “Khazia râhchawhpa liata thi awpa ta Izi râh tawhta miah namâ kaw chhi papua? Viahchhâ y va, ti chhao y va, he pati pasichhihpa he miah a ai tu ha bâ,” tah ei ta.
Chatawhcha Abeipa ta zawpizy hry liata parih châmaih thatlôpazy tuah ta, chyhsazy pachu ei ta, Izarei chyhsa hluhpi thi ei ta.

Zawpizy cha Mawsi lâ vawh ei ta, a hnohta, “ Abeipa nata nâma chakhiapa ta bie reih pi ta, eima vaw molei ha na. Abeipa lâ thlah miah chhâpa la, parihzy he keimo tawhta la awpa ta miah hiapa teh,” tah ei ta. Chatanachata Mawsi ta zawpizy châta thlahchhâ ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Parih châmaih thatlôpa nothlahpa tao la, atôh liata chaluah mah y. Parih pachupa maihta cha cha ama mo khiahta cha, ama hroh aw,” tah ta.
Cha hawhna chata Mawsi ta dawh parih tao ta, atôh liata chaluah ta. Parih pachupa maihta dawh parih cha ama moh nahta, hroh lymâ ei ta.
Izarei sawzy cha sie lymâ ei ta, Ôbô liata riehmo paryh ei ta.
Ôbô tawhta sie heih ei ta, Môabâ dady râhchawhpa liata nochhi lâ chhâh ta a ypa Iziabari liata riehmo paryh ei ta.
Cha tawhna chata sie heih ei ta, Zere saikao liata yna su paryh ei ta.

Cha tawhna chata sie heih ei ta, Anaw chavah haosâ lâta riehmo paryh ei ta. Anaw chavah cha Amawri mo râh saoh patluapa râhchawhpa liata a ypa a châ. Anaw chavah cha Môabâ râhri, Môabâ nata Amawri mo likawh râhri chavah a châ.
Chavâta Abeipa Adyuhnazy châbu liata, “Supha liata Vâhe nata Anaw saikaozy cha,
A saikao pâdawhzy ta Ari su tlô ta, Môabâ râhri taih a kawh,” tahpa ta reipa a châ.
Cha su tawhta Be khihpi lâ sie ei ta. Be cha tikhaoh tahna châ ta, Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Zawpizy awpakhy la, ti ei pie aw ei,” a tahna su kha a châ.
Chavâta Izarei ta hetana heta hla a sa: “Hy tikhaoh, ti kaw pali mah y! Tikhaoh lâ hla sa teh u!
Ryureina chôchahrei nata sômasi hmâpa ta, Beizy chaopa tikhaoh lâ hla sa u la, Râh chhituhpazy reipa tikhaoh lâ hla sa teh u!” Izarei sawzy cha râhchawhpa tawhta Matânâ lâ sie ei ta.
Matânâ tawhta Nâhalie lâta, Nâhalie tawhta Bamô lâta,
Bamô tawhta Môabâ lyu liata saikao nata râhchawhpa lâ a heihpa Piskâ tlâh laki lâ ama sie.
Izarei ta Amawri bei Sihaw lâ chyhsa tuah ta,

“Na râh siepahlie eina pasai awpa chi ta ei châ haw. Lyu lâ tlyma kre sadô lâ tlyma tlei leipa aw pi ta, tikhaoh ti chhao doh hra aw ma pi. Na râh eima khô hlâlei Abei Lâlai liata eima sie aw,” tahpa ta kei pachhosa ta.

Châhrasala Sihaw ta a râh siepahlie awpa ta Izarei cha pasai leipa ta. A pheisaih zydua awpakhy ta, Izarei a dyuh awpa ta râhchawhpa lâ tlao pua ha ta. Zahâza kei tlô ta, cha liata Izarei cha a dyuh ta.
Izarei ta zaozi ta Sihaw cha thie ta, Sihaw râh cha Anaw tawhta Zabaw taih la ta, Amawna mo râhri tlôna taih la ta, Amawna mo râhri cha â ipa ta dôhpa châpa vâta.
Izarei ta khihpi zydua la khai ta. Chatanachata Izarei cha Amawri mo khihpi zydua nata Hesbaw nata a khitaw zydua liata pahrâ ta.
Hesbaw cha Amawri bei Sihaw khihpi châ ta, Sihaw cha Môabâ bei parohpa a dyuh ta, Anaw chavah taihta a râh zydua a latuhpa kha a châ.
Chavâta hla phituhpazy ta, “Hesbaw lâ a vy teh u, A khihpi paduapathipa châ sala, Sihaw khihpi cha paduapa châ mawh sy.
Hesbaw tawhta mei pua ta, Sihaw khihpi tawhta meipaleih a pua; Môabâ râh Ari khih kâ khai ta, Anaw su sâhpazy a palâ khai haw.
Hy Môabâ, na hu a po kaw dia! Hy Khemô phopi, paraopa na châ haw! A sawchapawzy viavipa ta tao ta, A sawchanôzy Amawri bei Sihaw hnohta sei ta a pie ei.
Chavâta âmo cha tlokhuh parao pi ta, Hesbaw nata Dibô zy leidia ei ta; Nôpha tawhta Medebâ taihta roryhrapa ta eima tao haw,” tahpa ta hla ama phi.
Chatanachata Izarei cha Amawri mo râh liata pahrâ ta.
Mawsi ta Zaze mohparu awpa ta chyhsa tuah ta, a khihzy la ei ta, cha liata a ypa Amawri mo cha ama pho haw.
Chatawhcha a lie ei ta, Bâsanâ lâpi lâta khy ei ta. Bâsanâ bei Ôkâ cha Izarei sawzy Edarei liata a dyuh awpa ta ano nata a chyhsa zydua chhaota pua ta.

Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Ano kha chi khah y, ano nata a chyhsa zydua nata a râh na ku liata ei cha pie haw. Hesbaw liata a ypa Amawri bei Sihaw chô liata na taopa hawhna khata ano chô liata chhao na tao aw,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Bâsanâ bei Ôkâ nata a sawchapawzy nata a chyhsa zydua cha, pakha hmah pahlôh leipa ta ama thie khai haw. A râh chhao ama hnei haw.
Izarei sawzy cha sie lymâ ei ta, Zawdâh khô lâ Zerikô dady liata Môabâ bypizy liata riehmo paryh ei ta.
Zipô sawchapawpa Bâlâka ta Amawri mo chô liata Izarei hmotaopa zydua pahno ta.
Môabâ ta Izarei sawzy cha, ama hluh ngaitapa vâta chi ngaita ta. Izarei sawzy vâta Môabâ cha nôpopa ta y ta.

Môabâ mo ta Midia machâzy hnohta, “He phopi heta, viahchao tôhpa ta sibiepa a bâpa hawhta, eima chheipâh liata chyhsa zydua ama bâ khai aw,” tah ei ta. Zipô sawchapawpa Bâlâka cha, cha daihti liata Môabâ bei châ ta.

Bâlâka ta a pina râh Chavah kiah Pethô khih liata a ypa Beô sawchapawpa Bâlâma lâ chyhsa tuah ta, a hnohta, “Izi râh tawhta phopi miakha kaw pua ei ta, leilô zydua bie khai ei ta, tahmâ keima dady liata ama pahrâ.

Ngiachhiepa ta a vy la, he chyhsazy he chhie na vaw sapa mah y. Kei châta ama tha a tlô tu haw. Chatanachata âmo cha pahnie thei aw ei na ta, he râh tawhta ei papua thei ngyu aw ei. Byhnâ na awpa maih byhnâ to ei ta, chhie na sapa maih chhiesapa ta ama y tyh tahpa ei pahno,” tah ta.
Môabâ machâzy nata Midia machâzy cha pachaona ty a cheipa ta pua ei ta. Bâlâma kô ama tlô nahta, Bâlâka bietapa cha chho ei ta.
Bâlâma ta ama hnohta, “Tazâ he liata a rie u la, Abeipa ta eina chhopa hawhta nama hnohta bie ei vaw tlôkhei aw,” tah ta. Chatanachata Môabâ beimachâzy cha Bâlâma hnohta a rie ei ta.
Khazohpa cha Bâlâma lâ a vy ta, “Na hnohta a ypa chyhsazy kha ahyzy ma ama châ?” tah ta.
Bâlâma ta Khazohpa hnohta, “Zipô sawchapawpa Môabâ bei Bâlâka ta ei hnohta,

‘Izi râh tawhta phopi miakha kaw pua ei ta, leilô zydua ama bie khai haw. Chavâta tahmâ a vy la, âmo cha chhie na sapa mah y. Chatanachata âmo cha a dyuh thei aw na ta, ei papua thei ngyu aw ei,’ tahpa ta chyhsa a vaw tuah,” tah ta.
Khazohpa ta Bâlâma hnohta, “Ama hnohta na sie awpa châ leipa ta, cha phopi cha chhie na sapa awpa châ hra vei. Âmo cha byhnâ a topa ama châ,” tah ta.
Bâlâma cha my ta thyu ta, Bâlâka beimachâzy hnohta, “Nama râh lâ a lie teh u. Nama hnohta ei sie awpa Abeipa ta pasaih vei,” tah ta.
Môabâ beimachâzy cha thyu ei ta, Bâlâka lâ a lie ei ta, a hnohta, “Bâlâma cha eima hnohta a vy khoh vei,” tah ei ta.
Bâlâka ta beimachâ hluh via, âmo hlâta zachhih viapazy tuah heih ta.
Bâlâma kô kei tlô ei ta, a hnohta, “Zipô sawchapawpa Bâlâka ta hetana heta a tah: ‘Kei lâ a vy awpa ta khâpa ta hmah cha pakhâ khah sy.
Chyhsa rônah ngaitapa ta cha tao aw na ta, ei hnohta na reipa maih ei tao aw. Chavâta a vy tlai la, he phopi he chhie na sapa mah y,’ a tah,” tah ei ta.

Châhrasala Bâlâma ta Bâlâka chakaotuhpazy cha a chhy ta, ama hnohta, “Bâlâka ta tâkâ nata ngôh ta a biepa a o taihta eina piepa chhao ta, Abeipa ei Khazohpa bie khô lâ cha, hmo chyhpa tlyma, hmo laipa tlyma, khâpa hmah tao thei va na.
Chavâta Abeipa ta ei hnohta bie a rei via awpa a y ma tahpa ei pahno thei nawpa ta, tazâ chhao, he liata a rie heih chy muh vy,” tah ta.

Cha zâ liata, Khazohpa cha Bâlâma lâ a vy heih ta, a hnohta, “Chyhsazy cha nâma dy awpa ta a vypa ama châ khiahta cha, thyu la, ama hnohta sie mah y. Anodeikua ei cha chhopa deita na tao awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Bâlâma cha mydi ta thyu ta, alâ ky padia ta, Môabâ beimachâzy hnohta sie ta.

Châhrasala a siepa vâta Khazohpa cha a pathi ia ta. Chavâta Bâlâma a dyuh awpa ta, Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa ta lâpi liata a vaw duakhâh ta. Bâlâma cha a alâ kiahpa ta sie ta, a chakaotuhpa pano a hnohta sie ei ta.
Alâ ta Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa cha zaozi chabapa ta lâpi liata â duapa hmô ta. Chavâta alâ cha lâpi tleipa ta lyurâhpa lâ sie ta. Bâlâma ta alâ cha lâpi lâ pakuasa a chhuahpa ta chhei ta.
Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa cha kre sadô diahpai nata diahpai likawh lâpi buahpa liata a vaw duah ta.
Alâ ta Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa a hmô nahta, diahpai cha kei chatôh ta, Bâlâma phei cha diahpai liata charieh ta. Chavâta Bâlâma ta alâ cha chhei heih ta.
Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa cha a khô via lâ vawh ta, su buahpa, chachâh lâ tlyma, chavei lâ tlyma, tleina y leina liata a vaw duah heih ta.
Alâ ta Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa a hmô nahta, Bâlâma cha a byukhei ha ta. Bâlâma cha a pathi ia ta, a chôchahrei ta alâ cha chhei ta.
Abeipa ta alâ pakah pahy ta, Bâlâma hnohta, “Na chô liata khâpa hmo tao na ta ma, ei thôh dua eina chhei chi?” tah ta.
Bâlâma ta alâ hnohta, “Eina pasipasawhpa vâ chi ta a châ. Zaozi a chaba chhochhi aw sah la, ei cha thie ha aw,” tah ta.
Alâ ta Bâlâma hnohta, “Kei he na hro chhôh zydua ta na kiah chi ta, tahmâ taihta na kiapa na alâ châ va na mâ? Kha hawhta ei cha tao beih ma?” tah ta. Ano ta, “Tao beih va chi,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Bâlâma cha a mo pavâsa ta, zaozi chabapa ta lâpi liata a duahpa Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa cha hmô ta. A bôh ta, a hmia alei lâ a khupa ta pao ta.
Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa ta Bâlâma hnohta, “Khazia na alâ kha ei thôh dua na chhei? Pachâ teh, na siena chhâpa kha ei hmiakô liata raona a châpa vâta, cha pakhâ awpa ta ei vaw pua.
Alâ ta cha na hmô ta, ei hmiakô liata ei thôh dua a tlei. Kei tawhta tlei vei mawh sala, ano pahlôh aw na ta, nâ ei cha thie ha bâ aw,” tah ta.

Bâlâma ta vâlyuhchâpa hnohta, “Ei vaw molei ha na. Na pakhâ awpa ta lâpi liata nâ vaw duah tahpa ei pahno leipa vâta a châ. Chavâta ei sie awpa he na hmiakô liata hmo pha leipa a châ khiahta cha, tahmâ he ei kua aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa ta Bâlâma hnohta, “Chyhsazy hnohta sie mah y. Anodeikua ei cha chhopa bie deita na reih awpa a châ,” tah ta. Chatanachata Bâlâma cha Bâlâka beimachâzy hnohta sie ta.
Bâlâka ta Bâlâma â vy tahpa a thei nahta, Anaw lâta ama râhri chhâna Môabâ khihpi taih kei dy ta.
Bâlâka ta Bâlâma hnohta, “Hmo chatliepa a châpa vâta ei cha vaw padysapa a châ. Khazia nâ vy khoh vei? Lymâ châ pie thei lei awpa hawhta ma eina pachâ chi?” tah ta.
Bâlâma ta Bâlâka hnohta, “Moh teh, nâ lâ ei vy ha hih! Châhrasala keima kho ta bie to rei theina biehneina hnei va na. Khazohpa ta ei pakah liata a sopa bie deita ei rei awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Bâlâma cha Bâlâka hnohta sie ta, Kiria-huzô khihpi tlô ei ta.
Bâlâka ta viahchao tôhpa nata mietaku ta atheihna hlâ ta. Atheihna sa cha Bâlâma nata a hnohta a ypa beimachâzy paphao ta.
A mylâ my ta Bâlâka ta Bâlâma cha a chhi ta, Bâlâ su sâhpazy lâ khykhei ta. Cha su tawhta Izarei zawpi yna su thokha cha hmô theipa châ ta.
Bâlâma ta Bâlâka hnohta, “He liata maisâh miasari na taopa la, viahchao tôhpa pô sari nata mietaku tôhpa pô sari nâ chhuanohpa teh,” tah ta.
Bâlâka ta Bâlâma reipa hawhta tao ta. Bâlâka nata Bâlâma ta maisâh to liata viahchao tôhpa pô kha nata mietaku tôhpa pô kha lymâ hlâ ei ta.

Bâlâma ta Bâlâka hnohta, “Raopa hlâna na hlâpa kiapâh liata a vaw duah la, kei deikua cha ânano ta kei y na ta, Abeipa a vy aw ta, einâ vaw tyh ngyu aw. Eina pahmôsapa maih ei cha chho aw,” tah ta. Chatanachata tlâh laki lâ khy ta.
Khazohpa ta Bâlâma cha a vaw tyh ta. Bâlâma ta a hnohta, “Maisâh miasari tao na ta, maisâh to liata viahchao tôhpa pô kha nata mietaku tôhpa pô kha lymâ ei hlâ haw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Bâlâma pakah liata bie soh ta, “Bâlâka lâ a lie la, hetana heta kei reih teh,” tah ta.
Bâlâma cha Bâlâka lâ a lie ta. Bâlâka cha Môabâ beimachâ zydua chhaota raopa hlâna kiapâh liata a vaw duah thlâh ha ta.

Bâlâma ta a bie daopa cha reih ta: “Aramia tawhta Bâlâka ta nâ vaw chhi ta, Nochhi tlâhpizy tawhta Môabâ bei ta einâ vaw chhi; ‘A vy la, Zakaw chhie na sapa teh, A vy la, Izarei thailei pachâsa teh!’ eina tah.
Khazohpa ta chhie a sapa leipa cha, Kheihta chhiesapa thei aw na ta; Khazohpa ta thailei a pachâsa leipa cha, Kheihta thailei ei pachâsa thei aw?
Lôkâhpa khi tawhta Izarei cha hmô na ta, Tlâh laki tawhta ano cha ei sai; Moh tua, ano dei ta a ypa phopi châ ta, Phopi hropazy hawhta â pachâ leipa phopi a cha!
Ahy ma Zakaw dohlei reih thei aw ta, Ahy ma Izarei doh khuh a paki thei aw? Mosiapa thipa hawhta thi sah la, Ano chhâna hawhta ei chhâna châ mawh sy!” tah ta.
Bâlâka ta Bâlâma hnohta, “Ei chô liata khâpa na tao? Ei chariahzy chhiesapa awpa ta châ chhi na ta, châhrasala byhnâ tlao na awpa ei,” tah ta.
Bâlâma ta a chhy ta, “ Abeipa ta ei pakah liata a sopa cha ei rei awpa châ vei mâ?” tah ta.

Bâlâka ta a hnohta, “Ngiachhiepa ta su hro lâ na vaw zi heih teh. Cha su tawhta na hmô thei aw ei. A rakhapa ta hmô aw chi ta, ama zydua ta deikua hmô aw va chi. Cha su tawhta âmo cha chhie na sapa mah y,” tah ta.
Zôphi lyu liata Piskâ tlâh laki lâ a chhi ta, maisâh miasari tao ta, maisâh to liata viahchao tôhpa pô kha nata mietaku tôhpa pô kha lymâ hlâ ta.
Bâlâma ta Bâlâka hnohta, “Hao liata Abeipa bie ei kei chho chhôh ta, raopa hlâna kiapâh liana heta a vaw duah thlâh ha mah y,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Bâlâma cha a vaw tyh ta, a pakah liata bie soh ta, “Bâlâka lâ a lie la, a hnohta hetana heta kei reih teh,” tah ta.
Bâlâma cha Bâlâka lâ vawh ta. Bâlâka cha raopa hlâna kiapâh liata a vaw duah thlâh ha ta. Môabâ beimachâzy a hnohta y ei ta. Bâlâka ta a hnohta, “ Abeipa ta khâpa ma a reih? tah ta.
Bâlâma ta a bie daopa cha thaoh ta, “Hy Bâlâka, thyu la, nathlie teh, Zipô sawchapawpa y, ei bie he nathlie mah y.
Khazohpa cha chyhsapa a châ leipa vâta, Haih beih leipa ta; Chyhsa sawchapawpa a châ leipa vâta, A palôh panano beih vei. A rei hapa tao leipa ta a y aw ma? A chho hapa patlô leipa ta a y aw ma?
Pachâ teh, Byhnâ aw awpa ta biepiepa ei dao; Byhnâ awpa ha ta, Panano thei khao va na.
Zakaw liata chhiena hmô leipa ta, Izarei liata tymâna hmô vei. Abeipa ama Khazohpa ama hnohta y ta, Ama Bei palyupalihna pyu ama hry liata a y.
Izi tawhta âmo a kaw chhi papuapa Khazohpa cha, Âmo châta chaoliah tôhpa ki hawhta a châ.
Dyuthaina ta Zakaw tiah leipa aw ta, Pachaona ta Izarei hria thei aw vei; Zakaw nata Izarei thâtih rei tita, Khazohpa hmotaopa kyh reih tyhpa a châ aw.

Moh tua, hao phopi huh! Chakeibarôhneipa panô hawhta thyu ta, Chakeibarôhneipa tôhpa hawhta â pathlua huh. A sa taipa a nie hlâlei a byu leipa aw ta, A thiepa thisaih a doh hlâlei a byu aw vei,” tah ta.
Bâlâka ta Bâlâma hnohta, “Âmo châta chhiesapa leipa la, byhnâ chhao awpa hra khah y,” tah ta.
Bâlâma ta Bâlâka a chhy ta, “‘ Abeipa ta a reipa zydua ei tao aw,’ tahpa cha chho va na ma?” tah ta.
Bâlâka ta Bâlâma hnohta, “A vy teh, su hro lâ ei châ chhi aw. Cha su chhâ ta cha Khazohpa palôh patlâh thei ngyu aw ta, cha tawhna chata âmo cha chhie eina sapa thei ngyu aw chi,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Bâlâka ta Bâlâma cha râhchawhpa lâ a heihpa Peô tlâh laki lâ a chhi ta.
Bâlâma ta Bâlâka hnohta, “He liata maisâh miasari na taopa la, viahchao tôhpa pô sari nata mietaku tôhpa pô sari nâ chhuanohpa teh,” tah ta.
Bâlâka ta Bâlâma reipa hawhta tao ta, maisâh to liata viahchao tôhpa pô kha nata mietaku tôhpa pô kha lymâ hlâ ta.
Izarei châta byhnâ awpa cha Abeipa a palysa tahpa Bâlâma ta a pahno nahta, a noh hro ta a tao tyhpa hawhta pachao awpa ta sie khao leipa ta, râhchawhpa lâ tlao a pangai haw.
Bâlâma cha mohmia pasaih ta, Izarei sawzy a chi chi ta riehmo ama paryhpa hmô ta. Khazohpa Thlahpa a chô liata vaw tlô ta,
chatanachata a bie daopa cha thaoh ta, “He he Beôrâ sawchapawpa Bâlâma bie daopa châ ta, Mo pavâsapa chyhsa bie daopa a châ.
Khazohpa biezy thei ta, Atotaotheipa aluahna hmô ta, Pao ta, mâ lâ hawhta y ta, Châhrasala a mo a padeih thlâhpa bie daopa a châ:
Hy Zakaw, na poh ozy â ngia kaw dia, Hy Izarei, na byureihzy â ngia kaw dia!
Saikao dia zualuapazy lyu ta, Chavah kiah liata sadôzy a lyu; Abeipa lopa tlôma-uzy lyu ta, Tizy kiah liata sidy thozy a lyu.
A chiahzy tawhta ti loh aw ta, Ti hluhpizy liata a chi a y aw; A bei cha Akâ hlâta rônah via aw ta, Â beinarâh cheihchalopa a châ aw.

Izarei cha Khazohpa ta Izi tawhta a kaw chhi papua ta, Ano châta chaoliah tôhpa ki hawhta a châ; A chariahpa râhzy palâ khai aw ta, Ama ruzy a tlawh ta pakeichheihpa ta, A châtaizy ta âmo a chhô pahlie aw.
Chakeibarôhneipa tôhpa hawhta a byu ta, Chakeibarôhneipa panô hawhta â zia; Ahy a pathyu ngâh aw? Byhnâ châ awpatuhpa cha byhnâ to sala, Chhie châ sapatuhpa cha chhiesapa châ mawh sy,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Bâlâka cha Bâlâma chô liata a pathi ia ta, a ku nata a ku thata a chô ta, Bâlâka ta Bâlâma hnohta, “Ei chariahpazy chhiesapa awpa ta cha aw na ta, pachâ teh, ei thôh dua byhnâ na awpa ei.
Chavâta tahmâ na o lâ a râ teh. Rônah ngaitapa ta cha tao awpa a chhuah na ta, châhrasala Abeipa ta na rônah awpa a cha pakhâ haw,” tah ta.
Bâlâma ta Bâlâka cha a chhy ta, “Kei lâta na vaw tuapa na chyhsazy hnohta,

‘Bâlâka ta tâkâ nata ngôh ta a biepa a o taihta eina piepa chhao ta, Abeipa bie khô lâ cha a phapa tlyma, a chhiepa tlyma, keima kho ta khâpa hmah tao thei va na. Abeipa ta a reipa deita ei reih aw,’ tah ha va na ma?
Tahmâ cha ei phopi lâ ei sie aw. A vy teh, noh a vaw tlô awpazy liata, he phopi ta na phopi chô liata ama tao awpa ei cha pahnosa aw,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Bâlâma ta a bie daopa cha thaoh ta, “He he Beôrâ sawchapawpa Bâlâma bie daopa châ ta, Mo pavâsapa chyhsa bie daopa a châ.
Khazohpa biezy thei ta, Chônôchaipa pahnona pahno ta, Atotaotheipa aluahna hmô ta, Pao ta, mâ lâ hawhta y ta, Châhrasala a mo a padeih thlâhpa bie daopa a châ:

Ano cha hmô na ta, Châhrasala tahmâ châ vei; Moh na ta, Châhrasala a hnia vei; Zakaw tawhta awhsi vaw pua aw ta, Izarei tawhta bei a vaw pua aw. Môabâ râh zydua pahnie aw ta, Sethâ saw zydua a pahleipadia khai aw.
Edômâ cha pahniepa châ aw ta, A chariahpazy ta Seirâ ama tiah aw; Izarei deikua a chhyu rili aw.
Zakaw tawhta bei vaw pua aw ta, Khihpizy liata laibâhpazy a pahleipadia aw,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Amale lâ a heih ta, a bie daopa thaoh ta, “Amale cha phopi hmiatuapa châ ta, A chhâna deikua tlokhuh leidiana a châ,” tah ta.
Keni mo lâ a heih ta, a bie daopa thaoh ta, “Na pahrâna su a i ta, Lôpanô liata bu na tu.
Châhrasala Asuria ta sei ta a châ chhi tita, Keni cha mei ta rao khaipa a châ aw,” tah ta.
A bie daopa thaoh heih ta, “Cha hmo cha Khazohpa ta a tao tita, Ahy a hroh thei aw tly?
Kiti tawhta balyhzy vaw tlô aw ta, Asuria a panawh aw; Ebe chhao panawh aw ta, Chhâzaw ta a leidia aw,” tah ta.
Cha khai tawhta Bâlâma cha thyu ta, a yna lâ sie ta, Bâlâka chhao cha a o lâ a di ha hra ta.
Siti liata Izarei a y nota, Izarei sawzy ta Môabâ chanôzy sihryhkhei ei ta.
Chanôzy ta ama khazohzy lâta atheihna hlânazy liata Izarei sawzy cha hrua ei ta. Izarei sawzy ta atheihnazy cha niepa ta, Môabâ khazohzy lâta a bôh ei ta.
Cha hawhna chata Izarei ta Peô liata Bâlâ nata azaona tao ta. Chavâta Izarei chô liata Abeipa pathi ia ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Izarei phopi chhituhpa zydua a chhi la, Abeipa pathiiana ru ngaitapa he Izarei chô tawhta a pai nawpa ta, âmo cha Abeipa hmiakô liata nohchhô sawhvaw ta paaosao teh,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Mawsi ta Izarei ryureituhpazy hnohta, “Peô liata Bâlâ nata azaona a taopa nama chyhsazy kha, nâmo tlai ta thie khai teh u,” tah ta.
Ahmaohna poh o chhikao liata ama cha hai nota, Izarei chyhsa pakha ta Midia chanô pakha Mawsi mohmô nata Izarei zawpi mohmô liata a o lâ a vaw chhi ta.
Theihthaipa Arawna sawchapawpa Eliaza sawchapawpa Phinehâ ta a hmô nahta, thyu ta, asei a la ta, zawpi hry tawhta pua ta.
Izarei chyhsa cha poh o chhôh lâ a ngiahnao ta, Izarei chyhsa nata chanô cha ama pano ta ama py liata a chô ta. Chatanachata potlana cha Izarei sawzy tawhta a pai haw.
Potlana liata a thipa zydua 24,000 ama châ.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,

“Theihthaipa Arawna sawchapawpa Eliaza sawchapawpa Phinehâ ta Izarei chô liata ei hiehâhna a papai haw. Ama chô liata ei hiatliana liata ano chhao a hia eina tliakhei hrapa vâta, ei hiatliana ta Izarei sawzy cha pahleipadia khao aw va na.
Chavâta a hnohta hetana heta chho teh, ‘A hnohta adyhna biehrai ei tao aw.
A Khazohpa châta a hiatlia ta, Izarei sawzy châta chatlaina a taopa vâta, cha cha ano nata a hnôhlâ ta a pathlazy châta chhâzaw ta theihthaipa châna biehrai a châ aw,’” tah ta.
Izarei chyhsa ama thiepa, Midia chanô nata hmaohkha ama thiepa moh cha Salu sawchapawpa Zimri châ ta, Simeôna chi liata pho kha hyutuhpa a châ.
Midia chanô ama thiepa moh cha Zuri sawchanô Kôzabi châ ta, Midia chi liata pho kha hyutuhpa sawchanô a châ.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Midia mo kha ama nô papo u la, thie teh u.

Peô kyh liata cha dôveipa ta nama nô cha papo ei ta. Peô vâta potlana a y nota ama sietanô Kôzabi, Midia hyutuhpa sawchanô cha thiepa châ ta, cha kyh liata chhao piehpie ngaitapa ta châ dôveituhpa ama châ,” tah ta.
Potlana a pai tawhta Abeipa ta Mawsi nata theihthaipa Arawna sawchapawpa Eliaza cha bie a chho ta, ama hnohta,
“Izarei chyhsa zydua maluh reih u la, kô kih tawhta chô lâ, a chhôh chhôh ta, Izarei râh liata a pahrâpa adyuhna lâ sie thei awpa zydua reih khai teh u,” tah ta.
Mawsi nata theihthaipa Eliaza ta Zerikô dady ta a ypa Zawdâh kiah liata Môabâ bypi liata Izarei sawzy cha bie chho ei ta, ama hnohta,
“ Abeipa ta Mawsi bie a piepa hawhta, kô kih tawhta chô lâ zydua maluh reih teh u,” tah ei ta. Hezy he Izi râh tawhta a kaw puapa Izarei sawzy ama châ.
Izarei sawchapaw uhtheipa cha Rubena châ ta, Rubena pathlazy cha, Hanô tawhta Hanô phozy, Pâluh tawhta Pâluh phozy;
Hezrô tawhta Hezrô phozy nata Kâmi tawhta Kâmi phozy ama châ.
Âmo cha Rubena pathla phozy châ ei ta, ama maluh rei theipa zydua cha 43,730 ama châ.
Pâluh sawchapawpa cha Eliabâ a châ.

Eliabâ sawchapawzy cha Nemua, Dâthâ nata Abirâ zy ama châ. Dâthâ nata Abirâ cha zawpi hry tawhta a tlyhpazy châ ei ta, Abeipa amâ dyuh nota, Kôrâ nata a pakaohpa ta Mawsi nata Arawna a chakhiapazy kha ama châ.
Alei ta a pakah â ta, âmo cha Kôrâ nata hmaohkha ta a palâ ha ei. Mei ta Kôrâ nata a py manôh 250 a kâsao nota, âmo chhao kâsao ta, zikyurâna ta ama vaw châ haw.
Kôrâ sawchapawzy deikua cha thi veih ei.
A pho pho ta reipa ta, Simeôna pathlazy cha, Nemua tawhta Nemua phozy, Zami tawhta Zami phozy, Zakhi tawhta Zakhi phozy;
Zerâ tawhta Zerâ phozy nata Sawla tawhta Sawla phozy ama châ.
Âmo cha Simeôna pathla phozy châ ei ta, ama zydua ta 22,200 ama châ.
A pho pho ta reipa ta, Kâdâ pathlazy cha, Zephô tawhta Zephô phozy, Hâki tawhta Hâki phozy, Suni tawhta Suni phozy;
Ôzni tawhta Ôzni phozy; Eri tawhta Eri phozy;
Arô tawhta Arô phozy nata Areli tawhta Areli phozy ama châ.
Âmo cha Kâdâ pathla phozy châ ei ta, ama maluh rei theipa zydua cha 40,500 ama châ.
Zudâh pathlazy cha Erâ nata Ônâ châ ei ta. Erâ nata Ônâ cha Kâna râh liata thi ha ei ta.
A pho pho ta reipa ta, Zudâh pathlazy cha, Selâh tawhta Selâh phozy; Phare tawhta Phare phozy nata Zerâ tawhta Zerâ phozy ama châ.
Phare pathlazy cha, Hezrô tawhta Hezrô phozy nata Hâmu tawhta Hâmu phozy ama châ.
Âmo cha Zudâh pathla phozy châ ei ta, ama maluh rei theipa zydua cha 76,500 ama châ.
A pho pho ta reipa ta, Iskâra pathlazy cha, Tola tawhta Tola phozy, Puvâ tawhta Puvâ phozy;
Zasu tawhta Zasu phozy nata Simrô tawhta Simrô phozy ama châ.
Âmo cha Iskâra pathla phozy châ ei ta, ama maluh rei theipa zydua cha 64,300 ama châ.
A pho pho ta reipa ta, Zebulawna pathlazy cha, Sere tawhta Sere phozy, Elaw tawhta Elaw phozy nata Zali tawhta Zali phozy ama châ.
Âmo cha Zebulawna pathla phozy châ ei ta, ama maluh rei theipa zydua cha 60,500 ama châ.
A pho pho ta reipa ta, Manase nata Epharai chizy tawhta a puapa Zawsi pathlazy cha, hezy he ama châ.
Manase sawchapawpa Mâkhi tawhta Mâkhi pho vaw pua ei ta, Mâkhi ta Kilia sa ta, Kilia tawhta Kilia pho ama vaw pua.
Kilia pathlazy châ, Izah tawhta Izah phozy, Hele tawhta Hele phozy;
Asrie tawhta Asrie phozy, Sekhe tawhta Sekhe phozy;
Semidâ tawhta Semidâ phozy nata Hepha tawhta Hepha phozy ama châ.
Hepha sawchapawpa Zelôphehâ cha sawchapaw hnei leipa ta, sawchanôzy deita hnei ta, Zelôphehâ sawchanôzy moh cha Mâhlâ, Noâh, Hôkalâ, Milkâ nata Tizah zy ama châ.
Âmo cha Manase pathla phozy châ ei ta, ama maluh rei theipa zydua cha 52,700 ama châ.
A pho pho ta reipa ta, Epharai pathlazy cha, Suthelâ tawhta Suthelâ phozy; Bekhe tawhta Bekhe phozy nata Tahâ tawhta Tahâ phozy ama châ.
Suthelâ pathla Erâni tawhta Erâni pho a vaw pua.
Âmo cha Epharai pathla phozy châ ei ta, ama maluh rei theipa zydua cha 32,500 ama châ. Chazy cha a pho pho ta reipa ta Zawsi pathlazy ama châ.
A pho pho ta reipa ta, Benzami pathlazy cha, Belâ tawhta Belâ phozy, Asbe tawhta Asbe phozy, Ahirami tawhta Ahirami phozy;
Sephupha tawhta Sephupha phozy nata Hupha tawhta Hupha phozy ama châ.
Belâ ta Aradâ nata Nâmâ sa ta, Aradâ tawhta Aradâ phozy vaw pua ta, Nâmâ tawhta Nâmâ phozy a vaw pua.
Âmo cha Benzami pathla phozy châ ei ta, ama maluh rei theipa zydua cha 45,600 ama châ.
A pho pho ta reipa ta, hezy he Dânâ pathlazy ama châ. Suhâ tawhta Suhâ phozy vaw pua ei ta, âmo cha a pho pho ta reipa ta, Dânâ pathlazy ama châ.
Suhâ pathla pho maluh rei theipa zydua cha 64,400 ama châ.
A pho pho ta reipa ta, Asera pathlazy cha, Imnâ tawhta Imnâ phozy, Isvi tawhta Isvi phozy nata Beriah tawhta Beriah phozy ama châ.
Beriah pathla Hebe tawhta Hebe phozy vaw pua ei ta, Malkie tawhta Malkie phozy ama vaw pua.
Asera ta sawchanô hnei ta, a moh cha Serâ a châ.
Âmo cha Asera pathla phozy châ ei ta, ama maluh rei theipa zydua cha 53,400 ama châ.
A pho pho ta reipa ta, Nâthalai pathlazy cha, Zazi tawhta Zazi phozy, Kuni tawhta Kuni phozy;
Zeze tawhta Zeze phozy nata Sile tawhta Sile phozy ama châ.
Âmo cha Nâthalai pathla phozy châ ei ta, ama maluh rei theipa zydua cha 45,400 ama châ.
Chazy cha Izarei saw maluh rei theipazy châ ei ta, ama zydua ta 601,730 ama châ.
Abeipa ta Mawsi chho ta:
“He sahlaozy hnohna heta ama maluh hawhta ryuto râh rai awpa a châ.
Maluh hluh viapa hnohta ryuto râh lai viapa pie aw chi ta, maluh chyh viapa hnohta ryuto râh chyh via na pie aw. Chi to hnohta ama maluh hluhnazie hawhta ryuto râh pie chyu awpa a châ.
Nuby a daopa ta râh cha rai awpa châ ta, ama pathlatuhpa chi moh ta râh cha ryuto châta ama to awpa a châ.
Nuby a daozie hawhta chi lai viapa nata chi chyh viapazy hnohta ryuto râh rai awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Hezy he a pho pho ta reipa Livai pathlazy ama châ: Kesao tawhta Kesao phozy, Kôhâ tawhta Kôhâ phozy nata Merâri tawhta Merâri phozy ama châ.
Libni phozy, Hebraw phozy, Mâhli phozy, Musi phozy nata Kôrâ phozy chhao Livai phozy ama châ hra. Kôhâ cha Amrâ paw châ ta,
Amrâ lapinô moh cha Livai sawchanô Zôkebe châ ta, Izi râh liata Livai ta a sapa a châ. Ano chata Amrâ liata Arawna nata Mawsi nata ama sietanô Miria zy a sa ei.
Arawna ta Nâdâ, Abihu, Eliaza nata Ithamâ sa ta.
Nâdâ nata Abihu deikua cha Abeipa hmiakô liata pasai leipa mei ama hlâ raruah nota ama thi haw.

Livai chi maluh rei theipa chapaw thla kha tawhta chô lâ zydua cha 23,000 ama châ. Âmo cha Izarei sawzy hry liata ryuto râh pie leipa ama châpa vâta, Izarei sawzy maluh reina liata rei pâpa châ veih ei.
Chazy cha Mawsi nata theihthaipa Eliaza rei theipa maluhzy châ ei ta, chazy cha Zerikô dady Zawdâh chavah kiah Môabâ bypi liata ama reipazy ama châ.
Chazy hry liana chata Sinai râhchawhpa liata Mawsi nata theihthaipa Arawna ta maluh ama vaw reipa Izarei sawzy pakha hmahta a hlao khao veih ei.
Abeipa ta, “Râhchawhpa liata ama thi thlyu awpa a châ,” a tah hapa vâta, Zephune sawchapawpa Kâlebâ nata Nunâ sawchapawpa Zawsua dei leipa ta cha, pakha hmah ahrohpa y veih ei.

Zelôphehâ sawchanôzy a vy ei ta. Zelôphehâ cha Hepha sawchapawpa châ ta, Hepha cha Kilia sawchapawpa châ ta, Kilia cha Mâkhi sawchapawpa châ ta, Mâkhi cha Manase sawchapawpa châ ta, Manase cha Zawsi sawchapawpa a châ. Zelôphehâ sawchanôzy cha Mâhlâ, Noâh, Hôkalâ nata Tizah zy ama châ.
Mawsi nata theihthaipa Eliaza nata beimachâzy nata zawpi zydua hmiakô liata ahmaohna poh o chhikao liata a kei duah ei ta, ama hnohta,
“Eima paw cha râhchawhpa liata thi ha ta, Abeipa a dyuh awpa ta a paraohpa ta a hmaohpakhypa Kôrâ py liata deikua a hlao vei. Ano moleina vâ tlai ta a thipa a châ. Sawchapaw hnei vei.
Sawchapaw a hnei leipa vâta, khazia eima paw moh cha a phoheihzy hry tawhta a lei aw? Eima paw unawhzy hry liata ryuto miah pie hra teh u,” tah ei ta.
Mawsi ta ama bie cha Abeipa hmiakô liata tlôkhei ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Zelôphehâ sawchanôzy reipa cha hmo dopa a châ. Ama paw unawhzy hry liata ama ryuto râh na pie hra awpa ei châ ta, ama paw ryuto râh cha âmo na pie awpa ei a châ.
Izarei sawzy hnohta, ‘Chyhsa ta sawchapaw hnei leipa ta a thi khiahta cha, a ryu cha a sawchanô nama pie awpa a châ.
Sawchanô a hnei vei khiahta cha, a ryu cha a unawhzy nama pie awpa a châ.
Unawh a hnei vei khiahta cha, a ryu cha a paw unawhzy nama pie awpa a châ.

A paw ta unawhzy a hnei vei khiahta cha, a ryu cha a pho liata a heinawh a hnia chaipa pie aw ei chi ta, ano ta a pakhy aw. Abeipa ta Mawsi bie a piepa hawhta, cha cha Izarei sawzy châta pachiana ryhpa a châ aw,’ tah mah y,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Abari tlâh lâ khi khy la, Izarei sawzy ei piepa râh cha kaw sai mah y.
Na hmô khai tawhta, na unawhpa Arawna a chiheihzy hnohta pahlyhpa a châpa hawhna khata, nâ chhao na chiheihzy hnohta pahlyhpa na châ aw.

Zini râhchawhpa liata zawpi ta einâ dyuh no ei ta, nâmo pano chhao ei biepiepa a dyuh hra ei chi ta, tizy kiah liata zawpi hmiakô liata eina palyupalih leipa vâ ei chi ta a châ,” tah ta. Cha tizy cha Zini râhchawhpa liata Kâdesâ liata Meribâ tizy a châ.
Mawsi ta Abeipa hnohta,
“Zawpizy he chhihtha awpa ta, Abeipa, chyhsa zydua thlahpa Khazohpa ta chyhsa pakha rao mawh sy.
Ano chata zawpizy hmia lâta pua aw ta, a tlôkhei aw ei. Zawpizy chhihtha aw ta, â ngiakhei aw ei. Chatanachata Abeipa chyhsa zawpizy cha vaituhpa hnei leipa mietaku hawhta y aw veih ei,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Nunâ sawchapawpa Zawsua, thlahpa ta a ylâhpa chyhsa kha a chhi la, a chô liata na ku pahnieh mah y.
Theihthaipa Eliaza nata zawpi zydua hmiakô liata paduasa aw chi ta, ama mohmô liata biehneina na pie aw.
Izarei zawpizy ta a rei amâ ngiah thei nawpa ta, na biehneina ano hnohta na hlâ aw.

Ano cha theihthaipa Eliaza hmiakô liata a duah aw ta, theihthaipa Eliaza ta Abeipa hmiakô liata Uri hmâpa ta pachiana bie a hiahripa tyh aw. Ano nata a hnohta a ypa Izarei zawpi zydua ano rei sai ta pua aw ei ta, ano rei sai ta amâ ngia aw,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta Abeipa biepiepa hawhta tao ta. Zawsua cha a chhi ta, Eliaza nata zawpi zydua hmiakô liata paduasa ta.
A chô liata a ku pahnieh ta, Mawsi hmâpa ta Abeipa biereipa hawhta biehneina cha pie ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Izarei sawzy biepie la ama hnohta hetana heta chho teh: ‘Kei lâta mei ta nama hlâ tyh awpa niepa hlânazy cha a daihti raopa liata nama hlâ tyh awpa a châ. Cha cha kei châta ropahâhpa a châ,’ tah ta.
He he mei ta hmohlâpa Abeipa lâta nama hlâ awpa a châ: Noh kha ta mietakutaw chapawpa kô khapa seina hnei leipa pô no lymâ ta, noh chareih ta raopa hlâna châta nama hlâ aw.
Mietakutaw pô kha my ta hlâ aw ei chi ta, pô kha zâlâ ta nama hlâ aw.
Niepa hlâna châta viahdie dipa kachu su hrawh su kha nata sathaw saohpa chhiehraôh ôh kha hlâ pâ awpa a châ.
Cha cha tao lymâ awpa raopa hlâna, Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpa ropahâhpa châ ta, Sinai Tlâh liata chahnao pa-ipa kha a châ.
Mietakutaw pô kha hlâna liata, dopa hlâna chhiehraôh ôh kha lymâ hlâ aw chi ta, Abeipa lâta dopa hlâna ta hlâ awpa kresawhti patapa cha su pathaihpa liata na patlai aw.
Zâlâ ta mietakutaw hropa hlâ aw chi ta, my ta na hlâpa niepa hlâna nata â chakaihpa dopa hlâna hawhna khata, Abeipa châta ropahâhpa mei ta hmohlâpa cha na hlâ aw.
“Pahânoh ta mietakutaw chapawpa, kô khapa seina hnei leipa pô no hlâ aw chi ta, â chakaihpa niepa hlâna châta viahdie dipa kachu su hrawh su no sathaw pahlaopa nata dopa hlâna na hlâ aw.
Cha cha Pahânoh maihta hlâ tyhpa raopa hlâna châ ta, raopa hlâna hlâ tyhpa nata â chakaihpa dopa hlâna thota hlâ awpa a châ.
“Nama thla thiehpa maihta, Abeipa lâta raopa hlâna, viahchao tôh dawpa pô no nata mietaku tôhpa pô kha nata mietakutaw chapawpa kô khapa seina hnei leipa pô sari nama hlâ tyh aw.
Viahchao tôhpa pô kha liata niepa hlâna châta viahdie dipa sathaw pahlaopa kachu su hrawh su thôh; mietaku tôhpa pô kha liata niepa hlâna viahdie dipa sathaw pahlaopa kachu su hrawh su no;
mietakutaw pô kha liata niepa hlâna châta viahdie dipa sathaw pahlaopa kachu su hrawh su kha zy cha raopa hlâna ropahâhpa, Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpa ta nama hlâ tyh aw.

Raopa hlâna ta â chakaihpa dopa hlâna châta, viahchao tôhpa pô kha liata kresawhti chhiehraôh ôh no châ aw ta, mietaku tôhpa pô kha liata chhiehraôh ôh kha nata khophie châ aw ta, mietakutaw pô kha liata chhiehraôh ôh kha a châ aw. Cha cha kô chhôh thla thiehpa maihta raopa hlâna hlâ awpa cha a châ.
Raopa hlâna hlâ tyhpa nata â chakaihpa dopa hlâna thota, Abeipa lâta moleina hlâna châta mie tôhpa pô kha nama hlâ aw.
“Thla khana, noh hrawh hleipalihna noh cha Abeipa zawpakhô kyhchhi a châ.
Cha thla, noh hrawh hleipangawhna noh cha kyhchhi noh châ ta, noh sari chhôh viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa nie awpa a châ.
Noh khana noh cha pakhypi pathaihpa châ aw ta, rai rupa nama hria awpa châ vei.
Mei ta hmohlâpa raopa hlâna deikua cha Abeipa lâ nama hlâ aw. Viahchao tôh dawpa pô no, mietaku tôhpa pô kha nata mietakutaw chapawpa kô khapa pô sari, seina hnei leipazy nama hlâ aw.
Raopa hlâna ta â chakaihpa niepa hlâna châta viahchao tôhpa pô kha liata viahdie dipa sathaw pahlaopa kachu su hrawh su thôh, mietaku tôhpa pô kha liata su hrawh su no,
mietakutaw pô saripazy châta mietakutaw pô kha liata su hrawh su kha lymâ ta nama hlâ aw.
Nama châta chatlaina tao nawpa ta moleina hlâna châta mie tôhpa pô kha nama hlâ aw.
Chazy cha my ta raopa hlâna nama hlâ tyhpa thota nama hlâ awpa a châ.

Cha hawhna chata Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpa niepa hlâna cha, noh sari chhôh, noh chareih ta nama hlâ aw. Cha cha Abeipa châta ropahâhpa châ ta, raopa hlâna hlâ tyhpa nata â chakaihpa dopa hlâna thota hlâ awpa a châ.
Noh sarina noh ta pakhypi pathaihpa hnei aw ei chi ta, rai rupa nama hria awpa châ vei.
“Nama hâta kyhchhi chhôh ta, Abeipa lâta niepa hlâna sâh thiehpa, thei hmiatuapazy nama hlâna noh ta, pakhypi pathaihpa hnei aw ei chi ta, rai rupa nama hria awpa châ vei.
Raopa hlâna ta viahchao tôh dawpa pô no, mietaku tôhpa pô kha, mietakutaw chapawpa kô khapa pô sari nama hlâ aw. Cha cha Abeipa châta ropahâhpa a châ.
Raona hlâna ta â chakaihpa niepa hlâna châta viahdie dipa sathaw pahlaopa cha, viahchao tôhpa pô kha liata kachu su hrawh su thôh, mietaku tôhpa pô kha liata su hrawh su no,
mietakutaw pô saripazy châta mietakutaw pô kha liata su hrawh su kha lymâ ta nama hlâ aw.
Nama châta chatlaina tao nawpa ta, mie tôhpa pô kha nama hlâ pâ aw.

Chazy cha raopa hlâna ta â chakaihpa dopa hlânazy chhaota pachhuahpanoh aw ei chi ta, raopa hlâna nata niepa hlâna hlâ tyhpazy thota hlâ awpazy a châ. Sahroh hlâ awpazy cha seina hnei leipazy ama châ awpa a châ.
“Thla sarina noh khana noh liata pakhypi pathaihpa hnei aw ei chi ta, rai rupa nama hria awpa châ vei. Nama châta chiahmiezy tôna noh a châ aw.
Raopa hlâna châta viahchao tôh dawpa pô kha, mietaku tôhpa pô kha, mietakutaw chapawpa kô khapa seina hnei leipa pô sari nama hlâ aw. Cha cha Abeipa châta ropahâhpa a châ aw.
Â chakaihpa niepa hlâna châta viahchao tôhpa pô kha liata viahdie dipa sathaw pahlaopa kachu su hrawh su thôh, mietaku tôhpa pô kha liata su hrawh su no,
mietakutaw pô saripazy châta pô kha liata su hrawh su kha lymâ ta nama hlâ aw.
Nama châta chatlaina tao nawpa ta, moleina hlâna mie tôhpa pô kha nama hlâ pâ aw.

Chazy cha, thla thieh raopa hlâna nata â chakaihpa niepa hlâna, raopa hlâna hlâ tyhpa nata â chakaihpa niepa hlâna nata dopa hlânazy thota, taozie awpa hawhta taopa ta, Abeipa châta ropahâhpa châta mei ta hmohlâpa hlâ awpazy a châ.
“Thla sarina noh hrawhna noh liata pakhypi pathaihpa nama hnei aw. Kâhvileipa ta y aw ei chi ta, khâpa rai hmah nama hria awpa châ vei.
Abeipa châta ropahâhpa raopa hlâna deikua cha hlâ aw ei chi ta, viahchao tôhpa pô kha, mietaku tôhpa pô kha, mietakutaw chapawpa kô khapa seina hnei leipa pô sari nama hlâ aw.
Â chakaihpa niepa hlâna châta viahchao tôhpa pô kha liata viahdie dipa sathaw pahlaopa kachu su hrawh su thôh, mietaku tôhpa pô kha liata su hrawh su no,
mietakutaw pô saripazy châta mietakutaw pô kha liata su hrawh su kha nama hlâ aw.

Moleina hlâna châta chhao mie tôhpa pô kha nama hlâ aw. Chazy cha chatlaina châta moleina hlâna nata raopa hlâna hlâ tyhpazy nata amâ chakaihpa niepa hlâna nata dopa hlânazy thota nama hlâ awpazy a châ.
“Thla sarina, noh hrawh hleipangawhna noh liata pakhypi pathaihpa hnei aw ei chi ta, rai rupa nama hria awpa châ vei. Abeipa châta noh sari chhôh kyhchhi nama hmâh aw.
Abeipa châta ropahâhpa, mei ta hmohlâpa raona hlâna viahchao tôh dawpa pô hrawh hleithôh, mietaku tôhpa pô no, mietakutaw chapawpa kô khapa seina hnei leipa pô hrawh hleipalih nama hlâ aw.

Amâ chakaihpa niepa hlâna châta hlâ awpa viahchao tôhpa pô hrawh hleithôh châta viahchao tôhpa pô kha liata viahdie dipa sathaw pahlaopa kachu su hrawh su thôh, mietaku tôhpa pô no châta mietaku tôhpa pô kha liata su hrawh su no,
mietakutaw pô hrawh hleipalih châta mietakutaw pô kha liata su hrawh su kha nama hlâ aw.
Moleina hlâna châta chhao mie tôhpa pô kha hlâ aw ei chi ta, chazy cha raopa hlâna hlâ tyhpa nata â chakaihpa niepa hlâna nata dopa hlânazy thota hlâ awpazy a châ.
“Noh nona liata viahchao tôh dawpa pô hrawh hleino, mietaku tôhpa pô no, mietakutaw chapawpa kô khapa seina hnei leipa pô hrawh hleipalih nama hlâ aw.
Amâ chakaihpa niepa hlâna nata dopa hlânazy cha, taozietyhpa nata sahroh hlâpa zie lymâ hawhta, viahchao tôhpa châta zy, mietaku tôhpa châta zy, mietakutaw châta zy nama hlâ aw.
Moleina hlâna châta chhao mie tôhpa pô kha hlâ aw ei chi ta, chazy cha raopa hlâna hlâ tyhpa nata â chakaihpa niepa hlâna nata dopa hlânazy thota hlâ awpazy a châ.
“Noh thôhna noh ta viahchao tôhpa pô hrawh hleikha, mietaku tôhpa pô no, mietakutaw chapawpa kô khapa seina hnei leipa pô hrawh hleipalih nama hlâ aw.
Amâ chakaihpa niepa hlâna nata dopa hlânazy cha, taozietyhpa nata sahroh hlâpa zie lymâ hawhta, viahchao tôhpa châta zy, mietaku tôhpa châta zy, mietakutaw châta zy nama hlâ aw.
Moleina hlâna châta chhao mie tôhpa pô kha hlâ aw ei chi ta, chazy cha raopa hlâna hlâ tyhpa nata â chakaihpa niepa hlâna nata dopa hlânazy thota hlâ awpazy a châ.
“Noh palihna noh ta viahchao tôhpa pô hrawh, mietaku tôhpa pô no, mietakutaw chapawpa kô khapa seina hnei leipa pô hrawh hleipalih nama hlâ aw.
Amâ chakaihpa niepa hlâna nata dopa hlânazy cha, taozietyhpa nata sahroh hlâpa zie lymâ hawhta, viahchao tôhpa châta zy, mietaku tôhpa châta zy, mietakutaw châta zy nama hlâ aw.
Moleina hlâna châta chhao mie tôhpa pô kha hlâ aw ei chi ta, chazy cha raopa hlâna hlâ tyhpa nata â chakaihpa niepa hlâna nata dopa hlânazy thota hlâ awpazy a châ.
“Noh pangawhna noh ta viahchao tôhpa pô chaki, mietaku tôhpa pô no, mietakutaw chapawpa kô khapa seina hnei leipa pô hrawh hleipalih nama hlâ aw.
Amâ chakaihpa niepa hlâna nata dopa hlânazy cha, taozietyhpa nata sahroh hlâpa zie lymâ hawhta, viahchao tôhpa châta zy, mietaku tôhpa châta zy, mietakutaw châta zy nama hlâ aw.
Moleina hlâna châta chhao mie tôhpa pô kha hlâ aw ei chi ta, chazy cha raopa hlâna hlâ tyhpa nata â chakaihpa niepa hlâna nata dopa hlânazy thota hlâ awpazy a châ.
“Noh charuna noh ta viahchao tôhpa pô charie, mietaku tôhpa pô no, mietakutaw chapawpa kô khapa seina hnei leipa pô hrawh hleipalih nama hlâ aw.
Amâ chakaihpa niepa hlâna nata dopa hlânazy cha, taozietyhpa nata sahroh hlâpa zie lymâ hawhta, viahchao tôhpa châta zy, mietaku tôhpa châta zy, mietakutaw châta zy nama hlâ aw.
Moleina hlâna châta chhao mie tôhpa pô kha hlâ aw ei chi ta, chazy cha raopa hlâna hlâ tyhpa nata â chakaihpa niepa hlâna nata dopa hlânazy thota hlâ awpazy a châ.
“Noh sarina noh ta viahchao tôhpa pô sari, mietaku tôhpa pô no, mietakutaw chapawpa kô khapa seina hnei leipa pô hrawh hleipalih nama hlâ aw.
Amâ chakaihpa niepa hlâna nata dopa hlânazy cha, taozietyhpa nata sahroh hlâpa zie lymâ hawhta, viahchao tôhpa châta zy, mietaku tôhpa châta zy, mietakutaw châta zy nama hlâ aw.
Moleina hlâna châta chhao mie tôhpa pô kha hlâ aw ei chi ta, chazy cha raopa hlâna hlâ tyhpa nata â chakaihpa niepa hlâna nata dopa hlânazy thota hlâ awpazy a châ.
“Noh chariena noh ta pakhypi pathaihpa hnei aw ei chi ta, rai rupa nama hria awpa châ vei.
Raopa hlâna ta viahchao tôhpa pô kha, mietaku tôhpa pô kha nata mietakutaw chapawpa kô khapa seina hnei leipa pô sari nama hlâ aw. Cha cha Abeipa châta ropahâhpa, mei ta hmohlâpa a châ.
Amâ chakaihpa niepa hlâna nata dopa hlânazy cha, taozietyhpa nata sahroh hlâpa zie lymâ hawhta, viahchao tôhpa châta zy, mietaku tôhpa châta zy, mietakutaw châta zy nama hlâ aw.
Moleina hlâna châta chhao mie tôhpa pô kha hlâ aw ei chi ta, chazy cha raopa hlâna hlâ tyhpa nata â chakaihpa niepa hlâna nata dopa hlânazy thota hlâ awpazy a châ.

“Nama bietai hmohlâpazy, nama lôhthai hmohlâpazy, nama raopa hlânazy, nama niepa hlânazy, nama dopa hlânazy nata nama aryhna hlânazy thota, chazy cha nama kyhchhi raopazy liata Abeipa lâ nama hlâ awpa a châ.”
Cha hawhna chata Mawsi ta Abeipa biepiepa zydua cha Izarei sawzy chho ta.
Mawsi ta Izarei chi hyutuhpazy chho ta, “He he Abeipa biepiepa a châ:
Chyhsa ta Abeipa liata bietai a tao khiahta tlyma, hmo tao awpa ta anosasyh â chahry khiahta tlyma, a bie a phie awpa châ vei. A pakah tawhta a puapa zydua hawhta a tao awpa a châ.
“Chanô laihsa ta a paw o liata a y thlâh ha nota, Abeipa liata bietai a tao khiahta tlyma, tao awpa ta anosasyh â chahry khiahta tlyma,
a bietai nata tao awpa ta anosasyh ta â chahrypa kyh cha a paw ta thei sala, â chalihsai thlâh ha khiahta cha, a bietai zydua nata tao awpa ta anosasyh ta â chahrypa zydua â duah aw.
Châhrasala a paw ta a thei nahta, a pakhâ ha khiahta cha, a bietai nata tao awpa ta anosasyh ta â chahrypazy miakha hmah a duah aw vei. A paw ta a pakhâ hapa vâta Abeipa ta â ngiahthai aw.
“Chanô ta a chô liata bietai a y thlâh ha nota tlyma, a hmao ta bie â taih chatlie tupa vâta anosasyh â chahryna daihti chhôh liata tlyma vahpa hnei sala,
a vahpa ta a bietai thâtih cha thei sala, a thei noh ta â chalihsai thlâh ha khiahta cha, a bietai cha a duah aw ta, tao awpa ta anosasyh â chahrypazy chhao â duah aw.

Châhrasala a vahpa ta a thei noh ta a pyh leipa sala a pakhâ ha khiahta cha, a lapinô chô liata bietai a ypa nata a hmao ta bie a taih chatlie tupa vâta anosasyh â chahrypazy cha, a vahpa ta pachhâsa aw ta, Abeipa ta â ngiahthai aw.
“Nôhmei tlyma, vahpa nata a chhaihpa chanô tlyma ta bietai a taopa nata tao awpa ta anosasyh â chahrypazy deikua cha, a chô liata â duah aw.
“Chanô ta a vahpa o liata a y thlâh ha nota bietai a tao khiahta tlyma, tao awpa ta anosasyh â chahry khiahta tlyma,
a vahpa ta thei sala, a chalihsaipa ta, a pakhâ leipa khiahta cha, a bietai zydua a duah aw ta, anosasyh ta â chahrypa zydua chhao â duah aw.

Châhrasala a vahpa ta a pahno noh ta, bie tloh leipa ta taopa ta, a pachhâsa ha khiahta cha, a hmao tawhta a puapa bietai tlyma, tao awpa ta anosasyh ta â chahrypa hmo tlyma a duah aw vei. A vahpa ta bie tloh leipa ta tao ha ta, Abeipa ta â ngiahthai aw.
Chanô bietai kheihawhpa tlyma, sasyh apakyna bietai chhao rai châ sala, a vahpa ta pa-i thei ta, a pachhâsa thei.

Châhrasala a vahpa ta, bietai kyh liata noh chareih â chalihsai thlâh ha khiahta cha, a lapinô bietai zydua nata tao awpa ta â chahrypa zydua cha a pa-ipa a châ. A pahno noh ta â chalihsai hapa vâta a pa-ipa a châ.
A thei noh tawhta daihti khachâ rakha ma a sie tawhta bie tloh leipa ta taopa ta, a pachhâsa khiahta cha, a vahpa ta a lapinô paraona maoh a phaoh aw,” tah ta.
Chazy cha chapaw nata a lapinô likah nata paw nata a sawchanô laihsa a paw o liata a y thlâh ha chypa likah liata bieraopa, Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta bie a piepazy cha a châ.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Midia mo chô liata Izarei sawzy phuh la teh. Cha khai tawhta na chiheihzy hnohta pahlyhpa na châ aw,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta zawpizy hnohta, “Midia mo chô liata Abeipa phuh lana patlôsa awpa ta sie awpa ta, nama hry liata chapawzy cha adyuhna chariah chhaichhi ta tobi teh u.
Izarei chi zydua ta chi kha tawhta sâh kha lymâ ta adyuhna lâ nama pasiesa awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Izarei saw sâh hluhpi hry tawhta chi kha tawhta sâh kha chyu papua ei ta, pheisaih thy kha nata sâh no cha, adyuhna lâta sie awpa ta chariah chhaichhi ta tobi ei ta.
