Mawsi ta âmo cha adyuhna lâ pasiesa ta, chi to hry tawhta sâh kha chyu pua ei ta, theihthaipa Eliaza sawchapawpa Phinehâ chhao, hmobaoh pathaihpazy nata biepie nawpa ta chiahmiezy chabapa ta adyuhna lâ sie hra ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi bie a piepa hawhta, Midia mo cha a dyuh ei ta, chapaw zydua ama thie khai haw.
Midia beizy chhao, ama chyhsa thiepazy hry liata thie pâ hra ei ta, Midia bei papangawh, Ivi, Reke, Zuri, Hurâ nata Rebâ nata Beô sawchapawpa Bâlâma chhao zaozi ta ama thie haw.
Izarei sawzy ta Midia chanôzy nata ama hawtizy cha sei ta a chhi ei ta, ama viahchao zydua, ama mietaku zydua nata ama hmobaoh zydua hraona sôh ta la ei ta.
Ama pahrâna khihpi zydua nata ama riehmo zydua mei ta rao khai ei ta.
Ama hraopa nata lapa zydua, chyhsapa chhao, sahroh chhao, ama siekhei haw.
Seizy, sahrohzy nata hraopazy cha, Zerikô dady Zawdâh kiapâh ta Môabâ bypi riehmo liata a ypa Mawsi nata theihthaipa Eliaza nata Izarei zawpizy lâ vaw tlô khei ei ta.
Mawsi nata theihthaipa Eliaza nata zawpi hyutuhpa zydua ta riehmo khôtho lâ kei dy ei ta.
Mawsi cha adyuhna chakaona rai lâ tawhta a vaw tlôpa pheisaih hyutuhpa, sâh kha chô liata hyutuhpazy nata za kha chô liata hyutuhpazy chô liata a pathi ia ta.
Mawsi ta ama hnohta, “Chanôzy cha ahrohpa ta ma nama pahlôh khai haw?
Pachâ teh u, âmo kha Bâlâma ryhraona ta Peô liata Izarei sawzy Abeipa chô liata paraona a pataosatuhpazy châ ei ta, âmo vâta Abeipa chyhsazy chô liata potlana a vaw tlôpa kha.
Chavâta tahmâ he chapaw hawti zydua kha thie khai u la, chapaw a ziakhei ta, a pahnopathei hapa chanô zydua chhao thie khai teh u.
Chapaw a ziakhei beih leipa nata a pahno pathei beih leipa chanô hawti zydua deikua cha, namâ pahlôh aw.
Riehmo khôtho lâ noh sari a rie aw ei chi ta, ahy rai chyhsa a thiepa nata ama thiepa a hriapa maih, nâmo chhao, nama seizy chhao, noh thôhna noh nata noh sarina noh ta namâ pathaisa aw.
Chysia to, savo ta taopa hmo to, mie hmi ta taopa hmo zydua nata tho ta taopa hmo zydua nama pathaisa khai aw,” tah ta.
Theihthaipa Eliaza ta adyuhna lâ a siepa pheisaihzy hnohta, “He he Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa ryhpa bieraopa a châ:
Ngôh, tâkâ, dawh, thua, râhvâ nata ky zy,

mei ta a parao thei leipa maih cha, mei liata pasiesa aw ei chi ta, chatanachata a vaw pathaih aw. Cha thota pathaisana ti ta pathaisa pâ awpa a châ. Mei ta a parao theipazy deikua cha, ti liata nama pasiesa aw.
Noh sarina noh ta nama chysiazy pasu aw ei chi ta, chatanachata nama pathaih ha aw. Cha khai tawhta riehmo lâ namâ ngia thei aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi chho ta,
“Nâ nata theihthaipa Eliaza nata zawpi hry tawhta chipho hyutuhpazy ta hraona sôh lapazy reih u la, chyhsapa chhao, sahroh chhao, reih khai teh u.
Hraona sôhzy cha adyuhna lâ a siepa pheisaihzy nata zawpi zydua rai awpa ta su no ta nama pachhaih aw.
Adyuhna lâ a siepa pheisaihzy tawhta Abeipa châta thyuna khei aw ei chi ta, za pangawh liata miakha lymâ ta, chyhsapazy, viahchaozy, alâzy, mietakuzy nama khei aw.
Nama kheipa khophie cha Abeipa tovyuh châ ta, theihthaipa Eliaza hnohta nama pie aw.

Izarei sawzy ta khophie ama topa tawhta, sypangawh liata miakha lymâ ta, chyhsapazy, viahchaozy, alâzy, mietakuzy, miezy nata sahroh zydua khei aw ei chi ta, Abeipa achhyna byureih mohôhtuhpa Livai chizy nama pie aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi bie a piepa hawhta, Mawsi nata theihthaipa Eliaza ta tao ei ta.
Pheisaihzy ta amâ lapa hraona sôh rei leipa ta, zawpi ta amâ lapa hraona sôh zydua cha, mietaku 675,000,
viahchao 72,000,
alâ 61,000 nata
chyhsa 32,000 a châ. Chyhsazy cha chapaw a ziakhei beih leipa nata a pahnopathei beih leipa chanôzy ama châ.
Adyuhna lâ a siepazy tovyuh awpa hraona sôh khophie liata mietaku 337,500 y ta,
cha tawhta Abeipa râhpaw cha mietaku 675 a châ.
Viahchao 36,000 y ta, cha tawhta Abeipa râhpaw cha viahchao 72 a châ.
Alâ 30,500 y ta, cha tawhta Abeipa râhpaw cha alâ 61 a châ.
Chyhsapa 16,000 y ei ta, cha tawhta Abeipa râhpaw cha 32 ama châ.
Abeipa ta Mawsi bie a piepa hawhta, Abeipa châta thyupa râhpaw cha, Mawsi ta theihthaipa Eliaza hnohta a pie.
Cha hawhna chata Mawsi ta hraona sôhzy cha, adyuhna lâ siepa pheisaihzy nata zawpizy châta khophie ta pachhaih ta, zawpi tovyuh cha,
mietaku 337,500,
viahchao 36,000,
alâ 30,500 nata
chyhsapa 16,000 a châ.

Abeipa ta Mawsi bie a piepa hawhta, Izarei sawzy ta khophie ama topa tawhta, Mawsi ta chyhsapa nata sahrohzy tawhta, sypangawh liata miakha lymâ ta la ta, Abeipa achhyna byureih mohôhtuhpa Livai chizy hnohta a pie ei.
Pheisaih sâh hluhpi chô liata hyutuhpazy, sâh kha hyutuhpazy nata za kha hyutuhpazy ta Mawsi a kei hnia ei ta,
Mawsi hnohta, “Châ chakaotuhpazy ta eima biehneina ry liata a ypa pheisaihzy maluh reih pi ta, eima hry liata pakha hmah a ki leipa y veih ei.

Tahmâ he eima hmôpa chyu tawhta, Abeipa châta eima thyuna ngôh hmobaohzy, karuzy, lâkyuzy, moh chahnaona kusadizy, rahyzy, pachhihzy cha eimâ chatlaina châta Abeipa hmiakô liata eima vaw cheih,” tah ei ta.
Mawsi nata theihthaipa Eliaza ta ngôh ta daipa hmobaoh zydua cha âmo tawhta a hlâh ei ta.
A sâh chô liata hyutuhpazy nata a za chô liata hyutuhpazy ta Abeipa lâta ngôh ama vaw hlâpa zydua cha sekel 16,750 a châ.
Pheisaihzy ta hraona sôh cha âmo châ chyu ta amâ vaw la hapa a châ.

Chatanachata Mawsi nata theihthaipa Eliaza ta a sâh chô liata hyutuhpazy nata a za chô liata hyutuhpazy tawhta ngôh cha a hlâh ei ta, Izarei sawzy ta Abeipa hmiakô liata amâ thei thlâh ha nawpa ta, ahmaohna poh o chhôh liata a ngiakhei ei ta.
Rubena nata Kâdâ pathlazy cha sahroh hluhpi hnei ei ta. Zaze râh nata Kilia râh hmô ei ta. A su cha sahroh châta su pha ngaitapa châ ta.
Kâdâ pathlazy nata Rubena pathlazy ta Mawsi nata theihthaipa Eliaza nata zawpi chhituhpazy hnohta,
“Atarô, Dibô, Zaze, Nimrâ, Hesbaw, Eliale, Sebâ, Nebô nata Biô râhzy cha,
Izarei zawpi hmiakô liata Abeipa ta a panawhpa râh, sahroh châta a pha ngaitapa râh a châ. Châ chakaotuhpazy he sahroh hnei pi ta.
Chavâta na mo eimâ dy khiahta cha, Zawdâh miah chakasa leipa la, ngiachhiepa ta he râh he eima pahrâ nawpa ta miah pie mah y,” tah ei ta.
Mawsi ta Kâdâ pathlazy nata Rubena pathlazy hnohta, “He liata nâmo a tyuh aw ei chi ta ma, nama unawhzy adyuhna lâ ama sie aw?
Khazia Abeipa ta âmo a piepa râh liata a ngia lei awpa ta Izarei sawzy palôh nama padua aw?
Châ pathlatuhpazy chhao ta, râh moh awpa ta Kâdesbânia tawhta ei tua no ei ta, cha hawhta ama tao hra.
Eskaw saikao ama tlô nahta, râh cha hmô ei ta, Abeipa piepa râh liata amâ ngia lei nawpa ta, Izarei sawzy palôh padua ei ta.
Cha noh liata, Abeipa cha a pathi ia ta, chhie sa ta,
‘Izi râh tawhta a kaw puapa, kô kih tawhta chô lâ chyhsazy cha, palôh tlokhuh ta eina zi leipa vâ ei ta, ahy hmah Abarahâ, Aisika nata Zakaw zy hnohta pie awpa ta bie ei taihpa râh hmô aw veih ei.
Keni chi Zephune sawchapawpa Kâlebâ nata Nunâ sawchapawpa Zawsua deikua cha, palôh tlokhuh ta Abeipa ama zipa vâta ama hmô aw,’ tah ta.
Abeipa cha Izarei chô liata a pathi ia ta, chavâta Abeipa mohmô ta hmo pha leipa a taotuhpa chhâ zydua ama leidia khai hlâlei, râhchawhpa liata kô sypalih chhôh a paviavisa ei.
Châ pathlatuhpazy kha moleipa pathlazy châ ei ta, nâmo chhao âmo su a thlapa ta, Izarei chô liata Abeipa pathiiana chichhihpa nama baichha via rili he zaw!
Abeipa pazina tawhta nama tleisai khiahta cha, Abeipa ta zawpizy he râhchawhpa liata siesai heih aw ta, he chyhsa zydua he nâmo ta nama pahleipadia khaipa a châ aw,” tah ta.
Kâdâ pathlazy nata Rubena pathlazy ta Mawsi cha a kei hnia ei ta, a hnohta, “He liata eima sahroh châta mietaku sadôzy nata eima sawzy châta khihpizy eima padua aw.

Keimo deikua cha, chariah chhaichhizy a tobi aw pi ta, Izarei sawzy ama pahrâ nawpa su eima tlôkhei hlâlei cha, ama hmia lâta eima sie aw. He râh liata a pahrâpa chyhsazy vâta, eima sawzy cha, thokhy ta dôhpa khihpizy liata ama pahrâ aw.
Izarei saw zydua ta ama ryuto râh ama to khai hlâlei eima o lâ a vaw lie aw ma pi.
Zawdâh hesâ nochhi lâ liana heta eima to awpa râh a ypa vâta, keimo cha Izarei sawzy hnohta Zawdâh haosâ nata a khô lâ râh to hra aw ma pi,” tah ei ta.
Mawsi ta ama hnohta, “Cha hawhta tao u la, chariah chhaichhi a tobipa ta Abeipa hmiakô ta adyuhna lâ sie teh u.
Chariah chhaichhi a tobipa maihta a chariahpazy a hmiakô tawhta papuapa a châ hlâlei cha, Abeipa hmiakô liata Zawdâh haosâ lâ y mawh sy.

Abeipa hmiakô liata râh nama la khai hlâlei namâ dyuh aw. Cha khai tawhta a vaw lie aw ei chi ta, Abeipa chô liata nata Izarei chô liata nama maophaohna nama chô liata y khao aw vei. Chatanachata he râh he Abeipa hmiakô liata nama ryuto râh a châ aw.
Cha hawhta nama tao leipa khiahta deikua cha, pachâ teh u, Abeipa chô liata moleipa châ aw ei chi ta, nama moleina ta a cha hmô papua aw ei tahpa pahno muh vy.
Nama sawzy châta khihpizy cha padua u la, nama mietakuzy châta sadôzy chhao cha tao u la, bie namâ taihpa hawhta tao teh u,” tah ta.
Kâdâ pathlazy nata Rubena pathlazy ta Mawsi hnohta, “Châ chakaotuhpazy heta eima zibeipa biepiepa hawhta eima tao aw.
Eima sawzy, eima lapinôzy, eima mietaku zawzy nata eima viahchao hri zydua Kilia khihpizy liata vaw y aw ei ta,
châ chakaotuhpazy deikua pi cha, eima zibeipa biepiepa hawhta, Zawdâh chaka aw pi ta, chariah chhaichhi a tobipa maihta Zawdâh cha Abeipa hmiakô liata eima chaka aw,” tah ei ta.
Chatanachata Mawsi ta Kâdâ nata Rubena pathlazy kyh liata, theihthaipa Eliaza nata Nunâ sawchapawpa Zawsua nata Izarei chi chhôhkha pawhrâhpazy biepie ta.

Mawsi ta ama hnohta, “Kâdâ pathla nata Rubena pathla, chariah chhaichhi a tobipa maih Abeipa hmiakô liata nama hnohta Zawdâh chaka hra aw ei ta, râh cha pahniepa a châ khiahta cha, Kilia râh he âmo ryuto châta nama pie aw.
Chariah chhaichhi a tobipa ta nama hnohta ama chaka hra vei khiahta deikua cha, Kâna râh liata nama hry liata ryuto ama hnei hra aw,” tah ta.
Kâdâ pathlazy nata Rubena pathlazy ta, “ Abeipa ta châ chakaotuhpazy hnohta a reipa hawhta eima tao aw.
Chariah chhaichhi a tobipa ta, Abeipa hmiakô liata Zawdâh cha chaka aw pi ta, Kâna râh liata eimâ ngia aw. Râh eima to awpa deikua cha Zawdâh hesâ lâ he a châ aw,” tahpa ta a chhy ei ta.

Chatanachata Mawsi ta Kâdâ pathlazy, Rubena pathlazy nata Zawsi sawchapawpa Manase pathla khophiezy hnohta Amawri bei Sihaw khinarâh nata Bâsanâ bei Ôkâ khinarâhzy cha, a khihpizy, khihpi râhzy nata a chheipâh râh khihpizy chhaota a pie ei.
Kâdâ pathlazy ta Dibô, Atarô, Arôe,
Atarôsôpha, Zaze, Zôbehâ,
Benirâ nata Beharâ khihpizy ama padua. Chazy cha thokhy nata mietaku sadô a hneipa khihpizy a châ.
Rubena pathlazy ta Hesbaw, Eliale, Kiriathai,
Nebô, Bâlâmeô nata Sibmâ khihpizy padua ei ta, khihpi ama paduapa thokha mohzy cha pananopa ta moh hropa ama bi.
Manase chi Mâkhi pathlazy ta Kilia râh siehnao ei ta, râh cha la ei ta, cha liata a pahrâpa Amawri mo papua ei ta.
Mawsi ta Kilia râh cha Manase chi Mâkhi pathlazy pie ta, cha liata ama pahrâ.
Manase pathla Zairâ ta cha râh liata khitawzy siehnao ta, la ta, a moh Havôzairâ a bi.
Nôbâ ta Kenathâ khihpi nata a khichapeihzy siehnao ta, la ta, ano moh pachyuhpa ta Nôbâ a bi.
Hezy he Izarei sawzy ta Izi râh ama puasai nota, Mawsi nata Arawna chhihthana ry liata a chhâh chhâh ta nata a py py ta ama siena su mohzy a châ.
Abeipa biepie hawhta, Mawsi ta a chhâh chhâh ta ama siena su mohzy cha roh ta, hezy he a chhâh chhâh ta ama siena su mohzy cha a châ.
Izarei sawzy cha thla khana liata Râmese tawhta pua ei ta. Thla khana, noh hrawh hleipangawhna noh, Zawpakhô noh mylâ ta, Izarei sawzy cha Izi mo zydua mohmô liata hmiakai kawpa ta ama pua.
Izi mo ta Abeipa ta ama sawchapaw uhtheipa a thie khai hapazy ama pabu hai nota, Izarei sawzy cha pua ei ta. Abeipa ta Izi mo khazohzy chô liata chhao hriena a patlôsa ha hra.
Izarei sawzy cha Râmese tawhta pua ei ta, Sukô liata riehmo paryh ei ta.
Sukô tawhta pua ei ta, râhchawhpa tytuapa Ethamâ liata riehmo ama paryh.
Ethamâ tawhta pua ei ta, Bâlâzephô nochhi lâta a ypa Pihahirô lâ kua ei ta, Mikadô kiapâh liata riehmo ama paryh.
Pihahirô tawhta pua ei ta, tilaipi liah liata siepahliepa ta râhchawhpa lâ a ngia ei ta, Ethamâ râhchawhpa liata noh thôh sie ei ta, Marâh liata riehmo ama paryh.
Marâh tawhta pua ei ta, tihnawh hnawh hrawh hleino nata thiahrâ kô kô sysari yna Elima tlô ei ta, cha liata riehmo ama paryh.
Elima tawhta pua ei ta, Tilaipi Saihpa kiapâh liata riehmo ama paryh.
Tilaipi Saihpa tawhta pua ei ta, Sini râhchawhpa liata riehmo ama paryh.
Sini râhchawhpa tawhta pua ei ta, Dôpakâ liata riehmo ama paryh.
Dôpakâ tawhta pua ei ta, Alusa liata riehmo ama paryh.
Alusa tawhta pua ei ta, Rephidi liata riehmo ama paryh. Cha cha zawpi do awpa ti y leina su kha a châ.
Rephidi tawhta pua ei ta, Sinai râhchawhpa liata riehmo ama paryh.
Sinai râhchawhpa tawhta pua ei ta, Kibarôhâtavâ liata riehmo ama paryh.
Kibarôhâtavâ tawhta pua ei ta, Hazerô liata riehmo ama paryh.
Hazerô tawhta pua ei ta, Rithamâ liata riehmo ama paryh.
Rithamâ tawhta pua ei ta, Rimôpere liata riehmo ama paryh.
Rimôpere tawhta pua ei ta, Libnâ liata riehmo ama paryh.
Libnâ tawhta pua ei ta, Risâ liata riehmo ama paryh.
Risâ tawhta pua ei ta, Kehelathâ liata riehmo ama paryh.
Kehelathâ tawhta pua ei ta, Sephe Tlâh liata riehmo ama paryh.
Sephe Tlâh tawhta pua ei ta, Hâradâ liata riehmo ama paryh.
Hâradâ tawhta pua ei ta, Mâkhelô liata riehmo ama paryh.
Mâkhelô tawhta pua ei ta, Tahâ liata riehmo ama paryh.
Tahâ tawhta pua ei ta, Terâ liata riehmo ama paryh.
Terâ tawhta pua ei ta, Mithakâ liata riehmo ama paryh.
Mithakâ tawhta pua ei ta, Hasmônâ liata riehmo ama paryh.
Hasmônâ tawhta pua ei ta, Môserô liata riehmo ama paryh.
Môserô tawhta pua ei ta, Benezakâ liata riehmo ama paryh.
Benezakâ tawhta pua ei ta, Hôhakikâ liata riehmo ama paryh.
Hôhakikâ tawhta pua ei ta, Zôbathâ liata riehmo ama paryh.
Zôbathâ tawhta pua ei ta, Abarônah liata riehmo ama paryh.
Abarônah tawhta pua ei ta, Eziôkebe liata riehmo ama paryh.
Eziôkebe tawhta pua ei ta, Zini râhchawhpa liata riehmo ama paryh. Cha cha Kâdesâ tahpa a châ hra.
Kâdesâ tawhta pua ei ta, Edômâ râh pai liata Hôri Tlâh liata riehmo ama paryh.
Theihthaipa Arawna cha Abeipa biepiepa hawhta, Hôri Tlâh lâ kiah ta, Izarei sawzy Izi râh tawhta ama kaw pua tawhta kô sypalihna, thla pangawhna, noh khana noh ta, cha liata a thi haw.
Hôri Tlâh liata a thi nota Arawna cha kô 123 uhtheipa a châ.
Kâna râh Neke liata a ypa, Kâna chyhsa Aradâ bei ta, Izarei sawzy ama vaw tlôpa thei ta.
Izarei sawzy cha Hôri Tlâh tawhta pua ei ta, Zalmônâ liata riehmo paryh ei ta.
Zalmônâ tawhta pua ei ta, Punô liata riehmo ama paryh heih.
Punô tawhta pua ei ta, Ôbô liata riehmo ama paryh.
Ôbô tawhta pua ei ta, Môabâ râh Iziabari liata riehmo ama paryh.
Iziabari tawhta pua ei ta, Dibôkadâ liata riehmo ama paryh.
Dibôkadâ tawhta pua ei ta, Almawdibalâthai liata riehmo ama paryh.
Almawdibalâthai tawhta pua ei ta, Nebô kiapâh liata Abari tlâhzy liata riehmo ama paryh.
Abari tlâhzy tawhta pua ei ta, Zerikô dady Zawdâh kiah liata Môabâ bypi liata riehmo paryh ei ta,
Zawdâh kiah Bezesimô tawhta Abesiti taihta Môabâ bypi liata riehmozy ama paryh lymâ.
Zerikô dady Zawdâh kiah Môabâ bypi liata, Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Izarei sawzy chho la, ama hnohta, ‘Zawdâh chakapa ta Kâna râh namâ ngia tita,

a râh chyhsa zydua nama hmiakô tawhta nama papua khai awpa a châ. Ama lô nothlahpa zydua parao khai aw ei chi ta, ama thua nothlah leihpa zydua chhao parao khai aw ei chi ta, ama su sâhpa zydua nama phie khai aw.
Râh cha hnei aw ei chi ta, cha liata nama pahrâ aw. Cha râh cha hnei awpa ta ei cha piepa ei a châ.

A pho pho ta nuby a dao aw ei chi ta, râh cha ryuto châta namâ rai aw. Chi lai viapazy cha ryuto râh lai via pie aw ei chi ta, chi chyh viapazy cha ryuto râh chyh via nama pie aw. Nuby ta a tlupa hawhta ama tovyuh a châ lymâ aw. Ryuto râh cha châ pathlatuhpazy chi yzie lymâ hawhta nama to awpa a châ.

A râh liata a pahrâpazy nama hmiakô tawhta nama papua khai vei khiahta deikua cha, nama paysapazy cha nama mo liata mobâ hawhta châ aw ei ta, nama kâ liata ahloh hawhta cha chho aw ei ta, nama pahrâna râh liata châ patypamâtuhpazy ama châ lymâ aw.
Ama chô liata tao awpa ei pachâpa cha, nama chô liata ei tao aw,’ tah mah y,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Izarei sawzy chho la, ama hnohta hetana heta biepie teh: Kâna râh nama tlô tita, nama ryuto râh a châ awpa Kâna râhri cha he hawhta a châ aw.
Chho lâta Zini râhchawhpa tawhta Edômâ râh a ripa ta sie aw ta, chho lâta nama râhri cha Tilaipi Iahpa chhâna tawhta nochhi lâta a sie aw.
Nama râhri cha Akarâbi lâ kiana chho lâ chhâh ta pako aw ta, Zini lâ sie aw ta, Kâdesbânia chho lâta pua aw ta, Hâzarâdy chapiapa ta, Azmaw lâta a sie aw.
Râhri cha Azmaw tawhta Izi Chavah lâ pako aw ta, tilaipi liata a chhâ aw.
“Notla lâ cha Tilaipi Kawhpa taih châ aw ta, cha cha notla lâta nama râhri a châ aw.
“He he Maw lâta nama râhri a châ aw: Tilaipi Kawhpa tawhta Hôri Tlâh lâta sie aw ta,
Hôri Tlâh tawhta Lebô-hâmâ lâ sie aw ta, Zedâ liata a chhâ aw.
Cha tawhna chata râhri cha Ziparaw lâta sie aw ta, Hâzarenâ liata a chhâ aw. Cha cha maw lâta nama râhri a châ aw.
“Nochhi lâta nama râhri cha Hâzarenâ tawhta Sephe taih a châ aw.
Râhri cha Sephe tawhta Aina nochhi lâta Riblâ taih a zu aw. Râhri cha zu lymâ aw ta, Chinere Tipo nochhi lâ tlôna taihta a sie aw.
Cha tawhna chata râhri cha Zawdâh lâta zu aw ta, Tilaipi Iahpa liata a chhâ aw. Cha râhri pakhâhpazy chhôh cha nama râh a châ aw,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta Izarei sawzy biepie ta, ama hnohta, “Cha râh cha Abeipa ta chi chaki nata chi khophiepa pie awpa ta bie a piepa, nuby a daopa ta nama to awpa ryuto râh a châ.
Rubena pathla nata Kâdâ pathla chizy deikua cha a chhôh chhôh ta ryuto râh to ha ei ta, Manase chi khophie chhao ama to ha hra.
Chi nopazy nata chi khophie cha, ama ryuto râh châta Zerikô dady ta a ypa Zawdâh haosâ, nochhi baih lâta râhzy ama to haw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Hezy he ryu ta nama to awpa râh châ rai awpa chyhsazy moh a châ: Theihthaipa Eliaza nata Nunâ sawchapawpa Zawsua ta ryuto râh cha ama cha rai aw.
Ryuto râh raina liata âmo bao awpa ta, chi to tawhta chhituhpa pakha chyu nama rao aw.
Cha chyhsazy moh cha, Zudâh chi tawhta Zephune sawchapaw Kâlebâ;
Simeôna chi tawhta Amihu sawchapaw Samuela;
Benzami chi tawhta Kislaw sawchapaw Eliadâ;
Dânâ chi tawhta Zôkali sawchapaw Buki;
Zawsi pathla Manase chi tawhta chhituhpa pakha, Ephô sawchapaw Hânie;
Epharai chi tawhta chhituhpa pakha, Siphatâ sawchapaw Kemua;
Zebulawna chi tawhta chhituhpa pakha, Pânâ sawchapaw Elizaphâ;
Iskâra chi tawhta chhituhpa pakha, Azani sawchapaw Pâtie;
Asera chi tawhta chhituhpa pakha, Selômi sawchapaw Ahihu nata
Nâthalai chi tawhta chhituhpa pakha, Amihu sawchapaw Pedahe zy ama châ aw,” tah ta.
Âmo cha Kâna râh liata Izarei sawzy ryuto râh rai awpa ta Abeipa ta bie a piepazy ama châ.
Zerikô dady Zawdâh kiapâh Môabâ bypi liata Abeipa ta Mawsi bie a chho ta, a hnohta,
“Izarei sawzy hnohta, ryuto râh ama hneipa tawhta Livai chi pahrâ nawpa khihpizy châta râh a chhaih awpa ta biepie teh. Khihpizy chaby liata sibiepa suzy chhao sahroh pasana châta nama pie pâ aw.
Khihpizy cha ama pahrâ nawpa châta châ aw ta, sibiepa suzy cha ama viahchao, ama sahroh nata ama sa zydua châta a châ aw.
Livai chi na pie awpa sibiepa suzy cha khihpi thokhy tawhta dy sâh kha a kawh awpa a châ.
Khihpi cha a liah liata sopa ta, khihpi thokhy tawhta thlie aw chi ta, nochhi lâta dy sâh no, chho lâta dy sâh no, notla lâta dy sâh no, maw lâta dy sâh no a châ aw.

“Livai chi nama pie awpa khihpizy hry liata khihpi miacharupazy cha abohna khihpizy châ aw ta, lianycheihpazy a râ nawpa khihpizy a châ aw. Cha khihpizy thota khihpi sypalih nata miano nama baichha aw.
Livai chi nama pie awpa khihpi zydua cha, ama sibiepa suzy chhaota, khihpi sypalih nata miacharie a châ aw.

Izarei sawzy nama pie awpa ryuto râhzy tawhta, ama ryuto râh lai nata chyh mopa ta, chi lai viapazy tawhta râh lai via la aw ei chi ta, chi chyh viapazy tawhta râh chyh via la aw ei chi ta, Livai chi hnohta khihpizy ama pie chyu aw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi bie a chho ta, a hnohta,
“Izarei sawzy chho la, ama hnohta hetana heta reih teh: Zawdâh chakapa ta Kâna râh namâ ngia tita,
chyhsa a thie tlamawpa lianycheihpa a râ nawpa ta, khihpi thokha cha abohna khihpizy ta nama rao aw.
Lianycheihtuhpa cha a thâtih pachia awpa ta zawpi hmia liata â duah hlâta a thi lei nawpa ta, cha khihpizy cha phuh latuhpazy tawhta namâ bohna a châ aw.
Khihpi nama pie awpazy tawhta abohna khihpi miacharu nama rao aw.
Zawdâh haosâ lâ khih thôh rao aw ei chi ta, Kâna râh liata khih thôh châ aw ta, chazy cha abohna khihpizy a châ aw.

Cha khihpi miacharupazy cha, Izarei sawzy châta abohna khihpizy châ aw ei ta, chihropa nata ama hnohta a pahrâpazy châta abohna khihpizy châ hra aw ta, chyhsa a thie tlamawpa maihta amâ râ nawpa khihpizy a châ aw.
“Thua chhaichhi hmâpa ta chyhsa phy sala, cha chyhsa cha a thi khiahta deikua cha, liany a cheihpa châ ta, lianycheihtuhpa cha thie thlyu awpa a châ.
Chyhsa thi theina alô chhaichhi hmâpa ta chyhsa phy sala, cha chyhsa cha a thi khiahta cha, liany a cheihpa châ ta, lianycheihtuhpa cha thie thlyu awpa a châ.
Chyhsa thi theina tho chhaichhi hmâpa ta phy sala, cha chyhsa cha a thi khiahta cha, liany a cheihpa châ ta, lianycheihtuhpa cha thie thlyu awpa a châ.
Thisaih phuh latuhpa ta lianycheihtuhpa cha a thie awpa châ ta, a hmô tita a thie aw.
“Chyhsa ta ahaona vâta chyhsa chatitha sala tlyma, a byhkhâhpa ta khâpa tlyma ta vawh sala tlyma, cha chyhsa cha a thi khiahta tlyma,
cha leipa chhao ta, ahaona vâta a ku ta a chôpa ta, cha chyhsa cha a thi khiahta tlyma, kupathlatuhpa cha thie thlyu awpa a châ. Liany a cheihpa châ ta, thisaih phuh latuhpa ta a hmô tita a thie aw.
“Châhrasala ahaona vâta châ leipa ta, chatitha tlamawpa vâta tlyma, a byhkhâh leipa ta khâpa tlyma ta vawh tlamawpa vâta tlyma,
hmô leipa ta, chyhsa thi theina alô pathla thlu tlamawpa vâta tlyma, cha chyhsa cha thi sala, a chariahpa châ leipa sala, pasasa â chhuahpa a châ vei khiahta cha,
he ryhpazy he hmâpa ta, lianycheihtuhpa nata thisaih phuh latuhpa likah liata zawpi ta ama pachiapa aw.

Zawpizy ta lianycheihtuhpa cha thisaih phuh latuhpa ku tawhta pachha aw ei ta, a boh awpa ta â râna, â bohna khihpi liata ama paysa aw. Sathaw pathaihpa ta sathawthupa theihthai beichaipa a thi hlâlei, cha liata a y thlâh ha awpa a châ.
Khatino rai ta, lianycheihtuhpa ta â râna abohna khihpi râhri khô lâ pua sala,
thisaih phuh latuhpa ta ano cha abohna khihpi râhri khô lâta hmô sala, thisaih phuh latuhpa ta lianycheihtuhpa cha a thie khiahta deikua cha, thisaih phuh latuhpa chô liata thisaih maoh y aw vei.
Liahnycheihtuhpa cha, theihthai beichaipa a thi hlâlei abohna khihpi liata pahrâ aw ta, theihthai beichaipa a thi tawhta deikua cha, a ryuto râh lâ â lie thei aw.
“Cha hmozy cha, nama pahrâna su zydua liata nama chhâ zydua châta bieraopa nata pachianazy a châ aw.
Chyhsa ta chyhsa a thie khiahta cha, pahnotuhpazy pakah tawhta bie a puapa ta thie awpa a châ. Châhrasala pahnotuhpa pakha bie dei ta chyhsa ahy hmah thie awpa châ vei.
Cha dei châ vei, liahnycheihtuhpa chatlaina sôh nama la awpa châ vei. Thina taihta thailei a châpa châ ta, thie thlyu awpa a châ.
Abohna khihpi lâ a râpa châta chhao, theihthai beichaipa a thi hlâta a râh lâ â lie thei nawpa ta chatlaina sôh nama lapa awpa châ vei.

Nama pahrâna râh nama papuapalei awpa châ vei. Thisaih ta râh papuapalei ta, thisaih palotuhpa thisaih dei leipa ta cha, khâpa chatlaina ta hmah râh chô liata thisaih palo thlupa cha pathaisa thei vei.
Kei Abeipa he Izarei sawzy hry liata pahrâ tlôh na ta, chavâta nama hnohta ei yna râh, nama pahrâna râh he nama papuapalei awpa châ vei,” tah ta.
Zawsi sawchapawpa Manase chi Mâkhi pathla Kilia pho hyutuhpazy a vaw hnia ei ta, Mawsi nata Izarei pathla chhituhpazy hmiakô liata bie reih ei ta,

ama hnohta, “ Abeipa ta ei zibeipa hnohta, nuby padaosapa ta Izarei sawzy ama ryuto râh pie awpa ta bie cha pie ta, eima unawhpa Zelôphehâ ryuto râh chhao a sawchanôzy hnohta pie awpa ta Abeipa ta ei zibeipa hnohta bie a cha pie hra.

Cha chanôzy chata Izarei chihropa sawchapawzy ama hnei khiahta deikua cha, ama ryuto râh cha miah pathlatuhpazy ryuto râh tawhta lapa châ aw ta, ama dyhchâna chi ryuto râh liata pahlyhpa a châ aw. Chatanachata eima ryuto râh châta nuby eimâ daopa eima pahlei aw.

Izarei sawzy zubili kô a vaw tlô tita, Zelôphehâ sawchanôzy ryuto râh cha, ama dyhchâna chi ryuto râh liata pahlyhpa a châ aw. Ama ryuto râh cha lapa châ aw ta, miah pathlatuhpazy ryuto râh cha pachhaihpa a châ aw,” tah ei ta.
Mawsi ta Abeipa bie hawhta Izarei sawzy cha piepa ta, ama hnohta, “Zawsi pathla chi bie reipa he bie dopa a châ.
Zelôphehâ sawchanôzy kyh liata Abeipa biepiepa cha hetana heta a châ: ‘Ama kho chaipazy hnei aw ei ta, anodeikua ama paw chi pho liata chapawzy ama hnei awpa a châ.
Izarei sawzy ryuto cha chi kha tawhta chihropa lâ pasie awpa châ vei. Izarei saw zydua ta ama pathlatuhpa chi ryuto râh ama hnei pazao lymâ aw.
Izarei saw ahy rai ta a pathlatuhpazy ryuto râh a hnei lymâ thei nawpa ta, Izarei chizy liata ryuto râh a hneipa sawchanô maih cha, a paw chi nata pho chyhsa lapinô a châ awpa a châ.
Izarei chi ryuto râh cha, chihropa lâ â pasie awpa châ vei. Izarei saw chi to ta ama ryuto râh chyu ama hnei lymâ awpa a châ’” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi bie a piepa hawhta, Zelôphehâ sawchanôzy ta tao ei ta,
Mâhlâ, Tizah, Hôkalâ, Milkâ nata Nôah zy ta ama paw unawhzy sawchapawzy cha vahpa ta ama hnei chyu.
Zawsi sawchapaw Manase pathlazy cha vahpa ta hnei ei ta, chatanachata ama ryuto râhzy cha ama paw chi nata pho ryuto râh ta a y lymâ.
Chazy cha Abeipa ta Mawsi hmâpa ta Zerikô dady Zawdâh haosâ Môabâ bypi liata Izarei sawzy hnohta a piepa biepiepazy nata ryhpazy a châ.

He biezy he Zawdâh nochhi lâ râhchawhpa liata Mawsi ta Izarei saw zydua hnohta a reipazy a châ. Cha su cha Arabâ râh Supha dady liata y ta, hiakha lâ baih liata Pârâ y ta, hiakha lâ liata Tôpheli, Lâbâ, Hazerô nata Dizahâ zy a y.
Hôribâ tawhta Kâdesbânia cha Seirâ Tlâh lâpi lâta noh hrawh hleikha sie a châ.
Izi râh ama puasai tawhta kô sypalihna, thla hrawh hleikhana, noh khana noh liata, Izarei sawzy kyh liata Abeipa ta a hnohta bie a piepa zydua cha, Mawsi ta Izarei sawzy chho ta.
Cha biezy cha Hesbaw liata a pahrâpa Amawri bei Sihaw a pahnie tawhta nata Astarô nata Edarei liata a pahrâpa Bâsanâ bei Ôkâ a pahnie tawhta Mawsi ta a reipa biezy a châ.
Zawdâh nochhi lâ Môabâ râh liata, Mawsi ta hetana heta ryhpa a chhopasia.
“ Abeipa eima Khazohpa ta Hôribâ tlâh liata bie miah chho ta, ‘He tlâh liata bohpi tlai nama y haw.

Chavâta a pasie bâ u la, Amawri tlâh râh lâ nata a chheipâh Arabâ râh lâ zy sie teh u. Tlâh râh, by râh, Neke râh, tilaipi kiah râh, Kâna râh nata Lebanaw râh lâ zy sie u la, chavah laipa Ufrâti chavah taihta sie teh u.

Moh teh u, nama hmiakô liata râh ei cha sopa ei hih. Sie u la, châ pathlatuhpa Abarahâ, Aisika nata Zakaw nata ama pathla vaw y lymâ awpazy hnohta pie awpa ta Abeipa ta bie â taihpa râh cha kei pahrâ teh u,’ miah tah ta.
“Cha nota nama hnohta, ‘Kei dei ta cha chhihtha thei khao veih ei na.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta cha papôh ei ta, moh teh u, tahmâ cha vâ awhsi zie tlai ta nama vaw pôh haw.
Abeipa, châ pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa ta tahmâ ta nama maluh hlâta a lie sâh hluhpi ta cha papôh ei sala, bie a châ taihpa hawh ei ta, byhnâ cha pie mawh ei sy!
Kheihta ma kei dei ta namâ tymânazy, nama phaohrizy nata namâ eichhianazy ei phaoh thei aw?
Nama chi chyu tawhta chyhsa sopa, hmo a pahno thaipa nata chyhsa zachhihpazy a tlyh u la, nama chô liata hyutuhpazy ta ei tao aw ei,’ tahpa ta cha chho ei na ta.
Nâmo ta, ‘Na reipa cha eima châta tao awpa ta hmo phapa a châ,’ tahpa ta nâ chhy ei chi ta.

Chatanachata nama chi to tawhta chyhsa sopa nata novâhna ta a biepa hyutuhpazy a chhi ei na ta, nama chô liata hyutuhpazy ta ei tao ei. A sâh chô liata hyutuhpazy, a za chô liata hyutuhpazy, sypangawh chô liata hyutuhpazy, pahrawh chô liata hyutuhpazy nata nama chi chhituhpazy ta ei tao ei.

Cha daihti liata, nama ryureituhpazy hnohta biehneina pie na ta, ama hnohta, ‘Nama unawhzy likah biepeipazy nathlie u la, chyhsa nata a unawhpa likah liata â do ngaitapa ta ryureih u la, chyhsa nata a hnohta a ypa chihropa likah liata chhao â do ngaitapa ta ryureih muh vy.

Ryureina liata thlua hlei nama hnei awpa châ vei. Mochyhpa nata molaipa bie â lyupa ta nama nathlie awpa châ ta, ahy hmia hmah nama moh awpa châ vei. Ryureina cha Khazohpa eih a châ. Nama châta bie rupa cha ei hnohta vaw tlôkhei tyh aw ei chi ta, kei ta ei pachia tyh aw,’ tah na ta.
Cha daihti liata, hmo nama tao awpa zydua bie ei cha pie ei.

“ Abeipa ta bie miah a piepa hawhta, Hôribâ tlâh tawhta pua pi ta, Amawri tlâh râh lâpi, râhchawhpa kawh ngaitapa nata chichhih ngaitapa nama hmôpa zydua kha siepahlie khaipa ta, Kâdesbânia khih tlô pi ta.
Nama hnohta, ‘ Abeipa eima Khazohpa ta miah a piepa Amawri tlâh râh nama tlô haw.

Moh teh u, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama hmiakô liata râh a cha sopa ei. Khy u la, Abeipa, châ pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa ta a cha chhopa hawhna ei khata, râh cha kaw pahrâ teh u. Chi leipa u la, riahchhiepa ta y hra khuh vy,’ cha tah ei na ta.

Nama zydua ta nâ vaw hnia ei chi ta, ei hnohta, ‘Râh kaw mohparu ta, lâpi eimâ chhih awpa nata khihpi eima chapia awpazy kyh miah za tlôkhei awpa ta, eima hmia lâta chyhsazy tuah ei suh u,’ tah ei chi ta.
Cha hmo chata na palysa ta, nama hry tawhta chyhsa pahrawh hleino, chi kha tawhta pakha lymâ ta a tlyh na ta.
Pua ei ta, tlâh râh lâ cha khy ei ta, Eskaw Saikao tlô ei ta, râh cha mohparu ei ta.
Cha râh liata theilâpazy lyu ei ta, za phaoh ei ta, ‘ Abeipa eima Khazohpa ta râh miah a piepa cha, râh pha ngaitapa a châ,’ tahpa ta bie ama za tlôkhei.
“Châhrasala khy khoh leipa ei chi ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa biepiepa cha zyh khoh veih ei chi.
Nama poh o liata paphôh ei chi ta, ‘ Abeipa ta miah â haopa vâta Amawri mo ku liata miah hlâ ta, miah pahleipadia awpa ta Izi râh tawhta miah â kaw chhi papua hih.

Khataih lâ cha ma eima khy aw? Eima unawhzy ta, “Cha phopi cha keimo hlâta pahreih via ei ta, ama doh chhao a sâh via ta, ama khihpizy lai kaw ta, avâ a daihpa thokhyzy ta amâ dôh. Anâki pathlazy chhao eima hmô,” tah ei ta, eima hnabei miah ama pady khai haw,’ tah ei chi ta.
Kei ta nama hnohta, ‘Nama nô a papo leipa u la, âmo cha chi khuh vy.
Nama hmia lâta a siepa Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta, Izi râh liata nama mohmô lia tlai ta nama châta a taopa hawhna khata, a châ dyuhpa aw ei.
Chyhsa ta a sawchapawpa a pipa hawhta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta râhchawhpa liata cha pi laih ei ta, he su nama vaw tlôna taihta lâpi tlykha ta a cha pi lymâpa ei nama hmôpa hawhna khata,’ tah na ta.
Chatanachôta Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha ngâ veih ei chi.
Nama poh o parai nawpa tluapa ta nama hmia lâta sie ta, zâ ta mei ta, nohchhô ta meihdo ta cha chhihthapa ta, nama siena lâpi châ pahmôtuhpa Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha ngâ veih ei chi.
“ Abeipa ta nama bie reipazy cha thei ta, a pathi ia ta,
‘He chhâ moleipazy hry tawhta ahy hmahta châ pathlatuhpazy hnohta pie awpa ta bie ei taihpa râh phapa cha hmô aw veih ei.
Zephune sawchapawpa Kâlebâ deikua cha, tlokhuh ta Abeipa a zipa vâta, râh phapa cha hmô aw ta, a tlypa râh cha ano nata a sawzy ei pie aw ei,’ tahpa ta bie a taih ta.
Nâmo vâta Abeipa cha keima chô liata chhao a pathi ia ta, ei hnohta, ‘Nâ chhao, cha râh cha a ngia aw va chi.
Châ chakaotuhpa Nunâ sawchapawpa Zawsua deikua â ngia aw. Ano kha pasyu mah y. Ano ta râh cha ryu ta Izarei a patosa aw.
Chariah ta ama patu aw nama tahpa hawtizy nata chhie nata pha a pahno mâh leipa tanoh nama sawzy heta a ngia aw ei ta, râh cha âmo pie aw na ta, âmo ta ama hnei aw.
Nâmo deikua cha a lie u la, Tilaipi Saihpa lâpi a chhihpa ta râhchawhpa lâta sie teh u,’ tah ta.

“Chatawhcha nâmo ta, ‘ Abeipa chô liata eima vaw molei haw. Abeipa eima Khazohpa ta bie miah a piepa hawhta, khy aw pi ta eimâ kaw dyuh aw,’ tah ei chi ta. Nama zydua ta chariah chhaichhi a tobi ei chi ta, tlâh râh lâ khypa cha hmo naopa hawhta pachâ ei chi ta.
Abeipa ta, ‘Ama hnohta reih teh, khy leipa u la, a kaw dyuh hra khuh vy. Nama hry liata y tlôh leipa aw na ta, nama chariahpazy ta ama cha pahnie pathlei aw,’ na tah ta.
Cha chho ei na ta, châhrasala nathlie khoh veih ei chi. Abeipa biepiepa chakhia ei chi ta, tlâh râh lâ nama khy raruah.
Tlâh râh liata a pahrâpa Amawri mo ta châ vaw dyuh ei ta, kheih hripi ta chyhsa amâ chadaipa hawhta cha chadai ei ta, Seirâ tawhta Hômâ taihta ama cha thie lymâ.
Vaw kua ei chi ta, Abeipa hmiakô liata cha ei chi ta, châhrasala Abeipa ta nama ao nathlie leipa ta, nâmo lâta a nah pachôh khoh khao vei.
Chavâta Kâdesâ liata noh hluhpi châh ei chi ta, noh hluhpi tlai cha liata nama ypa kha a châ.
“Cha khai tawhta a lie pi ta, Abeipa ta ei hnohta a reipa hawhta, Tilaipi Saihpa lâpi a chhihpa ta râhchawhpa lâ sie pi ta. Serâ Tlâh chahlôpa ta noh hluhpi eima sie.
Abeipa ta ei hnohta,
‘He tlâh chahlôpa ta bohpi sie ha ei chi ta, maw lâ pangaipa ta sie bâ muh vy.
Zawpi biepie la, ama hnohta, “Seirâ liata a pahrâpa Esaw pathla nama unawhzy râh nama sie pahlie bâ aw. Cha chi kaw aw ei ta, chavâta a sohsi kaw muh vy.
Âmo cha a dyuh khuh vy. Ama râh cha phei tlyna khi dâhdei chhao cha pie aw veih ei na. Seirâ Tlâh cha Esaw hnohta a pahrâ nawpa ta ei piepa a châ.
Nama nie awpazy âmo tawhta sôh ta chalei aw ei chi ta, nama do awpa tizy sôh ta nama chalei aw.

Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama ku raihria zydua liata byhnâ cha pie tyh ei ta, he râhchawhpa kawh ngaitapa nama siepahliezie haipa chhao a pahno. Kô sypalih chhôh zydua Abeipa nama hnohta y ta, khâpa hmah a phahla veih ei chi,” tah mah y,’ tah ta.
Chatanachata Seirâ liata a pahrâpa eima unawhpa Esaw pathlazy chahrihpa ta, Arabâ lâpi nata Elâthâ nata Eziôkebe zy tawhta lâhlapi ta sie pi ta. Lâ tlei pi ta, Môabâ râhchawhpa lâpi lâta eima sie.
“ Abeipa ta ei hnohta, ‘Môabâ mo patypamâ leipa u la, a dyuh hra khuh vy. Ama râh cha nama pahrâ nawpa ta cha pie aw veih ei na. Ari râh cha Lawta pathlazy hnohta ama pahrâ nawpa ta ei pie ha ei.
Kha hlâta cha, cha râh liata Anâki mo hawhta chyhsa pahreihpa nata doh seihpa nata maluh hluh ngaitapa Emi mo y tyh ei ta.
Anâki mo hawhta, âmo chhao cha Rephai mo tahpa ta pahnopa ama châ. Châhrasala Môabâ mo ta Emi mo tahpa ta ama aw tyh.

Kha hlâta cha, Seirâ liata chhao Hôri mo ama pahrâ tyh. Châhrasala Izarei sawzy ta Abeipa ta ryuto râh a piepa chô liata ama taopa hawhta, Esaw pathlazy ta Hôri mo cha pho ei ta, ama mohmô tawhta pahleipadia ei ta, ama râh liata ama pahrâ haw.
Abeipa ta, “Thyu u la, Zere chavah chaka teh u,” tah ta. Chatanachata Zere chavah cha chaka pi ta.

Kâdesbânia tawhta vaw pua pi ta, Zere chavah eima chakana taihta eima viavi chhôh zydua cha kô sythôh nata kô charie a châ. Cha daihti chhôh ta, Abeipa ta zikyu â râ hapa hawh ei ta, cha chhâ liata chariah a dyuh theipa pheisaih zydua riehmo tawhta ama leidia khai haw.
Riehmo tawhta a pahleipadia khai hlâlei ei cha, Abeipa ku ta âmo cha â dyuh lymâ ei.
“Chariah a dyuhpa chyhsa zydua zawpi hry tawhta leidia ei ta, ama thi khai tawhta,
Abeipa ta na chho ta,
‘Tanoh he Ari liata Môabâ râhri na chaka aw.
Amawna mo râh nâ hnia tita, âmo cha patypamâ leipa la, a dyuh hra khah y. Cha râh cha Lawta pathlazy hnohta ama pahrâ nawpa ta ei piepa râh a châpa vâta, Amawna mo râh cha, cha pie aw va na,’ tah ta.
Cha râh cha, kha hlâta cha Rephai mo pahrâ tyhna râh a châpa vâta, Rephai râh hawhta pachâpa a châ hra. Amawna mo ta Zazumi mo tahpa ta ama aw tyh.

Anâki mo hawhta chyhsa pahreihpa nata doh seihpa nata maluh hluh ngaitapa châ ei ta, châhrasala Abeipa ta âmo cha Amawna mo hmiakô liata pahleipadia ta, Amawna mo ta pho ei ta, ama râh liata ama pahrâ haw.

Cha hawhna chata Abeipa ta Seirâ liata a pahrâpa Esaw pathlazy châta chhao tao hra ta, Esaw pathlazy hmiakô liata Hôri mo cha pahleipadia ta, Esaw pathlazy ta Hôri mo cha pho ei ta, tanoh taihta ama râh liata ama pahrâ.
Kâza taihta khitawzy liata a ypa Avimi mo chhao, Kâftaw tawhta a vaw puapa Kâftaw mo ta pahleipadia ei ta, ama râh liata ama pahrâ ha hra.
“ Abeipa ta, ‘Thyu u la, sie u la, Anaw saikao chaka teh u. Moh teh u, Amawri chyhsa Hesbaw bei Sihaw nata a râh cha nama ku liata ei cha pie ha ei. A râh hnei pathao u la, ano cha a dyuh teh u.
Tanoh he avâ ry liata phopi zydua chô liata nâma china nata thlazohna paysa aw na ta, na thâtih a theipa maih a chalyu aw ei ta, nâma vâta pachârôh ngaitapa ta ama y aw,’ tah ta.
“Kedemô râhchawhpa tawhta Hesbaw bei Sihaw hnohta aryhna bie reih awpa ta chyhsa tuah na ta, a hnohta,
‘Na râh siepahlie eina pasai awpa chi ta ei châ haw. Lâlai a chhihpa ta sie aw na ta, chachâh lâ tlyma, chavei lâ tlyma, tlei aw va na.
Ei nie awpa châta sôh ta niebaw na chaleisa aw chi ta, ei doh awpa ti chhao sôh ta eina chaleisa aw chi. Phei ta na râh siepahlie awpa rie na pasai mah y.

Seirâ liata a pahrâpa Esaw pathlazy nata Ari liata a pahrâpa Môabâ mo ta ei chô liata ama taopa hawhta, Zawdâh chakapa ta Abeipa eima Khazohpa ta miah a piepa râh ei ngia hlâlei na râh siepahlie na pasai mah y,’ tah na ta.

Châhrasala Hesbaw bei Sihaw ta a râh siepahlie miah pasaih vei. Nama ku liata a cha pie thei nawpa ei ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta a palôh kuh pachhasa ta, tanoh ta a duahmo nama pahnopa hawhna heta, chhôrupa ta a tao haw.
“Chatawhcha Abeipa ta ei hnohta, ‘Moh teh, Sihaw nata a râh ei cha pie pathao haw. A râh cha hnei la pahrâ mah y,’ na tah ta.
Sihaw cha miah a dyuh awpa ta, a chyhsa zydua chhaota Zahâ liata vaw pua ta.
Abeipa eima Khazohpa ta Sihaw cha miah pie ta, ano nata a sawchapawzy nata a chyhsa zydua eima thie khai haw.
Cha daihti liata, a khihpi zydua la pi ta, chapawzy, chanôzy nata hawtizy eima pahleipadia khai haw. Pakha hmah pahlôh ma pi.
Eima lapa khihpizy eima hraona sôhthih nata sahrohzy deita keimo châta eimâ la.
Anaw saikao chhâna liata Arôerâ nata saikao liata khihpi a ypa tawhta Kilia taihta, thokhy a sâh tupa khihpi eima châta y vei. Abeipa eima Khazohpa ta eima ku liata miah a pie khai haw.
Amawna pathlazy râh nata Zabaw chavah kiah zydua nata tlâh râh khihpizy deikua cha, Abeipa eima Khazohpa ta la lei awpa ta miah a pakhâ hapa hawhta, a hnia veih ei chi.
“Chatawhcha a lie pi ta, Bâsanâ lâpi lâta khy pi ta. Bâsanâ bei Ôkâ nata a chyhsa zydua ta Edarei liata miah a dyuh awpa ta vaw pua ei ta.

Abeipa ta ei hnohta, ‘Ano kha chi khah y, ano nata a chyhsa zydua nata a râh na ku liata ei cha pie haw. Hesbaw liata a pahrâpa Amawri bei Sihaw chô liata na taopa hawhna khata, ano chô liata chhao na tao aw,’ tah ta.
Chatanachata Abeipa eima Khazohpa ta Bâsanâ bei Ôkâ nata a chyhsa zydua cha eima ku liata miah pie ta, pakha hmahta pahlôh leipa ta eima thie khai haw.
Cha daihti liata, a khihpi zydua la khai pi ta, âmo tawhta eima la leipa khihpi miakha hmah y vei. Bâsanâ bei Ôkâ khinarâh liata Akaw râh khihpi eima lapa zydua cha sycharu a châ.
Khihpi zydua cha thokhy a sâh ngaitapa ta dôhpa châ ei ta, khaohrei nata hraina hneipazy a châ. Cha khihpizy thota thokhy a hnei leipa khihpi hluhpi eima la hra.
Hesbaw bei Sihaw chô liata eima taopa hawhna khata, khihpi zydua parao pi ta, chapawzy, chanôzy nata hawtizy eima pahleipadia khai haw.
Eima pahniepa khihpizy hraona sôhthih nata sahrohzy deita eimâ la.
Cha daihti liata, Zawdâh nochhi lâta a ypa Amawri bei pano ku tawhta râhzy la pi ta, âmo cha Anaw saikao tawhta Hâmaw Tlâh taihta a pahrâpazy ama châ.
Hâmaw cha Sidaw mo ta Siriô tah ei ta, Amawri mo ta Seni ama tah.
By khihpizy nata Kilia nata Bâsanâ râh zydua, Sâlekâ tawhta Edarei taihta, Bâsanâ liata Ôkâ khinarâh khihpi zydua eima la khai haw.

Bâsanâ bei Ôkâ deita cha Rephai chi a y chhôhpa châ ta, a rakhô cha thua rakhô châ ta, a doh lâ dy chaki seih ta, a hâ lâ dy palih a kawh. Cha cha tahmâ taihta Amawna pathlazy khihpi Râbâ liata a y thlâh ha.
“Cha râh eima la nota, Anaw saikao chhâna liata a ypa Arôerâ tawhta Kilia tlâh râh khophie taihta, khihpi a ypazy chhaota, Rubena pathlazy nata Kâdâ pathlazy pie na ta.
Kilia râh laibâhpa nata Ôkâ khinarâh liata Bâsanâ râh zydua cha Manase chi khophiezy ei pie ei. Bâsanâ râh nata Akaw kao zydua cha Rephai râh tahpa ta pahno tyhpa a châ.
Manase pathla Zairâ ta Akaw râh zydua cha, Kesuri mo nata Mâkathai mo râhri taihta la ta, ano moh pachyuhpa ta Havôzairâ bi ta, chavâta Bâsanâ cha tanoh taihta Havôzairâ tahpa ta pahnopa a châ.
Kilia cha Mâki pie na ta,
Rubena pathla nata Kâdâ pathlazy hnohta Kilia tawhta Anaw saikao taihta ama râh châta ei pie ei. Ama râh cha saikao liah khophie tawhta a thao ta, Amawna mo râhri Zabaw chavah taihta a ô.
Arabâ râh chhao âmo râh châ ta, Zawdâh chavah cha râhri ta hmâpa ta, Chinere tawhta sie lymâ ta, nochhi lâta Piskâ baikhaihpa ry liata Tilaipi Iahpa Arabâ tilaipi taihta a châ.

“Cha daihti liata bie cha pie ei na ta, nama hnohta, ‘ Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta he râh he nama hnei awpa ta a cha pie ei. Nama pasaipha zydua chariah chhaichhi a tobipa ta nama unawhpa Izarei sawzy hmia lâta chavah ama chaka aw.
Sahroh hluhpi nama hnei tahpa pahno na ta, chavâta nama lapinôzy nata nama saw hawtipazy cha nama sahrohzy chhaota khihpi ei cha piepazy liata ama y aw.

Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama unawhzy a piepa râh, Zawdâh haosâ lâ râh cha nama unawhzy ta pahrâpa ta, Abeipa ta nâmo hawhta apahâna a pie ti ei ta, nâmo cha hnei awpa ta râh ei cha piepa chyu lâ namâ kaw lie aw,’ tah na ta.

Cha daihti lia pyly ta Zawsua cha biepie na ta, a hnohta, ‘He bei pano chô liata Abeipa nama Khazohpa hmotaopa zydua na mo ta a hmô khai haw. Cha hawhna chata na tlô awpa khinarâh zydua chô liata Abeipa ta a tao aw.
Âmo cha nama chi awpa châ vei, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta a châ dyuhkhei aw ei,’ tah na ta.
“Cha daihti liata Abeipa lâta thlahchhâ na ta, a hnohta,

‘Hy Abeipa Zehôvâh, châ chakaotuhpa he na rônahna nata na ku thatlôna pahmôsa chi ta, avâ liata tlyma, alei liata tlyma, na raihriazy he kheihawhpa khazoh ma a hria thei aw tly? Na hmotao rônahpazy he kheihawhpa khazoh ma a tao thei aw tly?
Ngiachhiepa ta Zawdâh chavah na chakasa la, Zawdâh haosâ râh phapa, tlâh râh phapa nata Lebanaw râh hao na patlôsa mah y,’ tah na ta.
Châhrasala nâmo vâta ei chô liata Abeipa a pathi ia ta, na nathlie khoh vei. Abeipa ta ei hnohta, ‘Â daih, cha kyh cha na chho khao khah y.
Piskâ tlâh laki lâ kiah la, notla lâ, maw lâ, chho lâ nata nochhi lâ a heih la, na mo ta sai mah y. Nâ la Zawdâh he chaka aw va chi.
Zawsua he biehneina pie la, pasyu la, a thapatlô mah y. Ano ta zawpizy he chhihtha aw ta, na kaw sai awpa râh cha ama ryuto châta a rai aw ei,’ tah ta.
Chatanachata Bepeô dady saikao liata y pi ta.
“Chavâta, Hy Izarei, bieraopa nata pachiana ei cha pachupazy ei he nathliepa ta, nama hroh thei nawpa ta zyh u la, Abeipa, châ pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa ta râh a cha piepa lâ sie u la, kei pahrâ teh u.
Bie ei cha piepa ei kha baichha leipa u la, thy bâ hra leipa u la, Abeipa nama Khazohpa biepiepa nama hnohta ei cha pie pachhuahpazy he zyh muh vy.
Bâlâpeô liata Abeipa hmotaopa kha nama mo ta hmô ta, Bâlâpeô a pazipa zydua Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama hry tawhta a pahleipadia khai hapa chhao nama hmô.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa khâchâ a patu hapazy deikua cha, tanoh taihta nama hroh hih.
Moh teh u, hnei awpa ta namâ ngia haina râh liata nama zyh awpa ta Abeipa ei Khazohpa ta bie eina piepa hawhta, bieraopazy nata pachianazy ei cha pachu ei hih.

Chavâta zyh u la, tao muh vy. Cha cha phopizy mohmô ta nama sona nata novâhna a châ aw. Chatanachata bieraopa zydua cha ama thei tita, “He phopi rônahpa he phopi sopa nata novâhpa tlai na ama châ,” ama tah aw.
Eima padona maih miah a hnia tyhpa Abeipa eima Khazohpa hawhta a hnia tyhpa khazoh a hnei hrapa phopi rônahpa khei hawhpa ma a y?
He tlu ta adopa ryhpa tanoh nama hmiakô liata ei sopa zydua hawhpa bieraopa nata pachiana a hnei hrapa kheihawhpa phopi rônahpa ma a y?

“Chavâta a sohsi u la, nama hro pakhâta ta a vao muh vy. Chataleipatala nama mo ta hmo a hmôpazy kha my aw ei chi ta, nama hro chhôh zydua ta nama palôh tawhta a lei pathlei aw. Chazy cha nama sawzy nata nama samohzy pachu tyh muh vy.

Hôribâ liata Abeipa nama Khazohpa hmiakô liata namâ dua noh kha a thei thlâh ha teh u. Abeipa ta ei hnohta, ‘Zawpizy ei hmiakô liata awpakhy teh. Ei biezy ei pahnosa aw ei. Chatanachata alei chô liata ama hro chhôh zydua ta na chi awpa ta a chu aw ei ta, ama sawzy chhao ama pachu pachhuah thei aw,’ tah ta.
A vaw hnia ei chi ta, tlâh thaby liata a vaw duah ei chi ta, tlâh cha mei ta kâ ta, a meipaleih avâ liahmari taih tlô ta. Meihdo vyhpa nata zoh kaluhpa ta tlâh cha pahly ta.
Abeipa ta mei tawhta nama hnohta bie vaw reih ta, a bie reipa ao thei ei chi ta, châhrasala a pôhpa hmô veih ei chi. A ao deita nama thei.
Nama hnohta a biehrai phuah ta, zyh awpa ta bie a cha pie ei. Cha cha Biepiepa Miahrawh châ ta, Abeipa ta lôphia miano liata a ropa a châ.
Cha daihti liata, hnei awpa ta nama pangaipa râh liata nama tao awpa bieraopa nata pachianazy cha pachu awpa ei ta, Abeipa ta bie eina pie.
“Chavâta pakhâta ta a vaih teh u. Hôribâ liata Abeipa ta mei tawhta nama hnohta bie a rei noh kha, a pôhpa hmô veih ei chi.
Chavâta namâ chhy awpa nothlahpa taopa ta nama molei tlamaw lei nawpa ta a vaih teh u. Kheihawhpa nothlahpa rai, chapaw a lyupa tlyma, chanô a lyupa tlyma,
alei liata sa a lyupa tlyma, avâ liata a zawpa mathlaw hneipa pavaw a lyupa tlyma,
alei liata a lyhpa a lyupa tlyma, alei ry lâta ti liata a ypa nga a lyupa tlyma, nama tao awpa châ vei.

Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta avâ ry liata chyhsa zydua châta a taopa noh, thlâpâ, awhsizy nata avâ liata a ypa zydua nama hmô tita, avâ lâ uapa ta, chazy chata nama palôh cha sy ei sala, namâ chhy pathlei lei nawpa ta a vaih teh u.
Tanoh nama châna hawhna heta, Abeipa ta a ryuto phopi châ awpa ta, Izi râh tawhta, thua patisana mei tawhta cha la papua ei ta, a châ kaw chhi papuapa ei kha a thei thlâh ha muh vy.
Cha dei châ vei, nâmo vâta Abeipa cha ei chô liata a pathi ia ta, Zawdâh chaka lei awpa nata Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta ryuto châta râh phapa a cha piepa ei a ngia lei awpa ta bie eina hraikhâh haw.
Kei cha he râh liata thi aw na ta, Zawdâh chaka aw va na. Nâmo deikua chaka aw ei chi ta, râh phapa cha nama kei hnei aw.

A vaih teh u, chataleipatala Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama hnohta bie a hraipa mypa ta, nothlahpazy taopa ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta kheihawhpa a lyupa nothlahpa hmah tao lei awpa ta a pakhâpa nama tao pathlei aw.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha a kâ patlô theipa mei châ ta, hiatlia a pasapa Khazohpa châ tlôh ta.
“Saw nata samohzy hneipa ta, cha râh liata bohpi nama y tawhta, moleina hmo taopa ta, nothlahpa kheihawhpa rai taopa ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa mohmô ta hmo paraopa ta, a hie nama pahâh khiahta cha,

nâmo pazei nawpa ta pahnokheituhpa châta avâ nata alei tanoh ei aw ei. Zawdâh chakapa ta nama kei hnei awpa râh tawhta thlai leidia aw ei chi ta, cha râh liata hroh pareih leipa aw ei chi ta, pahleipadia khaipa nama châ aw.
Abeipa ta phopizy hry liata cha papai aw ei ta, Abeipa ta a cha papaina phopizy hry liata a chyhta dei pahlôhpa nama châ aw.
Cha liata chyhsapa ku ta taopa tho nata lô khazoh, a hmô thei leipa, a thei thei leipa, a nie thei leipa, roh theina chhao a hnei leipa nama chakao aw.
Châhrasala cha tawhna chata Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha tlua u la, nama pathipalôh tlokhuh ta nata nama thlahpa tlokhuh ta nama tlua khiahta cha, nama hmô heih aw.
Rietheina a tyhpa ta, cha hmo zydua cha nama chô liata a vaw tlô tita, a chhâna liata cha Abeipa nama Khazohpa lâ kua heih aw ei chi ta, a ao nama nathlie aw.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha zawngiah theipa Khazohpa a châ. Cha pathlua leipa aw ei ta, cha pahleipadia hra leipa aw ei ta, châ pathlatuhpazy hnohta bie â taihpa a biehrai my aw vei.

“Nama y hlâta hlâno daihtizy kha hiahri u la, avâ chhâna hiakha lâ tawhta hiakha lâ chhâna taih hiahri tua u. Khazohpa ta alei chô liata chyhsapa a tao noh tawhta, he hawhpa hmo rônahpa he a y beih ma, theipa a châ beih ma?
Mei hry tawhta bie a reihpa Khazohpa ao thei ei chi ta, nama hroh thlâh hapa hawhna heta, Khazohpa ao thei ta a hroh thlâh hapa phopi hropa ama y ma?

Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta Izi râh liata nama mohmô lia tlai ta nama châta a taopa hawhna khata, pasiana ta zy, ngiana ta zy, hmonoâhpa ta zy, adyuhna ta zy, ku thatlôpa ta zy, bâh pazawhpa ta zy, hmo chichhih ngaitapa taopa zy ta, phopi miakha tawhta phopi miakha la papuapa ta, ano phopi a paduapa khazoh a y beih ma?
Nâmo hnohta deikua cha, Abeipa cha Khazohpa châ ta, ano leipa ta Khazoh hropa rai y veih ei tahpa palâhâhpa a châ.
A cha pachu thei nawpa ei ta, avâ tawhta a ao cha patheisa ei ta, alei chô liata ano mei rônahpa cha pahmôsapa ta, mei hry tawhta a bie nama thei.
Châ pathlatuhpazy kyh a pachâpa vâta, âmo hnôh lâta ama pathlazy a tlyh ta, a ypâna nata a hmotaotheina rônahpa ta Izi râh tawhta a châ chhi papua ei.
Nâmo hlâta phopi lai viapa nata thatlô viapazy nama hmia kô liata papua ta, tanoh nama hmôpa hawhna heta, ama râh cha nama ryuto châta cha pie awpa ta a châ kaw chhi ei.
Chavâta tanoh he Abeipa cha chô lâ avâ liata nata ry lâ alei liata Khazohpa châ ta, Khazoh hropa rai y veih ei, tahpa nama pathipalôh liata khâchâ a vao teh u.

Chavâta a bieraopa nata a biepiepa tanoh ta ei cha piepazy ei he nama zyh awpa a châ. Chatanachata nâmo nata nama pathlazy châta pha aw ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta chhâzaw châta râh a cha piepa lia ei ta nama hro a pareih aw,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Mawsi ta Zawdâh nochhi lâta khihpi miathôh a tlyh ta.
Chazy cha daihti khô chiehpa liata â khakhai leipa opapa a thie pathleipa a râ nawpa châta a châ. Cha khihpi miakha lâ lilaw a râ aw ta, a hrona a pabohsa aw.
Râhchawhpa tlâh by liata Beze khihpi cha Rubena pathlazy châta châ aw ta, Kâdâ pathlazy châta Kilia liata Ramô khihpi châ aw ta, Bâsanâ liata Kôlâ khihpi cha Manase chizy châta a châ aw.
He he Mawsi ta Izarei sawzy a piepa ryhpa a châ.
Hezy he Izi râh tawhta ama kaw pua nota, Mawsi ta Izarei sawzy hnohta a reipa pahnosanazy, bieraopazy nata pachianazy a châ.
Izi râh tawhta ama kaw pua nota, Mawsi nata Izarei sawzy ta ama thiepa, Hesbaw liata a ypa Amawri bei Sihaw râh liata Bepeô dady Zawdâh nochhi lâ liata a reipa biezy a châ.
Zawdâh nochhi lâta a pahrâpa Amawri bei pano, Sihaw nata Bâsanâ bei Ôkâ râhzy cha hnei ei ta,
Anaw saikao chhâna Arôerâ tawhta Siriô Tlâh taihta ama hnei. Siriô Tlâh cha Hâmaw Tlâh tahpa a châ hra.
Zawdâh nochhi lâta Arabâ râh zydua cha, Piskâ tlâh baikhaihpa ry liata Arabâ Tilaipi tlôna taihta ama hnei khai haw.
Mawsi ta Izarei saw zydua awpakhy ta ama hnohta, “Hy Izarei, tanoh nama nah theina liata ei reipa bieraopazy nata pachianazy he nathlie u la, a chu u la, pakhâta ta zyh teh u.
Abeipa eima Khazohpa ta Hôribâ liata eima hnohta bie hraih ta.
Cha biehrai cha Abeipa ta miah pathlatuhpazy hnohta vaw tao leipa ta, keimo sahlao, tanoh ahrohpa zydua hnohta a taopa a châ.
Abeipa ta tlâh liata mei hry tawhta hmiachhypa ta bie châ chho ei ta.
Cha nota, nâmo cha mei vâta chi ei chi ta, tlâh lâ namâ khy ngâh leipa vâta, Abeipa nata nâmo likawh liata a duah na ta, nama hnohta Abeipa bie ei phuahpa kha a châ. Abeipa ta hetana heta a tah.
“Kei he Abeipa na Khazohpa, Izi râh, seichâna o tawhta châ chhi papuatuhpa ei châ.
“Keima leipa ta khazoh hropazy na hnei awpa châ vei.

“Na châta nothlahpa khazoh na tao awpa châ vei. Chô lâ avâ liata a ypa a lyupa tlyma, ry lâ alei liata a ypa a lyupa tlyma, alei ry lâta ti liata a ypa a lyupa tlyma, kheihawhpa nothlahpa khazoh hmah na châta na tao awpa châ vei.

Chazy cha nâ chhy awpa châ leipa ta, na chakao awpa châ vei. Kei Abeipa na Khazohpa he Khazoh hiatlia pasapa châ na ta, pawzy paraona vâta sawzy a hrie tyhpa ei châ. Nâ haotuhpazy cha chhâ thôhna nata chhâ palihna taihta a hrie tyhpa châ na ta,
kyh na pachâ ta, ei biepiepazy a zyhtuhpa sâh hluhpizy chô liata deikua cha, ngiachhiena a palâsa tyhpa ei châ.
“ Abeipa na Khazohpa moh na reih thlâhthli awpa châ vei. Abeipa ta a moh a reih thlâhthlipa cha thailei a pachâsa aw.
“ Abeipa na Khazohpa ta bie a cha piepa hawhta, Pahânoh pathaisa aw chi ta, na chay awpa a châ.
Noh charu chhôh rai hria aw chi ta, na rai zydua na hria aw.

A noh sarina noh deikua cha, Abeipa na Khazohpa châta Pahânoh a châ. Cha noh liata cha khâpa rai hmah na hria awpa châ vei. Nâ chhao, na sawchapaw chhao, na sawchanô chhao, na seichapaw chhao, na seichanô chhao, na viahchao tôhpa chhao, na alâ chhao, na sahroh zydua nata na o liata chihropa a ypa zydua ta rai nama hria awpa châ vei. Nâ hawhta, na seichapawzy nata na seichanôzy chhao Pahânoh liata cha amâ pahâ khai aw.

Nâ chhao Izi râh liata sei châ chi ta, cha tawhtapa cha Abeipa na Khazohpa ta ku thatlôpa nata bâh pazawhpa ta a châ chhi papua tahpa a thei thlâh ha mah y. Chavâta Abeipa na Khazohpa ta Pahânoh chay awpa ta bie a cha pie.
“ Abeipa na Khazohpa ta bie a cha piepa hawhta, na nô nata na paw palyupalih teh. Chatanachata Abeipa ta râh a cha piepa liata vânoh to aw chi ta, na hro a pareih aw.
“Liany na chei awpa châ vei.
“Nâ phei awpa châ vei.
“Na paru awpa châ vei.
“Haipa ta na vaih na leih awpa châ vei.

“Na vaih lapinô na uahva awpa châ vei. Na vaih o na uahva awpa châ leipa ta, a lyu tlyma, a seichapaw tlyma, a seichanô tlyma, a viahchao tôhpa tlyma, a alâ tlyma, na vaih hmo kheihawhpa rai na uahva awpa châ vei.

“Cha biezy cha Abeipa ta tlâh liata mei nata meihdo nata zoh kaluhpa hry tawhta ao paro ngaitapa ta nama zawpi pôhpakhypa zydua hnohta reih ta, baichha khao vei. Cha biezy cha lô phiapa miano liata roh ta, ei hnohta eina pie.
“Mei ta tlâh a kâ hai nota, zohna hry tawhta ao nama theipa nahta, nama chi luhpa zydua nata nama machâ zydua nâ vaw hnia ei chi ta,
‘ Abeipa eima Khazohpa ta a rônahzie nata a zachhihzie miah pahmôsa ta, mei hry tawhta a ao eima thei. Khazohpa ta chyhsapa bie a chho ta, a hroh thlâh hapa tanoh eima hmô haw.
Chavâta khazia eima thi aw? Abeipa eima Khazohpa ao eima thei heih khiahta deikua cha, he mei chahra ngaitapa heta miah kâsao aw ta eima thi aw.
Keimo ta mei hry tawhta Khazohpa hrohpa bie reipa ao eima theipa hawhta thei ta, châhrasala a hrohpa chyhsa zydua hry liata ahy ma a y?

Chavâta nâ ta a kei hnia la, Abeipa eima Khazohpa ta a rei awpa zydua nathlie mah y. Chatanachata Abeipa eima Khazohpa ta na hnohta a reipa zydua miah chho aw chi ta, nathlie aw pi ta, eima tao aw,’ nama tah.
“Ei hnohta bie nama reipa cha Abeipa ta thei ta. Abeipa ta ei hnohta, ‘Kha phopi ta na hnohta bie ama reipa thei na ta, ama reipa zydua a pha.
Aw, he hawhpa palôh he khâ ama phaoh tyh mawh sala, na chipa ta, ei biepiepazy zyh aw ei ta, âmo nata ama pathlazy chhâzaw ta thlaochhipa ta ama y awpa tlai!
Vawh la, ama hnohta, “Nama poh ozy lâ a di teh u,” kei tah teh.
Nâ deikua cha ei kiapâh liata a duah la, hnei awpa ta râh ei piepa liata tao awpa na pachu awpa biepiepa, bieraopa nata pachiana zydua ei cha chho aw,’ tah ta.
Chavâta Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta bie a cha piepa hawh ei ta pakhâta ta tao u la, chachâh lâ tlyma, chavei lâ tlyma, nama tlei awpa châ vei.

Abeipa nama Khazohpa lâpi a chhih aw ei chi ta, a biepiepa zydua nama zyh awpa a châ. Chatanachata hroh aw ei chi ta, nama châta pha aw ta, nama hnei awpa râh liata thlaochhipa ta y aw ei chi ta, nama hro a pareih aw.
“He he Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nâmo pachu awpa ta bie eina piepa, hnei awpa ta nama kei tlô awpa râh liata nama zyh awpa biepiepazy, bieraopazy nata pachianazy a châ:
Chatanachata Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha chipa ta, a bieraopa nata a biepiepa ei cha piepazy he nama hro chhôh zydua ta zyh aw ei chi ta, nama hro a pareih aw.

Chavâta Hy Izarei, nathlie la, pakhâta ta zyh mah y. Chatanachata Abeipa, châ pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa ta bie a châ taihpa sâhpiti nata kheihti lona râh liata thlaochhipa ta y aw ei chi ta, thata nama pôh aw.
“Hy Izarei, nathlie teh. Abeipa cha eima Khazohpa châ ta, Abeipa cha pakha deita a y.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha nama pathipalôh tlokhuh ta, nama thlahpa tlokhuh ta, nama thatlôna tlokhuh ta kyh nama pachâ awpa a châ.
Tanoh ta bie ei cha piepazy ei he, nama palôh liata y thlâh ha mawh sy.
Nama sawzy phahnai khoh ngaitapa ta pachu aw ei chi ta, nama o liata namâ tyu nota zy, lâpi liata nama sie nota zy, namâ zia nota zy, nama thyu daihti zy liata nama reih tyh aw.
Ngiana châta nama ku liata chahry aw ei chi ta, khiriena ta nama mo nata mo likawh liata nama rie aw.
Nama ochhi tôhzy nata nama kaohraizy liata chhao nama roh awpa a châ.
“ Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta châ pathlatuhpa Abarahâ, Aisika nata Zakaw hnohta pie awpa ta bie â vaw taihpa râh, nama padua leipa khihpi rônahpa nata phapazy,
nama pabie leipa hmo phapa to ta a biepa ozy, nama chao leipa tikhaohzy, nama lo leipa kre sadôzy nata ôli thozy yna râh lâ a châ chhi ti ei ta, nie aw chi ta lôhrâtlôpa ta nama y tita,
a chado kaw muh vy. Chataleipatala Izi râh, seichâna o tawhta châ chhi papuatuhpa Abeipa nama my pathlei aw na.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha chi aw chi ta, ano deita chakao aw chi ta, ano moh reipa ta bie namâ taih awpa a châ.
Khazoh hropa, nama chheipâh liata a ypa chihropa khazohzy namâ chhy awpa châ vei.
Nama hnohta a ypa Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha hiatlia pasapa Khazohpa a châ. Nama chô liata Abeipa nama Khazohpa a pathi ia aw ta, alei chô tawhta a cha pahleipadia pathlei aw ei.
“Mâsâ liata nama pasiapa hawhna khata Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha nama pasia awpa châ vei.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama hnohta a cha piepa biepiepazy, a biepahnosapazy nata a bieraopazy pakhâta ta nama zyh awpa a châ.
Thlaochhipa ta nama y thei nawpa nata Abeipa ta châ pathlatuhpazy hnohta bie â vaw taihpa râh phapa lâ siepa ta nama hnei thei nawpa ta, Abeipa mohmô ta hmo dopa nata hmo phapa nama tao awpa a châ.
Abeipa ta a reipa hawhta, nama chariahpa zydua nama hmiakô tawhta nama papua khai awpa a châ.
“Noh hro ta nama sawzy ta, ‘ Abeipa eima Khazohpa ta bie a cha piepa ei, pahnokheinazy, bieraopazy, pachianazy cha khâpa ma a yzie?’ tahpa ta ama cha hiahri tita,
nama sawzy hnohta, ‘Izi râh liata Phiraoh sei ta y pi ta, Abeipa ta Izi râh tawhta ku thatlôpa ta miah â kaw chhi papua.
Abeipa ta ngiana nata hmonoâhpa rônahpa nata nôpochhih ngaitapazy Izi râh nata Phiraoh nata a chhôhkha zydua chô liata eima mohmô ta palâsa ta.
Keimo deikua cha miah pathlatuhpazy hnohta bie â vaw taihpa râh lâ miah a chhipa ta, cha râh cha miah pie awpa ta Izi râh tawhta miah â kaw chhi papua.
Thlaochhipa ta khâ ypa ta, tanoh hawhna heta eima hrona miah a pahlôh lymâ thei nawpa ta, Abeipa eima Khazohpa cha chipa ta, he bieraopa zydua he tao awpa ta Abeipa ta bie miah a pie.
Bie miah a piepa hawhta, biepiepa zydua he Abeipa eima Khazohpa hmiakô liata pakhâta ta eima tao khiahta cha, eima châta siana a châ aw’ tahpa ta nama chho aw.

“ Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta hnei awpa ta nama pangaipa râh a cha tlôkhei ti ei ta, phopi hluhpi, Hiti mo, Kikâsi mo, Amawri mo, Kâna mo, Perizi mo, Hivi mo nata Zebu mozy, nâmo hlâta maluh hluh viapa nata thatlô viapa phopi mia saripazy nama hmiakô tawhta a papua aw ei.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta âmo cha nama ku liata cha piepa ta nama pahnie tita, tlokhuh nama pahleipadia khai awpa a châ. Âmo nata biehrai nama tao awpa châ leipa ta, nama ngiachhie awpa châ hra vei.
Âmo nata a hnei pahlao awpa châ leipa ta, ama sawchapawzy châta nama sawchanôzy nama pie awpa châ leipa ta, nama sawchapawzy châta ama sawchanôzy nama hia awpa châ vei.
Chataleipatala keima pazina tawhta nama sawchapawzy patleisapa ta, Khazoh hropazy chakaosa aw ei ta, nama chô liata Abeipa a pathi iapa ta, thlai a cha pahleipadia pathlei aw ei.
Hetana heta ama chô liata nama tao aw: Ama maisâhzy pacho aw ei chi ta, ama lôbôzy nama pakei aw. Ama Aseri tôhzy thlu aw ei chi ta, ama khazoh nothlahpazy mei ta nama rao khai aw.
“ Abeipa nama Khazohpa châta phopi pathaihpa nama châ. Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta ano ryu sôhpa châ awpa ta, alei chô liata phopi zydua hry tawhta â tlyhpa nama châ.
Phopi hropazy hlâta nama hluh viapa vâta Abeipa ta nama chô liata a kyhpachâna palâsa ta a châ tlyhpa ei châ vei. Phopi zydua hry liata phopi chyh chaipa nama châ.
Abeipa ta kyh cha pachâ ei ta, châ pathlatuhpazy hnohta bie â taihpa a patlô khohpa vâta, Abeipa ta seichâna o tawhta ku thatlôpa ta cha pachha ei ta, Izi bei Phiraoh ku tawhta a cha pachha ei.

Chavâta Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha Khazohpa a châ tahpa pahno teh u. Ano cha Khazohpa ngâchhihpa châ ta, ano kyhpachâ ta a biepiepa a zyhtuhpazy chô liata a biehrai nata a zawngiahna chhâ sâh kha taihta a paysapa a châ.
Ano a haotuhpazy deikua cha, hmiadaisâ ta viari thô ta, a pahleipadia tyh ei. Ano a haotuhpazy viari thô awpa ta hawh aw vei. Hmiadaisâ ta viari a thô aw ei.
Chavâta tanoh ta ei cha piepa biepiepazy, bieraopazy nata pachianazy he zyh u la, tao muh vy.
“Cha pachiana biezy cha nathliepa ta, zyh ei chi ta nama taopa vâta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta châ pathlatuhpazy hnohta bie â vaw taihpa a biehrai nata a ngâchhihna nama chô liata a patlôsa aw.

Nama Khazohpa ta kyh cha pachâ aw ei ta, byhnâ cha pie aw ei ta, maluh a cha papôhsa aw ei. Cha pie awpa ei ta châ pathlatuhpazy hnohta bie â vaw taihpa râh liana cha nama chhi theizy, nama lei theizy, nama sâhzy, nama kresawhtizy nata nama sathawzy byhnâ pie aw ta, nama viahchao nata mietaku zawzy a papôhsa aw.
Phopi hropa zydua hlâta byhnâ pie viapa châ aw ei chi ta, nama hry liata a chanô chapaw ta saw leipa rai y aw veih ei. Nama sahrohzy chhao choh tlâ aw vei.
Abeipa ta hri zydua cha papaipa aw ei ta, Izi râh liata hri nama hmôpa kheihawhpa ta hmah cha pasasa leipa aw ei ta, châ haotuhpa zydua chô liata deikua a patlôsa aw.

Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama ku liata a cha pie awpa phopi zydua nama pahleipadia khai awpa a châ. Ngiachhiena mokhaoh ta âmo cha nama moh awpa ei châ leipa ta, ama khazohzy nama chakao awpa châ vei. Cha cha na châta khoheih a châ aw.
“Nama palôh ta, ‘He phopizy he keimo hlâta hluh via tlôh ei ta, kheihta ma eima pho thei aw?’ nama tah thei.
Âmo cha nama chi awpa châ vei. Phiraoh nata Izi râh zydua chô liata Abeipa nama Khazohpa hmotaopa kha a thei thlâh ha teh u.

Nama mo tlai ta pasiana rarôh ypa hmô ei chi ta, ngiana nata hmonoâhpazy taopa ta, ku thatlôpa nata bâh pazawhpa ta Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta a châ kaw chhi papuapa hawhna ei khata, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama chi kawpa phopizy chô liata chhao a tao aw.
Cha dei châ vei, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta ama hry liata kheihpangiah vaw tuah aw ta, nâmo tawhta a nyupa laibâhpa zydua taihta a siesao aw ei.
Âmo cha nama chi awpa châ vei. Abeipa nama Khazohpa, Khazoh rônahpa nata chichhihpa nama hnohta a y.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama hmia liata phopi a ypazy cha a chyh chyhta ta a cha papuapa aw ei. Thlai ta nama pahleipadia khai awpa ei châ vei. Chataleipatala râhsazy ta ama cha pôh thlu pathlei aw.
Phopizy cha pahleipadiapa ama châ khai hlâlei, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama ku liata pie aw ei ta, thata a patypamâ aw ei.
Ama beizy nama ku liata hlâ aw ta, avâ ry liata ama moh y khao lei awpa ta tao aw ei chi ta, nama pahleipadia khai hlâlei cha, châ pakhâ theipa pakha hmah y aw veih ei.

Ama khazoh nothlahpazy mei ta rao aw ei chi ta, cha liata a ypa tâkâ tlyma, ngôh tlyma, nama uahva awpa châ leipa ta, nama châta namâ la awpa châ hra vei. Chataleipatala khazoh nothlahpazy liata namâ ao pathlei aw, khazoh nothlahpa cha Abeipa nama Khazohpa châta pasichhihpa châ tlôh ta.

Na o chhôh liata hmo pasichhihpa nâ ngiakhei awpa châ vei. Chataleipatala nâ chhao, cha hmo hawhta pahleipadiapa na châ aw. Cha cha chhiesapa hmo a châpa vâta na pasi kaw awpa châ ta, nâ hao ngaita awpa a châ.

“Tanoh ta bie ei cha piepa zydua ei he pakhâta ta nama tao awpa a châ. Chatanachata hroh aw ei chi ta, pôh aw ei chi ta, châ pathlatuhpazy hnohta Abeipa ta bie â taihpa râh liata a ngia aw ei chi ta, râh cha nama hnei aw.

A biepiepazy nama zyh ma, zyh vei ma tahpa nama palôh pahno nawpa ta, cha panawh ta, cha pasia awpa ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta kô sypalih dua râhchawhpa liata a châ chhipa ei namâ thei thlâh awpa a châ.

Chyhsapa he viahchhâ dei ta hroh leipa ta, Abeipa pakah tawhta a puapa bie to ta tlao a hroh tahpa nama pahno thei nawpa ta, cha panawh ei ta, nodipa ta a cha paysa ei. Chatanachata nama pahno beih leipa, châ pathlatuhpazy chhao ta ama pahno beih leipa mânâ ta a cha pasa ei.
Kô sypalih chhôh nama chysiazy chy leipa ta, nama phei chhao thloh vei.
Chyhsa ta a sawchapawpa a chhoreipa hawhta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta a cha chhorei ei tahpa nama palôh ta pahno thlâh ha mawh sy.
Chavâta Abeipa nama Khazohpa biepiepazy zyh u la, a lâpi a chhihpa ta, ano cha chi muh vy.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta râh phapa, chavah hluhna nata saikao nata tlâh tawhta tihnawh nata vahtie ti lona râh lâ a châ chhi ei.
Cha râh cha âtâ nata bâli, kre zôh nata theiku kô, pawmikarânâ nata ôli kôzy nata kheihti yna râh a châ.
Phahla leipa ta viahchhâ nama nie nawpa râh, khâpa hmah namâ phahla lei nawpa râh châ ta, thuazy alô tlu ta hluh ta, tlâhzy liata dawh nama chao thei nawpa râh a châ.
Nie aw ei chi ta, lôhrâtlôpa ta nama y tita, râh phapa châ pietuhpa Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha reithai muh vy.
“ Abeipa nama Khazohpa biepiepazy, pachianazy nata bieraopazy tanoh ta ei cha piepa ei he nama zyh leipa khiahta cha, Abeipa nama Khazohpa my pathlei aw ei chi ta, chavâta a vaih muh vy.
Chataleipatala niepa ta lôhrâtlôpa ta nama y tita zy, o phapazy sapa ta cha liata na pahrâ tita zy,
nama viahchao hri nata mietaku zawzy a vaw pôh tita zy, nama tâkâ nata ngôhzy a pôh tita zy, nama hneipa zydua a pôh tita,
nama palôh lai aw ta, Izi râh seichâna o tawhta châ chhi papuatuhpa Abeipa nama Khazohpa nama my pathlei aw.
Ano ta râhchawhpa kawh ngaitapa nata rarôh y ngaitapa, rihhrâh nata râh cha-iazy yna, ti y leina râh chawh karaipa liata châ chhi ei ta, meilô lôpanô tawhta ti a cha papuapa ei.
Châ pathlatuhpazy ta ama pahno beih leipa mânâ ta cha pasa ei ta, a chhâna liata nama pha nawpa ta, cha panawh ei ta, a cha pasia ei.
Chataleipatala nama palôh liata, “Keimo hmotaotheina nata eima ku thatlôna ta he hmozy he eima hnei,” nama tah pathlei aw.

Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha namâ thei thlâh ha awpa a châ. Ano tlai cha nama hneirôh nawpa ta hmotaotheina châ pietuhpa ei châ ta, tanoh ta namâ tyhpa hawhna heta, châ pathlatuhpazy hnohta bie â taihpa a biehrai a pa-ituhpa a châ.
Chavâta Abeipa nama Khazohpa mypa ta, khazoh hropazy zipa ta, chazy cha chakaopa ta namâ chhy khiahta cha, nama leidia tlai aw tahpa tanoh zikyu ei châ râ ei.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa ao nama nathlie vei khiahta cha, nama hmiakô liata phopizy a pahleipadiapa hawhta, nâmo chhao nama leidia aw.
“Hy Izarei, nathlie teh, nâmo hlâta maluh hluh viapa nata thatlô viapa, avâ taihta thokhy ta dôhpa khihpizy siehnao ta pho awpa ta, tanoh cha Zawdâh nama chaka bâ aw.
Phopi pôh pahreihpa nata doh seihpa, Anâki pathlazy ama châ. Âmo cha pahno ei chi ta, ‘Anâki pathlazy hmiakô liata ahy a duah thei aw?’ ama tah tyhpa nama thei.

Chavâta Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha, mei a kâsao theipa hawhta nama hmia lâta a siepa a châ tahpa tanoh pahno teh u. Ano ta âmo cha nama hmiakô liata pahleipadia aw ta, a panawh aw ei. Abeipa ta bie a châ taihpa hawh ei ta, âmo cha papua aw ei chi ta, thlai nama pahleipadia aw.

“ Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta âmo cha nama hmiakô tawhta a cha papuapa khai tawh ei ta, nama palôh liata, ‘Eima siana vâta Abeipa ta he râh he hnei awpa ta miah â kaw chhi,’ nama tah awpa châ vei. He phopizy moleina vâta Abeipa ta nama hmiakô tawhta a papuapa ei tlao a châ.

Nâmo siana vâta tlyma, nama palôh â dopa vâta tlyma, ama râh liata a ngiapa ta nama hnei awpa châ leipa ta, he phopizy moleipa vâta nata Abeipa ta châ pathlatuhpa Abarahâ, Aisika nata Zakaw zy hnohta bie â vaw taihpa a pa-i thei nawpa ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta âmo cha nama hmiakô tawhta a papuapa a châ.
“Chavâta he he pahno teh u. Nama siana vâta Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta he râh phapa he hnei awpa ta a cha piepa ei châ vei. Nâmo cha phopi chhorupa nama châ.
“Râhchawhpa liata Abeipa pathi nama pa-iapa kha a thei thlâh ha u la, my beih khuh vy. Izi râh tawhta nama kaw pua noh tawhta, he su nama vaw tlôna taihta, Abeipa a dyuhtuhpazy nama châ.
Hôribâ liata chhao Abeipa pathi pa-ia ei chi ta, cha pahleipadia khai awpa taihta Abeipa cha nama chô liata a pathi a ia.

Bie rona lôphiazy, Abeipa ta nama hnohta bie a hraina biehrai lôphiazy la awpa ta tlâh lâ ei khy nota, noh sypalih nata zâ sypalih tlâh liata y na ta, viahchhâ rai nie leipa na ta, ti chhao doh va na.
Abeipa ta bie rona lôphia miano, Khazohpa kudy ta ropa na pie ta, cha liana chata namâ pôhpakhy noh ta tlâh chô liata mei hry tawhta Abeipa ta nama hnohta bie a reipa zydua ropa a châ.
Noh sypalih nata zâ sypalih a tloh nahta, Abeipa ta bie rona lôphia miano, biehrai lôphiazy cha na pie ta.

Abeipa ta ei hnohta, ‘Thyu la, he su tawhta zu para teh. Izi râh tawhta nâ kaw chhi papuapa, na phopi ama molei ha khuh. A chhih awpa ta bie ei piepa lâpi thlai tleisai ei ta, nothlahpa tlao amâ tao,’ tahpa ta na chho ta.
“Cha dei châ vei, Abeipa ta, ‘He phopi he ei hmô ha ei, moh tua, phopi chhorupa ama châ hih!
Chavâta na patypamâ khah y. Pahleipadia aw ei na ta, avâ ry tawhta ama moh ei phie aw. Âmo hlâta phopi hmotaothei viapa nata lai viapa ta nâ ei cha tao aw,’ tahpa ta na chho ta.
Chatanachata a heih na ta, tlâh tawhta za chô na ta, tlâh cha mei ta kâ hai ta, biehrai lôphia miano cha ei ku kârano ta chaba na ta.
Mohmia pasaih na ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa chô liata nama vaw moleipa hmô na ta. Viahchao taw nothlahpa a tao ei chi ta, Abeipa biepiepa lâpi tawhta thlai nama tlei haw.
Chavâta lôphia miano cha chalo na ta, ei ku kârano ta thy na ta, nama mohmô liata ei pakei hapa kha a châ.

Molei ha ei chi ta, Abeipa mohmô ta hmo parao ei chi ta, a hie nama pahâh hapa vâta, ei tao tuapa hawhna khata, noh sypalih nata zâ sypalih Abeipa hmiakô liata pao heih na ta, viahchhâ nie leipa na ta, ti chhao doh va na.

Abeipa cha nama chô liata thata a hiehâh ta, cha pahleipadia khai awpa taihta a khohpa vâta, Abeipa hiehâhna nata pathiiana cha chi na ta. Châhrasala kha daihti liana chhao khata Abeipa ta ei bie nathlie ta.
Abeipa cha Arawna chô liata pahleipadia khona taihta a pathi ia ta, châhrasala kha daihti liana khata Arawna châta chhao thlahchhâ na ta.

Nama moleina hmo, viahchao taw nothlahpa nama taopa kha la na ta, mei liata rao na ta, pakeichheih khaipa ta, dohlei hawhta dina taihta charo na ta, tlâh tawhta chavah zâ lohpa liata a paoh ei thy haw.
“Tâberâ liata zy, Mâsâ liata zy, Kibarôhâtavâ liata zy chhao Abeipa hie pahâh ei chi ta.

Abeipa ta, ‘Râh ei cha piepa ei cha kaw hnei teh u,’ tahpa ta Kâdesbânia tawhta a cha pasiesa no ei khata, Abeipa nama Khazohpa biepiepa cha a dyuh ei chi ta, ano cha ngâ leipa ei chi ta, a ao nathlie veih ei chi.
Ei cha pahno tua noh tawh ei ta Abeipa a dyuhpa nama châ.
“Cha pahleipadia awpa ei ta Abeipa ta bie a reih hapa vâta, Abeipa hmiakô liata pao na ta, noh sypalih nata zâ sypalih ei pao.
Abeipa lâ thlahchhâ na ta, a hnohta, ‘Hy Abeipa Zehôvâh, na rônahna ta na pachhapa, Izi râh tawhta ku thatlôpa ta nâ kaw chhi papuapa na phopi nata na ryutozy he rie pahleipadia khah y.
Châ chakaotuhpa Abarahâ, Aisika nata Zakaw zy a thei thlâh ha la, he phopi chhoruna, hmoparaona nata moleina he rie moh khah y.

Chataleipatala miah na kaw puakheina râh ta, “ Abeipa ta ama hnohta bie â taihpa râh lâ â chhi thei leipa vâ ei ta nata â haopa vâ ei ta, râhchawhpa liata thie awpa ta â chhi papua ei,” ama tah pathlei aw.
Âmo he na hmotaotheina rônahpa nata na bâh pazawhpa ta nâ kaw chhi papuapa na phopi nata na ryuto châ tlôh ei ta,’ tah na ta.
“Cha daihti liata Abeipa ta ei hnohta, ‘Lôphia hmiatuapa hawhna khata lôphia miano khai heih la, kei lâta tlâh lâ a khy la, a khô nawpa thobyh tao mah y.
Lôphia hmiatuapa na pakei hapazy liata bieropazy kha lôphiazy liata roh heih aw na ta, byh liata na khô aw,’ tah ta.
Chatanachata Akeisia tho ta byh tao na ta, hmiatuapa hawhta lôphia miano khai na ta, lôphia miano cheipa ta tlâh lâ khy na ta.
Abeipa ta lôphia hmiatuapazy liata a ropa, namâ pôhpakhy noh ta tlâh liata mei hry tawhta nama hnohta a reipa Biepiepa Miahrawh kha, lôphiazy liata roh heih ta. Cha cha Abeipa ta na pie ta.
Chatawhcha a zâ lie na ta, tlâh tawhta za chô na ta, lôphiazy cha byh ei taopa liata khô na ta, Abeipa ta bie eina piepa hawhta cha liata y thlâh ha ta.
“Izarei sawzy cha Berô Benezakâ tawhta Môserâ lâta sie ei ta. Cha liata Arawna thi ta, cha liata pabu ei ta. A sawchapawpa Eliaza ta ano su liata theihthaipa rai hria ta.
Cha tawhna chata Kukôdâ lâ sie ei ta, Kukôdâ tawhta chavah ti hluhna râh Zôbathâ lâ sie ei ta.

Cha daihti liata Abeipa ta Livai chizy cha Abeipa Biehrai Byh a sy awpa nata Abeipa hmiakô liata a duah ta ano chakao awpa nata a moh ta byhnâ a awtuhpa châ awpa ta panano ta, tanoh taihta cha hawhta ama hria lymâ.
Chavâta Livai cha a unawhzy hry liata tovyuh nata ryuto hnei vei. Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta a hnohta a reipa hawhta, Abeipa cha a ryuto a châ.
“Daihti hmiatuapa liatapa hawhna khata, tlâh liata noh sypalih nata zâ sypalih y na ta. Cha nona chhao chata Abeipa ta ei bie nathlie heih ta. Chavâta Abeipa ta a cha pahleipadia khoh leipa ei a châ.
Abeipa ta ei hnohta, ‘Thyu la, phopi kha chhihtha la, ama hmia lâta sie teh. Chatanachata sie aw ei ta, ama pathlatuhpazy hnohta bie ei taihpa râh ama hnei thei aw,’ tah ta.

“Chavâta Hy Izarei, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta a châ hnawpa ei cha khâpa hropa châ leipa ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha chipa ta, a lâpi zydua a chhih ta, ano kyhpachâ ta, nama pathipalôh tlokhuh ta nata nama thlahpa tlokhuh ta Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha chakao ta,
nama pha nawpa ta tanoh bie ei cha piepa ei, Abeipa biepiepazy nata bieraopazy zyhpa a châ.
Moh tua u, avâ nata avâ a sâh chaipa nata leilô nata a chhôh liata a ypa zydua he Abeipa nama Khazohpa eih sai a châ.
Cha hawhpa Abeipa chata châ pathlatuhpazy chô liata a palôh tlâh ta, ama kyhpachâ ta, tanoh nama châna hawhna heta, nâmo, ama pathlazy cha phopi zydua chô lâta cha sopa ta, a châ tlyhpa ei a châ hih.
Chavâta nama pathipalôh chopaw tai u la, chhorupa ta y khao khuh vy.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha khazohzy Khazohpa, beizy Beipa, Khazoh rônahpa, Khazoh thatlôpa nata chichhihpa, khokhei hlei hnei leipa nata panaopapana hmo a la beih leipa a châ.
Paw hnei leipazy nata nôhmeizy châta â dopa ta pachia ta, mapaihpazy kyhpachâ ta, niedo nata chysiazy a pie ei.
Chavâta mapaihpazy kyh pachâ teh u, nâmo chhao Izi râh liata mapaihpazy nama châ hrapa kha.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha chi aw chi ta, ano chakao aw chi ta, ano cha khâchâ patu aw chi ta, ano moh ta bie namâ taih awpa a châ.
Abeipa cha nama reithai awpa a châ. Ano cha nama Khazohpa châ ta, he hmo ronahpa nata rarôh ypa, nama mo ta a hmôpazy a taotuhpa a châ.
Châ pathlatuhpazy kha Izi râh lâ sysari ta zu ei ta, tahmâ cha Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta vâ awhsi zie ta hluhpa ta a cha tao ha ei.
“Chavâta Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha kyh pachâ u la, â hnawpazy, a bieraopazy, a pachianazy nata a biepiepazy khâ nama zyh awpa a châ.
Tanoh pachâ tua u. Abeipa nama Khazohpa chhoreina, a rônahna, a ku thatlôpa nata a bâh pazawhpa zy kha pachâ tua u. A pahno leipa nata a hmô leipa nama sawzy hnohta ei reipa châ vei.
Izi râh liata Izi bei Phiraoh chô liata nata a râh zydua chô liata hmonoâhpa a taopazy nata a raihriazy a pahno leipa nata a hmô leipa zy hnohta ei reipa châ vei.

Izi pheisaihzy nata ama arâzy nata ama talailihzy chô liata a taozie nata, ama châ vaw chadai nota Tilaipi Saihpa ti ta a pavaosapazy nata tanoh taihta Abeipa ta âmo a pahleipadia hapa a pahno leipa nata a hmô leipazy hnohta ei reipa châ leipa ta,
He su nama vaw tlô hlâlei râhchawhpa liata nama châta a hmotaopa a pahno leipa nata a hmô leipa zy hnohta ei reipa châ hra vei.

Rubena sawchapawpa Eliabâ sawchapawpa Dâthâ nata Abirâ chô liata a hmotaopa, alei ta a pakah â ta, Izarei saw zydua hry liata âmo nata ama chhôhkhazy cha ama poh ozy nata hmo hrohneipa amâ chhipa zydua chhaota a palâ khai hapa a pahno leipa nata a hmô leipa nama sawzy hnohta ei reipa châ leipa ta,
nâmo, nama mo tlai ta Abeipa hmo rônahpa taopa zydua a hmôtuhpazy hnohta ei reipa a châ.
“Chavâta thatlôpa ta ypa ta, hnei awpa ta nama pangaipa râh cha nama hnei thei nawpa ta, tanoh ta biepiepa ei cha piepa zydua he nama zyh khai awpa a châ.
Chatanachata Abeipa ta châ pathlatuhpazy nata ama pathlazy hnohta pie awpa ta bie â vaw taihpa râh, sâhpiti nata kheihti lona râh liata bohpi nama pahrâ thei aw.
Hnei awpa ta nama pangaipa râh cha nama vaw puana Izi râh, âhnalasi sadô liata chi tu ei chi ta nama phei ta ti nama bao tyhpa râh hawhpa kha châ vei.
Hnei awpa ta nama pangaipa râh cha tlâhzy nata saikaozy yna râh châ ta, vâsua ti a daopa râh a châ.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta a mohôhpa râh châ ta, kô thaby tawhta kô chhâna taihta Abeipa nama Khazohpa mo ta a tawpâpa râh a châ.
“Chavâta ei biepiepa, tanoh ta ei cha piepazy he ngâchhihpa ta zyh u la, Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha nama pathipalôh tlokhuh ta nata nama thlahpa tlokhuh ta kyhpachâpa ta nama chakao khiahta cha,
nama râh liata a daihtita liata vâsua hmiatuapa nata vâsua hnôhchaipa zy pasuasa tyh aw na ta, chatanachata nama sâh, nama kresawhti nata nama sathaw kôveizy nama pakhy tyh aw.
Nama sahrohzy châta nama lyuzy liata sibiepa paysa aw na ta, nie aw ei chi ta, aoh veipa ta nama y aw.
A vaih teh u, chataleipatala nama palôh dôveipa ta y aw ta, tlei aw ei chi ta, khazoh hropazy chakaopa ta namâ chhy pathlei aw.
Chata a châ khiahta cha, Abeipa pathi nama chô liata ia aw ta, avâ khaw aw ta, avâ sua leipa aw ta, alei ta thei pathei leipa aw ta, Abeipa ta râh phapa a cha piepa tawhta thlai nama leidia aw.
“Chavâta ei biezy he nama palôh nata nama pachâna liata khô aw ei chi ta, ngiana châta nama ku liata chahry aw ei chi ta, nama mo nata mo likawh liata khiriena ta a y awpa a châ.
Nama sawzy pachu aw ei chi ta, nama o liata namâ tyu nota zy, lâpi liata nama sie nota zy, namâ zia nota nata nama thyu daihti zy liata nama reih tyh aw.
Nama ochhi tôhzy nata nama kaohraizy liata roh aw ei chi ta,
chatanachata alei chô lâta avâ a y chhôh zydua cha, châ pathlatuhpazy hnohta pie awpa ta Abeipa ta bie â taihpa râh liata, nâmo nata nama pathlazy châta nama hro nohzy a pasisa aw.
Biepiepa ei cha piepa zydua ei he pakhâta ta zyh u la, Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha kyhpachâ u la, a lâpizy a chhihpa ta, ano khâchâ namâ patu khiahta cha,
Abeipa ta phopi zydua he nama hmiakô tawhta cha papuapa aw ei ta, nâmo hlâta maluh hluh viapa nata thatlô viapa phopizy râh cha nama hnei aw.
Nama phei pazah ta a tlypa maih cha nama eih a châ aw. Râhchawhpa tawhta Lebanaw taihta, Ufrâti chavah tawhta notla lâ tilaipi taihta nama râh a châ aw.
Ahy ta hmah cha pahnie aw veih ei. Nama hnohta a reipa hawhta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama tlô awpa râh zydua liata nâmo china nata nâmo vâta thlazohna a paysa aw.
“Moh teh u, tanoh nama hmiakô liata byhnâ nata chhiesana ei soh hih.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa biepiepa, tanoh ta ei cha piepa ei he nama zyh khiahta cha, byhnâ châ aw ta,
Abeipa nama Khazohpa biepiepazy cha zyh leipa ta, tanoh ta bie ei cha piepa ei he tleisaipa ta, nama pahno beih leipa khazoh hropazy nama pazi khiah deikua cha, chhiesana a châ aw.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta hnei awpa ta nama pangaipa râh a cha tlôkhei ti ei ta, Kerizi Tlâh tawhta byhnâ aw aw ei chi ta, Ebâ Tlâh tawhta chhie nama sa aw.
Cha tlâhzy cha Zawdâh haosâ, lâpi tawhta notla baih lâ, notla râh, Arabâ liata a ypa Kâna mo râh, Kilkal dady liata Môre thothih kiah liata a ypa tlâhzy a châ.
Zawdâh chaka aw ei chi ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta râh a cha piepa ei cha nama kei hnei aw. Cha râh cha hneipa ta, cha liata nama pahrâ tita,
tanoh ta nama hmiakô liata ei sopa bieraopa nata pachiana zydua he pakhâta ta nama zyh khai awpa a châ.
“Hezy he, alei chô liata nama hro chhôh zydua ta, Abeipa, châ pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa ta hnei awpa ta a cha piepa ei râh liata pakhâta ta nama zyh awpa bieraopazy nata pachianazy a châ.
Nama pho awpa phopizy ta tlâh sâhpazy nata tlâh byuhpazy liata nata tho hrohpa to ry liata ama khazohzy ama chakaona su zydua nama parao khai awpa a châ.

Ama maisâhzy pacho aw ei chi ta, ama lôbôzy a tlawh ta phychheih aw ei chi ta, ama Aseri tôhzy mei ta nama rao aw. Ama khazoh nothlahpazy chhawh pachhô aw ei chi ta, cha su tawhta ama moh nama pahlei ha aw.
Âmo taozie hawhta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha namâ chhy awpa châ vei.
“ Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama chi zydua hry liata a moh y nawpa ta â tlyhpa, a pahrâ nawpa su tlua aw ei chi ta, cha su lâ cha nama pangai tyh aw.

Cha liana chata nama raopa hlânazy, namâ theihnazy, nama su hrawh su khazy, nama chalopa hlânazy, nama bietaizy, nama lôhthai hlânazy, nama viahchao hri nata mietaku zaw hry liata a pataw tua chaipa zy nama vaw cheih awpa a châ.
