Cha liata Abeipa nama Khazohpa hmiakô liata nie aw ei chi ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama ku raihria maih liata byhnâ a cha piepa vâ ei ta, nâmo nata nama chhôhkhazy thaphapa ta nama y aw.
“Tanoh ta eima taozie hawhna heta, chyhsa to âmo ta pha ama tahpa hawhta ama tao awpa châ vei,
Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta a pahâ nawpa nata ryu châta a cha piepa ei râh nama tlô mâh leipa vâta.

Châhrasala Zawdâh chaka aw ei chi ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta ryuto châta râh a cha piepa liata nama pahrâ tita, nama chheipâh liata nama chariahpa zydua tawhta cha pahâsa aw ei ta, â bohpa ta nama y aw.

Hmohlâpa kyh liata nama hnohta ei biepiepa zydua, nama raopa hlânazy, namâ theihnazy, nama su hrawh su khazy, nama chalopa hlânazy nata Abeipa lâta bie namâ taihpa hmo phapazy cha, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta a moh y nawpa ta â tlyh awpa su liata nama hlâ tyh aw.

Chatanachata nâmo nata nama sawchapawzy, nama sawchanôzy, nama seichapawzy, nama seichanôzy nata nama hry liata tovyuh nata ryuto râh a hnei leipa Livai chi nama khih liata a ypazy chhao, Abeipa nama Khazohpa hmiakô liata thaphapa ta nama y aw.
Nama raopa hlânazy cha, su rypaohpa nama hmôpa maih liata hlâ thlâh lei awpa ta a vaih teh u.
Nama raopa hlânazy cha, nama chizy hry tawhta Abeipa ta â tlyh awpa chi pahrâna su liata hlâ tyh aw ei chi ta, cha liata nama hnohta ei biepiepa zydua nama tao tyh aw.

“Chatahrasala Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta byhnâ a cha piepa hawh ei ta, nama khihzy liata sa thie thei aw ei chi ta, nama khopa hawhta a sa nama nie thei aw. Sa pathaih leipazy nata pathaihpazy nie thei khai aw ei chi ta, zuneihpa nata sakhih sazy nama niepa hawhta nama nie thei aw.
Thisaih deikua nama nie awpa châ vei. Ti hawhta alei liata nama patlai awpa a châ.

Nama sâh, nama kresawhti, nama sathaw nata nama viahchao hri nata mietaku zaw hry liata a pataw tua chaipazy tawhta su hrawh su kha, nama bietai hmopiepazy, nama lôhthai hmopiepazy nata hmohlâ eihpazy chhao nama khih liata nama nie awpa châ vei.

Nâmo nata nama sawchapawzy, nama sawchanôzy, nama seichapawzy, nama seichanôzy nata Livai chi nama khih liata a ypazy ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta su a rao awpa liata nie aw ei chi ta, nama ku raihria theilâpa cha, Abeipa nama Khazohpa hmiakô liata thaphapa ta nama nie aw.
Nama râh liata nama pahrâ chhôh ta, Livai chi pathlua lei awpa ta a vaih teh u.
“Nama hnohta a bietai hawhta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama râh a pakawh tita, nama aoh liata sa a chhaoh sala, “Sa eima nie aw,” nama tah khiahta cha, nama khona daihti maihta sa nama nie thei aw.

Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta a moh y nawpa ta â tlyh awpa su nata namâ hla tu khiahta cha, nama hnohta ei biepiepa hawhta, Abeipa ta a cha piepa ei nama viahchao hri nata mietaku zaw hry liatapa thie aw chi ta, nama khona daihti maihta nama khih liata nama nie thei aw.
Zuneihpa sa nata sakhih sazy nama niepa hawhta nie aw chi ta, sa pathaih leipa nata pathaihpa nama nie thei khai aw.
Thisaih deikua cha a nie rai ta nama nie awpa châ vei. Thisaih cha hrona châ ta, hrona cha sa nata nama nie pâ awpa châ vei.
Thisaih nama nie awpa châ vei. Thisaih cha ti hawhta alei liata nama patlai awpa a châ.
Thisaih nama nie awpa châ vei. Cha cha Abeipa mohmô ta hmo dopa nama taopa châ aw ta, nâmo nata nama pathla vaw y lymâ awpazy châta a pha aw.
Nama hlâ awpa hmo pathaihpazy nata pie awpa ta bie namâ taihpazy deikua cha cheih aw chi ta, Abeipa ta su a rao awpa lâ nama sie aw.

Nama raopa hlânazy cha Abeipa nama Khazohpa maisâh liata a sapa nata a thisaih nama hlâ aw. Namâ theihna thisaih cha Abeipa nama Khazohpa maisâh liata patlai aw chi ta, a sa deikua cha nama nie thei aw.

Cha bie ei cha piepa zydua ei cha pakhâta ta nathlie u la, zyh muh vy. Chatanachata Abeipa nama Khazohpa mohmô ta hmo phapa nata hmo dopa nama taopa châ aw ta, nâmo nata nama pathla vaw y lymâ awpa chhâ zydua châta a pha aw.
“Pho awpa ta nama siehnaopa phopizy cha, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama hmiakô liata chhawh pathlahpa ta, âmo cha pho ei ta ama râh liata nama pahrâ tita,

nama hmiakô liata pahleipadiapa ta ama ypa hawhna khata, âmo lâpi a chhihpa ta namâ ao hra lei nawpa ta a vaih u la, ‘He phopizy heta kheihta ma ama khazohzy ama chakao tly? Âmo taozie hawhta kei chhao ei tao hra aw,’ tahpa ta ama khazohzy kyh hiahri khuh vy.

Abeipa na Khazohpa cha âmo taozie hawhta namâ chhy awpa châ vei. Ama khazohzy amâ chhyzie liata, Abeipa ta â haopa hmo pasichhihpa to tao ei ta, ama sawchapawzy nata ama sawchanôzy taih mei liata raopa ta ama khazohzy lâta ama hlâ tyh.
Bie ei cha piepa zydua ei he pakhâta ta nama tao awpa a châ. Nama baichha awpa châ leipa ta, nama thy bâ awpa châ hra vei.
“Nama hry liata hrohsopa tlyma, mâ sapa ta chhochhieliena bie a reihpa tlyma vaw pua ei sala, ngiana tlyma, hmonoâhpa tlyma cha pamosa ei sala,

ngiana nata hmonoâhpa ama cha chhopazy cha vaw tlô sala, nama hnohta, “Khazoh hropazy pazi sih la, âmo cha chakao ei suh u,” tahpa ta nama pahno beih leipa khazohzy pazi awpa ta ama cha chho khiahta cha,

cha hrohsopa bie tlyma, mâ sapa ta chhochhielietuhpa bie tlyma cha nama nathlie awpa châ vei. Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta ano cha nama pathipalôh tlokhuh ta nata nama thlahpa tlokhuh ta kyh nama pachâ ma, pachâ vei ma, tahpa a pahno khohpa vâta a cha pasiapa ei a châ.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa pazi aw ei chi ta, ano cha chipa ta, a biepiepazy nama zyh awpa a châ. A ao nathliepa ta, ano chakao aw ei chi ta, ano cha khâchâ namâ patu awpa a châ.

Cha hawhpa hrohsopa tlyma, mâ sapa ta chhochhieliena bie a reihpa tlyma deikua cha, Izi râh tawhta châ kaw chhi papuatuhpa, sei châna o tawhta châ chatlaituhpa Abeipa nama Khazohpa adyuhna bie reih ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta a chhih awpa ta bie a cha piepa ei lâpi tawhta patleisa a châ chhuahpa vâ ei ta, thie awpa a châ. Cha hawhna chata hmo pha leipa cha nama hry tawhta nama pahlei ha aw.

“Na nô sawchapawpa na unawhpa ta tlyma, na sawchapaw ta tlyma, na sawchanô ta tlyma, na kalachhôh liata na lapinô ta tlyma, na hrona tlu ta kyh na pachâpa na viasa pha chaipa ta tlyma ta, ‘Vawh sih la, khazoh hropazy chakao ei suh u,’ tahpa ta, nâ nata châ pathlatuhpazy ta nama pahno beih leipa khazoh a chhy awpa ta arulâta a cha reipasao khiahta cha,
lâhnia liata a ypa nama chheipâh phopizy khazoh rai châ sala, lâhla liata a ypa khazoh rai châ sala, alei chhâna hiakha lâ tawhta hiakha lâ taihta a ypa khazoh a châpa chhao ta,
a rei na zyh awpa châ leipa ta, a bie na nathlie awpa châ hra leipa ta, na ngia a cha chhie awpa châ vei. Na phih awpa nata na nyu awpa châ hra vei.
Na thie thlyu awpa a châ. Thie awpa ta nâ ta a chô liata na ku pathla tua chai aw chi ta, cha khai tawhta zawpi ta a chô liata ku ama pathla aw.
Izi râh tawhta châ kaw chhi papuatuhpa, sei châna o tawhta nâmo châ kaw chhituhpa Abeipa nama Khazohpa tawhta patleisa a châ chhuahpa vâ ei ta, alô ta nama vawhsao awpa a châ.
Chatanachata Izarei saw zydua ta thei aw ei ta, chi aw ei ta, nama hry liata cha hawhpa moleina chichhihpa cha tao khao aw veih ei.
“ Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta pahrâ nawpa ta a cha piepa ei nama khihpi miakha liata bie ama reipa thei u la,
nama hry tawhta moleipazy pua ei ta, nama pahno beih leipa khazoh hropazy a chhy awpa ta ama khihpi liata a pahrâpazy ama paviasa tahpa nama thei khiahta cha,
patluah aw ei chi ta, nama tlua aw. Pakhâta ta hiahri aw ei chi ta, biedopa châ sala, cha hawhpa hmo pasichhihpa cha nama hry liata taopa a châ tahpa pahno pasiapa a châ khiahta cha,
cha khihpi liata a pahrâpazy cha zaozi ta nama thie thlyu awpa châ ta, khihpi chhôh liata a ypa zydua nata sahroh zydua zaozi ta nama pahleipadia khai awpa a châ.

Hraona sôh zydua khihpi tlyliah khophie liata pahmaoh aw ei chi ta, khihpi nata hraona sôh zydua cha Abeipa nama Khazohpa lâta raopa hlâna ta tlokhuh mei ta nama rao khai aw. Cha khihpi cha chhâzaw ta lei byuhpa ta y aw ta, sa pathi heihpa châ khao aw vei.

Hraona sôh hmoziehpazy kheihawhpa hmah nama hria awpa châ vei. Chatanachata Abeipa cha a hiehâhna ru ngaitapa tawhta a palôh pananopa ta, a zawngiahna nama chô liata palâsa aw ta, châ pathlatuhpazy hnohta bie â taihpa hawhta, cha ngiachhie aw ei ta, a cha papôh aw ei.

Cha hawhta a châ thei nawpa ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ao nathlie aw ei chi ta, a mohmô liata hmo dopa taopa ta, tanoh ta ei cha piepa ei Abeipa nama Khazohpa biepiepa zydua he nama zyh khai awpa a châ.
“ Abeipa nama Khazohpa sawzy nama châ. Athihpa châta sasyh namâ â awpa châ leipa ta, nama khipâh sâ ngyupa ta nama patlyh awpa châ vei.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa châta phopi pathaihpa châ ei chi ta, Abeipa ta ano ryuto châ awpa ta alei chô liata phopi zydua hry tawhta â tlyh eihpa nama châ.
“Hmo pasichhihpa rai nama nie awpa châ vei.
Viahchao, mietaku, mie,
sakhih, sasu, sakicheihpa, sathawh, râh mie, sawzaw nata tlâh mietaku zy cha nama nie thei aw.
Sa to a chakie pachiah ta miano ta â pachhaihpa maih nata thie a chaeihpa maih nama nie thei aw.

A thie chaeih ta, a chaki a pachhaihpazy hry liata, hezy deikua he nama nie awpa châ vei: Râraoseihpa nata pazupi nata pihvao zy he ama thie chaeih ei ta, châhrasala ama chakie miano ta â pachhaih leipa vâta nama châta sa pathaih leipa a châ.
Vao he a chakie cha a pachhaih ta, châhrasala a thie a chaeih leipa vâta nama châta sa pathaih leipa a châ. A sa nama nie awpa châ leipa ta, thiruapa chhao nama hria awpa châ vei.
“Ti liata a pahrâpa zydua hry liata hezy he nama nie thei aw: Mathlaw nata phuhlu a hneipa maih nama nie thei aw.
Mathlaw nata phuhlu a hnei leipa cha nie thei aw veih ei chi, nama châta sa pathaih leipa a châ.
“Pavaw pathaihpa zydua nama nie thei.
Pahmôhpi, vâkhieh, vâkhieh vyhpa;
hmôchhih, riarâtaoh chi to, raawh chi to;
vawpô;
valâtla, seihhaohpa, pahmôh chyhpa chi to;
vaku chyhpa, tutahlupa, vaku ki hneipa;
ti pavaw daoh laipa, vâkhieh chapaipa, nga a niepa tyhphy;
vawpô nata riasi chizy, nôpinô nata pazu tâbalâpa zy cha nama châta sa pathaih leipa ama châpa vâta, nama nie awpa châ vei.
Mathlaw hnei ta, a pô ta a ypa lôvâpa zydua nama châta sa pathaih leipa châ ta, nie awpa châ vei.
Mathlaw hneipa sa pathaihpa zydua nama nie thei.

“Ano kho ta a thipa sa kheihawhpa hmah nama nie awpa châ vei. Nama khihzy liata a ypa chihropa nie awpa ta pie thei ei chi ta, râh hropa chyhsa hnohta nama zuah thei hra. Nâmo cha Abeipa nama Khazohpa châta phopi pathaihpa nama châ. Mie taw sa cha a panô sâhpiti ta nama chhoh awpa châ vei.
“Kô chareih nama lyu kôvei zydua tawhta su hrawh su kha nama pie tyh awpa a châ.

Abeipa nama Khazohpa china châh nama pahno lymâ thei nawpa ta, nama sâh, nama kresawhti, nama sathaw nata nama viahchao hri nata nama mietaku zaw hry liata a pataw tua chaipazy tawhta su hrawh su kha cha, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta a moh y nawpa ta â tlyh awpa su liata, ano hmiakô liata nama nie tyh aw.

Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta byhnâ a cha pie ti ei ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta a moh y nawpa ta â tlyh awpa su cha, nama yna tawhta a hla kawpa châ sala, su hrawh su kha cha, cha lâ a cheih thei awpa nama châ vei khiahta cha,
tâkâ lâta nama palie aw. Tâkâ cha cheih aw chi ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta su â tlyhpa lâ nama pangai aw.

Tâkâ cha Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta a moh y nawpa ta â tlyh awpa su liata nama palôh khopa maih chalei nawpa ta nama hmâh aw. Viahchao tlyma, mietaku tlyma, kresawhti tlyma, kresawhti patapa tlyma, nama palôh khopa maih chalei aw ei chi ta, cha liata Abeipa nama Khazohpa hmiakô liata nâmo nata na chhôhkhazy nie aw ei chi ta, thaphapa ta nama y aw.
Livai chizy cha nâmo hawhta tovyuh nata ryuto ama hnei hra leipa vâta, nama yna khih liata Livai chi a ypazy nama my awpa châ vei.
“Kô thôh chhâna maihta, cha kô liata kôvei zydua tawhta su hrawh su kha vaw cheih aw ei chi ta, nama yna khih liata nama pahmaoh aw.

Nâmo hawhta tovyuh nata ryuto a hnei leipa Livai chi nama khih liata a ypazy, mapaihpazy, paw hnei leipazy nata nôhmeizy a vy aw ei ta, nie aw ei ta, rihbiepa ta ama y aw. Chatanachata Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama ku raihria zydua liata byhnâ a cha pie aw ei.
“Kô sari chhâna maihta dyuchei ngiahthaina nama phuah aw.
He he dyuchei ngiahthaina ryhpa a châ: Dyu pacheisatuhpa maihta a vaih dyuchei â ngiahthai awpa a châ. Abeipa ngiahthaina phuahpa a châ hapa vâta, a vaih nata a unawhpa dyuchei a hiah awpa châ vei.
Chihropa cha dyuchei hiah thei aw ei chi ta, nama hneipa kheihawhpa rai nama unawhpa hnohta a ypa deikua cha, nama ku tawhta nama pathlie awpa a châ.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta ryuto châta hnei awpa ta râh a cha piepa ei liata byhnâ cha pie aw ei ta, dyhchhiepa nama hry liata y aw veih ei.
Byhna nama to thei nawpa ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ao pakhâta ta nathlie aw ei chi ta, tanoh ta biepiepa ei cha piepa zydua he nama zyh awpa a châ.

Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta bie a châ taihpa hawh ei ta byhnâ a cha pie aw ei. Phopi hluhpi dyu pacheisa aw ei chi ta, nâmo deikua dyuchei aw veih ei chi. Phopi hluhpi chô liata ryu reih aw chi ta, âmo deikua nama chô liata ryureih aw veih ei.

“ Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta râh a cha piepa ei khih miakha liata nama unawhzy hry liata dyhchhiepa ama y khiahta cha, nama unawh dyhchhiepazy chô liata lôhkhô namâ hli awpa châ leipa ta, nama ku nama pako awpa châ vei.
Âmo lâta nama ku pazawh aw ei chi ta, amâ phahlana pavao nawpa ta, amâ ngiahpa zie ta dyu namâ pacheisa awpa a châ.

A vaih teh u, chataleipatala, ‘Dyuchei ngiahthaina kô, kô sarina a vaw tlô daihmâ haw,’ tahpa ta nama unawh dyhchhiepa cha uasa a chhuah leipa ta, bao khoh leina palôh chhiepa nama hnei pathlei aw. Cha hawhta nama y khiahta cha, Abeipa lâ cha tlôkhei aw ei ta, nama châta moleina a châ aw.

Riapha kawpa ta nama pie awpa châ ta, nama pie tita a ngiapachhina palôh nama hnei awpa châ vei. Cha hawhta nama tao khiahta cha, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama hmotaopa zydua nata nama raihria zydua liata byhnâ a cha pie aw ei.
Khatino rai ta dyhchhiepazy nama râh liata ama y aw. Chavâta, “Nama râh liata dyhchhiepa nata phahlapa nama unawhzy lâta nama ku pazawh muh vy,” tahpa ta bie ei cha pie ei.
“Nama unawhpa Hebrai chyhsa chapaw tlyma, chanô tlyma, nama hnohta zuapa ama châ khiahta cha, kô charu cha chakao aw ei ta, a kô sarina liata cha, khotalaina hnei awpa ta pua nama pasai awpa a châ.
Khotalaipa ta ama pua tita, ku ruapa ta nama pasiesa awpa châ vei.
Nama mietaku zaw, nama sawhri nata nama kresawhti saohpazy tawhta mochhih leipa ta nama pie awpa a châ. Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta byhnâ a cha piepa hawh ei ta, âmo chhao nama pie hra awpa a châ.
Izi râh liata sei ta y ei chi ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta a cha chatlaipa ei kha namâ thei thlâh awpa a châ. Chavâta he biezy he tanoh ei cha pie ei.
Seizy ta nâmo nata nama chhôhkhazy kyh ama cha pachâpa vâ ei ta, nama hnohta ypa pha tah ei sala, ‘Cha puasai aw veih ei na,’ ama tah khiahta cha,
thua pazaopa la aw ei chi ta, ochhi pachhaipa ta ama nah vieh aw ei chi ta, chhâzaw ta nama sei ta ama y aw. Nama seichanô chô liata chhao, cha hawhta nama tao aw.

Nama unawhpa Hebrai seizy cha ahlaohpa hriapa lie no ta hria ei ta, kô charu ama cha chakao hapa vâta, khotalaina pie ta papua awpa cha, nama châta hmo ru tupa ta nama pachâ awpa châ vei. Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama hmotaopa zydua liata byhnâ a cha pie aw ei.

“Nama viahchao hri nata nama mietaku zaw hry liata a chapawpa a pataw tuapa maih cha, Abeipa nama Khazohpa châta nama panano awpa a châ. Nama viahchao hri liata a chapawpa a pataw tua chaipa cha, rai nama pahriasa awpa châ leipa ta, nama mietaku zaw hry liata a chapawpa a pataw tua chaipa hmi chhao nama ngyu awpa châ vei.
Sahroh chapawpa a pataw tuapazy cha, nâmo nata nama chhôhkhazy ta Abeipa ta su â tlyh awpa liata, Abeipa nama Khazohpa hmiakô liata kô chareih nama nie tyh awpa a châ.
Seina a hneipa, pheisypa tlyma, mochaopa tlyma, seina kheihawhpa rai a hneipa cha, Abeipa nama Khazohpa lâta atheihna ta nama hlâ awpa châ vei.
Nama yna khih liata nie aw ei chi ta, sa pathaih leipazy nata pathaihpazy chhao, sasu nata sakhih sazy niepa hawhta pachâpa ta nama nie thei khai aw.
A thisaih deikua nama nie awpa châ vei. Ti hawhta alei liata nama patlai awpa a châ.
“ Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta Abi thla liata Izi râh tawhta zâ ta a châ kaw chhi papuapa vâ ei ta, Abi thla cha chay aw chi ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa châta zawpakhô kyhchhi nama tao aw.
Abeipa ta a moh y nawpa su â tlyh awpa liata Abeipa nama Khazohpa lâta nama mietaku zaw hry tawhta nata viahchao hri hry tawhta zawpakhô atheihna châta nama hlâ aw.

Atheihna sa cha viahchhâ thinô pahlaopa chhaota nama nie awpa châ vei. Izi râh tawhta a para ngaitapa ta nama kaw puapa atheithlâhna châta, noh sari chhôh viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa, pasataona viahchhâ nama nie awpa a châ. Chatanachata Izi râh tawhta nama kaw puana noh cha, nama hro chhôh zydua ta namâ thei thlâh ha aw.
Nama pahrâna râh zydua liata noh sari chhôh thinô hmô awpa a y awpa châ vei. Noh khana noh zâlâ ta namâ theihna sa cha, a kheihawhpa hmah zâ chhôh zydua nata a mylâ taihta a y awpa châ vei.
Zawpakhô atheihna cha Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta a cha piepa ei khih to liata hlâ thlâh awpa châ leipa ta,
Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta a moh y nawpa ta â tlyhpa su liata, Izi râh tawhta nama kaw puana daihti, zâlâ noh tla daihti liata zawpakhô atheihna cha nama hlâ tyh awpa a châ.
Atheihna sa cha rao aw ei chi ta, Abeipa ta su â tlyhpa liata nama nie aw. My ta a lie aw chi ta, nama poh ozy lâ namâ di aw.
Noh charu chhôh viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa nie aw ei chi ta, noh sarina noh cha Abeipa nama Khazohpa châta pakhypi pathaihpa a châ aw. Cha noh liata cha, rai na hria awpa cha vei.
“Hâta ei sari nama paki aw. Cha cha sâkarâ ta sâh nama tai pathao noh tawhta rei awpa a châ.
Chatawhcha Abeipa nama Khazohpa châta Hâta Kyhchhi taopa aw ei chi ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta byhnâ a cha piepa lymâ hawh ei ta, lôhthai hlâna nama hlâ aw.

Chatanachata Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta a moh y nawpa ta â tlyhpa su liata, nama sawchapawzy, nama sawchanôzy, nama seichapawzy, nama seichanôzy, Livai chi nama yna khih liata a pahrâpazy, nama hry liata a ypa chihropazy nata paw hnei leipa nata nôhmeizy chhaota Abeipa nama Khazohpa hmiakô liata thaphapa ta nama y aw.
Izi seichâna liata nama ypa kha a thei thlâhpa ta, cha bieraopazy cha pakhâta ta nama zyh awpa a châ.
“Nama sawhri tawhta nata nama kre saohna khaoh tawhta nama kôveizy nama paly khai nahta, noh sari chhôh byureih kyhchhi nama chay awpa a châ.

Cha kyhchhi cha, nama sawchapawzy, nama sawchanôzy, nama seichapawzy, nama seichanôzy, Livai chi nama khih liata a ypazy, chihropazy, paw hnei leipazy nata nôhmeizy chhaota thaphapa ta nama hmâh tyh aw.

Abeipa ta â tlyhpa su liata Abeipa nama Khazohpa châta noh sari chhôh kyhchhi nama chay awpa a châ. Chatanachata Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama kôvei nata nama ku raihria zydua liata byhnâ cha pie aw ei ta, namâ lyna â ki aw.

“Chapaw zydua ta Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta â tlyh awpa su liata kô kha ta ei thôh a hmiakô liata namâ luah tyh awpa a châ. Viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa kyhchhi liata zy, hâta kyhchhi liata zy, byureih kyhchhi liata zy, Abeipa hmiakô liata ku ruapa ta namâ luah awpa châ vei.
Chyhsa to Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta byhnâ a cha patosapa lymâ hawh ei ta nama pie awpa a châ.
“ Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta a cha piepa ei khih to liata, chi to châta ryureituhpa nata hyutuhpazy rao aw ei chi ta, âmo chata ryureina siapa ta zawpizy ryu ama reipa tyh aw.
Adona nama charichamy awpa châ leipa ta, khokhei viapa nama hnei awpa châ vei. Panaopapana nama la awpa châ vei. Panaopapana ta asopazy mo pachao ta, mosiapazy â sia lâta bie a pareisa tyh.
Nama hro thei nawpa nata Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta râh a cha piepa ei cha ryu ta nama to thei nawpa ta, adona, adona deita nama zi awpa a châ.
“ Abeipa nama Khazohpa châta maisâh nama tao awpa kiapâh liata kheihawhpa tho hmahta Aseri tôh ta hmâpa ta nama bô awpa châ vei.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta â haopa alô chhao nama bô awpa châ vei.

“Seina a hneipa nata rei pasipasua thei awpa a hneipa viahchao tôhpa tlyma, mietaku tlyma hmâpa ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa lâ namâ theih awpa châ vei. Cha cha Abeipa na Khazohpa châta hmo pasichhihpa a châ.
“ Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta a cha piepa ei nama yna khih liata a y hrapa chapaw tlyma, chanô tlyma ta a biehrai paraopa ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa mohmô ta moleina hmo tao sala,
sie ta khazoh hropazy chakaopa ta chazy cha â chhy aw tlyma, a châ vei khiah, noh tlyma, thlâpâ tlyma, avâ liata a ypa kheihawhpa tlyma a chhypa ta, bie ei pie leipa tao sala,
a thâtih cha chho ei sala, nama vaw pahno khiahta cha, pakhâta ta namâ laichadai aw. Biedopa a châ tahpa pasiapa châ sala, cha hawhpa hmo pasichhihpa cha Izarei liata taopa a châ khiahta cha,
cha hmo moleipa a taotuhpa chapaw tlyma, chanô tlyma cha nama yna khih hawka lâ a chhi aw chi ta, cha chapaw tlyma, cha chanô tlyma cha alô ta nama vawhsao awpa a châ.
Thie awpa cha, pahnokheituhpa pano tlyma, pathôh tlyma pahnokheina bie ta thie awpa a châ. Pahnokheituhpa pakha bie ta thie awpa châ vei.
Pahnokheituhpazy ta thie awpa chô liata ama ku pathla tua chai aw ei ta, cha khai tawhta zawpi ta ku ama pathla aw. Cha hawhna chata hmo pha leipa cha nama hry tawhta nama pahlei awpa a châ.

“Thisaih a palona kyh tlyma, kheihawhpa vâta leihna kyh tlyma, atudaina kyh tlyma, nama yna khih liata biepeipa kheihawhpa rai châ sala, nâmo pachia awpa biepeipa rupa nama hnohta ama vaw tlôkhei khiahta cha, thyu aw ei chi ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta â tlyh awpa su lâ nama sie aw.
Cha daihti liata Livai chi theihthaipazy nata ryureituhpazy lâ vawh aw ei chi ta, ama hnohta nama tlôkhei aw. Âmo ta bietluna ama cha chho aw.
Abeipa ta â tlyh awpa su tawhta bietluna ama cha chhopa hawhta tao aw ei chi ta, ama cha pachupa hawhta pakhâta ta nama tao aw.
Ryhpa ama cha pachupa hawhta nata bietluna ama cha chhopa hawhta tao aw ei chi ta, bietluna ama cha chhopa cha chachâh lâ tlyma, chavei lâ tlyma nama tleisai awpa châ vei.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa chakaotuhpa theihthaipa nata ryureituhpa bie nathlie leipa ta, a papeisa leipa chyhsa cha thie awpa a châ. Cha hawhna chata, moleina cha Izarei tawhta nama pahleipadia aw.
Chatanachata chyhsa zydua ta thei aw ei ta, chi aw ei ta, papeisa leipa ta y khao aw veih ei.
“ Abeipa na Khazohpa ta râh a cha piepa ei a ngiapa ta, cha râh cha hneipa ta, cha liata nama pahrâ tita, ‘Eima chheipâh liata phopi zydua taozie hawhta bei eima hnei hra aw,’ nama tah khiahta cha,

bei cha hnei aw ei chi ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta â tlyhpa tlai bei ta nama hnei aw. Nama unawhzy hry tawhta pakha bei ta nama tao aw. Nama unawh a châ leipa chihropa cha, bei ta nama tao awpa châ vei.

Bei cha arâzy deikua a hluhpi a hnei awpa châ leipa ta, arâ hluhpi hnei thei nawpa ta Izi râh lâ chyhsa a tuah awpa châ vei. Abeipa ta, ‘Tahmâ tawhta cha, cha lâpi lâ nama kua beih khao awpa châ vei,’ cha tah ha tlôh ei ta.
Lapinô hluhpi a hnei awpa châ vei. Chataleipatala a lapinôzy ta a palôh ama paviasa pathlei aw. Tâkâ nata ngôh hluhpi a hnei awpa châ hra vei.
“A khinarâh beidyuchhai liata â tyu tita, Livai chi theihthaipazy a vaopa ryhpa cha, châbu liata â ro awpa a châ.

Ryhpa châbu cha a hnohta khâ y aw ta, a hro chhôh noh zydua ta a reih tyh aw. Chatanachata Abeipa a Khazohpa china kyh a chu thei aw ta, cha ryhpa nata bieraopazy liata bie zydua zyh aw ta, a tao lymâ aw.

Chatanachata a palôh lai leipa aw ta, a unawhzy chô lâta a soh aw vei. Biepiepa cha chachâh lâ tlyma, chavei lâ tlyma tlei sai leipa aw ta, â beina Izarei râh liata ano nata a pathlazy bohpi amâ bei thei aw.
“Theihthaipa chi Livai pathla zydua cha, Izarei sawzy hry liata tovyuh nata ryuto ama hnei hra awpa châ vei. Abeipa lâta mei ta hmohlâpazy ama nie awpa châ ta, cha cha ama ryuto a châ.
Ama unawhzy hry liata ryuto hnei aw veih ei. Abeipa ta bie â taihpa hawh ei ta, Abeipa cha ama ryuto a châ.
Hezy he theihthaipazy tovyuh a châ aw: Atheihna a hlâtuhpazy ta viahchao tôhpa nata mietaku ama hlâpa tawhta a palaih nata a ôhkhaih kârano nata a pavyhzy cha, theihthaipa ama pie awpa a châ.
Nama sâh, nama kresawhti nata nama sathaw a veih tuapa nata nama mietaku hmi ngyu tuapa zy chhao theihthaipa nama pie aw.
Ano nata a sawchapawzy cha, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta a moh ta a duah ta, chhâzaw ta chakao awpa ta nama chi zydua hry tawhta â tlypa ama châ.
“Livai chi pakha ta Izarei râh liata a pahrâna khih puasaipa ta, palôh khona hmeiseihpa ta Abeipa ta â tlyh awpa su lâ â vy khiahta cha,
Abeipa hmiakô liata a duah tyhpa Livai chi a unawhzy hawhta, Abeipa a Khazohpa moh ta cha liata a chakao hra aw.
A paw ryu a zuapa tawhta sôh a hmôpa thota, theihthaipazy tovyuh awpazy a to pâ aw.
“ Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta râh a cha piepa ei nama tlô tita, cha râh liata phopizy taozie pasichhihpazy nama tao awpa châ vei.
Ama sawchapaw nata sawchanô mei liata a hlâpazy, pachaothaipazy, kulâmohthaipazy, moliethaipazy nata peihthaipazy nama hry liata ama y awpa châ vei.
Dyuthaipazy, thlahpa nata ahripa bie a chho thaipazy nata athih lâ hryh thaipazy chhao nama hry liata ama y awpa châ vei.
Cha hmozy a taopa cha Abeipa pachâ ta pasichhihpa châ ta, cha hmo pasichhihpazy vâna chata Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama hmiakô tawhta a papua ha ei.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa hmiakô liata nama phapaki awpa a châ.
Nama kei pho awpa râh liata phopizy ta pachaothaipazy nata kulâmohthaipazy bie nathlie tyh ei ta, nâmo deikua cha, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta cha hawhpa hmo tao awpa cha pasaih veih ei.
“ Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta keima hawhpa hrohsopa nama unawhzy hry tawhta cha paduapa aw ei ta, a bie nama nathlie awpa a châ.

Hôribâ liata ahmaohpakhy noh ta, nâmo tlai ta, ‘ Abeipa eima Khazohpa ao cha keimo ta thei khao leipa aw pi ta, mei ru ngaitapa chhao he hmô khao leipa ta eima y aw, chataleipatala eima thi pathlei aw,’ tah ei chi ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa lâta nama khozie namâ hawpa hawhna khata, keima hawhpa hrohsopa a cha paduapa aw ei.
Abeipa ta ei hnohta, ‘Ama bie reipa a pha na.
Ama unawhzy hry tawhta nâ hawhpa hrohsopa paduapa aw ei na ta, a pakah liata ei biezy soh aw na ta, a hnohta bie ei piepa zydua ama hnohta a rei pachhuah tyh aw.
Hrohsopa ta ei moh ta ei bie a reipazy a thei khoh leipa cha, kei tlai ta ei pachia aw.
Bie rei awpa ei pie leipa tlai ta, ei moh ta bie a reihpa nata khazoh hropazy moh ta bie a reihpa hrohsopa cha a thi awpa a châ,’ tah ta.
“Nama palôh liata, ‘ Abeipa ta a rei leipa bie cha kheihta ma eima pahno thei aw?’ nama tah thei.

Hrohsopa ta Abeipa moh ta bie reih sala, a bie reipa cha vaw tlô leipa sala, â do leipa khiahta cha, cha cha Abeipa ta a rei leipa bie a châ. Hrohsopa ta a palai ngaitapa ta ano phichhyhpa bie a reipa châ ta, ano cha nama chi awpa châ vei.
“ Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta ama râh a cha piepa phopizy cha, Abeipa na Khazohpa ta chhawh pathlah aw ta, âmo su a thlapa ta, ama khihpizy nata ama ozy liata nama pahrâ tita,
Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta hnei awpa ta râh a cha piepa su lialôh viapazy liata khihpi miathôh nama rao aw.
Lianycheihpazy a râ nawpa khihpizy châ aw ta, khihpizy pangaina lâpizy tao aw ei chi ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta ryu ta a cha patosapa nama râh cha, su thôh ta pachhaihpa ta râhrizy nama tao aw.
“Abohna khihpizy lâ a râ thei awpazy cha, kha hlâta hmiahaona hnei hlei leipa ta a vaih a thie tlamawpazy ama châ aw.
Chyhsa pakha cha tho thlu awpa ta a vaih nata lyurâhpa lâ sie sala, tho â chai nota ahrei hâh tlopa ta a vaih a vawhsao pathlei khiahta cha, cha khihpi miakha lâ a râ aw ta, a hrona a pabohsa aw.

Chataleipatala thisaih phuh latuhpa ta a hiehâh lichih ta lianycheihtuhpa cha a chadai aw ta, lâpi a pasipa vâta pha aw ta a tusao pathlei aw. Kha hlâta hmiahaona a hnei leipa vâta, a vaih cha a thi tlâh châ taraw vei, a thie pathleipa a châ.
Chavâta abohna khihpi miathôh rao awpa ta bie ei cha pie ei.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta châ pathlatuhpazy hnohta bie â vaw taihpa hawhta, nama râhrizy pakawhpa ta, châ pathlatuhpazy hnohta pie awpa ta bie â vaw taihpa râh zydua a cha pie aw ei.

Cha tina chata tanoh ta bie ei cha piepa zydua he zyh aw ei chi ta, nama tao awpa a châ. Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha kyhpachâ aw ei chi ta, a lâpizy khâ namâ chhih aw. Chatanachata abohna khihpi miathôh thota khihpi hropa miathôh nama rao baichhi aw.
Chataleipatala Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta ryuto châta râh a cha piepa liata paraona a hnei leipa thisaih palopa châ aw ta, thisaih maoh nama phaoh pathlei aw.
“Chyhsa ta a vaih â haopa vâta a byh ta, thyuhnaopa ta tusao sala, abohna khihpi miakha lâ â râ khiah deikua cha,
a khih machâzy ta chyhsa tuah aw ei ta, cha chyhsa cha a vaw chhi aw ei ta, thie awpa ta thisaih phuh latuhpa ku liata ama hlâ aw.
Nama ngiachhie awpa châ vei. Paraona a hnei leipa thisaih a palopa vâta, thaileichâna cha Izarei tawhta nama pasipathai awpa a châ. Chatanachata nama châta a pha aw.
“ Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta hnei awpa ta râh a cha piepa ei, ryu ta nama to awpa râh liata chyhsa hmiatuapazy ta ama vaw bôpa nama vaih râhri lô nama pasie awpa châ vei.

“Ryhpa paraopa vâta tlyma, kheihawhpa hmo paraopa vâta tlyma leihpa chyhsa cha, pahnokheituhpa pakha bie ta thailei pachâsa awpa châ vei. Pahnokheituhpa pano bie ta tlyma, pahnokheituhpa pathôh bie ta tlyma pa-i awpa a châ.
Pahnokheituhpa pakheipa ta chyhsa ahy tlyma hmo a paraopa hawhta a leih khiahta cha,
biepeipa a hneipazy cha, cha daihti liata theihthaipazy nata ryureituhpazy lâ ama pano ta vawh aw ei ta, Abeipa hmiakô liata amâ duah aw.
Ryureituhpazy ta pakhâta ta pasia aw ei ta, bie pahnokheituhpa cha pahnokheituhpa pakheipa châ sala, a unawhpa cha haipa ta a leihpa a châ khiahta cha,
a unawhpa chô liata tao â chhuahpa hawhta, ano chô liata nama tao awpa a châ. Cha hawhna chata hmo pha leipa cha nama hry tawhta nama pahlei ha aw.
Cha thâtih cha laibâhpazy ta thei aw ei ta, chi aw ei ta, cha hawhpa hmo pha leipa cha nama hry liata tao khao aw veih ei.
Nama ngiachhie awpa châ vei. Hrona vyuhpa ta hrona, mo vyuhpa ta mo, hâh vyuhpa ta hâh, ku vyuhpa ta ku, phei vyuhpa ta phei a châ aw.

“Nama chariahzy a dyuh awpa ta nama sie tita, nâmo hneipa hlâta hluh viapa arâzy, talailihzy nata pheisaihzy nama hmô nahta, âmo cha nama chi awpa châ vei. Izi râh tawhta châ kaw chhi papuatuhpa Abeipa nama Khazohpa nama hnohta a y aw.
Adyuhna lâ nama sie chy ta, theihthaipa vaw pua aw ta, zawpi hnohta bie a reih aw.

Theihthaipa ta zawpi hnohta, ‘Hy Izarei, nathlie teh, tanoh cha nama chariahzy a dyuh awpa ta, adyuhna lâ nama sie aw. Riahchhiepa ta y khuh vy. Chi leipa u la, a chalyu hra leipa u la, âmo vâta thlazohpa ta y khuh vy.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa nama hnohta sie aw ta, nama chariahzy châ dyuhpa aw ei ta, a cha pachha aw ei,’ a tah aw.

Cha khai tawhta hyutuhpazy ta zawpi hnohta bie reih aw ei ta, ama hnohta, ‘O thiehpa sa ta a hlâ mâh leipa nama y ma? Kua sala a o lâ a di mawh sy. Chataleipatala adyuhna liata thi pathlei aw ta, chyhsa hropa ta a o cha a to pathlei aw.
Kre sadô tao ta a thei a nie mâh leipa nama y ma? Kua sala a o lâ a di mawh sy. Chataleipatala adyuhna liata thi pathlei aw ta, chyhsa hropa ta a kre sadô thei a nie pathlei aw.
Lapinô a pahawh ta a hnei mâh leipa nama y ma? Kua sala a o lâ a di mawh sy. Chataleipatala adyuhna liata thi pathlei aw ta, chyhsa hropa ta â pahawhpa cha a hnei pathlei aw,’ ama tah aw.

Hyutuhpazy ta zawpi hnohta reih via aw ei ta, ‘A chipa nata riahchhiepa nama y ma? Kua sala a o lâ a di mawh sy. Chataleipatala ano palôh duapa hawhta a unawhzy palôh a paduasa pathlei aw,’ ama tah aw.
Hyutuhpazy ta zawpi hnohta bie ama reih khai nahta, zawpi a chhihtha awpa pheisaih hyutuhpazy ama rao aw.
“A dyuh awpa ta khihpi namâ hnia tita, aryhna bie nama reih tua awpa a châ.
Khihpi ta châ vaw ryh ei sala, nama hnohta amâ vaw hlâ khiahta cha, cha liata a pahrâpa zydua cha nama rai hriatuhpa ta y aw ei ta, ama cha chakao aw.
Châ ryh khoh leipa ei sala, ama châ dyuh khiah deikua cha, khihpi cha nama dôh aw.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta khihpi nama ku liata a cha pie ti ei ta, khihsaw chapaw pitlohpa zydua zaozi ta nama thie khai aw.
Chanôzy, hawtizy, sahrohzy nata khihpi liata hmo a ypa zydua deikua cha, hraona sôh ta a la aw chi ta, chariahzy nama hraona sôh, Abeipa na Khazohpa ta a cha piepa ei cha nama châta a châ aw.
Cha hawhna chata nama yna tawhta lâhlapi ta a ypa khihpi zydua chô liata nama tao aw. Nama chheipâh râhzy liata khihpizy chô liata deikua cha, cha hawhta nama tao awpa châ vei.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta ryuto châta a cha piepa ei liata phopizy pahrâna khihpizy liata cha, husona a hneipa kheihawhpa hmah nama pahlôh awpa châ vei.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta bie a cha piepa hawh ei ta, Hiti mo, Amawri mo, Kâna mo, Perizi mo, Hivi mo nata Zebu mozy cha tlokhuh nama pahleipadia khai awpa a châ.
Chataleipatala ama khazohzy amâ chhyna liata hmo pasichhihpa ama taopa zydua tao hra awpa ta cha pachu aw ei ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa chô liata nama molei pathlei aw.

“Khihpi la a chhuahpa ta bohpi dôhpa ta namâ dyuh tita, cha liata thozy pahlei a chhuahpa ta ahrei ta nama thlu awpa châ vei. A thei nama nie thei awpazy châ ei ta, nama thlu awpa châ vei. Râh liata tho namâ dyuh awpa cha, chyhsapa ma ama châ?
A thei niepa chi châ vei tahpa nama pahnopa thozy deita paraopa ta thlu aw chi ta, nama chariahpa khihpi cha lapa a châ hlâlei khihpi dôh nawpa châta nama hmâh thei aw.
“ Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta hnei awpa ta râh a cha piepa ei liata, chyhsa ama thiepa ri lyurâhpa liata a zawh thlâh ha sala, a thietuhpa pahnopa a châ leipa khiahta cha,
nama machâzy nata ryureituhpazy vawh aw ei ta, ama thiena su nata a chheipâh liata khih a ypazy ahlana zie ama thlie aw.
Ri yna tawhta khih a hnia chaipa machâzy ta viahchao zeinô rai pahriasa mâh leipa, raopaky paky mâh leipa pô kha amâ chhi aw.
Khih machâzy ta viahchao zeinô cha, lei palie leina nata khâpa chi hmah chei leina ti lona saikao lâ a chhi aw ei ta, viahchao zeinô cha saikao liata a rao ama tai aw.

Chatawhcha Livai sawchapaw theihthaipazy hmia lâ ama vaw pua aw. Âmo cha Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta ano chakao awpa nata Abeipa moh ta byhnâ aw awpa ta a raopazy ama châ. Chavâta biepeipa nata atudaina kyhzy cha âmo pachiazie hawhta a châ aw.
Ri yna a hnia chaipa khihpi machâ zydua ta saikao liata viahchao zeinô rao ama âpa chô liata ama ku a si aw ei ta,
‘Eima ku ta he thisaih he palo leipa ta, eima mo ta thisaih palopa hmô hra vei.

Hy Abeipa, na chatlaipa na phopi Izarei sawzy he a ngiahthai la, na phopi Izarei sawzy he paraona hnei leipa thisaih maoh phaoh awpa ta pasaih khah y,’ tahpa ta reih aw ei ta, thisaih maoh ama phao awpa tawhta a ngiahthaipa ama châ aw.
Cha hawhna chata Abeipa mohmô ta hmo dopa tao aw ei chi ta, paraona hnei leipa thisaih palona maoh tawhta nama pathaih aw.
“Nama chariahzy a dyuh awpa ta hrâ nama sie nahta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta âmo cha nama ku liata cha pie ei ta, sei ta a chhi u la,
seizy hry liata chanô hmi phapazy hmô u la, lapinô ta hnei awpa nama khoh khiahta cha,
nama o lâ a chhi aw ei chi ta, ama luh a ngyu aw ei ta, ama pato tai aw ei ta,

sei chysia pahluh aw ei ta, nama o liata ama y aw. Thla kha bohloh ama nô nata ama paw mâchhie ama sa tua aw. Cha khai tawhta âmo lâ a ngia aw ei chi ta, ama vahpa châ aw chi ta, nama lapinô ama châ aw.
Ama chô liata namâ ly khao leipa khiahta cha, ama khona lâ maih sie nama pasai awpa a châ. Ama noh nama pazao hapa vâta, sôh ta nama zuah awpa châ leipa ta, sei ta nama hnei heih awpa châ khao vei.
“Chyhsa ta lapinô pano hnei sala, pakha kho via ta, pakha kho lei via sala, a kho viapa nata a kho lei viapa ta saw sapa raihrie ei sala, sawchapaw uhtheipa cha a kho lei viapa saw châ sala,
a sawchapawzy ryuto a rai noh ta, a kho lei viapa sawchapaw uhthei dopa hlâta a kho viapa sawchapawpa khokhei viapa ta, ano cha sawchapaw uhtheipa ta a tao awpa châ vei.

A kho lei viapa sawchapawpa cha sawchapaw uhthei dopa châ ta, ano cha a pahno awpa a châ. A hneipa zydua tawhta tovyuh su thôh su no a pie aw. Ano cha a thatlôna thei hmiatuapa châ ta, sawchapaw uhthei châna tovyuh cha ano eih a châ.
“Chyhsa ta sawchapaw chhorupa nata atyhmâhpa hnei sala, a nô nata a paw rei a ngiah leipa sala, ama chhoreipa chhao ta ama bie a nathlie khoh leipa khiahta cha,
a nô nata a paw ta patu aw ei ta, a yna khihpi liata machâzy ryureina thokhy chhikao lâ amâ chhi aw.
Khihpi machâzy hnohta, ‘Eima sawchapawpa he chhorupa nata atyhmâhpa châ ta, eima rei a ngiah khoh vei. Rikawhpa nata sahma lôpa a châ,’ ama tah aw.
Cha khai tawhta khihsaw zydua ta alô ta vawhsao aw ei ta, cha hawhna chata hmo pha leipa cha nama hry tawhta nama pahlei awpa a châ. Cha thâtih cha Izarei zydua ta thei aw ei ta, ama chi aw.
“Chyhsa ta thie tlâhpa moleina tao sala, thiepa châ sala, tho liata a ri nama bangieh khiahta cha,

a ri cha tho liata azozâkhihdei a y awpa châ vei. Cha noh lia tlai ta nama pabu awpa a châ. Tho liata bangiehpa maih cha Khazohpa chhiesapa châ tlôh ei ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta ryuto châta a cha piepa ei nama râh cha nama papuapalei awpa châ vei.
“Nama chiheihpa viahchao tôhpa tlyma, mietaku tlyma a leipa nama hmô khiahta cha, pahno lei namâ pachâ awpa châ vei. Nama chiheihpa lâ namâ chhi awpa a châ.

Nama chiheihpa cha lâhnia liata pahrâ leipa sala, sahroh hneituhpa nama pahno leipa khiahta cha, sahroh a leipa cha nama o lâ a chhi aw ei chi ta, nama chiheihpa ta a vaw tlua hlâlei nama hnohta y aw ta, a vaw tlua tita nama pie aw.

Nama chiheihpa alâ chhao, cha hawhta tao aw ei chi ta, a chysia chhao cha hawhta nama tao aw. Cha hawhna chata nama chiheihpa hmo pahleipa nama hmôpa maih nama tao aw. Pahno lei namâ pachâ awpa châ vei.
Nama chiheih alâ tlyma, a viahchao tôhpa tlyma, lâpi liata a paopa nama hmô khiahta cha, pahno lei namâ pachâ awpa châ vei. Nama pathyukhei awpa a châ.
“Chanô ta chapaw chysia â tao awpa châ leipa ta, chapaw ta chanô chysia â tao awpa châ hra vei. Ahy rai cha hawhta a taopa maih cha, Abeipa nama Khazohpa châta pasichhihpa a châ.
“Tho liata tlyma, alei liata tlyma pavaw bu hmô u la, a panô ta a taw tlyma, a tih tlyma â byu thlu thlâh ha chy khiahta cha, a taw cha a panô chhaota nama la awpa châ vei.
A panô pathlie aw ei chi ta, a taw deikua nama la thei. Nama châta pha aw ta, nama hro a pareih aw.
“O thiehpa nama sa tita, o chô tawhta chyhsa tla tlamawpa ta, nama o liata thisaih maoh nama paysa lei nawpa ta, o chô cha bâkhâh ta nama dôh awpa a châ.
“Nama kre sadô liata chicheipa chi no nama chei pakaoh awpa châ vei. Chataleipatala nama kôvei zydua, chi nama cheipa chhao, nama kre sadô a patheipa chhao, pathaih leipa a châ pathlei aw.
“Viahchao tôhpa nata alâ hmaohkha ta lei nama paliesa awpa châ vei.
“Sahmi nata lini pala sa pahlaopa namâ ky awpa châ vei.
“Poh namâ bu awpa cha, a ki mia palih liata pala pai pachhaohpa ta nama chakhi awpa a châ.
“Chyhsa ta lapinô hnei sala, â ziakhei khai tawhta a hao heihpa ta,
‘He chanô he hnei na ta, châhrasala ano ei hnia nahta, laihsakôpa a châna ano liata hmô va na,’ tahpa ta pathaih leipa hawhta baipa ta, a moh a pachhie khiahta cha,
chanô paw nata nô ta laihsakôpa a châna pasiana cha, thokhy chhikao liata machâzy hmiakô liata ama palâsa aw.
Chanô paw ta machâzy hnohta, ‘He chyhsa he ei sawchanô pahneisa na ta, a hao heih tlôh ta,

“Na sawchanô he laihsakôpa a châna hmô va na,” tahpa ta pathaih leipa hawhta bai ta. Hezy he ei sawchanô laihsakôpa a châna pasiana a châ hih,’ tah aw ta, khihpi machâzy hmiakô liata poh ama pakai aw.
Chatanachata khihpi machâzy ta chanô vahpa cha a chhi aw ei ta, ama hrie aw.
Izarei laihsakôpa moh a pachhiepa vâta tâkâ sekel za kha pacheisa aw ei ta, chanô paw ama pie aw. Chatanachata chanô cha a lapinô ta y aw ta, a hro chhôh zydua ta a ma awpa châ vei.
Hmo dopa châ sala, chanô cha laihsakôpa a châna pasia nawpa a y vei khiahta deikua cha,

a paw o liata sihryhpa ta y ta, Izarei liata hmo molei ngaitapa a taopa vâta, chanô cha a paw o chhikao lâ a chhi aw ei ta, a yna khihpi liata chyhsazy ta alô ta ama vawhsao awpa a châ. Cha hawhna chata nama hry liata hmo phaleipa cha nama pahlei awpa a châ.

“Chyhsa ta chyhsa hropa lapinô â ziakheipa hmôpa a châ khiahta cha, ama pano ta, a ziakheituhpa chapaw chhao, chanô chhao, ama thi awpa a châ. Cha hawhna chata hmo pha leipa cha Izarei tawhta nama pahlei aw.
“Lapinô châta a pahawhpa laihsakôpa cha, chyhsa ta khihpi liata hmô sala, â ziakhei khiahta cha,

khihpi chhôh liata a y thlâh hapa tlai ta chanô ta a awh leipa vâta nata chapaw chhao a vaih lapinô moh a pachhiepa vâta, ama pano ta khihpi thokhy chhikao lâ a chhi aw ei chi ta, alô ta nama vawhsao awpa a châ. Cha hawhna chata hmo pha leipa cha nama hry tawhta nama pahlei awpa a châ.
“Lapinô châta a pahawhpa laihsa cha, chyhsa ta lyurâhpa liata hmô ta, patupakhipa ta â ziakhei khiahta deikua cha, a ziakheituhpa chapaw deita a thi aw.
Laihsa cha kheihta hmah nama tah awpa châ vei. Laihsa chô liata thina taihta hrie tlâh a châpa moleina y vei. Cha hmo cha chyhsa ta a vaih thyuhnao ta a thiepa hawhpa a châ.
Lyurâhpa liata a tyh ta, a pahawhpa laihsa cha awh taraw ta, châhrasala a pachha awpa ama y leipa vâta, hrie awpa châ vei.
“Chyhsa ta laihsakôpa a pahawh leipa hmô ta, patu ta, â ziakheipa hmôpa a châ khiahta cha,
a ziakheituhpa chapaw ta laihsa paw cha tâkâ sekel sypangawh pie aw ta, a moh a pachhie hapa vâta, ano cha lapinô ta a hnei aw. A hro chhôh zydua ta a ma awpa châ vei.
“A paw lapinô a hneipa cha, a paw dua a thliapa a châpa vâta, chyhsa ta a paw lapinô a hnei awpa châ vei.
“Chyhsa a tihmô keipa tlyma, a chapaw chhaichhi taipa tlyma cha Abeipa pakhypi liata amâ hlao awpa châ vei.
“Riasaw cha Abeipa pakhypi liata â hlao awpa châ vei. A pathla chhâ hrawhna taihta ahy hmahta Abeipa pakhypi liata amâ hlao awpa châ vei.
“Amawna chyhsa tlyma, Môabâ chyhsa tlyma cha Abeipa pakhypi liata â hlao awpa châ vei. Ama pathlazy chhâ hrawhna taihta khati ta hmahta Abeipa pakhypi liata amâ hlao awpa châ vei.

Izi râh tawhta nama kaw pua nota, viahchhâ nata ti ta ama cha dy leipa vâta nata chhie cha sapa awpa ta Mesôpôtamia râh Pethô khih liata Beô sawchapawpa Bâlâma ama hruapa vâta, Abeipa pakhypi liata amâ hlao awpa châ vei.
Châhrasala Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta Bâlâma cha nathlie khoh vei. Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta kyh a cha pachâpa vâ ei ta, chhiesana cha nama châta byhnâ ta tlao a pachâsa haw.
Ama thlalôh nawpa nata ama hneirôh nawpa ta, nama hro chhôh zydua khati ta hmahta nama pachâkhei awpa ei châ vei.
“Edômâ mo cha nama unawhpa châ ei ta, namâ hao awpa châ vei. Izi mo chhao namâ hao awpa châ vei, nâmo chhao ama râh liata mapaihpa nama châpa kha.
Chhâ thôhna tawhta cha, ama pathlazy Abeipa pakhypi liata amâ hlao thei aw.
“Nama chariahzy a dyuh awpa ta riehmo nama paryh tita, hmo pathaih leipa to tawhta namâ panano awpa a châ.
“Nama hry liata chapaw ahy tlyma, zâ ta a baoti a puapa vâta pathaih leipa a châ khiahta cha, riehmo puasai chy aw ta, riehmo lâ a ngia mâh khao aw vei.
Zâlâ a vaw châ nahta, ti ta a ngai a si aw ta, noh tla tawhta riehmo lâ â ngia aw.
“Riehmo khôtho lâ lyupâh puana su rao aw ei chi ta, cha liata lyupâh nama pua tyh aw.
Nama hmobaohzy hry liata alei lina hnei aw chi ta, cha cha hmâpa ta lyupâh pua awpa ta khôtho liata namâ tyu nawpa su chao aw ei chi ta, nama lyupâh cha alei ta nama khu lilaw heih aw.

Cha pachha awpa ei nata nama chariahpazy nama hmiakô liata cha pie awpa ei ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha nama riehmo liata a vaw hlai tyh tlôh aw ta, chavâta nama riehmo cha a pathaih awpa a châ. Chataleipatala nama hry liata hmo pathaih leipa hmô aw ta, a cha siesai pathlei aw ei.
“A zibeipa a râsai ta nâmo châ vaw ngaipa sei cha, a zibeipa lâ nama pakuasa awpa châ vei.
A pahrâ khohna khih liata nama hry liata y aw ta, nama tlybai awpa châ vei.
“Izarei sawchanôzy hry liata nothlahpa achhyna o liata âzuahnô ta ama y awpa châ leipa ta, Izarei sawchapawzy hry liata chhao nothlahpa achhyna o liata âzuahpa ama y awpa châ vei.

Bie namâ taihpa châta pie awpa ta, chanô azuana ty nata chapaw azuana ty tawhta hmôpa sôhzy Abeipa nama Khazohpa o lâ nama cheih awpa châ vei. A miano heta Abeipa nama Khazohpa châta pasichhihpa a châ.
“Apôhna hneipa ta nama unawhzy dyu nama pacheisa awpa châ vei. Tâkâ liata apôhna tlyma, niedo liata apôhna tlyma, apôhna hneipa ta khâpa hmah dyu nama pacheisa awpa châ vei.

Chihropazy cha apôhna hneipa ta dyu nama pacheisa thei. Nama chiheihpazy deikua cha apôhna hneipa ta dyu nama pacheisa awpa châ vei. Chatanachata hnei awpa ta nama pangaipa râh liata nama raihria zydua liata Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta byhnâ a cha pie aw ei.

“ Abeipa nama Khazohpa lâta bie namâ taihpa a y khiahta cha, pahawh pasâh leipa ta nama pie awpa a châ. Chataleipatala Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta châ hnaw tlôh aw ei ta, nama châta moleina a châ pathlei aw.
Bie namâ taih leipa khiahta cha, thailei châ aw veih ei chi.
Nama hmao tawhta a puapa cha, nâmo kho tlai ta, nâmo pakah tlai ta Abeipa nama Khazohpa liata bie namâ taihpa a châpa vâta, nama tao thlyu awpa a châ.
“Nama vaih kre sadô nama chapia nota, nama lôhrâtlôna taih nie thei ei chi ta, nama hrâbyh liata deikua nama khô awpa châ vei.
Nama vaih lyu sâh hria mâh leipa nama chapia nota, nama ku ta sâh suh pahrie thei ei chi ta, sâkarâ ta deikua nama vaih sâh cha nama â awpa châ vei.
“Chyhsa ta lapinô hnei sala, a hro liata hmo ngia leipa khâpa tlyma a hmôpa vâta, mo tloh leina a hnei khiahta cha, mana châ ropa aw ta, a ku liata pie aw ta, a o tawhta a papua aw.
A pua tawhta chyhsa hropa lapinô châ heih sala,
a vahpa panona chhao ta khoh khao heih leipa ta, mana châ ropa ta, a ku liata pie ta, a o tawhta a papua ha khiahta cha, a vahpa panona a thi hapa chhao ta,

a vahpa hmiatuapa, ano a papua tuapa khata, cha chanô cha a lapinô ta hnei heih thei khao aw vei. A papuapalei hapa châ ta, a hnei heih khiahta cha, Abeipa hmiakô liata pasichhihpa a châ. Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta ryuto châta râh a cha piepa ei a pamoleisatuhpa nama châ awpa châ vei.
“Lapinô hnei dyupa cha adyuhna lâ a sie awpa châ leipa ta, rai hropa chhao pie awpa châ vei. Kô kha chhôh a o liata y aw ta, a lapinô a palysa aw.
“Chyhsa ta sâh chariehna lô a chô nata a ry miano ta tlyma, a chô lâtapa sai ta tlyma, sôhkâ ta a la awpa châ vei. Cha hawhta taopa cha, sôhkâ ta chyhsa hrona lapa a châ.

“Chyhsa ta a unawhpa Izarei chyhsa paru sala, sei ta ma a tao tly, a zuah tlyma, pahnopa a châ khiahta cha, parutuhpa cha thie awpa a châ. Cha hawhna chata hmo pha leipa cha nama hry tawhta nama pahlei awpa a châ.
“Phawhpa hri kyh liata, pakhâta ta tao aw ei chi ta, theihthaipa Livai chizy ta ama cha chhopa hawhta nama tao aw. Ama hnohta bie ei piepa hawhta, a sohsi ngaitapa ta nama tao aw.
Izi râh tawhta nama kaw puana lâpi liata Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta Miria chô liata a taozie kha a thei thlâh ha teh u.
“Hmo kheihawhpa tlyma nama vaih dyu nama pacheisa tita, ano tawhta sôhkâ la awpa ta a o chhôh lâ namâ ngia awpa châ vei.
Khôtho liata a duah aw ei chi ta, dyu nama pacheisapa ta sôhkâ cha khôtho lâ a cha kaw cheipa aw ei.
Dyhchhiepa a châ khiahta cha, a sôhkâ cha nama o liata nama pariesa awpa châ vei.

Noh a tla nahta, sôhkâ châta a poh nama lapa cha nama pie ha awpa a châ. Chatanachata zâ ta a bu awpa hnei aw ta, byhnâ a cha awpa aw ei. Cha cha Abeipa nama Khazohpa hmiakô liata nama siana a châ aw.
“Rai nama pahriasapa dyhchhiepa nata phahlapazy cha, nama chiheihpa ama châpa chhao ta, chihropa nama râh khih miakha liata a pahrâpa ama châpa chhao ta, nama tlybai awpa châ vei.

Dyhchhiepa châ ei ta, ama noh hlao cha amâ ngâchhâ chhôhpa a châpa vâta, ama hria noh lia tlai ta, noh tla hlâta ama hria hlao nama pie lymâ awpa a châ. Chataleipatala nama chô liata ama palôh tlâh leina Abeipa lâ tlôkhei aw ei ta, moleina vâta thailei nama châ pathlei aw.
“Sawzy vâta pawzy thie awpa châ leipa ta, pawzy vâta sawzy thie awpa châ hra vei. Chyhsa to âmo moleina vâ chyu ta thie awpa a châ.
Chihropa nata paw hnei leipazy adona nama charichamy awpa châ leipa ta, nôhmei poh sôhkâ ta nama lapa awpa châ hra vei.
Nâmo chhao Izi râh liata sei ta y ei chi ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta cha su tawhta a cha chatlaipa ei kha namâ thei thlâh ha awpa a châ. Chavâta cha hmo cha tao awpa ta bie ei cha pie ei.

“Nama lyu liata sâh nama hria nota, lyu liata sapiah nama my khiahta cha, la awpa ta nama kuahnao awpa châ vei. Mapaihpazy, paw hnei leipazy nata nôhmeizy châta nama siesai awpa a châ. Chatanachata Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama ku raihria zydua liata byhnâ a cha pie aw ei.
Nama ôli thei nama lyu tita, nama lyu bâhpazy nama kuahnao awpa châ vei. Mapaihpazy, paw hneileipazy nata nôhmeizy châta nama siesai awpa a châ.
Nama kre sadô liata kre thei nama lyu tita, kâmo nama thoh awpa châ vei. Mapaihpazy, paw hnei leipazy nata nôhmeizy châta nama siesai awpa a châ.
Izi râh liata sei ta nama ypa kha a thei thlâh ha teh u. Chavâta cha hmo cha tao awpa ta bie ei cha pie ei.
“Chyhsazy ta ama likah liata biepeipa ama hnei khiahta cha, ryureina lâ tlôkhei aw ei ta, ryureituhpazy ta ama pachia aw. Mosiapa cha thai pachâsa aw ei ta, moleipa cha thailei ama pachâsa aw.
Moleipa cha tu tlâh a châ khiahta cha, ryureituhpa ta paziasa aw ta, ryureituhpa hmiakô liata ama tu aw. A moleina yzie hawhta, ei khazie tu awpa ma tahpa raopa a châ aw.
Ei sypalih taih tu theipa châ ta, cha hlâta a hluh via awpa châ vei. Tu awpa zie bitaipa khô lâta ei hluhpi tupa a châ khiahta cha, nama mohmô liata nama unawhpa nama pamaophyuhsa tu pathlei aw.
“Viahchao tôhpa sâh a tly nota a hmao nama hi awpa châ vei.

“Unawhzy o kha liata pahrâ khoh ei sala, ama hry liata pakha sawchapaw hnei leipa ta a thi khiahta cha, athipa lapinô cha chhôhkha khôtho lâ dyh a châ awpa châ vei. A vahpa unawhpa ta ano lâ a ngia aw ta, lapinô ta hnei aw ta, vahpa unawhpa tao awpa a chô liata a tao aw.
Izarei hry liata a unawhpa moh a lei lei nawpa ta, a unawhpa lapinô a hneipa ta sawchapaw a sa tua chaipa cha, a unawhpa athipa moh a phaoh awpa a châ.

Unawh ahrohpa ta a unawhpa athipa lapinô cha a hnei khoh vei khiahta cha, a unawhpa lapinô cha thokhy chhikao liata machâzy lâ khy aw ta, ‘Ei vahpa unawhpa ta Izarei hry liata a unawhpa moh paysa lymâ awpa khoh leipa ta, vahpa unawhpa tao awpa ei chô liata tao khoh vei,’ a tah aw.
Khihpi machâzy ta chapaw cha aw aw ei ta, rei khei aw ei ta, ano ta, ‘Hnei khoh va na,’ khâchâ a tah ha khiahta cha,

a unawhpa lapinô ta machâzy hmiakô liata ano lâ pangai aw ta, a pheiky pahluhpa aw ta, a hmia liata a pachih pachhao aw ta, ‘A unawhpa chhôhkha a padua khoh leipa cha, a chô liata he hawhta taopa châ mawh sy,’ a tah aw.
Chatanachata a pathlazy cha, ‘A pheiky pahluhpa chhôh,’ tahpa ta Izarei hry liata pahnopa ama châ aw.
“Chyhsa a tu ei sala, pakhapa lapinô ta a vahpa pachha a chhuahpa ta, a vahpa a tu haipa cha, a chapaw chhaichhi liata a patu khiahta cha,
a ku nama taipa awpa a châ. Nama ngiachhie awpa châ vei.
“Nama sahria liata khopathliahna lô laipa nata chyhpa chi nanopazy namâ vao awpa châ vei.
Nama o liata panuana laipa nata chyhpa chi nanopazy nama hnei awpa châ vei.
Khopathliahna tlohpa nata dopa nama hnei awpa châ ta, panuana tlohpa nata dopa nama hmâh awpa a châ. Chatanachata Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta râh a cha piepa ei liata nama hro a pareih aw.
Cha hawhpa hmozy tao ta, â doleipa ta a taotuhpa zydua cha, Abeipa nama Khazohpa châta pasichhihpa ama châ.
“Izi râh tawhta nama kaw pua nota, Amale mo ta lâpi liata ama cha taozie kha a thei thlâh ha muh vy.
Nama riethei thachhâ lichih ta, lâpi liata châ vaw byh ei ta, hnôh a chhâhpa, chiehleipa hnôh a khawpa zydua ama thie khai haw. Khazohpa china rai hnei veih ei.

Chavâta Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta ryuto châta hnei awpa ta râh a cha piepa ei liata, nama chheipâh liata nama chariah zydua tawhta Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta a cha pahâsa ti ei ta, Amale mo cha avâ ry liata a thei thlâhpa ama châ khao lei nawpa ta, nama pahleipadia khai ha awpa a châ. Nama my cheita awpa châ vei.
“ Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta ryuto châta hnei awpa ta râh a cha piepa kei tlô aw ei chi ta, cha liata nama pahrâ tita,

Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta râh a cha piepa liata chhaohlei patheipa tawhta kô a veih tua chaipa zydua la aw chi ta, hrâbyh liata khô aw chi ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta a moh y nawpa ta â tlyh awpa su lâ nama siekhei tyh aw.

Cha daihti ta theihthaina rai a hriapa lâ vawh aw ei chi ta, a hnohta, ‘ Abeipa ta miah pathlatuhpazy hnohta pie awpa ta bie â taihpa râh eima tlô haw tahpa tanoh Abeipa na Khazohpa hnohta eima phuah,’ nama tah aw.
Theihthaipa ta hrâbyh cha nama ku tawhta la aw ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa maisâh thaby liata a patyuh aw.

Chatawhcha Abeipa nama Khazohpa hmiakô liata, ‘Eima paw cha Aramia chyhsa viavipa châ ta, Izi râh lâ zu ta, manôh chyhta chhaota cha liata za pahrâ ta, cha liata phopi rônahpa, thatlôpa nata maluh hluhpi vaw châ ta.
Izi mo ta miah taola ei ta, eima rie miah pathei ei ta, rai ru ngaitapa miah ama pahriasa.
Abeipa miah pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa awsao pi ta, Abeipa ta eima awna ao thei ta, eima rietheizie zy, eima hriapasazie zy nata tlybaipa ta eima yzie zy miah hmô ta.
Chatanachata Abeipa ta Izi râh tawhtapa cha ku thatlôpa nata bâh pazawhpa ta miah a kaw chhi ta, chichhih ngaitapa nata ngiana nata hmonoâhpazy hmâpa ta miah â kaw chhi papua.
He su lâ he miah a vaw chhi ta, he râh, sâhpiti nata kheihti lona râh he miah a pie.

Chavâta Hy Abeipa, tahmâ nâ ta miah na piepa chhaohlei thei pathei tua chaipazy eima vaw cheih,’ nama tah aw. Thei hmiatuapa nama hlâpazy cha Abeipa nama Khazohpa hmiakô liata soh aw ei chi ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha a hmiakô liata a bôhpa ta namâ naoh aw.
Chatanachata Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nâmo nata nama pathlazy hnohta hmo phapa a cha piepa ei liata, Livai chi nata nama hry liata chihropa a ypazy chhaota thaphapa ta nama y aw.

“Kô thôhna kô, su hrawh su kha piena kô liata, kô veihpa zydua tawhta su hrawh su kha soh aw ei chi ta, nama yna khih liata Livai chi a ypazy, mapaihpazy, paw hnei leipazy nata nôhmeizy ta nie ei sala, rihbiepa ta ama y thei nawpa ta nama pie aw.

Cha khai tawhta Abeipa nama Khazohpa hmiakô liata bie reih aw ei chi ta, a hnohta, ‘Eima hnohta bie miah na piepa hawhta, hmo pathaihpazy eima o tawhta papua pi ta, Livai chizy, mapaihpazy, paw hnei leipazy nata nôhmeizy eima pie. Na biepiepazy miakha hmah parao leipa pi ta, my hra ma pi.

Su hrawh su kha cha mâchhie eima sa nota nie leipa pi ta, eima pathaih lei daihti liata chhao kheihawhpa hmah la leipa pi ta, kheihawhpa hmah athihpa hlâ ma pi. Abeipa eima Khazohpa ao nathlie pi ta, bie miah na piepa zydua hawhta eima tao khai.
Na yna su pathaihpa vârâh tawhta za moh la, na phopi Izarei nata râh miah na piepa, miah pathlatuhpazy hnohta bie nâ vaw taihpa, sâhpiti nata kheihti lona râh he byhnâ pie mah y!’ nama tah aw.
“Tanoh he Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta he bieraopazy nata pachianazy he tao awpa ta bie a cha pie ei. Chavâta nama pathipalôh tlokhuh ta nata nama thlahpa tlokhuh ta zyhpa ta nama tao awpa a châ.
Tanoh he Abeipa cha nama Khazohpa a châ tahpa phuah ha ei chi ta, a lâpizy a chhihpa ta, a bieraopazy, a biepiepazy nata a pachianazy zyhpa ta, a ao nathlie awpa ta bie namâ taih haw.
Abeipa chhao ta bie a châ taihpa hawh ei ta, tanoh tlai ta nâmo cha a ryu sôhpa nata a biepiepa zydua a zyh awpa phopi ta a cha tao ha ei.

Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta bie â vaw taih hapa hawhta, nâmo cha reithaina, moh phana nata palyupalihna kyhzy liata, phopi a paduapa zydua chô liata y awpa nata Abeipa nama Khazohpa châta phopi pathaihpa châ awpa ta a cha padua ei,” tah ta.
Mawsi nata Izarei machâzy ta zawpizy biepie ei ta, ama hnohta, “Tanoh ta bie eima cha piepa zydua ei he a pyh teh u.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta râh a cha piepa ei lâ sie awpa ta Zawdâh nama chaka noh ta alô laipazy bô aw ei chi ta, alô baina ta nama patusa aw ei.

Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta râh a cha piepa ei, châ pathlatuhpazy Zehôvâh Khazohpa ta bie a châ taihpa ei, sâhpiti nata kheihti lona râh a ngia awpa ta Zawdâh nama chaka tita, he ryhpa biezy he alôzy liana cha nama roh awpa a châ.
Zawdâh nama chaka khai nahta, tanoh ta bie ei cha piepa hawhna ei heta, Ebâ Tlâh liata alô zy bô aw ei chi ta, alô baina ta nama patusa aw.
Cha liata Abeipa nama Khazohpa châta alô maisâh tao aw ei chi ta, thua chaihrai nama hmâ awpa châ vei.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa maisâh cha khai leipa alôzy ta nama tao awpa châ ta, cha liata Abeipa nama Khazohpa lâta raopa hlânazy nama hlâ aw.
Aryhna hlâna atheihnazy hlâ aw ei chi ta, cha liata nie aw ei chi ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa hmiakô liata thaphapa ta nama y aw.
He ryhpa bie zydua he, alôzy chô liana chata a sia ngaitapa ta nama roh awpa a châ,” tah ei ta.
Chatawhcha Mawsi nata Livai chi theihthaipazy ta Izarei zydua hnohta, “Hy Izarei, a chalih u la pakhâta ta nathlie teh u. Tanoh he Abeipa nama Khazohpa phopi nama châ haw.
Chavâta Abeipa nama Khazohpa bie nama zyh awpa châ ta, tanoh ta eima cha piepa a bieraopazy nata a biepiepazy he nama zyh awpa a châ,” tah ei ta.
Cha noh ta Mawsi ta zawpi cha biepie ta, ama hnohta,
“Zawdâh nama chaka khai tawhta, zawpizy châta byhnâ aw awpa ta, Simeôna chi, Livai chi, Zudâh chi, Iskâra chi, Zawsi chi nata Benzami chizy Kerizi Tlâh liata a duah aw ei ta,
chhiesa awpa ta, Rubena chi, Kâdâ chi, Asera chi, Zebulawna chi, Dânâ chi nata Nâthalai chizy Ebâ Tlâh liata amâ duah aw.
Chatawhcha Livai pathlazy ta ao paro ngaitapa ta Izarei chyhsa zydua hnohta hetana heta ama phuah aw.

“Khaipa ta tlyma, leihpa ta tlyma khazoh nothlahpa tao ta, cha hawhta zôthaipa ku ta taopa, Abeipa châta pasichhihpa khazoh nothlahpa arulâta a vaopa cha chhiesapa ta y mawh sy,” tah aw ei ta, zawpi ta, “Amen” ama tah aw.
“A nô tlyma, a paw tlyma a za leipa cha chhiesapa ta y mawh sy,” tah aw ei ta, zawpi ta, “Amen” ama tah aw.
“A vaih râhri a pasiepa cha chhiesapa ta y mawh sy,” tah aw ei ta, zawpi ta, “Amen” ama tah aw.
“Lâpi leipa lâta mochaopa a pasiesapa cha chhiesapa ta y mawh sy,” tah aw ei ta, zawpi ta, “Amen” ama tah aw.
“Chihropazy, paw hnei leipazy, nôhmeizy adona a tlybaipa cha chhiesapa ta y mawh sy,” tah aw ei ta, zawpi ta, “Amen” ama tah aw.
“A paw lapinô a ziakheipa cha, a paw dua a thliapa a châpa vâta, chhiesapa ta y mawh sy,” tah aw ei ta, zawpi ta, “Amen” ama tah aw.
“Sahroh kheihawhpa rai a ykheipa cha chhiesapa ta y mawh sy,” tah aw ei ta, zawpi ta, “Amen” ama tah aw.
“A sietanô, a paw sawchanô tlyma, a nô sawchanô tlyma, a ziakheipa cha chhiesapa ta y mawh sy,” tah aw ei ta, zawpi ta, “Amen” ama tah aw.
“A lapinô nô a ziakheipa cha chhiesapa ta y mawh sy,” tah aw ei ta, zawpi ta, “Amen” ama tah aw.
“Arulâta a vaih a thiepa cha chhiesapa ta y mawh sy,” tah aw ei ta, zawpi ta, “Amen” ama tah aw.
“Paraona hnei leipa thie nawpa ta panaopapana a lapa cha chhiesapa ta y mawh sy,” tah aw ei ta, zawpi ta, “Amen” ama tah aw.
“He ryhpa biezy a pyh leipa nata a tao leipa cha chhiesapa ta y mawh sy,” tah aw ei ta, zawpi ta, “Amen” ama tah aw.

“ Abeipa nama Khazohpa ao cha pakhâta ta nathliepa ta, tanoh ta bie ei cha piepa zydua ei he zyhpa ta nama tao khiahta cha, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta khizaw phopi zydua hlâta chônô viapa ta a cha tao aw ei.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa ao nama nathlie khiahta cha, he byhnâ zydua heta cha zi aw ei ta, nama hmia lâta a sie lymâ aw.
“O lâta byhnâ to aw ei chi ta, râh lâ chhao byhnâ nama to aw.
“Nama chhi theizy, nama chhaohlei theizy, nama sahrohzy, nama viahchaotaw nata nama mietakutawzy byhnâ topa ta y aw ei ta, ama pôh aw.
“Nama hrâbyh nata nama viahchhâ nyhna beikoh zy byhnâ topa ta ama y aw.
“Namâ ngia nota byhnâ to aw ei chi ta, nama pua tita byhnâ nama to aw.
“Châ dyuhtuhpa nama chariahzy Abeipa ta nama hmiakô liata panawhsa aw ta, châ dyuh awpa ta lâpi miakha tawhta a vaw ngia aw ei ta, lâpi miasari lâta amâ râpai aw.
“ Abeipa ta nama sawvâzy chô liata byhnâ patlôsa aw ta, nama ku raihria zydua byhnâ a pie aw. Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta râh a cha piepa ei liata byhnâ a cha pie aw ei.
“Bie a châ taihpa hawh ei ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa biepiepazy zyhpa ta a lâpizy namâ chhih khiahta cha, Abeipa ta ano châta phopi pathaihpa ta a cha tao aw ei.
Chatanachata Abeipa moh bipa nama châpa khizaw phopi zydua ta hmô aw ei ta, ama cha chi aw.
Châ pathlatuhpazy hnohta pie awpa ta Abeipa ta bie â vaw taihpa râh liata Abeipa ta byhnâ hluhpi a cha pie aw ei. Nama sawteih nawhteih pha aw ta, nama sahrohzy pôh aw ta, nama chhaohlei a pathei aw.

“ Abeipa ta ryubyh phapa avâzy cha pahypa aw ei ta, a daihtita liata nama râh liata avâ pasuasa aw ta, nama ku raihria zydua byhnâ a pie aw. Chatanachata phopi hluhpi dyu pacheisa aw ei chi ta, nâmo deikua ta dyu chei aw veih ei chi.

Tanoh ta bie ei cha piepa ei, Abeipa nama Khazohpa biepiepazy he zyhpa ta, pakhâta nama tao khiahta cha, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta chaolahmei châ leipa ta, luh ta cha tao aw ei ta; a ry châ leipa ta, a chô ta a cha tao aw ei.
Tanoh ta bie ei cha piepa ei he, a kheihawhpa lia hmahta chachâh lâ tlyma, chavei lâ tlyma tleisai leipa ta, khazoh hropazy pazi leipa ta nama chakao leipa khiahta cha, cha hawhta nama châ aw.

“ Abeipa nama Khazohpa ao nathlie leipa u la, Abeipa biepiepa nata a bieraopa tanoh ta ei cha piepazy ei he zyh leipa ta, nama tao leipa khiahta deikua cha, he chhiesana zydua he nama chô liata vaw tlô aw ta, nama hmia lâta a cha siekhâh lymâ aw ei.
“O lâta chhiesapa ta y aw ei chi ta, râh lâta chhao chhiesapa ta nama y aw.
“Nama hrâbyh nata nama viahchhâ nyhna beikoh zy chhiesapa ta a y aw.
“Nama chhi theizy, nama chhaohlei theizy, nama sahrohzy, nama viahchaotaw nata nama mietakutawzy chhiesapa ta y aw ei ta, pôh aw veih ei.
“Namâ ngia nota chhiesapa ta y aw ei chi ta, nama pua tita chhiesapa ta nama y aw.

“Hmo pha leipazy taopa ta, Abeipa nama tleisaipa vâta, Abeipa ta nama ku raihria zydua liata chhiesana, tymâna nata palôh chhâna zy vaw tuah aw ta, pahleipadiapa châ aw ei chi ta, thlai nama leidia aw.
Hnei awpa ta namâ ngiapa râh tawhta a cha pahleipadia khai hlâlei ei cha, Abeipa ta nama chô liata hri a patlôsa aw.
Chaohna, chasipa, thlohna, thata palona, nohkâhna, raohna nata maohna zy hmâpa ta Abeipa ta cha hrie aw ei ta, nama leidia hlâlei ama châ chadai lymâ aw.
Nama luh chô lâta avâzy cha dawh châ aw ta, nama ry lâta alei cha thua a châ aw.
Abeipa ta nama râh vâsua cha dohlei nata buchadoh lâta pachâsa aw ta, nama leidia hlâlei avâ tawhta nama chô liata a za tla aw.

“ Abeipa ta nama chariahzy hmiakô liata cha panawh aw ei ta, âmo a dyuh awpa ta lâpi miakha a chhih aw ei chi ta, lâpi miasari lâta ama hmiakô liata namâ râpai aw. Chatanachata khizaw khinarâh zydua chipa ta a paysatuhpa nama châ aw.
Nama rizy cha avâ pavaw zydua nata alei sazy ta nie aw ei ta, a laih awpa y aw veih ei.
Abeipa ta Izi kheihluhzy, byuhpa hrizy, riatha nata pathapa hrizy ta cha hrie aw ei ta, tlâh thei aw veih ei chi.
Abeipa ta hruna, mochaona nata palôh tymâna zy ta a cha hrie aw ei.

Mochaopa ta azohpa liata a pathâpazipa hawhta, nohchhô sawhvaw ta pathâpazi aw ei chi ta, nama lâpizy liata thlao a chhi leipa aw chi ta, tlybaipa nata hraopa ta y aw ei chi ta, châ pachha awpa ahy hmah y aw veih ei.
“Lapinô a pahawh aw ei chi ta, chyhsa hropa ta â ziakhei aw. O sa aw ei chi ta, tlôh aw veih ei chi. Kre sadô tao aw ei chi ta, a thei nie aw veih ei chi.

Nama mohmô liata nama viahchao tôhpa thiepa châ aw ta, a sa nie aw veih ei chi. Nama hmiakô liata nama alâ a daophi raruahpa châ aw ta, cha pie khao aw veih ei. Nama mietakuzy cha nama chariahpazy piepa châ aw ta, châ pachha awpa ahy hmah y aw veih ei.
Nama sawchapawzy nata nama sawchanôzy chihropa hnohta piepa châ aw ei ta, âmo vâpa ta noh chareih nama mo bâna taihta sai aw ei chi ta, tao theipa khâpa hmah hnei aw veih ei chi.
Nama pahno leipa phopi ta nama chhaohlei patheipa nata nama hriapasana theizy nie khai aw ei ta, nâmo cha khâ tlybai awpa nata riepathei awpa deita nama châ aw.
Nama mo ta a hmôpa hmozy ta a cha pahrusa aw ei.
Abeipa ta nama pakhu nata nama pheizy liata kheihluh pasapa tlâh thei leipa cha pathlasa aw ei ta, nama pheipazah tawhta nama laki taihta a y aw.

“ Abeipa ta nâmo nata nama bei nama pachâsa awpa cha, nama pahno beih leipa phopi, châ pathlatuhpazy chhao ta ama pahno beih leipa phopi lâ châ chhi aw ei ta, cha liata khazoh hropazy, tho nata lô khazohzy nama chakao aw.
Chatanachata Abeipa ta a châ chhi nawpa phopi zydua hry liata, chichhihpa nata bieso nata hmo chhiepa lâta pakhopâna nama châ aw.
“Lyu liata sâh hluhpi tu aw ei chi ta, khawsu ta nie khai aw ta, a chyhta dei nama hria aw.
Kre sadô tao aw chi ta, mohôh aw chi ta, châhrasala châkariepa ta nie khai aw ta, a kresawhti doh aw veih ei chi. Kre thei chhao lyu aw veih ei chi.
Nama râh zydua liata ôli tho loh aw ei chi ta, châhrasala nama ôli theizy zô khai aw ta, a thaw a thu aw veih ei chi.
Sawchapawzy nata sawchanôzy sa aw ei chi ta, châhrasala sei ta a chhi aw ei ta, nâmo eih châ aw veih ei.
Nama theilâpa kô zydua nata nama chhaohlei patheipa zydua khawsu châta a châ khai aw.
“Chihropa nama hry liata a ypazy nâmo hlâta a sâh via rili aw ei ta, nâmo deikua cha namâ hnai via lymâ aw.
Ama sôh dyuchei aw ei chi ta, nâmo sôh dyu cha chei aw veih ei. Âmo cha luh châ aw ei ta, nâmo cha chaolahmei nama châ aw.

“ Abeipa nama Khazohpa ao nathlie leipa ei chi ta, zyh awpa ta bie a cha piepa ei a biepiepazy nata a bieraopazy nama zyh leipa vâta, pahleipadiapa nama châ hlâlei, he chhiesana zydua he nama chô liata a vaw tlô aw. Chhiesanazy ta châ chadai aw ei ta, ama cha pha aw.
Cha cha nâmo nata nama pathlazy chô liata Khazohpa hriena a tlôpa kyh chhâzaw ta ngiana nata noâhchhihpa a châ aw.
Hmo to ativyna daihti liata Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha alypa nata thaphapa ta nama chakao leipa vâta,

nâmo châ dyuh awpa ta Abeipa ta a vaw tua awpa nama chariahzy cha, nodidâhphina, thluahruana nata ato phahlana chôta chakao aw ei chi ta, a cha pahleipadia khai hlâlei ei cha, nama rao liata thua raopaky a cha paky aw ei.
“ Abeipa ta nâmo châ dyuh awpa ta, khizaw chhâna lâhlapi tawhta phopi miakha pahmôhpi a pathlôpa hawhta vaw tuah aw ta, cha phopi cha a reih nama thei leipa,
machâzy a za leipa nata hawtizy a ngiachhie leipa phopi a hrâh ngaitapa a châ aw.

Cha phopi chata nama sahroh zaw nata nama chhaohlei patheipazy nie khai aw ta, tlokhuh a cha pahleipadia khaina taih ei ta nama sâh, nama kresawhti, nama sathaw, nama viahchao hri nata mietaku zaw zy ama nie khai aw. Nama châta khâpa hmah pahlôh aw vei.

“Nama râh chhôh zydua liata nama ngâpa thokhy a sâhpa nata a ipazy ama pacho khai hlâlei nama khihpi zydua liata cha dôh aw ei ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta râh a cha piepa liata nama khihpi zydua lia tlai ta ama cha dôh aw.
Nama chariahzy ta cha dôh aw ei ta, nôpopa ta ama cha so awpa vâta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta a cha piepa nama chipathla nama sawchapawzy nata na sawchanôzy sa taih nama nie aw.
Nama hry liata chyhsa nôpha chaipa nata ngiachhiena a hnei chaipa taihta a unawhpa nata a lapinô kho ngaitapa nata a saw a hroh tlakaihpa ngiachhie thei khao aw veih ei.

Nama chariah ta cha dôh aw ei ta, nama khihpi zydua liata nôpopa ta cha soh aw ei ta, chyhsa ta khâpa hmah a hnei khao lei awpa vâta, a sawzy sa a nie haipa cha mohropazy pie hra awpa pachâ thei aw vei.

“Nama hry liata chanô panyu chaipa nata nainyu chaipa, a nainyu tupa nata a panyu tupa vâta a pheipazah alei a tly beih leipa taih ta, a vahpa kho ngaitapa nata a sawchapaw nata a sawchanô zy ngiachhie thei khao aw vei.

Nama chariah ta cha dôh aw ei ta, nama khihpi zydua liata nôpopa ta ama cha soh awpa vâta, chanô ta ato a phahla aw ta, a phei nata phei likawh tawhta a saw a vaw pih dyupa nata â pyh haipa sawzy taih arulâta a nie aw.
“ Abeipa nama Khazohpa moh rônahpa nata chichhihpa nama chi thei nawpa ta, he châbu liata â rohpa ryhpa bie zydua he zyh leipa ta nama tao vei khiahta cha,
Abeipa ta nâmo nata nama pathlazy chô liata potlana chichhihpa a pai thai khao leipa nata hri ru ngaitapa a pai thai khaoleipazy a chareisa aw.
Nama chi kaw tyhpa Izi râh hrizy kha nama chô liata chareisa heih aw ta, a cha kopâ aw ei.
He ryhpa châbu liata ro leipa pasana nata potlana to chhao, nama leidia khaina taihta Abeipa ta nama chô liata a patlôsa aw.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa ao nama nathlie leipa vâta, avâ liata awhsi zie a châ tyhpa ei chi kha, a chyhta dei nama y aw.

Abeipa ta nama chô liata hmo phapa tao ta, nama maluh cha papôh awpa â lynazie a châpa hawhta, nama leina tao awpa nata cha pahleipadia awpa chhao cha Abeipa alynazie châ aw ta, hnei awpa ta namâ kei ngiapa râh tawhta phia pathlahpa nama châ aw.

“ Abeipa ta kaokih liata, alei chhâna miakha lâ tawhta miakha lâ chhâna taihta a ypa phopizy hry liata cha papai aw ei ta, cha liata nâmo nata châ pathlatuhpazy ta nama pahno beih leipa tho nata lô khazohzy nama chakao aw.
Cha phopizy hry liata huhnona rai hnei leipa aw ei chi ta, nama pheipazah châta a pahâna rai y aw vei. Cha liata Abeipa ta palôh achalyuna, mo bâna nata thlahpa thazeina zy a cha pie aw ei.
Nama hrona cha khatino rai ta chichhihpa ta y aw ta, chhô nah zâ ta thlazohpa ta y aw ei chi ta, chhôhmohpa ta hrona noh hnei aw veih ei chi.
Nama palôh liata chichhihna nata na mo ta a hmôpazy vâta, my ta, ‘Zâlâ a châ bâ mawh sala,’ tah aw ei chi ta, zâlâ ta, ‘My a châ bâ mawh sala,’ nama tah aw.

Nama hnohta, ‘Hmô heih khao aw veih ei chi,’ ei tahpa Izi râh lâpi liata Abeipa ta balyh ta châ chhi pakhua heih aw ei ta, cha liata nama chariahpazy seichapaw nata seichanôzy châta a zuah aw ei chi ta, ahy ta hmah cha chalei khoh aw veih ei,” tah ta.
Hezy he Abeipa ta Izarei sawzy hnohta Hôribâ liata bie a hraipa thota, Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta Môabâ râh liata biepie heih ta, Izarei sawzy chô liata bie a hraipazy a châ.
Mawsi ta Izarei saw zydua aw ta, hetana heta Abeipa bie a chho ei. “ Abeipa ta nama mohmô lia tlai ta Izi râh liata Phiraoh nata a chyhsa zydua nata a râh zydua chô liata a taopa zydua hmô ei chi ta,
pasiana ru ngaitapa nata ngiana nata hmonoâh rônahpazy chhao nama mo tlai ta nama hmô hra.
Châhrasala Abeipa ta pahno thaina pathipalôh, hmô theina mo nata thei theina nahzy tanoh taihta cha pie veih ei.
Râhchawhpa liata kô sypalih cha chhihtha ei na ta, nama pôhpa liata nama chysiazy chy leipa ta, nama phei liata nama pheikyzy chy hra vei.
Kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa ei châ tahpa nama pahno thei nawpa ta, viahchhâ nie leipa ei chi ta, kresawhti nata kresawhti patapa chhao doh veih ei chi.
He su nama vaw tlô nahta, miah a dyuh awpa ta Hesbaw bei Sihaw nata Bâsanâ bei Ôkâ vaw pua ei ta, châhrasala eima pahnie haw.
Ama râh la pi ta, Rubena chi, Kâdâ chi nata Manase chi khophie pahrâ nawpa ta eima pie.
Chavâta nama hmotaopa zydua liata thlaochhipa ta nama y lymâ thei nawpa ta, he biehrai biezy he zyh u la tao teh u.
Tanoh nama zydua ta Abeipa nama Khazohpa hmiakô liata a duah ei chi ta, nama chi pawhrâhpazy, nama machâzy, nama sawhkhâ molaipazy, Izarei chapaw zydua,
nama hawtizy, nama lapinôzy, chihropa nama riehmo liata a y hrapazy, nama tho a thlupa tawhta nama ti a thaihpa taihta Abeipa nama Khazohpa hmiakô liata namâ duah hih.
Chatanachata Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta tanoh ta nama hnohta a hraipa, Abeipa nama Khazohpa biehrai bietai liata namâ ngia thei aw.
Châ pathlatuhpa Abarahâ, Aisika nata Zakaw zy hnohta bie â taihpa nata nâmo hnohta chhao a reipa hawhta, tanoh he a phopi ta cha padua ei ta, ano cha nama Khazohpa a châ haw.
He biehrai nata bietai he nâmo hnoh dei ta a taopa châ leipa na ta,
tanoh ta Abeipa eima Khazohpa hmiakô liata a duahpazy nata tanoh eima hnohta a y hra leipazy hnohta chhao ei tao.
“Izi râh liata kheihta ma eima y tyh tahpa nata nama kaw chapiapa râhzy kheihta ma eima kaw sie pahlie tahpa nama pahno.
Ama hmo pasichhihpazy hmô ei chi ta, tho nata lô, tâkâ nata ngôhzy ta taopa ama khazoh nothlahpazy chhao nama hmô.

A vaih teh u, chataleipatala nama hry liata chapaw tlyma, chanô tlyma, pho tlyma, chi tlyma, tanoh Abeipa eima Khazohpa tawhta ama palôh tleisaipa ta, cha phopizy a chhypa khazohzy cha ngaipa ta chakao aw ei ta, nama hry liata châmaih khapa thari a thla pathlei aw.

“Cha hawhpa chyhsa ta he biehrai biezy he a thei tita, anosasyh ta a palôh ta byhnâ a awpa aw ta, ‘Ei palôh chhorupa lâpi a chhih hraw sah la, ei boh thlâh ha aw,’ tahpa ta pachâ aw ta, cha chata khihti phana râh chhao, râhchawhpa chhao, raona a tlôkhei aw.

Ano cha Abeipa ta a ngiahthai khoh leipa aw ta, Abeipa hiehâhna nata hiatliana ta a khu aw. He châbu liata ropa chhiesana zydua he a chô liata tla thlu aw ta, Abeipa ta avâ ry tawhta a moh a pahlei aw.
Abeipa ta ano cha, Izarei chizy hry tawhta la papua aw ta, ryhpa châbu liata ropa chhiesana biehrai zydua hawhta, chhiena rarôh ypa a chô liata a patlôsa aw.
“Chhâ a vaw y awpa, nama hnôhlâ ta nama saw a vaw y awpazy nata chihropa chyhsa râh hlapi tawhta a vy awpazy ta, cha râh liata Abeipa ta potlana nata hri a chareisapazy ama hmô aw.

A râh pôhpalôhpa cha, kaih nata alôh nata kârypa, khâpa chi hmah cheih leina, khâpa hmah pyu leina, sibiepazy chhao thao leina, Abeipa ta hiehâhpa nata pathi iapa ta a paraopa Sawdawmâ nata Kawmawrâ nata Adamâ nata Zebaw râhzy hawhta paraopa a châ aw.
Phopi to ta, ‘Khâpa vâta ma Abeipa ta cha râh cha, cha hawhta a tao tly? Cha hawhta hiehâhna ru ngaitapa a patlôsapa cha, khâpa ma a chhâpa a châ tly?’ ama tah aw.
“Cha tina cha chyhsazy ta, ‘Izi râh tawhta â chhi papua nona ei khata, Abeipa, ama pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa ta ama hnohta a taopa biehrai tleisai ei ta,
ama pahno beih leipa khazoh hropa, Abeipa ta âmo châta a rao leipa khazohzy chakao ei ta, amâ chhypa vâta a châ.
Chavâta cha râh chô liata Abeipa a pathi ia ta, he châbu liata ropa chhiesana zydua he ama chô liata patlôsa ta,
hiehâhna ru ngaitapa nata pathiiana sah ngaitapa ta ama râh tawhta phia pathlah ta, tanoh ta ama yzie hawhna heta, râh hro lâta a papaipatla ha ei,’ ama tah aw.
“Hmo nyupazy cha Abeipa eima Khazohpa eih châ ta, hmo palâhâhpazy deikua keimo nata eima pathlazy eih a châ. Chatanachata he ryhpa bie zydua he eima zyh thei aw.
“Byhnâ nata chhiesana hmo nama hmiakô liata ei sopa zydua he nama chô liata a vaw tlô tita, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta a cha papaipatlana râh phopizy hry liata nama y nota, he kyh he pachâpasiapa ta,
nâmo nata nama pathlazy ta Abeipa nama Khazohpa lâ kua heihpa ta, tanoh ta bie ei cha piepa hawhna ei heta, nama pathipalôh tlokhuh ta nata nama thlahpa tlokhuh ta a ao nama nathlie khiahta cha,
Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama seichâna tawhta cha pakuasa aw ei ta, a cha ngiachhie aw ei. Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta a cha papaipatlana râh phopizy tawhta cha pakhy aw ei ta, a cha pakuasa aw ei.
Avâ chy chhâna taihta paipatlapa ta nama ypa chhao ta, cha su tawhta Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta cha pakhy aw ei ta, cha tawhtapa cha a châ chhi heih aw ei.
Châ pathlatuhpazy râh hneipa lâ Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta châ chhi heih aw ei ta, cha râh cha nama hnei aw. Châ pathlatuhpazy hlâta Abeipa ta nâmo byhnâ cha pie via aw ei ta, a cha papôhsa via aw ei.

Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha nama pathipalôh tlokhuh ta nata nama thlahpa tlokhuh ta kyhpachâpa ta, na hroh thei nawpa ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama pathipalôh nata nama pathlazy pathipalôh chopaw a cha taipa aw ei.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta he chhiesana zydua he, nama chariahzy chô liata nata châ haotuhpazy nata châ taolatuhpazy chô liata a patlôsa aw.
Chatanachata kua aw chi ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ao nathlie aw ei chi ta, a biepiepa tanoh ta ei cha piepa zydua ei he nama zyh ha aw.

Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama ku raihria zydua, nama chipathla, nama sahroh taw nata nama chhaohlei thei zy byhnâ pie aw ta, thata a papôhsa aw. Châ pathlatuhpazy chô liata â lypa hawhna khata, Abeipa ta byhnâ cha pie aw ei ta, nama chô liata â ly heih aw.

Abeipa nama Khazohpa ao nathliepa ta, he ryhpa châbu liata ropa a biepiepazy nata a bieraopazy zyh u la, nama pathipalôh tlokhuh ta nata nama thlahpa tlokhuh ta Abeipa nama Khazohpa lâ namâ heih khiahta cha, cha byhnâzy cha nama to aw.
“He biepiepa tanoh ta ei cha piepa ei he, zyh awpa ta nama châta ru leipa ta, tloh thei lei awpa châ hra vei.
‘A biepiepa cha thei sih la, eima zyh thei nawpa ta, ahy vârâh lâ kiah aw ta, miah a kaw lapa aw?’ tah awpa ta, biepiepa cha vârâh liata a ypa châ vei.
‘A biepiepa cha thei sih la, eima zyh thei nawpa ta, ahy tilaipi khô lâ sie aw ta, miah a lapa aw?’ tah awpa ta, biepiepa cha tilaipi khô lâta a ypa châ hra vei.
Nama tao thei nawpa ta, bie ta châ hnia ei ta, nama pakah nata nama palôh liata a y.
“Pachâ tua u, tanoh he nama hmiakô liata hrona nata phana, thina nata raona soh na ta.

Abeipa nama Khazohpa kyhpachâ awpa ta, tanoh ta bie ei cha piepa he zyh u la, a lâpizy a chhihpa ta, a biepiepazy, a bieraopazy nata a pachianazy nama zyh khiahta cha, hroh aw chi ta, pôh aw chi ta, hnei awpa ta nama pangaipa râh liata Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta byhnâ a cha pie aw ei.
Nama pathipalôh a hro lâ a heih sala, a bie nathlie leipa ta, lâpi pavia u la, khazoh hropazy a chhypa ta nama chakao khiahta deikua cha,
nama leidia tlai aw tahpa tanoh ei cha chho ei. Zawdâh chakapa ta râh namâ ngia awpa nata nama hnei awpa liata hroh pareih aw veih ei chi.

Nama hmiakô liata hrona nata thina soh na ta, byhnâ nata chhiesana ei soh tahpa pahnokheituhpa châta tanoh he avâ nata alei ei aw ei. Hrona a tlyh u la, chatanachata nâmo nata nama chipathlazy nama hroh aw.

Abeipa nama Khazohpa kyhpachâ u la, a ao nathliepa ta, ano khâchâ patu teh u. Ano cha nama hrona châ ta, nama hro pasina a châ. Chatanachata Abeipa ta châ pathlatuhpa Abarahâ, Aisika nata Zakaw zy hnohta pie awpa ta bie â taihpa râh liata nama pahrâ thei aw,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta Izarei saw zydua hnohta bie reih lymâ ta.
Ama hnohta, “Tahmâ cha kô 120 uhtheipa châ ha na ta, pua-ei thei khao va na. Abeipa ta ei hnohta, ‘Zawdâh chaka aw va chi,’ na tah ha ta.

Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta hmia châ sahpa aw ei ta, ano tlai ta phopizy nama hmiakô tawhta pahleipadia aw ta, âmo cha nama pho aw. Abeipa ta a reipa hawhta, Zawsua ta hmia a sah aw ta, Zawdâh cha a chaka aw.
Abeipa ta Amawri bei Sihaw nata Ôkâ nata ama râh a pahleipadia nota ama chô liata a taopa hawhna khata, cha phopizy chô liata a tao hra aw.
Abeipa ta âmo cha cha pie aw ei ta, bie ei cha piepa zydua hawhna ei khata ama chô liata nama tao aw.
Thatlôpa nata riahphapa ta y u la, âmo cha chi leipa u la, thlazohpa ta y hra khuh vy. Nama hnohta a siepa cha Abeipa nama Khazohpa châ ta, cha my leipa aw ei ta, cha pathlua aw veih ei,” tah ta.

Chatawhcha Mawsi ta Zawsua aw ta, Izarei saw zydua mohmô liata a hnohta, “Thatlôpa nata riahphapa ta y teh. He phopi hnohna heta Abeipa ta ama pathlatuhpazy pie awpa ta bie â taihpa râh lâ sie aw chi ta, cha râh cha ryu ta na patosa aw ei.
Abeipa nama hmia lâta sie aw ta, nama hnohta y aw ta, cha siesai beih leipa aw ei ta, cha pathlua beih aw veih ei. Chi leipa u la, a ngiaroh hra khuh vy,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta ryhpa cha roh ta, Abeipa Biehrai Byh a sytuhpa Livai sawchapaw theihthaipazy nata Izarei machâzy hnohta pie ta.
Mawsi ta âmo cha biepie ta, ama hnohta, “Kô sarina, dyuchei ngiahthaina kô chhâna liata Byureih Kyhchhi liata,
Izarei saw zydua Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta su â tlyh awpa liata a hmiakô liata amâ vaw luah tita, he ryhpa he Izarei saw zydua theipa ta nama reih awpa a châ.

Zawpizy ta Abeipa nama Khazohpa china bie nathliepa ta, a chu ei sala, ryhpa bie zydua he zyhpa ta ama tao thei nawpa ta, chapawzy, chanôzy, hawtizy nata nama yna khihzy liata chihropa a ypazy nama awpakhy khai aw.

Ryhpa a pahno mâh leipa ama sawzy chhao, Zawdâh chakapa ta nama hnei awpa râh liata nama y chhôh zydua Abeipa nama Khazohpa china amâ chu lymâ thei nawpa ta, ryhpa he thei ta, amâ chu hra awpa a châ,” tah ta.

Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Pachâ teh, na thi daihti â hnia haw. Zawsua aw la, ahmaohna poh o liata a vy teh u, a hnohta biehneina ei pie aw,” tah ta. Mawsi nata Zawsua cha vawh ei ta, ahmaohna poh o liata kei y ei ta.
Abeipa cha poh o liata meihdo tôh ta a zâ luah ta, meihdo tôh cha poh o chhikao luh chô liata a duah ta.

Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Pachâ teh, châ pathlatuhpazy hnohta nâ mô nawpa daihti â hnia haw. He phopi he thyu aw ei ta, pahrâ awpa ta ama pangaipa râh liata chihropa khazohzy liata amâ phei aw. Na pathlua aw ei ta, ama hnohta ei hraipa ei biehrai ama parao aw.

Cha noh ta ama chô liata ei pathi ia aw ta, ei pathlua aw ei. Âmo tawhta ei hmia nyu aw na ta, pahleipadiapa ama châ aw. Hmo pha leipa nata nôpona hluhpi ama chô liata tlô aw ta, cha noh ta, ‘Eima Khazohpa eima hnohta a y leipa vâta, he hmo pha leipa he eima chô liata a vaw tlôpa châ vei ma?’ ama tah aw.
Khazoh hropazy lâ a heih ei ta hmo pha leipa ama taopa zydua vâta, cha noh liata ei hmia ei nyu tlai aw.
“Chavâta he hla he nama châta roh u la, Izarei sawzy pachu u la, Izarei sawzy ei dyuhna nâ pahnokheituhpa châta ama pakah liata soh u la, pasasa tyh muh vy.

Ama pathlatuhpazy hnohta bie ei taihpa sâhpiti nata kheihti lona râh lâ ei chhi ti ei ta, lôhrâtlôpa ta nie aw ei ta, ama thawh tita, khazoh hropazy lâ a heih aw ei ta, ama chakao aw. Na mohnao aw ei ta, ei biehrai ama parao aw.
