Hmo pha leipa nata nôpona hluhpi ama chô liata a vaw tlô tita, he hla he ama pathlazy pakah liata mypa ta a y lei awpa vâta, pahnokheituhpa âmo a padeituhpa a châ aw. Ei bietai râh ei tlôkhei hlâ chhao ei ta, ama palôh aheina lâ ei pahno khai,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Mawsi ta, cha noh ta hla phi ta, Izarei pathlazy a pachu ei.
Abeipa ta Nunâ sawchapawpa Zawsua cha biehneina pie ta, a hnohta, “Thatlôpa nata riahphapa ta y teh. Izarei sawzy he ama hnohta bie ei taihpa râh nâ ngiakhei aw ei. Na hnohta ei y lymâ aw,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta ryhpa bie zydua cha achhâna taihta châbu liata a ro khai nahta,
Biehrai Byh a sytuhpa Livai chizy Mawsi ta biepie ta, ama hnohta,
“Ryhpa châbu he la u la, nama paraona pahnokheituhpa châta Abeipa nama Khazohpa Biehrai Byh kâ lâta soh teh u.
Chhorupa nata kuhchhapa nama châzie ei pahno. Pachâ tua u, tanoh ei cha hrolâh chy no ei ta hmahta Abeipa namâ dyuh khiahta cha, ei thi tawhta chhochhi cha khatlu ta ma a châ aw tly?
Nama chi to machâzy nata nama hyutuhpazy kei lâ a vy awpa ta awpakhy teh u. He bie zydua he ama nah theina liata reih aw na ta, ei bie nâ pahnokhei awpa ta avâ nata alei ei aw aw ei.

Ei thi tawhta thata molei aw ei chi ta, bie ei cha piepa ei lâpi tawhta nama tleisai aw tahpa ei pahno. Noh a vaw tlô awpazy liata, nama ku hmotaopa ta Abeipa hie pahâhpa ta, a mohmô liata hmo pha leipa nama tao awpa vâta, hmo pha leipa ta a cha tla thlu aw ei,” tah ta.
Mawsi ta Izarei zawpi zydua theina liata he hla biezy he achhâna taihta reih ta.
“Hy avâzy saih u, Nah pachôh teh u, Bie ei reih aw; Ei pakah tawhta biezy he Alei ta thei mawh sy.
Ei pachuna avâ hawhta suah sala, Ei bie diati hawhta tla mawh sy; Si panyupa chô liata avâ di hawhta tla sala, Sihnapa chô liata avâ hawhta suah mawh sy.
Abeipa moh ei phuah aw, Eima Khazohpa cha rônahna patosa teh u!
“Lôpanô cha a hmotaopazy siapaki ta, A lâpi zydua â do. Ano cha Khazohpa ngâchhihpa châ ta, Paraona hnei leipa ta, Asiapa nata adopa a châ.
A chô liata molei ei ta, Ama moleina vâta, A sawzy châ khao veih ei; Chhâ haiphiahpa châ ei ta, Chhâ moleipa ama châ.
Hy nâmo, ahrupa nata angâpa phopi, Cha hawhta ma Abeipa cha viari nama thô? Ano cha châ taotuhpa nama paw châ ta, Cha tao ei ta nâmo châ paduatuhpa châ vei ma?
Hlâno daihti liata nohzy kha a thei u la, Chhâ hluhpi liata kôzy kha pachâ tua u; Nama pawzy hiahri u la, Ama cha pahmô aw; Machâzy hiahri u la, Ama cha chho aw.
Chônôchaipa ta phopizy ama ryuto râh pie ta, Âdâh pathlazy a pachhaih nona khata, Khazohpa sawchapawzy maluh hawhta, Phopizy châta râhri a pakhâh.
Abeipa tovyuh deikua cha a phopi châ ta, Zakaw cha a ryuto a châ.
“ Abeipa ta Zakaw cha râhchawhpa liata hmô ta, Râh chhiepa nata râh raohpa liata a hmô. Ano cha chahlôchaeipa ta mohôh ta, A mosaw hawh tlai ta a khâsia.
Pahmôhpi ta a taw a pazawsa tita, A taw chô lâta heih laih ta, A mathlaw pakai khâhpa ta a tla awpa pakhâ ta, A tla awpa nota a mathlaw ta a phaopa hawhta,
Abeipa tlai ta Zakaw cha a chhi ta, Râh hropa khazoh a hnohta y beih veih ei.
Lei su sâhpazy chô liata patyusa ta, Lyu kôveizy a paniesa tyh; Lôpanô tawhta kheihti ta chyh ta, Lôsohpa tawhta sathaw ta a chyh.

Viahchao hri sâhpiti kuapa ta cha pasa ta, Mietaku zaw sâhpiti ta a cha pasa; Mietakutaw thaw ta cha pasa ta, Bâsanâ mietaku tôhpa thaw ta cha pasapa ta, Mie thaw ta a cha pasa. Sâh pahâh chaipazy cha paniesa ta, Kre thisaih pathaihpa na doh tyh.
“Zesuruh cha vaw thawh ta â chapie. Vaw thawhpa ta, Vaw pahly chi ta, Na mithawh kaw. Châhrasala ano taotuhpa Khazohpa a heihsai ta, A pachhana lôpanô khâpasaw ta reih khao vei.
Chihropa khazohzy ta a hia patliasa ei ta, Pasichhihpazy taopa ta a hie ama pahâh.
Khazoh a châ leipa ahripazy lâta atheihna hlâ ei ta, Ama pahno beih leipa khazoh, Atlia ta a vaw ypa khazoh thiehpa, Pathlatuhpazy ta ama chi beih leipa Khazohzy lâta atheihna ama hlâ tyh.
Châ satuhpa Lôpanô pachâ khao leipa ei chi ta, Châ taotuhpa Khazohpa nama my haw.
Cha cha Abeipa ta hmô ta â hao kaw, A sawchapawzy ta a hie pahâh ei ta, A sawchanôzy ta a hie ama pahâh.
Chavâta Abeipa ta, ‘Ei hmia nyusai aw ei na ta, Ama chhâna ei moh tua aw. Chhâ moleipa châ ei ta, Ngâchhih leipa sawzy ama châ.

Khazoh a châ leipa ta ei hia na patliasa ei ta, Ama nothlahpazy ta ei hie eina pahâh ei. Chavâta phopi ta rei khi a tloh leipa chô liata Ama hia patliasa aw na ta, Râh hrupa hmâpa ta ama hie ei pahâh aw.
Ei hiehâhna ta mei papua ta, Athihkhih a thu chaipazy lâ taih kâ laih ta, Alei nata a kôveizy kâ khai ta, Tlâhpizy abôna chhao a kâ khai haw.
“‘Ama chô liata raona pacho thlu aw ei na ta, Ei châtaizy ei hmâ thlu aw ei.

Nodipa ta thi aw ei ta, Potlana rarôh ypa ta palâ khai aw ei ta, Hriiah chichhihpazy ta a palâ khai aw ei. Râhsa naoh seihpa zy âmo lâ tuah aw na ta, Dohlei liata alyhpa châmaih hneipa sazy âmo lâ ei tuah aw.
Khôtho lâta zaozi ta thi aw ei ta, O chhôh liata thlazohpa ta ama y aw; Satlia nata laihsa zy thi aw ei ta, Sâhpi a ngiehpa nata sâ pawhpazy ama thi khai aw.
A tlawh ta pachhaih aw ei na ta, Khizaw ta â thei khao lei awpa ta ei pamua aw ei,’ Vaw tah ha aw sah la a pha awpa tlai.
Ama chariahpazy ta pahno chhei ei sala hmahta, Âmo cha pasipasawhpa ta, ‘He zydua he Abeipa taopa châ vei, Keimo ku ta eima pahniepa a châ,’ Ama tah pathlei awpa ei chipa vâta a châ.
“Sona hnei leipa phopi châ ei ta, Âmo liata novâhna y vei.
Ama so mawh sala, Cha kyh cha ama novâh aw ta, Ama chhâ nawpa ama pahno awpa tlai!
Kheihta ma pakha ta sâh kha a chadai thei aw ta, Pano ta thy kha ama parâpaisa thei aw? Ama Lôpanô ta âmo cha zuah ha ta, Abeipa ta a uasa khao leipa vâ ei ta châ vei ma?
Âmo lôpanô cha keimo Lôpanô hawhpa châ vei; Cha cha eima chariahpazy chhao ta ama pahno.
“Ama kre zôh cha Sawdawmâ kre zôh tawhta a vy ta, Kawmawrâ lyuzy tawhta a vypa a châ; Ama kre theizy cha châmaih theizy châ ei ta, Ama kre saozy chhao kre sao khapazy a châ.
Ama kresawhti cha parih châmaih châ ta, Chyuphao châmaih thatlôpa a châ.
“Chazy cha ei yna liata pahmaoh na ta, Ei ryubyh chhôh liata ei khô ei.
Phuh cha keima la awpa châ ta, Kei ta viari ei thô aw; Ama phei a chakhao patoh aw ta, Ama chhiena noh â hnia haw; Ama raona noh a vaw tlô patoh aw.
Hmotaotheina ama hnei khao leipa Abeipa ta hmô ta, Sei chhao khotalaipa chhao ama y khao lei tita, Abeipa ta a phopi thaipachâsa aw ta, A chakaotuhpazy chô liata zawh â ngiah aw.
Abeipa ta, ‘Ama khazohzy khataih lia ama y haw, Amâ chhaina lôpanô khataih lia a y haw?
Amâ theihna thaw nie ei ta, Ama dopa hlâna kresawhti a doh tyhpazy kha, Khataih lia ama y haw? Vaw thyupa ta cha bao ei sala, Châ pabohsa bao ei sa!

“‘Tahmâ he pachâ teh u, Kei, kei deita he Ano cha châ na ta, Keima leipa ta Khazoh hropa rai y veih ei. Thie thei na ta, Ei pahro thei; Hmah paphao thei na ta, Ei patlâh thei; Ei ku tawhta a pachha theipa y veih ei.
Avâ lâ ei ku pazawh na ta, Tlyzaw ta a hrohpa ei châna moh reipa ta, Bie ei taih.
Ei zaozi patliepa ta sah la, Ryureina ei chaba tita cha, Ei khakhaipazy chô liata phuh la aw na ta, Nâ haotuhpazy viari ei thô aw ei.
Ei châtaizy thisaih pari awpa ta tao aw na ta, Ei zaozi ta sapa niepa ta, Thiepa nata patupazy thisaih doh aw ta, Chariah hyutuh sâ seihpazy luh tawhta thisaih a doh aw,’ tah ta.

“Hy avâzy saih u, Abeipa phopi a lykhei u la; Hy khazohzy saih u, A hmia liata a bôh teh u; Ana cha a chakaotuhpazy thisaih phuhlatuhpa châ ta, A khakhaipazy chô liata viari a thôtuhpa a châ. Ano a haotuhpazy viarithô aw ta, A râh nata a phopi châta chatlaina a tao aw.”
Mawsi cha Nunâ sawchapawpa Zawsua chhaota a vy ta, cha hla bie zydua cha zawpi theina liata reih ta.
Mawsi ta cha bie zydua cha Izarei zydua hnohta a rei khai nahta,
ama hnohta, “Tanoh nama hnohta bie ei reipa zydua liana heta nama pathipalôh khâchâ pachhô u la, he ryhpa bie zydua he zyh ta, tao awpa ta nama sawzy biepie teh u.
Cha biezy cha nama châta bie thlâhthlipa châ leipa ta, nama hrona châ ta, cha biezy cha nama zyh khiahta cha, zawdâh chakapa ta hnei awpa ta nama pangaipa râh liata nama hro a pareih aw,” tah ta.
Cha noh lilaw liata Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta,
“Môabâ râh liata Zerikô dady ta Abari tlâhthlôh liata Nebô Tlâh lâ khy la, hnei awpa ta Izarei sawzy hnohta ei piepa Kâna râh cha kaw sai mah y.
Na unawhpa Arawna kha Hôri Tlâh liata thi ta, a chiheihzy hnohta pahlyhpa a châpa hawhna khata, nâ chhao na kiapa tlâh chô liana cha thi aw chi ta, na chiheihzy hnohta pahlyhpa na châ hra aw.
Zini râhchawhpa liata Meribâ Kâdesâ tizy liata, Izarei sawzy hmiakô liata na ngâ leipa ei chi ta, Izarei sawzy hry liata eina palyupalih leipa vâ ei chi ta bietai râh cha a ngia aw veih ei chi.
Râh cha lâhla tawhta hmô aw chi ta, châhrasala Izarei sawzy ei piepa râh cha a ngia aw va chi,” tah ta.
He byhnâ awnazy he Khazohpa chyhsa Mawsi ta a thi hlâta Izarei sawzy châta byhnâ a awna a châ.

Hetana heta byhnâ a awpa ei: “Sinai tawhta Abeipa a vy ta, Seirâ tawhta noh hawhta vaw chhipa ta, Pârâ Tlâh tawhta a vaw khaih; Mopathaihpa thysâh hry tawhta a vy ta, A ku chachâh lâta mei paleih â chaba.
A châ na, a phopi kyhpachâ kaw ta, A mopathaihpa zydua a ku liata ama y. Na pheihniezy cha pazi ei ta, Na biepiepazy ama zyh tyh.
Mawsi ta ryhpa miah pie ta, Zakaw pathlazy ryuto châta miah a pie.
Phopi hyutuhpazy amâ hmaoh nota, Izarei chi zydua hmaohkha ta ama y nota, Abeipa cha Zesuruh liata bei ta a y.
“Rubena cha hroh sala, Thi khah sy; A pathla maluh deikua, Chyh mawh sy.”
Zudâh châta byhnâ awna: “Hy Abeipa, Zudâh ao nathlie la, A phopi lâ a chhi mah y. Nâma ku ta a chariahzy a dyuhpa la, Ano baotuhpa châ mah y.”
Livai châta byhnâ awna: “Livai hnohta na Thumi pie la, Na mopathaihpa hnohta na Uri pie mah y. Ano cha Mâsâ liata pasia chi ta, Meribâ tizy liata na pahao.
Na bie a ngiah ta, Na biehrai a zyhpa vâta, A nô nata a paw kyh liata, ‘Pachâ veih ei na’ tah ta; A unawhzy pahno leipa ta, A sawzy tlai chhao uasa vei.
Na bieraopazy Zakaw pachu aw ei ta, Na ryhpa biezy Izarei ama pachu aw; Na hmiakô liata ropahâhpa soh aw ei ta, Na maisâh liata raopa hlânazy ama hlâ aw.
Hy Abeipa, a sôh nata piah byhnâ pie la, A ku raihria a pyh mah y; A khakhaipazy chai chhawh la, Ama thyu khao lei nawpa ta, Ano a haotuhpazy chai chhawh mah y.”
Benzami châta byhnâ awna: “ Abeipa kho ngaitapa cha, A hnohta â bohpa ta pahrâ mawh sy; Abeipa ta noh y ta vaih sala, A ngiatlâhzy likawh liata pahrâ mawh sy.”
Zawsi châta byhnâ awna: “ Abeipa ta a râh byhnâ pie sala, Avâ hmo sôhpa diati patlasa sala, Alei ry lâta ti athupazy pie mawh sy.
Noh thei sôhpazy pie sala, Thla kôvei phazy pie mawh sy.
Tlâhpi hlôpazy liata hmo pha chaipazy pua sala, Tlâhthlôh zôpazy liata hmo sôh chaipazy pua mawh sy.
Alei hneirôna byhnâzy â kipa ta to sala, Chhobuh liata a pahrâpa khokheina to mawh sy. Cha byhnâzy cha Zawsi luh chô liata y sala, A unawhzy hry liata luh chaipa laki liata y mawh sy.

Zawsi cha viahchao pataw tuapa tôhpa hawhta rônah ta, A kizy chaoliah tôhpa ki hawhta a châ; A ki ta phopizy tôh aw ta, Ama zydua ta alei chhâna taih a tôh pathlah aw ei. Âmo cha Epharai thy hluhpi châ ei ta, Manase sâh hluhpizy ama châ.”
Zebulawna châta byhnâ awna: “Zebulawna y, na siena maih lia a ly la, Iskâra y, na poh ozy liata a ly mah y.
Tilaipi hneirônazy thaoh ei ta, Raphyu liata ryu a pabupazy ama thaopa vâta, Phopizy ama tlâhpi lâ a vy awpa ta hrua aw ei ta, Cha liata atheihna dopazy ama hlâ aw.”
Kâdâ châta byhnâ awna: “Kâdâ râh a pakawhtuhpa cha, Reithaipa ta y mawh sy! Kâdâ cha chakeibarôhneipa hawhta a byu ta, Bâh nata luhzy a hriechheihpa a châ.
Hyutuhpa tovyuh pahlôhpa a châpa vâta, Râh pha chaipa ano châta a tlyh ta; Phopi chhituhpazy ano lâ a vy ei ta, Abeipa adona ta bie pachia ta, Izarei châta a bieraopazy hawhta a pachia.”
Dânâ châta byhnâ awna: “Dânâ cha chakeibarôhneipa lochopa châ ta, Bâsanâ tawhta a vaw zawpa a châ.”
Nâthalai châta byhnâ awna: “Hy Nâthalai, khokheina vâta lôhrâtlôpa ta y chi ta, Abeipa byhnâ to a topa na châ; Notla râhzy pahrâ la, Chho râhzy pahrâ mah y.”
Asera châta byhnâ awna: “Asera cha sawchapawzy hry liata byhnâ to chai sala, A unawhzy khokheina hlaopa ta, Sathaw liata a phei ny mawh sy.
Na thokhy chhikao hrainazy cha, Thua nata dawh châ sala; Na hro chhôh zydua ta Thatlôpa ta y mah y.”
“Hy Zesuruh, Khazohpa hawhpa he ahy hmah y veih ei; Ano cha cha bao awpa ta avâzy chô liata kiah ta, A rônahpa ta avâpi chô a kiahpa a châ.
Tlyzaw Khazohpa cha na pahrâna châ ta, A ry lâta chhâzaw bâhzy a y; Na hmiakô tawhta chariahpa papua ta, ‘Pahleipadia teh u,’ a tahtuhpa a châ.
Chatanachata Izarei cha, Sâh nata kresawhti râh liata â bohpa ta ypa ta, Avâzy ta diati ama patlasana liata â bohpa ta y ta, Zakaw pahrâna cha thlalôhpa ta a y.

“Hy Izarei, na nohlao ngaita na! Nâ hawhta Abeipa ta a pachhapa phopi he ahy ma a y? Abeipa cha na châta baona vyhphao châ ta, Na pahniena zaozi a châ. Châ ngiarih awpa ta na chariahzy nâ lâ a vy aw ei ta, Ama ky lia na phei ta na tly aw ei.”
Mawsi cha Môabâ bypi tawhta Zerikô dady Nebô Tlâh liata Piskâ tlâh laki lâ khy ta. Abeipa ta râh zydua pamosa ta, Kilia tawhta Dânâ taih,
Nâthalai râh zydua, Epharai nata Manase râhzy, Zudâh râh zydua Notla Tilaipi taih;
Neke nata Bypi tawhta Zawâ taih pamosa ta. Bypi cha thiahrâ khihpi Zerikô saikao a châ.
Abeipa ta a hnohta, “He râh he, Abarahâ, Aisika nata Zakaw hnohta, ‘Na pathlazy ei pie aw ei,’ tahpa ta bie ei taihpa râh kha a châ. Na mo ta cha pahmôsa na ta, châhrasala a ngia aw va chi,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Abeipa chakaotuhpa Mawsi cha Abeipa bie hawhta Môabâ râh liata thi ta,
Bepeô dady Môabâ râh saikao liata ama pabu. Châhrasala a thlâ yna cha ahy hmahta tanoh taihta pahno veih ei.
Mawsi cha a thi nota kô 120 uhtheipa a châ. A mo zoh leipa ta, a tha tleih vei.
Izarei sawzy ta Mawsi cha Môabâ bypi liata noh sythôh chakhei ei ta. Mawsi chakheipa ta ama mâchhiesana nohzy cha chhâ ta.
Nunâ sawchapawpa Zawsua cha, Mawsi ta a chô liata a ku a pahniehpa vâta, sona thlahpa ta bie ta. Chavâta Izarei sawzy ta a bie nathlie ei ta, Abeipa ta Mawsi bie a piepa hawhta ama tao lymâ.
Cha khai tawhta cha Izarei hry liata Mawsi hawhta Abeipa ta hmiachhy ta a pahnopa hrohsopa y khao veih ei.
Abeipa ta Izi râh liata nata Phiraoh nata a chakaotuhpa zydua nata a râh zydua chô liata ngiana nata hmonoâhpazy a pataosapa hawhpa kha ano hawhta a tao theipa y veih ei.
Mawsi ta ku thatlôpa nata chichhihpa ta Izarei zydua mohmô liata a taopa hawhta a tao theipa y hra veih ei.
Abeipa chakaotuhpa Mawsi a thi tawhta, Mawsi baotuhpa Zawsua, Nunâ sawchapawpa hnohta Abeipa ta,
“Nâ chakaotuhpa Mawsi thi ha ta, chavâta tahmâ thyu la, nâ nata zawpi zydua ta Zawdâh chaka u la, Izarei phopi ei piepa râh lâ sie teh u.
Mawsi hnohta bie ei taihpa hawhta, nama phei ta nama tlypa maih ei cha pie khai aw ei.
Nama râhrizy chho lâta Râhchawhpa tawhta maw lâta Lebanaw taihta châ aw ta, nochhi lâta chavah laipa, Ufrâti chavah tawhta Hiti mo râh zydua ô ta, notla lâta Tilaipi Rônahpa taihta a châ aw.
Na hro chhôh zydua ahy ta hmah cha pahnie thei aw veih ei. Mawsi hnohta ei ypa hawhna khata, na hnohta ei y hra aw. Cha siesai leipa aw na ta, cha pathlua aw va na.
“Thatlôpa nata riahphapa ta y teh. He sahlao he ama pathlatuhpazy hnohta pie awpa ta bie ei taihpa râh cha ryu ta na patosa aw ei.

Thatlôpa nata riahpha ngaitapa ta y la, nâ chakaotuhpa Mawsi ta tao awpa bie a cha piepa ryhpa zydua pakhâta ta zyh la, tao mah y. Na siena lia maihta thlaochhipa ta na y thei nawpa ta, ryhpa bie he na chachâh lâ tlyma, na chavei lâ tlyma tleisai cheita khah y.

Ryhpa Châbu heta na pakah a puasai awpa châ leipa ta, a chhôh liata bieropazy chhô nah zâ ta tlao na pachâ awpa a châ. Chatanachata ryhpa biezy cha pakhâta ta na zyh thei aw. Cha hawhta na tao khiahta cha, na lâpizy patlâ aw ta, na hlao a tloh aw.
Bie cha pie va na mâ? Thatlôpa nata riahphapa ta y teh. Chi leipa la, ngiarohpa ta y hra kha. Abeipa na Khazohpa cha na siena maihta na hnohta a y lymâ aw,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Zawsua ta Izarei phopi hyutuhpazy biepie ta ama hnohta,

“Riehmo chahryh u la, zawpi hnohta, ‘Nama niedozy a chhuanoh teh u. Noh thôh khai tawhta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta hnei awpa ta râh a cha piepa ei liata a ngia ta, râh cha hnei awpa ta Zawdâh he nama chaka bâ aw,’ tahpa ta biepie teh u,” tah ta.
Rubena mo, Kâdâ mo nata Manase chi khophiezy hnohta Zawsua ta,
“ Abeipa chakaotuhpa Mawsi ta nama hnohta, ‘ Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta apahâna su cha pie ei ta, he râh he a cha pie aw ei,’ tahpa ta bie a cha piepa ei kha a thei thlâh ha muh vy.

Nama lapinô zy, nama hawtizy nata nama sahrohzy he Zawdâh hesâ lâ Mawsi ta râh a cha piepa liana ei heta y aw ei ta, nâmo chyhsa thatlô riahphapa sahlao deikua cha, chariah chhaichhi a tobipa ta nama unawhzy hmia lâta Zawdâh chaka aw ei chi ta, nama unawhzy nama bao tua aw.

Abeipa ta nama unawhzy cha, nâmo hawhta apahâna piepa ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta râh a piepa ei cha, âmo chhao ta ama hnei hlâlei bao aw ei chi ta, cha khai tawhta Abeipa chakaotuhpa Mawsi ta hnei awpa ta Zawdâh nochhi lâta râh a cha piepa lâ ei cha kua aw ei chi ta, râh cha nama hnei aw,” tah ta.
Izarei phopi hyutuhpazy ta Zawsua cha a chhy ei ta, a hnohta, “Tao awpa bie miah na piepa zydua tao aw pi ta, miah na tuana lâ maih eima sie aw.
Kyh to liata Mawsi bie eima zyhpa hawhna khata, na bie eima zyh lymâ aw. Abeipa na Khazohpa cha, Mawsi hnohta a ypa hawhna khata, na hnohta y mawh sy!
Kheihawhpa biepiepa rai châ sala, ahy rai na biepiepa a dyuhpa nata na biezy a nathlie leipa cha thiepa a châ aw. Thatlôpa nata riahphapa ta y mah y,” tah ei ta.

Nunâ sawchapawpa Zawsua ta mohparutuhpa pano Siti tawhta arulâta tuah ta, ama hnohta, “Sie u la, râh kaw moh u la, a eih pachaipa ta Zerikô khihpi kaw moh muh vy,” tah ta. Mohparutuhpazy cha sie ei ta, Rahâbi ama tahpa âzuahnô o liata a ngia ei ta, cha liata tlô ei ta.
Chyhsazy ta Zerikô bei hnohta, “Pachâ teh, râh mohparu awpa ta Izarei sawzy tazâ ama kaw tlô,” tah ei ta.
Zerikô bei ta Rahâbi lâ chyhsa tuah ta, a hnohta, “Na o liata a vaw tlôpa khichhaizy kha vaw papua teh. Râh mohparu awpa ta a vaw tlôpa ama châ,” tahpa ta pachhosa ta.

Châhrasala chanô ta mohparutuhpa pano cha a chhi ta, nyu ha ta. Chatanachata ama thâtih a vaw patluahpazy hnohta, “Â do na, kha chyhsazy kha ei o liata vaw tlô tlai ei ta, châhrasala khataih lâ tawhta a vypa ma ama châ tahpa pahno va na.
Vaw zoh ta, khihpi thokhy chhikao khaw chy ta, ama pua haw. Khataih lâ ma ama sie tahpa pahno va na. A chadai para u la, nama pha thlâh ha aw,” tah ta.
Rahâbi ta a khichhaizy cha vâphuh lâ a chhi ta, vâphuh liata pala kô a chahypa ry liata nyu ta.
Zerikô bei chyhsazy ta Zawdâh chakana su taihta mohparutuhpazy cha a chadai ei ta. Chadaituhpazy ama puapata nahta, thokhy chhikao khaw ha ei ta.
Mohparutuhpazy amâ zia hlâta, Rahâbi cha ama yna vâphuh lâ khy ta,
ama hnohta, “He râh he Abeipa ta a cha pie ha ei tahpa ei pahno. Nâmo china ta miah chanaoh ha ta, he râh liata a pahrâpa zydua nama hmiakô liata ama zao khai haw.

Izi tawhta nama kaw pua nota, Abeipa ta nama hmiakô liata Tilaipi Saihpa a pakuasazie nata Zawdâh haosâ Amawri bei pano Sihaw nata Ôkâ zy chô liata nama taozie zy thei pi ta, âmo cha tlokhuh nama pahleipadia khai hapa thâtihzy eima vaw thei.

Cha thâtih cha eima theipa nahta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha chô lâ avâ liata nata a ry lâ alei liata Khazohpa a châpa vâta, eima pathipalôhzy zao khai ha ta, nâmo vâta palôh a pachyu theipa ahy hmah y khao veih ei.

Chavâta tahmâ Abeipa moh ta bie einâ taih awpa ei chi ta ei châ haw ei. Kei ta nama chô liata ngiachhiena ei palâsapa hawhna heta, nâmo chhao ta ei paw chhôhkha chô liata ngiachhiena palâsa awpa ta bie nâ taih u la, ei lôh thei nawpa ta ngiana na pie teh u.
Chatanachata ei nô nata ei paw, ei rilâhpazy, ei narôzy nata ama chhôhkha zydua pahlôhpa châ aw ei ta, thina tawhta eima hrona miah nama pachha ha aw,” tah ta.

Mohparutuhpazy ta a hnohta, “Eima hmotaopa he nama reih leipa khiahta cha, eima hrona ta nama hrona cha pachha aw pi ta, eima thipa chhao ta eima thi aw. Abeipa ta râh he miah a pie tita, cha ngiachhie aw pi ta, na chô liata ngâchhih ngaitapa ta eima tao aw,” tah ei ta.
Rahâbi o cha khihpi thokhy pahniehpa ta sapa châ ta, thokhy chô liata a ypa a châpa vâta, chaori pangieh ta, mohparutuhpazy cha opy lâ tawhta pachôsa ta.

Ama hnohta, “Tlâhpi lâ khi pangaipa ta sie muh vy. Chataleipatala châ chadaituhpazy khata ama cha hmô pathlei aw. Châ chadaituhpazy ama kua heih hlâlei, cha liata noh thôh a nyu chy aw ei chi ta, cha khai tawhta nama sie nawpa lâ nama sie aw,” tah ta.
Mohparutuhpazy ta a hnohta, “Bie miah na pataihsapa tawhna heta thaileichâna hnei aw ma pi.

Nathlie teh, he râh eimâ vaw ngia tita, pala saihpa he miah na pangiehna opy liana he vaw chahry aw chi ta, na nô nata na paw, na rilâhpazy nata na paw chhôhkha zydua cha na o chhôh liata na paysa khai aw ei.

Ahy rai na o chhikao tawhta khiliah lâ a puapa maih cha, a thisaih maoh ano luh chô liata y aw ta, keimo cha thailei châ aw ma pi. O chhôh liata na hnohta a ypa chô liata ku pathlapa a châ khiahta deikua cha, a thisaih maoh cha eima luh chô liata a y aw.
Eima hmotaopa he na reih khiahta deikua cha, bie miah na pataihsapa heta miah chahry leipa aw ta, thailei châ aw ma pi,” tah ei ta.
Ano ta, “Nama bie hawhta châ mawh sy,” tah ta. Chatanachata mohparutuhpazy cha pasiesa ta, sie ha ei ta. Rahâbi ta Pala saihpa ta opy cha chahry ta.
Mohparutuhpazy cha pua ei ta, tlâhpi lâ cha sie ei ta, a vaw chadaipazy ama kua hlâlei, cha liata noh thôh y ei ta. Chadaituhpazy ta lâpi tlykha tlua ei ta, châhrasala hmô leipa ei ta.
Mohparutuhpa pano cha a lie ei ta. Tlâhpi tawhta za chô ei ta, chavah chaka ei ta, Nunâ sawchapawpa Zawsua kô kei tlô ei ta, ama chô liata hmo a tlôpa zydua chho ei ta.
Zawsua hnohta, “ Abeipa ta râh zydua eima ku liata miah a vaw pie ha tlai na. Cha râh liata a pahrâpa zydua keimo vâta ama zao khai haw,” tah ei ta.
Zawsua cha mydi kari ta thyu ta, Izarei saw zydua chhaota Siti tawhta Zawdâh lâ a pasie ei ta. Chavah ama chaka hlâta cha liata a rie ei ta.
Noh thôh a tloh nahta, hyutuhpazy ta riehmo chahryh ei ta.
Zawpizy cha biepie ei ta, ama hnohta, “Theihthaipa Livai chizy ta Abeipa nama Khazohpa Biehrai Byh amâ sypa nama hmôpa nahta, nama yna su tawhta a pasie aw ei chi ta, Byh cha nama pazi aw.

Anodeikua nâmo nata Byh likawh liata dy 2,000 rachhôh â hla awpa a châ. Namâ hnia awpa châ vei. Chatanachata nama sie nawpa lâpi cha nama pahno thei aw, kha hlâta he lâpi he a chhih beih tlôh lei khâh ei chi ta,” tah ei ta.
Zawsua ta zawpi hnohta, “A pathai teh u, mylâ Abeipa ta nama hry liata hmonoâhpa a tao aw,” tah ta.
Zawsua ta theihthaipazy hnohta, “Biehrai Byh a sypa ta, zawpi hmia lâta sie u la, Zawdâh chaka teh u,” tah ta. Chatanachata theihthaipazy ta Biehrai Byh cha a sy ei ta, zawpi hmia lâta sie ei ta.
Abeipa ta Zawsua hnohta, “Mawsi hnohta ei ypa hawhna khata na hnohta chhao ei y aw tahpa ama pahno thei nawpa ta, Izarei saw zydua mohmô liata tanoh tawhta ei cha cheihchalo pathao aw.
Biehrai Byh asytuhpa theihthaipazy hnohta, ‘Zawdâh ngiahkâ nama tlô tita, Zawdâh chavah kiah liata a chalihpa ta namâ duah awpa a châ,’ tahpa ta bie na pie aw ei,” tah ta.
Zawsua ta Izarei sawzy hnohta, “He lâ a vy u la, Abeipa nama Khazohpa bie vaw nathlie teh u,” tah ta.

Zawsua ta, “He hmozy liana heta Khazoh hrohpa cha nama hry liata y ta, nama hmiakô tawhta Kâna mo, Hiti mo, Hivi mo, Perizi mo, Kirkâsi mo, Amawri mo nata Zebu mozy a papua tlai aw ei tahpa nama pahno aw.
Moh teh u, khizaw zydua Abeipa Biehrai Byh ta nama hmia lâta Zawdâh a chaka hih.
Chi kha tawhta pakha lymâ ta, Izarei chizy hry tawhta chyhsa pahrawh hleino a tlyh teh u.

Khizaw zydua Abeipa Zehôvâh Byh asytuhpa theihthaipazy pheipazah ta Zawdâh ti a tlypa nahta, machha lâ tawhta Zawdâh chavah ti a zâ lohpazy cha chie pachhôpa ta a toh aw ta, â duah thlâh ha aw,” tah ta.
Chatanachata zawpizy cha Zawdâh chaka awpa ta ama poh ozy tawhta pua ei ta, Biehrai Byh asytuhpa theihthaipazy cha zawpi hmia lâta sie ei ta.
Sâh hria daihti chhôh zydua ta Zawdâh chavah cha a kao zydua bie khai ha tyh ta. Byh asytuhpazy Zawdâh kei tlô ei ta, Byh asytuhpa theihthaipazy phei ta ngiahkâ ti a tlypa nahta,

machha lâ tawhta ti a zâ loh haipa cha a duah ta, lâhlapi taihta, Zarethâ kiapâh ta a ypa Âdâh khihpi taihta â sâh pi ta a opa ta a toh ta, Tilaipi Iahpa, Arabâ Tilaipi lâta a lohpa ti cha chie pachhô ta, zawpizy cha Zerikô khih dady liata Zawdâh haosâ lâ ama pua haw.

Izarei saw zydua ta chavah cha alei hipa liata chaka ei ta, Izarei phopi zydua ta Zawdâh ama chaka khai hlâlei, Abeipa Biehrai Byh asytuhpa theihthaipazy cha Zawdâh chavah liah khophie alei hipa liata a duah thlâh ha ei ta.
A phopi duata Zawdâh ama chaka khai nahta, Abeipa ta Zawsua hnohta,
“Chi kha tawhta pakha lymâ ta zawpi hry tawhta chyhsa pahrawh hleino a tlyh aw chi ta,

ama hnohta, ‘Zawdâh liah khophie liata theihthaipazy phei â i ngaitapa ta â duana suzy tawhta alô miahrawh hleino kei la aw ei chi ta, vaw cheih aw ei chi ta, tazâ namâ rie nawpa su liata nama soh aw’, tahpa ta bie na pie aw ei,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Zawsua ta chi kha tawhta pakha lymâ ta, Izarei sawzy hry tawhta chyhsa pahrawh hleino a raopazy cha aw ta,

ama hnohta, “ Abeipa nama Khazohpa Byh hmia lâta siepa ta, Zawdâh liah khophie lâ vawh u la, Izarei chi kha châta alô miakha lymâ ta reipatipa ta, alô miakha chyu la u la, nama ngiatlâh ta a vaw pia muh vy.
Cha cha nama hry liata ngiana a châ aw. Chhâ vaw y awpazy liata nama sawzy ta, ‘He alôzy he khâpa tahna ma a châ tly?’ tahpa ta ama cha hiahri tita,

ama hnohta, ‘ Abeipa Biehrai Byh hmiakô liata Zawdâh tizy a chie pachhôpa atheithlâhna a châ. Abeipa Biehrai Byh ta Zawdâh a chaka nota, Zawdâh tizy a chie pachhô haw. Chavâta he alôzy he Izarei sawzy ta, cha thâtih cha chhâzaw ta amâ thei thlâh nawpa châta a châ,’ tahpa ta nama chho aw,” tah ta.
Izarei sawzy ta Zawsua biepiepa hawhta tao ei ta. Izarei chi zie ta Zawdâh chavah liah khophie tawhta alô miahrawh hleino la ei ta, ama riehmo lâ cheih ei ta, cha liata soh ei ta.
Alô miahrawh hleino cha, Zawsua ta Biehrai Byh asytuhpa theihthaipazy aduana su, Zawdâh chavah liah khophie liata bô ta, chazy cha tanoh taihta a y thlâh haw.

Mawsi ta Zawsua bie a piepa zydua hawhta, Abeipa ta zawpi tao awpa Zawsua a chhopazy ama tao khai hlâlei, theihthaipazy cha Zawdâh chavah liah khophie liata a duah thlâh ha ei ta. Zawpizy cha a para ngaitapa ta Zawdâh chaka ei ta.
Ama zydua ta haosâ lâ ama kia khai nahta, Abeipa Biehrai Byh nata asytuhpa theihthaipazy cha zawpi hmia lâta sie lymâ ei ta.
Rubena pathlazy, Kâdâ pathlazy nata Manase chi khophiezy chhao, Mawsi ta ama hnohta a reipa hawhta, chariah adyuhna chhaichhi a tobipa ta zawpi hmia lâta sie ei ta, Zawdâh cha chaka ei ta.
A dyuh awpa ta a mâ chiehpa pheisaih 40,000 ta Abeipa hmiakô liata Zawdâh cha chaka ei ta, Zerikô bypi lâ ama pangai.
Cha noh liata, Abeipa ta Izarei zydua mohmô ta Zawsua cha cheihchalo ta. Mawsi ama zapa hawhta, Izarei zawpi ta Zawsua cha a hrochhôh zydua ama za lymâ.
Abeipa ta Zawsua hnohta,
“Biehrai Byh asytuhpa theihthaipazy kha Zawdâh chavah tawhta vaw pua awpa ta biepie teh,” tah ta.
Zawsua ta theihthaipazy cha biepie ta, “Zawdâh chavah tawhta vaw pua teh u,” tah ta.

Chatanachata Abeipa Biehrai Byh asytuhpa theihthaipazy cha Zawdâh chavah liah khophie tawhta vaw pua ei ta, theihthaipazy pheipazah ta alei hipa a tlypa nahta, Zawdâh tizy cha a lo tyhpa hawhta za loh heih ta, a bie tyhpa hawhta a kao zydua a bie khai haw.
Izarei phopi cha cha thla khana, noh hrawhna noh ta Zawdâh tawhta pua ei ta, Zerikô nochhi râhri Kilkal liata riehmo paryh ei ta.
Zawdâh tawhta alô miahrawh hleino phaoh ei ta, chazy cha Zawsua ta Kilkal liata bô ta.
Zawsua ta Izarei sawzy hnohta, “Chhâ vaw y awpazy liata nama sawzy ta ama pawzy hnohta, ‘He alôzy he khâpa tahna ma a châ tly?’ tahpa ta ama hiahri tita,
‘Izarei ta alei hipa liata Zawdâh a chakapa atheithlâhna a châ,’ tahpa ta nama chho aw.
Zehôvâh Khazohpa ta eima chaka khai hlâlei Tilaipi Saihpa pakua ta, Tilaipi Saihpa chô liata a taopa hawhna khata, Zehôvâh Khazohpa ta nama chaka khai hlâlei Zawdâh tizy a cha pakuapa ei.
Chatanachata alei chô liata phopi zydua ta Abeipa ku cha ku thatlôpa a châ tahpa pahno aw ei ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha nama chi lymâ thei aw,” tah ta.

Izarei sawzy Zawdâh ama chaka khai hlâlei Abeipa ta Izarei sawzy hmiakô liata Zawdâh tizy a pakua tahpa thâtih cha, Zawdâh haosâ notla lâta a ypa Amawri bei zydua nata tilaipi kiah liata a ypa Kâna bei zydua ta ama thei nahta, Izarei sawzy vâta ama pathipalôh zao khaipa ta, ama thlah a hua khai ha ta.
Cha daihti liata, Abeipa ta Zawsua hnohta, “Meilô chaizôh tao la, Izarei sawzy kha ama chopaw a einona ta taipa heih teh,” tah ta.
Zawsua ta meilô chaizôhzy tao ta, Izarei sawzy cha Kibia Hârâlôthâ liata ama chopaw taipa ta.
He he Zawsua ta ama chopaw a taina chhâpa a châ: Izi râh tawhta a kaw puapa chariah adyuhpa chapaw zydua kha, Izi râh tawhta ama pua tawhta râhchawhpa lâpi liata thi khai ha ei ta.
Izi râh tawhta a kaw puapa zydua cha chopaw tai chiehpa sai châ ei ta, Izi râh tawhta ama kaw pua tawhta râhchawhpa lâpi liata a pihpazy zydua deikua cha, chopawtai leipazy ama châ.

Izarei sawzy ta Abeipa ao ama nathlie khoh leipa vâta, ama pathlatuhpazy hnohta pie awpa ta Abeipa ta bie â taihpa sâhpiti nata kheihti lona râh pahmôsa lei awpa ta Abeipa ta ama hnohta bie â taih haw. Chatanachata Izi râh tawhta a kaw puapa, chariah a dyuhpa Izarei phopi chapaw zydua ama leidia khai hlâlei, Izarei sawzy cha râhchawhpa liata kô sypalih chhôh ama viavi.
Chavâta Abeipa ta âmo vyuhpa ta a paduapa ama pathlazy cha Zawsua ta ama chopaw a taipa ei. Lâpi liata ama chopaw taipa a châ leipa vâta chopawtaileipa ta ama vaw y thlâh hapa a châ.
A phopi dua ta chopaw taipa ama châ khai tawhta, ama tlâh hlâlei cha ama riehmo chyu liata y chy ei ta.
Abeipa ta Zawsua hnohta, “Tanoh he Izi mo ama cha mohnaona nâmo tawhta ei pahlei haw,” tah ta. Chavâta cha su cha tahmâ taihta Kilkal tahpa a châ.
Izarei sawzy cha Kilkal liata riehmo paryh ei ta, cha thla, noh hrawh hleipalihna noh zâlâ ta Zerikô bypizy liata zawpakhô ama chay.
Zawpakhô mylâ ta, cha râh liata a papuapa viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa nata chhâmeih raopazy nie ei ta.
Râh liata a papuapa ama nie noh a mylâ tawhta cha, mânâ tla khao leipa ta, Izarei sawzy châta mânâ y khao vei. Cha kô tawhta cha Kâna râh chhaohlei thei ama nie pathao haw.

Zawsua cha Zerikô khihpi kiapâh liata a y nota, mohmia pasaih ta, a hmiakô liata chyhsa pakha, zaozi a paih tawhta phia chiehpa a chabapa ta a vaw duah thlâh ha ta. Zawsua ta kei pangai ta, a hnohta, “Keimo chhâh a châpa ma na châ, eima khakhaipazy chhâh a châpa chi maw?” tah ta.

Chyhsa chata, “Châ vei, Abeipa pheisaihzy hyutuhpa ei châ. Tahmâ ei vy haw,” tah ta. Chatawhcha Zawsua cha alei liata â khu lâta pao ta, Abeipa pheisaihzy hyutuhpa cha a chhy ta, a hnohta, “Ei zibeipa ta a chakaotuhpa hnohta khâpa ma rei awpa a hnei tly?” tah ta.
Abeipa pheisaihzy hyutuhpa ta Zawsua hnohta, “Na pheiky kha pahluh teh. Nâ duana su kha su pathaihpa a châ,” tah ta. Cha hawhna chata Zawsua ta a pheiky cha pahluh ta.
Izarei sawzy vâta Zerikô khihpi cha a chhôh lâ chhao khôtho lâ chhao khaw khaipa châ ta, ahy hmah pua leipa ei ta, ahy hmah a ngia hra veih ei.
Abeipa ta Zawsua hnohta, “Moh teh, Zerikô khihpi cha a khih bei nata a chyhsa thatlô riahphapazy chhaota na ku liata ei cha pie haw.
Pheisaih zydua ta khihpi cha ei kha chahlô tua aw ei chi ta, cha hawhna chata noh charu chhôh nama tao aw.
Theihthaipa pasari ta Byh hmia lâta mietaku tôhpa ki chiahmie miasari chaba aw ei ta, noh sarina noh ta khihpi cha ei sari chahlô aw ei chi ta, theihthaipazy ta chiahmie cha ama tô aw.

Mietaku tôhpa ki cha ao pasipa ta tô aw ei ta, chiahmie pyu nama theipa nahta, zawpi zydua ao paro ngaitapa ta awh aw ei chi ta, chatanachata khihpi thokhy cha cho aw ta, zawpizy cha âmo dady chyu liata khihpi chhôh lâ amâ ngia aw,” tah ta.
Nunâ sawchapawpa Zawsua ta theihthaipazy aw ta, ama hnohta, “Biehrai Byh he a sy u la, theihthaipa pasari ta Abeipa Byh hmia lâta mietaku tôhpa ki chiahmie miasari chabapa ta ama sie aw,” tah ta.
Zawsua ta zawpi hnohta, “Sie lymâ u la, khihpi cha chahlô teh u. Chariah chhaichhi a tobipa pheisaihzy cha Abeipa Byh hmia lâta sie mawh ei sy,” tah ta.

Zawsua ta zawpi hnohta bie a rei khai nahta, Abeipa hmiakô liata mietaku tôhpa ki chiahmie miasari a chabapa theihthaipa pasarizy cha, chiahmie tôna chôta sie lymâ ei ta, Abeipa Biehrai Byh ta âmo cha pazi ta.
Chariah chhaichhi a tobipa pheisaihzy cha chiahmie tôtuhpa theihthaipazy hmia lâta sie ei ta, hnôh lâta vaituhpazy ta Byh cha pazi ei ta, theihthaipazy ta chiahmie cha â zaopa ta tô lymâ ei ta.

Zawsua ta zawpi hnohta, “Awh awpa ta ei cha chho hlâlei ei cha, awh leipa u la, nama ao chhao theipa châ leipa sala, nama pakah tawhta bie rai pua khah sy. Awh awpa ta ei cha chho ti ei ta nama awh aw,” tahpa ta biepie ta.
Chatanachata Abeipa Byh cha khihpi ei kha chahlôsa ta, cha khai tawhta riehmo lâ a di ei ta, cha liata a rie ei ta.
Zawsua cha mydi kari ta thyu ta, theihthaipazy ta Abeipa Byh cha a sy ei ta.

Mietaku tôhpa ki chiahmie miasari a chabapa theihthaipa pasarizy cha, Abeipa Byh hmia lâta sie ei ta, â zaopa ta chiahmie tô ei ta. Chariah chhaichhi a tobipa pheisaihzy âmo hmia lâta sie ei ta, hnôh lâta vaituhpazy ta Abeipa Byh pazi ei ta, theihthaipazy ta â zaopa ta chiahmie tô ei ta.
Noh nona liata khihpi cha ei kha chahlô heih ei ta, riehmo lâ kua heih ei ta. Cha hawhna chata noh charu tao ei ta.

Noh sarina noh ta khih a deipa nahta thyu ei ta, ama tao tyhpa hawhta khihpi cha chahlô heih ei ta. Cha noh liata cha ei sari tlai chahlô ei ta, cha noh lia dei ta khihpi cha ei sari ama chahlôpa a châ.
Ei sarina ama chahlô nahta, theihthaipazy ta chiahmie tô ei ta, Zawsua ta zawpi hnohta, “Awh teh u, Abeipa ta khihpi he a cha pie ha ei.

Khihpi he a chhôh liata a ypa zydua chhaota Abeipa lâ hlâ ta, parao khai awpa a châ. Âzuahnô Rahâbi deikua cha, eima tuapa lyuhchâpazy a vaw nyupa vâta, ano nata a o liata a ypa zydua pahlôh awpa a châ.

Pahleipadia awpa hmo kheihawhpa hmah namâ la awpa châ vei. Pahleipadia awpa hmozy namâ la khiahta cha, nâmosasyh ta nama chô liata chhiesana patlôsa aw ei chi ta, Izarei riehmo chhiesapa ta tao aw ei chi ta, nôpopa ta nama soh pathlei aw.
Tâkâ, ngôh, dawh nata thua hmobaohzy deikua cha, Abeipa châta châ khai aw ta, Abeipa sôh o liata so awpa a châ,” tah ta.

Chiahmie pyu a paro nahta, zawpizy cha awh ei ta. Chiahmie pyu ama theipata nahta, zawpizy cha thata awh ei ta, chatanachata thokhy cha cho ta, a phia ta alei liata a pao haw. Chatawhcha zawpizy cha âmo dady chyu ta Khihpi chhôh lâ a ngia ei ta, khihpi cha la ei ta.
Khihpi liata a ypa zydua, chanô chapaw, hawti machâ, viahchao, mietaku nata alâ zy zaozi ta ama thie khai haw.
Râh mohparutuhpa chyhsa pano hnohna khata Zawsua ta, “Âzuahnô o liana hao a kei ngia u la, a hnohta bie namâ taihpa hawhna khata, a chhôhkha zydua chhaota puakhei teh u,” tah ta.
Mohparutuhpa satliazy cha a kei ngia ei ta, Rahâbi cha a nô nata a paw nata a rilâhpazy nata a chhôhkha zydua chhaota puakhei ei ta, Izarei riehmo khôtho liata ama paysa haw.
Khihpi cha a chhôh liata a ypa zydua chhaota mei ta rao ei ta, tâkâ, ngôh, dawh nata thua hmobaohzy deita Abeipa o sôh sona liata soh ei ta.

Âzuahnô Rahâbi nata a paw chhôhkha nata a hneipa zydua deikua cha, Zawsua ta pahlôh khai ta. Rahâbi deikua cha, Zawsua ta Zerikô khihpi mohparu awpa ta a tuapa lyuhchâpazy a vaw nyupa vâta, tanoh taihta Izarei hry liata a pahrâ haw.

Cha daihti liata, Zawsua ta zawpi cha chhie sakhâh ta, “Thyu ta, he Zerikô khihpi a paduapathipa maih cha Abeipa hmiakô liata chhiesapa ta y mawh sy. “A sawchapaw uhtheipa hrona ta Khihpi abôna lô bô sala, A sawchapaw seihnaipa hrona ta A chhikaozy padua mawh sy,” tah ta.
Abeipa cha Zawsua hnohta y ta, râh zydua liata a moh pathâh ha ta.

Châhrasala Izarei sawzy ta pahleipadia awpa hmozy kyh liata hmo parao ei ta. Zudâh chi Zerâ sawchapawpa Zabidi, Zabidi sawchapawpa Kâmi, Kâmi sawchapawpa Âkhâ ta pahleipadia awpa hmo vaw la ha ta. Chavâta Abeipa cha Izarei sawzy chô liata a pathi ia ta.

Zawsua ta Zerikô khihpi tawhta Bethel nochhi lâ Bethave kiapâh liata a ypa Ai khihpi lâ chyhsa tuah ta, ama hnohta, “Khy u la, râh kaw mohparu teh u,” tah ta. Chyhsazy cha khy ei ta, Ai khihpi cha kaw mohparu ei ta.

Zawsua lâ zâ lie ei ta, a hnohta, “Chyhsa zydua khy hlei khah ei sy. Chyhsa sâh no tlyma, sâh thôh tlyma khy ei sala, Ai khihpi cha a kaw dyuh mawh ei sy. Ai khihpi cha maluh chyhta dei châ ei ta, chavâta chyhsa zydua rie pathei awpa byuh vei,” tah ei ta.
Chatanachata zawpi hry tawhta chyhsa sâh thôh rachhôh khy ei ta, châhrasala Ai khihsawzy hmiakô liata amâ râpai haw.
Ai chyhsazy ta Izarei chyhsa sythôh nata pacharu thie ei ta, thokhy chhikao tawhta Sebari taihta a chadai ei ta. Chhutla ama chô nota thie ei ta, zawpizy palôh ti hawhta a zao khai haw.
Zawsua cha a chysiazy hrie ta, ano nata Izarei machâzy cha, Abeipa Byh hmiakô liata zâlâ taih â khu lâta alei liata pao ei ta, ama luh liata buchâh mia ei ta.

Zawsua ta, “Hy Abeipa Zehôvâh, Amawri mo ku liata miah hlâ ta thie awpa ta ma, he phopi he Zawdâh miah na vaw chakakhei? Zawdâh haosâ liata pahrâ awpa ta palôh a vaw patlâh thlâh ha sih la a pha via awpa tlai.
Hy Abeipa, rei theipa khâpa ei hnei khao? Izarei cha a chariahpazy ta ama pahnie ha he zaw!

Cha thâtih cha Kâna mo nata a râh liata a pahrâpa zydua ta thei aw ei ta, miah dôh aw ei ta, alei chô tawhta eima moh ama pahlei ha aw he zaw! Chata a châ khiahta cha, na moh rônahpa pabohsa awpa ta kheihta ma na tao khao aw?” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Zawsua hnohta, “Thyu teh! Khazia nâ khu thlâh haw?
Izarei ta hmo a parao haw. Ama hnohta bie ei piepa, ei biehrai parao ei ta, pahleipadia awpa hmo thokha amâ la haw. Hmo paru ei ta, haipa bie reih ei ta, ama parupazy cha ama hmo hry liata ama nyu.

Chavâta Izarei sawzy cha ama chariahzy hmiakô liata a duah thei khao veih ei. Ama chariahzy hmiakô tawhta a râpai ei ta, âmo chhao pahleipadia awpa ta raopa ama châ. Chavâta pahleipadia awpa hmozy cha nama hry tawhtapa nama pahleipadia leipa khiahta cha, nama hnohta y khao aw va na.

Thyu teh! Zawpi kha pathaisa la, ama hnohta, ‘Mylâ châta a pathai teh u. Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa ta hetana heta a tah: “Hy Izarei, pahleipadia awpa hmozy nama hry liata y ta, chazy cha nama hry tawhta nama pahleipadia hlâlei nama chariahzy hmiakô liata a duah thei aw veih ei chi,”’ tah teh.

My ta a chi chi ta a vaw luah aw ei chi ta, Abeipa ta chi a chakhipa tawhta a pho pho ta a vaw luah aw ei chi ta, Abeipa ta pho a chakhipa tawhta a chhôh chhôh ta a vaw luah aw ei chi ta, Abeipa ta a chakhipa chhôh tawhta pawhrâhpa pakha pakha ta namâ vaw luah aw.

Ahy rai châ sala, pahleipadia awpa hmo a hnohta hmôpa a châ khiahta cha, Abeipa biehrai parao ta, Izarei liata hmo pha lei ngaitapa a taopa vâta, cha chyhsa cha, a chhôhkha nata a hneipa zydua chhaota mei ta rao awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Zawsua cha mydi ta thyu ta, Izarei cha a chi chi ta vaw paluahsa ta, Zudâh chi chakhipa a châ.
Zudâh chi cha a pho pho ta vaw paluahsa ta, Zerâ pho chakhipa a châ. Zerâ pho cha a chhôh chhôh ta vaw paluahsa ta, Zabidi chhôh chakhipa a châ.
Zibidi chhôh pawhrâhpazy cha pakha pakha ta vaw paluahsa ta, Zudâh chi Zerâ sawchapawpa Zabidi, Zabidi sawchapawpa Kâmi, Kâmi sawchapawpa Âkhâ cha chakhipa a châ.
Zawsua ta Âkhâ hnohta, “Ei sawchapawpa, Abeipa Izarei Khazohpa parônahsa la, a hnohta a phuah teh. Khâpa hmo ma na tao tahpa na chho la, na phih khah y,” tah ta.
Âkhâ ta Zawsua cha a chhy ta, a hnohta, “Zehôvah, Izarei Khazohpa chô liata hmo ei vaw parao ha tlai. He he ei hmotaopa cha a châ:

Hraona sôhzy hry liata Sinâ poh pha ngaitapa nata tâkâ sekel za no nata ngôh tlo sekel sypangawh a hripa hmô na ta, ei hia na tlia ngaita ta, ei vaw la haw. Ei poh o chhôh liata alei ry liata nyu na ta, a ry chai liata tâkâ a y,” tah ta.
Zawsua ta lyuhchâpazy tuah ta, poh o lâ cha a râ ei ta, hraona sôhzy cha a poh o liata nyupa châ ta, a ry chai liata tâkâ vaw y thlâh ha ta.
Hraona sôhzy cha poh o chhôh tawhta la ei ta, Zawsua nata Izarei saw zydua lâta vaw cheih ei ta, Abeipa hmiakô liata soh ei ta.

Zawsua nata Izarei saw zydua ta Zerâ sawchapawpa Âkhâ cha tâkâ, poh, ngôh tlo, a sawchapawzy, a sawchanôzy, a viahchaozy, a alâzy, a mietakuzy, a poh o nata a hneipa zydua chhaota a chhipa ta, Akhôrâ Saikao lâ khykhei ei ta.

Zawsua ta, “Khazia nôpopa ta miah na paysa? Nâ chhao tanoh he Abeipa ta nôpopa ta a cha paysa aw,” tah ta. Chatanachata Âkhâ cha Izarei saw zydua ta alô ta vawhsao ei ta. A chhôhkhazy chhao vawhsao ei ta, ama vawhsao khai tawhta mei ta rao ei ta.

A chô liata alô hluhpi pacho thlu ei ta, cha cha tanoh taihta a y thlâh haw. Chatanachata Abeipa cha a pathiiana ru ngaitapa tawhta â palie haw. Chavâta cha su cha tanoh taihta Akhôrâ Saikao tahpa a châ.

Abeipa ta Zawsua hnohta, “Chi leipa la, thlazohpa ta y hra khah y. Adyuhna lâ a sie thei awpa chyhsa zydua na hnohta a chhi la, thyu la, Ai khihpi lâ sie teh. Pachâ teh, Ai khih bei nata a chyhsazy, a khihpi nata a râh na ku liata ei cha pie haw.

Zerikô nata a khih bei chô liata na taopa hawhna khata, Ai khihpi nata a khih bei chô liata chhao na tao aw. Ai khihpi liata deikua cha hraona nata sahrohzy namâ la thei aw. Khihpi cha a hnôh lâ tawhta namâ byh aw,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Zawsua nata pheisaih zydua cha Ai khihpi a dyuh awpa ta pua ei ta. Zawsua ta chyhsa thatlô riahphapa 30,000 a tlyh ta, âmo cha zâ ta pasiesa ta.
Ama hnohta, “Nathlie teh u, khihpi cha a hnôh lâ tawhta namâ byh aw. Khihpi tawhta â hlapi ta y leipa aw ei chi ta, nama zydua ta amâ chiehpa ta nama y awpa a châ.
Kei nata ei hnohta a ypa pheisaih zydua ta khihpi cha a vaw hnia aw pi ta, a hmiatuapa liata ama taopa hawhna khata miah a dyuh awpa ta vaw pua aw ei ta, ama hmiakô liata eimâ vaw râpai aw.

Miah a vaw chadai aw ei ta, khihpi tawhta â hlapi taih eimâ chadaisa aw. Âmo ta, ‘A hmiatuapa hawhna khata eima hmiakô liata amâ râpai ha heih hih,’ ama tah aw. Cha hawhna chata ama hmiakô liata eimâ vaw râpai aw.
Chatawhcha namâ byhna su tawhta vaw pua aw ei chi ta, khihpi cha nama chho aw. Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama ku liata a cha pie aw ei.
Khihpi nama lapa nahta, khihpi cha mei ta nama tô aw. Abeipa bie hawhta nama tao awpa a châ. Pachâ teh u, bie ei cha pie ei hih,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Zawsua ta âmo cha pasiesa ta. Abyhna su lâ cha sie ei ta, Ai khihpi notla lâta Bethel nata Ai likawh liata y ei ta. Zawsua deikua cha, cha zâ cha zawpizy hnohta a rie ta.
Zawsua cha mydi kari ta thyu ta, zawpi awpakhy ta, ano nata lzarei machâzy cha Ai khihpi pangaipa ta zawpi hmia lâta sie ei ta.
A hnohta a ypa pheisaih zydua khy ei ta, khihpi cha a kaw hnia ei ta, Ai khihpi maw lâ chhâh ta riehmo paryh ei ta. Ai khihpi nata ama likawh liata saikao y ta.
Pheisaih 5,000 a chhi ta, khihpi notla lâ chhâh Bethel nata Ai likawh liata pabyhsa ta.
Khihpi maw lâta riehmo supipa liata a ypa pheisaihzy nata notla lâta a byhpa pheisaihzy cha, ama yna su chyu liata a phapa ta a paryh ei ta. Zawsua deikua, cha zâ cha saikao liata a rie ta.

Ai khih bei ta Izarei pheisaihzy cha a hmô nahta, ano nata a khihsawzy cha a parapa ta mydi ta thyu ei ta, Arabâ dady su raopa liata Izarei a dyuh awpa ta pua ei ta. Châhrasala khihpi hnôh lâ tawhta amâ vaw byhpa pahno leipa ta.
Zawsua nata Izarei saw zydua cha panawh hapa hawhta y pakhei ei ta, râhchawhpa lâpi lâta a râ ei ta.
Khihpi liata a ypa zydua Izarei sawzy a chadai awpa ta a awpakhy ei ta. Zawsua cha a chadai ei ta, khihpi tawhta lâhlapi taih a chadai ei ta.
Ai nata Bethel khihpizy liata Izarei sawzy achadaina lâ a pua leipa chapaw pakha hmah y veih ei. Khihpi khaw leipa ta puasaipa ta Izarei sawzy cha a chadai ei ta.
Chatawhcha Abeipa ta Zawsua hnohta, “Asei nâ chabapa kha Ai khihpi lâ dypa ta hy teh. Khihpi cha na ku liata ei cha pie aw,” tah ta. Zawsua ta asei â chabapa cha khihpi lâ dypa ta hy ta.
Abyhtuhpazy ta ama yna tawhta thlai vaw thyu ei ta, Zawsua ta a ku a pazawhpa nahta, a râ ei ta, khihpi liata a ngia ei ta. Khihpi cha la ei ta, mei ta thlai ama rao pâ haw.

Ai chyhsazy cha hnoh lâ a heih ei ta, khihpi cha avâ lâta a khuh â charih haipa hmô ei ta. Râhchawhpa lâta a râpa Izarei sawzy ta âmo a chadaituhpa Ai chyhsazy cha amâ vaw lie hnao hapa vâta, Ai chyhsazy cha khataih lâ hmah a râ nawpa hnei khao veih ei.
Abyhtuhpazy ta khihpi cha la ei ta, khihpi meikhuh â charih haipa cha Zawsua nata Izarei saw zydua ta ama hmô nahta, a lie ei ta, âmo a vaw chadaipa Ai chyhsazy cha thie ei ta.

Khihpi a latuhpa Izarei pheisaihzy chhao, khihpi tawhta vaw pua ei ta, Ai chyhsazy cha a dyuh ei ta. Izarei pheisaihzy ta Ai chyhsazy cha dôh ei ta, thokha he lâ y ei ta, thokha hao lâ y ei ta. Izarei pheisaihzy ta Ai chyhsazy cha thie ei ta, ahrohpa tlyma, arâpa tlyma, pakha hmah y veih ei.
Ai khih bei cha ahrohpa ta patu ei ta, Zawsua lâ a vaw chhi ei ta.

Izarei sawzy ta Ai khihpi chyhsa zydua cha amâ vaw chadaina lyurâhpa nata râhchawhpa suzy liata thie ei ta, ama zydua ta zaozi ta ama thie khai nahta, Izarei saw zydua cha Ai khihpi lâ a lie ei ta, khihpi chhôh liata a ypazy cha zaozi ta thie ei ta.
Cha noh liata a thipa Ai chyhsa zydua cha chanô chapaw ta 12,000 ama châ.
Ai khihpi chyhsa zydua a pahleipadia khai hlâlei, Zawsua ta asei chabapa ta a ku a pazawhpa pathla vei.
Abeipa ta Zawsua hnohta bie a piepa hawhta, khihpi liata sahroh nata hmo a ypazy deita Izarei sawzy ta hraona sôh ta amâ la.
Zawsua ta Ai khihpi cha mei ta rao ta, chhâzaw ta alei byuhpa ta y awpa ta tao ta, tanoh taihta roryhrapa ta a y.

Ai khih bei cha zâlâ taih thokô liata pangieh ta, noh a tla nahta Zawsua ta biepie ta, a ri cha thokô tawhta la ei ta, khihpi angiana thokhy chhikao liata thy ei ta, a chô liata alô hluhpi pacho thlu ei ta, cha cha tanoh taihta a y thlâh haw.
Chatawhcha Zawsua ta Ebâ Tlâh liata Abeipa Izarei Khazohpa châta maisâh tao ta.

Abeipa chakaotuhpa Mawsi ta Izarei sawzy hnohta bie a piepa, Mawsi ryhpa châbu liata ropa hawhta, alô khai leipa, ahy ta hmah thua chaihrai ama hmâ thlu leipa alô ta maisâh cha a tao. Cha liata Abeipa lâta raopa hlânazy hlâ ei ta, aryhna hlâna atheihnazy chhao ama hlâ.
Cha liata, Izarei sawzy mohmô lia tlai ta, Mawsi ro chaneipa ryhpa kha Zawsua ta alôzy liata roh pachhuah ta.

Chatawhcha Izarei zydua, chihropa chhao, a râh chyhsa chhao, ama machâzy nata hyutuhpazy nata ama ryureituhpazy chhaota Abeipa Biehrai Byh asytuhpa Livai chi theihthaipazy hmiakô liata, Byh hiakha lâ nata hiakha lâ liata a duah ei ta. Â khophie Kerizi Tlâh hmia liata a duah ei ta, a khophie Ebâ Tlâh hmia liata a duah ei ta. Cha cha Abeipa chakaotuhpa Mawsi ta Izarei chyhsazy byhnâ awpa awpa ta Zawsua hnohta bie a vaw piepa hawhta taopa a châ.
Cha khai tawhta Zawsua ta ryhpa bie zydua, byhnâ awna nata chhiesana biezy cha, Ryhpa Châbu liata ropa hawhta reih khai ta.
Mawsi biepiepa zydua kha Zawsua ta Izarei zawpi zydua hnohta a rei leipa y vei. Chanôzy nata hawtizy nata ama hry liata chihropa a ypazy hnohta Zawsua ta a rei leipa ryhpa bie miakha hmah y vei.

Zawdâh haosâ tlâh râh nata bypi nata Tilaipi Laipa ngiahkâ zydua liata Lebanaw taihta a ypa bei zydua, Hiti bei, Amawri bei, Kâna bei, Perizi bei, Hivi bei nata Zebu beizy ta Izarei sawzy thâtih ama thei nahta,
â raohpa ta Zawsua nata Izarei a dyuh awpa ta a hmaohpakhy ei ta.
Châhrasala Kibiô khihsawzy ta Zerikô nata Ai khihpizy chô liata Zawsua hmotaopazy ama thei nahta,
piehpiepa ta hmotao ei ta. Sykhao nata kresawhti savo titheih chy karaopa, ahriepa nata baithlapazy ama alâzy paphaosa ei ta, lyuhchâpa hawhta a taopa ta Zawsua a kei tyh ei ta.
Pheiky chypa baithlapazy a ky ei ta, chysia parohpa ta a tobi ei ta, nie awpa ta amâ phaopa viahchhâzy chhao a chawhkaraipa nata a maohpazy a châ.
Chatanachata Kilkal liata riehmo paryhpa liata a ypa Zawsua lâ vawh ei ta, ano nata Izarei chyhsazy hnohta, “Râh hlapi tawhta a vypa châ pi ta, chavâta eima hnohta aryhna bie hraih teh u,” tah ei ta.
Izarei chyhsazy ta Hivi mo hnohta, “Eima hry liata a pahrâ hrapa nama châ thei mâh tâh. Kheihta ma nama hnohta aryhna bie eima hraih thei aw?” tah ei ta.
Âmo ta Zawsua hnohta, “Châ chakaotuhpazy eima châ,” tah ei ta. Zawsua ta ama hnohta, “Ahyzy ma nama châ? Khataih lâ tawhta a vypa ma nama châ?” tah ta.
Âmo ta a hnohta, “Châ chakaotuhpazy he Abeipa na Khazohpa moh vâta râh hlapi tawhta a vypa eima châ. A thâtih vaw thei pi ta, Izi râh liata a hmotaopa zydua nata
Zawdâh haosâ liata Amawri bei pano, Hesbaw bei Sihaw nata Astarô liata a ypa Bâsanâ bei Ôkâ chô liata a hmotaopa zydua eima thei.

Chavâta eima machâzy nata eima râh chyhsa zydua ta eima hnohta, ‘Lâpi liata nie awpazy a phaopa ta, âmo a tyh awpa ta sie aw ei chi ta, ama hnohta, “Châ chakaotuhpazy eima châ. Eima hnohta aryhna bie hraih teh u,” nama tah aw,’ tahpa ta miah ama chho.
Nâmo lâ a vy awpa ta eima o tawhta eima vaw pua nota, eima viahchhâzy he a sah hôlôpa ta a vaw phao pi ta, châhrasala tahmâ cha moh tua u, chawhkarai khai ha ta, a maoh khai ha hih.

Kresawhti savo titheihzy chhao he, eima ryh nota cha a thiehpa châ ei ta, moh tua u, a pyu khai ha hih. Eima chysia nata eima pheikyzy chhao, eima vaw siena â hla kawpa vâta ama chy khai ha hih,” tah ei ta.
Izarei sawzy ta viahchhâ cha nie pachhi ei ta, Abeipa pachâna deikua hiahri tua veih ei.
Chatanachata Zawsua ta âmo nata aryhna tao ta, pahlôh awpa ei ta ama hnohta bie hraih ta, zawpi hyutuhpazy chhao ta ama hnohta bie a taih ei ta.
Kibiô mo hnohta aryhna biehrai a tao tawhta noh thôh a châ nahta, ama chheipâh liata a ypa châ ei ta, ama hry liata a pahrâpa ama châpa pahno ei ta.
Izarei sawzy cha sie lymâ ei ta, noh thôhna noh ta Kibiô mo khihpizy kei tlô ei ta. Ama khihpizy cha Kibiô, Kephirâh, Berô nata Kiriaziari zy a châ.

Izarei zawpi hyutuhpazy ta Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa moh reipa ta ama hnohta bie amâ vaw taih hapa vâta, Izarei sawzy ta Kibiô mo cha thie veih ei. Cha kyh liata zawpi zydua ta hyutuhpazy chô liata paphôh ei ta.
Hyutuhpazy ta zawpi zydua hnohta, “Zehôvah, Izarei Khazohpa moh reipa ta ama hnohta bie a vaw taih ha pi ta, chavâta âmo cha hria hraoh ma pi.
Hetana heta ama chô liata tao sih la, pahlôh thlâh ha suh u. Chataleipatala ama hnohta bie a vaw taih ha tlôh pi ta, eima chô liata Abeipa hiehâhna a vaw tlô pathlei aw na,” tah ei ta.
Hyutuhpazy ta, “Pahlôh thlâh ha suh u. Anodeikua zawpizy châta tho pakhytuhpa nata ti thaihtuhpa ta ama y aw,” tah ei ta. Chatanachata hyutuhpazy reipa hawhta tao ei ta.
Zawsua ta Kibiô mo cha aw ta, ama hnohta, “Khazia eima hry liata a pahrâpa nama châpa tlai ta, ‘Lâhlapi tawhta a vypa na eima châ,’ tahpa ta miah nama dôvei?
Chavâta chhiesapa nama châ haw. Sei châ kôzaw aw ei chi ta, ei Khazohpa o châta tho pakhytuhpa nata ti thaihtuhpa ta nama y lymâ aw,” tah ta.

Âmo ta Zawsua cha a chhy ei ta, “Râh zydua he nâmo cha pie awpa nata râh liata a pahrâpa zydua nama hmiakô tawhta pahleipadia khai awpa ta, Abeipa na Khazohpa ta a chakaotuhpa Mawsi hnohta bie a pie tahpa a sia ngaitapa ta pahno pi ta, nâmo vâta eima hrona pahlei awpa eima chi ngaita. Chavâta kha hawhta eima taopa a châ.
Moh teh, tahmâ na ku liata eima y hih. A phapa nata â dopa ta na pahnopa hawhta eima chô liata tao mah y,” tah ei ta.
Chatanachata Zawsua ta pha a tahnazie hawhta tao ta, âmo cha Izarei sawzy ku tawhta pachha ta, Izarei sawzy ta thie khao veih ei.
Cha noh ta Zawsua ta Kibiô mo cha zawpi châta nata Abeipa ta a maisâh y nawpa ta a raopa su châta tho pakhy awpa nata ti thaih awpa ta rao ta, cha hawhna chata tanoh taihta ama y.

Zerusale bei Adônizede ta Zawsua ta Ai khihpi la ta, parao khai ta, Zerikô nata a khih bei a paraopa hawhta, Ai khihpi nata a khih bei chhao a parao khai hapa thâtih thei ta. Kibiô khihsawzy cha Izarei nata aryhna biehrai tao ei ta, Izarei hry liata ama pahrâ hapa thâtih chhao thei ta.

Chavâta chi ngaita ta. Kibiô cha khihpi lai ngaitapa, bei khihpi hawhpa châ ta. Ai khihpi hlâta lai via ta, a khihsaw chapaw zydua chhao pasaipha sai châ ei ta, chatanachôta Izarei nata aryhna a taopa vâta, Zerusale bei cha a chi ngaitapa a châ.
Chavâta Zerusale bei Adônizede ta Hebraw bei Hôhâ, Zarâmu bei Pirâ, Lakhi bei Zaphia nata Ekalaw bei Debi zy lâ chyhsa tuah ta, ama hnohta,
“A khy u la, na kaw bao teh u, Kibiô a dyuh ei suh u. Zawsua nata Izarei sawzy nata aryhna a tao ha hih,” tah ta.

Chatanachata Amawri bei papangawh, Zerusale bei, Hebraw bei, Zarâmu bei, Lakhi bei nata Ekalaw beizy cha a paraoh ei ta, ama pheisaih zydua chhaota khy ei ta, Kibiô khihpi riaai liata a pahmaoh ei ta, khihpi cha a dyuh ei ta.

Kibiô mo ta Kilkal riehmo liata a ypa Zawsua lâ chyhsa tuah ei ta, a hnohta, “Châ chakaotuhpazy he na bâh pathliah sai khah y. A chatliepa ta keimo lâ a khy la, miah kaw bao la, miah kaw pachha mah y. Tlâh râh liata a pahrâpa Amawri bei zydua a paraoh ei ta miah amâ dyuh hih,” tah ei ta.
Chatanachata Zawsua cha a pheisaih thatlôpa nata riahphapa zydua chhaota Kilkal tawhta khy ta.
Abeipa ta Zawsua hnohta, “Kha chyhsazy kha chi khah y. Âmo cha na ku liata ei cha pie haw. Na hmiakô liata a duah thei awpa ama hry liata pakha hmah y aw veih ei,” tah ta.
Zawsua cha azozâkhihdei ta Kilkal tawhta sie ta, eikhapi ta Amawri mo cha tla thlu ta.
Abeipa ta Izarei sawzy hmiakô liata Amawri mo cha patypamâsa ta, Kibiô liata thata thie ei ta, Behôrô lâ khyna lâpi lâta a chadai ei ta, Azekâ nata Mâkedâ khihpi taihta thie lymâ ei ta.

Izarei sawzy hmiakô tawhta a râpai ei ta, Behôrô chhutla ama chô hai nota, Abeipa ta avâ tawhta pareih laipa za patlasa ta, Azekâ tlôna taihta âmo cha daih lymâ ta, thata thi ei ta. Izarei sawzy ta zaozi ta ama thiepazy hlâ chhao ta pareih ta a daisaopa ama hluh via.

Abeipa ta Izarei sawzy ku liata Amawri mo a pie noh ta, Zawsua ta Abeipa bie a chho ta, Izarei sawzy mohmô liata, “Noh y, Kibiô chô liata a duah la, Thlâpâ y, Aizalô saikao chô liata a duah mah y,” tah ta.

Chatanachata râh ta a chariahpazy chô liata phuh a la khai hlâlei cha, Noh a duah ta, Thlâpâ chhao â chalih haw. He biezy he Zasâh châbu liata ropa a châ. Noh cha avâ liah khophie liata a duah ta, noh kha bohloh tlai tla leipa ta a y.
Cha hawhta Abeipa ta chyhsapa ao a nathliena noh cha, cha hlâta y beih leipa ta, cha khai tawhta chhao y beih khao vei. Abeipa ta Izarei â dyuhkheipa vâta a châ.
Cha khai tawhta Zawsua nata Izarei saw zydua cha Kilkal liata ama riehmo lâ a lie ha ei ta.
Bei papangawhzy cha a râ ei ta, Mâkedâ lôpu liata a nyu ei ta.
Zawsua hnohta, “Bei papangawhzy cha ama hmô haw. Mâkedâ lôpu liata amâ nyu,” tahpa ta chho ei ta.
Zawsua ta ama hnohta, “Lôpu paka cha alô laipazy ta pamai u la, vaituhpazy soh teh u.

Nâmo deikua cha, cha liata y khuh vy. Nama chariahzy a chadai u la, hnôh a chhâhpazy tawhta thie lymâ u la, ama khihpizy pangiasa khuh vy. Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta âmo cha nama ku liata a cha pie ha ei,” tah ta.
Zawsua nata Izarei sawzy ta ama chariahzy cha amâ mua khaina taihta thie ei ta. A laibâhpa chyhtazy deikua cha thokhy hneipa khihpizy lâ a râ ei ta.
Chatanachata zawpi zydua cha Mâkedâ liata a ypa Zawsua lâ thlalôhpa ta a lie ei ta. Izarei sawzy chô liata a reih a pathlie ngâhpa ahy hmah y khao veih ei.
Zawsua ta, “Lôpu paka kha pahy u la, bei papangawhzy kha ei hnohta a vaw chhi teh u,” tah ta.
Cha hawhna chata tao ei ta, bei papangawh, Zerusale bei, Hebraw bei, Zarâmu bei, Lakhi bei nata Ekalaw beizy cha lôpu tawhta Zawsua lâ a vaw chhi ei ta.

Beizy cha Zawsua kô ama vaw tlôkhei nahta, Zawsua ta Izarei chapaw zydua awpakhy ta, a hnohta a sie hrapa pheisaih hyutuhpazy hnohta, “A vaw hnia u la, he beizy rao he vaw tly teh u,” tah ta. A vaw hnia ei ta, beizy rao cha tly ei ta.
Zawsua ta ama hnohta, “Chi leipa u la, riahchhiepa ta y hra leipa u la, thatlôpa nata riahphapa ta y teh u. He hawhna heta Abeipa ta namâ dyuhpa nama chariahpa zydua chô liata a tao lymâ aw,” tah ta.
Cha khai tawhta Zawsua ta bei papangawhzy cha chhawh ta, thie ta, thokô miapangawh liata pangieh ta. Zâlâ taih thokô liata a bangieh ei ta.
Noh a tla nahta, Zawsua ta biepie ta, thokô tawhta la ei ta, amâ nyuna lôpu liata thy ei ta, lôpu paka cha alô laipazy ta pamai ei ta, cha hawhna chata tanoh taihta a y thlâh haw.

Cha noh ta Zawsua ta Mâkedâ khihpi cha la ta. Khihsawzy nata ama khih bei cha zaozi ta thie ta, cha khihpi liata a ypa zydua pamo khai ta, pakha hmah pahlôh vei. Zerikô bei chô liata a taopa hawhta, Mâkedâ bei chô liata chhao tao ta.
Zawsua cha a hnohta a ypa Izarei saw zydua chhaota Mâkedâ tawhta Libnâ khihpi lâ sie ta, khihpi cha a dyuh ta.

Abeipa ta Libnâ cha a khih bei chhaota Izarei ku liata pie ta. Khihpi cha a dyuh ta, a chhôh liata a ypa chyhsa zydua cha zaozi ta thie khai ta, chyhsa pakha hmah khihpi chhôh liata pahlôh vei. Zerikô bei chô liata a taopa hawhta, cha khih bei chô liata chhao tao ta.
Zawsua cha a hnohta a ypa Izarei saw zydua chhaota Libnâ tawhta Lakhi khihpi lâ sie ta. Khihpi cha dôhpa ta, a dyuh ta.
Abeipa ta Lakhi khihpi cha Izarei ku liata pie ta, a noh nona liata la ta. Libnâ chô liata a taopa hawhta, Lakhi khihpi chhôh liata a ypa chyhsa zydua zaozi ta thie khai ta.
Keze bei Hôrâ cha Lakhi khihpi bao awpa ta khy ta. Zawsua ta ano nata a sahlaozy cha pakha hmah pahlôh leipa ta thie khai ta.
Zawsua nata Izarei saw zydua cha Lakhi tawhta Ekalaw khihpi lâ sie ei ta. Khihpi cha dôhpa ta, a dyuh ei ta.
Cha noh ta khihpi cha la ei ta, zaozi ta ama pahleipadia haw. Lakhi chô liata a taopa hawhta, cha noh ta Ekalaw khihpi liata a ypa chyhsa zydua zaozi ta a thie khai ha ei.
Zawsua nata Izarei saw zydua cha Ekalaw tawhta Hebraw khihpi lâ khy ei ta, khihpi cha a dyuh ei ta.

Hebraw khihpi cha la ei ta, khihsawzy nata a khih bei nata a khichapeihzy liata a ypa chyhsa zydua zaozi ta thie ei ta. Ekalaw chô liata a taopa hawhta Hebraw khihpi nata a chhôh liata a ypa chyhsa zydua a pahleipadia khai ha ei. Pakha hmah pahlôh vei.
Cha khai tawhta Zawsua nata Izarei saw zydua cha Debi khihpi lâ a lie ei ta, khihpi cha a dyuh ei ta.

Khihpi nata a khih bei nata a khichapeih zydua la ei ta. Zaozi ta a dyuh ei ta, a chhôh liata a pahrâpa chyhsa zydua ama thie khai haw. Pakha hmah pahlôh vei. Libnâ nata a khih bei chô liata nata Hebraw chô liata a taopa hawhta, Debi nata a khih bei chô liata chhao tao ta.

Cha hawhna chata Zawsua ta râh zydua, tlâh râh, Neke râh, bypi râh nata pâdawhpa râhzy pahnie khaipa ta, ama bei zydua thie khai ta, pakha hmah pahlôh vei. Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa biepiepa hawhta, husona a hneipa maih a pahleipadia khai ha ei.
Zawsua ta Kâdesbânia tawhta Kâza taihta pahnie ta, Kôse râh zydua chhao, Kibiô taihta a pahnie khai ha ei.
Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa ta Izarei cha â dyuhkheipa vâta, cha bei zydua nata ama râhzy cha Zawsua ta ei kha ta a la khai thei ha ei.
Cha khai tawhta Zawsua cha a hnohta a ypa Izarei saw zydua chhaota Kilkal liata riehmo lâ a lie ha ta.
Izarei ta pahniena a topa thâtih cha, Hâzaw bei Zabi ta a thei nahta, Mâdô bei Zôbâ, Simrô bei, Akasâ bei,
maw lâta tlâh râh beizy, Chinerô chho lâta Arabâ beizy, bypi râh beizy, notla lâta Dôrâ beizy,
nochhi nata notla lâta a ypa Kâna mozy, tlâh râh liata a ypa Amawri mo, Perizi mo, Zebu mo nata Mizpâ râh Hâmaw tlâh ry liata a ypa Hivi mozy lâta chyhsa tuah ta.
Cha beizy cha ama pheisaih zydua chhaota chyhsa hluhpi, tilaipi kiah liata sadi zie tlai ta hluhpa ta, arâzy nata talailih hluhpi chhaota pua ei ta.
Beizy cha ama pheisaih zydua pahlyhpa ta Izarei a dyuh awpa ta pua ei ta, Merô tipo liata a riepakhy ei ta.

Abeipa ta Zawsua hnohta, “Âmo kha chi khah y. Mylâ tahmâ ti heta âmo cha thie chiehpa ta Izarei ku liata ei pie aw ei. Ama arâ chazawzy chhawh aw chi ta, ama talailihzy mei ta na rao khai aw,” tah ta.
Zawsua nata a pheisaih zydua ta âmo cha eikhapi ta Merô tipo liata pua thlupa ta, a dyuh ei ta.

Abeipa ta âmo cha Izarei ku liata pie ta, Izarei sawzy ta thie ei ta, Sidaw Rônahpa nata Mirephôthami nata nochhi lâta Mizpâ saikao taihta a chadai ei ta, pakha hmah pahlôh leipa ta ama thie khai haw.
Abeipa ta bie a piepa hawhta, Zawsua ta ama chô liata tao ta, ama arâ chazawzy chhawh ta, ama talailihzy mei ta rao ta.
Cha nona chata Zawsua cha a lie ta, Hâzaw khihpi la ta, a khih bei cha zaozi ta thie ta. Kha hlâta cha Hâzaw cha, a chheipâh khinarâh zydua hry liata khihpi chaipa a châ tyh.
Hâzaw khihpi liata a ypa chyhsa zydua cha zaozi ta thie khai ei ta, tlokhuh ama pahleipadia khai haw. Husona a hneipa pakha hmah pahlôh veih ei. Zawsua ta Hâzaw khihpi cha mei ta a rao haw.
Cha beizy khihpizy nata ama bei zydua cha, Abeipa chakaotuhpa Mawsi biepiepa hawhta, Zawsua ta la khai ta, zaozi ta âmo cha chhawhsao ta, a pamua ha ei.
Zawsua ta mei ta a raopa Hâzaw khihpi tah leipa ta, tlâh byuhpa liata khihpi padua chiehpazy cha, Izarei ta khih kha hmah mei ta rao vei.

Cha khihpizy hraona sôh zydua nata sahrohzy cha, Izarei sawzy ta hraona sôh châta a la ei ta, chyhsapa deikua cha ama pahleipadia khaina taihta zaozi ta thie ei ta, husona a hneipa khâpa hmah pahlôh veih ei.
Abeipa ta a chakaotuhpa Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa hawhta, Mawsi ta Zawsua cha biepie pachhuah ta, cha hawhna chata Zawsua ta a tao lymâ. Abeipa ta Mawsi bie a piepa zydua a tao leipa y vei.
Chatanachata Zawsua ta Kâna râh zydua cha la khai ta. Tlâh râh, Neke râh, Kôse râh zydua, bypi râh, Arabâ râh, Izarei tlâh râh nata ama bypi râhzy,
Seirâ Tlâh a kaw dypa Hâlâ Tlâh nata Hâmaw Tlâh ry Lebanaw saikao liata a ypa Bâlâkadâ taihta la khai ta. Ama bei zydua patu ta, a thie khai ha ei.
Cha beizy cha Zawsua ta bohpi â vaw dyuhpazy ama châ.
Kibiô liata a pahrâpa Hivi mo tah leipa ta cha, Izarei sawzy nata aryhna a taopa khihpi y veih ei. A dyuhpa ta lapa sai a châ.
Abeipa ta Mawsi bie a piepa hawhta, Zawsua ta âmo cha zawngiahna hnei leipa ta, tlokhuh pahleipadia ta a pamua khai nawpa ei ta, Abeipa ta ama palôh kuh pachhasa ta, Izarei a padyuhsapa ei.

Cha daihti liata Zawsua cha sie ta, Anâki mo cha tlâh râh tawhta chhawh pathlah ta. Hebraw tawhta zy, Debi tawhta zy, Anabi tawhta zy, Zudâh tlâh râh zydua tawhta nata Izarei tlâh râh zydua tawhta a chhawh pathlah khai ha ei. Zawsua ta Anâki mo nata ama khihpizy a pahleipadia khai haw.
Izarei sawzy râh liata Anâki mo pakha hmah y khao veih ei. Kâza khih, Kâthâ khih nata Asadô khihzy lia deita ta a chyhta ama y.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta a reipa zydua hawhta, Zawsua ta Kâna râh zydua la khai ta, ama chi apachhaihnazie hawhta ama ryuto râh a pie chyu ei. Chatanachata adyuhna pai ta, râh cha thlalôhpa ta y ha ta.
Hezy he Zawdâh haosâ nochhi lâta Anaw saikao tawhta Hâmaw Tlâh taihta nata Arabâ nochhi lâ râh liata beizy Izarei sawzy ta pahnie ei ta, ama râh ama lapazy ama châ:

Hesbaw liata a pahrâpa Amawri bei Sihaw pahnie ei ta. Amawri bei Sihaw cha Anaw saikao chhâna liata a ypa Arôerâ khihpi tawhta ryu a reihpa châ ta, a râh cha Anaw saikao liah khophie taihta nata Kilia râh khophie nata Amawna mo râhri Zabaw chavah taihta a châ.
Arabâ nochhi lâta a ypa Chinerô tipo tawhta Arabâ tipo, tipo iahpa taihta nata chho lâta Piskâ baikhaihpazy ry taihta Sihaw râhzy a châ hra.
Izarei sawzy ta Bâsanâ bei Ôkâ chhao pahnie ei ta. Bâsanâ mo cha Rephai chi laibâhpazy châ ei ta, Astarô nata Edarei khihpizy liata a pahrâpa ama châ.

Ôkâ cha Hâmaw Tlâh liata zy, Salekâ khihpi liata zy, Kesurimô nata Mâkâ mo râhri taihta Bâsanâ râh zydua chô liata zy ryureih ta, Hesbaw bei Sihaw râhri taihta Kilia râh khophie chô liata chhao ryu a reihpa a châ.
Abeipa chakaotuhpa Mawsi nata Izarei sawzy ta âmo cha pahnie ei ta. Ama râhzy cha Abeipa chakaotuhpa Mawsi ta Rubena chi, Kâdâ chi nata Manase chi khophiezy hnohta ama ryuto châta a pie ei.

Hezy he Zawsua nata Izarei sawzy ta Zawdâh notla lâta ama pahniepa râh beizy ama châ: Lebanaw saikao Bâlâkadâ tawhta Seirâ Tlâh a kaw dypa Hâlâ Tlâh taihta ama pahniepa râhzy cha Zawsua ta Izarei chizy hnohta ama chi apachhaihnazie hawhta ama ryuto châta a pie ei.
Cha râhzy cha tlâh râh, bypi râh, Arabâ râh, tlâh baihkhaihpa, râhchawhpa nata Neke râh liata a ypazy châ ei ta, Hiti mo, Amawri mo, Kâna mo, Perizi mo nata Zebu mo râhzy a châ.
Bei a pahniepazy cha Zerikô bei pakha, Bethel kiapâh ta Ai bei pakha,
Zerusale bei pakha, Hebraw bei pakha,
Zarâmu bei pakha, Lakhi bei pakha,
Ekalaw bei pakha, Keze bei pakha,
Debi bei pakha, Kedâ bei pakha,
Hômâ bei pakha, Aradâ bei pakha,
Libnâ bei pakha, Adulâ bei pakha,
Mâkedâ bei pakha, Bethel bei pakha,
Tâpuah bei pakha, Hepha bei pakha,
Aphe bei pakha, Saraw bei pakha,
Mâdô bei pakha, Hâzaw bei pakha,
Sirômerô bei pakha, Akasâ bei pakha,
Tânâ bei pakha, Mekidô bei pakha,
Kedesâ bei pakha, Kâmel tlâh liata Zôkania bei pakha,
Nâphatadaw liata Daw bei pakha, Kâlili liata Kôimâ bei pakha,
Tizah bei pakha, ama zydua ta bei sythôh nata bei kha ama châ.
Zawsua cha vaw machâ ta, pawpi kaw bâ ta. Abeipa ta a hnohta, “Machâ ha chi ta, pawpi kaw bâ chi ta, râh hra cha la awpa hluh chy tlôh ta.
Hezy he la mâh leipa râhzy a châ: Philistinâ râh zydua nata Kesuri mo râh zydua;

Izi râh kiapâh liata a ypa Sihaw tawhta maw lâta Ekaraw râhri taihta, Ekaraw cha Kâna râh hawhta pachâpa a châ; Philistinâ bei papangawh ryureina Kâza, Asadô, Askelaw, Kiti nata Ekaraw râhzy nata chho lâta Avimi râh;
Kâna râh zydua nata Sidaw râh Merâ tawhta Amawri râhri Aphe khih taih;
Kebâli râh nata nochhi lâta Lebanaw râh zydua Hâmaw Tlâh ry Bâlâkadâ tawhta Hâmathi khih angiana taih;

Lebanaw tawhta Misrephôthamâ taihta tlâh râh liata a pahrâpa zydua nata Sidaw râh zydua cha, la mâh leipa râhzy a châ. Âmo cha Izarei sawzy hmiakô tawhta papua aw ei na ta, bie ei cha piepa hawhta, ama râhzy cha Izarei sawzy ryuto châta na rai aw ei.
Chavâta tahmâ chi chakipazy nata Manase chi khophiezy hnohta he râhzy he ryuto châta rai mah y,” tah ta.
Manase chi khophie nata Rubena chi nata Kâdâ chizy cha Zawdâh nochhi lâta Mawsi ta âmo a piepa ryuto râhzy hnei ei ta. Abeipa chakaotuhpa Mawsi ta he râhzy he âmo a vaw pie ei:
Anaw saikao chhâna liata a ypa Arôerâ khihpi tawhta saikao liah khophie liata khihpi nata Dibô taihta Medebâ tlâhby râh zydua;
Hesbaw liata ryu a reihpa Amawri bei Sihaw khihpi zydua Amawna râhri taihta;
Kilia râh, Kesuri nata Mâkâ râh, Hâmaw Tlâh zydua nata Bâsanâ râh zydua Salekâ khihpi taihta;
Bâsanâ liata Ôkâ khinarâh zydua; ano cha Astarô nata Edarei khihzy liata bei ta a ypa châ ta, Rephai chyhsa a y chhôpa a châ. Cha beizy cha Mawsi ta siehnao ta, a papua ha ei.
Kesuri mo nata Mâkâ mo deikua cha, Izarei sawzy ta papua veih ei. Kesuri mo nata Mâkâ mo cha tanoh taihta Izarei sawzy hry liata ama y.
Livai chi deikua cha Mawsi ta ryuto râh pie vei. Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta a vaw rei hapa hawhta, Livai ryuto awpa cha Abeipa Izarei Khazohpa lâta mei ta hmohlâpazy a châ.
Rubena chi cha a pho pho ta Mawsi ta ryuto râh pie ta.
Ama râhri cha Anaw saikao chhâna liata a ypa Arôerâ khihpi tawhta saikao liah khophie liata khihpi nata Medebâ tlâhby râh zydua;
Hesbaw nata a tlâhby liata khihpi zydua; Dibô, Bamôbâlâ, Bebâlâmeônâ,
Zahâ, Kedemô, Mephâtâ,
Kiriathai, Sibamâ, saikao tlâh liata Zeresahâ,
Bepeôrâ, Piskâ baihkhaihpa, Bezesimô,

tlâhby khihpi zydua nata Hesbaw liata ryu a reihpa Amawri bei Sihaw khinarâh zydua a châ. Bei Sihaw cha, cha râh liata a pahrâpa beithopazy, Midia bei, Evi bei, Reke bei, Zuri bei, Hurâ bei nata Rebâ beizy chhaota Mawsi ta a vaw pahniepa bei kha a châ.
Beô sawchapawpa pachaothaipa Bâlâma chhao Izarei sawzy ta mohropa ama thiepazy hry liata zaozi ta ama thie ha hra.
Chatanachata Zawdâh chavah nata a by zydua cha Rubena pathlazy râh vaw châ ha ta, cha liata khihpizy nata khichapeihzy cha Rubena pathlazy ta a pho pho ta ryu ta ama to.
Mawsi ta Kâdâ chi chhao a pho pho ta ryuto râh pie ta.
Ama râh cha Zaze khihpi nata Kilia râh khihpi zydua, Amawna râh khophie, Râbâ nochhi lâta Arôerâ taih;
Hesbaw tawhta Ramâmize nata Betôni taih, Mâhanai tawhta Debi râh taihta a châ.

Saikao liata Beharâ, Benirâ, Sukô, Zaphônâ nata Hesbaw bei Sihaw râh hropazy chhao Kâdâ pathlazy râh châ ta, Zawdâh chavah cha râhri ta hmâpa ta, Zawdâh haosâ nochhi lâta Chinere Tipo mathi lâ chhâna taihta Kâdâ pathlazy râh a châ.
Chazy cha Kâdâ pathlazy ta a pho pho ta ama topa khihpizy nata ama khichapeihzy a châ.
Mawsi ta Manase chi khophiezy hnohta ryuto râh pie ta. Manase chi khophiezy hnohta a pho pho ta ryuto râh a rai ei.
Ama râh cha Mâhanai tawhta Bâsanâ râh zydua, Bâsanâ bei Ôkâ khinarâh zydua, Bâsanâ râh liata Zairâ kao khihpi zydua chhaota khih sycharu a châ.

Kilia râh khophie nata Bâsanâ bei Ôkâ khinarâh liata Astarô nata Edarei chhao âmo râh ta a ô. Chazy cha Manase sawchapawpa Mâkhi pathla khophiezy hnohta a pho pho ta ama ryuto châta piepa râhzy a châ.
Chazy cha Mawsi ta Zawdâh haosâ Zerikô nochhi lâ Môabâ bypi liata ama y nota ryuto châta a raipa râhzy a châ.
Livai chi deikua cha, Mawsi ta ryuto râh pie vei. Abeipa ta ama hnohta a rei hapa hawhta, Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa cha ama ryuto a châ.

Hezy he Izarei sawzy ta Kâna râh liata ryu ta ama topa râhzy a châ. Theihthaipa Eliaza, Nunâ sawchapawpa Zawsua nata Izarei chizy liata ama pho pawhrâhpazy ta, he râhzy he Izarei sawzy hnohta ama rai.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hmâpa ta bie a piepa hawhta, chi chaki nata khophie to awpa râhzy cha nuby a daopa ta raipa a châ.
Chi no nata khophiezy ryuto awpa râhzy cha Mawsi ta Zawdâh haosâ liata pie ha ta, Livai pathlazy deikua cha ama hry liata ryuto râh pie vei.

Zawsi pathlazy tawhta Manase nata Epharai tahpa ta chi no ta ama pua hapa vâta, Livai pathlazy cha râh to hra leipa ei ta, ama pahrâ nawpa châta khihpizy nata ama sahrohzy lao pabâsa nawpa châta khihpi chheipâh sibiepa râhzy piepa tlao ama châ.
Abeipa ta Mawsi bie a piepa hawhta Izarei sawzy ta tao ei ta, râh cha amâ rai.

Zudâh pathlazy ta Kilkal liata Zawsua lâ a vy ei ta. Keniza chyhsa Zephune sawchapawpa Kâlebâ ta Zawsua hnohta, “ Abeipa ta Kâdesbânia liata Khazohpa chyhsa Mawsi hnohta nâma nata keima kyh liata a reipa kha na pahno.
Abeipa chakaotuhpa Mawsi ta râh mohparu awpa ta Kâdesbânia tawhta eina tua nona kha kô sypalihpa châ na ta, ei palôh liata a ypa hawh tlai ta a hnohta bie ei za tlôkhei.
Ei hnohta a siepa ei unawhzy ta zawpi thlah thata pazo ei ta, kei deikua cha pathipalôh tlokhuh ta Abeipa ei Khazohpa pazi na ta.

Cha noh ta Mawsi ta ei hnohta, ‘Na pathipalôh tlokhuh ta Abeipa ei Khazohpa na pazipa vâta, na phei ta na tlypa râh cha nâ nata na pathlazy ta chhâzaw ryu ta nama to awpa a châ tlai aw,’ tahpa ta bie nâ taih ta.

Chavâta tahmâ pachâ tua, cha bie cha râhchawhpa liata Izarei sawzy ama viavi hai nota Abeipa ta Mawsi a chhopa châ ta, cha daihti tawhta reipa ta, Abeipa ta a bie hawhta kô sypalih nata kô pangawh tlai na pahrosa ta, moh tua, tahmâ cha kô sycharie nata kô pangawhpa ei châ ha hih.
Chatanachôta Mawsi ta eina tua daihti hawhna khata tahmâ chhao ei tha y chy ta, chariah a dyuh awpa nata puaei awpa ta, eikhano ta tha ei hneipa hawhna khata tahmâ chhao ei hnei chy.

Chavâta Abeipa ta na pie awpa ta, kha noh ta a reipa tlâh râh he kei na pie mah y. Cha liata Anâki mo y ei ta, ama khihpizy lai ngaita ta, thokhyzy ta dôh khaipa ama châ tahpa chhao, kha noh ta pahno ha chi ta. Abeipa ta na bao aw ta, Abeipa ta a reipa hawhta, âmo cha ei papua aw ei,” tah ta.
Zawsua ta Kâlebâ cha byhnâ awpa ta, Hebraw cha Zephune sawchapawpa Kâlebâ hnohta a ryuto râh châta pie ta.
Chatanachata Keniza chyhsa Zephune sawchapawpa Kâlebâ cha a pathipalôh tlokhuh ta Abeipa Izarei Khazohpa a pazipa vâta, Hebraw cha tanoh taihta a ryuto râh a châ haw.
Hebraw cha Kiriathâbâ tahpa ta aw tyhpa châ ta, Arabâ cha Anâki mo hry liata chyhsa rônah chaipa a châ. Chatanachata adyuhna pai ta, râh cha thlahlôhpa ta y ha ta.
Zudâh chi ta a pho pho ta ama to awpa piepa râh cha chho lâta Edômâ râhri nata chho chhâna Zini râhchawhpa taihta a châ.
Chho lâta ama râhri cha Tilaipi Iahpa chhâna, chho lâ a heihpa lihchakôpa tawhta a thao ta,
Akarâbi lâ kiana chho lâ pangaipa ta sie lymâ ta, Zini tlô ta, Kâdesbânia chho lâta khy ta, Hezrô kei tlô ta, Adarâ lâ khy ta, Kâkâ lâta pako ta,
Azmaw lâta sie ta, Izi chavah liata pua ta, tilaipi cha râhri chhâna a châ. Cha cha chho lâta nama râhri awpa a châ.
Nochhi lâ râhri cha Tilaipi Iahpa châ ta, Zawdâh tichhi taih a châ. Maw lâ râhri cha Zawdâh tichhi liata tilaipi lihchakôpa tawhta a thao ta,
Behôlâ lâta khy ta, Betharâbâ maw lâta sie lymâ ta, Rubena sawchapawpa Bôhâ Lôpanô taih khy ta.

Râhri cha Akhôrâ Saikao tawhta Debi lâta khy lymâ ta, Kilkal lâ pangaipa ta maw lâta sie ta. Cha cha saikao chho lâta a ypa Adumi mo yna lâ khyna dady liata a ypa a châ. Râhri cha Enâseme tizy chapiapa ta sie lymâ ta, Erôke liata a chhâ.

Cha tawhna chata râhri cha Hinô Sawchapawpa Saikao lâta khy ta, Zebu mo yna chho baikhaihpa taih tlô ta. Zebu he Zerusale a châ. Râhri cha Hinô notla lâta saikao kiapâh ta a ypa tlâh laki lâta khy ta. Cha cha Rephai maw lâta saikao chhâna a châ.
Tlâh laki tawhta râhri cha Nephatô chavah hnawh lâta sie ta, Epharaw tlâh khihpizy liata pua ta, Bâlâh lâta chô ta. Bâlâh cha Kiriazeri a châ.

Râhri cha Bâlâh liata pakopa ta notla lâta Seirâ Tlâh lâta sie ta, Ziari Tlâh maw lâ baikhaihpa chapiapa ta sie lymâ ta. Ziari he Keslaw a châ. Cha tawhna chata Beseme lâta chô ta, Timenâ chapiapa ta sie lymâ ta.
Râhri cha Ekaraw maw lâ baikhaihpa lâta sie ta, Sikarô lâta pako ta, Bâlâh tlâh liata sie lymâ ta, Zabine liata pua ta, tilaipi liata a chhâ.
Notla lâta râhri cha Tilaipi Laipa nata a ngiahkâ zydua a châ. Cha cha Zudâh pathlazy châta a pho pho ta ama to awpa râh a châ.

Abeipa ta bie a piepa hawhta, Zawsua ta Zephune sawchapawpa Kâlebâ cha Zudâh pathlazy hry liata tovyuh pie hra ta, a tovyuh cha Kiriathâbâ a châ. Cha cha Hebraw ama tah hra. Arabâ cha Anâki paw a châ.
Kâlebâ ta Anâki pathla pathôh, Sesai, Ahimâ nata Tâmai zy cha Hebraw khihpi tawhta papua ta.
Cha tawhna chata Debi khih liata a pahrâpazy khyhnao ta. Hlâno ta cha Debi he Kiriasephâ tahpa a châ.
Kâlebâ ta, “Ahy rai Kiriasephâ a dyuh ta a pahniepa cha ei sawchanô Akasâ lapinô ta ei pahneisa aw,” tah ta.
Kâlebâ unawhpa Kenâza sawchapawpa Ôthane ta Kiriasephâ cha pahnie ta, chatanachata Kâlebâ ta a sawchanô Akasâ cha lapinô ta pahneisa ta.
Ôthane lâ a vaw nahta, Akasâ ta a paw liata râh hia awpa ta a vahpa reipasao ta. Akasâ cha alâ tawhta chô ta, Kâlebâ ta a hnohta, “Khâpa na khoh?” tah ta.

Akasâ ta, “Byhnâ na awpa mah y. Neke râh eina pie ha hnohkua chi cha, tihnawhzy chhao eina pie pâ hra awpa chi ta ei châ haw,” tah ta. Chatanachata Kâlebâ ta Akasâ cha machhua lâta tihnawh nata mathi lâta tihnawhzy pie ta.
Hezy he Zudâh chi ta a pho pho ta ama to awpa ryuto râh a châ:
Edômâ râhri daih chho chhâna lâta Zudâh chi khihpizy cha Kâbazelâ, Ederâ, Zaku,
Kinâ, Dimônâ, Adadâ,
Kedesâ, Hâzaw, Ithanâ,
Ziphi, Tele, Belô,
Hâzawhâdatâ, Keriôhezraw, cha cha Hâzaw ama tah hra,
Amâ, Semâ, Môladâ,
Hâzakâdâ, Hesmaw, Bepele,
Hâzasualâ, Bâsebâ, Biziôthia,
Bâlâh, Imâ, Eza,
Eltôlâ, Khesi, Hômâ,
Zikalâ, Mâmanâh, Sâsanâ,
Lebao, Sili, Aina nata Rimaw khihpizy a châ. Khihpi zydua cha khih kih nata khih chaki châ ta, khichapeihzy ama hnei.
Notla bypi râh liata Zudâh khihpizy cha hezy he a châ: Estô, Zôrâh, Âsanâ,
Zanô, Enkâni, Tâpuah, Enâ,
Zarâmu, Adulâ, Sôkô, Azekâ,
Saraimi, Adithai, Kederâ nata Kederôthai, khihpi mia hrawh hleipalih nata ama khichapeihzy;
Zenâ, Hadâsâ, Midakâ,
Dilia, Mizpeh, Zôthelâ,
Lakhi, Bôzakâ, Ekalaw,
Kabônâ, Lâmâ, Kili,
Kederaw, Bedakô, Nâmâh, Mâkedâ, khihpi mia hrawh hleicharu nata ama khichapeihzy;
Libnâ, Ethâ, Âsâ,
Iphatâ, Âsanâ, Nezi,
Keilâh, Akazi nata Mâresâ, khihpi mia chaki nata ama khichapeihzy;
Ekaraw nata a khihpizy nata a khichapeihzy;
Ekaraw tawhta tilaipi taihta Asadô kiapâh ta a ypa khihpi zydua nata ama khichapeihzy;

Asadô nata a khihpizy nata ama khichapeihzy; Kâza nata a khihpizy nata ama khichapeihzy; Izi chavah taihta nata Tilaipi Laipa nata a ngiahkâzy liata a ypa khihpizy cha notla bypi lâta Zudâh khihpizy a châ khai.
Tlâh râh liata Zudâh khihpizy cha hezy he a châ: Sâmi, Zatia, Sôkô,
Dânâ, Kiriasânâ, cha cha Debi tahpa a châ hra,
Anabâ, Estemô, Animâ,
Kôse, Hôlô nata Kilô, khihpi mia hrawh hleikha nata ama khichapeihzy;
Arabâ, Dumâ, Esâ,
Zani, Betapua, Aphekâ,
Humtâ, Hebraw ama tah hrapa Kiriathâbâ nata Ziôrâ, khihpi mia chaki nata ama khichapeihzy;
Maônâ, Kâme, Ziphi, Zutâ,
Zezari, Zôdia, Zanô,
Kainâ, Kibia nata Timnah, khihpi miahrawh nata ama khichapeihzy;
Hâlahu, Bezu, Kedaw,
Mârathâ, Bethanô nata Eltekô, khihpi miacharu nata ama khichapeihzy nata
Kiriaziari ama tah hrapa Kiriabâlâ nata Râbâ, khihpi miano nata ama khichapeihzy cha, Tlâh râh liata Zudâh khihpizy ama châ.
Râhchawhpa râh liata Zudâh khihpizy cha hezy he ama châ: Bethârabâ, Midi, Sekâkâ,
Nibâsâ, Alôh Khihpi nata Enkedi khihpi zy châ ei ta, khihpi miacharu y ta, khichapeihzy ama hnei.
Zerusale liata a pahrâpa Zebu mo deikua cha, Zudâh pathlazy ta papua thei veih ei. Chavâta Zebu mo cha tanoh taihta Zerusale liata Zudâh pathlazy nata hmaohkha ta ama pahrâ.
Zawsi pathlazy tovyuh cha Zerikô tizy nochhi lâta a ypa Zerikô dady Zawdâh chavah tawhta a thao ta, Zerikô tawhta râhchawhpa lâta sie lymâ ta, Bethel tlâh râh lâta khy ta,
Luzi ama tahpa Bethel tawhta Arakhi râh Atarô chapiapa ta sie lymâ ta,
notla lâta Zaphâle râhri lâta chô ta, Behôrô mathi taihta sie ta, Keze lâ chô ta, tilaipi liata a chhâ.
Chazy cha Zawsi pathla Manase nata Epharai chizy ryuto râh a châ.
Hezy he Epharai pathlazy ta a pho pho ta ama to awpa ryuto râh a châ: Nochhi lâta ama râhri cha Atarôthadâ tawhta Behôrô machhua lâ taihta châ ta,
cha tawhna chata râhri cha tilaipi lâta sie ta, maw lâta Mikamethâ y ta, nochhi lâ pakopa ta Tanâsilô lâta sie ta, Zanô nochhi lâta sie lymâ ta,
Zanô tawhta Atarô nata Nârâ lâta chô ta, Zerikô tlô ta, Zawdâh liata a kaw pua.
Râhri cha Tâpuah tawhta notla lâta Kânâ chavah taihta sie lymâ ta, tilaipi liata a chhâ. Chazy cha Epharai chi ta a pho pho ta ama topa ryuto râh a châ.
Chazy thota, Manase pathlazy ryuto râhzy hry tawhta Epharai pathlazy châta raopa khihpi nata ama khichapeih zydua â hlao.
Keze liata a pahrâpa Kâna mo deikua cha, papua veih ei. Chavâta Kâna mo cha tanoh taihta Epharai mo hry liata pahrâ ei ta, rai hriatuhpazy ta taopa ama châ.

Manase cha Zawsi sawchapaw uhtheipa a châpa vâta, hetana heta a tovyuh taopa a châ. Manase sawchapaw uhtheipa cha Mâkhi châ ta, Mâkhi cha Kilia paw a châ. Mâkhi cha pheisaih riahphapa a châpa vâta, Kilia nata Bâsanâ râh cha ano piepa a châ.

Manase pathla hropazy, Abieze pathlazy, Helekâ pathlazy, Asrie pathlazy, Sekhe pathlazy, Hepha pathlazy nata Semidâ pathlazy chhao a pho pho ta ryuto râh piepa ama châ hra. Âmo cha Zawsi sawchapawpa Manase pathla chapawzy a pho pho ta a laichadaipa ama châ.

Manase pathla Zelôphehâ deikua cha sawchapaw hnei leipa ta, sawchanô sai hnei ta, a sawchanôzy moh cha Mâhlâ, Noâh, Hôkalâ, Milkâ nata Tizah zy ama châ. Zelôphehâ paw cha Hepha châ ta, Hepha paw cha Kilia châ ta, Kilia paw cha Mâkhi châ ta, Mâkhi paw cha Manase a châ.

Zelôphehâ sawchanôzy ta theihthaipa Eliaza nata Nunâ sawchapawpa Zawsua nata chhituhpazy lâ vawh ei ta, ama hnohta, “Eima rilâhpazy hry liata ryuto râh miah pie hra awpa ta Abeipa ta Mawsi kha bie a pie,” tah ei ta. Chatanachata Abeipa pakah bie hawhta, Zawsua ta âmo cha ama paw unawhzy hry liata ryuto râh a pie hra ei.
Chatanachata Zawdâh haosâ nochhi lâta Kilia nata Bâsanâ râhzy hleikhô ta, Manase cha ryuto râh su hrawh tlai to ta.
A chhâpa cha Manase sawchanôzy ta a sawchapawzy hry liata ryuto râh ama hnei hrapa vâta a châ. Kilia râh cha Manase sawchapaw hropazy piepa a châ.
Manase râhri cha Asera tawhta a thao ta, Sekhe nochhi lâta a ypa Miamethâ lâta sie ta, cha tawhna chata râhri cha chachâh lâta sie lymâ ta, Entapua mo yna taihta sie ta.
Tâpuah râh cha Manase eih châ ta, Manase râhri daih lâta Tâpuah khih deikua cha Epharai pathlazy eih a châ.
Râhri cha chho lâta chô ta, Kânâ vahtiepa tlô ta. Manase khihzy hry liata Epharai khih thokha y hra ta, Manase râhri deikua cha, vahtiepa maw lâta sie ta, tilaipi liata a chhâ.
Chho lâ Epharai râh châ ta, maw lâ Manase râh a châ. Manase râh cha tilaipi taih tlô ta, maw lâta Asera râh nata a ri ta, nochhi lâta Iskâra râh nata â ri.

Iskâra nata Asera râhzy liata chhao Manase ta khihpizy hnei ta, Besia nata a khichapeihzy, Ibalia nata a khichapeihzy, Dôrâ khihsawzy nata a khichapeihzy, Enadô khihsawzy nata a khichapeihzy, Tânâ khihsawzy nata a khichapeihzy nata Mekidô khihsawzy nata a khichapeihzy cha Manase khihpizy châ ei ta, bia thôh a ô.
Châhrasala Kâna mo ta cha râh liata pahrâ khâchâ amâ chhuah hapa vâta, cha khihpizy cha Manase pathlazy ta hnei thei veih ei.
Izarei sawzy ama tha a vaw tlô via nahta, Kâna mo cha raihriatuhpa ta tao ei ta, ama zydua ta papua khai khao veih ei.
