Zawsi pathlazy ta Zawsua hnohta, “ Abeipa ta byhnâ miah pie lymâ ta, tahmâ cha chipho lai ngaitapa vaw châ ha pi ta, kheihtazie ta tovyuh miakha deita miah patosa chi ta, ryuto râh su kha deita miah na pie thlâh haw,” tah ei ta.

Zawsua ta ama hnohta, “Cha hawhta maluh hluh ngaitapa chipho châ u la, Epharai tlâh râh cha nama châta a buah tu khiahta cha, nâmo tlai ta Perizi mo nata Rephai mo râh lâ khy u la, ama râhmâhpazy khi nama y nawpa ta kaw pathai muh vy,” tah ta.

Zawsi pathlazy ta, “Tlâh râh deita cha eima châta a daih aw vei. Châhrasala bypi râh liata a pahrâpa Kâna mo, Besia nata a khichapeihzy nata Zezari saikao liata a ypa zydua ta thua talailih hnei khai tlôh ei ta,” tah ei ta.
Zawsua ta Zawsi chi Epharai nata Manase pathlazy hnohta, “Chi laipa châ ei chi ta, nama tha chhao tlô ngaita ta, chavâta tovyuh miakha dei hnei aw veih ei chi.
Tlâh râh khi nâmo eih a châ aw. Râhmâhpa châ hra sala, pathai aw ei chi ta, a râh zydua nama eih a châ aw. Kâna mo cha thua talailihzy hneipa ta ama thatlô kaw hra sala nama papua thei aw,” tah ta.
Izarei zawpi zydua Silô khihpi liata a pahmaoh ei ta, cha liata achhyna poh o parai ei ta. Râh cha ama biehneina ry liata y ha ta.
Châhrasala Izarei sawzy hry liata ama ryuto râh rai mâh leipa chi sari y chy ei ta.
Zawsua ta Izarei sawzy hnohta, “Zehôvah, châ pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa ta râh a cha piepa lâ a ngiapa ta, râh cha hnei awpa ta khati taih ma lôhkhô namâ hli chy aw tly?
Chi to tawhta chyhsa pathôh chyu a tlyh u la, âmo cha tuah aw na ta, âmo cha sie aw ei ta, râh cha kei chahryh aw ei ta, ama ryuto râh chyu awpa cha roh aw ei ta, kei lâ amâ vaw lie heih aw.
Râh cha su sari ta ama pachhaih aw. Zudâh cha chho lâta a râh liata y aw ta, Zawsi chi cha Maw lâta ama râh liata ama y aw.
Râh cha su sari ta pachhaih aw ei chi ta, nama pachhaihzie cha he su liata kei lâ vaw tlôkhei aw ei chi ta, chatanachata he liata Abeipa eima Khazohpa hmiakô liata nuby ei châ daopa aw ei.

Livai chi deikua cha, Abeipa theihthaina raihria cha ama ryuto a châpa vâta, nama hry liata tovyuh hnei aw veih ei. Kâdâ, Rubena nata Manase chi khophie chhao Zawdâh haosâ nochhi lâ liata Abeipa chakaotuhpa Mawsi ta ama ryuto râh a vaw piepa kha ama to hra,” tah ta.

Chyhsazy cha thyu ei ta, sie ha ei ta. Râh thâtih ro awpa ta a siepazy hnohta Zawsua ta, “Râh cha va chahryh u la, a thâtih roh khai u la, kei lâta vaw tlôkhei heih muh vy. He Silô khih liana heta Abeipa hmiakô liata nuby ei châ daopa aw ei,” tahpa ta biepie ta.

Chyhsazy cha sie ei ta, râh cha chahryh ei ta. Râh cha su sari ta pachhaih ei ta, su to chhôh liata khih zydua cha châbu liata roh khai ei ta. Cha khai tawhta Zawsua yna Silô khihpi liata riehmo lâ a vaw lie ei ta.
Zawsua ta Silô khihpi liana chata Abeipa hmiakô liata âmo châta nuby a dao ta. Cha liata Zawsua ta Izarei sawzy cha ama chi apachhaihna yzie hawhta râh cha rai ta.
Benzami chi ta a pho pho ta ama to awpa râh cha nuby a daopa châ ta, Zudâh pathla nata Zawsi pathlazy likawh râh cha âmo ryuto râh châta raopa a châ.
Maw lâta ama râhri cha Zawdâh tawhta a thao ta, Zerikô baikhaihpa siepahliepa ta maw lâta khy ta, notla tlâh râh chapiapa ta khy lymâ ta, Beve râhchawhpa liata a chhâ.

Cha tawhna chata râhri cha Luzi baikhaihpa chapiapa ta chho lâta a sie. Luzi cha Bethel tahpa a châ hra. Cha tawhna chata Atarôthadâ lâta chô ta. Atarôthadâ cha Mathi Behôrô chho lâta tlâh liata a ypa a châ.

Behôrô chho lâta tlâh tawhna chata râhri cha notla baih lâ tawhta chho lâta pako ta, Zudâh pathlazy khihpi Kiriabâlâ liata a kaw pua. Kiriabâlâ he Kiriaziari tahpa a châ hra. Cha cha notla lâta a ypa râh a châ.
Chho lâta râhri cha Kiriaziari chhâna tawhta a thao ta, notla lâta sie lymâ ta, Nephatô chavah hnawh liata a pua.

Cha tawhna chata râhri cha Hinô Sawchapawpa Saikao dady ta a ypa tlâh thaby lâta chô ta. Cha tlâh cha Rephai Saikao maw lâta a ypa a châ. Râhri cha Zebu mo khihpi chho baikhaihpa chapiapa ta Hinô Saikao lâta chô ta, Erôke liata a pua.
Cha tawhna chata maw lâta pako ta, Enâseme lâta sie ta, Adumi lâ khyna dady ta a ypa Kelilô lâta sie ta, Rubena sawchapawpa Bôhâ Lôpanô lâta chô ta,
Arabâ maw lâta baikhaihpa chapiapa ta Arabâ lâta chô ta,
cha tawhna chata râhri cha Behôkalâ maw lâta baikhaihpa chapiapa ta sie lymâ ta, chho lâta Zawdâh chavah za chhâna Tilaipi Iahpa maw lâta lihchakô liata a pua. Cha cha chho lâta râhri a châ.
Nochhi lâta râhri cha Zawdâh chavah a châ. Cha cha Benzami pathlazy ta a pho pho ta ama to awpa ryuto râh ta a ôna chhôh a châ.
Hezy he Benzami chi ta a pho pho ta ama to awpa khihpizy a châ: Zerikô, Behôkalâ, Emekezezi,
Betharâbâ, Zemarai, Bethel,
Avimi, Pârâ, Ôpharâ,
Kepharâmôni, Ôphani nata Kebâ khihpizy châ ei ta, khihpi miahrawh hleino y ta, khichapeihzy ama hnei.
Kibiô, Ramâ, Berô,
Mizpeh, Kephirâh, Môzâ,
Reke, Ipelâ, Târalâ,

Zelâ, Helepha, Zebu khihpizy chhao amâ hlao. Zebu cha Zerusale a châ. Kiria­ziari nata Kibi khihpizy chhao a hlao ei ta, khihpi miahrawh hleipalih y ta, khichapeihzy ama hnei. Chazy cha Benzami pathlazy ta a pho pho ta ama to awpa ryuto râh a châ.
Nuby a daopa mianona cha, Simeôna chi ta a pho pho ta ama to awpa ta Simeôna chô liata tlu ta, ama to awpa râh cha Zudâh pathlazy ryuto râh chhôh liata a y.
Khihpi ama topazy cha Bâsebâ, Sebâ, Môladâ,
Hâzasualâ, Balâ, Ezemâ,
Eltôlâ, Bethulâ, Hômâ,
Zikalâ, Bemâkabô, Hâzasusâ,
Bethlebô nata Saruhe khihpizy châ ei ta, khihpi miahrawh hleithôh y ta, khichapeihzy ama hnei.
Khihpi hropa miapalih, Ainâ, Rimaw, Etherâ nata Asanâ khihpizy nata ama khichapeihzy â hlao hra.
Cha khihpizy chheipâh liata ama khichapeih zydua, Bâlâbe nata Râmâ chho lâ taihta amâ hlao. Chazy cha Simeôna chi ta a pho pho ta ama topa ryuto râhzy a châ.

Simeôna pathlazy ryuto râh cha Zudâh pathlazy tovyuh tawhta lapa a châ. Zudâh pathlazy tovyuh cha ama châta a kawh tu hapa vâta, Simeôna pathlazy cha Zudâh pathlazy ryuto râh tawhta pachhaihpa ama châ.
Nuby a daopa miathôhna cha Zebulawna pathlazy ta a pho pho ta ama to awpa ta Zebulawna chô liata tlu ta. Ama ryuto râh cha Sâridâ taih a tlô.
Ama râhri cha notla lâta sie ta, Maria lâ khy ta, Dâbese kaw hria ta, Zôkania kiapâh liata vahtiepa taih tlô ta.
Sâridâ tawhta nochhi lâta noh chhina dady ta sie lymâ ta, Kilôbaw râhri taih tlô ta, Dâberâ lâta pua ta, Zaphia lâta khy ta.
Cha tawhna chata nochhi lâta Kahepha nata Ekazi lâta sie lymâ ta, Rimaw liata pua ta, Niah lâ pako ta.
Cha tawhna chata râhri cha maw lâta pako heih ta, Hânathô lâta sie ta, Iphatâhe saikao liata a kaw pua.
Zebulawna khihpizy cha Kâtâ, Nâhalâ, Simrô, Idâlâ nata Bethlehe zy châ ei ta, khihpi miahrawh hleino y ta, khichapeihzy ama hnei.
Cha khihpizy nata ama khichapeihzy he Zebulawna pathlazy ta a pho pho ta ama topa ryuto râh a châ.
Nuby a daopa miapalihna cha Iskâra pathlazy ta a pho pho ta ama to awpa ta Iskâra chô liata tlu ta.
Ama râh khihpizy cha Zezari, Kesulô, Sune,
Hâphari, Siônâ, Anâharâ,
Râbi, Kisiônâ, Ebeza,
Reme, Enkâni, Enhâdâ nata Bepâze ama châ.
Râhri cha Tabaw, Sâzumâ nata Beseme khihpizy taih tlô ta, Zawdâh chavah liata a chhâ. Khihpi miahrawh hleicharu y ta, khichapeihzy ama hnei.
Cha khihpizy nata ama khichapeihzy cha Iskâra pathlazy ta a pho pho ta ama topa ryuto râh a châ.
Nuby a daopa miapangawhna cha Asera pathlazy ta a pho a pho ta ama to awpa ta Asera chô liata tlu ta.
Ama râh khihpizy cha Helkâthâ, Hâli, Bete, Âkasâ,
Alâmele, Amadi nata Misâ zy a châ. Notla lâta Kâmel nata Sihôlinâ taih tlô ta,
cha tawhna chata noh chhina lâta pako ta, Bedekô lâ khy ta, cha tawhna chata Zebulawna nata Iphatâhe saikao maw lâta Betheme nata Nelâ taih tlô ta, chavei lâta Kabu liata a chhâ.
Cha tawhna chata Hebraw, Rehô, Hâmô nata Kânâ zy lâta sie lymâpa ta, Sidaw Laipa taih tlô ta.
Cha tawhna chata râhri cha Râmâ lâta pako ta, thokhy hneipa Tyre khihpi lâta sie ta, cha tawhna chata Hôsâ lâta pako ta, Akazi râh tilaipi liata a chhâ.
Umâ, Aphe nata Rehô khihpizy chhao Asera râh liata a hlao ta, khihpi mia kih nata miano y ta, khichapeihzy ama hnei.
Cha khihpizy nata khichapeihzy cha Asera pathlazy ta a pho pho ta ama topa ryuto râh a châ.
Nuby a daopa miacharuna cha Nâthalai pathlazy ta a pho a pho ta ama to awpa ta Nâthalai chô liata tlu ta.
Ama râhri cha Helepha nata Zanâni thokô laipa tawhta a thao ta, Adamineke nata Zabane zy chahryh laih ta, Zawdâh chavah liata a chhâ.

Cha tawhna chata râhri cha notla lâ pakopa ta Aznôtabaw lâ sie ta, cha tawhna chata Hôkô lâta sie ta, chho lâta Zebulawna râh kei tlô ta, notla lâta Asera râh kei tlô ta, nochhi lâta Zudâh râh liata Zawdâh chavah liata a chhâ.
Khihpi thokhy a hneipazy cha Zidi, Zerâ, Hâmâ, Rakâ, Chinere,
Adamâ, Râmâ, Hâzaw,
Kedesâ, Edarei, Enhâzaw,
Iraw, Mikadâle, Hôre, Bethanâ nata Beseme zy châ ei ta, khihpi miahrawh hleichaki y ta, khichapeihzy ama hnei.
Cha khihpizy nata ama khichapeihzy cha Nâthalai pathlazy ta a pho pho ta ama topa ryuto râh a châ.
Nuby a daopa miasarina cha Dânâ pathlazy ta a pho pho ta ama to awpa ta Dânâ chô liata tlu ta.
Ama ryuto râh cha Zôrâ, Estaw, Iseme,
Sâbi, Aizalô, Zethalâ,
Elaw, Timnâ, Ekaraw,
Elteke, Kibethaw, Bâlathâ,
Zehudi, Beneberâ, Kâthârimô,
Mezakô nata Rakaw khihpizy nata Zôpâ daih lâta râhzy a châ.

Dânâ pathlazy cha ama râh awpa zydua ama la khai thei leipa vâta, Lese a kaw dyuh ei ta, la ei ta, zaozi ta pahleipadia ei ta, râh cha ama hnei haw. Cha liata pahrâ ei ta, ama pathlatuhpa Dânâ moh paphaopa ta Lese cha Dânâ tahpa ta a moh ama bi.
Cha khihpizy nata khichapeihzy cha Dânâ pathlazy ta a pho pho ta ama topa ryuto râh a châ.
Râh cha ryu ta to awpa ta ama tovyuh chyu raipa a châ khai tawhta, Izarei sawzy ta Nunâ sawchapawpa Zawsua cha ama hry liata ryuto râh pie hra ei ta.
Ano ta â hawpa Epharai tlâh râh liata Timnâserâ khihpi cha, Abeipa biepiepa hawhta Zawsua pie ei ta. Khihpi cha paduapathi ta, cha liata a pahrâ.

Chazy cha theihthaipa Eliaza, Nunâ sawchapawpa Zawsua nata Izarei chizy liata pho pawhrâhpazy ta Silô khihpi liata ahmaohna poh o chhikao liata Abeipa hmiakô ta nuby a daopa ta ryuto râh ama raipazy a châ. Cha hawhna chata râh araina cha ama patlô haw.
Chatawhcha Abeipa ta Zawsua hnohta,
“Mawsi hmâpa ta nama hnohta ei rei hapa hawhna khata, abohna khihpizy rao awpa ta Izarei sawzy chho teh.
Chatanachata achhuahna y leipa ta chyhsa a thie pathleipazy tlyma, pahno leipa ta a thie pathleipazy tlyma, abohna khihpizy lâ cha a râ aw ei ta, thisaih phuh latuhpa tawhta namâ bohna su a châ aw.

Chyhsa a thie pathleipa cha abohna khihpizy hry liata miakha lilaw lâ a râ aw ta, khihpi hawka chhikao liata a kei duah aw ta, khihpi machâzy theina liata a thâtih a reih aw. Machâzy ta ama hnohta khih chhôh lâ a chhi aw ei ta, a y nawpa su pie aw ei ta, ama hnohta a pahrâ aw.
Thisaih phuh latuhpa ta â vaw chadai khiahta cha, cha hlâta ahaona hnei leipa ta a vaih a thie pathleipa a châpa vâta, chyhsa thietuhpa cha a ku liata ama hlâ awpa châ vei.

A thâtih pachia awpa ta, zawpi hmiakô liata â duah hlâta nata cha daihti liata theihthaipa beichaipa a thi hlâlei abohna khihpi liata a y aw. Cha khai tawhta chyhsa thietuhpa cha â râsaipa khihpi, ano khih lâ a lie heih aw ta, ano o lia tlai â ngia heih aw,” tah ta.

Chatanachata Nâthalai tlâh râh Kâlili liata Kedesâ khihpi, Epharai tlâh râh liata Sekhe khihpi nata Zudâh tlâh râh liata Kiriathâbâ khihpizy cha abohna khihpizy châta rao ei ta. Kiriathâbâ cha Hebraw tahpa a châ hra.

Zawdâh haosâ Zerikô nochhi lâta Rubena chi pahrâna râhchawhpa tlâhby liata a ypa Beze khihpi, Kâdâ chi Kilia râh liata Ramô khihpi nata Manase chi Bâsanâ râh liata Kôlâ khihpizy chhao abohna khihpizy châta ama rao hra.

Cha khihpizy cha Izarei sawzy nata ama hry liata chihropa a ypazy châta abohna khihpizy ta raopa châ ta, ahy rai chyhsa a thie pathleipa cha, zawpi hmiakô liata â dua hlâta thisaih phuh latuhpa ku liata a thi lei nawpa ta, cha khihpi lâ cha â râ awpa a châ.
Livai chi chhôhkha pawhrâhpazy cha theihthaipa Eliaza nata Nunâ sawchapawpa Zawsua nata Izarei chizy liata ama pho pawhrâhpazy lâ vawh ei ta,
Kâna râh Silô khihpi liata ama hnohta, “Eima pahrâ nawpa khihpizy nata eima sahroh tlaih nawpa ta a chaby râhzy miah pie awpa ta, Abeipa ta Mawsi hmâpa ta bie a vaw pie hapa kha châ ta,” tah ei ta.
Chatanachata Abeipa biepiepa hawhta, Izarei sawzy ta ama ryuto râh tawhta, he khihpizy nata a chaby râhzy he Livai chizy ama pie.
Kôhâ pathla phozy to awpa nuby a dao tua chaipa châ ta. Zudâh, Simeôna nata Benzami chi tovyuhzy tawhta khihpi miahrawh hleithôh cha theihthaipa Arawna pathla Livai chizy hnohta ama pie.
Kôhâ pathla hropazy châta nuby a dao heihpa châ ta, Epharai chi, Dânâ chi nata Manase chi khophie phozy tovyuh tawhta khihpi miahrawh ama pie.
Kesao pathlazy châta nuby a daopa châ ta, Iskâra chi, Asera chi nata Nâthalai chi phozy tovyuh tawhta nata Bâsanâ râh liata Manase chi khophie phozy ryuto râh tawhta khihpi miahrawh hleithôh ama pie.
Merâri pathlazy chhao Rubena chi, Kâdâ chi nata Zebulawna chi tovyuhzy tawhta khihpi miahrawh hleino a pho pho ta ama to hra.
Cha khihpizy nata a chabyzy cha, Abeipa ta Mawsi hmâpa ta bie a piepa hawhta, Izarei sawzy ta Livai chizy hnohta nuby a daopa ta ama pie.
Khihpi moh palâsapazy he Zudâh chi tovyuh nata Simeôna chi tovyuh tawhta Livai chizy hnohta ama pie.
Nuby a dao tua chaipa cha Livai chi Kôhâ pho Arawna pathla chô liata tlu ta. Hezy he ama to awpa khihpizy a châ:
Zudâh tlâh râh liata Kiriathâbâ khihpi cha a chaby râhzy chhaota ama pie. Kiriathâbâ cha Hebraw tahpa châ hra ta, Arabâ cha Anâki paw a châ.
Khihpi lyuzy nata a khichapeihzy deikua cha, Zephune sawchapawpa Kâlebâ tovyuh châta piepa a châ.
Theihthaipa Arawna pathlazy cha lianycheihpazy abohna khihpi Hebraw nata a chabyzy, Libnâ khihpi nata a chabyzy,
Zati khihpi nata a chabyzy, Estemô khihpi nata a chabyzy,
Hôlô khihpi nata a chabyzy, Debi khihpi nata a chabyzy,
Aina khihpi nata a chabyzy, Zutâ khihpi nata a chabyzy, Beseme khihpi nata a chabyzy piepa châ ei ta, chi no tovyuh tawhta khihpi miachaki piepa ama châ.
Benzami chi tovyuh tawhta Kibiô khihpi nata a chabyzy, Kebâ khihpi nata a chabyzy,
Anathô khihpi nata a chabyzy, Almaw khihpi nata a chabyzy piepa châ ei ta, khihpi miapalih piepa ama châ.
Arawna pathla theihthaipazy tovyuh cha a zydua ta khihpi miahrawh hleithôh nata a chabyzy a châ.
Livai chi Kôhâ pathla hropazy châta nuby a daopa châ ta, Epharai chi tovyuh tawhta khihpizy piepa ama châ.
He khihpizy he piepa ama châ: Epharai tlâh râh liata a ypa lianycheituhpazy abohna khihpi Sekhe nata a chabyzy, Keze khihpi nata a chabyzy,
Kibazai khihpi nata a chabyzy, Behôrô khihpi nata a chabyzy, khihpi miapalih piepa ama châ.
Dânâ chi tovyuh tawhta Elteke khihpi nata a chabyzy, Kibethaw khihpi nata a chabyzy,
Aizalô khihpi nata a chabyzy, Kâthârimô khihpi nata a chabyzy, khihpi miapalih piepa ama châ.
Manase chi khophie tovyuh tawhta Tânâ khihpi nata a chabyzy, Kâthârimô khihpi nata a chabyzy, khihpi miano piepa ama châ.
Kôhâ pathla pho hropazy tovyuh cha a zydua ta khihpi miahrawh nata a chabyzy a châ.

He khihpizy he Livai chi Kesao pathla phozy piepa a châ: Manase chi khophie tovyuh tawhta lianycheituhpazy abohna khihpi Bâsanâ râh liata Kôlâ khihpi nata a chabyzy, Besterâ khihpi nata a chabyzy, khihpi miano piepa ama châ.
Iskâra chi tovyuh tawhta Kisiô khihpi nata a chabyzy, Dâberâ khihpi nata a chabyzy,
Zamu khihpi nata a chabyzy, Enkâni khihpi nata a chabyzy, khihpi miapalih piepa ama châ.
Asera chi tovyuh tawhta Misâ khihpi nata a chabyzy, Abadaw khihpi nata a chabyzy,
Helkâ khihpi nata a chabyzy, Rehô khihpi nata a chabyzy, khihpi miapalih piepa ama châ.
Nâthalai chi tovyuh tawhta lianycheituhpazy abohna khihpi Kâlili râh liata Kedesâ khihpi nata a chabyzy, Hâmôdaw khihpi nata a chabyzy nata Kâtani khihpi nata a chabyzy, khihpi miathôh piepa ama châ.
Kesao pathlazy ta a pho pho ta ama topa khihpizy cha a zydua ta khihpi miahrawh hleithôh nata a chabyzy a châ.
Livai chi hropa Merâri pathla phozy cha Zebulawna chi tovyuh tawhta Zônia khihpi nata a chabyzy, Kâratâ khihpi nata a chabyzy,
Dimnâ khihpi nata a chabyzy, Nâhalâ khihpi nata a chabyzy, khihpi miapalih piepa ama châ.
Rubena chi tovyuh tawhta Beze khihpi nata a chabyzy, Zahâza khihpi nata a chabyzy,
Kedemô khihpi nata a chabyzy, Mephâ khihpi nata a chabyzy, khihpi miapalih piepa ama châ.
Kâdâ chi tovyuh tawhta lianycheituhpazy abohna khihpi Kilia râh liata Ramô khihpi nata a chabyzy, Mâhanai khihpi nata a chabyzy,
Hesbaw khihpi nata a chabyzy, Zaze khihpi nata a chabyzy, a zydua ta khihpi miapalih piepa ama châ.
Chazy cha Livai chi hropa Merâri pathlazy ta a pho pho ta ama topa khihpizy châ ei ta, ama topa cha a zydua ta khihpi miahrawh hleino a châ.
Izarei sawzy ryuto râh hry liata Livai chi khihpizy cha, khihpi chabyzy chhaota, a zydua ta khih sypalih nata khih charie a châ.
Khihpizy ta a chaby liata sahroh tlaihna hnei chyu ei ta, khihpi zydua cha hawhta ama châ khai.
Cha hawhna chata Abeipa ta Izarei sawzy cha, ama pathlatuhpazy hnohta pie awpa ta bie â vaw taihpa râh zydua pie ta. Chatanachata râh cha hnei ei ta, cha liata pahrâ ei ta.

Abeipa ta ama pathlatuhpazy hnohta bie â vaw taihpa hawhta, Izarei sawzy cha su to liata apahâna pie ta. Abeipa ta ama chariah zydua ama ku liata a pie khaipa vâ ei ta, ama chariah ahy hmah ama hmiakô liata a duah theipa y veih ei.
Izarei phopi hnohta Abeipa bietai phapa zydua miakha hmah a tlô leipa y vei. A zydua ta a tlô paki khai haw.
Chatawhcha Zawsua ta Rubena mo, Kâdâ mo nata Manase chi khophiezy aw ta,
ama hnohta, “ Abeipa chakaotuhpa Mawsi ta bie a cha piepa zydua zyh ei chi ta, kei ta bie ei cha piepa zydua chhao nathlie ei chi ta,
noh hluhpi chhôh nama unawhzy siesai leipa ei chi ta, tanoh taihta siesai veih ei chi. Abeipa nama Khazohpa piepazy nama zyh lymâ.

Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta ama hnohta bie â taihpa hawhta, nama unawhzy cha apahâna a pie ha ei hih. Chavâta Abeipa chakaotuhpa Mawsi ta nama ryuto châta râh a cha piepa ei, Zawdâh haosâ liata nama poh ozy lâ a di bâ teh u.

Abeipa chakaotuhpa Mawsi ta bie a cha piepa hawh ei ta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha a kyh pachâ ta, a lâpi zydua a chhihpa ta, a biepiepazy zyh ta, ano cha khâchâ patupa ta, nama pathipalôh tlokhuh ta nata nama thlahpa tlokhuh ta ano chakao awpa ta biepiepa nata ryhpazy pakhâta ta nama zyh awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Zawsua ta âmo cha byhnâ awpa ta, pasiesa ta, ama poh ozy lâ a di ha ei ta.

Manase chi khophie cha Mawsi ta Bâsanâ râh liata ryuto râh pie ta, chi khophie deikua cha Zawsua ta notla lâ Zawdâh haosâ liata ama unawhzy hry liata ryuto râh a pie ei. Ama o lâ a padisa chy ta Zawsua ta âmo cha byhnâ awpa ta,

ama hnohta, “Sôh nata thih hluhpi chhaota nama poh ozy lâ a di teh u. Sahrohzy, tâkâzy, ngôhzy, dawhzy, thua nata chysia hluhpi chhaota nama poh ozy lâ a di u la, nama chariahzy nama hraona sôhzy kha nama unawhzy nata a rai teh u,” tah ta.

Chatanachata Rubena pathlazy, Kâdâ pathlazy nata Manase chi khophiezy cha, Kâna râh Silô khihpi liata Izarei sawzy nata a chhaih ei ta, Abeipa ta Mawsi hmâpa ta bie a vaw piepa hawhta, Kilia râh liata ama ryuto râh lâ ama sie haw.
Kâna râh Zawdâh kao ama tlô nahta, Rubena pathlazy, Kâdâ pathlazy nata Manase chi khophiezy cha Zawdâh chavah kiah liata maisâh lai ngaitapa tao ei ta.
Chyhsazy ta, “Rubena pathlazy, Kâdâ pathlazy nata Manase chi khophiezy ta Kâna râh tytua Zawdâh kao, Izarei sawzy râh liata maisâh ama tao,” tahpa ta ama reipa Izarei sawzy ta thei ei ta.
Cha bie cha Izarei sawzy ta ama thei nahta, âmo a dyuh awpa ta Izarei zawpi zydua Silô khihpi liata a hmaohpakhy ei ta.
Izarei sawzy ta Kilia râh liata a ypa Rubena pathlazy, Kâdâ pathlazy nata Manase chi khophiezy lâta theihthaipa Eliaza sawchapawpa Phinehâ tuah ei ta.
A hnohta chhituhpa pahrawh, Izarei chizy hry tawhta chhôhkha pawhrâh chaipa pakha lymâ ta pasiesa ei ta. Âmo cha Izarei sâh hluhpi hry liata chhôhkha pawhrâh chaipazy ama châ.
Rubena pathlazy, Kâdâ pathlazy nata Manase chi khophiezy yna Kilia râh lâ cha sie ei ta, ama hnohta,

“ Abeipa phopi manôh zydua ta hetana heta ama tah, ‘Khazia Izarei Khazohpa chô liata hmo nama parao? Tanoh he Abeipa nama pazina tawhta tleisai a chhuahpa ta maisâh a tao ei chi ta, tanoh he Abeipa namâ dyuh hih.
Peô su liata moleina kha eima châta a daih vei ma? Abeipa phopi chô liata potlana vaw tlô ta, kha moleina tawhta tahmâ taih eimâ pathai khai to leipa he.
Khazia tanoh Abeipa tleisai namâ chhuah heih tly? Tanoh Abeipa namâ dyuh khiahta cha, mylâ Izarei zawpi zydua chô liata a pathi a ia aw.

Râh nama topa a pathaih leipa khiahta cha, Abeipa achhyna byureih yna Abeipa râh lâ he vaw chaka u la, eima hry liata râh vaw hnei hra teh u. Anodeikua Abeipa eima Khazohpa maisâh dei leipa ta maisâh hropa taopa ta Abeipa namâ dyuh awpa châ leipa ta, keimo chhao miah namâ dyuh awpa châ vei.

Zerâ sawchapawpa Âkhâ ta pahleipadia awpa hmozy kyh liata biepiepa a paraopa vâta, Izarei zawpi chô liata hiehâhna a vaw tlôpa kha a thei thlâh ha veih ei chi ma? A paraona vâta ano deita a leidia leipa kha,’” tah ei ta.
Rubena pathlazy, Kâdâ pathlazy nata Manase chi khophiezy ta Izarei pho hyutuhpazy cha a chhy ei ta, ama hnohta,

“Zehôvah, khazohzy Khazohpa! Abeipa, khazohzy Khazohpa! Ano ta pahno ta, Izarei chhao ta pahno mawh sy! Eima maisâh taopa he Abeipa a dyuhpa tlyma, a rei a ngiah leipa tlyma a châ khiahta cha, tanoh he miah pahlôh khuh vy.

Abeipa eima pazipa tawhta tleisai nawpa ta eima châta maisâh a taopa eima châ khiahta nata cha liata raopa hlâna tlyma, niepa hlâna tlyma, aryhna hlâna atheihna tlyma hlâ nawpa ta a taopa eima châ khiahta cha, ano Abeipa tlai ta viari miah thô mawh sy.
Châhrasala cha hawhta châ vei. Eima chipa vâta a taopa tlao eima châ. Chhâ vaw y awpa liata nama pathlazy ta eima pathlazy hnohta, ‘Nâmo nata Abeipa Izarei Khazohpa cha khâpa azaona ma nama hnei?

Abeipa ta Zawdâh he nâmo nata keimo likawh râhri châta rao ha ta, chavâta nâmo Rubena pathlazy nata Kâdâ pathlazy saih u, Abeipa liata tovyuh hnei hra veih ei chi,’ ama vaw tah pathlei aw tahpa eima chipa vâta a châ. Nama pathlazy ta eima pathlazy cha Abeipa a chhy khao lei awpa ta ama tao thei mâh tâh.
Chavâta, ‘Maisâh tao ei suh u, raopa hlâna châta nata atheihna châta châ leipa ta,

keimo nata nâmo nata keimo hnôhlâ ta eima pathlazy likah liata pahnokheituhpa châ aw ta, chatanachata eima raopa hlânazy, atheihnazy nata aryhna hlânazy ta Abeipa cha a hmiakô liata chakao thei aw pi ta, chhâ vaw y awpa liata nama pathlazy ta eima pathlazy hnohta, “ Abeipa liata tovyuh hnei veih ei chi,” ama tah lei nawpa ta,’ tahpa ta eima taopa a châ.

Chavâta hetana heta eima pachâ: Chhâ vaw y awpa liata keimo hnohta tlyma, eima pathlazy hnohta tlyma, cha bie cha ama rei tita, keimo ta, ‘Nathlie teh u, miah pathlatuhpazy ta Abeipa maisâh ama taozie he raopa hlâna awpa nata atheihna awpa châ vei, keimo nata nâmo likah ta pahnokheituhpa châta a châ,’ eima tah nawpa ta, a taopa eima châ.

Abeipa a dyuh chachei leipa pi ta, Abeipa eima pazipa tawhta tleisai tiarâh ma pi. Abeipa achhyna byureih hmiakô liata Abeipa eima Khazohpa maisâh tah leipa ta, raopa hlâna châta tlyma, niepa hlâna châta tlyma, atheihna châta tlyma, maisâh tao cheita ma pi,” tah ei ta.
Theihthaipa Phinehâ nata a hnohta a siepa zawpi chhituhpa Izarei pho hyutuhpazy ta Rubena pathlazy, Kâdâ pathlazy nata Manase pathlazy bie reipa cha ama thei nahta, a ly kaw ei ta.

Theihthaipa Eliaza sawchapawpa Phinehâ ta Rubena pathlazy, Kâdâ pathlazy nata Manase pathlazy hnohta, “ Abeipa eima hry liata a y tlai tahpa tanoh eima pahno haw. Abeipa châta nama ngâchhihna nama pahlei leipa vâta, tahmâ he Abeipa ku tawhta Izarei sawzy nama pachha haw,” tah ta.

Chatanachata theihthaipa Eliaza sawchapawpa Phinehâ nata chhituhpazy cha, Rubena pathlazy nata Kâdâ pathlazy pahrâna Kilia râh tawhta Izarei pathlazy yna Kâna râh lâ a lie ei ta, bie cha kei tlôkhei ei ta.
Cha biezy chata Izarei sawzy cha palysa kaw ta. Chatanachata Izarei sawzy cha Khazohpa reithai ei ta, Rubena pathlazy nata Kâdâ pathlazy a dyuh ta, ama pahrâna râh parao awpa kyh reih khao veih ei.
Rubena pathlazy nata Kâdâ pathlazy ta, “He he Abeipa cha Khazohpa a châ tlai na tahpa eima likah liata Pahnokheituhpa a châ,” tah ei ta, maisâh cha Pahnokheituhpa tahpa ta a moh ama bi.
Abeipa ta Izarei cha ama chheipâh chariah zydua tawhta apahâna pie ta, bohpi a châ tawhta, Zawsua chhao cha vaw machâpa ta kô uhthei ngaitapa vaw châ ha ta.
Zawsua ta Izarei machâ, chhituhpa, ryureituhpa nata hyutuhpa zydua awpakhy ta, ama hnohta, “Kei cha machâ ha na ta, kô uhthei ngaitapa ei châ ha hih.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nâmo vâta he phopi zydua chô liata a taopa zydua nama hmô khai. Abeipa nama Khazohpa ano tlai ta a châ dyuhpa ei.
Pachâ teh u, phopi pahnie mâh leipazy nata kei tlai ta ei chhawh pathlah hapa, Zawdâh tawhta notla lâ Tilaipi Laipa tlôna taihta phopizy râh cha, nama chizy ryuto râh châta ei cha pie ei.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta âmo cha nama hmiakô liata papua aw ta, nama hmô pha leipa lâ a to khai aw ei. Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama hnohta a reipa hawhta, ama râh cha nama hnei aw.
Chavâta Mawsi ryhpa châbu liata ropa zydua riahphapa ta zyh u la, tao teh u. Chachâh lâ tlyma, chavei lâ tlyma, tleisai cheita khuh vy.
Nama hry liata a ypa phopizy a kao leipa u la, ama khazohzy moh pado khuh vy. Ama khazohzy moh ta bie a taih leipa u la, cha khazohzy cha chakao leipa u la, a chhy khuh vy.
Tanoh taihta nama taopa hawhna heta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa deita khâchâ nama patu awpa a châ.
Abeipa ta chi laipa nata thatlôpazy nama hmiakô tawhta papua khai ta, nama hmiakô liata a duah theipa tanoh taihta ahy hmah y veih ei.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta bie châ taih ei ta, ano tlai ta nâmo châta â dyuhpa vâta, nâmo chyhsa pakha ta chyhsa sâh kha namâ chadaipai aw.
Chavâta a phapa ta a sohsi u la, Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha kyhpachâ teh u.
Hnôh lâ a heihpa ta, phopi laibâhpa nama hry liata a pahrâpazy a zaokhipa ta, a hnei pahlao u la, nama o cha kiah ei sala, ama o nama kiah khiahta cha,

Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta phopizy he nama hmiakô tawhta papua khao aw vei tahpa pahno muh vy. Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta râh pha ngaitapa a cha piepa tawh eina heta nama leidia khai hlâlei, âmo cha nama châta khoheih nata aphyh châ aw ei ta, nama kâ châta tuna chôchahrei châ aw ei ta, nama mokhaoh châta ahloh ama châ aw.

“Tahmâ cha khizaw zydua siezie hawhta ei sie hra daihti liahsa â hnia haw. Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nâmo kyh liata bie pha a vaw rei hapa zydua kha, a patlô leipa miakha hmah y vei tahpa nama pathipalôh tlokhuh ta nata nama thlahpa tlokhuh ta nama pahno. Nama chô liata vaw tlô khai ta, a tlô leipa miakha hmah y vei.

Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta nama hnohta hmo phapa a reipa zydua nama chô liata a vaw tlô khaipa hawhta, a biepiepazy nama parao khiahta deikua cha, Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta râh phapa a cha piepa tawh ei ta a cha pahleipadia khai hlâlei ei cha, Abeipa ta hmo pha leipazy nama chô liata a vaw patlôsa aw.

Abeipa nama Khazohpa ta bie a cha piepa ei, a biehrai paraopa ta, khazoh hropazy pangaipa ta âmo cha chakaopa ta namâ chhy khiahta cha, nama chô liata Abeipa pathi ia aw ta, râh phapa a cha piepa tawhna ei heta thlai nama leidia aw,” tah ta.
Zawsua ta Izarei chi zydua cha Sekhe liata pahmaoh ta, Izarei machâzy, chhituhpazy, ryureituhpazy nata hyutuhpazy awpakhy ta. Khazohpa hmiakô liata a luah chyu ei ta.

Zawsua ta zawpi zydua hnohta, “Zehôvah, Izarei Khazohpa ta hetana heta a tah: ‘Châ pathlatuhpazy, Abarahâ nata Nâhaw paw Terâ tlai chhao kha, hlâno cha Ufrâti chavah khô lâ râh liata pahrâ tyh ei ta, khazoh hropazy ama chakao tyh.
Nâmo châ pathlatuhpa Abarahâ kha Chavah khô lâ tawhta a vaw chhi na ta, Kâna râh chhôh zydua ei chhihtha. A chipathla papôh na ta, Aisika kha ei pie.
Aisika hnohta Zakaw nata Esaw pie na ta. Esaw cha a ryuto châta Seirâ tlâh râh ei pie. Zakaw nata a sawzy cha Izi râh lâ zu ei ta.
Chatawhcha Mawsi nata Arawna tuah na ta, Izi râh cha ama hry liata ei patlôsapa potlana khata hrie na ta, cha khai tawhta ei châ chhi papua ei.
Châ pathlatuhpazy Izi râh tawhta a chhi papua ei na ta, tilaipi nama vaw tlô. Izi mo ta talailihzy nata arâ pheisaihzy chhaota châ pathlatuhpazy cha Tilaipi Saihpa taih a vaw chadai ei ta.

Châ pathlatuhpazy ta Abeipa pado ei ta, nâmo nata Izi mo likawh liata zohna vaw soh ta, Izi mo cha tilaipi ta pavaosa ta, a pamôh khai ha ei. Izi râh liata ei hmotaopa kha nama mo tlai ta hmô ta. Râhchawhpa liata bohpi nama y.

“‘Cha khai tawhta Zawdâh haosâ liata a ypa Amawri râh lâ ei châ chhi ei. Châ vaw dyuh ei ta, âmo cha nama ku liata ei cha pie ei. Chatanachata ama râh hnei ei chi ta, âmo cha nama hmiakô tawhta ei pahleipadia ha ei.
Zipô sawchapawpa Môabâ bei Bâlâka vaw thyu ta, Izarei cha a vaw dyuh ta, chhie cha sapa awpa ta Beô sawchapawpa Bâlâma hnohta chyhsa tuah ta, a paawsa.
Châhrasala Bâlâma bie nathlie khoh va na. Chavâta nama châta byhnâ tlao aw ta, Bâlâka ku tawhta ei cha pachha ei.

Cha khai tawhta Zawdâh chaka ei chi ta, Zerikô nama tlô. Zerikô chyhsazy ta châ vaw dyuh ei ta, Amawri mo, Perizi mo, Kâna mo, Hiti mo, Kikâsi mo, Hivi mo nata Zebu mozy chhao ta châ dyuh hra ei ta, châhrasala âmo cha nama ku liata ei cha pie ha ei.
Nama hmia lâta kheihpangiah tuah na ta, cha chata âmo cha nama hmiakô tawhta a chadai ta, Amawri bei pano â chadaipai ha ei. Nama zaozi ta tlyma, nama libaw ta tlyma nama pahniepa châ vei.
Nama hriapasa leipa râh nata nama padua leipa khihpizy cha pie ei na ta, chazy liata pahrâ ei chi ta, nama lo leipa kre sadô nata ôli sadô theizy nama nie.

“‘Chavâta Abeipa cha chi u la, hmeiseihpa nata â do ngaitapa ta ano cha chakao muh vy. Châ pathlatuhpazy ta Chavah haosâ nata Izi râh liata ama chakao tyhpa khazohzy kha thy khai u la, Abeipa chakao muh vy.

Abeipa chakaopa cha a pha lei awpa hawhta nama pahno khiahta cha, tanoh he ahy ma nama chakao aw, a tlyh teh u. Châ pathlatuhpazy ta Chavah haosâ liata ama chakao tyhpa khazohzy kha ma, nama pahrâ haipa râh Amawri mo khazohzy he ma, a tlyh teh u. Kei nata ei chhôhkha ta la Abeipa eima chakao aw,’” tah ta.
Zawpizy ta, “Zehôvâh Khazohpa siesaipa ta khazoh hropazy chakao cheita aw ma pi.

Abeipa eima Khazohpa, ano tlai cha keimo nata miah pathlatuhpazy Izi râh seichâna o tawhta miah a kaw chhi papua ta, eima mohmô liata ngiana rônah ngaitapazy taopa ta, eima siena maih nata phopi eima chatôhna zydua liata miah pabohsatuhpa a châ.
Abeipa ta phopi zydua, cha râh liata a pahrâpa Amawri mo chhao, eima hmiakô tawhta a papua khai ei. Chavâta keimo chhao Abeipa eima chakao aw, ano cha eima Khazohpa a châ,” tah ei ta.
Châhrasala Zawsua ta zawpi hnohta, “ Abeipa chakao thei aw veih ei chi. Ano cha Khazoh pathaihpa châ ta, hiatlia a pasapa Khazohpa a châ. Nama paraonazy nata nama moleinazy a ngiahthai aw vei.
Abeipa siesaipa ta râh hropa khazohzy nama chakao khiahta cha, nama chô liata hmo phapa a vaw tao hapa chhao ta, châ heihnaohpa ta hmo pha leipa ta cha thô aw ei ta, a cha pahleipadia aw ei,” tah ta.
Zawpizy ta Zawsua hnohta, “Châ vei, Abeipa khâchâ eima chakao aw,” tah ei ta.
Zawsua ta zawpi hnohta, “ Abeipa chakao awpa ta namâ tlyhpa kyh liata pahnokheituhpazy cha nâmosasyh tlai nama châ,” tah ta. Âmo ta, “Pahnokheituhpazy eima châ,” tah ei ta.
Zawsua ta, “Chata a châ khiahta cha, nama hry liata chihropa khazoh a ypazy kha thy khai u la, Abeipa Izarei Khazohpa lâta nama pathipalôh pahei teh u,” tah ta.
Zawpizy ta Zawsua hnohta, “ Abeipa eima Khazohpa chakao aw pi ta, a bie eima zyh lymâ aw,” tah ei ta.
Chatanachata Zawsua ta, cha noh liata zawpi hnohta bie hraih ta, âmo châta bieraopa nata pachianazy Sekhe liata tao ta.
Zawsua ta cha biezy cha Khazohpa ryhpa châbu liata roh ta, alô laipa la ta, Abeipa supathaihpa kiapâh ta ôkâ tho ry liata bô ta.

Zawsua ta zawpi zydua hnohta, “Moh teh u, he alô he miah pahnokheituhpa a châ aw. Abeipa ta eima hnohta bie a reipa zydua thei khai ta, chavâta nâmo châ pahnokheituhpa a châ aw. Chataleipatala nama Khazohpa cha namâ paphasai pathlei aw,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Zawsua ta zawpizy cha ama ryuto râh chyu lâta pasiesa ha ta.
Cha khai tawhta Nunâ sawchapawpa Zawsua, Abeipa chakaotuhpa cha kô 110 uhtheipa ta thi ta.
Kâsi tlâh maw lâta Epharai tlâh râh Timnâserâ liata a ryuto râh liata ama pabu.
Zawsua hro chhôh nata Zawsua hlâta a hro parei viapa, Abeipa ta Izarei châta hmo a taopa zydua a pahnotuhpa machâzy hro chhôh liata cha, Izarei sawzy ta Abeipa ama chakao lymâ.

Izarei sawzy ta Izi râh tawhta Zawsi ru ama kaw phaopa kha, Sekhe khihpi liata Zakaw ta Sekhe paw Hamô sawzy liata tâkâ za kha ta a chaleipa su liata pabu ei ta. Cha cha Zawsi pathlazy ryuto râh a châ pâ haw.
Arawna sawchapawpa Eliaza cha thi ta, a sawchapawpa Phinehâ hnohta a ryuto châta ama piepa Epharai tlâh râh Kibia khih liata ama pabu.
Zawsua a thi tawhta Izarei sawzy ta, “Kâna mo siehnao awpa ta ahy eima châta sie tua chai aw ta, âmo cha a kaw dyuh aw?” tahpa ta Abeipa hiahri ei ta.
Abeipa ta, “Zudâh sie mawh sy. Râh cha a ku liata ei pie haw,” tah ta.

Zudâh pathlazy ta ama unawhpa Simeôna pathlazy hnohta, “Eima ryuto râh lâ eima hnohta kaw sie u la, hmaohkha ta Kâna mo a kaw dyuh ei suh u. Keimo chhao nama ryuto râh lâ nama hnohta eima sie hra aw,” tah ei ta. Chatanachata Simeôna pathlazy cha Zudâh pathlazy hnohta adyuhna lâ sie ei ta.
Zudâh pathlazy cha khy ei ta, Abeipa ta ama ku liata Kâna mo nata Perizi mo pie ta. Beze khih liata chyhsa 10,000 thie ei ta.
Beze khih liata Adônibeze hmô ei ta, a dyuh ei ta, Kâna mo nata Perizi mo cha thata thie ei ta.
Adônibeze deikua a râ ha ta. A chadai ei ta, patu ei ta, a kupizy nata a pheipizy tai ei ta.

Adônibeze ta, “Ama kupi nata pheipi ei taipa bei sysarizy ta ei tlâhkhai ry liata azôpa a huah tyh ei ta, ei taopa hawh tlai ta Khazohpa ta viari eina thô he zaw,” tah ta. Zerusale lâ a chhi ei ta, cha liata thi ha ta.
Zudâh pathlazy ta Zerusale a dyuh ei ta, la ei ta, zaozi ta chhawhsao ei ta, khihpi cha mei ta rao ei ta.
Cha khai tawhta, Zudâh pathlazy cha tlâh râh nata Neke nata bypi liata a ypa Kâna mozy a dyuh awpa ta zu ei ta.
Zudâh ta Hebraw khih liata a pahrâpa Kâna mo siehnao ta, Sesai, Ahimâ nata Tâmai zy thie ta. Cha hlâta Hebraw khih cha Kiriathâbâ tahpa a châ.
Cha tawhna chata Zudâh pathlazy cha Debi khih liata a pahrâpazy siehnao ei ta. Cha hlâta Debi khih moh cha Kiriasephâ tahpa a châ.
Kâlebâ ta, “Ahy rai Kiriasephâ a dyuh ta a pahniepa cha ei sawchanô Akasâ lapinô ta ei pahneisa aw,” tah ta.
Kâlebâ nawhta Kenâza sawchapawpa Ôthane ta Kiriasephâ cha pahnie ta, chatanachata Kâlebâ ta a sawchanô Akasâ cha lapinô ta pahneisa ta.
Akasâ cha Ôthane lapinô a châ nahta, a paw hnohta râh hia awpa ta Ôthane cha pasyu ta. Akasâ cha alâ tawhta vaw chô ta, Kâlebâ ta a hnohta, “Khâpa na khoh?” tah ta.

Akasâ ta, “Byhnâ na pie mah y. Neke râh eina pie ha hnohkua chi cha, tihnawhzy chhao eina pie pâ awpa chi ta ei châ haw,” tah ta. Chatanachata Kâlebâ ta Akasâ cha machha lâta tihnawh nata mathi lâta tihnawhzy pie ta.
Mawsi puhpa Keni pathlazy cha Zudâh pathlazy chhaota thiahrâ khihpi tawhta pua ei ta, Aradâ kiapâh ta a ypa Neke liata Zudâh râhchawhpa lâ khy ei ta, cha liata a ypa phopi hry liata pahrâ ei ta.
Zudâh pathlazy cha ama unawhpa Simeôna pathlazy nata pua ei ta, Zephâ khih liata a ypa Kâna mo thie ei ta, a khihpi chhao tlokhuh ama parao khai haw. Chavâta khihpi moh chhao Hômâ tahpa a châ.
Zudâh pathlazy ta Kâza, Askelaw nata Ekarôna khihpizy cha ama râhzy chhaota la ei ta.
Abeipa cha Zudâh pathlazy hnohta y ta, chatanachata tlâh râh liata pahrâpazy papua khai ei ta, by liata pahrâpazy deikua, thua talailihzy ama hneipa vâta papua thei veih ei.
Mawsi ta a vaw rei hapa hawhta, Hebraw khih cha Kâlebâ pie ei ta, cha liata a ypa Anâki sawchapaw pathôhzy cha Kâlebâ ta a papua ha ei.
Benzami pathlazy deikua, Zerusale khih liata a pahrâpa Zebu mo papua veih ei. Chavâta Zebu mo cha tanoh taihta Zerusale liata Benzami pathlazy nata hmaohkha ta ama pahrâ lymâ.
Zawsi pathlazy chhao Bethel a dyuh awpa ta pua ei ta, ama hnohta Abeipa y ta.
Zawsi pathlazy ta Bethel lâ mohparutuhpazy tuah ei ta. Cha hlâta khihpi moh cha Luzi tahpa a châ.
Mohparutuhpazy ta chyhsa pakha khih chhôh tawhta a vaw puapa hmô ei ta, a hnohta, “Ngiachhiepa ta khih chhôh lâ angiana miah chho teh, na chô liata ngiachhiena eima palâsa aw,” tah ei ta.
Khihpi chhôh lâ angiana cha âmo chho ta. Chatanachata zaozi ta khihpi cha a dyuh ei ta, cha chyhsa nata a chhôhkha zydua deikua pahlôh ei ta.
Cha chyhsa cha Hiti râh lâ sie ta, khihpi padua ta, a moh Luzi bi ta, tanoh taihta cha khih moh cha a phaoh haw.

Manase pathlazy ta Besia nata a khichapeih liata pahrâpazy, Tânâ nata a khichapeih liata pahrâpazy, Dôrâ nata a khichapeih liata pahrâpazy, Ibalia nata a khichapeih liata pahrâpazy, Mekidô nata a khichapeih liata pahrâpazy papua leipa ei ta. Kâna mo ta cha râh liata pahrâ awpa khâchâ amâ chhuah hapa vâta ama papua leipa a châ.
Izarei sawzy ama tha a vaw tlô via nahta, Kâna mo cha raihriatuhpa ta tao ei ta, chavâta papua khai khao veih ei.
Epharai pathlazy chhao, Keze khih liata a ypa Kâna mo papua veih ei. Chavâta Kâna mo cha ama hry liata Keze khih liata ama pahrâ lymâ hra.
Zebulawna pathlazy chhao, Kitaraw nata Nâhalaw khihpizy liata pahrâpazy papua veih ei. Chavâta Kâna mo cha ama hry liata pahrâ lymâ hra ei ta, raihriatuhpazy ta hmâpa ama châ.
Asera pathlazy ta Akô, Sidaw, Ahilâ, Akazi, Helbâ, Aphi nata Rehô khihpizy liata pahrâpazy papua veih ei.
Cha râh liata a pahrâpa Kâna mo cha Asera pathlazy ta ama papua leipa vâta, Asera pathlazy cha Kâna mo nata ama pahrâ khoh lymâ.

Nâthalai pathlazy ta Beseme nata Bethanâ khihpizy liata pahrâpazy papua veih ei. Chavâta cha râh liata a pahrâpa Kâna mo hry liata pahrâ ei ta, Beseme nata Bethanâ liata pahrâpazy cha ama raihriatuhpazy châta hmâpa ama châ.
Dânâ pathlazy cha saikao by lâ ama zu awpa Amawri mo ta ama pasai leipa vâta, tlâh râh lâ ama pakuasa haw.

Amawri mo cha Here Tlâh liata nata Aizalô nata Sâbi khihpizy liata pahrâ lymâ awpa khâchâ a chhuah ei ta, châhrasala Zawsi pathlazy cha âmo hlâta ama thatlô via ta, chavâta Amawri mo cha raihriatuhpazy ta hmâpa ama châ.
Amawri mo râhri cha Akarâbi lâ kiana, Selâ tawhta machha lâ a châ.

Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa cha Kilkal tawhta Bôkhi lâ khy ta, Izarei sawzy hnohta, “Izi râh tawhta châ kaw chhi papua ei na ta, châ pathlatuhpazy hnohta bie ei taihpa râh liata châ ngiakhei ei na ta, ‘Nama hnohta bie ei hraipa parao beih aw va na.
He râh liata pahrâpazy nata biehrai nama tao awpa châ leipa ta, ama maisâhzy nama parao awpa a châ,’ tah na ta. Châhrasala ei ao nathlie veih ei chi. Khâpa vâta ma he hawhta nama tao?
Chavâta tahmâ ei cha chho ei. Âmo cha nama hmiakô tawhta papua khao aw veih ei na. Nama kâzy liata ahloh hawhta cha chhô aw ei ta, ama khazohzy cha nama châta khoheih ama châ aw,” tah ta.
Cha biezy cha Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa ta Izarei saw zydua hnohta a rei khaipa nahta, zawpizy cha aoh tlili ta cha ei ta.
Chavâta cha su moh cha Bôkhi tahpa châ ta, cha su liata Abeipa lâta atheihna ama hlâ.
Chatawhcha Zawsua ta zawpizy cha padisa ta. Izarei sawzy cha ama ryuto râh chyu liata pahrâ awpa ta sie ei ta.
Zawsua hro chhôh zydua nata Zawsua hnôhlâ ta Abeipa ta Izarei châta hmo rônahpa a taopa a hmôpa Izarei machâzy hro chhôh zydua liata, Izarei phopi cha ama zydua ta Abeipa ama chakao lymâ.
Chatawhcha Nunâ sawchapawpa Zawsua, Abeipa chakaotuhpa cha kô 110 uhtheipa ta thi ta.
Kâsi Tlâh maw lâ Epharai tlâh râh liata a ryuto râh Timnâhere liata ama pabu.
Cha chhâ chyhsa zydua chhao ama pathlatuhpazy hnohta pahlyhpa ama châ khai ha hra. Âmo hnôhlâ ta, Abeipa a pahno leipa nata Izarei châta Abeipa hmotaopazy a pahno leipa chhâ hropa vaw pua ta.
Izarei sawzy ta Abeipa mohmô liata moleina hmo taopa ta, Bâlâ khazohzy a chhy pathao ei ta.
Abeipa, ama pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa, Izi râh tawhta âmo a kaw chhi papuatuhpa cha a heihsaipa ta, ama chheipâh phopizy khazoh hropazy pazi ei ta, amâ chhy. Chavâta Abeipa hie ama pahâh haw.
Abeipa a heihsaipa ta, Bâlâ nata Astarô khazohzy tlao ama chakao.
Chavâta Abeipa cha Izarei chô liata a pathi ia ta, hraotuhpazy lâta âmo cha pie ta, ama hrao haw. Ama chheipâh chariahzy ku liata âmo cha zuah ta, ama chariahzy hmiakô liata a duah thei khao veih ei.
Hrâ ama siena maihta, Abeipa ta a reipa nata ama hnohta bie â taihpa hawhta, Abeipa ku tlai ta âmo cha â dyuhpa vâta, pahniepa ama châ lymâ. Chavâta ama pachâ a rôh ngaita.
Chatawhcha Abeipa ta ryureituhpazy padua ta. Ryureituhpazy chata Izarei sawzy cha âmo a hraotuhpazy ku tawhta ama pachha lymâ.

Chatanachôta ama ryureituhpazy bie nathlie khoh leipa ei ta, khazoh hropazy liata a phei ei ta, khazoh hropazy a chhy ei ta, ama pathlatuhpazy ta Abeipa biepiepazy zyhpa ta a lâpi amâ chhih tyhpa cha thlai ta tleisai ei ta, tao khao veih ei.

Abeipa ta ama châta ryureituhpazy a paduana daihti maihta, Abeipa cha ryureituhpa hnohta y ta, ryureituhpa hro chhôh zydua cha, Abeipa ta ama chariahzy ku tawhta a pachha lymâ tyh ei. Ama chariahzy ta tlybai ei ta, rie ama patheipa vâta, amâ hrôna ao ta Abeipa cha ngiachhiena a pahneisa heih tyh.

Châhrasala ryureituhpa a thipa nahta, hnôh lâ kua ei ta, ama pathlatuhpazy hlâ chhao ta molei viapa ta, khazoh hropazy chakao ei ta amâ chhy ha tyh. Ama tao tyhpa nata ama chhorunazy pathleih hlei veih ei.
Chavâta Abeipa pathi cha Izarei chô liata thata ia ta, “He phopi heta ama pathlatuhpazy hnohta bie ei piepa, ei biehrai parao ei ta, ei ao ama nathlie leipa vâta,
kei chhao ta Zawsua ta a thi hlâta a papua khai hmâ leipa phopizy he papuapa khao aw veih ei na.
Ama pathlatuhpazy ta Abeipa lâpi amâ chhih tyhpa hawhna khata, âmo he amâ chhih ma chhih vei ma tahpa pasiana châta phopizy he ei hmâh aw ei,” tah ta.
Chavâta Abeipa ta phopizy cha thlai papua khai leipa ta, pahlôh chy ta, Zawsua ku liata chhao vaw pie khai vei.
Hezy he Kâna râh liata adyuhna a tyh mâh leipa Izarei saw zydua pasia nawpa châta pahlôhpa phopizy ama châ.
Adyuhna a pahno mâh leipa Izarei chhâ vaw y lymâ awpazy ta adyuhzie ama pahno thei nawpa ta, pachuna châta pahlôhpa ama châ.
Phopi pahlôhpazy cha, Philistinâ bei papangawh, Kâna mo zydua, Sidaw mo zydua nata Lebanaw Tlâh nata Bâlâhâmaw Tlâh tawhta Lebôhamâ taihta a pahrâpa Hivi mo zydua ama châ.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hmâpa ta ama pathlatuhpazy hnohta a biepiepazy Izarei ta a zyh ma tahpa pasia nawpa ta âmo cha pahlôhpa ama châ.
Chatanachata Izarei sawzy cha Kâna mo, Hiti mo, Amawri mo, Perizi mo, Hivi mo nata Zebu mozy hry liata pahrâ ei ta.
Ama sawchanôzy lapinô ta hnei ei ta, âmo sawchanôzy chhao ama sawchapawzy pie ei ta, ama khazohzy ama chakao.
Izarei sawzy cha Abeipa mohmô ta moleina hmo tao ei ta. Abeipa ama Khazohpa cha mypa ta, Bâlâ nata Aserô chakao ei ta.
Chavâta Izarei chô liata Abeipa a pathi ia ta, Izarei sawzy cha Mesôpôtamia bei Kusarisathai lâ a zuah ha ei. Izarei sawzy cha Kusarisathai ry liata kô charie y ei ta.
Châhrasala Izarei sawzy ta Abeipa ama pado nahta, Abeipa ta Izarei sawzy châta pachhatuhpa padua tyh ta. Kâlebâ nawhta Kenâza sawchapawpa Ôthane cha Izarei pachha awpa ta Abeipa ta a padua.
Abeipa thlahpa a chô liata vaw tlô ta, Izarei chô liata ryureih ta. Ôthane cha adyuhna lâ sie ta, Abeipa ta Mesôpôtamia bei Kusarisathai cha a ku liata pie ta, Kusarisathai cha a pahnie haw.
Chatanachata râh cha kô sypalih chhôh thlalôhpa ta y ta. Chatawhcha Kenâza sawchapawpa Ôthane cha thi ha ta.
Izarei sawzy cha Abeipa mohmô ta moleina hmo tao heih ei ta. Abeipa mohmô ta moleina ama taopa vâta, Abeipa ta Môabâ bei Ekalaw cha Izarei pahnie awpa ta a tha patlô ta.
Ekalaw ta Amawna mo nata Amale mo cha ano bao awpa ta hrua ta. Sie ta Izarei cha pahnie ta, thiahrâ khihpi chhao la ta.
Chatanachata Izarei sawzy cha Môabâ bei Ekalaw ry liata kô hrawh hleicharie y ei ta.

Izarei sawzy ta Abeipa pado ei ta, Abeipa ta Benzami chi Kerâ sawchapawpa, chavei lâ a paohpa Ehu cha âmo pachhatuhpa ta padua ta. Môabâ bei Ekalaw lâ râhpaw pie awpa ta Izarei sawzy ta Ehu cha tuah ei ta.
Ehu ta zaozi hâh nopa, dy kha a seihpa daih ta, cha cha a chysiazy ry liata nyupa ta, a chachâh lâ byhpi liata chahry pâ ta.
Râhpaw cha Môabâ bei Ekalaw hnohta pie ta. Ekalaw cha chyhsa thawh kawpa châ ta.
Ehu ta râhpaw a hlâ khai nahta, râhpaw a vaw phaohtuhpazy cha pasiesa ta.

Châhrasala ano cha Kilkal kiapâh liata alô nothlahpa khazohzy yna su tawhta a lie heih ta, Ekalaw hnohta, “Hy abei y, bieparu cha chho awpa ei hnei,” tah ta. Abei ta, “A chalih teh u,” tah ta. A chakaotuhpa zydua a mohmô tawhta pua ei ta.

Bei Ekalaw cha a o chô lâta chhôhpadâhpa chakuapa liata ano deita ta â tyuh thlâh no châ ta. Ehu ta kei pangai ta, a hnohta, “Na châta Khazohpa tawhta bietapa ei hnei,” tah ta. Ekalaw cha a dyuchhai tawhta kaw thyu ta.
Ehu ta a chavei lâta ku ta a chachâh lâta byhpi liata zaozi cha phia ta, Ekalaw py liata vieh ta.
Zaozi cha a ngaih chhaota a pamôh ta, a thaw ta zaozi hâh a pamai hapa vâta, zaozi cha a py tawhta phia thei khao leipa ta, a ky lâ a puapahlie haw.
Ehu cha okah lâ pua ta, o chô chhôhpadâhpa ochhizy khaw ta, Ekalaw cha hraikhâh ta.
Ehu a pua tawhta bei chakaotuhpazy a vy ei ta, o chô chhôhpadâhpa ochhizy â hraipa hmô ei ta, “A chhôhpadâh chakuapa liata â pahâ chypa a châ aw hih,” tah ei ta.
Vâropi tlai, nôpo khai hana taihta hâ ei ta, o chô chhôhpadâhpa ochhizy a pahy khao lei nahta, châhbi la ei ta, pahy ei ta, ama zibeipa cha thiruapa ta siphiah liata â vaw hluah thlâh hapa hmô ei ta.
Abei ama hâ chhôh ta Ehu cha a râ syulyu ha ta. Alô nothlahpa khazohzy yna khô ta, Seirâ lâ a râ ta.
A tlô nahta, Epharai tlâh râh liata chiahmie tô ta, Izarei sawzy cha a hnohta tlâh râh tawhta zu ei ta, Ehu ta âmo cha chhihtha ta.

Ama hnohta, “Na zi teh u, Abeipa ta nama chariahpa Môabâ mo he nama ku liata a cha pie ha ei,” tah ta. Chatanachata Ehu cha pazipa ta zu ei ta, Môabâ râh daih lâta Zawdâh chaka theina su cha la ei ta, ahy hmah chakasa veih ei.
Cha daihti liata Môabâ mo 10,000 rachhôh, chyhsa thatlôpa nata riahphapazy thie ei ta, pakha hmah a râpa y veih ei.
Cha noh liata Môabâ cha Izarei ku ta pahniepa ta y ta. Chatanachata râh cha kô sycharie chhôh thlalôhpa ta y ta.
Ehu khai tawhta Anathâ sawchapawpa Sâkâ cha ryureituhpa vaw châ ta. Ano cha viahchao tona chôchahrei ta Philistinâ mo 600 a thiepa a châ. Ano chhao cha Izarei pachhatuhpa a châ hra.
Ehu a thi tawhta Izarei sawzy cha Abeipa mohmô ta moleina hmo tao heih ei ta.
Chavâta Abeipa ta âmo cha Hâzaw liata ryu a reihpa Kâna bei Zabi hnohta a zuah ha ei. Zabi pheisaihzy hyutuhpa cha Hârôse Hâkôi liata a pahrâpa Siserâ a châ.
Zabi cha thua talailih 900 hnei ta, Izarei sawzy cha kô kih tlai tlybaipa ta ama rie thata a pathei. Chavâta Izarei sawzy ta Abeipa pado ei ta.
Cha daihti liata Izarei ryureituhpa cha Lapidô lapinô hrohsonô Debawrâ a châ.
Debawrâ cha Epharai tlâh râh liata Râmâ nata Bethel likawh ta thiahrâ kô ry liata a tyuh tyh ta. Izarei sawzy ta ama bie pachiapa awpa ta ano lâ ama pangai tyh.

Debawrâ ta Kedesâ Nâthalai râh liata Abinôâ sawchapawpa Bâraka kei paawsa ta, a hnohta, “Zehôvâh, Izarei Khazohpa ta hetana heta a tah, ‘Sie la, Tabaw tlâh lâ pangai la, Nâthalai nata Zebulawna chizy tawhta pheisaih 10,000 a chhi teh.

Zabi pheisaihzy hyutuhpa Siserâ cha nâma châ dyuh awpa ta a talailih nata pheisaih zydua chhaota Kisaw chavah lâ vaw pavysa aw na ta, ano cha na ku liata ei cha pie aw,’ tahpa ta bie a cha pie,” tah ta.
Bâraka ta Debawrâ hnohta, “Eina sielâh khiah chi ta cha, ei sie aw. Eina sielâh vei khiah chi ta cha, sie aw va na,” tah ta.

Debawrâ ta, “Ei cha sielâh aw, anodeikua na lâpi a chhihpa he na châta rônahna cha tlôkhei aw vei, Abeipa ta Siserâ cha chanô ku liata a zuah awpa vâta,” tah ta. Chatawhcha Debawrâ cha thyu ta, Bâraka hnohta Kedesâ lâ cha sie ta.
Bâraka ta Zebulawna nata Nâthalai chizy Kedesâ liata awpakhy ta. Chyhsa 10,000 ta zi ei ta, Debawrâ chhao a hnohta sie hra ta.
Keni chyhsa Hebe cha a chiheih Keni mo hry tawhta a panano ta, âmo tawhta â hla kawpa ta Kedesâ kiapâh ta Zanâni liata ôkâ tho thih liata poh o rai ta. Keni mo he Mawsi puhpa Hôbâ pathlazy ama châ.
Abinôâ sawchapawpa Bâraka Tabaw Tlâh lâ a khy haw tahpa Siserâ chho ei ta.
Siserâ cha a talailih zydua pahmaoh ta, thua talailih 900 hnei ta, Hârôse Hâkôi tawhta Kisaw chavah taihta a awpakhypa a chyhsa zydua a hnohta y ei ta.

Debawrâ ta Bâraka hnohta, “Thyu teh! Tanoh he Abeipa ta na ku liata Siserâ a cha piena noh a châ hih. Na hmia lâta Abeipa a sie haw,” tah ta. Chatanachata Bâraka cha Tabaw Tlâh tawhta zu ta, chyhsa 10,000 ta zi ei ta.
Abeipa ta Siserâ nata a talailih zydua nata a pheisaih zydua cha zaozi ta a dyuh ta, Bâraka hmiakô liata âmo cha patypamâ ta. Siserâ cha talailih tawhta chô ta, a phei ta a râ ta.
Bâraka ta talailihzy nata pheisaihzy cha Hârôse Hâkôi taih a chadai ta. Siserâ pheisaih zydua cha zaozi ta thi khai ei ta, pakha hmah ahrohpa y veih ei.
Siserâ cha Keni chyhsa Hebe lapinô Zaeli poh o lâ a phei ta a râ ta. Hâzaw bei Zabi nata Keni chi Hebe pathlazy likah liata adyuhna a ypa vâta ano lâ a râpa a châ.

Zaeli cha Siserâ dy awpa ta pua ta, a hnohta, “A vaw ngia teh, ei zibeipa, kei lâ a vaw ngia teh, chi khah y,” tah ta. Chatanachata Siserâ cha Zaeli poh o chhôh lâ a ngia ta, Zaeli ta poh chypa ta khu ta.
Siserâ ta Zaeli hnohta, “Ngiachhiepa ta ti do awpa a chyhta na vaw pie teh, ei dâh na a phi kaw,” tah ta. Sâhpiti ôh pahy ta, padosa ta, Siserâ cha poh chypa ta khu heih ta.
Siserâ ta Zaeli hnohta, “Poh o chhikao liata a duah la, chyhsa ahy rai a vy sala, ‘He liata chyhsa a y ma,’ tahpa ta a cha hiahri khiahta cha, ‘Y vei’ tah lymâ mah y,” tah ta.

Siserâ cha a thachhâ kawpa vâta mokuh pahâh ngaitapa ta â mô chhôh ta, Hebe lapinô Zaeli cha poh o khaipâna la ta, syulô chaba ta, Siserâ cha chadi ta, a siali liata a puapahliena taihta khai ta, thi ha ta.

Bâraka ta Siserâ cha a vaw chadai ta. Zaeli cha ano dy awpa ta vaw pua ta, a hnohta, “A vy teh, na chyhsa tluapa ei cha pahmô aw,” tah ta. A hnohta vawh ta, Siserâ cha a siali liata poh o khaipâna achalohna chôta thiruapa ta â vaw zawh thlâh hapa hmô ta.
Cha noh liata Khazohpa ta Kâna bei Zabi cha Izarei sawzy hmiakô liata a panawh haw.
Izarei sawzy ku ta Kâna bei Zabi cha ama pahniena taihta thatlô viapa ta tôh lymâ ta, chatanachata Kâna bei Zabi cha ama pahleipadia haw.
Cha noh liata Debawrâ nata Abinôâ sawchapawpa Bâraka ta, hetana heta hla ama sa:
“Chhituhpazy ta Izarei liata chhihtha ei ta, Phopi âmo kho ta amâ vaw hlâ lymâ; Abeipa cha reithai teh u!
“Hy nâmo, abeizy, Nathlie u la; Hy nâmo, ryureihtuhpazy, Nama nah pachôh teh u; Abeipa lâ hla sa aw na ta, Abeipa Izarei Khazohpa lâ reithaina ei hlâ aw.
“Hy Abeipa, Seirâ tawhta pua chi ta, Edômâ râh tawhta na sie nona kha, Alei a chalyupa ta avâ za tla ta, Meihdozy ta ti a za pathla.
Tlâhpizy Abeipa hmiakô liata a chalyu ei ta, Sinai tlâh chhao Abeipa Izarei Khazohpa hmiakô liata â chalyu.
“Anathâ sawchapawpa Sâkâ hro chhôh ta, Zaeli hro chhôh ta cha, Lâlaizy hnypa châ ta, Khitlyhpazy lâdy amâ chhih tyh.
Izarei liata khitawzy y khao veih ei, Kei ei vaw thyu hlâ kha cha lei khai ha ei ta; Kei Debawrâ heta nô hawhta Izarei liata ei vaw thyu hlâ kha cha, Ama lei khai haw.
Khazoh thiehpazy amâ la nahta, Thokhy chhikaozy liata adyuhna a vaw y tyh. Vyhphao tlyma, asei tlyma, Izarei thy palih hry liata hmô awpa a y ma?
“Izarei ryureituhpazy lâta ei palôh sie ta, Zawpi hry tawhta âmo kho ta a vaw hlâpazy lâna tlai cha ei palôh a sie. Abeipa cha reithai teh u!
“Nâmo, alâ râhpa a kiahpazy saih u, Cha biezy cha phuah u la; Nâmo, pohphaw liata a tyuhpazy saih u, Cha biezy cha phuah u la; Nâmo, lâpi a chhihpazy saih u, Cha biezy cha phuah teh u.

Libaw katuhpazy pyu hlâta paro viapa ta, Ti yna suzy liata Abeipa hmotao siapa cha phuah aw ei ta, Izarei liata a khihsawzy hmotao siapa kyh ama phuah aw. Chatanachata Abeipa phopi cha, Khihpi thokhy chhikaozy lâ amâ pahri aw.
“Hy Debawrâ, a hra la, a hra teh! A hra la, a hra la, hla sa teh! Hy Bâraka, Abinôâ sawchapawpa, Thyu la, na patupazy sei ta a chhi teh!
“Laibâhpazy ta thatlôpazy siehnao ei ta, Abeipa phopi ta pasaiphazy ama pahnie.
“Amale liata thari a thlapa Epharai mo a zu ei ta, Hy Benzami, na chiheihzy ta ama cha pazi; Mâkhi tawhta ryureituhpazy a zu ei ta, Zebulawna tawhta pheisaih hyutuhpa chôchahrei a chabapazy amâ zu.
Iskâra chhituhpazy Debawrâ chhaota a vy ei ta, Iskâra cha Bâraka châta ngâ a chhih ta, A hnohta Saikao lâ ama sie. “Rubena phozy hry liata, A pachâpasiana thata a y.
Khazia mietaku sadôzy liata nâ tyuh thlâh haw? Mietaku zaw awna ramo pyu thei awpa ta ma? Rubena phozy hry liata, A pachâpasiana thata a y.
Kilia cha Zawdâh haosâ lâ y ta, Khazia Dânâ cha balyh liata a y thlâh haw? Asera cha tilaipi kiah liata a tyuh ta, A lihchakôpazy liata a pahrâ.
Zebulawna cha thina taihta a hrona a sokhâhpa phopi châ ta, Nâthalai chhao adyuhna su sâhpazy liata thina taihta â dyuh hra.
“Abeizy a vy ei ta, a dyuh ei ta, Kâna beizy ta Mekidô tizy kiah Tânâ liata amâ vaw dyuh; Hraona sôh lapa rai hnei veih ei.
Avâ tawhta awhsizy ta a zâ dyuh ei ta, Ama su tawhta Siserâ ama zâ dyuh.
Kisaw tily ta âmo cha phaoh ta, Chavah hlôpa, Kisaw tily ta a phaoh ha ei. Hy ei thlahpa, sie la, Thatlôpa ta sie lymâ mah y.
“Arâzy ta ama chakieh ta alei tu ei ta, Arâ chahrapazy a zaw ei ta amâ pathluah.
“Merô cha chhiesapa teh u,” Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa ta a tah; Abeipa bao awpa ta a vy leipa ei ta, Thatlôpazy adyuhna liata Abeipa bao awpa ta amâ vy leipa vâta, A khihsawzy cha thata chhiesapa teh u.
“Chanôzy hry liata Zaeli cha thlaochhi chai sala, Keni chyhsa Hebe lapinô cha, Poh o lia a pahrâpa chanôzy hry liata thlaochhi chai mawh sy!
Siserâ ta ti hiah ta, sâhpiti tlao pie ta; Beimachâ nyu ta sâhpiti kuapa a pie.
A ku râkha lâta poh o khaipâna pazapa ta, A chachâh lâta raihriatuhpa syulô chaba ta, Siserâ cha khai ta, A luh pakei ta, A siali liata a khaipahlie haw.
A phei thaby liata a bôhpa ta pao ta, Cha liata â zawh thlâh haw; A phei thaby liata a bôh ta, Â bôhna su liata pao ta, Cha liata a thi haw.
“Siserâ nô cha opy tawhta saipa ta, Samokaw tawhta chaphôhtu ta, ‘Khazia Siserâ talailih a vaw tlô to vei tly? Khazia a talailih pheizy a nainôsô tly i?’ tah ta.
Abeizuah so chaipazy ta a chhy ei ta, Hmeiseihta la, anosasyh ta tlao â chhypa a châ:

‘Hraona sôh hmô ei ta, Amâ rai ngâpa a châ aw, Mopakha ta laihsa pakha pano chyu ta amâ rai ngâpa a châ aw; Siserâ châta hraona poh rôh nypa, Hraona poh rôh nypa kikypa, Rao liata a ao awpa hraona poh rôh nypa kikypa cha, Siserâ châta zo no a châ aw,’” tah ta.

“Cha hawhna chata, Hy Abeipa, Na chariahpa zydua leidia khai ei sala, Na viasazy deikua cha, Noh hawhta khaih ei sala, Thatlôpa ta thyu mawh ei sy!” Chatanachata râh cha kô sypalih chhôh thlalôhpa ta y ta.
Izarei sawzy cha Abeipa mohmô ta moleina hmo tao heih ei ta. Chavâta Abeipa ta âmo cha Midia mo ku liata kô sari paysa ta.
Midia cha Izarei hlâta a thatlô via ta, Midia vâna chata Izarei sawzy cha tlâh liata khaohtlôzy, lôpuzy nata thokhyzy a tao ei ta.
Izarei ta chi a chei daihti maihta, Midia mo, Amale mo nata nochhi sawzy a vy ei ta, Izarei sawzy cha a dyuh tyh ei ta.
Ama kiapâh liata riehmo paryh ei ta, ama kôveizy cha Kâza taihta ama paraopa khai ha tyh. Izarei liata niedo rai pahlôh leipa ei ta, mietaku, viahchao nata alâ zy taihta ama lapa khai ha tyh.

Ama sahroh nata poh ozy chhaota vaw thyu tyh ei ta, khawsu tlu ta hluhpa ta vaw thyu ei ta, a chyhsa maluh nata ama râraoseihpazy cha rei tiah awpa chhao châ veih ei. A vy ei ta, râh cha roryhrapa ta ama so tyh.
Midia vâta Izarei cha riethei sipasa ngaitapa ta y ta. Chatawhcha Izarei sawzy ta Abeipa pado ei ta.
Izarei sawzy ta Midia mo vâta Abeipa ama pado nahta,

Abeipa ta Izarei sawzy hnohta hrohsopa vaw tuah ta. Hrohsopa chata ama hnohta, “ Abeipa Izarei Khazohpa ta hetana heta a tah: Izi râh tawhta châ chhi papua ei na ta, seichâna o tawhta ei châ chhi papua ei.
Izi mo ku tawhta nata nâmo châ tlybaipa zydua ku tawhta cha pachha ei na ta, nama hmiakô tawhta âmo cha papua na ta, ama râh ei cha pie ei.
Nama hnohta, ‘Kei he Abeipa nama Khazohpa ei châ. Ama râh nama pahrâpa liata Amawri mo khazohzy nama chi awpa châ vei,’ cha tah ei na ta. Châhrasala ei ao nathlie veih ei chi,” tah ta.

Chatawhcha Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa a vy ta, Ôpharâ khih liata ôkâ tho ry liata a tyuh ta. Cha ôkâ tho cha Abieze chi Zôasâ eih a châ. A sawchapawpa Kidia cha Midia mo ta ama hmô lei nawpa ta, kre saohna khaoh liata arulâta sâh tly ta.
Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa a hnohta a vaw luah ta, a hnohta, “Nâ, chyhsa thatlôpa nata riahphapa y, Abeipa na hnohta a y,” tah ta.

Kidia ta a hnohta, “Hy ei zibeipa, Abeipa eima hnohta a y tlôh khiahta cha, khazia ma he hawhpa hmo zydua he eima chô liata a vaw tlô tly? Miah pathlatuhpazy ta miah ama chho tyhpa, a hmo noâh taopa zydua kha khataih liata ma a y khai ha tly? ‘ Abeipa ta Izi râh tawhta miah â kaw chhi,’ tahpa ta miah chho ei ta, tahmâ cha Abeipa ta miah pathlua ha ta, Midia ku liata miah a hlâ ha he zaw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta a hnohta, “Na thatlôna ta sie la, Izarei he Midia ku tawhta pachha mah y. Kei tlai ta ei cha tuah hih” tah ta.

Kidia ta a hnohta, “Hy ei zibeipa, kheihta ma Izarei cha ei pachha thei aw? Moh tua, ei pho he Manase chi liata thatlô lei chaipa pho châ ta, keima tlai chhao he ei chhôhkha liata a nawh chaipa ei châ hih,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta a hnohta, “Na hnohta y aw na ta, Midia mo cha chyhsa pakha thiepa hawhta na thie khai aw ei,” tah ta.
Kidia ta a hnohta, “Tahmâ he na modypa ei châ khiahta cha, bie nâ chhotuhpa he nâma tlai na châ hmeiseih tahpa ngiana na pie teh.
Hmohlâpa vaw cheipa ta nâ lâ a vy aw na ta, na hmiakô liata ei soh hlâlei cha, ngiachhiepa ta he su tawhta a pasie khah y,” tah ta. Ano ta, “Nâ vy hlâlei ei vaw y thlâh ha aw,” tah ta.

Chatawhcha Kidia cha a o lâ vawh ta, mietaw pasyuh ta, viahdie kachu hmo kha ta thinô pahlao leipa viahchhâ tao ta. A sa cha hrâbyh liata khô ta, tihâh cha beih liata soh ta, ôkâ tho ry liata Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa lâ cha cheih ta, hlâ ta.
Khazohpa vâlyuhchâpa ta a hnohta, “Sa nata viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa kha la la, lôpanô chô liana heta soh la, a chô liata sa tihâh kha patlai thlu teh,” tah ta. Cha hawhna chata tao ta.

Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa ta a chôchahrei chabapa pawhmao ta sa nata viahchhâ cha kei saoh ta, lôpanô tawhta mei vaw pua ta, sa nata viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa cha a kâ khai haw. Chatawhcha Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa ta Kidia cha siesai ha ta.
Kidia ta Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa a châ tahpa pahno ha ta. Kidia ta, “Cha rimâ cha, Hy Abeipa Zehôvâh! Hmiachhypa ta Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa ei hmô ha he zaw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta a hnohta, “Na hnohta thlalôhna y mawh sy. Chi khah y, thi aw va chi,” tah ta.
Kidia ta cha su liata Abeipa châta maisâh tao ta, Zehôvâh Salom tahpa ta a moh a bi. Cha maisâh cha Abieze mo râh Ôpharâ khih liata tanoh taihta â duah thlâh haw.
Cha zâ liata Abeipa ta Kidia hnohta, “Na paw viahchao tôhpa la la, viahchao tôh hropa kô saripa chhao la la, na paw paduapa Bâlâ maisâh kha pacho la, a kiapâh liata Aseri tôh chhao thlu la,

he thokhy chô liana heta Abeipa na Khazohpa châta alô ta a pha kawpa ta paryhpa maisâh tao mah y. Chatawhcha viahchao tôhpa pô nona kha la la, Aseri tôh na thlupa tho hmâpa ta raopa hlâna ta hlâ mah y,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Kidia cha a chakaotuhpazy hry tawhta pahrawh a chhi ta, Abeipa ta a chhopa hawhta tao ta.
Khihpi chyhsazy mydi ta ama thyu nahta, Bâlâ maisâh cha cho ha ta, a kiapâh liata Aseri tôh chhao thlupa châ ta, maisâh paryhpa liata viahchao tôhpa pô nona hlâpa a châpa hmô ei ta.
“Ahy ma he hmo he a tao?” tahpa ta a hiahri ei ta. A phapa ta ama patluah khai nahta, “Zôasâ sawchapaw Kidia ta he hmo he a tao,” tah ei ta.
Chatawhcha khihpi chyhsazy ta Zôasâ hnohta, “Na sawchapawpa kha a vaw chhi teh, Bâlâ maisâh parao ta, a kiapâh liata Aseri tôh a thlupa vâta a thi awpa a châ,” tah ei ta.

Zôasâ ta ano a maochhietuhpa zydua hnohta, “Bâlâ cha namâ châhkhei tlai aw ma? Ano cha nama pachha aw ma? Ahy rai ano a châhkheipa maih my khihdei hlâta thiepa ama châ aw. A maisâh parao hapa châ ta, chavâta khazoh a châ khiahta cha, anosasyh ta a â duakhei mawh sy,” tah ta.
Cha noh tawhta Kidia cha “Zerubâlâ” tahpa ta awpa a châ. Cha cha, “Bâlâ ta Kidia cha a dyuh mawh sy,” tahna châ ta, Bâlâ maisâh a paraopa vâta, cha hawhta reipa a châ.
Chatawhcha Midia mo zydua, Amale mo nata nochhi chyhsazy a hmaohpakhy ei ta, Zawdâh chakapa ta, Zezari Saikao liata a rie ei ta.
Abeipa thlahpa cha Kidia chô liata vaw tlô ta. Chiahmie tô ta, Abieze pathlazy cha ano zi awpa ta awpapua ta.

Manase chi zydua hnohta chyhsazy tuah hra ta. Âmo chhao ano pazi awpa ta awpapuapa ama châ. Asera chi, Zebulawna chi nata Nâthalai chizy lâta chhao chyhsazy tuah ta, âmo chhao ta a vaw pahlyh hra ei ta.
Kidia ta Khazohpa hnohta, “Na reipa hawhta, ei ku ta Izarei na pachha awpa khiahta cha,
sawhri liata mietaku hmi soh aw na ta, mietaku hmi lia dei ta diati y sala, alei zydua deikua a hi khai khiahta cha, na reipa hawhta ei ku ta Izarei na pachha aw tahpa ei pahno aw,” tah ta.
Cha hawhna tlai chata vaw châ ta. A mylâ mydi kari ta thyu ta, mietaku hmi cha saoh ta, biebuh bie khaina taihta mietaku hmi liata diati cha vaw y ta.

Kidia ta Khazohpa hnohta, “Ei chô liata na hiehâh leipa la, eikhata bie bâh na pareisa heih mah y. Mietaku hmi ta pasia awpa eikhata na pasaih via mah y. Tahmâ cha mietaku hmi hi sala, alei zydua liata diati y mawh sy,” tah ta.
Cha hawhna tlai chata Khazohpa ta cha zâ liata tao ta. Mietaku hmi deita hi ta, alei chô zydua liata diati tla ta.
Zerubâlâ ama tahpa Kidia nata a hnohta a ypa zydua cha thyu patoh ei ta, Hârôdi chavah kiapâh liata a rie ei ta. Midia mo riehmo cha ama yna tawhta maw lâ Mawre tlâh kiapâh saikao liata y ta.
Abeipa ta Kidia hnohta, “Na hnohta a ypa chyhsazy kha ama ku liata Midia mo ei pie nawpa ta ama hluh tu haw. Chataleipatala Izarei ta, ‘Keima ku ta eina pachha’ tahpa ta einâ palai thlu pathlei aw.

Chavâta zawpi nah theina liata phuah la, ‘Ahy rai a chipa nata a chalyupa maih cha o lâ kua sala, Kilia tlâh tawhna heta a chatliepa ta sie mawh sy,’ tahpa ta reih teh,” tah ta. Zawpi hry tawhta 22,000 kua ei ta, 10,000 amâ ngua.

Abeipa ta Kidia hnohta, “Chyhsa ama hluh tu thlâh chy. Zawpizy kha chavah lâ zukhei la, cha liata kei ta ei cha pasiapa aw. ‘He chyhsa he na hnohta a sie aw,’ ei tahpa deita na hnohta sie aw ta, ‘He chyhsa he cha na hnohta sie aw vei,’ ei tahpa cha sie aw vei,” tah ta.

Chatanachata zawpizy cha chavah lâ zukhei ta. Abeipa ta Kiadia hnohta, “I hawhta a paleih ta ti a paliepa maih panano lymâ la, cha hawhna chata a pakhu paneih ta ti a dohpa maih panano hra teh” tah ta.
Ama ku ta ti li ei ta, a paliepa cha chyhsa 300 châ ei ta, ahropa zydua cha pakhu paneihpa ta ti a sypa ama châ.
Abeipa ta Kidia hnohta, “Ti a paliepa chyhsa 300 hmâpa ta cha pachha aw ei na ta, na ku liata Midia mo ei cha pie aw. Ahropa zydua cha ama o lâ chyu padisa khai teh,” tah ta.

Chatanachata Kidia ta chyhsa 300 pangua ta, Izarei chyhsa hropa zydua cha ama poh o lâ padisa khai ta. Chyhsa 300 chata zawpizy niedo nata chiahmiezy la ei ta. Midia mo riehmo cha ama nohdi saikao liata y ta.
Cha zâ ta Abeipa ta Kidia hnohta,“Thyu la, Midia mo riehmo za chho teh. Na ku liata ei cha pie haw.
Za chho awpa na chi khiahta deikua cha, châ chakaotuhpa Purâ kha a chhi la riehmo lâ cha zu mah y.

Ama biereipa thei aw chi ta, cha khai tawhta cha na ku thapatlôpa ta y aw ta, riehmo cha na za chho ngâh aw,” tah ta. Chatanachata Kidia cha a chakaotuhpa Purâ a chhi ta, pheisaihzy riehmo tytua chaipa lâ zu ta.

Midia mo, Amale mo nata nochhi chyhsa zydua cha khawsu hawh tlai ta hluhpa ta saikao liata vaw y ei ta. Ama râraoseihpazy cha rei tiah awpa châ leipa ta, tilaipi ngiahkâ liata sadi hawh tlai ta ama hluh.

Kidia a za tlô daihti cha, chyhsa pakha ta a viasa hnohta a mâ a vaw chho hai no châ ta. Cha chyhsa chata, “Pachâ tua, mâ sa na ta, bâli viahchhâ tlâ tlai cha Midia mo riehmo lâ he a zâ hluah lymâ ta, poh o za su ta, â theih lâta papao ta, poh o cha alei liata â chahyh thlâh haw,” tah ta.
A viasapa ta a chhy ta, “Cha cha hmo hropa châ vei. Izarei chyhsa Zôasâ sawchapawpa Kidia zaozi a châ chuh. Khazohpa ta Midia mo nata riehmo zydua he a ku liata a pie ha chuh,” tah ta.
Kidia ta mâ nata a chhopasiana cha a thei nahta, Khazohpa a chhy ta. Izarei riehmo lâ a lie ta, “Thyu teh u, Abeipa ta Midia pheisaihzy cha nama ku liata a cha pie ha ei,” tah ta.
A pheisaih 300 cha py thôh ta pachhaih ta, ama zydua ta chiahmie nata râchâ ruapazy chabasa chyu ta, râchâzy chhôh liata meirei soh ta.
Ama hnohta, “Na moh u la, ei taopa hawhta tao lymâ hra muh vy. Riehmo tytua chaipa ei tlô nahta, ei taopa hawhta tao hra muh vy.
Kei nata ei hnohta a ypazy ta chiahmie eima tô nahta, riehmo su toti tawhta chiahmie vaw tô hra aw ei chi ta, ‘ Abeipa nata Kidia châta’ tahpa ta nama vaw awh aw,” tah ta.
Kidia nata a hnohta a ypa chyhsa zakha cha, zâ riahvaina chhâh nona â thaona, riah ama vai pathao daihti liata riehmo tytuapa cha tlô ei ta. Chiahmie tô ei ta, râchâ ama chabapazy cha pakei ei ta.
Py thôh ta chiahmie tô ei ta, râchâzy pakei ei ta. Ama chavei lâta meirei chaba ei ta, ama chachâh lâta chiahmie tô awpa chaba ei ta. “ Abeipa nata Kidia Zaozi!” tahpa ta awh ei ta.
Chyhsa to riehmo chadôpa ta amâ duana su chyu liata a duah ei ta. Midia pheisaih zydua cha a râpai ei ta. Chipa ta awsâh laihna chôta a râ ei ta.

Kidia pheisaihzy ta chiahmie 300 ama tô nahta, Abeipa ta Midia pheisaih zydua cha âmo nata âmo pathyuhnaosa ta, zaozi ta a chhawh chaimâh ei ta. Zererâ lâchhâh ta a ypa Besitâ taihta a râpaipa ta, Tâbâ kiapâh ta a ypa Abemehôlâ râhri taihta a râpai ei ta.
Izarei sawzy cha Nâthalai, Asera nata Manase chizy tawhta awpakhy ei ta, Midia mo cha a chadai ei ta.

Kidia ta Epharai tlâh râh zydua lâ zikyu parâsa ta, ama hnohta, “Midia mo a zâ dyuh u la, Bebârâ taihta ti yna zydua la u la, Zawdâh chavah chhao la teh u,” tah ta. Chatanachata Epharai pathla zydua cha a hmaohpakhy ei ta, Bebârâ taihta ti yna zydua la ei ta, Zawdâh chavah chhao la ei ta.

Midia bei pano Ôrebâ nata Zibâ zy patu ei ta. Ôrebâ cha Ôrebâ lôpanô liata thie ei ta, Zibâ cha Zibâ kre saohna liata ama thie haw. Midia mo cha a chadai lymâ ei ta, Ôrebâ nata Zibâ luh cha Kidia yna Zawdâh haosâ lâ vaw phaoh ei ta.
Chatawhcha Epharai mo ta Kidia hnohta, “Khazia he hawhta eima chô liata na tao? Midia mo a dyuh awpa ta na sie nona kha khazia miah na hrua hra vei?” tah ei ta. Thata maochhie ei ta.
Kidia ta ama hnohta, “Nâmo hlâta khâpa ma ei tao via hlei? Epharai mo kre thei kâmo thohpa rakhapa hmahta Abieze mo kre thei lyupa zydua hlâta hluh via vei ma?
Khazohpa ta Midia bei Ôrebâ nata Zibâ zy nama ku liata cha pie ei ta, nâmo hlâta khâpa ma ei tao thei via hlei?” tah ta. Cha biezy a rei nahta, a chô liata ama hiehâhna dia ha ta.
Kidia nata a hnohta chyhsa 300 a ypazy cha Zawdâh chaka ei ta, ama thachhâ kaw ta. Châhrasala ama chariahzy cha a chadai lymâ ei ta.
Kidia ta Sukô mo hnohta, “Ngiachhiepa ta nâ zipa chyhsazy he viahchhâ tlâzy pie teh u, ama tha a chhâ ngaita hih. Midia bei Zebâ nata Zalmunâ ei chadai ei,” tah ta.
Châhrasala Sukô khih nôpawzy ta, “Khazia na pheisaihzy cha viahchhâ eima pie aw? Zebâ nata Zalmunâ cha na ku liata ama y ha ma?” tah ei ta.
Kidia ta, “A pha, Abeipa ta Zebâ nata Zalmunâ ei ku liata eina pie tita, râhchawhpa ahloh nata ahloh buhzy ta nama sapa ei cha hriechheih khai aw ei!” tah ta.
Cha tawhna chata Penia lâ sie ta, Sukô liata a reipa hawhta ama hnohta reih heih ta, Penia mo chhao ta Sukô mo achhyna hawh pyly ta a chhy ei ta.
Kidia ta Penia mo hnohta, “Thlalôhpa ta ei vaw lie tita, he o sâhpa he ei pacho aw,” tah ta.
Zebâ nata Zalmunâ cha, nochhi chyhsa pheisaih a thi bâhpa 15,000 chhaota Kakô liata y ei ta. Zaozi a chabapa pheisaih sai ta 120,000 ama thi hapa a châ.
Kidia cha Nôbâ nata Zôbehâ nochhi lâta poh o liata a pahrâpazy lâpi lâta khy ta, pheisaihzy cha a kaw dyuh ta. Pheisaihzy cha thlalôhpa ta vaw y thlâh ha ei ta.
Zebâ nata Zalmunâ cha a râ ei ta. Kidia ta âmo cha a chadai ta, Midia bei pano Zebâ nata Zalmunâ cha patu ta. Kidia ta Midia pheisaih zydua cha thata chalyusa ta.
Chatawhcha Zôasâ sawchapawpa Kidia cha adyuhna tawhta Here chakhâ lâpi lâta a vaw lie ta.
Sukô satlia pakha patu ta, bie hiahri ta. Satlia chata Sukô khih liata hyutuhpa nata machâ sysari nata pasari mohzy ropa ta.

Kidia cha Sukô mo lâ khy ta, ama hnohta, “Zebâ nata Zalmunâ he moh teh u, âmo kyh liata na pasipasawh ei chi ta, ‘Khazia na chyhsa thachhâpazy cha viahchhâ eima pie aw? Zebâ nata Zalmunâ cha na ku liata ama y ha ma?’ nama tahpazy kha ama châ hih,” tah ta.
Khihpi machâzy cha patu ta, râhchawhpa ahloh nata ahloh buhzy ta chheipa ta Sukô mo cha hrie ta.
Penia o sâhpa pacho ta, khihpi liata chyhsazy thie ta.
Chatawhcha Zebâ nata Zalmunâ hnohta, “Tabaw liata chyhsa nama thiepazy kha kheihawhpa chyhsazy ma ama châ?” tah ta. Âmo ta, “Nâma hawhpa he ama châ, abei saw lyuna ama hnei chyu,” tah ei ta.
Kidia ta, “Âmo kha ei unawh, ei nô sawchapawzy ama châ khawh. Abeipa hrona reipa ta ei reih, âmo kha vaw pahlôh ha u la cha, nâmo chhao ei cha thie lei awpa ei tlai,” tah ta.
A sawchapaw uhtheipa Zethe hnohta, “Thyu la, he chyhsazy he thie teh,” tah ta. Châhrasala satliapa dei a châ chypa vâta chi ta, a zaozi phia ngâh leipa ta.

Zebâ nata Zalmunâ ta, “Nâma tlai kha thyu la, miah vaw thie teh, chapawsaw thatlôpa na châ khawh,” tah ei ta. Kidia cha thyu ta, Zebâ nata Zalmunâ cha thie ta, ama râraoseihpazy rao liata tobina raopakyzy la ta.
Chatawhcha Izarei chyhsazy ta Kidia hnohta, “Eima chô liata ryureih mah y. Nâ nata na sawchapawpa nata na samohpa taihta ryureih lymâ teh u. Midia mo ku tawhta miah na pachha ha hih,” tah ei ta.
Kidia ta ama hnohta, “Kei ta nama chô liata ryureih leipa aw na ta, ei sawchapawpa chhao ta nama chô liata ryureih hra aw vei. Abeipa ta nama chô liata ryu tlao a reih aw,” tah ta.

Kidia ta ama hnohta, “Hmo miakha deikua ei châ haw khoh ei. Hraona hmo nama lapa tawhta rahyzy kha nama zydua ta na vaw pie teh u,” tah ta. Chariah ama hraopazy cha Ismela mo ama châpa vâta, ngôh rahy a hneipazy ama châ.
Âmo ta, “A ly kawpa ta eima cha pie aw,” tah ei ta. Poh phaw ei ta, chyhsa to ta rahy ama hraopazy cha vaw soh ei ta.
Kidia hnohta ngôh rahy ama piepa zydua cha sekel 1,700 a châ. Chazy hleikhô ta, raopakyzy, rahy bangiehpazy, Midia beizy a kypa chysia saihlawpazy nata ama râraoseihpa raopakyzy chhao â hlao.
Chatawhcha Kidia ta ngôh ta ephaw tao ta, ano khihpi Ôpharâ liata soh ta. Cha nothlahpa liana cha Izarei zydua ta sihryh ei ta, cha hmo cha Kidia nata a chhôhkha châta khoheih lâta â lie haw.
Midia cha Izarei sawzy hmiakô liata pahniepa ta y ta, ama luh pachhua thei khao veih ei. Chatanachata Kidia hro chhôh ta, râh cha kô sypalih chhôh thlalôhpa ta a y.
Zôasâ sawchapawpa Zerubâlâ cha sie ta, ano o liata kei pahrâ ta.
Kidia cha lapinô hluhpi a hneipa vâta, ano kalachhôh tawhta a puapa tlai sawchapaw sysari hnei ta.
Sekhe khih liata a nôtho chhao ta sawchapaw sapa hra ta, a moh Abimele a bi.
Zôasâ sawchapawpa Kidia cha chhâ palopa ta thi ta, Abieze mo khih Ôpharâ liata a paw Zôasâ thlâ liata ama pabu.
Kidia a thipa nahta, Izarei sawzy ta Abeipa cha tleisai heih ei ta. Bâlâzy liata sihryhpa ta, Bâlâberi cha ama khazoh ta tao ei ta.
Su to liata ama chariahzy ku tawhta âmo pachhatuhpa Abeipa ama Khazohpa cha Izarei sawzy ta a thei khao veih ei.
Zerubâlâ, Kidia ama tahpa khata, Izarei sawzy châta hmo phapa hluhpi vaw tao ta, châhrasala a chhôhkha chô liata phana ama palâsa awpa hawhta palâsa khao veih ei.
Zerubâlâ sawchapawpa Abimele cha a nô chhôhkhazy yna Sekhe lâ sie ta, a nô chhôhkhazy nata a nô phoheih zydua hnohta,

“Sekhe khih nôpaw zydua nah theina liata reih u la, ‘Nama châta kheihawhpa ma a pha via aw, Zerubâlâ sawchapaw sysaripa zydua ta nama chô liata ryu ama reih awpa ma, mopakha ta nama chô liata ryu a reih awpa maw?’ tah tua muh vy. Kei he nama rupa nata nama sapa ei châpa chhao a thei muh vy,” tah ta.

A nô chhôhkhazy ta Sekhe khih nôpaw zydua nah theina liata, cha bie zydua cha ano vyuhpa ta reih lymâ ei ta. Chatanachata ama palôhzy cha Abimele pazi khona lâta tliah ha ta, “Ano cha eima unawhpa mah a châ tâh,” tah ei ta.
Bâlâberi achhyna o liata a ypa tâkâ tlaw sysari Abimele pie ei ta. Abimele ta cha tâkâ cha hmâpa ta, chyhsa dyutlaileipa nata chhorupazy hrua ta, chazy chata ano cha pazi ei ta.

Ôpharâ khih liata a paw o lâ vawh ta, a unawh sysari, Zerubâlâ sawchapawzy cha lôpanô miakha chô liata thie khai ta. Zerubâlâ sawchapaw seihnai chaipa Zôthâ deikua cha, â nyu hapa vâta pahlôhpa a châ.
Chatawhcha Sekhe khih nôpaw zydua nata Bemilô khih nôpaw zydua a pahmaoh ei ta, vawh ei ta, Abimele cha Sekhe lôbô kiapâh ta ôkâ tho ry liata bei ta tao ei ta.

Cha cha Zôthâ ama chho nahta, khy ta Kerizi Tlâh laki liata a kaw duah ta, ao paro ngaitapa ta awh ta, ama hnohta, “Nâmo, Sekhe khih nôpawzy saih u, ei bie reipa he nathlie u la, Khazohpa ta a cha nathlie hra aw ei.
Ei kha cha thozy ta ama bei sathawthu awpa ta pua ei ta, ôli tho hnohta, ‘Eima bei châ mah y,’ tah ei ta.
Châhrasala ôli tho ta ama hnohta, ‘khazohzy nata chyhsazy palyupalihna châta hmâpa ei thaw he siesaipa ta vawh aw na ta ma, thozy chô liata zua ei kei chaneichanâ aw?’ tah ha ta.
Chatawhcha thozy ta theiku kô hnohta, ‘A vy la, eima bei vaw châ teh,’ tah ei ta.
Châhrasala theiku kô ta ama hnohta, ‘Ei thlôhna nata ei theilâ phapa he siesaipa ta vawh aw na ta ma, thozy chô liata zua ei kei chaneichanâ aw?’ tah ha ta.
Chatawhcha thozy ta kre zôh hnohta, ‘A vy la, eima bei vaw châ teh’ tah ei ta.
Kre zôh ta ama hnohta, ‘khazohzy nata chyhsazy a palysatuhpa ei kresawhti he siesaipa ta vawh aw na ta ma, thozy chô liata zua ei kei chaneichanâ aw?’ tah ha ta.
Chatawhcha tho zydua ta ahloh buh hnohta ‘A vy la, eima bei vaw châ teh’ tah ei ta.

Ahloh buh ta thozy hnohta, ‘Palôh hmeiseihpa ta nama bei châta sathaw eina thu tlai khiah ei chi ta cha, a vy u la, ei nohdi liata a vaw pahâ teh u. Cha hawhta a châ vei khiahta deikua cha, ahloh buh tawhta mei vaw pua sala, Lebanaw sidy thozy cha kâ khai mawh sy,’ tah ta.

“Chavâta tahmâ Abimele bei ta nama taopa he palôh hmeiseihpa nata sia ngaitapa ta a taopa châ u la, Zerubâlâ nata a chhôhkhazy chô liata a phapa ta taopa ta, a hmotaopa nata â phuhpa ta a chô liata nama taopa a châ khiahta cha, a pha.
Ei paw ta chariah châ dyuhpa ei ta, a hrona sokhâhpa ta Midia ku tawhta a cha pachha ei.

Châhrasala tanoh ei paw chhôhkhazy cha thyuhnao ei chi ta, a sawchapaw sysari po lôpanô miakha chô liata thie ei chi ta, a seichanô sawchapawpa Abimele cha Sekhe nôpawzy chô liata bei ta nama tao. Nama unawhpa a châpa vâta cha hawhta nama taopa a châ.
Tanoh he Zerubâlâ nata a chhôhkha­zy chô liata palôh hmeiseihpa nata sia ngaitapa ta a taopa nama châ khiahta cha, Abimele chô liata a ly teh u, ano chhao nama chô liata a ly mawh sy.

Cha hawhta a châ vei khiahta deikua cha, Abimele tawhta mei vaw pua sala, Sekhe nata Bemilô khih nôpawzy kâsao khai mawh sy. Sekhe nata Bemilô khih nôpawzy tawhta mei vaw pua sala, Abimele kâsao mawh sy,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Zôthâ cha a unawhpa Abimele a chipa vâta Berâ khih lâ a râ ta, cha liata pahrâ ta.
Abimele cha Izarei chô liata kô thôh ryureih ta.
Khazohpa ta Abimele nata Sekhe khih nôpawzy likah liata thlahpa chhiepa vaw tuah ta. Sekhe khih nôpawzy ta Abimele chô liata piehpie ngaitapa ta hmo tao ei ta.

Cha hmo cha Zerubâlâ sawchapaw sysarizy chô liata nôchhie ngaitapa ta ama taopa kha âmo chô liata palie thlusapa ta, ama thisaih maoh cha âmo a thietuhpa ama unawhpa Abimele chô liata paphaosa ta, a unawhzy thie awpa ta a ku tha a patlôtuhpa Sekhe mo chô liata chhao paphaosapa ta a y thei nawpa ta taopa a châ.
Chatanachata Sekhe khih nôpawzy ta arulâta Abimele a byh awpa ta tlâh lakizy liata chyhsazy soh ei ta. Cha lâpi lâ tawhta âmo a vaw chapiapa maih ama hrao lymâ. Cha kyh cha Abimele chhopa châ ta.
Ebe sawchapawpa Kalâ cha a unawhzy chhaota vaw thyu ta, Sekhe lâ sie ei ta. Sekhe khih nôpawzy ta ano cha ngâ kaw ei ta.
Lyu lâ sie ei ta, ama kre sadôzy liata kre theizy lyu ei ta, tly ei ta. Kyhchhi tao ei ta, ama khazoh o liata a ngiapa ta, niedoh ei ta, Abimele cha reipachhie ei ta.

Ebe sawchapawpa Kalâ ta, “Abimele cha ahy ma châ ta, keimo Sekhe mo pi he ahyzy ma eima châ tly? Khazia ano cha zua eima chakao aw? Ano cha Zerubâlâ sawchapawpa tlâ châ vei ma? Zebula chhao he ano ta hyutuhpa ta a taopa châ vei ma? Sekhe paw Hamô chyhsazy chakao hri teh u. Khazia ano cha eima chakao aw?
He chyhsazy he ei ku ry liata a ypa châ ei sala ei tah kaw dia! Abimele he ei pabâh ha awpa tlai! Abimele hnohta, ‘Na pheisaih pakhy via la vaw thyu teh,’ ei tah awpa tlai,” tah ta.
Khihpi ryureituhpa Zebula ta Ebe sawchapawpa Kalâ bie reipa cha a thei nahta, a hiehâh ngaita ta.
Zikyurâtuhpazy Abimele lâ arulâta tuah ta, a hnohta, “Pachâ teh, Ebe sawchapawpa Kalâ nata a unawhzy Sekhe lâ a vy ei ta, châ dyuh awpa ta khihpi ama pasyu.
Chavâta nâ nata na hnohta a ypa chyhsazy azo ta thyu u la, lyu liata a byh teh u.

My noh a vaw chhipa nahta, thyu patoh aw chi ta, khihpi he na vaw siehnao aw. Ano nata a hnohta a ypa chyhsazy châ dyuh awpa ta vaw pua aw ei ta, na ku ta tao awpa a hmôpa lymâ hawhta ama chô liata vaw tao mah y,” tah ta.
Abimele nata a hnohta a ypa chyhsazy cha azo ta thyu ei ta, py palih ta a pachhaihpa ta Sekhe khih kiapâh liata a nyu ei ta.
Ebe sawchapawpa Kalâ cha kei pua ta, khihpi angiana thokhy chhikao liata a kei duah ta. Abimele nata a hnohta a ypa chyhsazy cha amâ nyuna su tawhta kaw thyu ei ta.
Kalâ ta chyhsazy cha a hmô nahta, Zebula hnohta, “Moh tua, tlâh laki tawhta chyhsazy amâ zu khi,” tah ta. Zebula ta a hnohta, “Tlâhzy nohpahlipa hao na chyhsapazy hawhta na hmôpa a châ aw,” tah ta.
Kalâ ta, “Moh châh chi, râh liah khophie tawhta chyhsazy amâ zu hao zaw. Py khapa chhochhi cha Môneni ôkâ tho lâpi lâ tawhta amâ vy huh,” tah ta.

Zebula ta a hnohta, “Abimele cha ahy ma a châ tly? Khazia ano cha eima chakao aw, na tah vei ma kha? Tahmâ he na pakah khataih lâ a vaw haw? Âmo cha na mohnao kawpa phopi kha châ veih ei ma? Tahmâ pua la, a kei dyuh châh chi,” tah ta.
Kalâ cha pua ta, Sekhe nôpawzy hmia lâta sie ta, Abimele cha a kei dyuh ta.
Abimele ta a vaw chadai ta, Kalâ cha a râ ta. Khihpi angiana chhikao tlôna taihta chyhsa hluhpi hmah phaopa ta pao ei ta.
Abimele cha Arumâ khih liata pahrâ ta. Zebula ta Kalâ nata a unawhzy cha Sekhe khih liata y thei lei awpa ta a papua khai ha ei.
A mylâ ta, chyhsazy cha lyu lâ sie ei ta. Cha cha Abimele chho ei ta.
A chyhsazy a chhi ta, py thôh ta pachhaihpa ta, lyuzy liana cha a byh ei ta. Abimele cha mohmia pasaih ta, chyhsazy khihpi tawhta ama vaw puapa hmô ta. Thyu ta, âmo cha a dyuh ta, thie ta.
Abimele nata a hnohta a ypa py cha hmia lâ a râ ei ta, khihpi angiana thokhy chhikao liata a kei duah ei ta. Cha nota, py nopazy ta lyu liata a ypa zydua a râhnao ei ta, thie ei ta.
Cha noh ta, Abimele ta khihpi cha noh y ta a dyuh ta. Khihpi cha la ta, a khihsawzy thie ta. Khihpi cha tlokhuh parao ta, alôh a hie thlu haw.
Sekhe o sâhpa liata a ypa chhituhpa zydua ta, cha kyh cha ama thei nahta, Elberi achhyna o thokhy chhôh lâ a ngia ei ta.
Chhituhpa zydua Sekhe o sâhpa liata ama y pakhypa kyh Abimele chho ei ta.

Abimele nata a hnohta a ypa chyhsa zydua Zalmaw Tlâh lâ kiah ei ta. Abimele cha ahrei a chei ta, thopahrei ty kha pakhy ta, chalo ta a ngiatlâh ta a pia ta. A hnohta a ypa chyhsazy hnohta, “Ei taozie he hmô ei chi ta, ei taopa hawhna heta nâmo chhao tao para teh u,” tah ta.

Cha hawhna chata ama zydua ta thopahrei pakhy chyu ei ta. Abimele cha pazi ei ta, thokhy cha thopahrei pacho thlu ei ta. Thokhy chhôh liata a ypazy cha ama chô lâ tawhta mei ta rao thlu ei ta. Sekhe o sâhpa liata chyhsa zydua thi khai ei ta, chapaw nata chanô sâh kha rachhôh ama châ.
Chatawhcha Abimele cha Thebe lâ sie ta, Thebe khihpi cha dôh ta, la ta.
Khihpi chhôh liata o sâhpa a icha kawpa y ta. Khihpi liata chapaw nata chanô zydua nata khih nôpawpa zydua ta cha lâ cha a râ ei ta. A khawhlôh ei ta, o sâhpa vâphuh lâ kiah ei ta.
Abimele cha o sâhpa lâ vawh ta, a dyuh ta, mei ta rao awpa ta o sâhpa chhikao a kei hnia ta.
Chanô pakha ta sâh chariehna lô Abimele luh liata za pathla thlu ta, a luh rupa kei ha ta.

A chariah chhaichhi chabatuhpa satliapa aw para ta, a hnohta, “Na zaozi kha phia la na vaw thie teh, chyhsa ta, ‘Chanô ta na a thie,’ eina tah pathlei aw ei na,” tah ta. Satliapa ta Abimele cha zaozi a puapahliena taihta vieh ta, thi ha ta.
Izarei chyhsazy ta Abimele a thi haw tahpa ama pahno nahta, ama zydua ta ama o lâ chyu a di ha ei ta.
Abimele ta a unawh sysarizy thie ta, a paw chô liata a hmotaopa moleina kha, Khazohpa ta cha hawhna chata viari a thô hapa a châ.
Sekhe chyhsazy moleina zydua chhao, Khazohpa ta viari thôpa ta ama luh chô liata palie thlusa ta, Zerubâlâ sawchapawpa Zôthâ chhiesana ama chô liata a vaw tlô hapa a châ.
