Adôniza cha mietakuzy, viahchao tôhpazy nata sahroh dawpa pathawhpazy ta Erôke chheipâh ta a ypa Zôhele Lô liata atheihna hlâ ta. Abei sawchapawpa a unawhpa zydua nata Zudâh râh liata beimachâ zydua hrua khai ta.
Châhrasala hrohsopa Nâthâ, Benai, pasaiphazy nata a unawhpa Sawlawmaw deikua cha hrua leipa ta.
Nâthâ ta Sawlawmaw nô Bâsebâ hnohta, “Haki sawchapawpa Adôniza cha abei châ ha ta, cha kyh cha eima zibeipa Dâvi ta a pahno leipa kyh thei va chi ma?
Tahmâ a vy teh, nâ nata na sawchapawpa Sawlawmaw hrona a boh nawpa ta pachâna ei cha pie aw.

Bei Dâvi lâ thlai a kei ngia la, a hnohta, ‘Hy ei zibeipa abei y, châ chakaotuhnô hnohna heta, “Na sawchapawpa Sawlawmaw he keima hnôhlâ ta bei vaw châ aw ta, ano he ei beidyuchhai liata a tyuh awpa a châ,” tahpa ta bie nâ taih ha va chi ma? Khazia Adôniza cha bei a châ ha tly?’ kei tah mah y.
Abei bie na chho hai nota kei chhao a vaw ngia aw na ta, na biezy ei vaw pa-i aw,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Bâsebâ cha abei lâ vawh ta, a chhôhpadâhpa liata a kei ngia ta. Abei cha a machâ kaw bâpa vâta, Sunâ zuah Abisâ ta abei cha chakao ta.
Bâsebâ ta abei cha a bôhpa ta a naoh ta, abei ta, “Khâpa na khoh?” vaw tah ta.

Bâsebâ ta, “Ei zibeipa y, Abeipa na Khazohpa moh reipa ta châ chakaotuhnô hnohna heta, ‘Na sawchapawpa Sawlawmaw he keima hnôhlâ ta bei vaw châ aw ta, ano he ei beidyuchhai liata a tyuh awpa a châ,’ tahpa ta bie nâ taih chi ta.
Tahmâ pachâ tua, Adôniza ta tlao â bei haw. He kyh he ei zibeipa abei ta pahno ngyu va chi.
Viahchao tôhpazy, sahroh dawpa pathawhpazy nata mietakuzy thata thie ta, abei sawchapawpa zydua hrua ta, pheisaih hyutuhpa Zôabâ chhao hrua ta, châ chakaotuhpa Sawlawmaw deikua cha hrua vei.
Ei zibeipa abei y, ei zibeipa abei hnôhlâ ta na beidyuchhai liata a tyuh awpa ahy ma a châ aw tahpa na rei awpa hâpa ta, Izarei zydua ta ama cha mokhâh thlâh haw.

Chataleipatala he hawhta a vaw châ pathlei aw na. Ei zibeipa abei he ano a pathlatuhpazy hnohta â mô tita cha, kei nata ei sawchapawpa Sawlawmaw he hmoparaotuhpazy hawhta pachâpa eima châ aw,” tah ta.
Bâsebâ ta abei hnohta bie a rei hai nota, hrohsopa Nâthâ a kei ngia ta.
Abei hnohta, “Hrohsopa Nâthâ â vy,” tahpa ta chho ei ta. Nâthâ cha abei hmiakô a kei tlô nahta, abei hmiakô liata a hmia alei lâ a khupa ta a bôh ta.
Nâthâ ta, “Hy ei zibeipa abei y, ‘Keima hnôhlâ ta Adôniza he a bei aw ta, ano he ei beidyuchhai liata a tyuh awpa a châ,’ na tah ma?

Tanoh zu ta, viahchao tôhpazy, sahroh dawpa pathawhpazy nata mietaku­zy thata thie ta, abei sawchapawpa zydua nata pheisaih hyutuhpazy nata theihthaipa Abiathâ zy hrua ta. Adôniza hmiakô liata niepa ta doh ei ta, ‘Bei Adôniza hroh pareih mawh sy!’ ama tah.
Châ chakaotuhpa keima, theihthaipa Za­dô, Zehôdâ sawchapawpa Benai nata châ chakaotuhpa Sawlawmaw zy deikua cha miah hrua vei.

He hmo he ei zibeipa abei hmo taopa a châ tlôh khiahta cha, ano hnôhlâ ta ei zibeipa beidyuchhai liata ahy ma a tyuh aw tahpa kyh liata, châ chakaotuhpazy he miah na vaw chho beih leipa ma a châ ha tly?” tah ta.
Bei Dâvi ta a chhy ta, “Bâsebâ na awpa teh u,” tah ta. Bâsebâ cha abei yna lâ vawh ta, a hmiakô liata a kei duah ta.
Abei ta Bâsebâ cha bie a taih ta, a hnohta, “Nôpona zydua liata ei thlahpa a chatlaituhpa Abeipa moh reipa ta ei reih,

Abeipa Izarei Khazohpa moh ta, ‘Na sawchapawpa Sawlawmaw cha keima hnôhlâ ta a vaw bei aw ta, keima vyuhpa ta ei beidyuchhai liata a tyuh awpa a châ,’ tahpa ta bie ei châ taih hapa hawhna khata, tanoh he ei tao tlai aw,” tah ta.
Bâsebâ cha a hmia alei lâ a khupa ta a bôh ta, abei cha a naoh ta, a hnohta, “Ei zibeipa Bei Dâvi cha chhâzaw ta hroh mawh sy!” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Bei Dâvi ta, “Theihthaipa Zadô nata hrohsopa Nâthâ nata Zehôdâ sawchapawpa Benai zy na awpa teh u,” tah ta. Chatanachata abei hmiakô lâ a vy ei ta.
Abei ta ama hnohta, “Nama zibeipa chakaotuhpazy a chhi u la, ei sawchapawpa Sawlawmaw cha keima alâ chô liata pakiasa u la, Kihaw lâ a chhi teh u.
Cha liata, theihthaipa Zadô nata hrohsopa Nâthâ ta Izarei bei châta sathaw za thu mawh ei sy. Cha khai tawhta chiahmie tô aw ei chi ta,, ‘Bei Sawlawmaw hroh pareih mawh sy!’ nama tah aw.
Ano cha kaw pazi aw ei chi ta, a khy aw ta, ei beidyuchhai liata a tyuh aw ta, keima vyuhpa ta bei a châ aw. Izarei nata Zudâh chô liata ryureituhpa ta ano cha ei rao haw,” tah ta.
Zehôdâ sawchapawpa Benai ta abei cha a chhy ta, “Amen! Abeipa, ei zibeipa Khazohpa ta reih tlai mawh sy.
Abeipa ta ei zibeipa abei cha a ypâ tyhpa hawhna khata, Sawlawmaw hnohta chhao y lymâ sala, a beidyuchhai cha ei zibeipa Dâvi beidyuchhai hlâta parônahsa via mawh sy,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha theihthaipa Zadô, hrohsopa Nâthâ, Zehôdâ sawchapaw­pa Benai, Khere mo nata Pele mozy cha zu ei ta, Dâvi alâ chô liata Sawlawmaw cha pakiasa ei ta, Kihaw lâ a chhi ei ta.
Cha liata, theihthaipa Zadô ta poh o lâ saki sathaw ôh kei la ta, Sawlawmaw cha sathawthu ta. Chiahmie tô ei ta, zawpizy ta, “Bei Sawlawmaw hroh pareih mawh sy!” tah ei ta.
Zawpi zydua ta ano cha kaw pazi ei ta, ramozy tô ei ta, alei â patlaw khai ha khiah ma tah ngâna taihta a ly ngaitapa ta thata awh ei ta.

Ama kyhchhi a pai nahta, Adôniza nata a hruapa sahlao a hnohta a ypa zydua ta pyu cha thei ei ta. Chiahmie pyu a thei nahta, Zôabâ ta, “Khihpi chhôh liata pyu kalihpi to ngâpa cha khâpa pyu ma a châ tly?” tah ta.
Bie a rei hai no tlai chata, moh teh u, theihthaipa Abiathâ sawchapawpa Zawnathâ za tlô ta. Adôniza ta, “A vy tua, nâ cha chyhsa siapa châ chi ta, thâtih phapa na za tlôkhei thlyu na,” tah ta.
Zawnathâ ta a chhy ta, Adôniza hnohta, “Thâtihpha za tlôkhei va na, eima zibeipa Bei Dâvi ta Sawlawmaw cha bei ta a tao haw.
Theihthaipa Zadô, hrohsopa Nâthâ, Zehôdâ sawchapawpa Benai, Khere mo nata Pele mozy cha abei ta Sawlawmaw hnohta pasiesa ta, abei alâ chô liata pakiasa ei ta,

theihthaipa Zadô nata hrohsopa Nâthâ ta Sawlawmaw cha bei châta Kihaw liata sathaw ama thu haw. Cha su tawhta thapha ngaitapa ta khy ei ta, cha chata khihpi chhôh a khaipalie ngâ kawpa a châ. Cha cha a pyu nama theipa cha a châ.
Sawlawmaw cha khinarâh beidyuchhai liata â tyuh haw.

Cha dei châ vei, bei chakaotuhpazy a vy ei ta, eima zibeipa Bei Dâvi cha a vaw lykhei ei ta, ‘Na Khazohpa ta Sawlawmaw moh cha nâma moh hlâta pathâhsa via sala, a beidyuchhai cha nâma beidyuchhai hlâta parônahsa via mawh sy,’ ama tah. Abei chhao ta a rakhô liata a bôhpa ta â naoh ei.
Chatawhcha abei ta, ‘ Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa cha reithaipa ta y mawh sy! Ei beidyuchhai liata a tyuh awpa tanoh rao ha ta, ei mo tlai ta ei hmô haw,’ tahpa ta a rei pâ cheingei,” tah ta.
Adôniza hruapa chyhsa zydua cha a chalyu ei ta, thyu ei ta, ama lâpi chyu lâta sie khai ha ei ta.
Adôniza chhao ta Sawlawmaw cha chi ngaita ta, thyu ta, sie ta, maisâh kizy kei patu ta?

Sawlawmaw hnohta, “Adôniza ta Bei Sawlawmaw cha chi ta, chavâta maisâh kizy patu ta, ‘Bei Sawlawmaw ta a chakaotuhpa he zaozi ta thie lei awpa ta bie nâ taih ha tua mawh sy,’ a tah,” tahpa ta chho ei ta.
Sawlawmaw ta, “Chyhsa ngâchhihpa a châpa a palâsa khiahta cha, a sâbu miakha chhao alei liata tla aw vei. Paraona ano liata hmôpa a châ khiahta deikua cha a thi aw,” tah ta.
Bei Sawlawmaw ta chyhsa tuah ta, Adôniza cha maisâh tawhta a zâ chhi ei ta. Adôniza cha a vy ta, Bei Sawlawmaw cha a naoh ta, Sawlawmaw ta a hnohta, “Na o lâ a di mah y,” tah ta.
Dâvi cha a thi nawpa daihti a hnia ha ta. A sawchapawpa Sawlawmaw cha biepie ta, a hnohta,
“Khizaw ryhpa hawhta, kei chhao ei sie nawpa daihti â hnia haw. Thatlôpa ta y la, chapawsaw kawpa ta y mah y.

Na hmotaopa maih nata nâ heina lâ maihta thlaochhipa ta na y lymâ thei nawpa ta, Mawsi Ryhpa liata ropa hawhta, Abeipa na Khazohpa ta bie a cha piepazy a pyh la, a lâpizy a chhih la, a bieraopazy, a biepiepazy, a ryhpazy nata a pahnokheinazy zyh mah y.

Chatanachata Abeipa ta keima kyh liata, ‘Na pathlazy ta ama lâpi pakhâta ta pachâ ei sala, ama pathipalôh tlokhuh ta nata ama thlahpa tlokhuh ta ei hmiakô liata ngâchhihpa ta ama y khiahta cha, Izarei beidyuchhai liata a tyuh awpa chie aw veih ei,’ tahpa ta a reipa kha a pa-i aw.

“Zeru sawchapawpa Zôabâ ta ei chô liata a hmotaopa kha na pahno: Izarei pheisaihzy hyutuhpa pano, Nerâ sawchapawpa Abane nata Zethe sawchapawpa Amâsâ zy chô liata a hmotaopa kha na pahno. Âmo kha thie ta, adyuhna liata thisaih palopa cha adyhna daihti liata phuh la ta, thaileina a hnei leipa thisaih cha a chai liata chaisaih nata a phei liata pheikyzy liata a kia hapa kha a châ.
Chavâta na sona hmâh la, pha na tahzie hawhta tao mah y, a luh pawhpa cha thlalôhpa ta Athihkhih lâ pasiesa khah y.

Kilia chyhsa Bâzilai sawchapawzy chô liata deikua cha ngiachhiena palâsa la, âmo cha na tlâhkhai liata pati a dôhtuhpa hry liata pahlao hra mah y. Na unawhpa Absalaw tawhta ei râ nona khata, âmo cha thapasa ngaitapa ta keima lâ a vypazy ama châ.

Bahuri khihpa Benzami pathla Kerâ sawchapawpa Simei chhao na hnohta y ta, ano cha Mâhanai lâ ei sie noh ta chhiesana pha lei ngaitapa ta chhie nâ sapatuhpa a châ. Na dy awpa ta Zawdâh lâ â zu nota, ‘Zaozi ta cha thie aw va na,’ tahpa ta Abeipa moh ta bie a taih na ta.

Châhrasala ano cha thaileina a hnei leipa hawhta na pachâ awpa châ vei. Chyhsa sopa châ chi ta, a chô liata na tao awpa na pahno aw. A luh pawhpa cha thisaih chhaota Athihkhih lâ na pasiesa awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Dâvi cha a pathlatuhpazy hnohta a mô ta, Dâvi khihpi liata pabu ha ei ta.
Izarei chô liata Dâvi â beina kô zydua cha kô sypalih a châ. Hebraw liata kô sari a bei ta, Zerusale liata kô sythôh nata kô thôh â bei.
Chatanachata Sawlawmaw cha a paw Dâvi beidyuchhai liata a tyuh ta, â khinarâh chhao liahsa pa-ipa a châ.
Haki sawchapawpa Adôniza cha Sawlawmaw nô Bâsebâ lâ vawh ta. Bâsebâ ta, “Phana kyh lâta a vypa na châ ma?” tah ta. Adôniza ta, “Phana kyh a châ,” tah ta.
Adôniza ta, “Na hnohta bie rei awpa ei hnei,” tah ta. Bâsebâ ta, “Reih teh,” tah ta.

Adôniza ta, “Abeinarâh he keima eih châ ta, Izarei zydua chhao ta kei he bei châ awpa ta ama hnabeiseihpa ei châpa na pahno. Châhrasala khinarâh cha Abeipa ta ei unawhpa châta a rao hapa vaw châ palie ta, chavâta ei unawhpa eih a châ hapa he a châ.
Tahmâ he hmo miakha cha hia awpa hnei na ta, rie na ei khah y,” tah ta. Bâsebâ ta, “Reih teh,” tah ta.
Adôniza ta, “Sunâ zuah Abisâ he ei lapinô châta na pie awpa ta, ngiachhiepa ta Bei Sawlawmaw na chhopa mah y, nâma bie cha paryhsa leipa ta y aw vei,” tah ta.
Bâsebâ ta, “A pha na, abei cha ei cha chhopa aw,” tah ta.

Bâsebâ cha Adôniza hmo hiapa chhopa awpa ta Bei Sawlawmaw lâ vawh ta. Abei cha kaw thyu ta, a nô cha a vaw ly ta, a hmiakô liata a bôh ta. A beidyuchhai liata a tyuh heih ta, abei nô châta dyuchhai palasa ta, Bâsebâ cha abei chachâh lâta a tyuh ta.
Bâsebâ ta, “Hmo chynawh kawpa miakha cha hia awpa hnei na ta, paryhsa leipa ta y khah y,” tah ta. Abei ta a hnohta, “Hiah mah y, ei nô, paryhsa leipa ta y aw va na,” tah ta.
Bâsebâ ta, “Sunâ zuah Abisâ he na unawhpa Adôni­zah pie la, a lapinô ta pahneisa mah y,” tah ta.

Bei Sawlawmaw ta a nô cha a chhy ta, a hnohta, “Kheihtazie ta ma Sunâ zuah Abisâ cha Adôniza châta na vaw hia thlâh haw? Adôniza cha bei pachâsa awpa ta hiapa lâlao châh chi, ano cha ei uhta a châpa he! Theihthaipa Abiathâ nata Zeru sawchapawpa Zôabâ zy chhao ano chhâh a châhpa ama châpa kha,” tah ta.
Bei Sawlawmaw cha Abeipa moh ta bie a taih ta, “He bie vâna heta Adôniza hrona he pahleipa a châ leipa khiahta cha, Khazohpa ta ei chô liata tao sala, cha hlâta pasa viapa chhao ta tao mawh sy!
A bietai hawhta na padua ta, ei paw Dâvi beidyuchhai liata na patyusa ta, phopi ta nâ paduatuhpa Abeipa hrona reipa ta ei reih. Adôniza he tanoh tlai heta thie awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Bei Sawlawmaw ta Zehôdâ sawchapawpa Benai tuah ta, ano ta Adôniza cha chhawh ta, thi ha ta.

Abei ta theihthaipa Abiathâ hnoh­ta, “Anathô khih liata na o lâ a di teh. A thi tlâh châ chi ta, châhrasala ei paw Dâvi hmiakô liata Abeipa Zehôvâh Byh a sy tyhpa na châpa vâta nata ei paw rietheitaona zydua liata a vaw taokhei tyhpa na châpa vâta, tahmâ la cha thie mâh aw va na,” tah ta.
Sawlawmaw ta Abiathâ cha Abeipa theihthaipa a châna pabâh ta, chatanachata Abeipa ta Eli chhôhkha kyh Silô liata a reipa kha a vaw tlôpa a châ.
Cha thâtihzy cha Zôabâ ta a vaw thei nahta, Abeipa poh o lâ a râ ta, maisâh kizy kei patu ta. Zôabâ heta Absalaw kha cha a chhâh â châh lei tarawpa ta, Adôniza chhâh deikua cha a châh ta.

Bei Sawlawmaw hnohta, “Zôabâ cha Abeipa poh o lâ a râ ta, maisâh thaby liata a y thlâh ha,” tahpa ta chho ei ta. Sawlawmaw ta Zehôdâ sawchapawpa Benai tuah ta, a hnohta, “Khy la, kaw thie teh,” tah ta.

Benai cha Abeipa poh o lâ khy ta, Zôabâ hnohta, “Abei ta bie a cha pie, kaw pua teh,” tah ta. Zôabâ ta, “Kaw pua aw va na, he liata tlâ ei thi aw,” tah ta. Benai cha abei lâ vawh ta, a hnohta, “Zôabâ ta hetana heta tah ta, hetana heta einâ chhy,” tah ta.
Abei ta a hnohta, “A reipa hawhna chata kaw tao la, thie la, pabu mah y. Chatanachata a chhâpa y leipa ta Zôabâ ta thisaih a palona tawhna khata, kei nata ei paw chhôhkha na pathaisapa a châ aw.

Ano hlâta chyhsa sia viapa nata pha viapa pano, Nerâ sawchapawpa Izarei pheisaih hyutuhpa Abane nata Zethe sawchapaw­pa Zudâh pheisaih hyutuhpa Amâsâ zy kha, ei paw Dâvi pahno leipa ta thyuhnao ta, zaozi ta a thiepa vâ ei ta, thisaih a palona maoh cha Abeipa ta ano luh chô liata a vaw palie thlu aw.

Ama thisaih maoh cha Zôabâ luh chô liata nata a pathlazy luh chô liata chhâzaw ta a lie thlu aw ta, Dâvi nata a pathlazy chô liata nata a o nata a beidyuchhai chô liata deikua cha, Abeipa tawhta thlalôhna tlyzaw ta a y thlâh ha aw,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Zehôdâ saw­chapawpa Benai cha khy ta, Zôabâ cha chhawh ta, thie ta, râhchawhpa liata a o liata ama pabu haw.
Abei ta Zehôdâ sawchapawpa Benai cha, Zôabâ vyuhpa ta pheisaih hyutuhpa ta soh ta, abei ta Zadô cha Abiathâ vyuhpa ta theihthaipa ta a tao.
Abei ta Simei kei paawsa ta, a hnohta, “Zerusale liana heta o a sa la, cha liata pahrâ mah y. Cha tawhtapa cha khataih lâ hmahta na pua awpa châ vei.
Na pua noh, Kidaraw chavah na chaka noh cha, na thi noh a châ aw tahpa pahno mah y. Na thisaih cha nâma luh chô liata a y aw,” tah ta.
Simei ta abei hnohta, “Na reipa cha a pha na, ei zibeipa abei reipa hawh tlai ta, châ chakaotuhpa heta a tao lymâ aw,” tah ta. Simei cha Zerusale liata noh hluhpi y ta.
Kô thôh a tloh nahta, Simei seizy hry liata pano cha Mâkâ sawchapawpa Kâthâ bei Akisâ lâ a râ ha ei ta. Simei hnohta, “Na seizy cha Kâthâ liata ama y,” tahpa ta chho ei ta.
Simei cha thyu ta, alâ ky padia ta, a seizy tlua awpa ta Kâthâ bei Akisâ lâ cha sie ta. Simei cha sie ta, a seizy cha Kâthâ tawhta a vaw liekhei ta.
Simei cha Zerusale tawhta Kâthâ lâ sie ta, â vaw lie haw, tahpa ta Sawlawmaw cha chho ei ta.

Abei ta chyhsa tuah ta, Simei cha kei paawsa ta, a hnohta, “‘Na pua noh, khataih su lâ rai na siena noh cha na thina noh a châ aw tahpa a siapa ta pahno mah y,’ tahpa ta Abeipa moh ta bie cha pataihsa na ta, zikyu liahsa châ râ ha va na ma? Nâ chhao ta ei hnohta, ‘Na reipa a pha na, ei zyh aw’ na tah mâh tâh.
Khazia Abeipa lâta bie nâ taihpa nata kei ta biepiepa ei cha piepa na patlô vei?” tah ta.
Abei ta Simei hnohta, “Ei paw Dâvi na pasasana zydua kha na palôh liata na pahno ngâ thlâh ha aw. Chyhsa na pasana kha Abeipa ta nâma luh chô liata a cha vaw palie thlu aw.
Bei Sawlawmaw deikua cha thlaochhipa ta y aw ta, Dâvi beidyuchhai cha Abeipa hmiakô liata tlyzaw ta paduapa a châ aw,” tah ta.
Abei ta Zehôdâ sawchapawpa Benai cha biepie ta, Benai cha pua ta, Simei cha chhawh ta, thi ha ta. Chatanachata khinarâh cha Sawlawmaw ku liata pa-ipa châ ha ta.
Sawlawmaw cha Izi bei Phiraoh nata azaona tao ta. Phiraoh sawchanô lapinô ta hnei ta. Ano o nata Abeipa o a sa khai hlâta nata Zerusale thokhy a dôh khai hlâlei cha Dâvi khihpi liata paysa chy ta.
Abeipa moh châta o sapa a y mâh leipa vâta, Izarei phopi cha su sâhpazy liata atheihna hlâ tyh ei ta.
Sawlawmaw cha Abeipa kyhpachâpa ta, a paw Dâvi bieraopazy zyh ta. Atheihna nata hmohlâpazy deikua cha su sâhpazy liata a tao tyh.
Abei cha atheihna hlâ awpa ta Kibiô lâ sie ta. Cha cha su sâhpa kawh kawpa châ ta, cha maisâh chô liana cha Sawlawmaw ta raopa hlâna sâh kha a vaw hlâ tyhpa a châ.
Kibiô liana chata Abeipa cha Sawlawmaw hnohta zâ ta a mâ lâta a vaw luah ta. Khazohpa ta, “Hiah teh, khâpa ei cha pie aw,” tah ta.

Sawlawmaw ta, “Châ chakaotuhpa ei paw Dâvi kha na hmiakô liata ngâchhihna, siana nata palôh dopa phaopa ta a y tyhpa vâta, a chô liata ngiachhiena thata na palâsa. Cha ngiachhiena rônah ngaitapa cha a chô liata palâsa pazao chi ta, a beidyuchhai liata a tyuh awpa sawchapawpa chhao tanoh na pie haw.
Hy Abeipa ei Khazohpa y, châ chakaotuhpa he ei paw Dâvi su liata bei ta eina tao chi hih. Kei la hawtipa dei châ na ta, yzia dâh nata bierei kahthlâ chhao pahno thai va na.
Châ chakaotuhpa he nâ ta nâ tlyhpa na phopi, phopi rônahpa, zasâh manôh reih tiah leipa nata paki tiah leipazy hry liata ei y.

Chavâta châ chakaotuhpa he, na phopi chô liata ryu ei rei thei nawpa ta sona na pie mah y. Chatanachata a chhiepa nata a phapa ei pahrua thei aw. He tlu ta a hluhpa na phopi chô liana he ahy ma ryu a reih thei aw?” tah ta.
Sawlawmaw hmo hiapa chata Abeipa cha palysa ngaita ta.
Khazohpa ta a hnohta, “Hro pasina hiah leipa chi ta, hneirôna hiah hra leipa chi ta, na chariahpazy thina chhao hia leipa chi ta, hmo dopa pahno thei nawpa novâhna tlao na hiapa vâta,
pachâ teh, na bie hawhta tahmâ ei tao haw. Sona nata novâhna ei cha pie. Nâ hawhpa he, nâ na y hlâta y beih leipa ei ta, nâma khai tawhta chhao, nâ hawhpa he pua khao aw veih ei.
Na hia leipa hneirôna nata zachhihna chhao ei cha pie aw. Chatanachata na hro chhôh zydua ta, nâ hawhpa bei rai pua aw veih ei.
Na paw Dâvi ta ei lâpizy â chhihpa hawhta, nâ chhao ta ei lâpizy a chhihpa ta, ei bieraopazy nata ei biepiepazy na zyh khiahta cha, na hro ei pasisa aw,” tah ta.

Sawlawmaw cha a vaw hra ta, a mâ vaw châ ta. Chatawhcha Zerusale lâ vawh ta, Abeipa Biehrai Byh hmiakô liata a duah ta, raopa hlânazy nata aryhna hlânazy hlâ ta, a chakaotuhpa zydua châta kyhchhi a taopa ei.
Noh kha cha chanô âzuahpa pano abei lâ a vy ei ta, a hmiakô liata a duah ei ta.
Chanô pakha ta, “Hy ei zibeipa y, he chanô nah heta o miakha liata pahrâ pi ta, o liata a y nota saw sa na ta.
Saw ei sa tawhta noh thôh a châ nahta, he chanô chhao he saw sa hra ta. Keimo dei ta y pi ta, o liata keimo hnohta a ypa chyhsa hropa y leipa ei ta, keimo pano dei ta o liata eima y.
He chanô heta zâ ta a saw a hnieh ta, a saw cha thi ha ta.
Zâcho ta thyu ta, châ chakaotuhnô he ei mô chhôh ta, ei kiapâh liata ei sawcha­pawpa cha la ta, a chachôhna liata paziasa ta, a saw thipa cha keima chachôhna liata a vaw pazia.
A mylâ my ta ei saw sâhpi pazysa awpa ta thyu na ta, châhrasala thiruapa vaw châ thlâh ha ta. My ta ei vaw mo pasia nahta cha, keima sapa ei sawchapawpa kha vaw châ leipa ta,” tah ta.

Chanô hropa ta, “Châ vei, ahrohpa he keima sawchapawpa châ ta, athipa he nâma sawchapawpa a châ,” tah ta. Hmiatuapa khata, “Châ vei, athipa he nâma sawchapawpa châ ta, ahrohpa he keima sawchapawpa a châ,” tah heih ta. Cha hawhna chata abei hmiakô liata reih raihrie ei ta.

Abei ta, “Pakha ta, ‘Ahrohpa he keima sawchapawpa châ ta, athipa he nâma sawchapawpa a châ,’ tah ta, ahropa ta, ‘Châ vei; athipa he nâma sawchapawpa châ ta, ahrohpa he keima sawchapawpa a châ,’ tah ha hra tlôh ta.
Zaozi na vaw pie teh u,” tah ta. Zaozi cha abei hmiakô lâ vaw cheih ei ta.
Abei ta, “Hawti a hrohpa kha bo no ta tai u la, â khophie pakha pie u la, â khophie ahropa pie teh u,” tah ta.

A sawchapaw a hrohpa nô cha, a sawchapawpa a ngiachhie ngaitapa vâta, abei hnohta, “Hy ei zibeipa y, hawti a hrohpa he ano pie thlâh ha mah y. Hawti he rie thie khah y,” tah ta. Pakhanô deikua ta, “Keima eih châ leipa sala, nâma eih chhao châ hlei hra khah sa. Tai pachhô thlâh ha teh u,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha abei ta a chhy ta, “Hawti a hrohpa kha a hmiatuapa chanô kha pie teh u, hawti kha thie khah u, ano tlai kha a nô cha a châ,” tah ta.
Izarei saw zydua ta abei ta bietluna a taozie cha thei ei ta, ryureina dopa siekhei nawpa ta Khazohpa sona a chô liata a ypa ama hmôpa vâta, abei cha chi ngaita ei ta.
Bei Sawlawmaw cha Izarei zydua bei ta y ta,
hezy he a beimachâzy ama châ: Zadô sawchapawpa Azariah cha theihthaipa châ ta,
Sisâ sawchapaw Elihôre nata Ahiza cha chârohtuhpazy châ ei ta, Ahilu sawchapawpa Zehôsaphâ cha thâtih rohtuhpa a châ.
Zehôdâ sawchapawpa Benai cha pheisaih hyutuhpa châ ta, Zadô nata Abiathâ cha theihthaipazy ama châ.
Nâthâ sawchapawpa Azariah cha bia a vaotuhpazy hyutuhpa châ ta, Nâthâ sawchapawpa Zabu cha theihthaipa nata abei viasa châna a pakaoh.
Ahisâ cha abei o liata hyutuhpa châ ta, Abadâ sawchapawpa Adônirâ cha raihriapazy hyutuhpa a châ.

Sawlawmaw ta Izarei zydua chô liata hyutuhpa pahrawh hleino hnei ta, âmo cha abei nata a chhôhkhazy châta niedo a pachâtuhpazy ama châ. Hyutuhpa pakha ta kô kha ta thla kha châ lymâ ta niedo amâ tôh aw.
Hezy he ama mohzy a châ: Epharai tlâh râh a vaotuhpa cha Behu a châ.
Bedeke ta Mâkazi, Sâbi, Beseme nata Elôbehanâ khihzy a vao ta,
Behese ta Arubô, Sôkô nata Hepha râh zydua â vao.
Bebinadâ ta Daw râh tlâh sâhpa zydua â vao. Ano he Sawlawmaw sawchanônô Tâpha lapinô ta a hneipa a châ.
Ahilu sawchapawpa Bânâ ta Tânâ, Mekidô nata Zezari nohdi Zarethâ khihpi kiapâh liata a ypa Besia kao zydua nata Besia tawhta Abemehôlâ taih a vao ta, Zôkamia râhri taihta â vao.

Bekebe ta Ramôkilia bia â vao. Ano heta Kilia râh liata a ypa Manase sawchapawpa Zairâ khihzy a vao ta, Bâsanâ liata a ypa, Kilia râh liata a ypazy to pâ ta, Bâsanâ râh liata Akaw bia liata thokhy nata dawh chhikao lâhrei a hneipa khihpi rônahpa sycharu â vao ei.
Idô sawchapawpa Ahinadâ ta Mâhanai khihpi a vao ta,
Ahimazi ta Nâthalai râh â vao. Ano he Sawlawmaw sawchanô Bâsemâ lapinô ta a hneipa a châ.
Husai sawchapawpa Bânâ ta Asera râh nata Belô khih a vao ta,
Pârua sawchapawpa Zehôsaphâ ta Iskâra râh a vao ta,
Elâ sawchapawpa Simei ta Benzami râh â vao.
Uri sawchapawpa Kebe ta Kilia râh, Amawri bei Sihaw râh nata Bâsanâ bei Ôkâ râh zy â vao. Cha râh liata ryureituhpa hropa pakha a y hra.
Zudâh nata Izarei cha tilaipi ngiahkâ sadi zie tlai ta hluh ei ta. Niepa ta doh ei ta, thapha ngaitapa ta y tyh ei ta.
Sawlawmaw cha Ufrâti tawhta Philistinâ râh nata Izi râhri taihta râh zydua chô liata ryureih ta. Ano lâ râhpawzy pie ei ta, a hro chhôh zydua ta Sawlawmaw cha ama chakao lymâ.
Sawlawmaw abei o liata noh kha ta ama niepa cha viahdie dipa kachu hmo sythôh nata viahdie hrâhpa kachu hmo sycharu,
viahchao tôhpa pathawhpa po hrawh, sibiepa pabâsapa viahchao pô kih nata mietaku za kha châ ta, he thota zuneihpazy, sakhihzy, sasuzy, awh thawhpazy â hlao.
Ufrâti notla lâ râh zydua, Tiphasa tawhta Kâza taihta Ufrâti notla lâ râh bei zydua chô liata ryureih ta, a chheipâh râh zydua nata a dyryh ngaitapa ta a y lymâ.
Sawlawmaw hro chhôh zydua ta Zudâh nata Izarei cha, Dânâ tawhta Besebâ taihta, chyhsa to ama kre zôh ry liata nata ama theiku kô ry liata thlalôh ngaitapa ta ama y.
Sawlawmaw cha a talailih a daophipa arâzy pasyna o 40,000 hnei ta, arâ pheisaih 12,000 a hnei.
Hyutuhpa pahrawh hleinopazy heta âmo topa thla chyu liata, Bei Sawlawmaw châta nata Bei Sawlawmaw tlâhkhai liata a dôhtuhpa zydua châta niedo ama pie tyh. Khâpa hmah paphahlasa veih ei.
Ama tao awpa raopa chyu hawhta, hyutuhpa zydua ta arâzy nata arâ chahrapazy châta bâli sâh nata sawphaozy â ngiahna su lâ ama pie lymâ.
Khazohpa ta Sawlawmaw cha sona nata novâhna thata pie ta, tilaipi ngiahkâ liata sadi zie hawh tlai ta palôh kawhna a pie.
Chatanachata Sawlawmaw sona cha nochhi râh lâta chyhsa zydua sona nata Izi sona zydua a khô haw.
Chyhsa zydua hlâta so via ta, Ezrâ pathla Ethâ hlâta so via ta, Mâhô sawchapawpa Hemâ, Kâkaw nata Dâdâ zy hlâ chhao ta so via ta, a chheipâh râh zydua hry liata a mo thata a pathâh.
Bieso 3,000 reih ta, hla 1,005 a phi.

Tho thâtih zy reih ta, Lebanaw liata sidy tho tawhta pâhchhô liata a pyuhpa hisaw thâtih taihta a reihpa a châ. Râhsa thâtih, pavaw thâtih, alyhpasa thâtih nata nga thâtih zy chhao a reih theipa a châ.
Chatanachata Sawlawmaw sona nathlie awpa ta, râh to tawhta chyhsazy a vy ei ta, a sona thâtih a theipa, lei bei zydua chhao ta ama vaw ngai lymâ.
Sawlawmaw cha a paw su a thla awpa ta sathaw ama thu haw tahpa Tyre bei Hirâ ta a thei nahta, a chakaotuhpazy Sawlawmaw lâ tuah ta. Hirâ he Dâvi a pasô kawpa a châ.
Sawlawmaw ta Hirâ cha bieta ta, a hnohta,

“Ei paw Dâvi kha a chariahpazy ta chadô ei ta, amâ dyuh ngâ thlâh hapa vâta, Abeipa ta a chariahpazy cha a pheipazah ry liata a so hlâlei kha cha, Abeipa a Khazohpa châta o sapa thei vei tahpa na pahno.
Tahmâ deikua cha Abeipa ei Khazohpa ta su to liata thlalôhna eina pie haw. Khakhaipazy y khao leipa ei ta, vâchhiena chhao y khao vei.

Abeipa ta ei paw Dâvi hnohta, ‘Na sawchapawpa, nâma châ thla awpa ta na beidyuchhai liata ei patyusapa ta ei moh châta o cha a sa aw,’ tahpa ta a vaw rei hapa hawhta, tahmâ Abeipa ei Khazohpa moh châta o sa awpa ei chhuah.

Chavâta Lebanaw sidy thozy na thlupa awpa ta biepie mah y. Nâ chakaotuhpazy chhao châ chakaotuhpazy hry liata a vaw hlao aw ei ta, châ chakaotuhpazy hlao cha na reipa hawhta ei cha pie aw. Sidaw mo hawhta tho a thlu thaipa eima hry liata y veih ei tahpa na pahno,” tah ta.
Hirâ cha Sawlawmaw biezy a thei nahta, a ly ngaita ta, “He phopi rônahpa chô liata ryurei awpa ta sawchapaw sopa Dâvi hnohta a piepa Abeipa cha tanoh reithaipa ta y mawh sy!” tah ta.
Hirâ ta Sawlawmaw lâ chyhsa tuah ta, a hnohta, “Bie eina tapa chi kha vaw thei na ta, sidy tho kyh liata nata meisah vyhpa tho kyh liata, na khopa maih ei vaw tao lymâ aw.

Nâ chakaotuhpazy ta Lebanaw tawhta tilaipi taihta za phaoh aw ei ta, apâ hawhta chahrysa aw ei na ta, a su na raopa lâ tlôkhei awpa ta tilaipi liata ei za pasiesa aw. A su a za tlô nahta pathlâsa aw ei na ta, nâ vaw la aw. Nâ chhao ta ei chhôhkhazy niedo a tôhpa ta ei khopa na tao hra aw,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Hirâ ta Sawlawmaw cha a khopa zie ta sidy tho nata meisah vyhpa tho zy pie ta.
Sawlawmaw ta Hirâ chhôhkhazy nie awpa ta sâh kachu 20,000 nata sathaw chariehpa kachu 20,000 a pie. Cha hawhna chata Sawlawmaw ta Hirâ cha kô chareih ta a pie lymâ.
Abeipa ta bie â taihpa hawh tlai ta, Sawlawmaw cha sona ta tobi ta. Hirâ nata Sawlawmaw cha ama likah liata biehrai tao ei ta, a dyryh ngaitapa ta ama y lymâ.
Bei Sawlawmaw ta Izarei zydua hry tawhta raihriatuhpa py padua ta, ama zydua ta 30,000 ama châ.
Âmo cha Lebanaw lâ tuah ta, thy kha thy kha ta, a thla thla ta amâ thla lymâ. Lebanaw liata thla kha y ei ta, o liata thla no ama y tyh. Adônirâ cha raihriatuhpazy hyutuhpa a châ.
Sawlawmaw ta hmo a phaohpa 70,000 nata alô a khaipa 80,000 tlâh râh liata a hnei.
Sawlawmaw ta raihria vaituhpa 3,300 hnei ta, âmo he rai mohôhtuhpa nata hriatuhpazy vaituhpa ama châ.
Alô khaipazy ta o abôna paryh awpa ta, abei biepiepa ta alô lai ngaitapa nata alô mâ ru ngaitapazy ama khai lymâ.
Sawlawmaw chyhsa zôthaipazy, Hirâ chyhsa zôthaipazy nata Kebâli mozy ta alô khai ei ta, o sa nawpa tho nata lô zy ama pachhuahpanoh.
Izarei sawzy Izi râ tawhta ama kaw pua tawhta kô za palih nata sychariena kô, Izarei chô liata Sawlawmaw â beina kô palihna, Zivi thla, thla nona liata Abeipa o cha sa pathao ta.
Bei Sawlawmaw ta Abeipa châta o a sapa cha a doh lâ dy sycharu châ ta, a hâ la dy kih châ ta, â sâhna lâ dy sythôh a châ.
Achhyna o hmia lâta aikah cha, o hâ nata pakhopa ta, a hâ lâ dy kih châ ta, a doh lâ dy hrawh a châ.
Achhyna o pâhchhô liata opy buahpazy pahy ta, opy tôhtlâhzy cha a vâhchapiapa ta a tao.
Achhyna o khôtho lâta pâhchhô nata a chhôh lâta pâhchhô zy padôpa ta, pâhchhôzy pasusapa ta, o cha a chhâh ta sa ta, chhôhpadâhpazy a tao.

A ry chai chhâh cha dy pangawh kawh ta, a liah chhâh dy charu kawh ta, a chhâh thôhna cha dy sari a kawh. Pâhchhô liata pâhchhô tlâhzy chahraoh byuh lei awpa ta, pâhchhô patusanazy khôtho liata a tao.
Alô chaona su liata khai chiehpa alôzy ta Achhyna o cha sapa a châ. Chatanachata o sa chhôh zydua ta, syulô pyu, ahrei pyu nata thua chhaichhi pyu kheihawhpa hmahta Achhyna o liata thei awpa y vei.
A ry chai chhâh chhikao cha Achhyna o chho lâchhâh ta y ta, cha tawhta a liah chhâh lâ kiana nata a liah chhâh tawhta chhâh thôhna lâ kiana kahmizy a y.
Cha hawhna chata Achhyna o cha sa ta, a paloh haw. Achhyna o pâkôzy châta sidy tho hmâh ta, a vâphuh chhao sidy thophia a dia.
Achhyna o padôpa ta, chhôhpadâhpa dy pangawh a sâhpazy tao ta, chazy cha sidy tho ta Achhyna o nata pazaopa a châ.
Abeipa bie Sawlawmaw hnohta vaw tlô ta,

“He Achhyna o na sa haipa kyh liata, ei bieraopazy a pyhpa ta, ei ryureinazy a ngiahpa ta, ei biepiepa zydua zyhpa ta nâ chhih khiahta cha, na paw Dâvi hnohta bie ei vaw taih hapazy kha nâma liata ei patlô aw.
Izarei sawzy hry liata pahrâ aw na ta, ei phopi Izarei he siesai aw va na,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Sawlawmaw ta Achhyna o cha sa ta, paloh ha ta.
O chhôh lâ pâhchhô cha sidy thophia ta patho ta. Siphiah tawhta a chô lâ vâphuh taihta a chhôh lâ cha tho bai khai ta, a siphiah châta meisah vyhpa thophia a phaw.
Achhyna o chhôh, o hnôh lâ daih liata Su Pathaih Chaipa tao ta, cha cha dy kih ta taopa a châ. Siphiah tawhta vâphuh taihta sidy thophia sai ta chhôhpa a châ.
Su Pathaih Chaipa hmia lâ daih liata Achhyna o chhôh cha a doh lâta dy sypalih a châ.
O chhôh lâta sidy thozy liata pawpi pabyuhpa nata paw pakaipa nothlahpazy khiepa châ ta, o chhôh zydua cha sidy tho ta khu khai ta, alô rai a lâ vei.
Abeipa Biehrai Byh so nawpa ta, Achhyna o chhôh chaipa liata supathaihpa tao ta.
Cha supathaihpa cha a doh lâ dy kih, a hâ lâ dy kih, â sâhna lâ dy kih châ ta, ngôh suapa ta pahu khaipa a châ. Sidy maisâh chhao ngôh suapa ta a pahu hra.
Sawlawmaw ta Achhyna o chhôh cha ngôh suapa ta pahu khai ta, ngôh ta pahupa chhôhpadâhpa pathaihpa hmialâ liata ngôh bâliazy a parai.
Achhyna o chhôh lâ zydua cha ngôh ta pahu khai ta, Achhyna o chhôh supathaihpa liata maisâh chhao a pôhpalôhpa ta ngôh ta a pahu khai.
Chhôhpadâhpa pathaihpa liana chata, dy hrawh raihrie a sâhpa ta cherubi miano ôli tho ta tao ta.
Cherubi mathlaw miakha cha dy pangawh seih ta, cherubi mathlaw hiakha lâ chhao dy pangawh seih hra ta, a mathlaw miakha pawhmao tawhta mathlaw hiakha lâ pawhmao taihta dy hrawh a seih.
Cherubi hropa chhao dy hrawh seih hra ta, cherubizy cha â khopa nata yzie a lyupa ta taopa a châ.
Cherubi miakha cha â sâhna lâ dy hrawh châ ta, cherubi hropa chhao, cha tlu ta â sâh hra.

Cherubizy cha Achhyna o chhôh chaipa liata soh ta. Cherubizy cha ama mathlaw pakai ei ta, miakhapa mathlaw ta pâhchhô hiakha lâ hria ta, ahropa mathlaw ta pâhchhô hiakha lâ hria hra ta, ama mathlawzy cha Achhyna o liah khophie liata amâ tyh.
Cherubizy chhao cha ngôh ta a pahu hra ei.
Achhyna o pâhchhô zydua padôpa ta, a chhôh lâ chhao, khôtho lâ chhao, cherubizy, thiahrâ kôzy nata pawpi pakaipa nothlahpazy khiepa ta tobi ta.
Achhyna o siphiah chhao a chhôh lâ nata khôtho lâ ngôh ta a pahu khai.
Chhôhpadâhpa pathaihpa lâ angiana châta, a tôhtlâh miapangawh a hneipa ochhizy cha ôli tho ta tao ta.
Cha ôli tho ochhi mianopazy cha cherubizy, thiahrâ kôzy nata pawpi pakaipa nothlahpazy khiepa ta tao ta, chazy cha ngôh ta pahu ta, cherubizy nata thiahrâ kôzy cha ngôh ta a thia ei.
Cha hawh pyly ta, Achhyna o chhôh pipa lâ angiana ochhi chhao, ôli tho ta a tôhtlâh miapalih hneipa ta a tao.
Meisah vyhpa tho ochhi miano tao ta, ochhi miakha liata thophia miano cha thlâhkadi theipa châ ta, ochhi hropa liata phia no chhao thlâhkadi theipa a châ hra.
Chazy chô liata cherubizy, thiahrâ kôzy nata pawpi pakaipa nothlahpazy khie ta, â tlâkhâh kawpa ta ngôh ta pahu khaipa a châ.
Achhyna o dôhpachhôh tlyhmia cha alô khaipa tho thôh nata sidy tho tlâh kha ta pathopa ta a tao.
Kô palihna, Zivi thla liata, Abeipa o sa awpa ta lôbô bôpa châ ta,
kô hrawh hleikhana, Buli thla, thla chariena liata, Achhyna o cha a zydua ta, patohpatianazie hawh tlai ta paloh khaipa a châ. Kô sari tlai a sa.
Sawlawmaw ta ano o chhao sa ta, kô hrawh hleithôh a sa tawhta o cha palohpa a châ.

“Lebanaw Tho O” tahpa ta moh bipa ta, Sawlawmaw ta abei o cha a sa. A doh lâ dy za kha seih ta, a hâ lâ dy sypangawh kawh ta, dy sythôh â sâh. Sidy otôh tlâh palih ta patlâhpa chô liata palaih nata pâkôzy sidy tho hmâpa a châ.
Tlâh kha liata otôh tôh hrawh hleipangawh lymâ ta bôpa ta, otôh tôh sypalih nata tôh pangawh chô liata o chhâh cha sidy tho ta khupa a châ.
A kâ lâta pâhchhôzy liata opyzy tlâh thôh ta patlâh ta, opyzy cha â dadypa ta taopa ama châ.
Ochhi nata opy zydua cha ki palih ta taopa châ ei ta, opyzy cha tlâh thôh ta patlâhpa ta, opy py kha nata py kha â dadypa ta taopa a châ.
Otôh hluhpi a hneipa aikah tao ta, a doh lâ dy sypangawh seih ta, a hâ lâ dy sythôh a kawh. Aikah hmia liata laitlâ y ta, cha hmia liata chôkhu a hneipa otôhzy a y.
Beidyuchhai Aikah tao ta, he he ryurei nawpa su a châpa vâta, Ryureina Aikah tahpa ta awpa a châ. Cha cha siphiah tawhta palaih taihta sidy tho ta khupa a châ.

Ryureina Aikah hnôhlâ dôhpachhôh tlyhmia chhâna lâ liata abei pahrâ nawpa o y ta, cha cha aikah nata a lyupa ta sapa a châ. Sawlawmaw ta a lapinô, Phiraoh sawchanô châta chhao, aikah nata â lyupa ta o a sapa hra.

He o zydua he alô pha ngaitapazy hmâpa ta sapa a châ. Alôzy cha â su thaipa ta khai pachie khai hapa châ ta, a hmia a hnôh ta thoâna ta pamihpa a châ. He hawhna heta o abôna tawhta a palaih taihta nata dôhpachhôh tlyhmia kawh ngaitapa zy tao khaipa a châ.
O abôna cha alô pha ngaitapa, alô laipapi, alô dy hrawhpazy, alô dy chariepazy ta paryhpa a châ.
Cha chô lâ ta alô pha ngaitapa, â supa ta khai chiehpazy nata sidy thozy a y.
Dôhpachhôh tlyhmia kawh ngaitapa cha, alô khaipa tho thôh nata sidy thophia tho kha ta â dôpa ta dôhpa châ ta, cha hawhna chata Abeipa o dôhpachhôh tlyhmia nata aikah chhao taopa a châ.
Bei Sawlawmaw ta chyhsa tuah ta, Tyre khihpi tawhta Hirâ a vaw chhi ei ta.

Hirâ cha Nâthalai chi nôhmei sawchapawpa châ ta, a paw cha Tyre khihpa, dawh a daih thaipa a châ. Sona nata novâhna ta a biepa chyhsa châ ta, dawh daina kyh liata kheihawhpa rai a tao thaipa, zôthai ngaitapa a châ. Hirâ cha Bei Sawlawmaw lâ a vy ta, a rai zydua a hriapa lymâ.
Hirâ ta Dawh tôh miano â khopa ta leih ta, he dawh tôhzy he â sâhna lâ dy hrawh hleicharie châ ta, dy hrawh hleino â hlôpa a châ. A karyhpa ta taopa châ ta, zô palih a chha.
Dawh tôhzy pawhmao liata pataoh awpa ta, dawh leihpa lubyuhpa miano, dy pangawh raihrie a sâhpa ta a tao.
Dawh tôh pawhmao liata lubyuhpa cha dawh sao ta khupa châ ta, dawh sao miakha cha dawh bâlia miasari ta chapaipa a châ. Lubyuhpa miakha châta dawh sao miakha lymâ a tao.
Dawh tôh pawhmao liata lubyuhpa khuna dawh sao padôpa ta, pawmikarânâ tlâh no ta paziah ta, lubyuhpa hropa châta chhao cha hawhta a tao.
Aikah liata otôhzy pawhmao liata lubyuhpazy cha lilipaw lyupa ta taopa châ ta, dy palih a sâhpa ta taopa a châ.

Dawh tôh mianopazy pawhmao liata lubyuhpazy y ta, chazy cha dawh sao kiapâh liata â hlôpa ta taopa chô lâta taopa a châ. Cha lubyuhpazy liana cha pawmikarânâ nothlahpa za no raihrie sopa châ ta, lubyuhpa padôpa ta tlâh no ta taopa a châ.
Dawh tôhzy cha Achhyna o aikah liata bô ta. Chho lâ chhâh ta tôh kha bô ta, a moh Zaki bi ta, maw lâ chhâh ta tôh kha bô ta, a moh Bôaza a bi.
Dawh otôhzy pawhmao liata lubyuhpazy cha lilipaw lyupa ta taopa châ ta, cha hawhna chata otôh taona rai cha palohpa a châ.
Chatawhcha dawh tipâh ahlôpa lai ngaitapa tao ta. A chhôh dy hrawh tla ta, dy pangawh a sâh ta, dy sythôh ahlôpa a châ.
Tipâh tlâh ry liata, dy kha liata titheih theih hrawh lymâ ta, tipâh a dôna taihta titheihzy pataohpa a châ. Titheihzy cha tlâh no ta paziahpa châ ta, tipâh nata leih pâpa a châ.

Tipâh cha viahchao tôhpa pô hrawh hleino chô liata patyupa châ ta, pô thôh maw lâ a heih ta, pô thôh notla lâ a heih ta, pô thôh chho lâ a heih ta, pô thôh nochhi lâ â heih. Viahchao tôhpazy chô liana chata tipâh cha patyupa châ ta, a chhôh lâ ama chao ama chhy khai.
Tipâh cha pazah tie chha ta, nyu tlâh hawhta a tlâh taopa châ ta, lilipaw lyupa ta taopa a châ. Tibyh 2,000 â tlôh.
Patyuna miahrawh dawh ta tao ta. Patyuna cha a doh lâ dy palih seih ta, a hâ lâ dy palih kawh ta, dy thôh â sâh.
He he patyuna taonazie a châ: dawhphiazy y ta, dawhphiazy cha a tlâhzy ta patusapa a châ.

A tlâhzy ta patusapa dawhphiazy liana cha chakeibarôhneipazy, viahchao tôhpazy nata cherubi nothlahpazy a choh ta, chakeibarôhneipazy nata viahchao tôhpazy chô lâ nata ry lâ ta a tlâhzy liata pawpi nothlahpazy taopa a châ.
Patyuna to ta dawh tiaki miapalih nata dawh lâhreizy hnei ta, a ki palihzy liata biebuh ahniehnazy y ta, ahniehnazy cha a kâ to liata pawpi nothlahpazy taopa ta leihpa a châ.

Patyuna chhôh liana cha biebuh so nawpa byh taopa châ ta, â hlôpa ta a paka taopa a châ. A chô lâ dy kha a chaluah ta, a ry lâ dy kha nata khophie â pamôh. A paka cha â ngia kawpa ta khiepa a châ. Patyuna dawhphiazy deikua cha ki palih a hnei, â hlô veih ei.
A tiaki miapalihzy cha dawhphiazy ry lâta y ta, tiaki ngaihzy cha patyuna nata a zaopa ta taopa a châ. Tiaki cha dy kha nata khophie â sâh.
Patyuna tiakizy cha talailih tiaki hawhta taopa châ ta, a ngaihzy, a kiahzy, a patusana tlâhzy nata tiaki khaohzy cha leihpa sai a châ.
Patyuna ki palih liata ahniehna miapalih y ta, cha ahniehnazy cha patyuna nata pazao khaipa a châ.
Patyuna chô liata dawh ri â hlôpa, dy khophie a sâhpa y ta, cha cha patyuna tlâh nata dawhphiazy nata pazaopa ta leihpa a châ.
Patyuna ahniehnazy nata dawhphiazy cha, a su ruapa maih liata cherubizy, chakeibarôhneipazy, thiahrâ kôzy nata pawpi nothlahpazy ta a pabie.
Cha hawhna chata patyuna miahrawh cha tao ta, a zydua ta â khopa nata â lyupa ta leihpa a châ.
Chatawhcha dawh biebuh miahrawh tao ta. Biebuh cha a chhôh dy palih a thupa châ ta, kachu sypalih â tlôh. Patyuna miahrawhzy châta biebuh miakha chyu taopa a châ.
Chatawhcha patyunazy cha Achhyna o chho lâ liata miapangawh soh ta, Achhyna o maw lâta miapangawh soh hra ta, tipâh laipa cha chho nochhi lâ liata a patyu.
Hirâ ta beihzy, buchâh linazy nata biebuhzy tao hra ta. Chatanachata Hirâ ta Abeipa o sana liata Bei Sawlawmaw châta a tao awpa zydua cha patlô ta.
Hezy he a tao: Dawh tôh miano, dawh tôh pawhmao liata dawh lubyuhpa miano nata dawh tôhzy pawhmao liata dawh lubyuhpazy khu nawpa ta dawh sao miano tao ta,
dawh tôhzy pawhmao liata dawh luh byuhpazy chô liata biebuhzy khuna dawh sao mianozy liata, tlâh no ta patlâh awpa pawmikarânâ nothlahpa 400 tao ta.
Patyuna miahrawh nata patyuna chô liata so awpa biebuh miahrawh tao ta,
tipâh miakha nata a ry liata viahchao tôhpa pô hrawh hleino a tao.
Beihzy, buchâh linazy nata biebuhzy chhao a tao. Cha Abeipa o liata hmobaoh, Hirâ ta Bei Sawlawmaw châta a taopa zydua cha, dawh patliesapa ta taopa ama châ khai.
Chazy cha abei ta Zawdâh bypi liata Sukô nata Zarethâ likawh beihlei su liata leih ta.
Hmobaohzy cha hluh ngaita ta, khopathliah tiah awpa a châ leipa vâta, Sawlawmaw ta hmobaoh zydua cha khopathliah hlei vei. Chavâta dawh hmobaohzy amâ hrina ziepa cha pahnopa châ vei.
Sawlawmaw ta Abeipa o hmobaoh zydua cha tao ta. Ngôh maisâh, ngôh ta taopa Ypâna viahchhâ tlâhkhai,
Achhyna o chhôh supathaihpa hmiakô liata, chho lâ miapangawh nata maw lâ miapangawh ta sopa ngôh suapa meiôh tôhzy; ngôh pawpizy, ngôh meiôhzy, ngôh chaikiezy;

ngôh suapa ta taopa nyuzy, meiôh lao chakienazy, biebuhzy, ropahâhpa beihkohzy nata mei lanazy a tao. Achhyna o chhôh chaipa, Su Pathaih Chaipa lâ angiana nata Achhyna ochhôh pipa lâ angiana ochhi patunazy chhao ngôh ta a tao khai.

Cha hawhna chata Bei Sawlawmaw ta Abeipa o châta a tao awpa zydua cha patlô ta. A paw Dâvi ta Abeipa lâ a vaw hlâ hapa tâkâzy, ngôhzy nata hmobaohzy cha Sawlawmaw ta a ngiakhei ta, Abeipa o liata sôh sopakhyna suzy liata soh khai ta.

Sawlawmaw ta Abeipa Biehrai Byh cha, Dâvi khihpi Zaio tawhta la papua awpa ta, Izarei pathla chhituhpa zydua, Izarei machâzy nata Izarei chi hyutuhpa zydua cha, Bei Sawlawmaw hmiakô liata a luah awpa ta Zerusale liata awpakhy ta.
Chatanachata Izarei chapaw zydua cha thla sarina, Ethâni thla kyhchhi daihti liata Bei Sawlawmaw lâta a hmaohpakhy ei ta.
Izarei machâ zydua a vy ei ta, theihthaipazy ta Byh cha a sy ei ta.
Abeipa Byh, ahmaohna poh o nata poh o liata hmobaoh pathaihpa zydua a sy ei ta. Chazy cha theihthaipazy nata Livai chizy ta amâ sy.

Bei Sawlawmaw nata a hmiakô liata Izarei zawpi a hmaohpakhypa zydua cha, Byh hmiakô liata Sawlawmaw hnohta y ei ta, mietaku nata viahchao tôhpa hluhpi ta atheihna hlâ ei ta, a hluhzie cha paki tiah awpa nata rei tiah awpa châ vei.
Chatanachata theihthaipazy ta Abeipa Bieh­rai Byh cha, Achhyna o chhôh supathaihpa liata a y nawpa su liata a ngiakhei ei ta, Cherubi mathlawzy ry liata Su Pathaih Chaipa liata soh ei ta.
Cherubizy cha Byh luh chô liata ama mathlaw pakai ei ta, cherubizy ta Byh nata asyna lâzy cha pahli ei ta.

A lâzy cha a seih kawpa vâta, Achhyna o chhôh supathaihpa hmiakô liata Su Pathaihpa tawhta a pawhmaozy hmô theipa a châ. Khôtho lâ tawh deikua hmô theipa châ vei. Chazy cha tanoh taihta cha liata a y thlâh haw.

Lôphia miano tah leipa ta cha, Byh chhôh liata hmo hropa khâpa hmah y vei. Cha lôphiazy cha Izi râh tawhta ama kaw pua nota, Abeipa ta Izarei sawzy hnohta bie a hraina su Hôribâ Tlâh liata Mawsi ta a khôpazy a châ.
Su Pathaihpa tawhta theihthaipazy ama vaw puapa nahta, Abeipa o cha meihdo ta vaw bie khai ha ta,
meihdo vâna chata theihthaipazy cha chakao awpa ta a duah thei khao veih ei. Abeipa rônahna ta Abeipa o cha a bie khai haw.
Chatawhcha Sawlawmaw ta, “‘Meihdo chhapa liata ei pahrâ aw,’ Abeipa ta tah ta.
Na chhâzaw pahrâna su châta, O rônahpa ei cha sapa haw,” tah ta.
Izarei zawpi zydua amâ dua thlâh ha nota, abei cha zawpi lâ a heih ta, Izarei sawzy châta byhnâ aw ta.
Sawlawmaw ta, “Ei paw Dâvi hnohta a pakah ta bie a taih ta, a ku ta a bietai a patlôtuhpa Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa cha reithaipa ta y mawh sy!

Abeipa ta, ‘Izi râh tawhta ei phopi Izarei ei chhi papua noh tawhta, ei moh y nawpa o sa nawpa su châta, Izarei chizy hry liata kheihawhpa khih hmahta a tlyh beih va na. Châhrasala ei phopi Izarei hyutuhpa châta Dâvi cha ei tlyhpa a châ,’ tah ta.
Ei paw Dâvi khata Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa moh châta o sa khona a palôh liata vaw hnei ta.
Châhrasala Abeipa ta ei paw Dâvi hnohta, ‘Ei moh châta o sa khona palôh hnei chi ta, cha hawhpa palôh na hneipa cha na tao pha na.
Châhrasala nâma ta o cha sa aw va chi. Sawchapawpa na sa awpa ta ei moh châta o cha a sa aw,’ tah ha ta.

Abeipa ta a bietai cha tahmâ a patlô haw. Abeipa ta bie â vaw taipa hawh tlai ta, ei paw Dâvi su liata kei a duahpa ta, Izarei beidyuchhai liata a tyuh na ta, Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa moh châta o cha ei sa haw.
Cha liata Abeipa ta miah pathlatuhpazy Izi râh tawhta â chhi papua nota ama hnohta bie a hraipa, Abeipa biehrai yna Byh y nawpa su ei tao haw,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Sawlawmaw cha Izarei a hmaohpakhypa zydua mohmô ta Abeipa maisâh hmiakô liata a duah ta, avâ lâ a ku pazawh ta,

hetana heta thlahchhâ ta: “Hy Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa y, nâ hawhpa Khazohpa he, chô lâ avâ liata nata ry lâ alei liata y tlâ veih ei. Nâma cha biehrai patlô chi ta, pathipalôh tlokhuh ta na bie a zyhpa châ chakaotuhpazy chô liata ngiachhiena a palâsa tyhpa na châ.
Châ chakaotuhpa ei paw Dâvi hnohta na bietai na patlô haw. Na pakah ta reih chi ta, tanoh na ku ta na patlô haw.

Chavâta Hy Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa y, châ chakaotuhpa ei paw Dâvi hnohta, ‘Na pathlazy ta ama lâpizy pakhâta ta pachâ ei sala, nâ ta ei lâpi nâ chhihpa hawhna heta, âmo chhao ta ei lâpi amâ chhih lymâ khiahta cha, Izarei beidyuchhai liata ei hmiakô lia a tyuh awpa chyhsa na pathlazy tawhta chie aw veih ei’, tahpa ta bie nâ vaw taihpa kha patlô mah y.
Chavâta, Hy Izarei Khazohpa y, châ chakaotuhpa ei paw Dâvi hnohta na reipa bie kha ngiachhiepa ta pa-i mah y.
“Châhrasala Khazohpa cha alei chô liata a pahrâ tlai aw ma? Pachâ tua, avâ nata avâ a sâh chaipa liata hmah nâ tlôh leipa châ ta, he o ei sapa liata chhochhi cha nâ tlôh lei pachai aw dia!
Chatahrasala Hy Abeipa ei Khazohpa y, châ chakaotuhpa ta a cha padona nata a thlahchhâna he nathlie la, tanoh ta na hmiakô liata châ chakaotuhpa thlahchhâna nata hiana he rie pachâ mah y.

Chatanachata he su lâ he a vaw heih la, châ chakaotuhpa ta he su lâ a heihpa ta a thlahchhâna he nathlie la, ‘Cha liata ei moh a y aw,’ na tahna su, he o lâ tlai he chhô nah zâ ta na mo tawpâ thlâh ha mah y.

Châ chakaotuhpa nata na phopi Izarei sawzy ta he su lâ a heihpa ta thlah ama chhâ tita, ama hianazy vaw nathlie tyh mah y. Na pahrâna su vârâh tawhta vaw nathlie la, na thei tita, a ngiahthai tyh mah y.
“Chyhsa ahy tlyma a vaih chô liata hmo a paraopa vâta bie pataihsa awpa byuh sala, he o lâ a vypa ta na maisâh hmiakô liata bie â taih khiahta cha,
vârâh tawhta vaw nathlie la, châ chakaotuhpazy cha pachia la, thailei a châpa cha a hmotaopa a luh chô liata patlôsapa ta viarithô la, mosiapa cha thaipachâsa la, a siana yzie hawhta lymâ pie mah y.
“Na phopi Izarei sawzy ta na chô liata ama moleipa vâta, chariah hmia liata nawh ha ei sala, nâ lâ a vaw heih heihpa ta, na moh a châhkheipa ta, he o liata thlahchhâpa ta ama cha hiah tita,
vârâh tawhta vaw nathlie la, na phopi Izarei moleina cha a ngiahthai la, ama pathlatuhpazy na piepa râh lâ a chhi heih mah y.

“Na phopi Izarei sawzy na chô liata ama moleina vâta, avâ khaw chi ta, avâ rai pasuasa leipa ta ama rie na pathei tita, he su lâ a heihpa ta thlahchhâ ei sala, na moh a châhkheipa ta, ama moleina amâ heihsai khiahta cha,

vârâh tawhta vaw nathlie la, châ chakaotuhpa na phopi Izarei sawzy moleina cha a ngiahthai mah y. Lâpi dopa a chhih awpa ta âmo cha pachu la, ryuto châta na phopi na piepa râh liana he avâ pasuasa heih tyh mah y.

“Chakâhna tlyma, potlana tlyma, chawhkaraina tlyma, hmyna tlyma, khawsu tlyma, chângyu tlyma râh liata vaw y sala, ama chariahpa ta ama khihpizy dôhpa ta, potlana nata pasana kheihawhpa rai vaw tlô sala,
ama palôh pasana pahno chyupa ta, mopakha ta tlyma, Izarei zawpi ta tlyma, he o lâ he a heihpa ta ama ku pazawh ei sala, thlahchhâna nata hiana ama vaw tlôkhei khiahta cha,

na pahrâna su vârâh liata vaw nathlie la, a ngiahthai mah y. Ama palôh na pahnopa nata ama hrozie lymâ hawhta, chyhsa to chô liata hria la tao mah y. Nâma, nâma deita he Âdâh pathla zydua palôh a pahnotuhpa châ tlôh chi ta.
Chatanachata miah pathlatuhpazy na piepa râh liata ama pahrâ chhôh zydua ta ama cha chi lymâ aw.
“Cha hawhna hra chata, chihropa chyhsa, na phopi Izarei saw a châ leipa chhao na moh vâta râh hlapi tawhta â vy aw.
Na moh rônahpa nata na ku thatlôpa nata na bâh pazawhpa thâtih ama theipa vâta a vy aw ei ta, he o lâ a heihpa ta thlah ama chhâ tita,

na pahrâna su vârâh liata vaw nathlie la, chihropa ta a cha hiapa cha taopa mah y. Chatanachata khizaw phopi zydua ta na moh pahno aw ei ta, Izarei sawzy ta eima cha chipa hawhta, âmo chhao ta cha chi aw ei ta, o ei sapa he na moh a phaohpa a châ tahpa ama pahno aw.
“Na phopi ta ama chariah a dyuh awpa ta sie ei sala, kheihawhpa lâpi lâ tawhta na tuapa chhao ta, nâ tlyhpa khihpi nata na moh châta ei sapa o lâ he a heihpa ta Abeipa lâ thlah ama chhâ khiahta cha,
ama thlahchhâna nata ama hiana cha vârâh liata vaw nathlie la, ama chhâh a châ mah y.

“Chyhsa ahy hmah a molei beih leipa y veih ei. Na phopi chhao ta na chô liata ama molei tita, ama chô liata na pathi ia ta, chavâta ama chariahpa ku liata âmo cha pie chi ta, chariahpa râh lâhlapi lâta tlyma, lâhnia liata tlyma, sei ta a chhipa ta y ei sala,

sei ta amâ chhina râh liata ama palôh zy ananopa ta, ro ei sala, âmo a patutuhpazy râh liana chata, ‘Hmo vaw parao ha pi ta, â do lei ngaitapa nata molei ngaitapa ta eima vaw tao haw,’ tahpa ta cha hiah ei sala,

sei ta a chhituhpa ama chariahpazy râh liana chata, ama pathipalôh tlokhuh ta nata ama thlahpa tlokhuh ta ro ei sala, âmo pathlatuhpazy hnohta na piepa ama râh nata nâ tlyhpa khihpi nata na moh châta ei sapa o lâ he a heihpa ta, nâ lâta thlah ama chhâ khiahta cha,
ama thlahchhâna nata ama hiana cha, na pahrâna su vârâh liata vaw nathlie la, ama chhâh a châ mah y.

Na chô liata hmo a paraopa na phopi nata na chô liata hmo ama paraopa zydua cha a ngiahthai la, sei ta a chhituhpazy ta ama ngiachhie thei nawpa ta, sei ta a chhituhpazy liata ngiachhiena pahlaosa mah y.
Âmo cha nâma phopi nata na ryuto châ awpa ta, Izi râh, thua patisana hry tawhta nâ chhi papuapazy cha tlôh ei ta.
Châ chakaotuhpa nata na phopi Izarei hiana lâta na mo padeih la, ama cha padona maihta na nah vaw pachôh mah y.

Hy Abeipa Zehôvâh y, miah pathlatuhpazy Izi râh tawhta nâ chhi papua nota châ chakaotuhpa Mawsi hnohta na vaw rei hapa hawhta, âmo cha na ryuto châta khizaw phopi zydua hry tawhta na pananopa ama châ hih,” tah ta.
Sawlawmaw cha Abeipa lâta thlahchhâna nata hiana zydua a hnei khai nahta, Abeipa maisâh hmiakô liata pakhu paneihpa ta avâ lâ ku pazawhpa ta a yna tawhta thyu ta.
A duah ta, Izarei zawpi a hmaohpakhypa zydua cha byhnâ awpa ta, ao paro ngaitapa ta,
“A bietai zydua hawhta, a phopi Izarei sawzy apahâna a pietuhpa Abeipa cha reithaipa ta y mawh sy. A chakaotuhpa Mawsi hmâpa ta a bietai phapa zydua kha, a vaw tlô leipa bie miakha hmahta y vei.
Miah pathlatuhpazy hnohta a ypa hawhna khata, Abeipa eima Khazohpa cha eima hnohta y sala, miah siesai leipa sala, miah pathlua khah sy.
Chatanachata miah pathlatuhpazy bie a vaw pie hapa hawhta, a biepiepazy, a bieraopazy nata a ryureinazy zyh ta, a lâpi zydua a chhih awpa ta, eima palôh ano lâta a paheisa thei aw.

He ei bie reipazy, Abeipa hmiakô liata hiana ei tlôkheipazy he, chhô nah zâ ta Abeipa eima Khazohpa lâta a hnia sala, noh chareih ta â ngiahna lymâ hawhta, a chakaotuhpa nata a phopi Izarei chhâh he a châh lymâ mawh sy.
Chatanachata khizaw phopi zydua ta Abeipa deita he Khazohpa cha a châ, Khazoh hropa y veih ei, tahpa ama pahno aw.
Chavâta tanoh hawhna heta, Abeipa eima Khazohpa chô liata palôh phapakipa phaoh lymâ u la, a bieraopazy a chhihpa ta, a biepiepazy zyh lymâ muh vy,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha abei nata a hnohta a ypa Izarei saw zydua ta Abeipa hmiakô liata atheihna hlâ ei ta.
Sawlawmaw ta Abeipa lâta aryhna hlâna châta viahchao tôhpa 22,000 nata mietaku 120,000 Abeipa lâ hlâ ta. Cha hawhna chata abei nata Izarei saw zydua ta Abeipa o cha hlâ ei ta.

Cha noh lilaw liata, Abeipa o laihmia lâta dôhpachhôh tlyhmia liah chaipa cha, Bei Sawlawmaw ta Abeipa hmiakô liata pathaisa ta. Cha liata raopa hlâna, niepa hlâna nata aryhna hlâna thawzy hlâ ta. Abeipa hmiakô liata dawh maisâh cha raopa hlâna, niepa hlâna nata aryhna hlâna thaw hlâ nawpazy châta a chyh tu hapa vâta, dôhpachhôh tlyhmia liata hlâpa a châ.
Cha daihti liata Sawlawmaw ta kyhchhi noh sari tao ta. Lebôhamâ tawhta Izi Chavah taihta Izarei saw zydua a ki khaipa ta, zawpi hluhpi Abeipa eima Khazohpa hmiakô liata tlôpakhy ei ta.

A noh chariena noh ta zawpizy cha papaisa ta, abei cha byhnâ awpa ei ta, Abeipa ta a chakaotuhpa Dâvi nata a phopi Izarei chô liata phana a palâsapa zydua vâta, a ly ngaitapa nata palôh tlâh ngaitapa ta ama o chyu lâ amâ di haw.
Sawlawmaw ta Zehôvâh Khazohpa o nata abei o cha sa khai ta, o a sa khohpa zydua a paloh khaipa nahta,
Kibiô liata a hnohta â luahpa hawhna khata, Abeipa cha Sawlawmaw hnohta a vaw luah heih ta.

Abeipa ta a hnohta. “Na thlahchhâna nata na hiana, ei hmiakô liata na tlôkheipazy kha ei vaw thei haw. He Achhyna o na sapa he pathaisa na ta, he liata ei moh chhâzaw ta ei paysa haw. He liana heta ei mo nata ei palôh khâ a y ngâ thlâh ha aw.
Nâ chhao, na paw Dâvi hawhta palôh dopa nata siapa phaopa ta ei mohmô liata y la, bie ei cha piepa zydua tao la, ei bieraopazy nata ei pachianazy na zyh khiahta cha,
na paw Dâvi hnohta, ‘Izarei beidyuchhai liata a tyuh awpa na pathla tawhta chie aw veih ei,’ tahpa ta bie ei vaw taih hapa hawhta, Izarei chô liata nâ beina beidyuchhai cha chhâzaw ta ei pa-i aw.

Nâmo tlyma, nama pathlazy tlyma, eina zipa tawh ei chi ta na tleisaipa ta, nama hmiakô liata ei sopa ei biepiepazy nata ei bieraopazy zyh leipa ta, khazoh hropazy pangaipa ta, âmo cha chakaopa ta namâ chhy khiahta deikua cha,

Izarei cha râh ei piepa tawhna heta chhawh pathlah aw na ta, ei moh châta Achhyna o ei pathaisapa chhao he ei mohmô tawhta ei pasie syulyu ha aw. Chatanachata Izarei cha a chhiena lâta pakhona bieso châta nata pasipasawhna bie châta phopizy hry liata hmâpa a châ aw.
He o he raona a pachona a châ aw. A chapiapa maihta noâhpa ta ama hmaotô chie aw ei ta, ‘Khazia ma Abeipa ta he râh nata he o he, he hawhta a tao ha tly?’ tah aw ei ta,

chyhsazy ta, ‘Ama pathlatuhpazy Izi râh tawhta a chhi papuatuhpa Abeipa ama Khazohpa siesai ei ta, khazoh hropazy a patupa ta, a chhy ei ta, ama chakaopa vâta, Abeipa ta he chhiena zydua he ama chô liata a patlôsapa a châ,’ ama tah aw,” tah ta.
Sawlawmaw ta o miano, Abeipa o nata abei o cha, kô kih chhôh sa ta, a paloh tawhta,
Tyre bei Hirâ ta Sawlawmaw cha sidy thozy, meisah vyhpa thozy nata ngôhzy a byuhna zie hawhta â tôh khaipa vâta, Bei Sawlawmaw ta Hirâ cha Kâlili râh liata a ypa khih kih pie ta.
Hirâ cha Sawlawmaw ta khihpi a piepazy mo awpa ta Tyre tawhta a zu ta, châhrasala cha khihpizy chata palysa leipa ei ta.
Sawlawmaw hnohta, “He khih eina piepazy chi he kheihawhpa khihzy ma ama châ tly, ei unawhpa?” tah ta. Chavâta cha râh cha tanoh taihta Kabu tahpa a châ.
Hirâ ta abei hnohta ngôh talent 120 a vaw paphao hapa kha châ ta.
Bei Sawlawmaw ta rai hria awpa ta chyhsa a pathyu raruahna chhâpa cha, Abeipa o, ano o, diahsua, Zerusale thokhy, Hâzaw khihpi, Mekidô khihpi nata Keze khihpi zy padua awpa a byuhpa vâta a châ.
Izi bei Phiraoh ta khy ta Keze khih la ta, mei ta rao ta, cha khihpi liata a ypa Kâna mo thie ta, khihpi cha a sawchanô, Sawlawmaw lapinô hnohta thyukhei châta a pie.
Sawlawmaw ta Keze khihpi cha paduapathi ta, Mathi Behôrô khihpi chhao a paduapathi.
Bâlathâ khihpi nata Zudâh râhchawhpa liata Tâmâri khihpi paduapathi ta.

Hmo sopakhyna khihpi a hneipa zydua, a talailihzy sona khihpizy, a arâ pheisaih khihpizy nata a padua khohpa maih cha, Zerusale khihpi liata nata Lebanaw liata nata a khinarâh chhôh zydua liata Sawlawmaw ta a padua lymâ.
Izarei saw a châ leipa Amawri mo, Hiti mo, Perizi mo nata Zebu mo laibâhpa zydua,
cha liata ama pathla laibâhpa a ypa, Izarei sawzy ta ama pahleipadia khai thei leipazy cha, Sawlawmaw ta seizy ta tao ta, cha hawhna chata tanoh taihta ama y.
Izarei sawzy deikua cha, Sawlawmaw ta sei ta tao leipa ta, pheisaihzy, a chakaotuhpazy, a beimachâzy, a pheisaih hyutuhpazy, a talailih hyutuhpazy nata a arâ pheisaihzy ta a tao ei.
Âmo cha Sawlawmaw raihria chô liata hyutuhpazy châ ei ta, raihria vaituhpazy cha ama zydua ta 550 ama châ.
Phiraoh sawchanô deikua cha Dâvi khihpi tawhta Sawlawmaw ta ano châta o a sapa lâ khy ta. Sawlawmaw ta a o cha diahsua chhôhpa ta.

Sawlawmaw ta Abeipa châta maisâh a taopa liata kô kha ta ei thôh raopa hlâna nata aryhna hlâna hlâ tyh ta. Abeipa hmiakô liata maisâh liana chata ropahâhpazy chhao rao tyh ta. Chatanachata Achhyna o cha a paloh haw.
Bei Sawlawmaw ta Edômâ râh liata Tilaipi Saihpa ngiahkâ Elô kiapâh liata a ypa Eziôkebe su liata balyh py padua ta.
Hirâ ta ano a chakaotuhpa tilaipi yzie a pahnopa balyh chyhsazy cha, Sawlawmaw chakaotuhpazy hnohta balyh liata hria awpa ta tuah ta.
Balyh chyhsazy cha Ôphi lâ sie ei ta, cha tawhna chata ngôh talent 420 vaw phaoh ei ta, Bei Sawlawmaw lâta ama vaw tlôkhei.
Abeipa moh châta a hmotaopazy kyh liata Sawlawmaw moh pathâhnazie zy Sebâ beinô ta a thei nahta, bie khiakhi ngaitapazy ta pasia a chhuahpa ta ano lâ khy ta.
Zituhpa hluhpi nata ia-ôzy nata ngôh nata lôsôhpa hluhpi a phaohpa râraoseihpazy chhaota Zerusale lâ khy ta. Sawlawmaw kô a tlô nahta, a palôh liata a ypa zydua hiahri ta.
Sawlawmaw ta a hiahripa zydua cha a chhy khai ta, abei ta a chhopasia thei leipa bienyupa khâpa hmah y vei.
Sebâ beinô ta Sawlawmaw sozie zydua, a o sapa,

a tlâhkhai liata niedo, a beimachâzy atyuna paryhzie, a chakaotuhpazy chakaozie nata amâ tobizie, a nyu hlâtuhpazy nata Abeipa o liata raopa hlâna a hlâpazy a hmôpa cha, a huhiah chhao so pha thei khao leipa ta.
Abei hnohta, “Na biereipa nata na sozie zy ama reipa ei râh liata ei vaw theipa kha, â vaw do tlai he zaw.
Châhrasala a khy na ta, ei mo tlai ta ei kaw hmô hlâ heta cha, ama reipa kha zo hlei va na. Â khophie chhao eina chho leipa ei he. Na sozie nata na hneirôhzie he ama reipa ei theipa a khô syulyu haw.
Na chyhsazy ama nohlao kaw dia! Na hmiakô liata a duah ta, na sona bie a thei tyhpa châ chakaotuhpazy ama nohlao kaw na!

Na chô liata a ly ta, Izarei beidyuchhai liata châ patyutuhpa Abeipa na Khazohpa cha reithaipa ta y maw sy! Abeipa ta Izarei he chhâzaw ta kyhpachâ ta, chavâta adona nata siana ta ryu na reih thei nawpa ta bei ta a cha tao hih,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Sebâ Beinô ta Bei Sawlawmaw cha ngôh talent 120 nata ia-ô hluhpi nata lôsôhpazy pie ta. Sebâ Beinô ta Sawlawmaw a piepa ia-ô tlu ta a hluhpa a ngia beih khao vei.
Ôphi tawhta ngôh a vaw phaoh tyhpa Hirâ balyhzy ta Ôphi tawhta almu tho hluhpi nata lôsôhpazy chhao vaw phaoh ei ta.

Abei ta almu thozy cha Abeipa o nata abei o dyuhna châta nata hlasathaipazy châta totâ nata tlaipihzy taona châta hmâh ta. Cha tlu ta a hluhpa almu tho cha tanoh taihta vaw tlô khao leipa ta, hmô awpa y khao hra vei.
Bei Sawlawmaw ta Sebâ beinô cha, bei lymâ a piepazy thota, a khopa maih nata a hiapa maih pie ta. Chatanachata a chakaotuhpazy chhaota a râh lâ a lie ha ta.
Sawlawmaw liata kô kha chhôh ta ngôh a ngiapa cha talent 666 a châ.
Chazy cha sôdaohpazy, sôhpaliepazy, notla bei zydua nata râh ryureituhpazy ta râhpaw ama piepazy thota Sawlawmaw liata a ngiapa ngôhzy a châ.
Bei Sawlawmaw ta ngôh ta daipa vyhphao laipa 200 tao ta, vyhphao miakha liata ngôh sekel 600 lymâ hmâpa a châ.
Chatawhcha ngôh ta daipa vyhphao 300 tao ta, vyhphao miakha liata ngôh minâ miathôh lymâ hmâpa a châ. Chazy cha abei ta Lebanaw Râhmâhpa O liata soh ta.
Abei ta sianaoh beidyuchhai rônah ngaitapa chhao tao ta, ngôh pha chaipa ta pahu ta.
Beidyuchhai cha a kiana kahmi chhâh charu y ta, beidyuchhai hnôh lâ cha a hlô ta, dyuchhai kâ chavei chachâh ta a ku y ta, a kuzy kiah liata chakeibarôhneipa nothlahpa pô no a duah ta.

Beidyuchhai kahmi chhâh charuzy liata a kâ chavei chachâh ta chakeibarôhneipa nothlahpa pô hrawh hleino, chhâh kha liata pô no lymâ ta a duah ta. Cha hawhpa beidyuchhai cha kheihawhpa khinarâh châta hmah tao beih veih ei.

Bei Sawlawmaw nyu zydua cha ngôh nyu sai châ ta, Lebanaw Râhmâhpa O liata hmobaoh zydua chhao ngôh suapa ta taopa sai a châ. Tâkâ ta taopa y tlâ vei. Sawlawmaw daihti liata la, tâkâ cha khâpa saw ta reih veih ei.
Abei ta tilaipi liata Tâsi balyhzy hnei ta, chazy cha Hirâ balyhzy nata sie khoh tyh ei ta. Tâsi balyhzy chata kô thôh padai ta ei kha ngôh, tâkâ, sianaoh, veituh nata varapa zy vaw phaoh tyh ta.
Cha hawhna chata Bei Sawlawmaw cha hneirôna nata sona liata khizaw bei zydua a khô khai ha ei.
Kha­zohpa ta a palôh liata sona a sopa nathlie awpa ta, khizaw zydua ta Sawlawmaw cha ama pangai tyh.
A pangaipa maihta kuhriazy phaopa tyh ei ta, tâkâ nata ngôh hmobaohzy, chysiazy, myrâzy, ia-ôzy, arâzy, sabaituzy kô chareih ta ama vaw phaopa tyh.
Sawlawmaw ta talailihzy nata arâ pheisaihzy pahmaoh pakhy ta. Talailih 1,400 nata arâ pheisaih 12,000 hnei ta, chazy cha talailih sona khihpizy nata abei yna Zerusale liata soh ta.
Abei ta tâkâ cha alô hawhta pachâna taihta Zerusale liata pachô ta, sidy tho chhao Sephelâ liata theiku tho hawhta hluhpa ta a pachô.
Sawlawmaw arâzy cha Izi râh tawhta nata Kue tawhta chaleipa châ ei ta, abei sôhpalietuhpazy ta a mâ piepa ta Kue liata amâ hlâ tyh.
Talailih miakha ta sekel 600 lymâ ta nata arâ pô kha ta sekel 150 lymâ ta Izi râh lâ za chalei ei ta, abei sôhpalietuhpazy hmâpa ta Hiti beizy nata Syria beizy lâta ama zuah pachhuah tyh.
Sawlawmaw ta Phiraoh sawchanô thota, chihropa chanô hluhpi, Môabâ zuahzy, Amawna zuahzy, Edômâ zuahzy, Sidaw zuahzy, Hiti zuahzy khoh ta.

Âmo he Abeipa ta Izarei sawzy hnohta, “Âmo nama hnei awpa châ leipa ta, âmo chhao ta ama cha hnei awpa châ vei, ama khazohzy lâta nama palôh ama cha paheihsa thlyu awpa vâta,” tahpa ta a vaw rei hapa phopizy kha ama châ. Cha chihropa zuahzy cha Sawlawmaw ta khohpa ta âmo cha khâchâ patu ta.
Abei sawchanô sai ta nôbei 700 hnei ta, nôtho 300 a hnei. A lapinôzy heta a palôh ama patleisa hapa a châ.
Sawlawmaw cha a vaw machâ nahta, a lapinôzy ta khazoh hropazy lâta a palôh patleisa ei ta, a paw Dâvi palôh hawhta Abeipa a Khazohpa lâta a palôh tlokhuh hlâ thei khao vei.
Sawlawmaw cha Sidaw mo khazohnô Astarô nata Amawna mo khazoh pasichhihpa Mikô zy a chhy ta.
Chavâta Sawlawmaw cha Abeipa mohmô liata hmo pha leipa tao ta, a paw Dâvi taozie hawhta, Abeipa cha tlokhuh ta pazi vei.
Sawlawmaw ta Môabâ mo khazoh pasichhihpa Khemô châta nata Amawna mo khazoh pasichhihpa Môleka châta Zerusale nochhi lâ tlâh liata su sâhpa tao ta.
Cha hawhna chata chihropa a lapinô zydua châta su sâhpa taopa ta, cha liata ama khazohzy lâta hmohlâpa nata atheihnazy ama hlâ tyh.
Sawlawmaw palôh cha, a hnohta ei no po a luahpa Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa a tleisai hapa vâta, Sawlawmaw chô liata Abeipa a hiehâh ta.
He hmo kyh liana heta, Abeipa ta Sawlawmaw cha khazoh hropazy pazi lei awpa ta bie a pie hapa châ ta. Châhrasala Abeipa biepiepa cha zyh khao vei.
Chavâta Abeipa ta Sawlawmaw hnohta, “He hawhta y ha chi ta, zyh awpa ta bie ei cha piepa, ei biehrai nata ei bieraopazy na zyh leipa vâta, khinarâh he cha chhu aw na ta, châ chakaotuhpa ei pie aw.
Na paw Dâvi vâta nâma hro chhôh ta deikua cha, tao mâh leipa aw na ta, na sawchapawpa ku tawhta ei chhu aw.
Chatahrasala khinarâh cha a zydua ta cha chhu khai aw va na. Nâ chakaotuhpa Dâvi vâta nata ei tlyhpa Zerusale vâta, Izarei chi kha cha na sawchapawpa ei pie aw,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Abeipa ta Edômâ chyhsa Hâdâ cha Sawlawmaw khakhaipa lâta pachâsa ta. Ano he Edômâ râh liata abei pathla a châ.
Edômâ râh liata Dâvi a y nota, chyhsa ama thiepazy pabu awpa ta pheisaih hyutuhpa Zôabâ cha khy ta, Edômâ râh liata chapaw zydua a thie khai hapa kha a châ.
Zôabâ nata Izarei zydua cha cha liata thla charu tlai y ei ta, Edômâ râh liata chapaw zydua a thie khai hlâlei ama ypa kha a châ.
Châhrasala Hâdâ cha a paw chakaotuhpazy hry liata Edômâ chyhsa thokhazy chhaota Izi râh lâ a râ ha ta. He no heta Hâdâ cha hawtita a châ chy.

Midia râh tawhta pua ei ta, Pârâ lâ sie ei ta, Pârâ tawhta chyhsa a chhipa ta Izi râh lâ sie ei ta, Izi bei Phiraoh kô za tlô ei ta. Phiraoh ta Hâdâ cha o pie ta, a nie awpa pachâpa ta, râh chhao a pie.
Hâdâ cha Phiraoh mo a dy kaw ta, chatanachata a lapinô beinô Tâpene narônô cha lapi­nô ta pahneisa ta.
Tâpene narônô chata sawchapawpa Kenubâ sapa ta, Tâpene ta a sawchapawpa cha sâhpi a pathleihna taihta Phiraoh o liata mohôh ta. Kenubâ cha Phiraoh o liata Phiraoh sawzy hry liata y ta.

Dâvi cha a pathlatuhpazy hnohta â mô haw tahpa nata pheisaih hyutuhpa Zôabâ chhao a thi haw tahpa Hâdâ ta Izi râh tawhta a vaw thei nahta, Hâdâ ta Phiraoh hnohta, “Ei râh lâ a lie awpa ta na pasiesa mah y,” tah ta.

Phiraoh ta a hnohta, “Ei hnohta na ypa heta khâpa ma a phahla chi ta, na râh lâ a lie awpa cha na khoh tly?” tah ta. Hâdâ ta, “Khâpa hmah a phahla va na. Châhrasala rie na pasiesa thlâh ha teh,” tah ta.
Khazohpa ta Sawlawmaw khakhaipa châta Eliadâ sawchapawpa Rezô chhao pathyu ta. Rezô he a zibeipa Zôbabi bei Hadâdeze tawhta â râpa kha a châ.

Ano he Dâvi ta Zôbabi mo a pahnie tawhta, ano lâta chyhsazy awpakhy ta, hraotuhpa py hyutuhpa ta a ypa kha a châ. Dâmaskâ khihpi lâ sie ei ta, cha liata pahrâ ei ta, Dâmaskâ khihpi liata ano cha bei ta ama tao.
Ano chhao he Hâdâ hawhna khata Sawlawmaw rie a patheituhpa châ ta, Sawlawmaw hro chhôh zydua ta Izarei khakhaipa châ lymâ ta, Izarei a chhyh thai leipa a châ. Aramia râh chô liata ryureituhpa ta a y.
Zerôbaw chhao ta abei chô liata a ku hy hra ta. Ano cha Zeredâ khihpa Epharai chyhsa Sawlawmaw chakaotuhpa Nebâ sawchapawpa a châ. A nô moh cha Zerua châ ta, nôhmeipa a châ.
Abei chô liata a ku a hyna chhâpa cha he vâna heta a châ. Sawlawmaw ta diahsua chhôh ta, a paw Dâvi khihpi raonazy a taopathi.
Zerôbaw cha chyhsa thatlôpa nata riahphapa châ ta, raihria a saomâ kawpa satlia a châpa Sawlawmaw ta a hmô nahta, Zawsi pathla raihriatuhpa zydua chô liata hyutuhpa ta tao ta.
Cha daihti liata, Zerôbaw Zerusale tawhta a puapa cha Silôni chyhsa hrohsopa Ahiza ta lâpi liata vaw hmô ta. Ahiza cha chysia thiehpa a tobi ta, ama pano deita ta lyurâhpa liata y ei ta.
Ahiza ta a chysia thiehpa â tobipa cha la ta, hlai hrawh hleino lâta hrie ta.
Zerôbaw hnohta, “Hlai hrawh a la teh, Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa ta hetana heta a tah: ‘Pachâ teh, khinarâh he Sawlawmaw ku tawhta chhu aw na ta, Izarei chi hrawh ei cha pie aw.
Nâ chakaotuhpa Dâvi vâta nata Izarei chi zydua hry tawhta ei tlyhpa Zerusale khihpi vâna heta, ano ta Izarei chi kha a hnei aw.

Kei na tleisaipa ta, Sidaw mo khazohnô Astarô nata Môabâ mo khazoh Khemô nata Amawna mo khazoh Mikô zy a chhy ei ta, a paw Dâvi taopa hawhta ei lâpizy a chhih leipa ta, ei mohmô liata hmo dopa tao leipa ta, ei bieraopazy nata ei ryureinazy a zyh leipa vâta, cha cha ei tao aw.
Châhrasala ei biepiepazy nata ei bieraopazy a zyhpa, ei tlyhpa nâ chakaotuhpa Dâvi vâta, khinarâh cha a zydua ta a ku tawhtapa chhu khai aw va na. A hro chhôh zydua cha bei ta ei paysa awh.
A sawchapawpa ku tawhta deikua cha khinarâh he chhu aw na ta, Izarei chi hrawhzy cha nâma ei cha pie aw.
Ei moh y nawpa ta ei tlyhpa Zerusale khihpi liana heta nâ chakaotuhpa Dâvi cha meiôh a hnei lymâ thei nawpa ta, a sawchapawpa hnohta chi kha ei pie aw.
Nâ he bei ta cha tao aw na ta, na palôh khopa hawhta ryureih aw chi ta, Izarei chô liata bei ta na y aw.

Bie ei cha piepa zydua nathliepa ta, ei lâpizy a chhihpa ta, nâ chakaotuhpa Dâvi taopa hawhta, ei bieraopazy nata ei biepiepazy zyhpa ta, ei mohmô liata hmo dopa na tao khiahta cha, na hnohta y aw na ta, Dâvi pathla ei paduapa hawhta, na pathla chhao padua aw na ta, Izarei he ei cha pie aw.
Cha vâna chata Dâvi pathlazy cha pasa pataosa aw ei na ta, chhâzaw châta deikua la châ aw vei,’” tah ta.
Cha vâna chata Sawlawmaw ta Zerôbaw cha thie a chhuah ta. Châhrasala Zerôbaw cha thyu ta, Izi râh liata Izi bei Sisâ lâ a râ ta, Sawlawmaw thi hlâlei cha Izi râh liata y ta.
Sawlawmaw thâtih hropazy nata a hmotaopa zydua nata a sonazy cha Sawlawmaw hmotaopa rona châbu liata ro khaipa a châ.
Sawlawmaw ta Izarei râh zydua chô liata Zerusale liata ryu a rei chhôh cha kô sypalih a châ.
Sawlawmaw cha a pathlatuhpazy hnohta a mô ta, a paw Dâvi khihpi liata pabu ei ta, a sawchapawpa Rehôbaw ta ano su liata â bei.
Izarei saw zydua ta Rehôbaw cha bei ta tao awpa ta Sekhe liata a hmaoh ei ta, chavâta Rehôbaw cha Sekhe lâ sie ta.
Cha thâtih cha Nebâ sawchapawpa Zerôbaw ta a theipata nahta, Izi râh tawhta a kaw lie ta. Zerôbaw cha Bei Sawlawmaw riahchi ta â râna Izi râh liata a y thlâh ha chy no châ ta.
Chyhsa tuah ei ta, kei padysa ei ta. Zerôbaw nata Izarei a hmaohpakhypa zydua a vy ei ta, Rehôbaw hnohta,

“Na paw khata eima raopaky pahri ngaita tyh ta. Chavâta na paw ta rie miah patheipa nata raopaky a hri ngaitapa eima chô liata a pahniehpa he miah pahuapa la, chatanachata eima cha chakao aw,” tah ei ta.
Rehôbaw ta ama hnohta, “Noh thôh chhôh a di chy u la, cha khai tawhta kei lâ a vy heih muh vy,” tah ta. Chatanachata zawpizy cha sie ha ei ta.
Bei Rehôbaw ta a paw Sawlawmaw a hro nota, a hmiakô liata a duah tyhpa pawhrâhpazy a saohiah ta, ama hnohta, “He zawpizy he kheihawhta a chhy awpa ta ma ryh eina raokhei aw ei chi?” tah ta.
Âmo ta a hnohta, “He zawpizy chakaotuhpa ta tanoh y la, âmo cha chakao la, bie phapa ta nâ chhy khiah ei ta cha, chhâzaw ta châ chakaotuhpa ta ama y aw,” tah ei ta.
Châhrasala pawhrâhpazy ryhraokheina cha thy ta, ano richâhkha thyutlia a hmiakô liata a duah tyhpazy tlao a saohiah ta.
Ama hnohta, “‘Na paw ta raopaky miah a pakypa miah pahuapa teh,’ nâ tahpa zawpizy he kheihta a chhy awpa ta ma ryh eina raokhei aw ei chi?” tah ta.

A richâhkha thyutliazy ta a hnohta, “‘Na paw khata eima raopaky pahri ngaita tyh ta, nâ ta cha miah pahuapa teh,’ châ tahtuhpa, cha zawpizy hnohna chata, ‘Ei paw byhpizy hlâta ei kuparo tieta a lai via.

Ei paw khata raopaky a hri ngaitapa cha pakysa ei ta, kei ta nama raopaky ei baichha aw. Ei paw ta sôsi ta cha chhorei ei ta, kei ta râh cha-ia ta ei cha chhorei aw ei,’ tahpa ta nâ chhy aw,” tah ei ta.
Zerôbaw nata zawpi zydua cha abei ta, “Noh thôhna noh ta a vy heih muh vy,” a tahpa hawhta, a noh thôhna noh ta Rehôbaw lâ a vy ei ta.
Abei ta zawpizy cha reih chahrâh kawpa ta a chhy ta, pawhrâhpazy ta ryhraokheina ama piepa cha a pyh leipa ta,

thyutliapazy ryhraokheina hawhta âmo cha a chhy ta, ama hnohta, “Ei paw ta raopaky a hri ngaitapa cha paky ei ta, kei ta nama raopa­ky ei baichha aw. Ei paw ta sôsi ta cha chhorei ei ta, kei ta râh cha-ia ta ei cha chhorei aw ei,” tah ta.
Zawpi bie cha abei ta nathlie khoh vei. Abeipa ta Silô chyhsa Ahiza hmâpa ta Nebâ sawchapawpa Zerôbaw hnohta bie a reipa a vaw tlô thei nawpa ta, Abeipa ta a pataosapa a châ.

Abei ta ama bie nathlie khoh vei tahpa Izarei saw zydua ta ama hmô nahta, zawpi ta, “Dâvi liata tovyuh hnei leipa pi ta, Zese sawchapawpa liata ryuto hnei ma pi! Hy Izarei, nama poh o chyu lâ a di teh u; Nâ Davi, na chhôhkha tlâ pachâ teh,” tahpa ta abei cha a chhy ei ta, Izarei sawzy cha ama poh o lâ chyu a di ha ei ta.
Rehôbaw cha Zudâh khihpizy liata a pahrâpa Izarei sawzy chô lia deita â bei.

Bei Rehôbaw ta raihriatuhpazy hyutuhpa Adôrâ cha Zerôbaw py lâ tuah ta, châhrasala Izarei saw zydua ta alô ta vawhsao ha ei ta. Chatawhcha Bei Rehôbaw cha talailih liata thlai kiah ta, Zerusale lâ â râ haw.
Chatanachata Izarei sawzy cha tanoh taihta Dâvi pathlazy amâ chariah lymâ.

Zerôbaw â kaw lie haw tahpa Izarei zydua ta ama thei nahta, a hmaohpakhyna liata a vy awpa ta paawsa ei ta, Izarei zydua chô liata bei ta ama tao haw. Zudâh chi tah leipa ta cha Dâvi pathlazy a pazipa ahy hmahta y vei ei.

Rehôbaw cha Zerusale a tlô nahta, Izarei maw lâ chizy a dyuh ta, khinarâh cha Sawlawmaw sawchapawpa Rehôbaw khinarâh ta pachâsa heih awpa ta, Zudâh pathla zydua nata Benzami chi tawhta pasaipha chaipazy 180,000 awpakhy ta.
Châhrasala Khazohpa chyhsa Semiah hnohta Khazohpa bie vaw tlô ta,
“Sawlawmaw sawchapawpa, Zudâh bei Rehôbaw hnohta nata Zudâh nata Benzami pathla zydua hnohta nata zawpi zydua hnohta,

‘ Abeipa ta hetana heta a tah: Nama khy awpa châ leipa ta, nama unawhpa Izarei sawzy namâ kaw dyuh awpa châ vei. Nama o chyu lâta a di ha teh u. He bie he keima tawhta a puapa a châ,’ tahpa ta reih teh,” tah ta. Abeipa bie cha thei ei ta, Abeipa bie hawhta, o lâ a di ha ei ta.
Zerôbaw cha Epharai tlâh râh liata Sekhe khih padua ta, cha liata pahrâ ta. Cha tawhna chata pua ta, Penia khihpi padua ta.
Zerôbaw ta a palôh ta, “Abeinarâh he Dâvi pathlazy eih a châ thlâh ha heih thei ngyu aw.

He phopi heta Zerusale liata Abeipa Achhyna o liata atheihnazy hlâ awpa ta ama khy khiahta cha, he phopi palôh he ama zibeipa Zudâh bei Rehôbaw lâ a heih heih aw ta, kei he na thie aw ei ta, Zudâh bei Rehôbaw lâ amâ palie heih thei ngyu aw,” tah ta.

Abei cha chyhsa a saohiah ta, ngôh viahchaotaw pô no tao ta. Zawpi hnohta, “Zerusale lâ khy ngâ thlâh hapa cha nâmo châta rairu ngaitapa a châ. Chavâta Hy Izarei sawzy, moh teh u, hezy he Izi râh tawhta châ kaw chhi papuatuhpa nama khazohzy ama châ hih,” tah ta.
Viahchaotaw miakha Bethel liata soh ta, miakha Dânâ liata soh ta.
Chazy cha a chhy awpa ta Izarei phopi cha Dânâ taihta sie tyh ei ta. Chavâta cha hmo cha moleina vaw châ ha ta.
Zerôbaw cha su sâhpazy liata achhyna ozy sa ta, Livai pathla a châ leipa, chi to hry tawhta theihthaipazy rao ta.

Zudâh râh liata kyhchhi ama hnei tyhpa hawhta, thla chariena, noh hrawh hleipangawhna noh cha, Zerôbaw ta kyhchhi noh ta rao hra ta, maisâh liata atheihnazy a hlâ tyh. Cha hawhna chata Bethel liata tao ta, viahchaotaw nothlahpa a taopazy lâ cha atheihnazy hlâ ta. Su sâhpa a paduapa châta theihthaipazy cha Bethel liata soh ta.
Ano kho ta a raopa thla, thla chariena, noh hrawh hleipangawh noh liata, Bethel liata maisâh a taopa lâ cha khy tyh ta. Izarei sawzy châta kyhchhi rao ta, maisâh lâ khy ta atheihnazy a hlâ tyh.
Abeipa biepiepa hawhta, Zudâh tawhta Khazohpa chyhsa pakha Bethel lâ a vy ta. Zerôbaw cha maisâh kiapâh liata hmo hlâ awpa ta a duah ta.

Khazohpa chyhsa chata Abeipa bie ta maisâh cha awsao ta, “Hy maisâh, maisâh, Abeipa ta hetana heta a tah: ‘Nathlie teh, Dâvi pathlazy hry liata sawchapawpa, a moh Zôsia vaw pih aw ta, na chô liata atheihna a hlâ tyhpa su sâhpa theihthaipazy kha thie aw ta, âmo cha na chô liata vaw hlâ aw ta, chyhsapa rureihzy na chô liata raopa a châ aw,’” tah ta.

Cha noh lilaw liata Khazohpa chyhsa ta ngiana pie heih ta, Zerôbaw hnohta, “He he ngiana Abeipa ta a reipa cha a châ. Abeipa ta, ‘Pachâ teh, maisâh he patlawchheihpa châ aw ta, a chô liata buchâhzy cha leihtha khaipa a châ aw,’ a tah,” tah ta.

Khazohpa chyhsa ta Bethel liata maisâh awsaopa ta, bie a reipazy cha abei ta a thei nahta, Zerôbaw cha maisâh tawhta a ku pazawh ta, “Kha chyhsa kha patu teh u,” tah ta. Châhrasala Khazohpa chyhsa lâta a ku a pazawhpa cha eikhapi ta vaw sy ha ta, a ku cha ano lâ a dao thei khao leipa ta.
Khazohpa chyhsa ta Abeipa bie ta ngiana a reipa hawhna kha ta, maisâh chhao cha a vaw patlawchheih ta, maisâh liata buchâhzy cha a leihtha khai ha ta.

Chatawhcha abei ta a chhy ta, Khazohpa chyhsa hnohta, “Ei ku he a tlâh heih thei nawpa ta Abeipa na Khazohpa lâ ngiachhiena na hiapa la, thlah na chhâpa teh,” tah ta. Khazohpa chyhsa ta Abeipa lâ thlahchhâ ta, abei ku cha vaw tlâh heihpa ta, a y tyhpa hawhta vaw y ha ta.
Chatawhcha abei ta Khazohpa chyhsa hnohta, “Ei hnohta o lâ a vy la, a vaw pahâ chy mah y, lymâ ei cha pie aw,” tah ta.
Khazohpa chyhsa ta abei hnohta, “Na o khophie rai nâ pie awpa châ la, na hnohta a vy aw va na. He su liana heta viahchhâ nie leipa aw na ta, ti chhao doh aw va na.
Abeipa bie ta, ‘Viahchhâ na nie awpa châ leipa ta, ti chhao na do awpa châ leipa ta, nâ vyna lâpi lâta nâ lie heih awpa châ vei,’ tahpa ta bie eina pie haw,” tah ta.
Chatanachata lâpi hropa lâta sie ta, â vyna Bethel lâpi lâ tawhta a lie khao vei.
Bethel khih liata hrohsopa pawpipa pakha y ta. A sawchapawzy a vy ei ta, cha noh ta Bethel liata Khazohpa chyhsa hmotaopa zydua cha chho ei ta. Abei hnohta bie a reipazy chhao kha ama paw chho ei ta.
Ama paw ta ama hnohta, “Khataih lâpi lâta ma a sie” tah ta. A sawchapawzy ta Zudâh râh tawhta a vypa Khazohpa chyhsa siena lâpi cha chho ei ta.
A sawchapawzy hnohta, “Alâ ky na padiapa teh u,” tah ta. Alâ ky cha padiapa ei ta, kiah ta.
Khazohpa chyhsa cha a chadai ta, ôkâ tho ry liata â tyu thlâh hapa kei hmô ta, a hnohta, “Nâma he ma Zudâh râh tawhta a vypa Khazohpa chyhsa chi cha?” tah ta. Ano ta, “Ei châ mâh tâh,” tah ta.
Hrohsopa ta Khazohpa chyhsa hnohta, “Ei hnohta ei o lâ a vy la, viahchhâ vaw nie mah y,” tah ta.
Khazohpa chyhsa ta, “Na hnohta a vaw lie thei awpa châ leipa na ta, na o liata a ngia thei awpa châ va na. He su liana chhao heta na hnohta viahchhâ a nie thei awpa nata ti a doh thei awpa châ va na.
Abeipa bie ta ei hnohta, ‘Cha liata viahchhâ na nie awpa châ leipa ta, ti chhao na do awpa châ leipa ta, nâ vyna lâpi lâta nâ lie heih awpa châ vei,’ tahpa ta eina chho haw,” tah ta.

Hrohsopa ta a hnohta, “Kei chhao he nâ hawhta hrohsopa ei châ hra. Vâlyuhchâpa ta ei hnohta, ‘Viahchhâ zy niepa ta, ti zy doh awpa ta, na hnohta na o lâ a chhi mah y,’ tahpa ta Abeipa bie ta eina chho,” tah ta. Cha cha haipa bie a chhopa a châ.
Chatanachata Khazohpa chyhsa cha hrohsopa hnohna chata a lie ha ta. A o liata viahchhâ zy niepa ta, ti zy doh ta.
Tlâhkhai ama dôh nota, a kuakheituhpa hrohsopa hnohta Abeipa bie vaw tlô ta.
Hrohsopa ta Zudâh râh tawhta a vypa Khazohpa chyhsa hnohta, “ Abeipa ta hetana heta a tah: ‘ Abeipa bie a ngiah leipa chi ta, Abeipa na Khazohpa ta bie a cha piepa zyh leipa chi ta,
a vaw lie chi ta, “Viahchhâ nie leipa la, ti chhao doh khah y,” a cha tahna su liata viahchhâ nie chi ta, ti na dopa vâta, châ pathlatuhpazy thlâ liata na ri a zia aw vei,’ a tah” tah ta.
Viahchhâ nie ta, ti a do khai tawhta, hrohsopa ta Khazohpa chyhsa â lie kheipa châta alâ ky padiapa ta.

Khazohpa chyhsa cha sie ta, lâpi liata chakeibarôhneipa ta vaw y khâh ta, siesao ha ta. A ri cha lâpi liata a thy thlâh ha ta, alâ cha a kiapâh liata a duah ta, chakeibarôhneipa chhao cha a ri kiapâh liata a duah thlâh ha hra ta.

Cha su a chapiapa chyhsazy ta lâpi liata ri â thy thlâh hapa nata ri kiapâh liata chakeibarôhneipa a duah thlâh hapa cha hmô ei ta. A vy ei ta, cha thâtih cha hrohsopa pawpipa yna khih liata reih ei ta.

Cha thâtih cha lâpi tawhta ano a vaw kua kheipa hrohsopa khata a thei nahta, “ Abeipa bie a ngiah leipa Khazohpa chyhsa kha a châ chuh. Abeipa ta a hnohta a reipa bie hawh tlai ta, Abeipa ta chakeibarôhneipa lâta hlâ ta, vaw chaphy ta a siesao hapa a châ chuh,” tah ta.
A sawchapawzy hnohta, “Alâ ky na padiapa teh u,” tah ta. Padiapa ei ta.

Sie ta, lâpi liata a ri â thy thlâh hapa nata a ri kiapâh liata alâ nata chakeibarôhneipa a duah thlâh hapa zy cha kei hmô ta. Chakeibarôhneipa ta a ri cha vaw nie leipa ta, alâ chhao cha hmah vaw paphao vei.
Hrohsopa ta Khazohpa chyhsa ri cha la ta, alâ chô liata khaih ta, mâchhiesapa awpa nata pabu awpa ta, ano pahrâna khihpi lâ a lie khei ta.
A ri cha ano thlâ liata pazia ta, “A pei rimâ cha, ei unawhpa!” tahpa ta ama chakhei.
A pabu khai nahta, a sawchapawzy hnohta, “Ei thi tita, Khazohpa chyhsa pabuna thlâ liana heta na vaw pabu u la, ei rupazy he ano rupazy kiapâh liata vaw soh muh vy.
Khazohpa bie ta Bethel liata maisâh nata Samâri khihpizy liata su sâhpa o zydua a awsaona biezy kha a vaw tlô thlyu awpa châ tlôh ta,” tah ta.

Cha hmo a vaw tlô khai tawh chhao ta, Zerôbaw cha a yzie doleipa pathleih hlei leipa ta, Izarei chi to hry tawhta chyhsazy cha su sâhpa theihthaipazy châta tao lymâ ta, theihthaipa a châ khohpa maih su sâhpa theihthaipazy châta a rao lymâ ei.
Cha hmo cha Zerôbaw pathlazy châta moleina vaw châ ha ta, âmo a pamuatuhpa nata khizaw tawhta âmo a pahleipadiatuhpa a vaw châ haw.
Cha daihti liata Zerôbaw sawchapawpa Abizah cha pasa ta.

Zerôbaw ta a lapinô hnohta, “Thyu la, Zerôbaw lapinô a châ tahpa ama cha pahno lei nawpa ta a panano la, Silô lâ vawh teh. Cha liata hrohsopa Ahiza y ta, ano cha he phopi chô liata bei ta ei y awpa ei thâtih a reituhpa kha a châ.
Viahchhâ tlâ hrawh, viahchhâ pahupazy nata kheihti ôh kha phaoh la, ano lâ vawh teh. Hawti chô liata hmo a tlô awpa a cha chho aw,” tah ta.
Zerôbaw lapinô ta cha hawh­ta tao ta. Thyu ta, Silô lâ sie ta, Ahiza o cha kei tlô ta. Ahiza cha a machâ hapa vâta a mo zoh ha ta, hmô thei khao leipa ta.
Abeipa ta Ahiza hnohta, “Moh tua, a sawchapawpa pasana kyh liata châ saohiah awpa ta Zerôbaw lapinô nâ lâ â vy huh. Chanô hropa hawhta a vaw tao ta, hetana heta na chho aw,” tah ta.
Ochhi liata â vaw ngiapa a phei pyu a thei nahta, Ahiza ta, “Nâ, Zerôbaw lapinô y, a vaw ngia teh. Khazia chyhsa hropa hawhta nâ tao? Thâtih pha lei ngaitapa cha chho awpa ta tuapa ei châ.
Vawh la, Zerôbaw hnohta, ‘ Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa ta hetana heta a tah: “Izarei phopi sawzy hry tawhta cha cheihchalo na ta, ei phopi Izarei chô liata hyutuhpa ta ei cha tao.

Dâvi pathlazy tawhta khinarâh chhu na ta, nâ ei cha pie. Châhrasala nâ chakaotuhpa Dâvi hawhta y va chi. Ano cha ei biepiepazy a pyh ta, a pathipalôh tlokhuh ta na pazi ta, hmo dopa deita ei mohmô liata a tao tyh.
Nâ deikua cha nâma na y hlâta a vaw y tuapa chyhsa zydua hlâta hmo na parao via pachai. Khazoh hropazy nata nothlahpa leihpazy a tao chi ta, ei hie na pahâh chi ta, hnôh eina chhy ha chi.

Chavâta nathlie teh, Zerôbaw pathlazy chô liata hmo pha leipa ei vaw patlôsa aw. Chapaw maih cha, sei chhao, khotalaipa chhao, Zerôbaw tawhta ei chhawh pathlah khai ha aw ei. Zerôhaw o cha, chyhsa ta viahchao ie a raopa hawhta, a kâ patlô hana taihta mei ta ei rao khai ha aw.
Zerôbaw pathla khihpi liata a thipazy cha i ta chaih aw ei ta, lyurâhpa liata a thipazy cha vâ pavawzy ta ama dyh aw,” cha cha Abeipa ta a reih hawh,’ tah mah y.
Chavâta thyu la, na o la a di teh. Na phei ta khihpi a tlypa nahta, hawti cha a thi aw.

Izarei saw zydua ta ano châta mâchhiesa aw ei ta, ama pabu aw. Zerôbaw pathlazy hry liata, ano lia deita ta Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa a palysapa hmo phapa hmôpa a châpa vâta, Zerôbaw mo nata sa hry liata ano deita he thlâ liata pabupa a châ aw.
