Izarei chô liata ryureituhpazy ta ryu ama rei daihti rakha tawhna kha ta, Izarei beizy daihti chhôh zydua nata Zudâh beizy daihti chhôh zydua ta, Zawpakhô Kyhchhi he ama vaw chay khao leipa a châ.
Bei Zôsia abeina kô hrawh hleichariena kô lia deita ta Zawpakhô Kyhchhi cha Abeipa lâta Zerusale liata ama chay heih theipa a châ.

Cha dei châ vei, Abeipa o liata theihthaipa Hikia ta a hmôpa châbu liata ryhpa bie ropazy a pa-i thei nawpa ta, pachaothaipazy, dyuthaipazy, chhôhkha khazohzy, khazoh nothlahpazy nata Zudâh râh nata Zerusale khihpi liata pasichhihpa ama hmô tyhpa zydua cha, Zôsia ta a pahleipadia khai ha ei.

Mawsi ryhpa zydua hawhta, pathipalôh tlokhuh ta nata thlahpa tlokhuh ta nata thatlôna tlokhuh ta Abeipa lâ a heihpa Bei Zôsia hawhpa cha, ano hlâta a ypa beizy hry liata ahy hmah y leipa ei ta, ano hnôhlâ ta beizy hry liata chhao ano hawhpa ahy hmah y khao veih ei.
Chatanachôta Abeipa ­ta a hiehâhna ru ngaitapa, Manase ta a pathi a pa-iana zydua vâta Zudâh chô liata a hiehâhna cha papai hlei vei.
Abeipa ta, “Izarei ei papuapa hawhta Zudâh chhao ei mohmô tawhta papua aw na ta, khihpi ei tlyhpa, Zerusale nata ‘cha liata ei moh a y aw,’ ei tahpa Achhyna o chhao he hnôh ei chhy aw,” tah ta.
Zôsia thâtih hropazy nata a hmotaopa zydua cha, Zudâh beizy thâtih rona châbu liata ropa a châ.

Zôsia â bei nota, Izi bei Phiraoh Nekô cha Asuria bei a dyuh awpa ta Ufrâti chavah lâ khy ta. Bei Zôsia cha sie ta, Phiraoh Nekô cha Mekidô khih liata a kei duakhâh ta. Phiraoh Nekô ta Zôsia cha hmô ta, a thie haw.

A chakaotuhpazy ta a ri cha Mekidô tawhta Zerusale lâ talailih ta siekhei ei ta, ano thlâ liata ama pabu haw. Râh chyhsazy ta Zôsia sawchapawpa Zehôahâ a chhi ei ta, sathawthu ei ta, a paw su liata bei ta ama tao.
Zehôahâ cha kô kih nata kô thôhpa a châ nota a bei pathao ta, Zerusale liata thla thôh â bei. A nô moh cha Hâmutâ châ ta, Libnâ khihpa Zeremiah sawchanô a châ.
Zehôahâ cha ano pathlatuhpazy taozie zydua hawhta tao hrapa ta, Abeipa mohmô liata hmo pha lei ngaitapa tao ta.
Zehôahâ cha Zerusale liata ryureih thei khao lei awpa ta, Phiraoh Nekô ta Hâmathi râh Riblâ khih liata patâh ta, Zudâh râh cha tâkâ talent za kha nata ngôh talent miakha râhpaw a pacheisa lymâ.
Phiraoh Nekô ta Zôsia sawchapawpa Eliakima cha a paw Zôsia su liata bei ta tao ta, a moh Zehôki tahpa ta a panano. Zehôahâ deikua cha Izi râh lâ siekhei ta, cha liata thi ha ta.

Zehôki ta tâkâ nata ngôh cha Phiraoh pie ta, Phiraoh biepiepa hawhta a tâkâ lâta pie awpa ta, râh liata chhie a khei lymâ. Phiraoh Nekô lâ pie awpa ta, râh chyhsazy chei awpa zie tu ta, tâkâ nata ngôh a khei lymâ ei.
Zehôki cha kô kih nata kô pangawhpa a châ nota a bei pathao ta, Zerusale liata kô hrawh hleikha â bei. A nô moh cha Zebidâh châ ta, Rumâ khihpa Pedai sawchanô a châ.
Zehôki cha a pathlatuhpazy taozie zydua hawhta tao hrapa ta, Abeipa mohmô liata hmo pha lei ngaitapa tao ta.
Zehôki â bei nota Babylaw bei Nebukaneza ta Zerusale siehnao ta, Zehôki cha ano chakaotuhpa ta kô thôh y ta. Cha khai tawhta Zehôki ta Nebukaneza cha a heihsaipa ta, a chariah ha ta.

Abeipa ta Kaldia pheisaihzy, Aramia pheisaihzy, Môabâ pheisaihzy nata Amawna pheisaihzy cha Zehôki a dyuh awpa ta tuah ta. Abeipa ta a chakaotuhpa hrohsopazy hmâpa ta a vaw rei hapa Abeipa bie hawhta, Zudâh siehnao ta parao awpa ta a tuapa ei a châ.
Cha hmo cha Manase moleinazy nata a hmotaopa zydua vâta, Zudâh cha Abeipa mohmô tawhta pahlei awpa ta, Abeipa biepiepa ta Zudâh chô liata a vaw tlôpa a châ.
Manase ta chyhsa siapazy thisaih palo ta, Zerusale cha chyhsa siapazy thisaih ta a pabiepa vâta, Abeipa ta a ngiahthai thei vei.
Zehôki thâtih hropazy nata a hmotaopa zydua cha, Zudâh beizy thâtih rona châbu liata ropa a châ.
Zehôki cha a pathlatuhpazy hnohta a mô ta, a sawchapawpa Zehôkhi ta ano su liata â bei.
Babylaw bei ta Izi bei ry liata a ypa, Izi Chavah tawhta Ufrâti chavah taihta râh zydua a la khai hapa vâta, Izi bei cha a râh tawhta kaw pua khao vei.
Zehôkhi cha kô hrawh hleichariepa a châ nota a bei ta, Zerusale liata thla thôh â bei. A nô moh cha Nehustâ châ ta, Zerusale khihpa Enâthâ sawchanô a châ.
Zehôkhi cha a paw taozie zydua hawhta tao hrapa ta, Abeipa mohmô liata hmo pha leipa tao ta.
Cha nota Babylaw bei Nebukaneza chakaotuhpazy cha Zerusale lâ khy ei ta, khihpi cha dôh ei ta.
A chakaotuhpazy ta khihpi ama dôh hai nota, Babylaw bei Nebukaneza cha khihpi lâ a vy ta,

Zudâh bei Zehôkhi cha, a nô nata a chakaotuhpazy nata a beimachâzy nata abei o liata hyutuhpazy chhaota Babylaw bei lâ kei pua ei ta. Chatanachata Zehôkhi cha â beina kô chariena liata Babylaw bei ta a patu haw.

Abeipa ta a vaw reipa hawhta, Abeipa o liata ryusôhpa zydua nata abei o liata ryusôhpa zydua cha Babylaw bei ta a siekhei khai haw. Izarei bei Sawlawmaw ta Abeipa Achhyna o liata ngôh hmobaoh a taopa zydua chhao a pakeichheih khai haw.

Zerusale khihsaw zydua, beimachâ zydua nata pasaipha zydua siekhei khai ta, sei 10,000 tlai a siekhei ei. Zôthaipa nata syudaihpa zydua chhao a siekhei khai ha ei. Chyhsa dyhchhie chaipazy tah leipa ta cha, râh liata ahy hmah y khao veih ei.
Nebukaneza ta Zehôkhi cha Babylaw lâ a chhi ta. Abei nô, abei lapinôzy, beimachâzy nata râh liata chhituhpazy cha sei ta Babylaw lâ â chhi ha ei.
Babylaw bei ta chariah a dyuh thei awpa pasaipha sai ta 7,000 nata zôthaipa nata syudaihpa 1,000 sei ta Babylaw lâ â chhi ha ei.
Babylaw bei ta Zehôkhi paw unawhpa Mâtaniah cha Zehôkhi su liata bei ta tao ta, a moh Zedekia tahpa ta a thla.
Zedekia cha â bei pathao nota kô kih nata kô khapa châ ta, Zerusale liata kô hrawh hleikha â bei. A nô moh cha Hâmutâ châ ta, Libnâ khihpa Zere­miah sawchanô a châ.
Zehôki taozie zydua hawhta tao hrapa ta, Abeipa mohmô liata hmo pha leipa tao ta.
Abeipa pathiiana vâta, a mohmô tawhta papua hana taihta Zerusale nata Zudâh chô liata a vaw tlô hapa a châ. Zedekia cha Babylaw bei ry liata a ypa tawhta pua a chhuah ta.
Zedekia â beina kô chakina, thla hrawhna, noh hrawhna noh ta, Babylaw bei Nebukaneza ta a pheisaih zydua chhaota Zerusale siehnao ta. Khihpi dôh ei ta, khihpi padôpa ta dôhna diasuazy tao ei ta.
Bei Zedekia abeina kô hrawh hleikhana taihta khihpi cha dôh ei ta.
Thla palihna, noh chakina noh ta khihpi liata chakâh mozoh vaw tlô ta, râh zawpizy châta niedo y khao leipa ta.

Chatanachata khihpi thokhy papyu ei ta, pheisaih zydua cha abei sadô kiapâh thokhy miano likawh liata a ypa chhikao lâ tawhta, a zo ta a râ ei ta. Kaldia mo ta khihpi cha dôh thlâh ha ei ta. Arabâ bypi lâpi lâta sie ei ta.
Kaldia pheisaihzy ta abei cha a chadai ei ta, Zerikô bypi liata kei pha ei ta. Abei cha a pheisaih zydua ta a râsai khai ha ei ta.
Kaldia mo ta Bei Zedekia cha patu ei ta, Riblâ khihpi liata Babylaw bei lâ a chhi ei ta, cha liata a thâtih pachia ei ta.
Zedekia sawchapawzy cha ama paw mohmô liata thie ei ta, Zedekia chhao a mozy thaoh ei ta, bâliazy ta buh ei ta, Babylaw lâ siekhei ha ei ta.
Babylaw bei Nebukaneza abeina kô hrawh hleichakina, cha kô thla pangawhna, noh sarina noh ta, Babylaw bei chakaotuhpa, abei vaituhpazy hyutuhpa Nebuzarâdâ cha Zerusale lâ a vy ta.
Abeipa Achhyna o, abei o nata Zerusale liata o zydua mei ta rao ta, o rônahpa zydua mei ta a rao khai haw.
Zerusale padôpa ta taopa thokhyzy chhao, abei vaituhpazy hyutuhpa hnohta a ypa Kaldia pheisaihzy ta a zydua ta ama pacho khai haw.
Khihpi liata siesaipa chyhsazy nata Babylaw bei lâ âmo kho ta â hlâpazy nata zawpi laibâhpazy cha, abei vaituhpazy hyutuhpa Nebuzarâdâ ta sei ta â chhi khai ha ei.
Râh chyhsa dyhchhie chaipa thokhazy deikua cha, abei vaituhpazy hyutuhpa ta kre zôh mohôhtuhpa nata leipalietuhpazy châta a siesai ei.
Abeipa o liata dawh tôhzy nata patyunazy nata dawh tipâh Abeipa o liata a ypazy cha, Kaldia mo ta pakeichheih ei ta, dawhzy cha Babylaw lâ ama siekhei haw.
Beihzy, buchâh linazy, meiôh lao chakienazy, ropahâhpa raona beihkohzy nata Achhyna o liata chakaona châta hmâpa dawh hmobaoh zydua la ei ta,
mei lanazy nata rahôzy chhao ama la khai haw. Abei vaituhpazy hyutuhpa ta ngôh ta taopazy cha ngôh hmobaohzy hry liata soh ta, tâkâ ta taopazy cha tâkâ hmobaohzy hry liata soh ta, a siekhei haw.
Sawlawmaw ta Abeipa o châta dawh ta a taopa atôh miano, tipâh nata patyunazy liata dawh hmâpa zie cha pathliah tiah awpa chhao châ vei.

Atôh miakha asâhna lâ cha dy hrawh hleicharie châ ta, a pawhmao liata dawh lubyuhpa y ta, lubyuhpa cha dy thôh â sâh. Lubyuhpa cha dawh sao nata pawmikarânâ nothlahpazy ta pahlypa a châ. Atôh mianona chhao, cha hawhta taopa châ ta, dawhsaozy a hnei hra.
Abei vaituhpazy hyutuhpa ta theihthai bei Seriah nata ano a pazipa theihthaipa Zephania nata ochhi vaituhpa pathôh zy patu ta.

Pheisaih hyutuhpa pakha, khihpi liata a ypa beimachâ papangawh, râh chyhsazy moh rona rai a hriapa chârohtuhpa pheisaih hyutuhpa nata khihpi liata a ypa râh chyhsa sycharu chhao khihpi tawhta a siekhei ha ei.
Abei vaituhpazy hyutuhpa Nebuzarâdâ ta âmo cha a chhi ta, Riblâ khihpi liata Babylaw bei lâ tlôkhei ta.
Babylaw bei ta Hâmathi râh Riblâ khihpi liata âmo cha chhawh ta, a thie ha ei. Chatanachata Zudâh pathlazy cha ama râh tawhta seichâna lâ ama siekhei haw.
Babylaw bei Nebukaneza ta a siesaipa, Zudâh râh liata a nguapa chyhsazy châta, Sâphâ sawchapawpa Ahikâ sawchapawpa Kedaliah cha râhvaotuhpa ta tao ta.

Babylaw bei ta Kedaliah cha râhvaotuhpa ta a tao tahpa pheisaih hyutuhpa zydua nata ama sahlaozy ta ama thei nahta, Mizpâ khihpi liata Kedaliah lâ sie ei ta. Chazy cha Nethaniah sawchapawpa Ismela, Karia sawchapawpa Zôhanâ, Netôpha chyhsa Tahume sawchapawpa Seriah nata Mâkâ pathla sawchapawpa Zazeniah zy ama châ.

Kedaliah ta pheisaih hyutuhpazy nata ama sahlaozy cha bie a taih ta, ama hnohta, “Kaldia beimachâzy he chi khah u. He râh liata pahrâ u la, Babylaw bei chakao u la, chatanachata nama châta a pha aw,” tah ta.

Châhrasala thla sarina liata, bei pathla Elisâmâ sawchapawpa Nethaniah sawchapawpa Ismela cha, chyhsa pahrawh chhaota a vy ta, Kedaliah cha a dyuh ta, ano nata Zuzy nata Kaldia chyhsa a hnohta a ypazy chhao Mizpâ liata a thie khai ha ei.
Chatawhcha chyhsa zydua cha, a lai a chyh ta, pheisaih hyutuhpazy chhaota thyu ei ta, Kaldia mo ama chipa vâta, Izi râh lâ ama sie haw.

Babylaw bei Evimerôdâ ta a ryureina â thaona kô liata, Zudâh bei Zehôkhi cha, seichâna lâ a sie tawhta kô sythôh nata kô sarina, thla hrawh hleinona, noh kih nata noh sarina noh ta patâhna o tawhta papua ta.
Evimerôdâ ta Zehôkhi cha bie pha a chho ta, Babylaw liata a hnohta a ypa beizy hlâta â sâh viapa ta patyusa ta.
Zehôkhi cha patâhna o chysiazy pahluh ta, a hro chhôh zydua ta abei tlâhkhai liata a dôh lymâ.
Â mohôhna châta, noh chareih ta â ngiahpa hawhta, Babylaw bei ta a hro chhôh zydua tovyuh a pie lymâ.
Âdâh ta Sethâ sa ta, Sethâ ta Enawsâ sa ta,
Enawsâ ta Kenâ sa ta, Kenâ ta Mâhalâle sa ta, Mâhalâle ta Zare sa ta,
Zare ta Enawka sa ta, Enawka ta Methuselâ sa ta, Methuselâ ta Lâmeka sa ta,
Lâmeka ta Nôah sa ta, Nôah ta Semâ, Hamâ nata Zaphethâ zy a sa ei.
Zaphethâ sawchapawzy cha Kôme, Mâkaw, Mâdai, Zavâ, Tubâ, Mese nata Tirâ zy ama châ.
Kôme sawchapawzy cha Askenâ, Ripha nata Tôkamâ zy ama châ.
Zavâ sawchapawzy cha Elisâ, Tâsi, Kiti nata Rôdâni zy ama châ.
Hamâ sawchapawzy cha Kusi, Mizrai, Puti nata Kâna zy ama châ.
Kusi sawchapawzy cha Sibâ, Havilâ, Sâbatâ, Râmâ nata Satekâ zy ama châ. Râmâ sawchapaw­zy cha Sebâ nata Dedâ ama châ.
Kusi ta Nimraw sa ta, ano cha alei chô liata chyhsa thatlô riahphapa a y tuapa a châ.
Mizrai ta Ludi, Anami, Lehâbi, Nâtuhi,
Pârusi, Philistinâ mozy pathlatuhpa Kâluhi nata Kâftawri mozy sa ta.
Kâna ta sawchapaw uhtheipa Sidaw nata a pazipa Hethâ sa ta,
Zebu mo, Amawri mo, Kikâsi mo,
Hivi mo, Araki mo, Sini mo,
Avâdi mo, Zemâri mo nata Hâmathi mozy pathlatuhpa a châ.
Semâ sawchapawzy cha Elâmi, Asuria, Apasâ, Ludi nata Aramia zy châ ei ta, Aramia sawchapawzy cha Uzi, Hulâ, Kethe nata Mese zy ama châ.
Apasâ ta Selâh sa ta, Selâh ta Ebe a sa.
Ebe ta sawchapaw pano sa ta, pakhapa moh cha Pele châ ta, alei liata phopizy he ano daihti liata pachhaihpa ama châ. A unawhpa moh cha Zawkatâ a châ.
Zawkatâ ta Almôdâ, Selepha, Hâzamâve, Zerâ,
Hadôrâ, Uzalâ, Dikalâ,
Ôbâ, Abimelâ, Sebâ,
Ôphi, Havilâ, Zôbabi zy sa ta. Cha zydua cha Zawkatâ pathlazy ama châ.
Semâ pathlazy cha Apasâ, Selâh,
Ebe, Pele, Reu,
Seru, Nâhaw, Terâ nata
Abarâ zy ama châ. Abarâ cha Abarahâ a châ.
Abarahâ sawchapawzy cha Aisika nata Ismela zy ama châ.
Hezy he ama pathlazy ama châ: Ismela sawchapaw uhtheipa cha Nebaiô châ ta, a pazipazy cha Kedâ, Adabe, Mibasâ,
Mismâ, Dumâ, Mâsâ, Hadâ, Temâ,
Zetu, Nâphi nata Kedemâ zy ama châ. Chazy cha Ismela pathlazy ama châ.
Abarahâ nôtho Keturâ pathlazy cha Zimrâ, Zôkasâ, Medâ, Midia, Isbâ nata Suah zy ama châ. Zôkasâ sawchapawzy cha Sebâ nata Dedâ zy ama châ.
Midia sawchapawzy cha Epha, Ephe, Hanô, Abidâ nata Eldâ zy ama châ. Cha zydua cha Keturâ pathlazy ama châ.
Abarahâ ta Aisika sa ta. Aisika sawchapawzy cha Esaw nata Izarei ama châ.
Esaw sawchapawzy cha Eliphâ, Rue, Zeu, Zalâ nata Kôrâ zy ama châ.
Eliphâ sawchapawzy cha Temâ, Ômâ, Zephi, Kâtâ, Kenâza, Timnâ nata Amale zy ama châ.
Rue sawchapawzy cha Nâhâ, Zerâ, Sâmâh nata Miza zy ama châ.
Seirâ sawchapawzy cha Lôtâ, Sôbâ, Zibeô, Ânah, Disaw, Eza nata Disâ zy ama châ.
Lôtâ sawchapawzy cha Hôri nata Hômâ châ ei ta, Lôtâ sietanô cha Timnâ a châ.
Sôbâ sawchapawzy cha Alvâ, Mânahâ, Ebâ, Sephô nata Ônami zy ama châ. Zibeô sawchapawzy cha Aihza nata Ânah ama châ.
Ânah sawchapawpa cha Disaw châ ta, Disaw sawchapawzy cha Hedâ, Esbâ, Itharâ nata Kherâ zy ama châ.
Eze sawchapawzy cha Bilhâ, Zavâ nata Zakâ zy ama châ. Disâ sawcha­pawzy cha Uzi nata Aranâ ama châ.
Hezy he Izarei sawzy chô liata ryureituhpa bei ama y hlâta Edômâ râh liata ryureituhpa beizy ama châ: Beô sawchapawpa Belâ a bei ta, a khihpi moh cha Dinhabâ a châ.
Belâ a thi tawhta, Bôzrâ khihpa Zerâ sawchapawpa Zôbabi ta ano su liata a bei ta.
Zôbabi a thi tawhta, Temâni râh chyhsa Husâ ta ano su liata â bei.
Husâ a thi tawhta, Môabâ râh liata Midia mo a pahnietuhpa Bedâ sawchapawpa Hâdâ ta ano su liata a bei ta, a khihpi moh cha Avi a châ.
Hâdâ a thi tawhta, Mâsrekâ chyhsa Samlâ ta ano su liata â bei.
Samlâ a thi tawhta, Ufrâti chavah kiah liata Rehôbô khihpa Sawla ta ano su liata â bei.
Sawla a thi tawhta, Akabaw sawchapawpa Bâlâhanâ ta ano su liata â bei.
Bâlâhanâ a thi tawhta, Hâdâ ta ano su liata a bei ta, a khihpi moh cha Pai a châ. A lapinô moh cha Mehetabe châ ta, ano cha Mâteri sawchanô châ ta, Mâteri cha Mezahâ sawchanô a châ.
Hâdâ cha thi ta. Edômâ beizy cha Bei Timnâ, Bei Alvâ, Bei Zethe,
Bei Ôhôlibâmâ, Bei Elâ, Bei Pinaw,
Bei Kenâza, Bei Temâ, Bei Miza,
Bei Mâdie nata Bei Irâmâ zy châ ei ta, âmo cha Edômâ beizy ama châ.
Hezy he Izarei sawchapawzy ama châ: Rubena, Simeôna, Livai, Zudâh, Iskâra, Zebulawna,
Dânâ, Zawsi, Benzami, Nâthalai, Kâdâ nata Asera zy ama châ.

Hezy he Zudâh pathlazy ama châ: Zudâh ta Kâna zuah Bâsua chô liata sawchapaw pathôh, Erâ, Ônâ nata Selâh zy sa ta. Zudâh sawchapaw uhtheipa Erâ cha Abeipa mohmô liata moleipa châ ta, Abeipa ta a thie haw.
Zudâh cha a myuhnô Tâmâri liata Pereza nata Zerâ sa ta. Zudâh sawchapaw zydua cha papangawh ama châ.
Pereza sawchapawzy cha Hezrô nata Hâmu ama châ.
Zerâ sawcha­pawzy cha Zimri, Ethâ, Hemâ, Kâkaw nata Dârâ zy châ ei ta, ama zydua ta papangawh ama châ.
Kâmi sawchapawpa cha Âkhâ châ ta, Âkhâ cha Izarei sawzy a patypamâtuhpa, pahleipadia awpa hraona sôh a parutuhpa kha a châ.
Ethâ sawchapawpa cha Azariah a châ.
Hezrô sawchapawzy cha Zerame, Râmi nata Kelubai zy ama châ.
Râmi ta Aminadâ sa ta, Aminadâ ta Zudâh pathlazy chhituhpa Nâsô sa ta.
Nâsô ta Salmô sa ta, Salmô ta Bôaza sa ta,
Bôaza ta Ôbedâ sa ta, Ôbedâ ta Zese sa ta.
Zese ta sawchapaw uhtheipa Eliabâ sa ta, panona Abinadâ, pathôhna Simia,
papalihna Nethane, papangawhna Râdai,
pacharuna Ôze nata pasarina Dâvi zy sa ta.
Ama sietanôzy cha Zeru nata Abikai zy ama châ. Zeru sawchapawzy cha Abisai, Zôabâ nata Asahe zy châ ei ta, pathôh ama châ.
Abikai ta Amâsâ sa ta, Amâsâ paw cha Ismela chyhsa Zethe a châ.
Hezrô sawchapawpa Kâlebâ ta a lapinô Azubâ nata Zeriô chô liata sawzy sa ta, a sawchapawzy cha Zeserâ, Sôbâ nata Adô zy ama châ.
Azubâ a thi tawhta, Kâlebâ ta Epharâ hnei ta, ano ta Hurâ sapa ta.
Hurâ ta Uri sa ta, Uri ta Bezale a sa.
Cha khai tawhta Hezrô cha Kilia paw Mâkhi sawchanô hnei ta. Kô sycharu a châ nota a hneipa a châ. Ano ta Seku sapa ta.
Seku ta Zairâ sa ta, ano cha Kilia râh liata khihpi miakih nata miathôh a hneipa a châ.
Châhrasala Kesu nata Aramia ta Kilia râh liata Havôzairâ nata Kenathâ khihpizy nata ama khichapeihzy, khih sycharu cha âmo tawhta la ei ta. Ama zydua heta Kilia paw Mâkhi pathlazy ama châ.
Hezrô a thi tawhta Kâlebâ cha a paw Hezrô lapinô Epharâthâ cha lapinô ta hnei ta, ano ta Asahu sapa ta, Asahu cha Tekô paw a châ.
Hezrô sawchapaw uhtheipa cha Zerame châ ta, Zerame sawchapaw uhtheipa cha Râmi a châ. Hezrô sawchapaw hropazy cha Bunâ, Ôre, Ôze nata Ahiza zy ama châ.
Zerame ta lapinô hropa hnei ta, a moh cha Atarâ châ ta, ano cha Ônami nô a châ.
Zerame sawchapaw uhtheipa Râmi sawchapawzy cha Mâza, Zami nata Eke zy ama châ.
Ônami sawchapawzy cha Sâmai nata Zadâ ama châ. Sâmai sawchapawzy cha Nâdâ nata Abisu ama châ.
Abisu lapinô moh cha Abihai châ ta, ano ta Abisu châta Abâ nata Môli a sapa.
Nâdâ sawchapawzy cha Sele nata Apai châ ei ta, Sele cha saw hnei leipa ta a thi haw.
Apai sawchapawpa cha Isi châ ta, Isi sawchapawpa cha Sesâ a châ. Sesâ sawchapawpa cha Ahlai a châ.
Sâmai unawhpa Zadâ sawchapawzy cha Zethe nata Zawnathâ zy châ ei ta, Zethe cha saw hnei leipa ta a thi haw.
Zawnathâ sawchapawzy cha Pele nata Zaze ama châ. Âmo cha Zerame pathlazy ama châ.
Sesâ cha sawchapaw hnei leipa ta, sawchanôzy dei hnei ta. Sesâ cha Izi chyhsa Zarahâ ama tahpa sei hnei ta.
Sesâ ta a sawchanô cha a sei Zarahâ pahneisa ta, ano ta Atai sapa ta.
Atai ta Nâthâ sa ta, Nâthâ ta Zabâdi sa ta.
Zabâdi ta Ephalâ sa ta, Ephalâ ta Ôbedâ sa ta.
Ôbedâ ta Zehu sa ta, Zehu ta Azariah sa ta.
Azariah ta Helezi sa ta, Helezi ta Eliasâ sa ta.
Eliasâ ta Sismai sa ta, Sismai ta Sâluh sa ta.
Sâluh ta Zekamiah sa ta, Zekamiah ta Elisâmâ a sa.
Zerame unawhpa Kâlebâ sawchapaw uhtheipa cha Mâresâ châ ta, ano cha Ziphi paw a châ. Mâresâ sawchapawpa cha Hebraw a châ.
Hebraw sawchapawzy cha Kôrâ, Tâpuah, Reke nata Semâ zy ama châ.
Semâ ta Zawkia paw Râha sa ta, Reke ta Sâmai a sa.
Sâmai sawchapawpa cha Maô châ ta, Maô cha Bezu paw a châ.
Kâlebâ nôtho Epha ta Harânâ, Môza nata Kaze zy sa ta, Harânâ ta Kaze a sa.
Zadai sawchapawzy cha Reke, Zawthâ, Kesâ, Pele, Epha nata Sâpha zy ama châ.
Kâlebâ nôtho Mâkâ ta Sebe nata Tihânâ sa ta.
Mâmanâh paw Sâpha nata Mâbenâ nata Kibia paw Sevâ zy sa hra ta. Kâlebâ sawchanô cha Akasâ a châ.
Âmo cha Kâlebâ pathlazy ama châ. Ephrâthâ sawchapaw uhtheipa Hurâ sawchapawzy cha Kiriaziari paw Sôbâ,
Bethlehe paw Salmâ nata Bekade paw Harepha zy ama châ.
Kiriaziari mo pathlatuhpa Sôbâ ta pathla hropazy hnei ta, âmo cha Hârôe mo nata Menuhô mo khophie zy ama châ.
Kiriaziari phozy cha Ithari mo, Puthi mo, Sumathi mo nata Misrai mozy châ ei ta, âmo tawhna heta Zôrâ mo nata Estaw mozy ama vaw pua.
Salmâ pathlazy cha Bethlehe mo, Netôpha mo, Atôbezôabâ mo, Mânahâ mo khophie nata Zôri mozy ama châ.

Zabia liata chârohtuhpa phozy chhao âmo pathla châ ei ta, âmo cha Tirathi mo, Simiathi mo nata Sukuthi mozy ama châ. Âmo he Keni mo châ ei ta, Rekabâ pathlazy paw Hâmathi tawhta a vaw puapazy ama châ.
Hezy he Dâvi sawchapaw Hebraw khi liata a pihpazy ama châ. A sawchapaw uhtheipa cha Zezari zuah Ahinô chô liata a sapa Amanaw châ ta, a pazipa cha Kâmel zuah Abikai chô liata a sapa Dâniah châ ta,
pathôhna cha Kesu bei Tâmai sawchanônô Mâkâ sawchapawpa Absalaw châ ta, papalihna cha Haki sawchapawpa Adôniza châ ta,
papangawhna cha Abitâ chô liata a sapa Sephatiah châ ta, pacharuna cha a lapinô Ekalâ chô liata a sapa Itharia a châ.
Hebraw liata pacharu pih ei ta. Dâvi cha Hebraw liata kô sari nata thla charu a bei ta, Zerusale liata kô sythôh nata kô thôh â bei.
Dâvi sawchapaw Zerusale liata a pihpazy cha Simia, Sôbâ, Nâthâ nata Sawlawmaw zy châ ei ta, ama papalih heta Amie sawchanô Bâsua chô liata a sapazy ama châ.
Sawchapaw hropa pachaki hnei via ta, chazy cha Ibâ, Elisâmâ, Eliphele,
Nôkâh, Nephe, Zaphia,
Elisâmâ, Eliadâ nata Eliphele zy ama châ.
Âmo cha a nôthozy chô liata a sapazy rei pâ leipa ta, Dâvi sawchapawzy châ ei ta, ama sietanô cha Tâmâri a châ.
Sawlawmaw sawchapawpa cha Rehôbaw châ ta, Rehôbaw sawchapawpa cha Abizah châ ta, Abizah sawchapawpa cha Âsâ châ ta, Âsâ sawchapawpa cha Zehôsaphâ châ ta,
Zehôsaphâ sawchapawpa cha Zôrâ châ ta, Zôrâ sawchapawpa cha Ahazia châ ta, Ahazia sawchapawpa cha Zôasâ châ ta,
Zôasâ sawchapawpa cha Amazia châ ta, Amazia sawchapawpa cha Azariah châ ta, Azariah sawchapawpa cha Zôthâ châ ta,
Zôthâ sawchapawpa cha Ahâza châ ta, Ahâza sawchapawpa cha Hezekia châ ta, Hezekia sawchapawpa cha Manase a châ.
Manase sawchapawpa cha Amawna châ ta, Amawna sawchapawpa cha Zôsia a châ.
Hezy he Zôsia sawchapawzy ama châ: A sawchapaw uhtheipa cha Zôhanâ châ ta, panona Zehôki châ ta, pathôhna Zedekia châ ta, papalihna cha Sâluh a châ.
Zehôki sawchapawzy cha Zekôniah nata Zedekia zy ama châ.
Sei ta amâ chhipa Zekôniah sawchapawzy cha Siatie,
Malkirâ, Pedai, Senâza, Zekamiah, Hôsamâ nata Nedabiah zy ama châ.
Pedai sawchapawzy cha Zerubâbe nata Simei ama châ. Zerubâbe sawchapawzy cha Mesulâ nata Hânaniah châ ei ta, ama sietanô cha Selômi a châ.
Zerubâbe ta sawchapaw hropa papangawh hnei ta, chazy cha Hâsubâh, Ôhe, Berekiah, Hâsadiah nata Zusâhese zy ama châ.

Hânaniah sawchapawzy cha Pelatiah nata Zesai zy ama châ. Zesai sawchapawpa cha Rephiah châ ta, Rephiah sawchapawpa cha Ânâ châ ta, Ânâ sawchapawpa cha Ôbadia châ ta, Ôbadia sawchapawpa cha Sekaniah a châ.
Sekaniah sawcha­pawpa cha Semiah châ ta, Semiah sawchapawzy cha Hâtu, Ikâ, Bâriah, Niariah nata Saphâta zy châ ei ta, pacharu ama châ.
Niariah sawchapawzy cha Eliônai, Hizakiah nata Azrikâ zy châ ei ta, pathôh ama châ.
Eliônai sawchapawzy cha Hôdaviah, Eliasi, Peliah, Aku, Zôhanâ, Deliah nata Anani zy châ ei ta, pasari ama châ.
Zudâh sawchapawzy cha Pereza, Hezrô, Kâmi, Hurâ nata Sôbâ zy ama châ.
Sôbâ sawchapawpa Reai ta Zahâ sa ta, Zahâ ta Ahumai nata Lâhâ a sa ei. Âmo cha Zôrâ phozy ama châ.
Etamâ sawchapaw­zy cha Zezari, Ismâ nata Idabâ zy châ ei ta, ama sietanô moh cha Hâzelepôni a châ.
Penia ta Kedaw sa ta, Eze ta Husah a sa. Âmo cha Bethlehe paw Ephrâthâ sawchapaw uhtheipa Hurâ pathlazy ama châ.
Tekô paw Asahu ta lapinô pano, Helâ nata Nârâ hnei ta.
Nârâ chô liata Ahuzamâ, Hepha, Temeni nata Hâhastâri zy sa ta. Âmo cha Nârâ pathlazy ama châ.
Helâ sawchapawzy cha Zerethâ, Izah nata Ethanâ zy ama châ.
Kôza ta Anu, Zôbebâ nata Hâru sawchapawpa Ahahe phozy pathla ta.
Zabia cha a unawhzy hlâta zachhih viapa châ ta, a nô ta, “Riethei pasa ngaitapa ta ei sapa a châ,” tah ta a moh Zabia a bi.

Zabia ta Izarei Khazohpa pado ta, a hnohta, “Byhnâ na piepa ta, ei râh he na pakawhpa la ei tah kaw dia! Ei chô liata na ku y sala, riethei pasana ei chô liata a tlô lei nawpa ta, nâ pasasa thei awpa tawhta na pabohsa mah y!” tah ta. Khazohpa ta a hiapa cha pie ta.
Suhâ unawhpa Kheluh ta Mehi sa ta, Mehi ta Estaw sa ta.
Estaw ta Berâpha, Pâsia nata Inahâ paw Tehinâ zy sa ta. Âmo cha Rekâ mo ama châ.
Kenâza sawchapawzy cha Ôthane nata Seriah châ ei ta, Ôthane sawchapawzy cha Hâthâh nata Menôthai ama châ.
Menôthai ta Ôpharâ sa ta, Seriah ta Keharâ mo pathlatuhpa Zôabâ sa ta. Âmo cha zôthaipa ama châpa vâta Keharâ mo tahpa a châ.
Zephune sawchapawpa Kâlebâ sawchapawzy cha Iru, Elâ nata Nâmi zy châ ei ta, Elâ sawchapawpa cha Kenâza a châ.
Zehalele sawchapawzy cha Ziphi, Ziphâ, Tiria nata Azre zy ama châ.
Ezrah sawchapawzy cha Zethe, Meredâ, Ephe nata Zalô zy ama châ. Meredâ ta Phiraoh sawchanô Bithiah hnei ta, Bithiah cha saw phaoh ta, Miria, Sâmai nata Estemô paw Isbâ zy a sa ei.
A lapinô Zudâh zuah ta Kedaw paw Zere, Sôkô paw Hebe nata Zanô paw Zekuthie zy sa ta.
Hôdiah ta Nâhamâ sietanô hnei ta, a sawchapawzy cha Kâmi mo pathlatuhpa Keilâh nata Mâkâ mo pathlatuhpa Estemô zy ama châ.
Simô sawchapawzy cha Amanaw, Rinâ, Benhanâ nata Tilô zy ama châ. Isi sawcha­pawzy cha Zôhe nata Benzôhe ama châ.
Zudâh sawchapawpa Selâh sawchapawzy cha Lekâ paw Erâ, Mâresâ paw Lâdâh nata Bethabia liata poh rih dipa taotuhpazy ama châ.
Zôki, Kôzebâ mo, Zôasâ nata Môabâ nata Zasubilahe liata ryureituhpa Sârâpha zy chhao Selâh sawchapawzy ama châ hra. Cha kyh cha hlâno châropazy tawhta hmôpa a châ.
Âmo cha Netai nata Kederâ liata a pahrâpa beihvituhpazy châ ei ta, bei châta rai hria awpa ta, cha liata a pahrâpazy ama châ.
Simeôna sawchapawzy cha Nemua, Zami, Zari, Zerâ nata Sawla zy ama châ.
Sawla sawchapaw­pa cha Sâluh châ ta, Sâluh sawchapawpa cha Mibasâ châ ta, Mibasâ sawchapawpa cha Mismâ a châ.
Mismâ sawchapawpa cha Hâmua châ ta, Hâmua sawchapawpa cha Zaku châ ta, Zaku sawchapawpa cha Simei a châ.
Simei ta sawchapaw pahrawh hleicharu nata sawchanô pacharu hnei ta, a unawhzy deikua saw sa hluh veih ei. Ama pho chhao Zudâh mo hawhta pôh thei veih ei.
Bâsebâ, Môladâ, Hâzasua,
Bilhâh, Ezemâ, Tôlâ,
Bethua, Hômâ, Zikalâ,
Bemâkabô, Hâzasusi, Bethabiri nata Saraimi khihpizy liata ama pahrâ. Chazy cha Dâvi â bei hlâta ama khihpizy a châ.
Khichapeih miapangawh hnei ei ta, chazy cha Etamâ, Ainâ, Rimô, Tôkhe nata Asanâ zy châ ta,
khihpizy chadôpa ta Bâlâ taihta khichapeih zydua chhao amâ hlao. Chazy cha ama pahrâna suzy châ ta, ama thyutôna rona châbu chhao amâ vao.
Mesôbâ, Zamale, Amazia sawchapawpa Zôsâh,
Zôela nata Zôsibiah sawchapawpa Zehu zy chhao Simeôna pathlazy ama châ. Zôsibiah paw cha Seriah châ ta, Seriah paw cha Asie a châ.
Eliônai, Zakôbâ, Zesôhai, Asiah, Adie, Zesimie, Benai nata
Siphi sawchapawpa Ziza zy chhao Simeôna pathlazy ama châ. Siphi paw cha Alaw châ ta, Alaw paw cha Zediah châ ta, Zediah paw cha Simri châ ta, Simri paw cha Semiah a châ.
He liata ama moh paziahpazy he ama pho hyutuhpazy châ ei ta, ama pathlazy thata ama pôh.
Ama sahrohzy châta sibiepa yna suzy tlua laihpa ta, saikao nochhi lâta Kedaw angiana taihta sie ei ta.

Cha liata sahroh lao pabâsa nawpa sibiepa hluhna nata phana su hmô ei ta, a râh chhao kawh ngaita ta, dâhthloh ta, thlalôh a chhih kawpa râh a châ. Cha liata a vaw pahra tuapazy cha Hamâ pathlazy ama châ.

Zudâh pathla moh ropazy he Zudâh bei Hezekia â bei daihti liata a ngiapa châ ei ta, Hamâ mo poh ozy parao ei ta, cha liata a ypa Muni mo chhao ama pahleipadia khai haw. Pahleipadia khaipa ama châpa cha tanoh taihta hmô thei awpa ta a y. Sahroh châta sibiepa a ypa vâta, Muni mo su liata Simeôna mo ama pahrâ haw.
Simeôna pathlazy hry tawhta chyhsa za pangawh cha, Isi sawchapawpa Pelatiah, Niariah, Rephiah nata Uzie zy chhihthana ry liata Seirâ Tlâh lâ sie ei ta.
Amale mo a râpaipa laibâhpazy pahnie ei ta, tanoh taihta cha liata ama pahrâ haw.

Hezy he Izarei sawchapaw uhtheipa Rubena pathlazy ama châ. Rubena cha sawchapaw uhtheipa châ ta, châhrasala a paw rakhô a papuapaleipa vâta, sawchapaw uhthei châna tovyuh cha Izarei sawchapawpa Zawsi sawchapawzy hnohta piepa châ ha ta, chavâta pathlatuhpazy alaichadaina liata chhao, sawchapaw uhtheipa hawhta a laichadaipa châ khao vei.
Zudâh cha a unawhzy hry liata thatlô chaipa châ ta, ryureituhpa chhao ano tawhta pua ta, châhrasala sawchapaw uhtheipa tovyuh deikua cha Zawsi eih a châ.
Izarei sawchapaw uhtheipa Rubena sawchapawzy cha Hanô, Pâluh, Hezrô nata Kâmi zy ama châ.
Zôela sawchapawpa cha Semiah châ ta, Semiah sawchapawpa cha Kawkâ châ ta, Kawkâ sawchapawpa cha Simei châ ta,
Simei sawchapawpa cha Mikâ châ ta, Mikâ sawchapawpa cha Reai châ ta, Reai sawchapawpa cha Bâlâ châ ta,
Bâlâ sawchapawpa cha, Asuria bei Tikalâpilesa ta sei ta â chhipa Berâh kha châ ta, Rubena pathlazy hyutuhpa a châ.
Ama chhâzy thyutôna ro nota, a pho pho ta a laichadaipa ta, Rubena pathla hyutuhpazy cha, Zeili, Zekaria nata
Azazi sawchapawpa Belâ zy ama châ. Azazi paw cha Semâ châ ta, Semâ paw cha Zôela châ ta, ano cha Arôerâ tawhta Nebô nata Bâlâmeô taihta a pahrâpa a châ.
Kilia râh liata ama sahroh thata a pôhpa vâta, nochhi lâta râhchawhpa angiana tawhta Ufrâti chavah notla baih lâ taihta ama pahrâ.
Sawla â bei daihti liata Hâkari mo a dyuh ei ta, ama pahnie haw. Chatanachata Kilia nochhi lâ râh zydua liata ama poh ozy liata ama pahrâ haw.
Kâdâ pathlazy cha Rubena pathlazy kiapâh Bâsanâ râh liata Sâlekâ taihta pahrâ ei ta.
Ama hyutuhpa cha Zôela châ ta, a pazipazy cha Saphâ, Zanai nata Bâsanâ râh liata Saphâta zy ama châ.
A chhôh chhôh ta a laichadaipa ta ama unawh hropazy cha Mikaila, Mesulâ, Sebâ, Zôrai, Zakâ, Zia nata Ebe zy châ ei ta, pasari ama châ.

Hezy he Huri sawchapawpa Abihai pathlazy ama châ. Huri cha Zarôh sawchapawpa châ ta, Zarôh cha Kilia sawchapawpa châ ta, Kilia cha Mikaila sawchapawpa châ ta, Mikaila cha Zesisai sawchapawpa châ ta, Zesisai cha Zâhdô sawchapawpa châ ta, Zâhdô cha Buzi sawchapawpa a châ.
Kuni sawchapawpa Abadie sawchapawpa Ahi cha ama phozy hyutuhpa a châ.
Kilia liata pahrâ ei ta, Bâsanâ râh nata a khichapeihzy liata chhao pahrâ ei ta, si panyupa yna Saraw râh zydua liata ama râhri taihta ama pahrâ.
Cha zydua cha Zudâh bei Zôthâ â bei nota nata Izarei bei Zerôbaw â bei nota thyutôna alaichadaina châbu liata ro khaipa a châ.

Rubena chi, Kâdâ chi nata Manase chi khophiezy ta vyhphao nata zaozi a chaba theipa nata li a ka theipa pasaiphazy hnei ei ta, adyuhzie a thaipa nata adyuhna lâ a sie thei awpa pheisaih 44,760 ama hnei.
Hâkari mo, Zetu mo, Nâphi mo nata Nôdâ mozy siehnao ei ta.
Adyuhna liata Khazohpa lâ thlahchhâ ei ta, ano ama ngâpa vâta, a para ngaitapa ta ama hiana cha Khazohpa ta chyh-ei ta, Hâkari mo nata ama hnohta a ypa zydua cha ama ku liata a pie ha ei.
Ama sahrohzy, râraoseihpa 50,000, mietaku 250,000 nata alâ 2,000 siekhei ei ta, chyhsa chhao ahrohpa ta 100,000 ama siekhei haw.

Adyuhna cha Khazohpa eih a châpa vâta, Rubena chi, Kâdâ chi nata Manase chi khophiezy ta Hâkari mo nata ama hnohta a ypa hluhpi cha thiepa ta papao ei ta, Izarei sawzy seichâna lâ siekheipa ta ama yna daihti taihta Hâkari mo râh liana cha ama pahrâ haw.
Nochhi lâta a pahrâpa Manase chi khophiezy cha hluh kaw ei ta, Bâsanâ tawhta Bâlâhamaw, Seni nata Hâmaw Tlâh taihta ama pôh lymâ.
Ama chi pawhrâhpazy cha Ephe, Isi, Elie, Azarie, Zeremiah, Hôdaviah nata Zadie zy ama châ. Âmo cha pasaipha nata chyhsa mohpathâhpazy châ ei ta, ama chi pawhrâhpazy ama châ.
Châhrasala âmo pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa chô liata ngâchhih leipa ei ta, Khazohpa ta ama hmiakô liata a pahleipadiapa, cha râh phopizy khazohzy liata ama sihryh haw.

Chavâta Izarei Khazohpa ta Asuria bei Puli palôh nata Asuria bei Tikalâpilesa palôh pathyu ta, Rubena chi, Kâdâ chi nata Manase chi khophie zy cha sei ta a chhi ta, Hâlâ, Hâbaw nata Hârâ khihpizy nata Kôzani chavah liata âmo cha soh ta, tanoh taihta cha liata ama y.
Livai sawchapawzy cha Kesao, Kôhâ nata Merâri zy ama châ.
Kôhâ sawchapawzy cha Amrâ, Iza, Hebraw nata Uzie zy ama châ.
Amrâ pathlazy cha Arawna, Mawsi nata Miria zy ama châ. Arawna sawchapawzy cha Nâdâ, Abihu, Eliaza nata Ithamâ zy ama châ.
Eliaza ta Phinehâ sa ta, Phinehâ ta Abisua sa ta,
Abisua ta Buki sa ta, Buki ta Uzizi sa ta,
Uzizi ta Zerahiah sa ta, Zerahiah ta Meraiô sa ta,
Meraiô ta Amaria sa ta, Amaria ta Ahitu sa ta,
Ahitu ta Zadô sa ta, Zadô ta Ahimazi sa ta,
Ahimazi ta Azariah sa ta, Azariah ta Zôhanâ sa ta,
Zôhanâ ta Azariah sa ta, ano cha Zerusale liata Sawlawmaw paduapa Achhyna o liata theihthaipa rai a hriapa a châ.
Azariah ta Amaria sa ta, Amaria ta Ahitu sa ta,
Ahitu ta Zadô sa ta, Zadô ta Sâluh sa ta,
Sâluh ta Hikia sa ta, Hikia ta Azariah sa ta,
Azariah ta Seriah sa ta, Seriah ta Zehôzadâ sa ta.
Abeipa ta Zudâh râh nata Zerusale khihpi Nebukaneza ku liata seichâna lâ a pasiesa nona khata, Zehôzadâ chhao sei­châna lâ a sie ha hra.
Livai sawchapawzy cha Kesao, Kôhâ nata Merâri zy ama châ.
Kesao sawchapawzy moh cha Libani nata Simei a châ.
Kôhâ sawchapawzy cha Amrâ, Iza, Hebraw nata Uzie zy ama châ.
Merâri sawchapawzy cha Mâhli nata Musi ama châ. Hezy he ama pathlatuhpazy tawhta a laichadaipa ta Livai phozy ama châ.
Kesao sawchapawpa cha Libani châ ta, Libani sawchapawpa cha Zahâ châ ta, Zahâ sawchapawpa cha Zimâ châ ta,
Zimâ sawchapawpa cha Zôah châ ta, Zôah sawchapawpa cha Idô châ ta, Idô sawchapawpa cha Zerâ châ ta, Zerâ sawchapawpa cha Ziatherai a châ.
Hezy he Kôhâ pathlazy ama châ: Kôhâ sawchapawpa cha Aminadâ châ ta, Aminadâ sawchapawpa cha Kôrâ châ ta, Kôrâ sawchapawpa cha Asi châ ta,
Asi sawchapawpa cha Elkânâ châ ta, Elkânâ sawchapawpa cha Ebiasâ châ ta, Ebiasâ sawchapawpa cha Asira châ ta,
Asira sawchapawpa cha Tahâ châ ta. Tahâ sawchapawpa cha Urie châ ta, Urie sawchapawpa cha Uzia châ ta, Uzia sawchapawpa cha Sawla a châ.
Elkânâ pathlazy cha Amasai nata Ahimô châ ei ta,
Elkânâ sawchapawpa cha Zôphai châ ta, Zôphai sawchapawpa cha Nâhâ châ ta,
Nâhâ sawchapawpa cha Eliabâ châ ta, Eliabâ sawchapawpa cha Zerôhâ châ ta, Zerôhâ sawchapawpa cha Elkânâ a châ.
Samuela sawchapaw uhtheipa cha Zôela châ ta, panona cha Abizah a châ.
Hezy he Merâri pathlazy ama châ: Merâri sawchapawpa cha Mâhli châ ta, Mâhli sawchapawpa cha Libani châ ta, Libani sawchapawpa cha Simei châ ta, Simei sawchapawpa cha Uza châ ta,
Uza sawchapawpa cha Simia châ ta, Simia sawchapawpa cha Hâkiah châ ta, Hâkiah sawchapawpa cha Asiah a châ.
Hezy he Zerusale liata Byh â pahâ tawhta Abeipa o liata hla chhituhpazy châta Dâvi ta a raopa­zy ama châ.
Sawlawmaw ta Zerusale liata Abeipa Achhyna o a sa hlâta cha, ahmaohna poh o byureih liata hla sapa ta chakao tyh ei ta, taozie awpa raopa hawhta ama chakaona rai ama hria tyh.
Hezy he hla chhihthana rai hriatuhpazy nata ama sawchapawzy ama châ. Hezy he Kôhâ pathlazy tawhta hla sa thaipazy ama châ. Hlasathaipa Hemâ cha Zôela sawchapawpa châ ta, Zôela paw cha Samuela châ ta,
Samuela paw cha Elkânâ châ ta, Elkânâ paw cha Zerôhâ châ ta, Zerôhâ paw cha Elie châ ta, Elie paw cha Toâh châ ta,
Toâh paw cha Zupha châ ta, Zupha paw cha Elkânâ châ ta, Elkânâ paw cha Mâhâ châ ta, Mâhâ paw cha Amasai châ ta,
Amasai paw cha Elkânâ châ ta, Elkânâ paw cha Zôela châ ta, Zôela paw cha Azariah châ ta, Azariah paw cha Zephania châ ta,
Zephania paw cha Tahâ châ ta, Tahâ paw cha Asi châ ta, Asi paw cha Ebiasâ châ ta, Ebiasâ paw cha Kôrâ châ ta,
Kôrâ paw cha Izah châ ta, Izah paw cha Kôhâ châ ta, Kôhâ paw cha Livai châ ta, Livai paw cha Izarei a châ.
Hlasathaipa Hemâ baotuhpa cha a unawhpa Asâpha châ ta, ano cha Hemâ chachâh lâta a duah tyhpa a châ. Asâpha paw cha Berekiah châ ta, Berekiah paw cha Simia châ ta,
Simia paw cha Mikaila châ ta, Mikaila paw cha Bâsiah châ ta, Bâsiah paw cha Mâkia châ ta,
Mâkia paw cha Ethâni châ ta, Ethâni paw cha Zerâ châ ta, Zerâ paw cha Adiah châ ta,
Adiah paw cha Ethâ châ ta, Ethâ paw cha Zimâ châ ta, Zimâ paw cha Simei châ ta,
Simei paw cha Zahâ châ ta, Zahâ paw cha Kesao châ ta, Kesao paw cha Livai a châ.
Chavei lâta a duah tyhpa cha a unawhpa Merâri sawchapawpa Ethâ a châ. Ethâ paw cha Kisi châ ta, Kisi paw cha Abadi châ ta, Abadi paw cha Mâluh châ ta,
Mâluh paw cha Hâsabiah châ ta, Hâsabiah paw cha Amazia châ ta, Amazia paw cha Hikia châ ta,
Hikia paw cha Amazi châ ta, Amazi paw cha Bâni châ ta, Bâni paw cha Seme châ ta,
Seme paw cha Mâhli châ ta, Mâhli paw cha Musi châ ta, Musi paw cha Merâri châ ta, Merâri paw cha Livai a châ.
Ama unawhpa Livai chizy cha Khazohpa achhyna byureih chakaona raihria zydua hria awpa ta raopa ama châ.

Arawna nata a pathlazy deikua cha­, Khazohpa chakaotuhpa Mawsi ta bie a vaw piepa zydua hawhta, Su Pathaih Chaipa raihria zydua hriapa ta, Izarei châta chatlaina tao awpa ta, raopa hlâna maisâh liata nata ropahâhpa hlâna maisâh liata atheihna hlâna chakaona rai a hriatuhpazy ama châ.
Hezy he Arawna pathlazy ama châ: Arawna sawchapawpa Eliaza sawchapawpa cha Phinehâ châ ta, Phinehâ sawchapawpa cha Abisua châ ta,
Abisua sawchapawpa cha Buki châ ta, Buki sawchapawpa cha Uzizi châ ta, Uzizi sawchapawpa cha Zerahiah châ ta,
Zerahiah sawchapawpa cha Meraiô châ ta, Meraiô sawchapawpa cha Amaria châ ta, Amaria sawchapawpa cha Ahitu châ ta,
Ahitu sawchapawpa cha Zadô châ ta, Zadô sawchapawpa cha Ahimazi a châ.
Hezy he ama râh chhôh liata ama khihsa nawpa su pachhaihzie hawhta ama pahrâna suzy a châ: Nuby amâ daopa cha Arawna pathla Kôhâ phozy chô liata tlu tua chai ta,
Zudâh râh liata Hebraw khihpi nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy piepa ama châ.
Khihpi lyuzy nata a khichapeihzy deikua Zephune sawchapawpa Kâlebâ piepa a châ.
Arawna pathlazy cha Zudâh râh liata abohna khihpizy piepa châ ei ta, chazy cha Hebraw, Libnâ nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy, Zati, Estemô nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy,
Hile nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy, Debi nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy,
Asanâ nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy nata Beseme nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy a châ.

Benzami chi râh tawhta Kibiô khihpi, Kebâ khihpi nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy, Aleme khihpi nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy nata Anathô khihpi nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy piepa ama châ. Arawna pathla phozy châta khihpi piepa zydua cha khi hrawh hleithôh a châ.
Kôhâ pathla hropazy châta nuby a daopa châ ta, Manase chi khophie ryuto râh liata khih hrawh piepa ama châ.
Kesao pathlazy cha Iskâra chi ryuto râh, Asera chi ryuto râh, Nâthalai chi ryuto râh nata Bâsanâ liata Manase chi ryuto râhzy tawhta a pho pho ta khihpi miahrawh hleithôh piepa ama châ.
Merâri pathlazy cha Rubena chi ryuto râh, Kâdâ chi ryuto râh nata Zebulawna chi ryuto râhzy tawhta, nuby a daopa ta a pho pho ta khih hrawh hleino piepa ama châ.
Cha hawhna chata Izarei sawzy ta Livai chizy cha khihpizy nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy pie ei ta.
Zudâh chi ryuto râh, Simeôna chi ryuto râh nata Benzami chi ryuto râhzy tawhta khihpi moh palâsapazy he nuby a daopa ta piepa ama châ.
Kôhâ pathla pho thokha cha Epharai mo ryuto râh liata khihpizy to ei ta.
Abohna khihpizy piepa châ ei ta, chazy cha Epharai tlâh râh liata Sekhe nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy, Keze nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy,
Zôkamia nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy, Behôrô nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy,
Aizalô nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy nata Kâtharimô nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy piepa ama châ.
Kôhâ pathla hropazy châta, Manase chi khophie ryuto râh liata Ane khihpi nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy nata Bilia khihpi nata chhei­pâh si panyuna suzy ama pie.
Kesao pathlazy hnohta piepa khihpizy cha, Manase chi khophie ryuto râh Bâsanâ liata Kôlâ nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy, Astarô nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy;
Iskâra chi ryuto râh tawhta Kedesâ nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy, Dâberâ nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy,
Ramô nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy, Anemi nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy;
Asera chi ryuto râh liata Mâsalâ nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy, Abadaw nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy,
Hukô nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy, Rehô nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy;
Nâthalai chi ryuto râh liata Kâlili râh Kedesâ khihpi nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy, Hâmô nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy nata Kiriathai nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy a châ.
Merâri pathla hropazy hnohta Zebulawna chi ryuto râh liata Rimaw nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy, Tabaw nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy;
Zerikô dady Zawdâh haosâ, Zawdâh nochhi lâta Rubena chi ryuto râh râhchawhpa liata Beze nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy, Zazâh nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy,
Kedemô nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy, Mephâ nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy;
Kâdâ chi ryuto râh liata Kilia râh Ramô khihpi nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy, Mâhanai nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy,
Hesbaw nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy nata Zaze nata a chheipâh si panyuna suzy ama pie.
Iskâra ta sawchapaw papalih, Tola, Puah, Zasu nata Simrô zy sa ta.

Tola sawchapaw­zy cha Uzizi, Rephiah, Zerie, Zamai, Ibasâ nata Semuela zy châ ei ta, âmo he Tola pathla pawhrâhpazy ama châ. Ama chhâzy liata pasaiphazy châ ei ta, Dâvi abeina daihti liata maluh 22,600 ama y.
Uzizi sawchapawpa cha Izrâhia châ ta, Izrâhia sawchapawzy cha Mikaila, Ôbadia, Zôela nata Isiah zy châ ei ta, papangawh ama châ. Ama zydua ta ama pho pawhrâhpazy ama châ.
Lapinô hluhpi hnei ei ta sawchapaw hluhpi ama sapa vâta, ama pathlazy cha a chhâ chhâ ta reipa ta, adyuhna lâ a sie theipa pheisaih 36,000 ama y.
Thyutôna lâ tawhta a laichadaipa ta, Iskâra pathla pasaipha zydua cha maluh 87,000 ama châ.
Benzami ta sawchapaw pathôh, Belâ, Bekhe nata Zedia zy hnei ta.

Belâ sawchapawzy cha Ezbaw, Uzizi, Uzie, Zerimô nata Iri zy châ ei ta, papangawh ama châ. Âmo cha ama pathlazy pawhrâhpa nata pasaiphazy châ ei ta, thyutôna lâ tawhta a laichadaipa ta maluh 22,034 ama y.
Bekhe sawcha­pawzy cha Zemirâ, Zôasâ, Elieze, Eliônai, Ômri, Zeremô, Abiza, Anathô nata Aleme zy ama châ. Ama zydua ta Bekhe sawchapawzy ama châ.
Ama pathla pawhrâhpazy chhâ thyutôna a laichadaipa ta, pasaipha maluh 20,200 ama y.
Zedia sawchapawpa cha Bilhâ châ ta, Bilhâ sawchapawzy cha Zusi, Benzami, Ehu, Kenânâ, Zethâ, Tâsi nata Ahisahâ zy ama châ.
Ama pathla pawhrâhpazy tawhta a laichadaipa ta, ama zydua ta Zedia pathlazy châ ei ta, adyuhna lâ a sie theipa pasaipha maluh 17,200 ama y.
Iri sawchapawzy cha Supi nata Hupi châ ei ta, Ahe sawchapawpa cha Husi a châ.
Nâthalai sawchapawzy cha Zazie, Kuni, Zeze nata Sâluh zy châ ei ta, âmo cha Bilhâ pathlazy ama châ.
Manase ta a nôtho Aramia zuah chô liata sawchapaw pano, Asrie nata Kilia paw Mâkhi sa ta.
Mâkhi ta Hupi nata Supi mo tawhta lapinô hnei ta. A sietanô moh cha Mâkâ a châ. Mâkhi pathla hropa moh cha Zelôphehâ châ ta, ano cha sawchanôzy dei a hnei.
Mâkhi lapinô Mâkâ ta sawchapaw­ sa ta, a moh Peresi a bi. Peresi unawhpa moh cha Seresi châ ta, Peresi sawchapawzy cha Ulâ nata Rake ama châ.
Ulâ sawchapawpa cha Bedâ a châ. Âmo cha Manase sawchapawpa Mâkhi sawchapawpa Kilia pathlazy ama châ.
Kilia sietanô Hâmôleke ta Isahô, Abieze nata Mâhlâ zy sa ta.
Semidâ sawchapawzy cha Ahiana, Sekhe, Likhi nata Ania zy ama châ.
Epharai sawchapawpa cha Suthelâ châ ta, Suthelâ sawchapawpa cha Bere châ ta, Bere sawchapawpa cha Tahâ châ ta, Tahâ sawchapawpa cha Eliadâh châ ta, Eliadâh sawchapawpa cha Tahâ châ ta,

Tahâ sawchapawpa cha Zabâdi cha ta, Zabâdi sawchapawpa cha Suthelâ a châ. Epharai sawchapaw hropa Eze nata Elia zy cha, cha râh liata a pahrâpa Kâthâ khihsawzy ta ama sahroh zaw paru awpa ta a zu ei ta ama thie haw.
Ama paw Epharai cha noh hluhpi mâchhiesa ta, a unawhzy ano lâ sie ei ta, a thlah ama kei palôh.
Epharai cha a lapinô lâ a ngia ta, saw phaoh ta, sawchapaw sa ta, ama ochhôh chhiena ta a tla thlupa vâta, a moh Beriah a bi.
A sawchanô moh cha Serâ châ ta, ano ta Behôrô mathi nata Behôrô machhua zy padua ta, Uzeserâ khihpi chhao a padua.
Epharai sawchapaw hropa moh cha Repha châ ta, Repha sawchapawpa cha Resepha châ ta, Resepha sawchapawpa cha Telâ châ ta, Telâ sawchapawpa cha Tâhâ châ ta,
Tâhâ sawchapawpa cha Lâdâ châ ta, Lâdâ sawchapawpa cha Amihu châ ta, Amihu sawchapawpa cha Elisâmâ châ ta,
Elisâmâ sawchapawpa cha Nunâ châ ta, Nunâ sawchapawpa cha Zawsua a châ.
Ama ryuto râh nata pahrânazy cha Bethel nata a khichapeihzy châ ta, nochhi lâta Nârâ, notla lâta Keze nata a khichapeihzy, Sekhe nata a khichapeihzy, Ai nata a khichapeihzy â hlao khai.

Besai nata a khichapeihzy, Tânâ nata a khichapeihzy, Mekidô nata a khichapeihzy nata Daw nata a khichapeihzy chhao Manase pathlazy ryuto râh a châ hra. Cha suzy liata Izarei sawchapawpa Zawsi pathlazy ama pahrâ.
Asera sawchapawzy cha Imnâ, Isvâ, Isvi nata Beriah zy châ ei ta, ama sietanô cha Serâ a châ.
Beriah sawchapawzy cha Hebe nata Malkie châ ei ta, Malkie cha Bizai paw a châ.
Hebe ta Zaphâle, Sôme, Hôthâ nata ama sietanô Sua zy sa ta.
Zaphâle sawchapawzy cha Pâsakâ, Bimhâ nata Asvâ zy ama châ. Âmo cha Zaphâle pathlazy ama châ.
Seme sawchapawzy cha Ahi, Rôkâ, Zehubâ nata Aramia zy ama châ.
A unawhpa Helema sawchapawzy cha Zôpha, Imnâ, Selesi nata Amâla zy ama châ.
Zôpha sawchapaw­zy cha Suah, Hânephe, Suâ, Beri, Imrâh,
Beze, Hôdâ, Salmâ, Silsâh, Itharâ nata Beerâ zy ama châ.
Zethe sawchapawzy cha Zephune, Pispâ nata Arâ zy ama châ.
Ulâ sawchapawzy cha Arâh, Hânie nata Rizia zy ama châ.
Ama zydua ta Asera pathla pawhrâhpa nata pasaipha ta pahnopa hyutuh chaipazy ama châ. Thyutôna a laichadaipa ta, adyuhna lâ a sie theipa maluh ropazy cha 26,000 ama châ.
Benzami ta a sawchapaw uhtheipa Belâ sa ta, panona Asabe, pathôhna Aharâh,
papalihna Nohâh, papangawhna Râhpha zy sa ta.
Belâ sawchapawzy cha Adarâ, Kerâ, Abihu,
Abisua, Nâmâ, Ahôh,
Kerâ, Sephupha nata Hurâ zy ama châ.
Hezy he Ehu pathlazy ama châ. Âmo cha Kebâ liata a pahrâpa ama pathla pawhrâhpazy châ ei ta, Mânahâ lâ sei ta a chhipazy ama châ.
Chazy cha Nâmâ, Ahiza nata Kerâ zy ama châ. Kerâ cha Uza nata Ahihu paw a châ.
Sâharai ta a lapinô Husi nata Bârâ zy a padisa tawhta, Môabâ râh liata sawzy sa ta.
A lapinô Hôde chô liata Zôbâ, Zibia, Mesâ, Malkâ,
Zuza, Sâchia nata Mimâh zy sa ta. Âmo cha Sâharai sawchapawzy châ ei ta, a chhôh chhôh ta pawhrâhpazy ama châ.
Sâharai ta Husi chô lia chhao ta Abitu nata Elpâ sa ta.
Elpâ sawchapawzy cha Ebe, Mismâ nata Seme zy châ ei ta, Seme he Ônô nata Lôdâ khihpizy nata ama khichapeihzy paduatuhpa a châ.
Elpâ ta Beriah nata Semâ zy sa ta, âmo cha Aizalô liata pahrâpa ama pathla pawhrâhpazy châ ei ta, Kâthâ mo a papuatuhpazy kha ama châ.
Ahiô, Sâsakâ nata Zeremô zy chhao Elpâ sawchapawzy ama châ.
Zebadiah, Aradâ, Ede,
Mikaila, Ispâ nata Zôha zy cha Beriah sawchapawzy ama châ.
Zebadiah, Mesulâ, Hizki, Hebe,
Ismerai, Izliah nata Zôbabi zy chhao Elpâ sawchapawzy ama châ.
Zaki, Zikari, Zabidi,
Elienai, Zilethai, Elie,
Simei sawchapawzy cha Adiah, Berai nata Simrâ zy ama châ.
Ispâ, Ebe, Elie,
Abadaw, Zikari, Hâna,
Hânaniah, Elâmi, Anatothizah,
Iphadiah nata Penia zy cha Sâsakâ sawchapawzy ama châ.
Samserai, Sehariah, Athaliah,
Zaresiah, Elaizâh nata Zikari zy cha Zerôhâ sawchapawzy ama châ.
Âmo cha ama chhâ chyu liata ama pathla pawhrâhpazy châ ei ta, Zerusale liata a pahrâpazy ama châ.
Kibiô mo pathlatuhpa Zeili cha Kibiô khihpi liata pahrâ ta, a lapinô moh cha Mâkâ a châ.
A sawchapaw uhtheipa cha Abadaw châ ta, a pazipazy cha Zuri, Kisâ, Bâlâ, Nâdâ,
Kedaw, Ahiô, Zekhe nata
Simiah paw Mikalô zy ama châ. Âmo cha Zerusale khihpi liata ama unawhzy kiapâh liata ama unawhzy nata hmaohkha ta ama pahrâ.
Nerâ ta Kisâ sa ta, Kisâ ta Sawla sa ta, Sawla ta Zawnathâ, Malkhisua, Abinadâ nata Esbâlâ zy sa ta.
Zawnathâ sawchapawpa cha Meribâlâ châ ta, Meribâlâ ta Mikâ sa ta.
Mikâ sawchapawzy cha Pithaw, Mele, Târia nata Ahâza zy ama châ.
Ahâza ta Zehôadâh sa ta, Zehôadâh ta Aleme, Azamâve nata Zimri zy sa ta, Zimri ta Môza sa ta,
Môza ta Binia sa ta, Binia ta Râphâ sa ta, Râphâ ta Eliasâ sa ta, Eliasâ ta Aze sa ta.
Aze ta sawchapaw pacharu hnei ta, ama mohzy cha Azrikâ, Bôkeru, Ismela, Siariah, Ôbadia nata Hâna zy a châ. Cha zydua cha Aze sawcha­pawzy ama châ.
A unawhpa Ese sawchapawzy cha, a sawchapaw uhtheipa Ulâ, panona Zeu nata pathôhna Eliphele zy ama châ.
Ulâ sawchapawzy cha pasaipha thatlôpa nata likathaipazy châ ei ta, sawchapaw nata samoh hluhpi hnei ei ta, ama maluh 150 ama châ. Cha zydua cha Benzami pathlazy ama châ.
Chatanachata Izarei saw zydua thyutôna cha roh khaipa châ ta, chazy cha Abeizy Châbu liata ropa a châ. Zudâh cha a paraona vâta Babylaw lâ sei ta a chhipa châ ta.
Ama ryuto râh khihpizy liata a pahrâ pakhua heihpa hmiatuapazy cha Izarei saw thokhazy, theihthaipazy, Livai chizy nata Achhyna o liata chakaotuhpazy châ ei ta.
Hezy he Zudâh, Benzami, Epharai nata Manase pathlazy hry tawhta Zerusale liata a pahrâpazy ama châ:
Amihu cha Uthai paw châ ta, Uthai cha Ômri paw a châ. Ômri cha Imri paw châ ta, Imri cha Bâni paw a châ. Âmo cha Zudâh sawchapawpa Pereza pathla­zy ama châ.
Silôni pathlazy cha, a sawchapaw uhtheipa Asiah nata a sawchapaw hropazy ama châ.
Zerâ pathlazy cha Zue nata ama heinawh 690 zy ama châ.
Benzami pathlazy cha, Salu paw Mesulâ, Mesulâ paw Hôdaviah nata Hôdaviah paw Hâsenuah zy ama châ.

Ibaniah cha Zerôhâ sawchapawpa châ ta, Elâ cha Uzizi saw­chapawpa châ ta, Uzizi cha Mikari saw­chapawpa a châ. Mesulâ cha Sephatiah sawchapawpa châ ta, Sephatiah cha Rue sawchapawpa châ ta, Rue cha Ibenizah sawchapawpa a châ.
A chhâ chhâ ta reipa ta, heinawh 956 ama châ. Ama zydua ta ama pathla alaichadaina liata a chhôh chhôh ta pawhrâhpazy ama châ.
Zerusale liata a pahrâ heihpa theihthaipazy cha Zediah, Zehôiari, Zaki nata

Hikia sawcha­pawpa Azariah zy ama châ. Hikia cha Mesulâ sawchapawpa châ ta, Mesulâ cha Zadô sawchapawpa a châ. Zadô cha Meraiô sawchapawpa châ ta, Meraiô cha Khazohpa o liata hyutuhpa Ahitu sawchapawpa a châ.

Adiah paw cha Zerôhâ châ ta, Zehôrâ cha Pâsu sawchapawpa châ ta, Pâsu cha Mâkia sawchapawpa a châ. Mâsai cha Adie sawchapawpa châ ta, Adie cha Zazerâh sawchapawpa châ ta, Zazerâh cha Mesulâ sawchapawpa a châ. Mesulâ cha Mesilemi sawchapawpa châ ta, Mesilemi cha Ime saw­chapawpa a châ.
Ama heinawhzy rei pâpa ta, ama pho pawhrâhpa 1,760 y ei ta, Khazohpa o liata chakaona raihria liata a saomâ kawpazy ama châ.

Hezy he Livai pathla Zerusale liata a pahrâ heihpazy ama châ: Hâsuba sawchapawpa cha Semiah châ ta, Hâsuba cha Azrikâ sawchapawpa a châ. Azrikâ cha Hâsabiah sawchapawpa châ ta, âmo cha Merâri pathlazy ama châ.
Livai pathla hropazy cha Bâbakâ, Heresa, Kalâ nata Mâtaniah zy châ ei ta, Mâtaniah cha Mikhâ sawchapawpa a châ. Mikhâ cha Zikari sawchapawpa châ ta, Zikari cha Asâpha sawchapawpa a châ.

Ôbadia cha Semiah sawchapawpa châ ta, Semiah cha Kalâ sawchapawpa châ ta, Kalâ cha Zeduthu sawchapawpa a châ. Berekiah cha Âsâ saw­chapawpa châ ta, Âsâ cha Netôpha mo khihzy liata pahrâpa Elkânâ sawchapawpa châ ta, âmo chhao Livai pathla ama châ hra.
Chhikao vaituhpazy cha Sâluh, Aku, Talmaw, Ahimâ nata ama heinawhzy châ ei ta, Sâluh cha hyutuhpa a châ.
Kha hlâta cha Livai mo riehmozy liata chhikao vaituhpa châ ei ta, nochhi lâta abei chhikao vaituhpazy ama châ.

Sâluh cha Kôre sawchapawpa châ ta, Kôre cha Ebiasâ sawchapawpa châ ta, Ebiasâ cha Kôrâ sawchapawpa a châ. Ebiasâ nata Kôrâ pathla a heinawhzy cha chakaona raihria kyh liata maophaohtuhpa ama châ. Âmo pathlatuhpazy cha Abeipa riehmo mohôhtuhpazy châ ei ta, chhikao vaituhpazy ama vaw châ tyhpa hawhta, âmo chhao poh o chhikao vaituhpazy ama châ hra.
Kha hlâta cha Eliaza sawchapawpa Phinehâ cha ama hyutuhpa châ tyh ta, a hnohta Abeipa a y tyhpa a châ.
Meselemia sawchapaw­pa Zekaria cha ahmaohna poh o chhikao vaituhpa a châ.

Chhikao vaituhpa châta raopazy cha, ama zydua ta 212 ama châ. Ama thyutôna a laichadainazie hawhta, ama khih chyu liata ama moh ropa a châ. Âmo cha Dâvi nata hrohsopa Samuela ta ama maophaohna rai chyu liata ama padua.
Âmo nata ama sawzy cha Abeipa o chhikao vaina kyh liata maophaohtuhpa châ ei ta, achhyna byureih chhikaozy cha mohôhpa ta ama vaih tyh.
Chhikao vaituhpazy cha nochhi, notla, maw nata chho, kao palih liata ama y tyh.
Ama khihzy liata ama heinawhzy ta noh sari padai ta a thla tyh ei ta, ama rai ama bao tyh.
Chhikao vaituhpa hyutuh chaipa papalihzy cha Livai pathlazy châ ei ta, Khazohpa o chhôhpadâhpazy nata sôh sona mohôhna kyh liata maophaohnazy piepa ama châ.
Achhyna o mohôhna nata my chareih ta pahyna cha âmo maophaohna a châpa vâta, Khazohpa o chadôpa ta amâ riepâ tyh.
Thokha cha chakaona chhaichhi mohôhtuhpazy châ ei ta, amâ ngiakhei chy nata ama puakhei chy ta ama paki tyh.
Ahropazy cha hmobaoh hropazy nata beiphiah pathaihpazy mohôh awpa nata viahdie dipa, kresawhti, sathaw, ropahâhpa nata ia-ôzy mohôh awpa ta raopa ama châ.
Theihthaipa sawchapawpa thokhazy ta ia-ô pahlao awpazy ama pachhuapanoh tyh.
Kôrâ pho Sâluh sawchapaw uhtheipa Livai chi Mâtithiah cha viahchhâ phiapa taona liata maophaohtuhpa a châ.
Ama heinawh Kôhâ pathla thokha cha, viahchhâ chaluahpa taona liata maophaohtuhpazy châ ei ta, Pahânoh maihta amâ chhuanoh tyh.
Livai pathla pawhrâhpa hlasathaipazy cha Achhyna o chhôhpadâhpazy liata y ei ta, chhô nah zâ ta hria awpa maophaohna ama hneipa vâta, rai hropazy tawhta pahuapa ama châ.
Âmo cha Livai pathla pawhrâhpa, ama chhâ chyu liata hyutuhpazy châ ei ta, Zerusale liata a pahrâpazy ama châ.
Kibiô mo pathlatuhpa Zeili cha Kibiô khihpi liata pahrâ ta, a lapinô moh cha Mâkâ a châ.
A sawchapaw uhtheipa cha Abadaw châ ta, a pazipazy cha Zuri, Kisâ, Bâlâ, Nerâ, Nâdâ,
Kedaw, Ahiô, Zekaria nata Mikalô zy ama châ.
Mikalô cha Simia paw châ ta, âmo cha Zerusale liata ama heinawhzy kiapâh liata ama heinawhzy chhaota ama pahrâ.
Nerâ ta Kisâ sa ta, Kisâ ta Sawla sa ta, Sawla ta Zawnathâ, Malkhisua, Abinadâ nata Esbâlâ zy sa ta.
Zawnathâ sawchapawpa cha Meribâlâ châ ta, Meribâlâ ta Mikâ sa ta.
Mikâ sawchapawzy cha Pithaw, Mele, Târia nata Ahâza zy ama châ.
Ahâza ta Zarâh sa ta, Zarâh ta Aleme, Azamâve nata Zimri zy sa ta. Zimri ta Môza sa ta.
Môza ta Binia sa ta, Binia sawchapawpa cha Rephiah châ ta, Rephiah sawchapawpa cha Eliasâ châ ta, Eliasâ sawchapawpa cha Aze a châ.
Aze ta sawchapaw pacharu hnei ta, ama mohzy cha Azrikâ, Bôkeru, Ismela, Siariah, Ôbadia nata Hâna zy a châ. Chazy cha Aze sawchapawzy ama châ.
Philistinâ mo ta Izarei a dyuh ei ta, Izarei mo cha Philistinâ mo hmiakô liata a râpai ei ta, Kibô Tlâh liata thiepa châ ei ta, ama pao haw.
Philistinâ mo ta Sawla nata a sawchapawzy cha a chadai ei ta, Sawla sawchapawpa Zawnathâ, Abinadâ nata Mekhisua zy thie ei ta.
Adyuhna cha ru ngaita ta, Sawla cha thata chadie ei ta, likathaipazy ta Sawla cha hmô ei ta hmah paphao ei ta.

Sawla ta a chariah chhaichhi a chabatuhpa hnohta, “Na zaozi kha phia la, ei chhitlyuna taihta na vaw dy teh. Chataleipatala chopawtaileipazy a vy aw ei ta, einâ palai thlu pathlei aw ei na,” tah ta. Châhrasala a chariah chhaichhi a chabatuhpa cha a chi ngaitapa vâta tao ngâh leipa ta. Chatanachata Sawla cha a zaozi phia ta, a zaw thlu ta.
A chariah chhaichhi chabatuhpa ta Sawla cha a thi haw tahpa a hmô nahta, ano chhao a zaozi a zaw thlu ta, thi ha hra ta.
Cha hawhna chata Sawla nata a sawchapaw pathôhzy cha thi ei ta, ama chhôhkha duata â raohpa ta ama thi khai haw.

Pheisaihzy a râpai ei ta, Sawla nata a sawchapawzy ama thipa cha, Saikao liata a ypa Izarei chyhsazy ta ama hmô nahta, ama khihpizy puasaipa ta â râpai khai ha ei ta. Philistinâ mo a vy ei ta, Izarei khihpizy liata ama vaw pahrâ haw.
A mylâ ta, Philistinâ mo cha ama chariah thiepazy chysia pahluh awpa ta vawh ei ta, Kibô Tlâh liata Sawla nata a sawchapawzy ri a zawh thlâh hapa kei hmô ei ta.
Sawla cha a chysia pahluh ei ta, a luh nata a chariah chhaichhizy la ei ta, thâtih phapa cha ama khazoh nothlahpazy nata chyh­sazy hnohta phuah awpa ta, Philistinâ râh zydua lâta chyhsa tuah ei ta.
Sawla chariah chhaichhizy cha ama khazoh achhyna ozy liata soh ei ta, Dakao achhyna o liata a luh tawh ei ta.
Zabekilia khihsaw zydua ta Philistinâ mo ta Sawla chô liata ama hmotaopa zydua ama thei nahta,
pasaipha zydua pua ei ta, Sawla nata a sawchapawzy ri kei la ei ta, Zabe khihpi lâ ama siekhei haw. Ama ruzy cha Zabe khihpi liata ôkâ tho ry liata pabu ei ta, noh sari chhôh kâhvileipa ta y ei ta.
Sawla cha Abeipa châta ngâ â chhih leipa vâta a thi hapa a châ. Abeipa biepiepa zyh leipa ta, pachaothaipazy tlao a saohiah ta a pachaosa tyh ei.
Abeipa chhihthana tlua vei. Chavâta Abeipa ta Sawla cha thie ta, a khinarâh cha Zese sawchapawpa Dâvi hnohta a pie haw.
Izarei saw zydua ta Hebraw liata Dâvi hnohta a hmaohpakhy ei ta, “Pachâ teh, na rupa nata na sapazy eima châ hih.

Sawla â beina daihti liana chhao khata, Izarei puakhei ta a ngiakhei tyhpa cha nâ na châ. Abeipa na Khazohpa ta na hnohta, ‘Ei phopi Izarei vaituhpa châ aw chi ta, ei phopi Izarei chô liata bei ta na y aw,’ a cha tah,” tah ei ta.

Chatanachata Izarei machâ zydua cha Hebraw liata abei lâ a vy ei ta. Dâvi ta Hebraw liana cha Abeipa hmiakô liata ama hnohta bie hraih ta. Abeipa ta Samuela hmâpa ta a reipa hawhta, Dâvi cha Izarei bei châta sathawthu ei ta.
Chatawhcha Dâvi nata Izarei saw zydua cha Zerusale lâ sie ei ta. Zerusale cha Zebu tah tyhpa châ ta, a râh liata a pahrâpa Zebu mo pahrâna khihpi a châ.
Zebu khihsawzy ta Dâvi hnohta, “He liata a vaw ngia thei aw va chi,” tah ei ta. Chatahrasala Dâvi ta Zaio thokhy cha la ta, cha cha Dâvi khihpi tahpa a vaw châ haw.
Dâvi ta, “Ahy rai Zebu mo a thie tuachaipa cha pheisaih hyutuh chaipa a châ aw,” tah ta. Zeru sawchapawpa Zôabâ khy tuachai ta, chatanachata ano cha pheisaih hyutuh chaipa ta taopa a châ.
Dâvi cha thokhy chhôh liata pahrâ ta, chavâta cha khihpi cha Dâvi khihpi tahpa a châ.
Milô tawhta pathaopa ta khihpi zydua cha thokhy ta dôh ta, khihpi chhôh liata taopathi byuhpa hropazy cha Zôabâ ta taopathi ta.
Dâvi cha Pheisaihzy Abeipa ta a hnohta a ypa vâta, rônah via lymâ ta.
Hezy he Dâvi pasaiphazy châ ei ta, Abeipa bie ta Izarei thâtih a vaw reipa hawhta, Izarei zydua a paraohpa ta Dâvi bei ta taotuhpa nata a khinarâh liata thatlô ngaitapa ta baotuhpazy ama châ.
He he Dâvi pasaiphazy thâtih a châ: Hâkamôni chyhsa Zasôbia cha pasaipha pathôhzy hry liata hyutuh chaipa châ ta, chyhsa 300 chô liata asei pahieh ta, ei kha ta a thie khai theipa a châ.
Pasaipha pathôhzy hry liata ano a pazipa cha, Ahôh chyhsa Dôdô sawchapawpa Eliaza a châ.

Ano cha Philistinâ mo ta a dyuh awpa ta amâ hmaohpakhyna su Pâsdâmi liata Dâvi hnohta a ypa kha a châ. Cha liata bâli sâh ta a biepa lyu y ta, Izarei pheisaihzy cha Philistinâ mo tawhta a râpai ei ta.
Eliaza deikua cha, lyu liah liata a duah ta, khâchâ vaih ta, Philistinâ mo cha thie ta, Abeipa ta pahniena rônahpa ta a pachha ei.
Pheisaih hyutuhpa sythôhzy hry liata hyutuh chaipa pathôhzy cha, lôpanô yna Adulâ lôpu liata a ypa Dâvi lâ zu ei ta, Philistinâ pheisaihzy cha Rephai Saikao liata riehmo paryh ei ta.
Cha nota Dâvi cha thokhy chhôh liata y ta, Philistinâ pheisaihzy cha Bethlehe liata y ei ta.
Dâvi cha a dâhphi kaw ta, “Aw, Bethlehe liata tikhaoh ti, thokhy chhikao kiapâh liatapa kha doh awpa ta nâ piepa ama y mawh sala ei tah kaw dia!” tah ta.

Pasaipha pathôhzy ta Philistinâ pheisaihzy riehmo siepahliepa ta, thokhy chhikao kiapâh liata Bethlehe tikhaoh ti cha kei thaih ei ta, Dâvi lâ vaw cheih ei ta. Châhrasala doh ngâh khao leipa ta. Abeipa châta tlao patlai ta,

Dâvi ta, “He ti he ei Khazohpa hmiakô liata doh cheita aw va na. He chyhsazy heta ama hrona sokhâhpa ta he ti he kei thaih ei ta, ama hrona thisaih cha ei doh aw ma?” tah ta. Chavâta ti cha doh khao vei. Cha hmozy cha pasaipha pathôhzy ta ama tao.
Zôabâ unawhpa Abisai cha pasaipha sythôh hry liata hyutuh chaipa châ ta, chyhsa 300 asei pahieh thlu ta, a thie khai hapa a châ. Chavâta pasaipha pathôhzy moh pha tona liata â hlao hra.
Pasaipha pathôh hry liata pahlaopa a châ leipa chhao ta, âmo hlâta palyupalih tlâh viapa châ ta, Sythôh hry liata palyupalih tlâh chaipa châ ta, chavâta ama hyutuhpa ta ama tao.

Zehôdâ sawchapawpa Benai cha Kâbaze chyhsa riahphapa châ ta, hmo rônahpazy a taotuhpa a châ. Môabâ chyhsa riahphapa pano thie ta, dâhaw tla daihti liata zu ta, khaohtlô liata chakeibarôhneipa a thiepa a châ.

Izi chyhsa pôh pahreihpa, dy pangawh a sâhpa chhao a thie haw. Izi chyhsa cha asei laipa, thaiphia hawhpa a chaba ta, Benai ta chôchahrei a chabapa ta za pangai ta, Izi chyhsa asei chabapa cha chhu ta, Izi chyhsa cha ano asei ta a dysao haw.
Cha hmozy cha Zehôdâ sawchapaw­pa Benai ta tao ta, chavâta pasaipha pathôhzy hawhta moh phana a to hra.
Sythôhpazy hry liata cha palyupalih tlâh chaipa châ ta, châhrasala pasaipha pathôhzy hry liata deikua rei pâpa châ vei. Dâvi ta Benai cha abei vaituhpazy hyutuhpa ta a rao.
Dâvi pasaiphazy cha Zôabâ unawhpa Asahe, Bethlehe khihpa Dôdô sawchapawpa Ehânâ,
Hârôri chyhsa Sâmô, Pelôni chyhsa Helezi,
Tekô khihpa Ike sawchapawpa Irâ, Anathô chyhsa Abieze,
Husâ chyhsa Sibekai, Ahôh chyhsa Ilai,
Netôpha chyhsa Mâharai, Netôpha chyhsa Bânâ sawchapawpa Heledâ,
Benzami pathla Kibia khihpa Ribai sawchapawpa Ithai, Pirathô chyhsa Benai,
Kâsi vahtiepa liata Hurai, Abâthi chyhsa Abie,
Bâharu chyhsa Azamâve, Salbôni chyhsa Eliabâ,
Kizô chyhsa Hâse, Hârâ chyhsa Saki sawchapawpa Zawnathâ,
Hârâ chyhsa Sâkhâ sawchapawpa Ahiama, Ur sawchapawpa Eliphâ,
Mekherâ chyhsa Hepha, Pelôni chyhsa Ahiza,
Kâmel chyhsa Hezrô, Ezbai sawchapawpa Nârai,
Nâthâ unawhpa Zôela, Hâkari sawchapawpa Mibâ,
Amawna chyhsa Zele, Zeru sawchapawpa Zôabâ chariah chhaichhi chabatuhpa Berô chyhsa Nâharai,
Ithari chyhsa Irâ, Ithari chyhsa Kâre,
Hiti chyhsa Uria, Ahlai sawchapawpa Zabâ,
Rubena chyhsa Siza sawchapawpa Adinâ, Rubena chi hyutuhpa pakha nata a hnohta a ypa chyhsa sythôh,
Mâkâ sawchapawpa Hâna, Mithani chyhsa Zôsaphâ,
Asterâ chyhsa Uzia, Arôerâ chyhsa Hôthâ sawchapawpa Sâmâ nata Zeili,
Simri sawchapawpa Zedia nata a unawhpa Tizi chyhsa Zôha,
Mâhavi chyhsa Elie, Elnâ sawchapawpa Zeribai nata Zôsaviah, Môabâ chyhsa Ithamâh,
Mezôbâ chyhsa Elie, Ôbedâ nata Zasie zy ama châ.
Dâvi cha Kisâ sawchapawpa Sawla vâta puaei thei khao leipa ta a y nota, chyhsazy ta Zikalâ liata ano lâ a vy ei ta. Âmo cha adyuhna liata ano a baotuhpa pasaiphazy hry liata a hlao hrapazy ama châ.
Libaw a chabapazy châ ei ta, chavei chachâh ta li a ka thaipa nata cheisiah lô a siah thaipazy ama châ. Âmo cha Benzami pathla, Sawla heinawhzy ama châ.
Hyutuh chaipa cha Ahieze châ ta, a pazipa cha Zôasâ a châ. Ama pano heta Kibia chyhsa Semâh sawchapawzy ama châ. Ahropazy cha Azamâve sawchapawpa Zezie nata Pele, Berâkâh, Anathô chyhsa Zehu,
sythôh hry liata pasaipha nata sythôh hyutuhpa Kibia chyhsa Isamai, Zeremiah, Zahâzie, Zôhanâ, Kederâ chyhsa Zôzabâ,
Eluzai, Zerimô, Bialiah, Semariah, Hâruphi chyhsa Sephatiah,
Kôrâ chyhsa Elkânâ, Isiah, Azare, Zôze nata Zasôbia,
Kedaw chyhsa Zerôhâ sawchapawpa Zôelâ nata Zebadiah zy ama châ.

Kâdâ chi liata pasaipha thatlôpa nata chariah a dyuh thaipazy ta râhchawhpa thokhy liata a ypa Dâvi lâ amâ kei bai hra. Âmo cha vyhphao nata asei a hmâh thaipa châ ei ta, chakeibarôhneipa hmia phaoh ei ta, tlâh sakhihzy hawhta a chatliepa ama châ.
Ama hyutuhpa cha Eze châ ta, panona Ôbadia, pathôhna Eliabâ,
papalihna Mismânâh, papangawhna Zeremiah,
pacharuna Atai, pasarina Elie,
pachariena Zôhanâ, pachakina Elzabâ,
pahrawhna Zeremiah nata hleikhana Mâkhabânai zy ama châ.
Cha Kâdâ pathlazy cha pheisaih hyutuhpazy châ ei ta, ama hry liata thatlô lei chaipa chhao ta za kha a tlu ta, thatlô chaipa cha sâh kha â tlu.
Cha sahlao cha thla khana liata Zawdâh chavah a kao zydua a bie khai nota haosâ lâ kiah ei ta, saikao liata a pahrâpa zydua nochhi lâ nata notla lâ a parâpaisa khaipazy kha ama châ.
Benzami nata Zudâh chizy hry tawhta chyhsa thokha ta thokhy liata Dâvi lâ vawh ei ta.

Dâvi cha âmo dy awpa ta pua ta, ama hnohta, “Na bao awpa ta adyhna bie rei awpa ta kei lâ a vypa nama châ khiahta cha, ei palôh ta châ pazao aw ei ta, ei ku liata hmo doleipa khâpa hmah y vei tahpa pahno thlâh hana chôta, ei khakhaipazy na patusa namâ chhuah khiahta deikua cha, miah pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa ta cha hmô ei sala, viari cha thô mawh ei sy,” tah ta.

Sythôh chô liata hyutuhpa Amasai chô liata Thlahpa vaw tlô ta, ano chata, “Hy Dâvi y, na chyhsazy châ pi ta, Hy Zese sawchapawpa y, Na chhâh a châpazy eima châ hih! Thlalôhna, na chô liata thlalôhna y sala, Châ baotuhpazy chô liata thlalôhna y mawh sy! Na Khazohpa ta a cha bao lymâ hih,” tah ta. Chatawhcha Dâvi ta âmo cha a ly ta, a pheisaih hyutuhpazy ta a tao ha ei.

Sawla a dyuh awpa ta Philistinâ mo hnohta Dâvi a sie hra nota, Manase chi tawhta pheisaih thokhazy Dâvi lâ a vaw râ ei ta. Châhrasala Dâvi ta Philistinâ mo cha bao khao vei. Philistinâ ryureituhpazy ta reihpahmaoh ei ta, “A zibeipa Sawla chhâh a châpa ta, keimo luh tlao miah a la pathlei aw na,” tah ei ta, Dâvi cha ama pakuasa haw.
Zikalâ lâ a lie ta, Manase chi tawhta Adanâh, Zôzabâ, Zedia, Mikaila, Zôzabâ, Elihu nata Zilethai zy ta Dâvi cha amâ kei bai. Âmo cha pheisaih sâh kha hyutuhpazy ama châ.
Dâvi chariah a dyuhpazy amâ dyuhkhei tyh. Ama zydua ta pasaipha riahphapa nata pheisaih hyutuhpazy ama châ.
Noh chareih ta Dâvi chhâh a châpa chyhsazy a vy lymâ ei ta, Khazohpa pheisaih hawhta, pheisaih hluh ngaitapa ama vaw châ haw.
Abeipa bie hawhta, Sawla khinarâh cha Dâvi hnohta pie awpa ta, hezy he Hebraw liata Dâvi lâ a vypa, adyuhna chhaichhi atobipa pheisaih pyzy ama châ:
Zudâh pathla adyuhna chhaichhi atobipa, vyhphao nata asei a chabapa 6,800;
Simeôna pathla adyuhna liata pasaipha thatlô riahphapa 7,100;
Livai pathla 4,000;
Arawna pathla hyutuhpa Zehôdâ nata a hnohta a ypa 3,700;
thyutlia pasaipha riahphapa Zadô nata ano pho tawhta pheisaih hyutuhpa pakih nata pano;
Benzami pathla, Sawla heinawhpa, Sawla pathla chhâh a vaw châ tyhpazy tawhta 3,000;
Epharai pathla, ama phozy liata mohpathâhpa nata pasaipha riahphapa 20,800;
Manase chi khophie hry tawhta moh liahsa palâsapa ta, Dâvi bei ta tao awpa ta a vypa 18,000;
Iskâra pathla, noh nata daihti yzie pahno thai ei ta, Izarei ta a tao awpa a pahnopa hyutuhpa 200 nata ama chhihthana ry liata ama heinawh zydua;
Zebulawna pathla, adyuhna châta chariah chhaichhi pakipa ta a tobipa ta, achhuahna sianopa a hneipa pheisaih hlôpa 50,000;
Nâthalai pathla pheisaih hyutuhpa 1,000 nata vyhphao nata asei a chabapa pheisaih 37,000;
Dânâ pathla, chariah a dyuh awpa ta a mâ chiehpa 28,600;
Asera pathla, a dyuhzie thaipa nata a dyuh awpa ta a mâ chiehpa pheisaih 40,000;
Zawdâh haosâ lâta a ypa Rubena chi, Kâdâ chi nata Manase chi khophie zy tawhta adyuhna chhaichhi kipa ta atobipa pheisaih 120,000.

Cha pheisaih zydua cha chariah a dyuh thaipa châ ei ta, hrâsie awpa ta a mâ chiehpa ta a ypazy châ ei ta, Dâvi cha Izarei zydua chô liata bei ta tao awpa ta, palôh miakha phaohpa ta Hebraw lâ a siepazy ama châ. Cha hawh pyly ta, Izarei saw hropa zydua chhao ta, Dâvi bei ta tao awpa cha ama palôh â raoh khai.
Cha liata Dâvi hnohta niepa nata dopa ta ypa ta noh thôh châh ei ta. Ama unawhzy ta ama nie awpa nata do awpazy amâ vaw chhuahdy khai haw.

Cha dei châ vei, lâhlapi ta a ypa ama heinawh Iskâra, Zebulawna nata Nâthalai râh tawh zy taihta, ama niedo awpazy cha alâzy, râraoseihpazy, arâzy nata viahchao tôhpazy paphaosapa ta ama vaw hlâ lymâ. Izarei liata thaphana y ta, chatanachata viahdie hluhpi, theiku viahchhâzy, kre sao pachawhpazy, kresawhtizy, sathawzy, viahchaozy nata mietakuzy phaopa ta, Hebraw khihpi lâ ama sie lymâ.
Dâvi ta hyutuhpa zydua, sâh kha hyutuhpazy nata za kha hyutuhpazy a saohiah ta.

Dâvi ta Izarei zawpi ahmaohpakhypa zydua hnohta, “Nâmo ta a pha tah u la, Abeipa eima Khazohpa ta pha a tah khiahta cha, Izarei râh zydua liata eima unawh a ypazy nata khihpizy nata si panyuna su a hneipa khichapeihzy liata a ypa theihthaipazy nata Livai mozy lâ chyhsa tuah sih la, keimo lâ a vaw hmaoh awpa ta kei pahruasa ei suh u.
Sawla daihti nona khata eima Khazohpa Byh pado leipa pi ta, tahmâ kei la heih ei suh u,” tah ta.
Pahruana cha zawpizy ta a pha tah ei ta, Khazohpa Byh la awpa cha paryhsa ei ta.
Dâvi ta Izi chavah Sihô tawhta Lebôhamâ taihta a ypa Izarei saw zydua cha, Kiriaziari khihpi liata a ypa Khazohpa Byh cha kei la awpa ta awpakhy ta.

Chatanachata Dâvi nata Izarei saw zydua cha, cherubizy luh chô beidyuchhai liata a tyuhpa Abeipa moh ta awpa Khazohpa Byh cha la awpa ta, Kiriaziari ama tahpa Zudâh râh liata Bâlâh khihpi lâ khy ei ta.
Khazohpa Byh cha Abinadâ o tawhta talailih thiehpa ta siekhei ei ta, Uza nata Ahiô ta talailih cha haoh ei ta.
Dâvi nata Izarei saw zydua cha hlasapa ta, totâzy, tlaipihzy, khoh chyhpazy, paotlâzy, chiahmiezy tôpa ta Khazohpa hmiakô liata ama theina zydua papuapa ta palyupalihna tao ei ta.
Kidaw sawhri ama tlô nahta, viahchao tôhpazy amâ chapiapa vâta, Uza ta Byh cha patu a chhuahpa ta a ku kei paza ta,
Abeipa cha Uza chô liata a hiehâh ta, Byh a patupa vâta tusao ta, cha liata Khazohpa hmiakô liata thi ha ta.
Abeipa ta Uza chô liata ku a pathlapa vâta, Dâvi cha a hiehâh kaw ta. Chavâta cha su cha tanoh taihta Perezuza tahpa a châ.
Cha noh ta Dâvi ta Khazohpa cha chi ngaita ta, “Kheihta ma Khazohpa Byh he ei o ei tlôkhei thei aw?” tah ta.
Chavâta Dâvi ta Byh cha Dâvi khihpi lâ tlôkhei khao leipa ta, Kiti chyhsa Ôbededô o lâ tlao a tleikhei haw.
Khazohpa Byh cha Ôbededô o liata a chhôhkha hnohta thla thôh y ta. Abeipa ta Ôbededô chhôhkha nata a hneipa zydua cha byhnâ pie ta.
Tyre bei Hirâ ta Dâvi lâ chyhsa tuah ta, a o sa nawpa ta sidy thozy paphao ta. Lô zôthaipa nata tho zôthaipazy chhao tuah ta.
Dâvi ta Abeipa ta Izarei chô liata bei ta ano cha padua ta, a phopi Izarei vâta a khinarâh chhao thata cheihchalopa ta a y tahpa pahno ta.
Dâvi cha Zerusale liata lapinôzy hnei viapa ta, sawchapawzy nata sawchanôzy hnei via ta.
Zerusale liata a pihpa a sawzy cha Sâmua, Sôbâ, Nâthâ, Sawlawmaw,
Ibâ, Elisua, Elpele,
Nôkâh, Nephe, Zaphia,
Elisâmâ, Beliadâ nata Eliphele zy ama châ.

Philistinâ mo ta Dâvi cha Izarei râh zydua chô liata bei châta sathawthupa a châ tahpa ama thei nahta, Philistinâ mo zydua Dâvi tlua awpa ta khy ei ta. Cha thâtih cha Dâvi ta a thei nahta, âmo a dyuh awpa ta pua ta.
Philistinâ mo cha a vy ei ta, Rephai Saikao vaw chho ei ta.

Dâvi cha Khazohpa a saohiah ta, “Philistinâ mo a dyuh awpa ta ei khy aw ma? Âmo cha ei ku liata eina pie aw chi ma?” tah ta. Abeipa ta a hnohta, “Khy mah y, âmo cha na ku liata ei cha pie aw,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Dâvi cha Bâlâperâzi lâ khy ta, cha liata Philistinâ mo cha pahnie ta. Dâvi ta, “Khazohpa ta ei ku hmâpa ta ei chariahzy cha tisaih hawhta a ly ha ei,” tah ta.
Philistinâ mo cha ama khazohzy a râsai ei ta. Dâvi ta biepie ta, khazohzy cha mei ta ama rao khai haw.
Philistinâ mo ta saikao vaw chho heih ei ta.
Dâvi ta Khazohpa a saohiah heih ta, Khazohpa ta a hnohta, “Na khyhnao awpa ei châ vei. Âmo cha sie chahlô la, malburi thih dady liata na vaw pua thlu aw ei.
Malburi kôzy kithlao liata hrâsiepa pyu na thei nahta, a dyuh awpa ta na pua aw. Philistinâ pheisaihzy a dyuh awpa ta Khazohpa na hmia lâta a sie haw,” tah ta.
Khazohpa ta bie a piepa hawhta Dâvi ta tao ta, Philistinâ pheisaihzy cha Kibiô tawhta Keze taihta thie lymâ ei ta.
Chatanachata Dâvi moh cha râh to liata pathâh ta, Dâvi china cha Abeipa ta phopi zydua chô liata payasa ta.
Dâvi ta Dâvi khihpi liata ano châta ozy sa ta. Khazohpa Byh y nawpa su a chhuanoh ta, poh o raipa ta.
Dâvi ta, “Khazohpa Byh he Livai pathla dei leipa ta cha, ahy ta hmah amâ sy awpa châ vei. Âmo cha Khazohpa Byh chhâzaw ta a sytuhpa nata ano chakaotuhpa châta Abeipa ta a rao ei,” tah ta.
Dâvi ta Abeipa Byh cha kei la ta, a so nawpa su â chhuanohpa liata so awpa ta, Zerusale liata Izarei saw zydua cha awpakhy ta.
Dâvi ta Arawna pathlazy nata Livai pathlazy tawhta a awpakhypazy cha,
Kôhâ pathla tawhta pawhrâh chaipa Urie nata a unawhzy 120;
Merâri pathla tawhta pawhrâh chai­pa Asiah nata a unawhzy 220;
Kesao pathla tawhta pawhrâh chaipa Zôela nata a unawhzy 130;
Elizaphâ pathla tawhta pawhrâh chaipa Semiah nata a unawhzy 200;
Hebraw pathla tawhta pawhrâh chaipa Elie nata a unawhzy 80;
Uzie pathla tawhta pawhrâh chaipa Aminadâ nata a unawhzy 112 ama châ.
Chatawhcha Dâvi ta theihthaipa Zadô nata theihthaipa Abiathâ nata Livai pathla Urie, Asiah, Zôela, Semiah, Elie nata Aminadâ zy aw ta,
ama hnohta, “Nâmo cha Livai chi pawhrâh chaipazy nama châ. Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa Byh cha a su ei chhuanohpa lâ namâ vaw sy thei nawpa ta, nâmo nata nama unawhzy a pathai teh u.
A hmiatuapa liana khata, bieraopa hawhta ano pado leipa pi ta, nâmo ta Byh namâ sy leipa vâna khata, Abeipa eima Khazohpa cha eima chô liata a hie a hâhpa a châ,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa Byh a sy awpa ta theihthaipazy nata Livai pathlazy cha a pathai ei ta.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta bie a piepa hawhta, Livai pathlazy ta Khazohpa Byh cha a lâ ta ama ngiatlâh ta a sy ei ta.

Dâvi ta Livai pathla pawhrâhpazy cha ama unawhzy hry tawhta hlasathaipazy a tlyh ta, pyungiapa chhaichhi tlaipihzy, totâzy nata paotlâzy a paro ngaitapa ta patôsa ta, thaphana hla a paro ngaitapa ta pasasa awpa ta biepie ta.
Chatanachata Livai pathlazy ta Zôela sawchapawpa Hemâ, a unawhzy hry tawhta Berekiah sawchapawpa Asâpha, ama unawhpa Merâri pathla tawhta Kusai sawchapawpa Ethâ,
chhâ nona liata ama unawhzy tawhta Zekariah, Zazie, Semiramô, Zehie, Uni, Eliabâ, Benai, Mâsei, Mâtithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikaniah nata chhikao vaituhpa Ôbededô nata Zeili zy a tlyh ei ta.
Hlasathaipa Hemâ, Asâpha nata Ethâ zy cha dawh paotlâ tô awpa ta raopa ama châ.
Zekariah, Azie, Semiramô, Zehie, Uni, Eliabâ, Mâsei nata Benai zy cha Alamô siezie hawhta tlaipih tô awpa ta raopa ama châ.
Mâtithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikaniah, Ôbededô, Zeili nata Azaziah zy cha, Semini siezie hawhta totâ tô awpa ta raopazy ama châ.
Khenaniah cha pyungiapa a thaipa châ ta, pyungiapa kyh liata Livai pathla chhituhpa a châ. Ano ta pyungiapa chakaona rai a chhihtha lymâ.
Berekiah nata Elkânâ zy cha Byh châta chhikao vaituhpazy ama châ.

Theihthaipa sahlao, Sebaniah, Zehôsaphâ, Nethane, Amasai, Zekariah, Benai nata Elieze zy cha Kha­zohpa Byh hmiakô liata chiahmie tôtuhpazy ama châ. Obededô nata Zehiah cha Byh châta chhikao vaituhpazy ama châ.
Chatanachata Dâvi nata Izarei machâzy nata pheisaih sâh kha hyutuhpazy ta Ôbededô o liata a ypa Abeipa Biehrai Byh cha la awpa ta, thapha ngaitapa ta zu ei ta.
Khazohpa ta a baopa vâ ei ta, Abeipa Biehrai Byh a sytuhpa Livai pathlazy ta viahchao tôhpa pô sari nata mietaku tôhpa pô sari ta atheihna hlâ ei ta.
Dâvi cha lini poh rih dipa ta a tobi ta. Byh a sytuhpa Livai pathlazy nata hlasathaipazy nata pyungiapa chhituhpa Khenaniah zy chhao lini poh rih dipa ta a tobi ei ta. Dâvi cha lini ephaw â ky pâ.
Izarei saw zydua ta mietaku tôhpa ki, chiahmie nata paotlâ pyuzy chhaota thata rahaona chôta nata tlaipihzy nata totâzy a paro ngaitapa ta tôpa ta, Abeipa Biehrai Byh cha ama khykhei haw.
Abeipa Biehrai Byh cha Dâvi khihpi a kaw ngia ta. Sawla sawchanô Mikâli cha opy tawhta vaw sai ta, Bei Dâvi cha thapha ngaitapa ta a lâpa kei hmô ta, a palôh ta zakhei kaw ta.
Khazohpa Byh cha a ngiakhei ei ta, a so nawpa ta Dâvi ta a paraipa poh o chhôh liata soh ei ta, raopa hlânazy nata aryhna hlânazy Khazohpa hmiakô liata hlâ ei ta.
Dâvi ta raopa hlânazy nata aryhna hlânazy a hlâ khai nahta, Abeipa moh ta zawpizy cha byhnâ awpa ta.
Izarei saw zydua cha a chanô chapaw ta, viahchhâ tlâ kha, sa tlo kha nata kre thei pachawhpa sao kha chyu rai ta.
Dâvi ta Livai pathla thokhazy cha Abeipa Byh hmiakô liata chakao ta, Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa lâ thlahchhâpa ta, alyna bie reih ta, reithai awpa ta rao ta.

Hyutuh chaipa cha Asâpha châ ta, a pazipazy cha Zekariah, Zeili, Semiramô, Zehie, Mâtithiah, Eliabâ, Benai, Ôbededô nata Zeili zy châ ei ta, âmo cha tlaipih nata totâ a tô thaipazy ama châ. Asâpha cha paotlâ tôtuhpa châ ta,
theihthaipa Benai nata Zahâzie cha Khazohpa Bieh­rai Byh hmiakô liata a daihtita ta chiahmie a tô tyh awpazy ama châ.
Chatanachata cha noh liata, Abeipa lâ alyna bie reina hla sa awpa ta, Dâvi ta Asâpha nata a unawhzy cha rao ta, he Dâvi hla phipa he Abeipa lâ ama hlâ.
Abeipa lâ alyna bie hlâpa ta a moh pado u la, Phopizy hry liata a hmotaopazy pahnosa teh u!
Ano lâ hla sapa ta, Ano cha reithai u la; A hmotao noâhpa zydua phuah teh u!
A moh pathaihpa parônahsa u la, Abeipa a tluatuhpazy palôh cha, Thaphapa ta y mawh sy!
Abeipa nata a thatlôna tlua u la, A hmia khâ tlua muh vy!
A hmotao noâhpazy a thei thlâh ha u la, A hmonoâhpazy a theipa ta, A pachiana biezy a thei thlâh ha teh u.
Hy a chakaotuhpa Izarei pathla saih u, Hy â tlyhpa Zakaw sawzy saih u!
Ano cha Abeipa eima Khazohpa châ ta, A ryureina alei chô zydua liata a y.
A biehrai chhâzaw ta a thei thlâh ha u la, A biepiepa chhâ sâh hluhpi taihta a thei thlâh ha teh u.
Cha tlai cha Abarahâ hnohta a biehrai kha châ ta, Aisika hnohta a bietai châ hra ta,
Zakaw hnohta bieraopa ta pa-i ta, Izarei hnohta chhâzaw biehrai ta taopa ta,
“Kâna râh cha pie aw na ta, Cha cha na ryuto râh a châ aw,” a tah.
Maluh chyhta dei châ ei chi ta, Rei khi chhao a tloh leipa, Khichhaipa dei nama châ nona kha,
Phopi miakha tawhta miakha lâta viavi ei chi ta, Khinarâh miakha tawhta miakha lâ nama viavi laih.
Ahy ta hmah ama tlybai awpa pasaih leipa ta, Âmo vâta beizy ra ta,
“Ei sathawthupazy hria leipa u la, Ei hrohsopazy pasasa khuh vy!” a tah.
Leilô zydua saih u, Abeipa lâ hla sa u la, A pachhana bie noh chareih chho teh u.
Râhzy liata a rônahzie phuah u la, Phopi zydua hnohta a hmotao noâhpazy phuah teh u!
Abeipa cha rônah ta, Thata reithai awpa châ ta, Khazoh zydua hlâta chi chai awpa a châ.
Phopizy khazoh zydua cha nothlahpazy dei châ ei ta, Abeipa deikua cha avâzy a taotuhpa a châ.
A hmiakô liata rônahna nata abeina y ta, A yna su liata thatlôna nata thaphana a y.
Phopizy liata chi to saih u, Abeipa cha reithai u la, Abeipa cha rônahna nata thatlôna patosa teh u!
Abeipa cha a moh rônahna patosa u la, Hmohlâpa cheipa ta a hmiakô liata a vy teh u! Rônahna nata pathaihna ta Abeipa cha a chhy u la,
Leilô zydua saih u, A hmiakô liata a chalyu teh u; Khizaw he â ipa ta paduapa châ ta, A chalyu beih aw vei.
Avâzy ama thapha sala, Alei a ly mawh sy; Phopizy hry liata, “ Abeipa ta ryu a reih!” Tah mawh ei sy!
Tilaipi a rôh sala, A chhôh liata a ypazy a rôh mawh ei sy; Lyurâhpa a thapha sala, A chhôh liata a ypa to ama thapha mawh sy!
Abeipa cha alei pachia awpa ta a vy aw ta, Cha tita râhmâhpa thozy ta, A hmiakô liata thapha ta hla ama sa aw.
Abeipa lâ alyna bie hlâ teh u; Ano cha pha ta, A kyhpachâna a tleih beih leipa a châ.
“Hy eima pachhana Khazohpa y, Miah pachha la, Râh to tawhta miah pakhy la, Miah chatlai mah y; Chatanachata na moh pathaihpa lâ alyna bie reih aw pi ta, Na rônahna eima reithai aw.
Abeipa Izarei Khazohpa cha, Chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta reithaipa ta y mawh sy!” Chyhsa zydua ta, “Amen!” tah ei ta, Abeipa cha ama reithai.
Chatanachata Abeipa Biehrai Byh hmiakô liata â ngiahna hawhta noh chareih chakaona rai hria awpa ta, Bei Dâvi ta Asâpha nata a unawhzy soh ta.
Ôbededô nata a unawh sycharu nata pachariezy chhao soh ta. Zeduthu sawchapawpa Ôbededô nata Hôsâ cha chhikao vaituhpazy ama châ.
Kibiô su sâhpa liata Abeipa byureih liata chakaona raihria awpa ta, theihthaipa Zadô nata a unawhpa theihthaipazy soh hra ta.
Âmo cha Abeipa Ryhpa liata ropa, Abeipa ta Izarei sawzy bie a piepa zydua tao ta, my nata zâ ta raopa hlâna maisâh liata Abeipa lâ raopa hlâna a hlâ tyh awpazy ama châ.
A zawngiahna cha chhâzaw châta a châpa vâta, Abeipa lâ alyna bie a reih tyh awpa ta, Hemâ nata Zeduthu nata mohropa ama moh ta a tlyhpazy chhao, ama hnohta chakaosapa ama châ.
Hemâ nata Zeduthu cha pyungiapa châta chiahmiezy nata paotlâzy hnei ei ta, Khazohpa hla sa nawpa ta chhaichhizy ama hnei. Chhikao vaituhpazy châta Zeduthu sawchapawzy rao­pa ama châ.
Chatawhcha zawpi zydua ama o chyu lâta a di ei ta, Dâvi chhao a chhôhkhazy byhnâ awpa awpa ta a o lâ â di ha hra.
Dâvi cha a o liata a pahrâ tawhta, hrohsopa Nâthâ hnohta, “Moh tua, kei sidy tho o liata y na ta, Abeipa Bieh­rai Byh hmâchhâh poh o ry liata a y thlâh haw,” tah ta.
Nâthâ ta Dâvi hnohta, “Na palôh liata a ypa zydua tao mah y, Khazohpa na hnohta a y mâh tâh,” tah ta.
Châhrasala cha zâ lilaw ta Nâthâ hnohta Khazohpa bie vaw tlô ta,
“Vawh la, nâ chakaotuhpa Dâvi kei chho teh, Abeipa ta hetana heta a tah: ‘Ei pahrâ nawpa o nâ sapa awpa cha nâma châ va chi.
Izi râh tawhta Izarei ei kaw chhi papua noh tawhta tanoh taihta, o liata pahrâ leipa na ta, poh o miakha tawhta miakha lâ a pasie na ta, achhyna byureih miakha tawhta miakha lâ ei pasie lymâ.

Izarei saw zydua hnohta ei pasie laihna su to liata, ei phopi chhihtha awpa ta bie ei piepa Izarei ryureituhpa ahy hnohta tlyma, “Khazia sidy tho ta o eina sapa veih ei chi?” tahpa ta kawh kha chhâ ei vaw reih beih ma?’

Chavâta tahmâ nâ chakaotuhpa Dâvi hnohta hetana heta kei chho teh, ‘Pheisaihzy Abeipa ta hetana heta a tah, ei phopi Izarei chô liata ryureituhpa châ awpa ta, sibiepa su tawhta nata mietakuzy na vaina tawhta cha la papua na ta,
na siena maih liata na hnohta y lymâ na ta, na chariah zydua na hmiakô tawhta ei chhawh pathlah ha ei. Alei chô liata chyhsa rônahpazy hawhta moh rônahpa ei cha taopa aw.

Ei phopi Izarei châta su rao aw na ta, cha liata loh aw ei na ta, âmo su eihpa liata pahrâ aw ei ta, patypamâpa ta y khao aw veih ei. Eikhano hawhna khata, thachahra a hmâhpazy ta âmo cha parao khao aw veih ei.

Ei phopi Izarei chô liata ryureituhpazy ei raona daihti hawhna khata châ khao aw vei. Na chariah zydua ei panawhsa khai aw ei. Cha dei châ vei, Abeipa ta chipathla a cha paduapa aw tahpa na hnohta ei phuah.
Na nohzy a kipa ta, châ pathlatuhpazy hnohta na sie tita, châ thla awpa ta, na chipathla, na sawchapawzy hry tawhta pakha padua aw na ta, a khinarâh ei pa-i aw.
Ano ta o na sapa aw ta, kei ta a beidyuchhai chhâzaw ta ei pa-i aw.
A paw châ aw na ta, ei sawchapawpa a châ aw. Nâma hlâta a bei tuapa tawhta ei zawngiahna ei la hapa hawhna khata, ano tawhta ei zawngiahna la aw va na.
