Ei o liata nata ei khinarâh liata ano cha chhâzaw ta pa-i aw na ta, a beidyuchhai chhâzaw ta ei padua aw,’ tahpa ta,” tah ta.
Cha bie zydua nata cha aluahna hawh tlai ta Nâthâ ta Dâvi cha chho ta.
Chatawhcha Bei Dâvi cha a ngia ta, Abeipa hmiakô liata a tyuh ta, a hnohta, “Hy Zehôvâh Khazohpa, ahy ma châ na ta, ei chhôhkha he khâpa châ ta ma, he taih heta einâ vaw chhi chi tly?
Hy Khazohpa y, cha chhao cha na mohmô liata la, hmo chyhpata dei a châ. Hy Zehôvâh Khazohpa y, châ chakaotuhpa pathlazy kyh kô hluhpi châta reih ha chi ta, chyhsa rônahpa hawhta eina pachâ chi!
Châ chakaotuhpa na palyupalihna kyh liata, Dâvi heta reih awpa khâpa a hnei khao? Châ chakaotuhpa he pahno pasia tlôh chi ta.
Châ chakaotuhpa vâta, Hy Abeipa y, cha hmo rônahpa zydua cha na palôh hawh tlai ta tao chi ta, cha hmo rônahpazy cha na palâhâh haw.
Hy Abeipa y, eima nah theipa liata, nâ hawhpa he ahy hmah y leipa ei ta, nâ leipa ta Khazoh hropa y veih ei.

Na phopi Izarei hawhpa he alei chô liata khâpa phopi ma a y? Khazohpa ta ano phopi ta tao awpa ta, sie ta a kei chatlaipa phopi ahy ma a y? Izi râh tawhta na chatlaipa na phopi, ama hmiakô liata phopizy papuapa ta, na châta moh rônahpa nata noâhchhihpa hmozy châ awpa ta na taopa phopi hawhpa he ahy ma a y?
Chatanachata na phopi Izarei cha, chhâzaw ta nâma phopi châ awpa ta tao chi ta, nâma tlai cha, Hy Abeipa y, ama Khazohpa na vaw châ haw.
Chavâta tahmâ he, Hy Abeipa y, châ chakaotuhpa nata a pathlazy kyh na reipa kha, chhâzaw châta pa-i la, na reipa hawh tlai ta tao mah y.

Chatanachata ‘Pheisaihzy Abeipa cha Izarei Khazohpa châ ta, ano cha Izarei Khazohpa a châ,’ tahpa ta, na moh cha chhâzaw ta pa-ipa nata pachônôsapa ta y aw ta, châ chakaotuhpa Dâvi pathlazy cha na hmiakô liata paduapa ama châ aw.
Hy ei Khazohpa, nâma tlai ta, châ chakaotuhpa hnohna heta a pathlazy na paduapa awpa kyh palâhâh ha chi ta, chavâta châ chakaotuhpa heta riahphapa ta na hmiakô liata thlah ei chhâ ngâhpa a châ.
Hy Abeipa y, nâ cha Khazohpa châ chi ta, cha hmo phapa cha châ chakaotuhpa hnohta nâ taih haw.
Chavâta tahmâ, châ chakaotuhpa pathlazy cha chhâzaw ta na hmiakô liata ama y thei nawpa ta, âmo cha byhnâ pie mah y. Hy Abeipa, nâma tlai ta byhnâ aw ha chi ta, chhâzaw byhnâ châ mawh sy,” tah ta.
Cha hnôh lâta Dâvi ta Philistinâ mo a dyuh ta, pahnie ta, Kâthâ khihpi nata a khichapeihzy cha Philistinâ mo tawhta la ta.
Môabâ mo pahnie ta, chatanachata Môabâ mo cha Dâvi chakaotuhpa ta y ei ta, ano lâ râhpaw ama pie tyh.
Dâvi cha Ufrâti chavah kaozy liata a biehneina padua awpa ta a siena liata, Zôbâ bei Hadâdeze cha Hâmathi khihpi taihta a dyuh ta, pahnie ta.
Hadâdeze talailih 1,000, arâ pheisaih 7,000 nata alei pheisaih 20,000 patu ta. Talailih a daophipa arâ zydua cha ama chazaw chhawh khai ta, talailih 100 a daophi awpa deita a pahlôh.
Dâmaskâ liata Aramia mo ta Zôbâ bei Hadâdeze pachha awpa ta a vy ei ta, Dâvi ta Aramia pheisaih 22,000 thie ta.

Dâvi ta Dâmaskâ liata Aramia mo hry liata pheisaih suzy soh ta, chatanachata Aramia mo cha Dâvi chakaotuhpa ta y ei ta, ano lâ râhpaw ama pie lymâ. Abeipa ta Dâvi cha a siena maih liata pahniena pie lymâ ta.
Dâvi ta Hadâdeze chakaotuhpazy ta ama siekheipa ngôh vyhphaozy la ta, Zerusale lâ phaoh ta.
Dâvi ta Hadâdeze khihpi Tibâ nata Kunâ zy tawhta dawh hluhpi la ta. Chazy cha hmâpa ta Sawlawmaw ta dawh tipâh, dawh tôhzy nata dawh hmobaohzy tao ta.
Dâvi ta Zôbâ bei Hadâdeze pheisaih zydua a pahnie khai hapa thâtih Hâmathi bei Tou ta a thei nahta,

Dâvi ta Hadâdeze cha a dyuh ta a pahnie hapa vâta, a naoh awpa nata a lykhei awpa ta, a sawchapawpa Hadôrâ cha ano lâ tuah ta. Hadâdeze nata Tou cha khâ a dyuh tyhpa châ ei ta. Tou ta ngôh, tâkâ nata dawh hmobaoh to Dâvi lâ paphao ta.
Chazy cha Dâvi ta râh a pahniepa zydua, Edômâ mo, Môabâ mo, Amawna mo, Philistinâ mo nata Amale mozy tawhta tâkâ nata ngôh a lapazy chhaota Abeipa lâ hlâ ta.
Zeru sawchapawpa Abisai ta Alôh Saikao liata Edômâ pheisaih 18,000 thie ta.
Edômâ râh liata pheisaihzy soh ta, chatanachata Edômâ mo zydua cha Dâvi chakaotuhpazy ta y ha ei ta. Abeipa ta Dâvi cha a siena maih liata pahniena pie lymâ ta.
Chatanachata Dâvi cha Izarei saw zydua chô liata ryureih ta, a phopi zydua châta adona nata akhongâhna ta ryureih ta.
Zeru sawchapawpa Zôabâ cha pheisaih hyutuh chaipa châ ta, Ahilu sawchapawpa Zehôsaphâ cha thâtih rohtuhpa a châ.
Ahitu sawchapawpa Zadô nata Abiathâ sawchapawpa Ahimele zy cha theihthaipazy châ ei ta, Sâvasâ cha chârohtuhpa a châ.
Zehôdâ sawchapawpa Benai cha Khere mo nata Pele mo hyutuhpa châ ta, Dâvi sawchapawzy cha bei chakaona rai liata hyutuh chaipazy ama châ.
Cha khai tawhta, Amawna bei Nahâsâ cha thi ta, a sawchapawpa ta ano su liata a bei ta.

Dâvi ta, “Nahâsâ sawchapawpa Hânu cha, a paw ta ei chô liata phana a palâsa tyhpa hawhta, kei chhao ta chô liata phana ei palâsa hra aw,” tah ta. Chatanachata a paw thina kyh liata thlapalôh awpa ta, Dâvi ta Hânu lâ lyuhchâpazy tuah ta. Dâvi chakaotuhpazy cha Hânu thlapalôh awpa ta Amawna râh kei tlô ei ta.

Châhrasala Amawna pawhrâhpazy ta Hânu hnohta, “Dâvi heta na paw a zapa vâta thlapalôhtuhpazy nâ lâ a vaw tuapa a châ tahpa na pangiasa ma? Râh thâtih patluah ta, râh mohparu ta parao awpa ta, a chakaotuhpazy a vaw tuapa châ vei ma?” tah ei ta.
Hânu ta Dâvi chakaotuhpazy cha patu ta, ama kâhhmizy ngyu ta, ama viahkaozy â khophie liata, ama chaosa dady ta tai ta, âmo cha pakuasa ha ta.

Chakaotuhpazy hmo a tyhpa cha Dâvi chho ei ta. Chakaotuhpazy cha ama noza kaw ta, chavâta Dâvi ta âmo dy awpa ta chyhsazy tuah ta. Abei ta, “Nama kâhhmi a seih hlâlei Zerikô liata y chy u la, cha khai tawhta a vy lah vâ ei chi,” tah ta.

Amawna mo ta Dâvi châta roh chhiepa ama châ haw tahpa amâ pahno nahta, Hânu nata Amawna mo ta talailih nata arâ pheisaihzy a hlâ nawpa ta Mesôpôtamia, Aramiamâkâ nata Zôbâ râhzy lâ tâkâ talent 1,000 paphao ei ta.
Mâkâ bei nata a pheisaihzy nata talailih 32,000 a hlâh ei ta. Pheisaihzy cha Medebâ kiapâh liata riehmo paryh ei ta. Amawna mo cha ama khihpizy tawhta puapakhy ei ta, a dyuh awpa ta sie ei ta.
Cha thâtih cha Dâvi ta a thei nahta, Zôabâ nata pheisaih riahphapa zydua tuah ta.
Amawna mo cha vaw pua ei ta, a dyuh awpa ta khihpi chhikao liata a paziah ei ta. Adyuhna lâ a sie hrapa ama beizy cha âmo dei ta lyurâhpa liata y ei ta.
Zôabâ ta a hmia a hnôh ta amâ vaw dyuhpa a hmô nahta, Izarei pheisaih pha chaipazy a tlyh ta, Aramia mo a dyuh awpa ta âmo cha paziah ta.
A pheisaih hropazy cha a unawhpa Abisai ku liata soh ta, Amawna mo a dyuh awpa ta paziah ta.
Zôabâ ta, “Ei châta Aramia mo ama tha a tlô tu khiahta cha, na vaw bao aw chi ta, Amawna mo na châta ama tha a tlô tu khiahta cha, ei cha vaw bao aw.
Riahphapa ta y u la, eima phopi nata eima Khazohpa khihpizy châta eima thatlônazy hmâh suh vy. Abeipa ta pha a tahpa hawhta tao mawh sy,” tah ta.
Zôabâ nata a pheisaihzy cha Aramia mo a dyuh awpa ta a kei hnia ei ta, Aramia mo cha Zôabâ hmiakô liata a râpai ha ei ta.
Aramia mo amâ râpai hapa Amawna mo ta ama hmô nahta, âmo chhao cha Zôabâ unawhpa Abisai hmiakô liata a râpai ei ta, khihpi liata amâ ngia haw. Chatawhcha Zôabâ cha Zerusale lâ a lie ha ta.

Aramia mo cha Izarei ta a pahnie hapa ei ama pahno nahta, Ufrâti chavah haosâ lâta a ypa Aramia mo aw awpa ta lyuhchâpazy tuah ei ta. Aramia mo cha Hadâdeze pheisaih hyutuhpa Sopha chhihthana ry liata a vy ei ta.

Cha thâtih cha Dâvi chho ei ta, Izarei pheisaih zydua awpakhy ta. Zawdâh chaka ei ta, Aramia mo yna kei tlô ei ta, a dyuh awpa ta a paziah ei ta. Dâvi ta Aramia mo a dyuh awpa ta a pheisaihzy a paziah khai nahta, ano chhaota Aramia mo cha a dyuh ei ta.
Aramia mo cha Izarei sawzy hmiakô liata a râpai ha ei ta. Dâvi ta Aramia mo arâ pheisaih 7,000 nata alei pheisaih 40,000 zy thie ta, pheisaih hyutuhpa Sopha chhao a thie haw.

Hadâdeze chakaotuhpazy ta Izarei sawzy hmiakô liata pahniepa ta ama ypa ama hmô nahta, Dâvi nata aryhna tao ei ta, Dâvi ryureina ry liata y ha ei ta. Aramia mo ta Amawna mo cha pachha khoh khao veih ei.

Beizy hrâ ama sie tyhna châhvâ daihti liata, Zôabâ cha pheisaih hluhpi a chhipa ta hrâsiena lâ pua ta. Amawna râh parao ta, sie ta Râbâ khihpi dôh ta. Dâvi deikua cha Zerusale liata y ta. Zôabâ ta Râbâ khihpi cha a dyuh ta, pahnie ta.

Dâvi ta ama bei beilakho cha a luh tawhta la ta, ngôh talent miakha â hripa ta pahno ta. Lôsôhpazy chhao a chhôh liata y ta, cha cha Dâvi luh liata pakho ei ta. Khihpi hraona sôh hluhpi chhao vaw phaoh ta.

Râbâ khihsawzy cha puakhei ta, thoânazy, leipaliena thua pazaopazy nata ahreizy hmâpa ta raihriatuhpazy ta âmo cha hmâh ta. Cha hawhna chata Dâvi ta Amawna khihpi zydua cha tao ta. Cha khai tawhta Dâvi nata pheisaih zydua cha Zerusale lâ a lie ha ei ta.

Cha khai tawhta Philistinâ mo nata adyuhna Keze khihpi liata y ta. Husâ chyhsa Sibekai ta Sipai thie ta. Sipai cha mopahreihpazy pathla hry liatapa a châ. Chatanachata Philistinâ mo cha panawhpa ta y ha ei ta.
Philistinâ mo nata adyuhna y heih ta. Zairâ sawchapawpa Ehânâ ta Kiti chyhsa Kôliathâ unawhpa Lâmi thie ta. Lâmi asei bih cha thaisana batlâh tlu ta a laipa a châ.

Kâthâ liata adyuhna y heih ta. Cha khihpi liata chyhsa mopahreih ngaitapa, a ku chavei chachâh ta kuparo miacharu hnei ta, a phei chavei chachâh ta pheiparo miacharu a hneipa, a zydua ta kuparo nata pheiparo mia kih nata miapalih a hneipa y ta. Ano chhao cha mopahreihpazy pathla châ ta.
Cha chyhsa chata Izarei sawzy cha pahao ta, Dâvi unawhpa Simia sawchapawpa Zawnathâ ta a thie haw.
Âmo cha Kâthâ liata mopahreih­pazy pathla châ ei ta, Dâvi nata a chyhsazy ku liata a thipazy ama châ.
Sâtâ ta Izarei a dyuh awpa ta thyu ta, Izarei maluhpi rei awpa ta Dâvi cha reipasao ta.
Dâvi ta Zôabâ nata pheisaih hyutuhpazy hnohta, “Sie u la, Besebâ tawhta Dânâ taihta Izarei sawzy maluh reih u la, ama maluh zie ei pahno thei nawpa ta, na vaw chho heih muh vy,” tah ta.

Zôabâ ta, “ Abeipa ta a phopi he a lie za hluhpi ta papôh mawh sy! Ei zibeipa abei y, râhsaw zydua he ei zibeipa chakaotuhpa sai châ veih ei ma? Khâpa vâta ma ei zibeipa heta he hmo he tao awpa a khoh tly? He hmo heta khazia Izarei chô liata thaileichâna a tlôkhei aw tly?” tah ta.
Châhrasala abei bie ta Zôabâ cha pahnie ha ta. Chatanachata Zôabâ cha pua ta, Izarei râh zydua a chahryh khai tawhta Zerusale lâ a vaw lie ta.
Zôabâ ta Izarei phopi maluh pahlyhpakhypa cha Dâvi chho ta. Izarei râh zydua liata, zaozi a chaba theipa chapaw 1,100,000 y ei ta, Zudâh râh liata 470,000 ama y.
Zôabâ cha bei biepiepa kyh liata a palôh a châ lei ngaitapa vâta, Livai chi nata Benzami chi deikua ama maluh rei pâ khao vei.
Cha hawhta Izarei maluhpi reipa cha Khazohpa a ly leipa ta, chavâta Khazohpa ta Izarei sawzy cha hrie ta.
Dâvi ta Khazohpa hnohta, “Ei hmotaopa vâna heta ei vaw molei ngaita kaw na. Châhrasala tahmâ ei châ haw na, châ chakaotuhpa paraona he rie a ngiahthai mah y. Hru kawpa ta hmo ei vaw tao haw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta Dâvi hrohsopa Kâdâ hnohta,
“Vawh la, Dâvi hnohta, ‘ Abeipa ta hetana heta a tah: A tlyh awpa hmo miathôh cha pie na ta, miakha a tlyh aw chi ta, cha cha ei cha taopa aw, a tah na,’ tahpa ta na kei chho aw,” tah ta.
Kâdâ cha Dâvi lâ vawh ta, a hnohta, “ Abeipa ta hetana heta a tah, ‘Na khopa a tlyh teh.

Kô thôh chakâhna ma, thla thôh chhôh na chariahzy ta cha chadaipa ta ama zaozi ta ama cha pahleipadia awpa ma, noh thôh chhôh Abeipa zaozi ta potlana patlôsapa ta, Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa ta Izarei râh zydua a pahleipadia khai awpa ma?’ Tahmâ a tlyh teh, nâ vaw tuatuhpa hnohta kheihawhpa achhyna ma ei tlôkhei aw,” tah ta.
Dâvi ta Kâdâ hnohta, “Ei nô a po ngaita. Abeipa ku liata ei pao thlu aw, ano cha zawngiah thei ngaitapa châ tlôh ta. Chyhsapa ku liata la na papaosa khah y,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Abeipa ta Izarei chô liata potlana patlôsa ta, Izarei chyhsa 70,000 thi ei ta.

Zerusale pahleipadia awpa ta Khazohpa ta vâlyuhchâpa tuah ta, châhrasala pahleipadia awpa â chhuah hai nota, Abeipa ta hmô ta, chhiena patlôsa â chhuahpa cha a pathleih haw. Abeipa ta pahleipadiana rai a hria haipa vâlyuhchâpa hnohta, “Â daih haw, na ku hy khao khah y,” tah ta. Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa cha Zebu chyhsa Ôranâ sawhri kiapâh liata a duah ta.

Dâvi cha mohmia pasaih ta, alei nata avâ likawh liata â duah thlâh hapa Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa hmô ta. A ku liata zaozi â chabapa cha Zerusale chô liata pazawh ta. Dâvi nata machâzy cha latho poh a bupa ta alei liata â khu lâta pao ei ta.

Dâvi ta Khazohpa hnohta, “Phopi maluh reih awpa ta bie a piepa kha keima châ va na ma? A moleipa nata paraona lai ngaitapa a taotuhpa cha keima tlai he ei châ. He mietakuzy heta khâpa hmo ma ama parao tly? Hy Abeipa ei Khazohpa y, kei nata ei chhôhkha chô liata na ku tlao pathla la, potlana he na phopi chô liata rie chareisa khao khah y,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa ta Kâdâ hnohta, Dâvi cha khy sala, Zebu chyhsa Ôranâ sawhri liata Abeipa châta maisâh tao awpa ta Dâvi hnohta chho awpa ta biepie ta.
Kâdâ ta Abeipa moh ta a reipa bie hawhta Dâvi cha khy ta.
Ôranâ cha bâli sâh tly ngâ ta. A kei heih ta, vâlyuhchâpa kei hmô ta, a hnohta a ypa a sawchapaw papalihpazy cha a nyu ei ta.
Dâvi ta Ôranâ kô a kei tlô nahta, Ôranâ cha a vaw heih ta, Dâvi cha hmô ta, sawhri tawhta pua ta, a hmia alei lâ a bôhpa ta Dâvi cha a naoh ta.
Dâvi ta Ôranâ hnohta, “Potlana hri he zawpi tawhta a pai thei nawpa ta, he sawhrihmo he Abeipa châta maisâh ei tao nawpa ta na pie teh; a mâ dopa ei cha pie aw,” tah ta.

Ôranâ ta Dâvi hnohta, “Hnei mah y, ei zibeipa abei ta pha na tahpa hawhta tao mah y. Moh tua, raopa hlânazy châta viahchao tôhpazy cha pie pâ na ta, niepa hlâna châta sawhri chhaichhi thozy nata âtâ sâhzy ei cha pie pâ. A zydua ta ei cha pie khai,” tah ta.
Châhrasala Bei Dâvi ta Ôranâ hnohta, “Châ vei, a mâ dopa ei cha pie aw. Na eih cha Abeipa châta a saipa ta la leipa aw na ta, ei hryuhna rai y leipa ta raopa hlânazy hlâ aw va na,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Dâvi ta sawhrihmo chaleina châta ngôh sekel 600 khopathliah ta, Ôranâ cha pie ta.
Dâvi ta cha liata Abeipa châta maisâh tao ta, raopa hlânazy nata aryhna hlânazy hlâ ta. Abeipa pado ta, Abeipa ta avâ tawhta mei ta a zâ chhy ta, raopa hlâna chô liata mei za tla ta.
Chatawhcha Abeipa ta vâlyuhchâpa cha biepie ta, a zaozi cha a paih liata khô ha ta.
Dâvi ta Zebu chyhsa Ôranâ sawhrihmo liata Abeipa ta â vaw chhypa a hmô nahta, cha liata atheihna hlâ ta.
Cha nona cha, Mawsi ta râhchawhpa liata Abeipa achhyna byureih nata raopa hlâna maisâh a taopazy kha Kibiô khihpi su sâhpa liata y thlâh ha chy ta.
Châhrasala Dâvi cha Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa zaozi a chipa vâta, Khazohpa a saohiah awpa ta, cha su lâ cha sie ngâh vei.
Dâvi ta, “He su liana heta Zehôvâh Khazohpa o y aw ta, he su liana heta Izarei châta raopa hlâna maisâh a y aw,” tah ta.
Dâvi ta Izarei râh liata chihropa a ypazy awpakhy awpa ta biepie ta. Alô a khai thaipazy cha Khazohpa o sa nawpa châta alô khai awpa ta rao ta.
Dâvi ta dôhna chhikaozy khaipâ nawpa nata a patusanazy châta thua hluhpi a chhuanoh ta. Dawh hluhpi a chhuanoh hra ta, â hrina zie pathliah tiah awpa chhao châ vei.
Sidaw mo nata Tyre mo ta Dâvi cha sidy tho hluhpi vaw pie ei ta, chavâta Khazohpa o sa nawpa ta, sidy tho chhao rei tiah lei â chhuanoh.

Dâvi ta, “Ei sawchapawpa Sawlawmaw cha hawtipa châ ta, hmo yzie pahno tu mâh leipa ta, Abeipa châta o sa awpa hra cha, râh zydua liata a pathâhpa o laipa nata rônahpa a châ awpa châ tlôh ta. Chavâta Khazohpa o sa nawpa cha kei ta ei chhuanoh chhielie aw,” tah ta. Chatanachata Khazohpa o sa nawpa chhaichhi zydua cha Dâvi ta a thi hlâta â chhuanoh khai haw.
Chatawhcha Dâvi ta a sawchapawpa Sawlawmaw cha aw ta, Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa o sa awpa ta biepie ta.
Dâvi ta a sawchapawpa Sawlawmaw hnohta, “Ei sawchapawpa y, Abeipa ei Khazohpa moh châta o sa awpa ei palôh liata y ta.

Châhrasala Abeipa bie ei hnohta vaw tlô ta, ‘Nâ la thisaih thata palo chi ta, adyuhna ru ngaitapazy a dyuhpa ta, ei hmiakô liata alei chô liata thisaih thata na palopa vâta, ei moh châta o sa aw va chi.

Pachâ teh, sawchapawpa sa aw chi ta, ano cha adyhna a khohpa a châ aw. A chheipâh râhzy liata a chariah zydua nata a dyryhpa ta paysa aw na ta, apahâna ei pie aw. A moh cha Sawlawmaw châ aw ta, ano daihti liata la, Izarei râh liata thlalôhna nata abohna ei paysa aw.
Ano ta ei moh châta o a sa aw. Ano cha ei sawchapawpa châ aw ta, kei a paw ei châ aw. Â beina beidyuchhai cha Izarei râh liata chhâzaw châta ei padua aw,’ tahpa ta na chho ha ta.
“Chavâta ei sawchapawpa y, Abeipa na hnohta y mawh sy. Thlaochhipa ta y lymâ la, Abeipa ta na kyh a vaw rei chhielie hapa hawhta, hlaotloh kawpa ta Abeipa na Khazohpa o cha sa mah y.
Abeipa ta Izarei chô liata biehneina a cha pie tita, Abeipa na Khazohpa ryhpa na zyh thei nawpa ta, Abeipa ta sona nata novâhna cha pie mawh sy.
Abeipa ta Mawsi hnohta Izarei châta bieraopa nata pachiana a piepazy kha na zyh khiahta cha, thlaochhipa ta na y lymâ aw. Thatlôpa nata riahphapa ta y mah y. Chi leipa la, ngiaroh khah y.

Riethei thata taopa ta, Abeipa o châta ngôh talent thy hrawh nata tâkâ talent thy za kha a chhuanoh ha na ta, dawh nata thua chhao â hrina zie kho pathliah tiah lei ta hluhpa ta ei chhuanoh haw. Tho nata lô chhao ei chhuanoh khai haw. Chazy cha na vaw baichha aw.
Raihriatuhpa hluhpi na hnei. Alô a patlaw thaipazy, alô a khai thaipazy, tho zôthaipazy nata zôthaipa chi nanopazy rei tiah lei na hnei.
Ngôh, tâkâ, dawh nata thua rai a hria thaipazy hluhpi na hnei hra. Thyu la, hria teh! Abeipa na hnohta y mawh sy!” tah ta.
Dâvi ta Izarei chhituhpa zydua cha a sawchapawpa Sawlawmaw bao awpa ta biepie ta, ama hnohta,

“ Abeipa nama Khazohpa nama hnohta y vei ma? Su to liata apahâna cha pi ha veih ei ma? He râh liata a pahrâpazy cha Abeipa ta ei ku liata na pie ta, Abeipa nata a phopi hmiakô liata ama râh cha panawhpa ta a y haw.

Tahmâ nama pachâna nata nama palôh cha Abeipa nama Khazohpa padona lâta pahei u la, thyu u la, Zehôvâh Khazohpa supathaihpa cha sa muh vy. Chatanachata Abeipa Biehrai Byh nata Khazohpa hmobaoh pathaihpazy cha Abeipa moh châta sapa o liata a ngiakheipa a châ aw,” tah ta.
Dâvi cha hroh pareih kaw ta, chhâ â palo nawpa daihti â hnia nahta, a saw­chapawpa Sawlawmaw cha Izarei bei ta tao ta.
Dâvi ta Izarei chhituhpa zydua nata theihthaipazy nata Livai pathlazy awpakhy ta.
Livai pathla kô sythôh tawhta chô lâ maluh reipa châ ei ta, pitlohpa chapaw 38,000 ama châ.
Dâvi ta, “Livai pathla 24,000 zy cha Abeipa o sana liata hyutuhpazy châ aw ei ta, 6,000 Abeipa o liata hyutuhpazy nata ryureituhpazy châ aw ei ta,
4,000 chhikao vaituhpazy châ aw ei ta, 4,000 zy cha reithaina hla sa nawpa ta pyungiapa chhaichhi ei taopazy hmâpa ta Abeipa lâta reithaina hla satuhpazy ama châ aw,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Dâvi ta Livai sawchapawzy, Kesao nata Kôhâ nata Merâri zy cha a py py ta pachhaih ta.
Kesao sawchapawzy cha Lâdâ nata Simei ama châ.
Lâdâ sawchapawzy cha, pawhrâh chaipa Zehie châ ta, a pazipa ta Zethâ nata Zôela châ ei ta, pathôh ama châ.
Simei sawchapawzy cha Selômô, Hâzi nata Harânâ zy châ ei ta, pathôh ama châ. Âmo cha Lâdâ pathla pawhrâhpazy ama châ.
Simei sawchapawzy cha Zahâ, Zinâ, Zeu nata Beriah zy ama châ. Cha papalihzy cha Simei sawchapawzy ama châ.
Zahâ cha pawhrâh chaipa châ ta, Zizah ta a pazi. Zeu nata Beriah deikua cha, sawchapaw hnei hluh veih ei. Chavâta chhôhkha miakhapa hawhta reipa ama châ.
Kôhâ sawchapawzy cha Amrâ, Iza, Hebraw nata Uzie zy châ ei ta, papalih ama châ.

Amrâ sawchapawzy cha Arawna nata Mawsi ama châ. Arawna cha hmo pathaihpazy hria awpa ta pananopa châ ta, ano nata a pathlazy cha ropahâhpazy Abeipa hmiakô liata a rao tyh awpazy châ ei ta, Abeipa chakaopa ta, a moh ta byhnâ a aw tyh awpazy ama châ.
Khazohpa chyhsa Mawsi sawchapawzy chhao Livai chi hry liata pahlaopa ama châ.
Mawsi sawchapawzy cha Kesao nata Elieze ama châ.
Kesao­ sawchapawzy hry liata uhthei chaipa cha Sebua a châ.
Elieze sawchapaw uhtheipa cha Rehabiah a châ. Elieze cha sawchapaw hropa hnei leipa ta, Rehabiah deikua cha sawchapaw hluhpi a hnei.
Izah sawchapawzy hry liata pawhrâh chaipa cha Selômi a châ.
Hebraw sawchapawzy liata pawhrâh chaipa cha Zeriah châ ta, panona Amaria, pathôhna Zahâzie nata papalihna Zekamia zy ama châ.
Uzie sawchapawzy hry liata pawhrâh chaipa cha Mikâ châ ta, panona Isiah a châ.
Merâri sawchapawzy cha Mâhli nata Musi ama châ. Mâhli sawchapawzy cha Eliaza nata Kisâ ama châ.
Eliaza cha sawchapaw hnei leipa ta, sawchanôzy deita hneipa ta thi ha ta. A sawchanôzy cha ama chiheihpa Kisâ sawchapawzy ta lapinô ta ama hnei.
Musi sawchapawzy cha Mâhli, Ede nata Zeremô zy châ ei ta, pathôh ama châ.
Âmo cha a chhôh chhôh ta pawhrâhpazy tawhta a laichadaipa Livai pathlazy châ ei ta, kô kih tawhta chô lâ, Abeipa o liata chakaona rai a hria thei awpazy ama châ.
Dâvi ta, “ Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa ta a chyhsazy apahâna pie ta, Zerusale liata chhâzaw ta a pahrâ hapa vâta,
Livai pathlazy ta achhyna byureih nata a chakaona raihria nawpa hmobaoh kheihawhpa hmahta amâ sy awpa byuh khao vei,” tah ta.
Dâvi biepiepa hnôhchaipa hawhta, kô kih tawhta chô lâ Livai pathla maluh cha reipa a châ.

Ama maophaohna cha Abeipa o chakaona raihria liata Arawna sawchapawzy bao awpa châ ta, tlyhmiazy nata chhôhpadâhpazy mohôh ei ta, hmo pathaihpa zydua pasi tyh ei ta, Khazohpa o liata chakaona rai hropazy ama hria tyh.

Tlâhkhai liata viahchhâ chaluah awpa patohpatiana kyh liata zy, niepa hlâna viahdie patohpatiana kyh liata zy, viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa châta viahchhâ papa patohpatiana kyh liata zy, viahchhâ pakâhpa hlâ awpa patohpatiana kyh liata zy, sathaw pahlaopa hmohlâpa patohpatiana kyh liata zy, a hluhna nata a laina panuana kyh zy liata chhao, Arawna pathlazy baotuhpa ama châ.
My chareih ta a duah ei ta, Abeipa lâ alyna bie reipa ta ano reithai ei ta, zâlâ chhao cha hawhta ama tao tyh.
Pahânohzy, thla thiehpazy nata kyhchhi noh hropazy liata raopa hlânazy hlâ tita, baotuh awpa raopa zie lymâ hawhta, Abeipa hmiakô liata khâ amâ duah tyh.
Ahmaohna poh o nata su pathaihpa mohôhna kyh liata chhao maophaohna piepa châ ei ta, Abeipa o chakaona raihria liata Arawna sawchapawzy nata ama unawhzy ama bao tyh.
Arawna pathlazy cha he hawhta a py py ta pachhaihpa ama châ. Arawna sawchapawzy cha Nâdâ, Abihu, Eliaza nata Ithamâ zy châ ei ta,
Nâdâ nata Abihu cha ama paw thi hlâta thi ha ei ta, saw hnei veih ei. Chavâta Eliaza nata Ithamâ ta theihthaipa rai cha ama hria.
Dâvi ta theihthaipazy cha ama maophaohna chyu hria awpa ta, a py py ta pachhaih ta, Eliaza pathla Zadô nata Ithamâ pathla Ahimele ta Dâvi cha ama bao.

Ithamâ pathlazy lia hlâta Eliaza pathlazy liata pawhrâhpazy ama hluh viapa vâta, Eliaza pathlazy cha a chhôh chhôh ta pachhaihpa ta, pawhrâhpa pahrawh hleicharu raopa châ ei ta, Ithamâ pathlazy tawhta pacharie raopa ama châ.

Eliaza pathlazy nata Ithamâ pathlazy liata hyutuhpazy cha, hyutuhpa pathaihpa nata Khazohpa hyutuhpazy ama châ khaipa vâta, ama chakaona rai hria awpazy cha, nuby a daopa ta, â lyupa ta pachhaihpa a châ.

Ama raihria awpa nata ama mohzy cha, Livai pathla chârohtuhpa Nethane sawchapawpa Semiah ta bei nata hyutuhpazy, theihthaipa Zadô, Abiathâ sawchapawpa Ahimele, theihthaipa chhôhkha pawhrâhpazy nata Livai pathla pawhrâhpazy mohmô liata ama moh roh ta, Eliaza nata Ithamâ châta chhôhkha miakha chyu a tlyhpa a châ.
Nuby miakhana cha Zehôiari chô liata tlu ta, mianona Zediah,
miathôhna Hâri, miapalihna Seôri,
miapangawhna Mâkia, miacharuna Mizami,
miasarina Hâkô, miachariena Abiza,
miachakina Zesua, miahrawhna Sekaniah,
hleikhana Eliasi, hleinona Zaki,
hleithôhna Hupâ, hleipalihna Zesebia,
hleipangawhna Bilkâ, hleicharuna Ime,
hleisarina Hezi, hleichariena Hâpize,
hleichakina Pethâhiah, miakihna Zeheke,
miakih nata miakhana Zaki, miakih nata mianona Kamu,
miakih nata miathôhna Delia nata miakih nata miapalihna Mâzai zy ama châ.
Âmo cha Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa ta ama pathlatuhpa Arawna hnohta bie a piepa hawhta, ama nuby lymâ hawhta Abeipa o chhôh liata chakaona rai hria awpa ta raopa ama châ.
Hezy he Livai pathla pawhrâh hropazy ama châ: Amrâ sawchapawzy hry tawhta Subia cha pawhrâhpa châ ta, Subia sawchapawzy hry tawhta Zediah cha pawhrâhpa a châ.
Rehabiah pho liata, Rehabiah sawchapawpa Isiah cha pawhrâh chaipa a châ.
Izah pho liata Selômô cha pawhrâh chaipa châ ta, Selômô sawchapawzy hry liata Zahâ cha pawhrâh chaipa a châ.
Hebraw sawchapawzy hry liata Zeriah cha pawhrâh chaipa châ ta, panona Amaria, pathôhna Zahâzie nata papalihna Zekamia zy ama châ.
Uzie sawchapawzy hry liata Mikâ cha pawhrâh chaipa châ ta, Mikâ sawchapawzy hry liata Sâmi cha pawhrâh chaipa a châ.
Mikâ unawhpa cha Isiah châ ta, Isiah sawchapawzy hry liata pawhrâh chaipa cha Zekaria a châ.
Merâri sawchapawzy cha Mâhli nata Musi ama châ. Zaziah sawchapawzy hry liata pawhrâh chaipa cha Benô a châ.
Merâri pathla pawhrâh chaipazy cha Zaziah pho tawhta Benô, Sôhâ, Zaku nata Ibari zy châ ei ta,
Mâhli pho tawhta Eliaza châ ta, ano cha sawchapaw hnei vei.
Kisâ pho liata pawhrâh chaipa cha Kisâ sawchapawpa Zerame a châ.
Musi sawchapawzy cha Mâhli, Ede nata Zerimô zy ama châ. Âmo cha a pho pho ta a laichadaipa ta Livai pathla pawhrâhpazy ama châ.

Âmo chhao cha ama unawhpa Arawna sawchapawzy hawhna khata, Bei Dâvi, Zadô, Ahimele, theihthaipazy nata Livai pathla chhôhkha pawhrâhpazy mohmô liata nuby a dao hra ei ta, chhôhkha pawhrâh chaipa nata a unawh seihnai viapazy chhao, â lyupa ta nuby amâ dao khai.
Dâvi nata pheisaih hyutuhpazy ta Asâpha, Hemâ nata Zeduthu pathlazy cha totâzy, tlaipihzy, paotlâzy tô ta, hrohsona hlazy sa awpa ta panano ei ta. Hezy he pyungiapa chakaona rai a hriapazy ama châ:
Asâpha sawchapawzy tawhta Zaku, Zawsi, Nethaniah nata Asrelâh zy raopa châ ei ta, âmo cha abei biepiepa hawhta hrohsona hla a satuhpa ama paw Asâpha ta a chhihtha ei.

Zeduthu pho tawhta pacharu raopa châ ei ta, chazy cha Zeduthu sawchapawpa Kedaliah, Zeri, Zesai, Simei, Hâsabiah nata Mâtithiah zy ama châ. Âmo cha totâ tôpa ta Abeipa lâta alyna bie a reihpa nata reithaina hla a sapa ama paw Zeduthu ta a chhihtha ei.
Hemâ pho tawhta Hemâ sawchapaw­pa Bukiah, Mâtaniah, Uzie, Sebua, Zerimô, Hânaniah, Hânani, Eliathâh, Kidâti, Rômatize, Zôbekasâ, Mâlôthi, Hôthi nata Mâhaziô zy raopa ama châ.
Ama zydua heta abei hrohsopa Hemâ sawchapawzy châ ei ta, Khazohpa ta Hemâ cha sawchapaw pahrawh hleipalih nata sawchanô pathôh pie ta, âmo cha a bietai hawhta Khazohpa a cheihchalo awpazy ama châ.

Ama zydua ta Khazohpa o liata chakaona rai châta paotlâzy, tlaipihzy totâzy tôpa ta, ama paw chhihthana ry liata Abeipa o liata pyungiapa lâchhâh chakaona rai hriatuhpazy ama châ. Asâpha, Zeduthu nata Hemâ zy cha abei biepiepa ry liata a ypa ama châ.
Ama maluh cha, Abeipa hla sa awpa ta pachupa, hlasathaipa ama unawhzy chhaota 288 ama châ.
Chatanachata a lai a chyh, pachutuhpa nata achupa, ama zydua ta â lyupa ta ama tao awpa nuby amâ dao lymâ.

Nuby miakhana cha Asâpha sawchapawpa Zawsi nata a unawhzy nata a sawchapawzy chô liata tlu ta, pahrawh hleino ama châ. Mianona cha Kedaliah nata a unawhzy nata a sawchapawzy chô liata tlu ta, pahrawh hleino ama châ.
Miathôhna cha Zaku nata a sawchapawzy nata a unawhzy chô liata tlu ta, pahrawh hleino ama châ.
Miapalihna cha Izri nata a sawchapawzy nata a unawhzy chô liata tlu ta, pahrawh hleino ama châ.
Miapangawhna cha Nethaniah nata a sawchapawzy nata a unawhzy chô liata tlu ta, pahrawh hleino ama châ.
Miacharuna cha Bukiah nata a sawchapawzy nata a unawhzy chô liata tlu ta, pahrawh hleino ama châ.
Miasarina cha Zesarelâh nata a sawchapawzy nata a unawhzy chô liata tlu ta, pahrawh hleino ama châ.
Miachariena cha Zesai nata a sawchapawzy nata a unawhzy chô liata tlu ta, pahrawh hleino ama châ.
Miachakina cha Mâtaniah nata a sawchapawzy nata a unawhzy chô liata tlu ta, pahrawh hleino ama châ.
Miahrawhna cha Simei nata a sawchapawzy nata a unawhzy chô liata tlu ta, pahrawh hleino ama châ.
Hleikhana cha Azare nata a sawchapawzy nata a unawhzy chô liata tlu ta, pahrawh hleino ama châ.
Hleinona cha Hâsabiah nata a sawchapawzy nata a unawhzy chô liata tlu ta, pahrawh hleino ama châ.
Hleithôhna Subia nata a sawchapawzy nata a unawhzy chô liata tlu ta, pahrawh hleino ama châ.
Hleipalihna cha Mâtithiah nata a sawchapawzy nata a unawhzy chô liata tlu ta, pahrawh hleino ama châ.
Hleipangawhna cha Zeremô nata a sawchapawzy nata a unawhzy chô liata tlu ta, pahrawh hleino ama châ.
Hleicharuna cha Hânaniah nata a sawchapawzy nata a unawhzy chô liata tlu ta, pahrawh hleino ama châ.
Hleisarina cha Zôsbekâsâh nata a sawchapawzy nata a unawhzy chô liata tlu ta, pahrawh hleino ama châ.
Hleichariena cha Hânani nata a sawchapawzy nata a unawhzy chô liata tlu ta, pahrawh hleino ama châ.
Hleichakina cha Mâlôthi nata a sawchapawzy nata a unawhzy chô liata tlu ta, pahrawh hleino ama châ.
Miakihna cha Eliathâh nata a sawchapawzy nata a unawhzy chô liata tlu ta, pahrawh hleino ama châ.
Miakih nata miakhana cha Hôthi nata a sawchapawzy nata a unawhzy chô liata tlu ta, pahrawh hleino ama châ.
Miakih nata mianona cha Kidâti nata a sawchapawzy nata a unawhzy chô liata tlu ta, pahrawh hleino a châ.
Miakih nata miathôhna cha Mâhaziô nata a sawchapawzy nata a unawhzy chô liata tlu ta, pahrawh hleino ama châ.
Miakih nata miapalihna cha Rômatize nata a sawchapawzy nata a unawhzy chô liata tlu ta, pahrawh hleino ama châ.
Hezy he chhikao vaituhpa ta raopazy ama châ: Kôrâ pathla tawhta Asâpha sawchapawzy hry liata Kôre sawchapawpa Meselemiah raopa a châ.
Meselemiah ta sawchapawzy hnei ta. A sawchapaw uhtheipa cha Zekaria châ ta, panona Zedia, pathôhna Zebadiah, papalihna Zathânie,
papangawhna Elâmi, pacharuna Zehôhanâ nata pasarina Eliehônai zy ama châ.
Ôbededô cha Khazohpa ta byhnâ pie ta, sawchapawzy sa ta, a sawchapaw uhtheipa cha Semiah châ ta, panona Zehôzabâ, pathôhna Zôah, papalihna Sâkhâ, papangawhna Nethane,
pacharuna Amie, pasarina Iskâra nata pachariena Pulethai zy ama châ.
A sawchapawpa Semiah chhao sawchapawzy hnei ta, âmo cha ama pho pawhrâhpazy châ ei ta, chyhsa thatlôpazy ama châ.
Semiah sawchapawzy cha Ôthani, Repha, Ôbedâ nata Elzabâ zy châ ei ta, ama unawhpa Elihu nata Semakiah zy cha chyhsa thatlôpazy ama châ.

Ama zydua ta Ôbededô pathlazy châ ei ta, âmo nata ama sawchapawzy nata ama unawhzy cha chakaona rai a hria theipa chyhsa thatlôpazy ama châ. Ôbededô pathlazy cha ama zydua ta maluh sycharu nata pano ama châ.
Meselemiah ta sawchapaw nata unawh pahrawh hleicharie hnei ta, âmo cha chyhsa thatlôpazy ama châ.
Merâri pathlazy hry liata Hôsâ chhao sawchapawzy hnei ta, Simri cha pawhrâh chaipa a châ. Ano cha sawchapaw uhtheipa a châ lei tarawpa ta, a paw ta pawhrâh chaipa ta a rao.
Hôsâ sawchapaw panona cha Hikia châ ta, pathôhna Tebaliah châ ta, papalihna cha Zekaria a châ. Hôsâ sawchapawzy nata a unawhzy cha ama zydua ta pahrawh hleithôh ama châ.
Chhikao vaituhpa pyzy cha, ama unawhzy taozie hawhta, ama pawhrâhpazy moh zipa ta, Abeipa o liata chakaona raihria châta maophaohna raipa ama châ.
A lai a chyh â lyu khaipa ta, ama chhikao vai awpa chyu cha a chhôh chhôh ta nuby a dao ei ta.
Nochhi chhikao a vaih awpa nuby cha Selemiah chô liata tlu ta. A sawchapawpa Zekariah, ryhraotuhpa so ngaitapa châta chhao, nuby a daopa châ ta, ano vai awpa cha maw chhikao a châ.
Ôbededô vai awpa cha chho chhikao châ ta, a sawchapawzy cha hmo sopakhyna o vaih awpa ta maophaohna piepa ama châ.
Notla chhikao a vaih awpa nuby cha Supi nata Hôsâ chô liata tlu ta, lâpi chakhâpa liata Salekhe chhikao a vaih awpazy ama châ.

Nochhi chhikao cha noh chareih ta pacharu ta vaih ei ta, maw chhikao cha noh chareih papalih ta vaih ei ta, chho chhikao chhao noh chareih papalih ta vaih hra ei ta, hmo sopakhyna o vaituhpa châta pano lymâ ta raopa ama châ.
Notla lâta dôhpachhôh tlyhmia vaituhpa châta lâpi liata papalih sopa châ ta, dôhpachhôh tlyhmia liata pano sopa a châ.
Âmo cha Kôrâ nata Merâri pathlazy tawhta chhikao vaituhpa py pachhaihpazy ama châ.
Livai pathla Ahiza cha Khazohpa sôh sopakhyna o nata hmo pathaihpa sopakhyna o vaituhpa a châ.
Kesao sawchapawzy cha Lâdâ pathlazy châ ei ta, Lâdâ pathla Kesao pho pawhrâhpa cha Zehieli a châ.
Zehieli sawchapawzy cha Zethâ nata a unawhpa Zôela châ ei ta, âmo cha Abeipa o liata sôh sopakhynazy a vaotuhpa ama châ.
Amrâ pathla tawhta Izah pathlazy, Hebraw pathlazy nata Uzie pathlazy chhao Abeipa sôh mohôhtuhpazy ama châ hra.
Mawsi sawchapawpa Kesao sawchapawpa Sebua cha sôh sopakhyna avaotuhpa hyutuh chaipa a châ.
A unawhzy cha Elieze sawchapawpa Rehabiah, Rehabiah saw­chapawpa Zesai, Zesai sawchapawpa Zôrâ, Zôrâ sawchapawpa Zikari nata Zikari sawchapawpa Selômô zy ama châ.

Selômô nata a unawhzy cha Bei Dâvi, pho pawhrâhpazy, pheisaih sâh kha hyutuhpazy, pheisaih za kha hyutuhpazy nata pheisaih hyutuh chaipazy ta ama hlâpa, hmohlâpa pathaihpa sopakhyna zydua avaotuhpa ama châ.
Âmo cha adyuhna liata hraona sôh hmôpa, Abeipa o mohôhna nata taopathina châta ama hlâpa a vaotuhpazy ama châ.

Hrohsopa Samuela, Kisâ sawchapawpa Sawla, Nerâ sawchapawpa Abane nata Zeru sawchapawpa Zôabâ zy ta ama hlâpa hmo pathaihpazy a vaotuhpa châ ei ta, hmohlâpa pathaihpa zydua cha Selômô nata a unawhzy mohôhna ry liata sopa a châ.
Izah pathlazy tawhta Khenaniah nata a sawchapawzy cha, Achhyna o raihriazy piepa châ leipa ei ta, Izarei râh chakaona rai hria awpa ta hyutuhpa nata ryureituhpazy ta raopa ama châ.
Hebraw pathlazy tawhta Hâsabiah nata a unawhzy, chyhsa thatlôpa 1,700 zy cha, Zawdâh notla lâta Abeipa raihria zydua nata abei chakaona raihria kyh liata Izarei sawzy a vaotuhpa ama châ.

Hebraw pathla chhâzy a laichadaina liata, Zeriza cha Hebraw pathlazy hry liata pawhrâh chaipa a châ. Dâvi abeina kô sypalihna kô ta Hebraw pathlazy cha tluapa châ ei ta, Kilia râh liata Zaze khihpi liata Hebraw pathla thatlô riahphapazy hmôpa ama châ.

Bei Dâvi ta Zeriza nata a unawh 2,700 zy cha hyutuhpazy ta rao ta. Âmo cha chyhsa thatlôpa nata ama pho pawhrâhpazy châ ei ta, Khazohpa nata a zaopa hmo to nata abei raihria kyh zy liata Rubena chi, Kâdâ chi nata Manase chi khophie hyutuhpa châta raopazy ama châ.

Hezy he Izarei pho pawhrâhpazy, pheisaih sâh kha hyutuhpazy, pheisaih za kha hyutuhpazy nata ama ry liata hyutuhpazy ama châ. Âmo cha kyh to liata bei chakao ta, kô chhôh zydua ta thla chareih ta a thla lymâ awpazy châ ei ta, py kha liata maluh 24,000 lymâ ama y.
Zabadie sawchapawpa Zasôbia cha thla khana liata a chakao awpa py khana pheisaih hyutuhpa châ ta, a py liata pheisaih 24,000 ama y.
Ano cha Pereza pathla châ ta, pheisaih hyutuhpa zydua hyutuhpa a châ. Thla khana liata a chakao tyh.
Ahôh chyhsa Dôdai cha thla nona liata a chakaopazy pheisaih hyutuhpa châ ta, a py liata pheisaih 24,000 ama y.
Thla thôhna châta pheisaih hyutuhpa pathôhna cha, Zehôdâ sawchapawpa Benai châ ta, a py liata pheisaih 24,000 ama y.
Benai he pasaipha sythôh hry liata a hlaopa kha châ ta, pasaipha sythôhzy hyutuhpa a châ. A sawchapawpa Amizabâ cha ano py liata pheisaih hyutuhpa a châ.
Thla palihna châta pheisaih hyutuhpa papalihna cha, Zôabâ unawhpa Asahe châ ta, a sawchapawpa Zebadiah cha ano a pazipa châ ta, a py liata pheisaih 24,000 ama y.
Thla pangawhna châta pheisaih hyutuhpa papangawhna cha, Izrâ chyhsa Sâmahu châ ta, a py liata pheisaih 24,000 ama y.
Thla charuna châta pheisaih hyutuhpa pacharuna cha, Tekô chyhsa Ike sawchapawpa Irâ châ ta, a py liata pheisaih 24,000 ama y.
Thla sarina châta pheisaih hyutuhpa pasarina cha, Epharai pathla Pelôni chyhsa Helezi châ ta, a py liata pheisaih 24,000 ama y.
Thla chariena châta pheisaih hyutuhpa pachariena cha, Zerâ pathla Husâ chyhsa Sibekai châ ta, a py liata pheisaih 24,000 ama y.
Thla chakina châta pheisaih hyutuhpa pachakina cha, Benzami pathla Anathô chyhsa Abieze châ ta, a py liata pheisaih 24,000 ama y.
Thla hrawhna châta pheisaih hyutuhpa pahrawhna cha, Zerâ pathla Netôpha chyhsa Mâharai châ ta, a py liata pheisaih 24,000 ama y.
Thla hrawh hleikhana châta pheisaih hyutuhpa pahrawh hleikhana cha, Epharai pathla Pirathô chyhsa Benai châ ta, a py liata pheisaih 24,000 ama y.
Thla hrawh hleinona châta pheisaih hyutuhpa pahrawh hleinona cha, Ôthane pathla Netôpha chyhsa Hedai châ ta, a py liata pheisaih 24,000 ama y.
Hezy he Izarei chizy hyutuhpazy ama châ: Rubena chi hyutuhpa cha Zikari sawchapawpa Elieze châ ta, Simeôna chi hyutuhpa cha Mâkâ sawchapawpa Sephatiah a châ.
Livai chi hyutuhpa cha Kemua sawchapawpa Hâsabiah châ ta, Arawna pathlazy hyutuhpa cha Zadô a châ.
Zudâh chi hyutuhpa cha Dâvi unawhpa Elihu châ ta, Iskâra chi hyutuhpa cha Mikaila sawchapawpa Ômri a châ.
Zebulawna chi hyutuhpa cha Ôbadia sawcha­pawpa Ismiah châ ta, Nâthalai chi hyutuhpa cha Azarie sawchapawpa Zeremô a châ.
Epharai chi hyutuhpa cha Azaziah sawchapawpa Zôela châ ta,
Kilia râh liata Manase chi khophiezy hyutuhpa cha Zekaria sawchapawpa Idô a châ. Benzami chi hyutuhpa cha Abane sawchapaw­pa Zasie châ ta,
Dânâ chi hyutuhpa cha Zerôhâ sawchapawpa Azare a châ. Âmo cha Izarei chizy liata hyutuhpazy ama châ.
Abeipa ta Izarei sawzy cha avâ awhsi zie ta pôh awpa ta bie â vaw taih hapa vâta, kô kih ry lâ cha Dâvi ta ama maluh reih vei.

Zeru sawchapawpa Zôabâ ta maluhpi reih ta, châhrasala patlô vei. Maluhpi reipa vâta Khazohpa pathiiana Izarei chô liata a vaw tlôpa vâna khata, maluh ziepa cha Bei Dâvi thâtih rona châbu liata ropa châ vei.
Abei sôh mohôhtuhpa cha Adie sawchapawpa Azamâve châ ta, lyuzy, khihpizy, khitawzy nata o sâhpazy liata abei sôh mohôhtuhpa cha Uzia sawchapawpa Zawnathâ a châ.
Lyu liata leipalie raihriatuhpazy mohôhtuhpa cha Kheluh sawchapawpa Ezri châ ta,
kre sadô mohôhtuhpa cha Râmâ chyhsa Simei châ ta, kre sadô liata kre saohpa sopakhyna môhôhtuhpa cha Siphami chyhsa Zabidi a châ.
Bypi kao liata ôli tho nata theiku kô zy mohôhtuhpa cha Kede chyhsa Bâlâhanâ châ ta, sathaw sopakhyna mohôhtuhpa cha Zôasâ a châ.
Saraw si panyupa su liata sahroh zaw mohôhtuhpa cha Saraw chyhsa Sitai châ ta, saikao liata sahroh zaw mohôhtuhpa cha Adalai sawchapawpa Saphâta a châ.
Râraoseihpazy mohôhtuhpa cha Ismela chyhsa Ôbi châ ta, alâzy mohôhtuhpa cha Merônô chyhsa Zediah a châ.
Mietaku zaw mohôhtuhpa cha Hâkari chyhsa Zazi a châ. Cha zydua cha Bei Dâvi hmohneipa mohôhtuhpazy ama châ.
Dâvi puhpa Zawnathâ cha chyhsa sopa nata châthaipa a châpa vâta, ryhraokheituhpa a châ. Ano nata Hâkamôni sawchapawpa Zehie cha abei sawchapawzy pachutuhpa ama châ.
Ahitôphe cha abei ryhraokheituhpa châ ta, Arakhi chyhsa Husai cha abei viasa a châ.
Ahitôphe cha Benai sawchapawpa Zehôdâ ta a thla ta, Zehôdâ cha Abiathâ ta â thla. Zôabâ cha abei pheisaihzy hyutuh chaipa a châ.

Dâvi ta Izarei hyutuhpa zydua, chi hyutuhpazy, bei chakaotuhpa py hyutuhpazy, pheisaih sâh kha hyutuhpazy, pheisaih za kha hyutuhpazy, bei nata a sawchapawzy hmohneipa nata sahroh mohôhtuhpa zydua, pasaiphazy nata a dyuh thaipa pheisaih zydua Zerusale liata awpakhy ta.

Bei Dâvi cha a kaw duah ta, ama hnohta, “Ei unawhzy nata ei chiheihzy saih u, ei bie nathlie teh u. Abeipa Biehrai Byh a pahâ nawpa nata eima Khazohpa phei tlyna châta o sapa awpa ei palôh liata y ta, sana awpa chhao ei pachhuahpanoh haw.
Châhrasala Khazohpa ta ei hnohta, ‘Nâ la adyuhpa chyhsa, thisaih a palopa na châpa vâta, ei moh châta o sa aw va chi,’ na tah ha ta.

Chatahrasala Abeipa Izarei Khazohpa ta, kei he Izarei bei ta chhâzaw ta y awpa ta, ei paw chhôhkha zydua hry tawhta nâ tlyh ta. Zudâh cha chhituhpa châta a tlyh ta, Zudâh chi tawhta ei paw chhôhkha a tlyh ta, ei paw sawchapawzy hry tawhta kei cha Izarei zydua chô liata bei châ awpa ta a ly kawpa ta nâ tlyh ta.
Abeipa ta sawchapaw hluhpi na pie ta, ei sawchapawpa Sawlawmaw cha Abeipa khinarâh beidyuchhai liata a tyuh ta, Izarei chô liata ryureih awpa ta a tlyh ta.
Abeipa ta ei hnohta, ‘Ei o nata ei tlyhmiazy cha na sawchapawpa Sawlawmaw ta a padua aw. Ano cha ei sawchapaw châta a tlyh na ta, kei a paw ei châ aw.
Ei biepiepazy nata ei pachianazy pachyu kawpa ta a zyh lymâ khiahta cha, tanoh ta a duahmo hawhna heta, chhâzaw châta a khinarâh ei pa-i aw,’ tah ta.

Chavâta tahmâ Abeipa phopi Izarei saw zydua mohmô liata nata eima Khazohpa theina liana heta, Abeipa nama Khazohpa biepiepa zydua he zyh ta, pachâ awpa ta ei cha pasyu ei. Chatanachata he râh phapa he hnei aw ei chi ta, châ vaw pazi awpa nama pathlazy ta chhâzaw ta ama hnei awpa ryuto râh châta nama paryu pachhuah lymâ aw.

“Nâ, Sawlawmaw, ei sawchapawpa y, na paw Khazohpa he pahno la, pathipalôh tlokhuh ta nata tao khona palôh hneipa ta ano cha chakao mah y. Abeipa cha palôh zydua mohtuhpa châ ta, achhuahna nata pachâna zydua pahnotuhpa a châ. Ano cha na tlua khiahta cha, hmô awh chi ta, nâ heihsai khiah deikua cha, chhâzaw ta a cha thy aw.
A chado kaw mah y. Supathaihpa châta o sa awpa ta, Abeipa ta a cha rao. Thatlôpa ta y la, hria mah y,” tah ta.

Chatanachata Dâvi ta a sawchapawpa Sawlawmaw cha Achhyna o aikah, a ozy, sôh sopakhynazy, o chô chhôhpadâhpazy, o chhôh chhôhpadâhpazy nata zawngiahna dyuchhai chhôhpadâhpa sa nawpa ta a pachhuapanohziezy pie ta.
Abeipa o dôhpachhôh tlyhmia, tlyhmia a chadôpa chhôhpadâhpa zydua, Khazohpa o sôh sopakhynazy nata hmohlâpa pathaihpa sopakhynazy châta a pachhuapanohnazy chhao pie ta.

Dâvi ta Sawlawmaw cha theihthaipazy nata Livai pathlazy a py py ta pachhaihzie nata Abeipa o liata chakaona rai zydua hria nawpazie chho ta. Abeipa o liata chakaona rai hria nawpa hmobaoh kyh zydua chhao chho ta.
Chakaona chi nanopazy châta ngôh hmobaoh taona liata ngôh hmâ awpa zie zy, tâkâ hmobaoh taona liata tâkâ hmâ awpa zie zy,

ngôh meiôh patyunazy nata meiôhzy taona châta ngôh hmâ awpa zie zy, meiôh patyuna miakha nata meiôh miakha châta ngôh hmâ awpa zie zy, tâkâ meiôh patyuna miakha nata a meiôhzy châta tâkâ hmâ awpa zie zy cha, chakaona châta meiôh patyuna tao nawpa ta hmâ byuhpa zie lymâ hawhta a chho khai.
Viahchhâ chaluahpa tlâhkhai miakha châta ngôh hmâ awpa zie nata tâkâ tlâhkhaizy châta tâkâ hmâ awpa zie zy;

sa thaonazy, rahôzy nata nyuzy tao nawpa ta ngôh suapa hmâ awpa zie zy; ngôh biebuhzy tao nawpa ta biebuh miakha liata ngôh hmâ awpa zie zy, tâkâ biebuhzy tao nawpa ta biebuh miakha liata tâkâ hmâ awpa zie nata

ngôh suapa ta taopa ropahâhpa raona maisâh châta ngôh hmâ awpa zie zy chho ta. Ngôh cherubi talailih, ama mathlaw pakaipa ta Abeipa Biehrai Byh a khupa tao nawpa châta â chhuanohnazy chhao a chho hra.
Dâvi ta, “He zydua he, Abeipa ta ano ku tlai ta a ropa na pie ta, â chhuahna nata a taozie awpa zydua eina pahnosapa a châ,” tah ta.

Chatawhcha Dâvi ta a sawchapawpa Sawlawmaw hnohta, “Thatlôpa nata riahphapa ta y la, hria mah y. Chi leipa la, a ngiaroh khah y, Zehôvâh Khazohpa, ei Khazohpa tlai cha na hnohta a y mâh tâh. Abeipa o raihria zydua patlô khaipa a châ hlâlei, cha siesai leipa aw ta, cha pathlua aw vei.

Pachâ teh, Kha­zohpa o liata chakaona raihria zydua hria awpa ta theihthaipa nata Livai pyzy y ei ta, rai zydua liata palôh tlâh kawpa ta cha bao awpa ta, kao to liata a saomâpazy na hnohta ama y. Hyutuhpazy nata zawpi zydua chhao, na biehneina ry liata tlokhuh ama y khai aw,” tah ta.

Chatawhcha Bei Dâvi ta zawpi ahmaohpakhypa zydua hnohta, “Ei sawchapawpa Sawlawmaw he, ano deita he Khazohpa ta â tlyhpa châ ta, châhrasala hawtipa a châ chypa vâta hmo pahno tu mâh vei. O rônahpa sa awpa cha chyhsapa châta châ leipa ta, Zehôvâh Khazohpa châta a châpa vâta rai lai ngaitapa châ ta.

Chavâta ei tao theipa rakha liata cha, ei Khazohpa o châta ei pachhuahpanoh chhielie khai haw. Ngôh hmozy châta ngôh, tâkâ hmozy châta tâkâ, dawh hmozy châta dawh, thua hmozy châta thua, tho hmozy châta tho zy ei pachhuahpanoh khai haw. Chazy hleikhô ta, a pangia nawpa ta lôsôhpa cheihchapaipazy, thua rôh ngiapazy, alô rôh chi nanopazy, lôsôhpa to nata awlôteihpa zy chhao a hluhpi ei pachhuapanoh haw.
Cha dei châ vei, o pathaihpa châta ei pachhuapanohpazy hleikhô ta, keima ngôh nata tâkâ zy chhao ei pie pâ hra. Ei Khazohpa o he ei pachâ peimawh ngaitapa vâta, ei Khazohpa o châta ei piepa a châ.
Ôphi ngôh talent 3,000 nata tâkâ talent 7,000 cha o pâhchhôzy pahu nawpa ta pie na ta,
zôthaipazy ta ngôh nata tâkâ ta tao awpa hmo zydua ama tao nawpa châta keima sôh tawhta ei pie. Tanoh he ahy ma Abeipa châta ano kho tlai ta a pie hra aw?” tah ta.
Chatanachata chhôhkha pawhrâhpazy, Izarei chi hyutuhpazy, pheisaih sâh kha hyutuhpazy, pheisaih za kha hyutuhpazy nata abei raihria liata hyutuhpazy chhao ta âmo lôhthai ta pie chyu ei ta.
Khazohpa o sa nawpa ta ama piepa a tlohpakhypa cha ngôh talent 5,000 nata dari 10,000, tâkâ talent 10,000, dawh talent 18,000, thua talent 100,000 a châ.
Lôsôhpa a hneipazy chhao ta, Abeipa o sôh châta thyu ei ta, chazy cha Kesao pathla Zehie ta a mohôh.
Âmo khopasana tlai ta ama piepa a châpa vâta zawpizy cha amâ ly ngaita. Pathipalôh tlokhuh ta Khazohpa lâ âmo lôhthai ta ama piepa a châ. Bei Dâvi chhao â ly ngaita.
Chavâta Dâvi cha zawpi zydua hmia­kô liata Abeipa reithai ta. “Hy Abeipa, miah pathlatuhpa Izarei Khazohpa y, chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta reithaipa ta y mah y.

Hy Abeipa y, rônahna zy, hmotaotheina zy, palyupalihna zy, pahniena zy, abeina zy na eih châ ta, avâzy nata alei liata a ypa zydua chhao na eih a châ. Hy Abeipa, khinarâh cha na eih châ ta, ato chô lâta a to luh châta cheihchalopa na châ.

Hneirôna nata palyupalihnazy cha nâ tawhta a vypa châ ta, ato chô liata ryureituhpa na châ. Hmotaotheina nata thatlôna na ku liata y ta, chyhsa to parônahsa theina nata tha­tlôna pie theina chhao na ku liata a y.
Chavâta eima Khazohpa y, tahmâ alyna bie cha hlâ pi ta, na moh rônahpa eima reithai.

“Ahy ma châ na ta, ei chiheihzy chhao he ahyzy ma châ ei ta, he hawhta keimo kho tlai ta hmopiepazy eima vaw hlâ thei tly? Hmo to nâ tawhta eima hmôpa châ ta, na eih eima cha pie lilaw heihpa dei a châ.
Miah pathlatuhpazy hawhna khata, keimo cha na hmiakô liata khichhaipa nata khitlyhpa hawh dei châ pi ta, alei liata eima hro nohzy he nohpahlipa hawh dei châ ta, hnabeiseih awpa rai y vei.
Hy Abeipa eima Khazohpa y, na moh pathaihpa y nawpa o eima cha sapa awpa châta eima hmopiepa hluh ngaitapazy he, nâma ku tawhta eima hmôpazy châ ta, ato zydua he na eih sai a châ.

Ei Khazohpa y, nâ cha palôh mohpasia chi ta, adona liata nâ ly tahpa ei pahno. Palôh dopa phaopa ta, he hmozy he keima lôhthai tlai ta ei vaw hlâ. He liata a ypa na chyhsazy chhao heta âmo lôhthai tlai ta, a ly ngaitapa ta ama cha vaw hlâ tahpa ei hmô.
Hy Abeipa, miah pathlatuhpa Abarahâ, Aisika nata Izarei Khazohpa y, he hawhpa achhuahnazy nata pachânazy he na phopi palôh liata khâ paysa la, ama pathipalôhzy nâ lâ khâ paheisa mah y.

Ei sawchapawpa Sawlawmaw he, na biepiepazy, na ryhpa biezy nata na bieraopazy zyhpa ta, a zydua ta tao khai sala, o rônahpa cha a chhaichhi hmobaohzy ei chhuanoh hapa hawhta a sa thei nawpa ta, palôh phapakipa paphaosa mah y,” tah ta.
Dâvi ta zawpi zydua hnohta, “ Abeipa nama Khazohpa cha reithai teh u,” tah ta. Zawpi zydua ta Abeipa, ama pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa cha reithai ei ta, a bôh ei ta, Abeipa nata abei cha a naoh ei ta.

Abeipa lâ atheihnazy hlâ ei ta. A mylâ ta Abeipa lâ raopa hlânazy hlâ ei ta, viahchao tôhpa 1,000, mietaku tôhpa 1,000, mietakutaw 1,000, niepa hlânazy chhaota hlâ ei ta, Izarei saw zydua châta atheihna hluhpi ama hlâ.

Cha noh ta Abeipa hmiakô liata thapha ngaitapa ta niepa ta doh ei ta. Chatanachata Dâvi sawchapawpa Sawlawmaw cha bei ta ama pa-i chanei heih. Sawlawmaw cha Abeipa châta ryureituhpa châta sathawthu ei ta, Zadô cha theihthaipa châta sathaw ama thu.
Chatana­chata Sawlawmaw cha a paw Dâvi su liata bei châ awpa ta Abeipa beidyuchhai liata a tyuh ta. Vânoh thata to ta, Izarei saw zydua ta a rei amâ ngiah lymâ.
Hyutuhpa zydua, pasaipha zydua nata Bei Dâvi sawchapaw hropa zydua chhao ta, Bei Sawlawmaw ryureina ry liata ngâchhihpa ta y awpa ta bie amâ taih.
Abeipa ta Sawlawmaw cha Izarei saw zydua mohmô liata thata parônahsa ta, Izarei râ liata ano hlâta a bei tuapa ahy hmahta ama to thei leipa, bei rônah ngaitapa châna a patosa.
Zese sawchapawpa Dâvi cha Izarei saw zydua chô liata a bei ta.
Izarei chô liata Dâvi â beina kô zydua cha kô sypalih a châ. Hebraw liata kô sari a bei ta, Zerusale liata kô sythôh nata kô thôh â bei.
Bei Dâvi cha chyhsa hneirôhpa nata zachhihpa châ ta, kô hluhpi hroh ta, chhâ a palopa ta thi ha ta. A sawchapawpa Sawlawmaw ta ano su liata â bei.
Bei Dâvi hmotaopazy cha âthaona tawhta achhâna taihta hrohsopa Samuela châbu liata zy, hrohsopa Nâthâ châbu liata zy, hrohsopa Kâdâ châbu liata zy ropa a châ.
A ryureina thâtih zydua, a thatlôna thâtihzy, ano nata Izarei chô liata hmo a tlôpa thâtihzy nata khizaw hropa lâta khinarâhzy liata hmo a tlôpa thâtihzy chhao ropa a châ hra.
Dâvi sawchapawpa Sawlawmaw cha a khinarâh liata a pa-i ta, Abeipa a Khazohpa cha a hnohta y ta, thata parônahsa ta.
Sawlawmaw ta Izarei saw zydua, pheisaih sâh kha hyutuhpazy, pheisaih za kha hyutuhpazy, ryureihtuhpazy, Izarei râh zydua liata chhituhpa chhôh to pawhrâhpa zydua hnohta bie reih ta.
Sawlawmaw cha zawpi zydua chhaota Kibiô khihpi liata su sâhpa lâ sie ta. Cha su liata Abeipa chakaotuhpa Mawsi ta râhchawhpa liata a taopa Khazohpa ahmaohna poh o kha y ta.
Khazohpa Byh deikua cha, Dâvi ta Kiriaziari tawhta khykhei ta, a so nawpa su â chhuanohpa, Zerusale liata poh o a raipa liata soh ta.
Hurâ sawchapawpa Uri saw­chapawpa Bezale ta dawh maisâh a taopa chhao kha, Kibiô liata Abeipa achhyna byureih kiapâh liata y ta. Sawlawmaw nata zawpizy ta maisâh cha kei pangai ei ta.
Sawlawmaw ta ahmaohna poh o kiapâh liata dawh maisâh yna lâ khy ta, cha liata Abeipa hmiakô ta raopa hlâna sâh kha hlâ ta.
Cha zâ ta Sawlawmaw hnohta Khazohpa a vaw luah ta, a hnohta, “Khâpa ei cha pie aw, na hiah teh,” tah ta.
Sawlawmaw ta Khazohpa hnohta, “Ei paw Dâvi hnohna khata ngiachhiena thata paluahsa chi ta, ano su liata bei ta eina tao chi.
Hy Zehôvâh Khazohpa y, ei paw Dâvi hnohta na bietai kha tahmâ patlô mah y. Nâma tlai ta alei dohlei zie ta a hluhpa phopi chô liata bei ta eina tao chi hih.

Chavâta he phopi hmiakô liata ei pua nawpa nata ei ngia nawpa châta a ngiahpa sona nata novâhna na pie mah y. Chataleipatala he tlu ta a hluhpa na phopi chô liana he ahy ma ryu a reih thei aw?” tah ta.

Khazohpa ta Sawlawmaw hnohta, “Cha hmo cha na palôh liata y ta, sôh nata piah, hneirôna, palyupalihna, châ haotuhpazy hrona nata hro pareihna zy hiah leipa chi ta, ama bei ta ei cha taopa ei phopi chô liata ryu na rei thei nawpa ta, sona nata novâhna tlao eina hiapa vâ chi ta,

sona nata novâhna cha piepa na châ haw. Nâma hlâta bei a vaw châ tuapa ahy hmahta ama hnei thei leipa nata nâma khai tawhta bei a vaw châ awpa ahy hmahta ama hnei thei lei awpa sôh nata piah, hneirôna nata palyupalihna zy chhao ei cha pie aw,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Sawlawmaw cha Kibiô su sâhpa liata ahmaohna poh o hmiakô tawhta Zerusale lâ a lie ta. Izarei sawzy chô liata ryureih ta.
Sawlawmaw ta talailihzy nata arâ pheisaihzy pahmaoh pakhy ta. Talailih 1,400 nata arâ pheisaih 12,000 hnei ta, chazy cha talailih sona khihpizy nata abei yna Zerusale liata soh ta.
Abei ta tâkâ nata ngôh cha, alô hawhta pachâna taihta Zerusale liata pachô ta. Sidy tho chhao Sephelâ liata theiku tho hawhta hluhpa ta a pachô.
Sawlawmaw hneipa arâzy cha Izi nata Kue tawhta lapa châ ta, bei sôhpalietuhpazy ta a mâ piepa ta Kue liata ama za chalei tyh.
Talailih miakha ta tâkâ sekel 600, arâ pô kha ta tâkâ sekel 150 lymâ ta Izi râh lâ za chalei tyh ei ta, âmo tawhta Hiti bei zydua nata Aramia beizy lâta ama zuah pachhuah tyh.
Sawlawmaw ta Abeipa moh châta Achhyna o nata abei o sa a chhuah ta.
Hmo a phaoh awpa chyhsa 70,000, tlâh liata alô a khai awpa 80,000 nata âmo a mohôh awpa 3,600 rao ta.
Sawlawmaw ta Tyre bei Hirâ lâ chyhsa tuah ta, a hnohta, “Ei paw Dâvi chô liata hmo pha tao chi ta, a pahrâ nawpa o sa nawpa ta sidy thozy, na vaw paphaopa hawhna khata, kei chhao na taopa hra mah y.

Pachâ teh, Abeipa ei Khazohpa moh châta o sa awpa ei chhuah. Cha o cha Zehôvâh Khazohpa hmiakô liata ropahâhpa rao nawpa châta zy, viahchhâ chaluahpa so tyh nawpa châta zy, Izarei châta chhâzaw châta raopa Pahânoh, thla thiehpa nata Abeipa eima Khazohpa kyhchhi nohzy liata, my nata zâ ta raopa hlânazy hlâ nawpa châta a châ.
Keimo Khazohpa cha khazoh zydua hlâta rônah chaipa a châpa vâta, o ei sa awpa chhao o rônah ngaitapa a châ aw.

Châhrasala Zehôvâh Khazohpa cha avâ liata â tlôh leipa ta, avâ a sâh chaipa liata chhao â tlôh leipa châ tlôh ta, ahy ma a y nawpa o a sapa thei aw? A hmiakô liata atheihna hlâna rao nawpa châta tah leipa ta cha, kei bao hra heta o cha ei sapa thei aw ma?

Chavâta ei paw Dâvi ta Zudâh râh nata Zerusale liata zôthaipa a vaw hmâ tyhpa, tahmâ ta ei hnohta a ypazy nata hmaohkha ta hria awpa ta, ngôh, tâkâ, dawh nata thua rai a hria thaipa, poh saihdôhpa, saihlawpa nata nohpa a tao thaipa nata tho khie thaipa zôthaipa chyhsa pakha na za tuapa mah y.
Na chyhsazy cha Lebanaw thozy ama thlu thai kaw tahpa pahno na ta, chavâta Lebanaw sidy thozy, meisah thozy, alaku thozy chhao na vaw paphao mah y. Ei chyhsazy ta na chyhsazy cha ama kaw hriakhei aw.
O ei sa awpa he o rônahpa nata noâhchhihpa a châ awpa vâta, tho hluhpi patohpatia awpa â ngiah.
Na chyhsa tho thlutuhpazy cha âtâ viahdie bai 20,000, bâli sâh bai 20,000, kresawhti rahô 20,000 nata sathaw rahô 20,000 ei pie aw ei,” tah ta.
Tyre bei Hirâ ta châpaphaopa ta Sawlawmaw cha a chhy ta, a hnohta, “ Abeipa ta a phopi kyh a pachâ vâta, nâ cha ama chô liata bei ta y awpa ta a cha tao,” tah ta.

Hirâ ta reih lymâ ta, “Avâ nata alei a taotuhpa Izarei Khazohpa Zehôvâh cha reithaipa ta y sala, Zehôvâh Achhyna o nata abei o sa awpa ta patohpatia thaina nata novâhna a hneipa sawchapaw so ngaitapa Dâvi hnohta a pietuhpa cha reithaipa ta y mawh sy.
“Chavâta tahmâ chyhsa novâhpa nata zôthaipa Hurâmabi nâ lâ ei vaw tuah.

A nô cha Dânâ zuah châ ta, a paw deikua cha Tyre khihpa a châ. Ngôh, tâkâ, dawh, thua, alô, poh saihdôhpa, nohpa, saihlawpa nata pala rih dipa zy a hria thaipa châ ta, hmo to a khie thaipa nata a tao thaipa a châ. Na chyhsa zôthaipazy nata ei zibeipa, na paw Dâvi zôthaipazy hry liata a hria hra aw.
Chavâta ei zibeipa reipa âtâ sâh, bâli sâh, sathaw nata kresawhti zy cha, ei zibeipa ta a chakaotuhpazy lâ kaw paphao mawh sy.
Lebanaw tawhta tho cha nâ ngiahpa hawhta vaw thlu aw pi ta, tilaipi lâta Zôpâ taihta apâzy ta vaw siekhei aw pi ta, nâ ta Zerusale lâ na paly aw,” tah ta.
Sawlawmaw ta Izarei râh liata a paw Dâvi ta ama maluh a vaw reipa chihropa chyhsa zydua ama maluh reih ta, ama zydua ta 153,600 ama châ.
Hmo phaoh awpa ta chyhsa 70,000 rao ta, alô khai awpa 80,000 rao ta, zawpi raihria mokhei awpa ta 3,600 a rao ei.
Sawlawmaw ta Abeipa o cha Zeru­sale khihpi chhôh Môria Tlâh liata sa pathao ta. Cha su cha a paw Dâvi hnohta Abeipa â luahna su, Zebu chyhsa Ôranâ sawhrihmo kha châ ta, Dâvi ta â vaw tlyhpa su a châ.
Â beina kô palihna, thla nona, noh nona liata a sa pathao.
Khazohpa o sanazie awpa Sawlawmaw ta a thlienazie cha hetana heta a châ: A doh lâ cha dy thlienazie parohpa ta dy sycharu châ ta, a hâ lâ dy kih a châ.
Achhyna o hmia lâta aikah cha, a doh nata a hâ a khopa ta taopa châ ta, dy kih raihrie a châ. Â sâhna lâ cha dy 120 a châ. O chhôh lâ cha ngôh suapa ta a pahu.
Chhôhpadâhpa lai viapa pâhchhô liata meisah vyhpa bai ta, cha cha ngôh suapa ta pahu ta, cha liata thiahrâ tho nata bâlia nothlahpazy a tao.
O cha lôsôhpazy ta â ngia ngaitapa ta tobi ta, ngôh cha Paravai ngôh a châ.
O khâpiazy, a siphiahzy, a pâhchhôzy nata a ochhizy ngôh ta pahu ta, pâhchhôzy liata cherubi nothlahpazy khie ta.
Chatawhcha Su Pathaih Chaipa tao ta. A doh lâ cha o hâ nata pakhopa ta, dy kih ta taopa châ ta, a hâ lâ chhao dy kih a châ hra. Su Pathaih Chaipa cha ngôh suapa ta pahu ta, talent 600 hmâpa a châ.
A khaipâna ngôh ahrina zie cha sekel sypangawh a châ. O chô lâta chhôhpadâhpa chhao ngôh ta a pahu hra.
Su Pathaih Chaipa liata cherubi nothlahpa miano tao ta, chazy cha ngôh ta pahu ta.

Cherubi mathlawzy cha a miano ta pahlyhpa ta dy kih seih ta. Cherubi miakhapa mathlaw cha chavei chachâh ta dy pangawh raihrie seih ta. A mathlaw miakhapa ta pâhchhô daih ta, miakhapa ta cherubi hropa mathlaw kei daih ta.
Cherubi hropa mathlawzy chhao dy pangawh raihrie seih ta, a mathlaw miakhapa ta pâhchhô kei daih ta, miakhapa ta cherubi hropa mathlaw kei daih ta.
Cha cherubizy mathlaw cha dy kih a seih. Cherubizy cha o chhôh lâ a heipa ta, ama phei ta a duah ei ta.
Pohraipa cha pala nohpa, saihdôhpa nata saihlawpa nata pala rih dipa zy ta tao ta, a chô liata cherubi nothlahpazy a tao.
O hmia lâta dy sythôh nata dy pangawh a sâhpa a tôh miano bô ta, a pawhmao pabyuhpa cha dy pangawh raihrie a châ.
Pachhih a lyupa bâliazy tao ta, a tôh pawhmaozy cha chazai ta. Pawmikarânâ za kha tao ta, bâliazy liata a bangieh.
Atôhzy cha Achhyna o hmia lâta bô ta, miakha chho lâta bô ta, miakha maw lâta bô ta, chho lâta atôh cha Zaki bi ta, maw lâta atôh cha Bôaza a bi.
Dawh maisâh tao ta, a doh lâ dy kih, a hâ lâ dy kih, â sâhna lâ dy hrawh a châ.
Chatawhcha dawh tipâh ahlôpa tao ta, a chhôh dy hrawh tla ta, dy pangawh a sâh ta, dy sythôh ahlôpa a châ.
Tipâh tlâh ry liata, dy kha liata titheih theih hrawh lymâ ta, tipâh a dôna taihta titheihzy pataohpa a châ. Titheihzy cha tlâh no ta paziahpa châ ta, tipâh nata leih pâpa a châ.

Tipâh cha viahchao tôhpa pô hrawh hleino chô liata patyupa châ ta, pô thôh maw lâ a heih ta, pô thôh notla lâ a heih ta, pô thôh chho lâ a heih ta, pô thôh nochhi lâ â heih. Viahchao tôhpazy chô liana chata tipâh cha patyupa châ ta, a chhôh lâ ama chao ama chhy khai.
Tipâh cha pazah tie chha ta, a tlâh cha nyu tlâh hawhta, lilipaw lyupa ta taopa châ ta, tibyh 3,000 â tlôh.
A si nawpa ta rahô miahrawh tao ta, chho lâ miapangawh, maw lâ miapangawh patyu ta. Chazy cha raopa hlâna châta hmâpa hmobaohzy pasi nawpa châ ta, tipâh cha theihthaipazy a si nawpa châta a châ.
A taonazie awpa raopa hawhta, ngôh ta meiôh patyuna miahrawh tao ta, Achhyna o chhô liata chho lâchhâh miapangawh, maw lâchhâh miapangawh soh ta.
Tlâhkhai miahrawh tao ta, Achhyna o chhôh liata chho lâchhâh miapangawh, maw lâchhâh miapangawh soh ta. Ngôh rahô chhao za kha a tao.
Chazy hleikhô ta, theihthaipazy tlyhmia nata tlyhmia kawhpazy dôh ta, tlyhmia ochhizy tao ta, ochhizy cha dawh ta a pahu.
Tipâh cha Achhyna o chho nochhi chaki liata a patyu.
Hirâ ta beihzy, buchâh linazy nata biebuhzy tao hra ta. Chatanachata Hirâ ta Khazohpa o sana liata Bei Sawlawmaw châta a tao awpazy cha patlô ta.
Hezy he a tao: Atôh miano, biebuhzy, atôhzy pawhmao liata pabyuhpa miano, atôhzy pawhmao liata pabyuhpazy chô liata biebuhzy khuna sao miano nata
dawh tôhzy pawhmao liata dawh luh byuhpazy chô liata biebuhzy khuna dawh sao mianozy liata, tlâh no ta patlâh awpa pawmikarânâ nothlahpa 400 tao ta.
Patyunazy, patyuna chô liata biebuhzy chhao tao ta,
tipâh miakha nata a ry liata viahchao tôhpa pô hrawh hleino a tao.
Beihzy, buchâh linazy, sa thaonazy nata a hmobaoh zydua cha, Hurâmabi ta Abeipa o châta dawh patliepa ta Bei Sawlawmaw châta a tao.
Chazy cha abei ta Zawdâh bypi liata Sukô nata Zeredâ likawh beihlei su liata leih ta.
Sawlawmaw ta hmobaoh hluhpi tao ta, hmobaohzy tao nawpa ta dawh a hmâpa zie cha, khopathliah tiah awpa châ vei.
Sawlawmaw ta Khazohpa o hmobaoh zydua tao ta. A taopazy cha, ngôh maisâh nata Ypâna viahchhâ sona tlâhkhaizy;
a taonazie raopa hawhta taopa Achhyna o chhôh supathaihpa hmiakô liata pakhaih awpa ta ngôh suapa ta taopa meiôh patyuna nata a meiôhzy;
ngôh sua chaipa ta taopa pawpizy, meiôhzy nata chaikiezy;

ngôh suapa ta taopa meiôh poh chakienazy, rahôzy, ropahâhpa sona beihkohzy nata mei lanazy a châ. Achhyna o chhôh lâ angiana ochhizy, Su Pathaih Chaipa ochhizy nata Achhyna o chhôh liata chhôhpadâhpa lai chaipa ochhizy chhao ngôh ta a tao khai.

Cha hawhna chata Sawlawmaw ta Abeipa o châta a tao awpa zydua cha patlô ta. A paw Dâvi ta Abeipa lâ a vaw hlâ hapa tâkâzy, ngôhzy nata hmobaoh zydua a ngiakhei ta, Khazohpa o liata sôh sopakhyna suzy liata soh khai ta.
Sawlawmaw ta Abeipa Biehrai Byh cha, Dâvi khihpi Zaio tawhta la papua awpa ta, Izarei pathla chhituhpa zydua, Izarei machâzy nata Izarei chi hyutuhpa zydua Zerusale liata awpakhy ta.
Chatanachata Izarei chapaw zydua cha, thla sarina kyhchhi daihti liata abei hmiakô liata a hmaohpakhy ei ta.
Izarei machâ zydua a vy ei ta, Livai pathlazy ta Byh cha a sy ei ta.
Abeipa Byh, ahmaohna poh o nata poh o liata hmobaoh pathaihpa zydua a sy ei ta. Chazy cha Livai pathla theihthaipazy ta amâ sy.

Bei Sawlawmaw nata a hmiakô liata Izarei zawpi a hmaohpakhypa zydua cha, Byh hmiakô liata y ei ta, mietaku nata viahchao tôhpa hluhpi ta atheihna hlâ ei ta, a hluhzie cha paki tiah awpa nata rei tiah awpa châ vei.
Chatanachata theihthaipazy ta Abeipa Bieh­rai Byh cha, Achhyna o chhôh supathaihpa liata a y nawpa su liata a ngiakhei ei ta, Cherubi mathlawzy ry liata Su Pathaih Chaipa liata soh ei ta.
Cherubizy cha Byh luh chô liata ama mathlaw pakai ei ta, cherubizy ta Byh nata asyna lâzy cha pahli ei ta.

A lâzy cha a seih kawpa vâta, Achhyna o chhôh supathaihpa hmiakô liata Su Pathaihpa tawhta a pawhmaozy hmô theipa a châ. Khôtho lâ tawh deikua hmô theipa châ vei. Chazy cha tanoh taihta cha liata a y thlâh haw.

Lôphia miano tah leipa ta cha, Byh chhôh liata hmo hropa khâpa hmah y vei. Cha lôphiazy cha Izi tawhta ama kaw pua nota, Abeipa ta Izarei sawzy hnohta bie a hraina su Hôribâ Tlâh liata Mawsi ta a khôpazy a châ.
Cha liata a ypa theihthaipazy cha, py to ta amâ pathai khai hapa vâta, Su Pathaihpa tawhta vaw pua ei ta.

Livai pathla hlasatuhpa zydua, Asâpha, Hemâ, Zeduthu nata ama sawchapawzy nata ama chiheihzy cha lini poh rih dipa ta a tobipa ta, paotlâzy, tlaipihzy, totâzy chhaota maisâh nochhi lâchhâh liata a duah ei ta. Chiahmie tôtuhpa theihthaipa 120 chhao ama hnohta a duah hra ei ta.

Chiahmie tôtuhpazy nata hlasatuhpazy cha â raohpa ta, ao kha hawhta ao papuapa ta, Abeipa reithaipa ta alyna hla sa ei ta. Hla a vaw puapa nahta, chiahmie pyu, paotlâ pyu nata pyungiapa chhaichhi pyu hropazy vaw pua ta, “Ano cha pha ta, A zawngiahna cha chhâzaw ta a y aw,” tahpa ta Abeipa ama reithai nahta, Abeipa o cha meihdo ta vaw bi ha ta;
meihdo vâna chata theihthaipazy cha chakao awpa ta a duah thei khao veih ei. Abeipa rônahna ta Khazohpa o cha a bie khai haw.
Chatawhcha Sawlawmaw ta, “‘Meihdo chhapa liata ei pahrâ aw,’ Abeipa ta tah ta.
Châhrasala na chhâzaw pahrâna su châta, O rônahpa ei cha sapa haw,” tah ta.
Izarei zawpi zydua amâ dua thlâh ha nota, abei cha zawpi lâ a heih ta, Izarei zawpi zydua châta byhnâ aw ta.
Sawlawmaw ta, “Ei paw Dâvi hnohta a pakah ta bie a taih ta, a ku ta a bietai a patlôtuhpa Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa cha reithaipa ta y mawh sy!

Abeipa ta, ‘Izi râh tawhta ei phopi Izarei sawzy ei chhi papua noh tawhta, Izarei chizy hry liata kheihawhpa khih hmahta ei moh y nawpa o sa nawpa ta a tlyh beih leipa na ta, ei phopi Izarei chhituhpa châta ahy hmah a tlyh bei hra va na.
Tahmâ deikua cha, ei moh y nawpa châta Zerusale a tlyh ha na ta, ei phopi Izarei chhituhpa châta Dâvi ei tlyh haw,’ tahpa ta reih ta.
Ei paw Dâvi khata Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa moh châta o sa khona a palôh liata vaw hnei ta.
Châhrasala Abeipa ta ei paw Dâvi hnohta, ‘Ei moh châta o sa khona palôh hnei chi ta, cha hawhpa palôh na hneipa cha na tao pha na.
Châhrasala o a sa awpa cha nâ châ aw va chi. Sawchapaw na sa awpa ta ei moh châta o cha a sa aw,’ tah ha ta.

Abeipa ta a bietai cha tahmâ a patlô haw. Abeipa ta bie â vaw taipa hawh tlai ta, ei paw Dâvi su liata kei a duahpa ta, Izarei beidyuchhai liata a tyuh na ta, Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa moh châta o cha ei sa haw.
Cha liata Abeipa ta Izarei sawzy hnohta a hraipa Abeipa Biehrai yna Byh ei soh haw,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Sawlawmaw cha Izarei a hmaohpakhypa zydua mohmô ta Abeipa maisâh hmiakô liata a duah ta, a ku pazawh ta.

Sawlawmaw cha dawh laitlâ, a doh lâ dy pangawh, a hâ lâ dy pangawh, â sâhna lâ dy thôh ta tao ta, Achhyna o dôhpachhôh tlyhmia liata a patyupa chô liata a duah ta. Izarei zawpi zydua hmiakô liata a pakhu paneih ta, avâ lâ a heipa ta a bâh pazawh ta, hetana heta thlah a chhâ.

“Hy Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa y, nâ hawhpa Khazohpa he alei nata avâ liata y veih ei. Nâ cha pathi­palôh tlokhuh ta na lâpi a chhihpa châ chakaotuhpazy chô liata bietai patlôpa ta, ngiachhiena a palâsa tyhpa na châ.
Châ chakaotuhpa ei paw Dâvi hnohta na bietai na patlô haw. Na pakah ta reih chi ta, tanoh na ku ta na patlô haw.

Chavâta Hy Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa y, châ chakaotuhpa ei paw Dâvi hnohta, ‘Na pathlazy ta ama lâpizy pakhâta ta pachâ ei sala, nâ ta ei lâpi nâ chhihpa hawhna heta, âmo chhao ta ei ryhpa ama zyh lymâ khiahta cha, Izarei beidyuchhai liata ei hmiakô lia a tyuh awpa chyhsa na pathlazy tawhta chie aw veih ei’, tahpa ta bie nâ vaw taihpa kha patlô mah y.
Chavâta Hy Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa y, châ chakaotuhpa Dâvi hnohta na reipa bie kha ngiachhiepa ta pa-i mah y.

“Châhrasala Khazohpa cha alei chô liata chyhsapa hry liata a pahrâ tlai aw ma? Pachâ tua, avâ nata avâ a sâh chaipa liata hmah nâ tlôh leipa châ ta, he o ei sapa liata chhochhi cha, nâ tlôh lei pachai aw dia!
Chatahrasala Hy Abeipa ei Khazohpa y, châ chakaotuhpa ta a cha padona nata a thlahchhâna he nathlie la, na hmiakô liata châ chakaotuhpa thlahchhâna nata hiana he rie pachâ mah y.

Chatanachata he su lâ he a vaw heih la, châ chakaotuhpa ta he su lâ a heihpa ta a thlahchhâna he nathlie la, ‘Cha liata ei moh a y aw,’ na tahna su, he o lâ tlai he chhô nah zâ ta na mo tawpâ thlâh ha mah y.

Châ chakaotuhpa nata na phopi Izarei sawzy ta he su lâ a heihpa ta thlah ama chhâ tita, ama hianazy vaw nathlie tyh mah y. Na pahrâna su vârâh tawhta vaw nathlie la, na thei tita a ngiahthai tyh mah y.
“Chyhsa ahy tlyma a vaih chô liata hmo a paraopa vâta bie pataihsa awpa byuh sala, he o lâ a vypa ta na maisâh hmiakô liata bie â taih khiahta cha,
vârâh tawhta vaw nathlie la, châ chakaotuhpazy cha pachia la, thailei a châpa cha a hmotaopa a luh chô liata patlôsapa ta viarithô la, mosiapa cha thaipachâsa la, a siana yzie hawhta lymâ pie mah y.
“Na phopi Izarei sawzy ta na chô liata ama moleipa vâta, chariah hmia liata nawh ha ei sala, nâ la a vaw heih heihpa ta, na moh a châhkheipa ta, he o liata thlahchhâpa ta ama cha hiah khiahta cha,
vârâh tawhta vaw nathlie la, na phopi Izarei moleina cha a ngiahthai la, ama pathlatuhpazy nata âmo na piepa râh lâ a chhi heih mah y.

“Na phopi Izarei sawzy na chô liata ama moleina vâta, avâ khaw chi ta, avâ rai pasuasa leipa ta ama rie na pathei tita, he su lâ a heihpa ta thlahchhâ ei sala, na moh a châhkheipa ta, ama moleina amâ heihsai khiahta cha,

vârâh tawhta vaw nathlie la, châ chakaotuhpa na phopi Izarei sawzy moleina cha a ngiahthai mah y. Lâpi dopa a chhih awpa ta âmo cha pachu la, ryuto châta na phopi na piepa râh liana he avâ pasuasa heih tyh mah y.

“Chakâhna tlyma, potlana tlyma, chawhkaraina tlyma, hmyna tlyma, khawsu tlyma, chângyu tlyma râh liata vaw y sala, ama chariahzy ta ama khihpizy dôhpa ta, potlana nata pasana kheihawhpa rai vaw tlô sala,
ama pasataona nata ama pachârôhna pahno chyupa ta, mopakha ta tlyma, Izarei zawpi ta tlyma, he o lâ he a heihpa ta ama ku pazawh ei sala, thlahchhâna nata hiana ama vaw tlôkhei khiahta cha,

na pahrâna su vârâh tawhta vaw nathlie la, a ngiahthai mah y. Ama palôh na pahnopa nata ama hrozie lymâ hawhta, chyhsa to chô liata hria la tao mah y. Nâma, nâma deita he Âdâh pathlazy palôh a pahnotuhpa châ tlôh chi ta.
Chatanachata miah pathlatuhpazy na piepa râh liata ama pahrâ chhôh zydua ta, cha chi aw ei ta, na lâpi amâ chhih lymâ aw.

“Cha hawhna hra chata, na phopi Izarei saw a châ leipa chihropa chyhsa ta, na moh rônahpa nata na ku thatlôpa nata na bâh pazawhpa thâtih a theipa vâta, râh hlapi tawhta a vy sala, he o lâ a heihpa ta thlah a chhâ tita,

na pahrâna su vârâh tawhta vaw nathlie la, chihropa ta a cha hiapa cha taopa mah y. Chatanachata khizaw phopi zydua ta na moh pahno aw ei ta, Izarei sawzy ta eima cha chipa hawhta, âmo chhao ta cha chi aw ei ta, o ei sapa he na moh a phaohpa a châ tahpa ama pahno aw.
“Na phopi ta ama chariahzy a dyuh awpa ta sie ei sala, kheihawhpa lâpi lâ tawhta na tuapa chhao ta, nâ tlyhpa khihpi nata na moh châta ei sapa o lâ he a heihpa ta nâ lâta thlah ama chhâ khiahta cha,
ama thlahchhâna nata ama hiana cha vârâh tawhta vaw nathlie la, ama chhâh a châ mah y.

“Chyhsa ahy hmah a molei beih leipa y veih ei. Na phopi chhao ta na chô liata ama molei tita, ama chô liata na pathi ia ta, chavâta ama chariahpa ku liata âmo cha pie chi ta, râh lâhlapi lâta tlyma, lâhnia liata tlyma, sei ta a chhipa ta y ei sala,

sei ta amâ chhina râh liata ama palôh zy ananopa ta, ro ei sala, sei ama châna râh liana chata, ‘Hmo vaw parao ha pi ta, â do lei ngaitapa nata molei ngaitapa ta eima vaw tao haw,’ tahpa ta cha hiah ei sala,

sei ta amâ chhina râh liana chata, ama pathipalôh tlokhuh ta nata ama thlahpa tlokhuh ta ro ei sala, âmo pathlatuhpazy hnohta na piepa ama râh nata nâ tlyhpa khihpi nata na moh châta ei sapa o lâ he a heihpa ta, nâ lâta thlah ama chhâ khiahta cha,
ama thlahchhâna nata ama hiana cha, na pahrâna su vârâh tawhta vaw nathlie la, ama hiana cha hlao patloh la, na chô liata a molei hapa na phopi cha a ngiahthai mah y.
Hy ei Khazohpa y, he thlahchhâna su lâ he ngiachhiepa ta na mo padeih la, na nah pachôh mah y.
“Hy Zehôvâh Khazohpa y, Tahmâ thyu la, Na thatlôna Byh chhaota, Nâ pahâna su lâ sie mah y. Hy Zehôvâh Khazohpa y, Na theihthaipazy pachhana ta tobi la, Na mopathaihpazy na phana liata y mawh ei sy.
Hy Zehôvâh Khazohpa y, Na sathawthupa hmia su hro lâ paheisa leipa la, Châ chakaotuhpa Dâvi chô liata na zawngiahna kha, Khâ a thei thlâh ha mah y.”
Sawlawmaw ta thlah a chhâ khaipata nahta, avâ tawhta mei za tla ta, raopa hlâna nata atheihna sazy kâ khai ta, Abeipa rônahna ta Achhyna o cha bie ha ta.
Abeipa rônahna ta Abeipa o cha a pabie hapa vâta, theihthaipazy cha Abeipa o lâ a ngia thei khao leipa ei ta.

Izarei saw zydua ta avâ tawhta mei a za tlapa nata Achhyna o chô liata Abeipa rônahna cha ama hmô nahta, lôphia phawpa siphiah chô liata ama hmia alei lâ a khupa ta a bôh ei ta, “ Abeipa cha pha ta, A zawngiahna chhâzaw ta a y aw,” tahpa ta Abeipa cha a chhy ei ta, ano lâ alyna bie ama reih.
Chatawhcha abei nata zawpi zydua ta Abeipa hmiakô liata atheihna hlâ ei ta.
Bei Sawlawmaw ta atheihna hlâna châta viahchao tôhpa 22,000 nata mietaku 120,000 hlâ ta. Cha hawhna chata abei nata zawpi zydua ta Khazohpa o cha hlâ ei ta.

Theihthaipazy nata Livai pathlazy cha ama su chyu liata a duah ei ta, Abeipa lâ alyna bie reina, “A zawngiahna chhâzaw ta a y,” tahpa hla cha pyungiapa chhaichhizy nata patlapa ta sa ei ta. Âmo dady liata theihthaipazy ta chiahmie tô ei ta, Izarei saw zydua cha a duah thlâh ha ei ta. Cha hla nata pyungiapa chhaichhizy cha Bei Dâvi ta Abeipa reithai nawpa ta a hmâ tyhpa, pyungiapa chhaichhizy chhaota theihthaipazy a pasasa tyhpa hla a châ.

Sawlawmaw ta Abeipa o laihmia lâta dôhpachhôh tlyhmia liah chaipa cha pathaisa ta. Cha liata raopa hlâna nata aryhna hlâna thaw zy hlâ ta. Sawlawmaw taopa dawh maisâh cha raopa hlâna, niepa hlâna nata sa thaw zy hlâ nawpa châta a chyh tupa vâta, tlyhmia liah liata a hlâpa a châ.
Cha daihti liata Sawlawmaw ta kyhchhi noh sari tao ta. Lebôhamâ tawhta Izi Chavah taihta Izarei saw zydua a ki khaipa ta, zawpi hluh ngaitapa tlôpakhy ei ta.
Maisâh hlâna nata kyhchhina noh sari ama hmâ khai tawhta, a noh chariena noh ta pakhypi pathaihpa hmâh ei ta.

Thla sarina, noh kih nata noh thôhna noh ta, zawpizy cha ama o lâ chyu padisa ta. Abeipa ta Dâvi nata Sawlawmaw nata a phopi Izarei sawzy chô liata a phana a palâsapa zydua vâta, alypa nata thaphapa ta ama o lâ chyu a di ha ei ta.
Sawlawmaw ta Abeipa o nata abei o cha paloh ta. A palôh ta â chhuahpa hawh tlai ta, Abeipa o chhôh lâ nata ano o chhôh lâta tao awpa zydua chhao a phapa ta paloh khai ta.
Sawlawmaw hnohta zâ ta Abeipa a vaw luah ta, a hnohta, “Na thlahchhâna thei na ta, he su he keima châta atheihna o ta ei rao hawh.
Avâzy ei khawpa vâta khihti a y lei tita tlyma, khawsuzy bie ei piepa vâta râh a nie khai tita tlyma, ei phopi liata potlana ei chareisa tita tlyma,

ei moh a phaohpa ei phopi ta a panawh ei sala, thlahchhâpa ta ei hmia tlua ei sala, ama yzie moleinazy amâ heihsai khiahta cha, vârâh tawhta vaw nathlie aw na ta, ama moleinazy a ngiahthai aw na ta, ama râh cha ei patlâh heih aw.
He su liata thlahchhâna lâ cha ei mo tawpâ aw na ta, nah ei pachôh aw.
He o liata ei moh chhâzaw ta a y thei nawpa ta, he o he a tlyh na ta, ei pathaisa haw. He liana heta ei mo nata ei palôh chhâzaw ta a y thlâh ha aw.
Nâ chhao, na paw Dâvi hawhta ei mohmô liata y la, bie ei cha piepa zydua tao la, ei bieraopazy nata ei pachianazy na zyh khiahta cha,
na paw Dâvi hnohta, ‘Izarei chô liata ryu a reih awpa na pathla tawhta chie aw veih ei,’ tahpa ta bie ei hrai hapa hawhna khata, nâ beina beidyuchhai cha ei pa-i lymâ aw.
“Nama hmiakô liata ei sopa, ei bieraopazy nata ei biepiepazy a heihsaipa ta, khazoh hropazy pangaipa ta, âmo cha chakaopa ta namâ chhy khiahta deikua cha,

râh ei cha piepa tawhna ei heta cha phia aw ei na ta, ei moh châta ei pathaisapa, he o chhao he ei mohmô tawhta pazaw syulyu ha aw na ta, phopi to châta pakhona bieso nata pahneiparâsaona châta ei tao aw.
He o rônahpa he, a chapiapa maihta noâh tahpa ta, ‘Khazia ma Abeipa ta he râh nata he o he, he hawhta a tao ha tly?’ tah aw ei ta,

chyhsazy ta, ‘Ama pathlatuhpazy Izi râh tawhta a chhi papuatuhpa Abeipa, ama pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa siesai ei ta, khazoh hropazy a patupa ta, a chhy ei ta, ama chakaopa vâta, Abeipa ta he chhiena zydua he ama chô liata a patlôsapa a châ,’ ama tah aw,” tah ta.
Sawlawmaw ta Abeipa o nata ano o cha, kô kih chhôh sa ta, a paloh tawhta,
Hirâ ta khihpi a piepazy cha paduapathi ta, cha liata Izarei sawzy pahrâsa ta.
Sawlawmaw ta Hâmathizôbâ a dyuh ta, pahnie ta.
Râhchawhpa liata Tamô khihpi padua ta, Hâmathi liata chhao hmobaoh sona khihpizy padua ta.
Sawlawmaw ta Machhua Behôrô nata Mathi Behôrô khihpizy chhao thokhyzy, chhikaozy, ahraina lâzy hneipa a padua.

Bâlathâ khihpi, Sawlawmaw hneipa hmobaoh sona khihpi zydua, a talailihzy sona khihpizy nata a arâ pheisaihzy yna khihpizy padua ta, Zerusale, Lebanaw nata a ryureina râh chhôh zydua liata khihpi a padua khona maih liata Sawlawmaw ta a padua lymâ.
Izarei saw a châ leipa, Hiti mo, Amawri mo, Perizi mo, Zebu mo,
cha liata ama pathla laibâhpa a ypa, Izarei sawzy ta ama pahleipadia khai thei leipazy cha, Sawlawmaw ta raihriatuhpazy ta tao ta, cha hawhna chata tanoh taihta ama y.
Izarei sawzy deikua cha, Sawlawmaw ta a rai hria awpa seizy ta tao leipa ta, âmo cha pheisaihzy, pheisaih hyutuhpazy, talailih nata arâ pheisaih hyutuhpazy ta hmâpa ama châ.
Âmo cha zawpizy chô liata biehnei awpa ta Sawlawmaw ta a raopa hyutuhpazy châ ei ta, ama zydua ta 250 ama châ.

Sawlawmaw ta, “Ei lapinô cha Izarei bei Dâvi o liata a y awpa châ vei, Abeipa Byh â vyna suzy cha su pathaihpa châ tlôh ta,” tah ta. Chatanachata Phiraoh sawchanô cha Dâvi khihpi tawhta ano châta o a sapa lâ a chhi ha ta.
Sawlawmaw ta o hmia lâta aikah liata a taopa Abeipa maisâh chô liata, Abeipa lâ raopa hlânazy hlâ ta.

Cha raopa hlânazy cha Mawsi biepiepa hawhta noh chareih ta â ngiahna lymâ hawh ta hlâ tyhpa a châ. Pahânoh nata thla thieh nohzy liata hlâ tyhpa châ ta, kô chareih ta taopa kyhchhi miathôhpa, viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa kyhchhi, Hâta Kyhchhi nata Byureih Kyhchhi lia zy ta hlâ tyhpa a châ.

A paw Dâvi ta a vaw rao hapa hawhta, theihthaina rai hria awpa ta theihthaipazy cha a py py ta pachhaih ta, Livai pathlazy chhao theihthaipazy hmiakô liata reithaina hla sa awpa ta noh chareih ta â ngiahnazie hawhta a py py ta pachhaih ta, chhikao vaituhpazy chhao ama chhikao vai awpa chyu ta a py py ta a pachhaih ei. Cha hawhta tao awpa ta, Khazohpa chyhsa Dâvi ta bie a vaw pie hapa a châ.
Abei ta theihthaipazy nata Livai pathlazy bie a piepa cha, khâpa kyh lia hmahta tleisai leipa ei ta, sôh kyh liata chhao tleisai cheita veih ei.
Chatanachata Abeipa o sana kyh liata Sawlawmaw raihria zydua cha, Abeipa o lôbô bô noh tawhta pathaopa ta paloh khaipa châ ta. Abeipa o cha patlôpa a châ.
Chatawhcha Sawlawmaw cha Edômâ râh tilaipi kiah liata a ypa Eziôkebe nata Elô lâ sie ta.

Hirâ ta balyhzy nata tilaipi yzie a pahnopa balyh puhpazy Sawlawmaw lâ tuah ta. Sawlawmaw chakaotuhpazy chhaota Ôphi lâ sie ei ta, cha tawhna chata ngôh talent 450 vaw phaoh ei ta, Bei Sawlawmaw lâ ama vaw tlôkhei.

Sawlawmaw moh pathâhnazie Sebâ beinô ta a thei nahta, Sawlawmaw cha bie khiakhi ngaitapazy ta pasia awpa ta Zerusale lâ a khy ta. Zituhpa hluhpi nata ia-ôzy nata ngôh nata lôsôhpa hluhpi phaoh ta, râraoseihpazy chhaota khy ta. Sawlawmaw kô a tlô nahta, a palôh liata bie a ypa zydua chho ta.
Sawlawmaw ta a hiahripa zydua cha a chhy khai ta. Sawlawmaw ta a chhopasia thei leipa bienyupa khâpa hmah y vei.
Sebâ beinô ta Sawlawmaw sozie, a o sapa,

a tlâhkhai liata niedo, a beimachâzy atyuna paryhzie, a chakaotuhpazy chakaozie nata amâ tobizie, a nyu hlâtuhpazy nata amâ tobizie nata Abeipa o liata raopa hlâna a hlâpazy a hmôpa cha, a huhiah chhao so pha thei khao leipa ta.
Abei hnohta, “Na biereipa nata na sozie zy ama reipa ei râh liata ei vaw theipa kha, â vaw do tlai he zaw.
Châhrasala a khy na ta, ei mo tlai ta ei kaw hmô hlâ heta cha, ama reipa kha zo hlei va na. Na sona rônahzie â khophie chhao eina chho leipa ei he. Ama reipa ei theipa na khô syulyu haw.
Na lapinôzy ama nohlao kaw dia! Na hmiakô liata a duah ta, na sona bie a thei tyhpa châ chakaotuhpazy he ama nohlao kaw na!

Na chô liata a ly ta, ano châta bei châ awpa ta a beidyuchhai liata châ patyutuhpa Abeipa na Khazohpa cha reithaipa ta y maw sy! Na Khazohpa ta Izarei he kyhpachâ ta, chhâzaw châta a padua khohpa vâta, ryureina dopa nata siana ta ryu na reih thei nawpa ta, ama chô liata bei ta a cha tao hih,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Sebâ Beinô ta Bei Sawlawmaw cha ngôh talent 120 nata ia-ô hluhpi nata lôsôhpazy pie ta. Sebâ Beinô ta Bei Sawlawmaw a piepa ia-ô tlu ta a hluhpa y beih vei.
Ôphi tawhta ngôh a vaw phaoh tyhpa Hirâ chakaotuhpazy nata Sawlawmaw chakaotuhpazy ta alku tho nata lôsôhpazy chhao vaw phaoh ei ta.
Abei ta alku tho cha hmâpa ta Abeipa o nata abei o kahmizy tao ta, cha tho hmâpa chata hlasatuhpazy châta totâ nata tlaipih zy tao hra ta. Cha hawhpa cha Zudâh râh liata hmô awpa y beih vei.
Bei Sawlawmaw ta Sebâ beinô cha, ano kaw phaopa a hlao leipa ta, a khopa nata a hiapa maih pie ta. Chatanachata a chakaotuhpazy chhaota a râh lâ a lie ha ta.
Sawlawmaw liata kô kha chhôh ta ngôh a ngiapa cha talent 666 a châ.
Cha hry liana chata sôhdaohpa nata sôhpaliepazy ta râhpaw ama piepa a hlao vei. Arabia bei zydua nata Izarei râh pachhaihpa ryureituhpazy chhao ta Sawlawmaw hnohta ngôh nata tâkâ zy ama pie lymâ.
Bei Sawlawmaw ta ngôh ta daipa vyhphao laipa 200 tao ta, vyhphao laipa miakha liata ngôh sekel 600 lymâ hmâpa a châ.
Chatawhcha ngôh daipa vyhphao 300 tao ta, vyhphao miakha liata ngôh sekel 300 lymâ hmâpa a châ. Chazy cha abei ta Lebanaw Râhmâhpa O liata soh ta.
Abei ta sianaoh beidyuchhai rônah ngaitapa chhao tao ta, ngôh suapa ta pahu ta.

Beidyuchhai cha ngôh ta taopa kahmi nata pheitlyna zy hnei ta, beidyuchhai nata pazaopa ta taopa châ ta, kahmi cha chhâh charupa a châ. Atyuna chavei chachâh ta a kuzy y ta, beidyuchhai kuzy kiah liata chakeibarôhneipa nothlahpa pô no a duah ta.

Beidyuchhai kahmi chhâh charuzy liata a kâ chavei chachâh ta chakeibarôhneipa nothlahpa pô hrawh hleino, chhâh kha liata pô no lymâ ta a duah ta. Cha hawhpa beidyuchhai cha kheihawhpa khinarâh châta hmah tao beih veih ei.
Bei Sawlawmaw nyu zydua cha ngôh nyu sai châ ta, Lebanaw Râhmâhpa O liata hmobaoh zydua chhao, ngôh suapa ta taopa sai a châ. Sawlawmaw daihti liata la, tâkâ cha khâpa saw ta reih veih ei.
Abei balyhzy cha Hirâ chakaotuhpazy chhaota Tâsi la sie tyh ta. Tâsi balyhzy chata kô thôh padai ta ei kha, ngôh, tâkâ, sianaoh, veituh nata varapa zy vaw phaoh tyh ta.
Cha hawhna chata Bei Sawlawmaw cha hneirôna nata sona liata khizaw bei zydua a khô khai ha ei.
Khazohpa ta a palôh liata sona a sopa nathlie awpa ta, khizaw bei zydua ta Sawlawmaw cha ama pangai tyh.
Ano a tlypa bei maihta kuhriazy phaopa tyh ei ta, tâkâ nata ngôh hmobaohzy, chysiazy, myrâzy, ia-ôzy, arâzy, sabaituzy kô chareih ta ama vaw phaopa tyh.
Sawlawmaw ta arâ nata talailih sona su 4,000 hnei ta, arâ pheisaih 12,000 hnei ta, chazy cha talailih khihpizy liata nata Zerusale liata abei hnohta a paysa ei.
Ufrâti chavah tawhta Philistinâ nata Izi râhri taihta abei zydua chô liata a bei ta.
Abei ta tâkâ cha alô hawhta pachâna taihta Zerusale liata pachô ta, sidy tho chhao Sephelâ liata theiku tho hawhta hluhpa ta a pachô.
Izi râh nata râh to tawhta arâzy chhao Sawlawmaw châta chalei lymâpa a châ.
