Theihthaipazy cha a chhôh chhôh ta ama mohzy ropa châ ei ta, Livai pathlazy cha chakaona rai ama hria awpa lymâ hawhta, kô kih tawhta chô lâ zydua a py py ta ama moh ropa a châ.
Apathaina kyh liata ngâchhihpa ama châpa vâta, ama saw zydua, ama lapinô zydua, ama sawchapaw zydua, ama sawchanô zydua nata ama heinawh zydua chhaota thyutôna châbu liata pahlaopa ama châ.
Livai khihpizy lyu liata a pahrâpa Arawna pathla theihthaipa chapawzy nata Livai pathla moh ropazy hnohta ama tovyuhzy rai awpa ta, khihpizy liata chyhsa rao eihpazy sopa ama châ.
Cha hawhna chata Hezekia ta Zudâh râh zydua liata tao ta. Abeipa, a Khazohpa mohmô liata a phapa, â dopa nata ngâchhihpa hmozy tao ta.

Hezekia cha Khazohpa o liata chakaona raihria ky liata zy, ryhpa kyh liata zy, biepiepa kyh liata zy, a Khazohpa tluana kyh liata zy, a taopa maih liata pathipalôh tlokhuh ta tao lymâ ta, chavâta thlaochhipa ta a y lymâ.
Cha hawhta ngâchhih ngaitapa ta ama tao khai tawhta, Asuria bei Senâkeri ta Zudâh vaw siehnao ta. Zudâh cha ano biehneina ry liata so a chhuahpa ta, thokhy khihpizy dôhpa ta riehmozy paryh laih ta.
Zerusale a dyuh a chhuahpa ta Senâkeri a vaw siepa Hezekia ta a hmô nahta,
a beimachâzy nata a pasaiphazy a saohiah ta, khihpi khôtho lâta tihnawhzy chhie khai awpa ta ryhrao ta. Beimachâzy nata pasaiphazy ta Hezekia cha bao ei ta.
Zawpi hluhpi pôhpakhy ei ta, râh chhôh liata tihnawh nata chavah zydua chhie khai ei ta, “Khazia Asuria beizy a vy aw ei ta, ti hluhpi ama hmô aw,” tah ei ta.

Hezekia cha a tha a patlô ta. Thokhy a cho hapa zydua taopathi ta, thokhy chô liata o sâhpazy padua ta. Khôtho lâ tawhta thokhy hropa ta patho thlu ta. Dâvi khihpi thokhy chhao pasiepakaopa ta pa-i ta. Chaihraizy nata vyhphaozy hluhpi tao ta.
Adyuhna châta pheisaih hyutuhpazy rao ta, âmo cha khihpi chhikao tlyliah liata pahmaoh ta, ama hnohta,
“Thatlôpa nata riahphapa ta y u la, Asuria bei nata a pheisaih hri hluhpizy chi leipa u la, a ngiaroh hra khuh vy. Âmo chhâh a châpa hlâta keimo chhâh miah a châpa ama hluh via.
Ano chhâh a châpa cha sapa pheisaih châ ei ta, keimo chhâh a châpa cha Abeipa eima Khazohpa a châ. Ano ta miah bao aw ta, eima chariah miah â dyuhpa aw,” tahpa ta thapatlôna bie reih ta.
Cha hnôhlâ ta, a pheisaih zydua chhaota Lakhi khihpi a dôh haipa Asuria bei Senâkeri ta a pheisaihzy cha Zerusale liata Zudâh bei Hezekia nata Zudâh râhsaw zydua lâ tuah ta, ama hnohta,
“Asuria bei Senâkeri ta hetana heta a tah, ‘Zerusale khihpi cha dôh khai hapa châ ta, pasa nama tao ngâ kawpa cha, khâpa ma namâ ngâchhâ tly?’
Hezekia ta, ‘ Abeipa eima Khazohpa ta Asuria bei ku tawhta miah a pachha aw,’ tahpa ta a cha chhopa ei kha, nodipa nata dâhphipa ta thi awpa ta a châ chhi chheipa ei tlao a châ.

Kha Hezekia kha vei ma, khazoh su sâhpazy nata maisâhzy parao khaipa ta, Zudâh râhsaw nata Zerusale khihsawzy hnohta, ‘Maisâh miakha lia dei ta Khazohpa a chhy aw ei chi ta, cha maisâh chô lia dei ta atheihnazy nama hlâ aw,’ tahpa ta bie a pietuhpa kha a châ vei?
Kei nata nâ pathlatuhpazy ta râh hropazy nata phopi zydua chô liata hmo eima taopazy kha pahno veih ei chi ma? Cha râhzy khazohzy chata ei ku tawhta ama râhzy ama pachha thei ma?
Nâ pathlatuhpazy ta parao awpa ta ama rao hapa râhzy cha, ahy râh khazoh ta hmah ei ku tawhta a pachha theipa y veih ei. Nâmo Khazoh bao hra chata ma, ei ku tawhta zua châ pachha aw ei?

Chavâta Hezekia a padôveisa leipa u la, cha hawhta a châ chhi chhei awpa ei namâ pasaih awpa châ vei. Hezekia kha zo khuh vy. Kheihawhpa phopi nata khinarâh khazoh hmahta keima ku tawhta tlyma, nâ pathlatuhpazy ku tawhta tlyma, a phopi a pachha theipa y beih veih ei. Nâmo Khazohpa ma ei ku tawhta zua châ pachha aw ei?” tah ta.
Senâkeri pheisaihzy ta Zehôvâh Khazohpa nata a chakaotuhpa Hezekia cha, cha hlâta tha viapa ta reipachhie rili ei ta.

Senâkeri ta Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa pasipasawhna nata reipachhiena châ roh ta, “Khizaw phopizy khazohzy ta ei ku tawhta ama phopizy ama pachha thei tlâ leipa hawhta, Hezekia Khazohpa chhao ta, ei ku tawhta a phopi pachha thei aw vei,” tah ta.
Khihpi ama la thei nawpa ta, thokhy chô liata a ypa Zerusale khihsawzy cha, Asuria pheisaihzy ta Zudâh reih ta ao paro ngaitapa ta awsao ei ta, pachhiparypa ta pachisa ei ta.
Zerusale Khazohpa cha, khizaw phopizy khazohzy hawhta, ku ta taopa khazoh a châ hrazie reih ei ta.
Cha hawhpa bie ama reipa vâna chata, Bei Hezekia nata Amôza sawchapawpa hrohsopa Isai cha thlahchhâpa ta avâ lâ awh ei ta.

Abeipa ta vâlyuhchâpa za tuah ta, ano chata Asuria bei riehmo liata pasaiphazy, pheisaih hyutuhpazy nata chhituhpa zydua a thie khai ha ei. Chatanachata Senâkeri cha noza hmiachhiepa ta a râh lâ â lie haw. Noh kha cha a khazoh o lâ a vaw nota, ano sawchapawzy ta zaozi ta ama chhawhsao haw.
Cha hawhna chata Abeipa ta Hezekia nata Zerusale khihsawzy cha, Asuria bei Senâkeri ku tawhta nata a chariah zydua ku tawhta pachha ta, amâ ngiahpazy kao to tawhta a tlôkheipa lymâ ei.
Chyhsa hluhpi ta Abeipa châta Zerusale lâ hmopiepazy vaw cheih ei ta, Zudâh bei Hezekia châta hmo sôhpazy vaw cheih hra ei ta, cha daihti tawhta cha, phopi zydua mohmô liata cheihchalopa ta a y haw.
Cha daihtizy liata, Hezekia cha thi daihmâpa ta pasa ta. Abeipa lâ thlahchhâ ta, Abeipa ta a chhy ta, ngiana pie ta.
Châhrasala Hezekia cha palôh laipa ta y ta, ano châta hmo phapa taopa cha phana ta pie palie leipa ta. Chavâta ano nata Zudâh nata Zerusale chô liata pathiiana vaw tlô ta.
Châhrasala Hezekia nata Zerusale khihsawzy ta ama palôh liata amâ palaina cha a ngiapachhipa ta amâ panawh heihpa vâta, Hezekia hro chhôh ta cha Abeipa pathiiana ama chô liata vaw tlô khao vei.
Hezekia cha thata vaw hneirôh ta, thata palyupalihpa ta y ta. Tâkâzy, ngôhzy, lôsôhpazy, ia-ôzy, vyhphaozy nata hmobaoh mâ ru ngaitapa sona ozy sa ta.
Sâh nata kresawhti nata sathaw sopakhyna ozy sa ta, sahroh to so nawpa sahroh ozy nata mietaku sadôzy tao ta.
Khazohpa ta hneirôh ngaitapa ta tao ta, khihpizy ano châta padua ta, mietaku zaw nata viahchao hri hluhpi a hnei.
Kihaw chavah hnawh toh ta, Dâvi khihpi notla lâchhâh ta a palosa. Chatanachata Hezekia cha a hmotaopa zydua liata thlaochhipa ta y lymâ ta.

Babylaw beimachâzy ta lyuhchâpazy za tuah ei ta, râh liata ngiana hmo ama taopazy ama za patluahna kyh liata, Khazohpa ta Hezekia cha pasia ta, a palôh liata a ypa zydua pahno awpa ta ano y ta a paysa hapa kha a châ.
Hezekia hmotaopa hropa zydua nata a hmo pha taopa zydua cha, Amôza sawchapawpa hrohsopa Isai aluahna rona Zudâh nata Izarei Beizy Châbu liata ropa a châ.

Hezekia cha a pathlatuhpazy hnohta a mô ta, Dâvi sawchapawzy thlâsu machhua lâta ama pabu. Zudâh râhsaw zydua nata Zerusale khihsaw zydua ta a thi noh ta rônah ngaitapa ta ama palyupalih. A sawchapawpa Manase ta ano su liata â bei.
Manase cha kô hrawh hleinopa a châ nota a bei pathao ta, Zerusale liata kô sypangawh nata kô pangawh â bei.
Abeipa ta Izarei phopi hmiakô tawhta a papua hapa phopizy hmotaopa pasichhihpazy taopa ta, Abeipa mohmô liata hmo pha leipa tao ta.
A paw Hezekia ta a parao hapa su sâhpazy paduapathi ta, Bâlâ khazohzy châta maisâhzy tao ta, Aseri khazoh nothlahpazy tao ta, avâ liata a ypa zydua a chhy ta, a chakao ei.
Abeipa ta, “Zerusale liata chhâzaw ta ei moh a y aw,” a tahna Abeipa o liata khazoh hropa maisâhzy padua ta.
Abeipa o dôhpachhôh tlyhmia miano liata avâ liata a ypa zydua châta maisâhzy a padua.

A sawchapawzy cha raopa hlâna atheihna ta Hinô Sawchapawpa Saikao liata hlâ ta, kulâmopa, pachaopa nata molietaopa zy hmâh ta, peihthaipa nata athihpa bie a chho thaipazy â saohiah tyh. Cha hawhna chata Abeipa mohmô liata hmo molei ngaitapa taopa ta, Abeipa hie pahâh ha ta.

Khazohpa ta Dâvi nata a sawchapawpa Sawlawmaw hnohta, “He o nata Zerusale khihpi, Izarei chi zydua tawhta ei tlyhpa liana heta ei moh chhâzaw ta ei paysa aw,” a tahna Achhyna o liata ano taopa khazoh nothlahpa soh ta.

Khazohpa ta, “Bie ei piepa zydua, ryhpa zydua, bieraopazy nata Mawsi hmâpa ta tao awpa bie ei piepazy ama zyh khiahta cha, ama pathlatuhpazy ei piepa râh tawhna heta Izarei phei pasie khao aw va na,” a vaw tah hana Khazohpa o liata ano taopa khazoh nothlahpa soh ta.
Cha hawhna chata Manase ta Zudâh râhsawzy nata Zerusale khihsawzy cha lâpi paviasa ta, Abeipa ta Izarei hmiakô liata a pahleipadia hapa phopizy hlâ chhao ta hmo thata ama parao via.
Abeipa ta Manase nata a chyhsazy hnohta bie reih ta, châhrasala nathlie leipa ei ta.
Chavâta Abeipa ta Asuria pheisaih hyutuhpazy vaw tuah ta, Manase cha patu ei ta, a hnari daohpa ta dawh bâlia ta buh ei ta, Babylaw lâ ama siekhei haw.
Nôpo ngaitapa ta a y nahta, Abeipa a Khazohpa ngiachhiena a haw ta, a pathlatuhpazy Kha­zohpa hmiakô liata a panawh ta.
Khazohpa lâ thlahchhâ ta, a hiana cha Khazohpa ta thei ta, ngiachhie ta, a khinarâh Zerusale khihpi lâ â chhi pakhua heih. Chatanachata Manase ta Abeipa cha Khazohpa a châ tahpa a pahno haw.

Cha hnôhlâ ta Dâvi khihpi notla daih lâta saikao liata thokhy cha khôtho lâ tawhta thokhy hropa ta patho thlu ta, Nga Chhikao angiana liata chhao khôtho lâ tawhta thokhy patho hra ta, Ôphe taihta padôpa ta â sâh ngaitapa ta sa ta. Thokhy a hneipa Zudâh khihpi zydua liata pheisaih hyutuhpazy soh ta.
Chihropa khazohzy nata khazoh nothlahpazy Abeipa o tawhta la papua khai ta, Abeipa o tlâh liata nata Zerusale liata maisâh a taopa zydua chhao khihpi khôtho lâ a thy khai haw.
Abeipa maisâh paduapathi ta, aryhna hlâna atheihnazy nata alyna bie reinazy hlâ ta, Zudâh cha Abeipa Izarei Khazohpa chakao awpa ta biepie ta.
Chatanachôta chyhsazy ta su sâhpazy liata atheihna hlâ thlâh ha chy ei ta, châhrasala Abeipa ama Khazohpa lâta ama hlâ tyh.
Manase thâtih hropazy nata a Khazohpa lâta thlah a chhâna kyh nata Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa moh ta hrohsopazy ta a hnohta bie ama reipa kyhzy cha, Izarei Beizy Thâtih Rona Châbu liata ropa a châ.

A thlahchhâna, Khazohpa ta a hiana a ngia­chhiena, â panawh hlâta a moleina nata a ngâchhih leina zydua, su sâhpa a taona suzy nata Aseri tôh nata khazoh nothlahpazy a paduana thâtihzy cha, Hrohsopazy Thâtih rona châbu liata ropa a châ.
Manase cha a pathlatuhpazy hnohta a mô ta, ano o liata pabu ei ta, a sawchapawpa Amawna ta ano su liata â bei.
Amawna cha kô kih nata kô nopa a châ nota a bei pathao ta, Zerusale liata kô no â bei.
A paw Manase hawhta Abeipa mohmô liata hmo pha leipa tao ta. A paw Manase taopa khazoh nothlahpa zydua lâta atheihnazy hlâpa ta, khazoh nothlahpazy cha chakao ta.
Amawna cha a paw Manase a panawhpa hawhna khata Abeipa hmiakô liata a panawh khoh vei. Chavâta thaileichâna ano liata â baichha via lymâ.
A chakaotuhpazy ta arulâta tei ei ta, ano o liata ama thie haw.
Châhrasala râh zawpizy ta Bei Amawna a teituhpa zydua cha thie ei ta, a sawcha­pawpa Zôsia cha ano su liata bei ta ama tao haw.
Zôsia cha kô chariepa a châ nota a bei pathao ta, Zerusale liata kô sythôh nata kô kha â bei.
A pathlatuhpa Dâvi lâpizy a chhihpa ta, Abeipa mohmô liata hmo dopa tao tyh ta, chachâh lâ tlyma, chavei lâ tlyma tlei beih vei.

Zôsia cha â beina kô chariena liata, hawtipa a châ thlâh ha chy nota, a pathlatuhpa Dâvi Khazohpa cha tlua pathao ta. Kô hrawh hleino â bei kô ta, Zudâh râh nata Zerusale khihpi liata su sâhpazy, Aseri tôhzy, khazoh nothlahpa khiepa nata leihpazy a parao khai haw.

Bâlâ maisâhzy a mohmô liata chhawh pachhô ei ta, chazy hlâta a sâh viapa ta taopa ropahâhpa raona maisâhzy chhao a chhawh pathlah khai haw. Aseri tôhzy, khazoh nothlahpa khiepa nata leihpazy phy pazao khai ta, âmo lâta atheihna a hlâtuhpazy thlâ chô liata a paohpa a hiezâh.
Ama theihthaipazy ru ama maisâhzy liata rao ta, Zudâh râh nata Zerusale khihpi a pathai.
Cha hawhna chata Manase, Epharai, Simeôna nata Nâthalai khihpizy liata chhao a tao khai.

Maisâhzy parao ta, Aseri tôhzy nata khazoh nothlahpazy cha a paoh ta phy pazao ta, chazy hlâta â sâh viapa ta taopa, Izarei râh zydua liata ropahâhpa raona maisâhzy a chhawh pathlah khai haw. Cha khai tawhta Zerusale lâ a lie ta.

Râh nata Abeipa o a pathai khai nahta, â beina kô hrawh hleichariena kô liata, Zôsia ta Azaliah sawchapawpa Sâphanâ nata khihpi avaotuhpa Mâsei nata Zôahâ sawchapawpa chârohtuhpa Zôah zy cha, Abeipa a Khazohpa o pasiepakao awpa ta tuah ta.

Theihthai beichaipa Hikia lâ vawh ei ta, chyhsazy ta Khazohpa o lâ ama vaw cheipa sôhzy kei pie ei ta. Cha sôh cha ochhi vaituhpa Livai pathlazy ta Manase mo, Epharai mo, Izarei laibâhpazy, Zudâh mo nata Benzami mo nata Zerusale khihsawzy tawhta ama lapakhypa a châ.
Cha sôh cha Abeipa o raihria mohôhtuhpazy hnohta pie ei ta. Abeipa o raihria mohôhtuhpazy ta o pasiepakaona nata taopathina rai hria nawpa ta, sôh cha ama pie pachhuah tyh.
Zudâh beizy ta o rypa ta ama paysa hapa Abeipa o taopathi nawpa ta, alô khaipazy nata a pazaona nata pâkôzy châta thozy chalei nawpa ta, sôh cha zôthaipazy nata o satuhpazy ama pie.

Chyhsazy ta rai cha ngâchhih ngaitapa ta hria ei ta. Âmo mohôhtuhpazy châta Merâri pathla Livai chyhsa Zahâ nata Ôbadia nata Kôhâ pathla Zekaria nata Mesulâ zy raopa ama châ. Livai pathla hropa, pyungiapa tôthaipazy chhao,
hmo phaohtuhpazy nata raihria nanopazy liata hriatuhpa zydua mohôhtuhpa châta raopa ama châ. Livai pathla thokha cha chârohtuhpazy nata beimachâzy nata chhikao vaituhpazy ama châ.
Chyhsazy ta Abeipa o lâ ama vaw cheipa sôhzy ama vaw puakhei hai nota, theihthaipa Hikia ta Mawsi ku liata piepa Abeipa Ryhpa Châbu hmô ta.
Hikia ta chârohtuhpa Sâphâ hnohta, “Ryhpa Châbu kha Abeipa o liata ei hmô haw,” tah ta. Hikia ta châbu cha Sâphâ pie ta.
Sâphâ ta châbu cha abei lâ vawkhei ta, abei hnohta, “Tao awpa ta raopa zydua cha, châ chakaotuhpazy ta ama tao lymâ.
Abeipa o liata sôh zydua thaoh khai ha ei ta, mohôhtuhpazy nata raihriatuhpazy hnohta ama pie haw,” tah ta.
Chârohtuhpa Sâphâ ta abei hnohta, “Theihthaipa Hikia ta châbu eina pie,” tah ta. Chatanachata Sâphâ ta châbu cha abei hmiakô liata reih ta.
Ryhpa biezy a thei nahta, abei cha a chysiazy hrie ta.
Abei ta Hikia, Sâphâ sawchapawpa Ahikâ, Mikâ sawchapawpa Abadaw, chârohtuhpa Sâphâ nata bei chakaotuhpa Asiah zy biepie ta, ama hnohta,

“Vawh u la, châbu ama hmôpa liata â rohpa biezy kyh liata, kei nata Izarei nata Zudâh râh liata laibâhpazy châta Abeipa a kei saohiah teh u. Miah pathlatuhpazy khata he ryhpa châbu liata ropa hawhna heta Abeipa bie ama vaw zyh leipa vâta, Abeipa pathiiana ru ngaitapa eima chô liata lei thlupa a châ ha hih,” tah ta.

Chatanachata Hikia nata abei tuapazy cha hrohsonô Huldâ lâ vawh ei ta, abei bie reipa kyh a kei saohiah ei ta. Hrohsonô Huldâ cha Sâluh lapinô châ ta, Sâluh cha Tôkhâ sawchapawpa châ ta, Tôkhâ cha chysiazy vaituhpa Hâsrâh sawchapawpa a châ. Hrohsonô Huldâ cha Zerusale vaih nona liata a pahrâpa a châ.
Huldâ ta ama hnohta, “ Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa ta hetana heta a tah: ‘Kei lâta châ vaw tuahtuhpa chyhsa hnohna chata,

Abeipa ta hetana heta a tah, pachâ teh, he su nata a chhôh liata a pahrâpazy chô liata chhiena patlôsa aw na ta, Zudâh bei hmiakô liata ama rei papuapa, châbu liata ropa chhiesana zydua ama chô liata ei patlôsa aw.
Na siesai ei ta, khazoh hropazy lâta atheihnazy hlâ ei ta, ama ku ta ama taopa zydua ta ei hie eina pahâh ei. Chavâta he su chô liata ei pathiiana mei lei thlu aw na ta, pachhaipa châ aw vei.
Abeipa a saohiah awpa ta châ vaw tuahtuhpa Zudâh bei hnohta deikua cha, hetana heta chho teh u, Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa ta hetana heta a tah: Na bie theipazy kyh liata,

he su nata a chhôh liata a pahrâpazy kyh liata Abeipa biezy na thei nahta, na palôh panaipa ta, Khazohpa hmiakô liata a panawh chi ta. Ei hmiakô liata a panawhpa ta, na chysiazy hrie chi ta, ei hmiakô liata na chapa vâta, kei chhao ta ei cha thei haw, Abeipa ta a tah.

Pachâ teh, châ pathlatuhpazy hnohta cha pahlyh aw na ta, thlalôhpa ta thlâkhaoh a ngia aw chi ta, he su nata a chhôh liata a pahrâpazy chô liata chhiena ei patlôsa awpa cha, na mo ta hmô aw vei,’ tahpa ta nama chho aw,” tah ta. Cha biezy cha abei lâ tlôkhei ei ta.
Abei ta chyhsazy tuah ta, Zudâh râh nata Zerusale khihpi liata machâ zydua awpakhy ta.

Abei nata Zudâh râhsaw zydua, Zerusale khihsaw zydua, theihthaipazy nata Livai pathlazy, chyhsa zydua a lai a chyh ta Abeipa o lâ khy ei ta. Abeipa o liata ama hmôpa Biehrai Châbu liata bie zydua cha ama nah theina liata reih ta.

Abei cha ano su liata a duah ta, Abeipa hmiakô liata biehrai tao ta. Abeipa hnôh pazipa ta, a biepiepazy, a biepahnokheipazy nata a bieraopazy cha a pathipalôh tlokhuh ta nata a thlahpa tlokhuh ta zyh ta, cha châbu liata â rohpa biehrai biezy hawhta tao lymâ awpa ta biehrai tao ta.
Cha nota Zerusale liata a ypazy nata Benzami mo zydua chhao, cha hawhna chata biehrai pataosa khai ta. Zerusale khihsawzy ta Khazohpa, ama pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa biehrai bie hawhta tao ei ta.

Chatanachata Zôsia ta hmo pasichhihpa zydua Izarei râh zydua tawhta pahlei khai ta, Izarei râh liata a pahrâpa zydua Abeipa ama Khazohpa a chakaosa khai ha ei. Zôsia hro chhôh zydua Izarei sawzy ta Abeipa, ama pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa hnôh ama pazipa tleisai veih ei.
Zôsia ta Abeipa châta Zerusale liata Zawpakhô kyhchhi tao ta. Thla khana, no hrawh hleipalihna noh ta Zawpakhô mietakutaw thie ei ta.
Theihthaipazy ama raihria awpa chyu rao ta, Abeipa o liata chakaona rai hria awpa ta âmo cha pasyu ta.

Izarei saw zydua pachutuhpa nata Abeipa châta pathaihpa Livai pathlazy hnohta, “Izarei bei Dâvi sawchapawpa Sawlawmaw sapa o liata Byh pathaihpa cha soh teh u. Nama ngiatlâh ta a sy awpa byuh khao aw vei. Tahmâ he Abeipa nama Khazohpa nata a phopi Izarei sawzy cha chakao teh u.
Izarei bei Dâvi ropa hawhta nata a sawchapawpa Sawlawmaw ropa hawhta, a chhôh chhôh ta py a pachhaih aw ei chi ta, namâ chhuanoh aw.
Vâtlâh chyhsa nama unawhzy cha a chhôh chhôh ta pachhaihpa ta, Su Pathaihpa liata paduasa aw ei chi ta, Livai pathlazy chhao a chhôh chhôh ta a pachhaih aw ei chi ta, âmo cha nama chhihtha aw.
Zawpakhô mietakutaw cha thie aw ei chi ta, a pathai aw ei chi ta, Mawsi ku ta piepa Abeipa bie hawhta tao awpa ta, nama unawhzy châta namâ chhuanoh aw,” tah ta.

Cha liata a ypa vâtlâh chyhsa zydua châta Zawpakhô atheihna hlâ nawpa ta, Zôsia ta mietaku zaw tawhta mietakutaw nata mietaw 30,000 nata viahchao tôhpa 3,000 thyu ta. Chazy cha abei ta a sahrohzy tawhta a thyupa a châ.

A beimachâzy chhao ta zawpizy, theihthaipazy nata Livai pathlazy châta âmo lôhthai ta thyu hra ei ta. Khazohpa o hyutuh laipa Hikia, Zekaria nata Zehie zy ta Zawpakhô atheihna hlâna châta, theihthaipazy hnohta Zawpakhô mietakutaw 2,600 nata viahchao tôhpa 300 pie ei ta.

Kônaniah nata a unawhpa Semiah nata Nethane nata Livai pathlazy hyutuhpa Hâsabiah, Zeili nata Zôzabâ zy chhao ta, Zawpakhô atheihna hlâna châta Livai pathlazy hnohta mietakutaw nata mietaw 5,000 nata viahchao tôhpa 500 ama pie hra.
Chakaona a chhuanoh khaipa a châ nahta, abei biepiepa hawhta, theihthaipazy cha amâ dua nawpa su chyu liata a duah ei ta, Livai pathlazy chhao ama py chyu liata a duah ei ta.
Zawpakhô mietakutaw cha thie ei ta, Livai pathlazy ta a vo ama hlai hai nota, âmo tawhta thisaih ama daopa cha theihthaipazy ta thia ei ta.
Mawsi Châbu liata ropa hawhta, vâtlâh châta Abeipa lâ hlâ awpa ta, a chhôh chhôh ta amâ pachhaihnazie hawhta raopa hlânazy ama rairuah. Viahchao tôhpazy chhao, cha hawna chata ama rairuah hra.
Zawpakhô mietakutaw cha ryhpa hawhta mei liata pakâh ei ta, hmohlâpa pathaihpa sazy cha, beihzy, beih nali chhaopazy nata ukâzy ta chhoh ei ta, vâtlâhzy lâ thlai ama vawkhei.

Cha khai tawhta Livai pathlazy ta âmo nata theihthaipazy châta a chhuanoh ei ta. Arawna pathla theihthaipazy cha, raopa hlâna nata sa thawzy hlâpa ta, zâ taihta tymâpa ta ama ypa vâta, Livai pathlazy ta âmo nata Arawna pathla theihthaipazy châta amâ chhuanohpa a châ.

Dâvi biepiepa hawhta, Asâpha pathla hlasathaipazy cha ama châta su raopa liata y ei ta, Asâpha, Hemâ nata abei hrohsopa Zeduthu zy chhao ama châta su raopa liata y hra ei ta, chhikao vaituhpazy chhao ama chhikao chyu liata y ei ta. Ama unawh Livai pathlazy ta ama châta amâ chhuanoh hapa vâta, ama chakaona raihria siesai awpa byuh vei.
Chatanachata Bei Zôsia biepiepa hawhta, Zawpakhô chay awpa nata Abeipa maisâh liata raopa hlânazy hlâ awpa ta, Abeipa chakaona hmo zydua cha, cha noh ta a chhuanoh ei ta.
Cha liata Izarei saw a ypazy ta, cha daihti liata Zawpakhô cha chay ei ta, viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa kyhchhi chhao noh sari hmâh ei ta.

Hrohsopa Samuela daihti tawhna khata, cha hawhpa Zawpakhô kyhchhi cha Izarei râh liata hmâpa châ beih vei. Izarei bei ahy hmahta Bei Zôsia, theihthaipazy, Livai sahlao, cha liata a ypa Zudâh nata Izarei zydua nata Zerusale khihsawzy ta ama hmâpa Zawpakhô kyhchhi hawhpa cha hmâh beih hra veih ei.
Zôsia abeina kô hrawh hleichariena kô lia deita ta Zawpakhô Kyhchhi cha ama chay heih theipa a châ.
Cha zydua hnôhlâ ta, Zôsia cha Achhyna o a phapa ta a tao khai nahta, Izi bei Nekô ta hrâ kaw sie ta, Ufrâti chavah liata Kâkhemi khihpi kaw tlô ta. Zôsia ta Nekô cha a kei duakhâh ta.

Nekô ta Zôsia lâ lyuhchâpazy tuah ta, a hnohta, “Hy Zudâh bei y, nâma nata keima likah liata khâpa a tah thai leina ma eima hnei? Tanoh he nâma a dyuh awpa ta a khy va na. Ei dyuh haipa phopi a dyuh awpa ta a khypa ei châ. Khazohpa ta a para awpa ta bie na pie ta, chavâta ei chhâh a châpa Khazohpa cha a dyuh khah y, chataleipatala a cha pahleipadia pathlei aw,” tah ta.
Châhrasala Zôsia ta kuasai khoh leipa ta, Nekô cha a dyuh awpa ta â lânazie a panano ta. Khazohpa pakah tawhta Nekô bie reipa cha nathlie khoh leipa ta, a dyuh awpa ta Mekidô bypi lâ sie ta.
Likathaipazy ta Bei Zôsia cha ka ei ta. Abei ta a chakaotuhpazy hnohta, “Na siekhei teh u, hmah thata ei phaoh,” tah ta.

A chakaotuhpazy ta talailih tawhta la ei ta, ano talailih hropa liata soh ei ta, Zerusale lâ siekhei ei ta. Bei Zôsia cha thi ta, a pathlatuhpazy thlâsu liata pabu ei ta. Zudâh nata Zerusale mo zydua ta Zôsia mâchhie sa ei ta.

Zeremiah chhao ta Zôsia chaphôhtuna hla sa ta, hlasathaipa chanô nata chapaw zydua ta, Zôsia pasai leina chaphôhtuna hlabiezy tanoh taihta ama reih ngâ thlâh ha chy. Zôsia pasai leina chaphôhtuna hla sapa cha, Izarei râh liata tao tyh awpa ryhpa ta a pyh ei ta, chaphôhtuna hlazy liata pahlaopa a châ.
Zôsia hmotaopa hropa zydua, Abeipa Ryhpa liata ropa hawhta a hmo pha taopazy nata
a hmotaopazy cha, hmiatua chaipa nata hnôh chaipa chhao, Izarei nata Zudâh Beizy Châbu liata ropa a châ.
Zudâh zawpizy ta Zôsia sawchapawpa Zehôahâ a chhi ei ta, a paw su a thla awpa ta Zerusale liata bei ta tao ei ta.
Zehôahâ cha kô kih nata kô thôhpa a châ nota a bei pathao ta, Zerusale liata thla thôh â bei.
Â beina cha Izi bei ta Zerusale liata pabâh ta, Zudâh râh cha tâkâ talent za kha nata ngôh talent miakha râhpaw a pacheisa lymâ.
Izi bei ta Zehôahâ unawhpa Eliakima cha Zudâh nata Zerusale bei ta tao ta, a moh Zehôki tahpa ta a panano. A unawhpa Zehôahâ cha Nekô ta Izi râh lâ â chhi haw.
Zehôki cha kô kih nata kô pangawhpa a châ nota a bei pathao ta, Zerusale liata kô hrawh hleikha â bei. Abeipa a Khazohpa mohmô liata hmo pha leipa tao ta.
Babylaw bei Nebukaneza ta ano a dyuh awpa ta vaw thyu ta, bâliazy ta buh ta Babylaw lâ a siekhei haw.
Nebukaneza ta Abeipa o hmobaoh thokhazy chhao la ta, Babylaw lâ phaoh ta, a yna abei o liata soh ta.
Zehôki thâtih hropazy, hmo pasichhihpa a taopazy nata a yzie pha leipazy cha, Izarei nata Zudâh Beizy Châbu liata ropa a châ. A sawchapawpa Zehôkhi ta ano su liata â bei.
Zehôkhi cha kô hrawh hleichariepa a châ nota a bei ta, Zerusale liata thla thôh nata noh hrawh â bei. Abeipa mohmô liata hmo pha leipa tao ta.

Châhvâ daihti liata, Bei Nebukaneza ta Zerusale lâ chyhsa tuah ta, Abeipa o liata hmobaoh sôhpazy chhaota Bei Zehôkhi cha Babylaw lâ ama siekhei haw. Nebukaneza ta Zehôkhi unawhpa Zedekia cha Zudâh nata Zerusale bei ta a tao.
Zedekia cha kô kih nata kô khapa a châ nota a bei pathao ta, Zerusale liata kô hrawh hleikha â bei.
Abeipa a Khazohpa mohmô liata hmo pha leipa tao ta. Abeipa pakah tawhta a puapa bie a reihtuhpa hrohsopa Zeremiah hmiakô liata a panawh khoh vei.
Khazohpa moh ta bie a pataihsa hapa Bei Nebukaneza chhao â chariah. A rao pachyupa ta, a palôh kuh pachhasa ta, Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa lâ a heih khoh vei.

Theihthai laipazy nata zawpizy chhao ta, ngâchhihna rai hnei khao leipa ei ta, phopi hropazy hmotaopa pasichhihpazy tao hra ei ta, Abeipa ta Zerusale liata a pathaisapa Abeipa o taih chhao ama papuapalei.
Abeipa, ama pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa ta, ano phopi nata a pahrâna su tha a pasapa vâta, a chalihsai leipa ta, âmo lâta lyuhchâpazy khâ tuah ta.

Châhrasala Khazohpa lyuhchâpazy cha pasipasawh tyh ei ta, Khazohpa biezy cha khâpasaw ta reih leipa ei ta, a hrohsopazy chhao ama pahneisao tyh. Achhâna liata Abeipa pathiiana a phopi chô liata vaw tlô ta, patlâh thei awpa châ khao vei.

Chavâta âmo a dyuh awpa ta, Abeipa ta Kaldia bei pathyusa ta, ano ta ama satliazy ama supathaihpa o liata zaozi ta thie ta, satlia nata laihsa, machâpa nata pawpi nôpipazy chhao ngiachhiena rai hnei leipa ta thie lymâ ta. Abeipa ta Zerusale khihsawzy cha Kaldia bei ku liata a hlâ khai ha ei.
Khazohpa o liata hmobaoh zydua, a laipa chhao, a chyhpa chhao, Abeipa o liata sôh sopakhypa zydua, abei sôh nata a beimachâzy sôhzy taihta Babylaw râh lâ a siekhei khai haw.
Khazohpa o cha mei ta rao ei ta, Zerusale thokhy pacho ei ta, a chhôh liata abei o zydua mei ta rao ei ta, hmobaoh sôhpa zydua ama parao khai haw.
Zaozi a khôkhâhpazy cha Babylaw lâ a chhi ei ta, Persia khinarâh â duana taihta Bei Nebukaneza nata a sawchapawzy chakaotuhpazy ta ama y lymâ.
Cha hmo cha râh ta Pahânohzy a hmâh thei nawpa ta, râh cha kô sysari chhôh roryhrapa ta a y awpa kyh, Zeremiah pakah ta a reipa Abeipa bie a vaw tlôpaki nawpa a châ.

Persia bei Kôresâ â beina kô khana liata, Zeremiah pakah tawhta a puapa Abeipa bie a vaw tlôpaki thei nawpa ta, Abeipa ta Persia bei Kôresâ palôh pathyu ta. Chatanachata a khinarâh zydua liata biephuahpa tao ta, hetana heta ropa ta a papua:

“Persia bei Kôresâ ta hetana heta a tah, ‘ Abeipa, avâ Khazohpa ta khizaw khinarâh zydua na pie ha ta, Zudâh râh Zerusale khihpi liata ano châta o sapa awpa ta bi eina pie. Nama hry liata ano phopi a châpa maih chô liata Abeipa a Khazohpa cha a hnohta y sala, Zerusale lâ cha khy mawh sy,’” tah ta.

Persia bei Kôresâ â beina kô khana liata, Zeremiah pakah tawhta a puapa Abeipa bie a vaw tlôpaki thei nawpa ta, Abeipa ta Persia bei Kôresâ palôh pathyu ta. Chatanachata a khinarâh zydua liata biephuahpa tao ta, hetana heta ropa ta a papua:
“Persia bei Kôresâ ta hetana heta a tah: Abeipa, avâ Khazohpa ta khizaw khinarâh zydua na pie ha ta, Zudâh râh Zerusale khihpi liata ano châta o sapa awpa ta bi eina pie.

Nama hry liata ano phopi a châpa maih chô liata a Khazohpa cha a hnohta y sala, Zudâh râh liata Zerusale lâ khy sala, Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa o cha kaw sa mawh sy. Abeipa cha Zeru­sale liata a ypa Khazohpa a châ.

Laibâhpazy cha khataih su liata ama ypa chhao ta, ama yna su liata chyhsazy ta tâkâzy, ngôhzy, hmobaohzy nata sahrohzy ta ama bao chyu awpa a châ. Hezy he Zerusale liata Khazohpa o châta lôhthai sôh ama thyupazy hleikhô ta ama thyu via awpazy a châ,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Zudâh nata Benzami pho pawhrâhpazy, theihthaipazy, Livai pathlazy nata Zerusale liata Abeipa o paduapathi awpa ta Khazohpa ta a palôh a pathyupa zydua thyu ei ta.
Chyhsazy ta lôhthai sôh ama thyupazy hleikhô ta, ama chheipâh liata chyhsa zydua ta tâkâ hmobaoh­zy, ngôhzy, hmozy, sahrohzy nata hmo sôhpazy piepa ta, ama ku tha patlô ei ta.
Bei Kôresâ chhao ta, Nebukaneza ta Abeipa o liata hmobaohzy Zerusale tawhta phaoh ta a khazohzy o liata a sopazy thaoh papua hra ta.
Chazy cha Persia bei Kôresâ ta sôh avaotuhpa Mitharedâ mohôhna ry liata thaoh papua ta, Mitharedâ ta sôh cha reih ta, Zudâh pawhrâhpa Sebâza hlâ ta.
A ziepa cha, ngôh rahô 30, tâkâ rahô 1,000, chaizôh 29,
ngôh biebuh 30, tâkâ biebuh 410 nata hmobaoh hropa 1,000 châ ta,
ngôh nata tâkâ hmobaohzy cha a zydua ta 5,400 a châ. Babylaw liata sei ta a tâhpazy Zerusale lâ a chhipa ama châ nota, Sebâza ta cha hmobaoh zydua cha Zerusale lâ a phaoh khai haw.
Hezy he Babylaw bei Nebukaneza ta Zudâh râh tawhta Babylaw lâ sei ta â chhipa, Zerusale nata Zudâh râh liata ama khih lâ chyu ta a vaw kuapazy ama châ.
Chazy cha Zerubâbe, Zesua, Nehemiah, Seriah, Relai, Môdekai, Bilsâ, Mispâ, Bikavai, Rehu nata Bânâ zy hnohta â liepazy ama châ. He he seichâna tawhta a vaw kuapa Izarei phopi maluh a châ:
Pârô pathlazy 2,172;
Sephatiah pathlazy 372;
Arâh pathlazy 775;
Pâhamôabâ pathlazy tawhta Zesua nata Zôabâ pathlazy 2,812;
Elâmi pathlazy 1,254;
Zatu pathlazy 945;
Zakai pathlazy 760;
Bâni pathlazy 642;
Bebai pathlazy 623;
Azkâ pathlazy 1,222;
Adônikâ pathlazy 666;
Bikavai pathlazy 2,056;
Adinâ pathlazy 454;
Ate pathlazy tawhta Hezekia pathlazy 98;
Bezai pathlazy 323;
Zôrâh pathlazy 112;
Hâsu pathlazy 223;
Kibâ pathlazy 95;
Bethlehe pathlazy 123;
Netôpha mo 56;
Anathô mo 128;
Azamâve pathlazy 42;
Kiriathari, Kephirâh nata Berô pathlazy 743;
Râmâ nata Kebâ pathlazy 621;
Mikamâ mo 122;
Bethel mo nata Ai mozy 223;
Nebô pathlazy 52;
Mâkabi pathla 156;
Elâmi pathla hropazy 1,254;
Hâri pathlazy 320;
Lôdi, Hâdi nata Ônô pathlazy 725;
Zerikô pathlazy 345;
Senâ pathlazy 3,630.
He he theihthaipa a vaw liepazy maluh a cha: Zesua pho Zediah pathlazy 973;
Ime pathlazy 1,052;
Pâsu pathlazy 1,247;
Hâri pathlazy 1,017.
Livai pathlazy hry liata Hôdaviah pathla Zesua nata Kâdamie pathlazy tawhta 74 amâ vaw lie.
Hlasathaipazy hry tawhta Asâpha pathlazy 128 amâ vaw lie.
Chhikao vaituhpazy hry tawhta Sâluh pathlazy, Ate pathlazy, Talmô pathlazy, Aku pathlazy, Hâti pathlazy nata Sôbai pathlazy, ama zydua ta 139 amâ vaw lie.
Achhyna o liata chakaotuhpa a vaw liepazy cha Ziha pathlazy, Hâsupha pathlazy, Tâbao pathlazy,
Kerô pathlazy, Siaha pathlazy, Pâdô pathlazy,
Lebanâ pathlazy, Hâkabâ pathlazy, Aku pathlazy,
Hâkâ pathlazy, Salmai pathlazy, Hâna pathlazy,
Kide pathlazy, Kâhâ pathlazy, Reai pathlazy,
Rezi pathlazy, Nekôdâ pathlazy, Kâzamâ pathlazy,
Uza pathlazy, Pâsia pathlazy, Besai pathlazy,
Asnâ pathlazy, Muni pathlazy, Nephusi pathlazy,
Bâkabu pathlazy, Hâkupha pathlazy, Hâhu pathlazy,
Bâzlu pathlazy, Mehidâ pathlazy, Hâsâh pathlazy,
Bakô pathlazy, Siserâ pathlazy, Temâ pathlazy,
Neziah pathlazy nata Hâtipha pathlazy ama châ.
Sawlawmaw chakaotuhpa a vaw liepazy cha Sôtai pathlazy, Hâsôphere pathlazy, Perudâ pathlazy,
Zalâh pathlazy, Dâkô pathlazy, Kide pathlazy,
Sephatiah pathlazy, Hâti pathlazy, Pôkerehazibai pathlazy nata Ami pathlazy ama châ.
Achhyna o chakaotuhpazy nata Sawlawmaw chakaotuhpazy pathla a vaw liepazy cha, ama zydua ta 392 ama châ.
He sahlaozy he Temelâ, Tehâsâ, Keru, Adanâ nata Ime zy tawhta â khypazy châ ei ta, Izarei saw ama châ nata châ lei deikua cha, ama pho nata ama thyutôna a laichadai thei veih ei:
Chazy cha Deliah pathlazy, Tôbia pathlazy nata Nekôdâ pathlazy châ ei ta, ama zydua ta 652 ama châ.

Theihthaipa a vaw liepazy cha Hâbiah pathlazy, Hâkô pathlazy nata Bâzilai pathlazy ama châ. Bâzilai pathlazy cha, chyhsa pakha ta Kilia chyhsa Bâzilai sawchanô lapinô ta hnei ta, ama moh a phaoh pâ hapa pathlazy ama châ.
Cha sahlaozy cha theihthaipazy thyutôna rona châbu liata ama moh tlua ei ta, châhrasala hmô leipa ei ta, chavâta pathaih leipa hawhta pachâpa châ ei ta, theihthaipazy hry liata pahlaopa châ veih ei.
Râhvaotuhpa ta ama hnohta, “Uri nata Thumi a saohiah theipa theihthaipa a y hlâlei pati pathaih chaipazy ama nie awpa châ mâh vei,” tahpa ta a chho ei.
Seichâna tawhta a vaw kuapa Zawpi maluh zydua cha 42,360 a châ.
Chazy thota ama seichapaw nata seichanô 7,337 a hlao ei ta, hlasathaipa chanô nata chapaw 200 amâ hlao.
Arâ 736, sabaitu 245,
râraoseihpa 435 nata alâ 6,720 ama hnei.
Zerusale liata Abeipa o ama tlô nahta, chhôhkha pawhrâhpa thokhazy ta, a su ualuapa liata Khazohpa o padua heih nawpa ta, lôhthai sôhzy thyu ei ta.
Ama thyu theipa rakha ta thyu chyu ei ta, o sana sôh sopakhyna liata ngôh dari 61,000, tâkâ minâ 5,000 nata theihthaipa viahkao 100 ama pangia.

Chatanachata theihthaipazy, Livai pathlazy vâtlâh tho­khazy, hlasathaipazy, chhikao vaituhpazy nata Achhyna o liata chakaotuhpazy cha ama khih chyu liata pahrâ khai ei ta, Izarei saw hropazy chhao ama khih chyu liata ama pahrâ khai.
Thla sarina vaw tlô ta, Izarei sawzy ama khih chyu liata ama pahrâ khai nahta, zawpizy reihkha tlapa ta Zerusale liata a hmaohpakhy ei ta.

Zôzadâ sawchapawpa Zesua nata theihthaipa chakaona rai a hrialâhpazy nata Siati sawchapawpa Zerubâbe nata a heinawhzy thyu ei ta, Khazohpa chyhsa Mawsi Ryhpa liata ropa hawhta, raopa hlânazy hlâ nawpa ta, Izarei Khazohpa maisâh tao ei ta.
Maisâh cha a y tyhna su liata padua ei ta, cha râhzy liata a pahrâpa phopizy ama chipa vâta, my nata zâlâ ta hlâpa, raopa hlânazy cha maisâh liata ama hlâ tyh.
Ryhpa liata ropa hawhta, Byureih Kyhchhi hmâh ei ta, noh chareih ta hlâ awpa zie raopa hawhta raopa hlânazy ama hlâ.
Cha khai tawhta, raopa hlâna hlâ tyhpazy, thla thieh atheihna hlâ tyhpazy, Abeipa kyhchhi raopa zydua liata atheihna hlâ tyhpazy nata Abeipa lâta lôhthai hmohlâpazy ama hlâ tyh.
Raopa hlânazy cha thla sarina, noh khana tawhta Abeipa lâta ama hlâ pathao. Abeipa Achhyna o lôbô deikua bô mâh veih ei.

Chavâta lô nata tho raihria liata zôthaipazy hnohta sôh pie ei ta. Persia bei Kôresâ pasaina hawhta, Lebanaw tawhta tilaipi kiah liata Zôpâ khihpi taihta sidy tho vaw phao awpa ta, Sidaw mo nata Tyre mozy cha nie awpazy, do awpazy nata sathawzy ama pie.

Zerusale liata Khazohpa o ama tlô tawhta kô nona, thla nona liata, Siati sawchapawpa Zerubâbe nata Zôzadâ sawchapawpa Zesua nata ama heinawh theihthaipazy, Livai pathlazy nata seichâna tawhta Zerusale lâ a vaw liepa zydua ta Achhyna o paduapathina rai hria pathao ei ta. Kô kih tawhta chô lâ Livai pathlazy cha Abeipa o sana raihria hyutuhpazy ta ama rao.

Zesua nata a sawchapawzy nata a unawhzy, Zudâh pathla Kâdamie nata a sawchapawzy, Henadâ sawchapawzy, Livai pathlazy nata ama sawchapawzy nata ama unawhzy ta Khazohpa o liata raihriatuhpazy cha ama mohôh.

Osatuhpazy ta Abeipa Achhyna o lôbô ama bô nahta, theihthaipazy ta ama theihthaipa chysiazy ta a tobipa ta, chiahmiezy chabapa ta hmia lâ vaw pua ei ta, Livai chi Asâpha pathlazy chhao paotlâzy chabapa ta, Izarei bei Dâvi biepiepa hawhta Abeipa reithai awpa ta vaw pua hra ei ta.

Abeipa liata amâ lyna nata ano reithaina cha, “ Abeipa cha pha ta, A zawngiahna cha, Izarei chô liata chhâzaw ta a y,” tahpa ta hla ta amâ chhy palie. Abeipa o lôbô ama bô hapa vâta, zawpi zydua ta ao paro ngaitapa ta awh ei ta, Abeipa ama reithai.
O hmiatuapa a vaw hmô hapa theihthai pawpipa, Livai chi pawpipa nata pho pawhrâhpa hluhpizy deikua cha, o lôbô bôpa ama hmô nahta, chyhsa hluhpi a lypa ta ama awh hai nota, aoh tlili ta ama cha.
Zawpizy cha ao paro ngaitapa ta awh ei ta, lâhlapi tawhta ama pyu thei theipa a châ. Chavâta chyhsazy ta alyna vâta awhpa ao ma, zawpi chapa ao ma tahpa chhao pachhaih thei khao veih ei.
Seichâna tawhta a vaw kuapa Zudâh mo nata Benzami mozy ta Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa Achhyna o ama sapa kyh cha ama khakhaipazy ta ama thei nahta,

Zerubâbe nata pho pawhrâhpazy lâ vawh ei ta, ama hnohta, “Eima cha sakhei aw, keimo chhao nâmo hawhta nama Khazohpa a chhy hra pi ta, he liata miah a vaw chhituhpa Asuria bei Esâhadô â bei no tawhna khata nâmo Khazohpa lâta atheihna eima hlâ lymâ,” tah ei ta.

Châhrasala Zerubâbe nata Zesua nata Izarei pho pawhrâhpa hropazy ta ama hnohta, “Eima Kha­zohpa o sana liata namâ hlao hra nawpa kyh y vei. Persia bei Kôresâ ta bie miah a piepa hawhta, keimo tlai ta Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa o cha eima sa aw,” tah ei ta.
Izarei râh liata a vaw y chiehpa chyhsazy ta Zudâh mo cha ama hnabei pady ei ta, o cha sa ngâh lei awpa ta pachhipary ei ta.
Persia bei Kôresâ a bei chhôh zydua ryhraokheituhpazy hnohta panaopapanazy piepa ta, Achhyna o sa amâ chhuahpa cha patypamâ lymâ ei ta. Persia bei Dâria â beina taihta cha hawhta ama tao lymâ.
Ahasuarâ â bei nota, â bei pathaona daihti liata, dyuhtuhpazy ta Zudâh nata Zerusale mo leihna châ ano lâ paphao ei ta.
Âtazezia â bei nota, Bislâ, Mitharedâ, Tabe nata ama hrialâhpazy ta Persia bei Âtazezia lâ châ paphao ei ta. Ama châ ropa cha Aramia reih ta ropa nata paliepa a châ.
Pheisaih hyutuhpa Rehu nata chârohtuhpa Sisai ta Zerusale mo leihna châ cha, Persia bei Âtazezia hnohta paphao ei ta.
Pheisaih hyutuhpa Rehu nata chârohtuhpa Sisai nata ama hrialâhpa ryureihtuhpazy, râhvaotuhpazy, hyutuhpazy, Persia mozy, Ere liata a ypazy, Babylaw mozy, Elâmi pathla Susâ liata a ypazy,
chyhsa rônahpa nata phapa Ôsnâpâ ta a chhi ta Samâri khihpizy liata nata Chavah Haosâ râh hropazy liata a sopa phopizy tawhta Bei Âtazezia lâ châ paphao ei ta.
He he ama châpaphaopa cha a châ: “Hy Bei Âtazezia, Chavah Haosâ râh liata a ypa châ chakaotuhpazy ta eima châ naoh.

Nâ tawhta keimo lâ a khypa Zuzy kha Zerusale lâ ama sie haw tahpa abei ta vaw pahno mawh sy. Chhorupa nata moleipa khihpi kha paduapathi ei ta, a thokhy paloh ha ei ta, tahmâ â bônazy ama pasiepakao hai.
He khihpi he paduapathipa ta, a thokhyzy ama paloh tita cha, râhpawzy, leimâzy nata chhiezy pie khoh khao leipa aw ei ta, abei sôh a tlapahnai aw tahpa abei ta pahno mawh sy.
Abei o alôh a paliepa eima châpa vâta, abei nohzaona a hmôtuhpa châ awpa cha, keimo châta khochhih lei kawpa a châ. Chavâta he châ he cha vaw paphao pi ta, eima cha pahnosa.

Châ pathlatuhpazy thâtih rona châbu liata vaw tlua tua awpa ta eima châ haw. He khihpi he chhorupa nata beizy nata râhzy châta tymâna a tlôkhei tyhpa khihpi châ ta, hlâno tawhta abei a dyuh awpa ta a thyu tyhpa khihpi a châzie thâtihzy rona châbu liata na hmô aw. Cha vâna chata he khihpi he roryhrapa ta a y hapa a châ.
He khihpi he paduapathipa châ sala, a thokhyzy palohpa a châ khiahta cha, Chavah Haosâ lâ he râh hnei khao aw va chi tahpa abei eima pahnosa,” tahpa ta.

Abei ta hetana heta achhyna châ a paphao: “Pheisaih hyutuhpa Rehu nata chârohtuhpa Sisai nata ama hrialâhpa Samâri râh nata Chavah Haosâ lâta a ypazy saih u, he hawhpa daihti lia heta nama chô liata thlalôhna y mawh sy.
Châ miah nama vaw paphaopa kha ei hmiakô liata a phapa ta reih ei ta.
Biepiepa tao na ta, tlua ei ta, kha khihpi kha hlâno tawhta abei a thyuhnao tyhpa, abei a paphasai ta a dyuh tyhpa khihpi a châ tlai tahpa hmôpapuapa a châ.
Bei thatlôpazy ta Zerusale chô liata ryu vaw reih ei ta. Âmo chata Chavah Haosâ râh zydua chô liata ryureih ei ta, cha beizy lâta râhpawzy, leimâzy, chhiezy ama vaw pie tyh.
Chavâta chyhsazy cha a chalih awpa ta biepie u la, biepiepa ei papua heih hlâlei khihpi ama paduapathi awpa châ vei.
Cha biepiepa tao awpa ta pahawhpasâh khuh vy. Khazia cha hmo cha lai via lymâpa ta, abei châta raona a vaw tlô aw?” tahpa ta.

Bei Âtazezia tawhta châ cha Rehu nata chârohtuhpa Sisai nata ama hrialâhpazy hmiakô liata ama rei khaipa nahta, a chatliepa ta Zerusale liata Zuzy lâ cha sie ei ta, thachahra nata biehneina hmâpa ta ama chalihsa haw.
Chatanachata Zerusale liata Khazohpa o raihria cha a chalih ha ta, Persia bei Dâria â beina kô nona taihta â chalih haw.
Cha daihti liata, hrohsopa Hâkai nata Idô sawchapawpa Zekaria ta Zudâh nata Zerusale liata Zu chyhsa a ypazy hnohta ama chô liata a ypa Izarei Khazohpa moh ta hrohsona bie phuah ei ta.

Siati sawchapawpa Zerubâbe nata Zôzadâ sawchapawpa Zesua cha thyu ei ta, Zerusale liata Khazohpa o paduapathina rai cha hria pathao heih ei ta. Khazohpa hrohsopazy chhao, âmo bao awpa ta ama hnohta y ei ta.
Cha nona chata Chavah Hao­sâ râhvaotuhpa Tâtenai nata Sethâbôzenai nata ama hrialâhpazy âmo lâ a vy ei ta, ama hnohta, “He o tôhtlâh padua ta, a o paloh awpa ta ahy ma bie châ pie ei?” tah ei ta.
“He o a satuhpazy he ama moh ahyzy ma ama châ?” tahpa ta hiahri ei ta.
Châhrasala Khazohpa mo cha Zu machâzy chô liata a choh ta, Dâria lâta tlôkheipa achhyna châ ama hmô hlâlei paduapathina raihria a chalih a chhuah veih ei.
He he Chavah Haosâ râh avaotuhpa Tâtenai nata Sethâbôzenai nata a hrialâhpa Chavah Haosâ lâta a ypa râhvaotuhpazy ta Bei Dâria hnohta châ ama paphaopa a châ.
Châ cha hetana heta roh ei ta, Bei Dâria lâ ama paphao: “Bei Dâria hnohta thlalôhna kipa y mawh sy.

He he abei ta vaw pahno mawh sy. Zudâh râh liata Khazohpa rônahpa o lâ khy pi ta. O cha alô lai ngaita­pazy ta sapa châ ta, a pâhchhôzy tho ta chhôhpa a châ. Ama ku liata rai cha a phapa ta sie ta, a hmasie lymâ.
‘He o tôhtlâh bô ta, a o paloh awpa heta ahy ma bie châ pie ei?’ tahpa ta ama machâzy hiahri pi ta.
Na pahno awpa ta, ama mohzy hiahri pi ta, ama chhituhpazy moh chhao eima roh khai.
Hetana heta miah amâ chhy: ‘Avâ nata alei Kha­zohpa chakaotuhpazy châ pi ta, kô hluhpi a sie hapa liata paduapa, Izarei bei rônahpa ta sa ta, a vaw paloh hapa o eima sa pathi.

Miah pathlatuhpazy ta avâ Khazohpa hie ama vaw pahâh hapa vâta, âmo cha Kaldia chyhsa Babylaw bei Nebukaneza ku liata pie ta, ano chata o he parao ta, Izarei chyhsazy cha Babylaw lâ sei ta â chhi ha ei.
Châhrasala Babylaw bei Kôresâ â beina kô khana liata, Bei Kôresâ ta he Khazohpa o he paduapathi awpa ta biepie ta.

Nebukaneza ta Zerusale liata Achhyna o liata ngôh nata tâkâ hmobaohzy la ta, Babylaw râh achhyna o liata a sopazy cha, Bei Kôresâ ta Babylaw achhyna o tawhta la ta, râhvaotuhpa ta a sopa Sebâza hnohta hlâ ta,
a hnohta, “He hmobaohzy he phaoh la, sie la, Zerusale liata Achhyna o liata soh la, Achhyna o cha a y tyhna su liata paduapathipa châ mawh sy,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Sebâza cha vaw tlô ta, Zerusale liata Achhyna o lôbô cha bô ta, cha daihti tawhta tahmâ taihta, o cha sa lymâpa châ ta, châhrasala patlôpa châ mâh vei,’ tah ei ta.

Chavâta abei ta pha a tah khiahta cha, Babylaw liata abei hmo parohpazy sopakhyna liata tluapa châ sala, Zerusale liata Khazohpa o he paduapathi awpa ta, Bei Kôresâ khata biepiepa a vaw tao tlai ma tahpa mo pasiapa châ sala, he kyh liata abei ta a khozie miah pahnosa mawh sy,” tah ei ta.
Chatawhcha Bei Dâria ta biepie ta, Babylaw liata hmo parohpa sopakhyna o liata châbu parohpazy tlua ei ta.
Media râh liata Ekabâtanâ khihpi liata abei o liata châchatypa, a chhôh liata he hawhta ropa hmô ei ta:

“Biepapuapa: Bei Kôresâ â beina kô khana liata, Bei Kôresâ ta hetana heta bie a papua: Zerusale liata Khazohpa o kyh liata, atheihna hlâna o cha paduapathipa châ sala, â bônazy pa-ipa châ mawh sy. O cha dy sycharu a sâh aw ta, dy sycharu a kawh aw.
A pâhchhôzy cha alô laipa tlâh thôh ta pachopa châ aw ta, a chô liata tho ta tlâh kha chhôhpa a châ aw. A hryuhna cha abei sôh tawhta piepa a châ aw.

Khazohpa o liata ngôh nata tâkâ hmobaohzy Nebukaneza ta Zerusale Achhyna o tawhta la ta, Babylaw lâ a phao hapazy chhao, kuakheipa châ sala, Zerusale liata Achhyna o liata âmo su chyu liata so heihpa châ mawh sy. Chazy cha Khazohpa o liata nama soh awpa a châ.
“Chavâta Chavah Haosâ râh liata râhvaotuhpa Tâtenai, Sethâbôzenai nata ama hrialâhpa Chavah Haosâ râh liata râhvaotuhpazy saih u, Achhyna o a paduapathituhpazy cha tlei teh u.
Khazohpa o ama sapa cha kheihta hmah tah khuh vy. Zu chyhsa râhvaotuhpazy nata Zu machâzy ta Khazohpa o cha a su parohpa liata paduapathi mawh ei sy.

Cha dei châ vei, Khazohpa Achhyna o paduapathina kyh liata, Zu machâzy châta nama tao awpa biepiepa ei tao. Hryuhna zydua pahawhpasâh leipa ta, Zu machâzy hnohta pie lymâ awpa châ ta, Chavah Haosâ râh tawhta râhpawzy tawhta piepa a châ aw.

Avâ Khazohpa lâta raopa hlânazy châta viahchao tôhpazy, mietaku tôhpazy nata mietakuzy â ngiahpa zie ta pie aw ei chi ta, âtâ sâh, alôh, kresawhti nata sathaw chhao, Zerusale liata theihthaipazy ta byuh ama tahpa hawhta nama pie lymâ aw. Chazy cha pathliethlaw leipa ta, noh chareih ta pie lymâ awpa a châ.
Chatanachata avâ Khazohpa a palysapa atheihnazy hlâ aw ei ta, abei nata a sawchapawzy hrona châta thlah ama chhâ tyh aw.
Ahy rai ta biepiepa ei taopa he a panano khiahta cha, a o pâkô thliepa châ aw ta, cha chata ano cha chhôpahlie aw ta, a o cha hnaihny thyna ta taopa a châ aw.

Biepiepa he panano awpa ta tlyma, Zerusale liata Khazohpa o parao awpa ta tlyma, a ku a hypa abei tlyma, phopi tlyma cha, cha liata a moh a paysatuhpa Khazohpa ta ano cha parao mawh sy. Kei Dâria ta biepiepa he ei papua. Phahnai ngiah ngaitapa ta zyh awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Chavah Haosâ râh avaotuhpa Tâtenai, Sethâbôzenai nata ama hrialâhpazy ta Bei Dâria châpaphaopa liata biepiepa zydua cha phahnaingiah ngaitapa ta tao ei ta.

Hrohsopa Hâkai nata Idô sawchapawpa Zekaria zy hrohsona bie phuahpa hawhta, Zu machâzy ta o cha sa ei ta, ama hmasie lymâ ta. Izarei Khazohpa biepiepa hawhta nata Persia beizy, Kôresâ, Dâria nata Âtazezia zy biepiepa hawhta, Achhyna o cha sa ei ta, ama paloh haw.
Achhyna o cha Bei Dâria abeina kô charuna, Adar thla, noh thôhna noh ta palohpa a châ.
Izarei sawzy, theihthaipazy, Livai pathlazy nata seichâna tawhta a vaw kuapazy ta a ly ngaitapa ta Khazohpa o cha ama hlâ.
Khazohpa o hlâna liata viahchao tôhpa 100, mietaku tôhpa 200, mietakutaw 400 hlâ ei ta. Izarei zydua châta moleina hlâna atheihna châta, Izarei chi zie hawhta, mie tôhpa pô 12 ama hlâ hra.
Mawsi Châbu liata ropa hawhta, Zerusale liata Khazohpa chakao awpa ta theihthaipazy nata Livai pathlazy cha âmo py chyu liata y awpa ta raopa ama châ.
Thla khana, noh hrawh hleipalihna noh liata, seichâna tawhta a vaw kuapazy ta Zawpakhô kyhchhi chay ei ta.

Theihthaipazy nata Livai pathlazy cha hmaohkha ta a pathai ei ta, ama zydua ta ama pathaih hapa vâta, Zawpakhô mietakutaw cha, seichâna tawhta a zâ liepazy, theihthaipa chakaona rai ama hrialâhpazy nata âmo châta thie ei ta.

Atheihna sa cha seichâna tawhta a vaw kuapa Izarei sawzy ta nie ei ta, Izarei râh liata a vaw pahrâpa phopizy pathaih leina tawhta a pananopa ta Abeipa Izarei Khazohpa a chhy awpa ta âmo a pazaopa maihta nie hra ei ta.

Thinô pahlao leipa Viahchhâ Kyhchhi cha noh sari chhôh a ly ngaitapa ta hmâh ei ta. Abeipa ta Asuria bei palôh âmo lâ paheisa ta, Izarei Khazohpa o sana liata ama ku tha a patlôpa vâta, Abeipa liata amâ ly ngaita.

Cha hnôhlâ ta, Persia bei Âtazezia â bei nota, Ezrâ cha Babylaw tawhta Zerusale lâ khy ta. Ezrâ cha Seriah sawchapawpa châ ta, Seriah cha Azariah sawchapawpa châ ta, Azariah cha Hikia sawchapawpa châ ta,
Hikia cha Sâluh sawchapawpa châ ta, Sâluh cha Zadô sawchapawpa châ ta, Zadô cha Ahitu sawchapawpa châ ta,
Ahitu cha Amaria sawchapawpa châ ta, Amaria cha Azariah sawchapawpa châ ta, Azariah cha Meraiô sawchapawpa châ ta,
Meraiô cha Zerahiah sawchapawpa châ ta, Zerahiah cha Uzizi sawchapawpa châ ta, Uzizi cha Buki sawchapawpa châ ta,
Buki cha Abisua sawchapawpa châ ta, Abisua cha Phinehâ sawchapawpa châ ta, Phinehâ cha Eliaza sawchapawpa châ ta, Eliaza cha theihthai beichaipa Arawna sawchapawpa a châ.
Ezrâ cha chârohtuhpa châ ta, Abeipa Izarei Khazohpa piepa Mawsi Ryhpa a thai ngaitapa a châ. Abeipa a Khazohpa ku a chô liata a ypa vâta, a hiapa maih abei ta a pie lymâ.
Bei Âtazezia â beina kô sarina liata, Izarei saw thokhazy, theihthaipa nata Livai pathla thokhazy, hlasathaipazy, chhikao vaituhpazy nata Achhyna o chakaotuhpazy Zerusale lâ khy hra ei ta.
Ezrâ cha thla pangawhna, Âtazezia abeina kô sarina kô ta Zerusale lâ sie ta.
Thla khana, noh khana noh ta Babylaw tawhta sie ta, a Khazohpa ku phapa a chô liata y ta, thla pangawhna, noh khana noh ta Zerusale cha tlô ta.
Ezrâ cha Abeipa Ryhpa a chu ta, â chupazy cha hrokhei ta, Abeipa bieraopazy nata pachianazy cha, Izarei liata pachu awpa ta a palôh liahsa tao ta.
He he Bei Âtazezia ta theihthaipa Ezrâ hnohta a piepa cha a châ. Theihthaipa Ezrâ cha chârohtuhpa châ ta, Abeipa biepiepazy nata Izarei sawzy châta a bieraopazy kyh liata athaipa a châ.
“Beizy bei Âtazezia ta avâ Khazohpa Ryhpa rohtuhpa theihthaipa Ezrâ ei châ naoh. He hawhpa daihti liana heta thlalôhna na hnohta y mawh sy.
Ei khinarâh chhôh liata Izarei sawzy tlyma, ama theihthaipazy tlyma, Livai pathlazy tlyma, âmo kho ta Zerusale lâ a sie khohpa maih na hnohta sie awpa ta biepiepa ei papua.
Na ku liata a ypa Khazoh Ryhpa hawhta, Zudâh nata Zerusale thâtih pasia awpa ta, abei nata a ryhraokheituhpa pasarizy ta eima cha tuah.
Abei nata a ryhraokheituhpazy ta âmo lôhthai ta Zerusale liata a ypa Izarei Khazohpa ama piepa tâkâ nata ngôh phaoh aw chi ta,
Babylaw râh zydua liata tâkâ nata ngôh na hmôpazy nata zawpi nata theihthaipazy ta Zerusale liata ama Khazohpa o châta âmo lôhthai ta ama piepazy na phaoh khai aw.

Cha sôhzy cha hmâpa ta, viahchao tôhpazy, mietaku tôhpazy, mietakutawzy nata ama niepa hlânazy nata dopa hlânazy phahnai khoh ngaitapa ta chalei aw chi ta, Zerusale liata nama Khazohpa o liata maisâh liata na hlâ aw.
Tâkâ nata ngôh hmâ laibâhpazy cha, nâ nata na unawhzy ta pha nama tahnazie hawhta, nama Khazohpa khozie ta nama hmâh thei aw.
Na Khazohpa o liata chakaona rai hria nawpa ta hmobaoh ama cha piepazy cha, Zerusale Khazohpa hmiakô liata na hlâ aw ei.
Na Khazohpa o châta byuh hropazy y sala, nâma patohpatia awpa chi a châ khiahta cha, abei sôh vaw hmâ lymâ mah y.

“Kei Bei Âtazezia tlai ta Chavah Haosâ râh liata sôh avaotuhpa zydua hnohta biepiepa ei papua: Avâ Khazohpa Ryhpa rohtuhpa theihthaipa Ezrâ ta a châ hnawpa maih ei cha, phahnai khoh ngaitapa ta nama taopa lymâ aw.
Tâkâ talent 100, sâh bai 100, kresawhti tibyh 100, sathaw tibyh 100 nata alôh zy a mâ leipa ta nama vaw pie lymâ aw.
Avâ Khazohpa ta bie a piepa maih, avâ Khazohpa o châta a zydua ta tao lymâpa châ mawh sy. Chataleipatala abei nata a sawchapawzy râh liana heta pathiiana a tlô pathlei aw.

Theihthaipazy, Livai pathlazy, hlasathaipazy, chhikao vaituhpazy, Achhyna o liata chakaotuhpazy nata Khazohpa o liata chakaotuhpa hropa zydua cha râhpaw tlyma, leimâ tlyma, hmohneipa chhie tlyma, pacheisa awpa ta ryhpa ta pasaih vei tahpa eima cha pahnosa.

“Chatawhcha nâ, Ezrâ y, na ku liata a ypa Khazohpa sona hawhta, Chavah Haosâ lâta a ypa râh zydua pachia awpa ta, na Khazohpa ryhpa a pahnopazy cha, pachiatuhpazy nata ryureituhpazy ta na rao aw ei. Na Khazohpa ryhpa a pahno leipazy cha na pachu aw ei.
Na Khazohpa ryhpa nata abei ryhpa a zyh leipa maih cha, hriena pasa ngaitapa ta hriepa châ aw ta, thiepa tlyma, râh tawhta papuapa tlyma, a hmohneipa lapa tlyma, patâhpa tlyma a châ aw,” tah ta.
Zerusale liata Abeipa o â ngia ngaitapa ta tobi awpa ta, cha hawhpa hmo cha abei palôh liata sopa ta,

abei nata a ryhraokheituhpazy hmiakô liata nata bei pheisaih hyutuhpazy hmiakô ta ei chô liata ngiachhiena a palâsatuhpa Abeipa, miah pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa cha reithaipa ta y mawh sy. Abeipa ei Khazohpa ku ei chô liata a ypa vâta, ei tha a patlô na ta, na sielâh awpa ta Izarei chhituhpazy ei pahmaoh ei.
Hezy he Izarei pho pawhrâhpazy châ ei ta, Bei Âtazezia â bei nota, Babylaw tawhta ei hnohta Zerusale lâ a siepa Izarei sawzy thyutôna a châ:
Phinehâ pathlazy tawhta Kesao, Ithamâ pathlazy tawhta Dâniah, Dâvi pathlazy tawhta Hâtu,
Sekaniah pathlazy tawhta Pârô pathlazy hry liata Zekaria nata a hnohta moh ropa pawtlohpa 150;
Pâhamôabâ pathlazy tawhta Zerahiah sawchapawpa Eliehônai nata pawtlohpa 200,
Zatu pathlazy tawhta Sekaniah sawchapawpa Zahâzie nata pawtlohpa 300,
Adinâ pathlazy tawhta Zawnathâ sawchapawpa Ebe nata pawtlohpa 50,
Elâmi pathlazy tawhta Athaliah sawchapawpa Zesai nata pawtlohpa 70,
Sephatiah pathlazy tawhta Mikaila sawchapawpa Zebadiah nata pawtlohpa 80,
Zôabâ pathlazy tawhta Zehie sawchapawpa Ôbadia nata pawtlohpa 218,
Bâni pathlazy tawhta Zosiphiah sawchapawpa Selômi nata pawtlohpa 160,
Bebai pathlazy tawhta Bebai sawchapawpa Zekaria nata pawtlohpa 28,
Azkâ pathlazy tawhta Hâkatâ sawchapawpa Zôhanâ nata pawtlohpa 110,
hnôh chai ta a vaw tlôpa Adônikâ pathlazy tawhta moh ropa Eliphele, Zuli, Semiah nata pawtlohpa 60 nata
Bikavai pathlazy tawhta Uthai nata Zaku nata pawtlohpa 70 zy ama châ.
Ahavâ lâta a lohpa chavah liata pahmaohpakhy ei na ta, cha liata noh thôh y pi ta. Zawpizy nata theihthaipazy cha moh ei na ta, cha liata Livai pathla pakha chhao hmô leipa na ta.
Chavâta chhituh viapa Elieze, Arie, Semiah, Enâthâ, Zari, Enâthâ, Nâthâ, Zekaria nata Mesulâ zy paawsa na ta, hmo a pahnopa Zôiari nata Enâthâ zy chhao paawsa na ta.

Âmo cha Kâsiphia su liata chhituhpa Idô lâ tuah ei na ta, eima Khazohpa o liata a chakao awpazy a vaw chhi awpa ta, Kâsiphia su liata achhyna o chakaotuhpa Idô nata a unawhzy hnohta kei reih awpa ta ei chho ei.

Khazohpa ku phapa eima chô liata y ta, hmo a pahno thaipa chyhsa Serebiah nata a sawchapawzy nata a heinawhzy pahrawh hleicharie a vaw chhi ei ta. Serebiah cha Mâhli pathlazy hry liatapa châ ta, Mâhli paw cha Livai châ ta, Livai paw cha Izarei a châ.
Hâsabiah nata Merâri pathlazy tawhta Zesai nata a heinawhzy nata ama sawchapawzy pakih vaw sie hra ei ta.
Chazy hleikhô ta, Dâvi nata a beimachâzy ta Livai pathlazy bao awpa ta ama raopa Achhyna o chakaotuhpa 220 amâ hlao. Ama zydua ta ama moh roh khaipa a châ.

Chatawhcha keimo nata eima sawzy nata eima hmohneipazy lâpi liata â bohpa ta eima sie thei nawpa ta hiah awpa ta, eima Khazohpa hmiakô liata a panawhpa ta, kâhvileipa ta thlahchhâ awpa ta, Ahavâ chavah liata phuah na ta.

“Eima Khazohpa ku cha ano a tluatuhpa zydua chô liata phana châta y tyh ta, a pathiiana hmotaotheina deikua cha, ano a heisaituhpa zydua chô liata a y tyh,” tahpa ta abei eima chho hapa vâta, lâpi liata eima chariahzy tawhta miah vaih awpa pheisaih nata arâ pheisaihzy abei lâta hia awpa ei noza kawpa vâta, kâhvileipa ta thlahchhâna cha ei phuahpa a châ.
Chatanachata kâhvileipa ta ypa ta, abohna châta eima Khazohpa cha hiah pi ta. Eima Khazohpa ta eima hiana cha miah nathlie ta.
Theihthaipa pawhrâh viapazy hry liata pahrawh hleino, Serebiah nata Hâsabiah nata ama unawh pahrawhzy panano ei na ta.
Bei nata a ryhraokheituhpazy, a beimachâzy nata cha liata a ypa Izarei zydua ta eima Khazohpa o châta ama hlâpa tâkâ, ngôh nata hmobaohzy cha khopathliahna ta pathliahpa ei na ta.
Tâkâ talent 650, tâkâ hmobaoh talent 200, ngôh talent 100,
dari 1,000 chyu a hripa ngôh biebuh 20, ngôh tlu ta a sôhpa dawh pathliepa a ngia ngaitapa hmobaoh miano ama ku liata hlâ na ta.
Ama hnohta, “ Abeipa châta pathaihpa châ ei chi ta, hmobaohzy chhao pathaih ei ta, tâkâ nata ngôh zy he Abeipa, châ pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa châta lôhthai thyuna sôh sai a châ.
Theihthaipa pawhrâh viapazy nata Livai pathlazy nata Izarei pho pawhrâhpazy hmiakô liata Zerusale liata Abeipa o chhôhpadâhpa liata kho nama pathliah hlâlei cha vaih u la, a vao teh u,” tah na ta.
Theihthaipazy nata Livai pathlazy ta Zerusale liata eima Khazohpa o lâ cheih awpa ta, tâkâ nata ngôh nata hmobaoh khopathliahpazy cha la ei ta.

Chatawhcha Zerusale lâ sie awpa­ ta, thla khana, noh hrawh hleinona noh ta, Ahavâ chavah tawhta pua pi ta. Eima Khazohpa ku cha eima chô liata y ta, lâpi liata miah a byhpa eima chariahzy ku tawhta miah pachha lymâ ta.
Zerusale tlô pi ta, cha liata noh thôh y pi ta.

A noh palihna noh ta, tâkâzy, ngôhzy nata hmobaohzy cha eima Khazohpa o liata khopathliah pi ta, Uria sawchapawpa theihthaipa Meremô ku liata eima hlâ. A hnohta Phinehâ sawchapawpa Eliaza chhao y ta. Livai chi Zesua saw­chapawpa Zôzabâ nata Binu sawchapaw­pa Nôdiah zy ama hnohta y hra ei ta.
Ngôh nata tâkâ nata hmobaoh zydua cha rei khaipa nata khopathliah khaipa châ ta, â hrina zie chhao ro khaipa a châ.

Cha daihti liata, paipatlapa, seichâna tawhta a vaw kuapazy ta Izarei Khazohpa lâta raopa hlânazy hlâ ei ta. Viahchao tôhpa pô hrawh hleino, mietaku tôhpa sychaki nata pô charu, mietakutaw sysari nata pô sari Izarei zydua châta hlâ ei ta. Cha zydua cha Abeipa lâta raopa hlâna sai a châ.
Abei biepapuapa cha, Chavah Haosâ lâta beimachâzy nata râhvaotuhpazy pie ei ta, âmo ta zawpi nata Khazohpa o raihriazy cha ama bao lymâ.

Cha hmozy taopa a châ khai nahta, beimachâzy kei lâ a vy ei ta, ei hnohta, “Izarei sawzy nata theihthaipazy nata Livai pathlazy ta he râh liata a vaw pahrâpa phopizy tawhta a panano leipa ei ta, Kâna mo, Hiti mo, Perizi mo, Zebu mo, Amawna mo, Môabâ mo, Izi mo nata Amawri mo hmotaopa pasichhihpazy ama tao hra.

Ama sawchanôzy cha âmo nata ama sawchapawzy ta lapinô ta hnei ei ta, chatanachata chi pathaihpa cha, cha râh liata phopi hropazy chi nata a pahlaopahlipa ta a y haw. He ngâchhih leina kyh liana heta beimachâzy nata chhituhpazy ama châ pachai,” tahpa ta na chho ei ta.
Cha thâtih cha ei theipa nahta, ei viahkao nata ei poh hrie nata, ei sâ nata ei kâhhmi phia na ta, a pachâna pahno leipa ta a tyuh na ta.

Cha hawhta a pachâna pahno leipa ta zâlâ atheihna hlâ daihti taihta ei tyuh thlâh nota, seichâna tawhta a vaw kuapazy paraona vâta Izarei Khazohpa bie ta a chalyupazy ei kiapâh liata a vaw hmaoh ei ta.
Zâlâ atheihna daihti liata kâhvileipa ta ei ypa tawhta thyu na ta, ei viahkao nata ei poh a hrie khai hapazy chhaota ei pakhu paneih na ta, Abeipa ei Khazohpa hmiakô lâ ei bâh pazawh na ta, a hnohta,
“Hy ei Khazohpa y, nâ lâ a vaw heih awpa he ei noza ta ei hmia a chhie kaw dia. Hy ei Khazohpa, eima paraonazy cha eima luh hlâta a sâh via ta, eima thaileichâna ta avâ a kaw daih haw.

Miah pathlatuhpazy daihti tawhta tanoh taihta thata thailei a châpa eima châ. Eima paraonazy vâta, keimo nata eima beizy nata eima theihthaipazy cha, râh hropa beizy ku liata nata zaozi ta thie awpa ta hlâpa châ pi ta, seichâna lâta a chhi awpa nata hrao awpa ta hlâpa eima châ. Tanoh taihta noza hmiachhiepa ta eima y.

Tahmâ deikua cha, Abeipa eima Khazohpa ta bohpi leipa chhôh khokheina miah patosa ta, laibâhpazy miah pahlôhpa ta, a su pathaihpa liata abohna miah pie ta. Eima mozy pavâ awpa nata seichâna tawhta a chyhta a hua awpa ta, eima Khazohpa ta miah pasaih ta.

Seizy châ pi ta, châhrasala eima Khazohpa cha eima seichâna liata miah a heihsai vei. Persia beizy hmiakô liata eima chô liata a zawngiahna a palâsa. Eima Khazohpa o padua ta, a raonazy taopathi awpa ta, eima seichâna tawhta miah pahua ta, Zudâh nata Zerusale liata abohna thokhyzy miah a taopa.
“Hy eima Khazohpa, khâpa eima reih khao aw? Na biepiepazy a heihsai pi ta,

châ chakaotuhpa hrohsopazy hmâpa ta, ‘Hnei awpa ta namâ ngia awpa râh cha, a râh liata a pahrâpa phopizy pathaih leina ta a puapa râh châ ta, râh âthaona tawhta achhâna taihta ama pasichhihna nata puana ta a biepa a châ.

Chavâta nama sawchanôzy ama sawchapawzy pahneisa leipa u la, ama sawchanôzy nama sawcha­pawzy pahneisa hra leipa u la, âmo nata adyryhna nata ama byhnâ awna zy tlua khuh vy. Chatanachata thatlôpa ta y aw ei chi ta, râh phana nie aw ei chi ta, râh cha nama sawzy châta chhâzaw ta ama to awpa ryu ta nama paryu thei aw,’ tahpa biepiepazy eimâ heihsai haw.

Eima chô liata hmo tlôpazy he moleina hmo eima taopazy nata eima thaileichâna lai ngaitapazy vâta a châ. Chatanachôta Hy eima Khazohpa y, eima moleina nata â phuhpa hlâta a nai viapa ta miah hrie chi ta, he hawhta laibâhpazy miah na pahlôh.

Na biepiepazy parao heihpa ta, hmo pasichhihpa a taopa, he phopizy nata eimâ hnei pahlao lymâ aw ma? Cha hawhta eima tao khiahta cha, eima chô liata thata na hiehâhpa ta, laibâhpa nata ahrohpazy y khao leina taihta miah na pahleipadia khai dâhdei ha aw cha zaw!

Hy Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa y, nâ cha adopa châ chi ta, tanoh ta hmo a ypa hawhna heta, keimo cha laibâhpa a râpazy eima châ. Moh tua, eima thaileichâna chhaota na hmiakô liata eima y hih. Eima thaileichâna vâta, na hmiakô liata a duah thei awpa pakha hmah y ma pi,” tah na ta.

Ezrâ cha Khazohpa o hmiakô liata â khu lâta pao ta, chana chôta thlahchhâ ta, moleinazy palâhâh ta reihpha a chei hai nota, Izarei saw hluhpi, chapawzy, chanôzy nata hawtizy ano lâ a vaw hmaoh ei ta, aoh tlili ta cha ei ta.

Elâmi pathla Zehie sawchapawpa Sekaniah ta Ezrâ hnohta, “Eima Kha­zohpa châta ngâ a chhih khao leipa pi ta, he râh liata chihropa chanôzy lapinô ta vaw hnei pi ta, cha hawhta a châpa chhao ta, Izarei châta hnabeiseihna a y chy.

Chavâta ei zibeipa nata eima Khazohpa biepiepa ta a chalyupazy ryhraokheipa hawhta, Izarei sawzy ta chihropa zuah lapinô ta ama hneipa zydua nata ama sawzy papua khai awpa ta, eima Khazohpa liata bie hraih ei suh u. Cha hawhta eima tao tita deikua cha, Ryhpa hawhta taopa châ mawh sy.
Thyu la, tao mah y, na maophaohna mah a châ tâh, na hnohta eima y. Thatlôpa ta y la, tao mah y,” tah ta.
Ezrâ cha thyu ta, theihthaipa pawhrâh viapazy, Livai pathlazy nata Izarei saw zydua cha, cha bie hawhta tao awpa ta bie pataihsa ta. Chatanachata bie a taih ei ta.

Ezrâ cha Khazohpa o hmiakô tawhta a pasie ta, Eliasi sawcha­pawpa Zôhanâ chhôhpadâhpa liata a ngia ta. Seichâna tawhta a vaw kuapazy ngâchhih leina kyh liata mâchhie a sapa vâta, viahchhâ nie leipa nata ti chhao do leipa ta, cha liata azozâkhihdei y ta.
Seichâna tawhta a vaw kuapa Zudâh râh nata Zerusale liata a ypa zydua hnohta Zerusale liata a hmaohpakhy awpa ta bie papuapa châ ta.

Ahy rai chhituhpazy nata machâzy biepiepa hawhta, noh thôh chhôh ta a vaw tlô leipa cha, a hmohneipa zydua patu khaipa châ aw ta, ano chhao seichâna tawhta a vaw kuapazy py tawhta papuapa a châ aw tahpa bie papuapa a châ.

Zudâh nata Benzami mo zydua noh thôh chhôh ta Zerusale liata a hmaohpakhy ei ta. Thla chakina, noh kihna noh ta amâ hmaohpakhy. Zawpi zydua cha Khazohpa o tlyhmia kawhpa liata a tyuh ei ta, cha biezy vâta nata vâsua ru ngaitapa vâta thata a chalyu ei ta.
Theihthaipa Ezrâ a kaw duah ta, ama hnohta, “Ngâchhihna pahlei ei chi ta, chihropa chanô nama hneipa vâta, Izarei thaileichâna papôhsapa a châ.

Chavâta tahmâ Abeipa, châ pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa liata nama moleinazy palâhâhpa ta reihpha cheih u la, a khopa tao u la, he râh liata a pahrâpa phopizy nata chihropa lapinô ta nama hneipazy tawhta a panano teh u,” tah ta.
Zawpi zydua ta ao paro ngaitapa ta a chhy ei ta, “Chata châ mawh sy; na reipa hawhta eima tao aw.

Anodeikua zawpi he hluh tlôh pi ta, avâ hra ru ngaita ta, khôtho liata a duah thei khao ma pi. Cha kyh liata thata hmo vaw parao ha pi ta, chavâta cha hmo cha noh kha noh no ta tao thei awpa chi châ vei.

Eima beimachâzy ta Zawpi zydua vyuhpa ta a duah ei sala, eima khihpizy liata chihropa lapinô a hneipa zydua cha, khihpi to liata machâzy nata ryureituhpazy chhaota, amâ vy nawpa daihti raopa liata a vy lymâ ei sala, chihropa lapinô ta hneipa vâta eima chô liata Khazohpa pathiiana ru ngaitapa cha pakuasapa a châ hlâlei, cha hawhta tao lymâ mawh ei sy,” tah ei ta.
Cha bie cha Asahe sawchapawpa Zawnathâ nata Tikavâ sawchapawpa Zazei deita ta khoh leipa ei ta, Livai chi Mesulâ nata Sabethai ta âmo cha a châh ei ta.

Seichâna tawhta a vaw kuapazy deikua cha, cha hawhta tao ei ta. Theihthaipa Ezrâ ta ama pho yzie lymâ hawhta ama moh ropa ta pho pawhrâhpazy a tlyh ta. Thla hrawhna, noh khana noh ta, cha bie cha pachâ awpa ta a tyuhpakhy ei ta.
Thla khana, noh khana noh ta, chihropa chanô a hneipa chapawzy cha pahno khai ei ta.
Hezy he theihthaipa sawzy hry tawhta chihropa chanô lapinô ta a hneipazy ama châ: Zôzadâ sawchapawpa Zesua pathlazy nata a unawhzy tawhta Mâsei, Elieze, Zari nata Kedaliah zy châ ei ta,
âmo chata ama lapinôzy a chhaih awpa ta bie a taih ei ta, ama thaileichâna atheihna hlâna châta mietaku zaw tawhta mietaku tôhpa pô kha ama hlâ.
Ahropazy cha Ime pathlazy tawhta Hânani nata Zebadiah;
Hâri pathlazy tawhta Mâsei, Elaizâh, Semiah, Zehie nata Uziah;
Pâsu pathlazy tawhta Eliônai, Mâsei, Ismela, Nethane, Zôzabâ nata Eliasâ zy ama châ.
Livai pathlazy tawhta Zôzabâ, Simei, Kelitâ ama tahpa Keliah, Pethâhiah, Zudâh nata Elieze zy châ ei ta,
hlasathaipazy tawhta Eliasi nata chhikao vaituhpazy tawhta Sâluh, Tele nata Uri zy ama châ.
Hezy he Izarei sawzy hry liata chihropa lapinô ta a hneipazy ama châ: Pârô pathlazy tawhta Ramiah, Iziah, Mâkia, Mizami, Eliaza, Hâsabiah nata Beniah;
Elâmi pathlazy tawhta Mâtaniah, Zekariah, Zehie, Abadi, Zeremô nata Elaizâh;
Zatu pathlazy tawhta Eliônai, Eliasi, Mâtaniah, Zeremô, Zabâdi nata Aziza;
Bebai pathlazy tawhta Zehôhanâ, Hânaniah, Zabai nata Athlai;
Bâni pathlazy tawhta Mesulâ, Mâluh, Adiah, Zasu, Sialâ nata Zeremô;
Pâhamôabâ pathlazy tawhta Adanâ, Khelâ, Benai, Mâsei, Mâtaniah, Bezale, Binu nata Manase;
Hâri pathlazy tawhta Elieze, Isizah, Mâkia, Semiah, Simeôna,
Benzami, Mâluh nata Semariah;
Hâsu pathlazy tawhta Mâtenai, Mâtatâh, Zabâ, Eliphele, Zeremai, Manase nata Simei;
Bâni pathlazy tawhta Mâdai, Amrâ, Ule,
Benai, Bedei, Keluhi,
Vâniah, Meremô, Eliasi,
Mâtaniah, Mâtenai nata Zaâsu;
Binu pathlazy tawhta Simei,
Selemiah, Nâthâ, Adiah,
Mâkhanâdebai, Sasai, Sarai,
Azare, Selemiah, Semariah,
Sâluh, Amaria nata Zawsi;
Nebô pathlazy tawhta Zeili, Mâtithiah, Zabâ, Zebinâ, Zadai, Zôela nata Benai zy ama châ.
Cha zydua cha chihropa chanô lapinô ta a hneipazy châ ei ta, ama lapinôzy cha ama sawzy chhaota ama pasiesa haw.
Hezy he Hâkaliah sawchapawpa Nehemiah biezy a châ. Kô kihna, Kislev thla liata, Susâ liata abei o liata ei y nota,
ei unawhpa Hânani nata Zudâh râh tawhta chyhsa thokhazy vaw tlô ei ta. Seichâna tawhta a puapa Zu chyhsazy nata Zerusale thâtihzy hiahri ei na ta.

Âmo ta ei hnohta, “Seichâna tawhta a vaw kuapa, Zudâh râh liata ahrohpa ta a ypazy cha, nôpo ngaitapa nata noza hmiachhiepa ta y ei ta, Zerusale thokhy cho khai ha ta, a chhikaozy mei ta a kâ khai haw,” tahpa ta na chho ei ta.
Cha biezy cha ei thei nahta, thlai a tyuh na ta, cha na ta, noh hluhpi mâchhiesa na ta, avâ Khazohpa hmiakô liata kâhvileipa ta thlahchhâ na ta.
“Hy Abeipa, avâ Khazohpa, Khazohpa rônahpa nata zachhihpa, kyh cha pachâ ta, na biepiepa a zyhtuhpazy chô liata biehrai patlôpa ta, ngiachhiena a palâsatuhpa y,

Izarei sawzy moleina, na chô liata eima moleinazy reihpha ei cheina he na nah vaw pachôh la, na mo vaw padeih la, châ chakaotuhpa, na phopi Izarei sawzy châta, châ chakaotuhpa ta chhô nah zâ ta na hmiakô liata ei thlahchhâna he rie vaw nathlie mah y. Kei nata ei chiheihzy ta eima vaw molei haw.
Na chô liata hmo pha lei ngaitapa tao pi ta, châ cha­kaotuhpa Mawsi hnohta na piepa biepiepazy, bieraopazy nata ryhpazy zyh khoh ma pi.
Châ chakaotuhpa Mawsi hnohta, ‘Ngâ namâ chhih leipa khiahta cha, phopizy hry liata cha hiepatla aw ei na ta,

kei lâ vaw kuapa ta, ei biepiepazy zyhpa ta nama tao khiahta deikua cha, avâ chy chhâna taihta papuapa châ hra u la, cha tawhta châ chhi pakhy aw ei na ta, ei moh y nawpa ta ei tlyhpa su lâ ei châ chhi heih aw ei,’ tahpa ta bie na piepa kha, rie a thei mah y.
He sahlao he na hmotaotheina rônahpa nata na ku thatlôpa ta na chatlaipa, châ chakaotuhpazy nata na phopi ama châ hih.

Hy Abeipa, châ chakaotuhpa thlahchhâna lâ he na nah rie vaw pachôh mah y. Na moh china liata a lypa, châ chakaotuhpazy thlahchhâna lâ na nah vaw pachôh la, châ chakaotuhpa he tanoh hlao na patlohsa la, he chyhsa mohmô liana heta zawngiahna rie na patosa mah y,” tah na ta. Kei cha abei nyu hlâtuhpa ei châ.
Bei Âtazezia â beina kô kihna, Nisan thla liata, a hmiakô liata kresawhti ama vaw so nahta, kresawhti cha la na ta, abei pie na ta. Cha hlâta a hmiakô liata pachârôhna hmia phaoh beih leipa na ta.
Abei ta ei hnohta, “Tlâhleipa chhao châ leipa chi ta, khazia pachârôhna hmia na phaoh? Hmo hropa châ vei, palôh liata pachârôhna na hneipa vâta a châ,” na tah ta. Chi ngaita na ta.

Abei hnohta, “Abei cha hroh kôzaw mawh sy! Nâ pathlatuhpazy thlâ yna khihpi cha roryhrapa ta y ta, a chhikaozy chhao mei ta a kâ khai nota, kheihta ma pachârôhna hmia phaoh leipa ta ei y thei aw,” tah na ta.
Abei ta, “Khâpa na hia khoh?” na tah ta. Avâ Khazohpa lâ thlahchhâ na ta.

Abei hnohta, “Abei ta paryhsa sala, châ chakaotuhpa he na modypa ei châ khiahta cha, Zudâh râh liata nâ pathlatuhpazy thlâ yna khihpi lâ na pasiesa la, cha khihpi cha paduapathi awpa ta na pasaih mah y,” tah na ta.
A kiapâh liata abeinô chhao a tyuh thlâh ha ta, abei ta, “Khachâ na hawh aw, khati nâ vaw lie heih aw?” na tah ta. A daihti ei taih nahta, abei cha a ly kawpa ta na pasiesa ta.
Abei hnohta, “Abei ta a paryhsa khiahta cha, Zudâh râh ei tlôna taihta ama râhzy siepahlie na pasai awpa ta, Chavah Haosâ râhvaotuhpazy lâta châ na taopa awpa ta ei châ haw.

Abei râhmâhpa avaotuhpa Asâpha hnohta chhao, Achhyna o dôhna chhikao tlâh, khihpi thokhy nata ei pahrâ nawpa o châta a ngiahpa thozy na pie awpa ta châ na taopa awpa ta ei châ haw,” tah na ta. Ei Khazohpa ku phapa cha ei chô liata y ta, abei ta ei hiapazy cha hlao na patloh ta.
Chavah Haosâ râhvaotuhpazy kô ei tlô nahta, abei châzy cha pie ei na ta. Na sielâh awpa ta, abei ta pheisaih hyutuhpazy nata arâ pheisaihzy tuah ta.
Cha thâtih cha Hôrô chyhsa Sanbâlâ nata Amawna chyhsa molaipa Tôbia ta ama vaw thei nahta, Izarei sawzy châta phana tao awpa ta a vaw tlô awpazy thâtih ta âmo cha palysa lei kaw ta.
Zerusale cha tlô na ta, cha liata noh thôh y na ta.

Kei nata ei hnohta a ypa chyhsa chyhta chhaota zâ ta pua pi ta. Ei Khazohpa ta Zerusale châta ei tao awpa ei palôh liata a sopa cha, ahy hmah chho leipa ei na ta. Ei kiapa sahroh dei leipa ta cha, sahroh hropa ei chhipa y vei.
Zâ ta pua na ta, Saikao Chhikao, Drâkao Tikhaoh nata Hnaihny Chhikao zy chapiapa ta sie na ta, Zerusale thokhy chopa nata mei ta a chhikao a kâpazy moh na ta.
Tihnawh Chhikao nata Abei Tipo lâ sie na ta, ei kiapa sahroh sie thei nawpa su rai y leipa ta.
Zâ ta chavah kaw sao na ta, thokhy cha mohpasia na ta, vaw kua na ta, Saikao Chhikao lâ tawhta a di na ta.
Khihpi ryureituhpazy ta khataih lâ ma sie na ta, khâpa ma ei tao tahpa pahno veih ei. Zuzy, theihthaipazy, nôpawpazy, beimachâzy nata raihria awpa mohropazy chhao chho mâh tlâ veih ei na.

Ama hnohta, “Eima duahmo chhiezie he hmô ei chi ta, Zerusale cha roryhrapa ta y ta, a chhikaozy mei ta a kâ khai ha hih. A vy teh u, mohnaopa ta eima y khao lei nawpa ta, Zerusale thokhy he paduapathi suh u,” tah na ta.

Hmopha tao nawpa ta ei Khazohpa ku ei chô liata a yzie nata ei hnohta abei biereipazy âmo chho ei na ta. Âmo ta, “Thyu sih la, paduapathi tlai ei suh u,” tah ei ta. Chatanachata raihria phapa châta ama ku tha a patlô ei ta.

Cha thâtih cha Hôrô chyhsa Sanbâlâ nata Amawna chyhsa molaipa Tôbia nata Arabia chyhsa Kese zy ta ama thei nahta, miah pasipasawhpa ta miah pahneisao ei ta, “Khâpa hmo ma nama tao? Abei ma nama chakhia aw?” miah tah ei ta.

Âmo cha a chhy ei na ta, ama hnohta, “Avâ Khazohpa ta vânoh miah a patosa aw. Keimo ano chakaotuhpazy thyu aw pi ta, khihpi he eima paduapathi aw. Nâmo deikua cha, Zerusale khihpi liana heta tovyuh nata biehneina nata a chhu thei awpa khâpa hmah hnei aw veih ei chi,” tah na ta.

Theihthai beichaipa Eliasi nata theihthaipa chakaona rai a hrialâhpazy thyu ei ta, Mietaku Chhikao paduapathi ei ta. Abeipa lâ hlâ ei ta, a ochhizy tao ei ta. Zakha Osâhpa nata Hânane Osâhpa tlôna taihta thokhy cha paduapathi ei ta, Abeipa lâ ama hlâ.
Ano pazipa ta Zerikô mo ta paduapathina rai hria ei ta. Âmo pazipa ta Imri sawchapawpa Zaku ta hria ta.
Hâsenâ sawchapawzy ta Nga Chhikao paduapathi ei ta. A tlâhzy pakhâh ei ta, a ochhizy, a hrainazy nata a lâhreizy ama tao.

Âmo pazipa ta Hâkô sawchapawpa Uria sawchapawpa Meremô ta taopathi ta. Âmo pazipa ta Mesezabe sawchapawpa Berekiah sawchapawpa Mesulâ ta taopathi ta. Âmo pazipa ta Bânâ sawchapawpa Zadô ta taopathi ta.
Âmo pazipa ta Tekô mo ta ama taopathi. Châhrasala Tekô nôpawzy cha ama Beipa rai hria awpa a chhuah veih ei.
Pâsia saw­chapawpa Zehôdâ nata Besôdei sawchapawpa Mesulâ zy ta Zesanah Chhikao taopathi ei ta. A tlâhzy pakhâh ei ta, a ochhizy, a hrainazy nata a lâhreizy tao ei ta.
Âmo a pazipa cha, Kibiô chyhsa Melâtiah nata Merônôthi chyhsa Chadô ta taopathi ei ta. Âmo cha Chavah Haosâ râh râhvaotuhpa atyuna Kibiô nata Mizpâ chyhsazy ama châ.
A pazipa ta ngôh daihtuhpa Hâhiah sawchapawpa Uzie ta taopathi ta. A pazi heihpa cha, ropahâhpa taotuhpa hry liatapa Hânaniah ta taopathi ta. Âmo ta Thokhy Kawhpa taihta Zerusale cha ama paduapathi.
Âmo a pazipa cha, Zerusale bia khophie ryureituhpa Hurâ sawchapawpa Rephiah ta taopathi ta.
Âmo a pazipa ta Hârumâ sawchapawpa Zediah ta a o dady liata taopathi ta. Ano pazipa ta Hâsabâniah sawchapawpa Hâtu ta taopathi ta.
Hâri sawchapawpa Mâkia nata Pâhamôabâ sawchapawpa Hâsuba zy ta su hropa nata meihô patina o sâhpa ama taopathi.
Ano pazipa ta Halôhe sawchapawpa, Zerusale bia khophie ryureituhpa Sâluh nata a sawchanôzy ta ama taopathi.
Hânu mo nata Zanô mo ta Saikao Chhikao taopathi ei ta. A ochhizy, a hrainazy nata a lâhreizy tao ei ta, Hnaihny Chhikao taih taopathi ei ta, thokhy cha dy sâh kha ama taopathi.
Rekhâ sawchapawpa, Behakere bia ryureituhpa Mâkia ta Hnaihny Chhikao taopathi ta. Chhikao cha paduapathi ta, a ochhizy, a hrainazy nata a lâhreizy a tao.

Kôhôzeh sawchapawpa, Mizpâ bia ryureituhpa Sâluh ta Tihnawh Chhikao taopathi ta. Tihnawh Chhikao cha paduapathi ta, a chô khu ta, a ochhizy, a hrainazy nata a lâhreizy a tao. Abei sadô liata Selâh Tipo dôhna chhao taopathi ta, Dâvi khihpi tawhta a chôpa hleidy taihta a taopathi.
Ano pazipa ta Azbu sawchapawpa, Bezu bia khophie ryureituhpa Nehemiah ta taopathi ta. Dâvi thlâ dady liata tipo pa-opa nata pasaiphazy o taihta a taopathi.
Ano a pazipa cha Livai pathlazy ta taopathi ei ta, Bâni sawchapawpa Rehu nata ano pazipa ta Keilâh bia khophie ryureituhpa Hâsabiah ta ano bia châta a taopathi.
Ano pazipa ta ama unawhzy ta taopathi ei ta. Henadâ sawchapawpa, Keilâh bia khophie ryureituhpa Bavai ta a taopathi.
Ano pazipa su liata Zesua sawchapawpa, Mizpâ ryureituhpa Eze ta taopathi ta, chariah chhaichhi sona lâ kiana dady, thokhy pakopa liata a taopathi.
Ano pazipa su liata Zabai sawchapawpa Bâruka ta phahnaingiah ngaitapa ta thokhy pakopa tawhta theihthai beichaipa Eliasi o ochhi taihta tao pathi ta.
Ano pazipa su liata Hâkô sawchapawpa Uria sawchapawpa Meremô ta Eliasi o ochhi tawhta Eliasi o chhâna taihta a taopathi.
Ano a pazipa cha a chheipâh liata theihthaipazy ta ama taopathi.
Âmo pazipa ta Benzami nata Hâsuba ta ama o dady liata taopathi ei ta. Âmo pazipa ta Ananiah sawchapawpa Mâsei sawchapawpa Azariah ta a o kiapâh liata a taopathi.
Ano a pazipa su liata Henadâ sawchapawpa Binu ta Azariah o tawhta thokhy pakopa nata thokhy ki taihta a taopathi.
Uzai sawchapawpa Palâ ta thokhy pakopa dady nata riahvaituhpazy yna o sâhpa kiapâh liata abei o chô lâ khyna dady taopathi ta. Ano pazipa ta Pârô sawchapawpa Pedai nata
Ôphe liata a ypa Achhyna o chakaotuhpazy ta nochhi lâchhâh Ti Chhikao dady taih nata o sâhpa lâ kiana taihta a taopathi.
Ano a pazipa su liata Tekô mo ta o sâhpa lâ kiana dady nata Ôphe thokhy taih ama taopathi.
Arâ Chhikao chô lâ cha theihthaipazy ta ama o dady chyu liata taopathi ei ta.
Âmo a pazipa cha, Ime sawchapawpa Zadô ta ano o dady liata taopathi ta. Ano pazipa ta nochhi chhikao vaituhpa Sekaniah sawchapawpa Semiah ta taopathi ta.
Ano a pazipa su liata Selemiah sawchapawpa Hânaniah nata Zalâpha sawcha­paw pacharuna Hânu ta ama taopathi. Ano pazipa ta Berekiah sawchapawpa Mesulâ ta ano chhôhpadâhpa dady taopathi ta.
Ano pazipa ta ngôh daihtuhpa hry liatapa Mâkia ta Mopasiana Chhikao dady liata Achhyna o chakaotuhpazy o nata sôdaohpazy o nata thokhy ki chô chhôhpadâhpa taih taopathi ta.
Ngôh daihtuhpazy nata sôdaohpazy ta thokhy ki chô chhôhpadâhpa nata Mietaku Chhikao likawh ama taopathi.
Thokhy eima taopa thâtih cha Sanbâlâ ta a thei nahta, thata a pathi ia ta, Zuzy cha pahneisao ta.

Chatanachata a unawhzy nata Samâri pheisaihzy hmiakô liata, “He Zu dyutlai leipazy heta khâpa ma ama tao hra tly? Khihpi amâ paduapathi heih aw ma? Atheihnazy ama hlâ aw ma? Noh kha ta patlô zua amâ chhuah hra ma? Mei ta a kâ hapa alôzy cha hnaihny tawhta thaopa ta ama pathieh heih aw ma?” tah ta.
A kiapâh liata Amawna chyhsa Tôbia y ta, ano ta, “Khâpa thokhy cha ma zua ama padua thei hra bao aw tly? Changie ta hmah kiah sala, alô thokhy ama taopa cha a pacho thlâh bao aw na,” tah ta.
Thlahchhâ na ta, “Hy eima Khazohpa, miah nathlie mah y. Mohnaopa ta eima y hih. Miah ama pasipasawhna he ama luh chô liata palie thlu la, hraopa ta y ei sala, râh hropa liata sei ta y mawh ei sy.
O satuhpazy hmia liata na hie ama cha pahâh haw. Chavâta ama thaileichâna khu leipa la, ama moleinazy na mohmô tawhta pahlei khah y,” tah na ta.
Chatanachata thokhy cha padua pi ta. Zawpizy ta hria khohna palôh ama hneipa vâta, thokhy cha â sâhna khophie taih thlai patlô pi ta.
Zerusale thokhy taopathina raihria cha a hmasie lymâ ta, a raonazy pamai pathaopa a châ tahpa Sanbâlâ, Tôbia, Arabia mo, Amawna mo nata Asadô mozy ta ama thei nahta, ama hiehâh ngaita ta.
Zerusale siehnao ta tymâna tao awpa ta a paraoh ei ta.
Eima Khazohpa lâta thlahchhâ pi ta, âmo tawhta eimâ boh thei nawpa ta chhô nah zâ ta vaituhpazy soh pi ta.
Zudâh zawpizy ta, “Hmo phaohtuhpazy ama tha a chhâ haw. Hnaihny hra cha hluh tlôh ta, keimo ta la thokhy he padua thei aw ma pi,” tah ei ta.
Eima chariahpazy ta, “Âmo lâ vawh aw pi ta, thie aw pi ta, raihria eima chalihsa hlâlei pahno leipa aw ei ta, miah hmô aw veih ei,” tah ei ta.
Cha nota ama chheipâh liata a pahrâpa Zuzy ta, “Namâ vaw lie tita su to tawhta amâ châ dyuh aw,” tahpa ta ei hrawh tlai miah chho ei ta.
Chavâta zawpizy cha ama zaozizy, ama aseizy, ama libawzy a chabapa ta, thokhy hnôhky lâta â hnai chaina su ruapazy liata, a pho pho ta soh ei na ta.

Chatawhcha mohmia pasaih na ta, thyu na ta, nôpawpazy nata ryureituhpazy nata zawpizy hnohta, “Âmo cha chi khuh vy. Abeipa rônahpa nata chichhihpa a thei u la, nama unawhzy, nama sawchapawzy, nama sawchanôzy, nama lapinôzy, nama ozy châta a dyuh muh vy,” tah na ta.

Amâ chhuahna eima pahnonazie eima chariahzy ta vaw thei ei ta. Khazohpa ta amâ chhuahna a parao hapa eima pahnonazie chhao vaw thei hra ei ta. Chatanachata thokhy lâ kua heih pi ta, eima raihria chyu hria heih pi ta.
Cha noh tawhta cha, ei chyhsa â khophie ta raihria ei ta, â khophie ta aseizy, vyhphaozy, libawzy, chachôhna vyhphaozy a chaba ei ta. Chhituhpazy cha Zudâh pathla,
thokhy a chhôh haipazy hnôh lâta a duah ei ta. Hmo a phaohpazy chhao ama ku râkha lâta hmo patu ei ta, râkha lâta chaihrai chaba ei ta.
Raihriatuhpazy ta ama zaozi a pataihpa ta raihria ei ta. Ei kiapâh liata chiahmie tôtuhpa y ta.
Nôpawpazy, ryureituhpazy nata zawpizy hnohta, “Rai a hluh ngaitapa vâta, thokhy chô liata a pachhaih khai ha pi ta, pakha nata pakha likawh eimâ hla kaw hih.
Chiahmie pyu nama theina su liata, cha liana cha keimo lâ a vaw hmaoh tyh muh vy. Eima Khazohpa ta miah â dyuhpa aw,” tah na ta.
Chatanachata rai cha hriapasa pi ta, â khophie ta my khihdei tawhta zâlâ awhsi â lâna taihta asei a chaba ei ta.

Cha nona chata zawpi hnohta, “Zerusale a chapiapa maih cha, âmo a chakaotuhpazy chhaota Zerusale liata a rie lymâ mawh ei sy. Chatanachata zâ ta miah vaih aw ei ta, nohchhô ta rai miah ama hriakhei aw,” tah na ta.
Chavâta kei chhao, ei unawhzy chhao, ei satliazy chhao, vaituhpa nâ zi tyhpazy chhao, ahy hmahta eima chysia pahluh leipa pi ta, ti eima do no chhao ta eima chaihraizy soh ma pi.
Chatawhcha zawpizy nata ama la­pinôzy ta ama unawh Zuzy chô liata paphôhpa ta thata awh ei ta.
Thokhazy ta, “Keimo sahlao he eima sawchapawzy nata eima sawchanôzy chhaota hluh ngaita pi ta, chavâta nie awpa hneipa ta eima hroh thei nawpa ta, sâh a chhuhrao ei suh u,” tah ei ta.
“Chakâhna a tlôpa vâta, nie awpa sâh eima hnei thei nawpa ta, eima lyuzy, eima kre sadôzy, eima ozy taihta sôhkâ ta eima sokhâh lymâ bâ,” a tahpazy y hra ei ta.
“Eima lyu nata eima kre sadô râhpawzy abei hnohta pie awpa ta, sôhzy dyuchei pi ta.

Eima sapa he eima unawhzy sapa hawhta châ ta, eima sawzy chhao âmo sawzy hawhta châ hra ei ta. Cha hawhta a châ nota, eima sawchapawzy nata sawchanôzy cha sei pachâsa awpa duahmo liata a duah pi ta, eima sawchanô thokhazy chhochhi cha sei ta taopa ama châ haw. Chyhsa hropazy ta eima lyu nata kre sadôzy ama hnei khai ha tawhta cha, tao thei awpa hnei khao ma pi,” a tahpazy chhao ama y.
Cha biezy nata ama paphôhna aozy ei thei nahta, ei hiehâh ngaita ta.
Kei nata kei ta a chhohia na ta, nôpawpazy nata ryureituhpazy maochhie ei na ta, ama hnohta, “Nama unawhzy tawhta apôhna la ei chi ta,” tah na ta, ama thâtih pachâ awpa ta zawpi awpakhy na ta,

ama hnohta, “Keimo ta phopizy lâta zuapa eima unawh Zu chyhsazy eima theina hawhta chatlai pi ta, nâmo deikua cha, nama unawhzy zuah ei chi ta, eima hnoh cheingei ta zuapa ama châ hih!” tah na ta. A thlih thlâh ha ei ta, rei awpa khâpa hmah pahno leipa ei ta.
Chavâta ama hnohta, “Nama hmotaopa he pha vei. Eima chariah phophizy ta miah ama pahneisao lei nawpa ta, eima Khazohpa nama chi awpa châ vei ma?
Cha dei châ vei, kei nata ei unawhzy nata nâ chakaotuhpazy ta âmo cha sôh nata sâh zy â bâh ta eima pie lymâ. Ngiachhiepa ta apôhna hneipa ta dyu pacheisapa he pathleih ei suh u.
Tanoh tlai heta ama lyuzy, ama kre sadôzy, ama ôli sadôzy, ama ozy pakua khai ha u la, ama sôh, sâh, kre sadô nata sathaw zy tawhta apôhna nama lapazy pakua khai ha teh u,” tah na ta.
