A vy u la, Abeipa hmotaopazy he moh u la, Roryhrapa ta leilô a paysa hazie he moh tua u.
Adyuhnazy khizaw kaokih taihta chalihsa ta, Libaw thliepa ta asei taipachhô ta; Talailihzy mei ta a rao khai ha tyh!
“A chalih u la, Khazohpa ei châ tahpa pahno teh u. Phopizy hry liata cheihchalopa ta y aw na ta, Alei chô liana heta cheihchalopa ta ei y aw.”
Pheisaihzy Abeipa eima hnohta y ta, Zakaw Khazohpa cha eimâ bohna thokhy a châ.
Hy phopizy saih u, nama ku chabaih u la, Lyna hla sapa ta Khazohpa lâ awh teh u!
Abeipa Chônôchaipa cha chi awpa châ ta, Ano cha alei chô zydua liata bei rônahpa a châ.
Phopizy eima ry liata panawhsa ta, Râhzy eima phei ry liata a panawhsa.
Eima ryuto râh miah a tlyhpa ta, A kyhpachâpa Zakaw myuh miah a pie.
Khazohpa cha rahaona chhaota chô lâ kiah ta, Abeipa cha chiahmie pyu chhaota a kiah haw.
Khazohpa lâ reithaina hla sa u la, Reithaina hla sa teh u! Eima Beipa lâ reithaina hla sa u la, Reithaina hla sa teh u!
Khazohpa cha khizaw zydua Bei châ ta, Maskili hla paryhpa ta ano cha reithai teh u!
Khazohpa cha râhzy chô liata ryureituhpa châ ta, Khazohpa cha beidyuchhai pathaihpa liata a tyuhpa a châ.
Phopizy tawhta beizy a hmaoh ei ta, Abarahâ Khazohpa phopi chhao amâ hmaoh. Khizaw vyhphaozy he Khazohpa eih châ ta, Ano cha thata cheihchalopa a châ.
Abeipa cha rônah ta, Eima Khazohpa khihpi tlâh pathaihpa liata, Rônah ngaitapa ta reithai awpa a châ.
A tlâh sâhzie angiana ta, Khizaw zydua palysa ta, Maw lâta Zaio Tlâh cha, Bei rônahpa khihpi a châ.
Khazohpa cha thokhy ta dôhpa abei ozy liata pahrâ ta, Ano tlai cha abohna thokhy a châzie a palâsa.
Moh teh u, beizy a awpakhy ei ta, Hmaohkha ta ama vaw sie.
Thokhy khihpi ama hmô nahta thata a pahlaw ei ta, Thlazohpa ta amâ râpai.
Achalyuna ta âmo cha patu ta, Chanô sawzeih pasa ta ama pasa.
Nochhi thlih hmâpa ta, Tâsi balyhzy na parao haw.
Eima theipa hawh tlai ta, Pheisaihzy Abeipa khihpi liata hmô pi ta, Eima Khazohpa khihpi liata eima hmô; Khihpi cha Khazohpa ta chhâzaw ta a pabohsa aw.
Hy Khazohpa y, nâma Achhyna o chhôh liata Na kyhpachâna tleih beih leipa eima pachâ tyh.
Hy Khazohpa, na moh hawh tlai ta, Na reithaina khizaw kaokih taihta tlô ta, Na ku chachâh lâ cha siana ta a bie.
Na ryureina dopazy vâta, Zaio Tlâh a ly sala, Zudâh sawchanôzy thaphapa ta y mawh ei sy!
Zaio chahlôpa ta padô u la, A riahvaina osâhpazy reih teh u.
Chhâ a vaw y awpazy chho awpa ta, Khôtho lâ tawhta thokhy pathopazy pachâ u la, Abei o thokhyzy chahryh teh u.
Ano cha Khazohpa cha châ ta, Chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta eima Khazohpa a châ; Thina khô lâ taihta miah a chhihtha aw.
Phopizy saih u, He he thei u la; Khizaw chyhsa zydua saih u, Nah pachôh teh u.
Molai mochyh, dyhpha dyhchhie, Nah pachôh khai teh u!
Ei pakah ta sona bie reih aw ta, Ei palôh pachâpa cha novâhna bie a châ aw.
Bieso lâ ei nah pachôh aw na ta, Ei bie khiakhipa totâ ta ei chhopasia aw.
Khazia nôpona daihti liata chi aw na ta, Moleipazy dôveina ta eina chadô tita ei chi aw?
Khazia ama hneina a ngâchhâ ei ta, Ama hnei thluna a palaikheipazy ei chi aw ei?
Chyhsapa ta chyhsa hropa chatlai thei leipa ta, A hrona ty Khazohpa hnohta pie khai thei hra vei.
Ama hro chatlaina ty cha ru tu ha ta, Sôh ta chatlai thei awpa châ vei.
Chhâzaw ta hroh ta, Thlâkhaoh hmô beih lei awpa ta ma â pachâ tly?
He he chyhsa to pahnopa a châ: Chyhsa sopazy chhao thi ei ta, Ahrupa nata angâpa leidia raihrie ei ta, Ama sôh mohropazy châta ama siesai tyh.
Ama moh ta râh mohzy bi hra ei sala, Ama chhâzaw o cha ama thlâzy châ ta, Chhâ zydua ta ama pahrâ nawpa su a châ.
Chyhsapa cha hneirôh kaw hra sala, Chhâzaw ta y thlâh ha aw vei; Sazy hawhta a thi hra aw.
He he hru riahphapazy lâpi châ ta, Ama biereipa a pyhtuhpa nata a zituhpazy tovyuh a châ.

Mietakuzy hawhta Athihkhih châta raopa châ ei ta, Thina cha âmo vaituhpa châ aw ta, Chyhsa dopazy ta my ta ama chô liata ryu ama reih aw. Ama o rônahpazy siesai aw ei ta, Athihkhih ta ama piziezy a parao khai ha aw.
Kei deikua cha ei hrona he, Khazohpa ta Athihkhih hmotaotheina tawhta chatlai aw ta, Ano ta eina vaw dy aw.
Chyhsa a vaw hneirôh tita ngiaroh leipa la, A o a rônah via rilipa chhao ta chi khah y.
A thi tita khâpa hmah a phao thei tlôh leipa aw ta, A rônahna ta ano cha zi aw vei.
A hro nota byhnâ a topa hawhta â pachâ hra sala, Thlaochhipa ta na y nota chyhsazy ta cha reithai hra ei sala,
Ano pathlatuhpa chhâ hnohta a pahlyh aw ta, Khaihna hmô heih beih khao aw vei.
Chyhsapa cha hneirôh kaw hra sala, Novâhna a hnei vei khiahta cha, Sazy thipa hawhta a thi tyh.
Abeipa, Khazohpa Atotaotheipa ta bie reih ta, Noh chhina tawhta noh tlana taihta, Leilô zydua a awpakhy.
Khazohpa cha Zaio tawhta vaw khaih ta, Khihpi ngia chaipa tawhta a vaw khaih.
Eima Khazohpa a vy ta, A thlih thlâh ha vei; A hmiakô liata mei thata kâ ta, A chheipâh liata thlihpi thata a pathli.
A phopi pachia awpa ta, Chô lâ avâzy aw ta, Alei chhao a aw.
“Atheihna ta ei hnohta biehrai a taopa, Ei mopathaihpa zy kha, Kei lâta awpakhy teh u,” Abeipa ta a tah.
Avâzy ta a siana phuah ta, Khazohpa ano tlai cha pachiatuhpa a châ.
“Hy ei phopi, nathlie teh, Bie ei reih aw; Hy Izarei, ei cha chakhia aw, Kei he Khazohpa châ na ta, Na Khazohpa cha ei châ.
Atheihna na hlâpazy vâta cha ra leipa na ta, Raopa hlânazy ei hmiakô liata khâ na hlâ tyhpa vâta cha ra hra va na.
Na o tawhta viahchao tôhpa la leipa aw na ta, Na sahroh o tawhta miezy la hra aw va na.
Râhmâhpa liata râhsa zydua kei eih châ ta, Tlâhpi sâh kha liata sa zydua chhao kei eih a châ.
Tlâhpizy liata pavaw zydua pahno khai na ta, Lyurâhpa liata hmohrohneipa zydua kei eih a châ.
“Ei no a dipa chhao ta, Nâ la cha chho hlei aw va na; Khizaw nata a chhôh liata a ypa zydua he, Kei eih sai a châ.
Viahchao tôhpa sa niepa ta, Mie thisaih ei doh beih ma?
Khazohpa lâta alyna biereina atheihna hlâ la, Chônôchaipa hnohta na bietaizy patlô mah y.
Nôpona noh liata na pado la, Cha pachha aw na ta, Chatanachata eina parôhnasa aw chi,” Abeipa ta a tah.
Moleipa hnohta deikua cha, Kha­zopa ta hetana heta a tah: “Ei bieraopa bievaopa ta reih ta, Ei biehrai na hmaozy ta reih awpa ta, Khâpa biehneina ma na hnei tly?
Pachuna a haopa ta, Ei biezy hnôhchhy tlôh chi ta.
Aparupa na hmô nahta, A chô liata a ly chi ta, Apheipazy nâ kao tyh.
“Na pakah moleina lâ pie chi ta, Na paleih ta dôveina bie a tao tyh.
A tyuh chi ta, na unawhpa reipasipasua chi ta, Na nô sawchapawpa cheingei na reipachhie.
Cha hmozy cha tao chi ta, Châhrasala a chalih thlâh ha na ta, Nâma hawhpa khiah ma ei châ eina tah chi. Châhrasala tahmâ cha, cha ra aw na ta, Hmiadaisâ ta ei cha leih bâ aw.
“Chavâta nâmo, Khazohpa a mypa saih u, A phapa ta pachâ teh u; Chataleipatala cha hriechheih aw ei na ta, Châ pachha awpa y aw veih ei.
Alyna bierei atheihna hlâtuhpa ta na parônahsa ta, A yzie â dopa ta a vaotuhpa hnohta, Khazohpa pachhana ei pahmô aw.”
Hy Khazohpa, na kyhpachâna tleih beih leipa vâta, Na ngiachhie la; Na zawngiahna chhâ tiah leipa vâta, Ei paraonazy a ngiahthai mah y.
Ei paraona tawhta liahsa na pasi la, Ei moleina tawhta na pathaisa mah y!
Ei paraonazy pahno thlâh ha na ta, Ei moleina ei hmiakô liata khâ a y.
Na chô liata, nâma chô lia tlai ta vaw molei na ta, Na mohmô liata hmo pha leipa ei vaw tao haw; Na biezy liata thaichâ chi ta, Na pachiana liata seina y vei.
Pachâ teh, paraona liata taopa châ na ta, Ei nô ta moleina liata a phaopa ei châ.
Pachâ teh, chhôh lâta hmeiseihna khoh chi ta, Palôh chhôh liata sona eina pachu chi.
Hisaw ta na pathai la, Ei pathaih aw; Na pasi la, Dâhaw hlâta ei ngyuh via aw.
Thaphana nata alyna pyuzy na patheisa heih la, Na thlie hapa ruzy he a ly heih mawh sy.
Ei moleinazy tawhta na hmia nyu la, Ei paraona zydua pahlei khai mah y.
Hy Khazohpa, palôh pathaihpa kei liata paysa la, Pachâna dopa ei chhôh liata pathieh heih mah y.
Na hmiakô tawhta na thy leipa la, Na Thlahpa Pathaihpa na lapa khah y.
Na pachhana alyna na pie heih la, Thlahpa khona ta na patu thlâh ha mah y.
Chatanachata paraotuhpazy na lâpi pachu aw ei na ta, Moleipazy nâ lâ ama vaw kua aw.
Hy Khazohpa, ei pachhana Kha­zohpa y, Thisaih maoh tawhta na pachha mah y; Chatanachata ei paleih ta a paropa ta na siana hla a sa aw.
Hy Abeipa, ei hmaozy pahy la, Ei pakah ta na reithaina a phuah aw.
Atheihna liata a ly leipa chi ta, A lypa châ la, ei cha hlâ ha awpa tlai; Raopa hlâna ta na palôh patlâh hra aw vei.
Khazohpa khopa atheihnazy cha palôh keichheihpa châ ta, Hy Khazohpa, palôh keichheihpa nata ropa cha dytha aw va chi.
Nâ lynazie hawhta Zaio chô liata hmopha tao la, Zerusale thokhyzy padua mah y.
Chatanachata atheihna dopazy liata a ly aw chi ta, Raopa hlânazy nata tlokhuh raopa hlânazy liata a lypa ta, Na maisâh liata viahchao tôhpazy hlâpa a châ aw.
Hy chyhsa thatlôpa, khazia hmo pha leipa nâ palaikhei tly? Khazohpa phana cha noh y ta y tlôh ta.
Nâ, dôveina rai a hriatuhpa, Na paleih ta raona patohpatia ta, Na paleih cha chaidâh tiahpa hawhta a châ.
Phana hlâta chhiena pasô via chi ta, Biedopa reipa hlâta haipa bie reipa na pasô via.
Hy nâ, dôvei a thaipa paleih, Chyhsa a palâ khaipa bie to na pasô rimâ cha!
Khazohpa ta tlyzaw ta cha parao aw ta, Na poh o tawhta châ daophipa ta cha hriechheih aw ta, Ahrohpa râh tawhta a cha phia pathlah aw.
Cha cha mosiapazy ta hmôpa ta chi aw ei ta, Ano cha pahneisao aw ei ta,
“Moh tua u, he chyhsa he, Khazohpa cha â chhaina ta tao leipa ta, A hneirôna liata a pahnieh ta, A moleina liata tha â patlôpa chyhsa a châ hih,” ama tah aw.
Kei deikua cha Khazohpa o liata, Ôli tho hrohpa hawhta châ na ta, Khazohpa kyhpachâna tleih beih leipa cha, Chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta ei ngâ aw.
Cha hmo cha na taopa vâta, Chhâzaw ta alyna bie cha hlâ aw na ta; Na mopathaihpazy mohmô liata, Na moh ei hâ hualua aw; Cha cha hmo phapa châ tlôh ta.
Ahrupa ta a palôh liata, “Khazohpa y vei,” a tah tyh. Avyuhna tao ei ta, Moleina pasi chhihpa tao ei ta, Hmo pha a taopa rai y veih ei.
Khazohpa ta vârâh tawhta chyhsa sawzy za sai ta, Novâhna hneipa ta, Khazohpa a tluapa ama y ma tahpa a za moh tyh.
Pao khai ha ei ta, Avyuhna liata amâ ngia khai haw; Hmo pha a taopa rai y veih ei, Pakha hmah y veih ei.
Moleina hmo a tao tyhpazy he ama novâh vei tlyma i? Viahchhâ niepa hawhta ei chyhsazy nie khai ei ta, Khazohpa padona châh pahno veih ei.
China rai y leina liata, Chi ngaitapa ta y ei ta; Adyuhna riehmo châ paryh thlupa ruzy cha, Khazohpa ta a hiepatla khai haw; Khazohpa ta âmo cha a thy hapa vâta, Maophyuhpa ta na soh ha ei.
Izarei pachhana cha, Zaio tawhta vaw pua sala ei tah kaw dia! Khazohpa ta a phopi vânoh a patosa heih tita, Zakaw cha a ly sala, Izarei cha thaphapa ta y mawh sy!
Hy Khazohpa, na moh ta na pachha la, Na thatlôna ta thai na pachâsa mah y.
Hy Khazohpa, ei thlahchhâna thei la, Ei pakah biezy lâta na nah pachôh mah y.
Chihropazy ta na thyuhnaopa ta, Chyhsa nôchhiepazy ta ei hrona tei ei ta, Ama hmiakô liata Khazohpa soh veih ei.
Pachâ teh u, Khazohpa cha nâ baotuhpa châ ta, Abeipa cha ei hro nâ deichhytuhpa a châ.
Ei chariahpazy cha chhiena ta viarithô aw ta, Na ngâchhihna vâta âmo cha pahleipadia mah y.
Lôhthai hlâna ta nâ lâ atheihna hlâ aw na ta, Hy Abeipa, na moh ei reithai aw, Cha cha hmo phapa châ tlôh ta.
Ei nôpona zydua liata na pachha ta, Ei chariahpazy ama nawhpa ei mo ta a hmô haw.
Hy Khazohpa, ei thlahchhâna lâ na nah pachôh la, Ei châ hawna he a nyusai khah y!
Na nathlie la, nâ chhy mah y; Ei palôh a tymâ ta ei pachâ a rôh ngaita,
Chariahpa pyu thei na ta, Moleipa ta eina moaipa vâta. Chhiena na thy thlu ei ta, Hiehâhpa ta eina taochhie ei.
Ei chhôhso palôh pasa ngaita ta, Thina chichhihpazy ta eina vi.
China nata achalyuna ta na patu ta, Thlazohna ta eina chanaoh.
“Aw, vachhuh hawhta mathlaw hnei aw sah la, A zaw aw na ta, ei pahâ ha awpa tlai!
A châ na, lâhlapi lâ a zaw syulyu ha aw na ta, Râhchawhpa liata ei y ha awpa tlai!
Abohna su lâ a râ para aw na ta, Thlihpipa nata thlihrâhpa tawhta ei boh ha awpa tlai!” tah na ta.
Hy Abeipa, khihpi liata atudaina nata ahryuna zy hmô na ta; Âmo cha pahleipadia la, Ama paleih hriechheih khai ha mah y.
Chhô nah zâ ta khihpi cha a thokhy chô liata chahlô ei ta, Khihpi chhôh cha moleina nata tymâna ta a bie.
Khihpi chhôh cha paraona ta bie ta, Tlybaina nata dôveina zy ta a lâlaizy puasai beih vei.
Nâ reipachhietuhpa cha chariahpa a châ khiahta cha, Maoh oh thei thlâh ha aw na ta; Nâ palai thlupa cha khakhaipa a châ khiahta cha, Ei nyusai thei thlâh ha aw.
Châhrasala nâ, ei chiheihpa chyhsa, Ei kaolâhpa nata ei viasa phapa cheingei ta, Cha hawhta eina tao chi.
Nâ nata kei cha reikah thlôhpa ta bie reih khoh tyh pi ta, Khazohpa o liata a kao tyhpa mah eima châ tâh.
Ei chariahpazy chô liata thina vaw tlô sala, Ama hrohpa ta Athihkhih lâ sie mawh ei sy; Ama pahrâna su liata hmo pha leipa y ta, Ama palôh hmo pha leipa ta a bie.
Kei deikua cha Khazohpa pado aw na ta, Abeipa ta eina pachha aw.
Zâlâ ta zy, my ta zy, nohchhô ta zy, Ei nôpona bie reipa ta a rôh na ta, Abeipa ta ei ao eina thei.
Nâ dyuhpa hluh ngaita hra ei sala, Ei hro he chatlaipa ta abohna su liata paysa ta, Chariah ei dyuhpa tawhta eina pachha haw.
Âmo cha hro a thla awpa khoh leipa ei ta, Khazohpa ama chi leipa vâta, Beidyuchhai liata tlyzaw ta a tyuhpa Khazohpa ta, Ei hiana thei aw ta âmo cha a panawh aw.
Ei kaolâhpa ta a viasazy a dyuh ta, A biehrai a parao haw.
A pakah cha sâhpiti kuapa hawhta pahnia ta, A palôh lia deikua adyuhna ta a bie. A biezy sathaw hlâta nai via ta, Châhrasala zaozi phia hapa a châ.
Na phaohri Abeipa liata pachhô la, Ano ta tha a cha patlô aw; Mosiapa cha pao pasaih beih aw vei.
Châhrasala Hy Khazohpa, Moleipazy cha leidiana khaohtlô liata pathla aw chi ta, Thisaih a palopa nata chyhsa a dôveipazy cha, Ama chhâ khophie chhao hroh aw veih ei. Kei deikua cha, nâ ei cha ngâ aw.
Hy Khazohpa, na ngiachhie mah y; Chyhsa ta na tlypâ ta, Nâ dyuhtuhpa ta noh y ta eina tlybai.
Ei chariahpazy ta noh y ta na tlypâ ei ta, Chyhsa hluhpi ta a khotlâh kawpa ta einâ dyuh ei.
Ei china maihta, Nâma liata a pahnieh na ta;
Khazohpa cha a bie vâta reithai na ta, Khazohpa cha ngâ na ta, Chi aw va na. Chyhsapa ta kheihta eina tah thei aw?
Noh y ta ei biezy pachiahpaliahsa ei ta, Ama pachâna zydua cha ei chhie nawpa sai a châ.
Na teiparupa ta nâ byh ei ta, Ei sievawnazy ngia ei ta thie einâ chhuah ei.
Ama moleina vâta âmo cha hrie la, Hy Khazohpa, phopizy cha pathi iapa ta panawhsa mah y!
Ei viavinazy ngiapa ta, Ei mothlihzy na chhiehraôh liata ryh chi ta, Na châbu liata ropa a châ.
Ei cha padona noh liata, Ei chariahpazy hnôh a sy aw ei ta, Khazohpa cha ei chhâh a châ tahpa ei pahno aw.
Khazohpa cha a bie vâta reithai na ta, Abeipa cha a bie vâta reithai na ta,
Khazohpa cha ngâ na ta, Chi aw va na. Chyhsapa ta kheihta eina tao thei aw?
Hy Khazohpa, bie ei châ taihpazy patlô aw na ta, Alyna biereina hmohlâpa ei cha pie aw.
Khazohpa hmiakô liata chareipa ta, Hrona khaihpa liata charei awpa ta, Ei hrona he thina tawhta pachha chi ta, Ei pheizy he ahluana tawhta na pabohsa haw.
Hy Khazohpa, na ngiachhie la, Na ngiachhie tlai mah y, Ei hro ta nâ a châ chhai hih; Raona thlihpizy â pai hlâlei cha, Na mathlaw nohdi ry liata ei châ chhai aw.
Khazohpa Chônôchaipa pado na ta, Kei liata â chhuahna a patlôpa Khazohpa tlai cha ei pado.
Khazohpa ta a zawngiahna nata a ngâchhihna tuah aw ta, Avâ tawhta vaw tuapa ta na pachha aw ta, Nâ taolatuhpazy maophyuhpa ta a paysa aw.
Ei hrona he chakeibarôhneipazy hry liata y ta, Sahrâhpazy hry liata a zia na ta; Asei nata châtai hâh hnei ta, Zaozi tiahpa paleih a hneipa chyhsa sawzy hry liata ei y.
Hy Khazohpa, avâzy chô lâta cheihchalopa ta y la, Na rônahna ta leilô zydua bie mawh sy!
Ei sie nawpazy liata sao na parai khâh ei ta, Ei hro ta a ngiaroh ngaita. Ei lâpi liata khaohtlô na chao khâh ei ta, Âmo ta tlao ama tla tyh.
Hy Khazohpa, ei palôh a i ta, Ei palôh â i ngaita; Hla ei sa aw, Reithaina hla ei sa aw.
Hy ei thlahpa, A hra teh! Hy tlaipih nata totâ zy saih u, A hra teh u! Kei ta khihdeipa ei pahra aw!
Hy Abeipa, phopizy hry liata alyna bie cha hlâ aw na ta, Râhzy hry liata na reithaina hla ei sa aw.
Na kyhpachâna tleih beih leipa ta avâzy kaw daih ta, Na ngâchhihna ta meihdozy a kaw tlô.
Hy Khazohpa, avâzy chô lâta cheihchalopa ta y la, Na rônahna ta leilô zydua bie mawh sy!
Hy ryureituhpazy saih u, biedopa nama reih tlai ma? Chyhsa sawzy châta â dopa ta ryu nama reih tlai ma?
Châ bao va, nama palôh ta hmo doleipa tao ei chi ta, Nama ku ta alei chô liata thachahra a hmâh tyh.
Moleipazy cha chhi tawhta nomâpa châ ei ta, Ama pipa nahta lâpi paviapa ta, Haipa biezy ama reih lymâ.
Parih châmaih hawhpa châmaih hnei ei ta, Vâzi nahpâpa, nah a chahu tyhpa hawhta ama châ.
Parih pangâhthaipazy ao nathlie leipa ei ta, Pachaothaipa piehpiepa ao chhao nathlie veih ei.
Hy Khazohpa, ama pakah liata hâhzy thlie la, Hy Abeipa, chakeibarôhneipa lochopa naohzy thlie pachhô mah y.
Ti a loh pathlahpa hawhta lei ei sala, Ama châtaizy ta ama mopâ tita a hmao a bih ha mawh sy.
Chaikarupa a zaopa hawhta zao ei sala, Thiruapa ta hawsaih a pihpa, Noh a hmô beih leipa hawhta châ mawh ei sy.
Nama beihzy ahloh tho mei ta a palalôh hlâta, Tho hrohpa ta tlyma, tho raohpa ta tlyma, Moleipa cha phi pathlahpa a châ aw.
A phuh lapa a châpa a hmô tita, Mosiapa cha a ly aw ta; Moleipazy thisaih liata a phei â si aw.
Chatanachata chyhsapa ta, “Mosiapa châta lymâ y tlai ta, Khizaw ryureihtuh Khazohpa a y tlai na,” a tah awh.
Hy ei Khazohpa, ei chariahpazy tawhta na pachha la, Nâ thyuhnaopazy tawhta na vaih mah y.
Moleina hmo a taotuhpazy tawhta na pabohsa la, Thisaih a palopa chyhsazy tawhta na pachha mah y.
Hy Abeipa, moh tua, Ei hrona a byh ei ta, Thatlôpazy ta eina tei ei. Ei paraona vâta châ leipa ta, Ei moleina vâta châ hra vei.
Ei taopasi leipa chhao ta, Na tei awpa ta a râ ei ta, Amâ kei chhuanoh. A hra la, na bao awpa ta a vy la, moh tua.
Hy Zehôvâh Khazohpa Atotaotheipa, Nâ cha Izarei Khazohpa châ chi ta, Râhzy hrie awpa ta thyu la, Moleina rarôh ypa taotuhpazy cha, Ahy hmah pahlôh khah y.
Zâlâ maihta a vaw lie ei ta, Izy hawhta ngapa ta, Khihpi ama chahlô tyh.
Moh teh u, ama pakah ta pa-ua ei ta, Ama hmaozy liata zaozi y ta, “Ahy miah a thei aw?” ama tah tyh.
Nâ deikua cha, Hy Abeipa, Âmo pahneisao chi ta, Râhzy mohnaochhihpa ta na tao.
Hy ei thatlôna, Ei cha mokhâh aw; Hy Khazohpa, Ei thokhy na châ.
A kyhpachâna tleih beih leipa Khazohpa ta na vaw dy aw ta, Ei chariahpazy pahniepa ta ama ypa eina pamosa aw.
Âmo cha thie hlei khah y, Chataleipatala ei phopi ta a my pathlei aw na; Hy Abeipa, eima vyhphao, Na hmotaotheina ta âmo cha paviavisa la, Panawh hri mah y!
Ama pakah moleinazy vâta, Ama hmao biezy vâta, Amâ palaina lia tlai ta a ao mawh ei sy. Chhiesana bie nata haipa bie ama reipazy vâta,
Âmo cha na pathiiana ta kâsao khai sala, Khazohpa cha Zakaw pathlazy chô liata ryureih ta, Khizaw kaokih taihta ryu a reih tahpa pahno mawh ei sy.
Zâlâ maihta a vaw lie ei ta, Izy hawhta ngapa ta, Khihpi ama chahlô tyh.
Nie awpa tluapa ta a khiekhâ ei ta, Ama rih a bie vei khiahta cha ama pahnua tyh.
Kei deikua cha na thatlôna hla sa aw na ta, Na kyhpachâna tleih beih leipa kyh Mydi ta a paropa ta ei sa tyh aw. Nâ cha ei thokhy châ chi ta, Ei nôpona noh ta ei chhaipa na châ.
Hy ei thatlôna, Nâma reithaina hla ei sa aw; Hy Khazohpa, nâ cha ei thokhy châ chi ta, Ei chô liata zawngiahna a palâsatuhpa Khazoh na châ.
Hy Khazohpa, miah thy ha chi ta, Miah na papyu haw; Na hie cha pahâh ha pi ta, Miah paduapathi heih mah y.
Râh he pasihsa chi ta, Na hriechheih khai ha hih; A chalyu ngâ kaw ta, A pyunazy taopathi mah y.
Na phopi he hmo rupazy pahmôsa chi ta, Kresawhti miah pado chi ta, Paochheichhâpa ta miah na tao haw.
Nâma châ chituhpazy châta pohraipa parai chi ta, Libaw tawhta amâ râ nawpa na taopa ei.
Chatanachata na kyhpachâpazy cha pabohsapa ta eima y aw; Na ku chachâh lâta miah pachha la, Miah a chhy mah y!
Khazohpa ta a su pathaihpa tawhta hetana heta a tah: “Thaphapa ta Sekhe khihpi pachhaih aw na ta, Sukô Saikao ei rairuah aw.
Kilia cha kei eih châ ta, Manase chhao kei eih a châ; Epharai cha ei lakhu châ ta, Zudâh cha ei ryureina chôchahrei a châ.
Môabâ cha ei ku asina rahô châ ta, Edômâ cha ei pheiky sona a châ; Philistia chô liata pahniena hladyuh ei pathluah.”
Ahy ma thokhy khihpi lâ nâ chhi aw? Ahy ma Edômâ lâ nâ chhihtha aw?
Hy Khazohpa, miah dytha ha va chi ma? Hy Khazohpa, eima pheisaihzy hnohta na sie khao vei he zaw.
Khakhaipazy a dyuh awpa ta miah bao mah y, Chyhsapa pachhana cha hraoleipa a châ.
Khazohpa chhaota riahphapa ta a dyuh aw pi ta, Ano tlai ta eima chariahpazy a tlypâ aw.
Hy Khazohpa, ei awna he thei la, Ei thlahchhâna he nathlie mah y.
Ei palôh chhâ daihti liata, Alei chhâna tawhta cha pado na ta, Kei hlâta a sâh viapa lôpanô lâ nâ chhi mah y.
Nâ cha ei chhaina châ chi ta, Chariahpa tawhta ei bohna thokhy na châ.
Na poh o liata chhâzaw ta na paysa la, Na mathlaw ry achhaina su liata na pabohsa mah y!
Hy Khazohpa, ei bietaizy thei ha chi ta, Na moh a chituhpazy ryuto eina patosa ha chi.
Abei hro he pasisa la, Chhâ zydua taihta a kô pasisa mah y!
Khazohpa hmiakô liata tlyzaw ta a bei sala, Ngâchhihna nata biehmeiseihpa cha, Ano hrôbiehtuhpa ta raopa mah y!
Chatanachata na moh reithaina hla sa aw na ta, Ei bietaizy noh chareih ei patlô aw.
Ei hro he Khazohpa lia dei ta apahâna hmô ta, Ano tawhta ei pachhana a vaw tlô.
Ano deita cha ei lôpanô nata ei pachhana châ ta, Ei thokhy châ ta, A chalyu beih aw va na.
Thokhy a sia haipa nata diahpai a pao haipa hawhpa chyhsa tlai he, Khati taih ma tei aw ei chi ta, Nama zydua ta namâ dyuh aw?
A duahmo sâhpa tawhta chati pathlah awpa ta tei ei ta, Haipa bie reipa liata amâ ly kaw tyh. Ama pakah ta byhnâ aw ei ta, Ama palôh ta chhie ama sa tyh.
Ei hro ta Khazohpa deita hâ ta, Ano tawhta ei hnabeiseihna a vaw tlô.
Ano deita cha ei lôpanô nata ei pachhana châ ta, Ei thokhy châ ta, a chalyu beih aw va na.
Khazohpa liata ei pachhana nata ei rônahna a pahnie ta, Khazohpa cha ei thatlôna lôpanô nata ei bohna a châ.
Hy chyhsazy saih u, ano cha khâ ngâ u la, A hmiakô liata nama palôh pakeichheih muh vy; Khazohpa cha eimâ chhaina a châ.
Mochyhpazy cha ei kha husopa hawh dei châ ei ta, Molaipazy chhao dôveina deita a châ; Khopathliahna liata a hua syulyu ha ei ta, Ama pano ta ei kha husopa hlâta amâ hua via.
Chyhsa hmo chhupa liata ngâna pahnieh leipa u la, Hraona sôh liata hnabeiseihna doleipa hnei hra khuh vy; Hneirôna a vaw pôh tita, Cha liata nama palôh soh khuh vy.
Khazohpa ta ei kha reih ha ta, He he ei no ei theina a châ: Hmotaotheina cha Khazohpa eih châ ta,
Hy Abeipa, ngâchhihna cha nâma eih a châ. Chyhsa to ama hmotaopa lymâ hawhta na thô tyh.
Hy Khazohpa, nâ cha ei Khazohpa châ chi ta, Hmeiseihta ta ei cha tlua; Ti y leina râh raohpa nata riethei thachhâna râh liata, Nâma vâpa ta ei hro dâhphi ta, Nâma vâpa ta ei sapa a panao.
Chavâta su pathaihpa liata cha moh na ta, Na hmotaotheina nata na rônahna ei moh thlâh haw.
Na ngâchhihna cha hrona hlâta pha via ta, Ei hmaozy ta a cha reithai aw.
Ei hro chhôh zydua ta cha reithai aw na ta, Na moh ta ei kuzy ei chaluah aw.
Sa thawhpa nata nie pahâhpa nie nota lôhrâtlôpa hawhta, Ei hro he nâma liata a lôhrâtlô aw ta, Ei pakah ta thaphana hmao ta a cha reithai aw.
Ei rakhô chô liata châ thei na ta, Zâ vaina daihtizy liata na thâtih ei pachâ tyh.
Nâ cha nâ baotuhpa châ chi ta, Na mathlaw nohdi ry liata alyna hla ei sa aw.
Ei hro ta khâchâ cha patu ta, Na ku chachâh lâta eina cha-ao chi.
Ei hrona pahlei a chhuapazy deikua cha, Alei su ry chaipazy lâ ama zu aw.
Zaozi hmotaotheina liata hlâpa châ aw ei ta, Changiezy tovyuh ama châ aw.
Abei deikua cha Khazohpa liata a ly aw ta, Khazohpa moh ta bie a taihpa zydua cha thaphapa ta y aw ei ta, Haipa bie a reihpa hmaozy deikua cha pamaipa a châ aw.
Hy Khazohpa, ei nôpona ao he vaw thei la, Chariahpa chichhihna tawhta ei hrona he pabohsa mah y.
Arulâta moleipazy teina tawhta na nyu la, Hmoparaotuhpa zasâh manôhzy tawhta na nyu mah y.
Chazy chata zaozi hawhta ama paleih chata ei ta, Châtai hawhta bie khapazy ta ama mopâ.
Amâ byhna su tawhta chyhsa phapazy ka ei ta, Â pachyh vei nota eikhapi ta ama ka tyh.
Hmo moleina tao awpa ta a pasyu raihriepa ta, Arulâta khoheih chô awpa kyh zy reih ei ta, “A hmô theipa y aw veih ei,” ama tah tyh.
Hmo doleipa tao awpa patuapalua ei ta, “Hmo phapa eima patuapalua haw,” ama tah tyh. Chyhsapa palôh nata pachâna he la, A vaw piehpie kaw tlai na!
Châhrasala Khazohpa ta âmo cha châtai ta ka ta, Eikhapi ta hmahphaopa ta ama y.
Âmo paleihzy ta âmo cha a lie thlupa ta, Paraopa ta y aw ei ta; A hmôpa maihta ama luh ama chahuah chie aw.
Chatanachata chyhsa zydua ta chipa ta, Khazohpa raihria phuah aw ei ta, A hmotaopazy ama pachâ aw.
Mosiapazy cha Abeipa liata a ly ei sala, Ano cha a chhai mawh ei sy! Palôh dopa zydua ta ano cha reithai mawh ei sy!
Hy Khazohpa, Zaio liata reithaina ta cha hâ thlâh ha ta, Bietaizy nâma liata patlôpa a châ aw.
Hy thlahchhâna a theituhpa y, Chyhsapa zydua nâ lâ amâ vy aw.
Moleina ta miah a pahnie tita, Eima paraonazy vâta chatlaina miah na taopa tyh.

Na dôhpachhôh tlyhmia liata pahrâ awpa ta, A tlyh chi ta, na kiapâh lâ nâ chhipazy cha, Ama nohlao kaw dia! Na o phana vâta lôhrâtlôpa ta y aw pi ta, Nâma Achhyna o pathaihpa vâta lôhrâtlôpa ta eima y aw.
Hy eima pachhana Khazohpa y, Hmo rônahpa taopa ta siana ta miah a chhy chi ta; Nâ cha khizaw kaokih hnabeiseihna châ chi ta, Tilaipi a hla chaipazy hnabeiseihna chhao na châ.
Na thatlôna ta tlâhpizy padua chi ta, Na hmotaotheina ta na pa-i.
Tilaipi a aoh ngâpazy chalihsa chi ta, Ama tichatlaopa a aoh ngâpazy chalihsapa ta, Phopizy atlaokalina na chalihsa haw.

Chatanachata leilô chhânazy liata a pahrâpazy chhao ta, Ngiana hmonoâhpa na taopazy vâta chipa ta ama y. My khih vaw deih ta, My noh chhina nata zâlâ noh tlana râhzy cha, Thaphapa ta na paawhsa tyh ei.
Alei he vaw tlypa ta ti bao chi ta, Alei thata na paphasa; Khazohpa chavah cha ti ta bie ta, Na vaw pachhuapanoh chiehpa hawhta, Chyhsazy cha sâh ta na pasa ei.
Leipaliezy ti ta pabie chi ta, A lei byuhpazy paraihpa ta, Vâsua ti ta panaisa chi ta, Chicheizy byhnâ na pie tyh.
Kô cha kôvei lakho pakho chi ta, Na talailihzy siena liata a khô pathlah laih.
Râhchawhpa liata sibiepa thata rôh ta, Tlâhthlôhzy cha thaphana ta amâ tobi.
Sibiepa suzy cha sahroh zaw ta bie ta, Saikaozy sâh ta khu khaipa ta, Hmaohkha ta awh ei ta, Alyna hla ama sa khoh.
Leilô zydua saih u, Khazohpa lâ thaphapa ta awh u la,
A moh rônahna hla sapa ta, Reithaina rônahpa hlâ teh u.
Khazohpa hnohta, “Na hmotaopazy noâh a chhih ta, Na hmotaotheina a rônah kaw dia! Chavâta na chariahpazy a bôhpa ta nâ lâ amâ vy.
Khizaw zydua nâ lâ a bôhpa ta, Nâ reithaina hla sa ei ta, Na moh reithaipa ta ama sa,” tah muh vy.
A vy u la, Khazohpa hmotaopazy he moh teh u: Chyhsa sawzy chô liata a hmotaopa he, Noâh â chhih kaw dia!
Tilaipi cha alei hipa pachâsa ta, Phei ta vahpi ti ama chaka. Cha liata ano liata thaphapa ta eima y;
A thatlôna ta tlyzaw ta ryureih ta, A mo ta râhzy khâ a vaih tyh. Dyuhtuhpazy âmosasyh a cheihchalo khah ei sy.
Hy phopizy saih u, eima Khazohpa reithai u la, Ano reithaina pyu cha theipa ta y mawh sy.
Ano cha eima hrona a pabohsatuhpa châ ta, Eima phei a chapia awpa a pasaih leipa a châ.
Hy Khazohpa, miah pasia chi ta, Tâkâ pasiapa hawhta miah na pasia.
Sao lâta miah a chhi chi ta, Eima ky liata phaohri ngaitapa miah na pavi.
Eima luh chô liata chyhsazy pakiasa chi ta, Mei nata ti sie pahlie pi ta, Chatanachôta ativyna su lâ miah nâ chhi papua.
Raopa hlânazy chhaota na o liata a vaw ngia aw na ta, Ei bietaizy nâ liata ei patlô aw.
Ei hmao ta a vaw rei hapazy patlô aw na ta, Ei nôpo nota ei pakah ta bie â taihpazy ei patlô aw.
Sa thawhpazy ta raopa hlânazy cha hlâ aw na ta, Mietaku tôhpazy ta châ theihpa ta, Viahchao tôhpazy nata miezy ei cha hlâ aw.
Nâmo, Khazohpa a chipa zydua saih u, A vy u la, nathlie teh u; Ei hro châta a hmotaopazy ei cha chho aw ei.
Ei pakah ta ano cha pado na ta, Ei paleih ta ei palyupalih.
Ei palôh liata moleina ei pasô khiahta cha, Abeipa ta na nathlie aw vei.
Châhrasala Khazohpa ta na nathlie hmeiseih ta, Ei thlahchhâna ao a thei haw.
Ei thlahchhâna dytha leipa ta, Kyh eina pachâna a tleih beih leipa vâta, Khazohpa cha reithaipa ta y mawh sy!
Khazohpa ta miah ngiachhie sala, Byhnâ miah pie sala, Eima chô liata a hmia pakhaihsa mawh sy.
Chatanachata na lâpi cha alei chô liata pahnopa ta y aw ta, Na pachhana cha râh to liata pahnopa a châ aw.
Hy Khazohpa, phopizy ta cha reithai ei sala, Phopi to ta cha reithai mawh ei sy!
Râhzy ama thapha sala, Alyna hla sa mawh ei sy; Nâ cha phopizy â khongâhpa ta pachia chi ta, Khizaw râhzy a chhihthatuhpa na châ.
Hy Khazohpa, phopizy ta cha reithai ei sala, Phopi to ta cha reithai mawh ei sy!
Alei ta a kôvei papôhsa ta, Khazohpa, eima Khazohpa tlai ta byhnâ miah a pie aw.
Khazohpa ta byhnâ miah pie aw ta, Khizaw kaokih ta ano cha chi mawh ei sy!
Khazohpa cha thyu aw ta, A chariahpazy papaipa ta y aw ei ta, Ano ahaotuhpazy a hmiakô liata amâ râpai aw.
Meikhuh phaoh pathlahpa ta a ypa hawhta, Âmo cha papua aw chi ta; Mei liata kheilôh a zaopa hawhta, Moleipazy cha Khazohpa hmia­kô liata ama leidia aw.
Mosiapazy deikua cha thaphapa ta, Khazohpa hmiakô liata palôhtlâhpa ta y aw ei ta, A ly ngaitapa ta ama rahao aw.
Khazohpa lâ hla sa u la, A moh reithai­pa ta sa teh u; Meihdo chô liata a kiahpa châta hla sa u la, A moh cha Abeipa châ ta, A hmiakô liata a lypa ta y teh u!
Ano cha a pahrâna su pathaihpa liata a ypa Khazohpa châ ta, Paw hnei leipazy châta paw châ ta, Nôhmeizy a duakheituhpa a châ.
Khazohpa ta matlupa châta chhôhkha taopa ta, Atâhpazy papuapa ta thlao pachhisa ta; Dyuhtuhpazy deikua cha râh raohpa liata ama pahrâ.
Hy Khazohpa, na phopi hmia lâta sie chi ta, Râhchawhpa liata na sie laih nona kha,
Khazohpa, Sinai Khazohpa hmiakô liata, Khazohpa, Izarei Khazohpa hmiakô liata, Alo a sih ta, Avâzy ta avâ a za pasuasa.
Hy Khazohpa, khihti phapa vaw tuah chi ta, Na ryuto a panao hapa na paduapathi heih.
Na sahlaozy cha liata pahrâ ei ta, Hy Khazohpa, na phana ta dyhchhiepazy na pasa ei.
Abeipa ta bie pie ta, Cha thâtih a phuahtuhpa chanôzy cha, Ama hluh ngaita dia!
“Beizy nata ama pheisaihzy rawrôh ta a râ ei ta, Amâ râpai khai haw,” ama tah. O hâtuhpa chanôzy ta hraona sôh amâ rai.
Mietaku sadôzy liata a ypa chanôzy cha, Tâkâ ta pahupa mathlaw a hneipa vachhuh lyu ei ta, A mathlaw pawhmaozy liata ngôh patliepa a ypa hawhta ama châ.
Atotaotheipa ta cha liata beizy a papai nona kha la, Zalmaw tlâh liata dâhaw a tlapa na a lyu.
Hy tlâh rônahpa, Bâsanâ tlâh, Hy tlâh lakizy, Bâsanâ tlâh!
Hy tlâh laki saih u, Khazia Khazohpa ta a pahrâ nawpa ta a khopa tlâh cha, A haopa ta moh ei chi ta, Tlyzaw ta Abeipa pahrâ nawpa tlâh cha, A haopa ta nama moh tly?
Khazohpa talailihzy cha thy hluhpi châ ta, Thy sâh hluhpi a châ; Abeipa cha Sinai liata a ypa hawhna khata, Pathaihna ta ama hry liata a pahrâ.
Hy Zehôvâh Khazohpa, Chô lâ na kia nota, Patupazy cha sei ta a chhi chi ta; Cha liata na pahrâ thei nawpa ta, Chyhsazy tawhta hmopiepazy daopa ta, Dyuhtuhpazy tawhta chhao na daopa kha.
Abeipa cha reithaipa ta y mawh sy, Ano cha noh chareih ta phaohri miah phaokheituhpa châ ta, Khazohpa cha eima pachhana a châ.
Eima Khazohpa cha pachhana Khazohpa châ ta, Thina tawhta puana chhao, Abeipa, zibeipa liata a y.
A chariahpazy deikua cha, Khazohpa ta ama luh chhawh pathlah aw ta, A thaileichâna lâpi a chhihpa hrôtô a chhawh pathlah aw.
Abeipa ta hetana heta a tah: “Bâsanâ râh tawhta a chhi heih aw ei na ta, Tilaipi athupa tawhta ei chhi heih aw ei.
Chatanachata ama thisaih liata na phei tly aw chi ta, Na izy paleih ta khakhaipazy liata tovyuh a hnei aw.”
Hy Khazohpa, na sie haipa hmô ei ta, Ei Khazohpa, ei Beipa, Su pathaihpa lâ na siepa chhao ama hmô.
Hlasathaipazy hmia a sahpa ta, Pyungia tô thaipazy a hnôh chai ta y ei ta, A likawh liata laihsa kôpazy paotlâ tôpa ta sie ei ta,
“Khazohpa cha pakhypi rônahpa liata reithai u la, Izarei tihnawh saih u, Abeipa cha reithai teh u,” ama tah.
Hawti chaipa Benzami ta âmo cha chhihtha ta, Zudâh chhituhpa hluhpi y ei ta, Zebulawna nata Nâthalai chhituhpazy amâ hlao hra.
Hy Khazohpa, na hmotaotheina aw la, Hy Khazohpa, na tao tyhpa hawhta, Na thatlôna miah pahmô heih mah y.
Zerusale liata nâma Achhyna o vâta, Beizy ta kuhriazy ama cha vaw cheipa aw.
Lohthizy hry liata sahrâhpazy ra la, Phopizy viahchao tôhpa nata viahchaotawzy ra mah y. Râhpaw a tlaichhaipazy cha na phei ry liata tlypâ la, Adyuhna a pahâh kawpa phopizy hiepatla ha mah y.
Izi râh tawhta lyuhchâpazy a khy aw ei ta, Kusi ta Khazohpa lâ a ku thlai a pazawh aw.
Hy khizaw râhzy saih u, Abeipa lâ reithaina hla sa u la,
Avâzy chô a kiahpa lâta, Avâ hlôpazy chô a kiahpa lâ tlai ta, Reithaina hla sa muh vy. Moh teh u, a ao papua ha ta, A ao rônahpa a papua haw.
Khazohpa cha hmotaotheina patosa teh u; A rônahna Izarei chô liata y ta, A thatlôna avâ liata a ypa a châ.
Hy Khazohpa, na supathaihpa liata chizapa châ chi ta, A phopi hnohta hmotaotheina nata thatlôna a piepa, Izarei Khazohpa na châ. Khazohpa cha reithaipa ta y mawh sy!
Hy Khazohpa, na pachha mah y! Tizy ta ei rao taih eina vao ha hih.
Chiatlao athupa liata a pamôh na ta, Tly nawpa rai y vei; Ti athupa tlô na ta, Tisaih ta eina vao.
Ei awna ta ei thachhâ ta, Ei rao chhao hi khai ha ta, Ei Khazohpa ei hâna ta ei mo a zoh khai haw.
A chhâpa y leipa ta nâ haotuhpazy cha, Ei luh liata ei sâzy hlâta hluh via ei ta, Parao awpa ta haipa ta nâ teituhpazy chhao, Ama thatlô ngaita. Khâpa hmo ma ei paru tly, Tahmâ ei thô heih awpa cha?
Hy Khazohpa, ei hruzie pahno chi ta, Ei moleinazy nâ tawhta nyupa châ vei.
Hy Pheisaihzy Abeipa Zehôvâh, Nâma châ hâtuhpazy cha, Keima vâta nozapa ta y leipa ei sala; Hy Izarei Khazohpa, Nâma châ tluatuhpazy chhao, Keima vâta hmiachhiepa ta y khah ei sy.
Nâma vâta reipachhiena tao na ta, Nohzaona ta ei hmia a khu.
Ei unawhzy liata khichhaipa hawhta châ na ta, Ei nô sawzy liata chihropa hawhta ei châ haw.
Na o châta phahnai ei ngiahna ta na nie khai ha ta, Châ reipachhietuhpazy reipachhiena ei chô liata a tla.
Chana nata kâhvileipa ta ei hro ei panawh châh ta, Reipachhiena tlao ei hlao.
Ei chysia châta latho poh ei hmâ nahta, Ama reih khoh kawpa tlao ei châ ha tyh.
Thokhy chhikao liata a tyuhpazy ta ei kyh reih ei ta, Sahma paripazy ta hla eina phi ei.
Kei deikua la, Hy Abeipa y, Nâ lâta thlah ei chhâ. Hy Khazohpa, na kyhpachâna tleih beih leipa vâta, Daihti rypaohpa liata nâ chhy la, Na pachhana ngâchhihna ta nâ chhy mah y.
Chiatlao lia tla awpa tawhta na pachha la, Ei chariahpazy tawhta na pachhapa ta, Ti athupa tawhta na pachha mah y.
Tisaih ta na phaoh leipa sala, Ti athupa ta na palâ hra leipa sala, Khaohtlô ta a pakah na pabieh khâh khah sy.
Hy Abeipa, nâma kyhpachâna cha pha tlôh ta, Nâ chhy mah y; Na zawngiahna a chhâ thai leipa vâta, Kei lâ a vaw heih mah y.
Châ chakaotuhpa he na hmia nyusai leipa la, Ei nôpo ngaita ta, Thlai nâ chhy mah y.
Nâ vaw hniapa ta ei thlahpa chatlai la, Ei chariahpazy vâta na pachha mah y!
Reipachhiena ei tyhpazy pahno chi ta, Ei nozana nata ei nohzaona zy na pahno; Ei khakhaipazy chhao na pahno khai.
Reipachhienazy ta ei palôh pasasa ei ta, Pachârôhpa ta ei y. Nâ ngiachhie awpa tlua na ta, Châhrasala ahy hmah y veih ei; Thlah nâ palôh awpa tlua na ta, Châhrasala pakha hmah hmô veih ei na.
Pati vyuhpa ta châmaih na pie ei ta, Ei dâhphi nota kresawhti thaopa eina padosa ei.
Ama hmiakô liata ama tlâhkhai cha, Khoheih vaw châ sala; Thlalôhpa ta ama y hai nota, Âmo châta aphyh châ mawh sy.
Ama hmô thei lei nawpa ta ama mozy zoh sala, Ama chaizy khâ a chalyu mawh sy.
Na ruchhôna ama chô liata lei thlu la, Na pathiiana ta âmo cha patu mawh sy.
Ama riehmo roryhrapa ta y sala, Ama poh ozy liata ahy hmahta pahrâ khah ei sy.
Na tupa chyhsa chô liata taolana baichha ei ta, Hmah na paphaopazy pasana ama reih chanei tyh.
Ama chô liata hriena baichha lymâ la, Âmo cha na siana liata pangiasa khah y.
Ahrohpazy châbu tawhta ama moh phiepa châ sala, Mosiapazy hry liata ama moh roh khah y.
Kei deikua cha pasataopa nata pachârôhpa ta y na ta, Hy Khazohpa, na pachhana ta chô lâ na soh mawh sy.
Khazohpa moh cha hla ta reithai aw na ta, Alyna bie reipa ta ano cha ei palyupalih aw.
Cha chata viahchao tôhpa hlâpa hlâta, Abeipa palysa via aw ta; Ki nata chakiezy a hneipa viahchao tôhpa hlâpa hlâta, Abeipa a palysa via aw.
Areisipazy ta cha cha hmô aw ei ta, Amâ ly aw; Nâmo, Khazohpa a tluatuhpazy saih u, Nama palôh a hra mawh sy.
Abeipa ta phahlapazy ao thei ta, A phopi atâhpazy mohnao vei.
Avâ nata alei ta ano cha reithai sala, Tilaipizy nata a chhôh liata a pie theipa zydua ta, Ano cha reithai mawh ei sy.
Khazohpa ta Zaio cha pachha aw ta, Zudâh khihpizy a padua aw; Cha liata a chyhsazy pahrâ aw ei ta, Râh cha ama hnei aw.
A chakaotuhpa chipathlazy ta râh ryu to aw ei ta, A moh a pasôtuhpazy cha liata ama pahrâ aw.
Hy Khazohpa, na pachha awpa ta a para la, Hy Abeipa, thlai na pachha mah y!
Ei hrona pahlei a chhuapazy cha, Nozapa nata noraihpa ta y ei sala, Ei hmahphaona liata a lypazy cha, Nohzaopa ta kua mawh ei sy!
“Khawh, khawh!” a tatuhpazy cha, Hmiachhiepa ta a lie mawh ei sy.
Châ tluatuhpa zydua cha, Nâma liata a lypa ta ama thapha sala, Na pachhana a pasôtuhpazy ta, “Khazohpa cha a rônah na,” tah mawh ei sy!
Kei deikua cha dyhchhiepa nata phahlapa châ na ta, Hy Khazohpa, kei lâ a vy para mah y! Nâ baotuhpa nata nâ pachhatuhpa châ chi ta, Hy Abeipa, hawh khah y!
Hy Abeipa, nâ châ chhai na ta, Maophyuhpa ta na paysa khah y!
Na siana vâta na pachha la, Na papua mah y; Kei lâ na nah vaw pachôh la, Na pachha mah y!
Khâ ei pangai tyh awpa, Ei chhaina lôpanô na châpa la; Ei lôpanô nata ei thokhy châ chi ta, Na pachha awpa ta biepie mah y.
Hy ei Khazohpa, moleipa ku tawh­ta na pachha la, Chyhsa chhiepa nata adoleipa ku tawhta na pachha mah y.
Hy Abeipa, nâ cha ei hnabeiseihna châ chi ta, Hy Abeipa, ei hawti no tawhta ei ngâchhâpa na châ.
Chhi tawhta nâ liata a pahnieh na ta, Ei nô py tawhta nâ latuhpa na châ. Khâ ei cha reithai aw.
Chyhsa hluhpi châta ngiana châ na ta, Châhrasala nâ cha ei chhaina thatlôpa na châ.
Ei pakah he nâma reithaina ta bie ta, Nâma palyupalihna ta noh y ta a bie.
Ei machâ tita na thy leipa la, Ei tha â sy tita na siesai khah y.
Ei chariahpazy ta ei kyh na reih ei ta, Ei hrona a byhtuhpazy a pachia ei ta,
“Khazohpa ta a siesai haw, A chadai u la patu teh u; A pachha awpa y khao veih ei,” ama tah.
Hy Khazohpa, nâ hla leipa la, Hy ei Khazohpa, na bao awpa ta a para mah y!
Nâ leihtuhpazy maophyuhpa ta leidia ei sala, Pasasa nâ chhuahpazy cha, Mohnaona nata nohzaona ta khu mawh ei sy.
Kei deikua cha hnabeiseihpa ta khâ y aw na ta, Ei cha reithai via rili aw.
Ei pakah ta na siana bie chho aw ta, Na pachhana bie noh y ta a chho aw, A chhozie awpa ei pahno thai leipa chhao ta.
Hy Abeipa Zehôvâh, Na hmotao rônahpa reithaipa ta a vy aw na ta, Na siana ei phuah aw, Nâma siana tlai cha ei phuah aw.
Hy Khazohpa, ei hawti no tawhta na pachu chi ta, Tanoh taihta na hmotao noâhpazy ei phuah lymâ.

Chavâta Hy Khazohpa, Machâpa nata sâ pawhpa ei châ tita, Na siesai khah y; Chhâ a vaw y awpa hnohta na thatlôna ei phuah hlâlei cha, Na siesai leipa la; Miah a vaw pazi awpazy hnohta Na hmotaotheina ei phuah hlâlei cha, Na siesai hra khah y.
Hy Khazohpa, na siana nata na hmo­taotheina ta avâ sâhpazy kaw daih ta, Nâ cha hmo rônahpazy a taotuhpa na châ; Hy Khazohpa, nâ hawhpa he ahy ma a y?
Nôpona nata chhiena hluhpi nâ pahmôsatuhpa nâma tlai chata, Na pahro heih aw chi ta, Alei athupa tawhta eina thaoh heih aw chi.
Ei rônahna papôhsa aw chi ta, Thlah eina palôh heih aw chi.
Na ngâchhihna vâta, Hy Khazohpa, Totâ ta cha reithai aw na ta; Hy Izarei Mo Pathaihpa, Tlaipih ta cha reithaipa ta ei sa aw.
Nâma reithaina hla ei sa tita, Ei hmaozy he thaphapa ta awh aw ta; Na chatlaipa ei hro chhao heta, Thaphapa ta a awh aw.
Ei paleih he noh y ta na siana bie reih aw ta, Pasasa nâ chhuahpazy cha, Maophyuhpa nata hnabeidypa ta ama y.
Hy Khazohpa, abei hnohta na ryureina dopa pie la, Abei sawchapawpa hnohta na siana pie mah y!
Na phopi chô liata siana ta ryureih sala, Dyhchhiepazy chô liata adona ta ryureih mawh sy!
Tlâhpizy ta na phopi châta sivâphana papua ei sala, Tlâhthlôhzy ta adona byhnâzy papua mawh ei sy!
Râhsaw dyhchhiepazy a duakhei sala, Phahlapa sawzy pachhapa ta, Tlybaituhpazy chanaoh mawh sy!
Noh a y chhôh zydua ta cha chi ei sala, Thlâpâ y chhôh zydua cha chipa ta, Chhâ zydua ta cha chi mawh ei sy!
Abei cha sibie thlyupa chô liata vâsua hawhta châ sala, Alei a baopa khihti hawhta châ mawh sy!
Ano hro chhôh nohzy liata cha, Chyhsa siapazy a sosâh ei sala, Thlâpâ a lei hlâlei cha, Sivâphana thata y mawh sy!
Tilaipi tawhta tilaipi taihta biehnei sala, Chavah tawhta alei chhâna taihta biehnei mawh sy!
Râhchawhpa chiphozy a hmiakô liata a bôh ei sala, A chariahpazy cha dohlei palie mawh ei sy!
Tâsi nata liahpahlô beizy ta ano lâ râhpaw pie ei sala, Sebâ nata Sibâ beizy ta kuhriazy pie mawh ei sy!
Bei zydua ta a hmiakô liata a bôh ei sala, Râh zydua ta ano cha chakao mawh ei sy!
Ano cha phahlapa ta a aw tita, A pachhatuhpa châ ta; Baotuh hnei leipa dyhchhiepa ta a aw tita, A pachhatuhpa a châ.
Chiehleipa nata phahlapazy ngiachhie ta, Phahlapazy hrona a pachha.
Tlybaina nata thachahra hmâna tawhta ama hrona chatlai ta, A mohmô liata ama thisaih a sôh ngaita.
Abei cha hroh pareih sala, Sebâ ngôh piepa châ mawh sy! Ano châta khâ thlahchhâ ei sala, Noh y ta byhnâ awpa mawh ei sy!
Râh liata kô thata veih sala, Tlâhpizy liata sâh a chanei mawh sy. A thei cha Lebanaw hawhta châ sala, Khihpi chyhsazy chhao lyurâh sibiepa hawhta, Ama paw pakai mawh ei sy.
A moh chhâzaw ta y sala, Noh a chhi chhôh zydua cha, A moh pathâh lymâ mawh sy! Phopi cha ano liata byhnâ topa ta y sala, Râh zydua ta ano cha nohlaopa tah mawh ei sy!
Abeipa, Izarei Khazohpa cha, Reithaipa ta y mawh sy; Ano deita he hmonoâhpazy taotuhpa a châ.
A moh rônahpa cha chhâzaw ta reithaipa ta y sala, Leilô zydua he a rônahna ta bie mawh sy! Amen! Amen!
Zese sawchapawpa Dâvi thlahchhânazy cha, He liana heta a chhâ haw.
Khazohpa cha Izarei chô liata pha ta, Palôh pathaihpazy chô liata a vaw pha tlai na.
Kei deikua cha ei phei chakânazy a chapia daihmâ ta, Ei pheizy â chakhao daihmâ.
Moleipazy vâphana ei hmô nahta, Apalaipazy ei uahva kaw tyh ei.
Ama thi noh taihta pasana rai tao leipa ei ta, Thawh kaw ei ta ama mitlaoh ngaita.
Mohropazy hawhta a tymâ leipa ei ta, Chyhsa hropazy hawhta pasa tao veih ei.
Chavâta apalaina cha ama pachhih châ ta, Nôchhiena chysia amâ tobi.
Ama pachâna cha moleina ta bie ta, Ama palôh saduthliena ta a bie.
Chyhsa pahneisaopa ta bie chhiepa reih ei ta, A palai ngaitapa ta tlybaina bie ama reih tyh.
Ama pakah ta avâzy taih reipachhie ta, Ama paleih ta alei zydua a chahryh.
Chavâta a phopi cha âmo lâ kua ei ta, Âmo liata adoleina hmô veih ei.
“Khazohpa ta kheihta ma a pahno thei aw? Chônôchaipa ta pahnona a hnei ma?” ama tah.
Moh teh, hezy he moleipazy châ ei ta, Phasapa ta ypa ta, Ama hneirôna a papôhsapazy ama châ hih.
Hraoleipa ta ei palôh pathaisa na ta, Seina hnei lei awpa ta hraoleipa ta ei ku ei si tyh.
Noh y ta rie patheipa châ na ta, My chareih ta chhoreipa ta ei y.
“Cha hawhta ei reih aw,” tah aw sah la, Na sawzy chhâ he a paphasaipa ei châ aw.
Cha hmo cha pahno ei chhuah nahta, Kei châta pahno ru ngaitapa châ ha tyh ta;
Khazohpa supathaihpa liata ei ngia nahta, Ama chhâna awpa cha ei pahno thai haw.
Âmo cha su pahniapazy liata soh chi ta, Raokei awpa ta na papaosa ei.
Kheihtazie ta ma sôkha ta pahleipadiapa châ ei ta, Hmo chichhihpazy ta a phaoh pathlah thlâh ha ei tly!
Chyhsa a kaw hra ta, A mâsapa khâpasaw ta a rei leipa hawhta; Hy Abeipa, nâ hra tita, Âmo cha nothlahpa hawhta hmô aw chi ta, Khâpasaw ta reih aw va chi.
Ei hro a pachârôh ta, Ei palôh ahloh chhôpa hawhta a y nota,
Ahrupa nata hmo a pahno leipa châ na ta, Na hmiakô liata râhsa hawhta ei ypa kha.
Chatahrasala na hnohta y lymâ na ta, Ei ku chachâh lâ khâ eina patu chi.
Na ryhraona ta na chhihtha chi ta, Cha khai tawhta rônahna liata einâ ly aw chi.
Avâ liana khi ta, Nâ leipa ta ahy hropa ma ei hnei tly? Alei liana chhao heta, Nâ leipa ta khopa hro hnei va na.
Ei sapa nata ei palôh he a tleih thei, Châhrasala Khazohpa cha ei palôh thatlôna châ ta, Tlyzaw châta ei tovyuh a châ.
Pachâ teh, nâma châ hlapazy cha leidia aw ei ta, Na châta ngâchhih leipazy cha ama chhâna na patlôsa tyh.
Kei châta deikua cha, Khazohpa a hniapa he a pha na; Abeipa Zehôvâh cha ei chhaina ta hmâh na ta, Na raihria kyh zydua ei chho lymâ aw.
Hy Khazohpa, khazia chhâzaw ta miah thy chi ta, Khazia na sibiepa su liata mietakuzy cha, Na hiehâhna meikhuh ta na pa-uh khai ha ei tly?
Na phopi he a thei mah y; Hlâno tawhta na chaleipazy châ pi ta, Na ryuto chipho châ awpa ta na chatlaipazy eima châ! Na pahrâ tyhna Zaio Tlâh chhao a thei mah y.
Chhâzaw ta a rao hapa su lâ he na phei vaw pahei tua, Chariahpa ta su pathaihpa liata hmo to a parao khai haw.
Na phopi apakhyna liata na khakhaipazy rahao ei ta, Âmo ngianazy ama taw thlu.
Ahrei chalopa ta, Râhmâhpa tho a thlupazy ama lyu.
Râhmâhpa tho liata nothlahpa khiepa zydua cha, Ahrei nata syulôzy ta ama thlu khai haw.
Na supathaihpa mei ta rao ei ta, Na moh yna ama papuapalei.
Ama palôh ta, “Parao khai ha ei suh u,” tah ei ta, Râh liata Khazohpa achhyna o zydua ama rao khai haw.
Ngiana nata hmonoâhpazy hmô khao leipa pi ta, Hrohsopa rai y khao leipa ei ta; Khati taih ma he hawhta a sie aw tahpa a pahnopa chhao, Eima hry liata y veih ei.
Hy Khazohpa, khati taih ma khakhaipa ta a cha pahneisao aw? Chariahpa ta chhâzaw ta na moh a reipachhie aw ma?
Khazia na ku nâ dao ha tly, Khazia na ku chachâh lâ nâ dao ha tly? Na chysia byh tawhta na ku phia la, Âmo cha pahleipadia ha mah y.
Hy Khazohpa, nâ cha hlâno tawhta ei Beipa châ chi ta, Alei chô zydua liata pachhana a taotuhpa na châ.
Na thatlôna ta tilaipi pachhaih chi ta, Tilaipi sa lai ngaitapazy luh na pakei haw.
Leviathâ luhzy pakei chi ta, Râhchawhpa sazy nie awpa ta Leviathâ cha na pie ei.
Tihnawhzy a papuatuhpa nata vahtiezy a palosatuhpa châ chi ta, Vahtly tipi a pakuatuhpa na châ.
Chhô he na eih châ ta, Zâ chhao na eih a châ; Avâ liata khaihpazy soh chi ta, Noh chhao khi nâma sopa a châ.
Alei liata râhrizy pakhâh chi ta, Nopi nata chasipaw zy na tao.
Hy Abeipa, he he a thei mah y; Chariahpa ta cha pahneisao ta, Phopi hrupa ta na moh a reipachhie.
Na vachhuh hrona cha, Sahrâhpazy hlâ leipa la; Na chyhsa dyhchhiepazy hrona chhao, Chhâzaw ta my khah y.
Lei su zohpazy cha thachahra hmâna ta a bie hapa vâta, Na biehrai pachâ tyh mah y.
Tlybaipazy cha nozapa ta pakuasa leipa la, Dyhchhiepa nata phahlapa zy ta na moh cha reithai mawh ei sy.
Hy Khazohpa, thyu la, na bie a duakhei la, Ahrupa ta noh y ta a cha reipachhiezie he a thei mah y!
Na khakhaipazy palopasahpa my leipa la, Châ thyuhnaopazy achiaburâhna paru via lymâpa chhao my khah y!
Hy Khazohpa, alyna bie eima cha hlâ; Na moh â hniapa vâta alyna bie cha hlâ pi ta, Na hmonoâh taopa kyhzy eima phuah.
Nâ ta, “Daihti ei raopa liata, Â dopa ta ei pachia aw.
Alei nata a chô liata a ypa zydua â chalyu nota, A tôhzy a patutuhpa cha keima ei châ.
A khotlâhpazy hnohta, ‘A khotlâh khah u,’ tah na ta, Hmoparaopazy hnohta, ‘Nama kizy chaluah khah u,’ ei tah.
Nama ki â sâhpa ta chaluah leipa u la, Nama rao pachhuapa ta bie reih khuh vy,” tah chi ta.
Chyhsapa cheihchalona cha, Nochhi lâ tawhta a zu leipa ta, Notla lâ tawhta a khy hra leipa ta, Râhchawhpa tawhta a vy hra vei.
Pachiatuhpa cha Khazohpa châ ta, Ano ta pakha panawhsa ta, Pakha a cheihchalo tyh.
Abeipa ku liata cha, Kresawhti pahâhpa nyu a y; Kresawhti cha a buchaphy pua ngâ ta, Abeipa ta patlai ta, Khizaw liata moleipa zydua ta doh ei ta, A chaopahrâ taihta ama doh khai haw.
Kei deikua cha, Zakaw Khazohpa thâtih khâ phuah aw na ta, Ano reithaipa ta ei sa aw.
Moleipa ki zydua tai pachhô aw na ta, Mosiapazy ki deikua cha chaluahpa a châ aw.
Zudâh liata Khazohpa pahno ei ta, Izarei liata a moh parônahsapa ta a y.
Salem liata a byureih y ta, Zaio liata a pahrâna su a y.
Cha liata châtai patliepazy thlie pachhô ta, Vyhphao, zaozi nata chariah chhaichhizy a thlie pachhô khai haw.
Râhsazy ta a biepa tlâhpizy hlâta, Khaih via chi ta, na rônah via.
Riahphapazy hraopa ta y ei ta, Amâ môna liata a môsao ei ta, Pasaiphazy ama ku hmâh thei khao veih ei.
Hy Zakaw Khazohpa, na rana vâta, Arâ nata a kiahtuhpa zy pao ei ta, Nokhih pahno leipa ta ama y.
Nâ, nâma tlai cha chi awpa châ chi ta, Na pathi a ia ha khiahta cha, Ahy ma na hmiakô liata a duah thei aw?
Avâ tawhta pachiana bie phuah chi ta, Alei ta chi ta, sidiapa ta a y.
Lei liata reisipazy pachha awpa ta Khazohpa thyu ta, Pachiana dopa a phuah nota, Alei ta chi ta, sidiapa ta a y.
Hmeiseihta ta, chyhsapa chô liata na pathiiana cha, Nâma reithaina châ aw ta; Na pathiiana tawhta a bohpazy cha, Chaisaih ta nâ saih aw ei.
Abeipa nama Khazohpa liata biezy a taih u la, Nama bietaizy cha patlô muh vy; Chi awpa lâna chata a chheipâh râhzy ta, Hmosaipiepazy vaw cheih mawh ei sy.
Ano cha ryureituhpazy thlahpa a chhawh pathlah theipa châ ta, Lei beizy ta ama chi awpa a châ.
Ao paropa ta Khazohpa lâ awh na ta, Khazohpa lâ tlai cha ao paropa ta ei awh; Kei lâta a nah a pachôh aw.
Ei nôpona noh liata Abeipa tlua na ta, Zâ ta chhao ei ku pathla leipa ta ei pazawh lymâ; Ei hro he thlapalôh thei awpa châ khao vei.
Khazohpa ei thei châh ta, A hrô na ta; Ei pachâ châh ta, Ei thlahpa tha a chhâ tyh.
Mo paso lei awpa ta na tao chi ta, Nôpopa ta bie chhao reih thei khao va na.
Hlâno daihtizy rohpady na ta, Kô hluhpi a khô hapazy ei pachâ tyh.
“Zâ ta ei hla a thei sah la, Ei palôh ta pachâ tua sah,” tah na ta, Chatanachata ei thlahpa ta pakhâta ta a tlua:
“Abeipa ta chhâzaw ta a thy pathlah aw ma? Khokheina palâsa beih khao aw vei ma?
A zawngiahna a chhâ pathlah ha aw ma? A bietai chhâ zydua châta a rao ha aw ma?
Khazohpa ta ngiachhiena hnei awpa a my ha ma? Hiehâhna ta ma a thapasana a khaw haw?”
Chatawcha ei palôh liata, “Chônôchaipa ku chachâh lâta hmo a tao khao leipa he, Keima adoleina vâta a châ,” tah na ta.
Abeipa hmotaopazy a thei thlâh ha aw na ta, A châ na, hlâno ta na hmonoâh taopazy ei thei thlâh ha aw.
Na raihria zydua pachâ aw na ta, Na hmotao thatlôpazy ei laichadai aw.
Hy Khazohpa, na lâpi cha a pathaih tlai na; Eima Khazohpa hawhta a rônahpa khazoh hropa ahy a y?
Nâ cha hmonoâhpa a taotuhpa Khazohpa châ chi ta, Phopizy hry liata na thatlôna na palâsa haw.
Na bâh ta na phopi chatlai chi ta, Zakaw nata Zawsi pathlazy na chatlai ha ei.
Hy Khazohpa, tizy ta cha hmô ei ta, Tizy ta ama cha hmô nahta chi ngaita ei ta, Ti athupazy taihta amâ chalyu.
Meihdozy ta ti za patlai ei ta, Avâzy ta tôkalôhpa pathuasapa ta, Na châtaizy su to liata ama pathlie.
Na tôkalôhpa pyu cha khisô liata y ta, Na dôhlazy ta khizaw pakhaihsapa ta, Alei he a chalyu ta â chatho.
Na lâpi ta tilaipi siepahlie ta, Na lâthlôh ta ti lai ngaitapazy a siepahlie; Chatanachôta na pheihniezy hmô awpa y vei.
Mawsi nata Arawna ku ta, Mietaku zaw hawhta na phopi na chhihtha.
Hy ei phopi, ei pachuna nathlie la, Ei pakah biezy lâta na nah pachôh mah y!
Pakhona bie hmâpa ta ei pakah â aw na ta, Hlâno tawhta bienyupazy ei reih aw.
Miah pathlatuhpazy ta miah chho ei ta, Thei pi ta eima pahnopa biezy ei reih aw.
Ama pathlazy phih leipa aw pi ta, Chhâ a vaw y awpa hnohta tlao eima chho aw; Abeipa hmotao rônahpa nata a thatlônazy chho aw pi ta, Hmonoâhpa a taopazy eima chho aw.
Zakaw châta bieraopa padua ta, Izarei châta ryhpa a tao; Ama pathlazy pachu awpa ta, Miah pathlatuhpazy hnohta bie a pie ei.
Chatanachata chhâ a vaw y awpazy ta pahno aw ei ta, Hawti a pih mâh leipazy chhao ta vaw pahno aw ei ta, Thyu aw ei ta ama pathlazy ama chho pachhuah lymâ aw.
Ama hnabeiseihna Khazohpa liata pahnieh aw ei ta, Khazohpa hmotaopazy my leipa ta, A biepiepazy ama zyh lymâ aw.
Âmo pathlatuhpazy hawhta, Chhorupa nata dyuhtuhpa châ leipa aw ei ta, Palôh a i leipa chhâ lyu leipa aw ei ta, Khazohpa châta thlahpa ngâchhih leipa hawhpazy châ aw veih ei.
Epharai mo cha libaw a chaba ei ta, Châhrasala adyuhna noh liata hnôh amâ sy haw.
Khazohpa biehrai zyh leipa ei ta, A ryhpa lâpi a chhih veih ei.
A hmotaopazy my ei ta, Hmonoâhpa a pahmôsapazy chhao ama my haw.
Ama pathlatuhpazy mohmô ta hmonoâhpazy tao ta, Izi râh Zônâ lyuzy liata hmonoâhpazy a taopa ei.
Tilaipi pachhaihpa ta âmo cha pasiesa ta, Tizy toh ta a chalihsa.
Nohchhô ta meihdo ta âmo chhihtha ta, Zâ ta mei khaihpa ta a chhihtha ei.
Râhchawhpa liata lôpanôzy patlaw ta, Tilih athupa ti hawhta, Doh awpa hluhpi a pie ei.
Lôpanô tawhta vahtiezy papua ta, Vahpi tizy hawhta a palosa.
Chatanachôta a chô liata molei via rili ei ta, Chônôchaipa cha râhchawhpa liata amâ dyuh.
Ama palôh ta Khazohpa pasia ei ta, Ama aohkhopa pati amâ hnaw.
Khazohpa reipachhie ei ta, “Khazohpa ta râhchawhpa liana heta, Tlâhkhai â chhuahdy thei tlai aw ma?
Lôpanô tu ta tizy vaw puapa ta, Vahtiepazy kao a khô pathlah. Viahchhâ chhao miah piepa ta, A phopi nie awpa sa miah a pie thei tlai aw ma?” ama tah.
Chavâta, cha biezy cha Abeipa ta a thei nahta, A pathi ia ngaita ta; Zakaw cha mei ta vaw pua thlu ta, Abeipa hiehâhna ta Izarei cha a thyuhnao.
Khazohpa a ngiapâ leipa ei ta, A pachhana ama ngâ leipa vâta, Cha hmo cha ama chô liata a tlôpa a châ.
Chatahrasala chô lâ avâzy khi biepiepa ta, Vârâh ochhizy pahy ta;
Ama nie awpa mânâ ama chô liata za pasuasa ta, Vârâh sâh a pie ei.
Vâlyuhchâpazy viahchhâ cha chyhsazy ta nie ei ta, Khazohpa ta nie awpa hluhpi a za pathlapa ei.
Avâzy liata nochhi thlih pathlisa ta, A hmotaotheina ta chho thlih a pathlisa.
Dohlei hawhta ama chô liata sa pasuasa ta, Tilaipa sadi hawhta mathlaw hneipa pavawzy a pasuasa.
Ama riehmo liah liata patlasa ta, Ama pahrâna zydua liata a patlasa.
Ama aohkhopa a piepa vâ ei ta, Nie ei ta rihbiepa ta ama y.
Châhrasala ama aoh lôhrâ tlô hlâta, Ama pakahzy liata pati a y thlâh chy nota,
Khazohpa hiehâhna ama chô liata vaw tlô ta, Ama chyhsa thatlô chaipazy thie ta, Izarei satliazy a tusao ha ei.
Cha zydua cha amâ tyhpa chhao ta, Molei ngâ thlâh chy ei ta; Hmonoâhpazy a taopa chhao ta, Zo hlei veih ei.
Chavâta ama nohzy cha, Hu ei kha sopa hawhta a lei awpa ta tao ta; Ama kôzy chhao, China ta kô châh a padisa ei.
A thie nah ei ta ano cha pado ei ta, Ropa ta Khazohpa ama tlua heih tyh.
Khazohpa cha ama lôpanô a châ tahpa a thei ei ta, Chônôchai Khazohpa cha, Âmo chatlaituhpa a châ tahpa amâ thei heih tyh.
Châhrasala ama pakah ta papyupahly pakhei ei ta, Ama paleih ta haipa bie ama rei thlu tyh.
Ano liata ama palôh a i leipa ta, A biehrai liata ngâ a chhih veih ei.
Chatahrasala ano cha thapasana ta a biepa a châpa vâta, Ama paraona cha a ngiahthai ta, Âmo cha pahleipadia vei. A hiehâhna ei hluhpi padia ta, A pathiiana zydua pathyu khoh vei.
Chyhsapa deita ama châ tahpa a thei thlâh ha ta, Thlih khô ta a vaw kua khao leipa hawhta ama châpa â thei thlâh haw.
Râhchawhpa liata ei hluhpi chakhia ei ta, Râraohpa liata ei hluhpi a pachâ ama parôh.
Khazohpa pasia chanei ngâ thlâh ha ei ta, Izarei Mo Pathaihpa ru ama pachhô chanei heih tyh.
A hmotaotheina a thei khao leipa ei ta, Khakhaipa tawhta âmo a pachha noh a thei khao veih ei.
Izi liata ngiana a taopazy a thei khao leipa ei ta, Zônâ lyuzy liata a hmonoâh taopazy a thei khao hra veih ei.
Ama vahpi tizy thisaih lâta palie ta, Chavâta ama vahtie tizy doh thei khao veih ei.
Ama hry liata mathyupa hri hluhpi tuah ta, Chazy chata âmo cha nie khai ei ta; Cha-uzy chhao tuah ta, Chazy chata âmo cha a pahleipadia khai ha ei.
Ama chicheipazy chângyu pie ta, Ama hriapasana thei khawsu a pie haw.
Ama kre zôhzy cha pareih hmâpa ta parao ta, Ama theiku kôzy chhao dâhaw hmâpa ta a parao haw.
Ama viahchaozy pareih lâ hlâ ta, Ama mietakuzy pachie lâ a hlâ haw.
A hiehâhna ru ngaitapa ama chô liata pathla thlu ta, Vâlyuhchâpa sahlaozy ta, Pathiiana, ruchhôna nata nôpona zy ama vaw tlôkhei.
A hiehâhna châta lâpi taopa ta, Thina tawhta ama thlahpa pahlôh leipa ta, Potlana lâta ama hrona a hlâ ha ei.
Izi râh liata sawchapaw uhtheipa zydua thie ta, Hamâ poh ozy liata ama thatlôna thei hmiatuapazy a thie ha ei.
A phopi deikua cha mietaku hawhta puakhei ta, Mietaku zaw hawhta râhchawhpa liata a chhihtha ei.
Â bohpa ta âmo cha chhihtha ta, Khâpa hmah chi veih ei; Ama chariahpazy deikua cha, Tilaipi ta a vao khai ha ei.
Âmo cha a râh pathaihpa lâ a chhi ta, A ku chachâh lâta a pahniepa tlâhpi lâ â chhi ei.
Ama hmiakô liata phopizy papua ta, Ama râhzy cha Izarei chizy ryuto châta pachhaih ta, Izarei chizy cha phopizy poh ozy liata a pahrâsa ei.
Chatanachôta Chônôchai Khazohpa cha pasiapa ta chakhia ei ta, A bieraopazy zyh veih ei.
Kua ei ta âmo pathlatuhpazy hawhta, Piehpie ngaitapa ta hmotao ei ta; Libaw doleipa hawhta, A pahnieh tlâh châ veih ei.
Ama su sâhpazy vâta a hie pahâh ei ta, Ama khazoh nothlahpazy vâta hiatliapa ta ama paysa.
Cha kyh cha Khazohpa ta a thei nahta, A hiehâh ngaita ta; Izarei cha a dytha pathlah haw.
Silô liata a byureih siesai ta, Chyhsapa hry liata a pahrâna poh o a siesai haw.
A thatlôna cha sei châ awpa ta hlâ ta, A rônahna chhao a khakhaipa ku liata a hlâ haw.
A phopi cha zaozi liata hlâ ta, A ryuto chô liata a hiehâhna a papua thlu.
Mei ta ama satliazy kâ khai ha ta, Ama laihsazy ahneina hla sa thei khao veih ei.
Ama theihthaipazy zaozi ta pao ei ta, Ama nôhmeizy chaphôhtu khao veih ei.
Abeipa cha â môpa tawhta a kaw hra ta, Chyhsa thatlôpa ta kresawhti vâta a awhpa hawhta awh ta.
A khakhaipazy hnôh pasysa ta, Chhâzaw ta nozapa ta a tao ha ei.
Zawsi poh o dytha ta, Epharai chi a tlyh vei.
Zudâh chi tlao a tlyh ta, A kyhpachâpa Zaio Tlâh tlao â tlyh haw.
A supathaihpa cha avâzy hawhta sa ta, Tlyzaw châta a paduapa alei hawhta a sa.
A chakaotuhpa Dâvi cha a tlyh ta, Mietaku sadôzy tawhta a aw papua.
A phopi Zakaw vaih ta, A ryuto Izarei vaih awpa ta, Mietakuzy vaina tawhta a aw papua.
Chatanachata Dâvi cha palôh dopa ta Izarei sawzy vaih ta, Ku zôthaina ta âmo a chhihtha ei.
Hy Khazohpa, phopi hropazy ta na ryuto râh lâ a vaw ngia ei ta, Nâma Achhyna o pathaihpa papuapaleipa ta, Zerusale khihpi ama parao haw.
Châ chakaotuhpazy ri cha, Avâ pavawzy nie awpa ta pie ei ta; Na chyhsa ngâchhihpazy sapa chhao, Alei liata sahrâhpazy nie awpa ta ama pie.
Zerusale khihpi zydua liata, Ti hawhta ama thisaih patlai ei ta, Âmo a pabu awpa chhao y veih ei.
Eima chheipâh râhzy pasipasawh awpa lâta pua ha pi ta, Eima kiapâh liata a ypazy ta miah pahneisao ei ta, Miah ama reipachhie.
Hy Abeipa, khati taih ma a châ aw tly? Chhâzaw ta ma na hie a hâh thlâh ha aw? Na hiatliana cha mei hawhta ma a kâ aw?
Châ pahno leipa râhzy chô liata na hiehâhna lei thlu la, Na moh a pado leipa abeinarâhzy chô liata chhao lei thlu mah y!
Zakaw palâ ha ei ta, A pahrâna roryhrapa ta ama tao haw.
Miah pathlatuhpazy moleina vâta miah hrie leipa la, Na zawngiahna ta miah a tyh patoh mawh sy, Thata panawhpa ta eima y ha hih.
Hy eima pachhana Khazohpa y, Na moh rônahna châta miah bao mah y; Na moh vâta miah pachha la, Eima moleinazy miah chatlaipa mah y!
Khazia ma phopizy ta, “Ama Khazohpa cha khataih liata a y?” ama tah aw? Châ chakaotuhpazy thisaih phuh miah lapa la, Eima hmiakô lia tlai ta, Phopizy hry liata pahnopa ta y mawh sy!
Atâhpazy ahrôna na hmiakô liata vaw tlô sala, Na hmotaotheina rônahzie lymâ hawhta, Thi awpa ta raopazy cha pahlôh mah y!
Hy Abeipa, eima chheipâh râhzy ta ama cha pasipasawhnazy kha, A lie sari ta ama chô liata viari thô mah y!
Keimo na phopi, na sibiepa su liata mietakuzy deikua ta cha, Chhâzaw ta alyna bie cha hlâ aw pi ta; Chhâ zydua ta na reithaina hla eima chanei lymâ aw.
Hy Izarei vaituhpa, Na nah vaw pachôh la; Mietaku zaw hawhta Zawsi a chhihthatuhpa y, Na nah vaw pachôh mah y! Cherubizy chô liata bei ta patyupa y, Vaw khaih mah y!
Epharai nata Benzami nata Manase hmiakô liata, Na thatlôna pathyu la, Miah pachha awpa ta a vy mah y!
Hy Khazohpa, miah paduapathi heih la, Pachhapa ta eima y thei nawpa ta, Na hmia vaw pakhaihsa mah y!
Hy Zehôvâh Khazohpa Atotaotheipa, Khachâ ma na phopi thlahchhânazy vâta, Na hie a hâh aw tly?
Âmo cha mothlih viahchhâ ta pasa chi ta, Mothlih nyu biepa na padosa ei.
Eima chheipâh râhzy ta amâ chhu awpa ta miah tao chi ta, Eima chariahpazy ta miah ama pahneisao hih.
Hy Khazohpa Atotaotheipa, Miah paduapathi heih la; Pachhapa ta eima y thei nawpa ta, Na hmia vaw pakhaihsa mah y!
Izi tawhta kre zôh vaw phaoh chi ta, Phopizy papuapa ta, Ama râh liata na kre zôh na loh.
Chhaohlei pathaipa chi ta, Â thupi taih a thari thla ta, Lyurâh a bie khai haw.
A nohdi ta tlâhpizy khu ta, A chiahzy ta sidy kô laipazy a pahli.
Tilaipi lâta a chiahzy pazawh laih ta, Chavah taihta a chhyh a paka laih.
Khazia ma a diahpaizy na parao ha tly? A chapiapa maihta a theizy ama lyu bâ he zaw!
Râhmâhpa liata ngiahraih ta a theizy hrao ta, Râhsa zydua ta ama nie.
Hy Khazohpa Atotaotheipa, Vaw kua heih mah y! Avâ tawhta za sai la, Kre zôh he za moh la, Saihei mah y.
Na ku chachâh lâta na lopa kre zôh he vaih la, Nâma châta na palaiseihpa chiah he mohôh mah y.
Na kre zôh mei ta raopa ta thlu ei ta, Na rana vâta na phopi a leidia ha hih.
Na ku chachâh ta na hmâpa chyhsa chô liata na ku pahnieh la, Nâma châta na mohôhpa chyhsa sawchapawpa chô liata na ku pahnieh mah y!
Cha kuasai khao aw ma pi; Eima hrona he pahlôh la, Na moh eima pado aw!
Hy Zehôvâh Khazohpa Atotaotheipa, Miah paduapathi heih mah y! Pachhapa ta eima y thei nawpa ta, Na hmia vaw pakhaihsa mah y!
Eima thatlôna Khazohpa lâ ao paropa ta hla sa u la, Zakaw Khazohpa lâ a lypa ta awh teh u!
Reithaina hla sapa ta khoh tô u la, Totâ nata tlaipih pyu ngiapazy tô teh u.
Thla thiehpa liata chiahmie tô u la, Thlâpâ pôlô no nata eima kyhchhi noh liata chhao tô teh u.
Cha cha Izarei châta bieraopa châ ta, Zakaw Khazohpa biepiepa a châ.
Zawsi châta bieraopa ta tao ta, Izi râh lâ a sie nota a bieraopa châ ta, Reih thei leipazy hry liata a y nota a bieraopa a châ.
Abeipa ta hetana heta a tah: “Na ngiatlâh tawhta phaohri cha pachhôpa na ta, Na kuzy hrâbyh tawhta ei pahua.
Nôpopa ta na aw chi ta, Ei cha pachha; Tôkalôhpa su nyupa liata châ chhy na ta, Meribâ tizy liata ei cha pasia.
Hy ei phopi, nathlie teh, Biesakâ ei cha vaw hih! Hy Izarei, ei bie vaw nathlie ha mawh la cha,
Nâma liata khazoh hropa y leipa aw ta, Chihropa khazoh hmia liata nâ bôh lei awpa tlai!
Kei he Abeipa na Khazohpa châ na ta, Izi râh tawhta châ kaw chhi papuatuhpa kha ei châ. Na pakah a kawhpa ta â la, Ei pabie aw.
“Châhrasala ei phopi ta ei ao nathlie leipa ta, Izarei ta nâ ngiarih khoh vei.
Chavâta ama palôh kuhchha awpa ta pasaih na ta, Âmo ryhraona liata sie awpa ei pasai ha ei.
Aw, ei phopi ta ei bie nathliepa ta, Izarei ta ei lâpizy a vaw chhih ha mawh sala cha,
Ama chariahpazy thlai panawh aw ei na ta, Ama khakhaipazy chô liata ei ku ei hy ha awpa tlai!
Abeipa a haotuhpazy ta ano ry a vaw daoh aw ei ta, Châhrasala ama tovyuh awpa cha chhâzaw hriena a châ aw.
Nâ deikua cha sâh pahâh chaipa ta cha pasa aw na ta, Lôpanô tawhta kheihti ta lôhrâ ei cha patlô aw.”
Khazohpa ta vâ pakhypi rônahpa chhihtha ta, Khazohzy hry liata ryureina siekhei ta, Hetana heta pachiana bie a phuah:
“Khati taih ma â doleipa ta ryureih aw ei chi ta, Moleipazy nama khokhei via chy aw?
Chiehleipa nata paw hnei leipazy a duakhei u la, Pasataopa nata dyhchhiepazy adona pabohsa muh vy.
Chiehleipa nata phahlapazy pachha u la, Moleipazy ku tawhta âmo cha thaoh teh u.
“Pahnona hnei leipa ei ta, Novâhna hnei hra veih ei; Zohna liata charei ei ta, Leilô abôna zydua â chalyu haw.
“Khazohzy hawhta cha vaw pachâ ei na ta, Nama zydua ta Chônôchaipa sawzy hawhta ei cha pachâ ei.
Châhrasala chyhsapa hawhta thi hra aw ei chi ta, Ryureituhpazy hawhta nama pao hra aw.”
Râh zydua he na ryuto châ ta, Chavâta Hy Khazohpa, thyu la, Khizaw liata ryureih mah y!
Hy Khazohpa, a chalih leipa la, Hy Khazohpa, a thlih thlâh ha leipa la, Y molo cheita khah y!
Moh tua, na chariahpazy palopasah ei ta, Châ haotuhpazy ama luh ama pachhua.
Na phopi he piehpie kawpa ta tei ei ta, Na ryusôhpazy a dyuh awpa ta amâ patlapasao.
“A vy u la, ama phopi he pamua ha ei suh u; Izarei moh he a thei thlâhpa ta y khao khah sy!” ama tah.
Reih kha tlapa ta cha tei ei ta, Châ dyuh awpa ta biehrai ama tao.
Chazy cha Edômâ nata Ismela mo poh ozy, Môabâ nata Hâkari mozy,
Kebâli mo, Amawna mo nata Amale mozy, Philistinâ mo nata Tyre mozy châ ei ta,
Asuria mo chhao ta âmo amâ pazao; Âmo he Lawta pathla bâh thatlôpazy ama châ.
Midia mo chô liata na taopa hawhna khata, Ama chô liata tao la; Kisaw chavah liata Siserâ nata Zabi chô liata na taopa hawna khata, Ama chô liata tao hra mah y.
Âmo cha Enadaw liata pahleipadiapa châ ei ta, Chhaohlei châta ie hawh dei ama châ haw.
Ama nôpawpazy cha, Ôrebâ nata Zibâ hawhna khata tao la; Ama beimachâ zydua cha, Zebâ nata Zalmunâ hawhna khata tao mah y.
Âmo cha, “Khazohpa sibiepa suzy he, Keimo châta a la ei suh u,” A tahtuhpazy kha ama châ.
Hy ei Khazohpa, âmo cha doh khupa hawhta tao la, Thlih hmia liata sâh sihpa hawhta tao mah y.
Mei ta râhmâhpa a kâpa hawhta, Meipaleih ta tlâhpizy a charôhpa hawhta,
Âmo cha na thlihpipa ta a chadai la, Na chothyu ta pachisa mah y!
Hy Abeipa, na moh ama tlua thei nawpa ta, Ama hmia cha nozana ta pabie mah y.
Chhâzaw ta nozapa nata ngiarohpa ta y ei sala, Nohzaopa ta leidia mawh ei sy.
Nâ deita he Zehôvâh moh a phaohpa châ chi ta, Khizaw zydua liata Chônôchaipa na châ tahpa ama pahno aw.
Hy Pheisaihzy Abeipa, Na byureihzy cha kho â chhih kaw dia!
Ei hro ta Abeipa dôhpachhôh tlyhmiazy vâ ngaita ta, A panao khai haw; Ei palôh nata ei sapa zy ta, Kha­zohpa hrohpa lâ alyna hla ama sa.
Hy Pheisaihzy Abeipa, Ei Beipa nata ei Khazohpa, Na maisâh kiapâh liata la, Boby hmahta o hnei ta, Siviah chhao ta bu a hnei, A tawzy so nawpa ta.
Na o liata a pahrâpazy cha ama nohlao na, Chhâzaw ta ama cha reithai aw.
Nâma liata ama thatlôna a ypazy nohlao ei ta, A palôh liata Zaio pangaina lâlai a ypazy cha ama nohlao na.
Bâkâ Saikao hipa ama siepahlie nota, Tihnawhzy yna su ta tao ei ta; Vâsua hmiatuapa ta pabie ta, Tipozy lâta â lie tyh.
Sie ei ta ama thatlô via rili ta, Zaio liata Khazohpa hnohta amâ luah hlâlei ama sie lymâ.
Hy Zehôvâh Khazohpa Atotaotheipa, Ei thlahchhâna he thei la; Hy Zakaw Khazohpa y, Nah vaw pachôh mah y!
Hy Khazohpa, eima vyhphao he moh la, Na sathawthupa hmia he sai tua!
Na dôhpachhôh tlyhmia liata noh kha ypa cha, Su hropa liata noh sâh kha ypa hlâta a pha via. Moleipa poh o liata pahrâpa hlâta cha, Ei Khazohpa o chhikao vaituhpa châ awpa ei khoh via.
Zehôvâh Khazohpa cha noh nata vyhphao châ ta, Abeipa cha khokheina nata palyupalihna a pietuhpa a châ. Âdopa ta a ypazy châta cha, Hmo phapa thlyu aw vei.
Hy Pheisaihzy Abeipa, Nâma châ ngâtuhpa cha a nohlao na!
Hy Abeipa, na râh khokhei chi ta, Zakaw cha vânoh na patosa heih.
Na phopi paraona a ngiahthai chi ta, Ama moleina zydua na khu khai.
Na pathiiana zydua pachhâsa chi ta, Na hiehâhna ru ngaitapa nâ heihsai haw.
Hy eima pachhana Khazohpa, Miah paduapathi heih la, Eima chô liata na ruchhôna papai mah y!
Chhâzaw ta ma eima chô liata na hie a hâh aw? Chhâ zydua taihta ma na hie a hâh ngâ thlâh ha aw?
Na phopi he nâma liata â ly thei nawpa ta, Miah pahra heih aw va chi ma?
Hy Abeipa, na ngâchhihna miah pahmôsa la, Na pachhana miah pie mah y.
Zehôvâh Khazohpa ta bie a rei awpa cha ei nathlie aw; A phopi hnohta thlalôhna bie reih aw ta, A mopathaihpazy hnohta a reih aw; Âmo deikua cha hruna lâ a heih khao khah ei sy.
Eima râh liata rônahna a pahrâ thei nawpa ta, A pachhana ta ano a chituhpazy â vaw hnia.
Ngâchhihna nata biehmeiseihpa a tyh ei ta, Siana nata thlalôhna ta amâ pahnâ.
Biehmeiseihpa alei tawhta kaw pyuh ta, Siana ta avâ tawhta a za sai tyh.
Abeipa ta hmo phapa pie aw ta, Eima râh liata kôvei a pha aw.
Abeipa hmia lâta siana sie aw ta, A hniezy cha lâpi ta a tao aw.
Hy Abeipa, kei lâ na nah vaw pachôh la, Nâ chhy mah y; Dyhchhiepa nata phahlapa ei châ hih.
Khazohpa a pachâpa châ na ta, Ei hrona he pahlôh mah y; Ei Khazohpa châ chi ta, Nâma châ ngâpa he pachha la, Châ chakaotuhpa he pachha mah y.
Hy Abeipa, noh y ta cha pado na ta, Na ngiachhie mah y!
Hy Abeipa, nâ lâta ei hro kaw chaluah na ta, Châ chakaotuhpa hro he palysa mah y!
Hy Abeipa, nâ cha Khazoh phapa nata a ngiahthai theituhpa châ chi ta, Châ padotuhpazy chô liata zawngiahna a hnei hluh ngaitapa na châ.
Hy Abeipa, ei thlahchhâna lâ na nah vaw pachôh la, Ngiachhie ei châ hawna ao he nathlie mah y.
Einâ chhy awpa vâ chi ta, Ei nôpona noh liata ei cha pado tyh aw.
Hy Abeipa, khazohzy hry liata nâ hawhpa rai y leipa ei ta, Na hmotaopa hawhta a taopa rai y veih ei.
Hy Abeipa, phopi na taopa zydua a vy aw ei ta, Na hmiakô liata a bôhpa ta, Na moh ama palyupalih aw.
Nâ cha rônahpa nata hmonoâh taotuhpa châ chi ta, Nâma deita he Khazohpa na châ.
Hy Abeipa, na biehmeiseihpa liata ei y thei nawpa ta, Na lâpi na pachu la; Na moh ei chi thei nawpa ta, Palôh a ipa na pie mah y.
Hy Abeipa ei Khazohpa, Ei palôh zydua ta alyna bie cha hlâ na ta, Chhâzaw ta na moh ei parônahsa aw.
Kyh eina pachâna chi he rônah ta, Athihkhih ry chaipa tawhta ei hro na pachha haw.
Hy Khazohpa, chyhsa a khotlâhpazy ta na thyuhnao ei ta, Chyhsa nôchhiepa sahlao ta ei hrona pahlei amâ chhuah; Ama hmia lâta nâ cha soh veih ei.
Châhrasala Hy Abeipa, Nâ cha zawngiahna nata ngiachhiena a hneipa Khazoh châ chi ta, A hiehâh a rupa nata kyhpachâna nata ngâchhihna ta a biepa Khazoh na châ.
Kei lâ a vaw heih la, Na ngiachhie mah y; Châ chakaotuhpa he na thatlôna pie la, Châ chakaotuhnô sawchapapawpa he pachha mah y.
Hy Abeipa, na baopa ta, Thlah na palôh ha chi ta, Na khokheina ngiana na pahmô mah y; Nâ haotuhpazy ta hmô ei sala, Hmiachhiepa ta ama yna hâh ta.
Tlâh pathaihpa liata a khihpi padua ta,
Abeipa ta Zaio hawkazy cha pasô ta, Zakaw pahrâna zydua hlâta a pasô via.
Hy Khazohpa khihpi, Nâma hmo rônahpazy ama reih.

Nâ pahnopazy hry liata a hlao hrapa, Rahâbi nata Babylaw kyh reih aw na ta, Pachâ teh, Philistia nata Tyre kyh reipa ta, Kusi kyh chhao reih aw na ta, “He chyhsa he Zaio liata a pihpa a châ,” ama tah aw.
Zaio kyh liata hetana heta ama tah aw: “He chyhsa nata hao chyhsa hao Zaio liata a pihpa châ ei ta, Chônôchaipa tlai ta Zaio cha a padua aw.”
Abeipa ta phopizy moh a roh tita, “He chyhsa he cha Zaio liata a pihpa a châ,” a tah aw.
Hlasathaipazy nata lâhthaipazy ta â lyupa ta, “Ei byhnâ hnawh zydua Zaio liata a y,” ama tah aw.
Hy Abeipa, ei pachhana Khazohpa y, Na hmiakô liata chhô nah zâ ta ei awh hih.
Ei thlahchhâna na kô vaw tlô sala, Ei awhna lâ na nah vaw pachôh mah y!
Ei hro he nôpona ta bie ta, Ei hrona chhao Athihkhih â hnia ha bâ.
Khaohtlô lâ a zu awpazy hry liata rei pâpa châ na ta, Tha a hnei khao leipa chyhsa ei châ.
Athihpazy hry liata pathliepa hawhta châ na ta, Ama thiepa thlâ liata a ziapa hawhta ei châ; Na ku tawhta chhawh pathlah hapa ama châpa vâta, Nâ thei khao leipazy hawhta ei châ.
Khaohtlô athupa liata na pathla chi ta, Su zohpa nata athupa liata eina soh chi.
Na pathiiana ta thata na vi ta, Na tichatlaopa ta eina vao.
Ei viasa phapazy ta ama pathlua awpa ta na tao chi ta, Âmo châta pasichhihpa ta eina tao ha chi. Khawhlôhpa ta y na ta, Pua thei va na.
Pachâchhiena vâta ei mo zoh khai ha ta, Hy Abeipa, noh chareih ta cha pado na ta, Nâ lâta ei kuzy ei vaw pazawh.
Athihpazy châta hmonoâhpazy na tao tyh ma? Athihpazy thyu ei ta ama cha reithai tyh ma?
Na kyhpachâna tleih leipa thlâ liata phuah ei ta, Na ngâchhihna Chhokhih liata ama phuah tyh ma?
Na hmonoâhpazy zohna su liata ama pahno ma? Na siana cha myna râh liata ama pahno ma?
Hy Abeipa, kei deikua cha, cha awsao na ta, Mydi ta ei thlahchhâna na hmiakô liata a vaw tlô tyh.
Hy Abeipa, khazia ei hro he na dytha? Khazia na hmia eina nyusai chi?
Ei hawti no tawhta pasataopa ta, Thi daihmâpa ta y tyh na ta; Nâma chipa ta thlazohpa ta y na ta, Ngiarohpa ta ei y tyh.
Na pathiiana ta na vao ta, Na thyuhnaona rarôh ypa ta eina pahleipadia haw.
Noh y ta tisaih hawhta na chadô ei ta, Su to tawhta eina dôh ei.
Ei kyhpachâpa nata ei viasa ta pathlua awpa ta na tao chi ta, Zohna deita ei hmiapahnopa a châ bâ.
Abeipa kyhpachâna tleih beih leipa cha, Chhâzaw ta hla ta sa aw na ta; Na ngâchhihna cha, Chhâ zydua liata ei pakah ta ei pahnosa aw.
“Na kyhpachâna tleih beih leipa cha, Chhâzaw ta a duah aw ta, Avâzy liata na ngâchhihna na pa-i aw,” tah na ta.
“Ei tlyhpa chyhsa hnohta biehrai tao na ta, Nâ chakaotuhpa Dâvi hnohta bie ei taih haw:
‘Na chipathla cha tlyzaw châta pa-i aw na ta, Na beidyuchhai chhao chhâ zydua châta ei padua aw,’” na tah.
Hy Abeipa, avâzy ta na hmonoâhpazy reithai ei sala, Mopathaihpazy pakhypi liata na ngâchhihna reithai mawh ei sy!
Avâzy liana khita Abeipa pakhopâ thei awpa ahy ma y ta, Abeipa hawhpa he vâmozy hry liata ahy ma a y?
Ano cha mopathaihpazy pakhypi liata ama chi ngaitapa châ ta, A kiapâh liata a ypa zydua hlâta ama chiza chaipa Khazohpa a châ.
Hy Zehôvâh Khazohpa Atotaotheipa, Hy Abeipa, nâ hawhta thatlôpa he ahy ma y ta, Nâ hawhta ngâchhihna ta a chadôpa he ahy ma a y?
Tilaipi a lai lymâpa chô liata ryureih chi ta, Tichatlaopa a pathluah ngâpazy na chalihsa tyh.
Rahâbi cha chyhsa thiepa hawhta taichheih chi ta, Na chariahpazy na bâh thatlôna ta na papai ha ei.
Vârâhzy khi nâma eih châ ta, Alei chhao he nâ eih a châ; Khizaw nata a chhôh liata a ypa zydua he, Na taopa sai a châ.
Maw paysa chi ta, Chho na paysa; Tabaw nata Hâmaw ta, A ly ngaitapa ta na moh ama reithai.
Bâh hmotaotheipa hnei chi ta, Ku thatlôpa na hnei; Na ku chachâh lâ cheihchalopa ta a y.
Siana nata adona cha na beidyuchhai abôna châ ta, Kyhpachâna nata ngâchhihna na hmia lâta ama sie.
Thaphana pyu a theipa phopi cha a nohlao na, Hy Abeipa, âmo cha, Na hmia khaihna liata a chareipazy ama châ.
Na moh vâta noh y ta thaphapa ta y ei ta, Na siana vâta cheihchalopa ta ama y.
Nâ cha ama thatlôna rônahna châ chi ta, Na khokheina vâta eima ki cheihchalopa ta a y.
Eima vyhphao cha Abeipa eih châ ta, Eima bei cha Izarei Mo Pathaihpa eih a châ.
Hlâno ta na chyhsa ngâchhihpa hnohta, Aluahna ta hetana heta na tah: “Pasaipha hnohta thatlôna pie na ta, Phopi vyuhpa ta atlypa cha ei cheihchalo.
Nâ chakaotuhpa Dâvi hmô na ta, Ei sathaw pathaihpa ta ano cha sathaw ei thu.
Ei ku ta ano cha padua aw ta, Ei bâh ta tha a patlô aw.
Chariahpa ta ano cha tiah leipa aw ta, Moleipa ta panawh aw vei.
A khakhaipazy a hmiakô liata taichheih aw ei na ta, Ano a haotuhpazy ei tusao aw ei.
Ei ngâchhihna nata ei kyhpachâna a hnohta y aw ta, Ei moh vâta a ki cheihchalopa ta a y aw.
Tilaipi chô liata a ku pahniehsa aw na ta, Chavahzy chô liata a ku chachâh lâ ei pahniehsa aw.
Na aw aw ta, ‘Ei Paw châ chi ta, Ei Kha­zohpa nata ei pachhana lôpanô na châ,’ Eina tah aw.
Ei sawchapaw uhtheipa ta tao aw na ta, Lei beizy hry liata chônôchaipa ta ei tao aw.
Ei kyhpachâna tleih beih leipa cha, Ano châta chhâzaw ta soh aw na ta; Ei biehrai ano châta â i lymâ aw.
A chipathla tlyzaw ta padua aw na ta, Avâ y chhôh zydua a beidyuchhai â duah lymâ aw.
A sawzy ta ei ryhpa siesai ei sala, Ei bie pachiapazy a chhih leipa ta,
Ei bieraopazy parao ei sala, Ei biepiepazy ama zyh vei khiah deikua cha,
Ama paraona vâta sômasi ta hrie aw ei na ta, Ama moleina vâta chheipa ta ei hrie aw ei.
Châhrasala ei kyhpachâna tleih beih leipa cha, Ano tawhta la leipa aw na ta; Ei ngâchhihna ama chô liata tleih beih aw vei.
Ei biehrai parao leipa aw na ta, Ei pakah tawhta bie a pua hapa panano aw va na.
Ei pathaihna moh reipa ta, Chhâzaw châta ei kha bie a taih ha na ta; Dâvi hnohta haipa bie reih aw va na.
A chipathla tlyzaw ta a duah aw ta, Ei hmiakô liata noh a y chhôh zydua cha, A beidyuchhai â duah lymâ aw.
Thlâpâ hawhta tlyzaw ta a duah aw ta, Avâ liata pahnokheituhpa ngâchhihpa ta a y aw.”
Tahmâ deikua cha dythapa ta thy ha chi ta, Na sathawthupa chô liata na pathi thata a ia haw.
Châ chakaotuhpa chô liata na biehrai parao chi ta, A lakho dohlei liata na papuapalei haw.
A diahsuazy papyu chi ta, A thokhyzy na pacho khai haw.
A chapiapa maihta hrao ei ta, A chheipâh râhzy ta ama pahneisao.
A khakhaipazy ku chachâh lâ cheihchalo chi ta, A chariahpa zydua thaphapa ta na paysa ei.
A zaozi hâh pakosa chi ta, Adyuhna liata a duah thei awpa ta tao khao va chi.
A rônahna pachhâsa chi ta, A beidyuchhai alei lâ na thy haw.
A thyutliana nohzy pachhohsa chi ta, Nozana ta na khu haw.
Hy Abeipa, khati taih ma a châ aw? Chhâzaw ta ma nâ nyu aw? Khati taih ma na pathiiana mei hawhta a kâ aw?
Ei daihti chyuzie he a thei mah y! Khazia ma chyhsa saw zydua he, Hraolei­pa ta na vaw paysa ei tly?
Kheihawhpa chyhsa ma thina hmô leipa ta A hroh thlâh ha aw tly? Ahy ma Athihkhih hmotaotheina tawhta A hro a pachha thei aw tly?
Hy Abeipa, na kyhpachâna tleih beih leipa kha, Khataih liata a y haw? Hmeiseihpa ta Dâvi hnohta bie nâ taihpa kha, Khataih liata a y haw?
Hy Abeipa, châ chakaotuhpazy pahneisaopa ta eima ypa he a thei la, Râh zydua pasipasawhna ei palôh liata ei taopazy he a thei mah y.
Hy Abeipa, na chariahpazy ta miah ama pasipasawhna biezy a thei la, Na sathawthupa pheihnie ama reipachhienazy he a thei mah y.
Abeipa cha tlyzaw ta reithaipa ta y mawh sy! Amen, Amen.
Abeipa, nâ cha chhâ zydua ta, Eima pahrâna na châ.
Tlâhpizy ama y hlâta y ha chi ta, Leilô nata khizaw zy na padua hlâ chhao ta na y haw; Chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta Khazohpa na châ.
Chyhsapa cha dohlei lâ pakuasa tyh chi ta, A hnohta, “Hy chyhsa saw saih u, Dohlei lâ kua heih teh u!” na tah tyh.
Na mohmô liata cha kô sâh kha he, Zâhnia noh a khôpa hawh châ ta, Zâ vaih khana chhôh hawh dei a châ.
Tisaih hawhta âmo cha phaoh pathlah chi ta, Ramâ hawhta lei ei ta, My sibie hrohpa hawh dei ama châ.
My ta hroh silipa ta kaw thyu ta, Zâlâ ta uah ta a raoh ha tyh.
Na hiehâhna ta miah nie khai ha ta, Na pathiiana vâta ngiarohpa ta eima y.
Eima paraonazy na hmiakô liata soh chi ta, Arulâta eima moleinazy chhao, Na hmia khaihna liata na soh tyh.
Na pathiiana ry liata eima noh zydua lei ta, Ahrôna ta eima kôzy eima pachhâ tyh.

Eima hro chhôh kôzy cha kô sysari châ ta, Thatlôna vâta kô sycharie chhao a châ thei; Châhrasala hro pasina cha hriapasana nata pachârôhna dei châ ta, Thlai lei ei ta, keimo chhao eimâ zaw syulyu tyh.
Ahy ma na hiehâhna hmotaotheizie pahno ta, Chi nâ chhihna nata na pathiiana chichhihzie a pahno tly?
Sona palôh eima hnei thei nawpa ta, Eima hro chhôh nohzy reizie awpa miah pachu mah y!
Hy Abeipa, vaw kua mah y! Khachâ ma na hie a hâh aw tly? Châ chakaotuhpazy chô liata thapasana hnei mah y!
Na kyhpachâna tleih beih leipa ta, My chareih lôhrâ miah patlô la; Chatanachata eima hro chhôh noh zydua liata, Alypa nata thaphapa ta eima y lymâ aw.
Pasa miah na pataosana noh zie ta, Thaphana miah pie heih la; Chhiena eimâ tyhna kô zie ta, Thaphana miah pie heih mah y.
Châ chakaotuhpazy ta na hmotaopa hmô ei sala, Ama pathlazy ta na hmotaotheina rônahpa hmô mawh ei sy!
Abeipa eima Khazohpa khokheina eima chô liata y sala, Eima ku raihria eima chô liata pa-i mawh sy. A châ na, eima ku raihria pa-i mah y.
Chônôchaipa pahrâna o liata a chhaipa chyhsa cha, Atotaotheipa nohdi liata â pahâ aw.
Abeipa hnohta, “Ei chhaina nata ei thokhy châ chi ta, Ei ngâpa ei Khazohpa na châ,” ei tah awh.
Khoheih a chôh thaipazy khoheih tawhta cha pachha aw ta, Potlana chichhihpa tawhta a cha pachha aw.
A mathlaw hmi ta cha khu aw ta, A mathlaw ry liata achhaina na hmô aw; A ngâchhihna cha vyhphao nata thokhy a châ.
Zâ chichhihna chi leipa aw chi ta, Nohchhô ta châtai a zawpa chi aw va chi.
Zohna liata potlana a chareipa chi leipa aw chi ta, Nohchhô ta pahleipadiatuhpa chhao chi aw va chi.
Na kâ lâta sâh kha pao aw ei ta, Na chachâh lâta thy kha ama pao aw; Nâ deikua châ hnia aw veih ei.
Na mo ta moh aw chi ta, Moleipa viarithôpa a châpa na hmô aw.
Abeipa cha na pahrâna châta hmâh chi ta, Chônôchaipa cha nâ chhaina ta na hmâpa vâta,
Chhiena ta cha tla thlu leipa aw ta, Potlana ta na poh o a hnia aw vei.
Na siena lia maihta châ vaih awpa ta, Nâma kyh liata a vâlyuhchâpazy bie a pie aw ei.
Alô liata na phei nâ pachhi lei nawpa ta, Ama ku ta ama cha chalo ha aw.
Chakeibarôhneipa nata vâzi zy tlypâ aw chi ta, Chakeibarôhneipa lochopa nata parihpi chhao, Phei ta na tlysao aw ei.
Abeipa ta hetana heta a tah: “Kyh khâchâ nâ pachâpa cha pachha aw na ta, Ei moh a pahnopa cha ei pabohsa aw.
Eina pado tita a chhy aw na ta, Nôpona daihti liata a hnohta ypa ta, Pachha aw na ta ei palyupalih aw.
Hro pasina ta a palôh patlâh aw na ta, Ei pachhana ei pahmôsa aw.”
Abeipa lâta alyna bie reipa cha pha ta, Hy Chônôchaipa, na moh reithaipa ta sapa cha a pha na.
My ta na kyhpachâna tleih beih leipa phuah na ta, Zâ ta na ngâchhihna ei phuah tyh.
Totâ ri hrawhpa ta cha reithai na ta, Tlaipih nata ao ngiapa ta ei cha reithai tyh.
Hy Abeipa, na raihria vâta ei thapha ta, Na ku raihriazy vâta alyna hla ei sa.
Hy Abeipa, na hmotaopazy cha rônah ta, Na pachânazy â thu kaw dia!
