Na moh ei reithai thei nawpa ta, Patâhna o tawhta na papua mah y! Ei chô liata phana hluhpi na tao awpa vâta, Mosiapazy ta eina chadô aw ei.
Hy Abeipa, ei thlahchhâna he thei la, Ngiachhie ei châ hawna lâ he na nah vaw pachôh mah y! Na ngâchhihna vâta na chyhei la, Na siana vâta na chyhei mah y!
Na hmiakô liata la, Ahrohpazy hry liata mosiapa ama y leipa vâta, Châ chakaotuhpa he pachiana liata a ngiakhei khah y.
Chariahpa ta ei thlahpa a chadai ta, Ei hrona he alei liata taichheih ta; Ama thi tawhta bohpi a châ hapazy hawhta, Zohna liata eina pahrâsa haw.
Chavâta ei thlahpa kei liata panao ta, Ei palôh kei liata ngiarohna ta a bie.
Hnôhlâ daihtizy a kaw theipa ta, Na hmotaopa zydua saipalie na ta, Na ku raihriazy ei rohpady tyh.
Ei kuzy nâ lâta pazawh tyh na ta, Ei thlahpa cha nâma vâpa ta alei hipa hawhta a dâh a phi tyh.
Hy Abeipa, thlai na chyhei mah y! Ei thlahpa a panao ha hih! Na hmia na nyusai khah y, Chataleipatala khaohtlô lâ a zupazy hawhta ei y pathlei aw na.
Nâ ei cha ngâpa vâta, Na kyhpachâna tleih beih leipa kyh cha, My ta na patheisa tyh mah y. Nâ lâta ei thlahpa a chaluahpa ei châpa vâta, Ei sie nawpa lâpi na pahnosa tyh mah y.
Hy Abeipa, ei chariahpazy tawhta na pachha mah y, Châ chhai awpa ta nâ lâ ei vaw râ hih!
Ei Khazohpa na châpa vâta, Na khopa tao awpa ta na pachu mah y! Na Thlahpa phapa ta, Lâpi patlâpa liata nâ chhi mawh sy!
Hy Abeipa, na moh vâta, Ei hrona he pabohsa la; Na siana vâta ei thlahpa he, Nôpona tawhta papua mah y!
Ei chô liata na kyhpachâna tleih beih leipa vâta, Ei chariahpazy chhawh pathlah khai la; Ei khakhaipa zydua pahleipadia khai mah y; Châ chakaotuhpa ei châ hih!
Abeipa, ei lôpanô cha reithaipa ta y mawh sy, Ano ta ei kuzy he hrâsiezie pachu ta, Ei ku parozy he a dyuhzie a pachu.
Ano cha ei châta ngâchhihpa nata ei thokhy châ ta, Ei diahsua nata nâ pachhatuhpa a châ; Ei vyhphao nata ei chhaina châ ta, Phopizy ei ry liata panawhtuhpa a châ.
Hy Abeipa, chyhsapa he khâpa ma châ ta, Na pahno tyh tly? Chyhsa sawchapawpa chhao he khâpa ma châ ta, Na pachâ tyh tly?
Chyhsapa cha hu ei kha sopa hawh dei châ ta, A hro chhôh nohzy cha nohpahli a lei tyhpa hawh dei a châ.
Hy Abeipa, avâzy za pahnai la, Za chô mah y! Tlâhpizy hria la, Meikhuh pua mawh sy!
Dôhla pathliesa la, Na chariahpazy hiepatla mah y; Na châtaizy ka la, Âmo cha patypamâ mah y!
Chô lâ tawhta na ku za paza la, Na pachha la, ti laipa tawhta na thaoh la, Chihropazy ku tawhta na pachha mah y.
Ama pakah ta haipa bie a reih tyhpazy châ ei ta, Ama ku chachâh lâ cha adoleina ku a châ.
Hy Khazohpa, hla thiehpa cha sapa aw na ta, Tlaipih ri hrawhpa tôpa ta ei cha reithai aw.
Nâ cha beizy pahniena a pietuhpa châ chi ta, Zaozi thatlôpa tawhta châ chakaotuhpa Dâvi a pachhatuhpa na châ.
Ama pakah ta haipa bie a reih tyhpa, Chihropazy ku tawhta na pachhapa ta na pabohsa la; Ama ku chachâh lâ adoleina ku a châpazy tawhta, Na pachhapa ta na pabohsa mah y.
Eima sawchapawzy thyutlia lochona daihti cha, Chichei daw phapa hawhta châ ei sala; Eima sawchanôzy thyutlia lochona daihti chhao, Abei o liata otôh khiepazy hawhta châ mawh ei sy.
Eima sawvâzy cha, Kôvei chi to ta bie ei sala, Eima mietakuzy chhao, Lyuzy liata thysâh hluhpi pataw mawh ei sy.
Eima viahchaozy vô lymâ ei sala, Hrih leipa ta pataw lymâ mawh ei sy. Eima lâlaizy liata, Chana nata pachârôhna zy y khah sy!
Cha hawhpa byhnâ ta vaoheipazy cha ama hu â hieh na! Abeipa ama Khazohpa ta a hneipazy cha ama hu â hieh na!
Hy ei Khazohpa nata ei Beipa, Cha palyupali aw na ta, Chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta na moh ei reithai aw.
Noh to ta cha reithai aw na ta, Chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta na moh ei reithai aw.
Abeipa cha rônah ta, Rônahpa ta reithai awpa a châ; A rônahzie cha, A laichadai khai thei rimâ awpa châ vei.
Chhâ kha tawhta chhâ hropa lâta, Na hmotaopazy reithai pachhuah lymâ aw ei ta, Na hmotao rônahpazy ama phuah lymâ aw.
Nâ beina rônahzie nata ngiazie reih aw na ta, Na hmotao noâhpazy ei reih tyh aw.
Na hmotaopa thatlôzie nata rarôh yzie reih aw ei ta, Kei chhao ta na rônahzie ei phuah aw.
Na phana hluhzie reih aw ei ta, Na siana kyh hla ta ama sa aw.
Abeipa cha ngiachhiena nata zawngiahna a hneipa châ ta, Hiehâhna kyh liata nainô sôpa châ ta, Kyhpachâna tleih beih leipa ta a biepa a châ.
Abeipa cha mo to chô liata pha ta, A zawngiahna cha a hmotaopa zydua chô liata a y.
Hy Abeipa, na hmotaopa zydua ta alyna bie cha hlâ aw ei ta, Na mopathaihpa zydua ta ama cha reithai aw.
Na khinarâh rônahzie reih aw ei ta, Na hmotaotheina kyh ama chho aw.
Chyhsa sawzy hnohta na hmotao rônahpazy pahnosa aw ei ta, Na khinarâh rônahzie nata ngiazie ama pahnosa aw.
Na khinarâh cha tlyzaw khinarâh châ ta, Na ryureina chhâ zydua ta â duah aw. Abeipa cha a bie zydua liata ngâ a chhih ta, A hmotaopa zydua liata a phapa a châ.
Abeipa cha a pao awpa zydua patu ta, A bôhpa zydua a pathyu tyh.
Mokhaoh to ta cha mokhâh ei ta, A daihti ta nie awpa na pie tyh ei.
Na ku pakai chi ta, Hmohrohneipa to khopa lôhrâ na patlô tyh.
Abeipa cha a yzie zydua liata sia ta, A hmotaopa zydua liata ngâchhihpa a châ.
Abeipa cha a padotuhpa zydua a hnia ta, Hmeiseihpa ta a padotuhpa zydua a hniapa a châ.
Ano a chituhpazy khopa hlao patloh tyh ta, Ama awna ao thei ta a pachha tyh ei.
Abeipa cha ano kyh a pachâtuhpa zydua pabohsa ta, Hmoparaopazy deikua cha, A pahleipadia aw ei.
Ei pakah ta Abeipa reithaina bie a reih tyh aw; Chyhsa zydua ta a moh pathaihpa cha, Chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta reithai mawh ei sy.
Abeipa cha reithai teh u! Hy ei thlahpa, Abeipa cha reithai mah y!
Ei hro chhôh zydua ta Abeipa cha reithai aw na ta, Husona ei hnei chhôh ta, Ei Khazohpa reithaina hla ei sa aw.
Abeizy a ngâchhâ leipa la, Chyhsa sawzy chhao a ngâchhâ khah y, Ano liata pachhana y vei.
A hu ta a puasai tita, Chhaohlei lâ kua heih ta; Cha noh lia tlai chata â chhuahnazy a lei pâ haw.
Zakaw Khazohpa cha baotuhpa ta hnei ta, Abeipa a Khazohpa liata hnabeiseihna a hneipa cha, A hu â hieh na!
Abeipa cha avâ nata alei taotuhpa châ ta, Tilaipi nata a chhôh liata a ypa zydua a taotuhpa chhao châ ta, Tlyzaw ta biehmeiseihpa a vao thlâhpa a châ.
Tlybaipazy châta adona a duakheituhpa châ ta, Nodipazy nie awpa a pietuhpa a châ. Abeipa cha atâhpazy papua ta,
Mochaopazy mo a pavâsa. Abeipa cha a bôhpazy pathyu ta, Abeipa cha mosiapazy kyh a pachâ.
Abeipa cha mapaihpazy vaih ta, Nôhmei nata paw hnei leipazy a deichhy tyh; Hmoparaopazy hro deikua cha, Âbôkalie lâta a paysa tyh.
Abeipa cha tlyzaw ta ryureih aw ta, Hy Zaio, na Khazohpa cha chhâ zydua ta ryu a reih aw. Abeipa cha reithai teh u!
Abeipa cha reithai teh u! Eima Khazohpa reithaipa ta hla sapa cha pha ta, Kho â chhih ngaita; Reithaina hla hlâ awpa cha, Tao awpa tlai a châ.
Abeipa ta Zerusale padua ta, Izarei phopi hiepatlapazy a pahmaohpakhy heih ei.
Palôh keichheihpazy patlâh ta, Ama hmahzy a chahrypa ei.
Awhsi ziepa pahno ta, Ama moh a bi khai ei.
Eima Beipa cha rônah ta, Hmotaotheina lai ngaitapa a hnei; A novâhna thlie thei awpa châ vei.
Abeipa cha areisipazy cheihchalo ta, Hmoparaopazy deikua cha alei lâ a pazaw lymâ.
Alyna bie hlâpa ta Abeipa lâ hla sa u la, Totâ chhaota eima Khazohpa cha reithai teh u!
Ano ta avâzy khi meihdozy ta khu ta, Alei châta vâsua a chhuanohpa ta, Tlâhzy liata sibiepa a papyusa.
Râhsazy nie awpa pie ta, Raawh taw a sâh ngâpazy nie awpa a pie ei.
Â lyna cha arâ thatlôna vâta châ leipa ta, A palôh tlâhna chhao pheisaihzy phei vâta châ vei.
Abeipa cha ano a chituhpazy vâta a palôh tlâh ta, A kyhpachâna hnabeiseihtuhpazy vâta a palôh a tlâh tyh.
Hy Zerusale, Abeipa cha reithai la, Hy Zaio, na Khazohpa cha reithai mah y!
Ano ta na thokhy chhikao lâhreizy pa-isa ta, Na chhôh liata na sawzy byhnâ a awpa tyh ei.
Na râhri chhôh liata adyhna tao ta, Sâh pha chaipa ta na rih a cha pabie tyh.
Alei lâ biepiepa paphao ta, A bie cha a chatliepa ta a sie.
Mietaku hmi hawhta dâhaw patlasa ta, Buchâh hawhta dâhaw a hiepatla.
Viahchhâ tlawhzy hawhta dâhaw tlozy za thy ta, Chasipa a vaw patlôsapa hmia liata, Ahy a duah thei aw?
A bie paphao ta, A bie ta dâhaw tlozy cha pazao ta; Thlih pathlisa ta, Tizy a palosa.
Zakaw hnohta a bie phuah ta, Izarei hnohta a bieraopazy nata a ryhpazy a phuah.
Kheihawhpa phopi chô liata hmahta cha hawhta tao beih vei; Chavâta a ryhpazy pahno veih ei. Abeipa cha reithai teh u!
Abeipa cha reithai teh u! Vârâh tawhta Abeipa cha reithai u la, Vâ chô sâhpa liata ano cha reithai teh u!
A vâlyuhchâpa zydua saih u, Ano cha reithai u la; A vâ pheisaih zydua saih u, Ano cha reithai teh u!
Noh nata thlâpâ saih u, Ano cha reithai u la; Awhsi khaihpa zydua saih u, Ano cha reithai teh u!
Avâ a sâh chaipazy saih u, Ano cha reithai u la; Avâ chô liata ti a ypazy saih u, Ano cha reithai teh u!
Ano ta biepie ta paysapa ama châpa vâta, Chazy chata Abeipa moh cha reithai mawh ei sy!
Âmo cha chhâzaw nata tlyzaw châta padua ta, Ano ta bie pie ta, A bie cha lei beih aw vei.
Alei tawhta Abeipa cha reithai u la, Tilaipi hmohrohneipa lai ngaitapazy nata ti athupa zydua saih u, Abeipa cha reithai teh u.
Mei nata pareih, dâhaw nata ameih zy saih u, Abeipa cha reithai u la; A bie a zyhpa thlihpizy saih u, Abeipa cha reithai teh u!
Tlâhpizy nata tlâhthlôhzy saih u, Abeipa cha reithai u la; Theilâpa kôzy nata sidy thozy saih u, Abeipa cha reithai teh u.
Râhsazy nata osazy saih u, Abeipa cha reithai u la; Âlyhpa sazy nata azawpa pavawzy saih u, Abeipa cha reithai teh u.
Lei beizy nata phopi zydua saih u, Abeipa cha reithai u la; Beimachâzy nata ryureituhpa zydua saih u, Abeipa cha reithai teh u.
Satlia laihsa saih u, Abeipa cha reithai u la; Machâ hawti saih u, Abeipa cha reithai teh u!
Ano moh deita cheihchalo tlâhpa a châpa vâta, Abeipa moh cha reithai mawh ei sy; A rônahna cha alei nata avâ hlâta a sâh via.
A mopathaihpa zydua rônahna châta, A phopi ki cheihchalo ta; A kiapâh liata a ypa Izarei sawzy châta, A phopi ki a cheihchalo haw. Abeipa cha reithai teh u!
Abeipa cha reithai teh u! Abeipa lâta hla thiehpa sa u la, Mopathaihpazy pakhypi liata a reithaina hla sa teh u!
Izarei cha a Taotuhpa chô liata a thapha sala, Zaio sawzy cha ama Beipa chô liata a ly mawh ei sy!
Lâpa ta a moh reithai ei sala, Khoh nata totâ chhaota ano reithaipa ta sa mawh ei sy!
Abeipa cha a phopi chô liata a palôh tlâh ta, Areisipazy cha pachhana ta a palyupalih ei.
Mopathaihpazy cha rônahna liata a ly ei sala, Ama rakhôzy chô liata thaphapa ta hla sa mawh ei sy.
Khazohpa reithaina ao cha ama rao liata y sala, Zaozi kârano ta a tiah raihriepa cha ama ku liata y mawh sy.
Râhzy chô liata phuh la aw ei ta, Phopizy ama hrie aw.
Ama beizy bâlia paky aw ei ta, Ama nôpawpazy thua keihrai daipa ta,
Pachiana bie ro chiehpa hawhta, Phopizy cha ama pachia aw. Cha cha a mopathaihpa zydua châta rônahna a châ aw. Abeipa cha reithai teh u!
Abeipa cha reithai teh u! Khazohpa cha a supathaihpa liata reithai u la, A vâ thokhyzy liana khi ta reithai teh u!
A hmotaopa rônahpazy vâta ano cha reithai u la, A rônah ngaitanazie lymâ hawhta ano cha reithai teh u!
Chiahmie pyu ta ano cha reithai u la, Tlaipih nata totâ ta ano cha reithai teh u!
Khoh nata lâpa ta ano cha reithai u la, Pyungiapa ri chhaopa nata ramo ta ano cha reithai teh u!
Paotlâ reih pakyhpa ta ano cha reithai u la, Paotlâ reih chhiehpa ta ano cha reithai teh u!
Husona a hneipa to ta Abeipa cha reithai mawh sy! Abeipa cha reithai teh u!
He he Dâvi sawchapawpa, Izarei bei Sawlawmaw biesozy ta â chhuahpa a châ:
Sona nata pachuna pahno awpa ta, Pahnona biezy liata novâhna hnei awpa ta,
Sona, siana, adona nata akhongâhna kyh zy liata Pachuna dao awpa ta;
Sona a phahlapazy hnohta sona pie awpa ta, Thyutliapazy hnohta pahnona nata hmia nata hnôh sai thaina pie awpa ta;
Asopazy ta theipa ta ama pahnona a pôh via nawpa ta, Novâhpazy ta pasopakâna bie ama dao thei nawpa ta,
Bieso nata pakhona bie liata novâhna hnei awpa ta, Asopazy bie nata ama bie khiakhipazy liata novâhna hnei awpa ta.
Abeipa china cha novâhna athaona châ ta, Ahrupazy ta sona nata pachuna ama mohnao tyh.
Ei sawchapawpa y, na paw chhoreina bie nathlie la, Na nô pachuna bie a heihsai khah y;
Na luh châta pawpi pachhih a ngia ngaitapa châ ei ta, Na rao châta pachhihzy ama châ.
Ei sawchapawpa y, moleipazy ta ama cha reipasao khiahta cha, A pyh khah y.
“Eima hnohta a vy la, Thisaih palo awpa ta a byh sih la, A chhâpa y leipa ta paraona a hnei leipazy a byh ei suh u.
Athihkhih hawhta a hrohpa ta âmo cha palâ sih la, Khaohtlô liata a tlapazy hawhta ama pôhpa dua ta palâ ei suh u.
Hmo sôhpazy hmô aw pi ta, Hraona sôh ta eima o eima pabie aw.
Eima hry liata miah a hlao hra la, Tâkâ sahria miakha eimâ hly aw,” Tahpa ta ama cha reipasao tita,
Ei sawchapawpa y, ama lâpi a chhih hra leipa la, Ama lâpizy tawhta na phei a sysai ha mah y.
Moleina lâta ama pheizy a râ ta, Thisaih palo awpa ta amâ para tyh.
Pavaw mohmô ta sao paraipa cha, Hraoleipa ta paraipa a châ.
He chyhsazy heta âmo thisaih a byh ei ta, Âmo hrona amâ byh.
He he avyuhna ta athôhna a chadaipa karâypa chyhsa zydua chhâna a châ, Avyuhna ta hneipa sôh chata a hneituhpazy hrona a pahlei tyh.
Sona cha khiliah liata a paropa ta awh ta, Sôhdaoh suzy liata a aony a pasâh.
Khiliah lôhawh chaina su liata awh ta, Khihpi thokhy chhikaozy liata hetana heta a tah:

“Nâmo sona a phahlapazy saih u, So leipa ta ypa he khachâ ma nama pasô chy aw tly? Pasipasawh a thaipazy ta khachâ ma chyhsa pasipasawhpa paphasa aw ei ta, Ahrupazy ta khachâ ma pahnona amâ hao aw tly?
Ei chhoreina lâ namâ vaw heih khiahta cha, Pachâ teh u, ei thlahpa cha hry aw ei na ta, Ei biezy ei cha pahnosa aw ei.
Cha aw ei na ta, Khoh leipa ei chi ta; Ei ku pazawh na ta, Ahy hmahta uasa leipa ei chi ta;
Ei ryhraopa zydua hraoleipa ta tao ei chi ta, Ei chhoreina rai namâ pyh khoh leipa vâta,
Kei chhao ta chhiena namâ tyhna liata cha pahneisao aw ei na ta, Hmo chichhihpa ta a cha tla thlu ti ei ta ei cha pahneisao aw ei.
Hmo chichhihpa ta thlihpipa hawhta a cha chhei ti ei ta, Chhiena ta khisô hawhta a châ pahieh thlu ti ei ta, Nôpona nata pachârôhna a cha vaw tlô thlu ti ei ta, Ei cha pahneisao aw ei.
Cha tina chata na pado aw ei ta, Châhrasala a chhy aw veih ei na; Thata na tlua awh ei ta, Châhrasala na hmô aw veih ei.
Pahnona a hao ei ta, Abeipa china a tlyh leipa ei ta,
Ei ryhraopa miakha hmahta khoh leipa ei ta, Ei chhoreina zydua ama papeisa leipa vâta,
Âmo yzie thei nie aw ei ta, Âmo hmotaopazy ta lôhrâ amâ patlô aw.
Sona a phahlapazy cha lâpi ama tleisaina ta âmo cha thie tyh ta, Ahrupazy chhao âmo hruna ta a pahleipadia tyh ei.
Ei bie a nathlietuhpa deikua cha â bohpa ta y aw ta, Chhiena chi leipa aw ta, Chhôhmohpa ta a y aw.”
Ei sawchapawpa y, ei biezy a pyhpa ta, Ei biepiepazy paso pha la;
Sona lâ na nah pachôhpa ta, Novâhna lâ na palôh pahei la;
Chatatly, pahno thaina padopa ta, Novâhna hnei awpa ta thata awh la,
Sona cha tâkâ tluapa hawhta tlua la, Ryubyh nyupa tluapa hawhta na tlua khiahta cha,
Abeipa china kyh liata na novâh aw ta, Khazohpa pahnona nâ huah aw.
Sona cha Abeipa piepa châ ta, A pakah tawhta pahnona nata novâhna a pua.
Chyhsa dopa châta sona patapa pachôpa ta, Ngâchhihpa ta a ypazy châta ano cha vyhphao a châ.
Adona lâpizy vaih ta, A mopathaihpazy hrozie a vaih tyh.
Chatanachata siana nata adona kyh liata na novâh aw ta, Akhongâhna nata lâpi phapa to kyh na no a vâh aw.
Sona cha na palôh chhôh liata a ngia aw ta, Pahnona cha na hro châta kho â chhih kaw aw.
Pahnona ta cha mokhâh aw ta, Novâhna ta a cha vaih aw.
Moleipa lâpi tawhta cha pachha aw ta, Chyhsa paviasana bie a reihpazy tawhta a cha pachha aw.
Âmo zohna lâpizy a chhih awpa ta, Siana lâpizy a tleisai hapa ama châ.
Moleina hmo taopa liata ama thapha ta, Molei chochhiena a lypazy ama châ.
Ama lâpi a kokaliepazy châ ei ta, Chyhsa dôvei khohna hro a hneipazy ama châ.
Sona ta khichhai chanô tawhta cha pachha aw ta, Chihropa chanô reikah thaina tawhta a cha pachha aw.
Cha chanô cha a thyutlia nota â kaolâhpa siesai ta, A Khazohpa biehrai a my hapa a châ.
A o cha thina liata a pamôh ta, Athipazy lâta a lâpizy a sie.
Ano a pangai hapa cha ahy hmah kua heih khao leipa ei ta, Hrona lâpizy hmô heih thei khao veih ei.
Chavâta lâpi phapa a chhih la, Siana lâpi liata sie mah y.
Adopazy cha râh liata pahrâ aw ei ta, Phapakipazy cha râh liata ama y thlâh ha aw.
Hmoparaopazy deikua cha râh tawhta chhawh pathlahpa châ aw ei ta, Piehpiepazy cha râh tawhta phiapa ama châ aw.
Ei sawchapawpa y, ei pachuna my leipa la, Na palôh ta ei biepiepazy a vao thlâh ha mah y.
Hro pasina cha pie aw ta, Kô hluhpi cha pahrosapa ta, Thlalôhna a cha pie aw.
Ngâchhihna nata biehmeiseihpa ta châ heihsai khah sy; Na rao liata chazei la, Na palôh lôphiapa liata roh ha mah y.
Chatanachata Khazohpa nata chyhsa mohmô liata, Khokheina nata moh phana na hmô aw.
Na pathipalôh tlokhuh ta Abeipa ngâ la, Nâma pahnona liata a pahnieh khah y.
Na lâpi zydua ano pahnosa lymâ la, Na lâpizy a patlâsa lymâ aw.
Nâma pachâ ta a pasosa leipa la, Abeipa chi la, Moleina siesai mah y.
Cha cha na sapa châta tlâhna châ aw ta, Na rupazy châta thohna a châ aw.
Na hneina ta Abeipa palyupalih la, Na kôvei a daih tuachaipa zydua ta Abeipa cha palyupalih mah y.
Chatanachata na sawvâzy cha bie pakhô aw ta, Na kresawhti saohna lô beihzy cha, Kresawhti thiehpa ta a khô pathlah aw.
Ei sawchapawpa y, Abeipa chhoreina cha, Papeisa leipa ta y leipa la; A cha ra tita, Na palôh pasa khah sy.
Paw ta sawchapaw â lypa a rapa hawhta, Abeipa chhao ta a kyhpachâpa cha a ra tyh.
Sona a hmôpa cha nohlaopa châ ta, Novâhna a hneipa chhao nohlaopa a châ hra.
Sona tawhta athôhna cha tâkâ tawhta athôhna hlâta pha via ta, Sona papôhpa cha ngôh papôhpa hlâta a pha via.
Sona cha lôsôhpa hlâta sôh via ta, Na kho kawpa hmo kheihawhpa nata hmah Pakhopâ thei rimâ awpa châ vei.
A ku chachâh lâta hro pasina y ta, A chavei lâta hneirôna nata zachhihna a y.
A lâpizy cha lâpi khochhihpazy châ ta, A lâthlôh zydua cha thlalôhna lâthlôh a châ.
Ano â patupa maih châta hrona tho châ ta, Â ipa ta ano a patupazy cha thaphapa ta ama y.
Abeipa ta sona ta alei he bô ta, Novâhna ta avâzy khi a padua.
A pahnona ta ti athupazy pasa ta, Meihdozy ta diati ama patlasa.
Ei sawchapawpa y, hezy he mopakhô leipa la, Sona patapa nata pahnona zy chhy lymâ mah y.
Na hro châta hrona châ aw ta, Na rao châta atobina a châ aw.
Chatanachata na lâpi liata â bohpa ta sie aw chi ta, Na phei a chapia aw vei.
Nâ zia tita chi leipa aw chi ta, A zia aw chi ta, mokuh pahâh kawpa ta nâ mô aw.
Eikhapi ta chichhihpa a vaw tlô awpa a ngiaroh leipa la, Hmoparaopazy chô liata chhiena a vaw tlô awpa chhao a ngiaroh khah y.
Abeipa cha na riahphana châ aw ta, Na phei khoheih liata a ao awpa tawhta a vaih aw.
Tao theina na hnei khiahta cha, A to tlâhpazy châta hmo phapa pakhâ khah y.
Na hnei thlâh hapa tlai ta, na vaih hnohta, “A di chy la, a vy heih mah y, Mylâ ei cha pie aw,” Na tah awpa châ vei.
Cha ngâ ta na kiapâh liata a pahrâpa, Na opa chô liata hmo chhiepa tao a chhuah khah y.
Châ pasasa leipa chyhsa cha, A chhâpa y leipa ta a dyuh khah y.
Thachahra a hmâhpa chyhsa cha uahva leipa la, A lâpi kheihawhpa hmahta a tlyh khah y.
Palôh a kopa cha Abeipa châta pasichhihpa châ ta, Palôh patlâpazy deikua cha Abeipa ngâpa chyhsazy ama châ.
Abeipa chhiesana cha hmoparaopa­ o liata y ta, Mosiapa pahrâna deikua cha byhnâ a pie tyh.
Mohnaotuhpazy cha mohnao ta, Areisipazy chô liata deikua ngiachhiena a palâsa tyh.
Asopazy cha palyupalihna ryu to aw ei ta, Ahrupazy deikua cha nohzaona ama to aw.
Ei sawchapawzy saih u, paw pachuna bie thei u la, Novâhna nama hnei thei nawpa ta nathlie teh u.
Pachuna phapa ei cha pie ei hih, Ei ryhpa bie a heihsai khuh vy.
Ei paw sawchapaw hâtipa ei châ nota, Ei nô ta a hmô chhôhpa nata a dao kawpa ei châ nota,
Ei paw ta na pachu ta ei hnohta, “Na palôh ta ei biezy he khâchâ a vao sala, Ei biepiepazy he zyh la, hroh mah y.
Sona tlua la, Novâhna tlua mah y; Ei pakah tawhta bie a puapazy my leipa la, Tleisai khah y.
Sona cha siesai khah y, A cha hrôbieh lymâ aw; A kyh pachâ mah y, A cha vaih lymâ aw.
Sona thabypa cha he he a châ: Sona cha tlua la, Khâpa zydua hlâta novâhna tlua chai mah y.
Sona cha pasâhsa la, A cha cheihchalo aw; A pyhpahly la, A cha palyupalih aw.
Ngiachhiena pawpi na luh liata tawh aw ta, Lakho rônahpa a cha pakho aw.
Ei sawchapawpa y, nathlie la, ei biezy a pyh mah y; Chatanachata na chhâ a pasi aw.
Sona lâpi cha pachu na ta, Lâpi dopa liata ei cha chhihtha.
Na sie nota châ pakhâpa y leipa aw ta, Nâ râ tita a chapia aw va chi.
Pachuna cha khâchâ patu la, Papua khao khah y; Na hrona châ ta, Liahsa a vao ha mah y.
Hmoparaopa lâpi liata a ngia leipa la, Moleipa lâthlôh a chhih khah y.
Cha lâpi liata sie leipa la, Khôkhâh ha mah y; Tleisai la, Sie lymâ mah y.
Hmo ama parao ha tua leipa ta cha, A mô thei leipa ei ta; Chyhsa ama chapiasa ha tua leipa ta cha, Ama mo ku thei vei.
Paraona viahchhâ nie ei ta, Nôchhiena kresawhti ama doh tyh.
Mosiapazy lâpi deikua cha khihdei khaihpa hawh châ ta, Nohchhô locho a tlô hlâlei a khaih via lymâ.
Hmoparaopazy lâpi cha zoh kaluh ha ta, Khâpa ma amâ chapia tahpa chhao pahno veih ei.
Ei sawchapawpa y, ei biezy nathlie la, Ei biereipazy lâta na nah pachôh mah y.
Na mohmô tawhta pua leipa ei sala, Na palôh liata khâchâ a vao ha mah y.
Sona nata novâhna cha a hmôtuhpazy châta hrona châ ta, Ama sapa zydua châta tlâhna a châ.
Na palôh pakhâta ta vaih mah y, Hrona tihnawh vaw puana châ tlôh ta.
Bie hloh hneipa na pakah tawhta thy la, Dôveina bie chhao na hmao tawhta thy ha mah y.
Na mo ta hmia lâ moh lymâ sala, Na mo vo chhao â dypa ta hmia lâ sai lymâ mawh sy.
Na phei tlyna lâpi paraih la, Na lâsie a patlâ lymâ aw.
Chachâh lâ tlyma chavei lâ tlyma tlei leipa la, Moleina hmo tawhta na phei pasie ha mah y.”
Ei sawchapawpa y, ei sona he nathlie la, Ei novâhna lâ he na nah pachôh mah y.
Chatanachata novâhna hnei aw chi ta, Na hmaozy ta pahnona â vao aw.
Chanô ngâchhih leipa hmao cha kheihti hawhta a thlaoh ta, A pakah chhao sathaw hlâta a pahnia via.
Achhâna lâ deikua cha hmo khapa hawhta kha ta, Zaozi hâh nopa hawhta a châ.
A pheizy thina lâ zu ei ta, A pheizy ta Athihkhih lâpi amâ chhih.
Hrona lâpi kyh pachâ leipa ta, A lâthlôhzy pavia ta, Khataih lâ ma a sie tahpa pahno vei.
Chavâta ei sawchapawzy saih u, Tahmâ na nathlie u la, Ei pakah biezy he a heihsai khuh vy.
Cha hawhpa chanô cha a heihsai u la, A o chhikao chhao a hnia khuh vy.
Chataleipatala na zachhihna mohropazy pie pathlei aw chi ta, Na hro chhôh kôzy chhao nôchhiepazy na pie pathlei aw.
Khichhaipazy ta na thatlôna hmâpa ta lôhrâ a patlô pathlei aw ei ta, Na hriapasana chhao chihropa o lâ a sie pathlei aw.
Na hro chhâna liata cha a hrô aw chi ta, Na sapa nata na pôhpa a rao khai tita cha,
“Kheihtazieta ma chhoreina a hao na ta, Ei palôh ta rana kha a vaw papeisa vei tly!
Nâ pachutuhpazy ao vaw nathlie leipa na ta, Nâ chhihthatuhpazy lâ ei nah ei vaw pachôh vei tly?
Zawpi ahmaohpakhyna liata, Maophyuh chhie ta ei maophyuh daihmâ hih,” na tah aw.
Nâma tikhaoh tawhta ti doh la, Nâma tihnawh tawhta ti a lohpa doh mah y.
Na tihnawhzy su to liata loh pathlahpa ta, Lâlaizy liata chavah tizy a loh awpa a châ ma?
Na tihnawhzy cha nâma châ dei châ sala, Na hnohta a ypa khichhaipazy châta châ khah sy.
Na tihnawh cha byhnâ to sala, Na thyutlia no lapinô liata a ly mah y.
Ano cha sakhi chanôpa khochhih ngaitapa châ ta, Sathawh chanôpa pha ngaitapa a châ. A sâhpizy ta lôhrâ khâ cha patlôsa sala, A kyhpachâna iahzaipa ta khâ y mah y.
Ei sawchapawpa y, khazia chanô ngâchhih leipa iahzaipa ta y aw chi ta, Apheinô hnôbia cha nâ pyhpahly aw?
Chyhsapa lâpizy cha Abeipa hmiakô liata y ta, A siena lâ maih Abeipa ta a moh tyh.
Hmoparaopa cha a paraona khoheih liata a ao aw ta, A moleina chaori ta â ipa ta a chahry aw.
Pachuna a phahlapa vâta thi aw ta, A hru tupa vâta a leidia aw.
Ei sawchapawpa y, na vaih châta sôhkâ sopa la, Khichhaipa vyuhpa ta nâ dua khiahta cha,
Na pakah biezy liata a ao chi ta, Na pakah biezy ta a cha patu hapa a châ.
Ei sawchapawpa y, Na vaih ku liata y ha chi ta, Chavâta he he tao la, Nâmasasyh ta a pachha mah y. A chatliepa ta vawh la, A panawh la, Na vaih cha a haw mah y.
Na mo a mô leipa sala, Na mo vo tla-uah hra khah sy.
Sakathaipa tawhta sakhi â bohpa hawhta, Nâmasasyh ta a pachha la; Khoheih chôtuhpa ku tawhta pavaw â bohpa hawhta, Nâmasasyh ta a pachha mah y.
Nâ thathipa, hloia lâ vawh la, A hroziezy moh la, so ha mah y.
Hloia ta abei hnei leipa ta, Hyutuhpa nata ryureituhpa hnei hra vei.
Nopi daihti ta nie awpa pachô ta, Sâh hria daihti ta nie awpa a pahmaoh tyh
Hy thathipa, khachâ ma a zia aw chi ta, Khati ta ma nâ môpa tawhta na thyu aw?
Buakha a môpa ta, Buakha tla-uah chi ta, Buakha ku chakhipa ta nâ pahâ chhôh ta;
Dyhchhiena ta hraotuhpa hawhta cha vaw tlô thlu aw ta, Phahlana ta chaihrai chhaopa chyhsa hawhta a cha vaw tlô thlu aw.
Chyhsa dyutlai leipa, chyhsa moleipa cha, Pakah hloh chhaota â khie tyh.
A mo ta mopasihpa ta, A phei ta hria ta, A kudy ta a dy tyh.
Chyhsa parao khohna palôh phaopa ta, Hmo chhiepa tao a chhuah ta, Achhaihna chi a tu lymâ.
Chavâta chhiena ta eikhapi ta vaw tlô thlupa ta, Sôkha ta paraopa châ aw ta, Taopathi heih theipa châ khao aw vei.
Abeipa â haopa hmo miacharu y ta, A châta pasichhihpa miasari a y.
Chazy cha, â khotlâhpa mokhaohzy, Paleih haihthaipa, Paraona a hnei leipa thisaih a palopa kuzy,
Hmo pha leipa tao a chhuahpa palôh, Paraona lâ a râpa ngiahly thatlôpa,
Haipa hu a sopa pahnokheituh pakheipa nata Unawhzy achhaihna chi tutuhpazy ama châ.
Ei sawchapawpa y, na paw biepiepa a ngiah la, Na nô pachuna a heihsai khah y.
Na palôh liata khâ châh sala, Na rao liata khâ a ao mah y.
Na sie nota cha chhihthapa ta, Nâ zia tita cha vaih aw ei ta, Na thyu tita bie ama châ chho aw.
Biepiepa cha meiôh châ ta, Pachuna cha khaihna châ ta, Chhoreina rana cha hrona lâpi a châ.
Chanô moleipa tawhta cha vaih aw ta, Apheinô paleih pahniapa tawhta a cha vaih aw.
A chhithaina cha na palôh ta tlaichhai leipa sala, A mopadei ta a cha patu awpa a pasaih khah y.
Viahchhâ tlâ kha ta âzuahnô chalei theipa châ ta, Vahpa chhaopa chanô a châna a hro zachhihna deikua a pahlei aw.
Chyhsa ta a chachôhna liata mei soh sala, A chysiazy kâ leipa ta a y aw ma?
Chyhsa ta meihei iapa chô liata sie sala, A pheizy u leipa ta a y aw ma?
A vaih lapinô lâ a ngiapa chhao, cha hawhta y hra aw ta, Cha chanô a hriapa maih cha hrie leipa ta pua aw veih ei.
Parutuhpa ta a nodipa papai nawpa ta a paru khiahta cha, Chyhsazy ta parutuhpa cha mohnao hlei veih ei;
Patupa a châ khiahta deikua cha, A lie sari ta a thô awpa châ ta, A hneipa zydua a pie khai awpa a châ.
Chanô liata a pheipa cha, Hmo a pahno thai leipa châ ta; Cha hawhpa hmo a taopa cha, Anosasyh â paraopa a châ.
Hmaphaohpa nata maophyuhpa ta y aw ta, A nohzaona a hnao pathaih theipa châ aw vei.
Chanô vahpa cha hiatliana vâta a hie thata hâ aw ta, Phuh a lana noh liata ngiachhiena hnei aw vei.
Achatlaina sôh a pyh leipa aw ta, Kuhria hluhpi pie hra la, A palôh châ hlei aw vei.
Ei sawchapawpa y, ei biezy zyh la, Ei biepiepazy a vao thlâh ha mah y.
Ei biepiepazy zyhpa ta hroh la, Ei pachuna cha na mosawpa hawhta a vao mah y.
Na kuparozy liata a ky la, Na palôh lôphiapa liata roh mah y.
Sonô hnohta, “Ei sietanô na châ,” tah la, Pahnona hnohta, “Ei viasa phapa,” tah mah y.
Sona ta chanô sihryhpa tawhta cha vaih aw ta, Apheinô reikah pahniapa tawhta a cha vaih aw.
Ei o opy samokaw tawhta, Khôtho lâ sai na ta,
Hmo a pahno thai leipa satlia pakha tlai cha, Sona a phahlapazy hry liata hmô na ta, Thyutliapazy hry liata a hmia ei siah.
Chanô yna kiapâh khiliah liata a khie laih ta, A o lâpi a chhihpa ta,
Zâlâ azo hrahri ta, Zâ zohna ry liata chanô cha a pangai.
Moh teh u, âzuahnô hawhta a tobi ta, Achhuahna a hneipa chanô ta thlai a vaw dy.
Reih hluhpa nata lieluh pâpaw a zohpa châ ta, O liata a phei ngia a ryh leipa a châ.
Thiapawh khiliah liata y ta, Tahmâ sôdaohna su liata y heih ta, Su to liata a byh ta a hâ tyhpa a châ.
Satliapa cha thlai patupa ta sy ta, Hmia kai kawpa ta a hnohta,
“Aryhna hlâna atheihnazy ei hlâ awpa châ ta, Tanoh kha ei bietai ei patlô haw.
Chavâta nâma a tyh awpa ta vaw pua na ta, Cha tlua chaimâh na ta, Tahmâ ei cha hmô ha hih.
Ei hmohphaw chhao khuna pohzy ta khu ha na ta, Izi pala rih dipa poh chapaipa tlai ta ei khu haw.
Deiryh ropahâhpa ta ei rakhô roh pahâhsa na ta, Lilipaw nata lôiasoh ropahâhpazy ei hry haw.
A vy teh, azozâkhihdei kyhpachâna ti doh sih la, Kyhpachâna ta khiahlôh a patlâh tua ei si.
Ei vahpa lâhlapi lâ khitlyh ha ta, O liata y vei.
Tâkâ sykhao kha a phao ta, Thla pôlô hlâlei cha vaw tlô aw vei,” a tah.
A reikah thaina ta satliapa cha pahnie ta, A reih pahniana ta a sydie haw.
Viahchao tôhpa thiena su lâ a siepa hawhta, Ahrupa cha thlai ama patupa hawhta, Satliapa ta chanô cha thlai a pazi haw.
Pavaw ta khoheih liata thlai â chohpa hawhta, Châtai ta a pathi a papyu hlâlei cha, A hmotaopa chata a hrona a pahlei aw tahpa pahno vei.
Chavâta sawchapawzy saih u, Tahmâ na nathlie u la, Ei biereipazy he a phapa ta pachâ teh u.
Chanô hrozie lâ cha nama palôh a heih leipa sala, A lâpi lâ tlei khuh vy.
Chyhsa hluhpi hmah paphao ha ta, Zasâh manôh a thie ha ei.
A o cha Athihkhih lâpi châ ta, Thina chhôhpadâhpa lâ a zupa a châ.
Sona ta awh ta, Novâhna ta a ao ki a pasâh.
Lâthlôh kiah su a sâhpa liata zy, Lâpi atyhna su liata zy,
Khih thokhy chhikao kiah liata zy, Hawka liata zy a duah ta, Hetana heta ao paro ngaitapa ta a awh tyh:
“Hy nâmo, chyhsazy saih u, ei cha aw ei hih, Ei awna he chyhsa sawzy lâta a châ.
Hy nâmo, sona a phahlapazy saih u, Sona a chu u la; Nâmo, ahrupazy saih u, Pahnona a chu teh u.
Nathlie teh u, bie phapazy reih aw na ta, Ei hmao tawhta bie dopa a vaw pua aw.
Ei pakah ta biehmeiseihpa reih aw ta, Paraona cha ei hmao châta pasichhihpa a châ.
Ei pakah bie zydua asiapa châ khai ta, Bie akopa tlyma, bie hloh hneipa tlyma y tlâ vei.
Chyhsa novâhpa châta cha sia khai ei ta, Pahnona a hmôpazy châta chhao amâ do khai.
Tâkâ vyuhpa ta ei pachuna a la u la, Ngôh phapa vyuhpa ta pahnona tlao a la teh u.
Sona cha lôsôhpazy hlâta pha via ta, Na tlaichhai kawpa khâpa nata hmah Pakhopâ theipa châ vei.
“Sona ta hetana heta a tah: Kei, sona he pahnona nata pahrâ khoh na ta, Novâhna nata pachâhpady thaina ei hnei.
Abeipa china cha moleina a haopa a châ. Apalaina nata apasâhsana a hao na ta, Moleina hro zy ei hao; Phichhyhpa bie chhao ei hao.
Ryhrao thaina nata sona dopa zy cha kei eih châ ta, Novâhna hnei na ta, thatlôna ei hnei.
Keima baona ta beizy ryureih ei ta, Ryureituhpazy ta ryureina dopa ama siekhei.
Keima baona ta beimachâzy ryureih ei ta, Nôpawpa zydua ta â dopa ta ryu ama reih tyh.
Kyh nâ pachâtuhpazy cha ama kyh pachâ na ta, Palôh hmeiseihpa ta nâ tluapazy ta eina hmô ei.
Hneirôna nata zachhihna zy ei hnohta y ta, Hneirôna nata siana tlyuhpa chhao ei hnohta a y.
Keima thei cha ngôh hlâta pha via ta, Ngôh suapa hlâ chhao ta a pha via; Ei kôvei chhao tâkâ suapa hlâta a pha via.
Siana lâpi a chhih na ta, Adona lâthlôh ei chhih.
Kyh nâ pachâtuhpazy hnohta ryuto pie ei na ta, Ama ryubyhzy ei pabiepa ei.
“ Abeipa ta hmo a tao tua nota na tao ta, Hlâno ta a tao tuachaipa ei châ.
Tlyzaw ta a ypa châ na ta, Leilô y hlâta taopa châ na ta, Tao tuachaipa ei châ.
Ti athupa y hlâta y ha na ta, Ti hluhpi a palipa tihnawhzy y hlâta ei y haw.
Tlâhpizy yzie a hnei hlâta pih ha na ta, Tlâhthlôhzy ama y hlâta ei pih haw.
Leilô nata lyurâhpazy a tao hlâta pih ha na ta, Khizaw dohlei hmiatuachaipa a y hlâta ei pih haw.
Avâzy a padua nota y ha na ta, Ti athupa chô liata vâphuh a chhôh nota ei y haw.
Chô lâ avâzy a pa-i nota y ha na ta, Ti athupa tihnawhzy a tao nota ei y haw.
Tizy ta a biepiepa ama parao lei nawpa ta, Tilaipi râhrizy taopa ta leilô abôna a tao no khata ei y haw.
Rai a thaipa hawhta Abeipa kiapâh liata y na ta, A noh chareih ta â lyna châ na ta, A hmiakô liata khâ ei ly tyh.
A pahrâna khizaw liata thaphapa ta y na ta, Chyhsa sawzy chô liata ei ly kaw tyh.
“Chavâta sawchapawzy saih u, Tahmâ na nathlie teh u: Ei lâpi a chhihpazy cha ama hu â hieh aw.
Pachuna nathliepa ta so u la, Dytha khuh vy.
Noh chareih ta ei chhikaozy lâ a vypa ta, Ei dôhpachhôh ochhizy liata hâ tyh ta, Ei bie a nathlie tyhpa cha a nohlao na.
Nâ hmôpa maih hrona a hmôpa châ ei ta, Abeipa khokheina ama to aw.
Nâ hmô leipa deikua cha anosasyh ta hmah a paphao ta, Nâ haopa zydua chhao thina kyh a pachâpa ama châ.”
Sonô ta a o sa ta, Otôh tôh sari a bô.
A sahrohzy thiepa ta, A kresawhtizy pahlao ta, A tlâhkhai â chhuanoh.
Khihpi su sâh chaipazy tawhta awh awpa ta, A laihsazy tuah ta,
“Sona a phahlapa cha he lâ a vy mawh sy,” tah ta; Pahnona a phahlapa hnohta,
“A vy la, ei viahchhâ nie la, Ei kresawhti pahlao chiehpa he doh mah y.
Hruna hrozy siesaipa ta hrona hnei la, Novâhna lâpi a chhih mah y,” a tah.
Chyhsa a khotlâhpazy a chhoreipa cha, Ano hmâchhâh taochhiena a tyh ta; Chyhsa moleipa a rapa chhao, Ano hmâchhâh hmah a phaoh tyh.
Akhotlâh kawpa chyhsa la ra hlei khah y, A châ hao pathlei aw na; Chyhsa sopa ra la, Kyh a cha pachâ aw.
Chyhsa sopa cha pachu la, So via rili aw ta; Chyhsa siapa chhao na pachu khiahta cha, A thaina a pôh rili aw.
Abeipa china cha sona athaona châ ta, Mo Pathaihpa pahnona cha novâhna a châ.
Na nohzy pasisa aw na ta, Na hro chhôh kôzy ei baichha aw.
Na vaw sopa chhao ta, Nâma châta soh chi ta; Nâ khotlâh khiahta cha, Nâ pyly ta pasa na tao aw.
Chanô hrupa cha a pyury ru kaw ta, Sona a phahla ta, khâpa hmah pahno vei.
A o ochhi liata a tyuh tyh ta, Khihpi su sâh chaipazy liata dyuchhai liata chhao a tyuh tyh ta,
Ama lâpi liata a sie haipa, Ano a chapiapa maih aw ta,
“Sona a phahlapa cha he lâ a vy mawh sy!” tah ta. Pahnona a phahlapa hnohta,
“Parupa ti cha thlôh ta, Arulâta viahchhâ niepa chhao a pahâh ngaita,” a tah.
Châhrasala ano a pangaipa ta, Athihpazy cha liata y ei ta, A chyhsa hruapazy chhao, Athihkhih a thu chaipa liata a ypa ama châpa pahno vei.
He he Sawlawmaw biesozy a châ: Sawchapaw sopa ta a paw palysa ta, Sawchapaw hrupa deikua cha a nô pachârôhna a tlôkhei tyh.
Moleina ta sôh hmôpa cha athôhna y leipa ta, Siana deikua cha thina tawhta a pachha tyh.
Mosiapa nodi awpa cha Abeipa ta pasaih leipa ta, Moleipa aohkhopa deikua cha a pakhâ ha tyh.
Ku thathipa ta dyhchhiena tlôkhei ta, Ku tiamapa deikua cha hneirôna a tlôkhei ty.
Nopi daihti liata a pachô pakhypa cha sawchapaw sopa châ ta, Sâh hria nota a mô thlâh hapa sawchapawpa deikua cha nozana a tlôkhei tyh.
Mosiapa luh liata vânoh y ta, Moleipa pakah deikua cha nôchhiena ta a pahly.
Mosiapa atheithlâhna cha vânoh tona châ ta, Moleipa moh deikua cha a thuzao aw.
Palôh sopa cha biepiepazy a pyh ta, Ahrupa reikah hluhpa deikua cha a pao aw.
Â dopa ta a siepa cha â bohpa ta sie ta, A lâpi a pakosapa deikua cha â lâ thlyu tyh.
Chyhsa a mopasihpa cha nôpona tlôkhei ta, Ahrupa reikah hluhpa chhao a pao aw.
Mosiapa pakah cha hrona tihnawh châ ta, Moleipa pakah deikua cha nôchhiena ta a pahly.
Ahaona ta ahryuna papua ta, Kyhpachâna deikua cha paraona zydua a khu tyh.
Novâhna a hneipa hmaozy liata sona hmôpa châ ta, Pahnona a phahlapa châta deikua cha a ky châta sôsi a y.
Asopa cha pahnona pachô ta, Ahrupa pakah deikua cha raona a pahniasa tyh.
Chyhsa hneirôhpa sôh cha â bohna khihpi thokhy châ ta, Sipasapazy dyhchhiena cha ama raona a châ.
Mosiapa hriapasana cha hrona tlôkhei ta, Moleipa athôhna deikua cha paraona a tlôkhei tyh.
Pachuna a pyhtuhpa cha hrona lâpi liata sie ta, Rana a dythapa deikua cha mohropazy â chhi chhei tyh.
Ahaona a phihtuhpa cha hmao haihthaipa hnei ta, Kyh reina bie a papuapa cha ahrupa a châ.
Bie hluhpi a reihpa cha paraona a phahla leipa ta, A hmao a sohsi theipa deikua cha chyhsa sopa a châ.
Mosiapa paleih cha tâkâ suapa châ ta, Moleipa palôh deikua cha khâpa hmah a phuh vei.
Mosiapa hmao ta chyhsa hluhpi pasa ta, Ahrupa deikua cha pahnona a phahlapa ta a thi tyh.
Abeipa byhnâ cha chyhsa pahneirôhsa ta, Pachârôhna baichha tyh vei.
Ahrupa châta hmo doleipa taopa cha saisopa hawh châ ta, Novâhpa châta deikua sona cha hmo sôhpa a châ.
Moleipa cha a chipa hawh tlai ta a chô liata vaw tlô aw ta, Mosiapa khopa deikua cha piepa a châ aw.
Khisô vaw pathli ta, Moleipa y khao leipa ta, Mosiapa deikua cha chhâzaw lôbô a châ.
Hâh châta kresawhti thaopa nata mo châta meikhuh hawhta, Thathipa chhao ano a tuahtuhpa châta a châ.
Abeipa china cha hro pareihna châ ta, Moleipa kôzy deikua cha pachhohsapa a châ aw.
Mosiapa hnabeiseihna ta alyna tlôkhei ta, Moleipa saduthliena deikua cha a leidia aw.
Abeipa china cha seina hnei leipa châta a thokhy châ ta, Moleina hmo a taotuhpazy châta deikua cha raona a châ.
Mosiapa cha râh tawhta papuapa châ leipa aw ta, Moleipa deikua cha râh liata pahrâ aw vei.
Mosiapa pakah ta sona papua ta, Nôchhiepa paleih deikua cha taipa a châ aw.
Mosiapa hmaozy ta a pyh tlâhpa pahno ta, Moleipa pakah deikua cha nôchhiena bie a reih tyh.
Khopathliahna doleipa cha Abeipa châta hmo pasichhihpa châ ta, Khopathliahna dopa deikua cha â ly tyh.
Apalaina a vaw y nahta, Maophyuhna vaw y ta; Areisipa deikua cha, Sona a hneipa a châ.
Chyhsa dopazy cha amâ dona ta âmo chhihtha ta, Piehpiepazy deikua cha âmo zietiahna ta a pahleipadia tyh ei.
Hiehâhna noh liata cha, Hneirôna ta phahnaina hnei khao leipa ta; Siana deikua ta cha, Thina tawhta a pachha tyh.
Phapakipa cha a siana ta a lâpi patlâsa ta, Moleipa deikua cha ano moleina ta a pao tyh.
Adopazy cha amâ dona ta âmo pachha ta, Piehpiepazy deikua cha âmo aohraohna liata amâ ao tyh.
Moleipa cha a thi nahta, A hnabeiseihna lei pâ ta, Hneirôh awpa ta a saduthliepa chhao a lei ha tyh.
Mosiapa cha nôpona tawhta pachhapa châ ta, Moleipa deikua cha nôpona lâ tlao â ngia tyh.
Khazohpa a pachâ leipa chyhsa cha, A pakah ta a vaih parao ta, Mosiapa deikua cha, A pahnona ta a vaih a pachha tyh.
Mosiapa chô liata hmo pha a tlôh nahta, Khihpi a ly ta; Moleipa a leidia nahta, Thaphapa ta ama rahao tyh.
Mosiapazy byhnâ ta khihpi cheihchalo ta, Moleipazy pakah ta khihpi a parao tyh.
A vaih a mohnaopa cha pahnona a phahlapa châ ta, Chyhsa novâhpa deikua cha â chalih tyh.
Chyhsa kyhchhie a reih thaipa cha bieruzy phuah tyh ta, Ngâchhihna palôh a hneipa deikua cha bie a nyu thei.
Chhihthana y leina liata cha phopi pao tyh ta, Ryhrao thaipa hluhna liata deikua cha abohna a y tyh.
Khichhaipa châta sôhkâ a sokhâhpa cha pasa tao aw ta, Sôhkâ a sokhâh leipa deikua cha palôh pahâpa ta a y aw.
Ngiachhiena a hneipa chanô cha zachhihna hnei ta, Thachahra a hmâhpa chyhsazy ta hneirôna ama hnei.
Zawngiah theipa chyhsa cha ano hro châta hmo phapa tao ta, Chyhsa chhiepa deikua cha ano sapa châta pasana a tlôkhei tyh.
Moleipa cha dôveina hmâpa ta hlao tyh ta, Siana chi a tupa deikua cha lymâ dopa a hmô tyh.
Siana liata â ipa ta a duahpa cha hrona to aw ta, Moleina hmo a chadaituhpa deikua cha a thi aw.
Palôh akopazy cha Abeipa châta pasichhihpa châ ei ta, Seina hnei leipazy hrozie deikua cha â lyna a châ tyh.
Hmeiseihta ta moleipa cha hrie leipa ta y leipa aw ta, Mosiapa pathlazy deikua cha pa­chhapa ta ama y aw.
Chanô chhithaipa pachâna a hnei leipa cha, Vao hmaothy liata ngôh rahy pataohpa hawhta a châ.
Mosiapa khopa cha phana ta chhâ tyh ta, Moleipa saduthliena deikua cha hiehâhna ta a chhâ tyh.
A saipa ta hiepatlapa cha pôh rilina châ ta, Byuhpa hleikhô ta riakhiehpa deikua cha phahlana a châ.
Chyhsa riaphapa cha a dyh pha aw ta, Ti a baotuhpa cha anosasyh â baopa a châ.
A sâh a pasaih leipa cha chyhsa ta chhiesapa aw ei ta, A zuahtuhpa luh chô liata deikua cha byhnâ a y aw.
Phahnai khohpa ta phana a tluapa cha khokheina hmô ta, Chhiena a tluapa deikua cha chhiena ta a vaw tlô thlu aw.
A hneirôna a ngâchhâpa cha pao aw ta, Mosiapa deikua cha sibiepa hrohpa hawhta a laiseih aw.
Ano chhôhkha a patypamâtuhpa cha ziza ryu to aw ta, Ahrupa cha palôh sopa chakaotuhpa a châ aw.
Mosiapa thei cha hrona tho châ ta, Chyhsa hro a pahnietuhpa cha asopa a châ.
Mosiapa hmahta alei liata viarithôpa ama châ khiahta cha, Moleipa nata hmoparaopa chhochhi cha, Khatlu ta pasa viapa ta viarithôpa ma ama châ aw tly!
Chhoreina a pasôpa cha pahnona a pasôpa châ ta, Rana a haopa deikua cha râhsa hawhpa a châ.
Chyhsa phapa cha Abeipa kho­kheina hmô aw ta, Moleina palôh a phaohpa deikua cha thailei a pachâ aw.
Moleina hmo taona tawhta ahy hmah a duah leipa ei ta, Mosiapa thari deikua cha phiapa châ aw vei.
Chanô phapa cha a vahpa châta lakho châ ta, Nozana a vaw tlôkheipa chanô deikua cha, A vahpa ru a pahmytuhpa a châ.
Mosiapa pachânazy cha a do ta, Moleipa ryhraona deikua cha dôveina a châ.
Moleipa biezy cha thisaih palo awpa ta a byh ta, Adopa pakah deikua cha âmo a pachha tyh.
Moleipazy cha thypa châ ei ta, y khao veih ei; Mosiapa pathlazy deikua cha amâ duah lymâ aw.
Pahnona phapa a hneipa chyhsa cha reithaina hlao ta, Palôh chhiepa chyhsa deikua cha mohnaona a hlao tyh.
Chyhsa pipawpa hawhta â tao ta nie a phahla thlâh hapa hlâta cha, Chyhsa nawhpa châ ta chakaotuhpa hneipa a pha via.
Mosiapa cha a sahroh hrona pachâ peimawh ta, Moleipa zawngiahna deikua cha nôchhiena a châ.
A chhaohlei a palietuhpa cha, Nie awpa hluhpi hnei aw ta; Hraoleipa a chadaituhpa deikua cha, Pahnona â phahla.
Moleipa cha hmoparaopa hraona sôh uahva ta, Mosiapa thari deikua cha a pathei aw.
Moleipa cha ano hmao paraona liata a ao ta, Mosiapa deikua cha tymâna a khôkhâh tyh.
Chyhsa cha a reikah thei tawhta hmo phapa ta a lôhrâ patlô ta, Ano ku hmotaopa tlai ta ano lâ a vaw lie thlu heih tyh.
Ahrupa cha ano mokhaoh liata a lâpi a do ta, Asopa deikua cha chhosina a nathlie tyh.
Ahrupa cha a ruchhôna thlai a lâ tyh ta, Asopa deikua cha hmia pachhiena pahno lei â pachâ tyh.
Pahnokheituh ngâchhihpa cha biedopa reih ta, Pahnokheituh pakheipa deikua cha haipa bie a reih tyh.
Zaozi chhôpa hawhta pasapa ta bie a reihpa y ei ta, Asopa paleih deikua cha tlâhna a châ tyh.
Biedopa hmao cha chhâzaw a daih ta, Haipa paleih deikua cha buakha dei â daih.
Hmo chhiepa tao a chhuahpazy palôh liata dôveina y ta, Adyhna a taotuhpazy deikua cha alyna ama hnei.
Mosiapazy chô liata hmo chhiepa tlô leipa ta, Moleipazy deikua cha tymâna ta ama bie.
Paleih haihthaipa cha Abeipa châta pasichhihpa châ ta, Âdopa ta a taotuhpazy deikua cha â ly ei.
Asopa cha a pahnopazy nyu ta, Ahrupa deikua cha hruna bie a phuah tyh.
Tiamapa ku ta ryureina chaba aw ta, Thathipa deikua cha ku rai hriatuhpa a châ aw.
Palôh rietheina ta chyhsa tha pachhâ ta, Bie phapa deikua ta a palysa tyh.
Mosiapa cha a vaih châta chhituhpa châ ta, Moleipa lâpi deikua cha ama paviana a châ.
Thathipa cha a sa kapa rao awpa hnei leipa aw ta, Tiamapa deikua cha dyhphana ryusôhpa a hnei aw.
Siana lâpi liata hrona y ta, Cha lâthlôh liata cha thina y vei.
Sawchapaw sopa cha a paw pachuna nathlie ta, Chhorupa deikua cha chhoreina nathlie khoh vei.
A pakah thei tawhta chyhsa ta hmo phapa nie aw ta, Nôchhiepa khona deikua cha atudaina a châ tyh.
A pakah a sohsi theipa cha a hro pabohsa ta, A hmao a kawhpa deikua cha a hro a rao tyh.
Thathipa hro cha hmo khoh kaw ta, Châhrasala a hnei theipa y leipa ta; Tiamapa hro deikua cha, Lôhrâtlôna taihta a hnei.
Mosiapa cha haipa a hao ta, Moleipa deikua cha nozana nata nohzaona a tlôkhei tyh.
Siana ta adopa ta a ypazy hrôbieh ta, Moleina deikua cha moleipa a papao tyh.
Chyhsa pakha cha anosasyh hneirôhpa hawhta â tao ta, Châhrasala a hneipa y leipa ta; Chyhsa hropa ta sipasapa hawhta â tao ta, Châhrasala sôh hluhpi a hnei.
Chyhsa ta a sôh ta a hrona a chatlai ta, Sipasapa deikua cha pachhiparyna a tyh vei.
Mosiapa khaihna cha khaih pha ta, Moleipa meiôh deikua cha pachhaipa a châ aw.
Apatahsana cha ahryuna dei papua ta, Pachâna a latuhpazy deikua cha sona ama hmô tyh.
Dôveina ta sôh hmôpa cha pai aw ta, Hriapasana ta hmôpa deikua cha a pôh aw.
Hnabeiseihna pahawhsapa ta palôh pasasa ta, Saduthliepa a vaw tlôpa deikua cha hrona tho a châ.
Bie a mohnaopa chyhsa cha anosasyh ta raona a tao ta, Biepiepa a chizapa deikua cha lymâ a hmô aw.
Chyhsa sopa pachuna cha hrona tihnawh châ ta, Thina khoheih ama khôkhâh thei aw.
Pahnona phapa cha khokheina tona châ ta, Piehpiepazy lâpi deikua cha ama raona a châ.
Asopa cha pahnona ta hmo tao ta, Ahrupa deikua cha a hruna a paziah tyh.
Lyuhchâpa moleipa cha tymâna a tyh ta, Vyuhtuapa ngâchhihpa deikua cha tlâhna a tlôkhei tyh.
Pachuna a khoh leipa cha dyhchhiena nata nohzaona ta tlô thlu aw ta, Rana a pyhpa deikua cha palyupalihpa a châ tyh.
Khopa hmôpa cha hro châta thlôh ta, Moleina siesaipa deikua cha ahrupazy châta pasichhihpa a châ.
Chyhsa sopa a pakyhpa cha ano chhao soh aw ta, Ahrupazy viasa deikua cha pasa a tao aw.
Moleipazy cha chhiena ta chadai ei ta, Mosiapazy deikua cha phana ama hmô tyh.
Chyhsa phapa cha a samohzy to awpa taihta ryu siesai ta, Moleipa sôh deikua cha mosiapa châta pachôpa a châ.
Sipasapa leipalie ta niedo hluhpi papua ta, Châhrasala ryurei doleipa vâta pahleipadiapa a châ tyh.
Sôsi a hmâh khoh leipa cha a sawchapawpa a haopa châ ta, A kyh a pachâpa deikua cha thlai a chhorei tyh.
Mosiapa cha a hro lôhrâ patlôna khi hnei ta, Moleipa py deikua cha a rua aw.
Chanô sopa cha a o sa ta, Chanô hrupa deikua cha ano ku tlai ta a o a parao.
Â dopa ta a hrohpa cha Abeipa a chipa châ ta, Hrozie akopa deikua cha Abeipa a mohnaopa a châ.
Ahrupa pakah liata apalaina sôsi y ta, Asopazy hmao deikua cha âmo a pabohsa tyh.
Viahchao tôhpazy y leina liata cha sachâki pathaih ta, Châhrasala kôvei phana cha viahchao tôhpa thatlôna vâta a châ.
Pahnokheituhpa ngâchhihpa cha haipa bie reih leipa aw ta, Pahnokheituhpa pakheipa deikua cha hai­pa biezy a papua tyh.
Chyhsa a mohnaopa cha sona tlua ta hmô leipa ta, Novâhpa deikua cha a naosiapa ta a pahnona a hmô thei.
Ahrupa cha a hlasai mah y, Ano tawhta nâ chu awpa biesozy y vei.
Asopa sona cha a sie nawpa lâpi pahnosa ta, Ahrupazy hruna deikua cha dôveina a châ.
Ahrupazy cha thaileichâna hlâna pahneisao ei ta, Adopazy deikua cha ngiahthaina liata amâ ly tyh.
Palôh cha ano ngâlâh ta a pasana pahno ta, Â lyna liata chhao khôtho chyhsa a lykheipa y veih ei.
Moleipa o cha paraopa châ aw ta, Adopa poh o deikua cha vânoh topa ta a y aw.
Chyhsapa pachâ ta lâpi dopa a lyupa y ta, A chhâna lâta deikua thina lâpi a châ tyh.
Pahneina liata chhao palôh pasana y thei ta, Thaphana chhao a chhâna lâta cha pachârôhna lâta a pua thei.
Palôh hnôhsypa cha a hrozie theizy ta pabiepa châ aw ta, Chyhsa phapa chhao a hrozie theizy ta pabiepa a châ aw.
Sona a phahlapa cha bie to zo ta, Chyhsa sopa deikua cha a lâpizy a pachâ tyh.
Asopa cha a chado kaw ta, Hmo pha leipa tao vei; Ahrupa deikua cha a riah pha kaw ta, Pachâ tua leipa ta hmo a tao tyh.
Pathi pachhohpa cha hru kawpa ta hmo tao ta, Hmo chhiepa tao â chhuahpa chhao a haopa a châ tyh.
Sona a phahlapazy cha hruna ryu to ei ta, Asopazy deikua cha pahnona lakho pakhopa ama châ.
Chyhsa chhiepazy cha chyhsa phapazy hmiakô liata panawhsapa châ ei ta, Moleipazy chhao mosiapazy chhikao liata panawhsapa ama châ.
Sipasapa cha a vaih chhao ta a hao ta, Hneirôhpa deikua cha viasa hluhpi a hnei.
A vaih a mohnaopa cha moleipa châ ta, Dyhchhiepazy chô liata a ria a phapa deikua cha vânoh a to aw.
Hmo pha leipa tao a chhuahpazy cha viavi tyh ei ta, Hmo pha tao a chhuahpazy deikua cha kyhpachâna nata biehmeiseihpa ama hlao tyh.
Hriapasana to liata athôhna y ta, Reih hluh thlâhthlipa deikua cha dyhchhiena a tlôkhei.
Asopazy lakho cha hneirôna châ ta, Ahrupazy hruna deikua cha hruna dei a tlôkhei tyh.
Pahnokheituhpa dopa cha hronazy pachha ta, Pahnokheituhpa pakheipa deikua cha haipa bie â duakhei tyh.
Abeipa a chipa chyhsa cha a riahpha ta, A sawzy ta a chhai awpa ama hnei.
Abeipa china cha hrona tihnawh châ ta, Abeipa a chituhpa cha thina khoheih a khôkhâh aw.
Phopi maluh hluhpa cha abei rônahna châ ta, Phopi a y vei khiahta cha ryureituhpa chhao a rao aw.
Hiehâhna kyh liata nainôsôpa chyhsa cha novâhna a hnei hluhpa châ ta, Thlai ta a hie a hâh thlâh ha tyhpa chyhsa deikua cha hruna a cheihchalo tyh.
Palôh alyna cha sapa tlâhna châ ta, Hiatliana deikua cha ru hmyna a châ.
Sipasapa a tlybaipa cha a Taotuhpa palôh a pasasapa châ ta, Phahlapazy a ngiachhiepa deikua cha a Taotuhpa a palyupalih.
Moleipa cha a hmo chhie taopa vâta pao ta, Mosiapa deikua cha thina liata hnabeiseihna a hnei.
Novâhpa palôh liata cha sona a chalih thlâh ha ta, Ahrupazy hry liata deikua cha â chaluah lymâ.
Siana ta râh cheihchalo ta, Moleina deikua cha phopi to châta nohzaona a châ.
So kawpa ta hmo a taopa chakaotuhpa cha, Abei ta khokhei ta; Nozana a tlôkheituhpa chakaotuhpa chô liata deikua cha, Abei pathiiana ta a tla thlu tyh.
Achhyna naipa ta pathiiana padia ta, Reih chahrâhpa deikua ta hiehâhna a pathyu tyh.
Asopa paleih ta pahnona papua ta, Ahrupa pakah deikua cha bie hrupa a reih tyh.
Abeipa mo cha su to liata y ta, Hmo chhiepa nata hmo phapa zy a sai thlâh ha tyh.
Paleih naipa cha hrona tho châ ta, Paleih haiphiahpa deikua cha palôh a pakeichheih tyh.
Ahrupa cha a paw pachuna mohnao ta, Asopa deikua cha a paw rana a uasa tyh.
Mosiapa o liata cha sôh hluhpi y ta, Moleipa sôh hmôpa deikua cha tymâna a tlôkhei tyh.
Asopazy hmao cha pahnona hiepatla ta, Ahrupazy palôh deikua cha cha hawhta châ vei.
Moleipa atheihna hlâpa cha Abeipa châta pasichhihpa châ ta, Chyhsa dopa thlahchhâna deikua cha Abeipa ta â ly.
Moleipa lâpi cha Abeipa châta pasichhihpa châ ta, Siana lâpi a chhituhpa deikua cha Abeipa ta kyh a pachâ.
Lâpi a heihsaituhpa châta chhoreina ru ngaitapa y ta, Rana a haotuhpa chhao a thi aw.
Athihkhih nata Chhokhih hmahta Abeipa hmiakô liata â lâ khai khiahta cha, Chyhsa sawzy palôh chhochhi cha khatlu ta ma a hmiakô liata â lâ aw tly!
Chyhsa mohnao a hmâhpa cha rana pasô leipa ta, Chyhsa sopa pangai aw vei.
Palôh thaphapa ta hmia alyna tao ta, Palôh vâsâhna deikua cha thlahpa hro tha a pachhâ tyh.
Novâhpa palôh cha pahnona tlua ta, Ahrupa pakah deikua cha hruna a nie tyh.
Dyhchhiepa châta cha noh zydua a pha leipa sai châ ta, Palôhtlâh a paohpa châta deikua cha kyhchhi â zao thlâh haw.
Abeipa china chôta a chyhta hneipa cha, Sôh hluhpi hnei ta a tymâpa hlâta a pha via.
Ahaona chôta viahchao tôhpa thawhpa sa niepa hlâta cha, Kyhpachâna chôta âhna pati niepa a pha via.
Chyhsa pathichhiepa cha ahryuna pathyu ta, Nônaipa deikua cha aeichhiana a padia tyh.
Thathipa lâpi cha ahloh thih hawhta châ ta, Adopa lâthlôh deikua cha lâlai a raih pha kawpa a châ.
Sawchapaw sopa cha a paw palysa ta, Ahrupa deikua cha a nô a mohnao.
Hruna cha sona a phahlapa châta â lyna châ ta, Chyhsa novâhpa deikua cha lâpi patlâpa liata a sie tyh.
Ryhraona phapa a y leina liata cha achhuahnazy a hlaotloh thei leipa ta, Pasopakâtuhpa ama hluhna liata deikua cha achhuahnazy a hlaotloh tyh.
Thlai ta achhyna pie tyhpa ta chyhsa palysa ta, A daihtita ta bie rei tyhpa cha a pha kaw dia!
Asopa châta cha hrona lâpi he â sâh lâta kiah lymâ ta, Chatanachata â hnai lâta Athihkhih lâpi a tleisai thei ha aw.
Apalaipa o cha Abeipa ta parao ta, Nôhmei râhri deikua cha a pa-i tyh.
Moleipazy pachâna cha Abeipa châta pasichhihpa châ ta, Mopathaihpazy bie deikua cha khochhihpa a châ.
Athôhna doleipa hmô khohpa ta karâypa chyhsa cha, A chhôhkha châta tymâna tlôkhei ta; Panaopapana a haopa deikua cha, A hro a pareih aw.
Mosiapa palôh cha â chhy hlâta pachâ tua tyh ta, Moleipa pakah deikua cha hmo pha leipazy a reih pôziah tyh.
Abeipa cha moleipa tawhta a hla ta, Mosiapa thlahchhâna deikua a thei tyh.
Mokhaoh khaihna ta palôh palysa ta, Thâtih pha ta ru a pathawh tyh.
Hrona chhoreina a nathliepa nakhaoh cha, Asopazy hry liata a pahrâ aw.
Pachuna a uasa leipa cha a hro khâpasaw ta a reih leipa châ ta, Chhoreina a nathliepa deikua cha novâhna a to aw.
Abeipa china cha sona pachuna châ ta, Palyupalihna to awpa ta a reisi tua awpa a byuh.
Palôh achhuahna cha chyhsapa eih châ ta, Paleih achhyna deikua cha Abeipa tawhta a châ.
Ano mo liata cha chyhsa ta a hrozie zydua a pathaihpa hawhta hmô ta, Abeipa deikua cha palôh kho a pathliah tyh.
Na raizy Abeipa pavao sa la, Nâ chhuahpazy a hlaotloh aw.
Abeipa ta hmo to a chhâpa hneipa ta tao ta, Moleipa chhao he chhiena noh châta a taopa a châ.
Palôh laipa chyhsa cha Abeipa châta pasichhihpa châ ta, Hriena khôkhâh cheita aw vei.
Kyhpachâna nata ngâchhihna ta moleina chatlai ta, Abeipa chipa vâta chyhsa ta moleina a siesai tyh.
A hroziezy ta Abeipa a palysapa chyhsa cha, A chariahpazy taihta ano nata a ryh awpa ta Abeipa ta a taopa tyh.
Adoleipa ta sôh hluhpi hneipa hlâta cha, A sia kawpa ta a chyhta hneipa a pha via.
Chyhsapa palôh ta a lâpi pachâhpady ta, A lâsie a chhituhpa deikua cha Abeipa a châ.
Abei hmao liata Khazohpa bietapa y ta, Pachiana liata a pakah ta pachia chhei aw vei.
Khopathliahna dopa nata thliena dopa zy he Abeipa eih châ ta, Sykhao liata khopathliahna lô zydua chhao ano taopa sai a châ.
Beidyuchhai cha siana ta paduapa a châpa vâta, Hmo pha leipa taopa cha beizy châta pasichhihpa a châ.
Hmao siapa cha abei alyna châ ta, Biedopa a reihpa cha a pasô tyh.
Abei pathiiana cha thina lyuhchâpa châ ta, Châhrasala chyhsa sopa ta cha a padia thei aw.
Abei hmia khaihpa liata hrona y ta, A khokheina cha châhvâ vâsua meihdo hawhta a châ.
Ngôh hlâta sona hneipa pha via syulyu ta, Tâkâ vyuhpa ta novâhna tlao a tlyh awpa a châ.
Chyhsa dopa lâlai cha moleina chahrih ta, A lâpi a phapa ta a vaihpa cha a hrona a pabohsa.
Apalaina cha raona hmia lâta sie ta, Akhotlâhna palôh chhao paona hmia lâta a sie.
Apalaipazy hry liata hraona sôh a raipa hlâta cha, Sipasapazy hry liata areisina palôh phaopa a pha via.
Bie pakhâta ta a pachâpa cha hmo phapa hmôpapua aw ta, Abeipa a ngâpa cha byhnâ a to aw.
Palôh sopa cha hmo yzie a pahno thaipa tahpa châ aw ta, Reikah thlôhpa ta chyhsa a pahnie tyh.
Novâhna cha a hneituhpa châta hrona tihnawh châ ta, Hruna deikua cha ahrupazy châta hriena a châ.
Asopa palôh ta a pakah pasosa ta, A hmao liata thaina a baichha tyh.
Bie phapa cha kheihthlawh hawh châ ta, Hro châta thlôh ta, ru châta hnatlâna a châ.
Chyhsapa pachâ ta lâpi dopa a lyupa y ta, A chhâna lâta deikua thina lâpi a châ tyh.
Ahriapasapa cha ano aohkhopa châta hriapasa ta, A pakah aohkhopa ta a pahriasa tyh.
Chyhsa dyutlai leipa cha hmo pha leipa tao a chhuah tyh ta, A hmaozy cha mei sahpa hawhta a châ.
Ngâchhih leipa chyhsa cha ahryuna chi hie ta, Bieparu rei a hmâhpa chhao viasazy a pachhaih ty.
Chyhsa hro chhiepa ta a vaih dôvei tyh ta, Lâpi pha leipa liata â chhi tyh.
A mo vo a chakhyhpa cha hmo doleipa tao â chhuahpa châ ta, A hmao a papiepa chhao hmo pha leipa a tlôkhei tyh.
Luh pawhpa cha rônahna lakho châ ta, Siana hro vâta hmôpa a châ.
Chyhsa palôh pasipa cha, Thatlôpa hlâta pha via ta; Ano palôh chô liata bie a hnei theipa chhao, Khihpi a latuhpa hlâta a pha via.
Nuby cha byhpi chô liata a daopa châ ta, Biechhâna deikua cha Abeipa tawhta a châ tyh.
Atudaih ngâna o liata kyhchhi pati niepa hlâta cha, Adyryh kawpa ta laochhohpa bawpa a pha via.
Sei sopa cha maophyuhna a tlôkheituhpa sawchapaw chô liata ryureih aw ta, Unawhpa pakha hawhta a zibeipa ryu a to hra aw.
Pathaisana beih cha tâkâ châta châ ta, Patina mei chhao ngôh châta a châ; Abeipa deikua cha palôh a pasia tyh.
Hmo pha leipa a taotuhpa cha moleipa hmaokah nathlie tyh ta, Haihthaipa chhao chochhiepa paleih lâ a nah a pachôh tyh.
Sipasapa a mohnaopa cha, Ano Taotuhpa palôh pasasa ta; Mohropa chhiena liata a lypa chhao, Hriena khôkhâh aw vei.
Samohzy cha machâpazy lakho châ ei ta, Sawzy rônahna chhao ama pawzy a châ.
Reih phapa cha ahrupa nata a khyh leipa ta, Hmao haihthaipa chhochhi abeisaw nata â khyh lei pachai.
Panaopapana cha a pietuhpa châta dyu hawhta châ ta, Â heina lâ maihta a hlaotloh lymâ.
Kyhpachâna a tluapa cha, Paraona a khupa châ ta; Paraona a reih chanei ngâ thlâh hapa deikua cha, Viasazy a pachhaih tyh.
Ahrupa ei za kha chheipa hlâta cha, Asopa ei kha rapa â ngia pathu via.
Chyhsa moleipa cha chakhia nawpa sai tlua ta, Chavâta lyuhchâpa nô­chhiepa tua thlupa a châ aw.
Ahrupa a hru nota a tyh awpa hlâta cha, Chavyh a taw la hapa a tyh awpa ngâh â chhih via.
Chhiena ta phana a thôtuhpa cha, Hmo phaleipa ta a o puasai aw vei.
Ahryuna athaona cha ti pasapa hawhta châ ta, Chavâta ahryuna a pua hlâta a hneisai ha mah y.
Moleipa thai a pachâsatuhpa cha, Abeipa châta pasichhihpa châ ta; Mosiapa thailei a pachâsatuhpa chhao, Abeipa châta pasichhihpa a châ.
Ahrupa cha palôh a hnei leipa châ ta, Chavâta sona chalei nawpa ta a ku liata sôh sopa cha, Khâpa ma a phahnai aw?
Viasa cha khatino rai ta kyhpachâ ta, Unawhpa deikua cha tymâna daihti châta a pihpa a châ.
Pahnona a phahlapa cha bie a taih ta, A vaihzy mohmô ta sôhkâ a sokhâh tyh.
Moleina hmo taopa a pahâh kawpa cha, A hryuchhia a khohpa châ ta; A chhikao a pasâhpa chhao, Raona a tluapa a châ.
Palôh akopa chyhsa cha hmo phapa hmô leipa ta, Paleih haihthaipa chhao chhiena â tyh tyh.
Ahrupa a satuhpa cha anosasyh ta pachâ a parôh ta, Ahrupa paw cha alyna hnei vei.
Palôh thaphapa cha thohna phapa châ ta, Palôh pasapa deikua cha ruzy a pahi tyh.
Moleipa cha arulâta panaopapana la ta, Adona lâpizy a parao tyh.
Sona cha novâhna a hneipa hmiakô liata y ta, Ahrupa mo deikua cha kaokih liata a y tyh.
Sawchapaw hrupa cha a paw pachârôhna châ ta, Ano a satuhpa nô palôh pasana a châ.
Mosiapa hriepa cha pha leipa ta, Nôpawpazy amâ dona vâta tupa chhao pha vei.
Bierei a chadopa cha chyhsa sopa châ ta, A reikah a sôhpa chhao chyhsa novâhpa a châ.
Ahrupa chhao â chalih thlâh ha khiahta cha, Asopa hawhta pachâpa châ ta; A hmao a mo khiahta cha, Chyhsa novâhpa hawhta a ngiahpa a châ.
Ano dei ta a y nanopa cha ano khopa sai a tluapa châ ta, Sona dopa zydua a dyuhpa a châ.
Ahrupa cha novâhna liata alyna hnei leipa ta, Ano palôh reipapuana lia deita ta â ly tyh.
Moleina a vaw y nahta, Papeisaleina vaw y tyh ta; Chyhsa za leina a y nahta, Nohzaona a y tyh.
Chyhsa pakah biezy cha ti athupa châ ta, Sona tihnawh cha vahtie loh zaolaopa hawhta a châ.
Moleipa khokhei viapa pha lei­pa ta, Mosiapa adona chhupa chhao pha vei.
Ahrupa hmao cha ahryuna tlôkhei ta, A pakah ta atuna a aw.
Ahrupa pakah cha ano raona châ ta, A hmao chhao a hro châta khoheih a châ.
Hohiahpa biezy cha pati pahâhpa hawhta châ ta, Py chhôh lâ a zu tyh.
A raihria liata chyhsa thathipa cha, Paraotuhpa unawhpa a châ.
Abeipa moh cha thokhy a sâhpa thatlôpa châ ta, Mosiapazy ta cha lâ a râ ei ta amâ boh tyh.
Chyhsa hneirôhpa sôh cha â bohna khihpi thokhy châ ta, Thokhy a sâhpa hawhta a mothlaw liata a y tyh.
Palôh laina cha raona hmia lâta sie ta, Areisina deikua cha palyupalihna hmia lâta a sie.
Bie thei pasia hlâta achhyna a piepa chyhsa cha, A hruna nata a maophyuhna a palâsa.
Palôh thatlôpa cha pasana tao thei ta, Palôh hmahphaopa deikua cha ahy ma a tao thei aw?
Palôh sopa cha pahnona hmô ta, Asopa nakhaoh chhao pahnona a tlua tyh.
Kuhria piepa cha a pietuhpa châta lâpi tao ta, Chyhsa rônahpazy hmiakô liata â chhi tyh.
A vaihzy a vy ei ta ama padei hlâta cha, A thaichâna bie a reih tuapa cha adopa hawhta â lâ tyh.
Nuby a daopa ta ahryuchhiana pachhâsa ta, A hryuh haipa thatlôpazy a pachhaih tyh ei.
Unawh pasasa hapa cha khihpi thatlôpa hlâta pahnie ru via ta, Cha hawpa ahryuna cha thokhy tlâh hawhta a châ.
Chyhsa pakah thei ta a rih pabie ta, A hmao kôvei ta lôhrâtlôpa ta a y.
Paleih hmotaotheina liata thina nata hrona y ta, A pasôtuhpazy ta a theizy ama nie aw.
Lapinô a hmôpa cha hmo phapa a hmôpa châ ta, Abeipa khokheina a totuhpa a châ.
Sipasapa cha â haw ta a haw tyh ta, Hneirôhpa deikua cha a chahrâh kawpa ta â chhy tyh.
Viasa hluhpi hneipa cha raona châ thei ta, Châhrasala unawh hlâta â i viapa viasa a y.
Chyhsa hrupa hmao haihthaipa châpa hlâta cha, Sipasapa ngâchhihpa châpa a pha via.
Pahnona a phahlapa hro cha pha leipa ta, A phei a parapa chhao a sumiesumâ tyh.
Chyhsa ta ano hruna vâta a lâpi a raopa tlai cha, Abeipa chô liata palôh ruchhôna a hnei tyh.
Sôh ta viasa hluhpi pahneisa ta, Sipasapa deikua cha a viasapa taihta a pathlua.
Pahnokheituh pakheipa cha hrie leipa ta y leipa aw ta, Haipa hu a sopa chhao pua aw vei.
Chyhsa hluhpi ta riaphapa khokheina tlua ei ta, Hmosaipa a pietuhpa cha chyhsa to viasa a châ.
A unawhzy hmahta sipasapa cha amâ hao khiahta cha, A viasazy chhochhi ta cha khatlu ta ma amâ hla aw tly! Bie ta âmo cha a chadai ta, Châhrasala ama siesai syulyu haw.
Sona a hneipa cha a hro pasô ta, Novâhna a vaotuhpa chhao hmo phapa a hmô aw.
Pahnokheituh pakheipa cha hrie leipa ta y leipa aw ta, Haipa bie a reihpa cha a leidia aw.
Ahrupa nata phasana hro a khyh leipa ta, Sei ta abeisawzy chô liata ryu a reipa awpa chhochhi â khyh lei pachai.
Sona ta chyhsa palôh pasisa ta, Pasasana mopakhôpa cha a rônahna a châ.
Abei hiehâna cha chakeibarôhneipa a rôhpa hawhta châ ta, A khokheina deikua cha sibiepa chôta diati a tlapa hawhta a châ.
Sawchapaw hrupa cha, A paw châta chhiena châ ta; Lapinô paphôh thaipa chhao, Ti di a thlaoh ngâ thlâh hapa hawhta a châ.
O nata sôh zy cha pawzy tawhta ryuto châ ta, Lapinô sopa deikua cha Abeipa tawhta a châ.
Thathina ta mokuhthuna liata pangiasa ta, Chyhsa a ychakhyhpa cha nodi a tao aw.
Biepiepa a vaopa cha a hro a vaopa châ ta, A lâpizy a uasa leipa deikua cha a thi aw.
Dyhchhiepa chô liata a ria a phapa cha, A sôh Abeipa dyu a pacheisapa châ ta; Abeipa ta a dyuchei cha a thô aw.
Na sawchapawpa cha chhorei teh, Hnabeiseihna a y lah y; A leidia thlâh ha awpa ta pachâ khah y.
Pathi chhie ngaitapa chyhsa cha hriena â tyh aw, Na pachhapa chhao ta pachha chanei ngâ thlâh ha awpa a byuh aw.
Pasopakâna bie nathlie la pachuna a pyh mah y, Achhâna liata sona na hmô aw.
Chyhsapa palôh liata achhuahna hluhpi y ta, Châhrasala a duah awpa cha Abeipa ryhraopa a châ tyh.
Chyhsapa khochhihna cha kyhpachâna a hneipa he châ ta, Haihthaipa hlâta cha sipasapa kho â chhih via.
Abeipa china cha hrona tlôkhei ta, A hneipa maih palôh pahâ kawpa ta a pahâ ei ta, Chhiena ta âmo cha tly aw vei.
Thathipa cha beikoh liata a ku ny ta, A pakah lâ chalo heih awpa dâhdei chhao hoh vei.
Chyhsa a pasipasawhpa cha tu la, Sona a phahlapa ta sona a chu aw ta; Chyhsa sovâhpa cha chhorei la, A pahnona a pôh aw.
A paw chô liata kupathla ta a nô a papuapa sawchapaw cha, Nozana nata nohzaona a tlôkheituhpa a châ.
Ei sawchapawpa y, pachuna nathliepa na bâsai khiahta cha, Novâhna biezy na paviasai aw.
Pahnokheituhpa leilôpa ta adona pahneisao ta, Moleipa pakah ta moleina a palâ tyh.
Chyhsa pasipasawh a hmâhpazy châta hriena a mâ chiehpa ta y ta, Ahrupazy hnôhky chhao tu awpa ta a mâ chiehpa ta a y.
Kresawhti cha pahneisaotuhpa châ ta, Sahma cha tu a thyupa a châ; Chazy ta a dôvei theipa chyhsazy cha asopa châ veih ei.
Abei hiehâhpa cha chakeibarôhneipa a rôhpa hawhta châ ta, Abei hie a pahâhpa chyhsa cha a hro châta chi â chhih.
Ahryuna a chalihsaipa cha zachhihna palâsa ta, Ahrupa deikua cha tu a thyu laih aw.
Thathipa cha chasipaw nota lei a palie hoh leipa vâta, Sâh hria daihti liata khâpa hmah hmô aw vei; Kudaopa ta a y aw.
Chyhsa palôh liata saduthliena cha ti athupa hawhta châ ta, Châhrasala novâhna a hneipa chyhsa ta cha a sy papua thei aw.
Mo hluhpi ta chyhsa phapa hawhta âmosasyh a reih ei ta, Chyhsa ngâchhihpa deikua ahy a hmô thei aw?
Mosiapa cha â dona hrokhei lymâ ta, A vaw pazi awpa a pathlazy thlaochhipa ta ama y aw.
Ryureina beidyuchhai liata a tyuhpa abei cha, A mo ta hmo pha leipa zydua a pahrua tyh.
“Ei palôh pathaihsa ha na ta, Ei moleina tawhta ei pathaih haw,” Ahy ma a tah thei tly?
Khopathliahna lô doleipa nata thliena ri doleipa zy cha, A miano ta Abeipa châta pasichhihpa a châ.
Hawtipa chhao a hro a pathaih nata pathaih leizie zy, Â do nata do leizie zy, A hmotaopa liata anosasyh ta a palâsa tyh.
Theina nah nata hmôna mo zy he, A miano ta Abeipa taopa sai a châ.
Amôpa tlaichhai khah y, Na dyhchhie pathlei aw na; Na mo padeih la, Niedo hluhpi na hnei aw.
Hmo chaleituhpa ta, “Pha vei, pha vei,” tah ta, Châhrasala chalei ta a pua tita cha â palaikhei kaw heih.
Ngôh y ta lôsôhpazy chhao a hluh kaw, Châhrasala novâhna hmaozy he lôsôhpa sôhpazy cha ama châ.
Khichhaipa châta sôhkâ a sohpa cha, A chysia lapa la; Chihropa châta sôhkâ a sohpa chhao, A bietai châta a chysia lapa mah y.
Dôveina ta viahchhâ hmôpa cha chyhsa châta pahâh kaw ta, A hnôhlâ ta deikua cha lochapo ta a pakah a bie aw.
Achhuahna cha ryureina ta a pa-i awpa châ ta, Hrâsie awpa chhao pasopakâna sopa ta tao awpa a châ.
Hohiahpa ta a khiekhâpa ta bieparu papua tyh ta, Chavâta pakah kawhpa chyhsa cha a pakyh khah y.
A paw tlyma a nô tlyma chhie a sapa cha, Zoh kaluhna su liata a meiôh pachhaipa a châ aw.
Âthaona liata tararuahna ta râh hneipa cha, Achhâna lâta byhnâ châ khao tyh vei.
“Moleina cha viari ei thô aw,” tah khah y, Abeipa hâ la ano ta a cha pachha aw.
Khopathliahna lô doleipazy cha Abeipa châta pasichhihpa châ ta, Thliena ri doleipazy chhao pha vei.
Chyhsapa keih chakânazy cha Abeipa raopa châ ta, Kheihta ma chyhsa ta a lâpi a pahno thei aw?
A chatlie baikhaipa ta Abeipa lâ hmo hlâ awpa bie a taihpa cha, Â taihtuhpa châta khoheih châ ta; Bietai tao khai tawhta pachâ pathi heihpa chhao, Â taihtuhpa châta khoheih a châ hra.
Bei sopa cha moleipa pahrua thai ta, Ama chô liata tiaki a pahieh thlu tyh ei.
Chyhsapa hrona hu cha Abeipa meiôh châ ta, A pôhpa chhôh liata a ypa zydua a palâsa tyh.
Kyhpachâna nata biehmeiseihpa ta abei cha hrôbieh ta, Ngâchhihna ta a beidyuchhai cha pabohsapa a châ.
Satliapazy rônahna cha ama thatlôna châ ta, Pawpipazy angiana deikua cha ama luh pawhpa a châ.
Hmah yna taihta tupa ta moleina pathai ta; Chheinazy ta palôh chhôh chaipazy chhao a pathai tyh.
Abei palôh cha Abeipa ku liata y ta, Vahtie ti hawhta a khona lâ maih a palosa tyh.
Chyhsa cha ano mokhaoh liata a lâpi to â do tah ta, Abeipa deikua cha palôh kho a pathliah tyh.
Abeipa châta cha siana nata adona ta hmo taopa he, Atheihna hlâta a pyh tlâh a châ via.
Mo a sâhpa nata palôh laipa cha moleina châ ta, Cha cha moleipa meiôh a châ.
Achhuahna phapa a hneipa chyhsa tiamapa cha a dyhpha aw ta, Palôh charâpa chyhsa deikua cha dyhchhiena lâ a pangai aw.
Paleih haihthaipa ta sôh hmôpa cha, Ti hu a lei haipa nata thina khoheih a châ.
Moleipazy cha adona ama tao khoh leipa vâta, Âmo nôchhiena ta a phi pathlah aw ei.
Thailei a châpa lâpi cha a ko ta, Chyhsa pathaihpa hro deikua cha â do.
A hryu nawpa sai a tlua thlâh hapa lapinô nata o laipa liata y khohpa hlâta la, Vâphuh chaki liata ypa a pha via.
Moleipa hro cha moleina khoh ta, A vaihzy ta a mo liata khokheina hmô veih ei.
Mohnao a hmâhpa hriepa a châ nahta, Sona a phahlapa vaw so ta; Chyhsa sopa cha pachupa a châ nahta, A pahnona â baichha tyh.
Khazoh Siapa ta moleipa o cha mohpathli ta, Moleipazy cha raona lâta a thy tyh ei.
Sipasapa awna lâta a nah a chahupa cha, Ano chhao awh aw ta a chhypa châ aw vei.
Arulâta hmosai piepa ta hiehâhna padia ta, Kalachhôh liata panaopapana nyupa ta pathiiana rupa a padia tyh.
Pachiana dopa cha mosiapa alyna châ ta, Moleipa châta deikua cha raona a châ.
Sona lâpi a tleisaipa cha, Athipazy ypakhyna liata â pahâ aw.
Haosai a tlaichhaipa cha sipasapa châ aw ta, Kresawhti nata sathaw a tlaichhaipa chhao hneirôh aw vei.
Moleipa cha mosiapa châta chatlaina châ aw ta, Apaphasaituhpa chhao chyhsa dopa châta chatlaina a châ aw.
Chanô paphôhthaipa nata pathichhiepa pahrâ lâhpa hlâta la, Râhchawhpa liata pahrâpa a pha via.
Chyhsa sopa pahrâna liata cha ryu sôhpa nata sathaw y ta, Chyhsa hrupa deikua cha a palâ khai ha tyh.
Siana nata ngâchhihna a chadaipa cha, Hrona, siana nata zana a hmô aw.
Chyhsa sopa cha pasaiphazy khihpi lâ kiah aw ta, Amâ pahniehna thokhy a pacho aw.
A pakah paleih a vaihpa cha, Nôpona tawhta a hro a vaihpa a châ.
Akhotlâhpa nata apatahsapa moh cha “Mohnaotuh” châ ta, Apalaina nata atahtheina ta hmo a tao tyhpa a châ.
Thathipa cha a ku ta rai a hria khoh leipa vâta, A hmo khohpa ta ano cha a thie aw.
Thathipa cha noh y ta khohlei khona sai ta bie ta, Mosiapa deikua cha pahlôh leipa ta tlao a pie tyh.
Moleipa atheihna hlâpa cha pasichhihpa châ ta, Moleina palôh chhaota a hlâpa chhochhi cha pasi â chhih via pachai.
Pahnokheituh pakheipa cha leidia aw ta, Bie a thei hmeiseihpa bie deikua cha â duah aw.
Chyhsa moleipa cha hmiakawh kawpa ta y ta, Chyhsa dopa deikua cha a lâpizy a phapa ta a pachâ tyh.
Kheihawhpa sona, novâhna nata ryhraothaina hmahta Abeipa cha pahnie aw vei.
Arâ cha adyuhna noh châta a mâ chiehpa ta y ta, Pahniena deikua cha Abeipa eih a châ.
Hneirôna hlâta moh phana a tlyh via awpa châ ta, Tâkâ nata ngôh hlâta pasâhsapa a pha via.
Hneirôhpazy nata sipasapazy a tyh ei ta, Ama zydua a taotuhpa cha Abeipa a châ.
Asopa cha chichhihpa hmô thaipa ta a nyusai ta, Sona a phahlapa deikua cha chatôh ta pasa a tao tyh.
Areisina nata Abeipa china lymâzy cha, Hneirôna, zana nata hrona zy a châ.
Palôh akopa lâpi liata ahlohzy nata khoheihzy y ta, A hro a vaihpa ta â hlasai aw ei.
Hawtipa cha a sie nawpa lâpi pachu la, A pitloh tita chhao siesai aw vei.
Hneirôhpa cha dyhchhiepa chô liata ryureih ta, Dyucheituhpa cha a pacheisatuhpa sei a châ.
Adoleina chi a tupa cha chhiena hria aw ta, A hiehâhna chôchahrei chhao a tlie aw.
Chyhsa riaphapa cha sipasapazy niedo â chhaih tyhpa vâ ei ta, Vânoh a to aw.
Chyhsa a mohnaopa cha papua u la, Ahryuna nata atuna zy â chalih aw.
Palôh pathaihna pasô ta, A reikah a phapa cha, Abei chhao viasa ta â tao thei aw.
Abeipa mo ta pahnona a hneipa chyhsa cha mokhâh ta, Piehpiepa bie deikua cha a thy pathlah tyh.
Thathipa cha, “Khôtho liata chakeibarôhneipa y ta, Lâlaizy liata eina thie aw,” a tah tyh.
Chanô sihryhpa pakah cha khaohtlô a thupa châ ta, Abeipa hie a pahâhpa cha cha liata a tla aw.
Hawtipa palôh liata hruna a bai ha ta, Sôsi ta chhoreina ta hruna cha lâhla lâ â chadai pai aw.
Ano hneirôna papôh nawpa ta dyhchhiepa tlybai ta, Hneirôhpa hnohta sôh nah thih a piepa cha, Dyhchhiena ta a tlô thlu aw.
Na nah pachôhpa ta asopa biezy nathlie la, Ei sona a chuna châta na palôh hmâh mah y.
Na chhôh liata a vao awpa châta pha ta, Na hmao liata a y awpa châta a pha khai.
Abeipa na ngâ thei nawpa ta, Chazy cha tanoh cha pahnosa na ta, Nâ lia tlai ta ei cha pahnosa haw.
Na châta bieso sythôh cha ropa na ta, Ryhraona nata pahnona zy ei cha ropa hih.
Chatanachata biedopa nata biehmeiseihpa pahno aw chi ta, Châ tuahtuhpazy hnohta biedopa na tlôkhei thei aw.
Sipasapa hrao khah y, Sipasapa a châ khaw; Pasataopa chhao thokhy chhikao liata tu lao khah y.
Abeipa ta ama bie a duakhei tlôh aw ta, Âmo a hraotuhpazy hro a hrao hra aw.
Hiehâh naopa chyhsa a viasa leipa la, Pathichhiepa chyhsa chhao a pakyh khah y.
A hrozie hâ a la aw chi ta, Na hro châta khoheih a châ pathlei aw.
Bie a taih thaipazy hry liata a hlao leipa la, Leibâh châta sôhkâ a sokhâhtuhpazy hry liata chhao a hlao khah y.
Na pie awpa na hnei khao vei tita, Na rakhô ama châ daophi pâ pathlei aw.
Châ pathlatuhpazy ta ama vaw bô hapa râhri lôbô hlôpa cha, Pasi cheita khah y.
Rai a thai kawpa chyhsa cha moh tua, Abei hmiakô liata a duah aw ta, Chyhsa zawrâpa hmiakô liata a duah aw vei.
Ryureituhpa nata pati na dôh khoh tita, Na hmiakô liata ahy ma a y tahpa a phapa ta pachâ mah y.
Niebaw a zoh kawpa na châ khiahta cha, Na rao liata chaizôh soh mah y.
A pati pahâhpazy tlaichhai kaw khah y, Dôveina pati ama châ.
Hneirôh awpa ta na rie a pathei tu leipa la, Â daihna rakha pahno awpa ta so thai kaw mah y.
Sôh cha na hmôpa nahta thlai a pai tyh; A mathlaw kaw thao ta, Pahmôh hawhta avâ lâ â zaw syulyu ha tyh.
Chyhsa mochhihpa viahchhâ cha nie leipa la, A pati pahâhpazy chhao tlaichhai hlei khah y.
A hryuh awpa sai pachâ ta, “Nie la, doh mah y,” cha tah taraw ta, A palôh hmeiseihpa liata deikua cha châ ly hlei vei.
A chyhta na niepa chhao pali lilaw aw chi ta, Na bie phapa tlao na papâpahria.
Ahrupa theina liata bie reih khah y, Na sona biezy a mohnao pathlei aw na.
Râhri lôbô hlôpazy pasie leipa la, Paw hnei leipazy lyu liata a ngia khah y.
Âmo chatlaituhpa cha a thatlô tlôh ta, Âmo a duakheipa ta a châ dyuh pathlei aw na.
Pachuna lâ na palôh pahei la, Na nah chhao pahnona biezy lâ pahei mah y.
Sawnawh chhoreipa a chalihsai khah y, Sôsi ta na tupa chhao ta thi aw vei.
Sôsi ta na tu khiahta cha, Athihkhih tawhta a hrona na pachha aw.
Ei sawchapawpa y, na palôh a so khiahta cha, Keima palôh chhao â ly aw.
Na hmao ta hmo dopa a rei tita, Ei palôh â ly ngaita aw.
Na palôh ta moleipazy uahva leipa sala, Noh y ta Abeipa chipa ta tlao y mah y.
Hmialâ daihti hnei aw chi ta, Na hnabeiseihna cha pahleipa châ aw vei.
Ei sawchapawpa y, nathliepa ta so la, Lâpi dopa liata na palôh soh mah y.
Kresawhti iahzaipazy hry liata a hlao leipa la, Sa zohpazy hry liata chhao a hlao khah y.
Sahma paripa nata sa zohpa zy cha dyhchhiena lâ pangai aw ei ta, Tla-uahna ta âmo cha poh chypa a pabu aw ei.
Châ satuhpa na paw bie nathlie la, Na nô a nôpi tita mohnao khah y.
Biehmeiseihpa chalei la zuah khao leipa la, Sona nata pachuna nata pahnona zy chalei mah y.
Mosiapa paw cha a ly ngaita aw ta, Sawchapaw sopa paw chhao a saw chô liata â ly kaw aw.
Na paw nata na nô thaphapa ta y ei sala, Châ satuhpa na nô cha a lypa ta y mawh sy.
Ei sawchapawpa y, na palôh na pie la, Na mozy ta ei lâpizy moh mawh sy.
Âzuahnô cha khaohtlô athupa châ ta, Apheinô chhao tikhaoh buahpa a châ.
Hraotuhpa hawhta chyhsa a byh ta, Chyhsapazy hry liata ngâchhih leina a papôhsa.
Ahy ma a hupo ta, ahy ma a pachâ a rôh? Ahy ma a hryuh ta, ahy ma a paphôh? Ahy ma a chhâpa y leipa ta hmah a phaoh? Ahy ma a mozy a saih khai haw?
Âmo cha kresawhti dona liata a y parei tupazy châ ei ta, Kresawhti pahlaopa do awpa ta a puapazy ama châ.
Kresawhti a saih nota moh leipa la, Nyu liata a rôh â ngia kawpa chhao moh hra leipa la, A loh zaolao ngâpa chhao moh hra khah y.
A chhâna liata cha parih hawhta cha pachu aw ta, Vâzi hawhta a cha pachu aw.
Na mo ta hmo nano kawpazy hmô aw ta, Na palôh ta bie chhiepazy a reih pathlei aw.
Tilaipi liah liata a ziapa hawhta châ aw chi ta, Balyh pohraina tôh pawhmao liata a ziapa hawhta na châ pathlei aw na.
“Na tu ei ta, pasa leipa na ta, Na chhei ei ta, pahno va na. Ei kaw hrapa nahta, Ei doh heih aw,” A tahpa na châ pathlei aw na.
Chyhsa moleipazy uahva leipa la, Ama hry liata a hlao awpa chhao tlaichhai khah y.
Ama palôh ta thachahra hmâna kyh patuapalua ei ta, Ama hmao ta tymâna bie a reihpa ama châ.
O cha sona ta sapa châ ta, Novâhna ta paduapa a châ;
Chhôhpadâhpazy chhao pahnona ta taopa châ ta, Hmo ngiapa nata hmo sôhpazy ta pabiepa a châ.
Chyhsa sopa cha thatlôpa châ ta, Pahnona a hneipa ta a hmotaotheina a papôhsa tyh.
Ryhraona sopa tao khai tawhta hrâ na sie awpa châ ta, Ryhraokheituhpa hluhna liata pahniena a y tyh.
Ahrupa châta sona cha a sâh tu ha ta, Thokhy chhikao liata a pakah â vei.
Hmo pha leipa tao awpa ta ryh a raopa cha, Paraopakeituhpa ama tah aw.
Ahrupa ryhraona cha moleina châ ta, Chyhsa mohnao a hmâhpa cha, Chyhsapa châta pasichhihpa a châ.
Tymâna noh liata na panao thlâh ha khiahta cha, Na thatlôna a chyh kaw tahna a châ.
Thi awpa ta a chhipazy cha pachha la, Thie awpazy cha pachha thlyu teh.
“Pachâ teh, he hmo he pahno ma pi,” Na tah khiahta cha, Palôh khopathliahtuhpa ta pahnopa ta, Na hro a vaotuhpa ta pahno thlâh ha ta, Chyhsa to ama hmotaopa lymâ hawhta viari a thô aw ei.
Ei sawchapawpa y, kheihti cha pha ta, nie la, Kheithlawh ti thlôhpa a thlaohpazy ta na pakah lôhrâ patlô mawh sy.
Sona cha na hro châta a châ tahpa pahno la, Na hmô khiahta cha hmialâ daihti hnei chi ta, Na hnabeiseihna lei aw vei.
Hy moleipa, mosiapa pahrâna su a byh leipa la, A o liata thachahra hmâ thlu khah y.
Mosiapa cha ei sari pao hra sala thyu heih tyh ta, Moleipazy deikua cha ei kha chhie atyhna liata amâ hluah tyh.
Na chariahpa a pao nota a ly leipa la, Â chapia nota na palôh thapha khah sy.
Chataleipatala Abeipa ta hmô aw ta a ly leipa aw ta, A chô liata a pathiiana a lapa pathlei aw na.
Hmo pha leipa a taotuhpazy vâta na pachâ a parôh leipa la, Moleipazy uahva hra khah y.
Chyhsa chhiepa châta hmialâ daihti y leipa ta, Moleipa meiôh cha pachhaipa a châ aw.
Ei sawchapawpa y, Abeipa chipa ta abei chhao chi la, Cha hawhta a y leipazy cha a pahlao khah y.
Abeipa nata abei ta ama chô liata raona eikhapi ta patlôsa aw ei ta, Kheihawhpa chhiena ma ama patlôsa thlu aw tahpa ahy a pahno aw?
Hezy chhao he chyhsa sopa biereipazy a châ. Pachiana liata khokhei viapa hneipa pha vei.
Moleipa hnohta, “Nâ do na,” a tahpa cha, Phopizy ta chhiesapa aw ei ta, Râhzy ta chyhuh ama sapa aw.
Moleipa thailei a pachâtuhpazy deikua cha a ly aw ei ta, Ama chô liata byhnâ phapazy a vaw tlô aw.
Achhyna dopa piepa cha, Hmao liata sypa hawhta a châ.
Khôtho lâta na rai a chhuanoh la, Lyu liata na raizy a ngoh tawhta, Na o cha sa mah y.
A chhâpa y leipa ta na vaih kyh liata pahnokheituhpa ta y leipa la, Na hmao ta dôvei khah y.
“Ei chô liata a taopa hawhta ano chô liata tao aw na ta, A hmotaopa viari ei thô aw,” tah khah y.
Thathipa lyu chapia na ta, Pahnona a phahlapa kre sadô ei chapia.
Moh teh u, ahloh buhzy ta pahli khai ha ta, Thlahbeizy ta lyu hmia zydua khupa ta, A dôhna alô diahpai chhao a cho khai haw.
Cha cha ei hmô nahta pachâ na ta, Moh na ta hetana heta pachuna ei dao.
Buakha a môpa ta, Buakha tla-uah chi ta, Buakha ku chakhipa ta nâ pahâ chhôh ta,
Dyhchhiena ta hraotuhpa hawhta cha vaw tlô thlu aw ta, Phahlana ta chaihrai chhaopa chyhsa hawhta a cha vaw tlô thlu aw.
Hezy he Sawlawmaw biesozy châ hra ei ta, Zudâh bei Hezekia chyhsazy ta ama ro pachhuahpazy a châ.
Bie nyupa cha Khazohpa rônahna châ ta, Abei rônahna deikua cha bie tluapapuapa a châ.
Avâzy â sâhpa nata alei â thupa hawhta, Abeizy palôh chhao a laichadai theipa châ vei.
Tâkâ tawhta a saiiepazy la ha la, Syudaihpa ta hmobaoh tao nawpa chhaichhi phapa hnei aw ta;
Abei mohmô tawhta moleipazy la ha la, A beidyuchhai cha siana ta paduapa a châ aw.
Abei hmiakô liata nâmasasyh ta a chhaodaolaoh leipa la, Chyhsa rônahpazy su liata a duah khah y.
Nôpawpazy mohmô ta â hnai lâ patyusapa hlâta, “He lâ a khy teh,” ama cha tahpa a pha via.
Ryureina liata chyhsa leih awpa a para khah y, A chhâna lâta na vaih ta maoh cha paphyuh aw ta, Tao awpa pahno leipa ta na y pathlei aw na.
Biepeipa na hneipa cha na vaih nata reih khoh u la, Mohropa bieru phuah khah y.
Chataleipatala a theituhpa ta maophyuhpa ta cha tao aw ta, Na moh chhiena chhâ thai khao leipa ta a y pathlei aw na.
A daihtita ta bie reipa cha, Tâkâ byh liata ngôh epuh hawhta a châ.
Ngôh rahy nata ngôh suapa atobina kho â chhihpa hawhta, Chyhsa sopa chhoreina chhao, Reingiahpa nakhaoh liata kho â chhih.
A tuahtuhpa châta lyuhchâpa ngâchhihpa cha, Sâh hria daihti liata dâhaw chakuapa hawhta châ ta, A zibeipazy hro a palysa tyh.
Hmo a pie leipa tlai ta piepa hawhta â reihpa cha, Vâsua ti a hnei leipa meihdo nata thlih hawhta a châ.
Palôh pasina ta ryureituhpa pahnie theipa châ ta, Paleih naipa ta ru a pakei thei.
Kheihti na hmô khiahta cha, Â daihpa rakha ta nie mah y; Na nie hluh tu khiahta cha, Na pali pathlei aw na.
Na vaih o tlykiah tu khah y, Cha ai aw ta a châ hao pathlei aw na.
A vaih chô liata pahnokheituhpa pakheipa ta a ypa chyhsa cha, Byuthô, zaozi nata châtai tiahpa hawhta a châ.
Tymâna daihti liata chyhsa ngâchhih leipa chô liata a pahniehpa cha, Hâh a charuapa nata phei a pahleihpa hawhta a châ.
Palôh rietheipa châta hla sapa cha, Chasi noh ta chysia pahluhpa hawhta châ ta, Lôiah liata sahma thaopa baopa hawhta a châ.
Na chariahpa a no a di khiahta cha nie awpa pie la, A dâh a phi khiahta cha ti do awpa pie mah y.
A luh chô liata meihei iapa a pathlupa châ aw chi ta, Abeipa ta lymâ a cha pie aw.
Maw thlih ta vâsua vaw tlôkhei ta, Kyh rei a hmâhpa paleih ta hiehâhna hmia a tlôkhei.
A hryu nawpa sai a tlua thlâh hapa lapinô nata o laipa liata y khohpa hlâta la, Vâphuh chaki liata ypa a pha via.
Râh hlapi tawhta thâtih phapa cha, Dâhphipa châta ti chakuapa hawhta a châ.
Chyhsa siapa moleipa hmiakô liata a paopa cha, Vahtie panôpa nata tihnawh puapa hawhta a châ.
Kheihti nie hluh tupa pha leipa ta, Rônahna tluapa chhao rônah hlei vei.
Anosasyh â pahnie leipa chyhsa cha, Khihpi chopa thokhy a hnei leipa hawhta a châ.
Nopi noh nata dâhaw tlapa a khyh leipa ta, Sâh hria daihti nata vâsuapa â khyh leipa hawhta, Palyupalihna chhao ahrupa nata a khyh vei.
Boby a viapa hawhta nata siviah â zawpa hawhta, A chhâpa y leipa ta chhiesapa cha a pai aw.
Chheina ri cha arâ châta châ ta, Chhâri cha alâ châta châ ta, Sôsi cha ahrupa ky châta a châ.
Ahrupa cha a hruzie hawhta a chhy khah y, Chataleipatala ano hawhta na châ pathlei aw na.
Ahrupa cha a hruzie hawhta a chhy teh, Chataleipatala asopa hawhta â pachâ pathlei aw na.
Ahrupa ku liata bietapa a paphaopa cha, Ano phei tai pachhô ta atudaina ti a dohpa a châ.
Ahrupazy hmao liata bieso cha, Pheisypa pheizy â pathliah thlâhthlipa hawhta a châ.
Ahrupa hnohta palyupalihna hlâpa cha, Cheisiah liata cheichâ lô pataohpa hawhta a châ.
Ahrupazy pakah liata bieso cha, Sahma paripa ku liata ahloh buh hawhta a châ.
Ahrupa nata a khiekhâ a pahâhpa rai pahriasapa cha, Likathaipa ta chyhsa to hmah a paphaopa hawhta a châ.
