I ta a palipa a nie heih tyhpa hawhta, Ahrupa chhao ta a hruzie a palâsa chanei heih tyh.
Ano mokhaoh liata â pasosa kawpa chyhsa na hmô tyh ma? Cha hawhpa chyhsa hlâta cha, Ahrupa châta hnabeiseihna a y via.
Thathipa ta, “Lâpi liata chakeibarôhneipa y ta, Lâlaizy liata chakeibarôhneipa a y,” a tah ty.
Ochhi a baolie liata â pahiehpa hawhta, Thathipa cha a rakhô liata â paliepatheih.
Thathipa cha a ku beikoh liata a ku ny ta, A pakah lâ chalo heih awpa dâhdei chhao hoh vei.
Hmo a laichadai thaipa pasari hlâ chhao ta, Thathipa cha ano mo liata â pasosa via tyh.
Mohropazy ahryuna liata a chahraohpa cha, I a vaw râpa nakao liata patupa hawhta a châ.
Meirei nata châtai nata thina hiepatlatuhpa ahrupa hawhta,
A vaih a dôveituhpa ta, “Sai na ei so bao!” a tah tyh.
Tho chhâ ta mei a thipa hawhta, Hohiahpa y leina liata cha ahryuna chhao â chalih.
Meihei cha meihô châta châ ta, Tho cha mei pati nawpa a châpa hawhta, A paphôh thaipa chyhsa cha ahryuna a pa-iatuhpa a châ.
Hohiahpa biezy cha pati pahâhpa hawhta châ ta, Py chhôh lâ a zu tyh.
Palôh chhiepa hnei ta a hmao a pahnia kaw heih tlôhpa cha, Alei beih tâkâ ta pahupa hawhta a châ.
Ahaona a hneipa cha a hmao liata nyuthu tyh ta, A palôh liata deikua cha dôveina a paveih tyh.
Bie phapa a reipa chhao ta zo khah y, A palôh liata hmo pasichhihpa miasari a vaopa a châ.
Ahaona a hneipa cha dôveina ta khupa a châpa chhao ta, A moleina cha tlâh pahnopa ta palâsapa a châ aw.
Khaohtlô a chaopa cha a chhôh liata tla aw ta, Alô a pahluahpa chhao ano â vaw hlua thlu heih aw.
Paleih haihthaipa cha a pasasapazy a hao ta, Papyupahlyna pakheipa pakah chhao paraona rai a hria tyh.
Mylâ ta hmo a vaw y awpa a palaikhei khah y, Cha noh chata khâpa ma a vaw tlôkhei aw tahpa pahno tlôh chi va.
Nâma pakah ta a reithai leipa la, Mohropa ta tlao cha reithai sala; Nâma hmao ta châ leipa sala, Khichhaipa hmao ta tlao cha reithai mawh sy.
Alô cha a hri ta, Sadi chhao â hri; Châhrasala ahrupa ta chyhsa a patypamâpa cha, Cha miano hlâta â hri via.
Hiehâhna cha a nôchhie ta, pathiiana chhao â tlao, Châhrasala ahy ma hiatliana hmiakô liata a duah thei aw?
Kyhpachâna â nyupa hlâta cha, A lâhâh ta rapa a pha via.
Viasa ta hmah paphaopa cha ngâ lei nawpa y leipa ta, Chariahpa apahnâna deikua cha a pakheipa a châ.
Rihbiepa châta cha kheihti chhao pasi a chhih ta, Nodipa châta deikua cha hmo khapa zydua chhao a thlôh khai.
A o a viavisaipa chyhsa cha, A bu a zaw saipa pavaw hawhta a châ.
Sathaw nata ropahâhpa ta palôh palysa ta, Viasa ryhraokheina bie phapa chhao a thlôh ngaita.
Nâma viasa nata na paw viasa a paphasai leipa la, Chhiena nâ tyhna noh ta na unawhpa o pangai khah y. Lâhlapi liata unawhpa hlâta cha, Lâhnia liata a y pa na opa phapa a pha via.
Ei sawchapawpa y, so la, ei palôh palysa mah y, Chatanachata nâ reipachhietuhpazy ei chhy thei aw ei.
Asopa cha chichhihpa hmô thaipa ta a nyusai ta, Sona a phahlapa deikua cha chatôh ta pasa a tao tyh.
Khichhaipa châta sôhkâ a sohpa cha, A chysia lapa la; Chihropa châta sôhkâ a sohpa chhao, A bietai châta a chysia lapa mah y.
Mydi kari ta thyu ta, A paro ngaitapa ta a vaih byhnâ a awpatuhpa cha, Ano châta chhie a sapa hawhta pachâpa a châ aw.
A hryu a pahâh kawpa lapinô cha, Avâ neih nota avâ di a tla ngâ thlâhpa nata miakha a châ.
Cha hawhpa lapinô pakhâ a chhuahpa cha, Thlih pakhâpa nata miakha châ ta; Ku chachâh lâta sathaw patupa nata miakha a châ.
Thua cha thua ta chatapa châ ta, Chyhsapa chhao chyhsa hropa ta a chata tyh.
Theiku kô a mohôhpa ta a thei nie aw ta, A zibeipa a chakaopa chhao palyupalihpa a châ aw.
Ti liata hmia tyhpa â lapa hawhta, Chyhsapa palôh cha chyhsapa châna a palâsa tyh.
Athihkhih nata Chhokhih zy ta â daih tahpa ama hnei leipa hawhta, Chyhsapa mo ta â dai tahna rai hnei vei.
Pathaisana beih cha tâkâ châta châ ta, Patina mei chhao ngôh châta a châ; Chyhsapa deikua cha, Reithai a hlaona daihti liata pasiana â tyh tyh.
Ahrupa sôkhaoh liata sâh chhaota Sôkhaih ta daih hra la, Ahruna ta ano cha siesai hlei aw vei.
Na mietaku zawzy duahmo pahno pasia la, Na sahroh zawzy a phapa ta vaih mah y.
Hneirônazy cha chhâzaw châta châ leipa ta, Bei lakho chhao chhâ zydua châta châ vei.
Sibiepa raoh ta si panyupa kaw thaopa ta, Tlâhpizy liata âhnalasi pakhypa a châ tita,
Mietakutawzy ta na chysia châ tôh aw ei ta, Miezy ta lyu ty ama châ tôh aw.
Na pati châta mie sâhpiti â daihpa ta hnei aw chi ta, Na chhôhkha châta nie awpa y aw ta, Na sawchanôzy mohôhna châta chhao â khi aw.
Ahy ta hmah ama chadai leipa chhao ta, Moleipazy cha a râpai ei ta; Mosiapazy deikua cha, Chakeibarôhneipa hawhta ama riah a pha.
Râh ta hmo a parao nahta, Ryureituhpa hluhpi vaw pua tyh ei ta; Pahnona nata novâhna a hneipa ryureituhpa ry liata deikua cha, Râh â ipa ta bohpi â duah tyh.
Dyhchhiepa ta dyhchhie hropa a tlybai pachhuah heihpa cha, Vâsua ta nie awpa rai pahlôh leipa ta, Chichei a phy pathlah khai hapa hawhta a châ.
Ryhpa a heihsaituhpazy cha moleipazy reithai tyh ei ta, Ryhpa a zyhtuhpazy deikua ta cha moleipazy amâ dyuh tyh.
Chyhsa chhiepazy cha adona kyh ama novâh leipa ta, Abeipa a tluatuhpazy deikua cha adona kyh liata tlokhuh ama no a vâh.
Hrozie doleipa hneirôhpa hlâta cha, Â dona a hrokheipa dyhchhiepa a pha via.
Ryhpa a zyhpa cha sawchapaw sopa châ ta, Azohpazy viasa deikua cha a paw no a paza tyh.
A pôhna chadaipa ta a sôh a papôhsatuhpa cha, Dyhchhiepazy chô liata riaphapa châta a sôh cha a pachô.
Ryhpa nathlie khoh leipa ta a nah su hro lâ a paheipa cha, A thlahchhâna chhao pasichhihpa a châ.
Lâpi doleipa liata chyhsa dopa a pasiesatuhpa cha, Ano khaohtlô chaopa lia tlai ta tla aw ta; Chyhsa phapakipazy deikua cha, Ryu phapa ama to aw.
Hneirôhpa cha ano mokhaoh liata a pasosa kaw ta, Châhrasala novâhna a hneipa dyhchhiepa ta Hneirôhpa châna dopa a hmô pasia aw.
Mosiapazy ta pahniena ama to nahta, Palyupalihna rônahpa y ta; Moleipazy ama thyu nahta deikua cha, Chyhsazy amâ nyu tyh.
A moleinazy a phihtuhpa cha vânoh to leipa aw ta, A moleinazy palâhâh ta a siesaipa deikua cha zawngiahna a hmô aw.
Abeipa khâ a chipa chyhsa cha vânoh to aw ta, A palôh kuh khâ a pachhapa deikua cha chhiena lâ a tla aw.
Phopi dyhchhiepa chô liata ryureihtuh chhiepa cha, Chakeibarôhneipa a rôhpa hawhta châ ta, Chavyh a thyupa hawhta a châ.
Novâhna a phahlapa ryureituhpa cha, Tlybaituhpa nôchhiepa châ ta; Adoleipa ta athôhna hmôpa a haotuhpa deikua cha, A hro chhôh kôzy a pasisa aw.
Chyhsa thisaih maoh a phaohpa cha, Khaoh­tlô lâ a râ aw ta, Ahy ta hmah bao khah sy.
Adona ta a hrohpa cha pachhapa châ aw ta, A hroziezy adoleipa deikua cha eikhapi ta a pao aw.
A chhaohlei a palietuhpa cha, Nie awpa hluhpi hnei aw ta; Hraoleipa a chadaituhpa deikua cha, A phahlapa hluhpi a hnei aw.
Chyhsa ngâchhihpa cha byhnâ hluhpi to aw ta, Hneirôh patoh a chhuahpa deikua cha hrie leipa ta pua aw vei.
Khokhei viapa hneipa pha leipa ta, Châhrasala viahchhâ tlâ kha vâta, Chyhsa ta hmo a parao thei.
Chyhsa riakhiehpa cha hneirôh awpa ta a para ta, Leina ta a vaw tlô thlu aw tahpa pahno vei.
A paleih ta a reithai pakheipa hlâta cha, Chyhsa a chhoreituhpa ta hnôhlâ ta khokheina a hlao via aw.
A paw tlyma a nô tlyma hrao ta, “Paraona châ vei,” a tahtuhpa cha, Paraotuhpa viasa a châ.
Karâypa chyhsa cha ahryuna pathyu ta, Abeipa a ngâtuhpa deikua cha pathawhsapa a châ aw.
Ano palôh a ngâtuhpa cha ahrupa châ ta, So thai kawpa ta a ypa deikua cha pachhapa a châ aw.
Dyhchhiepa a pietuhpa cha a phahla leipa aw ta, A mo a pasopa deikua cha chhiesana thata â tyh aw.
Moleipazy ama thyu nahta, Chyhsazy a nyu ei ta; Moleipazy ama leidia nahta, Mosiapazy ama pôh tyh.
Khâ chhoreipa chhao ta a kuh a chhapa cha, Eikhapi ta thliepa châ aw ta, Tlâh thei khao aw vei.
Mosiapazy ta ryu ama rei nahta, Zawpi a ly ei ta; Moleipazy ta ryu ama rei nahta, Zawpi amâ hrô tyh.
Sona a pasôpa sawchapawpa cha a paw palysa ta, Âzuahnô a pakyhpa deikua cha a paw sôh a papai tyh.
Abei ta adona ta râh padua ta, Hmopiepa a latuhpa deikua ta cha a parao tyh.
A vaih a reithai pakheipa cha, A phei sao â parai khâhpa a châ.
Moleipa cha a paraona liata a ao ta, Mosiapa deikua cha hla sa ta a tha a pha.
Mosiapa cha dyhchhiepazy adona pahno ta, Moleipa deikua cha, Cha hawhpa pahnona kyh liata a novâh vei.
Mohnaotuhpazy ta khihpi pakâ ei ta, Asopazy deikua cha hiehâhna ama padia tyh.
Chyhsa sopa ta chyhsa hrupa ryureina liata â ngiakhei khiahta cha, Ahrupa cha hiehâhpa nata pahneiparâpa ta y ta, Aryhna y thei vei.
Thisaih dâhphipazy cha chyhsa phapa a hao ei ta, Chyhsa dopazy hrona ama tei tyh.
Ahrupa cha a hiehâhna zydua reih papua ta, Asopa deikua cha nyu ta â chalihkhei tyh.
Ryureituhpa ta haipa bie a nathlie khiahta cha, A beimachâ zydua chhao ama molei tyh.
Dyhchhiepa nata tlybaituhpa a tyh ei ta, Abeipa ta ama mo a pavâsa raihrie ei.
Dyhchhiepazy châta â dopa ta a pachiatuhpa abei cha, Chhâzaw ta a beidyuchhai â duah aw.
Sôsi nata rana ta sona pie ta, Ano y ta paysapa hawti deikua cha, A nô châta nozana a tlôkhei tyh.
Moleipazy ama pôh nahta, Moleina chhao pôh ta; Châhrasala mosiapazy ta ama paopa ama hmô aw.
Na sawchapawpa cha chhorei la, Thlalôhpa ta cha paysa aw ta; Palôh lyna a cha pie aw.
Hmiasai y leina liata cha phopi leidia ei ta, Ryhpa a zyhpa deikua cha vânoh a to aw.
Chakaotuhpa cha bie dei ta chhorei awpa châ vei, A novâh hra sala tao hlei aw vei.
Bie rei a chhaohdaolaohpa na hmô tyh ma? Cha chyhsa hlâta cha ahrupa châta hnabeiseihna a y via.
A hawti no tawhta a sei a dao palaopa cha, A chhâna lâta sâlâpa chyhsa ta a papua aw.
Chyhsa pathichhiepa cha ahryuna pathyu ta, Chyhsa hiehâhpa ta hmo hluhpi a parao tyh.
Chyhsa cha â palaina ta ano panawh aw ta, Chyhsa areisipa deikua cha palyupalihna a hlao aw.
Parutuhpa â pakaohpa cha ano hrona a haopa châ ta, Chhiesana bie thei ta, châhrasala reih vei.
Chyhsapa cha a china ta anosasy khoheih a chôkhâh ta, Abeipa a ngâtuhpa deikua cha â boh aw.
Chyhsa hluhpi ta ryureituhpa khokheina tlua ei ta, Châhrasala Abeipa tawh deita ta chyhsa ta adona a hmô tyh.
Chyhsa doleipa cha mosiapa châta pasichhihpa châ ta, Chyhsa dopa chhao moleipa châta pasichhihpa a châ hra.
Hezy he Zake sawchapawpa Aku biesozy châ ta, Ithia hnohta reih ta, Ithia ta Ukâ hnohta a reipazy a châ.
Hru tu ha na ta, Chyhsapa a châ tlâh chhao châ va na, Chyhsapa novâhna hnei va na.
Sona a vaw chu beih leipa na ta, Pathaihpa pahnona chhao a vaw chu beih va na.

Avâ lâ kiah ta a zâ chô heihpa cha ahy ma a châ tly? A ku ta thlih a chahupa cha ahy ma a châ tly? A poh ta ti a chatypa cha ahy ma a châ tly? Khizaw kaokih zydua a paduapa cha ahy ma a châ tly? A moh ahy ma a châ tly? A sawchapawpa moh ahy ma a châ tly? Na pahno mah tâh!
Khazohpa bie zydua â do tahpa pasiapa châ ha ta, Ano cha a chhaituhpazy châta vyhphao a châ.
A biezy baichha khah y, Chataleipatala cha ra aw ta, Haihthaipa ta hmôpa na châ pathlei aw na.
Hmo mia no cha hiah na ta, Ei thi hlâta na thlyu khah y.
Adoleina nata haipa zy kei tawhta lâhlapi lâ pasie ha la, Dyhchhiena tlyma hneirôna tlyma na pie leipa la, Ei ngiahpa rakha ta na pasa lymâ mah y.
Chataleipatala lôhrâtlôpa ta y aw na ta, “ Abeipa cha ahy ma a châ?” tahpa ta, Ei châ paphasai pathlei aw na. Dyhchhiepa ei châ khiahta cha paru aw na ta, Khazohpa moh ei pachhie pathlei aw na.
Chakaotuhpa cha a zibeipa hnohta reipachhie beih khah y, Chataleipatala chhie cha sapa aw ta, Thailei pachâpa na châ pathlei aw na.
Ama pawzy chô liata chhie a sapazy y ei ta, Ama nôzy byhnâ a awpa leipazy chhao ama y.
Âmo mokhaoh liata pathaih â tah kawpazy y ei ta, Châhrasala ama puana pathaipa châ hlei veih ei.
Ama mo a sâh kawpazy chhao y ei ta, Ama mo vozy â sâh lâ sai ta a sai tyh.
Zaozi hâh a hneipazy y ei ta, Chaizôh naoh a hneipazy chhao ama y; Alei tawhta dyhchhiepazy palâ khai ei ta, Chyhsazy hry tawhta phahlapazy ama palâ tyh.
Chava ta sawchanô pano hnei ta, Ama moh cha, “Na pie teh” nata “Na pie teh” a châ. A lôhrâ a tlô beih leipa hmo mia thôh y ta, “Â daih” a tah beih leipa hmo mia palih a y.
Athihkhih nata chhi chohpa zy cha ama lôhrâtlô beih leipa ta, Alei chhao ti ta a lôhrâtlô beih hra leipa ta, Mei ta, “Â daih,” tah beih vei.
Paw a mohnaopa mokhaoh nata Nô a nawhtawpa mokhaoh cha, Saikao raawhzy ta thaoh aw ei ta, Vâkhiehzy ta ama nie aw.
Hmo mia thôh ei châta noâhchhih ngaitapa y ta, Ei no a vâh thei leipa mia palih a y:
Avâ liata pahmôh lâpi, Lôpanô chô liata parih lâpi, Tilaipi liah khophie liata balyh lâpi nata Chapaw ta laihsa a pangaina lâpi zy ei novâh thei vei.
He he apheinô hro cha a châ: A nie khai tawhta a hmao a hru ta, “Moleina hmo khâpa hmah tao va na,” a tah tyh.
Hmo mia thôh vâta alei a chalyu ta, Mia palih ta a vi tita cha phaoh thei khao tyh vei:
Sei ta bei a châ tita, Ahrupa ta niedo lôhrâtlôpa ta a y tita,
Chanô khochhih leipa ta vahpa a hnei tita nata Seichanô ta a zibeinô su â thla tita alei â chalyu tyh.
Alei chô liana heta hmo chyhpata mia palih y ta, Châhrasala ama so ngaita:
Hloia zaw cha thatlô lei kawpa châ ei ta, Châhrasala nopi nota nie awpa ama pachô.
Tlâh pazupi zaw chhao pachyu lei kawpa châ ei ta, Châhrasala lôkâhpazy liata ama o ama tao.
Khawsuzy ta bei hnei leipa ei ta, Châhrasala a hri hri ta ama sie.
Zytôpuhpa chhao a kuzy ta a patu laih ta, Châhrasala abei ozy liata a pahrâ.
Hmo mia thôh cha ama lâ chakâzie mopa ta rônah ngaita ei ta, Ama keih raizie a rônah ngaitapa mia palih a y:
Chakeibarôhneipa cha râhsazy hry liata thatlô chaipa châ ta, Khâpa ta hmahta pasysa thei vei.
Awhkhypa cha a khotlâh kawpa ta awhpanô a charia ta, Mie tôhpa chhao mie panô hmia liata cha hawhta tao ta, A siehnaopa a hnei leipa bei chhao rônah kawpa ta a sie tyh.
Hru kawpa ta nâmasasyh a pasâhsapa ta, Hmo chhiepa tao awpa nâ chhuah khiahta cha, Na pakah a chahu mah y.
Sâhpiti patlaopa ta sâhpiti kuapa papua ta, Hnapasu chamiehpa ta thi papua ta, Hie pahâhpa ta ahryuna a papua tyh.
Hezy he Bei Lemua hnohta a nô ta a pachupa biesozy a châ.
Hy ei sawchapawpa, khâpa ma na tao? Ei chhi tawhta a puapa y, khâpa ma na tao? Ei bietai sawchapawpa, khâpa ma na tao?
Na thatlôna cha chanôzy pie leipa la, Na hroziezy chhao beizy a paraotuhpazy pie khah y.
Hy Lemua y, kresawhti he beizy châta châ leipa ta, Beizy cha kresawhti ama do awpa châ vei; Ryureituhpazy chhao sahma ama do awpa châ vei.
Ama do khiahta cha ryhpa my aw ei ta, Pasataopazy adona ama pahleipa pathlei aw.
Leidia haipazy hnohta sahma pie u la, Palôh pasapazy hnohta kresawhti pie teh u.
Doh ei sala ama dyhchhiena my ei sala, Ama pachârôhna amâ thei khao leina hâh ta.
Reihpathlie thei leipazy châta na pakah â la, Vâchhiepazy a duakheipa ta na pakah â mah y.
Na pakah âpa ta siana ta ryureih la, Dyhchhiepa nata phahlapazy adona a duakhei mah y.
Lapinô phapa ahy ma a hmô thei aw? Lapinô phapa cha lôsôhpazy hlâta a sôh via syulyu.
A vahpa palôh ta ano cha ngâ ta, Athôhna hmô leipa ta y aw vei.
A hro chhôh noh zydua liata a vahpa châta Chhiena lâ châ leipa ta phana lâ sai ta hmo a taopa tyh.
Mietaku hmi nata pala rih dipa tlua ta, A ku ta palôhtlâhpa ta a hria tyh.
Sôhryhpa balyhzy hawhta châ ta, Lâhlapi tawhta niedozy a vaw tlôkhei tyh.
Azo ta thyu ta, A chhôhkha nie awpa patohpatia ta, A chakaotuhpa laihsazy chhao ama nie awpa tovyuhzy a pie tyh ei.
Lyu hnei thei nawpa ta saduthliepa ta chalei ta, A hriapasana ta a hmôpa sôh hmâpa ta kre sadô a tao.
Thatlôna ta a chai a saih ta, A bâh thazy a patlô tyh.
A sôhpaliepa â thôh tahpa pahno ta, Zâ ta chhao a meiôh thi beih vei.
Raha ku liata a ku soh ta, A ku ta lahmi a patu.
Dyhchhiepazy lâta a ku pazawh ta, Phahlapazy lâta a ku a paza tyh.
A chhôhkha châta dâhaw chi leipa ta, A chhôhkha zydua poh saihlawpa a pabu ei.
Ano châta chhao rakhô pohzy tao ta, A chysia cha pala rih dipa nata sainohpa a châ.
Thokhy chhikaozy liata râh machâzy hnohta a vahpa â tyu nota, A vahpa cha zawpi pahnopa a châ.
Pala rih dipa chysiazy taopa ta zuah ta, Chaisaihzy sôhdaohpa lâ a paphao tyh.
A chysia cha thatlôna nata rônahna châ ta, A ly kawpa ta daihti a vaw tlô awpa a mokhâh tyh.
Sona ta a pakah â ta, A paleih liata nôphana pachuna bie a y.
A chhôhkha khihsatôhtuna a phapa ta mohôh ta, Thathina viahchhâ nie vei.
A sawzy thyu ei ta, “Nohlaonô” tah ei ta, A vahpa chhao thyu ta a lapinô cha reithaipa ta,
“Chanô hluhpi tao pha kaw sai ei ta, Châhrasala na ly khai ha ei,” a tah.
Khoiah hneina cha dôveina châ ta, Chhithaina chhao hraoleipa a châ; Abeipa a chituhpa chanô deikua cha reithaipa a châ aw.
A hriapasana theilâpazy vâta lapinô cha palyupalih la, A hmotaopazy ta thokhy chhikaozy liata ano cha reithai mawh sy.
He he Dâvi sawchapawpa Zerusale bei, Biechhotuhpa biezy a châ:
Biechhotuhpa ta, “Hraoleipa sai, hraoleipa sai, Hraoleipazy hry liata hrao lei chaipa, Ato hraoleipa sai a châ,” tah ta.
Chyhsapa he noh ry liata a hriapasana tawhta Khâpa athôhna ma a hmô tly?
Chhâ kha lei ta, chhâ hropa vaw y heih ta, Alei deikua cha chhâzaw ta a y ngâ thlâh haw.
Noh vaw chhi ta, noh tla ta, A vaw chhina su lâ thlai a kua heih tyh.
Thlih cha chho lâ pathli ta, Maw lâ khy heih ta; Pathli chahlô lymâpa ta, A vaw puana lâ a kua heih tyh.
Chavah zydua tilaipi liata tla ei ta, Châhrasala tilaipi cha bie beih vei; Chavahzy cha ama lona tyhpa lâta, Ama loh chanei lymâ.
Hmo zydua riethei thachhâ chhihpa châ ei ta, Chyhsa ta rei tiah awpa chhao châ vei. Mokhaoh ta a hmo hmôpa liata a lôhrâ tlô leipa ta, Nakao ta a hmo theipa liata a rih bie vei.
A y hapa cha a y heih awpa châ ta, Tao hapa chhao tao heih awpa a châ; Noh ry liana heta hmo thiehpa rai y vei.
“Moh tua u, he he a thiehpa cha a châ,” Tah thei awpa hmo a y rai ma? Eima y hlâ tawhta a vaw y kôzawpa sai a châ.
Hmo parohpazy a thei ngâ thlâh hapa châ leipa ta, Hmo a vaw y awpazy chhao, Chhâ a vaw y awpazy ta a thei ngâ thlâh ha aw veih ei.
Kei, Biechhotuhpa he Izarei chô liata Zerusale liata bei châ na ta.
Avâ ry liata hmo a ypa zydua sona ta tlua awpa ta ei palôh hmâh na ta. Khazohpa ta chyhsa sawzy tao awpa a vaw piepazy he tymâna dei a vaw châ.
Noh ry liata hmotaopa zydua hmô khai na ta, moh tua u, ato hraoleipa sai châ ei ta, thlih a chadaipa deita a châ:
Apako chiehpa cha patlâ thei awpa châ khao leipa ta, A y leipa chhao rei pâ thai awpa châ vei.
Keimasasyh ta, “Sona hluhpi hnei ha na ta, keima hlâta Zerusale liata a vaw y tuapa zydua hlâta thata so viapa ta, ei palôh chhao ta sona nata pahnona hro a padi haw,” a tah na ta.
Chatanachata sona kyh pahnopa ta, hruna nata ngâna kyh chhao pahno awpa ta ei palôh hmâh na ta. Cha chhao cha thlih a chadaipa deita a châ tahpa ei pahno haw.
Sona hluhna liata tymâna chhao hluh ta, Pahnona a papôhsatuhpa cha pachârôhna a papôhsatuhpa a châ.
Ei palôh liata, “Khawh, a vy teh, alyna ta duah ei cha pasia tua aw, a ly kawpa ta y teh,” tah na ta. Châhrasala moh tua u, cha chhao cha hraoleipa a châ.
Pahneina hnohta, “Hruna a châ,” tah na ta, Alyna hnohta, “Khâpa phahnaina ma a hnei,” ei tah tyh.

Chyhsa sawzy he hro chhôh noh chyhta ama hnei chhôh ta, avâ ry liata sona hmotaopa ma a pha via, hruna hmotaopa ma, tahpa ei pahno thei nawpa ta, ei palôh cha sona ta pachhihthasa lymâna chôta, ei pôhpa he kresawhti ta palysapa ta hruna patu a chhuah na ta.
Rai hluhpi hriapa ta, ozy a sa na ta, kre sadôzy ei châta ei tao.
Sadôzy nata theilâpa thihzy a tao na ta, cha liata theilâpa tho to loh na ta.
Thody lai haipazy ta a biepa thothihzy a chyh thei awpa ta, tipozy chhao keima châta ei tao.
Seichapawzy nata seichanôzy chalei na ta, ei o liata a pihpa seizy chhao ei hnei. Viahchao hri hluhpi nata mietaku zaw hluhpi hnei na ta, Zerusale liata a vaw y tuapazy hlâta thata ei hnei hluh via.
Tâkâ nata ngôh nata abeizy nata râhzy ryusôhpazy pakhy na ta, chapaw nata chanô hlasathaipazy hnei na ta, chyhsa sawchapawzy alyna nôtho hluhpi chhao ei hnei.
Thata vaw hneirôh na ta, Zerusale liata a vaw pahrâ tuapazy ei ly khai ha ei. Sona chhao ei hnei lymâ.
Ei mo ta a khopa maih thlyu leipa na ta, ei palôh chhao alyna kheihawhpa liata hmahta pakysa va na. Ei hriapasana zydua liata ei palôh a ly ta, cha cha ei hriapasana zydua vâta ei lymâ a châ.
Ei hriapasa­na zydua nata ei ku ta ei hriapa zydua pachâ na ta, moh teh u, cha zydua cha hraoleipa châ ei ta, thlih a chadaipa deita a châ; noh ry liana heta hmo phahnaipa khâpa hmah y vei.
Chatawhcha sona nata ngâna nata hruna kyh zy lâ a heipa ta pachâ na ta. Abei a thla awpa chyhsa cha, bei tuapazy tao chiehpa tah leipa ta cha, khâpa hropa ma a tao thei aw?
Khaihna cha zohna hlâta a pha viapa hawhta, sona chhao hruna hlâta a pha via tahpa ei hmô haw.
Chyhsa sopa cha a luh liata mokhaoh hnei ta, ahrupa deikua cha zohna ry liata a sie tyh. Châhrasala ama to awpa cha ama zydua châta miakhapa a châ tahpa ei pahno.

Chatawhcha ei palôh ta, “Ahrupa chô liata hmo a tlôpa cha keima chô liata chhao tlô hra tlôh aw ta, cha hawhpa khiahta cha, ei sona heta khâpa phahnaina ma a hnei tly?” tah na ta. Ei palôh liata, cha chhao cha hraoleipa a châ ei tah tyh.
Asopa chhao, ahrupa chhao, chhâzaw ta a thei thlâh hapa châ aw veih ei. Nohzy khô laih aw ta, mypa ama châ khai aw. Asopa chhao ahrupa hawhta a thi thlâh ha hrapa a châ.
Chavâta hro he ei hao. Noh ry liata hmotaopa zydua he, ei pachâ nâ parôhtuhpa dei châ ei ta, ato zydua hraoleipa châ ei ta, thlih a chadaipa deita a châ.
Ei hriapasana zydua he ei hnôhlâ ta a vaw y awpa châta ei râsai awpa deita a châpa ei pahnopa vâta, noh ry liata ei hriapasana zydua he ei hao.

Cha chyhsa cha asopa ma a châ aw, ahrupa ma tahpa ahy a pahno aw tly? Chatanachôta ei sona hmâpa ta noh ry liata ei hriapasana zydua chô liata biehneituhpa a châ pyly aw. Cha chhao cha hraoleipa deita a châ.
Chavâta a heihhâ na ta, noh ry liata rai ei hriapasana zydua liata ei hnabei a dy haw.
Chyhsa ta sona nata novâhna nata zôthaina zy hmâpa ta hriapasa ta, a châh ta cha, a hriapasa leipa to awpa ta siesai awpa a châ thlâh ha tyh. Cha chhao cha hraoleipa nata paraona lai ngaitapa a châ.
Chyhsa ta tiamapa nata palôh rietheipa ta noh ry liata a hriapasana tawhta khâpa ma a hmô?
A hro chhôh noh zydua cha vâsâhna sai ta bie ta, a raihria chhao ruchhôna dei a châ. Zâ ta chhao a palôh a pahâ vei. Cha chhao cha hraoleipa deita a châ.
Chyhsapa châta, niepa ta doh ta, a hriapasana liata alyna hneipa hlâta a pha viapa y vei. Cha chhao cha Khazohpa tawhta a châ tahpa ei hmô haw.
Ano tawhta a châ vei khiahta cha, ahy ma nie thei aw ta, ahy ma alyna a hnei thei aw?

Ano a palysatuhpa cha, Khazohpa ta sona nata novâhna nata alyna pie ta, moleipa deikua cha, Khazohpa palôh a patlâhpa hnohta pie awpa lapakhyna nata pahmaohpakhyna rai a pahriasa tyh. Cha chhao cha hraoleipa châ ta, thlih a chadaipa deita a châ.
Ato châta daihti y ta, Avâ ry liata hmo to châta daihti raopa a châ.
Pi daihti y ta, thi daihti a y; Lo daihti y ta, lo chiehpa phia daihti a y;
Thie daihti y ta, patlâh daihti a y; Phie daihti y ta, sa daihti a y;
Cha daihti y ta, pahnei daihti a y; Mâchhiesa daihti y ta, lâ daihti a y;
Alô thy daihti y ta, alô pahmaoh daihti a y; A pyhpahly daihti y ta, a pyhpahly lei daihti a y;
Tlua daihti y ta, pahlei daihti a y; Paso daihti y ta, thy pathlah daihti a y;
Hrie daihti y ta, bieh daihti a y; A chalih daihti y ta, bierei daihti a y;
Kyhpachâ daihti y ta, a hao daihti a y; A dyuh daihti y ta, a dyh daihti a y.
Raihriatuhpa ta a hriapasana tawhta khâpa athôhna ma a hmo?
Khazohpa ta chyhsa sawzy hnohta a tymâkhei awpa ta rai a vaw piepa cha ei pahno haw.
Ato ama daihti chyu liata â ngia ngaitapa ta taopa ta, chyhsapa palôh liata tlyzaw soh ta, châhrasala Khazohpa hmotaopa cha âthaona tawhta achhâna taihta pahno thei hlei vei.
A ly ngaitapa ta y ta, ama hro chhôh zydua hmo phapa taopa hlâta a pha viapa y vei tahpa ei pahno haw.
Chyhsa to ta niepa ta doh ei sala, ama hriapasana zydua liata a ly mawh ei sy. Cha cha Kha­zohpa kuhria a châ.

Khazohpa ta a taopa maih cha a y kôzaw aw tahpa ei pahno. Khâpa hmahta baichha theipa châ leipa aw ta, la bâ theipa cha aw vei. Chyhsazy ta a hmiakô liata chizapa ta ama y thei nawpa ta, Khazohpa ta a taopa a châ.
A y haipa he, a y chiehpa kha châ ta; a vaw y awpa chhao, a y chiehpa kha a châ. Khazohpa ta a lei hapa a paysa heih tyh.
Cha dei châ vei, adona yna su liata paraona y hra ta, siana yna su liata chhao paraona a yzie noh ry liata ei hmô.
Hmo to nata rai to châta daihti raopa a châ khaipa vâta, Khazohpa ta mosiapa chhao moleipa chhao a pachia khai aw ei tahpa ei palôh ta pachâ na ta.
Chyhsa sawzy cha sahrohzy deita ama châzie âmosasyh ta amâ pahno thei nawpa ta, Kha­zopa ta âmo cha a pasia ei tahpa chhao ei palôh ta pachâ na ta.

Chyhsa sawzy chô liata a tlô awpa nata sahrohzy chô liata a tlô awpa cha miakhapa châ ta, pakha thi ta, ahropa chhao a thi hra. Husona miakha a hneipa châ ei ta, chyhsapa cha sahroh hlâta a duahmo pha via hlei vei. Ato zydua hraoleipa a châ khai.
Ama pangaina su â lyu khai. Ama zydua ta dohlei tawhtapa châ ei ta, ama zydua ta dohlei lâ ama kua heih.
Chyhsapa thlahpa chô lâ kiah ta, sahroh thlahpa alei ry lâ a zu tahpa ahy ma a pahno?

Chyhsapa châta cha, raihria awpa he a tovyuh a châpa vâta, a raihria liata a ly awpa hlâta a pha viapa y vei tahpa ei hmô haw. ­ A thi khô lâta hmo a ypa pamosa awpa ta, ano cha ahy ma a vaw kuakhei thei aw?

Pachâ via heih na ta, noh ry liata tlybaina zydua hmô na ta. Moh teh u, tlybaipa ta a ypazy cha mothlih chhaota y ei ta, thlah a palôh awpa hnei veih ei. Âmo a tlybaituhpazy cha hmotaotheina hnei ei ta, âmo deikua cha thlah a palôh awpa y veih ei.
Chatawhcha athipazy kyh patuapalua na ta, a thi hapazy kha a hroh chypazy hlâta vâpha viapa ama châzie ei palôh liata â vaw lâ.
Athipa nata ahrohpa hlâ chhao ta, a pih leipa, noh ry liata moleina hmotaopa rai a hmô leipa châ awpa a pha via syulyu.
Hriapasana nata raihria liata zôthaina zydua chhao he, vaihzy uahvana vâta a vaw ypa a châ tahpa hmô na ta. Cha chhao cha hraoleipa châ ta, thlih a chadaipa deita a châ.
Ahrupa cha a ku pako ta, Ano sa â nie tyh.
Chhôhmoh kawpa ta pazah kha hneipa cha, Hriapasa kawpa ta pazah miano hnei ta, Thlih a chadaipa hlâta a pha vai.
Sai heih na ta, noh ry liata hraoleipa ei hmô via heih.

Chyhsa matlupa pakha y ta, sawchapaw tlyma, unawh tlyma hnei leipa ta, ano dei ta a o liata pahrâ ta. Châhrasala a hriapasana chhâ thai khao leipa ta, hneirôna liata a mo lôhrâtlô beih leipa ta, “Ahy châta ma he tlupo ta hriapasa na ta, hro pahâh leina taihta ei hria tly?” tahpa ta anosasyh ta a hiahri beih hra vei. Cha chhao cha hraoleipa deita châ ta, thapawh a chhih leipa raihria a châ.
Pano cha pakha hlâta a pha via, ama hriapasana lymâ a hluh via awpa vâta.
Pakha a pao khiahta cha, pakhapa ta a viasapa cha a pathyu aw. Ano dei ta a ypa deikua cha a hu a po na, a pao tita a pathyu awpa ama y leipa vâta.
Chyhsa pano amâ zia khoh khiahta cha, ama lalôh aw. Pakha dei ta â zia khiahta cha, kheihta ma a lalôh thei aw?
Pakha deipa cha chyhsa ta a pahnie thei ngyu ma, pano deikua pahnie thei aw vei. Chaori ri thôh ta charipa cha, thlai ta chie aw vei.
Bei hrupa machâpa, pachâna lana châh chhao a pahno khao leipa hlâta cha, thyutlia sopa dyhchhiepa a pha via.
Bei hrupa cha, bei châ awpa ta a pihpa châ hra sala, dyhchhiepa vaw châ thei ta, thyutlia sopa dyhchhiepa chhao, patâhna o tawhta beidyuchhai liata â kaw tyuh thei.
Chyhsa a hrohpa zydua noh ry liata ama chareipa hmô na ta, abei su liata a duahpa thyutliapa chhao kha ama hry liata hmô hra na ta.

Bei thyutliapa ta a chhihthapa zawpi zydua cha chhâ tiah veih ei. Chatahrasala ano hnôhlâ ta a vaw y awpazy ta a chô liata a ly hlei aw veih ei. Cha chhao cha hraoleipa châ ta, thlih a chadaipa deita a châ.
Khazohpa o lâ na pangai nota na phei a phapa ta vaih mah y. Ahrupazy atheihna hlâpa hlâta bie nathlie awpa ta a hniapa a pha via, ahrupazy cha khâpa ma ama tao tahpa ama pahno leipa vâta.
Na pakah a para leipa la, na palôh ta Khazohpa hmiakô ta bie rei awpa chatlie tu khah sy. Khazohpa cha avâ liata y ta, nâ deikua cha alei liata y tlôh chi ta, chavâta bie reih chyh mah y.
Pachâna hluh tupa ta mâsapa pahluh ta, bie rei hluh tupa ta hruna bie a papua hluh tyh.
Khazohpa lâ hmo pie awpa bie nâ taih khiahta cha, na bietai patlô awpa ta pahawhpasâh khah y. Khazohpa cha ahrupazy chô liata a ly vei. Bie nâ taihpa cha patlô mah y.
Bie a taih tlôh ta patlô leipa hlâta cha, bie a taih leipa a pha via.
Na pakah ta cha pamoleisa leipa sala, vâlyuhchâpa hmiakô liata, taopasipa a châ tah hra khah y. Khazia Khazohpa cha na bie vâta a hiehâhpa ta, na ku raihriazy a parao aw?
Mâsana a hluhna liata bie ruapa hluh ta, hraoleipa chhao a hluh tyh. Khazohpa deita na chi awpa a châ.

Dyhchhiepazy tlybaipa ta ama ypa nata adona nata siana zy thachahra hmâpa ta pahleipa a châzie zy bia liata na hmô khiahta cha, cha kyh liata na noâh khah sy. Hyutuh laipa cha ano hlâta a sâh viapa ta mohpathli ta, âmo pano chô lâta chhao hyutuhpa a sâh viapazy ama y heih.
Châhrasala mo to chhaohlei kôvei a niepa sai châ ei ta, abei tlai chhao cha lyutaopazy ta ama chyhpa a châ.
Tâkâ a tlaichhaipa cha tâkâ liata a lôhrâ patlô beih leipa aw ta, hneirôna a tlaichhaipa chhao a sôh hmôpa ta a lôhrâ patlô beih aw vei. Cha chhao cha hraoleipa deita a châ.
Hneina a pôh khiahta cha, a nietuhpa pôh ei ta; a mokhaoh ta sôh a hmôpa tah leipa ta cha, sôh hneituhpa châta khâpa athôhna ma a hnei?
Raihriatuhpa cha a nie hluh tlyma, a nie chyh tlyma, a mokuh pahâh kaw ta; hneirôhpa deikua cha, rih biena taihta a niepa chhao ta a mô thei vei.
Hmo pha lei ngaitapa noh ry liata ei hmô: Chyhsa ta ano palôh pasa nawpa ta sôh nata thih a pachôpa hih.
A sôh nata thihzy cha chhiena â tyhna liata lei khai ha ta, a sawchapaw châta a ku liata khâpa hmah y khao vei.
A nô chhi tawhta thluahruapa ta a vaw puapa hawhta, thluahruapa ta kua heih aw ta, a hriapasana theilâpazy chhao khâpa hmah a phao thei aw vei.
He chhao he hmo pha lei ngaitapa a châ: a vaw tlô no hawhna khata a sie heih aw. Thlih châta hriapasapa dei châ ta, a châta khâpa athôhna ma a hnei?
Cha dei châ vei, a hro chhôh noh zydua ta ruchhôpa nata pasapa nata hiehâhpa ta zohna liata pati a nie tyh.

Moh teh u, hmo phapa nata a hmiepa ta ei hmôpa cha, chyhsa ta niepa ta doh ta, Khazohpa ta a piepa noh chyhta a hnei chhôh ta, noh ry liata a hriapasana zydua liata alyna a hnei awpa he a châ. Cha cha a tovyuh a châ.

Cha dei châ vei, Khazohpa ta chyhsa hnohta sôh nata piah nata hneirôna zy a pie tita, chazy liata alyna châh pahno ta, a tovyuh a pyh thaipa ta, a hriapasana liata alyna châh a pahnopa cha, Khazoh hmosaipiepa a châ.
Khazohpa ta a palôh khâ a palysa awpa vâta, a daihti khô chiehpazy a thei tu khao aw vei.
Noh ry liata hmo pha leipa ei hmôpa y ta, cha chata chyhsapa he thata a vi:

Khazohpa ta chyhsa pakha cha hneirôna, sôh nah piah nata zachhihna zy pie ta, a aoh khopa maih a nie thei leipa y vei. Châhrasala a aoh khopazy a nie awpa cha Khazohpa ta pasaih leipa ta, chihropa ta tlao a nie haw. Cha chhao cha hraoleipa châ ta, hmo pha lei ngaitapa a châ.

Chyhsa ta saw za kha hneipa ta kô hluhpi hroh sala, kô khazie leichâ a hro pasipa chhao ta, a hro nohzy cha a khozie hawhta hmâh thei leipa sala, a pha thipa chhao ta pabupa a châ leipa khiahta cha, cha hawhpa chyhsa hlâta cha athipa ta a pihpa a pha via ei tah.
Cha hawsaih cha hraoleipa ta vaw pih ta, zohna lâ sie heih ta, zohna ta a moh a khu haw.
Cha dei châ vei, noh khaihpa hmô leipa ta, khâpa hmah pahno hra vei. Chatahrasala kô hluhpi a hrohpa hlâna khata apahâna a hmô pha via.
Kô sâh lie no hmah hroh hra sala, hmo phapa a hmô tlôh vei khiahta cha, athipa ta a pihpa hlâta a pha viana y vei. Ama pano ta su miakha a pangaipa ama châ.
Chyhsapa hriapasana zydua cha a aoh châta châ ta, châhrasala a aoh lôhrâ tlô beih vei.
Chyhsa sopa cha ahrupa hlâta khâpa phahnai viana ma a hnei? Dyhchhiepa chhao mohropazy hmiakô liata yzie a thai kawpa vâta, khâpa athôhna ma a hmô tly?
Hnei thei leipa hmo khopa vâta palôh a zawvaw ngâpa hlâta cha, mo ta hmôpa hneipa rakha liata palôhtlâh a paopa a pha via. Cha chhao cha hraoleipa châ ta, thlih a chadaipa dei a châ.
Hmo a vaw ypa maih rao chhielie hapa châ ta, chyhsapa chhichâna chhao pahno chiehpa a châ. Chavâta chyhsapa ta ano hlâta thatlô viapa bie cha ei thei vei.
Bie a hluh via nahta, hraoleipa hluh via ta, chyhsapa châta khâpa athôhna ma a hnei?

Tihu buakha a vaw luah ta a lei heihpa hawhta, hro chhôh noh chyhta hnei ta, nohpahlipa hawhta a khôpa chyhsapa châta a pha chai awpa ahy ma a pahno tly? Ahy ma chyhsapa hnohta a thi tawhta noh ry liata hmo a vaw y awpa a chho thei aw tly?
Sathaw sôhpa hlâta moh phana pha via ta, Pi noh hlâta thi noh a pha via.
Kyhchhi a hlaopa hlâta, Mâchhiesana o lâ vawpa a pha via; Cha cha chyhsa zydua chhâna noh châ ta, Ahrohpazy ta ama palôh liata ama khô awpa a châpa vâta.
Hmiaphao pachârôhna ta palôh lyna a taopa vâta, Pachârôhpa cha pahneipa hlâta a pha via.
Asopa palôh cha mâchhiesana o liata y ta, Ahrupa palôh deikua cha alyna o liata a y.
Ahrupazy hla sapa nathliepa hlâta cha, Asopazy chhoreina nathliepa a pha via.
Ahrupazy pahneina pyu cha, Beih ry liata ahloh buh kâpa pyu nata â lyu. Cha chhao cha hraoleipa deita a châ.
Tlybaina ta asopa chhao pahrusa ta, Panaopapana ta palôh a pamoleisa tyh.
Hmo chhâna cha â thaona hlâta pha via ta, Palôh maoh oh theina cha palôh laipa hlâta a pha via.
Hiehâhna cha ahrupazy palôh liata riehmo a paryhpa châ ta, Chavâta hiehâh awpa ta na palôh a para khah y.
“Khazia ma tahmâhlâ daihti hlâta, Hlâno daihti kha a pha via thlâh ha tly?” tah khah y. He na hiahrina he sona tawhta a puapa châ vei.
Ryu cha sona nata â pakaoh khiahta cha, Hmo phapa châ ta; Noh a hmôtuhpazy châta chhao, Athôhna a châ.
Sôh ta a pabohsapa hawhta, Sona chhao abohna châ ta; Sona a hneipa ta a hrona a pabohsapa he, Pahnona phahnaina a châ.
Khazohpa hmotaozie he pachâ tua u, A pako hapa cha ahy ma a patlâsa thei khao aw?
Phana noh liata a ly la, chhiena no liata he he pachâ mah y: Phana chhao, chhiena chhao, Khazohpa taopa a châpa vâta, chyhsapa ta a hmialâ daihti liata hmo a vaw y awpa khâpa hmah pahno vei.
Tihu buakha a vaw lâ ta, a lei heihpa hawhta, daihti chyuta ei hro chhôh heta hmo toti ei hmô haw. Mosiapa ta a siana liata a leidia nota, moleipa ta a paraona chôta a hro a pasi thlâh haw.
Sia tupa ta y leipa la, so tupa ta y hra khah y. Khazia nâmasasyh ta nâ pahleipadia aw?
Molei tupa ta y leipa la, hru hra khah y. Khazia na chhâ a palo leipa ta na thi aw?
He he nâ patu awpa a pha, pathlie cheita khah y. Khazohpa a chituhpa cha, cha hawhta tah tu pâpa hnei lei awpa ta â vaih aw.
Khihpi liata ryureituhpa pahrawh hlâta, Chyhsa sopa cha sona vâta a tha a tlô via.
Alei chô liana heta chyhsa siapa, A molei beih leipa pakha hmah y veih ei.
Chyhsa bie reipa maih nathlie khoh hlei khah y, Chataleipatala châ chakaotuhpa ta Chhie a cha sapa na thei pathlei aw na.
Nâma tlai chhao ta mohropazy chô liata Ei hluhpi chhie na vaw sapa na palôh ta a pahnopa kha.
He hmo zydua he sona ta ei pasia khai haw. “Ei so kaw bâ aw,” tah na ta, châhrasala a hniasia vei.
Sona cha lâhlapi liata y ta, â pathu ngaitapa liata a ypa a châ. Ahy ma a hmô thei aw?
Sona patuapalua ta, tlua ta, hmo yziezy pahno awpa ta ei palôh pahei na ta, moleina he hruna a châzie nata hrungâ kathluhna kyhzy pahno awpa ta ei palôh pahei hra na ta.

Chatanachata thina hlâta a kha viapa ei hmô haw: Cha cha khoheih palôh nata sao palôh a phaohpa chanô châ ta, a ku keihrai ta a hmâhpa chanô a châ. Khazohpa a palysapa cha, cha chanô tawhta a boh aw ta, moleipa deikua cha a patu aw.
Moh teh u, hmo yzie pahno awpa ta, hmo miakha tawhta miakha ei tlua laih nota ei hmôpa cha he he a châ, biechhotuhpa ta a tah.
Cha cha ei hro ta khâ a tluapa, châhrasala ei hmô thei leipa a châ. Chapaw sâh kha hry liata pakha hmô na ta, chanôzy hry tawhta deikua, pakha hmah hmô va na.
He he ei hmô chhôhpa cha a châ: Khazohpa ta chyhsapa he chyhsa dopa châ awpa ta tao ta, châhrasala hmo chhiepa to ama patuapalua tyh.
Ahy ma asopa lyu ta, Ahy ma bieso yzie a pahno? Chyhsapa cha a sona ta a hmia pakhaihsa ta, A hmiaphao nâ a chhih leina chhao a panano.
Abei cha Khazohpa bietai a daopa a châpa vâta, a biepiepa zyh mah y.
Abei hmiakô tawhta pua awpa ta a para leipa la, a hmiakô liata hmo chhiepa a duakhei khah y, ano khozie hawhta hmo a taopa châ tlôh ta.
Abei bie a bei chai ta, ahy ma a hnohta, “Khâpa ma na tao?” a tah thei aw?
Biepiepa a zyhpa cha pasa tao aw vei. Palôh sopa cha a daihti pahno thai ta, taozie dopa chhao a pahno.
Chyhsapa cha a phaohri ta vi hra sala, hmo to a daihti hnei ta, a taozie a hnei khai.
Hmo a vaw y awpa a pahno chhieliepa y veih ei. Chavâta hmo a vaw y awpa kyh chyhsapa hnohta ahy ma a chho thei aw?

Ahy hmahta husona patu theina hmotaotheina hnei leipa ei ta, thina noh chô liata bie a hnei theipa y hra veih ei. Adyuhna a y ngâ nota cha, ahy hmahta a pheisaih rai pahâsa thaipa a châ leipa hawhta, moleina ta moleina a taotuhpazy cha papua aw vei.
Noh ry liata hmo taopa zydua saipa ta ei palôh hmâh na ta, he he ei hmôpa cha a châ: chyhsapa ta chyhsa hropa chô liata biehneina hmâh ta, châhrasala cha cha ano pasa nawpa tlao a châ tyh.

Chatawhcha a pha kawpa ta moleipa ama pabupa hmô na ta. He moleipazy he moleina hmo taona chôta su pathaihpa liata a ngia heih pua heih a tahpa nata khihpi liata reithai a hlaopazy ama châ. Cha chhao cha hraoleipa deita a châ.
Moleina hmo a taopazy cha thlai ta hriepa ama châ leipa vâta, chyhsa sawzy palôh cha moleina kyh liata a riah a pha tlamaw tyh.
Chyhsa moleipa cha ei za kha a molei hapa chhao ta, hroh thlâh ha chy hra sala, Khazohpa a chituhpazy ta Khazohpa ama chipa cha a pha pyly tahpa ei pahno.
Moleipa châta deikua cha a hro chypa chhao ta pha hlei aw vei. Khazohpa china a hnei leipa vâta, nohpahlipa hawh deita châ ta, a hro pareih hmeiseih aw vei.
Alei chô liata hmo a ypa hraoleipa y ta. Mosiapazy ta moleipazy hmotaopa ty phaoh ei ta, moleipazy ta mosiapazy hmotaopa byhnâ ama to. Cha chhao cha hraoleipa deita a châ tahpa ei pahno.

Chavâta chyhsapa châta hro lyna hnei awpa ei khokhei. Noh ry liana heta niepa ta doh ta, a lypa ta y awpa hlâta a pha viapa chyhsapa châta y vei. Chatanachata noh ry liata Khazohpa ta a piepa a hro chhôh noh zydua liata, alyna chôta a hriapasa lymâ thei aw.
Sona kyh pahno awpa nata alei chô liata chyhsazy hmotaopa pahno awpa ta, chhô nah zâ ta mokuh saihpa ta ei pachâna hmâh na ta.

Khazohpa raihria zydua moh na ta, noh ry liata hmo a ypa zydua he chyhsapa ta pahno khai thei vei tahpa ei pahno haw. Chyhsapa ta thata hriapasapa ta tlua hra sala, hmô papua khai beih aw vei. Chyhsa sopa chhao ta, a pahnopa hawhta a reih hra sala, hmô papua khai thei beih aw vei.

He kyh zydua he a chu pasiapa ta thata pachâ na ta. Mosiapa nata asopa hmotaopazy cha Khazohpa ku liata a ypa a châ tahpa ei pahno haw. Kyhpachâna kyh tlyma, ahaona kyh tlyma, chyhsapa ta pahno chhielie vei. A hmialâ daihti liata hmo a vaw y awpa sai a châ.

Chyhsa zydua chô liata hmo a vaw tlô awpa â lyu khai. Mosiapa nata moleipa, chyhsa phapa nata chyhsa chhiepa, chyhsa pathaihpa nata chyhsa pathaih leipa nata atheihna a hlâpa nata a hlâ leipa zy chô liata â lyupa ta hmo a vaw tlô tyh. Chyhsa phapa chô liata hmo a tlôpa hawhta, moleipa chô liata tlô ta, bie â taihpa chô liata tlôpa hawhta, bie â taih leipa chô liata chhao a tlô hra.

Noh ry liata hmo taopa to liata hmo chhiepa a ypa cha he he a cha: chyhsa zydua ama tovyuh awpa â lyu khaipa hih. Chyhsa sawzy cha ama hro chhôh ta ama palôh liata moleina nata hruna ta bie ta, cha hnôhlâ ta athipazy yna lâ ama sie tyh.
Ahrohpazy hnohta a pahlao chypa châta deikua cha hnabeiseihna a y. I hrohpa cha chakeibarôhneipa thipa hlâta a phahnai via.
Ahrohpazy cha ama thi awpa a pahno ei ta, athipazy deikua cha khâpa hmah pahno khao veih ei. Chavâta lymâ ama dao awpa y khao leipa ta, ama moh chhao mypa ta a y.
Ama kyhpachâna, amâ haona nata ama hiatliana zy lei khai ha ta, noh ry liata hmo taopazy liata tovyuh rai hnei khao veih ei.
Khazohpa ta na hmo taopazy a pyh ha ta, chavâta sie la, a lypa ta na viahchhâ nie la, palôh tlâhpa ta na kresawhti doh mah y.
Na chysia khâ dieh sala, na luh liata sathaw hi beih khah sy.

Tihu buakha a vaw lâ ta a lei heihpa hawhta, Khazohpa ta noh ry liata noh chyhta a cha piepa liana heta, na kyhpachâpa na lapinô hnohta na hro a lypa ta hmâh mah y. Cha cha na hro chhôh ta na tovyuh châ ta, noh ry liata na hriapasana lymâ a châ.
Na ku ta hria awpa a hmôpa maih cha, na theina zydua papuapa ta hria mah y. Na pangai haipa Athihkhih liata cha, rai tlyma, pachâna tlyma, pahnona tlyma, sona tlyma y khao aw vei.

Noh ry liata ei hmô heihpa cha he he a châ: Arâpasuana liata a râ theipa ta pahniena to hlei leipa ta, Adyuhna liata chhao thatlôpa ta pahniena to hlei vei; Asopa ta nie a phahla ta, Novâhpa hneirôh hlei leipa ta, Athaipa chhao khokheina to hlei vei. Chyhsa to ta daihti nata ryhpaohna ama hnei chyu.

Châhrasala chyhsapa ta ano daihti awpa pahno vei. Sao chichhihpa liata ngazy amâ aopa hawhta nata khoheih liata pavawzy amâ aopa hawhta, daihti chhiepa eikhapi ta a vaw tlô thlu ti ei ta, chyhsa sawzy cha, cha liata amâ ao tyh.
Sona pakhopâna chhao noh ry liata hmô na ta, rônah ngaitapa ei palyusa.
Chyhsa chyhta pahrâna khihpi chypa miakha y ta. Bei rônahpa ta vaw siehnaopa ta, a khihpi cha dôh ta. A thokhyzy pacho awpa ta thata a hriapasa.
Cha khihpi liata chyhsa sopa dyhchhiepa pakha y ta, a sona ta cha khihpi cha a pachha haw. Châhrasala cha dyhchhiepa cha a thei tlâ khao veih ei.
Chyhsa sipasapa sona cha mohnaopa ta, a biezy nathlie vei hra ei sala, kei la, “Thatlôna hlâta sona a pha via,” ei tah pyly.
Ahrupazy hry liata ao paro ngaitapa ta ryureituhpa awhpa hlâta cha, asopa ta a notata bie a reipa nathlie a pha via.
Sona cha adyuhna chariah chhaichhizy hlâta pha via ta, châhrasala moleipa pakha ta hmo phapa hluhpi a parao tyh.
Mathyu thipa thu roh ta ropahâhpa roh a pahleipa hawhta, Bâhta hruna ta sona nata zachhihna a pahlei thei.
Asopa palôh cha chachâh lâ a heih ta, Ahrupa palôh deikua cha chavei lâ â heih tyh.
Ahrupa cha lâpi liata a sie no taihta sona a phahla ta, Ahrupa a châzie chyhsa to hnohta a phuah laih.
Ryureituhpa ta na chô liata a hie a hâh khiahta cha, Na yna su puasai khah y; Hiehâhna a pai tita cha, Taopasina lai ngaitapa chhao a ngiahthaipa a châ tyh.
Noh ry liata hmo chhiepa miakha hmô na ta, ryureituhpa tao chheipa lai ngaitapa a châ:
Ahrupazy cha su sâhpazy liata sopa châ ei ta, hneirôhpazy su nawhpa liata amâ tyupa ei hmô.
Arâ chô liata seizy hmô na ta, seizy hawhta alei liata abeizy ama siepa ei hmô.
Khaohtlô a chaopa cha a khaohtlô chaopa liata tla aw ta, Dôhna a chatôhpa chhao parih ta a pachu aw.
Alô chaotuhpa cha, Alô ta hmah paphao ta; Tho patlawtuhpa chhao, Thozy ta a hrona ama pahlei tyh.
Thua chhaichhi tiah leipa sala, Chyhsa ta a chata vei khiahta cha, Tha hmâ via awpa byuh ta; Sona deikua cha, Hlaotlohna a pietuhpa a châ.
Parih ta pamaohpa a châ hlâta, A pamaohtuhpa a pachu ha khiahta cha, Pari pamaohtuhpa châta phahnaina y vei.
Asopa cha a pakah biezy ta ngiachhiena pahlaosa ta, Ahrupa hmao deikua cha ano a palâtuhpa a châ.
A pakah tawhta bie a puapata nahta, Hruna bie sai pua tyh ta; A bie chhâna lâ cha, Pei a hriapa hrungâna bie a châ tyh.
Hmialâ daihti a pahnopa y leipa ei ta, Thi hnôhlâ ta hmo a y awpa a reih theipa ama y leipa chhao ta, Ahrupa cha bie hluhpi reih ta, a reih via lymâ.
Ahrupa cha a hriapasana ta a tha pachhâ ta, Khihpi lâpi chhao pahno khao vei.
Hy râh, na bei châta sei hnei chi ta, Na beimachâzy my ta kyh a chhi tyhpa râh y, Na hu a po na!
Hy râh, na bei châta bei pathla hnei chi ta, Na beimachâzy a daihti liata kyh a chhi tyhpa y, Na nohlao na! Kyhchhina liata pari awpa ta doh leipa ei ta, Thatlôna châta ama doh tyh.
Thathina vâta vâphuh tla ta, Diathlâna vâta o a zu.
Pahnei awpa ta kyhchhi taopa châ ta, Kresawhti ta hro palysa ta, Tâkâ cha khopa to hneina a châ.

Abei cha chhiesapa leipa la, Na palôhrupa liata chhao chhiesapa leipa la, Na rakhô liata hneirôhpa chhiesapa hra khah y. Vâ pavawzy ta na ao a zawkhei aw ei ta, Mathlaw a hneipa hmohrohneipazy ta ama chho pathlei aw na.
Ti chô liata na viahchhâ thy la, Noh hluhpi tawhta na hmô heih aw.
Alei chô liata chhiena a vaw tlô thei awpa na pahno leipa vâta, Chyhsa pasari hnohta tovyuh pie la, Pacharie hnohta chhao pie mah y.
Meihdo cha vâsua ta a bie khiahta cha, Alei chô liata a za patlai tyh. Tho cha chho lâ tlyma, maw lâ tlyma a pao khiahta cha, A paona su liata â zawh tyh.
Thlih sai a mohpa ta chi cheih leipa aw ta, Meihdo sai a saipa ta sâh hria aw vei.
Ziza lâpi pahno leipa chi ta, nô chhi chhôh liata hawsaih rupa a vaw y laihnazie na pahno leipa hawhta, ato zydua a taotuhpa Khazohpa hmo taozie zy chhao pahno va chi.
My ta chi tu la, zâlâ chhao na ku pako thlâh ha khah y. Kheihawhpa ma a pyuh aw, he he ma, hao hao ma, a miano ta ama pha aw ma, tahpa zy pahno va chi.
Khaihna cha pha ta, noh hmôpa cha mokhaoh châta mo a pahâh ngaita.
Chavâta chyhsa ta kô hluhpi a hro khiahta cha, cha zydua liata a ly mawh sy. Anodeikua cha zohna nohzy chhao a hluh kaw aw tahpa a thei mawh sy. Hmo a vaw tlôpa zydua he hraoleipa sai na a vaw châ.

Hy satlia, na thyutliana liata a ly mah y. Na palôh ta na thyutlia daihti liata cha palysa mawh sy. Na palôh khopa zi la, mo pha na tahpa zi mah y. Anodeikua cha cha zydua vâna chata Khazohpa ta a cha pachia aw tahpa pahno mah y.
Pachârôhna na palôh tawhta pahlei la, hmo chhiepa na pôhpa tawhta hnei ha mah y. Thyutlia daihti nata locho no chhao he hrao­leipa deita a châ.
Na thyutliana nohzy liata, châ Taotuhpa a thei thlâh ha mah y. Chhiena nohzy a vaw tlô hlâta nata “Alyna rai hnei va na,” na tahna kôzy â vaw hnia hlâta;
noh nata khaihna nata thlâpâ nata awhsi zy a zoh hlâta nata vâsua khai tawhta meihdozy a kua heih hlâta;
o vaituhpazy a chalyupa ta, thatlôpazy ama ky a pakopa ta, ama chyh tupa vâta sâh chariehtuhpazy a chalihpa ta, opy tawhta a saituhpazy ama mo a zoh hlâta;
khiliah ochhizy khawpa ta, sâh chariehpa pyu diapa ta, pavaw sâpa pyu vâta chyhsa thyupa ta, hlasathaipa laihsazy hla pyu a diah hlâta;

su sâhpa chipa ta, lâpi liata chichhih­pazy ypa ta, kuasâh tho a paw pawhpa ta, khawsu dusawta ta siepa ta, a chhâzaw o lâ â di bâ awpa vâta chyhsapa ta khopa hnei khao leipa ta a y hlâta, mâchhiesatuhpazy khiliah liata amâ hlaihlâ hlâta;
tâkâ ri a chie hlâta, ngôh biebuh a kei hlâta, tihnawh liata alei beih pakeipa a châ hlâta, tikhaoh liata tiaki a kei hlâta;
dohlei a yna tyhpa alei lâ a kua heih hlâta nata thlahpa a pietuhpa Khazohpa lâ a kua heih hlâta, châ Taotuhpa cha khâ a thei mah y.
Hraoleipazy hraoleipa, ato zydua he hraoleipa sai a vaw châ, Biechhotuhpa ta a tah.
Biechhotuhpa cha sona a hneipa dei châ leipa ta, chyhsazy hnohta pahnona pachu ta, bieso hluhpi pachâ ta, a chu ta, a pha ngaitapa ta a paryhpakhy.
Biechhotuhpa cha bie khochhihpazy hmô awpa ta tlua ta, biehmeiseihpazy cha â do ngaitapa ta a rohtuhpa a châ.
Chyhsa sopa biezy cha chôchahrei pazaopa hawhta châ ta, bieso lapakhypazy cha thuakhai ta â i ngaitapa ta khaipâ hapa hawhta a châ. Chazy cha Mietaku Vaituhpa pakha ta a piepazy a châ khai.
Ei sawchapawpa y, hezy dei châ leipa ta, hezy khô lâta hmozy liata chhao a chado mah y. Châbu hluhpi taopa ta chhâna hnei leipa ta, a chu hluhpa chhao sapa rietheina a lapa tlâ a châ.
Bie zydua reipa nata theipa a châ khai tawhta, cha bie zydua sypahmaohna cha he he a châ: Khazohpa chi la, a biepiepazy a pyh mah y. Cha cha chyhsa to tao awpa ama maophaohna a châ.
Khazohpa ta hmo taopa zydua, a phapa chhao, a chhiepa chhao, pachia khai aw ta, arulâta taopa zydua chhao a pachia khai aw.
He he hlazy hry liata hla pha chaipa, Sawlawmaw hlazy a châ.
Ei lôhdupaw ta na sy sala, A hmao ta na sy mawh sy! Na kyhpachâna cha kresawhti hlâta pha via ta,
Na sathawzy chhao a roh a pahâh ngaita. Na moh cha sathaw ropahâhpa patlaipa hawhta châ ta, Chavâta laihsazy ta ama cha khoh ngaita.

Na ku ta nâ kei la, A râ ei suh u. Abei ta a chhôhpadâhpazy lâ einâ ngiakhei haw. Nâ liata a lypa ta eima thapha aw ta, Na kyhpachâna cha kresawhti hlâta eima cheihchalo via aw; Ama cha khoh kaw saipa he â vaw do tlai na.
Hy Zerusale zuahzy saih u, Vyh kaw hraw sah la, Kho ei chhih kaw; Kedâ poh ozy lyu na ta, Sawlawmaw pohraipazy ei lyu.

Ei vyh kawpa vâta na moh ngâ kaw khuh vy, Noh ta eina vawhpa vâta a châ hih. Ei nô sawchapawzy ta ei chô liata ama hiehâh ta, Kre sadô vaituhpa ta na tao ei ta, Chavâta keima kre sadô hmâchhâh ei vaih thei khao vei hih!

Nâ ei palôh ta a khopaw y, na chho teh, Khataih liata ma na mietaku zaw pasa chi ta, Khataih liata ma nohchhô ta na pabyusa tyh ei? Khazia ma pohluh a khupa chanô hawhta, Na viasazy mietaku zaw kiah liata ei y aw?
Hy chanôzy hry liata chhithai chainô y, Na pahno vei khiahta la, Mietaku zaw hniehnôh vaw chathôh laih la, Mietaku vaituhpazy poh ozy kiah liata, Na mietaw chanôpazy vaw pasa mah y.
Hy ei lôhdunô, ei cha pakhopâ tyh, Phiraoh talailih arâ chanôpa nahta.
Lôsôhpa ta a tobipa na ôhzy kho a chhih ngaita ei ta, Ngôh pachhih rizy a aopa na rao chhao kho â chhih ngaita.
Ngôh pachhih cha taopa aw pi ta, Tâkâ pataih pâpa pachhih eima cha taopa aw.
A rakhô liata abei â tyu nota, Ei spinâ sathaw ropahâhpa ta a charao.
Ei lôhdupaw cha kei châta, Ei sâhpizy likawh liata a hniehpa deiryh byh a châ.
Ei lôhdupaw cha kei châta, Enkedi kre sadô liata henâ pawpi sao hawhta a châ.
Nâ ngia kaw dia, ei lôhdunô, Âh, nâ vaw ngia tlai na; Na mokhaohzy cha vachhuhzy a lyu.
Âh, nâ ngia tlai na, ei lôhdupaw, Kho nâ vaw paoh tlai na. Eima rakhô hroh sili ta,
Eima pâkôzy cha sidy thozy châ ei ta, Eima seihâhzy chhao meisah thozy a châ.
Saraw rôspaw châ na ta, Saikao lilipaw ei châ.
Ahlohzy hry liata lilipaw hawhta, Ei lôhdunô chhao laihsazy hry liata â ngia patlua.
Râhmâhpa thozy hry liata epuh kô hawhta, Ei lôhdupaw chhao satliazy hry liata â lâ patlua. Palôhtlâh ngaitapa ta a nohdi ry liata a tyuh na ta, Ei pakah liata a thei a thlôh ngaita.
Kyhchhina o lâ nâ chhi ta, Ei chô liata kyhpachâna poh eina zawhpa.
Kre chawhpa viahchhâ ta tha na patlô la, Epuh ta tha na pathyu mah y; Na vâ cha iapa ta ei pasa hih.
A ku chavei lâta bâh lô na pahua ta, A ku chachâh lâta einâ pyhpahly.
Hy Zerusale zuahzy saih u, Lyurâh sakhih nata sasu moh ta, Bie ei cha pataihsa ei; Ano tlai ta a khoh hlâlei la, Kyhpachâna cha a tha pathyu leipa u la, Pahra hra khuh vy.
Cha cha ei lôhdupaw ao a châ chu! Moh teh u, â vy hai, Tlâhpizy chô liata a vaw zaw laih ta, Tlâhthlôhzy chô liata châki a vaw zoh laih.
Ei lôhdupaw cha sakhih lyu ta, Zuneih tôh dawpa a lyu. Moh teh u, eima pâhchhô a pahlipa ta a duah ta, Opyzy tawhta vaw moh ta, Samokaw tawhta a vaw sai ngâ kaw huh.
Ei lôhdupaw ta bie reih ta, ei hnohta, “Ei kyhpachâpa, kei châta chhithai chainô, Thyu la, vaw kiah bâ mah y.
Moh teh, chasipaw chha ha ta, Saopi chhao chhâ ta a khô ha hih.
Alei liata pawpizy a vaw lâ ei ta, Pavaw to sâ daihti vaw tlô ta, Vachhuh tutarunô ao zy chhao eima thei haw.
Theiku theizy hmoh ei ta, Kre zôhzy vaw pawh ei ta, Ama ropahâhpazy ama pathlisa ngâ kaw bâ hih. Ei kyhpachâ, kei châta chhithai chainô, Thyu la, vaw kiah bâ mah y,” eina tah.
Hy ei vachhuh, lôpanô keipazy liata a nyu chi ta, Lôkâhpa khuazy liata a y tyhpa y, Na hmia na pahmô la, Na ao na patheisa mah y; Na ao thlôh ta, Na hmia kho â chhih kaw dia!
Eima kre sadôzy ama paw locho daihti châ ha ta, Kre sadôzy a paraotuhpa changiezy miah patupa la, Changie tawzy miah patupa mah y.
Ei lôhdupaw cha kei eih châ ta, Kei chhao ano eih ei châ; Ei lôhdupaw cha lilipawzy hry liata A mietaku zawzy a patlaihsa tyh.
Noh vaw nai ta, Nohawh tlâh a khô hlâlei cha, Ei lôhdupaw y, kei lâ a vaw heih la, Sakhih hawhta châ la, Betheri tlâhpizy liata zuneih tôh dawpa lyu mah y.
Zâ ta khôpheih chô tawhta rohpadypa ta, Lôh rie ei ngiabâh chaipaw cha tlua na ta, Tlua na ta, châhrasala hmô va na.
Thyu aw na ta khihpi chahryhpa ta, Lâlaizy nata tlyliahzy chahryh laih aw na ta, Lôh rie ei ngiabâh chaipaw cha ei tlua laih aw. Tlua laih na ta, châhrasala hmô va na.
Khihpi vaituhpazy ta Khihpi ama chahlô nota na hmô ei ta. “Lôh rie ei ngiabâh chaipaw nama hmô ma?” tah ei na ta.
Âmo ei khôpa nah ei ta, Lôh rie ei ngiabâh chaipaw cha hmô na ta; Ei hmôpa nahta patu na ta, Ei nô o lâ ei chhi hlâlei cha, Nâ phaohtuhpa chhôhpadâhpa lâ ei chhi hlâlei cha, Pathlie khao va na.
Hy Zerusale zuahzy saih u, Lyurâh sakhih nata sasu moh ta, Bie ei cha pataihsa ei; Ano tlai ta a khoh hlâlei la, Kyhpachâna cha a tha pathyu leipa u la, Pahra hra khuh vy.
Deiryh nata sathaw ropahâhpa a thu ta, Sôhdaoh liata ropahâhpa paohzy a hniapa ta, Meikhuh a duahpazy hawhta, Râhchawhpa tawhta â vypa hao ahy ma a châ tly?
Moh tua u, Sawlawmaw amâ syna dyuchhai a châ huh! Pasaipha sycharu ta chadô ei ta, Izarei pasaiphazy ta ama chadô.
Ama zydua ta zaozi a vao ei ta, Riah tu a thaipa sai ama châ. Ama byhpi liata zaozi a vao chyu ei ta, Zâ chariah chichhihpazy amâ dyuh.
Bei Sawlawmaw cha Lebanaw tho hmâpa ta, Asyna dyuchhai ano châta a tao ta.
A tôhzy tâkâ ta tao ta, Â hniehna ngôh châ ta, Â tyuna cha poh nohsaihpa a châ. A chhôh cha Zerusale zuahzy ta Kyhpachâna ta ama tobi.
Hy Zaio zuahzy saih u, pua u la, Bei Sawlawmaw hao moh tua u. A lapi hnei noh châta a nô ta lakho a pakhopa a kho ta, A palôh thapha noh ta â kho awpa lakho a khopa ta â vy huh.
Âh, nâ ngia tlai na, ei lôhdunô, Na vaw chhithai tlai na! Nâ khuna poh ry liata na mozy vachhuh lyu ta, Na sâ chhao Kilia tlâhzy tawhta a zâ chôpa mie hrizy a lyu.
Na hâhzy cha ti pasi khai tawhta a vaw puapa, Hmi ngyu duapa mietaku panô zawzy lyu ta, Ama zydua ta maphieh taw pataw chyu ei ta, Ama taw ama pahlei tlâ leipa hawhta a châ.
Na hmaozy pala saihlawpa lyu ta, Na pakah chhao kho â chhih ngaita. Nâ khuna poh ry liata na ôkhaihzy cha, Pawmikarânâ patlawpazy a lyu.
Na rao cha alôzy pachopa ta paduapa Dâvi o sâhpa lyu ta; Cha liata vyhphao sâh kha a bangieh ta, Pasaiphazy vyhphao sai a bangieh.
Na sâhpi mianozy cha sakhih taw pô no lyu ei ta, Lilipawzy hry liata a tlaihpa Sakhih taw maphieh tlai ama lyu.
Noh vaw nai ta, Nohawh tlâh a khô hlâlei cha, Deiryh tlâhpi lâ a chhei aw na ta, Ropahâhpa tlâhthlôh lâ ei chhei aw.
Nâ ngia paki tlai na, ei lôhdunô, Sei nawpa rai hnei va chi.

Hy keima myuh thieh, ei hnohta Lebanaw tawhta za sie la, Ei hnohta Lebanaw tawhta za sie ha mah y. Amânâ laki tawhta vaw pua la, Seni nata Hâmaw laki tawhta vaw pua mah y. Chakeibarôhneipa lôpuzy tawhta vaw pua la, Keichhoh tlâhpi tawhta vaw pua mah y.
Hy ei sietanô, keima myuh thieh, Na iah ta ei chhôhso na zai ta, Ei kha eina vaw mopa chi ta, Na pachhih liata lôsôhpa miakha ta, Ei chhôhso a pahnie haw.
Hy ei sietanô, keima myuh thieh, Na kyhpachâna khoiah a vaw hnei rimâ cha! Na kyhpachâna kresawhti hlâta pahâh via syulyu ta, Na sathaw ropahâhpa chhao, Ropahâhpa zydua hlâta a pahâh via.
Hy keima myuh thieh, Na hmao tawhta pawti a thlaoh ta, Na paleih ry liata kheihti nata sâhpiti a y; Na chysia roh cha Lebanaw roh a lyu.
Ei sietanô cha sadô khawpa châ ta, Ei myuh thieh cha tihnawh chhie pachhôpa, Tikhaoh pamaipa a châ.
Na chiahzy cha pawmikarânâ sadô châ ta, Thei pha chaipazy pathei ta, Henâ nata spinâ zy puana sadô a châ.
Spinâ nata iahsamai zy y ta, Basuh ropahâhpa nata lôiasoh zy a y. Ropahâhpa tho to y ta, Deiryh nata lilipaw chhao a y; Ropahâhpa chi to yna sadô a châ.
Tihnawh palina sadô châ ta, Hrona tikhaoh chhao y ta, Lebanaw tawhta vahtiezy lona sadô a châ.

Hy maw thlih, a hra la, Hy chho thlih, a vy mah y! Ei sadô liata vaw pathli u la, A ropahâhpazy charao zaolao mawh sy. Ei lôhdupaw cha a sadô liata a vaw ngia sala, A thei pahâh chaipazy vaw nie mawh sy.

Ei sadô, ei sietanô, ei myuh lâ cha a ngia na ta, Ei deiryh nata ropahâhpa lapakhypa ta, Ei kheihti nata ei kheihthlawh nie na ta, Ei sâhpiti nata ei kresawhti cha ei doh. Hy viasazy, niepa ta, doh u la, Kyhpachâna paripa ta y muh vy!

A zia taraw na ta, Ei palôh deikua â hra thlâh haw. Nathlie tua u! Ei lôhdupaw ta ochhi vaw chakhyh ta, “Hy ei sietanô, ei khochainô, Ei vachhuh, kei châta sia pakinô, Ochhi na vaw pahy teh. Diati ta ei luh padâ ta, Zâ ameih ta ei sâphiehpa a padâ khai ha hih,” tah ta.
Ei chysia pahluh ha na ta, Kheihta ma thlai ei tobi heih thei aw? Ei phei a si ha na ta, Khazia ei papua heih aw?
Ei lôhdupaw cha opy liata a ku vaw chahraoh ta, Ei chhôhso palôh eina hria ngaita.
Ei lôhdupaw ochhi pahypa awpa ta thyu na ta, Ochhi lâzy chô liata ei kuzy tawhta deiryh a thlaoh ta, Ei kuparozy tawhta deiryh tizy â thlaoh ngâ kaw.

Ei lôhdupaw cha ochhi pahypa na ta, Châhrasala ei lôhdupaw cha a lie ta, Sihnôh a kua syulyu haw. A bie reipa ta ei palôh pakeichheih ta, Tlua na ta, châhrasala hmô khao va na; Aw na ta, châhrasala na chhy khao vei.
Khihpi vaituhpazy ta khihpi ama chahlôna liata na hmô ei ta, Na tupa ta, hmah na paphao ei ta; Thokhy vaituhpazy ta ei khuna poh eina hlaipa ei.
Hy Zerusale zuahzy saih u, Bie ei cha pataihsa ei; Ei lôhdupaw kha nama hmô khiahta cha, Vâiana vâta na a pasa tahpa na vaw chhopa muh vy.
Hy chanôzy hry liata chhithai chainô y, Khâpa liata ma na lôhdupaw cha mohropazy hlâta a pha via tly? Khâpa liata ma na lôhdupaw cha mohropazy hlâta pha via ta, Cha hawhta bie miah na pataihsa tly?
Ei lôhdupaw cha a mo ngyuh ta, A sapati chhao pha kaw ta; Thy kha hry liata â lâ patlua.
A luh cha ngôh sua chaipa châ ta, A sâphiehpazy a pako ta, Raawh vyhpa hawhta a vyh pathlie.
A mokhaohzy cha vahtie kao liata vachhuhzy lyu ta, Sâhpiti ta a ngai a si ta, Tipo kiah liata â choh thlâh hapa vachhuhzy a lyu.
A ôkhaihzy cha ropahâhpa rakhôzy lyu ta, Sibie roh thlôhpa tlâh byuhpazy a lyu. A hmaozy cha lilipawzy lyu ei ta, Deiryh ti a thlaoh ngâpa hmaozy a châ.
A kuzy cha ngôh chôchahreizy lyu ei ta, Beri lôsôhpa pataohpa ngôh chôchareizy tlai ama lyu. A pôhpa cha sianaoh patliepa lyu ta, Saphai lôsôhpazy ta tobipa sianaoh tlai a lyu.
A pheizy cha alabastâ otôhzy lyu ei ta, Ngôh ta taopa patyuna chô liata paduapa, Alabastâ otôhzy tlai ama lyu. A pizie cha Lebanaw lyu ta, Sidy tho pha chaipa a lyu.
Ano cha a reikah a thlôh chaipa châ ta, Kho a pao chaipa a châ. Hy Zerusale zuahzy saih u, Ei lôhdupaw cha ano cha châ ta, Ei viasapa cha ano cha na a châ.
Hy chanôzy hry liata chhithai chainô, Na lôhdupaw cha khataih lâ a sie haw? Na lôhdupaw cha khataih lâ ma sihnôh a kua haw? Eima cha vaw tluakhei aw hih.
Ei lôhdupaw cha a sadô lâ sie ta, Ropahâhpa rakhôzy yna lâ a sie haw. A sadô liata a mietaku zaw patlaihsa awpa ta sie ta, Lilipawzy lyu awpa ta a sie haw.
Ei lôhdupaw eih châ na ta, Ei lôhdupaw chhao kei eih a châ; Ei lôhdupaw cha lilipawzy hry liata A mietaku zawzy a patlaihsa tyh.
Hy ei lôhdunô, Tizah hawhta a ngiapa ta, Zerusale hawhta kho a chhih chi ta, Pohraipazy a chaluahpa pheisaih hri hawhta, Hihâ na hnei ngaita.
Na mozy ta na pahnie tu ha ei ta, Rie na moh khao khah y; Na sâ chhao mie hri lyu ta, Kilia tlâhpi tawhta a zâ chôpa mie hri tlai a lyu.
Na hâhzy cha ti pasi khai tawhta a vaw puapa, Hmi ngyu duapa mietaku panô zawzy lyu ta, Ama zydua ta maphieh taw pataw chyu ei ta, Ama taw ama pahlei tlâ leipa hawhta a châ.
Nâ khuna poh ry liata na ôkhaihzy cha, Pawmikarânâ patlawpazy a lyu.
Beinô sycharu nata nôtho sycharie y ei ta, Laihsa kôpa rei tiah lei ama y.

Ei vachhuh, keima phapakinô deikua cha, Pakha deita a y; A nô sawchanô hnei chhôhpa châ ta, Ano a satuhpa a nô mody chaipa a châ. Chanôzy ta ano cha hmô ei ta, Nohlao ama tah. Beinôzy nata nôthozy chhao ta ano cha hmô ei ta, Hetana heta ama reithai:
“My khihdei hawhta pavâpa ta, Chôthlapi hawhta panyu ta; Noh lynô hawhta khaihpa ta, Pohraipazy a chaluahpa pheisaih hri hawhta Hihâ a hneipa cha ahy ma a châ tly?”
Saikao liata pawpi a pawhpazy sai ta, Kre zôhzy ama paw ama pabyuh mâh ma tahpa mopa ta, Pawmikarânâzy ama paw ama pakai mâh ma tahpa moh awpa ta, Thei hyh châpa sadô lâ zu na ta.
Ei vaw pahno hmâ hlâta, Ei khona ta ei chiheih talailihzy liata na sopa ta, Bei talailihzy liata na vaw soh thlâh ha ta.
Hy Sulâ zuahnô, Vaw kua teh, vaw kua teh; Eima mo eima cha tawpâna hâh ta, Vaw kua la, vaw kua ha mah y. Khazia Mahânai lâ mopa hawhta, Sulâ zuahnô cha nama mo nama tawpâ thlâh ha aw tly?
Pheiky nâ kypa nâ tlai rimâ cha, Hy nôpawpa sawchanô! Na byhpizy thyu phazie cha lôsôhpazy lyu ei ta, Zôthaipa kuzô hawh tlai ta amâ ngia.
Na paliah cha kresawhti a chhâ beih leipa Biebuh pahlôpa lyu ta, Na py chhao lilipawzy ta chadôpa Sâh pathlupa a lyu.
Na sâhpi mianozy cha sakhih taw pô no lyu ei ta, Sakhih taw maphieh tlai ama lyu.
Na rao cha sianaoh o sâhpa lyu ta, Na mokhaohzy cha Bârabi thokhy chhikao kiapâh ta a ypa, Hesbaw liata tipozy ama lyu. Na hnapasu chhao Dâmaskâ lâ a heihpa, Lebanaw o sâhpa a lyu.
Na luh cha Kâmel Tlâh lyu ta, Na sâphiehpa cha nohsaihpa hawh a châ. Na sâphiehpazy liata abei â ao haw.
Hy lôhdunô, khâ a ly chi ta, Na chhithaizie nata na rianaizie rimâ cha!
Na pôraoh thiahrâ kô lyu ta, Na sâhpizy thiahrâ thei sao a lyu.
Thiahrâ kô kiah aw na ta, A thei sao ei patu aw tah na ta. Aw, na sâhpizy cha kre saozy lyu ei sala, Na hu roh epuh roh lyu sala,
Na pakah cha kresawhti pahâh chaipa hawhta châ mawh sy. Ei pakah kresawhti cha, Ei lôhdupaw châta pahnia kawpa ta loh sala, A hmaozy nata a hâhzy chô liata loh zaolao mawh sy.
Ei lôhdupaw eih châ na ta, A khona chhao keima châta a châ.
Ei lôhdupaw, a vy mah y, Râh lâ sie ei sih la, Henâ buhzy hry liata a kei rie khoh suh vy.
Mydi ta kre sadô lâ sie ei sih la, Kre zôhzy ama paw ama pabyuh mâh ma, Kei moh ei sih la; Kre paw lochopa ta, Pawmikarânâ paw a pakai mâh ma, Kei moh ei suh u. Cha liata ei kyhpachâna ei cha hlâ aw.
Hy ei lôhdupaw y, Khoiahzy ta ropahâhpa papua ei ta, Eima ochhizy kiah liata theilâ pahâhpa to y ta, Theilâ thiehpa nata theilâ hlôpazy, Nâma châta ei cha sopa thlâh ha lah y.
Aw, ei rilâhpa hawhta châ la, Ei nô sâhpi a pazypa châ la ei tah kaw dia! Khôtho liata cha hmô aw sah la, Cha pahnâ aw na ta, Ahy hmahta eina reipachhie lei awpa ei tlai.
Châ chhi aw na ta, Nâ pachu tyhpa Ei nô o liata ei châ ngiakhei ha awpa tlai. Kresawhti ropahâhpa cha padosa aw na ta, Ei pawmikarânâ thei ti ei cha padosa awpa tlai.
A ku chavei lâta bâh lô na pahua ta, A ku chachâh lâta einâ pyhpahly.
Hy Zerusale zuahzy saih u, Bie ei cha pataihsa ei; Ano tlai ta a khoh hlâlei la, Kyhpachâna cha a tha pathyu leipa u la, Pahra hra khuh vy.

A lôhdupaw a vaw hnieh laihpa ta, Râhchawhpa tawhta â vypa hao ahy ma a châ tly? Epuh kô ry liata cha pahra na ta, Cha liata na nô cha na hnohta sawzeihpa ta y ta, Cha liata châ satuhpa cha sawzeihpa ta a y.

Na chachôhna liata chahnaona hawhta na soh la, Na ku liata chahnaona hawhta nâ ky mah y; Kyhpachâna cha thina tlu ta a thatlô ta, Hiatliana cha Athihkhih tlu ta â hrâh. Kyhpachâna cha meipaleih hawhta a duah ta, Meipaleih thatlô ngaitapa hawhta a duahpa a châ.

Kyhpachâna mei cha, Ti hluhpi ta pachhai thei leipa ta, Tisaih chhao ta pamôh thei vei. A o liata a hneina zydua pie khaipa ta, Chyhsa ta kyhpachâna chalei â chhuah khiahta cha, Thata mohnaopa a châ aw.
Sietanô seihnainô hnei pi ta, A sâhpizy hra cha pabyuh mâh leipa ta. Ano miah ama vaw hia noh liata, Eima sietanô châta khâpa ma eima taopa aw tly?
Thokhy a châ khiahta cha, A chô liata tâkâ o sâhpa sa aw pi ta; Ochhi a châ khiahta cha, Sidy thophia ta eima dôh aw.
Thokhy châ na ta, Ei sâhpizy chhao o sâhpazy ama lyu hih. Chavâta ano mo liata la, Thlalôhna a hneipa hawhta na ei vaw châ haw.
Sawlawmaw cha Bâlâhamaw liata kre sadô hnei ta, Mokhâhtuhpazy hnohta hria hlao hneipa ta pahriasa ta, Chyhsa to ta a theilâpa ty châta, Tâkâ tlaw sâh kha ama vaw chei chyu awpa a châ.
Ei kre sadô, keima kre sadô tlai cha ei hmiakô liata a y hih; Hy nâ Sawlawmaw, nâ ta sâh kha hnei la, Theilâpa mokhâhtuhpazy ta za no hnei mawh ei sy.
Hy nâ sadôzy liata a pahrâpa y, Viasazy ta na ao ama cha nathlie, Kei chhao na ao thei hraw sah y.
Hy ei lôhdupaw, a para teh, Sakhih hawhta châ la; Ropahâhpa tlâhpizy liata, Zuneih tôh lochopa lyu mah y.
He aluahna he Zudâh bei Uzia, Zôthâ, Ahâza nata Hezekia zy amâ bei nota, Amôza sawchapawpa Isai ta Zudâh nata Zerusale kyh liata a hmôpazy a châ.
Hy avâzy saih u, nathlie u la, Hy leilô, na nah pachô teh; Abeipa ta hetana heta a tah: “Sawzy a kuhkheipa ta palaiseihsa ei na ta, Châhrasala einâ chariah ha ei.
Viahchao tôhpa ta a hneituhpa pahno ta, Alâ ta a puhpa châki a pahno; Izarei deikua ta pahno leipa ta, Ei phopi ta a novâh vei.”

Âh, râh moleipa châ ei ta, Paraona a phaohpa phopi ama châ; Moleina hmo a taopa chipathla châ ei ta, Avyuhna a taopa sawzy ama châ. Abeipa siesaipa ta, Izarei Pathaihpa cha mohnao ei ta, Hnôh ama chhy haw.
Khazia hmo parao lymâpa ta, Tupa ta khâ nama y aw? Na luh zydua pasa ta, Na palôh tlokhuh a panao haw.
Pheipazah tawhta luh taih tlai ta, Pasa khai ha ta; Hmah nata thidôna nata hniahzy ta bie ta, Hniahzy cha pazâpa châ leipa ta, Chahrypa nata sathaw hniapa châ hra vei.
Nama râh roryhrapa ta y ta, Nama khihpizy mei ta kâ ta; Nama mohmô lia tlai ta, Chihropazy ta nama râh ama palâ khai haw. Chihropazy ta râh parao khai ha ei ta, Roryhrapa ta a y.
Kre sadô liata byureih hawhta, Zaio sawchanô cha siesaipa châ ta; Athei lyu liata chapu hawhta siesaipa ta a y; Khihpi dôh hapa hawhta a châ.
Pheisaihzy Abeipa ta Laibâhpa chyhta miah pahlôhpa vei mawh sala; Sawdawmâ hawhna khata châ aw pi ta, Kawmawrâ hawhna khata eima y aw.
“Nâmo, Sawdawmâ ryureituhpazy saih u, Abeipa bie thei u la, Nâmo, Kawmawrâ mo saih u, Eima Khazohpa pachuna bie lâ nama nah pachôh teh u!

“Nama atheihna hluh ngaitapazy he, Ei châta khâpa a phahnai?” Abeipa ta a tah. “Mietaku tôhpa raopa hlânazy na ai ha ta, Sahroh pathawhpa thawzy eina ai haw; Viahchao tôhpazy thisaih liata a ly leipa na ta, Mietakutaw nata mie thisaihzy liata a ly hra va na.
“Ei hmiakô liata a luah awpa ta namâ vy nota, Ei dôhpachhôh tlyhmia tlybai awpa ta, Ahy ma châ hnaw ei?

Hraoleipa atheihnazy vaw cheih khao khah u; Ropahâhpa chhao ei châta pasichhihpa a châ. Thla thiehpa nata Pahânoh nama chay tyhpazy Chhyh thai khao leipa na ta; Noh peimawhpazy nama chay tyhpa chhao, Chhyh thai khao va na; Moleina chhaota pakhypi pathaihpa nama hmâ tyhpazy chhao Chhyh thei khao va na.
Nama thla thiehpa kyhchhi ei hro ta a hao ta, Nama daihti eihpa kyhchhizy ei hro ta â hao; Ei châta phaohri deita châ ei ta, Phaoh thei khao va na.
Nama ku avâ lâ nama pazawh tita, Ei mo châ chahusai aw ei na ta; Ei hluhpi thlah nama chhâpa chhao ta, Nathlie aw va na; Nama kuzy thisaih ta bie tlôh ta.
Nama ngai a sipa ta a pathai u la, Hmo moleipa nama taopazy ei mohmô tawhta pahlei teh u; Hmo pha leipa tao khao leipa u la,
Hmo pha tao a chu teh u; Adona tlua u la, Tlybaina a dyuh teh u; Paw hnei leipazy chô liata adona patlôsa u la, Nôhmeizy reikhei teh u.
“A vy teh u, Pachâ khoh tua suh u,” Abeipa ta a tah. “Nama moleinazy cha, Saihlawpa hawhta saih hra sala, Dâhaw hawhta ngyuh aw ta; Saihdôhpa hawhta saih hra sala, Mietaku hmi hawhta a y aw.
A phapa nata reingiahpa ta nama y khiahta cha, Râh phana nie aw ei chi ta;
Reingiah leipa ta einâ dyuh khiah ei chi ta deikua cha, Zaozi ta a cha nie aw ei, Abeipa pakah ta a reih haw,” tah ta.
Kheihtazieta ma khihpi ngâchhihpa, Adona ta a bie tyhpa khihpi kha, Sihryhpa lâta a pua ha tly i? Ano liata siana pahrâ tyh ta, Tahmâ deikua cha, Lianycheihtuhpazy pahrâna a châ ha hih!
Na tâkâ cha thua saiiepa lâta a lie ta, Na kresawhti pha chaipa chhao ti pahlaopa a châ haw.

Na beimachâzy cha chyhsa a chakhia thaipa châ ei ta, Parutuhpazy viasa ama châ. Chyhsa to ta panaopapana tlaichhai ei ta, Kuhriazy amâ chadai tyh. Paw hnei leipazy a duakhei leipa ei ta, Nôhmeizy aduakheina bie chhao ama hnohta tlô beih vei.
Chavâta Abeipa, Pheisaihzy Abeipa, Izarei Thatlôpa ta hetana heta a tah: “Âh, ei chariahpazy papai aw na ta, Ei khakhaipazy chô liata phuh ei la aw.
Na chô liata ei ku pathla aw na ta, Na saiiepa cha lôiah ta pasi aw na ta, Na thua chhiepa cha ei pathaisa aw.

Hnôhlâ daihti hawhna khata, Na ryureituhpazy padua heih aw ei na ta; Âthaona daihti hawhna khata, Na ryhraotuhpazy ei padua heih aw ei. Cha khai tawhta cha, siana khihpi tahpa châ aw chi ta, Ngâchhihpa khihpi tahpa na châ aw.”
Zaio cha adona ta chatlaipa châ aw ta, A tlâh chyhsa molei ropazy chhao, Siana ta chatlaipa ama châ aw.
Hmoparaopazy nata moleipazy deikua cha, Hmaohkha ta pahleipadiapa châ aw ei ta, Abeipa a siesaipazy chhao ama leidia aw.
Nama mopakiapa ôkâ thozy zakhei aw ei chi ta, Sadô namâ tlyhpazy vâta nohzaopa ta nama y aw.
A hna a uah hapa ôkâ tho hawhta châ aw ei chi ta, Ti y leina sadô hawhta nama châ aw.
Thatlôpa cha meibu hawhta châ aw ta, A raihria meihlih hawhta a châ aw; A miano ta kâ khoh aw ta, A pachhai awpa y aw veih ei.
He he Amôza sawchapawpa Isai ta Zudâh nata Zerusale kyh a hmôpa bie a châ.
Noh hnôhlâzy liata cha, Hetana heta a vaw châ aw: Abeipa o tlâh cha, Tlâhpi a sâh chaipazy liata paduapa a châ aw; Tlâhthlôhzy chô lâta chaluahpa châ aw ta, Râh to ta ama by aw.

Zaio tawhta ryhpa bie pua aw ta, Zerusale tawhta Abeipa bie a pua awpa vâta, Phopi hluhpi a vy aw ei ta, “A vy teh u, Abeipa Tlâh lâ khy sih la, Zakaw Khazohpa o lâ khy suh u; A lâthlôhzy miah pachu sala, A lâpizy eimâ chhih theina hâh ta,” Ama tah aw.

Abeipa ta râhzy likah pachia aw ta, Phopizy likah aeinazy a pathlâ aw; Ama zaozizy cha leipaliena chhaichhi lâta palie aw ei ta, Ama aseizy chhao thochiah taina chaihrai lâta ama palie aw; Phopi nata phopi ta zaozi a hy thlu khao leipa aw ei ta, A dyuhzie chhao a chu khao aw veih ei.
Hy Zakaw pathlazy saih u, a vy u la, Abeipa khaihna liata charei ei suh u.

Na phopi hry liata nochhi chyhsa ziehchhôhpa hmozy ta bie ta, Philistinâ mo hawhta pachaopadâhpazy tao ei ta, Chihropazy nata azaona ama taopa vâta, Na phopi cha siesai chi ta, Zakaw pathlazy cha na siesai ha ei.
Ama râh cha tâkâ nata ngôh ta bie ta, Ama sôh nata thihzy chhâ tiah vei; Ama râh cha arâzy ta bie ta, Ama talailihzy chhâ tiah vei.
Ama râh cha khazoh nothlahpazy ta bie ta, Ama ku ta ama taopazy hmia liata a bôh ei ta, Âmo kuparo ta a taopazy hmia liata amâ bôh tyh.
Chavâta chyhsapa cha panawhpa châ ta, Chyhsa to pahnaipa ama châ. Âmo cha a ngiahthai kha y!
Abeipa chichhihna nata â beina rônahna tawhta a râ u la, Lôpanô liata a ngia u la, Dohlei liata a nyu teh u.
Chyhsa mo apasâhsana cha pahnaipa châ aw ta, Chyhsa apalaina chhao panawhpa châ aw ta, Cha noh liata cha Abeipa deita cheihchalopa a châ aw.
A palaipa nata a khotlâhpa nata a pasâhsapa zy cha, Ama chô liata chhiena a patlôsa nawpa noh Pheisaihzy Abeipa ta hnei ta, Panawhpa ama châ aw.
A khotlâhpa nata a pasâhsapa Lebanaw sidy thozy chô liata zy, Bâsanâ ôkâ tho zydua chô liata zy,
Tlâhpi a sâhpa nata tlâhthlôh a chaluahpa zydua chô liata zy,
O sâhpa nata thokhy to chô liata zy,
Tâsi balyh zydua nata balyh angiapa zydua chô liata Chhiena a patlôsana noh a vaw tlô aw.
Chyhsa apalaina cha panawhpa châ aw ta, Chyhsa apasâhsana chhao pahnaipa a châ aw; Cha noh liata cha Abeipa deita cheihchalopa châ aw ta,
Khazoh nothlahpazy cha ama leidia khai aw.
Abeipa ta alei chalyu awpa ta a thyu tita, Chyhsazy cha Abeipa chichhihna tawhta a râ aw ei ta, Â beina rônahna tawhta amâ râ aw; Lôpanô lôpuzy liata a ngia aw ei ta, Alei khaohzy liata amâ ngia aw.
Cha noh liata cha chyhsazy ta, A chhy awpa ta âmo ta amâ taopa, Tâkâ nata ngôh nothlahpazy thy aw ei ta, Zabihzy nata pazu tâbalâpazy pahrâ nawpa ta ama siesai aw.
Abeipa ta alei chalyu awpa ta a thyu tita, Chyhsazy cha Abeipa chichhihna tawhta a râ aw ei ta, Â beina rônahna tawhta amâ râ aw; Lôpanô lôpuzy liata a ngia aw ei ta, Alei khaohzy liata amâ ngia aw.
Chyhsapa he ngâ khao khah y, A hnapasu liata husona a hneipa deita a châ hih; Pasâhsa kaw nawpa khâpa a hnei tly?
Moh tua u, Pheisaihzy Abeipa Zehôvâh ta Zerusale nata Zudâh apahniehnazy a la khai ha hih; Niedo zydua la khai ha ta, Ti zydua a la khai haw.
Pasaiphazy nata pheisaihzy, Ryureituhpazy nata hrohsopazy, Pachaothaipazy nata machâzy,
Pheisaih sypangawh hyutuhpazy nata chyhsa molaipazy, Ryhraotuhpazy nata moliethaipazy la ta, Peihthaipazy a la khai ha ei.
Thyudyupazy cha ama beimachâzy ta tao aw na ta, Hawtizy ta ama chô liata ryu ama reih aw.

Chyhsazy amâ tlybai raihrie aw: Ama chyhsa châ lâhpazy tlybai aw ei ta, Ama vaihzy ama tlybai aw. Thyutliapa ta machâpa chô liata sâlâ kaw aw ta, Chyhsa nawhpa chhao zachhihpa chô liata a sâlâ kaw aw.
Chyhsa ta a unawhpa cha a paw o liata patu aw ta, “Nâ cha chysia hnei chi ta, Chavâta eima chhituhpa ta y mah y; He raona â pathlupa he, Na ryureina ry liata a y aw,” tah aw ta,
Châhrasala cha noh liata a unawhpa ta, “Kei la hmah chahrytuhpa châ aw va na, Ei o liata viahchhâ nata chysia y hra vei, Phopi chhituhpa ta na tao aw veih ei chi,” Tahpa ta â chhy aw.
Ama bie nata ama hmotaopazy ta Abeipa chakhia ta, A rônahna hmia chhao thlah ama sa leipa vâta, Zerusale cha a chapia ta, Zudâh a pao haw.
Ama hmia phao ta ama châna palâsa ta, Ama moleina Sawdawmâ hawhta ama phuah; Nyu veih ei. Ama hu a po na! Âmosasyh ta raona amâ taopa a châ.
Mosiapazy cha ama châta a pha aw tahpa chho mah y, Ama hmotaopa theilâpa ama nie aw.
Moleipa cha a hu a po na! Chhiena a tyh aw ta, A hmotaopazy viarithôpa a châ aw.
Hawsaihzy ta ei phopi chhihtha ei ta, Chanôzy ta ama chô liata ryu ama reih. Hy ei phopi, châ chhituhpazy ta cha chhihtha chhei ei ta, Nama sie nawpa kyh liata noraihpa ta ama cha tao haw.
Abeipa cha a ryureina dyuchhai liata a tyuh ta, Phopizy pachia awpa ta â vaw duah.
Abeipa ta a phopi machâzy pachia ta, A chhituhpazy a pachia; “Kre sadô a nie khaipa cha, Nâmo tlai he châ ei chi ta; Nama ozy liata, Dyhchhiepazy hraona sôh a y.
Kheihta ma dyhchhiepazy hmia chariehpa ta, Ei phopi cha nama chanaoh ngâ tly?” Pheisaihzy Abeipa Zehôvâh ta a tah.

Abeipa ta hetana heta a tah: “Zaio sawchanôzy cha a khotlâh kawpa ta, Ama rao pachhuapa ta a hlaihlâ ei ta, Ama mozy ta sydie ei ta, Ama chao chamieh chamâpa ta, Ama phei lâkyuzy ama parosa laihpa vâta,
Zaio sawchanôzy cha, Abeipa ta ama luh hmah paysa aw ta, Zehôvâh ta luh pôlôpa ta a tao aw ei.”
Cha noh liata, Abeipa ta amâ tobina zydua, ama phei lâkyuzy, luh chazaina pohzy, thlâpâ diehpa lyupa ta taopa pachhihzy;
rahyzy, lâkyuzy, raoao pohzy;
luh khunazy, phei kalyzy, chaisaihnazy, ropahâhpa byhzy, chhiena a tyh lei nawpa ta a kypazy;
kusadizy nata hnapasu rahyzy,
kyhchhi chysiazy, ngiatlâh baipa pohzy, viahkao pasipazy, sahriazy;
thlalâzy, poh rih dipazy, khuthozy nata hmiakhunazy a pahluhpa khai aw ei.
Ropahâhpa vyuhpa ta hmo thupa vaw y aw ta, Chaisaihna vyuhpa ta chaori a y aw. Sâ mihpa vyuhpa ta luh pôlôna y aw ta, Poh ngiapa vyuhpa ta latho hnorâh y aw ta, Chhithaina vyuhpa ta nozana a y aw.
Na chapawzy zaozi ta pao aw ei ta, Na pasaiphazy adyuhna liata ama pao aw.
A thokhy chhikaozy cha, Chaphôhtupa ta mâchhiesa aw ei ta; Ziahzirohpa ta alei liata â tyuh aw.
Cha noh liata, chanô pasari ta chapaw pakha patu aw ei ta, “Keimo pati nie aw pi ta, keimo chysiazy eimâ tao aw, na moh deita miah paphaosa la, eima nozana miah chhiehruhpa mah y,” ama tah aw.
Cha noh liata, Abeipa chiah cha a ngia ngaitapa ta rônah ngaita aw ta, râh theizy cha Izarei laibâhpazy châta amâ palaikheipa nata ama rônahna a châ aw.
Zaio liata siesaipa nata Zerusale liata a nguapa, Zerusale liata a hrohpa moh ropazy cha pathaihpa tahpa ama châ aw.
Abeipa ta Zaio sawchanôzy thuhnyna cha pathai aw ta, Zerusale liata thisaih a kiahpazy cha pachiana thlahpa nata mei thlahpa ta a pasi aw.

Chatawhcha Abeipa ta Zaio Tlâh liata pahrâna su zydua chô liata nata pakhypi a hmâhpa zydua chô liata, nohchhô ta meihdo, zâ ta meikhuh nata meipaleih khaihna a paysa aw. Cha hmo rônahpa zydua chô lâta khuna y aw ta,
cha cha nohchhô noh lo nota nohdi a chhai nawpa byureih châ aw ta, thlihpipa nata vâsua tawhta a boh nawpa ta a chhaina byureih a châ aw.
Ei kyhpachâpa châta hla sa aw na ta, Ei kyhpachâpa kre sadô hla ei sa aw: Tlâhthlôh lei pha kawpa liata, Ei kyhpachâpa ta kre sadô hnei ta.

Alei chhiah ta, alôzy thypa ta, Kre zôh pha chaipa loh ta; A liah liata vaina o sâhpa sa ta, Cha liata kre saohna khaoh a chao. Kre thei pha pathei awpa ta mokhâh ta, Châhrasala kre sihpa tlao a pathei.
Hy Zerusale khihsawzy nata Zudâh chyhsazy saih u, Tahmâ kei nata ei kre sadô likah miah pachia teh u.
Ei tao hapazy hleikhô ta, Ei kre sadô châta tao via awpa a y khao ma? Kre thei phapa pathei awpa ei mokhâh hai nota, Khazia ma kre sihpa a pathei thlâh ha tly i?
Chavâta ei kre sadô chô liata ei tao awpa Tahmâ ei cha chho aw ei. A diahpai phie aw na ta, Nie khaipa ta a y aw. A diahsua parao aw na ta, Tlypâpa ta a y aw.

Sadô rypa ta tao aw na ta, A chiahzy taipa châ khao leipa aw ta, A lyu thlyupa châ khao hra leipa aw ta, Diahsai nata ahlohzy tlao a pyu awh. Sadô chô liata avâ suah lei awpa ta, Meihdozy chhao bie ei pie ha aw ei.

Pheisaihzy Abeipa kre sadô cha, Izarei pathlazy he châ ta; Zudâh chyhsazy he, A chichei khochhihpazy cha ama châ. Adona mokhâh ta, Châhrasala moh teh u, thisaih palona tlao a hmô. Siana mokhâh ta, Châhrasala moh teh u, chana pyu tlao a thei.
Râh ruapa y khao leina taihta, O nata o pazao ta, Râh nata râh a pazaopazy cha Ama hu a po na! Râh liah khophie liata Âmo dei ta ama pahrâ.
Pheisaihzy Abeipa ta ei nah theina liata hetana heta a tah: “O rônahpazy cha roryhrapa ta y tlai aw ei ta, O laipa nata o ngiapazy chhao pahrâtuhpa hnei khao aw vei.
Kre sadô bai hrawh lyu liata beihrai kha ngâlâh veih aw ta, Sâh chi bai kha tu liata kachu kha ngâlâh a veih aw.”
Mydi kari ta thyupa ta sahma do awpa ta a râ ei ta, Zâcho taihta kresawhti paripa ta a ypazy cha Ama hu a po na!
Ama kyhchhizy liata kresawhti doh ei ta, Totâ, tlaipih, paotlâ nata siaramo zy tôpa ta a ly ei ta, Abeipa hmotaopazy deikua cha pachâ veih ei, A ku raihriazy chhao hmô veih ei.
Chavâta ei phopi cha pahnona amâ phahlapa vâta sei ta a chhipa ta y ei ta, Ama chyhsa zachhihpazy nodipa ta thi ei ta, Ama zawpizy dâhphipa ta ama thi.

Chavâta Athihkhih ta a laopalâna pakawhpa ta, A pakah kawhna zie thlie thei lei awpa ta a pakah a â. Zerusale beimachâzy nata zawpizy Athihkhih lâ zu aw ei ta, Sahma sâtlâh paziahpa ta, Khihpi liata a ly kaw tyhpazy chhao, Athihkhih lâ ama zu aw.
Chyhsapa cha panawhpa ta y tyh ta, Chyhsa to pahnaipa ama châ tyh; Ama mo a sâhpazy cha, Pahnaipa ama châ tyh.
Pheisaih Abeipa deikua cha, A ryureina dopa vâta cheihchalopa ta y aw ta; Khazohpa Pathaihpa cha, A siana hmotaopazy liata a pathaihna pasiapa a châ aw.
Mietakutawzy ta khihpi rypazy cha ama lao bâna su châta hmâh aw ei ta, Chihropazy ta hneirôhpazy siesaipa ama nie aw.
Adoleina khawhhrizy ta paraona a daophi laih ei ta, Talailih chaorizy a daophipa hawhta moleina a daophipazy cha, Ama hu a po na!

“Eima hmô thei nawpa ta, A para sala, A tao awpa cha a chatliepa ta tao mawh sy. Eima pahno thei nawpa ta, Izarei Pathaihpa ryhraona cha a vaw hnia sala vaw tlô mawh sy!” A tahtuhpazy cha ama hu a po na!

Hmo chhiepa cha hmo phapa tah ta, Hmo phapa cha hmo chhiepa a tahpa zy; Khaihna cha zohna ta rao ta, Zohna cha khaihna ta a raopa zy; Akhapa cha athlôhpa ta rao ta, Athlôhpa cha akhapa ta a raopazy cha, Ama hu a po na!
Âmo mo liata â pasosa kaw ei ta, Âmo mohmô liata thai â tah kawpazy cha, Ama hu a po na!
Kresawhti dona liata ama riahpha kaw ta, Sahma thatlôpa pahlaona liata pasaipha kawpazy cha, Ama hu a po na!
Panaopapana lapa ta, Thailei a châpa thai pachâ ei ta, Thai a châpa cha thailei ama pachâsa tyh.

Chavâta mei ta sâhkô chuahmi charôh ta, Meipaleih vâta sibie raohpa â chahkaopa hawhta, Ama thari hmy aw ta, Ama paw chhao doh hawhta â zaw aw; Pheisaihzy Abeipa ryhpa dytha ei ta, Izarei Mo Pathaihpa bie ama mohnaopa vâta.

Chavâta Abeipa pathi cha a phopi chô liata ia ta, Ama chô liata a ku hy ta a tu ha ei. Tlâhpizy a chalyu ta, Ama rizy cha hnaihny hawhta Lâlaizy liata amâ thy hôlô. Cha zydua cha a tao hapa chhao ta, A hiehâhna pai to leipa ta, A ku a hy ngâ thlâh ha chy.
Râh hlapazy lâta ngiana poh chaluahpa ta, Khizaw kaokih zydua a pahipa ta aw aw ta; Moh teh u, a para aw ei ta, A chatliepa ta amâ vy aw.
Thachhâpa y leipa aw ei ta, Achapiapa y aw veih ei. Tla-uahpa y leipa aw ei ta, Amôpa y aw veih ei. Ama chaisaih a hua tlâ leipa aw ta, Ama pheiky ri chie tlâ aw vei.
Ama châtaizy tiah kaw ta, Ama libaw zydua a kei chiehpa ta y ta, Ama arâ chakiezy cha pachielô lyu ta, Ama talailih tiakizy cha khisô a lyu.
Amâ rôhpa pyu chakeibarôhneipa a rôhpa pyu lyu ta, Chakeibarôhneipa lochopazy hawhta amâ rôh. Siechahnuapa ta sa tai aw ei ta, Siekhei aw ei ta, a pachha thei awpa y veih ei.
Cha noh liata, tilaipi a rôhpa hawhta, Izarei chô liata amâ rôh aw. Chyhsa ta râh a sai khiahta cha, Zohna nata nôpona sai hmô aw ta, Khaihna cha meihdozy vâta a zoh ha aw.
Bei Uzia a thi kô ta, Abeipa cha beidyuchhai a sâhpa nata a chaluahpa liata â tyu thlâh hapa hmô na ta. A poh rônahpa ta Achhyna o pabie khai ha ta.
Beidyuchhai chô lâta serâfizy a duah ei ta. Mathlaw miacharu chyu hnei ei ta. Mathlaw miano ta a hmia khu ta, miano ta a pheizy khu ta, miano ta a zaw ta.
