He hawhpa hmo a taopa chyhsa cha, Abeipa ta a chi pamua sala, Zakaw poh o liata a pahrâ awpa chipathlazy hnei leipa sala, Pheisaihzy Abeipa lâta hmo a hlâ awpa chipathla chhao hnei khah sy.

Hmo hropa nama taopa chhao a y via. Abeipa ta nama hmohlâpa uasa khao leipa ta, nama ku tawhta palôhtlâhpa ta a châ hlâ khao leipa vâ ei ta, mothlih, chana nata arôhna ta Abeipa maisâh cha nama pabie.

Chatanachôta, “A chhâpa khâpa ma a châ tly?” nama tah thlâh ha chy. A chhâpa cha, Abeipa cha nâ nata na thyutlia no lapinô likah bie pahnokheituhpa châ ta, na lapinô cha nâ kaolâhpa, biehrai na taokheipa châ ta, châhrasala ano châta ngâ nâ chhih khao leipa vâta a châ.

Sapa nata thlahpa liata pôhkha châpa ta ano eih ama châ thei nawpa ta, Khazohpa ta pôhkha ta a taopa châ veih ei ma? Khazia pôhkha ta a tao ei? Khazohpa ta ano khozie hawhta a ypa chipathla a tluapa vâta, pôhkha ta a taopa ei a châ. Chavâta nama thlahpa hro a phapa ta vaih u la, ahy rai a thyutlia no lapinô châta a ngâchhihna pahlei beih khah sy.

“Nôvah a chhaihpa he ei hao,” Abeipa Izarei Khazohpa ta a tah. “Chysia a tobipa hawhta thachahra hmâna ta a tobipa chhao ei hao hra. Chavâta nama thlahpa hro a phapa ta vaih u la, ngâchhihna pahlei khuh vy,” Pheisaihzy Abeipa ta a tah.

Nama biezy ta Abeipa rie nama pathei kaw tyh. Châhrasala nâmo ta, “Kheihta ma Abeipa rie cha eima pathei,” nama tah. “Moleina hmo a taopa zydua Abeipa mohmô liata la pha khai ei ta, Abeipa ta â ly kaw ei na,” tah ei chi ta, “Adona Khazohpa cha khataih liata ma a y?” nama tahpazy liana heta Abeipa rie nama pathei haw.

“Moh teh u, ei hmia lâta lâpi a chhuahdy awpa ta, ei lyuhchâpa ei vaw tuah aw. Nama tluapa Abeipa cha ano Achhyna o lâ eikhapi ta â vy aw. Moh teh u, nama tlaichhaipa biehrai lyuhchâpa cha â vy hai,” Pheisaihzy Abeipa ta a tah.
Châhrasala ahy ma â vyna noh liata pachyu thei aw ta, â vaw luah tita a duah thei aw? Ano cha patina mei hawhta châ ta, chysia pasutuhpa sâhbaw hawhta a châ.

Tâkâ pathaituhpa nata a thlipasohtuhpa hawhta a tyuh aw ta, Livai pathlazy cha pathaisa aw ta, ngôh nata tâkâ a thlipasohpa hawhta âmo cha a thlipasoh aw ta, siana ta Abeipa lâta hmohlâpazy ama hlâ aw.
Chatanachata Zudâh nata Zerusale hmohlâpazy cha, hlâno nohzy nata hlâno kôzy hawhna khata Abeipa châta palôhtlâh chhihpa hmo a châ heih aw.

“Pachia awpa ta châ vaw hnia aw ei na ta, dyuthaipazy, apheipazy, haipa ta bie â taihpazy, ama raihriatuhpazy hlao â dopa ta a pie leipazy, nôhmei nata hara a tlybaipazy, chihropa nama hry liata a ypazy chô liata adoleipa ta hmo a taopazy nata nâ chi leipazy châta, a chatliepa ta âmo a leihtuhpa ei châ aw,” Pheisaihzy Abeipa ta a tah.
“Kei he Abeipa châ na ta, anano beih va na. Chavâta, Hy nâmo, Zakaw pathlazy saih u, pahleipadia khaipa ta nama y leipa a châ hih!

Châ pathlatuhpazy daihti tawhna khata, ei biepiepazy tleisai tyh ei chi ta, zyh veih ei chi. Kei lâ vaw kua u la, nâmo lâ ei vaw kua aw,” Pheisaihzy Abeipa ta a tah. “Châhrasala nâmo ta, ‘Kheihta ma eima vaw kua aw?’ nama tah.
Chyhsapa ta Khazohpa a hrao aw ma? Nâmo deikua ta cha eina hrao tyh ei chi. Châhrasala nâmo ta, ‘Kheih ta ma eima cha hrao tyh?’ nama tah. Su hrawh su kha nata thyunazy liata eina hrao tyh ei chi.
Eina hrao ngâ thlâh hapa vâ ei chi ta, nama râh dua ta chhiesana ry liata nama y.

Ei o liata nie awpa a y thei nawpa ta, su hrawh su kha zydua cha thyupakhyna o liata vaw cheih teh u. Cha hawhta nama tao khiahta cha, nama châta vârâh opyzy pahypa ta, nama so nawpa a y khao leina taihta byhnâzy ei cha vaohei ei ma, vaohei veih ei ma, na pasia teh u,” Pheisaihzy Abeipa ta a tah.
“Arievazy ta nama chhaohlei theizy ama nie lei nawpa ta pakhâ aw ei na ta, nama sadô liata kre zôhzy pathei leipa ta y aw vei,” Pheisaihzy Abeipa ta a tah.
“Chatanachata râh zydua ta nohlaopa cha tah aw ei ta, râh khochhih ngaitapa nama châ aw,” Pheisaihzy Abeipa ta a tah.
“Eina chakhiana ei chi biezy a pasa ngaita,” Abeipa ta a tah. “Châhrasala nâmo ta, ‘Kheihta ma nâma chakhiana biezy cha eima reih?’ nama tah.
‘Khazohpa chakaopa he hraoleipa dei a châ. A biepiepazy eima zyhpa nata mâchhiesapazy hawhta Pheisaihzy Abeipa hmiakô liata eima y tyhpa heta khâpa phahnaina ma a hnei tly?
Tahmâ cha apalaipazy nohlaopa tah pi ta, moleipazy hra ta ama hneirôhpa dei châ leipa ta, Khazohpa pasia ei ta amâ boh thlâh haw,’ nama tah.”

Chatawhcha Khazohpa a chipazy cha a chhohia raihrie ei ta, Abeipa ta ama biereipazy nathliepa ta thei ta. Chatanachata Abeipa a chipa nata a moh a pasâhsapazy atheithlâhna châbu cha a mohmô liata ropa a châ.
“Ei ryu sôhpazy ei paki ti ei ta, kei eih châ aw ei ta, paw ta ano palôh a hmôpa a sawchapawpa a hrôbiehpa hawhta âmo cha ei hrôbieh aw ei,” Pheisaihzy Abeipa ta a tah.
Chatanachata mosiapa nata moleipa likah ananona nata Khazohpa a chakaopa nata a chakao leipa likah ananonazy nama hmô heih aw.

“Moh teh u, noh cha a vaw tlô hai; patina mei hawhta a kâ aw. Apalaipazy nata moleina a taopazy cha sawphao châ aw ei ta, cha noh a vaw tlô haipa chata kâ aw ei ta, buchâh lâta a palie ha aw ei; a thari nata a chiah miakha dâhdei chhao pahlôhpa châ aw vei,” Pheisaihzy Abeipa ta a tah.
“Châhrasala nâmo, ei moh a chizapazy châta siana noh, a mathlaw liata tlâhna a ypa noh a vaw chhi aw. Pua aw ei chi ta, viahchaotaw a o tawhta pazopa hawhta châki nama zoh aw.
Cha hmozy ei tao noh liata cha, moleipazy tlypâ aw ei chi ta, nama pheipazah ry liata buchâh hawhta ama châ aw,” Pheisaihzy Abeipa ta a tah.
“Nâ chakaotuhpa Mawsi ryhpa kha a thei u la, Izarei zydua châta Hôribâ tlâh liata ei piepa biepiepazy nata ryhpazy kha a thei teh u.
Moh teh u, Abeipa noh rônahpa nata rarôh y ngaitapa a vaw tlô hlâta hrohsopa Elaizâh ei cha za tuapa tua aw ei.

Ano chata pawzy palôh cha ama sawzy lâta paheisa aw ta, sawzy palôh chhao ama pawzy lâta a paheisa aw; chataleipata la, a vy aw na ta, râh he chhiesapa ta ei parao pathlei aw na,” Pheisaihzy Abeipa ta a tah.
He he Zisu Krista thyutôna châbu a châ. Zisu Krista cha Dâvi pathla châ ta, Dâvi cha Abarahâ pathla a châ.
Abarahâ cha Aisika paw châ ta, Aisika cha Zakaw paw a châ. Zakaw cha Zudâh nata a unawhzy paw châ ta.
Zudâh cha Pereza nata Zerâ paw châ ta, ama nô cha Tâmâri a châ. Pereza cha Hezrô paw châ ta, Hezrô cha Aramâ paw a châ.
Aramâ cha Aminadâ paw châ ta, Aminadâ cha Nâsô paw a châ. Nâsô cha Salmô paw châ ta,
Salmô cha Bôaza paw a châ. Bôaza nô cha Rahâbi a châ. Bôaza cha Ôbedâ paw châ ta, Ôbedâ nô cha Ruthi a châ. Ôbedâ cha Zese paw châ ta,
Zese cha Bei Dâvi paw a châ. Dâvi cha Sawlawmaw paw châ ta, Sawlawmaw nô cha Uria lapinô kha a châ.
Sawlawmaw cha Rehôbaw paw châ ta, Rehôbaw cha Abizah paw a châ. Abizah cha Âsâ paw châ ta,
Âsâ cha Zehôsaphâ paw a châ. Zehôsaphâ cha Zôrâ paw châ ta, Zôrâ cha Uzia paw a châ.
Uzia cha Zôthâ paw châ ta, Zôthâ cha Ahâza paw a châ. Ahâza cha Hezekia paw châ ta,
Hezekia cha Manase paw a châ. Manase cha Amôsâ paw châ ta, Amôsâ cha Zôsia paw a châ.
Zôsia cha Zekôniah nata a unawhzy paw châ ta, âmo he Babylaw lâ a chhipa ta ama y no rachhôh ta a pihpa ama châ.
Hezy he Babylaw lâ sei ta a chhipa ama châ tawhta a pihpazy ama châ: Zekôniah cha Salâtia paw châ ta, Salâtia cha Zerubâbe paw a châ.
Zerubâbe cha Abinadâ paw châ ta, Abinadâ cha Eliakima paw a châ. Eliakima cha Azô paw châ ta,
Azô cha Zadô paw a châ. Zadô cha Akhi paw châ ta, Akhi cha Elidâ paw a châ.
Elidâ cha Eliaza paw châ ta, Eliaza cha Mâthanâ paw a châ. Mâthanâ cha Zakaw paw châ ta,
Zakaw cha Zawsi paw a châ. Zawsi cha Mâri vahpa châ ta, Mâri cha Mesia ama bipa Zisu nô a châ.

Chatanachata chhâ zydua cha, Abarahâ tawhta Dâvi taihta chhâ hrawh hleipalih châ ta, Dâvi tawhta Babylaw lâ sei ta a chhipa ama châna taihta chhâ hrawh hleipalih châ ta, Babylaw lâ sei ta a chhipa ama châ tawhta Mesia pina taihta chhâ hrawh hleipalih a châ.
Zisu Krista vaw pinazie cha hetana heta a châ. Zawsi ta Zisu nô Mâri cha a pahawh ta, amâ pahlyh hlâta Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta saw paphaosa ta.
A vahpa Zawsi cha chyhsa siapa a châpa vâta, Mâri noh pazao awpa khoh leipa ta, arulâta a chhaih a chhuah ta.

Châhrasala he hmo he a pachâ hai nota, Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa cha a hnohta a mâ lâta a vaw luah ta, “Dâvi sawchapawpa Zawsi y, Mâri na lapinô ta hnei awpa chi khah y. A saw phaopa kha Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta a paphaosapa a châ.
Sawchapaw sa aw ta, a chyhsazy ama moleinazy tawhta a pachha awpa vâta, a moh Zisu na bi aw,” tah ta.
Cha hmo zydua cha Abeipa ta hrohsopa pakah hmâpa ta,

“Pachâ teh u, laihsa kôpa ta saw phaoh aw ta, Sawchapawpa sa aw ta, A moh Imanuel ama bi aw,” tahpa ta a reipa kha â ki thei nawpa ta a vaw tlôpa a châ. Imanuel cha “Khazohpa eima hnohta a y,” tahna a châ.
Zawsi cha a vaw hra ta, Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa ta bie a piepa hawhta tao ta, Mâri cha lapinô ta hnei ta.
Châhrasala Mâri ta sawchapaw a sa hlâ via cha a zialâh vei. Zawsi ta a sawchapawpa moh cha Zisu a bi.
Herawda â bei nota Zudia râh Bethlehe khih liata Zisu a vaw pi nahta, nochhi chyhsa sopazy Zerusale lâ a vy ei ta,
“Zuzy bei a pihpa cha khataih liata a y? Nochhi lâta ano awhsi hmô pi ta, ano a naoh awpa ta eimâ vy,” tah ei ta.
Cha bie cha Bei Herawda ta a thei nahta, ano nata Zerusale liata chyhsa zydua cha ama nôpo kaw ta.
Theihthai beichaipazy nata ryhpa pachutuhpa zydua awpakhy ta, Mesia pina awpa cha khataih liata a châ tahpa ta âmo hiahri ta.
Âmo ta, “Zudia râh Bethlehe liata a châ. Hrohsopa ta,

“‘Nâ, Bethlehe, Zudâh râh liatapa, Zudâh ryureituhpazy hry liata chyh chai cheita aw va chi; Ei phopi Izarei vaih awpa ta, Na chhôh tawhta ryureituhpa a vaw pua awpa vâta,’ tahpa ta a vaw roh,” tah ei ta.
Herawda ta chyhsa sopazy cha arulâta aw ta, khatita ma awhsi cha â lâ tahpa âmo hiahri pasia ta.

Bethlehe khih lâta âmo cha pasiesa ta, “Sie u la, hawsaih cha a phapa ta kei tlua teh u. Nama hmô nahta, a thâtih thlai na vaw chho muh vy. Chatanachata kei chhao sie aw na ta, ei kei naoh hra aw,” tah ta.
Abei bie cha ama nathlie khai nahta, sie ha ei ta. Nochhi lâta awhsi ama hmôpa kha ama hmia lâta sie lymâ ta, hawsaih yna chô liata â dua hlâlei cha, âmo chhihtha lymâ ta.
Awhsi cha ama hmô nahta, thaphapa ta a ly ngaita ei ta.
O chhôh lâ a ngia ei ta, hawsaih cha a nô Mâri hnohta hmô ei ta, a bôhpa ta a naoh ei ta. Ama ryubyhzy pahy ei ta, hmosaipa ngôh, deiryh nata myrâ zy pie ei ta.
Ama mâ lâta Herawda lâ kua lei awpa ta chhopa ama châpa vâta, lâpi hropa lâta ama râh lâ a lie ha ei ta.

Ama sie tawhta, Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa cha Zawsi hnohta a mâ lâta a vaw luah ta, a hnohta, “Thyu la, hawsaih nata a nô kha a chhi la, Izi râh lâ a râ teh. Herawda ta hawsaih kha pahleipadia awpa ta a tlua awpa vâta, ei cha chho heih hlâlei cha, cha liata y thlâh ha mah y,” tah ta.
Zawsi cha thyu ta, hawsaih nata a nô cha a chhi ta, azo ta Izi râh lâ cha sie ta.
Herawdâ a thi hlâlei cha, cha liata y ei ta. Cha hmo cha Abeipa ta hrohsopa pakah ta, “Ei sawchapawpa cha Izi râh tawhta ei aw papua aw,” a tahpa kha a vaw tlô thei nawpa ta a châ.

Herawda cha chyhsa sopazy ta ama dôpa a pahno nahta, a hiehâh ngaita ta, chyhsa tuah ta, chyhsa sopazy tawhta a daihti a pahnopa hawhta, Bethlehe khih nata a chheipâh zydua liata chapaw hawti kô no tawhta a ry lâ zydua cha thie khai awpa ta biepie ta.
Hrohsopa Zeremiah ta,
“Râmâ liata ao theipa châ ta, Chana nata mâchhiesana ao a châ; Râkheli ta a sawzy chakhei ta, Ama y khao leipa vâta, Thlapalôh thei awpa châ vei,” tahpa ta a reipa kha a vaw tlô hapa a châ.
Herawda a thi tawhta, Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa ta Izi râh liata Zawsi hnohta a mâ lâta a vaw luah ta,
a hnohta, “Thyu la, hawti nata a nô kha a chhi la, Izarei râh lâ sie mah y, hawti hrona la a chhuahpazy kha ama thi haw,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Zawsi cha thyu ta, hawti nata a nô a chhi ta, Izarei râh lâ sie ta.
Châhrasala Akhelâ ta a paw Herawda vyuhpa ta Zudia râh chô liata â bei tahpa a thei nahta, cha lâ sie awpa cha chi ta, a mâ lâta chhopa a châpa hawhta, Kâlili lâ sie ha ta.
Khihpi miakha, Nâzari ama tahpa lâ sie ta, cha liata kei pahrâ ta. Cha hmo cha, “Ano cha Nâzari chyhsa ama tah aw,” tahpa ta hrohsopazy pakah ta ama reipa kha a vaw tlô thei nawpa ta a châ.
Cha nohzy liata, Bâtituhpa Zawhâna cha Zudia râhchawhpa liata bie chho awpa ta a vy ta,
“Ro teh u, vârâh khinarâh cha â hnia haw,” tahpa ta bie chho ta.
Hrohsopa Isai ta, “Râhchawhpa liata awhpa ao ta, Abeipa lâthlôh a chhuahdy u la, A lâpizy patlâsa teh u,” tahpa ta a vaw reichhieliepa kha, ano he a châ.
Zawhâna cha râraoseihpa hmi chysia ta a tobi ta, savo chaisaihna ta a chai a saih ta, a pati cha khawsu nata kheihti a châ.
Zerusale nata Zudia râh liata chyhsa zydua nata Zawdâh chavah chheipâh liata chyhsa zydua puapa ta ano lâ a vy ei ta,
ama moleinazy palâhâhpa ta Zawdâh chavah liata ano ta bâti pachâsa ei ta.
Phârisaih nata Saduasi hluhpi ta bâti châ awpa ta ano lâ amâ vypa a hmô nahta, ama hnohta, “Nâmo, vâzi pathlazy saih u! Hiehâhna vaw tlô awpa a râsai awpa ta ahy ma zikyu châ râ ei?
Rona moh phaoh tlâhpa ta pathei teh u.
‘Abarahâ pathla eima châ,’ a tah khuh vy. Khazohpa ta he alôzy tawhna heta Abarahâ pathlazy a padua thei tahpa ei cha chho ei.
Tahmâ chhao tlai he, tho tharizy liata ahrei sopa a châ haw. Tho to thei pha a pathei leipa maih thlu ta mei liata thypa a châ aw.

“Kei ta rona châta ti ta cha bâti ei na ta, ei hnôhlâ ta a vy awpa deikua cha, keima hlâta rônah viapa châ ta, kei la a pheiky chaba tlâh chhao châ va na. Ano ta Thlahpa Pathaihpa nata mei ta a cha bâti aw ei.
A ku liata a barah y ta, a sawhri sâh zie aw ta, a sâh pâh liata a ryh aw. Asihpa deikua cha, mei pachhai thei leipa liata a rao aw,” tah ta.
Cha nona chata Zisu cha, Zawdâh chavah liata bâti châ awpa ta, Kâlili tawhta Zawhâna lâ a vy ta.
Châhrasala Zawhâna ta, “Nâ ta bâti eina pachâsa awpa chi tlao ei ngiah. Kheihtazieta kei lâ a vypa ma na châ?” tah ta, thlyu a chhuah ta.
Zisu ta a chhy ta, “Â ryh tah thlâh ha teh. Siana zydua pakipa cha eima châta a ngiahpa a châ,” tah ta. Chatanachata paryhsa ha ta.
Zisu cha bâti a châ khaipa nahta, ti tawhta thlai kaw pua ta, avâ a vaw pahy ta, Khazohpa Thlahpa cha vachhuh hawhta za chô ta, a chô liata â chohpa hmô ta.
Avâ tawhta ao ta, “He he ei Sawchapawpa kyh ei pachâ ngaitapa, a chô liata ei ly ngaitapa a châ,” tah ta.
Cha khai tawhta Zisu cha ahripa ta a reipasao awpa ta, Thlahpa ta râhchawhpa lâ a chhi ta.
Noh sypalih nata zâ sypalih chaheihpa ta a y tawhta a no vaw di ha ta.
Reipasaotuhpa a vy ta, a hnohta, “Khazohpa Sawchapawpa na châ khiahta cha, alôzy he viahchhâ lâta a vaw lie awpa ta biepie teh,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a chhy ta, “‘Chyhsapa he viahchhâ dei ta hroh aw vei, Khazohpa pakah tawhta bie to a puapa ta tlao a hroh aw,’ Tahpa ta ropa a châ,” tah ta.
Cha khai tawhta, ahripa ta khihpi pathaihpa lâ a chhi ta, Achhyna o laki pazaopa liata soh ta,

a hnohta, “Khazohpa Sawchapawpa na châ khiahta cha, a zaw pathlah teh, “‘Khazohpa ta nâma kyh liata, A vâlyuhchâpazy biepie aw ta, Na phei alô liata nâ chhuh lei nawpa ta, Ama ku ta ama cha chalo aw,’ Tahpa ta ropa a châ,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “‘Abeipa na Khazohpa na pasia awpa châ vei,’ tahpa ropa a châ hra,” tah ta.
Ahripa ta tlâh sâh ngaitapa lâ a chhi heih ta, khizaw khinarâh zydua nata ama rônahna zydua pamosa ta.
A hnohta, “Â khu lâta pao la, einâ chhy khiah chi ta cha, he hmo zydua he ei cha pie aw,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Sâtâ, a râ teh! ‘Abeipa na Khazohpa a chhy aw chi ta, Ano deita na chakao awpa a châ,’ Tahpa ta ropa châ tlôh ta,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha ahripa ta Zisu cha siesai ha ta. Vâlyuhchâpazy a vy ei ta, ano cha ama chakao haw.
Zawhâna ama patu haw tahpa Zisu ta a thei nahta, Kâlili lâ a lie ta.
Nâzari khih puasai ta, sie ta, tilaipi kiah liata Kâpynia khih, Zebulawna nata Nâthalai râh liata pahrâ ta.
Cha hmo cha hrohsopa Isai ta,
“Zebulawna râh nata Nâthalai râh, Tilaipi pangaina, Zawdâh haosâ râh, Zenitaizy pahrâna Kâlili râh
Zohna liata a tyuhpazy ta Khaihna rônahpa ama hmô haw; Thina nohpahli râh liata atyuhpazy chô liata, Khaihpa a vaw khaih haw,” tahpa ta a reipa kha a vaw tlô thei nawpa ta a châ.
Cha daihti tawhta Zisu ta, “Ro teh u, vârâh khinarâh cha â hnia haw,” tahpa ta pachu pathao ta.
Kâlili Tipo kiah liata a sie hai nota, unawh pano, Saimaw, Pity ama tahpa nata a unawhpa Adaru zy cha tilaipi liata sao ama vaw ngâpa hmô ta. Âmo cha nga patutuhpazy ama châ.
Ama hnohta, “Na zi teh u, chyhsa patutuhpa ta ei cha tao aw ei,” tah ta.
Ama saozy thlai siesaipa ta Zisu cha zi ha ei ta.
Cha tawhtapa cha sie lymâ ta, unawh hropa pano, Zebâdi sawchapawpa Zâmie nata a unawhpa Zawhâna zy cha ama paw Zebâdi chhaota saozy balyh liata ama taopathi ngâpa hmô ta, âmo cha aw ta.
Ama balyh nata ama paw cha thlai siesaipa ta Zisu cha zi ha ei ta.
Kâlili râh zydua chahryh ta, amâ pakhyna ozy liata pachupa ta, khinarâh thâtihpha chho lymâ ta, zawpi hry liata hri to nata pasana to a hneipazy patlâh ta.
Suria râh zydua liata a moh pathâh ta, chyhsa tlâhleipa zydua, pasana a hneipa nata hri ohpazy, ahripa patupazy, riapamiepazy nata asypazy a hnohta a vaw chhi ei ta, patlâh lymâ ta.
Kâlili tawhta zy, Dekâpôli tawhta zy, Zerusale tawhta zy, Zudia tawhta nata Zawdâh haosâ râh tawh zy ta zawpi hluhpi ta ano cha zi ei ta.
Zisu cha zawpizy a hmô nahta, tlâh lâ kiah ta, a tyuh ta, a pachupazy a hnohta a vy ei ta.
Hetana heta âmo cha pachu ta.
“Thlahpa sipasapazy ama nohlao na, vârâh khinarâh ama eih a châpa vâta.
“Pachârôhpazy ama nohlao na, thlapalôhpa ta ama y awpa vâta.
“Nônaipazy ama nohlao na, lei ryu ama to awpa vâta.
“Siana khopa vâta nodi dâhphipazy ama nohlao na, ama aoh a vei awpa vâta.
“Zawngiah theipazy ama nohlao na, zawngiahna ama hmô awpa vâta.
“Palôh pathaihpazy ama nohlao na, Khazohpa ama hmô awpa vâta.
“Aryhna taotuhpazy ama nohlao na, Khazohpa sawzy bipa ama châ awpa vâta.
“Siana vâta taola a taopazy ama nohlao na, vârâh khinarâh ama eih a châpa vâta.
“Chyhsa ta keima vâta cha reipachhiepa ta nata cha taolapa ta, bie pha leipa to ta â doleipa ta ama cha tei tita, nama nohlao na.
A ly u la, thaphapa ta y teh u, vârâh liata nama lymâ hluhpi a y. Cha hawhna chata, nâmo hlâta a vaw y tuapa hrohsopazy chhao ama vaw taola tyh.
“Chhaohlei alôh nama châ. Alôh cha a padâh ha khiahta cha, kheihta a iah thei khao aw? Khâpa châta hmah phahnai khao leipa aw ta, thy ta phei ta tlypâ awpa dei a châ aw.
“Khizaw khaihpa nama châ. Tlâh laki liata khih a ypa cha nyu theipa châ vei.
Chyhsa ta meiôh pakhaih sala, bai ry liata soh beih veih ei. Meiôh tôh liata soh ei ta, o chhôh liata a ypa zydua khaihna a pie tyh.
Cha hawhna chata, nama khaihna cha chyhsa mohmô ta khaih mawh sy. Chatanachata nama hmo pha taopa hmô aw ei ta, nama Paw avâ liata a ypa ama palyupalih thei aw.
“Ryhpa nata hrohsopa biezy pahleipadia awpa ta â zupa hawhta na pangiasa khuh vy. Pahleipadia awpa ta â zupa châ leipa na ta, pakisa awpa ta â zupa tlao ei châ.
Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, avâ nata alei a lei hlâlei cha, Ryhpa bie liata ropa châsâ chyh chaipa tlyma, achôpa di chaipa tlyma, ato zydua a tlôpaki khai hlâlei cha lei aw vei.

Chavâta ahy rai, he biepiepazy hry liata a chyh chaipa miakha chhao pahua ta, cha hawhta tao hra awpa ta mohropazy a pachupa cha, vârâh khinarâh liata a chyh chaipa ta reipa châ aw ta, ahy rai Ryhpa chyh chaipa chhao zyh ta, a pachupazy deikua cha, vârâh khinarâh liata rônahpa ta bipa ama châ aw.
Ei cha chho ei, nama siana cha ryhpa pachutuhpazy nata Phârisaihzy siana hlâta a sia via vei khiahta cha, vârâh khinarâh a ngia thei aw veih ei chi.
“Hlâno chyhsazy hnohta, ‘Liany na chei awpa châ vei, liany a cheihpa cha a thâtih pachiapa a châ aw,’ tahpa ta chhopa ama châpa kha nama pahno.

Kei deikua ta cha ei cha chho ei. Ahy rai a unawhpa chô liata a hie a hâhpa cha, a thâtih pachia tlâh a châ. A unawhpa ‘Dyutlaileipa’ a tahpa cha ryureina liata tlôkhei tlâh châ ta, ‘Ahrupa’ a tahpa chhao, hriena su mei lâ sie tlâh a châ.
Chavâta na hmopiepa maisâh liata na hlâ hai nota, na unawhpa ta na chô liata palôh pha leina a hneipa nâ thei khiahta cha,
na hmopiepa cha maisâh hmiakô liata soh chy la, vawh la, na unawhpa cha a kei ryh ha tua la, cha khai tawhta a vy la, na hmopiepa cha hlâ mah y.

Lyuh châ tuatuhpa nata ryureina su lâ nama sie hai nota, lâpi liata aryhna tao para ha mah y. Chataleipatala lyuh châ tuatuhpa ta ryureituhpa lâ cha hlâ aw ta, ryureituhpa ta vaituhpa lâ cha hlâ aw ta, patâhna o liata khôpa na châ pathlei aw.
Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho, na chei awpa phusâ dipa taihta na pie khai hlâlei cha, cha su tawhta pua aw va chi.
“‘Nâ phei awpa châ vei,’ ama tahpa nama thei haw.
Châhrasala ei cha chho ei, ahy rai aohraohpa ta chanô a mohpa cha, a palôh ta chanô liata â phei haw.
Na mo chachâh lâta a cha pahluasa khiahta la, khie la thy syulyu ha mah y. Na pôhpa duata hrienasu liata thypa hlâta cha, na sa pachiahpa miakha pahleipa cha a pha via.
Na ku chachâh lâta a cha pahluasa khiahta la, tai la thy ha mah y. Na pôhpa duata hrienasu liata thypa hlâta cha, na sa pachiahpa miakha pahleipa cha a pha via.
“‘Ahy rai a lapinô a mapa cha, mana châ a hnohta pie mawh sy,’ tahpa a châ.
Châhrasala ei cha chho ei, ahy rai, apheina kyh châ tlôh leipa ta, a lapinô a mapa cha, a lapinô a papheisatuhpa châ ta, ahy rai mapa chanô a hneipa cha apheipa a châ hra.
“Hlâno chyhsazy hnohta, ‘Haipa ta bie nâ taih awpa châ vei, bie nâ taihpa cha Abeipa lâta na patlô awpa a châ,’ tahpa ta chhopa ama châpa nama pahno.
Kei deikua ta cha ei cha chho ei, bie rai a taih khah u. Avâ reipa ta bie a taih khuh vy, avâ cha Khazohpa beidyuchhai châ tlôh ta.
Alei reipa ta bie a taih hra khuh vy, alei he a pheitlyna châ tlôh ta. Zerusale reipa ta bie a taih hra khuh vy, Zerusale cha Bei rônahpa khihpi châ tlôh ta.
Na luh reipa ta bie a taih hra khah y, sâbu miakha chhao papawhsa thei leipa chi ta, pavyhsa thei va chi.
Na biereipa cha, a châpa khiah ‘A châ’ tah la, a châ leipa khiah, ‘Châ vei’ tah mah y. Cha khô lâ cha moleipa tawhta a vypa a châ.
“‘Mo vyuh ta mo, hâh vyuh ta hâh,’ ama tahpa nama pahno.
Kei deikua ta cha ei cha chho ei, moleipa a dyuh khah u. Chyhsa ta na baih chachâh lâ a cha chabaih khiahta cha, hiakha lâ chhao dao mah y.
Chyhsa ta lyuh cha tua sala, na viahkao rytho a cha lapa khiahta cha, na viahkao pasipa chhao pie pâ mah y.
Chyhsa ta me kha a cha pasiesa raruah khiahta cha, a hnohta me no sie mah y.
Châ hiahpa maih pie la, dyu châ cheipa thlyu khah y.
“‘Na vaih kyhpachâ la, na chariahpa a hao mah y,’ ama tahpa nama pahno.
Kei deikua ta cha ei cha chho ei, nama chariahpazy kyh pachâ u la, châ taolatuhpazy thlahchhâpa muh vy.
Chatanachata nama Paw avâ liata a ypa sawzy nama châ aw. Ano cha chyhsa chhiepa nata phapa chô liata noh pachhisa ta, chyhsa siapa nata sialeipa chô liata chhao avâ a pasuasa tyh.
Kyh châ pachâtuhpazy deita kyh nama pachâ khiahta cha, khâpa lymâ nama hmô aw? Chhiekheituhpazy chhao ta cha hawhpa cha tao thlâh ha veih ei ma?
Nama unawhzy deita bie namâ chho khiahta cha, chyhsa hropazy hlâta nama tao viana khâpa a y? Zenitaizy chhao ta cha hawhpa cha tao thlâh ha veih ei ma?
Nama Paw avâ liata a ypa a sia pakipa hawhta, nâmo chhao nama sia paki awpa a châ.
“Chyhsa hmô awpa ta hmo pha a taopa nama châ lei nawpa ta a chado teh u. Chataleipatala nama Paw vârâh liata a ypa tawhta lymâ hmô aw veih ei chi.

“Chavâta phahlapazy hmo na pie tita, phapakheipazy ta chyhsa reithaina ama hlao thei nawpa ta, pakhyna ozy liata nata lâlaizy liata ama taopa hawhta, na hmia lâta chiahmie tô laih khah y. Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, ama lymâ ama hmô haw.
Nâ deikua cha phahlapazy hmo na pie tita, na ku chachâh lâta a taopa cha na ku chavei lâta pahno khah sy.
Chatanachata na hmopiepazy cha arulâta y aw ta, na Paw arulâta châ hmôtuhpa ta lymâ a cha pie aw.

“Thlah nama chhâ tita, phapakheipazy hawhta tao khuh vy. Âmo cha chyhsa ta ama hmô thei nawpa ta, pakhyna ozy liata nata khiliah suzy liata a duahpa ta thlah ama chhâ tyh. Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, ama lymâ ama hmô haw.
Nâ deikua cha thlah na chhâ tita, na chhôhpadâhpa lâ a ngia la, ochhi khaw la, na Paw arulâta a ypa lâta thlahchhâ mah y. Na Paw arulâta a hmôtuhpa ta a cha pie aw.
“Thlah nama chhâ tita, Zenitaizy taozie hawhta, hraoleipa biezy reih chanei ngâ thlâh ha khuh vy. Zenitaizy ta bie hluhpi ama reipa vâta ama thlahchhâpa nathliepa awpa hawhta ama pachâ.
Âmo hawhta tao khuh vy. Namâ ngiahpazy cha nama hia hlâ chhao ta nama Paw ta a pahno.
Chavâta nâmo la hetana heta thlahchhâ tyh muh vy: “‘Eima Paw vârâh liatapa, Na moh zachhih mawh sy.
Na khinarâh vaw tlô mawh sy. Na khopa vârâh liata ama taopa hawhta, Alei liata taopa châ mawh sy.
Noh chareih nie awpa miah pie mah y.
Eima chô liata hmo a paraopazy eimâ ngiahthaipa hawhta, Eima paraonazy miah ngiahthai mah y.
Reipasaona lâta miah a chhi khah y, Moleipa tawhta miah pachha mah y. Khinarâh zy, hmotaotheina zy, rônahna zy, Chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta na eih châ tlôh ta. Amen.’
“Nama chô liata hmo a paraopazy namâ ngiahthai khiahta cha, nama Paw vârâh liata a ypa ta a châ ngiahthai hra aw ei.
Nama chô liata hmo a paraopazy namâ ngiahthai vei khiahta cha, nama Paw ta nama hmoparaopazy châ ngiahthai hra aw veih ei.

“Kâhvileipa ta nama y tita, phapakheipazy hawhta thachhâna hmia phaoh khuh vy. Âmo cha kâhvileipa ta ama ypa chyhsazy ta ama pahno thei nawpa ta, thachhâna hmia ama palâsa tyh. Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, ama lymâ ama hmô haw.
Nâ deikua cha kâhvileipa ta na y tita, na luh sathaw a thu la, na hmia a pahlie mah y.
Chatanachata kâhvileipa ta na ypa cha chyhsazy ta pahno leipa aw ei ta, na Paw arulâta a ypa deita ta pahno aw ta, na Paw arulâta châ hmôtuhpa ta lymâ a cha pie aw.
“Chhoma-u nata saiiepa ta niepa ta, parutuhpazy ta a ngia ei ta ama paru theina alei liana heta ryuzy a pachô khuh vy.
Chhoma-u nata saiiepa ta a nie thei leina, parutuhpazy ta amâ ngia thei leina nata paru thei leina vârâh liata ryuzy tlao a pachô muh vy.
Na ryu yna liata na palôh chhao a y aw.
“Mokhaoh cha pôhpa meiôh a châ. Na mo a sia khiahta cha, na pôhpa duata a khaih aw.
Na mo a rao ha khiahta deikua cha, na pôhpa dua ta a zoh aw. Nâma liata khaihna cha zohna châ ha sala, zohna cha a zoh ngaita aw dia!

“Ahy hmahta abei pano chakao pabaoh thei aw veih ei. Pakha a hao aw ta, ahropa cha kyh a pachâ aw. Cha leipa chhao ta, pakha rei a ngiah aw ta, ahropa cha a mopakhô aw. Khazohpa nata khizaw sôh chakao pabaoh thei veih ei chi.

“Chavâta ei cha chho ei, nama hrona kyh liata nôpopa ta y leipa u la, nama nie awpa nata nama doh awpa kyh liata nôpopa ta y hra khah u. Nama pôhpa kyh liata nôpopa ta y leipa u la, namâ bu sai awpa kyh liata nôpopa ta y hra khah u. Niepa hlâta hrona sôh via ta, chysia hlâta pôhpa sôh via vei ma?

“Vâ pavawzy khi moh tua u: Chi cheih leipa ei ta, hria hra leipa ei ta, sawvâ liata ryh hra veih ei. Châhrasala nama Paw vârâh liata a ypa ta a pasa lymâ ei. Nâmo cha âmo hlâta sôh via syulyu veih ei chi ma?
Nama hry liata ahy ma pachârôhpa vâta a doh dy kha a paseihsa via thei?
Khazia abu asai kyh liata nama nô a po? Râh liata lilipawzy pachâ tua u, kheihta ma ama laiseih? Hriapasa leipa ei ta, pala so hra veih ei.
Châhrasala ei cha chho ei, Sawlawmaw tlai chhao kha a rônahna zydua liana khata, he pawpi miakha tlu ta a ngiapa ta a tobi vei.

Hy nâmo, ngiapâ chyhpa saih u, râh liata sibiepa tanoh hroh ta, mylâ mei liata thy thlâh ha awpa hmahta Khazohpa ta cha tlatlu ta a tobi khiahta cha, nâmo chhochhi cha, cha tobi via syulyu aw veih ei ma?
“Chavâta ‘Khâpa eima nie aw?’ ‘Khâpa eima doh aw?’ ‘Khâpa eimâ tobi aw?’ tahpa ta nôpopa ta y khuh vy.
Zenitaizy ta cha hmo zydua cha ama tlua tyh. Cha zydua cha namâ ngiahpa a châ tahpa nama Paw vârâh liata a ypa ta a pahno.
Khazohpa khinarâh nata a siana tlua tua u la, cha hmo zydua cha baichhapa nama châ aw.
“Chavâta mylâ châta nôpopa ta y khuh vy. Mylâ cha anosasyh ta â pachâ chhyh aw. Noh kha châta noh kha nôpo â daih.
“Sei khuh vy, seipa ta nama y lei nawpa ta.
Nama seipa hawhta cha sei aw ei ta, nama panuapa hawhta ama cha panuapa aw.
Khazia nâma mo liata pâkô a ypa hmô leipa chi ta, na unawhpa mo liata mobâ na hmô?
Nâma mo liata pâkô a y thlâh ha nota, kheihta ma na unawhpa hnohta, ‘Mobâ kha cha vaw thaopa haw sah,’ na tah thei aw?
Nâ, phapakheipa, nâma mo liata pâkô kha la ha tua la, chatanachata na unawhpa mo liata mobâ cha a siapa ta hmô aw chi ta, na thaopa thei aw.
“Izy cha hmo pathaihpa pie leipa u la, vaozy hmiakô liata nama taikuh lôsôhpazy thy hra khuh vy. Ama phei ta tly aw ei ta, ama châ liehnao pathlei aw.
“Hiah teh u, piepa nama châ aw. Tlua teh u, nama hmô aw. Chakhyh teh u, pahypa nama châ aw.
A hiahpa maihta piepa châ ei ta, a tluapa ta hmô ta, a chakhyhpa cha pahypa a châ.
Nama hry liata ahy ma a sawchapawpa ta viahchhâ hiah sala, alô a pie aw?
Nga hiah sala, parih a pie aw?

Nâmo, moleipazy chi hmahta, nama sawzy hmo phapa piena châh nama pahno khiahta cha, nama Paw vârâh liata a ypa chhochhi ta cha, kha tlu ta hluh viapa ta ma a hiahtuhpazy hnohta hmo phapa a pie aw tly!
Chavâta chyhsa ta nama chô liata ama tao awpa nama khopa hawhta, chyhsa chô liata tao hra muh vy. Cha cha ryhpa nata hrohsopazy bie a châ.
“Chhikao buahpa liata a ngia teh u. Leidiana lâta siena chhikao cha kawh ta, a sie nao ta, cha lâta â ngiapa cha ama hluh ngaita.
Hrona lâ siena chhikao deikua cha buah ta, a sie ru ta, cha lâta a siepa cha ama chyhta.
“Hrohso pakheipazy tawhta a vaih muh vy. Chazy cha mietaku vo a bupa ta nâmo lâ a vy ei ta, ama chhôh lâ deikua cha changie chahraochatôhpazy ama châ.
Ama thei tawhta nama pahno aw. Ahloh liata kre thei ama lyu beih ma? Diahsai liata theiku ama lyu beih ma?
Tho phapa ta thei phapa pathei ta, tho chhiepa ta thei chhiepa a pathei.
Tho phapa ta thei chhiepa pathei beih leipa ta, tho chhiepa ta thei phapa pathei beih vei.
Thei phapa a pathei leipa tho maih cha thlupa châ ta, mei liata thypa a châ tyh.
Cha hawhna chata, hrohso pakheipazy chhao ama thei tawhta nama pahno aw.
“ ‘Abeipa, Abeipa,’ nâ tahpa maihta, vârâh khinarâh a ngia leipa aw ei ta, ei Paw vârâh liata a ypa khopa a taotuhpa deita ta â ngia aw.
Cha noh liata chyhsa hluhpi ta ei hnohta, ‘Abeipa, Abeipa, na moh ta hrohsona bie phuah ma pi ma, na moh ta ahripazy papua ma pi ma, na moh ta hmonoâhpa hluhpi tao ma pi ma?’ ama tah aw.
Cha tina chata ama hnohta, ‘Nâmo, moleina hmo a taopazy saih u, cha pahno beih veih ei na, na siesai teh u,’ ei tah aw ei.
“Ei biezy he thei ta a taopa maih cha, chyhsa sopa, lôpanô chô liata o a sapa hawhta a châ.
Avâ suah ta, ti vaw lai ta, thlih ta o vaw su ta, châhrasala o cha cho vei, lôpanô chô liata bôpa a châpa vâta.
Ei biezy thei ta a tao leipazy deikua cha, chyhsa hrupa, sadi chô liata o a sapa hawhta ama châ.
Avâ vaw suah ta, ti vaw lai ta, thlih ta o cha vaw su ta, o cha a cho haw. O chopa cha a rarôh y ngaita,” tah ta.
Cha biezy cha Zisu ta a reih khai nahta, zawpizy cha a pachuna bie vâta ama noâh kaw ta.
Ryhpa pachutuhpazy hawhta châ leipa ta, biehneina a hneipa hawhta a pachupa vâta a châ.
Zisu cha tlâh tawhta a za chô nahta, zawpi hluhpi ta ano cha zi ei ta.
Phawhpa pakha a hnohta a vy ta, a hmiakô liata a bôh ta, a hnohta, “Abeipa, na khoh khiahta la eina pathaisa thei chi na,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a ku ta kei paza ta, phawhpa cha hria ta, a hnohta, “Ei khoh na, pathaih mah y,” tah ta. Phawhpa cha thlai pathaih ha ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Ahy hmahta chho lei awpa ta a sohsi mah y. Anodeikuacha ama zo thei nawpa ta, sie la, theihthaipa a kei pamosa la, Mawsi ta hmo hlâ awpa a raopa kha kei hlâ mah y,” tah ta.
Zisu cha Kâpynia khih â ngia nahta, pheisaih za kha hyutuhpa a vy ta, a hnohta,
“Abeipa, nâ chakaotuhpa asypa cha o liata a zia thlâh ha ta, a pasa ngaita,” tah ta, patlâh awpa ta a haw ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “A vy aw na ta, ei patlâh aw,” tah ta.
Pheisaih za kha hyutuhpa ta, “Abeipa, ei o nâ ngia tlâh châ va na. Bie kawh kha reih la, nâ chakaotuhpa cha a tlâh aw.

Kei chhao he biehneina a chabatuhpa châ na ta, ei ry liata pheisaihzy ama y hra. Pheisaih pakha hnohta, ‘Sie teh,’ tah na ta, sie ta, ahropa hnohta, ‘A vy teh,’ tah na ta, a vy ta, nâ chakaotuhpa hnohta, ‘He he tao teh,’ tah na ta, a tao tyh,” tah ta.
Zisu ta cha bie cha a thei nahta, a noâh kaw ta, a pachupazy hnohta, “Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, he tlu ta ngiapâna thatlôpa he Izarei liata pakha hmah hmô va na.
Ei cha chho ei, nochhi notla tawhta chyhsa hluhpi a vy aw ei ta, Abarahâ, Aisika nata Zakaw zy hnohta vârâh khinarâh liata amâ tyuh aw.
Khinarâh sawzy hawhta â pachâpazy deikua cha, khôtho lâ zohna liata thypa châ aw ei ta, cha liata chana nata hâh chariehna a y aw,” tah ta.
Zisu ta pheisaih za kha hyutuhpa hnohta, “Sie mah y. Nâ ngiapâna hawhta na châta taopa a châ aw,” tah ta. Chatanachata chakaotuhpa cha, cha dawh liana tlai chata tlâh ha ta.
Zisu Pity o liata â ngia nahta, a pihnô cha chasipa ta â zia thlâh hapa hmô ta.
A ku hria ta, a chasipa cha pai ha ta, thyu ta Zisu cha chakao pâ ha ta.
Zâlâ a vaw châ nahta, ahripa patupa hluhpi a vaw chhi ei ta, bie ta ahripazy cha papua ta, tlâh leipa zydua patlâh lymâ ta.
Cha hmo cha hrohsopa Isai ta, “Ano ta eima pasanazy a la ta, eima hriiahzy miah a phaopa,” tahpa ta a reipa kha a vaw tlô thei nawpa ta a châ.
Zisu ta a kiapâh liata zawpi hluhpi a hmô nahta, haosâ lâ chaka awpa ta biepie ta.
Ryhpa pachutuhpa pakha a vy ta a hnohta, “Pachutuhpa, na siena lâ maih ei cha zi aw,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Changiezy ta khaoh hnei ei ta, vâ pavawzy ta bu ama hnei. Chyhsa Sawchapawpa deikua cha luh nyu nawpa su chhao hnei vei,” tah ta.
Pachupa hropa pakha ta a hnohta, “Abeipa, ei paw kei pabu ha tua awpa na pasaih mah y,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Na zi teh, athihpazy ta ama chyhsa athipazy cha pabu mawh ei sy,” tah ta.
Zisu cha balyh liata a kiah nahta, a pachupazy ta ano cha pazi ei ta.
Tipo liata thlihpi ru ngaitapa vaw pathli ta, ama balyh cha tichatlaopa ta vao ha ta. Zisu deikua cha a mô thlâh ha ta.
A pachupazy a vy ei ta, Zisu cha pahra ei ta, “Abeipa, miah pachha teh, eima leidia hai hih,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Ngiapâna chyhpa saih u, khazia nama chi?” tah ta. Thyu ta thlihzy nata tichatlaopa cha ra ta, sidia ha ta.
Chyhsazy cha ama noâh kaw ta, “He chyhsa he kheihawhpa chyhsa ma a châ tly, thlihzy nata tichatlaopazy taihta a rei amâ ngiahpa he,” tah ei ta.
Haosâ Kâdarene râh a tlô nahta, ahripa patupa pano thlâ tawhta vaw pua ei ta, Zisu cha a vaw tyh ei ta. A hrâh ngâsâ ei ta, chavâta cha lâpi liana cha ahy hmahta ama sie ngâh tyh leipa a châ.
Thata awh ei ta, “Khazohpa Sawchapawpa, kheihta miah tao awpa ma na khoh? Noh taihpa tlô hlâta riethei miah pataosa awpa ta ma nâ vy?” tah ei ta.
Ama yna tawhta a hla kawpa liata vao zaw hluhpi ama lao chuah ei ta.
Ahripazy ta a haw ei ta, a hnohta, “Miah na papua awpa khiahta cha, vao zawzy py chhôh liata miah pangiasa mah y,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Sie teh u,” tah ta. Chatawhcha vaw pua ei ta, vaozy chhôh liana cha a ngia ei ta, vao zaw zydua cha tilaipi ngiahkâ pâdawhpa lâ a râ ei ta, ti liata tlasao khai ha ei ta.
Vao pasatuhpazy cha a râ ei ta, khihpi a ngia ei ta, ato chho ei ta. Ahripa patupazy chô liata hmo a tlôpazy chhao chho ei ta.
A khihpi ta Zisu a tyh awpa ta vaw pua ei ta, ama hmô nahta, ama bia puasai awpa ta a haw ei ta.
Zisu cha balyh liata kiah ta, haosâ lâ chaka ta, ano khih lâ sie ta.

Chyhsa thokha ta asypa pakha a rakhô chhaota ano lâ a vaw sy ei ta. Zisu ta amâ ngiapâna a hmô nahta, asypa hnohta, “Ei sawchapawpa, thlalôhpa ta y mah y, na moleinazy a ngiahthaipa a châ haw,” tah ta.
Ryhpa pachutuhpa thokhazy ta ama palôhrupa ta, “He chyhsa heta Khazohpa a reipachhie he,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama pachânazy cha pahnopa ta, “Khazia nama palôh liata hmo moleipa nama pachâ?
Kheihawhpa ma a rei a nao via aw, ‘Na moleinazy a ngiahthaipa a châ haw,’ tahpa ma, ‘Thyu la sie teh,’ tahpa maw?

He hmo he, chyhsa Sawchapawpa he moleinazy a ngiahthai theina biehneina khizaw liata a hnei tahpa nama pahno nawpa ta taopa a châ,” tah ta. Asypa hnohta, “Thyu la, na hmohphaw la la, na o lâ a di teh,” tah ta.
Asypa cha thyu ta, a o lâ a di ha ta.
Zawpizy ta cha cha ama hmô nahta, chi ngaita ei ta, chyhsapazy hnohta cha hawhpa biehneina a pietuhpa Khazohpa cha reithai ei ta.
Cha su tawhta Zisu cha sie lymâ ta, chhie kheina su liata atyuhpa chyhsa pakha a moh Mathai ama tahpa hmô ta, a hnohta, “Na zi teh,” tah ta. Thyu ta, zi ha ta.
O liata pati ama dôh hai nota, chhiekheituhpa nata moleipa hluhpi a vy ei ta, Zisu nata a pachupazy cha pati dôh lâh ei ta.
Phârisaihzy ta cha cha ama hmô nahta, a pachupazy hnohta, “Khazia nama pachutuhpa heta chhiekheituhpazy nata moleipazy pati a dôh lâh thlâh ha ei?” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta cha bie cha a thei nahta, ama hnohta, “Atlâhpazy ta dawhty a ngiah leipa ei ta, tlâhleipazy ta amâ ngiah.
Vawh u la, ‘Atheihna khoh leipa na ta, zawngiahna ei khoh,’ tahpa bie yzie cha a kei chu teh u. Chyhsa siapazy pado awpa ta a zupa châ leipa na ta, moleipazy pado awpa ta a zupa tlao ei châ,” tah ta.
Zawhâna pachupazy a hnohta a vy ei ta, “Khazia keimo nata Phârisaihzy he kâhvileipa ta y tyh pi ta, na pachupazy he kâhvileipa ta ama y hra vei?” tah ei ta.

Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Myuhneituhpa a y thlâh ha nota, ahneina kyhchhi a hlaopazy mâchhie ama sa aw ma? Ama hry tawhta myuhneituhpa lana daihti vaw tlô aw ta, cha tita deikua cha kâhvileipa ta ama y aw.
Ahy hmahta pohthâ thiehpa ta chysia parohpa baithla beih veih ei. Ama baithla khiahta cha, a baithlana ta chysia parohpa cha hrie aw ta, â hrie lao ha aw.

Savo titheih parohpa liata kresawhti thiehpa ryh beih hra veih ei. Ama ryh khiahta cha, savo titheih cha pa aw ta, kresawhti a leih aw ta, savo titheih cha a parao ha aw. Kresawhti thiehpa cha savo titheih thiehpa liata ama ryh tyh, chatanachata amâ boh raihrie aw,” tah ta.

Cha biezy cha Zisu ta ama hnohta a rei hai nota, ryureituhpa pakha a vy ta, a hmiakô liata a bôh ta, a hnohta, “Tahmâ tlai kha ei sawchanô thi ta, châhrasala a vy la, a chô liata na ku pahnieh la, a hroh heih aw,” tah ta.
Zisu cha thyu ta, a pachupazy chhaota ryureituhpa cha pazi ei ta.
Chanô pakha kô hrawh hleino thi lohpa ta tlâhleipa ta a hnôh lâta pazi ta, a poh pai hria ta,
“A poh pai chhâ ei hria khiahta cha, patlâhpa ta ei y aw,” tahpa ta pachâ ta.
Zisu cha a vaw heih ta, chanô cha hmô ta, a hnohta, “Ei sawchanô, thlalôhpa ta y mah y. Nâ ngiapâna ta a cha patlâh haw,” tah ta. Cha dawh liana chata chanô cha patlâhpa ta y ha ta.
Zisu cha ryureituhpa o a tlô nahta, ramo tôtuhpazy nata zawpi a tymâ ngaitapazy hmô ta,
ama hnohta, “Pua teh u, hawtinô he thi vei, â môpa a châ hih,” tah ta. Zisu cha pahneisao ei ta.
Châhrasala zawpizy cha khôtho lâ ama pua khai nahta, a ngia ta, hawtinô cha a ku ta patu ta, kaw thyu ha ta.
Cha thâtih cha, a chheipâh râh zydua liata pathâh ta.
Cha su tawhta Zisu cha sie lymâ ta, mochaopa pano ta ano pazi ei ta, “Dâvi Sawchapawpa, miah ngiachhie teh,” tahpa ta ao paro ngaitapa ta awh ei ta.
O chhôh lâ â ngia nahta, mochaopazy cha a hnohta a vy ei ta, Zisu ta ama hnohta, “He hmo he ei tao thei tahpa namâ ngiapâ ma?” tah ta. Âmo ta a hnohta, “Abeipa y, eimâ ngiapâ na” tah ei ta.
Ama mo cha hria ta, ama hnohta, “Namâ ngiapâna hawhta nama chô liata vaw tlô mawh sy,” tah ta.
Ama mo vaw pavâ ha ta. Zisu ta âmo cha zikyu a râ ta, ama hnohta, “Ahy hmahta pahno lei awpa ta a sohsi muh vy,” tah ta.
Châhrasala sie ei ta, a thâtih cha, cha râh chhôh zydua liata tlao pathâhsa lymâ ha ei ta.
Chyhsazy ama pua nahta, ahripa patupa reih pathlie thei leipa a hnohta a vaw chhi ei ta.
Ahripa a puapa nahta, reih pathlie thei leipa cha a reih pathlie thei ha ta. Zawpizy cha ama noâh ngaita ta, “He hawhpa he Izarei liata hmô beih ma pi,” tah ei ta.
Phârisaihzy deikua ta, “Ahripa bei a châpa vâta ahripazy a papua theipa a châ hih,” tah ei ta.
Zisu cha khihpi nata khitaw zydua chahryh ta, amâ pakhyna ozy liata pachupa ta khinarâh thâtihpha phuah lymâ ta. Hriiah to nata pasana to patlâh ta.
Zawpizy a hmô nahta, vaituhpa hnei leipa mietakuzy hawhta, nôpopa nata baotuhpa hnei leipa ta ama ypa vâta, âmo cha a thapasa ngaita ta.
A pachupazy hnohta, “Sâh hria awpa hluhpi y ta, hriatuhpazy deikua ama chyh.
Chavâta sâh hria awpa ta hriatuhpazy a vaw tuah thei nawpa ta, sâh hria Beipa lâ hiah teh u,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a pachupa pahrawh hleinozy aw ta, thlahpa puapazy papua thei awpa nata hriiah to nata pasana to patlâh thei awpa ta âmo cha biehneina pie ta.
Lyuhchâpa pahrawh hleinozy moh cha hezy he ama cha: A hmiatua chai ta, Saimaw, Pity ama bipa nata a unawhpa Adaru; Zebâdi sawchapawpa Zâmie nata a unawhpa Zawhâna;
Phili nata Bâthawlawmu; Thawma nata chhiekheituhpa Mathai; Alphu sawchapawpa Zâmie nata Thâdia;
Zilô py liatapa Saimaw nata a patusatuhpa Zudâh Iskari zy ama châ.
He pahrawh hleinozy he Zisu ta tuah ta, ama hnohta hetana heta bie a pie ei: “Zenitaizy lâpi lâta sie leipa u la, Samâri khihpi liata chhao a ngia hra leipa u la,
Izarei phopi mietaku a leipazy lâta tlao sie teh u.
Nama siena liata, ‘Vârâh khinarâh cha â hnia haw,’ tahpa ta chho lymâ teh u.
Tlâhleipazy patlâh u la, athipazy pathyu u la, phawhpazy pathaisa u la, ahripazy papua teh u. A saipa ta hmô ei chi ta, a saipa ta pie teh u.
Nama chaisaihna liata ngôh tlyma, tâkâ tlyma, dawh tlyma a phao leipa u la,
nama khitlyna sahria tlyma, viahkao pasipa zo no tlyma, pheikyzy tlyma, chôchahrei tlyma a phao hra khah u. Raihriatuhpa cha a nie tlâh a châ.
Khihpi liata tlyma, khitaw liata tlyma namâ ngia tita, cha liata tlô tlâh a châpa chyhsa tlua u la, nama sie hlâlei cha, cha liata y teh u.
O namâ ngia tita a naoh teh u.

Cha o liata chyhsazy cha a naoh tlâh ama châ khiahta cha, nama thlapalôhna bie ama chô liata tlô sala, a naoh tlâh ama châ vei khiahta deikua cha, nama thlapalôhna bie cha nâmo lâ vaw kua heih mawh sy.
Ahy rai châ ly leipa tlyma, nama biezy a nathlie leipa tlyma cha, cha o tawhta tlyma, cha khih tawhta tlyma nama pua tita, nama phei liata buchadoh chatho thlu teh u.
Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, ryureina noh liata, cha khih hlâta Sawdawmâ nata Kawmawrâ pasa taopa a zie a y via aw.
“Pachâ teh u, changie hry liata mietaku hawhta ei cha tua ei hih. Chavâta parihzy hawhta so u la, vachhuhzy hawhta nônaipa ta y teh u.
Chyhsazy tawhta a vaih teh u. Ryureina lâ cha hlâ aw ei ta, pakhyna ozy liata ama cha tu aw.
Zenitaizy hmiakô liata bie pahnotuhpazy châ awpa ta, keima vâta ryureituhpazy nata abeizy hmiakô liata ama châ chhi aw.
Ama cha patu tita, ‘Kheihta ma bie eima reih aw, khâpa bie ma eima reih aw,’ tahpa ta nama nôpo khah sy. Nama rei awpa cha a daihtita liata piepa nama châ aw.
Bie a reih awpa cha nâmo châ veih ei chi, nama Paw Thlahpa ta nâmo hmâpa ta tlao a reih aw.
Thie awpa ta, unawhpa ta a unawhpa patusa aw ta, paw ta a saw a patusa aw. Sawzy ta nôpawzy a dyuh aw ei ta, ama pathiesa aw.
Ei moh vâta chyhsa to a haopa ta y aw ei chi ta, achhâna taihta â ipa ta a duahpa cha pachhapa ta a y aw.
Khihpi miakha liata ama cha taola tita, khihpi hropa lâ a râ teh u. Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, Chyhsa Sawchapawpa â vy hlâta Izarei khihpi zydua chahryh khai hmâ aw veih ei chi.
“Pachupa cha a pachutuhpa chô lâta y leipa ta, sei chhao a zibeipa chô lâta y vei.
Pachupa cha ano pachutuhpa a lyupa a daih ta, sei ta a zibeipa a lyupa â daih. O hneituhpa hmahta Belzebu ama tah khiahta cha, a chhôhkhazy chhochhi cha khatlu ta ma ama reipachhie via aw tly!
“Chavâta âmo cha chi khuh vy. A lâ lei awpa ta khupa khâpa hmah y leipa ta, pahno lei awpa ta phihpa khâpa hmah y vei.
Zohna liata ei cha chhopa ei he, khaihna liata reih u la, bieparu ta nama theipa kha, vâphuh chô tawhta awh teh u.
Pôhpa thie thei ta, thlahpa a thie thei leipazy chi leipa u la, hrienasu liata pôhpa nata thlahpa a pahleipadia theipa cha tlao chi teh u.
Boby pô no phusâ miakha ta zuapa châ vei ma? Ama hry liata pô kha chhao nama Paw paryhsana leipa ta alei liata tla aw vei.
Nama luh liata sâ zydua chhao reih khaipa a châ.
Chavâta chi khuh vy, boby hluhpi hlâta nama sôh via.
“Ahy rai chyhsa hmiakô liata nâ châhkheipa cha, ei Paw vârâh liata a ypa hmiakô liata a châhkhei aw na ta,
ahy rai chyhsa hmiakô liata nâ paphapa cha, ei Paw vârâh liata a ypa hmiakô liata ei papha hra aw.
“Khizaw liata adyhna chareisa awpa ta a vypa hawhta na pachâ khuh vy. Adyhna chareisa awpa châ leipa ta, zaozi chareisa awpa ta a vypa tlao ei châ.
Sawchapaw ta a paw, sawchanô ta a nô, myuhnô a nohnô padyuhsa awpa ta a vypa ei châ.
Chyhsa chariahpazy cha ano chhôhkhapa cheingei tawhta ama châ aw.
Kei hlâta a paw tlyma, a nô tlyma kyh a pachâ viapa cha, ei chyhsa tlâh châ vei. Kei hlâta a sawchapaw tlyma, a sawchanô tlyma kyh a pachâ viapa chhao, ei chyhsa tlâh châ vei.
Ahy rai a kraws a piapa ta nâ zi leipa cha, ei chyhsa tlâh châ vei.
Ahy rai a hrona a hmôpa ta a hrona pahlei aw ta, keima vâta a hrona a pahleipa ta a hrona a hmô heih aw.
“Ahy rai nâmo châ lypa cha keima nâ lypa châ ta, ahy rai kei nâ lypa cha nâ tuahtuhpa a lypa a châ.
Ahy rai hrohsopa cha hrohsopa a châpa vâta a lypa cha, hrohsopa lymâ hmô aw ta, chyhsa siapa cha chyhsa siapa a châpa vâta a lypa chhao, chyhsa siapa lymâ a hmô aw.
Ahy rai, he chyhsa chyhpatazy hry liata pakha hnohta, ei pachupa a châpa vâta ti chakuapa nyu kha a piepa cha, hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, a lymâ pahlei cheita aw vei.”
Zisu cha a pachupa pahrawh hleinozy bie a pie khai tawhta, ama khihpizy liata pachu awpa nata bie chho awpa ta, cha su tawhta pua ta.
Krista hmotaopazy cha, Zawhâna ta patâhna o tawhta a vaw pahno nahta, a pachupazy tuah ta,
Zisu hnohta, “A vy awpa cha na châ ma, ahropa eima hâ aw ma?” tahpa ta pahiahrisa ta.
Zisu ta âmo cha a chhy ta, “Sie u la, nama theipa nata hmôpazy he Zawhâna kei chho teh u:
Mochaopazy ama mo pavâ ta, pheisypazy phei ta sie ei ta, phawhpazy pathaisapa ta y ei ta, nahpâpazy ta thei ei ta, athipazy pathyupa ta y ei ta, dyhchhiepazy hnohta thâtihpha chhopa a châ haw.
Ei chô liata palôhchâ leina a hnei leipa chyhsa cha a nohlao na,” tah ta.
Zawhâna pachupazy ama sie nahta, Zisu ta zawpi hnohta Zawhâna thâtih reih ta: “Khâpa mo awpa ta ma râhchawhpa lâ nama sie? Ziza ta lohthi a chalyupa mo awpa ta ma?
Khâpa mo awpa ta ma nama pua tly? Chysia naipa ta a tobipa chyhsa mo awpa ta ma? Chysia phapa ta a tobipazy cha abei ozy liata mah ama y tâh.
Cha khiah, khâpa mo awpa ta ma nama pua? Hrohsopa mo awpa ta ma? Ano cha hrohsopa a châ tlai, ei cha chho ei, hrohsopa hlâta rônah viapa a châ.
“‘Moh teh u, ei lyuhchâpa na hmia lâta tuah na ta, Ano ta na hmia lâta na lâpi â chhuahdy aw!’ tahpa ta a thâtih ropa kha, ano he a châ.
Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, chanô sapazy hry liata Bâtituhpa Zawhâna hlâta rônah viapa pua veih ei. Chatahrasala vârâh khinarâh liata chyhsa nawh chaipa cha ano hlâta a rônah via.
Bâtituhpa Zawhâna daihti tawhta tahmâ taihta vârâh khinarâh cha thachahra ta adyuhna vâta pasa tao lymâ ta, thachahra a hmâhpazy ta tararuahna ta ama la lymâ.
Zawhâna a vaw pua hlâna khata, hrohsopa zydua nata Ryhpa bie ta ama vaw chhochhielie haw.
Cha cha nama zo khoh khiahta cha, ano he Elaizâh a vy awpa cha a châ.
Theina nakhaoh a hneipa ta thei mawh sy.
“He chhâ he khâpa nata ma ei pakho aw tly? Hawtizy sôdaohna su liata a tyuh ei ta, ama viasazy ama awpa a lyu.
“‘Ramo cha tôpa pi ta, Lâh leipa ei chi ta; Chaphôh cha tupa pi ta, Mâchhiesa hlei veih ei chi.’
“Zawhâna a vy ta, nie leipa ta, doh hra leipa ta, ‘Ahripa a hnei,’ tah ei ta.

Chyhsa Sawchapawpa a vy ta, nie ta, doh ta, ‘Moh tua u, azohpa nata kresawhti parâpa, chhiekheituhpazy nata moleipazy viasa huh!’ tah heih ei ta. Châhrasala sona cha a hmotaopazy tawhta â dozie â lâ tyh,” tah ta.
Hmonoâhpa a tao hluh chaina khihpizy cha, ama ro leipa vâta ra ta.
“Kôrâzi, na hu a po na! Besaidâ, na hu a po na! Nâmo liata hmonoâhpa taopazy kha, Tyre nata Sidaw liata taopa châ sala, latho poh a bupa ta, buchâh a mia aw ei ta, ama ro ha awpa tlai.
Châhrasala ei cha chho ei, ryureina noh liata la nâmo pasa taopa hlâta Tyre nata Sidaw pasa tao awpa a zie a y via aw.

Nâ, Kâpynia, avâ taihta palyupalihpa ta na y aw ma? Athihkhih lâ a daophi pathlahpa na châ aw. Nâma liata hmonoâhpa taopazy kha, Sawdawmâ liata taopa châ sala, Sawdawmâ kha tanoh taihta a y thlâh ha awpa tlai.
Châhrasala ei cha chho ei, ryureina noh liata la, nâma pasa taopa hlâta Sawdawmâ râh pasa taopa a zie a y via aw,” tah ta.
Cha daihti liata Zisu ta, “Hy ei Paw, lei nata vâ Beipa, nâ ta he hmozy he chyhsa sopa nata novâhpazy liata nyu chi ta, hawti chyhpazy hnohta na phuahpa vâta ei châ ly ngaita.
A châ na, ei Paw, cha hawhpa cha na khopa châ tlôh ta.
Ei Paw ta ato zydua eina hlâ haw. Paw dei leipa ta cha, ahy hmahta Sawchapawpa he pahno leipa ei ta, Sawchapawpa nata ano ta a hnohta a palâhâhpa tah dei leipa ta cha, ahy hmahta Paw pahno veih ei.
Nâmo, hriapasapa nata phaohripa zydua saih u, kei lâ a vy u la, ei cha pahâsa aw ei.
Ei raopaky a ky u la, kei tawhta a chu teh u. Kei cha areisipa nata palôh nônaipa ei châ. Nama thlahpazy châta apahâna nama hmô aw.
Ei raopaky cha pha ta, ei phao chhao â hua,” tah ta.
Cha daihti liata, Zisu cha Pahânoh ta sâh thihzy chapiapa ta sie ta. A pachupazy cha ama nodi kaw ta, sâh suhzy thliepa ta nie ei ta.
Phârisaihzy ta ama hmô nahta, a hnohta, “Moh tua, na pachupazy ta Pahânoh ta tao lei awpa hmo ama tao,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Dâvi nata a hnohta a ypazy ta ama nodi nota ama hmotaopa kha reih beih veih ei chi ma?
Khazohpa o liata a ngia ta, ano nata a hnohta a ypazy châta nie pasai leipa, theihthaipazy deita nie theipa Ypâna Viahchhâ ama niepa kyh kha thei beih veih ei chi ma?
Theihthaipazy ta Pahânoh ta Achhyna o liata Pahânoh parao ei ta thai ama châ thlâh hapa kyh Ryhpa bie liata ropa chhao kha, reih beih veih ei chi ma?
Ei cha chho ei, Achhyna o hlâta hmo rônah viapa he liata a y.
‘Atheihna khoh leipa na ta, zawngiahna ei khoh,’ tahpa he a yzie a pahnopasiapa châ u la cha, thaileina a hnei leipa thailei nama pachâsa lei awpa tlai.
Chyhsa Sawchapawpa he Pahânoh Beipa châ tlôh ta,” tah ta.
Zisu cha, cha su tawhta sie ta, amâ pakhyna o liata a ngia ta.
Chyhsa pakha ku sypa y ta, Zisu ama leih thei nawpa ta a hnohta, “Pahânoh ta chyhsa patlâhpa he Ryhpa ta a pasaih ma?” tahpa ta hiahri ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Chyhsa ta mietaku pô kha hnei sala, cha cha Pahânoh ta khaohtlô liata tla ha sala, nama hry liata ahy ma pazapa ta a thaoh leipa a y aw ei chi?
Mietaku hlâta chyhsapa cha sôh via syulyu vei ma? Chavâta Pahânoh ta hmo pha taopa cha Ryhpa ta a pasaih,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha chyhsa hnohna chata, “Na ku pazawh teh,” tah ta. A ku pazawh ta, a ku hiakha lâtapa hawhta vaw tlâh ha ta.
Phârisaihzy deikua cha pua ei ta, ano ama pahleipadia thei nawpa ta bie a pachia ei ta.
Amâ chhuahpa cha a pahno nahta, Zisu cha, cha su tawhta sie ha ta. Chyhsa hluhpi ta ano cha zi ei ta, ama zydua ta patlâh ta.
A châna phuah lei awpa ta âmo cha biepie ta.
Cha hmo cha hrohsopa Isai ta,
“Moh teh u, he he ei tlyhpa nâ chakaotuhpa châ ta, Ei kho ngaitapa nata a chô liata ei thlahpa â ly kawpa a châ. A chô liata ei Thlahpa soh aw na ta, Zenitaizy hnohta ryureina dopa a phuah aw.
Chyhsa a hryuh leipa aw ta, Awhsâh hra leipa aw ta, Tlyliah liata a ao a theipa y aw veih ei.
Lohthi tliepa-ipa thlie lao leipa aw ta, Meiôh thi daihmâpa pachhai lao aw vei; Ryureina dopa pahniena a patosa hlâlei cha,
Ano moh liata Zenitaizy ama hnabei a seih aw,” tahpa ta a reipa a vaw tlô thei nawpa ta a châ.
Chatawhcha ahripa ta a patupa, mochaopa nata reih pathlie thei leipa pakha a hnohta a vaw chhi ei ta. Zisu ta ano cha patlâh ta, reih pathlie thei leipa cha reih pathlie theipa ta, a mo pavâ ha ta.
Zawpi zydua cha ama noâh ngaita ta, “He he Dâvi Sawchapawpa a châ thei aw ma?” tah ei ta.
Phârisaihzy deikua ta cha thâtih cha ama thei nahta, “He chyhsa heta ahripazy hyutuhpa Belzebu vâta ahripazy a papua theipa a châ hih,” tah ei ta.

Ama pachâpazy a pahno nahta, Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Khinarâh a chhaihzaoh ta âmo nata âmo a dyuhpa maih cha rao tyh ei ta, khihpi tlyma, chhôhkha tlyma, a chhaihzaoh ta âmo nata âmo a dyuhpa maih a duah aw veih ei.
Sâtâ ta Sâtâ a papua khiahta cha, ano nata ano â dyuhpa châ ta, kheihta a khinarâh â duah thei aw?
Kei ta Belzebu moh ta ahripazy ei papua khiahta cha, nama sawchapawzy kha ahy moh ta ma ahripazy ama papua tyh? Chavâta âmo cha châ pachiatuhpazy ama châ aw.
Khazohpa Thlahpa vâta ahripazy a papuapa ei châ khiahta deikua cha, Khazohpa khinarâh cha nama chô liata a vaw tlô hapa a châ.
Chyhsa ta chyhsa thatlôpa o liata a ngia sala, cha chyhsa thatlôpa cha a chahry ha tua leipa khiahta cha, kheihta a hmozy a hrao thei aw? A chahry khai tawhta a o cha a hrao thei aw.
Ei chhâh a châ leipa cha nâ dyuhtuhpa châ ta, nâ pahmaohkhei leipa cha a papaituhpa a châ.
Chavâta ei cha chho ei, chyhsa moleina to nata Khazohpa ama reipachhiena cha a ngiahthaipa châ aw ta, Thlahpa reipachhiepa deikua cha, a ngiahthaipa châ aw vei.
Chyhsa Sawchapawpa a reipachhiepa cha a ngiahthaipa châ aw ta, Thlahpa Pathaihpa a reipachhiepa deikua cha, he chhâ nata chhâ vaw y awpa liata chhao, a ngiahthaipa châ aw vei.
“Tho phapa cha a thei pha ta, tho chhiepa cha a thei a chhie. Tho cha a thei tawhta pahnopa a châ.
Vâzi pathlazy saih u, nâmo moleipazy ta kheihta hmo phapa nama reih thei aw? Palôh liata a bie pakhôpa cha pakah ta a reih papua tyh.
Chyhsa phapa ta a ryubyh phapa tawhta hmo phapa papua tyh ta, chyhsa chhiepa ta a ryubyh chhiepa tawhta hmo chhiepa a papua tyh.
Ei cha chho ei, chyhsazy ta bie pha leipa ama reipa maih cha, ryureina noh liata amâ reipasia awpa a châ.
Na biezy vâta thai châ aw chi ta, na biezy lilaw ta thailei pachâsapa na châ aw,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha ryhpa pachutuhpa nata Phârisaih thokhazy ta a hnohta, “Pachutuhpa, nâma tawhta ngiana hmô awpa eima khoh,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta âmo cha a chhy ta, “Chhâ moleipa nata apheipazy ta ngiana ama tlua tyh. Châhrasala hrohsopa Zawna ngiana dei leipa ta cha, ngiana hropa piepa châ aw vei.
Zawna ta nga laipa py chhôh liata noh thôh nata zâ thôh a ypa hawhta, Chyhsa Sawchapawpa chhao alei chhôh liata noh thôh nata zâ thôh a y aw.
“Pachiana noh liata, Ninivâ mo kha he chhâ nata vaw thyu khoh aw ei ta, he chhâ he thailei ama pachâsa aw. Âmo cha Zawna biechhopa vâta ro ei ta, moh teh u, Zawna hlâta rônah viapa he liata a y.

Chho beinô chhao, pachiana noh liata, he chhâ nata vaw thyu khoh aw ta, he chhâ he thailei a pachâsa aw. Sawlawmaw sona nathlie awpa ta hmah, khizaw chhâna tawhta a vy ta, moh teh u, Sawlawmaw hlâta rônah viapa he liata a y.
“Thlahpa puapa cha chyhsa tawhta a pua nahta, apahâna su tluapa ta ti y leina suzy chahryh ta, châhrasala hmô leipa ta.
‘Ei vaw puana o lâ kha ei kua heih aw,’ tah ta. A tlô nahta, o cha a ruapa ta, phi chiehpa nata paryh khaipa ta hmô ta.

Sie ta, thlahpa hropa pasari, ano hlâta molei viapazy a vaw chhi ta, cha liata a ngia ei ta, ama pahrâ haw. Hnôhlâ ta cha chyhsa duahmo cha, hmiatuapa hlâ khata a chhie via syulyu haw. Cha hawhna chata, he chhâ moleipa chhao he a vaw y hra aw,” tah ta.
Zawpizy hnohta bie a rei hai nota, a nô nata a unawhzy ta ano cha bie a chho khoh ei ta, khôtho liata a duah ei ta.
Chyhsa pakha ta a hnohta, “Na nô nata na unawhzy ta bie châ chho khoh ei ta, khôtho liata amâ duah thlâh haw,” tah ta.
Zisu ta bie a chhotuhpa cha a chhy ta, a hnohta, “Ei nô cha ahy maw, ei unawhzy cha ahyzy maw?” tah ta.
Chatawhcha a pachupazy lâta a ku pazawh ta, “Hezy he ei nô nata ei unawhzy cha ama châ.
Ahy rai ei Paw vârâh liata a ypa khopa a taopa maih cha, ei unawh nata ei sietanô nata ei nô zy ama châ,” tah ta.
Cha noh lilaw ta Zisu cha o tawhta pua ta, tipo kiah liata a tyuh ta.
Chyhsa hluhpi a hnohta a vypakhy ei ta, balyh liata kiah ta, a tyuh ta, zawpi zydua cha raphyu liata a duah ei ta.
Pakhona biezy hmâpa ta âmo cha bie hluhpi chho ta, ama hnohta, “Chi hietuhpa cha chi hie awpa ta pua ta.
Chi cha hie ta, chi thokha cha lâthlôh kiah liata tla ei ta, pavawzy a vy ei ta, dyh khai ha ei ta.
Chi thokha cha lôphiariapa alei apapa liata tla ei ta, alei a chha leipa vâta thlai kaw pyuh ei ta,
noh a vaw chhi nahta, nohsa ta aih ei ta, thari a hnei leipa vâta ama uah haw.
Chi thokhazy cha ahloh thih liata tla ei ta, ahloh buhzy kaw rôh ta, chi riepazy cha ama disao haw.
Chi hropazy cha, alei phapa liata tla ei ta, thokha a lie za kha ta, thokha a lie sycharu ta, thokha a lie sythôh ta thei ama pathei.
Nakhaoh a hneipa ta thei mawh sy,” tah ta.
A pachupazy a vy ei ta a hnohta, “Khazia pakhona biezy hmâpa ta ama hnohta bie na reih?” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta âmo cha a chhy ta, ama hnohta, “Nâmo cha vârâh khinarâh bieparuzy pahno awpa ta piepa châ ei chi ta, âmo deikua cha piepa châ veih ei.
A hneipa hnohta pie baichhapa châ aw ta, a hluhpi a hnei aw. A hnei leipa deikua cha, a hnei chhôhpa chhao, ano tawhta lapa a châ aw.
He vâna heta ama hnohta pakhona biezy hmâpa ta ei reipa a châ. Hmô ei ta, hmô tlôh leipa ei ta, thei ei ta thei tlôh leipa ei ta, pahno thai hra veih ei.
Hrohsopa Isai ta, “‘Thei cha thei aw ei chi ta, Châhrasala nama novâh aw vei; Hmô cha hmô aw ei chi ta, Châhrasala pahno thai aw veih ei chi.

Cha phopi palôh cha a kuhchha ha ta, Ama nah ta bie thei thai khao leipa ta, Ama mo ama paso haw. Chata châ vei sala cha, Ama mo ta hmôpa ta, Ama nah ta thei aw ei ta, Ama palôh ta pahnopa ta, Kei lâ a vaw heih aw ei ta, Ei patlâh ha awpa ei tlai,’ tahpa ta hrohsona bie a reipa kha ama chô liata a vaw tlô hapa a châ.
“Nâmo deikua cha nama nohlao kaw dia! Nama mozy ta hmô ta, nama nahzy ta a thei.
Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, hrohsopa hluhpi nata mosiapa hluhpi ta nama hmôpa he hmô byuh kaw ei ta, châhrasala hmô veih ei. Nama theipazy he thei byuh kaw ei ta, châhrasala thei veih ei.
“Chi hietuhpa pakhona bie yzie he nathlie teh u:
Ahy rai khinarâh bie thei ha tlôh ta, a pahno thai vei khiahta cha, moleipa a vy ta, a palôh liata chi hiepa cha a lapa ha tyh. Cha cha lâpi liata chi hiepa cha a châ.
He he lôphiariapa liata chi hiepa a châ. Bie a theipa nahta, a lypa ta thlai a pyh ta,
châhrasala ano liata thari a thla leipa vâta, bohpi leipa dei y thei ta, bie vâta rietheipasana tlyma, taolana tlyma a vaw y nahta, thlai a pao ha tyh.
He he ahloh thih liata chi hiepa cha a châ. Bie cha thei ta, châhrasala khizaw hmo pachâna nata hneirôna tlaichhaina ta bie cha disao ta, pathei leipa ta a y tyh.
Lei phapa liata chi hiepa deikua cha, bie cha thei ta a pahno thaipa a châ. Thei pathei ta, thokha a lie za kha, thokha a lie sycharu nata thokha a lie sythôh ta a pathei tyh,” tah ta.
Ama hnohta pakhona bie hropa reih heih ta, “Vârâh khinarâh cha chyhsa ta a lyu liata chi phapa a hiepa nata pakhopa a châ.
A chyhsazy amâ mô chhôh ta, a chariahpa a vy ta, sâh hry liata sâh pakheipa hie ta, sie syulyu ha ta.
Chizy cha vaw laiseih ta, a suh a vaw tao nahta, sâh pakheipazy chhao cha a vaw lâ hra ei ta.
Lyu hneituhpa chakaotuhpazy a vy ei ta, a hnohta, ‘Pâpuh, na lyu liata chi phapa ma na hie vei? Kheihtazie ta sâh pakheipazy he a vaw pua thlâh haw?’ tah ei ta.
Ano ta ama hnohta, ‘Chariahpa ta a vaw taopa a châ chuh,’ tah ta. Chakaotuhpazy ta a hnohta, ‘Cha khiahta la, vawh sih la, kei phia ha awpa na khoh ma?’ tah ei ta.
Ano ta, ‘Châ vei, sâh pakheipazy nama phiana liata sâhzy nama phia pâ pathlei aw na.

Sâh hria daihti taih cha y khoh thlâh ha ei sala, sâh hria daihti liata hriatuhpazy hnohta, “Sâh pakheipazy kha pahmaoh tua u la, rao awpa ta a pia ta chahry u la, sâh deikua cha ei sawvâ liata pahmaoh teh u,” ei tah aw,’” tah ta.
Zisu ta pakhona bie hropa ama hnohta reih heih ta. “Vârâh khinarâh cha chyhsa ta âhrâ chi hmô kha lyu liata a pariepa hawhta a châ.

Âhrâ chi cha chi zydua liata chi chyh chaipa châ ta, châhrasala a vaw laiseih tita cha, chicheipa zydua hlâta lai chai ta, thokô a vaw châ tyh. Chatanachata vâ pavawzy a vy ei ta, a chiahzy liata bu ama tu tyh,” tah ta.
Zisu ta pakhona bie hropa ama hnohta reih heih ta, “Vârâh khinarâh cha chanô ta thinô la ta, viahdie saikhua miathôh liata pabu ta a zydua ta a thyu khai hapa hawhta a châ,” tah ta.
Cha hmo zydua cha Zisu ta zawpizy hnohta pakhona biezy hmâpa ta reih ta. Pakhona bie hmâ leipa ta ama hnohta bie a reipa y vei.
Cha hmo cha hrohsopa ta, “Pakhona biezy hmâpa ta ei pakah â aw na ta, Hmo nyupazy ei phuah aw, Khizaw y tua no tawhta nyu hapazy cha,” tahpa ta a reipa kha a vaw tlô thei nawpa ta a châ.
Zisu ta zawpizy cha siesai ta, o liata a ngia ta, a pachupazy ano lâ a vy ei ta, a hnohta, “Lyu liata sâh pakheipa pakhona bie kha miah chhopasia teh,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta a chhy ta, “Chi phapa a hietuhpa cha Chyhsa Sawchapawpa a châ.
Lyu cha khizaw châ ta, chi phapa cha khinarâh sawzy ama châ. Sâh pakheipazy cha moleipa sawzy châ ei ta,
âmo a hietuhpa chariahpa cha ahripa a châ. Sâh hria daihti cha daihti chhâna châ ta, hriatuhpazy cha vâlyuhchâpazy ama châ.
Sâh pakheipazy cha pahmaohpa ta mei liata raopa ama châpa hawhta, daihti chhâna liata a châ hra aw.
Chyhsa Sawchapawpa ta a vâlyuhchâpazy tuah aw ta, moleina a patlôsatuhpa zydua nata hmo pha leipa a taotuhpa zydua cha, a khinarâh tawhta la papua aw ta,
moleipazy cha patina meihô liata ama thy aw. Cha liata chana nata hâh chariehna a y aw.
Chyhsa siapazy deikua cha, ama Paw khinarâh liata noh hawhta ama khaih aw. Nakhaoh a hneipa ta thei mawh sy.
“Vârâh khinarâh cha lyu liata ryubyh nyupa chyhsa pakha ta hmô ta, nyu heih ta, a ly ngaitapa ta sie ta, a hneina zydua zuah ta, cha lyu cha a chaleipa hawhta a châ.
“Vârâh khinarâh cha sôdaohpa ta taikuh lôsôhpa a tluapa hawhta a châ heih.
Taikuh lôsôh ngaitapa miakha a hmô nahta, sie ta a hneipa zydua zuah ta a chaleipa hawhta a châ.
“Vârâh khinarâh cha tilaipi liata sao paraipa, nga chi to a aopa hawhta a châ.
Sao cha a bie nahta, nga patutuhpazy ta ngiahkâ lâ a daophi ei ta, a tyuh ei ta, nga phapazy cha hrâbyh liata soh ei ta, a chhiepazy deikua cha ama thy tyh.
Cha hawhna chata daihti chhâna liata a y hra aw. Vâlyuhchâpazy a zu aw ei ta, moleipazy cha mosiapazy tawhta pahrua aw ei ta,
moleipazy cha patina meihô liata ama thy aw. Cha liata chana nata hâh chariehna a y aw.
“Cha hmo zydua cha nama pahno thai khai ma?” tah ta. Âmo ta a hnohta, “Eima pahno,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Chavâta vârâh khinarâh châta pachusapa ryhpa pachutuhpa maih cha, o hneituhpa ta a ryubyh tawhta hmo thiehpa nata hmo parohpa a thao papuapa hawhta a châ,” tah ta.
Cha pakhona biezy a rei khai nahta, Zisu cha cha su tawhta pua ta.
A khih kei tlô ta, amâ pakhyna o liata âmo cha pachu ta, ama noâh ngaita ta, “He chyhsa heta khataih tawhta ma he sona nata hmotaotheinazy he a hnei tly?
He chyhsa he zôthaipa sawchapawpa kha châ vei ma? A nô chhao Mâri ama tahpa kha châ vei ma? A unawhzy chhao Zâmie, Zawsi, Saimaw nata Zudâh zy châ veih ei ma?
A sietanôzy chhao eima hnohta y khai thlâh ha veih ei ma? He chyhsa heta, khataih tawhta ma he hmo zydua he a hmô tly?” tah ei ta.
Ano cha chhyh thai leipa ei ta. Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Hrohsopa cha a khih nata a chhôhkha liata tah leipa ta la, palyupalihna hlao leipa ta y beih vei,” tah ta.
Amâ ngiapâ leipa vâta, cha liata hmonoâhpa hluhpi tao vei.
Cha daihti liata, Kâlili râh ryureituhpa Herawda ta Zisu thâtih cha thei ta.
A chakaotuhpazy hnohta, “Cha chyhsa cha Bâtituhpa Zawhâna kha a châ. Athihpa hry tawhta pathyu heihpa a châ chuh. Chavâta hmonoâhpa taotheina ano liata a ypa a châ,” tah ta.
Herawdâ ta a unawhpa Phili lapinô Herawdi vâta Zawhâna cha patu ta, chahry ta patâhna o liata a vaw khô hapa a châ.
Zawhâna ta a hnohta, “He chanô na hnei awpa he ryhpa ta pasaih vei” tahpa ta a chho tyhpa vâta, patu ta a patâhpa a châ.
Herawda ta Zawhâna cha thie awpa khoh ta, châhrasala zawpi ta hrohsopa ta ama pachâ vâta, zawpi riah chipa ta thie ngâh leipa ta.
Herawda pina noh vaw tlô ta, alykheituhpazy hmiakô liata Herawdi sawchanônô ta lâh ta, cha chata Herawda cha palysa kaw ta.
A hiapa maih pie awpa ta bie a taih ta.
A nô ta a pasyupa hawhta, Herawda hnohta, “Bâtituhpa Zawhâna luh beikoh ta na vaw pie teh,” tah ta.
Abei cha a pachârôh kaw ta, châhrasala a bietai vâta nata a hruapazy vâta, Herawdi sawchanônô hiapa cha pie awpa ta biepie ta.
Chyhsa tuah ta, Zawhâna luh cha patâhna o liata kei pataisa ta.
A luh cha beikoh ta vaw cheih ei ta, laihsanô cha pie ei ta, ano ta a nô lâ vawkhei ta.
Cha khai tawhta Zawhâna pachupazy a vy ei ta, a ri cha la ei ta, ama pabu haw. Sie ei ta, cha thâtih cha Zisu kei chho ei ta.

Zisu ta Zawhâna thâtih cha a thei nahta, cha su tawhta pua ta, ano dei ta balyh ta sie ta, su dâhthlohpa lâ pangai ta. Cha thâtih cha zawpi ta ama pahno nahta, khihzy tawhta phei ta siepa ta ano cha pazi ei ta.
Ngiahkâ lâ a pua nahta, zawpi hluhpi hmô ta, âmo cha a thapasa ngaita ta, ama hry liata tlâhleipazy patlâh ta.
Zâlâ a vaw châ nahta, a pachupazy ano lâ a vy ei ta, a hnohta, “Su dâhthlohpa liata y tlôh pi ta, zâlâ ha ta, nie awpa a chalei awpa ta zawpizy he khihzy lâta tahmâ pasiesa teh,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta, “Ama sie awpa byuh vei. Nâmo ta nie awpa pie teh u,” tah ta.
Âmo ta a hnohta, “Viahchhâ tlâ pangawh nata ngasa miano dei leipa ta cha, he liata khâpa hmah hnei ma pi,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta, “Cha cha kei lâ vaw cheih teh u,” tah ta.

Zawpizy cha sibiepa chô liata a tyuh awpa ta biepie ta, viahchhâ tlâ pangawh nata ngasa miano cha la ta, avâ lâ moh ta, byhnâ aw ta. Chatawhcha viahchhâ cha eichheih ta a pachupazy hnohta pie ta, pachupazy ta zawpizy cha rai ei ta.
Ama zydua ta nie ei ta, ama rih bie khai ta. Nie laibâhpa chhao hrâbyh hmo hrawh hleino tlai a huah ei ta.
A niepa zydua cha chanô nata hawtizy rei leipa ta, chapaw pitlohpa sai ta sâh pangawh rachhôh ama châ.
Zawpizy a pasiesa chhôh ta, a pachupazy cha balyh ta haosâ lâ pasiesa chhielie ta.
Zawpizy liahsa a pasiesa khai tawhta, ano dei ta thlahchhâ awpa ta tlâh lâ kiah ta. Zâlâ taihta Zisu cha ano dei ta cha liata y thlâh ha ta.
Cha daihti liata cha, balyh chhao ngiahkâ tawhta â hlapi sie ha ta. Thlih ta a supa vâta, tichatlaopa ta balyh cha thata phaoh pahai ta.
Zâ vaina ei palihna liata, tilaipi chô liata phei ta siepa ta a pachupazy lâ a vy ta.
Pachupazy ta tipo chô liata phei ta a siepa ama hmô nahta, chi ngaita ei ta, “Thlahmihpa a châ huh,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta âmo cha thlai bie a vaw chho ta, ama hnohta, “Thlalôhpa ta y teh u, keima na ei châ, chi khah u,” tah ta.
Pity ta a hnohta, “Abeipa, nâma na châ khiahta cha, ti chô liata nâma lâ a vy awpa ta bie na pie teh,” tah ta.
Zisu ta, “A vy châh chi,” tah ta. Pity cha balyh tawhta thlai pua ta, Zisu lâ pangaipa ta ti chô liata sie ta.
Châhrasala thlihpipa a hmô nahta, chi ngaita ta, a pamôh pathao ha ta, “Abeipa, na pachha teh,” tahpa ta awh ta.
Zisu ta a ku thlai kei pazawh ta, Pity cha patu ta, a hnohta, “Hy nâ, ngiapâ chyhpa, khazia nâ lôh vei?” tah ta.
Balyh liata amâ ngia nahta, thlih cha a chalih ha ta.
Balyh liata a ypazy a vy ei ta, ano cha a chhy ei ta, a hnohta, “Khazohpa Sawchapawpa na vaw châ hmeiseih tlai na,” tah ei ta.
Chatawhcha haosâ lâ kiah ei ta, Kenesare râh kei tlô ei ta.
Cha su liata chyhsazy ta ano a châ tahpa ama pahnopa nahta, a chheipâh râh chyhsa zydua bieta ei ta, tlâhleipa zydua ano lâ a vaw chhi ei ta.
A poh pai chhâ hria awpa ta Zisu cha a haw ei ta, a hriapa maihta tlâh lymâ ei ta.
Phârisaihzy nata ryhpa pachutuhpazy cha, Zerusale tawhta Zisu lâ a vy ei ta, a hnohta,
“Khazia na pachupazy ta machâzy taozietyhpa ama parao tly? Pati ama nie chy ta ama ku a si veih ei,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta a chhy ta, ama hnohta, “Khazia nâmo chhao ta nama taozietyhpa a tlychakapa ta Khazohpa biepiepa nama parao?
Khazohpa ta, ‘Na nô nata na paw palyupalih teh,’ tah ta, ‘A nô tlyma, a paw tlyma a reipachhietuhpa cha a thi thlyu awpa a châ,’ a tah.
Nâmo deikua ta, ‘Ahy rai a nô tlyma, a paw tlyma hnohta, “Keima tawhta baona na hmô awpa vyuhpa cha Khazohpa hnohta ei pie haw,”
a tahpa maih cha, hmopiepa ta a paw tlyma, a nô tlyma, a palyupalih awpa byuh khao vei,’ nama tah tyh. Nama taozietyhpa a tlychakapa ta, Khazohpa bie cha hraoleipa ta nama tao haw.
Nâmo, phapakheipazy saih u, nama yzie kyh liata Isai ta,
“‘He phopi heta, Ama hmao ta na palyupalih ei ta, Ama pathipalôh ta deikua einâ hla kaw ei.
Chyhsapa biepiepazy cha, Biezyhpa hawhta pachu ei ta, Hraoleipa ta einâ chhy ei,’ tahpa ta â do ngaitapa ta a vaw chhochhielie haw,” tah ta
Chatawhcha zawpizy ano lâ awpakhy ta, ama hnohta, “Nathlie u la, pahno teh u.
Pakah liata a ngiapa ta chyhsa papuapalei leipa ta, pakah tawhta a puapa ta chyhsa a papuapalei tyh,” tah ta.
Cha khai tawhta a pachupazy a vy ei ta, a hnohta, “Cha bie cha Phârisaihzy ta thei ei ta, ama palôh a tlâh lei kaw tahpa na pahno ma?” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta a chhy ta, ama hnohta, “Tho to ei Paw vârâh liata a ypa ta a loh leipa maih cha phiapa a châ.
Âmo y ta y thlâh ha ei sa. Chhituhpa mochaopazy ama châ. Mochaopa ta mochaopa a chhihtha khiahta cha, khaohtlô liata hmaohkhata ama tla aw,” tah ta.
Pity ta a hnohta, “Cha pakhona bie yzie cha miah chhopasia teh,” tah ta.
Zisu ta, “Nâmo chhao taihta a yzie pahno to veih ei chi ma?
Pakah liata a ngiapa cha pavyh lâ palâh ta, lyupâh puana lâta a pua tyh tahpa pahno veih ei chi ma?
Châhrasala pakah tawhta a puapa cha, pathipalôh tawhta a kaw puapa a châpa vâta, cha tlai chata chyhsa a papuapalei tyh.
Moleina pachâna, lianycheina, apheina, apatlana, paruna, haipa bie reipa nata reipachhiena zy he palôh tawhta a kaw puapa a châ.
Chazy chata chyhsa a papuapalei tyh. Ku a si leipa ta pati niepa ta chyhsa papuapalei vei,” tah ta.
Cha su tawhta Zisu cha pua ta, Tyre nata Sidaw bia liata a ngia ta.
Cha râh liata a ypa Kâna chanô pakha a vy ta, “Hy Abeipa, Dâvi Sawchapawpa, na ngiachhie teh. Ahripa ta ei sawchanô patu ta thata a pasa,” tahpa ta awh ta.
Châhrasala Zisu ta kawh kha hmahta a chhy leipa ta. A pachupazy a vy ei ta a hnohta, “Pasiesa ha mah y, miah a awsao laih ngâ thlâh haw,” tahpa ta a haw ei ta.
Zisu ta, “Izarei phopi mietaku aleipazy hnoh dei ta tuapa ei châ,” tah ta.
Châhrasala chanô cha a vy ta, Zisu hmiakô liata a bôh ta, a hnohta, “Abeipa, na bao mah y,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a chhy ta, “Sawzy viahchhâ chhu ta, izy piepa cha hmo yzie châ vei,” tah ta.
Chanô ta, “Abeipa, â do na. Châhrasala izy chhao ta ama zibeipa tlâhkhai tawhta azôhpa a tlapazy cha ama nie tyh hra mâh tâh,” tah ta.
Zisu ta chanô cha a chhy ta, a hnohta “Hy chanô, nâ ngiapâna thatlô rimâ cha! Na khopa hawhta na chô liata vaw tlô mawh sy,” tah ta, cha dawh lia tlai ta a sawchanô cha tlâh ha ta.
Zisu cha, cha su tawhta pua ta, Kâlili Tipo kiah tlô ta, tlâh lâ kiah ta, cha liata a tyuh ta.
Zawpi hluhpi a hnohta a vy ei ta, pheisypazy, mochaopazy, pihpasipazy, reih pathlie theileipazy nata pasana hropa a hneipa hluhpi a phei thaby liata vaw soh ei ta, âmo cha patlâh lymâ ta.

Reih pathlie theileipazy ta reih pathlie ei ta, pihpasipazy tlâh ei ta, pheisypazy phei ta sie ei ta, mochaopazy ta ama hmô thei hapa zawpizy ta ama hmô nahta, ama noâh ngaita ta, Izarei Khazohpa cha reithai ei ta.

Zisu ta a pachupazy aw ta, ama hnohta, “Zawpizy he tahmâ noh thôh tlai ei hnohta y ha ei ta, nie awpa khâpa hmah ama hnei leipa vâta, ei ngia eina chhie ngaita ei. Nodipa ta âmo pasiesa awpa hra cha, lâpi liata ama panao pathlei awpa vâta khoh leipa na ta,” tah ta.
Pachupazy ta a hnohta, “He zie zydua zawpi rih pabie nawpa ta, he su dâhthlohpa liana heta kheihta ma viahchhâ eima hmô thei aw?” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Viahchhâ tlâ khazie nama hnei?” tah ta. Âmo ta, “Tlâ sari nata nga dipa chyhta eima hnei,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta zawpizy cha alei liata a tyuh awpa ta biepie ta,
viahchhâ tlâ sari nata ngasazy cha la ta, alyna bie a rei khai nahta, eichheih ta, a pachupazy hnohta pie ta, pachupazy ta zawpizy cha rai ei ta.
Ama zydua ta nie ei ta, ama rih bie khai ta. Nie laibâhpa azôhpa chhao hrâbyh hmo sari tlai a huah ei ta.
A niepa zydua cha chanô nata hawtizy rei leipa ta, chapaw pitlohpa sai ta sâh palih ama châ.
Zawpizy a pasiesa khai tawhta, balyh liata kiah ta, Mâkadâ râh lâ sie ha ta.
Phârisaihzy nata Saduasizy a vy ei ta, ano pasia nawpa ta vârâh tawhta ngiana pahmôsa awpa ta hiah ei ta.
Zisu ta âmo cha a chhy ta, “Zâlâ a vaw châ nahta, avâ a saih khiahta cha, ‘Noh a pha aw,’ tah ei chi ta,
mydi ta avâ saih ta a panoh khiahta cha, ‘Tanoh la avâ a suah aw,’ nama tah tyh. Avâ yzie chhopasiana pahno ei chi ta, daihti ngianazy deikua cha pahno thei veih ei chi.
Chhâ moleipa nata apheipazy ta ngiana tlua tyh ei ta, châhrasala Zawna ngiana dei leipa ta cha, ama hnohta ngiana rai piepa châ aw vei,” tah ta. Âmo cha puasai ta, sie syulyu ha ta.
Pachupazy cha haosâ lâ tlô ei ta, viahchhâ a phao awpa my ha ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “A hrohrua u la, Phârisaihzy nata Saduasizy thinô liata a vaih teh u,” tah ta.
Pachupazy ta, “Viahchhâ a vaw phao leipa pi ta,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta cha kyh cha a pahno nahta, “Ngiapâ chyhpa saih u, khazia ma viahchhâ nama hnei leipa kyh nama reih?
Pahno to veih ei chi ma? Chyhsa sâh pangawh châta viahchhâ tlâ pangawh a daih ta, a laibâhpa hrâbyh khazie ma namâ huah tahpa kha a thei thlâh ha veih ei chi ma?
Chyhsa sâh palih châta viahchhâ tlâ sari a daih ta, a laibâhpa hrâbyh khazie ma namâ huah tahpa chhao kha a thei thlâh ha veih ei chi ma?
Viahchhâ kyh nama hnohta reih va na tahpa khazia nama pahno to vei tly? Phârisaihzy nata Saduasizy thinô liata a vaih teh u,” tah ta.
Chatanachata viahchhâ thinô liata a vaih awpa ta a chhopa ei châ leipa ta, Phârisaihzy nata Saduasizy pachuna liata a vaih awpa kyh tlao a châzie pahno ha ei ta.
Zisu cha Philipi Kaisaria bia a vaw tlô nahta, a pachupazy hnohta, “Chyhsazy ta Chyhsa Sawchapawpa he ahy na a châ ama tah?” tahpa ta hiahri ta.
Âmo ta, “Thokha ta Bâtituhpa Zawhâna a châ, cha tah ei ta; thokha ta Elaizâh a châ, cha tah ei ta; thokha ta Zeremiah tlyma hrohsopa ahy tlyma a châ, ama cha tah,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Cha khiahta la, nâmo zaw ahy a châ eina tah ei chi?” tah ta.
Saimaw Pity ta, “Mesia, Khazohpa hrohpa Sawchapawpa na châ,” tahpa ta a chhy ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Saimaw, Zawna sawchapawpa, na nohlao na! Sapa nata thisaih ta a cha pahnosapa châ leipa ta, ei Paw vârâh liata a ypa ta a cha pahnosapa a châ.
Chavâta ei cha chho, nâ cha Pity na châ. He lôpanô chô liana heta ei Awnanopa padua aw na ta, Athihkhih chhikaozy ta pahnie aw vei.
Vârâh khinarâh châhbizy cha pie aw na ta, alei liata na chahrypa maih, vârâh liata chahrypa châ aw ta, alei liata na pathlâpa maih, vârâh liata pathlâpa a châ aw,” tah ta.
Zisu ta Mesia a châ tahpa cha ahy hmah chho lei awpa ta pachupazy cha â ipa ta zikyu a râ ta.

Cha rakha tawhta cha Zisu ta a pachupazy hnohta Zerusale lâ a khy awpa nata machâzy, theihthai beizy nata ryhpa pachutuhpazy ta pasa thata ama pataosa awpa kyh nata, ama thie awpa nata noh thôh noh ta pathyupa ta a y awpa kyh zy reih pathao ta.
Pity ta Zisu cha anano ta a chhi ta, ra ta, a hnohta, “Abeipa, Khazohpa ta pasaih khah sy! Cha cha na chô liata tlô cheita khah sy,” tah ta.
Zisu cha Pity lâ a heih ta, a hnohta, “Sâtâ, ei hnôh lâ y teh! Ei châta ahluana na châ he. Khazohpa hmozy pachâ leipa chi ta, chyhsapa hmozy tlao na pachâ via he,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a pachupazy hnohta, “Ahy rai eina zi khoh khiahta cha, anosasyh a paky sala, a kraws a piapa ta na zi mawh sy.
Ahy rai a hrona pabohsa a chhuahpa cha, a hrona pahlei aw ta; keima vâta a hrona a pahleipa deikua cha, a hrona a hmô heih aw.
Chyhsa ta khizaw he a pôhpalôhpa ta hnei sala, a thlahpa a pahlei tlôh khiahta cha, a châta khâpa a phahnai aw? Cha leipa chhao ta, chyhsa ta a thlahpa vyuhpa ta khâpa a pie aw?
Chyhsa Sawchapawpa cha a Paw rônahna ta a vâlyuhchâpazy chhaota a zu tlôh aw ta, chyhsa to ama hmotaopa hawhta a thô aw ei.
Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, he liata a duahpazy hry liana heta, Chyhsa Sawchapawpa he a khinarâh liata â zupa ama hmô hlâlei cha, thina a padi lei awpa ama y,” tah ta.
Noh charu khai tawhta Zisu ta Pity nata Zâmie nata a unawhpa Zawhâna zy a chhi ta, âmo cha anano ta tlâh sâhpa lâ kiakhei ta.
Ama hmiakô liata a hmia a vaw nano ha ta, a hmia cha noh hawhta khaih ta, a chysiazy chhao khaihpa hawhta vaw dieh ta.
Mawsi nata Elaizâh ama hnohta a vaw luah ei ta, Zisu cha bie a chho ei ta.
Pity ta Zisu hnohta, “Abeipa, he liata eima ypa he a pha na. Na khoh khiahta cha, he liata byureih miathôh, nâma châta miakha, Mawsi châta miakha, Elaizâh châta miakha ei tu aw,” tah ta.
A rei hai no tlai chata, meihdo râhpa ta âmo cha vaw khu ta, meihdo tawhta ao vaw pua ta, “He he ei Sawchapawpa kho ngaitapa, a chô liata ei ly ngaitapa a châ, a bie nathlie teh u,” tah ta.
Cha bie cha pachupazy ta ama thei nahta, â khu lâta pao ei ta, chi ngaita ei ta.
Zisu a vy ta âmo cha hria ta, ama hnohta, “Thyu teh u, chi khuh vy,” tah ta.
Kaw moh ei ta, Zisu dei leipa cha ahy hmah hmô leipa ei ta.
Tlâh tawhta ama za chô hai nota, Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Chyhsa Sawchapawpa he athihpazy hry tawhta a thyu heih hlâlei cha, aluahna nama hmôpa kha ahy hmah chho khuh vy,” tahpa ta biepie ta.
Pachupazy ta a hnohta, “Khazia ryhpa pachutuhpazy ta Elaizâh â vy tua awpa na a châ ama tah tly?” tahpa ta hiahri ei ta.
Zisu ta a chhy ta, ama hnohta, “Elaizâh cha a vy tua tlai aw ta, ato zydua a paduapathi aw.

Châhrasala ei cha chho ei, Elaizâh cha a vy ha ta, ano cha pahno leipa ei ta, a chô liata ama khozie hawhta ama taopa kha a châ. Cha hawhna hra chata Chyhsa Sawchapawpa chhao he ama ku liata pasa a tao aw,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Bâtituhpa Zawhâna kyh ama hnohta a reipa a châzie pachupazy ta pahno ha ei ta.
Zawpi yna ama za tlô nahta, chyhsa pakha ano lâ a vy ta, a hmiakô liata pakhu paneih ta,
a hnohta, “Abeipa, ei sawchapawpa ngiachhie mah y. Riapamiepa châ ta, thata pasa taopa ta, ei hluhpi mei liata pao ta, ei hluhpi ti liata a pao.
Na pachupazy lâ a vaw chhi na ta, âmo ta patlâh thei leipa ei ta,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a chhy ta, ama hnohta, “Hy ngiapâleipa nata chhorupa chhâ saih u, khachâ ma nama hnohta ei y aw? Khachâ ma ei cha pachâ thai aw ei? Kei lâ a vaw chhi teh u,” tah ta.
Zisu ta ahripa cha ra ta, hawtipa chhôh tawhta pua ta, hawtipa cha thlai vaw tlâh ha ta.
Pachupazy cha âmo dei ta Zisu lâ a vy ei ta, a hnohta, “Khazia keimo ta thlahpa puapa eima papua thei vei?” tah ei ta.

Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Namâ ngiapâna a chyhpa vâta a châ. Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, âhrâ chi hmô kha tie chhâ ta ngiapâna nama hnei khiahta la, he tlâh hnohna heta, ‘He tawhta hao lâ a pasie teh,’ tah u la, â pasie thlâh ha aw. Nama châta tao thei leipa khâpa hmah y aw vei.
Châhrasala he hawhpa he cha, thlahchhâna nata kâhvileipa deita ta papua theipa a châ,” tah ta.
Kâlili râh liata ama ypakhy nota, Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Chyhsa Sawchapawpa he chyhsazy ku liata hlâpa ta a y daihmâ.
Thie aw ei ta, noh thôh noh ta pathyupa ta a y aw,” tah ta. Chavâta pachupazy cha ama pachârôh ngaita ta.
Kâpynia ama tlô nahta, Achhyna o chhie kheituhpazy Pity hnohta a vy ei ta, “Nâmo pachutuhpa he chhie pie tyh hra vei ma?” tah ei ta.

Ano ta, “A pie tyh,” tah ta. Pity cha o chhôh lâ â ngia nahta, Zisu ta ano cha bie a chho tua ta, a hnohta, “Saimaw, kheihta na pachâ? Lei beizy ta ahy tawhta ma leimâ nata chhiezy ama khei tyh? Ama sawzy tawhta ma, ahropazy tawhta?” tah ta.
Pity ta, “Ahropazy tawhta,” tah ta. Zisu ta a hnohta, “Cha khiahta la, sawzy cha amâ ei ha chuh.

Châhrasala ama palôh pachhie lei nawpa ta, tilaipi lâ vawh la, keipa kei ny la, nga na paao tua chaipa la la, a pakah cha-ia la tâkâ tlaw no hmô aw chi ta, cha cha la la, keima nata nâma chhie châta ama hnohta pie mah y,” tah ta.
Cha nota pachupazy Zisu lâ a vy ei ta, a hnohta, “Vârâh khinarâh liata ahy ma a rônah chai aw?” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta hawti pakha aw ta, ama hry liata paduasa ta,
ama hnohta, “Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, nama yzie pananopa ta, hawtizy hawhta nama châ vei khiahta la, vârâh khinarâh a ngia cheita aw veih ei chi.
He hawti hawhta areisipa cha vârâh khinarâh liata a rônah chai aw.
“Ahy rai ei moh ta he hawhpa hawti pakha chhao a lypa cha, keima nâ lypa a châ.
Châhrasala nâ ngiapâtuhpa hawtizy hry liata pakha chhao a pahluasapa cha, a rao liata charona lô lai ngaitapa paaopa ta, tilaipi athupa liata pathla syulyupa a châta a pha via aw.
“Molei reipasaonazy vâta khizaw he a hu a po kaw dia! Reipasaona cha a y awpa tlai châ ta, châhrasala reipasaona a paysatuhpa cha a hu a po na!

Na ku tlyma, na phei tlyma ta a cha pamoleisa khiahta cha, tai la, thy ha mah y. Ku no tlyma, phei no tlyma hneipa ta, chhâzaw mei liata thypa na châ awpa hlâta cha, pihpasipa ta tlyma, pheisypa ta tlyma, hrona liata a ngiapa na châta a pha via.
Na mo ta a cha pamoleisa khiahta la, thaoh la, thy syulyu ha mah y. Mo no hnei ta hrienasu mei liata thypa ta na y awpa hlâta cha, mo kha hnei ta hrona liata a ngiapa na châta a pha via.
“He hawtitazy hry liata pakha chhao mopakhô lei awpa ta a sohsi teh u. Vârâh liata ama vâlyuhchâpazy ta ei Paw vârâh liata a ypa hmia khâ ama sai tyh tahpa ei cha chho ei.
Chyhsa Sawchapawpa cha leidiapazy pachha awpa ta a zupa a châ.
