Zisu ta ama bie reipa cha a thei nahta, pakhyna o hyutuhpa hnohta, “Chi leipa la, a ngiapâ thlâh ha mah y,” tah ta.
Pity nata Zâmie nata Zâmie unawhpa Zawhâna zy dei leipa cha, ahy hmahta ano zi awpa pasaih leipa ta.
Pakhyna o hyutuhpa o cha kei tlô ei ta, Zisu ta zawpizy a tymâpa ta cha ei ta, ama sâh awh ngâpa hmô ta.
A kei ngia ta, ama hnohta, “Khazia a tymâpa ta nama cha? Hawtinô he thi vei, â môpa dei a châ,” tah ta.
Zawpizy ta pahneisao ei ta. Châhrasala zawpi zydua cha khôtho lâ papua khai ta, hawtinô paw nata nô nata a hnohta a ypazy a chhi ta, hawti yna lâ cha a ngia ei ta.
Hawtinô ku cha patu ta, a hnohta, “Tâlithâ kumi,” tah ta. Cha yzie cha, “Hawtinô, ei cha chho, thyu teh,” tahna a châ.
Hawtinô cha thlai thyu ta, sie thei ha ta. Hawtinô cha kô hrawh hleinopa a châ. Zawpizy cha ama noâh ngaita ta.
Zisu ta cha thâtih cha ahy hnohta hmah pahnosa lei awpa ta zawpizy cha â i ngaitapa ta biepie ta. Hawtinô cha niepa pie awpa ta âmo cha chho ta.
Cha su tawhta pua ta, a khih lâ ngai ta, a pachupazy ta ano cha zi ei ta.

Pahânoh ta pakhyna o liata pachu pathao ta. A bie a theituhpa hluhpizy cha ama noâh ngaita ta, “He chyhsa heta, he biezy he khataih tawhta ma a pahno tly? He chyhsa hnohta sona piepa he kheihawhpa sona ma a châ tly? Kha hawhpa hmonoâhpazy kha, kheihta ma a ku ta a tao thei tly?

He chyhsa he Zâmie, Zôse, Zudâh nata Saimaw zy unawhpa, Mâri sawchapawpa, tho zôthaipa kha châ vei ma? A sietanôzy chhao, he liata eima hnohta y thlâh ha veih ei ma?” tah ei ta. Chavâta a chô liata ama palôh châ leipa ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Hrohsopa cha, a khih nata a chiheih nata a chhôhkha liata tah leipa ta la, palyupalihna hlao leipa ta y beih vei,” tah ta.
Chavâta tlâhleipa chyhsa chyhtazy chô liata a ku pahnieh ta a patlâhpazy dei leipa ta cha, Nâzari khih liata hmonoâhpa tao thei vei.
Ama zo leina kyh liata noâh a tah ngaita. Chatawhcha khihzy chahryhpa ta, pachu lymâ ta.
Pahrawh hleinozy cha aw ta, pano lymâ ta tuah ta, thlahpa puapazy chô liata biehneina ama hnohta pie ta.
Chôchahrei dei leipa ta cha, khâpa hmah, viahchhâ tlyma, sahria tlyma, ama chaisaihna liata tâkâ tlyma a phao lei awpa ta, âmo cha biepie ta.
Pheiky deikua a kypa ta, viahkao zo no a ky lei awpa ta biepie hra ta.
Ama hnohta, “Khataih lia rai ta, nama tlôna o cha nama sie heih hlâlei puasai khuh vy.
Châ ly leipa nata nama bie a nathlie khoh leipa khihzy cha, nama puasai tita, ama thaileichâna pahnosana châta nama phei liata buchadoh chatho thlu teh u,” tah ta.
Chatanachata sie ei ta, ro awpa ta chyhsazy chho laih lymâ ei ta.
Ahripa hluhpi papua ei ta, tlâhleipa hluhpi sathaw thu ei ta, ama patlâh lymâ.

Zisu cha a moh a pathâh kawpa vâta, Bei Herawda chhao ta a thâtih vaw thei ta. Thokhazy ta, “Bâtituhpa Zawhâna kha athipa hry tawhta thyu heih ta, chavâta he hmonoâhpa tao theina biehneinazy he ano liata a ypa a châ,” tah ei ta.
Ahropazy ta, “Elaizâh a châ,” tah ei ta. Ahropazy heih ta, “Hrohsopa na a châ, hrohsopa parohpa hry liata pakha a lyu,” tah ei ta.
Herawda deikua ta a thei nahta, “A luh ei tai hapa Zawhâna a vaw thyu heihpa a châ chuh,” tah ta.
Herawdâ ta a unawhpa Phili lapinô Herawdi cha lapinô ta a hneipa kyh liata, chyhsa tuah ta Zawhâna cha patusa ta, patâhna o liata chahryna chôta a khôpa kha a châ.
Zawhâna ta Herawda hnohta, “Na unawhpa lapinô na hneipa he ryhpa ta pasaih vei,” tahpa ta a chhopa vâta a châ.
Chavâta Herawdi ta Zawhâna cha a hao kaw ta, thie awpa khoh ta, châhrasala tao thei leipa ta.
Herawda ta Zawhâna cha chyhsa siapa nata pathaihpa a châ tahpa a pahnopa vâta chi ta, a pabohsapa a châ. A bie a thei nahta, a nôpo kaw tyh ta, châhrasala a ly ngaitapa ta a nathlie pyly tyh.
Herawdi châta daihti rypaohpa vaw y ta. Herawda ta a pina noh liata a beimachâzy, a pheisaih hyutuhpazy nata Kâlili râh liata molaipazy châta kyhchhi tao ta.
Herawdi sawchanônô a vaw ngia ta, lâh ta, Herawda nata a hnohta a tyuhpazy cha palysa ngaita ta. Abei ta laihsa hnohta, “Na khopa maih na hiah teh, ei cha pie aw,” tah ta.
A hnohta bie a taih ta, “Khâpa rai eina hiapa maih chi cha, ei râh khophie chhao châ sala, ei cha pie aw,” tah ta.
Laihsa cha pua ta, a nô hnohta, “Khâpa ei hia aw?” tah ta. A nô ta, “Bâtituhpa Zawhâna luh,” tah ta.
Laihsa cha abei lâ thlai a ngia ta, a hnohta, “Bâtituhpa Zawhâna luh beikoh liata sopa ta thlai eina pie awpa chi ta ei khoh,” tah ta.
Abei cha a pachârôh ngaita ta, châhrasala chyhsa peimawhpa a hruapazy hmiakô liata bie â taih hapa vâta, laihsa hnohta bie a rei hapa cha parao khoh leipa ta.
Abei ta pheisaih thlai tuah ta, Zawhâna luh vaw chei awpa ta biepie ta. Pheisaih cha vawh ta, Zawhâna luh cha patâhna o liata kei tai ta.
Beikoh ta a luh cha vaw cheih ta, laihsa hnohta pie ta, laihsa ta a nô hnohta pie ta.
Cha thâtih cha Zawhâna pachupazy ta ama pahno nahta, a ri la ei ta, thlâ liata ama pazia haw.
Lyuhchâpazy Zisu lâ vaw kua ei ta, ama hmotaopa nata pachupa kyh zydua Zisu chho ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Nâmo dei ta su dâhthlohpa lâ a vy u la, buakha a pahâ chy teh u,” tah ta. Chyhsa hluhpi ta zu heih, khy heih ama tahpa vâta, pati dâhdei chhao nie hmâ leipa ei ta.
Âmo deita ta su dâhthlohpa lâ cha balyh ta sie ei ta.
Chyhsa hluhpi ta ama siepa cha hmô ei ta, âmo ama châ tahpa pahno ei ta, khih to tawhta phei ta a vaw râ chyu ei ta, tlô khâh ha ei ta.
Zisu cha ngiahkâ lâ a pua nahta, zawpi hluhpi hmô ta, vaituhpa hnei leipa mietaku hawhta ama châpa vâta, âmo cha a tha pasa ngaita ta. Âmo cha hmo hluhpi pachu ta.
Zâlâ a vaw châ nahta, a pachupazy ano lâ a vy ei ta, a hnohta, “He he su dâhthlohpa châ ta, zâlâ a châ ha hih.
Ama nie awpa khâpa chhâ ma amâ kei chalei thei nawpa ta, zawpizy he eima chheipâh khihzy nata lyuzy lâ pasiesa teh,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Nâmo ta nie awpa pie teh u,” tah ta. Âmo ta a hnohta, “Dinâri za no mâ ta viahchhâ kei chalei sih la ma, nie awpa cha âmo eima pie aw?” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Viahchhâ tlâ khazie nama hnei? Vawh u la, kei moh tua u,” tah ta. Ama hneipa zie ama pahno nahta, “Viahchhâ tlâ pangawh nata ngasa miano,” tah ei ta.
Zawpizy cha sibiepa su liata a py py ta patyusa awpa ta a pachupazy cha biepie ta.
Chatanachata a py py ta, za kha py ta zy, sypangawh py ta zy a tyuh ei ta.

Zisu ta viahchhâ tlâ pangawh nata ngasa miano cha la ta, avâ lâ ua ta, byhnâ aw ta. Viahchhâzy cha eichheih ta, zawpizy rai awpa ta a pachupazy pie ta. Ngasa mianopa cha pachhaih ta ama zydua ta rai ta.
Ama zydua ta nie ei ta, ama rih bie khai ta.
Viahchhâ nata ngasa ama nie bâhpa chhao hrâbyh hmo hrawh hleino tlai a huah ei ta.
Viahchhâ a nietuhpazy cha paw tlohpa sai ta sâh pangawh ama châ.
Zawpizy a pasiesa chhôh ta, a pachupazy cha a hmia lâta, haosâ Besaidâ khih lâ balyh ta thlai pasiesa chhielie ta.
Âmo a pasiesa khai nahta, thlahchhâ awpa ta tlâh lâ kiah ta.
Zâlâ a vaw châ nahta, balyh cha tipo liah liata y ta, ano cha tlâh liata ano dei ta y ta.
Thlih ta thata a supa vâta, balyh ama hiapa ama rie a thei kawpa ta hmô ta. Zâ vaina ei palihna rachhôh liata, âmo cha chapia a chhuahpa ta, tipo chô liata phei ta siepa ta, âmo cha kei pangai ta.
Tipo chô liata phei ta a siepa ama hmô nahta, thlahmihpa khiah ma tah ei ta, thata sâh ei ta.
Ama zydua ta hmô khai ei ta, ama chi ngaita. Zisu ta a pachupazy cha bie thlai a chho ta, ama hnohta, “Thlalôhpa ta y teh u; keima na ei châ. Chi khah u,” tah ta.
Ama hnohta balyh liata a ngia ta, thlih cha a chalih ha ta. A pachupazy cha ama noâh ngaita ta.
Ama palôh kuhchhapa vâta, viahchhâ kyh liata hmo a tlôpa kha ama pahno thai leipa a châ.
Haosâ lâ ama chaka nahta, Kenesare râh kei tlô ei ta. Ngiahkâ liata ama balyh hraih ei ta.
Balyh tawhta ama pua nahta, chyhsazy ta ano cha thlai pahno ha ei ta.
Cha râh chaby zydua lâ thlai sie ei ta. A yna su ama pahnona lâ maih tlâhleipazy ama hmohphaw chhaota a vaw sy ei ta.

Khitaw liata zy, khihpi liata zy, lyu liata zy, khataih lia rai ta a siena maihta, tlâhleipazy cha sôhdaoh su liata zy pazia ei ta, a poh pai chhâ hria awpa ta Zisu cha a haw ei ta, a hriapa maihta tlâh lymâ ei ta.
Phârisaihzy nata Zerusale tawhta a vypa ryhpa pachutuhpa thokhazy Zisu lâ amâ vypakhy nahta,
a pachupa thokhazy cha ku a si leipa ta, ku puapa ta pati ama niepa hmô ei ta.
Phârisaihzy nata Zu chyhsa zydua cha, machâzy taozietyhpa zipa ta, ama ku a phapa ta amâ si ha tua leipa ta cha pati nie beih veih ei.

Chavâta sôhdaoh su tawhta o lâ amâ di tita, ama ngai amâ si ha tua leipa ta cha, pati nie veih ei. Taozietyhpa ama zyhpa hropa hluhpi y ta, nyuzy, beihzy, dawhbeihzy nata niena tlâhkhaizy pasinazie hawhpa taozietyhpa hluhpi ama chhypa a y hra.
Phârisaihzy nata ryhpa pachutuhpazy ta Zisu hnohta, “Khazia na pachupazy ta machâzy taozietyhpa zi leipa ta, ku puapa ta pati ama nie thlâh haw?” tahpa ta hiahri ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Isai ta nâmo, phapakheipazy kyh liata, “‘He phopi heta ama hmao ta na palyupalih ei ta, Ama pathipalôh deikua ta cha einâ hla kaw ei.
Chyhsapa biepiepazy cha, Biezyhpa hawhta pachu ei ta, Hraoleipa ta einâ chhy ei,’ tahpa ta a vaw chhochhieliepa kha â vaw do kaw tlai na.
Khazohpa biepiepazy siesai ei chi ta, chyhsa taozietyhpa tlao namâ patu,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Nama taozietyhpa nama chhy lymâ thei nawpa ta, Khazohpa biepiepazy thy nawpa rypaohna nama pahno kaw!
Mawsi ta, ‘Na nô nata na paw palyupalih teh. Ahy rai a nô tlyma, a paw tlyma a reipachhipa cha a thi tlai awpa a châ,’ tah ta.
Nâmo deikua ta, ‘Chyhsa ta a nô tlyma, a paw tlyma hnohta, “Keima tawhta na hmô awpa zydua cha, Khazohpa lâ ei hlâ khai haw,” a tah khiahta cha,
a nô châta tlyma, a paw châta tlyma, khâpa hmah taopa awpa pasaih khao veih ei chi.
Cha hawhna chata nama taozietyhpa namâ pie pachhuah lymâpa hmâpa ta, Khazohpa bie hraoleipa ta nama tao tyh. Cha hawhpa cha hmo hluhpi nama tao,’” tah ta.
Chatawhcha zawpizy ano lâ awpakhy heih ta, ama hnohta, “Nama zydua ta ei bie nathlie u la, pahno teh u.
Khôtho lâ tawhta chyhsa chhôh lâ a ngiapa khâpa hmo hmahta chyhsapa papuapalei thei vei. Chhôh lâ tawhta a kaw puapa ta chyhsapa cha tlao a papuapalei tyh.
Nakhaoh a hneipa maihta thei mawh sy,” tah ta.
Zawpizy cha o chhôh lâ â ngiasai tawhta, a pachupazy ta pakhona bie a reipa kyh hiahri ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Nâmo chhao taihta pahno thai veih ei chi mâ? Khôtho lâ tawhta chyhsapa chhôh lâ a ngiapa ta chyhsapa papuapalei vei.
Palôh liata a ngia leipa ta, pavyhpi liata a ngia ta, lyupâh puana lâta a pua ha tyh tahpa pahno veih ei chi ma?” tah ta. Cha hawhna chata Zisu ta niepa zydua a pathaih khaizie phuah ta.
Chatawhcha Zisu ta, “Chyhsa chhôh tawhta a kaw puapa ta chyhsapa a papuapalei tyh.
Chhôh tawhta, chyhsapa pathipalôh tawhta, pachâna moleipazy a kaw pua tyh. Apatlana, paruna, lianycheina, apheina,
uahvana, chhiena, dôveina, parâna, kiaphaona, reipachhiena, apalaina nata hruna zy he palôh tawhta a kaw pua tyhpa a châ.
Cha hmo zydua cha chhôh tawhta a kaw puapa châ ta, chazy chata chyhsa a papuapalei tyh,” tah ta.
Cha su tawhta Zisu cha thyu ta, Tyre nata Sidaw biazy chahryh ta. O miakha liata a ngia ta, ahy hmahta ama pahno awpa khoh leipa ta, châhrasala nyu thei awpa châ leipa ta.
Chanô pakha, thlahpa puapa ta a sawchanô hawti a patu hapa ta Zisu thâtih cha thei ta, ano lâ thlai a vy ta, a phei thaby liata kei pao ta.
Cha chanô cha Krikâh chyhsa, Suria râh Phônisia liata a pihpa a châ. A sawchanô tawhta ahripa papua awpa ta a haw ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Sawzy ama rih bie tua mawh sy. Sawzy ku liata viahchhâ chhu ta, izy piepa cha hmo yzie châ vei,” tah ta.
Chanô ta a chhy ta, “A châ na, Abeipa! Châhrasala tlâhkhai ry liata izy chhao ta sawzy viahchhâ zôhpa a tlapazy cha ama nie tyh mâh tâh,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Na bie reipa vâna chata na o lâ a di mah y. Ahripa cha na sawchanô chhôh tawhta a pua haw,” tah ta.
Chanô cha o lâ a di ta, rakhô liata a zia thlâh hapa hawtinô cha hmô ta, ahripa chata puasai ha ta.
Zisu cha Tyre nata Sidaw râh tawhta pua ta, Dekâpôli râh chapiapa ta Kâlili Tipo kei tlô ta.
Chyhsa pakha nahpâpa nata reih pathlie thei leipa ano lâ a vaw chhi ei ta, a chô liata a ku pahnieh awpa ta a haw ei ta.
Zawpi hry tawhta ânano ta a chhi ta, a kuparozy ta a nakhaohzy cha hria ta, a pachih ta pachhao ta, a paleih hria ta.
Avâ lâ moh ta, a hrô ta, a hnohta, “Ephâthâ,” tah ta, cha cha “A pahy teh,” tahna a châ.
A nakhaohzy a vaw pahy ta, a paleih chahryna chhao a vaw pathlâ ta, a siapa ta bie reih thei ha ta.
Zisu ta ahy hmahta chho lei awpa ta âmo cha biepie ta. Châhrasala a pakhâ via nahta, phahnai ngiah viapa ta pathâhsa via rili ei ta.
Zawpizy cha rei thai leina taihta ama noâh ta, “Hmo to a tao phazie rimâ cha! Nahpâpa taihta patheisa ta, reih pathlie thei leipa taihta a pathliesa haw,” tah ei ta.
Cha nohzy liata, zawpi hluhpi a vypakhy heih ei ta, nie awpa khâpa hmah hnei leipa ei ta. Zisu ta a pachupazy aw ta, ama hnohta,
“Zawpizy he tahmâ noh thôh tlai ei hnohta y ha ei ta, nie awpa khâpa hmah ama hnei leipa vâta, tha ei pasa ngaita ei.
Nie leipa ta ama o lâ ei padisa khiah ei ta cha, thokhazy cha amâ vyna a hla tlôh ta, lâpi liata ama panao aw,” tah ta.
A pachupazy ta a chhy ei ta, “He zie chyhsa nie awpa ta, he su dâhthlohpa liana heta kheihta ma viahchhâ eima hnei thei aw?” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta, “Viahchhâ tlâ khazie nama hnei?” tah ta. “Tlâ sari,” tah ei ta.
Zawpizy cha alei liata patyusa ta. Viahchhâ tlâ sari cha la ta, alyna bie a rei khai nahta, eichheih ta, zawpizy rai awpa ta, a pachupazy cha pie ta. Pachupazy ta zawpizy cha rai ei ta.
Nga dipa chhao a chyhta hnei ei ta. Byhnâ a aw khai nahta, cha chhao cha zawpizy rai awpa ta a pachupazy chho ta.
Nie ei ta, ama rih bie khai ta. Nie laibâhpa azôhpa chhao hrâbyh hmo sari tlai a huah ei ta.
A niepa zydua cha sâh palih rachhôh ama châ. Chatawhcha zawpizy cha pasiesa ha ta.
Zisu cha a pachupazy chhaota balyh thlai kiah ta, Dalmanuthâ râh lâ sie ha ta.
Phârisaihzy vaw pua ei ta, Zisu bie cha ei ei ta. Ano pasia nawpa ta, avâ tawhta ngiana ano liata tlua ei ta.
Zisu cha a thlahpa ta thata a hrô ta, “He chhâ heta khazia ngiana a tlua tly? Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, he chhâ hnohna heta ngiana piepa châ aw vei,” tah ta.
Âmo cha siesai ta, balyh liata kiah ta, haosâ lâ chaka ha ta.
Pachupazy ta viahchhâ a phao awpa my ha ei ta, viahchhâ tlâ kha dei leipa ta cha, balyh liata ahropa rai hnei leipa ei ta.
Zisu ta pachupazy cha zikyu a râ ta, ama hnohta, “A hrohrua u la, Phârisaihzy thinô nata Herawda thinô tawhta a vaih teh u,” tah ta.
Pachupazy ta viahchhâ ama hnei leipa kyh reih ei ta.
Zisu ta ama biereipa cha pahno ta, ama hnohta, “Khazia viahchhâ nama hnei leipa kyh nama reih? Pahno thai to veih ei chi ma? Nama no a vâh to vei ma? Nama palôh kuh a chha thlâh ha chy ma?
Mokhaoh hnei ei chi ta, hmô veih ei chi ma? Nakhaoh hnei ei chi ta, thei veih ei chi ma? A thei khao veih ei chi ma?
Chyhsa sâh pangawh châta viahchhâ tlâ pangawh ei pachhaih nona khata, hrâbyh hmo khazie ma nie laibâhpa namâ huah khawh?” tah ta. Âmo ta, “Hmo hrawh hleino,” tah ei ta.
“Cha khiahta la, chyhsa sâh palih châta viahchhâ tlâ sari ei pachhaih nona khata, a laibâhpa khazie namâ huah?” tah ta. Âmo ta, “Hmo sari,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Pahno thai to veih ei chi ma?” tah ta.
Besaidâ khih tlô ei ta. Mochaopa Zisu lâ a vaw chhi ei ta, hria awpa ta a haw ei ta.
Mochaopa cha a ku ta patu ta, khih tawhta puakhei ta, a mo liata a pachih pachhao ta, a chô liata a ku a pahnieh khai nahta, hiahri ta, “Khâpa chhâ na hmô ma?” tah ta.
Chyhsa cha kaw ua ta, “Chyhsa hmô na ta, châhrasala tho a pasiepasâ ngâpa hawhta ei hmô,” tah ta.
A mo liata a ku pahnieh heih ta, mohmia pasaih awpa ta chho ta, a mo vaw pavâpa ta, ato a sia ngaitapa ta hmô thei ha ta.
Zisu ta, “Khih liata a ngia khah y,” tah ta, o lâta padisa ha ta.
Zisu cha a pachupazy chhaota Kaisaria Philipi khihzy lâ sie ta. Lâpi liata ama sie nota, a pachupazy hnohta, “Chyhsazy ta ahy a châ eina tah ei?” tahpa ta hiahri ta.
Âmo ta a chhy ei ta, “Bâtituhpa Zawhâna a châ, cha tah ei ta; thokha ta Elaizâh a châ, cha tah ei ta; thokha ta hrohsopa ahy tlyma a châ, ama cha tah,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta, “Cha khiahta la, nâmo zaw ahy a châ eina tah ei chi?” tah ta. Pity ta a chhy ta, a hnohta, “Mesia na châ,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a thâtih cha ahy hmah chho lei awpa ta pachupazy cha biepie ta.

Zisu ta chyhsa Sawchapawpa cha hmo hluhpi pasa a tao awpa châ ta, machâzy, theihthai beizy nata ryhpa pachutuhpazy ta khoh leipa aw ei ta, thie aw ei ta, noh thôh khai tawhta a thyu heih awpa kyh a pachupazy pachu pathao ta.
Cha bie cha a sia ngaitapa ta reih ta. Pity ta Zisu cha a chhi nano ta, ra ta.
Zisu cha a vaw palie ta, a pachupazy moh ta, Pity cha ra ta, a hnohta, “Sâtâ, ei hnôh lâ y teh! Khazohpa hmozy pachâ leipa chi ta, chyhsapa hmozy tlao na pachâ via he,” tah ta.
Zawpizy cha a pachupazy chhaota ano lâ awpakhy ta, ama hnohta, “Ahy rai eina zi khoh khiahta cha, anosasyh a paky sala, a kraws a piapa ta na zi mawh sy.
Ahy rai a hrona pabohsa a chhuahpa cha, a hrona pahlei aw ta, keima vâta nata thâtihpha vâta a hrona a pahleipa deikua cha, a hrona a pabohsa aw.
Chyhsa ta khizaw he a pôhpalôhpa ta hnei sala, a thlahpa a pahlei tlôh khiahta cha, a châta khâpa a phahnai aw?
Chyhsa ta a thlahpa vyuhpa ta khâpa a pie thei aw?

Ahy rai, he apheihmâhpa nata moleipa chhâ liana heta, kei nata ei biezy a zakheipa maih cha, Paw rônahna nata vâlyuhchâpa pathaihpazy chhaota Chyhsa Sawchapawpa â zu tita, ano cha a zakhei hra aw,” tah ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, he a duahpa sahlaozy hry liata, Khazohpa khinarâh hmotaotheina chhaota a vaw tlôpa ama hmô hlâlei cha, thina a padi lei awpa ama y,” tah ta.
Noh charu khai tawhta Zisu ta Pity, Zâmie nata Zawhâna zy a chhi ta, âmo dei ta tlâh sâhpa lâ khykhei ta. A hmiaphao cha ama hmiakô liata a vaw nano ha ta.
A chysiazy cha a thlaraw vaw sie ta, alei chô liata chysia pasutuhpazy ta ama padiehsa theipa hlâ syulyu ta vaw dieh via ha ta.
Elaizâh nata Mawsi ama hnohta a vaw luah ei ta, Zisu cha bie a chho ei ta.
Pity ta Zisu hnohta, “Pachutuhpa, he liata ypa he eima châta a pha na. Byureih miathôh, nâma châta miakha, Mawsi châta miakha, Elaizâh châta miakha tu ei suh u,” tah ta.
Chi kaw ei ta, Pity cha bie hropa rei awpa pahno leipa ta.
Chatawhcha meihdo ta âmo cha vaw khu ta, meihdo tawhta ao vaw pua ta, “He he ei Sawchapaw, kyh ei pachâpa a châ. A bie nathlie teh u,” tah ta.
Thlai mohmia pasaih ei ta, Zisu dei leipa cha, ama hnohta ahy hmah hmô khao leipa ei ta.
Tlâh tawhta ama za chô nota, athihpa hry tawhta Chyhsa Sawchapawpa a thyu heih hlâlei cha, hmo ama hmôpazy ahy hmah chho lei awpa ta âmo cha biepie ta.
A bie reipa cha a vao thlâh ha ei ta, athihpa hry tawhta thyuheihpa cha khâpa tahna ma a châ tly, tahpa ta a hiahri raihrie ei ta.
Pachupazy ta a hnohta, “Khazia ryhpa pachutuhpazy ta Elaizâh â vy tua awpa a châ ama tah tly?” tahpa ta hiahri ei ta.

Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Hmo to zydua tao pathi awpa ta Elaizâh cha â vy tuapa tlai a châ. Cha khiahta la, Chyhsa Sawchapawpa cha pasana hluhpi tao aw ta, mohnaopa ta a y awpa kyh cha, khâpa vâta ropa ma a châ?
Châhrasala ei cha chho ei, Elaizâh cha a thâtih ropa hawh tlai ta a vy ha ta, ama khozie hawhta a chô liata ama taopa kha a châ,” tah ta.
A pachupa hropazy yna ama za tlô nahta, ama kiapâh liata zawpi hluhpi hmô ei ta. Ryhpa pachutuhpazy nata pachupazy cha bie a ei ngâ kaw ei ta.
Zawpi zydua ta Zisu ama hmôpa nahta, noâh tah kaw ei ta. Ano lâ thlai a râpa ta, a naoh ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Ryhpa pachutuhpazy nata khâpa bie ma namâ ei?” tah ta.
Zawpi hry liata pakha ta, “Pachutuhpa, ei sawchapawpa nâ lâ ei vaw chhi. Ei sawchapawpa he thlahpa hnei ta, cha thlahpa chata reih pathlie thei leipa ta a tao haw.

Thlahpa ta a patuna maihta, taikhy ta, a pakah buchaphy tla ta, a hâhzy charieh ta, a pôhpa a vaw pala khai ha tyh. Thlahpa puapa cha papua awpa ta, na pachupazy a haw ei na ta, châhrasala papua thei veih ei,” tah ta.
Zisu ta âmo cha a chhy ta, “Hy ngiapâleipa chhâ saih u, khachâ ma nama hnohta ei y aw? Khachâ ma ei cha pachâ thai aw ei? Kei lâ a vaw chhi teh u,” tah ta.
Hawtipa cha ano lâ a vaw chhi ei ta. Zisu a hmôpa nahta, thlahpa ta hawtipa cha a rie thlai patheisa ta, alei liata pao ta, a hluah ta, a pakah buchaphy tla ngâ kaw ta.
Zisu ta a paw hnohta, “He hawhta a vaw y pathaona he khachâ a châ haw?” tah ta. A paw ta, “A hawtita tawhta a châ.
Pahleipadia awpa ta ei hluhpi mei liata zy, ti liata zy a papaosa tyh. Khâpa chhâ na tao thei khiahta la, miah ngiachhie la, miah bao mah y,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “‘Na tao thei khiahta la,’ na tah ma! Ngiapâtuhpa châta cha, ato tao theipa a châ,” tah ta.
Hawtipa paw cha thlai awh ta, “Ei ngiâpâ na, ei ngiapâleina liata na bao mah y,” tah ta.

Zawpi amâ vaw râpakhy haipa Zisu ta a hmô nahta, thlahpa puapa cha ra ta, a hnohta, “Nâ, reih pathlie thei leina nata nahpâna thlahpa, bie ei cha pie, a chhôh tawhta vaw pua la, a ngia heih khao khah y,” tah ta.
Thlahpa puapa cha awsâh ta, hawtipa cha thata a taochhie khai tawhta pua ha ta. Hawtipa cha athipa hawhta vaw y ta, chyhsa hluhpi ta, “A thi hapa he,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta a ku patu ta, pathyu ta, a vaw duah ha ta.
O chhôh lâ â ngia nahta, a pachupazy ta, “Khazia keimo ta thlahpa puapa eima papua thei vei?” tahpa ta arulâta hiahri ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “He hawhpa he cha thlahchhâna nata kâhvileina dei leipa ta cha, khâpa ta hmahta papua thei vei,” tah ta.
Cha su tawhta pua ei ta, Kâlili râh chapiapa ta sie ei ta. Ahy hmahta a sievawna ama pahno awpa khoh leipa ta.
A pachupazy cha pachu ta, ama hnohta, “Chyhsa Sawchapawpa he chyhsazy ku liata hlâpa châ aw ta, thie aw ei ta, ama thie tawhta noh thôh noh ta a thyu heih aw,” tah ta.
Châhrasala a bie reipa cha a pachâ nawpa rai pahno veih ei. Ano hra cha hiahri ngâh tlôh leipa ei ta.
Kâpynia khih tlô ei ta. O chhôh liata a y nota ama hnohta, “Lâpi liana kha khâpa bie ma namâ ei tly?” tah ta.
Ahy ma a rônah chai aw tahpa lâpi liata amâ vaw ei laihpa vâta, phie a chalih khai ha ei ta.

A tyuh ta, pahrawh hleinozy cha aw ta, ama hnohta, “Ahy rai a hmiatua chaipa a châ khoh khiahta cha, chyhsa zydua hlâta hnôh chaipa ta a y awpa châ ta, chyhsa zydua chakaotuhpa ta a y awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Hawtipa pakha la ta, ama hry liata paduasa ta, a bâh liata a pyh ta, ama hnohta,
“Ahy rai ei moh ta he hawhpa hawti pakha chhao a lypa cha, keima nâ lypa a châ. Keima nâ lypa cha, keima nâ lypa châ leipa ta, nâ tuahtuhpa a lypa tlao a châ,” tah ta.
Zawhâna ta a hnohta, “Pachutuhpa, chyhsa pakha na moh ta ahripa a papuapa hmô pi ta, miah a pazi leipa vâta eima pakhâ haw,” tah ta.
Zisu ta, “Pakhâ khuh vy. Chyhsa ahy rai ei moh ta hmonoâhpa a taopa cha, hnôhlâ ta thlai na reipachhie pazi aw vei.
Ahy rai miah a dyuh leipa cha eima chhâh a châpa a châ.
Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, ahy rai Krista moh vâta ti nyu kha châ padopa cha, a lymâ pahlei cheita aw vei.
“Ahy rai, he nâ ngiapâtuhpa hawtizy hry liata pakha chhao a pahluasapa cha, a rao liata charona lô laipa paaopa ta tilaipi liata thypa châ sala ano châta a pha via aw.
Na ku ta a cha pamoleisa khiahta cha, tai ha mah y. Ku miano ta Kehenâ lâ sie awpa hlâta cha, ku miakha chôpa ta hrona liata a ngiapa na châta a pha via.
Kehenâ liata cha ama lôpa thi beih leipa ta, mei chhao pachhaipa ta y beih vei.
Na phei ta a cha pamoleisa khiahta cha, tai ha mah y. Phei no hneipa ta Kehenâ lâ thypa châ awpa hlâta cha, pheisypa ta hrona lâ a ngiapa na châta a pha via.
Kehenâ liata cha ama lôpa thi beih leipa ta, mei chhao pachhaipa ta y beih vei.
Na mo ta a cha pamoleisa khiahta cha, thaoh ha mah y. Mo no hneipa ta Kehenâ liata thypa châ awpa hlâta cha, mo kha hneipa ta Khazohpa khinarâh lâ a ngiapa na châta a pha via.
Kehenâ liata cha, ama lôpa thi beih leipa ta, mei chhao pachhaipa ta y beih vei.
Chyhsa to mei ta pasiapa châ aw ei ta, atheihna to alôh ta pa-iahpa a châ aw.
Alôh cha a pha, châhrasala alôh cha a padâh ha khiahta cha, kheihta ma nama pa-iahsa heih thei aw? Alôh hawhta iah u la, a dyryh kawpa ta y muh vy,” tah ta.
Zisu cha, cha su tawhta pua ta, Zawdâh haosâ Zudia râh lâ sie ta. Zawpizy ano lâ a vypakhy heih ei ta. A tao tyhpa hawhta, âmo cha pachu heih ta.
Phârisaihzy ano lâ a vy ei ta, ano pasia nawpa ta, “Chapaw ta a lapinô ma awpa ryhpa ta a pasaih ma?” tahpa ta hiahri ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Mawsi ta kheihta ma bie a cha pie ei?” tah ta.
Âmo ta, “Mawsi ta mana châ ropa ta lapinô ma awpa a pasaih,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Nama palôh kuhchhana vâta, he biepiepa he nama châta a ropa a châ.
Châhrasala leilô tao tua no tawhta, ‘Khazohpa ta âmo cha chapaw nata chanô ta a tao ei.
Chavâta chapaw ta a nô nata a paw siesai aw ta, a lapinô a patu aw.
Chatanachata panozy cha pôhpa miakha ama vaw châ ha aw.’ Pano châ khao leipa ei ta, pôhpa miakha tlao ama châ haw.
Chavâta Khazohpa ta a pazaopa cha, chyhsa ta pachhaih khah sy,” tah ta.
O liata ama y nota, a pachupazy ta cha bie cha Zisu hiahri heih ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Ahy rai a lapinô ma ta, chyhsa hropa a hneipa cha, cha chanô chô liata a pheipa a châ.
Chanô chhao ta a vahpa a chhaih sala, chyhsa hropa a hnei khiahta cha, cha chapaw chô liata â pheipa a châ hra,” tah ta.
A hria awpa ta hawtizy ano lâ a vaw chhi ei ta, pachupazy ta âmo cha ra ei ta.
Zisu deikua ta, cha cha a hmô nahta, a ly leipa ta, ama hnohta, “Hawtizy kei lâ a vaw chhi u la, dytha khah u. Khazohpa khinarâh cha, he hawhpa chyhsazy eih châ tlôh ta.
Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, Khazohpa khinarâh cha, hawti a lypa hawhta a ly leipa maihta a ngia cheita aw veih ei,” tah ta.
Hawtizy cha a bâh ta chalo ta, ama chô liata a ku pahnieh ta, byhnâ awpa ta.
Sie awpa ta a pua nahta, chyhsa pakha ano lâ a vaw râ ta, a hmiakô liata pakhu paneih ta, a hnohta, “Pachutuh phapa, chhâzaw hrona ei hnei thei nawpa ta khâpa ei tao aw?” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Khazia phapa eina tah chi? Khazohpa dei leipa ta ahy hmahta phapa y veih ei.
Biepiepazy na pahno: ‘Liany cheih kha, Aphei kha, Paru kha, Haipa ta chyhsa leih kha, Chyhsa dôvei kha, Na nô nata paw palyupalih teh,’ tahpazy na pahno,” tah ta.
Ano ta Zisu hnohta, “Pachutuhpa, cha zydua cha ei hawti no tawhta ei zyh lymâ tyh,” tah ta.

Zisu ta ano cha moh ta, a kyhpachâ kaw ta, a hnohta, “Hmo miakha nâ phahla: sie la, na hneipa zydua zuah la, dyhchhiepazy pie mah y. Chatanachata vârâh liata ryu na hnei aw. Cha khai tawhta a vy la, na zi mah y,” tah ta.
Sôh hluhpi a hneipa a châpa vâta, cha bie vâna chata a hmia chhie kaw ta, pachârôhpa ta sie ha ta.
Zisu cha mohmia pasaih ta, a pachupazy hnohta, “Hneirôhpazy châta la, Khazohpa khinarâh liata a ngia awpa a ru kaw aw tlai na” tah ta.
Pachupazy ta a bie reipa cha noâh tah kaw ei ta. Zisu ta âmo cha a chhy heih ta, “Saw saih u, Khazohpa khinarâh liata a ngia awpa cha a ru kaw tlai mâh tâh!
Chyhsa hneirôhpa Khazohpa khinarâh liata a ngia awpa hlâta cha, râraoseihpa chiephoh khaoh liata a ngia awpa tlao a nao via,” tah ta.
Pachupazy cha ama noâh ngaita ta, a hnohta, “Chata khiahta cha, ahy ma pachha a châ thei aw tly?” tah ei ta.

Zisu ta âmo cha moh ta, ama hnohta, “Cha cha chyhsapa châta la tao thei rimâ awpa châ leipa ta, Khazohpa châta deikua cha, tao thei leipa hmo châ vei. Khazohpa châta cha, ato tao theipa a châ,” tah ta.
Pity ta a hnohta, “Moh tua, keimo he ato siesaipa ta eima cha zi hih,” tah ta.
Zisu ta, “Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, keima vâta nata thâtihpha vâta, o tlyma, unawhzy tlyma, sietanôzy tlyma, nô tlyma, paw tlyma, sawzy tlyma, râhzy tlyma a siesaipa cha,
tahmâ hro chhôh tlai heta ozy, unawhzy, sietanôzy, nôzy, sawzy, râhzy a lie za kha ta hmô aw ei ta, taolana nata daihti vaw tlô awpazy liata chhâzaw hrona ama hnei aw.
Châhrasala hmiatua chaipa hluhpizy cha hnôh chaipa châ aw ei ta, hnôh chaipazy cha hmiatua chaipazy ama châ aw,” tah ta.

Zerusale lâ khy ei ta, lâpi liata ama sie nota, Zisu cha hmia a sah ta. Pachupazy ta noâh tah kaw ei ta, ano a zituhpazy chhao ta chi ngaita ei ta. Pahrawh hleinozy cha anano ta a chhi ta, a chô liata hmo vaw tlô awpazy âmo chho ta,

ama hnohta, “Pachâ teh u, Zerusale lâ eima khy hai hih. Chyhsa Sawchapawpa he theihthai beizy nata ryhpa pachutuhpazy ku liata hlâpa châ aw ta, âmo ta thie awpa ta thailei pachâsa aw ei ta, Zenitaizy ku liata ama hlâ aw.
Zenitaizy ta ano cha pasipasawh aw ei ta, ama pachih ta pachhao aw ei ta, chhei aw ei ta, ama thie aw. Noh thôh noh ta a thyu heih aw,” tah ta.
Zebâdi sawchapaw Zâmie nata Zawhâna cha Zisu lâ a vy ei ta, a hnohta, “Pachutuhpa, eima châ hawpa maih miah na taopa awpa ta eima khoh,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Khâpa cha taopa ei sah la nama khoh?” tah ta.
Âmo ta a hnohta, “Na rônahna liata na chachâh lâta pakha, na chavei lâta pakha, miah patyusa mah y,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Nama hiapa pahno veih ei chi. Ei nyu dopa nama doh thei aw ma? Ei bâti châna liata namâ bâti thei hra aw ma?” tah ta.
Âmo ta a hnohta, “Eima tao thei aw,” tah ei ta. Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Ei nyu dopa cha doh thei aw ei chi ta, ei bâtina liata chhao namâ bâti thei ngyu aw.
Châhrasala ei chachâh lâ tlyma, ei chavei lâ tlyma a tyuh awpa kyh cha, keima pie awpa châ vei. Âmo châta a chhuahdy chiehpazy châta tlao a châ,” tah ta.
Pahrawhzy ta cha kyh cha ama vaw pahno nahta, Zâmie nata Zawhâna chô liata ama palôh châ lei kaw ta.

Zisu ta pachupazy cha aw ta, ama hnohta, “Zenitaizy chô liata ryureituhpa ta raopazy ta cha, ama sahlaozy chô liata amâ bei ngaitazie nata ama molaipazy chhao ta ama sahlaozy chô liata bie ama hnei ngaitazie nama pahno.
Nâmo hry liata deikua cha, cha hawhta a châ awpa châ vei. Ahy rai nama hry liata molaipa châ a khoh khiahta cha, châ chakaotuhpa ta a y awpa châ ta,
ahy rai nama hry liata hmiatua chaipa châ a khoh khiahta cha, chyhsa zydua sei ta a y awpa a châ.
Chyhsa Sawchapawpa chhao tlai he, chyhsazy ta ano ama chakao awpa ta a zupa châ leipa ta, ano ta chyhsazy chakaopa ta, chyhsa hluhpi chatlaina châta a hrona pie awpa ta a zupa a châ,” tah ta.
Zerikô tlô ei ta. Zisu cha a pachupazy nata chyhsa hluhpi chhaota Zerikô tawhta pua ta. Timia sawchapawpa mochaopa kudaopa Bâtimia cha lâpi kiah liata a vaw tyuh thlâh ha ta.
Nâzari Zisu a châ tahpa a thei nahta, awh ta, a hnohta, “Zisu, Dâvi Sawchapawpa, na ngiachhie mah y!” tah ta.
Chyhsa hluhpi ta a chalih awpa ta ra ei ta, châhrasala “Dâvi Sawchapawpa, na ngiachhie mah y!” tahpa ta awh via rili ta.
Zisu cha a duah ta, “Kei aw teh u,” tah ta. Mochaopa cha kei aw ei ta, a hnohta, “Thlalôhpa ta y la, thyu teh, a cha aw chu,” tah ei ta.
Mochaopa cha a poh thypa ta, a kaw zaw ta, Zisu lâ thlai pangai ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Khâpa cha taopa awpa ma na khoh?” tah ta. Mochaopa ta a hnohta, “Pachutuhpa, mo pavâ awpa ei khoh,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Sie mah y, nâ ngiapâna ta a cha patlâh haw,” tah ta. Chatanachata a mo thlai vaw pavâ ta, lâpi liata Zisu cha zi pâ ha ta.
Zerusale a hnia ei ta, Ôli tlâh liata Bethaphâ nata Bethâni khih ama tlô nahta, Zisu ta a pachupazy hry liata pano tuah ta,
ama hnohta, “Nama hmia lâta khih lâ hao vawh u la, khih namâ ngia nahta, ahy hmah kia beih leipa alâtaw hraipa hmô aw ei chi ta, pathlâ u la, a vaw chhi muh vy.
‘Khazia khata nama tao?’ châ tahpa ama y khiahta cha, ‘Abeipa ta a khoh, he liata thlai a vaw soh heih aw,’ nama tah aw,” tah ta.
Pachupazy cha vawh ei ta, ochhi kiapâh, khôtho lâ lâlai liata alâtaw â hraih thlâh hapa hmô ei ta, pathlâ ei ta.
Cha liata a duahpa thokhazy ta ama hnohta, “Khazia alâtaw kha nama pathlâ?” tah ei ta.
Zisu bie reipa cha âmo chho ei ta, chatanachata pasiesa ha ei ta.
Alâtaw cha Zisu lâ a vaw chhi ei ta, ama pohzy ta a ky padia ei ta, Zisu ta alâ cha kiah ta.
Chyhsa hluhpi ta lâpi liata ama pohzy phaw ei ta, ahropazy ta lyurâhpa liata thobuh chiahzy chhawhpa ta phaw ei ta.
A hmia lâta a siepazy nata a hnôh lâta a pazipazy ta, “Haozanâ! Abeipa moh ta a vypa cha reithaipa ta y mawh sy!
Eima paw Dâvi khinarâh a vaw tlô awpa cha reithaipa ta y mawh sy! Chônôchaipa liata Haozanâ!” tahpa ta awh ei ta.
Zerusale â ngia nahta, Achhyna o lâ vawh ta. Hmo to a mo khai nahta, vaw zâlâ ha ta, pua ta, pahrawh hleinozy chhaota Bethâni lâ sie ha ei ta.
A mylâ ta, Bethâni tawhta amâ vy nahta, a nodi kaw ta.

Lâhla tawhta theiku kô buh rôhpa kei hmô ta, a thei hmô awpa hnabeiseihpa ta pangai ta. A kei tlô nahta deikua cha, a hna dei leipa cha khâpa hmah hmô leipa ta. Theiku pathei daihti a châ mâh leipa vâta a châ.
Zisu ta theiku kô hnohta, “Ahy hmahta na thei nie beih khao khah sy,” tah ta. Cha bie cha a pachupazy ta thei ei ta.
Zerusale tlô ei ta. Achhyna o liata a ngia ta, Achhyna o liata hmo a zuahtuhpazy nata a chaleituhpazy papua ta, tâkâ rituhpa tlâhkhaizy nata pivaw zuahtuhpa dyuchhaizy chhao chati pathlah ta.
Achhyna o chapiapa ta hmo phaopa chhao ahy hmah pasai khao leipa ta.
Âmo cha pachu ta, ama hnohta, “‘Ei o cha phopi zydua châta thlahchhâna o ama bi aw,’ tahpa ta ropa châ vei ma? Nâmo deikua ta cha, parutuhpazy lôpu ta nama tao ha he zaw,” tah ta.
Theihthai beizy nata ryhpa pachutuhpazy ta cha bie cha thei ei ta. Zawpi zydua ta a pachuna noâh ama tah ngaitapa vâta, Zisu cha chi ei ta, ama pahleipadia thei nawpa lâpi tlua ei ta.
Zâlâ a vaw châ nahta, khihpi tawhta pua ta.
My ta ama sie nota, theiku kô kha chapia ei ta, a thari taihta a raoh khai hapa hmô ei ta.
Pity ta a vaw thei ta, Zisu hnohta, “Pachutuhpa, moh tua! Theiku kô chhie na sapa kha a raoh ha huh,” tah ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Khazohpa a ngiapâ teh u.

Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, ahy rai he tlâh hnohna heta, ‘A pasie la, tilaipi liata a kei thy teh,’ tah sala, a palôh liata a lôh leina hnei leipa ta, a bie reipa cha a vaw tlô aw tahpa â ngiapâ khiahta cha, a châta taopa a châ aw.
Chavâta ei cha chho ei, khâpa rai thlahchhâna ta nama hiapa maih hmô hapa hawhta pachâ teh u. Chatanachata nama hiapa cha nâmo eih a châ aw.
Thlahchhâpa ta namâ duana maihta, chyhsa chô liata kheihawhpa biepeipa nama hneipa maih a ngiahthai ha muh vy. Chatanachata nama Paw vârâh liata a ypa chhao ta nama paraonazy a châ ngiahthai aw ei.
Namâ ngiahthai vei khiahta cha, nama Paw vârâh liata a ypa ta nama paraonazy châ ngiahthai aw veih ei,” tah ta.
Zerusale lâ a lie heih ei ta. Achhyna o chhôh liata â hlaihlâ hai nota, theihthai beizy, ryhpa pachutuhpazy nata machâzy ano lâ a vy ei ta,
a hnohta, “Khâpa biehneina hmâpa ta ma he hmozy he na tao? He hmozy tao awpa ta ahy ma biehneina châ pie?” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Bie kawh kha ei cha hiahri hra aw ei. Nâ chhy u la, kei chhao ta he hmozy he ahy biehneina ta ma ei tao tahpa ei cha chho aw ei.
Zawhâna bâtina kha vârâh tawhtapa ma, chyhsapa tawhtapa maw? Nâ chhy teh u,” tah ta.
A chhohia ei ta, “‘Vârâh tawhtapa,’ tah mawh sih la, ‘Cha khiah khazia a bie nama zo vei?’ miah tah ha aw?
‘Chyhsapa tawhtapa,’ eima tah thlâh ha aw tlyma?” tah ei ta. Châhrasala chyhsa zydua ta Zawhâna cha hrohso hmeiseihpa hawhta ama pachâpa vâta, zawpi chi tlôh ei, tahpa ta noraihpa ta y ei ta,
Zisu cha a chhy ei ta, “Pahno ma pi,” tah ei ta. Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Kei chhao ta ahy biehneina ta ma he hmozy he ei tao tahpa cha chho hra aw veih ei na,” tah ta.

Pakhona biezy ta ama hnohta reih heih ta. “Chyhsa pakha ta kre sadô tao ta. Sadô cha dôh ta, kre saohna khaoh chao ta, o sâhpa sa ta, lyutaotuhpazy hnohta thlyu hlao awpa ta pie ta, râh hlapi lâ sie ha ta.
A thei lyu â daih nahta, lyutaopazy lâ chakaotuhpa tuah ta, kre sadô theilâpazy âmo lâ kei palasa ta.
Chakaotuhpa cha vaw patu ei ta, chhei ei ta, ku ruapa ta pasiesa ei ta.
Chakaotuh hropa âmo lâ tuah heih ta, ano chhao cha a luh liata alô ta vawh ei ta, hmah paphao ei ta, nozachhih ngaitapa ta tao ei ta.
Ahropa tuah heih ta, ano chhao cha thie ei ta. Chakaotuhpa hropazy chhao, cha hawhta vaw tao lymâ ei ta, thokha tu ei ta, thokha thie ei ta.
Pakha deita hnei bâ ta, cha cha a sawchapaw kho ngaitapa a châ. ‘Ei sawchapawpa chhâ he cha ama za aw,’ tahpa ta pachâ ta. Ano cha a chhâ chaina ta âmo lâ tuah ta.
Châhrasala lyutaotuhpazy ta, ‘He chyhsa he ryutotuhpa cha a châ hih. A vy u la, thie ei suh u. Chatanachata ryu a to awpa cha keimo châta a châ aw,’ tah ei ta.
A sawchapawpa cha patu ei ta, thie ei ta, kre sadô khôtho lâ ama thy haw.
Kre sadô hneituhpa ta kheihta a tao aw? Vawh aw ta, lyutaotuhpazy pahleipadia aw ta, kre sadô cha chyhsa hropazy a pie aw.
Biehrai liata, “‘O satuhpazy alô kho leipa kha, A ki lô a vaw châ haw;
Cha cha Abeipa taopa châ ta, Eima mo liata â ngia ngaita,’ tahpa ta ropa reih beih veih ei chi ma?” tah ta.
Cha pakhona bie cha âmo a nuapa ta a reipa a châ tahpa ama pahnopa vâta, Zisu cha patu awpa khoh ei ta. Châhrasala zawpi ama chipa vâta, Zisu cha siesaipa ta, sie ha ei ta.
A bie reipa liata patu a chhuahpa ta, Phârisaihzy nata Herawda py liata chyhsa thokha Zisu lâ tuah ei ta.

A kô ama tlô nahta, a hnohta, “Pachutuhpa, chyhsa dopa châ chi ta, ahy pachâna hmahta a papeisa va chi tahpa eima pahno. Chyhsapa alânazie ta cha pahnie leipa ta, hmeiseihna kyh ta Khazohpa lâpi na pachu tyh. Kaisarâ lâ chhie piepa he ryhpa ta a pasaih ma, pasaih vei?
Eima pie aw ma, pie aw vei?” tah ei ta. Zisu ta ama pasuapachao tahpa pahno ta, ama hnohta, “Khazia eina pasia ei chi? Tâkâ dinâri miakha na vaw pie teh u, ei moh tua aw,” tah ta.
Tâkâ cha vaw pie ei ta. Zisu ta ama hnohta, “He he ahy nothlahpa nata ahy moh maw?” tah ta. Âmo ta, “Kaisarâ,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Kaisarâ hmozy cha Kaisarâ pie u la, Khazohpa hmozy cha Khazohpa lâ pie teh u,” tah ta. Ama noâh ngaita ta.
Thyuheihna y vei a tahpa Saduasizy ano lâ a vy ei ta, a hnohta,

“Pachutuhpa, Mawsi ta châ miah ropa ta, ahy rai a unawhpa ta saw hnei leipa ta a lapinô a thisai khiahta cha, a unawhpa lapinô cha hnei aw ta, a unawhpa châta chi a pathlapa awpa a châ tahpa ta miah a chho.
Unawh pasari y ei ta, a uhthei chaipa ta lapinô hnei ta, chi pathla leipa ta thi ha ta.
Unawh panona ta a uhta lapinô cha hnei ta, ano chhao chi pathla leipa ta thisai ha hra ta. Unawh pathôhna chhao, cha hawhta châ hra ta.
Unawh pasarina chhao ta chi pathla leipa ta thi ha hra ta. Achhâna liata, chanô chhao cha thi pâ ha hra ta.
Thyuheihna daihti liata, ama thyuheih tita ahy lapinô ma a châ aw? Ama pasari ta lapinô ta hnei chyu tlôh ei ta,” tahpa ta hiahri ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Cha vâna chata vei ma nama pachâpasi tyh vei? Biehrai pahno leipa ei chi ta, Khazohpa hmotaotheina chhao pahno veih ei chi?
Athihpa hry tawhta ama thyuheih tita la, nôvah ahneina y khao aw vei. Vârâh liata vâlyuhchâpazy hawhta tlao ama châ ha aw.

Athihpazy pathyupa ta ama y awpa kyh cha, Mawsi châbu liata thobuh kyh rona liana khata, Khazohpa ta, ‘Kei he Abarahâ Khazohpa, Aisika Khazohpa nata Zakaw Khazohpa ei châ,’ tahpa ta Mawsi a chhona bie kha reih beih veih ei chi ma?
Khazohpa cha athihpazy Khazohpa châ leipa ta, ahrohpazy Khazohpa a châ. Nama pachâ chhei haw,” tah ta.

Ryhpa pachutuhpazy hry liata pakha ano lâ a vy ta. Bie amâ ei ngâpa cha thei ta, a phapa ta â chhy lymâpa a hmô nahta, Zisu hnohta, “Biepiepa zydua hry liata khâpa ma a peimawh chai?” tahpa ta hiahri ta.
Zisu ta, “Biepiepa peimawh chaipa cha he he a châ, ‘Hy Izarei, nathlie teh: Abeipa eima Khazohpa, Abeipa cha pakha deita a y.
Abeipa na Khazohpa cha na pathipalôh tlokhuh ta, na thlahpa tlokhuh ta, na pachâna tlokhuh ta nata na thatlôna tlokhuh ta kyh na pachâ awpa a châ,’ tahpa hih.
A pazipa cha, ‘Nâma kyh nâ pachâpa hawhta, na vaih kyh na pachâ awpa a châ,’ tahpa he a châ. He hlâta biepiepa rônah viapa y vei,” tahpa ta a chhy ta.
Ryhpa pachutuhpa ta a hnohta, “Pachutuhpa, na reipa â do na. Biedopa tlai na na reih. Khazohpa pakha deita y ta, ano leipa ta Khazohpa hropa rai y veih ei.

Khazohpa cha pathipalôh tlokhuh ta, pahnona tlokhuh ta nata thatlôna tlokhuh ta kyhpachâpa nata sasyh kyh a pachâpa hawhta vaih kyhpachâpa cha, a pôhpa duata rao khaipa raopa hlânazy nata atheihnazy hlâta pha via syulyupa a châ,” tah ta.
So ngaitapa ta â chhypa cha Zisu ta a hmô nahta, a hnohta, “Khazohpa khinarâh tawhta a hla va chi,” tah ta. Cha rakha tawhta cha, ahy hmahta bie hiahri ngâh khao veih ei.
Zisu cha Achhyna o liata pachu ta, hiahrinazy a chhy lymâ ta, ama hnohta, “Kheihtazie ta ma ryhpa pachutuhpazy ta Krista cha Dâvi sawchapawpa a châ tahpa ta ama rei tyh tly?
“‘Abeipa ta ei Beipa hnohta, Na chariahpazy na phei ry liata ei so khai hlâlei cha, Ei chachâh lâta a tyuh mah y,’ a tahpa kha.
Dâvi ta ano cha Abeipa a tah tlôh khiahta cha, kheihta ma Krista cha Dâvi sawchapawpa a châ thai aw?” tah ta. Zawpizy ta a ly ngaitapa ta a bie cha nathlie ei ta.
A pachu lymâna liata hetana heta reih ta: “Ryhpa pachutuhpazy tawhta a vaih teh u. Âmo cha viahkao pasipazy a kypa ta, sôdaohna suzy liata anaohna hnabeiseih ei ta,
pakhyna o liata dyuchhai pha chaipazy a hnaw ei ta, kyhchhina liata su pha chaipazy amâ haw tyh.
Nôhmei olyuzy nie khai ei ta, a chapuahchaluah nawpa ta a pasi pi ta thlah ama chhâ tyh. Cha hawhpa chyhsazy cha thailei ama châ pachai aw,” tah ta.
Zisu cha thyuna byh dady liata a tyuh ta, chyhsazy ta thyuna byh liata tâkâ ama pathlapa cha moh ta. Chyhsa hneirôhpa hluhpizy ta a hluhpi pathla ei ta.
Nôhmei dyhchhiepa a vy ta, tâkâ dipa miano pathla ta. Cha cha phusâ miakha tlu a châ.
Zisu ta a pachupazy aw ta, ama hnohta, “Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, sôh thyuna byh liata a pathlapa zydua hlâta, he nôhmei dyhchhiepa heta a pathla hluh chai.
Mohropa zydua cha ama hnei laikhôpa thyu ei ta, he chanô deikua he cha, dyhchhie kawpa châ hra sala, a khihsatôhtuna châta a hmâ awpa a hnei chhôhpa a thyu khai ha hih,” tah ta.
Achhyna o tawhta a pua nahta, a pachupazy hry liata pakha ta a hnohta, “Pachutuhpa, moh tua, alôzy nata ozy he a rônah kaw dia!” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “He o rônahpazy he na hmô bao ma cha? Alô pachopazy he parao leipa ta miakha hmahta y aw vei,” tah ta.
Achhyna o dady ta Ôli tlâh liata â tyu thlâh ha nota, Pity, Zâmie, Zawhâna nata Adaru zy ta arulâta bie hiahri ei ta.
“Cha hmozy cha khati ta a vaw tlô aw? Cha hmo zydua vaw tlô nawpa daihti ngiana khâpa a y aw? Miah chho teh,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Ahy hmahta ama cha dôvei lei nawpa ta a vaih teh u.
Chyhsa hluhpi ta, ‘Krista ei châ,’ tahpa ta ei moh ta a vy aw ei ta, chyhsa hluhpi ama dôvei aw.
Adyuhnazy nata adyuhna bie pathâhpazy nama thei tita, nôpopa ta y khuh vy. Chazy cha a vaw tlô awpa rai a châ, châhrasala chhâna la châ mâh vei.
Phopi nata phopi a dyuh aw ei ta, khinarâh nata khinarâh amâ dyuh aw. Su hluhpi liata alozy a sih aw ta, chakâhnazy a tlô aw. Chazy cha sawzeih pasa athaona a châ.

“Châhrasala a hrohrua teh u. Ryureituhpazy cha patusa aw ei ta, pakhyna ozy liata cha chhei aw ei ta, keima vâta ryureituhpazy nata abeizy hmiakô liata a duah aw ei chi ta, ama hmiakô liata pahnotuhpa châ awpa ta namâ duah aw.
Thâtihpha cha phopi zydua hnohta chho khai tua awpa a châ.

Cha patupa ta ama châ chhi tita, khâpa eima reih aw tahpa ta pachâ chhie chhielie khuh vy. A daihtita liata bie vaw tlô aw ta, cha bie cha nama rei awpa a châ. A reihtuhpa cha nâmo châ leipa aw ei chi ta, Thlahpa Pathaihpa tlao a châ aw.
Thie awpa ta, unawhpa ta a unawhpa patusa aw ta, paw ta a saw patusa aw ta, sawzy ta ama nôpawzy a dyuh aw ei ta, ama pathiesa aw.
Chyhsa zydua ta ei moh vâta ama châ hao aw. Châhrasala achhâna taihta a tao hualuapa cha pachhapa ta a y aw.
“Châhrasala roryhrana pasichhihpa cha â dua lei nawpa su liata â duapa nama hmô tita, Zudia liata a ypazy cha tlâh lâ a râ mawh ei sy. A reihtuhpa ta a yzie pahno thai mawh sy.
O chô liata a ypa ta o ry lâ chô leipa sala, a o liata hmo la awpa ta a ngia khah sy.
Lyu liata a ypa ta a poh la awpa ta kua heih khah sy.
Cha nohzy liata chanô sawphaohpa nata hawsaih a pyh haipazy hupo awpa rimâ cha!
Cha hmo cha chasipaw nota a vaw tlô lei nawpa ta thlahchhâ teh u.
Cha nohzy cha riethei pasana noh châ aw ta, cha tlatlu ta rarôh ypa cha, Khazohpa taopa leilô y tua no tawhta tahmâ taihta y beih leipa ta, y heih khao aw vei.
Abeipa ta cha nohzy cha pachhosa leipa chhochhi sala, chyhsa ahy hmahta pachhapa ta y aw veih ei. Châhrasala chyhsa atlyhpa, a raopazy vâta nohzy cha a pachhohsapa a châ.
Chyhsa ta nama hnohta, ‘Moh teh u, Mesia cha he liata a y,’ a tah khiahta tlyma, ‘Moh teh u, hao liata a y,’ a tah khiahta tlyma, zo khuh vy.
Mesia pakheipazy nata hrohso pakheipazy vaw pua aw ei ta, ngiana nata hmonoâhpazy ama tao aw. Tao theipa châ sala, atlyhpazy taih ama dôvei aw.
Nâmo deikua cha, a vaih teh u, ato ei cha chhochhielie ha ei hih.
“Cha nohzy liata, riethei pasana a y khai tawhta, noh pazohsapa châ aw ta, thlâpâ khaih khao leipa aw ta,
avâ tawhta awhsizy za tla aw ei ta, avâ hmotaotheinazy cha chalyupa a châ aw.
Chatawhcha Chyhsa Sawchapawpa cha hmotaotheina nata rônah ngaitapa ta meihdo hry liata â zupa ama hmô aw.
A vâlyuhchâpazy tuah aw ta, â tlyhpazy cha kaokih miapalih tawhta, alei chy chhâna tawhta avâ chy chhâna taihta a pakhy aw.
“Theiku kô tawhta a chu teh u. A chhyh panyupa kaw paka ta, a hna a vaw thao khiahta cha, nopi â hnia haw tahpa nama pahno.
Cha hawhna hra chata, chazy a vaw tlôpa nama hmô tita, Chyhsa Sawchapawpa cha a vaw hnia ha ta, chhikao thaby liata a y tahpa pahno teh u.
Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, cha hmo zydua a tlô paki khai hlâlei cha, he chhâ he lei aw vei.
Lei nata vâ a lei aw, ei biezy deikua lei aw vei.
“Châhrasala cha noh nata dawh cha, Paw dei leipa ta cha, ahy hmahta pahno veih ei. Vârâh liata vâlyuhchâpazy ta pahno leipa ei ta, Sawchapawpa chhao ta pahno vei.
A daihti vaw tlô nawpa nama pahno leipa vâta, riavaihpa ta y u la, a hrohruapa ta thlahchhâ teh u.

Cha daihti vaw tlô nawpa cha, chyhsa ta lâhlapi lâ khitlyh ta, a o a siesaipa cha a chakaotuhpazy ku liata soh ta, ama raihria awpa pie chyu ta, ochhi vaituhpa cha, khâ a hra thlâh ha awpa ta bie a piepa hawhta a châ.
Chavâta a hrohrua teh u, o hneituhpa vaw tlô nawpa daihti cha, zâlâ ta ma, zâcho ta ma, awhkho ta ma, my ta ma a châ aw tahpa pahno tlôh leipa ei chi ta.
Chataleipatala eikhapi ta a vy aw ta, namâ mô chhôh ta a cha vaw pachhai pathlei aw ei.
Nama hnohta ei reipa he chyhsa zydua hnohta a reihpa ei châ: Riavaihpa ta y teh u,” tah ta.
Zawpakhô nata thinô pahlao leipa Viahchhâ Kyhchhi tlô hlâ noh nona liata, theihthai beizy nata ryhpa pachutuhpazy ta Zisu cha dôpakhei ta patupa ta, ama thie thei nawpa kyh tlua ei ta.
Châhrasala, “Kyhchhi chhôh ta la châ khah sy. Chataleipatala zawpi a patypamâ pathlei aw na,” tah ei ta.
Bethâni liata phawhpa Saimaw o liata pati a dôh hai nota, chanô pakha ta spinâ suapa ta taopa alabastâ sathaw sôh ngaitapa ôh vaw cheih ta, sathaw ôh cha pakei ta, Zisu luh liata bao ta.
Cha liata a ypa thokha cha ama hiehâh kaw ta, “Khazia ma sathaw ropahâhpa a pahryuh thlâhthli tly?
He sathaw he dinâri za thôh hlâta hluh via ta zuah theipa châ ta, cha cha dyhchhiepazy piepa châ sala, a pha via awpa tlai,” tah ei ta. Chavâta chanô cha thata reipachhie ei ta.
Zisu ta, “Chanô he kheihta hmah tah khuh vy. Khazia nama patypamâ? Ei chô liata hmo phapa a taopa a châ hih.
Dyhchhiepazy cha nama hnohta khâ a ypa châ ei ta, nama khona maihta ama châta hmo pha nama tao thei. Kei deikua cha, nama hnohta khâ a y awpa châ va na.
Chanô heta a tao theipa a tao hih. Pabu awpa ta ei pôhpa he sathaw a thu chhieliepa a châ.
Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, khizaw zydua liata thâtihpha ama chhona su lia maihta, he chanô hmotaopa he ano a thei thlâh nawpa ta ama reih lymâ hra aw,” tah ta.
Pahrawh hleino hry liata a hlao hrapa Zudâh Iskari ta Zisu patusa awpa ta theihthai beizy lâ vawh ta.
Cha kyh cha theihthai beizy ta ama thei nahta, a ly kaw ei ta, Zudâh Iskari hnohta tâkâ pie awpa bie a taih ei ta. Zudâh cha Zisu patusa awpa ta rypaohna tlua ta.

Thinô pahlao leipa Viahchhâ kyhchhi noh, noh hmiatua chaipa, zawpakhô mietakutaw ama thie tyhna noh liata, a pachupazy ta a hnohta, “Khataih liata ma Zawpakhô pati na nie nawpa châ chhuahdy paw sih la na khoh?” tah ei ta.
A pachupazy hry liata pano tuah ta, ama hnohta, “Khihpi liata a kei ngia u la, chyhsa pakha tibeih a chabapa ta châ tyh aw ei ta, ano cha nama pazi aw.
Â ngiana o hneituhpa hnohta, ‘Pachutuhpa ta, “Ei pachupazy chhaota zawpakhô pati ei nie nawpa chhôhpadâhpa khataih liata a y?” a tah,’ nama tah aw.
A o chô lâta chhôhpadâhpa laipa, tobi chiehpa nata a mâ chiehpa cha pahmô aw ei ta, cha liata eima châta zawpakhô pati cha namâ chhuahdy aw,” tah ta.
Pachupazy cha pua ei ta, khihpi cha kei tlô ei ta, ama hnohta a reipa hawh tlai ta hmô ei ta, zawpakhô pati cha a chhuahdy ei ta.
Zâlâ a vaw châ nahta, Zisu cha pachupa pahrawh hleinozy chhaota a vy ta.
Tlâhkhai liata dôh ei ta, ama nie hai nota, Zisu ta, “Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, nama hry liata pakha, ei hnohta a nie hrapa tlai ta einâ paphasai aw,” tah ta.
Ama pachârôh kaw ta, pakha pakha ta a hnohta, “Kei ei châ ma?” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Pahrawh hleino hry liata pakha, beikoh ei chapaolâhpa he a châ.
Chyhsa Sawchapawpa cha, a thâtih ropa hawh tlai ta a sie aw. Châhrasala Chyhsa Sawchapawpa a patusatuhpa cha a hu a po na! Cha chyhsa cha pih leipa sala, a châta a pha via awpa tlai,” tah ta.
Ama nie hai nota, Zisu ta viahchhâ la ta, byhnâ a aw khai nahta, eichheih ta, ama hnohta pie ta, “Nie teh u. He he ei sapa a châ,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha nyu la ta, alyna bie a rei khai nahta, ama hnohta pie ta, ama zydua ta doh ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “He he ei thisaih, chyhsa hluhpi châta a lohpa biehrai thiehpa a châ.
Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, Khazohpa khinarâh liata a thiehpa ta ei dona noh a tlô hlâlei la, kre zôh patheipa tawhta doh heih khao aw va na,” tah ta.
Hla ama sa khai nahta, Ôli Tlâh lâ sie ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “‘Mietaku vaituhpa tu aw na ta, mietakuzy ama pai aw,’ tahpa ropa hawhta, nama zydua ta nama pao khai aw.
Châhrasala pathyupa ta ei y tawhta, nama hmia lâta Kâlili râh lâ ei sie aw,” tah ta.
Pity ta a hnohta, “Ama zydua ta pao khai hra ei sala, kei la pao aw va na,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho, tazâ tlai heta, awh ei no a kho hlâta, ei thôh einâ paphasai aw chi,” tah ta.
Pity ta pachyu ngaitapa ta, “Na thina liata thi hra awpa chhao ta, châ paphasai cheita aw va na,” tah ta. Ama zydua ta cha hawhta reih chyu ei ta.
Kesemani ama tahpa lâ sie ei ta. A pachupazy hnohta, “Thlah ei kei chhâ chhôhta, he liata a vaw tyuh chy muh vy,” tah ta.
A hnohta Pity nata Zâmie nata Zawhâna a chhi ta, Zisu cha nôpopa ta a pachârôh ngaita ta.
Ama hnohta, “Ei thlahpa a pachârôh ngaita ta, thina taihta a châ. He liata vaw y u la, vaw vaih teh u,” tah ta.
A chyhta kei chakâ via ta, alei liata a khu lâta pao ta, tao theipa a châ khiahta cha, cha dawh chata ano khô awpa ta thlahchhâ ta.
“Abâ, ei Paw, nâma châta la, ato tao theipa a châ. He nyu he kei tawhta pasie ha mah y. Châhrasala keima rei châ leipa sala, nâma rei tlao châ mawh sy,” tah ta.
A vy ta, Pity nata Zâmie nata Zawhâna zy cha a vaw mô thlâh ha ei ta. Pity hnohta, “Saimaw, nâ mô ha mâ? Dawh kha chhao vaih thei va chi ma?
Reipasaona liata namâ ngia lei nawpa ta a vaih u la, thlahchhâ teh u. Thlahpa ta la hoh ta, sapa deikua a dadieh,” tah ta.
Vawh ta thlahchhâ heih ta, a rei hmopa pyly reih heih ta.
A vy heih ta, mokuh ama saih thei leipa vâta, a vaw mô thlâh ha heih ei ta, â chhy nawpa chhao pahno veih ei.
A ei thôhna ta vaw kua heih ta, ama hnohta, “A pahâ ei chi ta ma namâ mô thlâh ha chy? Â daih ha bâ, a daihti a vaw tlô haw. Moh teh u, Chyhsa Sawchapawpa he moleipazy ku liata hlâpa a châ ha bâ hih.
Thyu teh u, sie ei suh u. Moh teh u, nâ patusatuhpa â vaw hnia ha huh,” tah ta.

Bie a rei hai no tlai ta, pahrawh hleino hry liata a hlao hrapa Zudâh cha vaw tlô pâ ha ta. A hnohta theihthai beizy nata ryhpa pachutuhpazy nata machâzy nata zawpizy cha zaozi nata thothu a cheipa ta vaw tlô hra ei ta.
A patusatuhpa ta, “Ei pahnâpa cha nama patu khohpa cha a châ aw. Patu u la, a phapa ta vaihpa ta a chhi muh vy,” tahpa ta ama hnohta ngiana vaw pie chhielie ha ta.
A vaw tlôpa nahta, Zisu cha thlai pangai ta, a hnohta, “Pachutuhpa!” tah ta, Zisu cha a pahnâ ta.
Chatanachata Zisu cha chahnao chakhipa ta, patu ha ei ta.
A kiapâh liata a duahpazy hry liata pakha ta a zaozi phia ta, Theihthai Beichaipa chakaotuhpa cha chhawh ta, a nakao pathai pathlah ha ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Zaozi nata thothuzy a cheipa ta ma, hraotuhpa patupa hawhta na patu awpa ta nama vaw pua?
Achhyna o liata noh to pachupa ta nama hnohta y tyh na ta, na patu leipa ei chi ta. Châhrasala Biehrai bie a vaw tlô nawpa ta, he hmo he a ypa a châ,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha pachupa zydua cha Zisu a paphasaipa ta, a râsai khai ha ei ta.
Satlia pakha cha, poh rih dipa chysia deita a tobipa ta Zisu cha zi ta. Ano cha patu ei ta,
châhrasala a poh rih dipa chysia cha siesaipa ta, thluahruapa ta a râ ha ta.
Zisu cha Theihthai Beichaipa lâ a chhi ei ta. Theihthai bei zydua, ryhpa pachutuhpa zydua nata machâ zydua a vypakhy ei ta.
Pity cha â hlapi ta Zisu cha pazi ta, Theihthai Beichaipa o dôhpachhôh tlyhmia taihta pazi ta. Vaituhpazy hry liata mei a aihpa ta a tyuh hra ta.
Zisu ama thie thei nawpa ta theihthai beizy nata ryureituhpa zydua ta ano leihna tlua ei ta, châhrasala hmô leipa ei ta.
Chyhsa hluhpi ta haipa ta leih ei ta, châhrasala ama leihna cha a lyu tlâ leipa ta.
Thokha a vaw duah ei ta, haipa ta vaw leih ei ta,
“He chyhsa heta, ‘He Achhyna o, ku ta sapa he phie aw na ta, noh thôh chhôh ta Achhyna o hropa ku ta sa leipa ei padua aw,’ a tahpa eima thei,” tah ei ta.
He liana chhao heta, ama pahnona bie a raohâh leipa ta.
Theihthai Beichaipa cha ama hry liata a kaw duah ta, Zisu hnohta, “A chhy awpa hnei va chi ma? He chyhsazy ta ama cha leihna he khâpa ma a châ?” tah ta.
Châhrasala a chalih thlâh ha ta, khâpa hmah a chhy leipa ta. Theihthai Beichaipa ta hiahri heih ta, “Nohlaopa Sawchapawpa Krista cha na châ ma?” tah ta.
Zisu ta, “Ei châ na, Chyhsa Sawchapawpa he Hmotaotheina chachâh lâta a tyuhpa ta, vâ meihdo hry liata â zupa nama hmô aw,” tah ta.
Theihthai Beichaipa cha a poh hrie ta, “Leihna hropa khâpa eimâ ngiah khao?
Khazohpa a reipachhienazie nama thei haw. Kheihta nama pachâ?” tah ta. Ama zydua ta ano cha thie tlâh ta rao ei ta.
Thokha ta Zisu cha ama pachih ta pachhao ei ta, a hmia pahly ei ta, tu ei ta, a hnohta “Hrohsona bie cha phuah châh chi!” tah ei ta. Vaituhpazy ta amâ chhi pâ ta chabaih ei ta.
Pity cha dôhpachhôh tlyhmia liata arulâta a y nota, Theihthai Beichaipa chakaotuhpa laihsazy hry liata pakha a vy ta,
Pity mei â aihpa hmô ta, moh ta, a hnohta, “Nâ chhao he Nâzari chyhsa Zisu hnohta a ypa kha na châ hra,” tah ta.
Pity ta a papha ta, “Na reipa cha pahno va na, a yzie pahno va na,” tah ta. Chatawhcha aikah lâ kei pua ta, awh khoh pâ ha ta.
Chakaotuhpa laihsa ta hmô ta, a kiapâh liata â duahpazy hnohta “He chyhsa he ama hry liata a hlaopa a châ hra,” tah heih ta.
Châhrasala a papha heih ta. Buakha y ta, a kiapâh ta â duahpazy ta Pity hnohta, “Kâlili chyhsa châ tlôh chi ta, ama hry liata nâ hlao tlai hra,” tah ei ta.
Châhrasala chhie a sakhâh ta, bie a taih ta, “Cha chyhsa nama reipa cha pahno va na,” tah ta.
Cha nota awhkhypa cha a einona ta thlai vaw khoh ta. Pity cha Zisu ta a hnohta, “Awh ei no a kho hlâta, ei thôh einâ paphasai aw chi,” a tahpa bie kha a vaw thei ta. Palôh keichheihpa ta cha ta.
My a vaw châpa nahta, theihthai beizy ta machâzy, ryhpa pachutuhpazy nata ryureituhpa zydua a chhohia ei ta. Zisu cha chahrypa ta a chhi ei ta, Pilâ lâ hlâ ei ta.
Pilâ ta a hnohta, “Zuzy Beipa na châ ma?” tah ta. Zisu ta a chhy ta, “Na reipa hawhta ei châ,” tah ta.
Theihthai beizy ta kyh hluhpi ta vaw leih ei ta.
Pilâ ta hiahri heih ta, a hnohta, “Khâpa hmah a chhy aw va chi ma? Pachâ tua, ama cha leihna zyzie hih,” tah ta.
Châhrasala Zisu ta khâpa hmah a chhy via khao leipa ta. Chavâta Pilâ cha a noâh kaw ta.
Chyhsa atâhpazy hry liata zawpi ta amâ hawpa pakha cha, Zawpakhô kyhchhi noh ta Pilâ ta papua tyh ta.
He daihti liata patâhna o liata chyhsa pakha, a moh Bârabâ ama tahpa y ta. Ano cha ryureina a dyuhpa ta liany a cheihpa vâta patâhpa a châ.
Zawpizy khy ei ta, Pilâ cha ama châta a tao tyhpa hawhta tao heih awpa ta a haw ei ta.
Pilâ ta ama hnohta, “Zuzy Beipa he cha papuapa aw ei sah la, nama khoh ma?” tah ta.
Zisu cha theihthai beizy ta hiatliana vâta ama patusapa a châzie pahno thlâh ha ta.
Châhrasala theihthai beizy ta Bârabâ papua hri awpa ta zawpi pasyu ei ta.
Pilâ ta âmo cha a chhy ta, ama hnohta, “Cha khiah Zuzy Beipa nama bipa he zaw, kheihta ei tao aw?” tah heih ta.
Zawpizy ta, “Khaipâ teh,” tahpa ta thata awh heih ei ta.
Pilâ ta ama hnohta, “Khazia maw, khâpa moleina ma a tao haw?” tah ta. Châhrasala, “Khaipâ teh,” tahpa ta thata awh via rili ei ta.
Pilâ ta zawpi palysa khohpa ta, Bârabâ cha papua ta, Zisu cha a chhei khai nahta, khaipâ awpa ta hlâ ha ta.
Zisu cha pheisaihzy ta râhvaotuhpa o dôhpachhôh, Pritôria ama tahpa lâ a ngiakhei ei ta. Ama py liata pheisaih zydua awpakhy ei ta.
Viahkao pasipa nohsaihpa paky ei ta, hloh lakho phiehpa a luh liata pakho ei ta.
“Zuzy Beipa, hroh pareih mah y!” tahpa ta a naoh ei ta.
Lohthi ta a luh liata chhei ei ta, ama pachih ta pachhao ei ta, ama pakhu paneihpa ta a naoh ei ta.
Ama pasipasawh khai nahta, poh nohsaihpa cha hlaipa ei ta, ano viahkao pasipa pakysa heih ei ta, khaipâ awpa ta a chhi ha ei ta.
Lâpi liata amâ tyhpa Kurini khihpa Saimaw cha Zisu kraws papiasa raruah ei ta. Ano cha Alezandâ nata Rufu zy paw châ ta, khitaw lâ tawhta a vaw tlôpa a châ.
Zisu cha Luh Ru Su ama tahpa Kalvari tlâh lâ a chhi ei ta.
Myrâ nata pahlaopa kresawhti pie ei ta, châhrasala doh khoh leipa ta.
Chatawhcha khaipâ ei ta, a chysiazy a rai ei ta, nuby a daopa ta ama to awpa chyu a la ei ta.
Zisu ama khaipâna daihti cha my dawh chakipa liata a châ.
Ano leihna bie a luh chô liata ama tawpa cha, “Zuzy Beipa,” tahpa a châ.
Zisu hnohta hraotuhpa pano, a chachâh lâta pakha, a chavei lâta pakha khaipâ hra ei ta.
Chatanachata, “Moleipazy hry liata rei pâpa a châ,” tahpa Biehrai bie a vaw tlô paki haw.
Cha su a chapiapazy ta ama luh chahuahpa ta, “Âh! Nâ, Achhyna o phie ta, noh thôh ta a sa heih awpa chi,
nâmasasyh ta a pachha la, kraws tawhta za chô châh chi!” tahpa ta pasipasawh ei ta.
Cha hawhna hra chata theihthai beizy nata ryhpa pachutuhpazy chhao ta pasipasawh hra ei ta, “Chyhsa hropazy pachha ta, ano hmâchhâh â pachha thei khao vei huh.
Izarei Beipa Mesia cha tahmâ tlai heta kraws tawhta za chô bao sa! Cha cha eima hmô khiahta cha, eimâ ngiapâ aw,” tah ei ta. A hnohta khaipâ hrapazy chhao ta pasipasawh hra ei ta.
Dawh hrawh hleino a vaw paro nahta, cha daihti tawhta zâlâ dawh thôhpa taihta, alei chô zydua vaw zoh kaluh ha ta.
Dawh thôhpa liata, Zisu cha ao paro ngaitapa ta awh ta, “Elôi, Elôi, lâmâ sabakthâni?” tah ta, cha yzie cha “Ei Khazohpa, ei Khazohpa, khazia eina pathlua chi?” tahna a châ.
A kiapâh liata a duahpa thokhazy ta cha bie cha ama thei nahta, “Nathlie tua u, Elaizâh a aw chu,” tah ei ta.
Chyhsa pakha a râ ta, kresawhti thaopa liata ti pasysana ny ta, lohthi pawhmao liata pataoh ta, padosa ta, “Ano la awpa ta Elaizâh â zu ma tahpa hâ sih la, moh tua suh u,” tah ei ta.
Zisu cha ao paro ngaitapa ta awh ta, a hu chhâ ha ta.
Achhyna o pohraipa cha a chô lâ tawhta a ry lâ taihta â khophie ta a hrie ta.
A hmiakô liata a duahpa pheisaih za kha hyutuhpa ta, cha hawhta a hu chhâpa cha a hmô nahta, “He chyhsa he Khazohpa Sawchapawpa a châ hmeiseih tlai na,” tah ta.
Lâhla tawhta a saipa chanôzy chhao y ei ta, chazy hry liata Mâri Mâdali, Zâmie seihnai viapa nata Zôse zy nô Mâri nata Salômi zy amâ hlao hra.
Kâlili liata Zisu a y no kha, âmozy heta zi ei ta, ama chakao tyh. A hnohta Zerusale lâ a khy hrapa chanô hropa hluhpi chhao amâ hlao hra.
Zâlâ a vaw châ nahta, Pachyh noh a châpa vâta, cha cha Pahânoh a pazipa noh châ ta,
Arimathai khihpa Zawsi, ryureituh zachhihpa nata Khazohpa khinarâh vaw tlô awpa a hâ hrapa cha a vy ta, a riah a paphapa ta Pilâ lâ a ngia ta, Zisu ri cha hiah ta.
Cha hawhta thlai a thi thlâh hapa cha Pilâ chhao ta noâh tah kaw ta, pheisaih za kha hyutuhpa cha aw ta, a thi ha tlai ma tahpa ta hiahri ta.
A thi ha tlaipa kyh pheisaih za kha hyutuhpa tawhta a pahno nahta, a ri cha Zawsi hnohta pie ta.
Zawsi ta poh rih dipa chalei ta, Zisu ri cha la ta, poh rih dipa ta pahly ta, lôkhaoh khiepa thlâ liata pazia ta. Thlâ paka cha alô ta pamai ta.
Mâri Mâdali nata Zôse nô Mâri ta a paziana su cha hmô ei ta.
Pahânoh a chhâ nahta, Mâri Mâdali, Zâmie nô Mâri nata Salawmi zy cha, Zisu sathawthu awpa ta ropahâhpa chalei ei ta.
Hâta noh hmiatuapa mydi ta, noh a chhi tawhta thlâ lâ vawh ei ta.
“Thlâ pamaina alô kha ahy ma miah a pasiepa aw tly?” tahpa ta reih laih ei ta.
Kaw moh ei ta, alô lai ngaitapa cha â pasie hapa hmô ei ta.
Thlâ chhôh lâ a ngia ei ta, satlia pakha poh diehpa a bupa ta, a ri aziana chachâh lâta a tyuhpa hmô ei ta, ama noâh ngaita ta.
Ano ta ama hnohta, “Nama noâh khah sy. Nâzari khihpa Zisu, ama khaipâpa kha nama tlua tahpa ei pahno. A thyu haw. He liata y khao vei. Moh teh u, ama paziana hih.
Sie u la, a pachupazy nata Pity hnohta, ‘Nama hnohta a reipa hawhna tlai khata, nama hmia lâta Kâlili lâ a sie hai, cha liata nama hmô aw,’ tahpa ta kei chho teh u,” tah ta.
Noâh ngaitapa nata achalyuna chôta pua ei ta, thlâ tawhta a râ ei ta, ama chipa vâta, ahy hnohta hmahta khâpa bie hmah reih leipa ei ta.
Hâta noh hmiatuapa mydi ta a thyuheih nota, a chhôh tawhta ahripa pasari a papuapa Mâri Mâdali hnohta a luah tua chai ta.
Mâri Mâdali cha Zisu hnohta a y tyhpazy lâ vawh ta, mâchhiesapa ta a cha ngâpazy hnohta Zisu a hmôna thâtih kei chho ta.
Zisu cha hroh ta, Mâri Mâdali ta a hmô tahpa ama theipa chhao ta, zo leipa ei ta.
Cha hnôhlâ ta, ama hry liata chyhsa pano, khitaw lâ ama sie hai nota, hmia nanopa ta ama hnohta a luah heih ta.
Âmo cha kua ei ta, pachupa hropazy kei chho ei ta, châhrasala âmo chhao cha zo leipa ei ta.

Cha khai tawhta, pahrawh hleikhazy tlâhkhai liata pati ama dôh hai nota, ama hnohta a luah heih ta. A thyuheih tawhta a hmôtuhpazy bie ama zo leipa vâta nata amâ ngiapâleina nata ama palôh kuhchhana vâta âmo cha ra ta.
Ama hnohta, “Khizaw zydua liata sie u la, hmotaopa zydua hnohta thâtihpha chho teh u.
A ngiapâ ta bâti a châpa cha pachhapa ta y aw ta, a ngiapâ leipa deikua cha thaileichâpa ta a y aw.
He ngianazy heta ngiapâtuhpazy cha a zi lymâ aw: Ei moh ta ahripazy papua aw ei ta, reih thiehpa ta reih aw ei ta,
ku ta parihzy patu aw ei ta, thina châmaih kheihawhpa rai doh hra ei sala, âmo pasasa aw vei. Tlâhleipazy chô liata ama ku pahnieh aw ei ta, ama tlâh lymâ aw,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Abeipa Zisu cha ama hnohta bie a reih khai nahta, vârâh lâ a chhipa ta y ta, Khazohpa chachâh lâta a kaw tyuh ha ta.
Pachupazy cha sie ei ta, su to liata bie chho ei ta. Abeipa ta âmo cha hriakhei ta, ama bie chhopazy pa-i nawpa ta, ngiana hmonoâhpazy ta a pazi lymâ ei.
Eima hry liata hmo vaw tlôpa thâtihzy kha chyhsa hluhpi ta roh ha ei ta,
a hmôtuhpazy nata bie chakaotuhpazy ta âthaona tawhta miah hlâ pachhuah hra ei ta.
Hy zachhih chaipa Theôphilâ y, kei chhao ta, daihti khachâ rakha ma a sie hapa tawhna khata, cha thâtih zydua cha a siapa ta a laichadai na ta, â pazipa ta cha ropa awpa a phapa ta ei pahno.
Chatanachata bie ama cha pachupazy kha âdopazy tlai a châ tahpa na pahno aw.
Zudia bei Herawda daihti liata, Abizah py liata theihthaipa pakha, a moh Zekaria ama tahpa y ta. Cha chyhsa chata Arawna pathla hry liatapa Elizabe cha lapinô ta hnei ta.
Ama pano ta Khazohpa hmiakô liata chyhsa siapa châ ei ta, Abeipa biepiepa nata bieraopa zydua liata seina hnei leipa ta a zyh lymâpa ama châ.
Châhrasala Elizabe cha a choh hapa vâta saw hnei leipa ei ta, ama pano ta machâ kaw bâ ei ta.
Chatawhcha hetana heta vaw châ ta. Noh kha cha ano py chakao daihti liata, Zekaria chhao Khazohpa hmiakô liata theihthaipa chakaona rai hria hra ta.
Theihthaipazy taozietyhpa hawhta, Abeipa Achhyna o liata a ngia ta, ropahâhpa rao awpa ta nuby a daopa châ ta, cha cha Zekaria chô liata tlu ta.
Ropahâhpa raona daihti liata, zawpi zydua cha khôtho liata thlahchhâ ei ta.
Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa pakha a hnohta a vaw luah ta, ropahâhpa raona maisâh chachâh lâta a vaw duah ta.
Vâlyuhchâpa cha a hmô nahta, Zekaria cha a nôpopa ta, chi ngaita ta.
Châhrasala vâlyuhchâpa ta a hnohta, “Zekaria, chi khah y, na thlahchhâna kha theipa a châ haw. Na lapinô Elizabe ta sawchapawpa sa aw ta, a moh Zawhâna na bi aw.
Thaphana nata alyna hnei aw chi ta, ano vaw pipa cha chyhsa hluhpi ta amâ ly aw.
Abeipa hmiakô liata chyhsa rônahpa a châ aw. Kresawhti nata sahma a do awpa châ leipa ta, a nô chhi chhôh tawh tlai ta, Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta a bie aw.
Izarei saw hluhpi Abeipa ama Khazohpa lâta a paheisa heih aw.

Elaizâh thlahpa nata hmotaotheina ta Khazohpa hmiakô liata sie aw ta, pawzy palôh cha sawzy lâta paheisapa ta, reingiah leipazy cha mosiapazy sona lâta paheisa aw ta, phopi pachhuahpanohpa cha Abeipa châta a mâ chiehpa ta a tao aw,” tah ta.
Zekaria ta vâlyuhchâpa hnohta, “Cha cha kheihta ei pahno thei aw? Pawpipa châ na ta, ei lapinô chhao machâ ha ta,” tah ta.
Vâlyuhchâpa ta a chhy ta, “Kei he Kabriel ei châ. Khazohpa hmiakô liata a duah tyhpa châ na ta, bie cha chho ta, he thâtih lychhihpa he cha vaw tlôkhei awpa ta tuapa ei châ.
Pachâ teh, a daihti raopa liata a vaw tlô awpa ei bie reipazy na zo leipa vâta, cha hmozy a vaw tlô hlâlei cha, bie reih thei khao aw va chi, nâ thlih thlâh ha aw,” tah ta.
Zawpi ta Zekaria cha hâ thlâh ha ei ta, Achhyna o liata a y parei kawpa vâta ama noâh kaw ta.
A vaw pua nahta, âmo cha bie a chho thei khao leipa ta, Achhyna o liata aluahna a hmô tahpa pahno ei ta. Bie a reih thei khao leipa vâta, ama hnohta a ku ta thliethlâ ta.
A chakaona daihti a chhâ nahta, Zekaria cha o lâ a di ha ta.
Cha hnôhlâ ta a lapinô Elizabe cha saw phaoh ta, thla pangawh chhôh a nyu ta,
“Chyhsazy hry liata ei noza hmiachhiena papai nawpa ta, Abeipa ta na ngiachhie ta, he hmo he eina taopa,” tah ta.
A thla charuna liata, Khazohpa ta vâlyuhchâpa Kabriel cha Kâlili râh liata khihpi miakha, Nâzari ama tahpa liata a ypa,
laihsa kôpa lâ tuah ta. Laihsa kôpa cha Dâvi pathla Zawsi ta hnei awpa ta â pahawhpa châ ta, a moh cha Mâri a châ.
Vâlyuhchâpa cha ano lâ a vy ta, a hnohta, “Ei châ naoh na, nohlaopa y, Abeipa na hnohta a y! Chanôzy hry liata nohlao chaipa na châ,” tah ta.
Vâlyuhchâpa bie reipa ta Mâri cha a nô papo kaw ta, kheihawhpa anaohna ma a châ tahpa pachâ ta.
Vâlyuhchâpa ta a hnohta, “Mâri, chi khah y, Khazohpa khokheina na to hih.
Pachâ teh, na chhi liata nawh a choh aw ta, sawchapaw sa aw chi ta, a moh ta Zisu na bi aw.
Ano cha chyhsa rônahpa châ aw ta, Chônôchaipa Sawchapawpa bipa a châ aw. A pathlatuhpa Dâvi beidyuchhai cha Abeipa Khazohpa ta a hnohta pie aw ta,
Zakaw pathlazy chô liata chhâzaw ta a bei aw ta, a khinarâh chhao chhâna hnei aw vei,” tah ta.
Mâri ta vâlyuhchâpa hnohta, “Cha cha kheihta a châ thei aw, laihsa kôpa châ tlôh na ta?” tah ta.
Vâlyuhchâpa ta a hnohta, “Thlahpa Pathaihpa na chô liata vaw tlô aw ta, Chônôchaipa hmotaotheina ta a cha khu aw. Chavâta hawti pathaihpa a vaw pih awpa cha, Khazohpa Sawchapawpa bipa a châ aw.
Pachâ teh, na chiheih chanô a choh hapa Elizabe chhao khata, a nôpi tawhta saw phaoh ta, tahmâ he a thla charuna a châ haw.
Khazohpa châta tao thei leipa hmo y vei,” tah ta.
Mâri ta, “Moh teh, Abeipa seichanô ei châ. Na bie hawhta ei chô liata tlô mawh sy,” tah ta. Chatawhcha vâlyuhchâpa ta Mâri cha siesai ha ta.
Cha khaipa nahta, Mâri cha thlai thyu ta, tlâh râh liata a ypa Zudia khihpi miakha lâ sie ta.
Zekaria o liata a ngia ta, Elizabe cha a naoh ta.
Elizabe ta Mâri anaohna a thei nahta, a chhi liata hawsaih cha a tlieh ta. Elizabe cha Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta vaw bie ta,
ao paro ngaitapa ta awh ta, “Chanô zydua hry liata nohlao chaipa châ chi ta, na chhi thei chhao a nohlao na!
He nohlaona he kheihtazieta a topa ma ei châ tly, ei Beipa nô ta eina vaw tly thlâh hapa chi he?
Pachâ teh, nâ naohna ao kha ei nakhaoh liata â ngiapa nahta, ei chhi liata hawsaih cha a lypa ta â chotlai ngâ kaw.
Abeipa ta a hnohta bie a reipa a vaw tlô aw tahpa a zopa chanô cha a nohlao na,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Mâri ta, “Ei hro ta Abeipa reithai ta,
Khazohpa nâ Pachhatuhpa liata ei thlahpa â ly,
A seichanô nawhpa he a ngiachhiepa vâta. Tahmâ tawhta cha, Chhâ zydua ta nohlaonô eina tah aw ei.
Atotaotheipa ta hmo rônahpa na taopa ta, A moh cha pathaihpa a châ.
A zawngiahna cha ano a chipazy châta châ ta, Chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta a y aw.
A bâh ta a thatlôzie pamosa ta, Palôh laipazy a papaipatla tyh.
Thatlôpazy ama beidyuchhai tawhta a daophi ta, Areisipazy a cheihchalo tyh.
Nodipa cha hmo phapazy ta pabie ta, Hneirôhpazy aruapa ta a pasiesa.
A zawngiahna atheithlâhna châta, A chakaotuhpa Izarei cha bao ta,
Miah pathlatuhpazy hnohta reih ta, Abarahâ nata a pathlazy hnohta a reipa hawhta, A chakaotuhpa Izarei cha a bao haw,” tah ta.
Mâri cha Elizabe hnohta thla thôh rachhôh y ta, cha khai tawhta a o lâ a lie ha ta.
Elizabe cha a nawh hnei daihti a vaw daih ta, sawchapaw sa ta.
Abeipa ta Elizabe chô liata zawngiahna rônah ngaitapa a palâsa haw tahpa a opazy nata a chiheihzy ta ama thei nahta, a lykhei ngaita ei ta.
A noh chariena noh ta hawsaih chopawtai awpa ta a vy ei ta, a paw moh zipa ta a moh Zekaria bi a chhuah ei ta.
Châhrasala a nô ta, “Châ vei, Zawhâna bi awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Âmo ta a hnohta, “Na chiheihzy hry liata, cha moh a phaohpa ahy hmah y veih ei,” tah ei ta.
A paw cha thliethlâpa ei ta, a moh bi awpa a khopa hiahri ei ta.
Zekaria ta chârona lôchâ hiah ta, “A moh Zawhâna a châ,” tahpa ta roh ta. Ama zydua ta ama noâh kaw ta.
Sôkha ta a pakah vaw âpa ta, a paleih a vaw thlâ ta, reih pathliepa ta Khazohpa reithai ta.
Ama opa zydua ta chi ngaita ei ta. Cha hmo kyh zydua cha Zudia tlâh râh zydua liata pathâh ta.
A theipa maihta ama palôh liata khô ei ta, “Cha hawti cha kheihawhpa chyhsa ma a vaw châ aw?” tahpa pachâ ei ta. Abeipa ku cha hawti hnohta y ta.
A paw Zekaria cha Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta bie ta, hrohsona bie phuah ta,
“Abeipa Izarei Khazohpa cha, Reithaipa ta y mawh sy! A chyhsazy za tly ta, A pachha haw.
A chakaotuhpa Dâvi pathla hry tawhta, Pachhana ki miah a chaluahpa haw.
Leilô pi tua no tawhta A hrohso pathaihpazy pakah ta a rei hapa hawhta,
Eima chariahzy tawhta pachhapa ta y aw pi ta, Miah a haopazy ku tawhta pachhapa ta eima y aw.
Miah pathlatuhpazy hnohta Zawngiahna bietai palâsa ta, A biehrai pathaihpa â thei thlâh haw.
Miah pathlatuhpa Abarahâ hnohta Miah bao awpa ta bie â taihpa hawhta,
Eima chariahpazy ku tawhta miah a pachha haw.
Chavâta chi leipa ta ano chakao aw pi ta, Eima hro chhôh zydua ta, Pathaihpa nata siapa ta a hmiakô liata eima y thei aw.
Chavâta nâ, hawtipa y, Chônôchai hrohsopa tahpa na châ aw. Abeipa lâpizy a chhuahdy awpa ta, A hmia lâta sie aw chi ta,
A chyhsazy moleina a ngiahthaipa ta, Pachhana pahnona pie awpa ta,
Eima Khazohpa zawngiahna vâta, Chô lâ tawhta noh chhipa ta miah a za tly aw;
Zohna liata a tyuhpazy khaihna piepa ta, Thina nohpahli liata a tyuhpazy pakhaihsa awpa ta, Thlalôhna lâpi liata eima pheizy chakâsa awpa ta,” tah ta.
Hawsaih cha laiseih lymâ ta, thlahpa liata a tha vaw tlô via lymâ ta, Izarei hnohta â luah hlâlei cha râhchawhpa liata y thlâh ha ta.
Cha nohzy liata, Kaisarâ Awkâstu ta khizaw zydua maluhpi rei awpa ta biepie ta.
Cha maluhpi reina cha Kurinia Suria râhvaotuhpa a châ nota tao tuapa a châ.
Chyhsa to ama moh parosa awpa ta ama khih lâ sie chyu ei ta.
Zawsi chhao Dâvi chhôhkha nata a pathla a châpa vâta, Kâlili râh Nâzari khih tawhta Bethlehe ama tahpa Zudia râh Dâvi khihpi lâ sie ta.
Moh parosa awpa ta, lapinô châta â pahawhpa Mâri, saw pih daihmâpa nata sie ei ta.
Cha liata ama y nota, Mâri cha a saw pina noh a vaw ki ha ta.
Saw tuapa ta chapaw sa ta, poh pahlyna ta pahly ta, khichhai riebu liata amâ tlôh leipa vâta, sachâki liata pazia ta.
Cha râh liata mietaku vaituhpazy y ei ta, zâ ta ama mietakuzy vaipa ta lyu liata a rie pâ ei ta.
Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa cha ama hnohta a vaw luah ta, Abeipa rônahna ta ama chheipâh cha za khaih ta, chi ngaita ei ta.
Vâlyuhchâpa ta ama hnohta, “Chi khah u la, nathlie teh u, mo to châta thâtihpha lychhih ngaitapa ei cha vaw tlôkheipa ei.
Tanoh he Dâvi khihpi liata nama châta Pachhatuhpa a pih haw, Beipa Krista cha!
He he nama châta ngiana a châ aw: Pohpahlyna ta pahlypa ta, sachâki liata â ziapa hawsaih nama hmô aw,” tah ta.
Sôkha ta vâlyuhchâpa hnohta vâmo hluhpi a vaw luah ei ta, Khazohpa reithai ei ta,
“Khazoh Chônôchaipa hnohta rônahna y sala, Lei chô liata â lypa chyhsazy hnohta thlalôhna y mawh sy!” tah ei ta.
Vâlyuhchâpazy ta vârâh lâ ama siesaipata nahta, mietaku vaituhpazy ta, “Tahmâ he Bethlehe lâ thlai sie sih la, Abeipa ta miah a chhopa, hmo a vaw tlôpa cha kei moh suh u,” a tah ei ta.
A para kawpa ta sie ei ta, Mâri nata Zawsi nata sachâki liata hawsaih paziapa cha kei hmô ei ta.
Hawsaih ama hmô nahta, ama hnohta hawsaih thâtih ama chhopa kha reih ei ta.
A theipazy ta mietaku vaituhpazy bie reipa cha noâh tah kaw ei ta.
Mâri deikua cha, cha hmo zydua cha a palôh liata pachâ ta, a vao thlâh ha ta.
Mietaku vaituhpazy cha, ama hnohta chhopa hawh tlai ta thei ei ta ama hmôpa vâta, Khazohpa reithaina chôta kua ha ei ta.
Noh charie vaw tloh ta, hawsaih cha chopawtaipa a châ khai nahta, a moh Zisu bi ei ta. Cha moh cha chhi liata nawh â choh hlâta, vâlyuhchâpa ta moh a vaw bi chhielie hapa kha a châ.
Mawsi ryhpa hawhta amâ pathaisana noh a vaw tlô nahta, hawsaih Zisu cha Abeipa lâ hlâ awpa ta Zerusale lâ siekhei ei ta.
He he Abeipa ryhpa bie liata, “Chapaw saw chhi a pahy tuapa maih cha, Abeipa châta pathaihpa bipa a châ aw,” tahpa ta ropa hawhta tao ei ta,
Abeipa ryhpa bie ta, atheihna hlâna châta “Vachhuh bao kha tlyma, pivaw taw pô no tlyma,” hlâ awpa a tahpa hawhta ama taopa a châ.

Cha daihti liata, chyhsa pakha, a moh Simeôna ama tahpa Zerusale liata y ta. Ano cha chyhsa siapa nata Khazohpa a chipa châ ta, Izarei thlapalôh nawpa daihti a hâpa, Thlahpa Pathaihpa a hneipa chyhsa a châ.
Abeipa bietaipa Krista a hmô hlâta cha thina a hmô lei awpa kyh Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta vaw pahnosa ha ta.
Thlahpa pahnosapa ta Achhyna o lâ vawh ta, hawsaih Zisu cha a nôpawzy ta ryhpa bie hawhta tao awpa ta, Achhyna o liata amâ kei ngiakhei nahta,
Simeôna ta Zisu cha a bâh ta a pyh ta,
“Hy Abeipa, na bie hawhta, Châ chakaotuhpa he Thlahlôhpa ta pasiesa bâ mah y.
Na pachhana ei mo ta hmô ha ta,
Phopi to mohmô ta na pachhuahpanohpa cha ei hmô haw.
Zenitaizy hnohta aluahna châta khaihna châ aw ta, Na phopi Izarei rônahna a châ aw,” tahpa ta Khazohpa reithai ta.
Hawsaih thâtih a reipa cha, a nô nata a paw ta noâh tah kaw ei ta.

Simeôna ta âmo cha byhnâ awpa ta, a nô Mâri hnohta, “Pachâ teh, he hawti he Izarei hry liata chyhsa hluhpi paona nata thyuna châta raopa a châ. Ano cha ngiana châ aw ta, chyhsa hluhpi ta ama reipachhie aw.
Zaozi ta na palôh chhôpahlie aw ta, chyhsa hluhpi palôh liata pachânazy palâhâhpa a châ aw,” tah ta.
Cha liata hrohsonô pakha, Anâ ama tahpa y ta, ano cha Asera chi Phanua sawchanô a châ. Anâ cha nôpi kaw bâ ta, dyh a châ tawhta a vahpa hnohta kô sari dei pahrâ hmâ ta,
nôhmei châpa ta kô sycharie nata kô palih chhôh a ypa a châ. Achhyna o puasai leipa ta, chhô nah zâ ta kâhvileipa ta thlahchhâpa ta Khazohpa â chhy tyh.
Cha daihti lia tlai ta, Anâ cha a vy ta, Khazohpa lâ alyna bie reih ta, Zerusale chatlaina a hâtuhpa zydua hnohta Zisu thâtih cha chho ta.
Abeipa ryhpa bie hawhta hmo to zydua ama tao khai tawhta, Kâlili râh liata ama khih Nâzari lâ a lie ei ta.
Hawsaih cha laiseih lymâ ta, a tha vaw tlô ta, sona ta bie ta, Khazohpa ngiachhiena ano liata y lymâ ta.
Kô chareih ta Zawpakhô kyhchhi daihti ta Zisu nô nata paw cha Zerusale lâta khy tyh ei ta.
Zisu cha kô hrawh hleino a châ nahta, ama tao tyhpa hawhta Zerusale lâ khy heih ei ta.
Kyhchhi a pai nahta, a lie ei ta, hawtipa Zisu cha Zerusale liata y patlua ha ta. A nôpawzy ta pahno leipa ei ta.
Noh kha lâsie sie ha ei ta, zawpi hry liata â hlao hra awpa hawhta pachâpa ta, ama heinawhzy nata ama hmia pahnopazy hry liata tlua ei ta.
Ama hmô leipa vâta, tlua lymâpa ta Zerusale lâ a lie ei ta.
Noh thôh ama tlua khai tawhta, Achhyna o liata hmô ei ta, pachutuhpazy hry liata a tyuh ta, ama biezy nathliepa ta, âmo lâta hiahrinazy a vaw tao ngâpa hmô ei ta.
A bie reipa a theipa maihta, a novâhzie nata â chhynazy vâta ama noâh kaw ta.
A nôpawzy ta ama hmô nahta, ama noâh ngaita ta, a nô ta a hnohta, “Ei sawchapawpa, khazia he hawhta miah na tao? Na paw nata thlazoh ngaitapa ta thata eima cha tlua,” tah ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Khazia eina tlua ei chi? Ei Paw o liata ei y awpa a châ tahpa pahno veih ei chi ma?” tah ta.
Ama hnohta a biereipa cha a pachâna pahno leipa ei ta.
A nôpawzy hnohta zu ta, Nâzari khih cha tlô ta, a nôpawzy bie zyhpa ta y ta. A nô ta hmo zydua cha a palôh ta a vao thlâh ha ta.
Zisu cha laiseih ta, so via rili ta, Khazohpa nata chyhsapa modypa ta y ta.

Taibiria Kaisarâ â beina kô hrawh hleipangawhna liata, Pawtia Pilâ cha Zudia râh râhvaotuhpa châ ta, Herawda cha Kâlili bei a châ. A unawhpa Phili cha Ituria nata Tarâkôniti bei châ ta, Lysania cha Abilene bei a châ.
Anâ nata Kaiphâ theihthai beichaipazy ama châ nota, râhchawhpa liata a ypa Zekaria sawchapawpa Zawhâna hnohta Khazohpa bie vaw tlô ta.
Zawhâna cha Zawdâh chheipâh râh zydua chahryh ta, moleinazy a ngiahthai nawpa ta rona bâtina bie chho ta.
Hrohsopa Isai châbu biezy liata ropa hawhta, “Râhchawhpa liata awhtuhpa ao ta, ‘Abeipa lâthlôh a chhuahdy u la, A lâpizy patlâsa teh u.
Saikao to pabiepa châ aw ta, Tlâhpi nata tlâhthlôh to pahnaipa a châ aw. Lâpi akopazy patlâpa châ aw ta, Lâpi chhiepazy pamihpa a châ aw.
Chyhsa zydua ta Khazohpa pachhana ama hmô aw,’” tahpa ta bie chho ta.
Bâti châ awpa ta ano lâ zawpi a vypazy hnohta Zawhâna ta, “Nâmo, vâzi pathlazy saih u, hiehâhna vaw tlô awpa a râsai awpa ta ahy ma zikyu châ râ ei?
Rona moh phaoh tlâhpa ta pathei teh u. ‘Abarahâ pathla eima châ,’ a tah khuh vy. Khazohpa ta he alôzy tawhna heta Abarahâ pathlazy a padua thei tahpa ei cha chho ei.
Tahmâ chhao tlai he, tho tharizy liata ahrei sopa a châ haw. Tho to thei pha a pathei leipa maih thlu ta mei liata thypa a châ aw,” tah ta.
Zawpizy ta a hnohta, “Cha khiahta la khâpa eima tao aw?” tah ei ta.
Zawhâna ta ama hnohta, “Ahy rai viahkao zo no a hneipa ta, a hnei leipa hnohta pie sala, ahy rai niedo a hneipa ta, cha hawhta tao hra mawh sy,” tah ta.
Chhiekheituhpazy chhao ta bâti châ awpa ta a vy ei ta, a hnohta, “Pachutuhpa, khâpa eima tao aw?” tah ei ta.
Ano ta ama hnohta, “Chhie nama khei awpa zie hlâta a hluh via khei khuh vy,” tah ta.

Pheisaihzy chhao ta a hnohta, “Keimo chhao he khâpa eima tao aw?” tah ei ta. Ano ta ama hnohta, “Pachhiparypa nata â doleipa ta leihpa ta ahy sôh hmah nama la awpa châ vei. Nama hlao liata palôhtlâh namâ paoh awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Zawpizy cha ama hnabeiseihna a sâh ngaita ta, chyhsa to ta ama palôh liata, “Zawhâna he Krista châ thlâh ha khiah maw,” tahpa ta pachâ ei ta.

Zawhâna ta âmo cha a chhy ta, “Kei ta la ti ta cha bâti ei na ta, châhrasala keima hlâta rônah viapa â vy hai, kei la a pheiky ri a pathlâ tlâh chhao châ va na. Ano ta la Thlahpa Pathaihpa nata mei ta a cha bâti aw ei.
A ku liata barah y ta, a sawhri sâh zie aw ta, a sâh cha pâh liata a ryh aw. Asihpa deikua cha mei pachhai thei leipa liata a rao aw,” tah ta.
Pasyuna bie hropa hluhpi hmâpa ta, chyhsazy hnohta Thâtihpha chho lymâ ta.
Bei Herawda cha a unawhpa lapinô Herawdi kyh liata nata hmo moleipa a taopa zydua vâta Zawhâna ta vaw chhorei ta.
Zawhâna hmotaopazy ta a hie pahâh via rili ta, chavâta Zawhâna cha patâhna o liata khô ha ta.
Chyhsa zydua bâti ama châ khai tawhta, Zisu chhao cha bâti châ hra ta. Thlah a chhâ hai nota, avâ a vaw pahy ta,
Thlahpa Pathaihpa cha pôhpa hneipa ta, vachhuh hawhta za chô ta, Zisu chô liata a zâ choh ta. Avâ tawhta ao za pua ta, “Ei Sawchapaw kyh ei pachâpa na châ, na chô liata ei ly ngaita,” tah ta.
Zisu cha chakaona rai â thao nota, kô sythôh rachhôhpa châ ta, chyhsapa lâ tawhta cha Zawsi sawchapawpa a châ. Zawsi cha Heli sawchapawpa châ ta,
Heli cha Mathâ sawchapawpa a châ. Mathâ cha Livai sawchapawpa châ ta, Livai cha Melki sawchapawpa a châ. Melki cha Zanai sawchapawpa châ ta, Zanai cha Zawsi sawchapawpa a châ.
Zawsi cha Mâtathia sawchapawpa châ ta, Mâtathia cha Amôsâ sawchapawpa a châ. Amôsâ cha Nâhu sawchapawpa châ ta, Nâhu cha Esli sawchapawpa a châ. Esli cha Nakai sawchapawpa châ ta,
Nakai cha Mâthi sawchapawpa a châ. Mâthi cha Mâtathia sawchapawpa châ ta, Mâtathia cha Semei sawchapawpa a châ. Semei cha Zôseka sawchapawpa châ ta, Zôseka cha Zôdâ sawchapawpa a châ.
Zôdâ cha Zôanâ sawchapawpa châ ta, Zôanâ cha Resâ sawchapawpa a châ. Resâ cha Zerubâbe sawchapawpa châ ta, Zerubâbe cha Salâtia sawchapawpa a châ. Salâtia cha Neri sawchapawpa châ ta,
