Neri cha Melki sawchapawpa a châ. Melki cha Adi sawchapawpa châ ta, Adi cha Kôsâ sawchapawpa a châ. Kôsâ cha Elmadâ sawchapawpa châ ta, Elmadâ cha Erâ sawchapawpa a châ.
Erâ cha Zawsua sawchapawpa châ ta, Zawsua cha Eliaza sawchapawpa a châ. Eliaza cha Zôri sawchapawpa châ ta, Zôri cha Mathâ sawchapawpa a châ. Mathâ cha Livai sawchapawpa châ ta,
Livai cha Simeôna sawchapawpa a châ. Simeôna cha Zudâh sawchapawpa châ ta, Zudâh cha Zawsi sawchapawpa a châ. Zawsi cha Zônami sawchapawpa châ ta, Zônami cha Eliakima sawchapawpa a châ.
Eliakima cha Melia sawchapawpa châ ta, Melia cha Menâ sawchapawpa a châ. Menâ cha Mâtathâ sawchapawpa châ ta, Mâtathâ cha Nâthâ sawchapawpa a châ. Nâthâ cha Dâvi sawchapawpa châ ta,
Dâvi cha Zese sawchapawpa a châ. Zese cha Ôbedâ sawchapawpa châ ta, Ôbedâ cha Bôaza sawchapawpa a châ. Bôaza cha Salâ sawchapawpa châ ta, Salâ cha Nâsô sawchapawpa a châ.

Nâsô cha Aminadâ sawchapawpa châ ta, Aminadâ cha Âdami sawchapawpa a châ. Âdami cha Ani sawchapawpa châ ta, Ani cha Hezrô sawchapawpa a châ. Hezrô cha Pereza sawchapawpa châ ta, Pereza cha Zudâh sawchapawpa a châ.
Zudâh cha Zakaw sawchapawpa châ ta, Zakaw cha Aisika sawchapawpa a châ. Aisika cha Abarahâ sawchapawpa châ ta, Abarahâ cha Terâ sawchapawpa a châ. Terâ cha Nâhaw sawchapawpa châ ta,
Nâhaw cha Seru sawchapawpa a châ. Seru cha Reu sawchapawpa châ ta, Reu cha Pele sawchapawpa a châ. Pele cha Ebe sawchapawpa châ ta, Ebe cha Selâh sawchapawpa a châ.
Selâh cha Kainanâ sawchapawpa châ ta, Kainanâ cha Aphakhâ sawchapawpa a châ. Aphakhâ cha Semâ sawchapawpa châ ta, Semâ cha Nôah sawchapawpa a châ. Nôah cha Lâmeka sawchapawpa châ ta,
Lâmeka cha Methuselâ sawchapawpa a châ. Methuselâ cha Enawka sawchapawpa châ ta, Enawka cha Zare sawchapawpa a châ. Zare cha Mahâlale sawchapawpa châ ta, Mahâlale cha Kainanâ sawchapawpa a châ.
Kainanâ cha Enawsâ sawchapawpa châ ta, Enawsâ cha Sethâ sawchapawpa a châ. Sethâ cha Âdâh sawchapawpa châ ta, Âdâh cha Khazohpa sawchapawpa a châ.
Zisu cha Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta biepa ta Zawdâh chavah tawhta a lie ta, Thlahpa ta râhchawhpa lâ a chhi ta.
Cha liata noh sypalih chhôh ahripa ta reipasao ta. Cha nohzy liata khâpa hmah nie leipa ta, a chhâna lâ cha a no vaw di ha ta.
Ahripa ta a hnohta, “Khazohpa Sawchapawpa na châ khiahta cha, he alô he viahchhâ lâta a lie awpa ta biepie teh,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a chhy ta, “‘Chyhsapa he viahchhâ dei ta hroh aw vei,’ tahpa ropa a châ,” tah ta.
Ahripa ta tlâh lâ khykhei ta, movi hlâta khizaw khinarâh zydua pahmô ta,
a hnohta, “He zydua chô liata biehneina cha pie aw na ta, a rônahna chhao ei cha pie aw. He zydua he ei hnohta piepa châ ta, kei ta ei khopa maih ei pie tyh.
Einâ chhy khiah chi ta cha, he zydua he na eih a châ khai aw,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a chhy ta, “‘Abeipa na Khazohpa a chhy aw chi ta, Ano deita na chakao aw,’ Tahpa ropa a châ,” tah ta.
Ahripa ta Zisu cha Zerusale lâ a chhi ta, Achhyna o laki a sâh chaipa liata soh ta, a hnohta, “Khazohpa Sawchapawpa na châ khiahta cha, he tawhna heta a zaw pathlah teh.
Nâma kyh liata cha, “‘Cha vaih awpa ta, A vâlyuhchâpazy biepie aw ta,
Ama ku ta ama cha chalo ha aw. Chataleipatala na phei alô liata nâ chhuh pathlei aw,’ Tahpa ropa a châ,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a chhy ta, “‘Abeipa na Khazohpa na pasia awpa châ vei,’ tahpa a châ,” tah ta.
Zisu cha ahripa ta reipasaona to ta a reipasao khai tawhta, rypaohna daihti hâ awpa ta siesai ha chy ta.
Zisu cha Thlahpa hmotaotheina ta Kâlili râh lâ a lie ta, cha râh chheipâh zydua liata a thâtih pathâh ta.
Amâ pakhyna ozy liata pachu lymâ ta, chyhsa zydua reithaipa ta y ta.
Zisu cha a laiseihna Nâzari khih tlô ta. A tao tyhpa hawhta, Pahânoh ta pakhyna o liata a ngia ta, Khazohpa bie reih awpa ta a duah ta.
Hrohsopa Isai châbu chatypa vaw pie ei ta. Châbu chatypa cha pathlâ ta, he hawhta rona su hmô ta,

“Abeipa Thlahpa cha ei chô liata y ta, Dyhchhiepazy hnohta thâtihpha chho awpa ta sathaw eina thu. Atâhpazy hnohta puana bie chho ta, Mochaopazy mopavâsa awpa ta na tuah ta, Tlybaipazy khotalaina pie ta,
Abeipa palôhtlâhna kô phuah awpa ta eina tuah,” tahpa ta reih ta.
Châbu cha chaty ta, chakaotuhpa pie pakhua ta, a tyuh ta. Pakhyna o liata chyhsa zydua ta Zisu cha ama mo tawpâ thlâh ha ei ta.
Ama hnohta, “Tanoh nama theina lia tlai ta Biehrai bie â ki haw,” tah ta.
Chyhsa zydua ta Zisu cha reithai ei ta, ngiachhiena bie a pakah tawhta a puapazy vâta ama noâh kaw ta, “He chyhsa he Zawsi sawchapawpa kha châ vei ma?” tah ei ta.

Ano ta ama hnohta, “Nâmo ta la, ‘Dawhty y, nâmasasyh ta a patlâh teh,’ tahpa bieso na rei thlupa ta, ‘Kâpynia liata na taopa eima theipa kha, na khih liata chhao tao hra mah y,’ nama tah thlyu aw,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Zisu ta, “Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, hrohsopa ahy hmahta a khih liata pasô veih ei.
Châhrasala biedopa ei cha chho ei. Elaizâh hro nota, kô thôh nata thla charu avâ a khaw ta, râh zydua liata chakâhna thata a tlô nona kha, Izarei liata nôhmei hluhpi ama y.
Châhrasala ahy hnohta hmah Elaizâh kha tuapa châ leipa ta, Sidaw râh liata Zarephâ khihpa nôhmei pakha lâ deita tuapa a châ.
Hrohsopa Elaisâh hro no chhao khata, Izarei liata phawhpa hluhpi y ei ta, châhrasala ahy hmah pathaisapa châ leipa ei ta, Suria chyhsa Nâmâ deita pathaisapa a châ,” tah ta.
Cha biezy cha ama thei nahta, pakhyna o liata chyhsa zydua cha ama hiehâh ngaita ta.
Thyu ei ta, khih tawhta papua ei ta, ama khih lôkâh khua liata chati pathlah awpa ta a chhi ei ta.
Châhrasala ama hryhrih ta a zie lymâ ta, a pua haw.
Zisu cha Kâlili râh Kâpynia khih lâ zu ta, Pahânoh ta âmo cha pachu ta.
Biehnei ngaitapa ta a pachupa vâta, a pachuna cha noâh tah kaw ei ta.
Pakhyna o liata, ahripa puapa a hneipa chyhsa pakha y ta, ao paro ngaitapa ta,
“Nâzari Zisu, kheihta tao awpa ma miah na khoh? Miah pahleipadia awpa ta ma nâ vy? Ahy ma na châ tahpa ei cha pahno, Khazohpa Mopathaihpa na châ,” tahpa ta awh ta.
Zisu ta ano cha ra ta, a hnohta, “A chalih la, a chhôh tawhta pua teh!” tah ta. Cha chyhsa cha ahripa ta ama hry liata papaosa ta, pasasa leipa ta, a chhôh tawhta a vaw pua haw.
Ama zydua ta noâh tah ngaita ei ta, “He bie he khâpa bie ma a châ tly? Biehneina nata hmotaotheina ta thlahpa puapa biepie ta, ama pua thlâh hapa he,” tah ei ta.
Chatanachata a thâtih cha, cha râh chheipâh su to liata pathâh ha ta.
Zisu cha thyu ta, pakhyna o tawhta pua ta, Saimaw o liata a ngia ta. Saimaw lapinô nô cha hrisypa ta thata sy ta, patlâh awpa ta Zisu cha a hawpa ei ta.
A kiapâh liata a kei duah ta, hrisypa cha ra ta, pai ha ta. Pity pihnô cha thlai thyu ta, âmo cha chakao ta.
Noh a tla hai nota, pasana hri nanopa a ohpazy cha, ama chhôhkhazy ta Zisu lâ a vaw chhi ei ta, ama zydua chô liata a ku pahniehpa ta patlâh lymâ ta.
Ahripazy chyhsa hluhpi chhôh tawhta vaw pua ei ta, “Khazohpa Sawchapawpa na châ!” tahpa ta awh ei ta. Châhrasala âmo cha ra ta, Mesia a châ tahpa ama pahnopa vâta, bie ama rei awpa pasaih leipa ta.
Khih a deih nahta, Zisu cha pua ta, su dâhthlohpa lâ sie ta. Zawpizy ta tlua ei ta, ano lâ a vy ei ta, âmo siesai lei awpa ta patu a chhuah ei ta.
Châhrasala Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Khi hro lâzy chhao Khazohpa khinarâh thâtihpha he ei chho hra awpa a châ. Cha châna chata tuapa ei châ,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Zudia râh pakhyna ozy liata bie chho lymâ ta.
Noh kha cha zawpi ta Khazohpa bie nathlie awpa ta thata ama by nota, Zisu cha Kenesare tipo kiah liata a duah ta.
Tipo kiah liata balyh miano hmô ta, nga patutuhpazy deikua cha ama balyhzy puasaipa ta, ama saozy pasipathai ei ta.
Balyh miakha, Saimaw eih liata kiah ta, raphyu tawhta a chyhta pasie via awpa ta a haw ta. A tyuh ta, balyh tawhta zawpizy cha pachu ta.
Bie a rei khai nahta, Saimaw hnohta, “Âthupa lâ pangai u la, nga patu awpa ta nama saozy vawh teh u,” tah ta.
Saimaw ta a chhy ta, “Hyutuhpa y, azozâkhihdei ta hriapasa pi ta, khâpa hmah patu ma pi. Châhrasala na bie hawhta sao cha ei vawh aw,” tah ta.
Zisu reipa hawhta ama tao nahta, nga hluhpi patu ei ta, ama saozy a hrie pâ khai ha ta.
Balyh hropa liata ama pyheih a ypazy cha âmo bao awpa ta ku ta a kei ei ta. A vy ei ta, ama balyh miano liata pabie ei ta, balyhzy cha a pamôh daihmâ ta.
Cha cha Saimaw Pity ta a hmô nahta, Zisu phei thaby liata kei pao ta, “Hy Abeipa, na siesai teh, moleipa ei châ hih,” tah ta.
Ama nga patupa cha ano nata a viasazy ta noâh tah ngaita ei ta.
Saimaw pyheih, Zebâdi sawchapawpa Zâmie nata Zawhâna zy chhao ta noâh tah kaw hra ei ta. Zisu ta Saimaw hnohta, “Chi khah y, tahmâ tawhta la chyhsa na patu bâ aw,” tah ta.
Ama balyhzy ngiahkâ lâ puakhei ei ta, ato siesaipa ta Zisu cha zi ha ei ta.
Chatawhcha khih miakha liata a y nota, chyhsa pakha a pôhpa duata phawhpa a vy ta. Zisu a hmô nahta, a hmiakô liata pao ta, “Abeipa, na khoh khiahta la, eina pathaisa thei chi na,” tahpa ta a haw ta.
Zisu ta a ku pazawh ta, kei hria ta, “Ei khoh na, pathaih mah y,” tah ta. A phawhpa cha thlai lei ha ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta ta biepie ta, “Ahy hmah chho leipa la, theihthaipa a kei pamosa aw chi ta, na pathaih ha tlai tahpa pahno nawpa ta, Mawsi biepiepa hawhta hmohlâpa kei hlâ mah y,” tah ta.
Châhrasala a thâtih cha pathâh via rili ta, zawpi hluhpi ta a bie thei khohpa vâta nata ama pasanazy patlâh awpa khopa vâta a vypakhy ei ta.
Châhrasala Zisu cha su dâhthlohpa liata thlahchhâ awpa ta sie ha ta.

Noh kha cha a pachu hai nota, cha liata Phârisaihzy nata ryhpa pachutuhpazy a tyuh hra ei ta. Âmo cha Kâlili nata Zudia khih to tawhta nata Zerusale tawhta a vypazy ama châ. Patlâh theina Abeipa hmotaotheina cha Zisu liata y ta.
Asypa pakha a rakhô duata a vaw sy ei ta, Zisu lâ a ngiakhei ta, a hmiakô liata soh awpa a chhuah ei ta.
Zawpi vâta a ngiakhei thei leipa ei ta. Vâphuh lâ kiah ei ta, a hmohphaw duata a pyupa liata za pathliah ei ta, a liah liata Zisu hmiakô liata za soh ei ta.
Amâ ngiapâna cha a hmô nahta, Zisu ta, “Chyhsa y, na moleinazy a ngiahthaipa a châ haw,” tah ta.
Ryhpa pachutuhpazy nata Phârisaihzy ta ama palôh liata sei ei ta, “Khazohpa a reipachhiepa he ahy ma a châ tly? Khazohpa dei leipa ta ahy ma moleinazy a ngiahthai thei?” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama pachâna cha a pahno nahta, “Khazia nama palôh ta nama sei tly?
‘Na moleinazy a ngiahthaipa a châ haw,’ tahpa ma a rei a nao via, ‘Thyu la, phei ta sie teh,’ tahpa maw?

He hmo he, chyhsa Sawchapawpa he moleinazy a ngiahthai theina biehneina khizaw liata a hnei tahpa nama pahno nawpa ta taopa a châ,” tah ta. Asypa hnohta, “Ei cha chho, thyu la, na hmohphaw la la, na o lâ a di teh,” tah ta.
Ama mohmô liata thlai thyu ta, â ziana hmohphaw cha la ta, Khazohpa reithaina chôta o lâ a di ha ta.
Ama zydua ta noâh tah ngaita ei ta, Khazohpa reithai ei ta, “Tanoh he hmonoâhpa eima hmô hih,” tah ei ta, china ta bie ei ta.
Cha khai tawhta Zisu cha pua ta, chhie kheina su liata a tyuhpa, chhiekheituhpa a moh Livai ama tahpa hmô ta, a hnohta, “Na zi teh,” tah ta.
Ato siesaipa ta, thyu ta, Zisu cha zi ha ta.
Livai ta a o liata Zisu châta kyhchhi rônahpa tao ta, chhiekheituhpa hluhpi nata chyhsa hropazy ta Zisu nata a pachupazy cha tlâhkhai liata pati dôhkhei ei ta.
Phârisaihzy nata ama ryhpa pachutuhpazy ta a pachupazy hnohta paphôh ei ta, “Kheihtazie ta chhiekheituhpazy nata moleipazy hnohta nie ta a doh thlâh ha tly?” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta âmo cha a chhy ta, “Atlâhpazy ta dawhty a ngiah leipa ei ta, tlâhleipazy ta amâ ngiah.
Mosiapazy pado awpa ta a zupa châ leipa na ta, moleipazy pado ta, parosa awpa ta a zupa tlao ei châ,” tah ta.

Âmo ta Zisu hnohta, “Zawhâna pachupazy cha kâhvileipa ta y tyh ei ta, thlah ama chhâ tyh. Phârisaih pachuna a zyhpazy chhao, cha hawhta ama tao tyh hra. Na pachupazy deikua cha nie ei ta ama doh lymâ,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta âmo cha a chhy ta, “Myuhneituhpa a y chhôh ta, ahneina kyhchhi a hlaopazy kâhvileipa ta nama paysa beih ma?
Châhrasala ama hry tawhta myuhneituhpa lana nohzy vaw tlô aw ta, cha nohzy lia deikua cha kâhvileipa ta ama y aw,” tah ta.

Zisu ta ama hnohta he pakhona bie chhao he reih ta, “Ahy hmahta pohthâ thiehpa hriepa ta, chysia parohpa liata baithla beih veih ei. Cha hawhta ama tao khiahta cha, pohthâ thiehpa ta chysia parohpa cha parao aw ta, pohthâ thiehpa nata chysia parohpa cha a hmie aw vei.

Ahy hmahta savo titheih parohpa liata kresawhti thiehpa ryh beih veih ei. Ama ryh khiahta cha, kresawhti thiehpa ta savo titheih cha tôhchheih aw ta, kresawhti cha a leih aw ta, savo titheih chhao a rao aw.
Kresawhti thiehpa cha savo titheih thiehpa liata ama ryh tyh.
Ahy hmahta kresawhti hlôpa a do khai tawhta, a thiehpa doh khoh khao aw vei, ‘Ahlôpa a pha via,’ a tah aw,” tah ta.
Pahânoh ta sâh thih liata a sie hai nota, a pachupazy ta sâh suzy thlie ei ta, ama kupazah ta chanaohpa ta nie ei ta.
Phârisaih thokhazy ta, “Khazia ryhpa pasai leipa Pahânoh ta nama tao?” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta a chhy ta, “Dâvi nata a hnohta a ypazy ta ama nodi nota ama hmotaopa kha reih beih veih ei chi ma?
Khazohpa o liata a ngia ta, theihthaipazy deita nie pasaipa Ypâna Viahchhâ la ta, nie ta, a hnohta a ypazy chhao a pie hrapa kyh kha reih beih veih ei chi ma?” tah ta.
Chatawhcha ama hnohta, “Chyhsa Sawchapawpa he Pahânoh Beipa a châ,” tah ta.
Pahânoh hropa liata, Zisu cha pakhyna o liata a ngiapa ta pachu ta. Cha liata chyhsa pakha a ku chachâh lâ asypa y ta.
Ryhpa pachutuhpazy nata Phârisaihzy ta ano ama leih thei nawpa ta, Pahânoh ta a patlâh nata patlâh lei mohpathli ei ta.
Zisu ta ama palôh a pahno nahta, kusypa hnohta. “A vy la, he liata a vaw duah teh,” tah ta. Kusypa cha thyu ta, cha liata a duah ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Ei cha hiahri ei, Pahânoh ta khâpa tao awpa ma ryhpa ta a pasaih, hmo pha tao awpa ma, hmo chhie tao awpa maw? Hrona pabohsapa ma, hrona pahleipadiapa maw?” tah ta.
Ama zydua ta a moh pachâh khai nahta, kusypa hnohta, “Na ku pazawh teh,” tah ta. A reipa hawhta tao ta, a ku cha vaw pha ha ta.
Ryhpa pachutuhpazy nata Phârisaihzy cha ama pathi ia ngaita ta, Zisu chô liata kheihta tao awpa ma tahpa a chhohia ei ta.
Cha nohzy liata, Zisu cha thlahchhâ awpa ta tlâh lâ khy ta, azozâkhihdei ta Khazohpa lâ thlahchhâ ta.
Khih a pavâ nahta, a pachupazy aw ta, ama hry tawhta pahrawh hleino a tlyh ta, ama moh ta lyuhchâpazy bi ta.
Chazy cha Pity tahpa ta a moh a bipa Saimaw nata a unawhpa Adaru, Zâmie nata Zawhâna, Phili, Bâthawlawmu,
Mathai, Thawma, Alphu sawchapawpa Zâmie, Zilô py liatapa Saimaw,
Zâmie sawchapawpa Zudâh nata a patusatuhpa Zudâh Iskari zy ama châ.

Ama hnohta zu ta, a bypa liata a duah ta. A pachupazy ano lâ a vy ei ta. Zudia râh zydua tawhta nata Zerusale khih tawhta nata tilaipi kiah Tyre nata Sidaw khihzy tawhta chyhsa hluhpi ano lâ a vy ei ta.
A bie nathlie awpa nata ama pasanazy patlâh awpa ta a vypa ama châ. Thlahpa chhiepazy ta a patypamâpazy chhao patlâhpa ama châ.
Zawpi zydua ta Zisu cha hria a chhuah ei ta, ano tawhta hmotaotheina pua ta, chyhsa zydua a patlâh lymâ ei.
Zisu ta a pachupazy cha moh ta, ama hnohta, “Nâmo, sipasapazy saih u, nama nohlao na, Khazohpa khinarâh cha nâmo eih a châpa vâta.
“Nâmo, tahmâ nota nodipazy saih u, nama nohlao na, nama rih a bie awpa vâta. “Nâmo, tahmâ nota a chapazy saih u, nama nohlao na, nama pahnei awpa vâta.
“Chyhsa Sawchapawpa vâta, chyhsazy ta châ haopa ta, cha pathluapa ta, cha pasipasawhpa ta, nama moh ama cha pachhie tita, nama nohlao na!
Cha noh liata a ly u la, thaphapa ta a thluah teh u. Pachâ teh u, vârâh liata nama lymâ hluhpi a y. Âmo pathlatuhpazy chhao khata, hrohsopazy chô liata, cha hawhta ama vaw tao tyh.
“Nâmo, tahmâ ta hneirôhpazy deikua cha, nama hu a po na, nama lymâ nama hmô hapa vâta.
“Nâmo, tahmâ nota rihbiepazy saih u, nama hu a po na, nama no a di awpa vâta. “Nâmo, tahmâ nota a pahneihpazy saih u, nama hu a po na, mâchhiesapa ta nama y awpa vâta.
“Chyhsa to ta ama cha reithai tita nama hu a po na, cha hawhna chata ama pathlatuhpazy ta hrohso pakheipazy chô liata ama vaw tao tyh.
“Ei bie a theituhpa saih u, ei cha chho ei. Nama khakhaipazy kyhpachâ u la, châ haotuhpazy chô liata hmo pha tao teh u.
Nama chô liata chhie a sapazy byhnâ awpa u la, châ pasipasawhpazy thlahchhâpa teh u.
Na baih hiakha lâ châ chabaihpa cha, hiakha lâ chhao dao la, na poh châ chhupa chhao, na viahkao pasipa a la awpa thlyu khah y.
Châ hiahpa maih pie la, na hmo châ lapatuhpa cha hiah khao khah y.
Chyhsa ta nama chô liata ama tao awpa nama khopa hawhta, nâmo chhao chyhsa chô liata tao hra teh u.
“Kyh châ pachâtuhpazy deita kyh nama pachâ khiahta cha, khâpa athôhna ma nama hmô aw? Chyhsa moleipazy chhao ta kyh a pachâtuhpa cha kyh ama pachâ thei mâh tâh.
Nama chô liata hmo pha a taopazy chô lia deita hmo pha nama tao khiahta cha, khâpa athôhna ma nama hmô aw? Chyhsa moleipazy chhao ta, cha hawhpa cha ama tao thei mâh tâh.

Hmô heih awpa hnabeiseih theipa hnoh deita dyu nama pacheisa khiahta cha, khâpa athôhna ma nama hmô aw? Chyhsa moleipazy chhao ta, a ualua ta hmô heih awpa ta, moleipazy hnohta ama pacheisa thei mâh tâh.

Nama khakhaipazy kyh pachâ u la, ama phana awpa tao u la, a vaw kua heih awpa hnabeiseih leipa ta dyu pacheisa teh u. Chatanachata nama lymâ hluh aw ta, Chônôchaipa sawzy nama châ aw. Ano cha alyna châh pahno leipazy nata moleipazy chhao a ngiachhie theipa a châ.
Nama Paw cha zawngiah theipa a châpa hawhta, nâmo chhao zawngiahna hnei teh u.
“Sei khah u, chatanachata seipa ta y aw veih ei chi. Ahy hmah thailei pachâsa khah u, chatanachata thailei pachâsapa ta y aw veih ei chi. A ngiahthai teh u, chatanachata a ngiahthaipa nama châ aw.

Pie teh u, chatanachata piepa ta nama y aw. Hnaohpa ta nata chalyupa ta nata a khô ngâpa ta panuana phapa cha, nama kalachhôh liata sopa a châ aw. Panuana nama hmâpa hawhta ama cha panuapa hra aw,” tah ta.
Ama hnohta pakhona bie reih heih ta, “Mochaopa ta mochaopa a chhihtha thei aw ma? Ama pano ta khaohtlô liata hmaohkha ta tla aw veih ei ma?
Pachupa cha a pachutuhpa chô liata y beih vei. Châhrasala liahsata ta pachu hapa cha, a pachutuhpa a lyu aw.
Khazia nâma mo liata pâkô a ypa hmô leipa chi ta, na unawhpa mo liata mobâ na hmô?

Nâma mo liata pâkô a ypa hmô leipa chi ta, kheihta ma na unawhpa hnohta, ‘Unawh, na mo liata mobâ kha cha vaw lapa ha sah,’ na tah thei? Nâ, phapakheipa, nâma mo liata pâkô kha la ha tua la, chatanachata na unawhpa mo liata mobâ la awpa cha a siapa ta na hmô thei aw.
“Tho phapa ta thei chhiepa pathei beih leipa ta, tho chhiepa ta thei phapa pathei beih hra vei.
Tho to ama thei ta pahnopa a châ. Ahloh liata theiku lyu beih leipa ei ta, diahsai liata kre thei lyu beih veih ei.

Chyhsa phapa ta a palôh ryubyh phapa tawhta hmo phapa papua tyh ta, chyhsa chhiepa ta a palôh ryubyh chhiepa tawhta hmo chhiepa a papua tyh. Chyhsa ta a palôh liata a bie pakhôpa cha, a pakah ta a papua tyh.
“Ei bie zyh tlôh leipa ei chi ta, khazia, ‘Abeipa, Abeipa,’ eina tah ei chi?
Kei lâ a vy ta, ei bie thei ta a taopa maih cha, khâpa a lyu tahpa ei cha pahmôsa aw ei.
Ano cha chyhsa ta o sa ta, â pathupi a lei chao ta, lôpanô chô liata abôna a paryhpa hawhta a châ. Ti a vaw lai nahta, tily chahra ngaitapa ta su ta, a phapa ta sapa a châpa vâta a chalyu vei.
Thei tlôh ta a tao leipa deikua cha, abôna a i leipa alei chô liata o a sapa chyhsa hawhta a châ. Tily chahrapa ta o cha su ta, thlai a cho haw. Cha o raopa cha a rarôh y ngaita,” tah ta.
Zawpi theipa ta bie zydua a rei khai nahta, Kâpynia khih liata a ngia ta.
Pheisaih za kha hyutuhpa chakaotuhpa kho ngaitapa cha tlâh leipa ta, thi daihmâ ta.
Zisu thâtih a thei nahta, a vy sala, a chakaotuhpa cha patlâh awpa ta a haw awpa ta Zu machâzy tuah ta.
Zisu kô kei tlô ei ta, thata a haw ei ta, “Ano la, cha hmo cha na taopa awpa tlâh a châ na,
eima phopi kyhpachâ ta, eimâ pakhyna o miah a sapatuhpa a châ,” tah ei ta.
Zisu cha ama hnohta sie ta, o a tlô chy ta, pheisaih za kha hyutuhpa ta a viasazy vaw tuah ta, “Abeipa, na rie a pathei khoh khah y, a o nâ ngiana tlâh châ va na.
Kei chhao nâ lâ a vy tlâh awpa ta a rao hra va na. A bie ta reih la, nâ chakaotuhpa cha a tlâh thlâh ha aw.

Kei chhao he biehneina a chabatuhpa châ na ta, ei ry liata pheisaihzy ama y hra. Pheisaih pakha hnohta, ‘Sie teh,’ tah na ta sie ta; ahropa hnohta, ‘A vy teh,’ tah na ta a vy ta; nâ chakaotuhpa hnohta, ‘He he tao teh,’ tah na ta a tao tyh,” tah ta.
Zisu ta cha biezy cha a thei nahta, a chô liata a noâh ngaita ta. Ano zituhpa zawpizy lâ a heih ta, ama hnohta, “Ei cha chho ei, Izarei lia hmahta he tlu ta ngiapâna he hmô va na,” tah ta.
A chyhsa tuapazy cha o lâ amâ vaw lie nahta, chakaotuhpa cha a tlâh hapa ta hmô ei ta.
A mylâ ta khih miakha Naini ama tahpa lâ sie ta, a pachupazy nata zawpi hluhpi a hnohta sie ei ta.
Khih hawka â kei hnia nahta, athihpa amâ vaw sypa hmô ta. Cha chyhsa cha nôhmei sawchapaw matlupa a châ. Khihsaw hluhpi a hnohta a vy hra ei ta.
Abeipa ta nôhmei cha a hmô nahta, a chô liata a thapasa ngaita ta, a hnohta, “Cha khah y,” tah ta.
A kei hnia ta, chhâchhua cha kei hria ta, asytuhpazy cha a duah ei ta. “Satliapa, ei cha chho, thyu teh,” tah ta.
Athihpa cha a vaw tyuh ta, a reih vaw pathlie ta. Zisu ta satliapa cha a nô lâ hlâ ta.
Ama zydua ta chi ngaita ei ta, Khazohpa reithai ei ta, “Eima hry liata hrohsopa rônahpa a vaw pua hih! Khazohpa ta a chyhsazy a vaw tly ha hih!” tah ei ta.
A thâtih cha Zudia râh nata a chheipâh râh zydua liata pathâh ta.
Cha hmo zydua cha Zawhâna pachupazy ta Zawhâna cha chho ei ta.
Zawhâna ta a pachupa pano aw ta, Abeipa lâ tuah ta, a hnohta, “A vy awpa cha na châ ma, chyhsa hropa ma eima hâ aw?” tahpa ta kei pahiahrisa ta.
Zisu kô ama tlô nahta, a hnohta, “Bâtituhpa Zawhâna ta, ‘A vy awpa cha na châ ma, chyhsa hropa ma eima hâ aw?’ tahpa cha hiahri awpa ta nâ lâ miah a vaw tuah,” tah ei ta.
Cha daihti liata, Zisu ta hri ohpa hluhpi nata potlana vâta pasapa nata thlahpa chhiepa ta a patupa hluhpi patlâhpa ta, mochaopa hluhpi mopavâna pie ta.

Âmo cha a chhy ta, “Vawh u la, nama hmôpa nata theipazy he Zawhâna kei chho u la, mochaopazy ama mo pavâ ta, pheisypazy phei ta sie ei ta, phawhpazy pathaih ei ta, nahpâpazy nah pavâpa ta, athihpazy pathyupa ta y ei ta, dyhchhiepazy hnohta Thâtihpha chhopa a châ, tahpa ta kei chho teh u.
Ei chô liata palôhchâ leina a hnei leipa chyhsa cha a nohlao na,” tah ta.
Zawhâna tuapazy ama sie tawhta, Zisu ta zawpi hnohta Zawhâna thâtih reih ta: “Khâpa mo awpa ta ma râhchawhpa lâ nama sie? Ziza ta lohthi a chalyupa moh awpa ta ma?
Khâpa mo awpa tlai ta ma nama pua? Chysia naipa a tobipa mo awpa ta ma? Moh teh u, chysia rônahpa a tobi ta, lôhrâtlôpa ta a ypazy cha abei ozy liata mah ama y tâh.
Cha khiah, khâpa mo awpa ta ma nama pua? Hrohsopa mo awpa ta ma? Ano cha hrohsopa a châ tlai, ei cha chho ei, hrohsopa hlâta rônah viapa a châ.
“‘Moh teh u, ei lyuhchâpa na hmia lâta tuah na ta, Ano ta na hmia lâta na lâpi â chhuahdy aw,’ tahpa ta a thâtih ropa kha, ano he a châ.
Ei cha chho ei, chanô sapa hry liata Zawhâna hlâta rônah viapa y veih ei. Châhrasala Khazohpa khinarâh liata chyhsa chyh chaipa cha ano hlâta a rônah via,” tah ta.
A bie reipa cha zawpi zydua nata chhiekheituhpazy ta ama thei nahta, Khazohpa hmotaopa siapa liata a ly ngaita ei ta. Âmo cha Zawhâna liata bâti a châ chiehpazy ama châ.
Phârisaihzy nata ryhpa pachutuhpazy deikua cha, âmo châta Khazohpa ryhraona cha khoh veih ei. Âmo cha Zawhâna liata bâti a châ leipazy ama châ.
Zisu ta, “He chhâ he khâpa nata ma ei pakho aw? Khâpa ma ama lyu?
Sôdaohna su liata a tyuh ei ta, “‘Ramo cha tôpa pi ta, Lâh leipa ei chi ta; Cha chakhei pi ta, Pachârôh hlei veih ei chi,’ tahpa ta â awsao raihriepa hawtizy ama lyu.
Bâtituhpa Zawhâna a vy ta, viahchhâ nie leipa ta kresawhti chhao doh leipa ta y ta, ‘Ahripa a hnei,’ tah ei chi ta.
Chyhsa Sawchapawpa a vy ta, niepa ta doh ta, ‘Moh tua u, rihkawhpa nata kresawhti parâpa, chhiekheituhpazy nata moleipazy viasa huh!’ nama tah heih.
Châhrasala sona â dozie cha a saw zydua liata â lâ tyh,” tah ta.
Phârisaih chyhsa pakha ta Zisu cha pati nie hrua ta, Phârisaih o liana cha a ngia ta, pati dôh ta.
Phârisaih o liata pati dôhpa ta â tyupa thâtih cha, cha khih liata chanô moleipa pakha ta a thei nahta, alabastâ sathaw ropahâhpa ôh a cheipa ta vawh ta.

Mothlih chhaota a hnôh lâta a phei thaby liata a duah ta, chanô mothlih ta Zisu phei cha padâ khai ha ta. A mothlih cha a sâ ta hru ta, Zisu phei cha a pahnâ ta, sathaw ropahâhpa ta a pheizy cha thu ta.

Cha hmo cha Zisu pati nie a hruatuhpa Phârisaih ta a hmô nahta, a palôh liata, “He chyhsa he hrohsopa a châ tlai khiahta cha, a hriatuhpa chanô he ahy ma a châ tahpa nata kheihawhpa chyhsa ma a châ tahpa a pahno thlyu awpa châ ta, ano he chanô moleipa châ tlôh ta,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a chhy ta, a hnohta, “Saimaw, na hnohta bie rei awpa ei hnei,” tah ta. Saimaw ta, “Pachutuhpa, reih mah y” tah ta.
Zisu ta, “Tâkâ dyu a pacheisatuhpa pakha liata chyhsa pano ta leibâh hnei ei ta. Pakha ta dinâri za pangawh a bâh ta, ahropa ta sypangawh a bâh ta.
A thô thei awpa ama châ leipa vâta, ama pano ta ama leibâh cha a ngiahthai raihrie ta. Cha pano liana chata, ahy ma dyupacheisatuhpa cha kyh a pachâ via aw?” tah ta.
Saimaw ta a chhy ta, “Leibâh hluh via â ngiahthaipa cha châ sala ei pangiasa,” tah ta. Zisu ta a hnohta, “Na pachâzie â do,” tah ta.

Chanô lâ a heih ta, Saimaw hnohta, “He chanô he na hmô ma? Nâ ta la na o liata a vaw ngia na ta, ei phei a si nawpa ti chhao na pie va chi. He chanô deikua heta a mothlih ta ei pheizy padâ ta, cha cha a sâ ta a hru.
Nâ ta la a pahnâ chhao nâ pahnâ va chi, he chanô deikua he la, ei vaw ngiapa nahta, ei phei â pahnâpa bâh mâh vei.
Nâ la ei luh liata sathaw na thu va chi. He chanô deikua cha, sathaw ropahâhpa ta ei phei sathaw a thu hih.
Chavâta ei cha chho, he chanô he cha, a kyhpachâna a hluh ngaitapa vâta a moleina hluhpi kha a ngiahthaipa a châ haw. Ngiahthai awpa a chyh khiahta cha, kyhpachâna chhao a chyh via hra,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha chanô hnohta, “Na moleinazy a ngiahthaipa a châ haw,” tah ta.
Pati a dôhlâhpazy ta, “He chyhsa he ahy ma a châ tly, moleinazy taih a ngiahthaipa chyhsa he?” tahpa ta a chhohia ei ta.
Zisu ta chanô hnohta, “Nâ ngiapâna ta a cha pachha haw. Thlahlôhpa ta sie mah y,” tah ta.
Sathawthupa a châ khai tawhta, Zisu cha biechhopa nata Khazohpa khinarâh thâtihpha phuahpa ta, khihpi nata khitawzy chahryh lymâ ta. Pahrawh hleinozy a hnohta y ei ta,
thlahpa chhiepazy âmo tawhta a papuapa nata pasana a patlâhpazy chhao amâ hlao hra. Âmo cha a chhôh tawhta ahripa pasari a papuapa Mâdali ama bipa Mâri,
Herawda sôh mokhâhtuhpa Kuza lapinô Zôanâ, Susanâ nata ahropa hluhpizy ama châ. Âmozy chata ama hneina tawhta Zisu cha ama deichhy lymâ.
Khi to tawhta chyhsazy ano lâ a vy ei ta, zawpi hluhpi amâ vaw hmaoh nahta, pakhona bie hmâpa ta bie reih ta,
“Chi hietuhpa cha chi hie awpa ta pua ta. Chi cha hie ta, thokha lâpi liata tla ei ta, tlypâpa ta y ei ta, avâ pavawzy ta ama dyh khai haw.
Thokha lôphiariapa liata tla ei ta, kaw pyuh ei ta, châhrasala ti pahna leipa vâta ama uah lilaw haw.
Thokha ahloh thih liata tla ei ta, ahloh nata pyuh khoh ei ta, ahloh ta a disao ha ei.
Thokha lei phapa liata tla ei ta, pyuh ei ta, a lie za kha ta ama pathei,” tah ta. Cha biezy cha a rei khai nahta, awh ta, “Ahy rai thei nawpa nakhaoh a hneipa ta thei mawh sy,” tah ta.
A pachupazy ta pakhona bie cha a yzie hiahri ei ta,

Zisu ta, “Nâmo hnohta la Khazohpa khinarâh bienyupazy pahno awpa ta piepa nama châ haw. Mohropazy hnohta deikua cha, pakhona bie ta reipa a châ. Moh aw ei ta, châhrasala hmô aw veih ei; thei aw ei ta, châhrasala pahno thai aw veih ei.
He he pakhona bie yzie cha a châ: Chi cha Khazohpa bie a châ.
Lâpi liata a tlapazy cha bie a theipazy châ ei ta, ahripa a vy ta, a ngiapâ leipa ei sala pachha ama châ thei lei nawpa ta, ama palôh liata bie a ypa cha a lapa ha ei.

Hezy he lôphiariapa liata chi hiepazy ama châ. Bie ama theipa nahta, a ly ngaitapa ta a pyh ei ta, châhrasala thari ama thla leipa vâta, bohpi leipa chhôh zyh ei ta, reipasaona a vaw y nahta, ama paosai ha tyh.

Hezy he ahloh thih liata chi a tlapazy cha ama châ. Bie thei ei ta, châhrasala ama sie nahta, hro chhôh khihsa pachâna nata hneirôna nata phasana tlaichhaina zy ta âmo cha disao ta, ama thei pitloh thei vei.
Lei phapa liata a tlapazy cha hezy he ama châ. Bie thei ei ta, palôh dopa nata phapa phaopa ta â ipa ta patu ei ta, hria hualuapa ta thei ama pathei tyh.
“Ahy hmah meiôh rao sala beih ta khu beih leipa ta, rakhô ry liata soh beih hra vei. O chhôh lâ a ngiapazy ta khaihna ama hmô thei nawpa ta, meiôh sona liata a soh tyh.
Phuah lei awpa ta phihpa khâpa hmah y leipa ta, pahno lei awpa nata a lâ lei awpa ta nyupa khâpa hmah y vei.
Chavâta nama bie theipa liata a chado teh u. A hneipa cha baichhapa châ aw ta, a hnei leipa cha, hneipa hawhta â pachâpa chhao, ano tawhta lapa a châ aw,” tah ta.
A nô nata a unawhzy Zisu lâ a vy ei ta, châhrasala zawpi vâta a hmô thei leipa ei ta.
A hnohta, “Na nô nata na unawhzy ta châ hmô khoh ei ta, khôtho liata amâ duah thlâh haw,” tahpa ta chho ei ta.
Zisu ta âmo cha a chhy ta, “Khazohpa bie thei ta, a taopazy cha ei nô nata ei unawhzy ama châ,” tah ta.
Noh kha cha a pachupazy chhaota balyh kiah ta, ama hnohta, “Tipo haosâ lâ kiah ei suh u,” tah ta, balyh cha hia ei ta.
Balyh ta ama sie hai nota Zisu cha a mô ha ta. Tipo liata thlihpi vaw pathli ta, ama balyh cha ti ta bie daihmâ ta, chichhihna a tyh ei ta.

Vawh ei ta, Zisu cha kei pathyu ei ta, a hnohta, “Pachutuhpa, Pachutuhpa, eima leidia aw he zaw!” tah ei ta. Zisu cha a vaw hra ta, thlih nata tichatlaopa ru ngaitapa cha ra ta, a chalih ei ta, sidia ha ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Khataih liata namâ ngiapâna a y haw?” tah ta. Chi kaw ei ta, ama noâh ngaita ta, “He chyhsa he ahy ma a châ tly? Thlih nata ti taih biepie ta, a bie ama zyhpa he!” tah ei ta.
Kerâsene râh tlô ei ta, cha cha Kâlili râh dady liata a ypa a châ.
Zisu cha ngiahkâ lâ a pua nahta, khihpi liata chyhsa pakha, ahripa a hneipa ta a vaw tyh ta. Cha chyhsa cha chysia â tao leina tawhta bohpi châ ha ta, o liata y leipa ta thlâzy liata a y tyhpa a châ.
Zisu a hmôpa nahta, awh ta, a hmiakô liata pao ta, ao paro ngaitapa ta, “Zisu, Khazohpa Chônôchai Sawchapawpa, ei chô liata khâpa tao awpa ma na khoh? Ei châ haw na, rie na taola khah y,” tah ta.

Cha thlahpa puapa cha, cha chyhsa tawhta pua awpa ta, Zisu ta bie a vaw pie ha chiehpa a châ. Cha chyhsa cha thlahpa puapa chata patu tyh ta, bâlia ta buhpa ta keihrai daipa ta vaih tyhpa a châ. Châhrasala ama chahrynazy cha chhie ta, ahripa chata râhchawhpa lâ a chadai ha tyh.
Zisu ta, “Na moh ahy?” tah ta. Ano ta, “Zahluh,” tah ta. Cha chyhsa chhôh liata ahripa hluhpi amâ ngiapa vâta a châ.
Ahripazy chata khaohtlô athupa liata tla awpa ta biepie lei awpa ta Zisu cha a haw ei ta.
Tlâh liata vao zaw hluhpi ama lao chuah ei ta. Vao chhôh liata pangiasa awpa ta Zisu cha a haw ei ta. Amâ hawna cha pasaih ta.
Ahripazy cha chyhsa chhôh tawhta pua ei ta, vao chhôh liata a ngia ei ta, vao zaw cha pâdawhpa lâ tawhta tipo lâ a râ ei ta, tipo liata tlasao khai ha ei ta.
Vao pasatuhpazy ta hmo a tlôpa cha ama hmô nahta, a râ ei ta, khihpi nata khitaw zy liata reih lymâ ei ta.

Khâpa hmo ma a tlô tahpa mo awpa ta chyhsazy pua ei ta, Zisu kô ama tlô nahta, ahripa ta a puasai hapa chyhsa kha, chysia a tobipa ta palôh pasohpa ta Zisu phei thaby liata â tyu thlâhpa hmô ei ta, chi kaw ei ta.
Hmo tlôpa a hmôpazy ta Zisu ta ahripa patupa a patlâhna thâtih cha âmo chho ei ta.
Kerâsene chheipâh râh liata chyhsa zydua cha chi ngaita ei ta, âmo puasai awpa ta Zisu cha a haw ei ta. Chavâta Zisu cha balyh kiah ta, a lie ha ta.
Ahripa ta a puasai hapa khata Zisu hnohta y awpa ta a haw ta, châhrasala Zisu ta,

“Na o lâ a di la, Khazohpa ta na chô liata hmo rônahpa a taopa kha kei phuah mah y,” tah ta, pasiesa ha ta. Sie ta, Zisu ta a chô liata hmo rônahpa a taopa cha, khihpi chhôh zydua liata phuah lymâ ta.
Zisu â vaw liepa cha zawpizy ta vaw hâ thlâh ha ei ta, thapha ngaitapa ta a vaw ly ei ta.
Chyhsa pakha a moh Zairu ama tahpa, pakhyna o hyutuhpa a vy ta, Zisu phei thaby liata pao ta, a o tly awpa ta a haw ta.
Zairu cha sawchanô matlupa, kô hrawh hleinopa hnei ta. Hawtinô cha thata pasa ta, thi daihmâ ta. Zisu cha a sie hai nota, zawpizy ta thata by ei ta.
Chanô pakha kô hrawh hleino thi lohpa, a sôh hneipa zydua dawhtyzy liata a hmâh khai tawh chhao ta, ahy ta hmah ama patlâh thei leipa y ta.
Cha chanô cha Zisu hnôh lâta pazi ta, a poh pai hria ta, a thi lopa cha thlai a hâh ha ta.
Zisu ta, “Ahy nâ hria?” tah ta. Chyhsa to ta ama hria leizie reih ei ta, Pity ta, “Pachutuhpa, zawpizy ta thata cha by ei ta, ama cha chakho hôlô!” tah ta.
Châhrasala Zisu ta, “Ahy tlyma ta eina hria, hmotaotheina ei chhôh tawhta a puapa ei pahno,” tah ta.
Chanô cha â nyu thei khao leipa â pahno nahta, achalyuna chôta a vy ta, a hmiakô liata pao ta, a hriana chhâpa nata thlai a tlâh hanazie zy cha chyhsa zydua hmiakô liata phuah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Ei sawchanô, nâ ngiapâna ta a cha patlâh haw. Thlalôhpa ta sie mah y,” tah ta.
Cha bie cha a rei hai nota, pakhyna o hyutuhpa o tawhta chyhsa pakha a vy ta, “Na sawchanô a thi haw, Pachutuhpa he patypamâ khao khah y,” vaw tah ta.
Cha bie cha Zisu ta a thei nahta, “Chi leipa la, a ngiapâ thlâh ha mah y, a tlâh aw,” tah ta.
O a tlô nahta, Pity, Zawhâna, Zâmie nata hawtinô nô nata paw dei leipa cha, ahy hmah o chhôh lâ a ngia awpa pasaih leipa ta.
Chyhsa zydua ta hawtinô cha chakheipa ta, mâchhie vaw sapa ei ta, Zisu ta, “Cha khah u, thi vei, â môpa a châ hih,” tah ta.
A thi ha tlai tahpa ama pahnopa vâta Zisu cha pahneisao ei ta.
Zisu ta hawtinô cha a ku patu ta, aw ta, “Hawtinô, thyu teh,” tah ta.
Hawtinô thlahpa cha vaw kua ta, thlai kaw thyu ha ta. Hawtinô cha niepa pie awpa ta biepie ta.
A nô nata a paw cha ama noâh ngaita ta. Châhrasala Zisu ta a hmotaopa cha ahy hmah chho lei awpa ta biepie ta.
Zisu ta pahrawh hleinozy awpakhy ta, ama hnohta ahripa zydua chô liata hmotaotheina nata biehneina nata pasanazy patlâh theina pie ta.
Khazohpa khinarâh bie chho awpa nata tlâhleipazy patlâh awpa ta âmo cha tuah ta.
Ama hnohta, “Nama khitlyna châta khâpa hmah a phao khuh vy. Chôchahrei, sahria, viahchhâ nata tâkâ zy a phao leipa u la, viahkao zo no hnei hra khuh vy.
Nama tlôna o liata y aw ei chi ta, cha o tawhta nama sie aw.
Châ ly leipa maih cha, cha khih tawhta nama pua tita, ama thaileichâna pahnosa nawpa ta nama phei liata buchadoh chatho thlu teh u,” tah ta.
Chatanachata sie ei ta, khihzy chahryh ei ta, su to liata thâtihpha chhopa ta tlâhleipazy patlâh lymâ ei ta.
Bei Herawda ta Zisu hmotaopa zydua cha thei ta, a noâh ngaita ta. A chhâpa cha thokha ta Zawhâna kha athihpa hry tawhta a vaw thyupa a châ tah ei ta,
thokha ta Elaizâh â vaw luah tah ei ta, thokha ta hlâno hrohsopa ahy tlyma a vaw thyu heihpa a châ ama tahpa vâta a châ.
Herawda ta, “Zawhâna kha a luh tai ha na ta, châhrasala he hawhta a thâtih ei thei heihpa chyhsa he ahy ma a châ tly?” tah ta. Zisu cha hmô a chhuah ta.
Amâ vaw lie nahta, lyuhchâpazy ta ama hmotaopa zydua Zisu chho ei ta. Zisu ta âmo cha a chhi ta, Besaidâ khih ama tahpa lâ ânano ta siekhei ta.
Châhrasala zawpizy ta ama pahno nahta, Zisu cha pazi ha hra ei ta. Zisu ta âmo cha a vaw ly ta, Khazohpa khinarâh thâtih chho ta, patlâh â ngiahpazy patlâh lymâ ta.

Zâlâ a vaw châ nahta, pahrawh hleinozy a vy ei ta, a hnohta, “Su dâhthlohpa liata y pi ta. Chavâta tlô o nata nie awpa ama hmô thei nawpa ta, zawpizy he eima chheipâh khihzy nata lyuzy lâ pasiesa teh,” tah ei ta.

Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Nâmo ta nie awpa pie teh u,” tah ta. Âmo ta, “Sie ei sih la, he chyhsa zydua châta nie awpa eima chalei leipa ta cha, viahchhâ tlâ pangawh nata ngasa miano dei leipa ta khâpa hmah hnei ma pi,” tah ei ta.
Pitlohpa chapaw sai ta sâh pangawh rachhôh y ei ta. Zisu ta a pachupazy hnohta, “A hlao hlao ta, sypangawh lymâ ta patyusa teh u,” tah ta.
Cha hawhta tao ei ta, patyusa khai ei ta.
Viahchhâ tlâ pangawh nata ngasa miano cha la ta, avâ lâ uapa ta byhnâ aw ta. Viahchhâ cha pachhaih ta, zawpi rai awpa ta pachupazy cha pie ta.
Ama zydua ta nie ei ta, ama rih bie khai ta, ama nie bâhpa hrâbyh hmo hrawh hleino tlai a huah ei ta.
Zisu cha ano dei ta thlah a chhâ nota, a pachupazy ano lâ a vy ei ta, ama hnohta, “Chyhsazy ta ahy a châ eina tah ei?” tahpa ta hiahri ta.
Âmo ta, “Bâtituhpa Zawhâna a châ, cha tah ei ta; châhrasala thokha ta Elaizâh a châ, cha tah ei ta; thokha ta hrohsopa ahy tlyma a thyuheihpa a châ, ama cha tah,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Cha khiahta la, nâmo zaw, ahy a châ eina tah ei chi?” tah ta. Pity ta, “Khazohpa Mesia na châ,” tah ta.
Cha bie cha ahy hmahta chho lei awpa ta Zisu ta biepie ta,
ama hnohta, “Chyhsa Sawchapawpa he pasa hluhpi tao aw ta, machâzy, theihthai beizy nata ryhpa pachutuhpazy ta khoh leipa aw ei ta, thie aw ei ta, noh thôhna noh ta pathyupa a châ aw,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha chyhsa zydua hnohta, “Ahy rai eina zi khoh khiahta cha, anosasyh a paky sala, noh chareih a kraws a piapa ta na zi mawh sy.
Ahy rai a hrona pabohsa a chhuahpa cha, a hrona pahlei aw ta, keima vâta a hrona a pahleipa deikua cha, a hrona a pabohsa aw.
Chyhsa ta khizaw he a pôhpalôhpa ta hnei sala, anosasyh a pahleipa ta â parao tlôh khiahta cha, a châta khâpa a phahnai aw.
Ahy rai kei nata ei biezy a zakheipa cha, Chyhsa Sawchapawpa ta a rônahna chhaota nata a Paw rônahna nata a vâlyuhchâpa pathaihpazy rônahna chhaota â zu tita, ano cha a zakhei hra aw.
Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, he liata a duahpa sahlao thokhazy he, Khazohpa khinarâh ama hmô hlâlei cha thina a padi lei awpa ama y,” tah ta.
Cha biezy cha a rei tawhta noh charie a châ nahta, Zisu cha Pity nata Zawhâna nata Zâmie zy a chhi ta, thlahchhâ awpa ta tlâh lâ kiah ta.
Thlah a chhâ hai nota, a hmiaphaozie a vaw nano ta, a chysiazy vaw dieh khai hapa ta, a thlarawsie ngâ kaw ta.
Chyhsa pano ta Zisu cha bie a chho ei ta. Cha chyhsazy cha Mawsi nata Elaizâh ama châ.
Rônahna ta a tobipa ta a zâ luah ei ta, Zisu thi nawpa kyh nata cha cha Zerusale liata a pangoh awpa kyh reih ei ta.
Pity nata a viasazy cha mokupa ta tlauah ei ta, amâ vaw hra nahta, a rônahna nata a hnohta chyhsa pano a duahpazy cha hmô ei ta.

Cha chyhsazy ta Zisu ama siesai hai nota, Pity ta Zisu hnohta, “Pachutuhpa, he liata ypa he eima châta a pha na! Byureih miathôh, nâma châta miakha, Mawsi châta miakha, Elaizâh châta miakha eima tu aw,” tah ta. Khâpa ma a reih tahpa chhao a theihlô vei.
Cha biezy cha a rei hai nota, meihdo a vaw chhoh ta, âmo cha khu ha ta. Meihdo liata amâ ngiapa cha chi ngaita ei ta.
Meihdo tawhta ao vaw pua ta, “He he ei Sawchapawpa, ei tlyhpa a châ; a bie nathlie teh u!” tah ta.
Ao â chalih nahta, Zisu cha ano dei ta hmô ei ta. Ama hmôpazy cha khâchâ a chalihkhei ei ta, cha nohzy liata ahy hnohta hmah chho veih ei.
A mylâ ta tlâh tawhta amâ zu nahta, chyhsa hluhpi ta ano cha vaw dy ei ta.
Zawpi hry tawhta chyhsa pakha vaw awh ta, “Pachutuhpa, ei sawchapawpa mo awpa ta ei châ haw, sawchapaw ei hnei chhôhpa châ tlôh ta.
Ei sawchapawpa cha ahripa ta patu ta, eikhapi ta awh tyh ta, padaosa ta, a pachih buchaphy a pua khai ha tyh. Hmah paphao ta, a pua rai ta puasai khoh vei.
Ahripa cha papua awpa ta na pachupazy a haw ei na ta, châhrasala papua thei veih ei,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a chhy ta, “Hy ngiapâleipa nata chhorupa chhâ saih u, khachâ ma nâma hnohta y aw na ta, ei cha pachâ thai aw ei tly? Na sawchapawpa cha he lâ a vaw chhi teh,” tah ta.
Â vy hai nota, ahripa ta taikhy ta, thata padaosa ta. Zisu ta thlahpa puapa cha ra ta, hawtipa cha patlâh ta, a paw lâta hlâ ta.
Khazohpa hmotaotheina rônahzie cha chyhsa zydua ta noâh tah ngaita ei ta. Chyhsa zydua ta a hmotaopa zydua cha noâh ama tah kaw nota, Zisu ta a pachupazy hnohta,
“He biezy he nama nakhaoh liata a ngia mawh sy: Chyhsa Sawchapawpa he chyhsazy ku ta patusapa ta a y aw,” tah ta.
Châhrasala a bie reipa cha, ama pahno thei lei nawpa ta nyupa a châpa vâta, a yzie pahno veih ei. Âmo hra ta a bie reipa kyh cha ano hiahri ngâh tlôh leipa ei ta.
Ama hry liata ahy ma a rônah chai aw tahpa kyh liata pachupazy hry liata aeichhiana pua ta.
Zisu ta ama palôh pachâna cha pahno ta, hawti pakha a chhi ta, a kiapâh liata paduasa ta,

ama hnohta, “Ahy rai ei moh vâta he hawti a lypa cha keima nâ lypa châ ta, ahy rai kei nâ lypa cha nâ tuahtuhpa a lypa a châ. Nama zydua hry liata a chyh chaipa cha, ano tlai cha a rônah chaipa a châ,” tah ta.
Zawhâna ta a chhy ta, “Pachutuhpa, chyhsa pakha ta na moh ta ahripazy a papuapa hmô pi ta, châ zituhpazy hry liata â hlao hra leipa vâta eima pakhâ haw,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Pakhâ khuh vy, châ dyuh leipa cha nama chhâh a châpa a châ,” tah ta.
Zisu cha vârâh lâ a chhipa ta a y nawpa daihti â hnia nahta, Zerusale lâ sie awpa ta a chhuah ta.
A hmia lâta zikyu a râpazy pasiesa ta. Âmo cha sie ei ta, ano a vaw chhuahdy awpa ta Samâri khih liata a ngia ei ta.
Châhrasala a hmia cha Zerusale lâ khâchâ a pahei hapa vâta, a vaw ly leipa ei ta.
Cha cha a pachupa Zâmie nata Zawhâna ta ama pahno nahta, “Abeipa, he sahlao he kâ khai awpa ta, Elaizâh hawh khata avâ tawhta mei pathla awpa ta aw sih la, a pha na tah ma?” tah ei ta.
Zisu cha a vaw heih ta, âmo cha ra ta, ama hnohta, “Kheihawhpa thlahpa tawhtapa ma nama châ tahpa pahno veih ei chi.
Chyhsa Sawchapawpa he chyhsa hrona pahleipadia awpa ta a zupa châ leipa ta, pachha awpa ta a zupa a châ,” tah ta. Chatawhcha khi hro lâ sie ha ei ta.
Lâpi liata ama sie hai nota, chyhsa pakha ta Zisu hnohta, “Na siena maihta ei cha zi aw,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Changiezy ta khaoh hnei ei ta, vâ pavawzy ta bu ama hnei. Chyhsa Sawchapawpa deikua cha, luh nyu nawpa su chhao hnei vei,” tah ta.
Chyhsa hropa hnohta, “Na zi teh,” tah ta. Châhrasala ano ta, “Abeipa, ei paw kei pabu ha tua awpa na pasaih mah y,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Athihpazy ta ama chyhsa athipazy cha pabu mawh ei sy. Nâ deikua cha sie la, Khazohpa khinarâh bie pathâhsa mah y,” tah ta.
Chyhsa hropa chhao ta, “Abeipa, ei cha zi aw, anodeikuacha ei o liata a ypazy atlâhna bie kei rei tua awpa na pasaih mah y,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Ahy rai leipalie liata a ku soh ta hnôh lâ a heihpa cha, Khazohpa khinarâh chyhsa tlâh châ vei,” tah ta.
Cha khai tawhta Abeipa ta chyhsa hropa sysari nata pano rao ta, a sie nawpa khih to nata su to liata a hmia lâta pano lymâ ta pasiesa chhielie ta.
Ama hnohta, “Sâh hria awpa hluhpi y ta, hriatuhpazy deikua ama chyh. Chavâta a sâh hria awpa ta hriatuhpazy a vaw tuah thei nawpa ta, sâh hria Beipa lâ hiah teh u.
Sie teh u; changiezy hry liata mietakutawzy hawhta ei cha tuah ei hih.
Tâkâ sykhao, sahria nata pheiky zy a phao leipa u la, lâpi liata chyhsa bie a chho khuh vy.
O namâ ngiapa maih liata, a hmiatua chai ta, ‘He o liata thlalôhna vaw tlô mawh sy!’ nama tah lymâ aw.
Cha o liata thlalôhna chyhsa a y khiahta cha, nama thlalôhna a chô liata y aw ta, thlalôhna chyhsa a y vei khiah deikua cha, nama thlalôhna cha nâmo lâ a vaw kua heih aw.
Cha o liata y u la, ama cha piepa maih niepa ta doh muh vy. Raihriatuhpa cha hlao hmô tlâh a châ. O kha tawhta o hro lâ namâ pasie awpa châ vei.
Khih namâ ngiana maihta, ama châ ly khiahta cha, ama cha piepa maih nie muh vy.
Cha liata tlâhleipazy patlâh u la, ama hnohta, ‘Khazohpa khinarâh ta a châ hnia ei,’ tah muh vy.
Khih namâ ngiapa liata ama châ ly vei khiahta cha, ama lâlaizy liata sie u la, ama hnohta,
‘Nama khih buchadoh eima phei liata â baipazy taihta eima cha chatho thlu hih. Châhrasala Khazohpa khinarâh cha â hnia haw tahpa pahno muh vy,’ nama tah aw.
Ei cha chho ei, cha noh liata, cha khih pasa tao awpa hlâta Sawdawmâ khih pasa tao awpa a zie a y via aw.
“Kôrâzi, na hu a po na! Besaidâ, na hu a po na! Nâmo liata hmonoâhpa taopazy kha Tyre nata Sidaw liata taopa châ sala, latho poh a bupa ta buchâh hry liata a tyuh aw ei ta, ama ro ha awpa tlai.
Pachiana noh liata, nâma pasa tao awpa hlâta Tyre nata Sidaw pasa tao awpa a zie a y via aw.
Hy Kâpynia, nâ chhao avâ taihta cheihchalopa ta y hra la, Athihkhih lâ chati pathlahpa na châ aw.
“Nama bie a theipa cha, ei bie a theipa a châ. Nâmo châ khoh leipa cha, kei nâ khoh leipa châ ta, kei nâ khoh leipa cha, nâ tuahtuhpa a khoh leipa a châ,” tah ta.
Sysari nata panozy cha a ly ngaitapa ta a vaw lie ei ta, “Abeipa, na moh vâta ahripazy eima rei sai ta ama y!” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Dôhla pathliepa hawhta Sâtâ avâ tawhta a za tlapa ei hmô.
Pachâ teh u, parihzy nata râh cha-iazy tlybai theina nata khakhaipa hmotaotheina zydua chô liata biehneina ei cha pie ei. Khâpa ta hmah cha pasasa aw veih ei.
Châhrasala thlahpazy nama rei sai ta ama ypa vâta a ly leipa u la, vârâh liata nama moh ropa a châpa vâta tlao a ly teh u,” tah ta.

Cha dawh liata Zisu cha Thlahpa Pathaihpa liata a ly ngaita ta, “Hy ei Paw, alei nata avâ Beipa, ei châ ly ngaita na. He hmozy he chyhsa sopa nata novâhpazy liata nyu chi ta, hawtizy hnohta tlao na phualuah. A châ na, ei Paw, cha hawhta tao awpa cha, nâ lyna châ tlôh ta.

Ei Paw ta ato zydua eina hlâ haw. Paw dei leipa ta cha, Sawchapawpa he ahy ma a châ tahpa ahy hmahta pahno veih ei. Paw he ahy ma a châ tahpa chhao, Sawchapawpa nata Sawchapawpa ta ama hnohta phuah awpa ta â tlyhpazy dei leipa ta cha, ahy hmahta pahno veih ei,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha pachupazy lâ a heih ta, arulâta ama hnohta, “Nama hmôpazy a hmô hrapa mozy cha ama nohlao kaw dia!
Ei cha chho ei, hrohsopa hluhpi nata abei hluhpi chhao ta nama hmôpazy he hmô khoh kaw tyh ei ta, châhrasala hmô veih ei. Nama theipazy he thei khoh kaw tyh ei ta, châhrasala thei veih ei,” tah ta.
Dâhthaipa pakha a kaw duah ta, Zisu cha pasia a chhuahpa ta a hnohta, “Pachutuhpa, chhâzaw hrona ei hnei nawpa ta khâpa ei tao aw?” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Ryhpa châbu liata khâpa â roh? Kheihta ma cha cha na rei tyh?” tah ta.

Ano ta, “Abeipa na Khazohpa cha na pathipalôh tlokhuh ta, na thlahpa tlokhuh ta, na thatlôna tlokhuh ta nata na pachâna tlokhuh ta kyh nama pachâ awpa a châ. Nâma kyh nâ pachâpa hawhta na vaih kyh na pachâ awpa a châ, tahpa ta ropa a châ,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Nâ chhy pado na. Cha hawhta tao la, na hroh aw,” tah ta.
Dâhthaipa cha thaichâ a chhuahpa ta, Zisu hnohta, “Cha khiahta la ei vaih cha ahy maw?” tah ta.
Zisu ta a chhy ta, “Chyhsa pakha Zerusale tawhta Zerikô lâ zu ta, hraotuhpazy a tyh ta, cha chyhsazy chata a chysiazy pahluhpa ei ta, thata tu ei ta, thi daihmâpa ta siesai ei ta.
Theihthaipa pakha, cha lâpi lâta zu chho ta, chyhsa cha a hmô nahta, lâkiah hiakha lâta chahrih ha ta.
Cha hawhna hra chata Livai chyhsa chhao, cha su cha za tlô ta, a hmô nahta, lâkiah hiakha lâta chahrih ha hra ta.
Samâri chyhsa deikua cha, a khitlyna liata, cha chyhsa yna cha za tlô ta, a hmô nahta, a thapasa ngaita ta.
Kei pangai ta, a hmahzy cha sathaw nata kresawhti bao ta, chahrypa ta. Ano sahroh chô liata pakiasa ta, khichhai riebu lâ pangaikheipa ta mohôh ta.
A mylâ ta dinâri miano pachhi ta, khichhai riebu vaituhpa hnohta pie ta, a hnohta, ‘Vaw mohôh la, he hleikhô ta na hryuhnazy cha, ei vy heih tita ei cha thô aw,’ tah ta.
Cha chyhsa pathôh hry liata, hraotuhpazy ta ama hraopa chyhsa châta ahy cha ma a vaih châ sala na pangiasa?” tah ta.
Ano ta, “A ngiachhietuhpa chuh,” tah ta. Zisu ta a hnohta, “Nâ chhao sie la, cha hawhta tao hra mah y,” tah ta.
Ama khitlyna liata, Zisu cha khih miakha liata a ngia ta. Chanô pakha a moh Marthâ ama tahpa ta a vaw ly ta, a o liata patlôsa ta.
Marthâ cha narô pakha, a moh Mâri ama tahpa hnei ta. Mâri cha Abeipa phei thaby liata a tyuh ta, a bie nathlie ta.
Marthâ deikua cha a chakaona raihria vâta, tymâ kawpa ta y ta. Zisu lâ vawh ta, a hnohta, “Abeipa, ei narônô ta kei dei ta eina chakaosapa he pha na tah thlâh ha ma? Na bao awpa ta chho teh,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta a chhy ta, “Marthâ, Marthâ, hmo hluhpi pachâ chi ta, nâ tymâ kaw.
Hmo miakha deita a byuh. Mâri ta tovyuh phapa a tlyh ta, cha cha lapa awpa châ vei,” tah ta.

Noh kha cha su miakha liata Zisu cha thlahchhâ ta, a chhâ khai nahta, a pachupa pakha ta a hnohta, “Abeipa, Zawhâna ta a pachupazy thlachhâzie a pachupa hawhna khata, nâ chhao thlahchhâzie miah pachu hra teh,” tah ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Thlah nama chhâ tita, hetana heta nama chhâ aw: “‘Eima Paw vârâh liatapa, Na moh zachhih mawh sy. Na khinarâh vaw tlô mawh sy.
Noh chareih nie awpa miah pie mah y.
Eima chô liata hmo a paraopazy eimâ ngiahthaipa hawhta, Eima paraonazy miah a ngiahthai mah y. Reipasaona lâta miah a chhi khah y,’” tah ta.
Chatawhcha a pachupazy hnohta, “Nama hry liata viasa a hneipa pakha ta, zâcho ta a viasapa o lâ vawh ta, a hnohta, ‘Viasa, viahchhâ tlâ thôh na patha tua.
Ei viasa khitlyhpa ta na vaw tlô ta, ei pie awpa khâpa hmah hnei va na,’ kei tah sala;
a viasa chata ochhôh lâ tawhta, ‘Na patypamâ khah y. Ochhi khaw hapa châ ta, ei sawzy chhao ei hnohta rakhô liata amâ zia haw. Chavâta thyupa ta cha pie thei va na,’ a kaw tah aw ma?
Ei cha chho ei, a viasa a châpa vâta thyupa ta a pie leipa chhao ta, bâh leipa ta a hia ngâ thlâh hapa vâta, thyu aw ta â ngiahpa hawhta a pie aw.
Ei cha chho ei, hiah teh u, piepa nama châ aw. Tlua teh u, nama hmô aw. Chakhyh teh u, pahypa nama châ aw.
A hiahpa maihta piepa châ ei ta, a tluapa ta hmô ta, a chakhyhpa cha pahypa a châ.
Nama hry liata ahy paw ma, a sawchapawpa ta viahchhâ hiah sala, alô a pie aw? A sawchapawpa ta ngasa hiah sala, ngasa vyuhpa ta parih a pie aw ma?
Awhtih hiah sala, râh cha-ia a pie aw ma?

Nâmo, moleipazy chi hmahta, nama sawzy hmo phapa piena châh nama pahno khiahta cha, nama Paw vârâh liata a ypa chhochhi ta cha, khatlu ta khokhei viapa ta ma a hiahtuhpazy hnohta Thlahpa Pathaihpa a pie aw tly!” tah ta.
Zisu ta ahripa reih pathlie thei leipa papua ta. Ahripa a pua nahta, reih pathlie thei leipa cha a reih pathlie thei ha ta. Zawpi ama noâh kaw ta.
Châhrasala thokha ta, “Ahripa bei Belzebu moh ta ahripazy a papuapa a châ hih,” tah ei ta.
Ahropazy ta ano pasia nawpa ta, vârâh tawhta ngiana a hnaw ei ta.
Ama pachânazy cha Zisu ta pahno ta, ama hnohta, “Kheihawhpa khinarâh rai âmosasyh ta a dyuhpa maih leidia tyh ei ta, âmosasyh ta a dyuhpa chhôhkha chhao ama pao tyh.
Belzebu moh ta ahripazy ei papuapa hawhta reih ei chi ta, Sâtâ chhao anosasyh ta â dyuh khiahta cha, kheihta ma a khinarâh â duah thei aw?
Kei ta Belzebu moh ta ahripazy ei papua khiahta cha, nama sawchapawzy kha ahy moh ta ma ahripazy ama papua tyh? Chavâta âmo cha châ pachiatuhpazy ama châ aw.
Khazohpa kudy hmâpa ta ahripazy a papuapa ei châ khiahta deikua cha, Khazohpa khinarâh cha nama chô liata a vaw tlô hapa a châ.
Chyhsa thatlôpa ta chaihrai â kipa ta chabapa ta, a o a vaih chhôh ta cha, a hmozy â bohpa ta a y.
Châhrasala ano hlâta thatlô viapa ta a vaw dyuh ta, a pahnie tita cha, â ngâchhâpa chaihraizy cha chhu ta, a sôh la ta, a rai tyh.
Ei chhâh a châ leipa cha, nâ dyuhtuhpa châ ta, nâ pahmaohkhei leipa cha, a papaituhpa a châ.
“Thlahpa puapa cha chyhsa tawhta a pua nahta, apahâna su tluapa ta ti y leina suzy chahryh ta, châhrasala hmô leipa ta, ‘Ei vaw puana o lâ ei kua heih aw,’ tah ta.
A tlô nahta, o cha phi chiehpa nata paryh khaipa ta hmô ta.

Sie ta, ano hlâta a chhie viapa ahripa hropa pasari a vaw chhi ta, cha liata a ngia ei ta, ama pahrâ haw. Cha chyhsa châta cha, a daihti hmiatuapa lâta a duahmo hlâ khata a daihti hnôhlâ ta a duahmo cha a chhie via syulyu haw,” tah ta.
Cha biezy cha a rei hai nota, zawpi hry tawhta chanô pakha ta vaw awh ta, a hnohta, “Nâma châ phaohtuhpa chhi cha a nohlao kaw dia! A sâhpi na pazypa chhao a nohlao kaw dia,” tah ta.
Châhrasala Zisu ta, “Khazohpa bie thei ta a zyhpazy cha chyhsa nohlao hmeiseihpazy tlao ama châ,” tah ta.
Zawpizy a vypakhy via lymâ ei ta, Zisu ta, “He chhâ he chhâ moleipa a châ. Ngiana tlua ei ta, châhrasala Zawna ngiana dei leipa cha, ama hnohta ngiana rai piepa châ aw vei.
Zawna cha Ninivâ mo châta ngiana a châpa hawhna khata, Chyhsa Sawchapawpa cha he chhâ châta ngiana a châ aw.

Chho beinô chhao, pachiana noh liata, he chhâ chyhsazy nata vaw thyu khoh aw ta, he chhâ he thailei a pachâsa aw. Sawlawmaw sona nathlie awpa ta hmahta khizaw chhâna tawhta a vy ta, moh teh u, Sawlawmaw hlâta rônah viapa he liata a y.
Pachiana noh liata, Ninivâ mo kha he chhâ nata vaw thyu khoh aw ei ta, he chhâ he thailei ama pachâsa aw. Âmo cha Zawna biechhopa vâta ro ei ta, moh teh u, Zawna hlâta rônah viapa he liata a y.
“Ahy hmahta meiôh rao sala su nyupa liata soh beih leipa aw ta, beih ta khu beih hra aw vei. O chhôh lâ a ngiapazy ta khaihna ama hmô thei nawpa ta, meiôh sona liata a soh tyh.
Na mo cha na pôhpa meiôh a châ. Na mo a sia khiahta cha, na pôhpa duata a khaih tyh. Na mo a rao khiahta deikua cha, na pôhpa duata a zoh tyh.
Chavâta a chado teh, chataleipatala na chhôh liata khaihna a ypa kha zohna a châ pathlei aw.
Na pôhpa kheihawhpa lia hmahta zoh leipa sala, khaihna ta a bie khiahta cha, meiôh khaihna ta khaihna a cha piepa hawhta, na pôhpa zydua a pakhaihsa aw,” tah ta.
Bie a rei hai nota, Phârisaih pakha ta pati nie hrua ta. A o liata a ngia ta, pati cha dôh ta.
Pati nie hlâta a ku â si leipa Phârisaih chata a hmô nahta, noâh tah kaw ta.
Abeipa ta a hnohta, “Nâmo, Phârisaihzy ta cha nyu nata beikoh zy a chô lâ pasi tyh ei chi ta, nama chhôh lâ deikua cha karâyna nata moleina ta a bie.
Ahrupa saih u! A chô lâ a taotuhpa ta a chhôh lâ chhao tao vei ma?
A chhôh liata hmo a ypa cha dyhchhiepazy pie awpa ta hmâh teh u, chatanachata nama châta ato a pathaih aw.

“Nâmo, Phârisaihzy saih u, nama hu a po na! Pudinâ nata sysadi nata âhnalasi to tawhta su hrawh su kha pie tyh ei chi ta, adona nata Khazohpa kyhpachâna hmâchhâh uasa leipa ta nama y. Chazy cha nama tao awpa tlai châ ta, ahropazy chhao uasa leipa ta nama y awpa châ vei.
Nâmo, Phârisaihzy saih u, nama hu a po na! Pakhyna ozy liata dyuchhai pha chaipa nata sôhdaoh suzy liata anaohnazy a tlaichhai kawpa nama châ.
Nama hu a po na! Ngiana tao leipa thlâ châ ei chi ta, chyhsazy ta pahno leipa ta ama sie thlu tyhpa thlâ hawhta nama châ,” tah ta.
Dâhthaipa pakha ta a chhy ta, “Pachutuhpa, cha biezy na reipa chata keimo chhao miah na reipachhie pâ hra,” tah ta.
Zisu ta, “Ryhpa pachutuhpa saih u, nâmo chhao nama hu a po na! Zawpizy phaohri ngaitapa paphaosa ei chi ta, nâmo deikua ta cha, nama kuparo miakha chhao ta phaohri cha hria khoh veih ei chi.
Nama hu a po na! Châ pathlatuhpazy ta ama thiepa hrohsopazy thlâ o nama sa tyh.
Cha chata châ pathlatuhpazy hmotaopa pahnokheipa ta, ama hmotaopa namâ pyhkheizie a palâsa. Âmo ta thie ei ta, nâmo ta ama thlâ ozy nama sa.
Chavâta Khazohpa sona chhao ta, ‘Ama hnohta hrohsopazy nata lyuhchâpazy tuah aw na ta, thokha thie aw ei ta, thokha ama taola aw,’ a tahpa kha a châ.
Chavâta leilô y tua no tawhta hrohsopazy thisaih maoh cha, he chhâ heta ama phaoh aw.

Maisâh nata supathaihpa likawh ta a thipa Abela thisaih tawhta Zekaria thisaih taihta, hrohsopazy thisaih maoh zydua ama phaoh aw. Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, he chhâ heta hrohsopazy thisaih maoh cha ama phaoh tlai aw.
Nâmo, dâhthaipazy saih u, nama hu a po na! Pahnona châhbi la ei chi ta, châhrasala nâmo a ngia tlôh leipa ei chi ta, mohropa a ngia awpazy nama pakhâ khai haw,” tah ta.
Cha su tawhta a pua nahta, ryhpa pachutuhpazy nata Phârisaihzy ta Zisu cha bie hluhpi pareisa raruah a chhuah ei ta.
A rei chheipa tawhta patu a chhuahpa ta a byh thlâh ha ei ta.
Cha nona chata, amâ tlypâ ngâna taihta zawpi sâh hluhpi a vaw hmaohpakhy ei ta, Zisu cha a pachupazy hnohta bie reih tua chai ta, “Phârisaihzy thinô liata a vaih teh u, cha cha phapakheina a châ.
A lâ lei awpa ta khupa khâpa hmah y leipa ta, pahno lei awpa ta nyupa khâpa hmah y vei.
Chavâta zohna liata nama reipa zydua cha khaihpa liata theipa châ aw ta; chhôhpadâhpa chhôh chaipa liata bieparu nama reipa zydua chhao, vâphuh tawhta phuahpa a châ aw.
“Ei viasa saih u, ei cha chho ei, pôhpa thie ta, cha hnôhlâ ta khâpa hmah a tao thei khao leipazy chi khuh vy.
Nama chi awpa dopa zikyu ei châ râ aw ei: A thie khai tawh chhao ta, hriena su liata thy theina bie a hneipa cha chi teh u. Ei cha chho ei, ano tlai cha chi teh u!
Rieta pô pangawh cha phusâ dipa miano ta zuapa châ vei ma? Châhrasala ama hry liata pô kha hmah Khazohpa hmiakô liata mypa châ vei.
Nama luh liata sâ zydua chhao rei khaipa a châ. Chavâta chi khuh vy, boby hluhpi hlâta nama sôh via mâh tâh.
“Ei cha chho ei, chyhsa hmiakô liata nâ châhkheipa maih cha, Chyhsa Sawchapawpa ta Khazohpa vâlyuhchâpazy hmiakô liata â châhkhei hra aw.
Chyhsa hmiakô liata nâ paphapa deikua cha, Khazohpa vâlyuhchâpazy hmiakô liata ei papha hra aw.
Chyhsa Sawchapawpa a reipachhiepa cha a ngiahthaipa châ aw ta, Thlahpa Pathaihpa a reipachhiepa deikua cha, a ngiahthaipa châ aw vei.
Pakhyna ozy liata nata ryureituhpa nata biehneituhpazy hmiakô liata ama châ chhi tita, kheihta ma eimâ chhy aw, khâpa bie ma eima rei aw tahpa ta nama thlazoh khah sy.
Nama rei awpa cha Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta a daihtita liata a cha pachu lymâ aw ei,” tah ta.
Zawpi hry liata chyhsa pakha ta Zisu hnohta, “Pachutuhpa, ryu na pachhaih awpa ta ei unawhpa na chhopa teh,” tah ta.
Châhrasala Zisu ta a hnohta, “Chyhsa, kei he ahy ma nâmo chô liata ryureituhpa nata ryu pachhaihtuhpa ta nâ tao?” tah ta.
Ama hnohta, “A chado u la, uahvana kheihawhpa lia rai ta a vaih teh u. Sôh hluhpi hneipa he chyhsapa hrona chhâpa châ vei,” tah ta.
Ama hnohta pakhona bie reih ta, “Chyhsa hneirôhpa lyu ta kôvei thata papua ta.
Hneirôhpa cha pachâ ta, ‘Kheihta ma ei tao aw tly, ei sâh nata ei bia so nawpa hnei tlôh lei khâh na ta?’ tah ta.
‘Hetana heta ei tao aw: Ei sawvâzy phie aw na ta, a lai viapa ta sa aw na ta, cha liata ei sâh nata ei hneipa zydua soh aw na ta.
Chatawhcha ei thlahpa hnohta, “Thlahpa y, kô hluhpi chhôh châta hmo hluhpi nâ pachô haw. A pahâ la, nie la, doh la, thaphapa ta y mah y,” ei tah aw,’ tah ta.
Châhrasala Khazohpa ta a hnohta, ‘Ahrupa! Tazâ he na thlahpa lapa châ aw ta, na hmo hneipazy kha ahyzy ma a to aw ei?’ tah ta.
Ano châta sôh pachô ta, Khazohpa lâta hneirôh tlôh leipa cha, cha chyhsa hawhta a châ aw,” tah ta.

Chatawhcha Zisu ta a pachupazy hnohta, “Ei cha chho ei, khâpa ma eima nie aw, tahpa ta nama hrona châta pachâ chhie leipa u la, khâpa ma eimâ bu eimâ sai aw, tahpa ta nama pôhpa châta pachâ chhie hra khah u.
Hrona he niedo kyh dei châ leipa ta, pôhpa he a bu a sai kyh dei châ vei.

Raawhzy he pachâ tua u. Sâh tu leipa ei ta, hria hra veih ei. Pâh pho leipa ei ta, sawvâzy sa hra veih ei. Châhrasala Khazohpa ta a pasa thlâh ha ei. Nâmo cha pavawzy hlâta nama sôh via syulyu mâh tâh.
Nama hry liata ahy ma pachârôhpa vâta a doh dy kha a paseihsa via thei?
Cha hawhpa hmo chyhpata hmah a tao thei leipazy ei chi ta, khazia hmo hropazy liata nama pachâ a rôh tly?

Lilipawzy laiseihzie pachâ tua u. Raihria leipa ei ta, pala hria hra veih ei. Châhrasala ei cha chho ei, Sawlawmaw tlai chhao kha, a rônah thei chaipa hawhta â tobi no kha, lilipaw miakha tlu chhao heta tobipa ta y vei.

Hy nâmo, ngiapâ chyhpa saih u, lyurâhpa sibiepa tanoh hroh ta, mylâ lômathu liata ti thlâh ha awpa hmahta Khazohpa ta cha tlatlu ta a tobi khiahta cha, nâmo chhochhi cha cha hlâta pha via syulyupa ta cha tobi aw veih ei ma!
Chavâta nama nie awpa nata nama do awpa tlua leipa u la, nôpopa ta y khuh vy.
Khizaw phopi to ta cha hmozy cha ama tlua tyh. Chazy cha namâ ngiah tahpa nama Paw ta a pahno.
A khinarâh tlao tlua u la, cha hmozy cha baichhapa nama châ aw.
“Sahlao chyhpa saih u, chi khuh vy. Khinarâh a cha pie awpa ei cha nama Paw alynazie a châ.
Nama hneipazy zuah u la, phahlapazy pie teh u. Parutuhpa ta a paru thei leina nata chhoma-u ta a parao thei leina vârâh liata tâkâ byh a chy beih leipa nata ryu a chhâ beih leipazy a pachô teh u.
Nama ryu yna liata nama palôh chhao a y aw.
“Chai a saihpa ta y thlâh ha u la, nama meiôh khâ ia mawh sy.
Ama zibeipa cha Kialao kyhchhi tawhta a vaw di ta, ochhi a chakhyh tita thlai pahy thei awpa ta, a chakaotuhpazy ta ama hâ thlâh hapa hawhta, a mâ chiehpa ta y teh u.

Ama zibeipa â vy tita, ano hâpa ta a vaw hra thlâh hapa chakaotuhpazy cha ama nohlao na! Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, ama zibeipa cha chakaona chysia a tobipa ta, chakaotuhpazy cha tlâhkhai liata pati padôhsa aw ta, a vy aw ta, âmo cha a chakao aw ei.
Zâcho ta tlyma, awhkho ta tlyma, a vy sala, amâ hra thlâh hapa ta a hmôpa chakaotuhpazy cha ama nohlao ngaita aw dia!
He he pahno teh u: Parutuhpa avyna daihti awpa cha o hneituhpa ta pahno ha sala, a hra aw ta, a o pahraosa aw vei.
Nâmo chhao a mâ chiehpa ta y teh u, nama pangiasa leina daihti liata Chyhsa Sawchapawpa cha a vy tlôh aw ta,” tah ta.
Pity ta, “Abeipa, cha pakhona bie cha keimo deita ma miah na chho, chyhsa zydua maw?” tah ta.
Abeipa ta, “A daihtita ta chhôhkha nie awpa pachhuahpanoh lymâ awpa ta, a zibeipa ta a o liata hyutuhpa châta a raopa, sôh mokhâhtuhpa ngâchhihpa nata sopa cha ahy ma a châ?
A zibeipa a vy tita, rai hria haipa ta a hmôpa chakaotuhpa cha a nohlao kaw aw dia!
Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, cha chakaotuhpa cha a hneipa zydua chô liata hyutuhpa ta a tao aw.
Chakaotuhpa ta a palôh liata, ‘Ei zibeipa charâ ta a vy bao aw vei,’ tahpa ta, chakaotuhpa hropazy cha a chanô chapaw ta tu sala, niedopa ta a pari khiahta deikua cha,
cha chakaotuhpa zibeipa cha a mokhâh leina noh nata a pahno leipa dawh liata a vy aw ta, chakaotuhpa cha hriechheih aw ta, ngâchhih leipazy to awpa a patosa aw.
A zibeipa khopa pahno thlâh hana chôta, a mâ chiehpa ta y leipa chakaotuhpa nata zibeipa khopa hawhta a tao leipa chakaotuhpa cha, thata tupa a châ aw.
Pahno leina vâta tu tlâhpa hmo a taopa chakaotuhpa deikua cha, a chyh via ta tupa a châ aw. A hluhpi piepa cha, a hluhpi a hnawpa châ aw ta; a hluhpi pavaosapa chhao, a hluhpi hnabeiseihpa a châ aw.
“Alei chô liata mei pathla awpa ta a vypa ei châ. Tahmâ chhao he kâ ha sala ei tah kaw dia!
Châhrasala bâti châ awpa ei hnei. Cha cha ei pangoh hlâlei cha ei hu a po kaw dia!
Khizaw liata adyhna chareisa awpa ta a vypa khiah ma eina tah ei chi ma? Châ bao va, ei cha chho ei, pachhaih awpa ta a vypa tlao ei châ.
Tahmâ tawhta cha, chhôhkha liata chyhsa papangawhzy amâ pachhaih aw. Pathôh ta pano a dyuh aw ei ta, pano ta pathôh amâ dyuh aw.

Amâ chhaih aw. A paw ta a sawchapawpa a dyuh aw ta, a sawchapawpa ta a paw â dyuh aw. A nô ta a sawchanô a dyuh aw ta, a sawchanô ta a nô â dyuh aw. A nohnô ta a myuhnô a dyuh aw ta, a myuhnô ta a nohnô â dyuh aw,” tah ta.
Zisu ta zawpizy hnoh chhao ta reih ta, “Notla lâta meihdo vaw thyupa nama hmô nahta, ‘Avâ a suah aw,’ thlai tah ei chi ta, a suah tlai tyh.
Chho thlih pathlipa nama hmô tita, ‘Noh a palo aw,’ tah ei chi ta, a palo tlai tyh.
Nâmo, phapakheipazy saih u, alei nata avâ yzie pahno thai ei chi ta, khazia tahmâhlâ hmo yzie he nama pahno thai vei?
“Khazia hmo dopa cha nâmo ta nama pasia thlâh ha vei?

Lyuh châ tuatuhpa nata ryureituhpa hmiakô lâ na sie nota, lâpi liata aryhna tlua lylia mah y. Chataleipatala ryureituhpa hmiakô liata châ chhi aw ta, ryureituhpa ta chyhsa patutuhpa cha patusa aw ta, chyhsa patutuhpa ta patâhna o liata a cha khô pathlei aw na.
Ei cha chho, na chei awpa phusâ dipa taihta na pie khai hlâlei cha, cha su tawhta pua aw va chi,” tah ta.

Cha daihti liata, chyhsa thokha a vy ei ta, Zisu hnohta Kâlili mo thâtih vaw chho ei ta. Kâlili mo cha atheihna ama hlâ hai nota Pilâ ta thie ei ta, ama thisaih cha atheihna sazy nata a pahlao hapazy ama châ tah ei ta.
Zisu ta âmo cha a chhy ta, “Cha Kâlili mo cha, cha hawhta pasa ama taopa vâta, Kâlili mohropa zydua hlâta molei via pachaipa ama châpa ta ma nama pangiasa?
Châ bao va, ei cha chho ei, nâmo chhao nama ro vei khiahta cha, cha hawhta nama leidia khai aw.
Silôam o sâhpa ta a visaopa chyhsa pahrawh hleicharie chhao kha, Zerusale khih liata a ypa zydua hlâta hmo parao via pachaipa ama châpa ta nama pangiasa ma?
Châ bao va, ei cha chho ei, nâmo chhao nama ro vei khiahta cha, cha hawhta nama leidia khai aw,” tah ta.
Zisu ta he pakhona bie he reih ta: “Chyhsa pakha cha a kre sadô liata theiku kô kha loh ta. A kô liata a thei kei tlua tyh ta, châhrasala thei kha hmahta hmô leipa ta.

Kre zôh mohôhtuhpa hnohta, ‘Moh tua, kô thôh chhôh tlai, he theiku kô liana he a thei tluapa ta a vy tyh na ta, thei kha hmah hmô beih va na. Thlu ha mah y. Alei a pahrâ pahraoh thlâhthlipa dei a châ’ tah ta.
Kre sadô mohôhtuhpa ta, ‘Pâpuh, atakô chhâ he cha y chy sala, a thaby liata chao aw na ta, sahroh ie ta ei vaohei chy aw.
Chatanachata hâhkô a pathei khiahta cha, a phapa châ sala, a pathei vei khiahta deikua cha, thlu thlâh ha lah vâ chi,’ tahpa ta â chhy,” tah ta.
Zisu cha Pahânoh ta pakhyna o miakha liata pachu ta.
Cha liata chanô pakha, kô hrawh hleicharie chhôh zôh akona thlahpa ta a patupa y ta. A zôh a kopa ta a bôh thlâh ha tyh ta, a patlâpa ta a duah thei leipa a châ.
Zisu ta ano cha a hmô nahta, aw ta, a hnohta, “Chanô, na pasana ta a cha pathlie haw,” tah ta.
A chô liata a ku pahnieh ta, chanô cha â patlâpa ta thlai a vaw duah ta, Khazohpa cha reithai ha ta.

Zisu ta Pahânoh ta chyhsa a patlâhpa vâta, pakhyna o hyutuhpa cha a hiehâh kaw ta, zawpi hnohta, “Chyhsapa raihria nawpa ta noh charu y ta, cha chhôh chata a vy u la, patlâhpa ta y teh u. Pahânoh ta la tao awpa châ vei,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta ano cha a chhy ta, “Nâmo, phapakheipazy saih u, Pahânoh ta nama viahchao tlyma, alâ tlyma, a o tawhta pathlâpa ta, ti padosa awpa ta a chhi tyh veih ei chi ma?
He chanô, Abarahâ sawchanô, Sâtâ ta kô hrawh hleicharie a chahry hapa he, Pahânoh chhao rai châ sala, pathlâ awpa cha tao hialia awpa châ vei ma?” tah ta.
Cha biezy cha a rei nahta, a khakhaipa zydua cha nozapa ta y ei ta. Zawpi deikua cha hmo rônahpa a taopa zydua vâta a ly ngaita ei ta.
Chatawhcha Zisu ta, “Khazohpa khinarâh cha khâpa ma a lyu? Khâpa nata ma ei pakho aw?
Khazohpa khinarâh cha, chyhsa ta âhrâ chi hmô kha la ta, a sadô liata a pariepa hawhta a châ. Chi cha kaw pyuh ta, thokô vaw châ ta, vâ pavawzy ta a chiahzy liata bu ama tu tyh,” tah ta.
Zisu ta reih heih ta, “Khazohpa khinarâh cha khâpa nata ma ei pakho aw?
Khazohpa khinarâh cha, chanô ta thinô la ta, viahdie saikhua miathôh liata pabu ta, a zydua ta a thyu khaina taihta a pabupa hawhta a châ,” tah ta.
Zisu cha Zerusale pangaipa ta sie ta, lâpi liata khihpi nata khitawzy chahryhpa ta pachu lymâ ta.
Chyhsa pakha ta a hnohta, “Abeipa, pachhapazy cha ama chyhta aw ma?” tah ta. Zisu ta a hnohta,
“Chhikao buahpa liata a ngia a chhuah lylia teh u. Ei cha chho ei, chyhsa hluhpi ta a ngia a chhuah aw ei ta, a ngia thei aw veih ei.

O hneituhpa thyu ta ochhi a khaw ha khiahta cha, nâmo ta khôtho liata a duahpa ta, ‘Abeipa, ochhi miah pahypa teh,’ tahpa ta ochhi chakhyh hra u la, ‘Khataih tawhta a vypa ma nama châ, cha pahno veih ei na,’ tahpa ta a châ chhy aw ei.
Nâmo ta, ‘Na hmiakô liata niepa ta doh tyh pi ta, eima tlyliahzy liata miah na pachu tyhpa kha,’ nama tah aw.
Châhrasala ano ta, ‘Ei cha chho ei, khataih tawhta a vypa ma nama châ, cha pahno veih ei na. Nâmo, hmo moleipa a taopa zydua saih u, kei tawhta sie syulyu ha teh u!’ a tah aw.
Khazohpa khinarâh liata Abarahâ, Aisika, Zakaw nata hrohsopa zydua nama hmô tita, nâmo cha khôtho lâ thypa châ aw ei chi ta, cha liata chana nata hâh chariehna a y aw.
Nochhi nata notla, maw nata chho tawhta chyhsa a vy aw ei ta, Khazohpa khinarâh kyhchhi tlâhkhai ama vaw dôh aw.
Pachâ teh u, hnôh chaipazy cha hmia chaipa châ aw ei ta, hmia chaipazy chhao hnôh chaipa ta a y awpazy ama y,” tah ta.
Cha dawh lia tlai chata Phârisaih thokha a vy ei ta, a hnohta, “Pua la, he tawhtapa he sie syulyu ha teh, Herawda ta thie a châ chhuah,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Cha changie hnohna chata hetana heta kei chho teh u, ‘Tanoh nata mylâ ahripazy papuapa ta patlâhna raizy hria aw na ta, a noh thôhna noh ta ei rai ei patlô aw.
Chatahrasala, tanoh chhao, mylâ chhao, hânoh chhao ei sie lymâ aw, hrohsopa cha Zerusale khihpi lia dei leipa ta cha, khôtho lâ thie theipa châ vei.’

Hy Zerusale, Hy Zerusale, hrohsopazy thie chi ta, nâ lâta tuapazy alô ta a vawhsaotuhpa khihpi! Awhpanô ta a tachhihzy a mathlaw ry liata a pahmaohpa hawhta, na sawzy pahmaoh a chhuah tyh na ta, châhrasala khoh va chi!
Moh tua u, nama o cha aruapa ta siesaipa a châ ha hih. Ei cha chho ei, ‘Abeipa moh ta a vypa cha reithaipa ta y mawh sy!’ nama tah hlâlei cha na hmô khao aw veih ei chi,” tah ta.
Pahânoh ta Phârisaihzy hyutuhpa pakha o liata pati nie awpa ta vawh ta, zawpizy ta Zisu cha moh pathli ei ta.
A hmiakô liata athlohpa pakha y ta.
Zisu ta dâhthaipazy nata Phârisaihzy cha a chhy ta, ama hnohta, “Pahânoh ta patlâhpa he ryhpa ta a pasaih ma, pasaih vei maw?” tah ta.
Châhrasala âmo cha a thlih thlâh ha ei ta. Zisu ta a thlohpa cha patu ta, a patlâh khai tawhta, pasiesa ha ta.
Ama hnohta, “Nama hry liata chyhsa pakha ta sawchapaw tlyma, viahchao tlyma hnei sala, Pahânoh ta tikhaoh liata tla sala, thlai ta a thaoh lei awpa ahy a y aw ei chi?” tah ta.
Cha biezy chhao cha a chhy thei veih ei.
Patinie hruapazy ta chyhsa peimawhpazy atyuna amâ chhupa a hmô nahta, ama hnohta pakhona bie reih heih ta.
“Kialao nie awpa ta chyhsa ta a cha hrua tita, chyhsa peimawhpazy atyuna liata a tyuh khah y. Nâma hlâta chyhsa peimawh viapa a hruapa y thei aw ta,
nama pano ta châ hruatuhpa cha a vy aw ta na hnohta, ‘Nâ tyuna kha he chyhsa he tlei teh,’ cha tah aw ta, nâ cha noza ngaitapa ta atyuna a hnai chaipa liata a tyuh awpa na châ pathlei aw.

Hruapa na châ tita, vawh la atyuna a hnai chaipa liata a tyuh mah y. Chatanachata châ hruatuhpa â vy tita, na hnohta, ‘Viasa, â sâh viapa lâ a pasie teh,’ cha tah aw ta, pati tlâhkhai na dôhlâhpa zydua mohmô ta palyupalihpa ta na y aw.
A pasâhsapa maih panawhpa châ aw ei ta, a panawhpa maih palyupalihpa ama châ aw,” tah ta.

Chatawhcha Zisu ta patinie a hruatuhpa hnohta, “Zâpati tlyma, kyhchhi rônahpa tlyma na tao tita, na viasazy, na unawhzy, na chieheihzy, na vaih hneirôhpazy hrua khah y. Chataleipatala cha hrua hri aw ei ta, thôpa ta na y pathlei aw.
Kyh na chhi tita, dyhchhiepazy, pihpasipazy, pheisypazy, mochaopazy tlao hrua mah y.
Âmo cha châ thô thei awpa ama châ leipa vâta, byhnâ to aw chi ta, chyhsa dopazy thyuheihna liata thôpa na châ aw,” tah ta.
Tlâhkhai liata pati a dôhlâhpa pakha ta cha biezy cha a thei nahta, a hnohta, “Khazohpa khinarâh liata pati a nie awpa cha a nohlao kaw dia!” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Ei kha cha chyhsa pakha ta kyhchhi rônahpa tao ta, chyhsa hluhpi hrua ta.
Nie daihti a châ nahta, a hruapazy hnohta, ‘A vy teh u, tahmâ ato â mâ haw,’ tah awpa ta a chakaotuhpa tuah ta.
Châhrasala ama zydua ta reihkha tlapa ta reina hnei khai ha ei ta. A hmiatua chaipa ta a hnohta, ‘Lyu chalei na ta, mo awpa ta ei sie awpa a byuh. Ngiachhiepa ta na pachâ thai mah y,’ tah ta.
Ahropa ta, ‘Viahchao tôhpa bao pangawh chalei na ta, mopasia awpa ta sie a chhuah na ta, ngiachhiepa ta na pachâ thai mah y,’ tah ta.
Ahropa chhao ta, ‘Lapinô pakia na ta, chavâta a vy thei aw va na,’ tah ta.

Chakaotuhpa cha a vy ta, cha biezy cha a zibeipa chho ta. O hneituhpa cha a pathi ia kaw ta, a chakaotuhpa hnohta, ‘A chatliepa ta pua la, khihpi lâlai nata lâpizy lâ vawh la, dyhchhiepazy, pihpasipazy, mochaopazy, pheisypazy a vaw chhi teh,’ tah ta.
Chakaotuhpa ta, ‘Ei zibeipa, na biepiepa hawhta tao hapa châ ta, châhrasala su a rua thlâh ha chy,’ tah ta.
Zibeipa ta chakaotuhpa hnohta, ‘Pua la, lâlai nata khih chaki lâ zy vawh la, ei o biena taihta chyhsazy a vaw ngia awpa ta kei reipasao lylia teh.
Ei cha chho ei, chyhsa ei hruapazy kha, pakha hmahta ei kyhchhi pati nie aw veih ei,’” tah ta.
Ei kha cha Zisu hnohta zawpi hluhpi sie ei ta, âmo lâ a heih ta, ama hnohta,
“Ahy rai ei hnohta a vy khohpa cha, a paw, a nô, a lapinô, a sawzy, a unawhzy, a sietanôzy nata ano hrona tlai chhao â hao vei khiahta cha, ei pachupa châ thei aw vei.
Ahy rai a kraws a piapa ta nâ zi leipa cha, ei pachupa châ thei aw vei.
Nama hry liata ahy ma o sâhpa sa a chhuah sala, a tyuh ta, o sana mâ a laichadaipa ta, o paloh nawpa sôh a hnei nata hnei lei a pasia ha tua lei awpa a y ei chi?
Chataleipatala, â bôna tao khai ha tlôhpa ta, a paloh thei leipa khiahta cha, a hmôpa maihta pasipasawh aw ei ta,
‘He chyhsa heta o sa ta, châhrasala paloh thei vei,’ ama tah pathlei aw.

Cha leipa chhao ta, ahy bei ma, bei hropa a dyuh awpa ta sie a chhuah sala, a tyuh aw ta, pheisaih thy no ta a vaw siehnaopa cha, pheisaih thy kha ta â tyh ngâh aw ma tahpa pachâ ha tua leipa ta a sie aw?
Â dyuh thei lei awpa khiahta cha, bei hropa cha lâhlapi liata a y nota, adyhna bietai hia awpa ta lyuhchâpa a tuah ha aw.
Cha hawhna hra chata nama hry liata chhao, a hneipa zydua a siesai leipa cha ei pachupa châ thei aw vei.
“Alôh cha a pha na, châhrasala alôh cha a padâh ha khiahta cha, kheihta a iah heih thei aw?
Alei châta phahnai leipa aw ta, lei phapa tao nawpa ta sahroh ie liata pahlao tlâh chhao châ aw vei. Thy awpa deita a châ aw. Thei nawpa nakhaoh a hneipa ta thei mawh sy,” tah ta.
Chhiekheituhpazy nata moleipazy ta a bie thei awpa ta a kiapâh lâ vaw pangai ei ta.
Phârisaihzy nata ryhpa pachutuhpazy ta, “He chyhsa heta moleipazy a pahlao ta, ama hnohta pati a nie tyh,” tahpa ta paphôh ei ta.
Chavâta he pakhona bie he ama hnohta reih ta:
“Nama hry liata ahy ma mietaku za kha hnei ta, pô kha pahlei ha sala, lyurâhpa liata sychaki nata pô chaki cha siesaipa ta, aleipa cha a hmô hlâlei tlua leipa ta y aw ei chi?
A hmô heih nahta, a ly ngaitapa ta a ngiatlâh liata a khaih aw.
O a tlô nahta, a viasazy nata a opazy awpakhy aw ta, ama hnohta, ‘Nâ lykhei teh u, ei mietaku a leipa kha ei hmô haw,’ a tah aw.
Ei cha chho ei, cha hawhna hra chata vârâh liata cha, ro awpa a hnei leipa chyhsa siapa sychaki nata pachaki chô liata alyna hlâta, molei ropa pakha chô liata alyna a hluh via aw.
“Cha leipa chhao ta, ahy chanô ma tâkâ tlaw hrawh hnei ta, tlaw kha pahlei ha sala, meiôh raopa ta o phi aw ta, a hmô hlâlei pakhâta ta tlua leipa ta a y aw?
A hmô nahta, a viasazy nata a opazy awpakhy aw ta, ‘Nâ lykhei teh u, tâkâ ei pahleipa kha ei hmô haw,’ a tah aw.
Ei cha chho ei, cha hawhna hra chata, Khazohpa vâlyuhchâpazy hmiakô liata cha, molei ropa pakha chô liata alyna a y tyh?” tah ta.
Zisu ta reih lymâ ta, “Chyhsa pakha cha sawchapaw pano hnei ta.
A seihnai viapa ta a paw hnohta, ‘Ei pâ, ryu ei to awpa na pie bâ teh,’ tah ta. Chatanachata ama paw ta a sôh cha a sawchapaw panozy pachhaih ta.
Bohpi leipa liata, a sawchapaw seihnaipa cha a tovyuh zydua pakhy ta, râh hlapi lâ sie ta. Cha liata phasa ngaitapa ta y ta, a sôh cha pahryuh thlâhthli ta.
A hneipa zydua a hmâ khai nahta, cha râh liata chakâh mozoh vaw tlô ta, nie awpa a phahla ha ta.
Chatanachata sie ta, cha râh chyhsa pakha hnohta hria hlao ta. Cha chyhsa chata vaolao pie awpa ta a lyu lâ tuah ta.
Nie awpa a piepa ama y leipa vâta a nodi ngaita ta, vaolao nie khohna taihta parôpachaw ta.
Â vaw pahno pasia nahta, ‘Ei paw o liata hria hlaopa hluhpi y ei ta, nie tiah lei ama hnei thlâh bao na ta, kei deikua cha nodipa ta he liata ei thi aw hih!
Thyu aw na ta, ei paw o lâ sie aw na ta, a hnohta, “Ei pâ y, Khazohpa chô liata nata nâma hmiakô liata hmo ei parao haw.
Na sawchapawpa ta bi tlâh chhao châ khao va na. Na hnohta hria hlaopa pakha hawhta rie na tao hra mah y,” ei tah aw,’ tah ta.
Chatanachata thyu ta, a paw lâ sie ta. Lâhlapi ta a y nota a paw ta vaw hmô ta, ngiachhie ngaita ta, a kei râ ta, a sawchapawpa cha a pyhpahly ta, a pahnâ ta.

A sawchapawpa ta a paw hnohta, ‘Ei pâ y, Khazohpa chô liata nata na hmiakô liata hmo ei parao haw. Na sawchapawpa ta bi tlâh chhao châ khao va na. Na hnohta hria hlaopa pakha hawhta rie na tao hra mah y,’ tah ta.
Châhrasala a paw ta a chakaotuhpazy hnohta, ‘Poh pha chaipa kha vaw cheih para u la, vaw pabu teh u. A ku liata kusadi paky u la, a phei liata pheiky paky teh u.
Viahchao taw thawhpa kha kei la u la, thie teh u. Thapha ngaitapa ta nie suh u.
He ei sawchapawpa he thi ha ta, a vaw hroh ha heih hih. Lei ha ta, eima hmô ha heih hih,’ tah ta. Chatanachata a lypa ta kyhchhi cha tao ei ta.
“A sawchapaw uhtheipa cha lyu tawhta o lâ vaw sie ta. O a vaw tlô chy ta pyungiapa tôpa pyu nata lâpa pyu thei ta.
Chakaotuhpa pakha aw ta, ‘Cha cha khâpa pyu maw?’ tah ta.
Chakaotuhpa ta, ‘Na nawhta vaw tlô ta, a tlâhpa nata â bohpa ta a hmô heihpa vâta, na paw ta viahchao taw thawhpa a thie,’ tah ta.
Sawchapaw uhtheipa cha a hiehâh ngaita ta, a ngia khoh leipa ta. A paw vaw pua ta, reipasao ta,

châhrasala a paw cha a chhy ta, ‘Pachâ tua, chatikôsy cha chakao na ta, na rei a ngiah leipa ta y beih va na. Chatanachôta ei viasazy nata alyna ei tao nawpa ta mietaw pô kha dâhdei chhao na pie beih va chi.
Châhrasala he na sawchapawpa, âzuahnôzy liata na sôh a hmâh khai hapa hmâchhâh he a vaw tlôpa nahta, viahchao taw thawhpa zua na thiepa bao!’ tah ta.
A paw ta a hnohta, ‘Ei sawchapawpa y, nâ cha ei hnohta a y kôzawpa châ chi ta, ei hneipa zydua he nâma eih mah a châ tâh.
Kyhchhi tao ta thapha ngaitapa ta y awpa cha â phuhpa rai a châ. He na nawhta he cha thi ha ta, a vaw hroh ha heih hih. Lei ha ta, eima hmô ha heih hih,’ a tah aw,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a pachupazy hnohta, he bie chhao he reih ta, “Chyhsa hneirôhpa pakha ta sôh mohôhtuhpa hnei ta, cha chyhsa chata a sôh a pahryuh thlâhthlipa kyh chyhsazy ta ano lâ vaw leih ei ta.
Sôh mohôhtuhpa cha aw ta, a hnohta, ‘Na thâtih ei theipa he khâpa ma a yzie? Sôh na mohôhna rona châbu vaw pangia teh. Sôh mohôhtuhpa châ thei khao aw va chi,’ tah ta.
Sôh mohôhtuhpa cha a palôh liata, ‘Ei zibeipa ta sôh mohôhna rai ei hriapa na pabâ â chhuah haw. Kheihta ma ei tao aw? Lei palie thei tlôh na va, kudao awpa hra ei noza tlôh.
Sôh mohôhna tawhta pabâhpa ei châ tita, chyhsazy ta ama o liata eina paysa thei nawpa ei ta a taozie awpa ei pahno haw,’ tah ta.
Chatanachata a zibeipa sôh a bâhpazy pakha pakha ta aw ta, a hmiatuapa hnohta, ‘Ei zibeipa liata khazie nâ bâh?’ tah ta.
Ano ta, ‘Sathaw ôh za kha,’ tah ta. Sôh mohôhtuhpa ta a hnohta, ‘Na châbu la la, a tyuh para la, sypangawh roh teh,’ tah ta.
Ahropa hnohta, ‘Nâma zaw khazie nâ bâh?’ tah ta. Ano ta, ‘Sâh saikhua za kha,’ tah ta. Ano ta a hnohta, ‘Na châbu la la, sycharie roh teh,’ tah ta.
A zibeipa ta sôh mohôhtuhpa adoleipa cha ryhraona a pahno thaipa liata tlao reithai ha ta. Khizaw sawzy he âmo chhâ hmo kyh liata la, khaihpa sawzy hlâta ama vaw so via.
Ei cha chho ei, khizaw sôh ta viasa a tao teh u. Chatanachata sôh a chhâ tita chhâzaw pahrâna suzy liata ama cha paysa aw.
“A chyhta chô liata ngâchhihpa cha, a hluhpi chô liata chhao ngâ â chhih tyh. A chyhta chô liata ngâchhih leipa cha, a hluhpi chô liata ngâchhih hra aw vei.
Khizaw sôh chô liata hmah ngâ namâ chhih vei khiahta cha, ahy ma sôh hmeiseihpa châ pavaosa ngâh aw ei?
Chyhsa hropa eih chô liata hmah ngâ namâ chhih vei khiahta cha, ahy ma nâmo eih awpa châ pie aw ei?
Chakaotuhpa ahy hmah hyutuhpa pano chakao pabaoh thei vei. Pakha a haopa ta pakha khoh aw ta, pakha a châhkheipa ta pakha a mohnao aw. Khazohpa nata sôh chakao pabaoh thei veih ei chi,” tah ta.
Cha biezy cha tâkâ a tlaichhai kawpa Phârisaihzy ta ama thei nahta, pahneisao ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Chyhsa mohmô liata a do kawpa hawhta a lâpa deita nama châ. Khazohpa deikua cha nama palôh a pahno. Chyhsa hry liata palyupalihna cha Khazohpa mohmô ta pasichhihpa a châ.
“Ryhpa nata hrohsopazy bie cha Zawhâna daihti taihta y ta. Cha rakha tawhta cha Khazohpa khinarâh thâtihpha chhopa châ ta, chyhsa to ta a ngia a chhuahpa ta ama chatôh lymâ.
Châhrasala ryhpa bie miakhata chhao a lei awpa hlâta, alei nata avâ leidia awpa a nao via.
“Ahy rai a lapinô ma ta, lapinô hropa a hneipa cha â pheipa a châ. A vahpa nata a chhaihpa chanô a hneipa chhao â pheipa a châ hra.
“Chyhsa hneirôhpa pakha y ta. Chysia saihlawpa nata rih dipa ta a tobipa ta, noh chareih phasa ngaitapa ta y tyh ta.
A kaohrai thaby liata sipasapa pakha, a moh Lâzarâh ama tahpa, a pôhpa duata hmah ta a biepa a zia tyh ta.
Chyhsa hneirôhpa tlâhkhai tawhta a tlaopazy nie awpa a khohpa vâta, cha liata â zia tyhpa a châ. Izy a vy ei ta, a hmahzy ama paliepa tyh.
Sipasapa cha thi ta, vâlyuhchâpazy ta a chhi ei ta, Abarahâ kalachhôh tlôkhei ei ta. Chyhsa hneirôhpa chhao cha thi ta, pabupa châ ta.
Athihkhih liata thata pasa tao ta, avâ kaw ua ta, lâhlapi liata Abarahâ kei hmô ta, Lâzarâh cha a kalachhôh liata vaw y thlâh ha ta.
Hneirôhpa cha awh ta, ‘Ei paw Abarahâ y, na ngiachhie la, Lâzarâh kha a kudy pawhmao ti liata ny sala, ei paleih chakuasa awpa ta na vaw tuapa mah y. Meipaleih liana heta ei pasa ngaita,’ tah ta.

Châhrasala Abarahâ ta, ‘Ei saw y, nâ cha na hro chhôh ta hmo phapa to chi ta, Lâzarâh deikua cha hmo chhiepa a topa kha pahno châh chi. Châhrasala tahmâ ano cha he liata thlahpalôhpa ta y ta, nâ cha pasa na tao kha zaw.

Cha leipa chhao ta, he su tawhta nâmo lâ sie a chhuahpazy ta ama sie thei lei nawpa nata kha su tawhta keimo lâ ahy hmah amâ vy thei lei nawpa ta, keimo nata nâmo likawh liata leichiepa kawh ngaitapa taopa a châ haw,’ tah ta.
