Hneirôhpa ta, ‘Cha khiahta la, ei paw y, Lâzarâh kha ei paw o lâ chhâ na tuah awpa ta ei châ haw.
Unawh papangawh hnei na ta, he su lâ amâ vy pathlei hra lei nawpa ta, zikyu a kei râ awpa ta tuah mah y,’ tah ta.
Abarahâ ta, ‘Mawsi nata hrohsopazy ama hnei mâh tâh. Âmo bie nathlie mawh ei sy,’ tah ta.
Hneirôhpa ta, ‘Châ vei, ei paw Abarahâ y, athihpa hry tawhtapa tlai ta âmo lâ a vaw khiahta cha, ama ro aw,’ tah ta.
Abarahâ ta a hnohta, ‘Mawsi nata hrohsopazy bie ama nathlie vei khiahta cha, athihpa hry tawhta a thyupa y hra sala, a bie zo hlei aw veih ei,’” tah ta.
Zisu ta a pachupazy hnohta, “Molei reipasaona cha a y awpa a châ. Châhrasala reipasaotuhpa cha a hu a po na!
He hawti chyhpatazy hry liata pakha chhao pamoleisa awpa hlâta cha, a pamoleisatuhpa cha a rao liata charona lô paaopa ta, tilaipi liata pathla syulyupa châ sala, a châta a pha via aw.
Â vaih teh u! Na unawhpa ta hmo a parao khiahta cha, chhorei la, a ro khiahta cha, a ngiahthai mah y.
Na chô liata noh kha ta ei sari hmo a paraopa chhao ta, ‘Ei ro ha na,’ tahpa ta, nâ lâ ei sari â vaw lie khiahta cha, nâ ngiahthai awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Lyuhchâpazy ta Abeipa hnohta, “Eimâ ngiapâna papôhsa mah y,” tah ei ta.
Abeipa ta, “Âhrâ chi hmô kha tie chhâ ta ngiapâna a hneipa châ u la, he malburi kô hnohna heta, ‘A phia la, tilaipi liata a bô teh,’ tah aw ei chi ta, nama rei â ngiah aw.
“Nama hry liata chakaotuhpa, lei palietuhpa tlyma, mietaku vaituhpa tlyma, a hneipa y u la, chakaotuhpa cha lyu lâ tawhta a vaw tlô nahta, ‘Tlâhkhai liata pati thlai vaw dôh teh,’ ahy a tah aw?
‘A patly la, zâpati na taopa teh. Niepa ta ei doh khai hlâlei na chakao la, cha khai tawhta nâ cha niepa ta doh lah vâ chi,’ tlao tah aw vei ma?
Chakaotuhpa cha biepiepa a taopa vâta a zibeipa ta alyna bie a hlâ beih ma?
Cha hawhna hra chata nâmo chhao, nama hnohta biepiepa zydua nama tao khai tita, ‘Chakaotuhpa phahnai leipa eima châ, eima tao awpa na tlâ eima tao,’ tah muh vy,” tah ta.
Zerusale lâ a sie nota, Samâri nata Kâlili râhri liata sie ta.
Khih miakha â ngia chy ta, phawhpa pahrawh ta vaw pangai ei ta. Cha chyhsazy cha lâhlapi ta a duah ei ta,
ao paro ngaitapa ta “Zisu, Hyutuhpa, miah ngiachhie mah y,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta âmo cha a hmô nahta, ama hnohta, “Vawh u la, theihthaipazy a kei pamosa teh u,” tah ta. Ama sie hai nota vaw pathaih ha ei ta.
Ama hry liata pakha cha, a tlâh hapa â hmô nahta, ao paro ngaitapa ta Khazohpa reithaina chôta kua ta.
Zisu phei thaby liata pao ta, a hnohta alyna bie reih ta. Cha chyhsa cha Samâri chyhsa a châ.
Zisu ta a chhy ta, “Chyhsa pahrawh pathaisapa châ veih ei mâ? Pachakipazy kha khataih liata ama y haw?
He chihropa dei leipa heta, Khazohpa reithai awpa ta a vaw kuapa pakha chhao y veih ei ma?” tah ta.
Alyna bie a vaw hlâtuhpa hnohta, “Thyu la, sie mah y, nâ ngiapâna ta a cha patlâh haw,” tah ta.
Phârisaihzy ta Khazohpa khinarâh vaw tlô nawpa daihti hiahri ei ta, Zisu ta âmo cha a chhy ta, “Khazohpa khinarâh cha mo ta hmô theipa ta vaw tlô aw vei.
‘Moh teh u, he liata a y!’ ‘Hao liata a y!’ tah hra aw veih ei. Khazohpa khinarâh cha nama chhôh liata a y,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha pachupazy hnohta, “Chyhsa Sawchapawpa hro nohzy he, noh kha chhâ hmô heih awpa nama khona nohzy a vaw tlô aw. Châhrasala hmô khao aw veih ei chi.
Nama hnohta, ‘Moh teh u, hao lâ huh!’ ‘Moh teh u, he lâ hih!’ ama cha tah aw. Pua leipa u la, âmo cha zi hra khuh vy.
Avâ hiakha lâta dôhla pathlie ta, avâ hiakha lâ taihta a khaih tyhpa hawhta, Chyhsa Sawchapawpa he ano noh liata cha a châ aw.
Châhrasala pasa hluhpi tao tua aw ta, he chhâ chyhsazy ta dythapa ta a y tua aw.
Chyhsa Sawchapawpa â vy heihna nohzy cha, Nôah hro nota yzie hawhna khata a châ aw.
Nôah balyh liata â ngiana noh taihta niedopa ta y ei ta, nôpi nôvahzy amâ pakia. Tipaua vaw tlô ta, ama zydua ta a pahleipadia khai ha ei.
Lawta hro nohzy liana chhao khata, cha hawhta a y hra. Niepa ta doh ei ta, hmo chalei ei ta, zuah ei ta, chi cheih ei ta, ozy ama sa.
Châhrasala Sawdawmâ khih tawhta Lawta a pua noh liata, vârâh tawhta mei nata kaih za suah ta, ama zydua ta a pahleipadia khai ha ei.
Chyhsa Sawchapawpa chaluahpa ta a yna noh liata chhao, cha hawhta a châ hra aw.
Cha noh liata, vâphuh liata a ypa ta a o chhôh liata a hmozy la awpa ta chô khah sy. Lyu liata a ypa chhao ta, o lâ sie khah sy.
Lawta lapinô kha a thei thlâh ha teh u.
Ahy rai a hrona pabohsa a chhuahpa cha, a hrona pahlei aw ta, a hrona a pahleipa deikua cha, a hrona a pabohsa aw.
Ei cha chho ei, cha zâ liana cha, rakhô miakha liata chyhsa pano a zia aw ei ta, pakha lapa châ aw ta, pakha siesaipa a châ aw.
Chanô pano sâh daih khoh aw ei ta, pakha lapa châ aw ta, pakha siesaipa a châ aw.
Chyhsa pano lyu liata y aw ei ta, pakha lapa châ aw ta, pakha siesaipa a châ aw,” tah ta.
Pachupazy ta a hnohta, “Abeipa, khataih liata maw?” tah ei ta. Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Sawhsawpa yna liata vâkhiehzy amâ hmaoh tyh,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a pachupazy cha hnabeidy leipa ta, khâ thlahchhâ awpa a châzie pakhona bie chho ta.
“Khih kha liata ryureituhpa pakha y ta, cha chyhsa cha Khazohpa chi leipa ta, chyhsa chhao a papeisa leipa a châ.
Cha khih liata nôhmei pakha y ta, ano chata, ‘Ei khakhaipa ta ei chô liata a hmotaopa adoleipa he phuh na lapa mah y,’ tahpa ta, ryureituhpa lâ cha vawh ngâ thlâh ha ta.
Ryureituhpa ta khachâ tlyma cha taopa khoh leipa ta. Châhrasala hnôhlâ ta pachâ heih ta, ‘Khazohpa chi leipa na ta, chyhsa chhao a papeisa vei hraw sah la,

he nôhmei he na patypamâ ngâ thlâh ha tlôh ta, chavâta phuh ei lapa thlâh ha tua aw, chataleipatala khâ a vy ngâ thlâh ha aw ta, ei rie eina pathei tu pathlei aw na,’ tah ta, a hiapa hawhna chata a taopa haw,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta, “Ryureituhpa sia leipa bie reipa kha thei teh u.
Khazohpa chhochhi ta cha, â tlyhpa, chhô nah zâ ta ano a awsaopazy châta hmo dopa taopa leipa ta a y aw ma? A pahawh pasâh aw ma?
Ei cha chho ei, ama châta hmo dopa thlai a taopa aw ei. Anodeikua cha Chyhsa Sawchapawpa â vy tita, khizaw liana he ngiapâna a vaw hmô aw tly ma?” tah ta.
Sia â tah kawpa ta, mohropazy a mohnaopa chyhsazy hnohta, he pakhona bie he Zisu ta reih ta:
“Chyhsa pano Achhyna o liata thlahchhâ awpa ta khy ei ta, pakha cha Phârisaih châ ta, pakha cha chhiekheituhpa a châ.

Phârisaih cha a duah ta, he hawhta thlah a chhâ: ‘Khazohpa y, mohropazy hawhta avyuhpa, chyhsa doleipa nata apheipa châ leipa na ta, he chhiekheituhpa hawhna chhao heta ei châ leipa vâta alyna bie ei cha hlâ.
Hâta chareih ta ei no kâhvileipa ta y tyh na ta, ei hmôpa zydua tawhta su hrawh su kha ei pie lymâ,’ tah ta.
Chhiekheituhpa deikua cha, lâhlapi ta a duah ta, avâ lâ chhao ua ngâh leipa ta, a chachôhna a chô ta, ‘Khazohpa y, kei moleipa he na ngiachhie mah y,’ tah ta.
Ei cha chho ei, thaichâpa ta a o lâ a dipa cha, Phârisaih châ leipa ta, chhiekheituhpa tlao a châ. Ahy rai a pasâhsapa maih panawhpa châ aw ei ta, a panawhpa maih palyupalihpa ama châ aw,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha a hria awpa ta hawsaihzy taih ano lâ a vaw chhi ei ta. Cha cha pachupazy ta ama hmô nahta, hawsaih a vaw chhipazy cha ra ei ta.
Châhrasala Zisu ta âmo cha ano lâ aw ta, “Hawtizy kei lâ pavysa u la, dytha khah u, Khazohpa khinarâh cha he hawhpa chyhsazy eih châ tlôh ta.
Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, Khazohpa khinarâh cha, hawti a lypa hawhta a ly leipa maihta a ngia cheita aw veih ei,” tah ta.
Ryureituhpa pakha ta a hnohta, “Pachutuh phapa, chhâzaw hrona ei hnei thei nawpa ta khâpa ei tao aw?” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Khazia phapa eina tah chi? Khazohpa dei leipa ta ahy hmahta phapa y veih ei.
Biepiepazy na pahno: ‘A phei kha, Liany cheih kha, Paru kha, Haipa ta chyhsa leih kha, Na nô nata na paw palyupalih teh,’ tahpazy na pahno,” tah ta.
Ano ta, “Cha zydua cha ei thyutlia daihti tawhta ei zyh lymâ tyh,” tah ta.

Cha cha Zisu ta a thei nahta, a hnohta, “Hmo miakha a phahlapa na hnei. Na hneipa zydua zuah la, dyhchhiepazy rai mah y. Chatanachata vârâh liata ryu na hnei aw. Cha khai tawhta a vy la, na zi mah y,” tah ta.
Cha biezy cha a thei nahta, sôh hluhpi a hneipa a châpa vâta a pachâ rôh ngaita ta.
Zisu ta hneirôhpa pachârôhpa cha a hmô nahta, “Hneirôhpazy châta la, Khazohpa khinarâh liata a ngia awpa a ru kaw tlai na!
Chyhsa hneirôhpa Khazohpa khinarâh liata a ngia awpa hlâta la, râraoseihpa chiephoh khaoh liata a ngia awpa tlao a nao via,” tah ta.
Cha bie a theipazy ta, “Cha khiahta cha, ahy ma pachha a châ thei aw tly?” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta, “Chyhsapa tao thei leipa he Khazohpa châta cha tao theipa a châ,” tah ta.
Pity ta, “Moh teh, eima olyuzy siesai khaipa ta eima cha zi hih,” tah ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, Khazohpa khinarâh vâta o tlyma, lapinô tlyma, unawhzy tlyma, nôpaw tlyma, sawzy tlyma a siesaipa cha,
tahmâ hro chhôh liana tlai heta a lie hluhpi ta hmô aw ta, daihti vaw tlô awpa liata chhâzaw hrona a to aw,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha pahrawh hleinozy anano ta a chhi ta, ama hnohta, “Pachâ teh u, Zerusale lâ eima khy hai hih. Chyhsa Sawchapawpa kyh liata, hrohsopazy bie reipa zydua kha patlôpa a châ aw.
Zenitaizy hnohta hlâpa châ aw ta, pahneisaisona châta hmâhpa ta, nozachhih ngaitapa ta tao aw ei ta, ama pachih ta ama pachhao aw.
Ama chhei khai tawhta, thie aw ei ta, a noh thôhna noh ta a thyu heih aw,” tah ta.
Châhrasala cha biezy cha a pachâna rai pahno veih ei. Cha bie cha âmo tawhta nyupa ta y ta, khâpa bie ma a reih tahpa chhao pahno veih ei.
Zerikô a tlô chy ta, mochaopa pakha lâpi kiah liata kudaopa ta a tyuh ta.
Zawpi siepa pyu a thei nahta, khâpa ma a châ tahpa hiahri ta.
Chyhsazy ta, “Nâzari Zisu a vaw sie hai,” tah ei ta.
Mochaopa cha awh ta, “Zisu, Dâvi Sawchapawpa, na ngiachhie mah y!” tah ta.
Hmia a sahpazy ta a chalih awpa ta ra ei ta. Châhrasala, “Dâvi Sawchapawpa, na ngiachhie mah y!” tahpa ta ta awh via rili ta.
Zisu cha a duah ta, mochaopa cha ano lâ a vaw chhi awpa ta biepie ta. A kiapâh a vaw tlô nahta,
“Khâpa cha taopa awpa ma na khoh?” tah ta. Ano ta, “Abeipa y, mo pavâ awpa ei khoh,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Na mo pavâ mawh sy. Nâ ngiapâna ta a cha patlâh haw,” tah ta.
A mo thlai vaw pavâ ha ta, Khazohpa reithaina chôta Zisu cha zi ha ta. Cha cha chyhsa zydua ta ama hmô nahta, Khazohpa reithai ei ta.
Zisu cha Zerikô khih a ngia ta, palâh a chhuah ta.
Chyhsa pakha a moh Zakia ama tahpa y ta. Ano cha chhiekheituh hyutuhpa châ ta, hneirôh kawpa a châ.
Zisu cha kheihawhpa chyhsa ma a châ tahpa hmô a chhuah ta. Châhrasala chyhsa doh chyupa a châpa vâta, zawpi hluhpi hry liata Zisu cha hmô thei leipa ta.
A sie nawpa lâpi lâ a râ khâh ta, a hmô thei nawpa ta theiku kô kiah ta.
Cha su a vaw tlô nahta, Zisu cha kaw ua ta, a hnohta, “Zakia, za chô para teh, tanoh he na o liata ei tlô awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Zakia cha za chô para ta, thapha ngaitapa ta Zisu cha a o liata patlôsa ta.
Cha cha ama hmô nahta, ama zydua ta reipasipasua ei ta, “Chyhsa moleipa o liata tlô awpa ta â ngia huh,” tah ei ta.

Zakia cha a duah ta, Abeipa hnohta, “Abeipa, moh tua, ei sôh khophie dyhchhiepazy hnohta pie aw na ta, chyhsa hmo kheihawhpa rai â doleipa ta ei lapa a y khiahta cha, a lie palih ta ei thô aw,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Tanoh he, he o liata pachhana a vaw tlô haw. Ano chhao he Abarahâ sawchapawpa châ hra tlôh ta.
Leidiapazy tlua ta pachha awpa ta, Chyhsa Sawchapawpa he â zupa rai a châ,” tah ta.
Cha biezy cha ama nathlie hai nota, Zerusale khih â hnia hapa vâta nata Khazohpa khinarâh thlai â vaw luah awpa ama pangiasapa vâta, zawpi hnohta pakhona bie reih ta.
“Beimachâ pakha cha khinarâh hnei theina ryuchâ a kei la ta, a vaw lie heih awpa ta râh hlapi lâ sie ta.
A sie chy ta a chakaotuhpa pahrawhzy aw ta, âmo cha tâkâ minâ tlaw hrawh chyu pie ta, ama hnohta, ‘Ei vaw tlô heih hlâlei sôh vaw palie muh vy,’ tah ta.
Châhrasala a khihsawzy ta ano cha a hao ei ta, ‘He chyhsa he eima bei châta khoh ma pi,’ tah awpa ta, ano hnôh lâta lyuhchâpa tuah hra ei ta.
Khinarâh hneina ryuchâ cha la ta, â vaw lie nahta, tâkâ a piepa chakaotuhpazy kha ano lâ a vy awpa ta biepie ta. Ama sôh paliepa tawhta khazie ma ama papôhsa chyu tahpa pahno khoh ta.
A vy tua chaipa ta, ‘Ei zibeipa, na minâzy khata minâ hropa tlaw hrawh a papôhsa,’ tah ta.
Abei ta a hnohta, ‘Chakaotuhpa phapa, na tao pha na! A chyhta chô liata ngâ nâ chhihpa vâta, khih hrawh chô liata hyutuhpa ta na y aw,’ tah ta.
A panona a vy ta, ‘Ei zibeipa, na minâ khata minâ hropa tlaw pangawh a papôh,’ tah ta.
Zibeipa ta a hnohta, ‘Nâ chhao khih pangawh chô liata hyutuhpa ta y mah y,’ tah ta.
Ahropa a vy ta, ‘Ei zibeipa, moh tua, na minâzy kha ahruna poh ta pahly na ta, a phapa ta ei cha pasopa hih.
Chyhsa chakhiehcharieh kawpa châ chi ta, na sokhâh leipa chhao la tyh chi ta, na tu leipa chhao a hria tyhpa na châpa vâta, cha chi na ta, he hawhta a taopa ei châ,’ tah ta.

Zibeipa ta a hnohta, ‘Chakaotuhpa moleipa, na pakah tawhta bie a puapa tlai ta thailei ei cha pachâsa aw! Chyhsa chakhiehcharieh kawpa châ na ta, ei sokhâh leipa chhao la tyh na ta, ei tu leipa chhao a hria tyhpa ei châpa cha na pahno naw?
Cha hnohkua cha khazia ei tâkâ kha sôh paliena o liata na soh vei? Ei vaw tlô tita a pôhna chhaota ei la awpa mah a châ tâh?’ tah ta.
A kiapâh liata a duahpazy hnohta, ‘A minâzy kha lapa u la, minâ tlawh hrawh a hneipa kha pie teh u,’ tah ta.
Âmo ta a hnohta, ‘Zibeipa, ano cha minâ tlaw hrawh a hnei ha kha zaw’ tah ei ta.
Zibeipa ta, ‘Ei cha chho ei, a hneipa maih baichhapa châ aw ei ta, a hnei leipa cha a hnei chhôhpa chhao lapa a châ aw.
Ama bei châta nâ khoh leipa ei chariahpazy kha, he lâ a vaw chhi u la, ei hmiakô liata thie teh u,’ a tah aw,” tah ta.
Cha biezy cha a rei khai nahta, hmia a sah ta, Zerusale lâ pangaipa ta sie ta.
Bethaphâ nata Bethâni khih kiapâh, Ôli tlâh ama tahpa a tlô nahta, pachupa pano tuah ta.
“Nama dady khih lâ hao vawh u la, namâ ngia tuana liata alâ taw buhpa, ahy hmah kia beih leipa hmô aw ei chi ta, pathlâ u la, a vaw chhi muh vy.
‘Khazia nama pathlâ?’ ama cha tah khiahta cha, ‘Abeipa ta a khoh,’ nama tah aw,” tah ta.
A tuapazy cha sie ei ta, a chhopa hawh tlai ta kei hmô ei ta.
Alâ taw ama pathlâ hai nota, a hneituhpazy ta ama hnohta, “Alâ taw kha khazia nama pathlâ?” tah ei ta.
Âmo ta, “Abeipa ta a khoh,” tah ei ta.
Alâtaw cha Zisu lâ a vaw chhi ei ta, ama pohzy ta a ky padia ei ta, Zisu cha pakiasa ei ta.
Alâ taw kiapa ta a siena lâpi tlykha ta ama pohzy phaw ei ta.
Zerusale a tlô chy, Ôli Tlâh lâ chôna lâpi liata a sie hai nota, a hmotaotheina rônahpa ama hmôpa zydua vâta, a zituhpa zawpizy cha a ly ngaita ei ta, ao paro ngaitapa ta Khazohpa reithai ei ta.
“Abeipa moh ta Bei a vypa cha reithaipa ta y mawh sy! Vârâh liata thlalôhna charei sala, chônôchaipa liana khita rônahna y mawh sy!” tah ei ta.
Zawpi hry liata Phârisaih thokha ta a hnohta, “Pachutuhpa, na pachupazy he ra teh,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta a chhy ta, “Ei cha chho ei, hezy heta amâ thlih thlâh ha khiahta la, alôzy chhâ heta ama awh aw,” tah ta.
Zerusale a kei hnia ta, khihpi cha a hmô nahta, chakhei ta,
“Aw, nâma ta, nâma tlai ta, na thlalôhna châta hmotaopazy he tanoh pahno thai mawh la ei tah kaw dia! Châhrasala tahmâ la na mohmô tawhta nyupa a châ haw.
Na chariahpazy ta diahsua cha dôhkhâhpa ta, cha chadô aw ei ta, su to tawhta ama châ dyuh nawpa nohzy a vaw tlô hai.

Nâ nata na chhôh liata a ypa na sawzy alei liata ama cha taikhy aw. Chariahpazy vaw tlô nawpa noh na pahno leipa vâta, nâma liata alô â pachopa rai miakha hmah y khao leina taihta ama cha parao aw,” tah ta.
Zisu cha Achhyna o liata a ngia ta, hmo a zuahpa nata a chaleipazy papua ta,
ama hnohta, “‘Ei o cha thlahchhâna o a châ aw,’ tahpa ropa châ ta, nâmo deikua ta cha hraotuhpazy lôpu ta tlao nama tao haw,” tah ta.
Noh chareih Achhyna o liata pachu tyh ta. Theihthai beizy nata ryhpa pachutuhpazy nata khihtlâh hyutuhpazy ta Zisu cha pahleipadia a chhuah ei ta.
Châhrasala zawpi zydua ta phahnai khoh ngaitapa ta a bie ama nathlie lymâpa vâta, khâpa hmah tao thei veih ei.
Noh kha cha Zisu ta Achhyna o liata zawpi pachu ta, thâtihpha a rei hai nota, theihthai beizy nata ryhpa pachutuhpazy cha machâzy chhaota a vy ei ta,
a hnohta, “Khâpa biehneina ta ma he hmozy he na tao, ahy ma he biehneina he châ pie? miah chho teh,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta âmo cha a chhy ta, “Kei chhao ta bie kawh kha ei cha hiahri hra aw ei. Na chho teh u,
Zawhâna bâtina kha vârâh tawhtapa ma, chyhsapa tawhtapa maw?” tah ta.
A chhohia ei ta, “‘Vârâh tawhtapa,’ tah mawh sih la, ‘Cha khiahta cha khazia namâ ngiapâ vei?’ miah tah ha aw.
‘Chyhsapa tawhtapa,’ tah mawh sih la, Zawhâna cha hrohsopa a châpa pahno pasia tlôh ei ta, chyhsa zydua ta alô ta miah vawhsao aw ei,” tah ei ta.
Chatanachata khataih tawhtapa ma a châ tahpa ama pahno leizie a chhy ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Kei chhao ta, ahy biehneina ta ma he hmozy he ei tao tahpa cha chho hra aw veih ei na,” tah ta.
Zawpi hnohta he pakhona bie he reih ta: “Chyhsa pakha cha kre sadô tao ta, lyutaopazy hnohta thlyuhlao awpa ta pie ta, bohpi y awpa ta râh hro lâ sie ha ta.

A thei lyu daihti a tlô nahta, kre sadô liata a patheipa tawhta a tovyuh la awpa ta, thlyuhlaotuhpazy lâta chakaotuhpa pakha tuah ta. Châhrasala thlyuhlaotuhpazy ta vaw tu ei ta, ku ruapa ta pasiesa ei ta.
Chakaotuhpa hropa tuah heih ta. Cha chhao cha vaw tu ei ta, nozachhih ngaitapa ta tao ei ta, ku ruapa ta pasiesa ei ta.
A pathôhna tuah heih ta. Cha chhao cha hmah paphaopa ta, papua ha ei ta.
Chatawhcha kre sadô hneituhpa ta, ‘Kheihta ma ei tao aw tly? Ei sawchapawpa kho ngaitapa he ei tuah thlâh ha tua aw. Ano chhâ he la ama vaw za via ngyu na,’ tah ta.
Châhrasala thlyuhlaotuhpazy ta ano cha ama vaw hmô nahta, a chhohia ei ta, ‘He chyhsa he ryutotuhpa a châ hih. A ryu cha eima to thei nawpa ta, thie ei suh u,’ tah ei ta.
Chatanachata kre sadô tawhta thy pathlah ei ta, ama thie haw. Kre sadô hneituhpa ta kheihta a tao aw ei?
A vy aw ta, thlyuhlaotuhpazy cha pahleipadia aw ta, kre sadô cha mohropazy a pie aw ei,” tah ta. Cha cha ama thei nahta, “Khazohpa ta pasaih khah sy?” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta âmo cha moh ta, “Cha khiahta cha, he bie ropa he khâpa ma a châ tly? “‘O satuhpazy alô kho leipa cha, A ki lô a vaw châ haw,’ tahpa hih,” tah ta.
“Ahy rai, cha alô chô liata a paopa cha keichheih aw ta, a vipa chhochhi cha a phypazao khai aw,” tah ta.
Cha nona tlai chata ryhpa pachutuhpazy nata theihthai beizy ta, cha pakhona bie cha âmo a rei chakiana bie a châ tahpa pahno ei ta, chavâta patu a chhuah ei ta, châhrasala zawpi chi ei ta.

Mohpathli awpa ta mohparutuhpazy tuah ei ta. Mohparutuhpazy cha a bie nathlie khoh hmeiseihpa hawhta y pakhei ei ta, râhvaotuhpa ryureina nata biehneina liata tlôkhei awpa ta, a bie rei chheipa patu awpa ta a byh ei ta.
Zisu cha bie hiahri ei ta, “Pachutuhpa, thlua hlei hnei leipa ta, âdopa ta bie reipa ta pachu chi ta, hmeiseihna kyh ta Khazohpa lâpi na pachu tyh tahpa eima pahno.
Kaisarâ lâ chhie piepa he eima ryhpa chakhiapa a châ ma, châ vei?” tah ei ta.
Châhrasala Zisu ta ama pasuapachao tahpa pahno ta, ama hnohta,
“Dinâri tâkâ na vaw pahmô tua u, ahy nothlahpa nata ahy moh ma â choh?” tah ta. Âmo ta, “Kaisarâ” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Cha thlaopa cha, Kaisarâ hmozy cha Kaisarâ lâ pie u la, Khazohpa hmozy cha Khazohpa lâ pie châh ei chi,” tah ta.
Zawpi hmiakô liata a bie rei chheipa patu awpa hmô leipa ei ta, â chhyna cha tlao ama noâh kaw ta, amâ chalih haw.
Thyuheihna y vei a tahpa Saduasizy ano lâ a vy ei ta,

a hnohta hiahrina tao ei ta, “Pachutuhpa, Mawsi ta châ miah ropa ta, ahy rai saw leipa ta a lapinô a thisai khiahta cha, a unawhpa ta nôhmei cha hnei aw ta, a unawhpa a thi hapa châta chi a pathlapa aw, tahpa ta miah a chho.
Unawh pasari y ei ta. A uhthei chaipa ta lapinô hnei ta, saw hnei leipa ta thi ha ta.
A panona ta a uhta lapinô cha hnei ta, ano chhao cha saw hnei leipa ta thi ha ta.
A pathôhna ta a uhta lapinô cha hnei heih ta, cha hawhna chata tao lymâ ei ta, pasarina taihta saw hnei leipa ta thi khai ha ei ta.
Achhâna liata chanô chhao cha thi ha hra ta.
Thyuheihna liata chanô cha ahy lapinô ma a châ aw? Ama pasari ta lapinô ta hnei chyu tlôh ei ta,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “He chhâ sawzy heta lapinô nata vahpa zy ama hnei tyh.
Chhâ vaw y awpa a to tlâh awpa ta pachâpazy nata athihpa hry tawhta thyuheihna liata a hlao tlâh awpa ta raopazy deikua la, lapinô pakia khao leipa aw ei ta, vahpa hnei khao aw veih ei.
Thi thei khao aw veih ei. Thyuheihna sawzy ama châpa vâta, Khazohpa sawzy châ ei ta, vâlyuhchâpazy hawhta ama châ haw.
Athihpazy pathyupa ta ama y awpa kyh he, Mawsi chhao khata a vaw reih haw. Abeipa cha Abarahâ Khazohpa, Aisika Khazohpa, Zakaw Khazohpa tahpa ta, thobuh liana kha a vaw palâsa ha mâh tâh.
Khazohpa cha athihpazy Khazohpa châ vei, ahrohpazy Khazohpa a châ. Chyhsa zydua he ano châta a hrohpa châ khai tlôh ei ta,” tah ta.
Ryhpa pachutuhpa thokha ta a chhy ei ta, “Pachutuhpa, na reipa cha â do kaw na,” tah ei ta.
Cha khai tawhta cha bie hropa hiahri ngâh khao veih ei.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Kheihtazie ta ma Mesia cha Dâvi Sawchapawpa a châ ama tah tyh tly?
Hlazy châbu liata, Dâvi cheingei ta, “‘Abeipa ta ei Beipa hnohta, Ei chachâh lâta a tyuh teh,
Na chariahzy na phei tlyna ta ei tao khai hlâlei cha,’ a tahpa kha.
Dâvi ta ano cha Abeipa a tah tlôh khiahta cha, kheihta ma a sawchapawpa a châ thei rai aw?” tah ta.
Chyhsa zydua theina liata, a pachupazy hnohta,

“Ryhpa pachutuhpazy tawhta a vaih teh u. Âmo cha viahkao pasipazy a kypa ta, sôdaohna suzy liata anaohna hnabeiseih ei ta, pakhyna ozy liata dyuchhai pha chaipazy a hnaw ei ta, kyhchhina liata su pha chaipazy amâ haw tyh.
Nôhmei olyuzy nie khai ei ta, a chapuahchaluah nawpa ta a pasi pi ta thlah ama chhâ tyh. Cha hawhpa chyhsazy cha thailei ama châ pachai aw,” tah ta.
Zisu cha mohmia pasaih ta, chyhsa hneirôhpazy ta thyuna byh liata thyuna ama pathlapa hmô ta.
Nôhmei dyhchhiepa ta phusâ dipa miano a vaw pathlapa hmô hra ta.
Zisu ta, “Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, âmo zydua hlâna heta, he nôhmei dyhchhiepa heta a thyu hluh via.
Mohropa zydua cha ama hnei laikhôpa thyu ei ta, he chanô deikua he cha, dyhchhie kawpa châ hra sala a khihsatôhtuna châta a hmâ awpa a hnei chhôhpa a thyu khai ha hih,” tah ta.
Chyhsa thokha ta Achhyna o cha alô ngiapa nata thyuna sôhzy tawhta â ngia ngaitapa ta tobipa a châzie ama rei hai nota, Zisu ta,
“He alô â pachopa nama hmôpazy he, a zydua ta parao khaipa ta a y nawpa nohzy a vaw tlô aw,” tah ta.
Âmo ta a hnohta, “Pachutuhpa, chazy cha khatita ma a châ aw? Chazy a vaw tlô chy ta ngiana kheihawhpa ma a y aw?” tahpa ta hiahri ei ta.
Zisu ta, “Ama cha dôvei lei nawpa ta a vaih teh u. Chyhsa hluhpi ei moh ta a vy aw ei ta, ‘Ano cha ei châ!’ ‘A daihti a tlô daihmâ haw!’ ama tah aw. Cha chyhsazy cha zi khuh vy.
Adyuhna nata tyhreihna kyhzy nama thei tita, chi khuh vy. Chazy cha a tlô tua awpa rai a châ, chhâna deikua thlai tlô mâh aw vei,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha ama hnohta, “Phopi nata phopi a dyuh aw ei ta, khinarâh nata khinarâh amâ dyuh aw.
Alo ru ngaitapazy a sih aw ta, su hluhpi liata chakâhna tlô aw ta, potlanazy a charei aw. Chichhihpa nata ngiana rarôh y ngaitapazy avâ liata â vaw luah aw.

Châhrasala cha zydua a tlô hlâta, cha patu aw ei ta, ama cha taola aw. Nama thâtih pachia awpa ta pakhyna ozy liata cha hlâpa ta, patâhna ozy liata cha khô aw ei ta, ei moh vâta beizy nata râhvaotuhpazy hmiâkô liata ama châ chhi aw.
Cha cha nama bie pahnopa reina rypaohpa a châ aw.
Kheihta ma eimâ chhy aw tahpa pachâ chhielie lei awpa ta nama palôh tao ha muh vy.
Bie nama rei awpa cha pie aw ei na ta, sona cha pie aw ei. Nama khakhaipazy ta nama bie cha ei thei leipa aw ei ta, cha pachhaipadai thei aw veih ei.
Nama nôpawzy, nama unawhzy, nama chiheihzy nata nama viasazy cheingei ta cha patusa aw ei ta, thokha chhochhi cha ama cha thie aw.
Ei moh vâta chyhsa zydua ta ama châ hao aw.
Châhrasala nama luh liata sâbu miakha chhao leidia aw vei.
Riethei nama tao hualuana ta nama hrona nama pabohsa aw.
“Zerusale khihpi cha pheisaihzy ta ama dôhpa nama hmô tita, roryhrapa ta a y nawpa â hnia haw tahpa pahno teh u.
Cha tita, Zudia râh liata a ypazy cha tlâhzy lâ a râ ei sala, khihpi chhôh liata a ypazy ta khihpi puasai ei sala, râh liata a ypazy ta khihpi chhôh lâ a ngia khah ei sy.
Cha nohzy cha phuh lana noh châ aw ta, chatanachata châbie ropa zydua kha â vaw ki aw.
Cha nohzy liata chanô sawphaohpa nata hawsaih a pyh haipazy hupo awpa rimâ cha! Khizaw liata rietheina thata y aw ta, he phopi chô liata hiehâhna a vaw tlô aw.
Zaozi ta thi aw ei ta, phopi zydua sei ta a chhipa ama châ aw. Zenitaizy noh â ki hlâlei cha, Zerusale cha Zenitaizy tlypâpa ta a y aw.
“Cha daihti liata, noh nata thlâpâ nata awhsizy liata ngiana y aw ta, tilaipi a aohpa nata tichatlaopazy pyu vâta, khizaw liata phopizy nôpopa nata pachârôhpa ta ama y aw.
Avâ hmotaotheinazy a chalyu aw ta, khizaw liata hmo a vaw tlô awpa pachâpa ta, chyhsazy chipa ta ama panao aw.
Cha tina chata Chyhsa Sawchapawpa cha hmotaotheina nata rônah ngaitapa ta meihdo hry liata â zupa ama hmô aw.
Cha hmozy a vaw tlô pathao tita, nama pachhana cha a hnia ha ta, thyu u la, avâ lâ moh muh vy,” tah ta.
Ama hnohta pakhona bie reih heih ta: “Theiku kô nata tho zydua he moh tua u.
A chhyh ama pakapa nahta, nopi â hnia haw tahpa nâmo tlai ta hmô ei chi ta, nama pahno tyh.
Cha hawhna chata, he hmozy a vaw tlôpa nama hmô tita, Khazohpa khinarâh cha â hnia haw tahpa pahno teh u.
Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, hmo zydua a tlô paki khai hlâlei cha, he chhâ he lei aw vei.
Lei nata vâ a lei aw, ei biezy deikua lei aw vei.
“A hrohrua teh u, chataleipatala phasana, sahma parina nata hro chhôh khihsa pachâna zy ta nama palôh pabie aw ta, cha noh chata khoheih hawhta eikhapi ta a cha vaw tlô thlu pathlei aw ei.
Cha noh cha khizaw pôhpalôhpa liata a pahrâpa zydua chô liata vaw tlô tlôh aw ta.
Cha hmo vaw tlô awpa zydua a khôkhâh tlâhpa nata Chyhsa Sawchapawpa hmiakô liata a duah tlâhpa ta raopa nama châ thei nawpa ta, khâpa no rai ta thlahchhâna chôta riavaihpa ta y teh u,” tah ta.
Zisu cha nohchhô ta Achhyna o liata pachu ta, zâ a vaw châ nahta, pua ta Ôli tlâh liata a rie tyh ta.
Mydi kari ta chyhsa zydua ano lâ a vy ei ta, Achhyna o liata a bie ama nathlie tyh.
Viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa kyhchhi, Zawpakhô ama tahpa a hnia ha ta.
Zawpi ama chipa vâta, theihthai beizy nata ryhpa pachutuhpazy ta arulâta Zisu cha tei ta, thie thei nawpa lâpi tlua ei ta.
Pahrawh hleinozy hry liata a hlaopa Zudâh Iskari ama tahpa chhôh liata Sâtâ a ngia ta.
Theihthai beizy nata hyutuhpazy lâ vawh ta, Zisu a patusa thei awpa kyh âmo cha kei chho ta.
A ly kaw ei ta, tâkâ pie awpa bie a taih ei ta.
Zudâh ta paryhsa ta, zawpi y lei nota patusa awpa ta rypaohna tlua ta.
Viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa kyhchhi, Zawpakhô mietakutaw thiena noh vaw tlô ta.
Zisu ta Pity nata Zawhâna cha, “Zawpakhô kyhchhi eima nie awpa a kei chhuanoh teh u,” tahpa ta tuah ta.
Âmo ta a hnohta, “Khataih liata pachhuahpanoh sih la na khoh?” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Khihpi namâ ngia nahta, chyhsa pakha tibeih chabapa ta châ vaw tyh aw ei ta, â ngiana lâ zi u la,
o hneituhpa hnohta, ‘Pachutuhpa ta, ei pachupazy chhaota zawpakhô pati eima nie nawpa khichhai chhôhpadâhpa khataih liata a y, a cha tah,’ nama tah aw.
O chô lâta chhôhpadâh kawhpa, atyuna nata tlâhkhaizy a y khaipa cha pahmô aw ei ta, cha liata nama pachhuahpanoh aw,” tah ta.
Vawh ei ta, ama hnohta a reipa hawh tlai ta kei hmô ei ta, zawpakhô pati cha pachhuahpanoh ei ta.
A daihti a vaw tlô nahta, Zisu cha lyuhchâpazy chhaota tlâhkhai liata pati dôh ta.
Ama hnohta, “Riethei ei tao hlâta, he zawpakhô pati he cha dôhlâh awpa ei, ei khoh ngaita.
Ei cha chho ei, Khazohpa khinarâh liata a hmeiseihpa ta â ki hlâlei cha, he pati he nie heih khao aw va na,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha nyu la ta, alyna bie a rei khai nahta, “He nyu he la u la, a rai teh u.
Ei cha chho ei, Khazohpa khinarâh a vaw tlô hlâlei cha, kre zôh thei ti he doh heih khao aw va na,” tah ta.
Viahchhâ la ta, alyna bie a rei khai nahta, eichheih ta, ama hnohta pie ta, “He he ei sapa, nama châta piepa a châ, einâ thei thlâh nawpa ei chi ta, he he tao tyh muh vy,” tah ta.
Cha hawhna hra chata, zâ pati ama nie khai nahta, nyu cha la ta, “He nyu, nama châta patlaipa he ei thisaih liata biehrai thiehpa, nama châta a lohpa a châ.
Châhrasala moh teh u, nâ patusa awpa ku cha, ei hnohta tlâhkhai chô liata a y.
Chyhsa Sawchapawpa he rao chhieliepa hawhta a sie aw, châhrasala a patusatuhpa chyhsa cha a hu a po kaw dia!” tah ta.
Cha hmo a tao awpa cha ahy ma a châ aw tahpa ta a hiahri chyu ei ta.
Ama hry liata ahy ma rônah chaipa ta pachâ awpa a châ tahpa kyh liata, pachupazy hry liata a eichhiana vaw pua ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Zenitai beizy cha ama sahlaozy chô liata a pabeisa ngaita ei ta, zawpi chô liata biehneituhpazy ta âmosasyh ta zawpi chyhtuhpa amâ tah tyh.
Nâmo deikua la cha hawhta châ veih ei chi. Nama hry liata a rônah chaipa cha seihnai chaipa hawhta y sala, hyutuh chaipa cha chakaotuhpa hawhta y mawh sy.
Ahy a rônah via, tlâhkhai liata pati a dôhpa ma, a chakaopa maw? Tlâhkhai liata pati a dôhpa châ vei ma? Kei deikua cha nama hry liata chakaotuhpa hawhta ei y hih.
“Nâmo cha rairuna ei tyh nota nâ ypâpazy châ ei chi ta,
ei Paw ta khinarâh eina piepa hawhta, nâmo chhao khinarâh ei cha pie ei.
Chatanachata ei khinarâh liata ei tlâhkhai liata niepa ta doh hra aw ei chi ta, beidyuchhai liata a tyuhpa ta Izarei pho hrawh hleinozy chô liata ryu nama reih aw.
“Saimaw, Saimaw, pachâ teh, Sâtâ ta sâh chanei ta a cha chanei thei nawpa ta, cha hnei awpa a khoh.
Châhrasala nâ ngiapâna a lei lei nawpa ta thlah ei cha chhâpa. Na vaw kua heih tita, na unawhzy thapatlô mah y,” tah ta.
Pity ta a hnohta, “Abeipa, na hnohta patâhna o lâ nata thina lâ sie awpa ta ei mâ thlâh haw,” tah ta.
Zisu ta, “Pity, ei cha chho, ‘Ano cha pahno va na,’ tahpa ta ei thôh einâ paphasai hlâ via chi cha, tanoh he awh khoh aw vei,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a pachupazy hnohta, “Tâkâ byh nata sahria nata pheiky leipa ta ei cha tua no ei kha, a phahlapa nama hnei rai ma?” tah ta. Âmo ta, “Hnei ma pi?” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Tahmâ la tâkâ byh a hneipa ta a phao sala, sahria a hneipa ta a phao mawh sy. Zaozi a hnei leipa ta a poh zuah sala, chalei mawh sy.
Ei cha chho ei, ‘Ano cha moleipa hry liata rei pâpa a châ,’ tahpa ropa hawhna khata, ei chô liata a vaw tlô tlai awpa a châ. Ei thâtih ama ropa kha a tlô paki haw,” tah ta.
Âmo ta, “Abeipa, moh tua, zaozi miano a y,” tah ei ta. Ano ta ama hnohta, “Â daih na,” tah ta.
Zisu cha pua ta, a tao tyhpa hawhta Ôli Tlâh lâ sie ta, pachupazy ta ano cha zi ei ta.
A su a tlô nahta, ama hnohta, “Reipasaona liata namâ ngia lei nawpa ta thlahchhâ teh u,” tah ta.
Alô vaw phana rakha lâ ânano ta sie ta, a pakhu paneih ta, thlahchhâ ta,
“Ei Paw y, â ryh na tah khiahta la, he nyu he keima tawhta pasie mah y. Châhrasala keima rei châ leipa sala, nâma rei sai châ mawh sy,” tah ta.
Vârâh tawhta vâlyuhchâpa pakha a vaw luah ta, Zisu cha tha vaw patlô ta.
A pachârôh ngaita ta, phahnai a ngiah via heihpa ta thlahchhâ ta. A mathlai di thisaih hawhta alei liata tla ta.
Thlah a chhâ khai tawhta thyu ta, pachupazy lâ a vy ta, pachârôhpa vâta amâ mô thlâhpa hmô ta.
Ama hnohta, “Khazia namâ mô thlâh haw? Reipasaona liata namâ ngia lei nawpa ta, thyu u la, thlahchhâ teh u,” tah ta.
Bie a rei hai nota, zawpi a vy ei ta, pahrawh hleinozy hry liata a hlaopa Zudâh ama tahpa cha hmia a vaw sah ta. A pahnâ a chhuahpa ta Zisu cha pangai ta.
Châhrasala Zisu ta a hnohta, “Zudâh, Chyhsa Sawchapawpa he a pahnâpa ta ma na patusa aw?” tah ta.
A kiapâh liata chyhsazy ta hmo a vaw tlô awpa ama hmô nahta, “Abeipa, zaozi ta eima chhawh aw ma?” tah ei ta.
Ama hry liata pakha ta theihthai beichaipa chakaotuhpa cha chhawh ta, a nakao chachâh lâ pathai ta.
Zisu ta, “Â daih,” tah ta. A nakao cha hria ta, patlâh ta.
Zisu ta ano patu awpa ta â vypa theihthai beizy, Achhyna o hyutuhpazy nata machâzy hnohta, “Hraotuhpa patu awpa hawhta ma, zaozizy, byuhthôzy chhaota nama vaw pua?
Achhyna o liata nama hnohta noh chareih y na ta, na hria tlôh ei chi va. Châhrasala tahmâ he nâmo daihti châ ta, zohna biehneina daihti a châ,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Zisu cha patu ei ta, puakheipa ta, theihthai beichaipa o lâ a chhi ei ta. Pity cha lâhlapi ta pazi laih ta.
Dôhpachhôh tlyhmia liah liata mei patih ei ta, chyhsazy a tyuh ei ta. Pity chhao ama hry liata a kei tyuh hra ta.
Mei khaihpa liata â tyupa cha chakaotuhnô pakha ta hmô ta, moh pasia ta, “He chyhsa chhao he a hnohta a ypa a châ hra,” tah ta.
Pity ta, “Chanô, ano cha pahno va na,” tah ta, a papha ha ta.
Taviapa ta mohropa ta vaw hmô heih ta, “Nâ chhao he ama hry liata a hlaopa na châ hra,” tah ta. Pity ta, “Chyhsa, châ va na,” tah ta.
Dawh kha rachhôh a khô tawhta, mohropa ta, “He chyhsa chhao he a hnohta a ypa kha a châ tlai hra, Kâlili chyhsa châ hra tlôh ta,” tahpa ta khâchâ bai ta.
Pity ta, “Chyhsa, na bie reipa cha pahno va na,” tah ta. A rei hai nota, awh khoh pâ ha ta.
Abeipa cha a vaw heih ta, Pity cha vaw moh ta. Pity cha Abeipa ta a hnohta, “Tanoh he awh a kho hlâta ei thôh einâ papha aw chi,” a tahpa bie kha a kaw thei ta.
Pua ta, aoh tlili ta cha ta.
Patâhna o liata Zisu vaituhpazy ta Zisu cha pasipasawhpa ta, tu ei ta.
A mo chahry ei ta, “Hrohsona bie phuah teh! Ahy châ tu?” tah ei ta.
Zisu cha reipachhie ei ta, bie pha leipa hluhpi rei thlu ei ta.
Khih a pavâpa nahta, phopi machâzy a hmaohpakhy ei ta, theihthai beizy nata ryhpa pachutuhpazy chhao y hra ei ta. Zisu cha ama ryureina lâ a chhi ei ta, a hnohta,
“Mesia na châ tlai khiahta cha, miah chho teh,” tah ei ta. Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Cha chho hraw ei sah la, zo aw veih ei chi.
Cha hiahri hra aw ei sah la, a chhy aw veih ei chi.
Châhrasala tahmâ tawhta la Chyhsa Sawchapawpa he Khazohpa hmotaotheina chachâh lâta â tyuh ha aw,” tah ta.
Ama zydua ta, “Cha khiah, Khazohpa Sawchapawpa ma na châ?” tah ei ta. Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Nâmo ta Khazohpa Sawchapawpa ei châpa nama reih cha zaw,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha âmo ta, “Khâpa pahnona hropa ma eimâ ngiah khao aw? Keimo tlai ta ano hmao tawhta eima thei ha cha zaw,” tah ei ta.
Zawpi zydua cha thyu ei ta, Zisu cha Pilâ lâ a chhi ei ta.
“He chyhsa heta eima phopi pasiesa chheipa ta, Kaisarâ lâ chhie pie awpa miah pakhâ ta, anosasyh ta Mesia â tahpa nata abeipa â tahpa eima thei,” tahpa ta leih ei ta.
Pilâ ta, “Zuzy Beipa na châ ma?” tah ta. Zisu ta, “Na reipa hawhta ei châ,” tah ta.
Pilâ ta theihthai beizy nata zawpizy hnohta, “He chyhsa chô liana heta thailei pachâsa nawpa khâpa hmah hmô va na,” tah ta.
Châhrasala âmo ta, “Kâlili râh tawhta pathaopa ta, he su taihta, Zudia râh su to liata pachupa ta chyhsazy a patypamâ lymâ,” tahpa ta leih via rili ei ta.
Pilâ ta cha cha a thei nahta, Zisu cha Kâlili chyhsa a châ nata châ lei hiahri ta.
Herawda avaona râh chyhsa a châpa a pahno nahta, Herawda lâ hlâ ha ta. Cha nota Herawda cha Zerusale liata a y no châ ta.
Herawda cha Zisu a hmô nahta, a ly ngaita ta. Zisu thâtih vaw thei ha ta, hmonoâhpa a taopa kheihawhpa chhâ ma hmô awpa hnabeiseih tyh ta, hmô awpa a byuh kaw tyhpa a châ.
Chavâta bie hluhpi hiahri ta, châhrasala a chhy tlâ leipa ta.
Theihthai beizy nata ryhpa pachutuhpazy a duah ei ta, thata leih ei ta.
Herawda nata a pheisaihzy ta Zisu cha mohnao kawpa ta pasipasawh ei ta. Poh rônahpa pabupa ta, Pilâ lâ hlâ pakhua ha ta.
Cha noh tawhta Herawda nata Pilâ cha a viasa kaw ei ta. Cha hlâ zydua cha a dyh thai leipa ama châ.
Pilâ ta theihthai beizy, ryureituhpazy nata zawpizy awpakhy ta,

ama hnohta, “He chyhsa he, chyhsazy a siekheichhei tahpa ta kei lâ namâ vaw chhipa kha châ ta. Nama hmiakô lia tlai ta a padai na ta, pachâ teh u, nama leihna kyh liana khata, he chyhsa chô liata a thaileichâna khâpa hmah hmô va na.
Herawda chhao ta hmô hra vei. Keimo lâ miah a vaw hlâ pakhua haw. Hmeiseih ta la, thina tlâh a châpa khâpa hmo hmah tao vei.
Chavâta chhei aw na ta, ei pathlie ha aw,” tah ta.
Zawpakhô kyhchhi maihta Pilâ ta atâhpa pakha zawpi lâ papua tyh ta.
Châhrasala â raoh ngaitapa ta awh ei ta. “Kha chyhsa kha pahleipadia la, Bârabâ kha miah papuapa teh,” tah ei ta.
Cha chyhsa cha sawhkhâ a dyuhpa ta khihpi liata tymâna a taopa vâta nata liany a cheipa vâta patâhna o liata khôpa a châ.
Pilâ ta Zisu a papua khohpa vâta, ama hnohta bie reih heih ta.
Châhrasala, “Khaipâ teh, khaipâ teh!” tahpa ta awh via rili ei ta.
A ei thôhna ta ama hnohta, “Khazia maw, he chyhsa heta khâpa hmo ma a parao? Thina tlâh a châpa thaileichâna ano liata khâpa hmah hmô va na. Chavâta chhei aw na ta, ei pathlie aw,” tah ta.
Châhrasala khaipâ awpa ta ao paro ngaitapa ta khâchâ a haw ei ta. Ama ao ta Pilâ cha pahnie ha ta.
Amâ hawpa hawhta pie awpa ta biechhâna a tao haw.
Papua awpa ta amâ hawpa, sawhkhâ â dyuhpa vâta nata lianycheina vâta patâhna o liata ama khôpa cha papua ta, Zisu deikua cha, ama khozie hawhta tao awpa ta âmo lâ hlâ ta.
Zisu cha siekhei ei ta, Kurini khihpa Saimaw, a yna râh lâ tawhta a vaw tlôpa cha patu ei ta, kraws papiasapa ta, Zisu hnôh lâta pasiesa ei ta.
Zawpi hluhpi nata ano châta mâchhiesapa ta a chakheipa chanôzy ta zi ei ta.
Zisu cha âmo lâ a heih ta ama hnohta, “Zerusale sawchanôzy saih u, na chakhei khah u, nâmo nata nama sawzy châta tlao cha teh u.
Moh teh u, nohzy a vaw tlô hai. Cha nohzy liata, ‘Chanô chohpa nata nawh â choh beih leipa chhi nata nawh ta a pazy beih leipa sâhpi zy cha ama nohlao na!’ ama tah aw.
Cha tina chata chyhsazy ta tlâhpizy hnohta, ‘Miah vi teh,’ tah aw ei ta; tlâhthlôhzy hnohta, ‘Miah khu teh,’ ama tah aw.
Tho hrohpa chô lia hmahta cha hawhta ama tao khiahta cha, tho raohpa chô liata chhochhi cha, khatlu ta ma ama tao aw tly?” tah ta.
A hnohta mohropa pano, moleipa thie awpazy a chhi hra ei ta.
Luh Ru Su ama tahpa Kalvari tlâh ama tlô nahta, kraws liata khaipâ ei ta. Moleipazy chhao, a chachâh lâta pakha, a chavei lâta pakha khaipâ hra ei ta.
Zisu ta, “Ei Paw y, âmo he a ngiahthai mah y, ama hmotaopa he ama pahno vei na,” tah ta. A chysiazy a rai awpa ta nuby a dao ei ta.

Zawpizy a kiapâh liata a duah ei ta, sai thlâh ha ei ta. Ryureituhpazy deikua ta pasipasawh ei ta, “Mohropazy a pachha tyh mâh tâh. Khazohpa Atlyhpa Mesia a châ tlai khiahta cha, anosasyh a pachha bao sa!” tah ei ta.
Pheisaihzy chhao ta Zisu cha pasipasawh ei ta, ano lâ a vy ei ta, kresawhti thaopa pie ei ta.
“Zuzy Beipa na châ tlai khiahta cha, nâmasasyh ta a pachha châh chi!” tah ei ta.
A luh chô liata Krikâh reih, Rawma reih nata Hebrai reihzy ta, “He he Zuzy Beipa a châ,” tahpa ta tawh ei ta.
Moleipa ama khaipâpa pakha ta Zisu cha reipachhie ta, “Mesia châ va chi mâ? Nâmasasyh ta a pachha la, keimo chhao miah pachha châh chi!” tah ta.
Pakhapa ta ano cha ra ta, “Khazohpa tlai chhao chi va chi ma? Thaileichâna miakha ta hriepa nama châpa he.
Keimo la hrie tlâh rai eima châ. Eima hmotaopa ty eima hmôpa a châ hih. He chyhsa deikua he cha, khâpa hmah parao vei,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Zisu hnohta, “Zisu, na khinarâh na tlô tita nâ thei mah y,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho, tanoh he ei hnohta Pârâdi liata na y aw,” tah ta.
Nohchhô dawh hrawh hleino rachhôh tawhta zâlâ dawh thôh taih, alei chô zydua vaw zoh kaluh ha ta.
Noh khaih khao leipa ta, Achhyna o pohraipa cha â khophie ta a hrie ta.
Zisu cha ao paro ngaitapa ta awh ta, “Ei Paw, na ku liata ei thlahpa ei cha pavaosa!” tah ta. Cha bie cha a rei khai nahta, a thlahpa pathlie ha ta.
Pheisaih za kha hyutuhpa ta hmo a tlôpa cha a hmô nahta, “He chyhsa he chyhsa siapa tlai na a châ!” tah ta, Khazohpa reithai ta.
Cha hmo cha sai awpa ta Zawpi a vypakhypa zydua ta, hmo a tlôpa cha ama hmô nahta, ama chachôhnazy a chôpa ta o lâ a di ha ei ta.
Zisu hmiapahnopa zydua nata Kâlili tawhta a vaw zipa chanôzy cha, lâhlapi ta a duah ei ta, cha hmozy cha sai ei ta.
Chyhsa pakha, a moh Zawsi ama tahpa, ryureituh phapa nata siapa y ta.
Ano cha Zisu thâtih ama pachiana nata ama hmotaopa a paryhsa leipa kha a châ. Arimathai khihpa Zu chyhsa châ ta, Khazohpa khinarâh vaw tlô awpa a hâpa a châ.
Cha chyhsa chata Pilâ lâ vawh ta, Zisu ri kei hiah ta.
Zisu ri cha la ta, poh rih dipa ta pahly ta, lôkhaoh khiepa thlâ, ahy hmahta pabu mâh leina liata pazia ta.
Cha noh cha Pachynoh châ ta, Pahânoh vaw châ daihmâ ha ta.
Kâlili tawhta Zisu a vaw zipa chanôzy chhao khata Zawsi cha zi ei ta, thlâ nata a ri pabunazie zy cha hmô ei ta.
O lâ a di ei ta, ropahâhpa nata sathawzy a chhuanoh ei ta. Pahânoh cha biepiepa hawhta a pahâ ei ta.
Hâta noh hmiatua chaipa mydi kari ta, chanôzy cha ropahâhpa amâ chhuanohpazy a cheipa ta, thlâ lâ vawh ei ta.
Thlâ tawhta alô â pasie hapa hmô ei ta.
Thlâ chhôh lâ a ngia ei ta, Abeipa Zisu ri cha hmô leipa ei ta.
Zisu ri a y khao leipa vâta nôpo kawpa ta ama y hai nota, poh diehpa a bupa chyhsa pano ama kiapâh liata a vaw duah ei ta.
Chanôzy cha chi ngaita ei ta, ama hmia alei lâ a khu ei ta. Chyhsazy chata ama hnohta, “Khazia athihpa hry liata ahrohpa nama tlua?
He liata y khao vei, a thyu haw. Kâlili liata a y nota nama hnohta bie a reipa kha a thei heih teh u.
Chyhsa Sawchapawpa cha moleipazy ku ta patusapa châ aw ta, khaipâ aw ei ta, a noh thôhna noh ta a thyu heih aw, a tahpa kha a thei teh u,” tah ei ta.
Chatanachata a bie reipazy kha a vaw thei heih ei ta,
thlâ tawhta a lie ei ta, cha hmo zydua cha pahrawh hleikhazy nata mohropazy chho ei ta.
Mâri Mâdali, Zôanâ, Zâmie nô Mâri nata ama hnohta a ypa chanô hropazy ta a thyuheihna thâtih cha lyuhchâpazy kei chho ei ta.
Châhrasala lyuhchâpazy ta cha biezy cha, bie thlâhthlipa ta rao ei ta, zo leipa ei ta.
Pity cha thyu ta, thlâ lâ a râ ta, a bôh ta, za moh ta, pala rih dipa pohzy deita hmô ta. Hmo yzie cha noâh tah ngaitana chôta a o lâ a di ha ta.
Cha noh liana tlai chata ama hry liata chyhsa pano cha khih miakha, Emâsâ ama tahpa lâ sie ei ta. Cha khih cha Zerusale tawhta me sari rachhôh a hlapa a châ.
Hmo vaw tlôpa zydua cha reih khoh laih lymâ ei ta.
Bie ama rei hai nota, Zisu cha ano tlai ta âmo vaw pangai ta, ama hnohta sie ta.
Châhrasala ano a châ tahpa ama pahno lei nawpa ta, ama mozy paliesapa ta y ta.
Ama hnohta, “Nama sie pâ ta nama reipa bie kha khâpa bie maw?” tah ta. Pachârôhpa ta a duah ei ta.
Ama hry liata pakha a moh Kaliôpâ ama tahpa ta a chhy ta, “Nâma deita he tahmâ nota Zerusale liata hmo tlôpa a pahno leipa Zerusale khichhai châ khiah chi?” tah ta.
Ano ta ama hnohta, “Khâpa hmozy maw?” tah ta. Âmo ta a hnohta, “Nâzari Zisu, Khazohpa nata chyhsa zydua mohmô liata bie nata hmotaopa liata hrohsopa thatlô ngaitapa thâtih a châ.
Eima theihthai beizy nata ryureituhpazy ta ano cha thailei pachâsa ei ta, thie awpa ta a chhi ei ta, ama khaipâna kyhzy kha na eima rei.
Keimo ta cha ano kha Izarei chatlaituhpa a châ awpa ta eima hnabei a seih thlâ bao na ta, khâpa rai châ sala, cha hmozy tlôna tawhta tanoh he a noh thôhna a châ haw.
Cha dei châ vei, eima py liata chanô thokha ta eima no miah ama paâhsa ngaita. Tamy kha thlâ lâ vawh ei ta,
a ri hmô khao leipa ei ta, vâlyuhchâpa a vaw luahpazy ama hmôpa kyh nata, vâlyuhchâpazy chata a hroh ha heihpa thâtih ama chhopa kyhzy vaw reih ei ta.
Eima hnohta a ypazy hry liata thokha thlâ lâ vawh ei ta, chanôzy reipa hawh tlai ta kei hmô ei ta, ano cha hmô khao veih ei,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Hy ahrupa saih u! Hrohsopazy bie reipa zydua a ngiapâ nawpa kyh liata nainôsôpazy saih u!
Mesia cha, cha hmozy cha pasa taopa ta a rônahna liata â ngia awpa châ vei ma?” tah ta.
Chatanachata Mawsi nata hrohsopa zydua tawhta pathaopa ta, Biehrai liata ano thâtih ropa zydua cha âmo chhopasia lymâ ta.
Ama sie nawpa khih tlô daihmâ ha ei ta. Ano cha â hla via sie a chhuahpa hawhta y ta.
Châhrasala thlyu ei ta, “Eima o liata tlô mah y, zâlâ ha ta, noh chhao a tla daihmâ ha hih,” tah ei ta. Chatanachata ama o liata tlô awpa ta a ngia ta.
Pati nie awpa ta ama hnohta tlâhkhai liata a dôh nahta, viahchhâ la ta, byhnâ aw ta, pachhaih ta, ama hnohta pie ta.
Chatawhcha ama mo vaw pavâ ta, Zisu a châ tahpa pahno ha ei ta. Zisu cha ama mohmô tawhta lei ha ta.
“Lâpi liata bie miah a chho ta, Biehrai biezy miah a chhopasia nona kha, eima pathipalôh a kâ ngâ kaw tlai vei ma kha?” tah ei ta.
Cha dawh lia tlai chata thyu ei ta, Zerusale lâ a lie ei ta. Pahrawh hleikhazy nata ama viasazy cha hmaohkha ta ama ypakhypa hmô ei ta.
Pahrawh hleikhazy chata, “Abeipa cha a thyu ha tlai, Saimaw hnohta â luah haw!” tah ei ta.
Âmo chhao ta, lâpi liata hmo a vaw tlôpa nata viahchhâ a pachhaih nota a hmia ama pahno hanazie zy chho hra ei ta.
Cha biezy cha ama rei hai nota, Zisu cha ama hry liata a vaw duah ta, ama hnohta, “Nama chô liata thlahlôhna y mawh sy,” tah ta.
Châhrasala a pahlawpa ta chi ngaita ei ta, thlahpa a hmôpa ta a pachâ ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Khazia tymâpa ta nama y? Khazia nama palôh liata a lôh leina a y?
Ei kuzy ei pheizy he moh tua u, keima tlai kha ei châ hih. Na vaw hria u la, na moh teh u. Keima eina hmôpa hawhna ei chi heta, thlahpa cha sapa nata rupa hnei vei,” tah ta.
Cha bie cha a rei khai nahta, a ku nata a pheizy cha âmo pahmô ta.
Amâ ly tupa vâta zo leipa ta y ei ta, noâhpa ta ama y hai nota, ama hnohta, “Nie awpa nama hnei ma?” tah ta.
Ngasa rao chiehpa miakha nata kheihthlawh pie ei ta.
Chazy cha la ta, ama hmiakô liata nie ta.

Chatawhcha ama hnohta, “Hezy he ei rei tyhpa, Mawsi Ryhpa liata nata Hrohsopazy Châbu liata nata Hlazy liata ei thâtih ropa zydua a vaw tlô khai awpazie nama hnohta ei y nota ei cha chho tyhpa ei kha a châ,” tah ta.
Biehrai biezy ama pahno thei nawpa ta, ama palôh pahy ta,
ama hnohta, “Hetana heta ropa a châ: ‘Mesia cha riethei tao aw ta, a noh thôhna noh ta athihpa hry tawhta thyu heih aw ta,
ano moh ta rona nata molei ngiahthaina thâtih cha, Zerusale tawhta pathaopa ta, phopi to hnohta chhopa a châ aw.’
Cha hmozy cha a pahnotuhpa nama châ.
Pachâ teh u, ei Paw bietaipa cha nama chô liata vaw tuah aw na ta, chô lâ tawhta hmotaotheina ta tobipa nama châ hlâta deikua cha, khihpi liana heta y thlâh ha muh vy,” tah ta.
Bethâni khih kiapâh taihta a pachupazy cha a chhi ta, a bâh pazawh ta âmo cha byhnâ awpa ta.
Byhnâ a awpa khai nah ei ta, a pachupazy cha a chhaih ta, vârâh lâ a chhipa ta y ha ta.
A pachupazy ta Zisu cha a naoh ei ta, a ly ngaitapa ta Zerusale lâ a lie ei ta,
Achhyna o liata khâ y ei ta, Khazohpa ama reithai tyh.
Âthaona liata Bie y ta, Bie cha Khazohpa hnohta y ta, Bie cha Khazohpa a châ.
Ano cha âthaona tawhta Khazohpa hnohta a ypa a châ.
Ato zydua ano hmâpa ta taopa châ ta, hmotaopa zydua ano a hlao leipa ta khâpa hmah taopa y vei.
Bie liata hrona y ta, cha hrona cha chyhsazy khaihna a châ.
Khaihna cha zohna liata vaw khaih ta, zohna ta khaihna cha pahnie vei.
Khazohpa tuapa chyhsa pakha y ta, a moh cha Zawhâna a châ.
Ano cha pahnokheituhpa châ awpa ta a vy ta, ano vâta chyhsa zydua amâ ngiapâ thei nawpa ta, khaihna a pahnokheituhpa châ awpa ta â vy.
Ano cha khaihna châ leipa ta, khaihna pahnokheituhpa châ awpa ta a vypa a châ.
Khaihna hmeiseihpa, chyhsa to a pakhaihpa cha khizaw lâ a zu ta.
Ano cha khizaw liata y ta, khizaw he ano hmâpa ta taopa châ ta, châhrasala khizaw ta ano cha pahno vei.
Ano chyhsazy lâ a zu ta, châhrasala a chyhsazy ta a ly veih ei.
Châhrasala ano a pyhpa nata ano a ngiapâpa zydua cha, Khazohpa sawzy châ theina biehneina a pie ei.
Cha chyhsazy cha thisaih ta sapa châ leipa ei ta, sapa khozie ta sapa châ hra leipa ei ta, chyhsapa khozie ta sapa châ veih ei. Khazohpa ta a sapazy ama châ.
Bie cha chyhsapa lâta a vaw lie ta, eima hry liata a pahrâ. A rônahna, a Paw Sawchapaw matlupa rônahna tlai cha hmô pi ta, ngiachhiena nata hmeiseihna ta a biepa a châ.

Zawhâna cha ano a pahnokheituhpa châ ta, ano kyh liata, “‘Ei hnôhlâ ta a vypa cha, kei ei y hlâta a y hapa châ ta, keima hlâta rônah viapa a châ’, tahpa ta a thâtih ei reipa kha, he chyhsa he a châ,” tah ta.
Ano pakina tawhta ngiachhiena to chyu pi ta, cha cha ngiachhiena chôta ngiachhie pachhuahna a châ.
Ryhpa cha Mawsi hmâpa ta piepa châ ta, ngiachhiena nata hmeiseihna deikua cha, Krista zawhzi ta a vaw ypa a châ.
Ahy hmahta Khazohpa hmô beih veih ei. Sawchapaw matlupa, Paw kalachhôh liata a ypa ta ano cha a palâhâh.
Zuzy ta Zerusale tawhta theihthaipazy nata Livai sahlaozy tuah ei ta, Zawhâna hnohta, “Ahy na châ?” tahpa ta ama pahiahrisa nota, Zawhâna ta hetana heta reih ta.
A phih leipa ta, a phuah ta, “Mesia châ va na,” tah ta.
Âmo ta, “Cha khiahta la, ‘Ahy na châ? Elaizâh na châ ma?’ tah ei ta. Ano ta ‘Châ va na,’ tah ta. ‘Hrohsopa na châ ma?’ tah ei ta. Ano ta, ‘Châ va na,’” tah ta.
Âmo ta a hnohta, “Cha khiahta la, ahy ma na châ? Miah tuahtuhpazy eimâ chhy awpa byuh tlôh ta, miah chho teh. Na thâtih rei awpa na hnei ma?” tah ei ta.
Zawhâna ta, “Kei cha ‘Abeipa lâthlôh paraih teh u!’ tahpa ta râhchawhpa liata awhtuhpa ao, hrohsopa Isai ta a reipa kha ei châ,” tah ta.
Ama chyhsa tuapazy kha Phârisaihzy ta ama tuapazy châ ei ta.
Âmo ta a hnohta, “Mesia tlyma, Elaizâh tlyma, hrohsopa tlyma na châ tlôh leipa khiahta cha, khazia chyhsazy bâti na pachâsa ei?” tah ei ta.
Zawhâna ta âmo cha a chhy ta, “Kei ta la ti ta cha bâti ei na ta, châhrasala nama hry liata nama pahno leipa chyhsa pakha a duah ta,
ano cha ei hnôhlâ ta a vypa châ ta, kei la a pheiky ri a pathlâ tlâh chhao châ va na,” tah ta.
Cha hmozy cha Zawdâh haosâ Bethâni khih liata Zawhâna ta bâti a pachâsa haina su liata a vaw tlôpa a châ.
A mylâ ta Zawhâna cha Zisu ta a vaw pangai haipa hmô ta, “Moh teh u, Khazoh Mietakutaw, khizaw moleina a siekheituhpa huh!
Hao chyhsa hao, ‘Ei hnôhlâ ta a vypa cha, keima y hlâta a y hapa châ ta, keima hlâta rônah viapa a châ’, tahpa ta a thâtih ei reipa kha a châ.
Ano cha ahy ma a châ tahpa kei chhao ta pahno va na. Châhrasala ano cha Izarei ta a pahno thei nawpa ta a vy na ta, ti ta bâti ei cha pachâsa ei,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Zawhâna ta Zisu thâtih a pahnokheizie hetana heta phuah ta: “Thlahpa cha vachhuh hawhta avâ tawhta za chôpa hmô na ta, a chô liata a choh ta.

Ano cha ahy ma a châ tahpa pahno va na. Châhrasala ti ta bâti pachâsa awpa ta nâ tuahtuhpa ta ei hnohta, ‘Thlahpa za chô ta, a chô liata â chohpa na hmôpa cha, ano tlai cha Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta bâti a pachâsa awpa cha a châ,’ tahpa ta na chho ta.
Cha cha hmô na ta, ano cha Khazohpa Sawchapawpa a châ tahpa a pahnotuhpa ei châ,” tah ta.
A mylâ ta Zawhâna cha a pachupa pano chhaota a duah ta,
Zisu â hlaihlâ ngâpa hmô ta, “Moh teh u, Khazoh Mietakutaw huh!” tah ta.
A pachupa pano ta a bie reipa ama thei nahta, Zisu cha zi ha ei ta.
Zisu cha a kei heih ta, ano ama vaw pazipa a hmô nahta, ama hnohta, “Khâpa nama tlua?” tah ta. Âmo ta, “Râbai, khataih liata na y?” tah ei ta. Râbai cha pachutuhpa tahna a châ.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “A vy u la, nama hmô aw,” tah ta. Chatanachata vawh ei ta, a yna cha hmô ei ta, zâlâ dawh palih rachhôh a châ hapa vâta, cha noh cha a hnohta y ei ta.
Zawhâna bie reipa a theipa vâta, Zisu zituhpa pano hry liata pakha cha Saimaw Pity unawhpa Adaru a châ.
Adaru cha a hmiatua chai ta a unawhpa Saimaw kei tlua ta, a hmô nahta, a hnohta, “Mesia eima hmô haw,” tah ta. Mesia cha Krista tahna a châ.
Adaru ta Saimaw cha Zisu lâ a chhi ta, Zisu ta ano cha vaw moh ta, “Zawhâna sawchapawpa Saimaw na châ, Kephâ ama cha tah ha bâ aw,” tah ta. Kephâ cha Pity tahna a châ.
A mylâ ta Zisu cha Kâlili râh lâ sie a chhuah ta. Phili hmô ta, a hnohta, “Na zi teh,” tah ta.
Phili cha Besaidâ khihpa châ ta, cha cha Adaru nata Pity yna khih a châ.
Phili ta Nâthaniah a hmô nahta, a hnohta, “Ryhpa châbu liata Mawsi ta a thâtih a ropa nata hrohsopazy ta ama ropa kha eima hmô haw. Ano cha Zawsi sawchapawpa Nâzari Zisu a châ,” tah ta.
Nâthaniah ta a hnohta, “Nâzari khih tawhta hmo phapa a pua thei aw ma?” tah ta. Phili ta a hnohta, “A vy la, vaw moh teh,” tah ta.
Zisu ta Nâthaniah ano lâ â vy haipa a hmô nahta, a thâtih reih ta, “Moh teh u, Izarei saw hmeiseihpa, haidihaiduana rai a hnei leipa chyhsa huh!” tah ta.
Nâthaniah ta a hnohta, “Kheihta eina pahno chi?” tah ta. Zisu ta a hnohta, “Phili ta a cha aw hlâta, theiku kô ry liata na y nona kha ei cha hmô haw,” tah ta.
Nâthaniah ta a chhy ta, “Râbai, Khazohpa Sawchapawpa na châ! Izarei Beipa na châ!” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “‘Theiku kô ry liata ei cha hmô’ ei cha tahpa vâta nâ ngiapâpa na châ ma? Chazy hlâta hmo rônah viapa na hmô aw,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha a hnohta, “Hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, avâ a pahypa hmô aw ei chi ta, Chyhsa Sawchapawpa chô liata Khazohpa vâlyuhchâpazy ama za chôpa nata ama kiapa nama hmô aw,” tah ta.
A noh thôhna noh ta Kâlili râh Kena khih liata ahneina y ta, cha liata Zisu nô chhao a hlao hra ta.
Zisu nata a pachupazy chhao ahneina a hlao awpa ta hruapa châ ei ta.
Kresawhti a daih khao leipa ta, a nô ta Zisu hnohta, “Kresawhti hnei khao veih ei,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a nô hnohta, “Chanô, cha cha keima pachâ awpa hmo a châ mâ? Ei daihti tlô mâh vei,” tah ta.
A nô ta chakaotuhpazy hnohta, “Nama hnohta a reipa maih tao lymâ muh vy,” tah ta.
Zuzy ryhpa hawhta pathaina tao nawpa ta, cha liata alô beihrai miacharu, chhiehraôh sypalih a tlôhpa nata sycharu a tlôhpazy patyuh ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Alô beihraizy kha ti pabie teh u,” tah ta. A kiah a chipa ta pabie khai ei ta.
Ama hnohta, “Tahmâ thaih u la, chôtla hyutuhpa lâ vawkhei teh u,” tah ta. Vawkhei ei ta.

Chôtla hyutuhpa ta ti kresawhti lâta a liepa cha doh ta, khataih tawhta a vypa ma a châ tahpa pahno leipa ta, ti a vaw thaihpa chakaotuhpazy deikua ta pahno ei ta. Chôtla hyutuhpa ta myuhneituhpa cha aw ta,
a hnohta, “Chyhsa to ta kresawhti phapa rai tua tyh ei ta, a hluh via ta ama doh khai tawhta a pha lei viapa ama rai tyh. Nâ deikua cha tahmâ taihta kresawhti phapa nâ khai thlâh hapa he,” tah ta.
Zisu ta hmonoâhpa a tao tua chaipa cha, Kâlili râh Kena khih liata tao ta, a rônahzie palâsa ta, chatanachata a pachupazy ta ano cha a ngiapâ ha ei ta.
Cha khai tawhta Kâpynia khih lâ zu ta, a nô nata a unawhzy nata a pachupazy chhao a hnohta zu hra ei ta. Cha liata noh chyhta y ei ta.
Zuzy Zawpakhô kyhchhi a hnia ha ta, Zisu cha Zerusale lâ khy ta.
Achhyna o liata viahchaozy, mietakuzy nata pivawzy a zuahpa sahlao nata tâkâ rituhpa sahlao a tyuhpazy hmô ta.
Khawhhri charipa ta chheina tao ta, ama mietaku nata viahchaozy chhaota Achhyna o tawhta papua khai ta. Tâkâ rituhpazy tâkâ cha leihtha ta, ama tlâhkhaizy chati pathlah ta.
Pivaw zuahtuhpazy hnohta, “Kha hmozy kha puakhei teh u. Ei Paw o he sôdaohna o ta tao khah u,” tah ta.
A pachupazy ta, “Na o châta phahnai ei ngiahna ta eina nie khai aw,” tahpa ropa bie a vaw thei ei ta.
Zuzy ta a hnohta, “He hmozy na taopa heta khâpa ngiana ma miah na pamosa?” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta âmo cha a chhy ta, “He o he phie u la, noh thôh chhôh ta ei padua heih aw,” tah ta.
Zuzy ta, “He o he kô sypalih nata kô charu sapa châ ta, nâ ta noh thôh chhôh ta na padua heih aw ma?” tah ei ta.
Châhrasala ano pôhpa Achhyna o kyh a reipa tlao a châ.
Chavâta athihpa hry tawhta pathyupa ta a y tawhna khata, cha kyh cha a reipa a châzie a pachupazy ta a thei ei ta, Biehrai nata Zisu bie reipa cha a ngiapâ ha ei ta.
Zawpakhô kyhchhi nota Zerusale liata y ta, hmonoâhpa a taopazy ama hmô nahta, chyhsa hluhpi ta a ngiapâ ei ta.
Châhrasala Zisu cha chyhsapa palôh zydua a pahno khaipa vâta, âmo liata ngâna pahnieh vei.
Chyhsapa palôh chhôh liata a ypa a pahno khaipa vâta, chyhsapa kyh liata chyhsapa ta a pahnokhei awpa a ngiah vei.
Phârisaih chyhsa pakha a moh Nikadima ama tahpa y ta, ano cha Zuzy ryureituhpa a châ.

Cha chyhsa cha zâ ta Zisu lâ a vy ta, a hnohta, “Râbai, Khazohpa tawhta pachutuhpa â vypa na châ tahpa eima pahno. Khazohpa a chô liata a y leipa khiahta la, he hmonoâhpa na taopa hawhpazy he ahy hmahta tao thei aw veih ei,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a chhy ta, a hnohta, “Hmeiseihta ta, hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho, ahy rai chô lâ tawhta a pihpathi leipa khiahta la, Khazohpa khinarâh a ngia thei aw vei,” tah ta.
Nikadima ta a hnohta, “Chyhsapa cha a pitloh tawhta kheihta a pih heih thei aw? A nô chhi liata a ngia chaneipa ta a pih heih thei aw ma?” tah ta.
Zisu ta a chhy ta, “Hmeiseihta ta, hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho, ahy rai ti nata Thlahpa ta a pih leipa khiahta la, Khazohpa khinarâh a ngia thei aw vei.
Sapa ta a pihpa cha sapa châ ta, Thlahpa ta a pihpa cha thlahpa a châ.
‘Na pihpathi awpa a châ,’ ei cha tahpa he na noâh khah sy.
Thlih cha a khona lâ maih a pathli tyh. A pyu thei chi ta, châhrasala khataih tawhta a vypa ma, khataih lâ ma a sie aw tahpa pahno va chi. Ahy rai Thlahpa ta a pihpa cha, cha hawhta ama y,” tah ta.
Nikadima ta a chhy ta, “Cha hmo cha kheihta a y thei aw?” tah ta.
Zisu ta a chhy ta, “Izarei pachutuhpa châ chi ta, chazy chhao cha pahno thai va chi ma?
Hmeiseihta ta, hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho, keimo ta la eima pahnopa reih pi ta, eima hmôpa eima pahnosa tyh. Châhrasala eima bie pahnopa cha zo veih ei chi.
Khizaw hmo ei cha chhopa ei hmahta nama zo vei khiahta cha, vârâh hmozy cha chho hraw ei sah la, kheihta nama zo aw?
Vârâh tawhta za chôpa Chyhsa Sawchapawpa dei leipa ta cha, vârâh lâ ahy hmah kiah beih veih ei.
Mawsi ta râhchawhpa liata parih a chaluahpa hawhna khata, Chyhsa Sawchapawpa he chaluahpa a châ aw,
ahy rai ano a ngiapâpa maih leidia leipa ta chhâzaw hrona ama hnei nawpa ta.
“Khazohpa ta khizaw kyh pachâ ngaita ta, chatanachata a Sawchapaw matlupa pie ta, ahy rai ano a ngiapâpa maih cha leidia leipa ta, chhâzaw hrona tlao ama hnei aw.
Khizaw thailei pachâsa awpa ta Khazohpa ta a Sawchapawpa khizaw lâ a tuapa châ vei, ano vâta khizaw pachhapa ta a y thei nawpa ta a tuapa tlao a châ.
Ahy rai ano a ngiapâpa cha thailei pachâsapa ta y aw vei. Ahy rai a ngiapâ leipa deikua cha, Khazohpa Sawchapaw matlupa moh â ngiapâ leipa vâta, tahmâ bawlawh ta thailei pachâsapa ta a y haw.
He he thailei pachâsana cha a châ: Khaihpa khizaw lâ a zu ta, châhrasala chyhsazy ta khaihpa hlâta zohna ama khoh via, ama hmotaopazy a moleipa vâta.
Hmo moleipa a taopa ta khaihpa â hao tyh. A hmotaopazy â lâ awpa vâta, khaihpa lâ a vy khoh vei.
Â dopa ta hmo a taopa deikua cha, a hmotaopazy Khazohpa vâta taopa a châpa â lâ thei nawpa ta, khaihpa lâ â vy tyh,” tah ta.
Cha khai tawhta Zisu nata a pachupazy cha Zudia râh lâ sie ei ta. Zisu chhao cha liata ama hnohta y hra ta, chyhsazy bâti pachâsa ta.
Zawhâna chhao ta Sâli khih kiapâh ta a ypa Ainaw khih liata bâti pachâsa hra ta. Cha liata ti a hluhpa vâta, zawpizy ano lâ a vy ei ta, bâti a pachâsa lymâ ei.
Cha daihti liata Zawhâna cha patâhna o liata khôpa châ mâh vei.
Zawhâna pachupa thokha nata Zu chyhsa pakha ta apathaisana kyh liata aeichhiana hnei ei ta.

Zawhâna lâ a vy ei ta, a hnohta, “Râbai, Zawdâh haosâ liata na hnohta a ypa, ano a pahnotuhpa na châpa nâ duakheipa kha, moh tua, chyhsazy bâti pachâsa ta, chyhsa zydua ta ano cha ama pangai lymâ,” tah ei ta.
Zawhâna ta a chhy ta, “Vârâh tawhta piepa a châ vei khiahta la, chyhsapa ta khâpa hmah hnei thei vei.
‘Kei he Mesia châ va na, a hmia lâta tuapa ei châ,’ ei tahpa kha, nâmo tlai he nâ pahnokheituhpazy nama châ.
Myuh a hneipa cha myuhneituhpa a châ. Myuhneituhpa viasa, myuhneituhpa pahnokhei awpa ta a duahpa cha, myuhneituhpa ao a theipa ta a palysa ngaita. Chavâta tahmâ ei lyna pakipa a châ haw.
Ano cha a rônah via rili awpa châ ta, kei deikua cha a nawh via lymâ awpa ei châ,” tah ta.
Chô lâ tawhta a zupa cha chyhsa zydua hlâta chônô chaipa a châ. Alei liata a pihpa cha lei chyhsa châ ta, lei hmozy a reih tyh. Vârâh tawhta a zupa deikua cha, chyhsa zydua hlâta chônô chaipa a châ.
A hmôpa nata a theipazy a pahnopa châ ta, châhrasala ahy hmahta a bie pahnopa cha a pyh veih ei.
A bie pahnopa a pyhpa cha, Khazohpa cha adopa a châ tahpa ta a moh a chahnao pa-i.
Khazohpa tuapa ta Khazohpa bie reih tyh ta, ano cha bitaipa y leipa ta Thlahpa a pietuhpa a châ.
Paw ta Sawchapawpa kyh pachâ ta, ato zydua a ku liata a pie khai haw.
Ahy rai Sawchapawpa a ngiapâpa cha chhâzaw hrona a hnei haw. Ahy rai Sawchapawpa bie a zyh leipa cha, hrona hmô aw vei, Khazohpa hiehâhna a chô liata tlao a y.
Zisu ta Zawhâna hlâta pachupa hluh via tao ta, bâti chhao a pachâsa hluh viapa kyh Phârisaihzy ta ama thei tahpa Zisu ta pahno ta.
Zisu ano tlai ta bâti a pachâsapa châ leipa ta, a pachupazy ta bâti ama pachâsapa tlao a châ.
Chatanachata Zudia râh puasai ta, Kâlili râh lâ kua ha ta.
Samâri râh a sie pahlie awpa byuh ta.
Samâri râh khih miakha Saikâ ama tahpa tlô ta. Cha cha Zakaw ta a sawchapawpa Zawsi a piepa lyu kiapâh liata a ypa a châ.
Zakaw tikhaoh chhao cha liata a y. Zisu cha a sie rietheipa vâta tikhaoh kiah liata a tyu ta. Nohchhô lichih châ ta.
Samâri chanô pakha ti thai awpa ta a vy ta. Zisu ta a hnohta, “Ti do awpa na pie teh,” tah ta.
A pachupazy cha niedo chalei awpa ta khihpi lâ vawh ha ei ta.

Samâri chanô ta a hnohta, “Nâ Zu chyhsa châ chi ta, kei Samâri chanô châ tlôh na ta, kheihtazieta ti do awpa eina hiah thlâh ha chi?” tah ta. Zu chyhsazy ta Samâri chyhsazy cha ama pa-i kaw tyhpa châ tlôh ta.
Zisu ta a chhy ta, “Khazohpa hmopiepa nata, ‘Ti do awpa na pie teh,’ châ tahtuhpa he pahno ha la cha, nâma ta a hnohta tlao hiah aw chi ta, ano ta ti hrohpa a cha pie ha awpa tlai,” tah ta.
Chanô ta a hnohta, “Pâpuh, ti thai nawpa khâpa hmah hnei tlôh chi va, tikhaoh hra a thu tlôh, khataih liatapa ma ti hrohpa cha na hmô?
Miah pathlatuhpa Zakaw hlâta na rônah via ma? Ano ta he tikhaoh he miah pie ta, ano chhao ta he ti he doh ta, a sawchapawzy nata a sahrohzy chhao ta ama dopa ti a châ,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a chhy ta, “Ahy rai he ti a dohpa maih a dâh a phi heih aw,
kei ta ei pie awpa ti a dohpa deikua cha, a dâh phi heih khao aw vei. Kei ta ei pie awpa ti cha, a chhôh liata tihnawh lâta a lie aw ta, chhâzaw hrona taihta a pali aw,” tah ta.
Chanô ta a hnohta, “Pâpuh, he tiaparâh ti thaih awpa ta ei vy khao lei nawpa nata ei dâh a phi khao lei nawpa ta, cha ti cha na pie teh,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Vawh la, na vahpa kei aw la, he lâ a vy heih mah y,” tah ta.
Chanô ta a chhy ta, “Vahpa hnei va na,” tah ta. Zisu ta a hnohta, “‘Vahpa hnei va na,’ na tahpa cha â do na.
Châhrasala vahpa papangawh hnei ha chi ta, tahmâ ta na hneipa he na vahpa châ vei. Chavâta na reipa cha â do,” tah ta.
Chanô ta a hnohta, “Pâpuh, hrohsopa na châ tahpa ei pahno haw.
Keimo miah pathlatuhpazy cha he tlâh liata Khazohpa amâ chhy tyh, nâmo deikua ta, Zerusale he chyhsazy ta Khazohpa amâ chhy nawpa su a châ nama tah,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Chanô, ei bie zo teh. He tlâh cheingei leipa liata chhao, Zerusale khih cheingei leipa liata chhao, Paw namâ chhy nawpa daihti a vaw tlô hai.
Nâmo ta nama pahno leipa a chhy tyh ei chi ta, keimo deikua ta cha eima pahnopa eimâ chhy tyh. Pachhana cha Zuzy tawhta a vaw puapa a châ.

Châhrasala a daihti a tlô daihmâ, tahmâ chhao a vaw tlô haw. Cha tita Khazohpa a chhy hmeiseihpazy ta thlahpa nata biehmeiseihpa ta Paw amâ chhy aw. Cha hawhpazy cha Paw ta ano a chhytuhpa châ awpa ta a tlua ei.
Khazohpa cha Thlahpa châ ta, ano achhytuhpazy ta thlahpa nata biehmeiseihpa ta amâ chhy awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Chanô ta a hnohta, “Krista ama tahpa Mesia cha, â vy aw tahpa ei pahno. Â vy tita, hmo to zydua miah a chho aw,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Bie châ chhotuhpa kei he, ano cha ei châ,” tah ta.

Cha nona chata a pachupazy vaw tlô ei ta. Chanô bie â chhopa cha ama noâh kaw ta, châhrasala ahy hmahta, “Khâpa na khoh?” tahpa tlyma, “Khazia chanô kha bie nâ chho?” tahpa tlyma, a hiahripa y veih ei.
Chatawhcha chanô cha a ti beihrai siesai ta, khih lâ vawh ta, chyhsazy hnohta,
“A vy u la, ei hmotaopa zydua nâ chho khaipa chyhsa vaw moh tua u. Mesia a châ thei aw tly ma?” tah ta.
Chyhsazy cha khih tawhta pua ei ta, ano lâ pangai ei ta.
Cha chhôh ta pachupazy ta Zisu cha pati nie awpa ta a haw ei ta, “Râbai, nie mah y,” tah ei ta.
Châhrasala Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Nama pahno leipa pati nie awpa ei hnei,” tah ta.
Pachupazy cha âmo nata âmo ta, “A nie awpa chyhsa ta ama vaw cheipa ma a châ tly?” a tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Ei pati cha nâ tuahtuhpa khopa taopa nata a raihria pangoh awpa a châ.
Nâmo ta, ‘Sâh hria â daih nawpa thla palih a byuh,’ tah veih ei chi ma? Moh teh u, ei cha chho ei, sai u la, lyuzy moh tua u, hria awpa ta a maih haw.
Sâh hriatuhpa cha hlao hmô ta, chhâzaw hrona châta a theizy a pakhy, chatanachata a tutuhpa nata hriatuhpazy cha amâ ly raihrie aw.
He liana heta, ‘Pakha ta tu ta, mohropa ta a hria,’ tahpa he biedopa a châ.
Nama hriapasa leipa hria awpa ta ei cha tuapa ei kha. Mohropazy ta hriapasa ei ta, nâmo ta ama hria chiehpa cha nama pazao,” tah ta.
Chanô ta, “Ei hmotaopa zydua eina chho lymâ,” tahpa ta a reipa vâta, cha khih liata a ypa Samâri chyhsa hluhpi ta Zisu cha a ngiapâ ei ta.
Samâri chyhsazy cha Zisu lâ a vy ei ta, ama hnohta châh awpa ta a haw ei ta, cha liata noh no châh ta.
Mohropa hluhpi chhao ta Zisu bie vâta a ngiapâ ha ei ta.
Âmo ta chanô hnohta, “Tahmâ la na bie reipa vâta a ngiapâpa châ khao ma pi. Keimo tlai ta a bie thei pi ta, he he khizaw Pachhatuhpa a châ tlai na tahpa eima pahno haw,” tah ei ta.
Noh no a châh tawhta, cha tawhta pua ta, Kâlili râh lâ sie ta.
Zisu ano tlai ta hrohsopa cha ano khih liata palyupalihpa ta y vei tahpa ta a vaw rei hapa a châ.
Kâlili râh a tlô nahta deikua cha, Kâlili mo ta, Zerusale khih liata Zawpakhô kyhchhi nota a hmotaopa zydua ama hmôpa vâta, a vaw ly ei ta. Âmo chhao cha kyhchhina lâ a sie hrapa ama châ.
Kâlili râh liata Kena khih, ti kresawhti lâta a pachâsana khih lâ a vaw lie ta. Kâpynia khih liata molaipa sawchapawpa cha pasa ta.
Cha chyhsa chata Zisu cha Zudia râh tawhta Kâlili râh lâ â vy tahpa a theipa nahta, ano lâ vawh ta, a sawchapawpa patlâh awpa ta Kâpynia lâ zu awpa ta a haw ta. A sawchapawpa cha thi daihmâ ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Ngiana nata hmonoâhpazy nama hmô vei khiahta la, a ngiapâ ngyu veih ei chi,” tah ta.
Molaipa ta Zisu hnohta, “Pâpuh y, ei saw a thi hlâta rie a zu mah y,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Sie mah y, na sawchapawpa cha a hroh aw,” tah ta. Cha chyhsa cha Zisu ta a hnohta bie a reipa cha zo ta, sie ha ta.
A zu hai nota, a chakaotuhpazy ta vaw dy ei ta, a sawchapawpa cha a tlâh haw tahpa chho ei ta.
A tlâh pathaona daihti âmo hiahri ta, âmo ta a hnohta, “Zâhia nohchhô dawh khapa ta chasipa ta a pathlie haw,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Na sawchapawpa cha a hroh aw,” a tahna daihti tlai kha a châpa ta, a paw ta pahno ta, chatanachata ano nata a chhôhkhazy cha ama zydua ta a ngiapâ ha ei ta.
Cha cha Zisu ta Zudia râh tawhta Kâlili râh lâ â vy nota hmo noâhpa a taopa a ei nona a châ.
Cha hnôhlâ ta Zuzy kyhchhi miakha y ta, Zisu cha Zerusale lâ khy ta.
Zerusale liata Mietaku Ochhi kiapâh liata tipo y ta, cha cha Hebrai reih ta Bethesdâ tah ei ta, okah miapangawh a hneipa a châ.
Chazy liata tlâhleipa hluhpi, mochaopazy, pheisypazy nata asihpazy a zia ei ta. Ti chatlaopa hâ tyh ei ta.
Daihti raopa liata, Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa cha tipo lâ a zupa ta, ti cha chatlaosa tyh ta. Ti â chatlao khai tawhta tipo liata â ny tuachaipa cha, kheihawhpa pasana rai patlâhpa a châ tyh.
Cha liata kô sythôh nata kô charie a pasapa chyhsa pakha y ta.
Cha liata â ziapa cha Zisu ta hmô ta, cha hawhta bohpi a y hapa a pahno nahta, a hnohta, “Patlâh na khoh ma?” tah ta.
Tlâhleipa chata a chhy ta, “Pâpuh, ti â chatlao nahta, tipo liata nâ ny awpa hnei leipa na ta, ei vaw hai nota mohropa ta eina chhao ha tyh ei,” tah ta.
Zisu ta a hnohta, “Thyu la, na hmohphaw la la, phei ta sie teh,” tah ta.
Cha chyhsa cha thlai vaw tlâh ha ta, a hmohphaw la ta, sie ha ta. Cha noh cha Pahânoh châ ta.
Zuzy ta a tlâh hapa hnohta, “Pahânoh a châ hih, na hmohphaw la awpa ta ryhpa ta pasaih vei,” tah ei ta.
Ano ta âmo cha a chhy ta, “Nâ patlâhtuhpa ano tlai ta ei hnohta, ‘Na hmohphaw la la, phei ta sie teh,’ eina tah,” tah ta.
Âmo ta a hnohta, “‘Na hmohphaw la la, phei ta sie teh,’ châ tahtuhpa cha ahy maw?” tah ei ta.
Châhrasala chyhsa a tlâh hapa ta a patlâhtuhpa cha ahy ma a châ tahpa pahno leipa ta, cha liata zawpi ama hluhpa vâta, Zisu hra cha sie ha ta.
A noh hropa ta Zisu ta ano cha Achhyna o liata hmô ta, a hnohta, “Moh teh, na tlâh ha hih! Molei khao khah y. Chataleipatala hmopha lei viapa na chô liata a vaw tlô pathlei aw na,” tah ta.
Cha chyhsa cha sie ta, a patlâhtuhpa cha Zisu a châzie Zuzy kei chho ta.
Pahânoh ta cha hawhpa hmozy cha a taopa vâta, Zuzy ta Zisu cha taolapa ta, thie a chhuah ei ta.
Zisu ta âmo cha a chhy ta, “Ei Paw cha tahmâ taihta rai hria lymâ ta, kei chhao ei hria lymâ hra,” tah ta.
Cha vâna chata Zuzy ta Zisu cha thie a chhuah via rili ei ta. Pahânoh a paraopa vâ dei châ leipa ta, Khazohpa cha “Ei paw” tah ta, Khazohpa tlu ta â taopa vâta a châ hra.

Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Hmeiseihta ta, hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, Sawchapawpa ta ano rei sai ta khâpa hmah tao thei vei. Paw hmotaopa a hmôpa deita a tao tyh. Paw ta a taopa maih cha, Sawchapawpa chhao ta a tao tyh.
Paw ta Sawchapawpa kyh pachâ ta, a hmotaopa maih a pahmô tyh. Chazy hlâta hmotao rônah viapa chhao pahmô aw ta, nama no a âh ngaita aw.
Paw ta athihpazy pathyu ta, a pahropa hawhta, Sawchapawpa chhao ta a khopa maih a pahro tyh.
Paw ta ahy hmah pachia vei, pachiana zydua cha Sawchapawpa hnohta a pie khai haw.
Chatanachata chyhsa zydua ta Paw ama zapa hawhta, Sawchapawpa chhao ama za hra aw. Ahy rai Sawchapawpa a za leipa cha, ano tuahtuhpa Paw a za leipa a châ.
Hmeiseihta ta, hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, ahy rai ei bie thei ta, nâ tuahtuhpa a ngiapâpa cha, chhâzaw hrona a hnei haw. Thailei pachâsapa châ leipa aw ta, thina tawhta hrona lâ tlao â ngia haw.
“Hmeiseihta ta, hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, a daihti a vaw tlô daihmâ, tahmâ chhao a vaw tlô haw. Cha tita athihpazy ta Khazohpa Sawchapawpa ao thei aw ei ta, a theipa maih ama hroh aw.
Paw cha hrona hnawh a châpa hawhta, Sawchapawpa chhao hrona hnawh châ awpa ta a tao.
Chyhsa Sawchapawpa a châpa vâta, a hnohta pachiana biehneina a pie.
Chazy cha nama noâh khah sy, a daihti a tlô daihmâ. Cha tita thlâ liata a ziapa zydua ta a ao thei aw ei ta,
ama kaw thyu khai aw. Hmopha a taopazy cha hrona to awpa ta thyu aw ei ta, moleina hmo a taopazy deikua cha, thailei châ awpa ta ama thyu aw.
“Keima kho ta khâpa hmah tao thei va na. Nah ta ei theipa hawhta pachia na ta, ei pachiana cha â do, keima rei sai ta y a chhuah leipa na ta, nâ tuahtuhpa rei sai ta y ei chhuahpa vâta.
Ei thâtih he kei deita pahnopa a châ khiahta cha, ei thâtih ei pahnosapa cha a do aw vei.
Ei thâtih nâ pahnokheituhpa pakha y ta, ei thâtih a pahnopa cha â do tahpa ei pahno.
Zawhâna lâ chyhsa tuah ei chi ta, ano ta bie hmeiseihpa pahnokheina bie a vaw reih haw.
Pahnokheina ei daopa kha, chyhsapa tawhta ei daopa châ leipa ta, pachha nama châ thei nawpa ta, cha biezy cha ei reipa a châ.
Zawhâna kha meiôh khaihpa nata khaih ngaitapa châ ta, a khaihna ry liata thaphapa ta y chy awpa nama khoh kaw.
Châhrasala pahnokheina ei hneipa he Zawhâna pahnokheina hlâta rônah viapa a châ.
Nâ tuahtuhpa Paw cha ei thâtih nâ pahnokheituhpa a châ. A ao thei beih leipa ei chi ta, a hmia hmô beih hra veih ei chi.
A tuapa namâ ngiapâ leipa vâta, a bie chhao nama palôh liata a vao veih ei chi.
Biehrai bie nama tlua tyh, a chhôh liata chhâzaw hrona a y tahpa nama pangiasapa vâta. Cha Biehrai tlai cha nâ pahnokheituhpa a châ.
Chatanachôta hrona hnei awpa ta kei lâ a vy khoh veih ei chi.
Chyhsapa palyupalihna a pyh va na.
Nâmo deikua cha ei cha pahno ei, nâmo liata Khazohpa kyhpachâna hnei veih ei chi.
Ei paw moh ta a vy na ta, nâ pyh veih ei chi. Mohropa la ano moh ta a vy sala, namâ pyh aw.
Nâmo nata nâmo a reithai raihrie ei chi ta, Khazohpa hmeiseihpa a y chhôhpa tawhta â vypa reithaina hmâchhâh nama tlua vei khiahta cha, kheihta namâ ngiapâ thei aw?
Kei ta Paw lâ ei cha leih awpa ei pangiasa khu vy. Nâmo châ leihtuhpa pakha a y, nama ngâpa Mawsi khawh.
Mawsi nama zo khiahta cha, kei chhao eina zo awpa ei chi a châ. Mawsi cha keima thâtih a rohpa a châpa kha.
Mawsi bie ropazy nama zo vei khiahta cha, kheihta ei biezy nama zo thei aw?” tah ta.
Cha hnôhlâ ta Zisu cha Kâlili Tipo haosâ lâ sie ta, cha tipo cha Taibiria Tipo tahpa a châ hra.
Tlâhleipazy chô liata hmonoâhpa a taopazy ama hmôpa vâta, zawpi hluhpi ta ano cha zi ei ta.
Zisu cha tlâh lâ kiah ta, cha liata a pachupazy hnohta a tyuh ta.
Zuzy Zawpakhô kyhchhi cha a hnia ha ta.
Mohmia pasaih ta, zawpi hluhpi ano lâ ama vaw pangaipa hmô ta, Phili hnohta, “He sahlaozy nie awpa viahchhâ khataih liata eima chalei aw?” tah ta.
Cha bie cha Phili pasia nawpa ta a reipa a châ, a tao awpa cha pahno thlâh ha ta.
Phili ta a chhy ta, “Chyhsa to ta a chyhta sai ama to awpa châta chhao, tâkâ dinâri za no mâ viahchhâ ta a daih aw vei,” tah ta.
A pachupazy hry liata pakha, Saimaw Pity unawhpa Adaru ta a hnohta,
“Bâli viahchhâ tlâ pangawh nata ngasa miano a hneipa chapaw hawti pakha he liata y ta, châhrasala he zie zydua hry liata, chazy cha khâpa didâh châ aw vei,” tah ta.
Zisu ta, “Zawpizy cha patyusa teh u,” tah ta. Cha liata sibiepa su kawhpa y ta. Chyhsazy cha a tyuh ei ta, ama zydua ta sâh pangawh rachhôh ama châ.
Zisu ta viahchhâ cha la ta, alyna bie a rei khai nahta, a tyuhpa sahlaozy cha rai ta. Ngasazy chhao ama khona zie ta rai ta.
Ama rihbiena taih ama nie khai tawhta, a pachupazy hnohta, “Khâpa hmah lei lei awpa ta, nie laibâhpa azôhpazy a huah khai ha teh u,” tah ta.
Nie laibâhpazy cha a huah ei ta, bâli viahchhâ tlâ pangawh a niepazy nie laibâhpa zôhpazy cha, hrâbyh byh hrawh hleino tlai a huah ei ta.
Zawpizy ta hmonoâhpa a taopa ama hmô nahta, “He chyhsa he khizaw lâ a vy awpa Hrohsopa a châ tlai hih!” tah ei ta.
Ano cha a chhi raruah ta, abei pachâsa awpa ta a vy amâ chhuah tahpa Zisu ta a pahno nahta, ano dei ta tlâh lâ kiah ha ta.
Zâlâ a vaw châ nahta, a pachupazy tipo lâ zu ei ta.
Balyh kiah ei ta, haosâ lâta Kâpynia khih pangaipa ta tipo liata sie ei ta. Vaw zoh ha ta, Zisu cha âmo lâ vaw tlô mâh leipa ta.
Thlihpi ru ngaitapa a pathlipa vâta tipo cha thata a chatlao ta.
Me thôh me palih rachhôh balyh ama hia tawhta, Zisu cha tipo chô liata phei ta vaw siepa ta, balyh lâ â vy haipa hmô ei ta, chi ngaita ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Keima na ei châ, chi khah u,” tah ta.
A ly kawpa ta balyh liata pakiasa ei ta, balyh chhao cha ama pangaipa râh thlai tlô pâ ha ta.

A mylâ ta tipo hesâ lâta zawpi a nguapazy ta haosâ liata balyh miakha deita a ypa kei hmô ei ta. Zisu cha a pachupazy hnohta balyh lâ a ngia leipa ta, a pachupazy cha âmo dei ta ama sie tahpa pahno ei ta.
Abeipa ta alyna bie a rei khai nahta viahchhâ ama niena su kiapâh liana kha Taibiria balyh hropazy vaw tlô ei ta.
Zawpi ta Zisu nata a pachupazy balyh liata ama y leipa ama hmô nahta, âmo chhao balyhzy liata kiah ei ta, Zisu tlua awpa ta Kâpynia lâ sie ha hra ei ta.
Tipo haosâ liata ama kei hmô nahta, a hnohta, “Râbai, khatita helâ nâ vy?” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta âmo cha a chhy ta, “Hmeiseihta ta, hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, hmonoâhpazy nama hmôpa vâta nâ tluapa châ leipa ei chi ta, viahchhâ nie ei chi ta, nama py biepa vâta nâ tluapa tlao nama châ.
Pati a leilô theipa châta hria leipa u la, chhâzaw hrona taihta a y awpa pati, Chyhsa Sawchapawpa ta a cha pie awpa ei châta tlao hria teh u. Paw Khazohpa ta ano cha chahnao pa-i ha tlôh ta,” tah ta.
Âmo ta a hnohta, “Khazohpa raizy a hriapa eima châ thei nawpa ta, khâpa eima tao aw?” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta âmo cha a chhy ta, “Khazohpa raihria cha he he a châ, a tuapa he a ngiapâ teh u,” tah ta.
Âmo ta a hnohta, “Hmô sih la eima cha zo thei nawpa ta, khâpa ngiana ma na tao aw? Khâpa hmo ma na tao aw?
‘Ama nie awpa viahchhâ vârâh tawhta a pie ei’ tahpa ropa hawhta, mânâ kha miah pathlatuhpazy ta râhchawhpa liata ama nie tyh,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Hmeiseihta ta, hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, vârâh tawhta viahchhâ kha Mawsi ta a cha piepa ei châ vei, ei Paw ta avâ tawhta viahchhâ hmeiseihpa a cha piepa ei a châ.
Khazohpa viahchhâ cha vârâh tawhta a zupa, khizaw lâta hrona a pietuhpa a châ,” tah ta.
Âmo ta a hnohta, “Abeipa, cha viahchhâ cha khâ miah pie mah y,” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Kei he hrona viahchhâ ei châ. Ahy rai kei lâ a vypa cha a nodi leipa aw ta, ahy rai nâ ngiapâpa cha a dâh phi beih aw vei.
Châhrasala ei cha chho ha ei, na hmô ei chi ta, chatanachôta nâ ngiapâ veih ei chi.
Paw ta eina piepa maih kei lâ amâ vy khai aw. Ahy rai kei lâ a vypa maih cha dytha cheita aw va na.
Keima khopa tao awpa ta vârâh tawhta a zupa châ leipa na ta, nâ tuahtuhpa khopa tao awpa ta a zupa tlao ei châ.
He he nâ tuahtuhpa khopa cha a châ, ano ta eina piepa zydua ahy hmah pahlei leipa aw na ta, noh chhâna noh liata ei pathyu aw ei.
He he ei Paw khopa cha a châ, ahy rai Sawchapawpa hmô ta a ngiapâpa maih cha chhâzaw hrona hnei aw ei ta, noh chhâna noh liata ei pathyu aw ei,” tah ta.
“Kei he vârâh tawhta viahchhâ a zâ chôpa cha ei châ,” a tahpa vâta Zuzy ta a chô liata paphôh ei ta.
“He he Zawsi sawchapawpa Zisu kha châ vei mâ? A nô nata a paw eima pahnopa kha châ vei ma? Tahmâ kheihtazieta ma, ‘Vârâh tawhta a zâ chôpa ei châ,’ a tah tly?” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta âmo cha a chhy ta, “Nâmo nata nâmo liata paphôh ngâ khah u.
Nâ tuahtuhpa Paw ta a sy vei khiahta la, ahy hmah kei lâ a vy thei aw veih ei. Kei lâ a vypa cha noh chhâna noh liata ei pathyu aw.
Hrohsopazy châbu liata, ‘Khazohpa pachupa ta ama y khai aw,’ tahpa ropa a châ. Paw bie thei ta, a chupa maih cha kei lâ amâ vy tyh.
Khazohpa tawhta a zâ chôpa dei leipa ta cha, ahy hmah Paw hmô beih veih ei. Ano cha Paw a hmôpa a châ.
Hmeiseihta ta, hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, ahy rai a ngiapâpa cha chhâzaw hrona a hnei haw.
Kei he hrona viahchhâ ei châ.
Châ pathlatuhpazy kha râhchawhpa liata mânâ ama nie tyh, châhrasala ama thi pyly.
He he vârâh tawhta viahchhâ a zâ chôpa cha a châ, chyhsa ta nie sala a thi lei nawpa ta.
Kei he vârâh tawhta viahchhâ hrohpa a zâ chôpa ei châ. Ahy rai he viahchhâ he a nie khiahta cha, chhâzaw ta a hroh thlâh ha aw. Khizaw hro nawpa ta ei pie awpa viahchhâ cha ei sapa he a châ,” tah ta.
Cha biezy vâta Zuzy cha âmo nata âmo a eichhia ei ta, “He chyhsa heta kheihta ma a sapa cha nie awpa ta miah a pie thei aw?” tah ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Hmeiseihta ta, hmeiseihta ta ei cha chho ei, Chyhsa Sawchapawpa sapa niepa ta a thisaih nama doh leipa khiahta cha, nâmo liata hrona hnei veih ei chi.
Ahy rai ei sapa nie ta, ei thisaih a dohpa cha chhâzaw hrona a hnei haw, noh chhâna noh liata ano cha ei pathyu aw.
Ei sapa he pati hmeiseihpa châ ta, ei thisaih he do awpa hmeiseihpa châ tlôh ta.
Ahy rai ei sapa nie ta, ei thisaih a dohpa cha, keima liata a y thlâh ha tyh, kei chhao ano liata ei y thlâh ha tyh.
A hroh thlâhpa Paw ta na tuah ta, Paw zawhzi ta a hrohpa ei châpa hawhta, ahy rai nâ niepa cha, keima zawhzi ta ano chhao a hroh aw.
He he vârâh tawhta viahchhâ za chôpa a châ. Pathlatuhpazy ta nie ei ta, ama thi pylypa viahchhâ hawhpa kha châ vei. He viahchhâ a niepa cha chhâzaw ta a hroh aw,” tah ta.
Cha biezy cha, Zisu ta Kâpynia liata a pachu nota, pakhyna o liata a reipa biezy a châ.
A pachupa hluhpizy ta cha bie cha ama thei nahta, “He he bie ru ngaitapa a châ, ahy ma a nathlie thei aw?” tah ei ta.
Cha bie kyh liata a pachupazy ama paphôh ngâpa a pahno nahta, Zisu ta ama hnohta, “He kyh liata palôh châ leipa ta nama y ma?
Chyhsa Sawchapawpa he a y tuana lâ a kiapa a hmôpa châ u la, kheihta nama tah aw?
Hrona pietuhpa cha Thlahpa a châ, sapa cha phahnaina hnei vei. Nama hnohta bie ei reipazy he Thlahpa châ ta, hrona chhao a châ.
Châhrasala nama hry liata thokha a zo leipa nama y,” tah ta. Ahyzy ma a zo veih ei, ahy ma a patusa aw, tahpazy cha Zisu ta athaona tawhta a vaw pahno chhielie hapa a châ.
Chavâta ama hnohta, “Cha vâna tlai chata nama hnohta, Paw ta a bao leipa ta cha, ahy hmah kei lâ a vy thei aw veih ei, ei tahpa kha a châ,” tah ta.
Cha rakha tawhta cha, a zituhpa hluhpi ta kuasai ei ta, a hnohta sie khao leipa ei ta.
Zisu ta pahrawh hleinozy hnohta, “Nâmo chhao na siesai awpa nama khoh hra ma?” tah ta.
Saimaw Pity ta a chhy ta, “Abeipa, ahy lâ ma eima sie aw, nâ cha chhâzaw hrona bie a hneipa châ chi ta,
keimo chhao ta châ ngiapâ pi ta, Khazohpa Mopathaihpa na châ tahpa eima pahno haw,” tah ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Nâmo pahrawh hleinozy chi he, keima ta ei châ tlyhpa châ veih ei chi ma? Châhrasala nama hry liata pakha cha ahripa a châ,” tah ta.
Saimaw Iskari sawchapawpa Zudâh, pahrawh hleinozy hry liata a hlao hrapa ta, ano a patusa nawpa kyh a reipa a châ.
Cha khai tawhta Zisu cha Kâlili râh chahryh ta. Zuzy ta thie amâ chhuahpa vâta, Zudia râh deikua chahryh a chhuah vei.
Zuzy Byureih Kyhchhi cha a hnia ha ta.
A unawhzy ta “He tawhta pua la, na pachupazy ta na hmotaopazy ama hmô thei nawpa ta, Zudia râh lâ sie mah y.
Moh pathâh a khohpa ta arulâta hmo tao beih vei. He hmozy he na tao tlôh khiahta cha, khizawpi hmô awpa ta tlao tao mah y,” tah ei ta.
A unawhzy chhao ta Zisu cha a ngiapâ leipa ei ta.
Zisu ta ama hnohta, “Ei daihti tlô mâh vei, nâmo daihti deikua cha khatino rai ta a tlô thlâh haw.
