Ama zydua ta ama noâh kaw ta, a pachâna rai pahno leipa ei ta, “He he khâpa ma a yzie tly?” tah ei ta.
Thokha ta pahneisao ei ta, “Kresawhti thiehpa ama pari he tly ma,” tah ei ta.

Pity cha pahrawh hleikhazy nata hmaohkha ta a duah ei ta, ao paro ngaitapa ta ama hnohta bie reih ta, “Nâmo, Zudia mo nata Zerusale liata a pahrâpa zydua saih u, hezy he pahno u la, ei biezy he nathlie teh u.
He sahlao he nama pangiasapa hawhta pari veih ei, my dawh chaki deita a châ chy hih.
He he hrohsopa Zôela ta,

“‘Noh chhâna nohzy liata cha, Hetana heta a vaw châ aw, Khazohpa ta a tah: Chyhsa zydua chô liata Ei Thlahpa hry aw na ta, Nama sawchapawzy nata nama sawchanôzy ta Hrohsona bie phuah aw ei ta, Nama thyutliazy ta aluahnazy hmô aw ei ta, Nama pawpipazy ta mâ lâta ama sa aw.
Cha nohzy liata cha, Nâ chakaotuhpa nata nâ chakaotuhnô liata Ei Thlahpa hry aw na ta, Hrohsona bie ama phuah aw.
Chô lâ avâ liata hmonoâhpazy, Ry lâ alei liata ngianazy, Thisaih nata mei nata meikhuh zy Ei chaluah aw.
Abeipa noh a vaw tlô hlâta, Noh rônahpa nata noâhchhihpa a vaw tlô hlâta, Noh cha zohna lâta a lie aw ta, Thlâpâ chhao thisaih lâta â lie aw.
Ahy rai Abeipa moh a padopa maih cha, Pachhapa ama châ aw,’ tahpa ta a vaw reipa kha a châ.

“Nâmo Izarei sawzy saih u, he biezy he thei teh u: Nâzari Zisu, Khazohpa ta ano hmâpa ta nama hry liata hmo rônahpazy, hmonoâhpazy nata ngianazy a taopa kha, Khazohpa ta â pyhpa chyhsa a châ tahpa nâmo tlai ta nama pahno.
Kha Zisu kha Khazohpa pachhuahpanohpa nata pahno chhieliepa hawhta, nâmo ta patusa ei chi ta, moleipazy ku ta khaipâ ei chi ta, nama thie hapa a châ.
Châhrasala ano cha thina ta patu thei vei. Khazohpa ta thina pasa taonazy cha pathlâpa ta, a pathyu haw.
Dâvi chhao khata Abeipa Zisu kyh liata, “‘Abeipa cha ei hmiakô liata khâ hmô na ta, Ei chachâh lâta y ta, A chalyu aw va na.
Chavâta ei palôh thapha ta, Ei paleih a ly ta, Ei sapa ta a hnabei a seih.
Athihkhih liata ei thlahpa siesai leipa aw chi ta, Na Mo Pathaihpa thuzao awpa pasaih aw va chi.
Hrona lâpizy na pahnosa chi ta, Na ypâna vâta alyna ta eina pabie aw chi,’ tahpa ta a vaw reih haw.
“Unawh saih u, pathlatuhpa Dâvi kyh riahpha ngaitapa ta ei cha chho thei ei. Ano cha thi ta, pabu ei ta, a thlâ chhao tanoh taihta eima hnohta a y.
Dâvi kha hrohsopa châ ta, a pathla hry liata pakha cha a beidyuchhai liata a tyuh awpa ta Khazohpa ta bie â taihpa pahno thlâh ha ta.
Chavâta Mesia thyu heih nawpa kyh hmô chhielie ta, Zisu cha Athihkhih liata siesaipa ta y leipa aw ta, a sapa chhao a thuzao lei awpa kyh a vaw rei chhielie hapa a châ.
Cha Zisu cha Khazohpa ta pathyu ta, keimo zydua he a pahnotuhpa eima châ.
Khazohpa ku chachâh lâta palyupalihpa ta y ta, Thlahpa Pathaihpa pie awpa bietai Paw tawhta hmô ta, nama hmôpa nata nama theipa hawhna heta, Thlahpa Pathaihpa hrypa a châ hih.
Dâvi kha vârâh lâ kiah vei, ano tlai ta, “‘Abeipa ta ei Beipa hnohta, Ei chachâh lâta a tyuh thlâh ha mah y,
Na chariahzy na phei tlyna ta ei tao khai hlâlei cha,’ tahpa ta a reipa tlao a châ.
Chavâta Zisu nama khaipâpa tlai kha, Khazohpa ta Abeipa nata Mesia ta a taopa a châ tahpa cha, Izarei phopi zydua ta pahno tlai mawh ei sy,” tah ta.
Cha biezy cha ama thei nahta, ama palôh chhô ha ta, Pity nata lyuhchâ hropazy hnohta, “Unawh saih u, khâpa eima tao aw,” tah ei ta.
Pity ta ama hnohta, “Ro u la, nama moleinazy a ngiahthaipa ta a y thei nawpa ta, Zisu Krista moh ta bâti châ chyu teh u. Chatanachata hmosaipiepa, Thlahpa Pathaihpa cha nama hmô aw.
Bietai cha nâmo châta châ ta, nama sawzy châta châ hra ta, lâhlapi ta a ypa zydua châta chhao châ ta, Abeipa eima Khazohpa ta a awpa zydua châta a châ,” tah ta.
Bie hropa hluhpi ta Zisu cha a châhkhei lymâpa ta zawpizy cha pasyu ta, ama hnohta, “He chhâ moleipa tawhna heta a pabohsa teh u,” tah ta.
A bie a zyhpa maihta bâti châ ei ta, cha noh liata chyhsa sâh thôh rachhôh baichhapa ama châ.
Ngiapâtuhpazy cha lyuhchâpazy pachuna dao awpa ta zy, akaona hnei awpa ta zy, viahchhâ pachhaih awpa ta zy, thlahchhâ awpa ta zy ta phahnai khoh ngaitapa ta y tyh ei ta.
Lyuhchâpazy ta hmonoâhpa nata ngiana hluhpi tao ei ta, chavâta chyhsa to ta chi ei ta.
Ngiapâtuhpa zydua hmaohkha ta y ei ta, hmo to a hly ei ta.
Ama ryuzy, ama sôhzy zuah ei ta, amâ ngiahpa chyu hawhta ama zydua ta a rai tyh ei ta.
Noh chareih Achhyna o liata palôh raoh ngaitapa ta a pakhy tyh ei ta, ama o lâta chhao, viahchhâ pachhaihpa ta thaphapa nata pasai ngaitapa ta pati ama nie pahmaoh tyh.
Khazohpa reithai ei ta, chyhsa zydua modypa ta ama y tyh. Chatanachata pachha a châpazy cha, noh chareih ta Abeipa ta ama hnohta a baichha lymâ ei.
Pity nata Zawhâna cha noh kia râhsâ ta thlahchhâ daihti nota Achhyna o lâ khy ei ta.
Chyhsa pakha pheisypa ta a pihpa a vaw sy ei ta, ano cha Achhyna o lâ a ngiapazy lâta ku dao awpa ta, Achhyna o Ochhi Ngiapa ama tahpa kiapâh liata noh chareih ama pazia tyhpa a châ.
Cha chyhsa chata Pity nata Zawhâna Achhyna o lâ ama ngia awpa a hmô nahta, ku vaw dao ta.
Pity ta ano cha moh ta, Zawhâna chhao ta moh hra ta, Pity ta, “Miah vaw moh tua,” tah ta.
Kudaopa cha âmo tawhta khâpa tlyma hmô awpa hnabeiseihpa ta, âmo cha vaw moh ta.
Pity ta, “Tâkâ nata ngôh hnei va na, châhrasala ei hnei chhôhpa ei cha pie aw. Nâzari Zisu Krista moh ta thyu la, na phei ta sie teh,” tah ta.
A ku chachâh lâ patu ta, pathyu ta, a pheizy nata a phei lobyuh rupazy cha a tha thlai vaw y ha ta.
Pheisypa cha a kaw zaw ta, a duah ta, phei ta sie ha ta. Phei ta siepa ta a thluah laih ta, Khazohpa reithaina chôta ama hnohta Achhyna o lâ a ngia ha hra ta.
Phei ta a siepa nata Khazohpa a reithaipa cha chyhsa zydua ta hmô ei ta.
Achhyna o Ochhi Ngiapa kiapâh liata kudaopa ta a tyuh tyhpa kha a châ tahpa pahno ei ta. A chô liata hmo a tlôpa cha ama noâh ngaita ta, a pachâna pahno leipa ei ta.
Pheisypa a tlâh hapa ta Pity nata Zawhâna a patu thlâh ha nota, chyhsa zydua cha noâh tah ngaitana chôta Sawlawmaw aikah ama tahpa liata âmo yna lâ a vaw râ pakhy ei ta.

Cha cha Pity ta a hmô nahta, zawpi hnohta bie reih ta, “Nâmo, Izarei mo saih u, he hmo he khazia nama no a âh? Keimo hmotaotheina nata Khazohpa eima pachâpa vâta ano he eima pasiesapa hawhta pachâpa ta, khazia miah nama mo thlâh haw?

Abarahâ Khazohpa, Aisika Khazohpa nata Zakaw Khazohpa, miah pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa ta a chakaotuhpa Zisu a parônahsapa a châ hih. Ano cha patusa ei chi ta, Pilâ ta pathlie â chhuahpa chhao ta, Pilâ hmiakô liata namâ paphasai hapa kha a châ.
Mopathaihpa nata Mosiapa kha dytha ei chi ta, lianycheihpa kha cha papuapa awpa ei ta tlao namâ haw.
Hrona pietuhpa cha thie ei chi ta, châhrasala Khazohpa ta ano cha athihpa hry tawhta a pathyu haw. Cha cha a pahnotuhpazy eima châ.
Zisu moh ta, Zisu moh angiapâna ta he chyhsa nama hmôpa nata nama pahno tyhpa he a thapatlô ta, ano vâta ngiapâna a vaw ypa ta nama zydua mohmô liata a patlâh ha hih.
“Châhrasala unawh saih u, nama ryureituhpazy ta ama pahno leipa vâta ama taopa hawhna khata, nâmô chhao nama pahno leipa vâta, hezy he nama taopa a châ tahpa ei pahno.
Khazohpa ta hrohsopa zydua pakah ta a Mesia cha riethei a tao awpa a châna kyh a vaw reih chhieliepa kha, a vaw patlôsapa a châ.
Chavâta ro u la, ano lâ kua teh u, nama moleinazy pahleipa a châ aw.
Chatanachata Abeipa tawhta ahrana daihtizy vaw tlô aw ta, Krista Zisu, nama châta â tlyhpa cha a vaw tuah aw.
Khazohpa ta bohpi tawhta a hrohso pathaihpazy pakah ta a vaw reipa, ato taopathi daihti a tlô hlâlei deikua cha, vârâh liata a y chy awpa a châ.
Mawsi tlai ta, ‘Abeipa Khazohpa ta keima hawhpa hrohsopa he nama unawhzy hry tawhta a cha paduapa aw ei. A biereipa maih nama nathlie awpa a châ.
Ahy rai, cha hrohsopa bie a nathlie leipa cha, phopi tawhta pahleipadiapa a châ aw,’ tahpa ta a vaw reih hapa kha.
Samuela nata a hnôhlâ ta hrohsopa a vaw ypa zydua chhao ta reih khai ei ta, he nohzy kyh he ama vaw phuah haw.

Nâmo he hrohsopazy saw châ ei chi ta, Khazohpa ta châ pathlatuhpazy hnohta biehrai tao ta, Abarahâ hnohta, ‘Na pathla tawhta khizaw liata phopi to byhnâ topa ta ama y aw,’ a vaw tahpa biehrai sawzy nama châ.
Khazohpa ta a chakaotuhpa cha pathyu ta, nama moleinazy tawhta cha paheisaisa ta, byhnâ cha pie awpa ta, nâmo lâta a vaw tuah tuachaipa a châ,” tah ta.
Pity nata Zawhâna ta zawpizy hnohta bie ama rei hai nota, theihthaipazy, Achhyna o hyutuhpazy nata Saduasi sahlaozy cha âmo lâ a vy ei ta.
Zawpi pachu ei ta, Zisu vâta athihpa hry tawhta thyuheihna kyh ama reipa vâta, ama palôh châ lei ngaita ta.
Pity nata Zawhâna cha patu ei ta, zâlâ a châpa vâta, a mylâ taihta patâhna o liata khô ei ta.
Châhrasala ama bie a theipa hry liata chyhsa hluhpi ta a ngiapâ ei ta, ama hluhna zie cha maluh sâh pangawh rachhôh ama châ.
A mylâ ta ama ryureituhpazy, machâzy nata ryhpa pachutuhpazy cha Zerusale liata a hmaohpakhy ei ta.
Theihthai beichaipa Anâ, Kaiphâ, Zawhâna, Alezandâ nata theihthai beichaipa chiheih zydua chhao a hlao ei ta.
Pity nata Zawhâna cha a liah liata paduasa ei ta, “Khâpa hmotaotheina ta ma, ahy moh ta ma, hezy he nama tao?” tahpa ta hiahri ei ta.
Pity cha Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta bie ta, ama hnohta, “Phopi ryureituhpazy nata machâzy saih u,
chyhsa sypa patlâh ta, hmo pha a taona kyh liata, he chyhsa he khâpa vâta ma a vaw tlâh haw, tahpa ta tanoh miah nama hiahri khiahta la,

nama zydua ta pahno u la, Izarei saw zydua ta pahno mawh ei sy. Nâzari Zisu Krista nama khaipâpa, Khazohpa ta athihpa hry tawhta a pathyu heihpa moh ta, he chyhsa he nama hmiakô liata a tlâhpa ta â duahpa a châ hih.
Cha Zisu cha, nâmo, o satuhpazy ta alô nama kho leipa, a ki liata alô phahnai chaipa a châ.
Ahy liata hmah pachhana y vei. Avâ ry liata chyhsa moh bipa hry liata miah pachha thei awpa mohropa rai y veih ei,” tah ta.
Pity nata Zawhâna riahphazie cha hmô ei ta, châthai leipa nata chyhsa zawrâpa dei ama châpa ama pahno nahta, ama noâh kaw ta. Zisu hnohta a y tyhpa ama châpa pahno ha ei ta.
Chyhsa ama patlâhpa ama hnohta a duahpa moh ei ta, reipasipasua nawpa hnei tlôh ei va.
Ryureina su tawhta pua awpa ta bie ama pie khai tawhta, âmo dei ta reipahmaoh ei ta,
“He chyhsazy he kheihta ma eima tao aw? Hmonoâhpa ngia tlâhpa ama taopa kyh Zerusale liata a ypa zydua ta a siapa ta pahno ei ta, keimo chhao ta eima ei thei vei kha zaw.
Anodeikuacha chyhsazy ta ama pahno kawh lymâ lei nawpa ta, he moh ta ahy hnohta hmah bie reih khao lei awpa ta pachhipary ei suh u,” tah ei ta.
Lyuhchâpazy cha aw ei ta, Zisu moh ta bie reih khao chachei lei awpa nata pachu khao lei awpa ta biepie ei ta.
Châhrasala Pity nata Zawhâna ta a chhy ei ta, “Khazohpa bie zyh leipa ta nâmo bie zyhpa cha, Khazohpa mohmô ta â do thai aw ma? Nâmo ta pasia teh u.
Keimo la hmo eima hmôpa nata eima theipazy reih leipa ta y thei ma pi,” tah ei ta.
Hmonoâhpa a tlôpa vâta, chyhsa zydua ta Khazohpa reithai ei ta, zawpizy vâna chata hrie ngâh khao leipa ei ta, pachhipary via heih ei ta, ama pathlie haw.
Hmonoâhpa taopa ta chyhsa ama patlâhpa cha, kô sypalih hlâta uhthei viapa châ tlôh ta.
Ama pathlie nahta, Pity nata Zawhâna cha ama viasazy lâ vawh ei ta, theihthai beizy nata machâzy ta ama hnohta ama reipazy cha chho ei ta.
Cha bie cha ama thei nahta, ama zydua ta â raohpa ta ao paro ngaitapa ta Khazohpa lâ thlahchhâ ei ta, “Hy Beichaipa, nâ cha lei nata vâ nata a chhôh liata a ypa zydua taotuhpa na châ.
Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta miah pathlatuhpa, châ chakaotuhpa Dâvi pakah ta, “‘Zenitaizy khazia ama pathi a ia, Phopizy khazia hmo hraoleipa ama pachâ?
Lei beizy thyu ei ta, Ryureituhpazy a hmaoh ei ta, Abeipa nata a Mesia amâ dyuh,’ tahpa ta na reipa kha a vaw tlô haw.
He khihpi liana heta, châ chakaotuhpa pathaihpa, na sathawthupa Zisu kyh vâta, Herawda nata Pawtia Pilâ nata Zenitaizy nata Izarei chiphozy amâ hmaohpakhy.
Na ku nata nâ chhuahna ta hmo a vaw tlô awpa na rao chhieliepazy tao awpa ta amâ hmaohpakhypa a châ.
Hy Abeipa, ama pachhiparynazy he pachâ tua. Châ chakaotuhpazy he riahpha ngaitapa ta na bie reih lymâ awpa ta miah bao mah y.
Patlâh awpa ta na ku pazawh la, châ chakaotuhpazy he, châ chakaotuhpa pathaihpa Zisu moh ta ngiana nata hmonoâhpazy pataosa lymâ mah y,” tah ei ta.
Thlah ama chhâ khai nahta, ama y pahmaohna o cha a vaw chalyu ta, ama zydua ta Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta bie ei ta, riahpha ngaitapa ta Khazohpa bie ama chho lymâ.
Ngiapâtuhpa manôh zydua cha palôh miakha nata pachâna su kha ta y ei ta. Ahy hmahta a sôh hneipazy cha ano eih sai ta rao leipa ta, hmo zydua a hly khai ei ta.
Lyuhchâpazy ta hmotaotheina thata hneipa ta, Abeipa Zisu thyuheihna kyh a châhkhei lymâ ei ta, ama zydua chô liata ngiachhiena thata y ta.
Ama hry liata a phahlapa ahy hmah y veih ei. Alei su nata o a hneipa maihta zuah ei ta, ama hmo zuapa ty cha vaw cheih ei ta,
lyuhchâpazy phei thaby liata soh ei ta, ama byuhpa rakha chyu ta amâ rai tyh.
Kuparâ chyhsa Livai chi Zawsi, lyuhchâpazy ta Bânabâ, thlalôhna saw ama tahpa chhao,
a lyu zuana mâ tâkâ vaw cheih ta, lyuhchâpazy phei thaby liata vaw soh ta.
Chyhsa pakha a moh Anania ama tahpa deikua cha, a lapinô Saphirâ nata râh zuah hra ei ta.
A lapinô pahnopa ta râh zuana ty cha phih bâ ha ta, a laibâhpa vaw cheih ta, lyuhchâpazy phei thaby liata vaw soh ta.
Pity ta, “Anania, Thlahpa Pathaihpa dô awpa nata râh zuana ty phih bâ awpa ta, khazia Sâtâ ta na palôh a pabie?

Râh cha a y chhôh zydua kha nâma eih châ vei mâ? Na zuah tawh chhao ta nâma rei sai châ pyly vei ma? Khazia he hawhpa hmo tao khohna palôh na hnei tly? Chyhsapa a dôveipa châ va chi, Khazohpa a dôveipa na châ,” tah ta.
Cha biezy cha Anania ta a thei nahta, pao ta, thi ha ta. Cha thâtih a theipa maihta chi ngaita ei ta.
Satliazy thyu ei ta, poh ta pahly ei ta, khôtho lâ a sy ei ta, pabu ha ei ta.
Dawh thôh rachhôh a châ nahta, a lapinô cha hmo tlôpa pahno leipa ta a ngia ta.
Pity ta a hnohta, “Na chho teh, râh cha he zie tlai heta ma nama zuah?” tah ta. Ano ta, “Y, he zie tlai he na a châ,” tah ta.
Pity ta a hnohta, “Khazia Abeipa Thlahpa pasia awpa ta bie namâ paraoh? Moh teh, na vahpa a pabutuhpazy phei cha ochhi ama vaw tlô ha huh, nâ chhao khôtho lâ amâ châ sy aw,” tah ta.
Saphirâ cha eikhapi ta Pity phei thaby liata pao ta, thi ha hra ta. Satliazy amâ vaw ngia nahta, Saphirâ cha a thipa ta vaw hmô ei ta, khôtho lâ a sy ei ta, a vahpa kiapâh liata pabu ei ta.
Awnanopa zydua nata cha kyh a theipa zydua ta ama chi ngaita.
Lyuhchâpazy ku ta ngiana nata hmonoâhpa hluhpi zawpi hry liata tao lymâpa châ ta. Ama zydua ta palôh miakha phaohpa ta Sawlawmaw Aikah liata y pakhy tyh ei ta.
Ama hry liata a pahlao ngâh leipa y hra ei sala, zawpi ta âmo cha pasâhsa ngaita ei ta.
Ngiapâtuhpa hluhpi a chanô chapaw ta Abeipa lâ amâ baichha via lymâ.
Pity â vy tita, a nohpahlipa chhâ ta a pahli thei nawpa ei ta, tlâhleipazy a vaw sy ei ta, rakhô nata hmohphawzy chô liata paziapa ta lâlaizy liata soh ei ta.
Zerusale chheipâh khihzy tawhta chyhsazy chhao a vy ei ta, tlâhleipazy nata thlahpa puapa ta a pasasapazy a vaw chhi ei ta, âmo chhao cha patlâh khaipa ama châ.
Chatawhcha theihthai beichaipa nata a sahlao zydua vaw thyu ei ta, âmo cha Saduasi py châ ei ta, hiatliana ta a biepa ama châ.
Lyuhchâpazy cha patu ei ta, vâtlâh patâhna o liata khô ei ta.
Châhrasala zâ ta Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa pakha ta patâhna o ochhizy cha vaw pahy ta, lyuhchâpazy cha papua ta, ama hnohta,
“Vawh u la, Achhyna o liata a kei duah u la, he hrona bie zydua he, zawpi hnohta kei chho teh u,” tah ta.

Cha bie cha ama thei nahta, mydi ta Achhyna o liata a ngiapa ta, pachu ei ta. Theihthai beichaipa nata a sahlaozy a vy ei ta, ryureituhpazy nata Izarei machâ zydua awpakhy ei ta, lyuhchâpazy a vaw chhi awpa ta patâhna o lâ chyhsa tuah ei ta.
Chakaotuhpazy cha vawh ei ta, âmo cha patâhna o liata hmô leipa ei ta, vaw kua ei ta.
Ama hnohta, “Patâhna o cha â bohpa ta khawpa châ ta, vaituhpazy chhao ochhi thaby liata amâ duapa hmô pi ta, châhrasala pahy pi ta, a chhôh liata ahy hmah hmô ma pi,” tah ei ta.
Achhyna o hyutuhpa nata theihthai beizy ta cha biezy cha ama thei nahta, kheihta ma a châ tly, tahpa pachâpa ta, a tymâ kaw ei ta.
Chyhsa pakha a vy ta ama hnohta, “Patâhna o liata nama khôpa chyhsazy kha Achhyna o liata a duah ei ta, zawpi ama pachupa ei hmô,” tahpa ta âmo cha vaw chho ta.
Achhyna o hyutuhpa cha chakaotuhpazy a chhipa ta vawh ta, zawpi ta alô ta ama vawh awpa ama chipa vâta, thachahra hmâ leipa ta lyuhchâpazy cha a vaw chhi ei ta.
Ama vaw tlôkhei nahta, ryureina hmiakô liata paduasa ei ta. Theihthai beichaipa ta âmo cha a padai ta,
“He moh heta pachu lei awpa bie cha pie ha pi ta, pachâ teh u, nama bie pachupa ta Zerusale nama pabie khai ha hih. He chyhsa thisaih maoh he eima chô liata patlôsa namâ chhuahpa a châ hih,” tah ta.
Pity nata lyuhchâpazy ta, “Chyhsa bie hlâta Khazohpa bie eima zyh via awpa a châ.
Nâmo ta tho liata khaipâpa ta nama thiepa Zisu kha, miah pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa ta a pathyu haw.
Izarei parosa ta, moleinazy a ngiahthai awpa ta, Khazohpa ta ano cha a chachâh lâta patyusa ta, Hyutuhpa nata Pachhatuhpa ta y awpa ta a cheihchalo haw.
Keimo he cha hmozy a pahnotuhpa châ pi ta, a bie a zyhpazy hnohta Khazohpa ta a piepa Thlahpa Pathaihpa chhao ta a pahno hra,” tahpa ta a chhy ei ta.
Cha biezy ama thei nahta, ama hie thata hâh ta, lyuhchâpazy cha thie a chhuah ei ta.
Châhrasala ryureituhpazy hry liata Phârisaih pakha, a moh Kâmalia ama tahpa, ryhpa pachutuhpa, chyhsa zydua ta ama zapa ta a kaw duah ta, lyuhchâpazy cha papua chy awpa ta biepie ta.
Ryureituhpazy hnohta, “Nâmo, Izarei mo saih u, he chyhsazy chô liata hmotao namâ chhuahpa liata a chado teh u.

Cha hlâna chhao khata Theudâ vaw pua ta, chyhsa peimawhpa a châpa ta a reih ta, chyhsa hluhpi, za palih rachhôh ta ano cha zi ei ta. Ano ama thie nahta, a zituhpa zydua cha pai khai ei ta, khâpa hmah châ khao veih ei.
Ano khai tawhta, maluhpi reina daihti liana kha, Kâlili chyhsa Zudâh vaw pua heih ta, ano lâta chyhsa hluhpi a sy heih hra. Ano chhao cha thi ta, a zituhpazy ama paipatla khai haw.
Chavâta tahmâ ei cha chho ei, he chyhsazy he hria khah u, âmo y ta y thlâh mawh ei sy. Amâ chhuahpa nata ama hmotaopa he chyhsapa tawhta a châ khiahta la, khâpa hmah châ aw vei.
Khazohpa tawhta a châ khiahta deikua cha, âmo he pahleipadia thei aw veih ei chi. Khazohpa a dyuhpa tlao nama châ aw!” tah ta.
A reipa cha pha tah ei ta, lyuhchâpazy cha aw ei ta, chhei ei ta, Zisu moh ta bie rei lei awpa ta biepie ei ta, ama pathlie haw.
Lyuhchâpazy cha ryureina tawhta pua ei ta, cha moh vâta maophyuhna a tao tlâhpa ta raopa ama châpa cha a ly ngaita ei ta.
Noh chareih Achhyna o liata nata o to tlypa ta, Zisu cha Mesia a châ tahpa bâh leipa ta pachu ei ta, ama chho lymâ.
Cha nohzy liata, pachupazy ama pôh via lymâ nahta, noh chareih ama hmo raipa liata ama nôhmeizy ama pachâ tyh leipa vâta, Krikâh Zuzy cha Hebraizy chô liata paphôh ei ta.
Pahrawh hleinozy ta pachupa zydua awpakhy ei ta, “Tlâhkhai liata chakaona peimawhpazy vâta, Khazohpa bie chho bâhsaipa pha aw vei.
Chavâta unawh saih u, nama hry liata Thlahpa nata sona ta a biepa, chyhsa moh phapa pasari a tlyh teh u, cha hmozy a pachâtuhpa châta âmo cha eima rao aw.
Keimo deikua cha thlahchhâna nata bie chho chakaona liata eima daihti eima hmâh aw,” tah ei ta.
Cha bie chata zawpi zydua palysa ta, ngiapâna nata Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta a biepa Stiphana nata Phili, Prôkôrâ, Nikanaw, Timô, Pâmenâ nata Zuzy phohlypa Antiôkâ khihpa Nikôla zy a tlyh ei ta.
Cha chyhsazy cha lyuhchâpazy hmiakô liata paduasa ei ta, ama chô liata ku pahniehpa ta, thlahchhâpa ei ta.
Chatawhcha Khazohpa bie cha pôh lymâ ta, pachupazy maluh cha Zerusale liata thata pôh ta, theihthaipa hluhpi chhao ta zo ei ta, amâ ngiapâ haw.
Stiphana cha ngiachhiena nata hmotaotheina ta bie ta, chyhsazy hry liata ngiana nata hmonoâhpa rônah ngaitapazy tao lymâ ta.
Sei Puapa sahlao pakhyna o ama tahpa tawhta chyhsa thokha, Kurini, Alezandria, Silisia nata Asia râhzy tawhta Zu chyhsazy vaw thyu ei ta, Stiphana bie cha vaw chakhia ei ta.
Châhrasala sona nata Thlahpa ta bie a reipazy cha ei thei leipa ei ta.
Arulâta chyhsazy pasyu ei ta, cha chyhsazy chata, “Mawsi nata Khazohpa a reipachhiena biezy eima thei,” tah ei ta.
Zawpizy, machâzy nata ryhpa pachutuhpazy pasyu ei ta, Stiphana cha tei ei ta, patupa ta, ryureina hmiakô liata a vaw chhi ei ta.
Pahnokheituh pakheipazy rao ei ta, âmo chata, “He chyhsa heta, bâh leipa ta he su pathaihpa nata ryhpa a reipachhie lymâ.
‘Nâzari Zisu ta, he su he parao aw ta, Mawsi ta ryhpa miah a piepazy a panano aw,’ tahpa a reipa eima thei,” tah ei ta.
Ryureina liata a tyuhpa zydua ta Stiphana cha moh ei ta, a hmia cha vâlyuhchâpa hmia hawhta hmô ei ta.
Theihthai beichaipa ta, “Cha biezy cha â do ma?” tah ta.
Stiphana ta, “Unawhzy nata pawzy saih u, na nathlie teh u. Miah pathlatuhpa Abarahâ kha Harânâ khih liata a y hlâ, Mesôpôtamia râh liata a y nona khata, rônahna Khazohpa ano lâ a vaw luah ta,
a hnohta, ‘Na râh nata na chiheihzy tawhta pua la, râh ei cha pahmô awpa lâ sie mah y,’ tah ta.
Chatanachata Kaldia râh tawhta pua ta, Harânâ khih liata pahrâ ta. A paw a thi tawhta, Khazohpa ta cha khih tawhta a chhi ta, tahmâ ta nama pahrâna râh lâ he pasiesa ta.
Châhrasala Khazohpa ta Abarahâ cha, he râh liata ryuto râh phei tlyna khi chhao pie leipa ta, saw a hnei lei tarawpa ta, a hnôhlâ ta a vaw pazi awpa a chipathla hnohta râh pie awpa ta bie a taih ta.
Cha kyh liata, Khazohpa ta Abarahâ hnohta a pathlazy maniah râh liata kô za palih sei ta y aw ei ta, riethei ama tao awpazie chho ta.
Châhrasala Khazohpa ta, ‘Sei châpa ta ama chakaopa phopi cha pachia aw na ta, cha khai tawhta kaw pua aw ei ta, he su liata eina chakao aw ei,’ tah ta.
Khazohpa ta Abarahâ cha chopawtaina biehrai pie ta. Abarahâ cha Aisika sa ta, a noh chariena noh ta a chopaw tai ta, Aisika ta Zakaw sa ta, Zakaw ta pathlatuhpa pahrawh hleinozy kha sa ta.
“Pathlatuhzy khata Zawsi chô liata ama hiatlia ta, Izi râh lâ zuah ei ta. Châhrasala Khazohpa a hnohta y ta,

a riethei taona zydua liata pachha lymâ ta, Izi bei Phiraoh hmiakô liata khokheina patosapa ta, sona ta tobi ta. Chatanachata Phiraoh ta Zawsi cha Izi râh chô liata ryureituhpa nata ano chhôhkha zydua chô liata ryureituhpa ta tao ta.
Izi nata Kâna râh zydua liata chakâhna tlô ta, ama riethei ngaita ta, miah pathlatuhpazy cha nie awpa rai hmô thei khao leipa ei ta.
Zakaw cha Izi râh liata sâh a ypa thâtih a thei nahta, miah pathlatuhpazy tuah ta, cha cha ama sie tua chaina a châ.
Ama sie ei nona liata, Zawsi ta a unawhzy cha a pahnosa ta, chatanachata Zawsi chhôhkha cha Phiraoh pahnopa châ ha ei ta.
Chatawhcha Zawsi ta a paw Zakaw nata a chhôhkha zydua kaw padysa ta, ama zydua ta sysari nata papangawh ama châ.
Zakaw cha Izi râh lâ zu ta, cha liata ano nata miah pathlatuhpazy cha thi ei ta,
Sekhe khih lâ ama ri phaoh ei ta, Abarahâ ta Sekhe khih liata Hamô sawchapawzy liata tâkâ ta thlâ su a chaleipa liata ama pabu.
“Khazohpa ta Abarahâ hnohta bie â taihpa a vaw tlô nawpa daihti â hnia nahta, Izarei sawzy cha Izi râh liata thata pôh ei ta, hluh via lymâ ei ta.
Zawsi a pahno leipa bei hropa Izi râh liata â vaw beina taihta pôh lymâ ei ta.
Cha bei cha eima chipho chô liata chhie ngaita ta, miah pathlatuhpazy cha ama hawsaihzy pahro lei awpa ta, tararuahna hmâpa ta pathysa lymâ ta.
Cha daihti liata Mawsi vaw pih ta, Khazohpa mohmô ta hmi pha kawpa châ ta. A paw o liata thla thôh mohôhpa a châ tawhta,
khôtho liata soh ei ta. Phiraoh sawchanô ta la ta, ano sawchapaw hawhta mohôh ta.
Mawsi cha Izi chyhsa sona zydua pachu ei ta, a bie nata a hmotaopa liata thatlô ngaitapa châ ta.
“Kô sypalih a tloh nahta, a unawh Izarei sawzy hmô khohna a palôh liata vaw y ta.
Izarei chyhsa pakha cha Izi chyhsa ta a taochhie haipa hmô ta, a chiheih cha a châhpa ta a phuh la ta, Izi chyhsa cha thie ha ta.
Mawsi cha ano ku ta Khazohpa ta Izarei sawzy a pachha ei tahpa a unawhzy ta ama pahno thai thlyu aw tahpa pachâ ta, châhrasala pahno thai leipa ei ta.
A mylâ ta chyhsa pano amâ tu hai nota kei tlô ta, âmo cha paryh a chhuah ta, ‘Pâpuh saih u, unawh nama châ khawh, khazia namâ tu?’ tah ta.
Châhrasala a opapa a tu ngâpa chata, Mawsi cha chatitha ta, ‘Eima chô liata hyutuhpa nata ryureituhpa ta ahy ma châ tao?
Zâhnia ta Izi chyhsa na thiepa hawhna khata ma thie ei nâ chhuah chi?’ tah ta.
Cha bie vâna chata Mawsi cha a râ ta, Midia râh liata mapaihpa ta y ta, cha liata sawchapaw pano sa ta.
“Kô sypalih a châ tawhta, Sinai Tlâh râhchawhpa thobuh liata, meipaleih hry liata vâlyuhchâpa a hnohta a vaw luah ta.
Mawsi ta a hmô nahta, a hmo hmôpa cha a noâh ngaita ta, mo awpa ta a kei hnia ta. Abeipa ao vaw pua ta,
‘Kei he châ pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa ei châ, Abarahâ Khazohpa, Aisika Khazohpa nata Zakaw Khazohpa ei châ,’ tah ta. Mawsi cha a chalyu ta, moh ngâh khao leipa ta.
Abeipa ta a hnohta, ‘Na phei tawhta na pheiky kha pahluh teh, nâ duana su kha alei pathaihpa a châ.
Izi râh liata ei phopi a ypazy rietheizie hmô na ta, amâ hrôna chhao ei thei haw. Chavâta âmo pachha awpa ta ei zu. A vy teh, Izi râh lâ ei cha tuah aw,’ tah ta.
“Kha Mawsi, ‘Hyutuhpa nata ryureituhpa ta ahy ma châ tao?’ tahpa ta ama dythapa kha, thobuh liata a hnohta a luahpa vâlyuhchâpa ku hmâpa ta, Khazohpa ta hyutuhpa nata pachhatuhpa châta vaw tuah ta.
Mawsi chata Izi râh liata zy, Tilaipi Saihpa liata zy, râhchawhpa liata zy, kô sypalih chhôh hmonoâhpa nata ngianazy taopa ta, Izarei sawzy a chhi papua ta.
Cha Mawsi cha Izarei sawzy hnohta, ‘Khazohpa ta keima hawhpa hrohsopa he nama unawhzy tawhta a cha paduapa aw ei,’ a tahtuhpa kha a châ.

Ano cha Sinai Tlâh liata ano bie â chhopa vâlyuhchâpa nata miah pathlatuhpazy chhaota râhchawhpa liata Izarei zawpi hnohta a ypa kha a châ. Miah pie pachhuah awpa ta bietapa hrohpazy a daotuhpa a châ.
Miah pathlatuhpazy ta a bie zyh khoh leipa ei ta, ano cha dytha ei ta, ama palôh ta Izi lâ kua ei ta.
Arawna hnohta, ‘Miah chhihtha awpa ta khazohzy miah taopa teh. He Mawsi, Izi râh tawhta miah a kaw chhi papuatuhpa he a thâtih pahno khao ma pi,’ tah ei ta.
Cha nohzy liata, viahchao taw nothlahpa tao ei ta, nothlahpa lâ cha atheihna hlâ ei ta, âmo ku ta taopa chô liata thapha ngaitapa ta y ei ta.

Chavâta Khazohpa ta âmo cha a heihsai ta, avâ liata awhsizy a chhy awpa ta âmo cha a siesai ha ei, hrohsopazy châbu liata, “‘Hy Izarei phopi, Râhchawhpa liata kô sypalih nama y chhôh ta, Sa thiepa nata atheihnazy eina hlâ ei chi ma?

A chhy awpa nothlahpazy tao ei chi ta, Môlôka achhyna byureih a sy ei chi ta, Nama Rephâ khazoh awhsi achhyna byureih namâ sy tyh; Chavâta Babylaw khô lâ ei cha paphao aw ei,’ tahpa ta ropa hawhna khata.
“Miah pathlatuhpazy khata Khazohpa achhyna byureih râhchawhpa liata hnei ei ta, Khazohpa ta taozie awpa Mawsi a chho nota, a nothlahpa a pahmôpa hawh tlai ta ama tao.

Cha achhyna byureih cha miah pathlatuhpazy pathla pachhuahpazy chhao ta chhy lymâ ei ta. Khazohpa ta miah pathlatuhpazy hmiakô liata phopizy papua ta, Zawsua chhaota râh ama kei pahrâ nona khata a ngiakhei ei ta. Cha achhyna byureih cha Dâvi daihti taihta y ta.
Dâvi cha Khazohpa modypa ta y ta, Zakaw Khazohpa pahrâ nawpa su hnei awpa ta hiah ta.
Khazohpa o cha Sawlawmaw ta tlao sa ta.
Châhrasala Chônôchaipa cha ku ta sapa ozy liata pahrâ vei, hrohsopa ta,
“‘Avâ cha ei beidyuchhai châ ta, Alei cha phei tlyna a châ. Kheihawhpa o ma eina sapa aw chi, Ei pahâna su chhao khâpa ma a châ?
He hmo zydua he keima ku ta taopa châ vei ma?’ tahpa ta a reipa hawhna khata.
“Nâmo, chyhsa chhorupa, palôh nata nakhaoh chopawtai leipazy saih u, Thlahpa Pathaihpa khâ a dyuh ei chi ta, châ pathlatuhpazy taopa hawhta, nâmo chhao nama tao hra.
Châ pathlatuhpazy ta ama taola leipa hrohsopa a y ma? Chyhsa Siapa a vy nawpa kyh a phuah chhieliepazy thiepa ta, cha Chyhsa Siapa a patusatuhpa nata a thietuhpazy cha nâmo he châ ei chi ta,
nâmo, vâlyuhchâpazy hmâpa ta piepa ryhpa hnei ta, a zyh khoh leipazy he nama châ,” tah ta.
Cha biezy cha ama thei nahta, ama pathi ia ngaita ta, Stiphana cha ama hâh charieh chie ei ta.
Châhrasala Stiphana cha Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta biepa ta, vârâh lâ sai ta, Khazohpa rônahna nata Khazohpa chachâh lâta Zisu â duahpa hmô ta.
“Moh teh u, vârâh a pahypa hmô na ta, Chyhsa Sawchapawpa cha Khazohpa chachâh lâta â duapa ei hmô” tah ta.
Chyhsazy cha ao paro ngaitapa ta awh ei ta, ama nah a chahu ei ta, â raohpa ta Stiphana cha a râhnao ei ta.
Khihpi khôtho lâ papua ei ta, alô ta vawh ei ta. Bie pahnotuhpazy ta satlia pakha, Sawla ama tahpa phei thaby liata ama pohzy soh ei ta.
Alô ta ama vaw hai nota, Stiphana cha awh ta, “Abeipa Zisu, ei thlahpa vaw dy mah y,” tah ta.
A pakhu paneih ta, ao paro ngaitapa ta, “Abeipa y, he ama moleina maoh he âmo paphaosa khah y,” tah ta. Cha bie cha a rei khai nahta, a mô ha ta.

Sawla chhao ta Stiphana ama thie awpa cha paryhsa ta. Cha noh tawhta, Zerusale liata Awnanopa cha taolana thata a tyh pathao ta. Lyuhchâpazy dei leipa cha, Zudia nata Samâri râhzy lâta paipatla khai ha ei ta.
Khazohpa a pachâpazy ta Stiphana cha pabu ei ta, a ri chô liata chaphôh thata tu ei ta.
Sawla deikua cha Awnanopa taola lymâ ta, o to a ngia ta, a chanô chapaw ta a daophi ta, patâhna o liata khô lymâ ta.
Paipatlapazy cha su to liata siepa ta, bie chho lymâ ei ta.
Phili cha Samâri khihpi lâ zu ta, ama hnohta Krista thâtih chho ta.
Hmonoâhpa a taopazy thei ei ta ama hmô nahta, zawpizy cha palôh miakha phaopa ta, Phili bie reipazy cha nathlie ei ta.
Thlahpa puapazy cha ao paro ngaitapa ta awhna chôta ama patupa chyhsa hluhpi chhôh tawhta vaw pua ei ta, asypa nata pheisypazy chhao patlâhpa châ ei ta.
Chatanachata cha khihpi liata alyna thata tlô ta.
Chyhsa pakha a moh Saimaw ama tahpa y ta. Ano cha dyu hmâpa ta, chyhsa rônahpa pakha hawhta a reih ta, Samâri khihsawzy noâh ngaitapa ta a vaw paysa tyhpa a châ.
Chyhsa zydua, hawti chaipa tawhta a lai chaipa taihta, “He chyhsa he Khazohpa hmotaotheina, Rônah ama tahpa kha a châ hih,” tah ei ta, a bie ama nathlie kaw tyh.
A dyu hmâpa ta bohpi noâh ngaitapa ta a vaw paysa hapa vâ ei ta, a bie ama nathlie kaw tyhpa a châ.
Phili ta Khazohpa khinarâh thâtihpha nata Zisu Krista moh a chhopa cha, Samâri mo ta a ngiapâ ei ta, a chanô chapaw ta bâti châ ei ta.
Saimaw chhao a ngiapâ ha hra ta, bâti a châ khai nahta, Phili hnohta y lymâ ta. Ngiana nata hmonoâhpa rônah ngaitapa a taopazy hmô ta, a noâh ngaita ta.
Zerusale liata a ypa lyuhchâpazy ta Samâri khih mo ta Khazohpa bie amâ ngiapâ hapa thâtih ama thei nahta, Pity nata Zawhâna cha âmo lâ tuah ei ta.
Pity nata Zawhâna cha zu ei ta, Samâri khih liata ngiapâtuhpazy cha Thlahpa Pathaihpa ama to thei nawpa ta thlahchhâpa ei ta.
Thlahpa Pathaihpa cha ahy chô liata hmah tlô mâh leipa ta, Abeipa Zisu moh ta bâti a châpa deita châ chy ei ta.
Lyuhchâpazy ta ama chô liata ama ku pahnieh ei ta, Thlahpa Pathaihpa hnei ha ei ta.
Lyuhchâpazy ku pahniehpa vâta Thlahpa Pathaihpa piepa a châ tahpa Saimaw ta a hmô nahta, lyuhchâpazy cha tâkâ pie ta,
“He hawhpa hmotaotheina he na pie hra teh u, ama chô liata ku ei pahniehpa maihta Thlahpa Pathaihpa a to hra nawpa ta,” tah ta.
Pity ta a hnohta, “Khazohpa hmopiepa cha tâkâ sôh ta chalei thei awpa ta na pachâpa vâta, na tâkâ cha na leidiana liata leidia hra mawh sy!
Na palôh phaozie Khazohpa hmiakô liata â doleipa vâta, he hmo liata a hlao hra leipa chi ta, tovyuh chhao hnei va chi.
Chavâta na moleina ro la, na palôh phaozie a châ ngiahthai thei nawpa ta, Abeipa lâ thlahchhâ mah y.
Ahaona châmaih ta bie chi ta, molei ta a cha chahry tahpa ei pahno,” tah ta.
Saimaw ta a chhy ta, “Nama bie reipa cha khâpa hmah ei chô liata a tlô lei nawpa ta, Abeipa lâ thlah na chhâpa teh u,” tah ta.
Pity nata Zawhâna cha Abeipa bie a châhkhei ei ta, ama chho khai nahta, Samâri râh khih hluhpi liata thâtihpha chho lymâna chôta, Zerusale lâ a lie ha ei ta.
Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa ta Phili cha bie a chho ta, “Thyu la, Zerusale tawhta Kâza lâ zuna lâpi, chho lâta râhchawhpa a chapiapa lâpi lâta sie teh,” tah ta.
Phili cha thyu ta, sie ta. Ethiôpia chyhsa pakha y ta. Ano cha Ethiôpia beinô Kandaki ry liata molaipa, hrilyupa châ ta, abeinô sôh mohôhtuhpa a châ. Khazohpa a chhy awpa ta Zerusale lâ khy ta.
A zâ liena lâta, a talailih liata atyuna chôta hrohsopa Isai châbu reih ta.
Thlahpa ta Phili hnohta, “Talailih lâ hao vawh la, a kei hnia teh,” tah ta.
Phili cha a kei râ ta, hrilyupa ta hrohsopa Isai châbu a rei haipa thei ta, a hnohta, “Na reipa kha a yzie na pahno ma?” tah ta.
Ano ta, “Ahy hmahta eina chhopasia leipa ei ta cha, kheihta ma a yzie ei pahno thei aw?” tah ta. Talailih lâ kiah ta, a hnohta a tyuh awpa ta Phili cha hrua ta.
He he Ethiôpia molaipa ta a reipa Biehrai cha a châ: “Thie awpa mietaku hawhta Ano cha a chhi ei ta, A hmi ngyutuhpa hmiakô liata Mietakutaw â chalih thlâh hapa hawhta, Ano chhao a pakah â vei.
Maoh paphyuhpa châ ta, Pachiana dopa pie veih ei. A pathlazy thâtih ahy a reih aw? A hrona khizaw tawhta la hapa châ tlôh ta.”
Hrilyupa ta Phili hnohta, “Ei cha hiahri tua aw, hrohsopa ta he biezy he ahy kyh ma a reih? Anosasyh kyh ma, mohropa kyh maw?” tah ta.
Phili cha a pakah â ta, cha Biehrai bie tawhta pathaopa ta, Hrilyupa cha Zisu thâtihpha chho ta.
Lâpi liata ama sie hai nota, ti yna tlô ei ta, hrilyupa ta, “Moh tua, he liata ti a y! Bâti châ awpa ta khâpa ma na pakhâ?” tah ta.
Phili ta a hnohta, “Na pathipalôh tlokhuh ta nâ ngiapâ khiahta cha, bâti na châ thei aw,” tah ta. Ano ta, “Zisu Krista cha Khazohpa Sawchapawpa a châ tahpa ei ngiapâ,” tah ta.
Talailih paduasa awpa ta biepie ta, Phili nata hrilyupa cha ama pano ta ti lâ zu ei ta, Phili ta hrilyupa cha bâti pachâsa ta.
Ti tawhta ama kaw pua nahta, Abeipa Thlahpa ta Phili cha a chhi ha ta, hrilyupa ta ano cha hmô khao leipa ta, thapha ngaitapa ta sie ha ta.
Phili cha Azôtu khih liata hmô ei ta, cha khih tawhta sie ta, Kaisarâ khih a tlôna taihta, khi to liata thâtihpha chho lymâ ta.
Sawla cha Abeipa pachupa sahlao pachhiparyna nata thie awpa kyhzy reih lymâ ta. Theihthai beichaipa lâ vawh ta,
Lâpi zyhna py liata chyhsa ahy rai a hmô khiah ei ta cha, a chapaw chanô ta chahrypa ta, Zerusale lâ â vaw chhi thei nawpa ei ta, Dâmaskâ pakhyna ozy liata pie awpa châzy hiah ta.
Sie ta, Dâmaskâ a tlô chy ta, avâ tawhta khaihpa ta a chheipâh liata eikhapi ta phu vaw khaih ta.
Alei liata pao ta, ao thei ta, ao chata a hnohta, “Sawla, Sawla, khazia eina taola chi?” tah ta.
Sawla ta, “Abeipa, ahy ma na châ?” tah ta. Ano ta, “Zisu, na taolapa kha ei châ.
Thyu la, khihpi liata a ngia teh, na tao awpa ama cha chho aw,” tah ta.
A hnohta a sie hrapazy ta ao cha thei ei ta, châhrasala chyhsa ahy hmah hmô leipa ei ta, noâhpa ta a duah ei ta.
Sawla cha alei tawhta kaw thyu ta, a mo vaw padeih ta, khâpa hmah hmô thei khao leipa ta. A ku ta chaao ei ta, Dâmaskâ lâ a chhi ei ta.
Noh thôh chhôh cha hmô thei leipa nata khâpa hmah niedoh leipa ta y ta.
Dâmaskâ liata pachupa pakha, a moh Anania ama tahpa y ta. Abeipa ta aluahna ta a hnohta, “Anania,” tah ta. Ano ta, “Abeipa, he liata ei y,” tah ta.
Abeipa ta a hnohta, “Thyu la, Lâpi Patlâpa ama tahpa lâ vawh la, Zudâh o liata Tarsâ khihpa, a moh Sawla ama tahpa kei tlua teh. Ano cha thlahchhâ hai ta,
chyhsa pakha a moh Anania ama tahpa a o lâ a vaw ngiapa ta, a mo pavâ nawpa ta a chô liata ku a pahniehpa kyh aluahna ta a hmô,” tah ta.
Anania ta a chhy ta, “Abeipa, cha chyhsa kyh cha chyhsa hluhpi tawhta ei thei mâh tâh. Zerusale liata na mopathaihpazy chô liata hmo chhiepa thata a taopa kha a châ.
He lia chhao ta, na moh a padopa zydua chahry theina biehneina theihthai beizy tawhta piepa a châ,” tah ta.
Châhrasala Abeipa ta a hnohta, “Vawh thlâh teh, ano cha Zenitaizy, abeizy nata Izarei sawzy lâta ei moh a ngiakheituhpa châ awpa ta, ei chhaichhi châta raopa a châ.
Ei moh vâta riethei khatlu ta ma a tao aw tahpa ei pahmôsa aw,” tah ta.

Anania cha pua ta, Sawla yna o liata a kei ngia ta. A chô liata a ku pahnieh ta, “Unawh Sawla, na mo pavâ nawpa nata Thlahpa Pathaihpa biepa ta na y thei nawpa ta, na vaw siena lâpi liata na hnohta a vaw luahpa Abeipa Zisu khata eina vaw tuah,” tah ta.
A mozy tawhta phuhlupa hawhta thlai za tla ta, a mo vaw pavâ ha ta. Chatawhcha thyu ta, bâti châ ta.
Pati nie ta, a tha vaw y ha ta. Sawla cha Dâmaskâ liata pachupazy hnohta, noh khazie tlyma y ta.
Sawla ta Zisu cha Khazohpa Sawchapawpa a châ tahpa pakhyna ozy liata thlai chho ta.

A bie a theipa zydua ta ama noâh kaw ta, “He chyhsa he Zerusale liata, he moh a padopazy a taola tyhpa kha châ vei mâ? Cha chyhsazy cha chahry ta, theihthai beizy lâ a chhi awpa ta, he lâ â vypa châ vei ma,” tah ei ta.
Sawla cha a thatlô via lymâ ta, Zisu cha Mesia a châ tahpa ta chhopasia ta, Dâmaskâ liata Zu chyhsa a ypazy cha cha-ohsa thlâh tyh ta.
Noh hluhpi a khô tawhta, Sawla thie awpa ta Zuzy cha a chhohia ei ta.
Châhrasala Sawla ta ama hmochhuahpa cha pahno ha ta. Thie awpa ta thokhy chhikao liata chhô nah zâ ta a byh ei ta.
Châhrasala a pachupazy ta Sawla cha zâ ta a chhi ei ta, thokhy opy lâ tawhta hrâbyh ta pathliah ei ta.
Sawla cha Zerusale a tlô nahta, pachupazy hnohta a pahlao awpa a chhuah ta. Pachupazy ta Sawla cha chi kaw ei ta, pachupa a châ hrapa cha zo leipa ei ta.

Bânabâ deikua ta ano cha a pyh ta, lyuhchâpazy lâ vawkhei ta, lâpi liata Abeipa hmô ta, Abeipa ta a hnohta bie â chhopa kyh zy, Dâmaskâ liata Zisu moh ta riahpha ngaitapa ta bie a chhopa kyh zy pachupazy hnohta reih ta.
Chatanachata Sawla cha Abeipa moh ta riahpha ngaitapa ta bie chhopa ta, Zerusale liata pachupazy hnohta a ngia heih, pua heih tahpa ta y ha hra ta.
Krikâh Zuzy hnohta bie reipa ta, ama biezy chakhia tyh ta. Krikâh Zuzy ta Sawla cha thie a chhuah ei ta.
Cha thâtih cha unawhzy ta ama pahno nahta, Kaisaria lâ zukhei ei ta, Tarsâ lâ pasiesa ha ei ta.

Chatanachata Awnanopa sahlaozy cha Zudia râh, Kâlili râh nata Samâri râh zydua liata a i via rilipa ta, thlalôhpa ta y ei ta. Abeipa china liata nata Thlahpa Pathaihpa thlapalôhna liata hroh ei ta, ama pôh via lymâ.
Pity cha khih zydua chahryh ta, Lydâ khih liata mopathaihpazy lâ zu ta.
Cha liata chyhsa pakha a moh Ainia ama tahpa, asypa vâta kô charie rakhô liata a zia hapa hmô ta.
Pity ta a hnohta, “Ainia, Zisu Krista ta a cha patlâh haw, thyu la na hmohphaw loh teh,” tah ta. Thlai thyu ha ta.
Lydâ mo nata Saraw mo zydua ta Ainia cha hmô ei ta, Abeipa lâ a heih ha ei ta.
Zôpâ liata Tâbi ama tahpa pachupa pakha y ta. A Krikâh moh cha Dawkâsi a châ. Cha chanô cha hmotao phapa nata hmopiepa ta chakaona kyh liata a piepasai ngaitapa châ ta.
Cha daihti liata Dawkâsi cha pasa ta, thi ha ta. A ngai ama pasi khai nahta, o chô chhôhpadâhpa liata pazia ei ta.
Lydâ khih cha Zôpâ khih kiapâh liata a ypa vâta, cha liata Pity a ypa pachupazy ta ama pahno nahta, ano lâ chyhsa pano tuah ei ta, a hnohta, “Hawh leipa ta keimo lâ a vy mah y,” tahpa ta a haw ei ta.

Pity cha thyu ta ama hnohta sie ta. O a tlô nahta, o chô chhôhpadâhpa lâ a chhi ei ta. Nôhmei zydua cha a kiapâh liata a duahpa ta, Dawkâsi a hro nota viahkao a biehpa nata chysia hropa a biehpazy pahmô ei ta, thata cha ei ta.
Pity ta ama zydua khôtho lâ papua ta, pakhu paneihpa ta thlahchhâ ta, athihpa ri lâ a heih ta, “Tâbi, thyu teh,” tah ta. Tâbi cha a mo vaw padeih ta, Pity a hmô nahta, a kaw tyuh ta.
Pity ta a ku hlâ ta, Tâbi cha pathyu ta. Mopathaihpazy nata nôhmeizy cha aw ta, Tâbi cha a hrohpa ta âmo pahmô ta.
Cha thâtih cha Zôpâ khih zydua ta pahno ei ta, chyhsa hluhpi ta Abeipa cha a ngiapâ ha ei ta.
Pity cha Zôpâ khih liata savo taotuhpa Saimaw o liata tlô ta, cha liata noh hluhpi châh ta.
Kaisaria liata Kawnilia ama tahpa chyhsa pakha y ta. Ano cha Rawma pheisaih Itali py ama tahpa liata pheisaih za kha hyutuhpa a châ.

Kawnilia cha Khazohpa a pachâpa chyhsa châ ta, a chhôhkha zydua chhao Khazohpa a chipa châ ei ta, chyhsa rietheipazy riapha ngaitapa ta baona a pie tyhpa châ ta, Khazohpa lâ thlah khâ a chhâ tyhpa a châ.
Zâlâ dawh thôh rachhôhpa liata, aluahna sia ngaitapa hmô ta. Khazohpa vâlyuhchâpa a o liata a vaw ngia ta, “Kawnilia,” vaw tah ta.
Kawnilia ta ano cha kei moh ta, chi ngaita ta, a hnohta, “Abeipa, khâpa maw?” tah ta. Vâlyuhchâpa ta a hnohta, “Na thlahchhânazy nata na hmopiepazy avâ lâ kiah ta, Khazohpa ta a pahno thlâh haw.
Tahmâ Zôpâ khih lâ chyhsa tuah la, chyhsa pakha Saimaw, Pity ama tahpa kei padysa mah y.
Savo taotuhpa Saimaw o liata tlô ta, a o cha tilaipi kiah liata a y,” tah ta.
Bie a chhotuhpa vâlyuhchâpa a sie nahta, Kawnilia cha a chakaotuhpazy hry liata chyhsa pano nata a vaituhpa pheisaihzy hry liata Khazohpa a pachâpa pheisaih pakha aw ta.
Bie zydua ama hnohta a chho khai nahta, âmo cha Zôpâ khih lâ tuah ta.
A mylâ ta, Kawnilia tuapa chyhsazy cha sie ei ta, khihpi ama tlô chy ta, Pity cha nohchhô locho ta thlahchhâ awpa ta vâphuh lâ kiah ta.
A nodi kaw ta, pati nie khoh ta, a nie awpa ama taopa hai nota, aluahna hmô ta.
Avâ a vaw pahy ta, poh lai ngaitapa a lyupa, ki palih ta buhpa alei lâ zâ pathliahpa hmô ta.
A chhôh liata phei palih a hneipa râhsa to, alyhpasa to nata avâ pavaw to y ei ta.
Ao vaw pua ta, a hnohta, “Pity, thyu la, thie la, nie teh,” tah ta.
Châhrasala Pity ta, “Abeipa, châ vei, ânapa nata pathaih leipa khâpa hmah nie beih va na,” tah ta.
A ei nona ta ao vaw pua heih ta, “Khazohpa ta a pathaisa hapa cha, nâma ta âna tah khah y,” tah ta.
Cha hawhna chata ei thôh vaw y ta, cha hmo cha avâ lâ chalopa ta y ha ta.
Pity ta aluahna a hmôpa cha a pachâ nawpa pahno leipa ta, nôpopa ta a y hai nota, Kawnilia vaw tuapa chyhsazy ta Saimaw o hiahripa ta, ochhi thaby liata a vaw duah ei ta,
cha liata Saimaw Pity a tlô ma, tahpa hiahri ei ta.
Pity cha aluahna kyh a pachâ hai nota, Thlahpa ta a hnohta, “Chyhsa pathôh ta ama cha tlua.
Thyu la, chô la, noraih leipa ta âmo pazi mah y, keima vaw tuapa ama châ,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Pity cha chyhsazy yna lâ za chô ta, ama hnohta, “Nama tluapa cha kei he ei châ. Khâpa ma namâ vyna chhâpa a châ?” tah ta.

Âmo ta, “Vâlyuhchâpa pathaihpa ta Kawnilia hnohta a luah ta, nâ cha vaw padysa ta, na biereipa a o liata nathlie awpa ta a chho. Ano cha pheisaih za kha hyutuhpa châ ta, chyhsa siapa nata Khazohpa a chipa, Zu phopi zydua ta ama reithaipa a châ,” tah ei ta.
Âmo cha aw ta, a o liata patlôsa ta. A mylâ ta Pity cha thyu ta, ama hnohta sie ta, Zôpâ khih liata unawh thokha chhao a hnohta sie hra ei ta.
A hânoh ta Kaisaria khih cha a ngia ei ta. Kawnilia cha a sanawh chhôhkha nata a viasa phapazy awpakhy ta, âmo cha vaw ydy ei ta.
Pity cha o â ngia chy ta, Kawnilia ta vaw dy ta, a phei thaby liata pao ta, a chhy ta.
Pity ta ano cha pathyu ta, “A duah teh, kei chhao nâ hawhta chyhsapa ei châ,” tah ta.
Pity cha Kawnilia bie a chhona chôta o chhôh lâ a ngia ta, chyhsa hluhpi a ypakhypazy cha hmô ta.

Ama hnohta, “Zu chyhsa châta chihropa chyhsa a pahlaopa nata a o liata chareipa cha ânapa hmo a chânazie nâmo chhao ta nama pahno. Châhrasala ahy hmah ânapa nata pathaih leipa ei tah awpa a châ leizie Khazohpa ta eina pahmôsa.
Chavâta eina vaw padysapa chi cha, reina hnei leipa ta a vypa ei châ. Cha hiahri tua ei sah la, khâpa vâta ma eina vaw padysa ei chi?” tah ta.

Kawnilia ta, “Noh palih a khô hapa liana khata, tahmâ daihti hawhpa taih he thlahchhâpa ta y na ta, zâlâ dawh thôhpa ta ei o liata thlah ei chhâ hai nota, chyhsa pakha poh diehpa a bupa ta ei hmiakô liata a vaw duah ta,
‘Kawnilia, na thlahchhâna kha theipa châ ta, na hmopiepazy chhao Khazohpa ta â thei.
Chavâta Zôpâ khih lâ chyhsa tuah la, Saimaw Pity ama tahpa kei padysa mah y. Ano cha tilaipi kiah liata savo taotuhpa Saimaw o liata a tlô,’ tah ta.

Chavâta thlai cha vaw padysa na ta, zawh a ngiah chi ta, nâ vy theipa he a lypa a châ kaw na. Abeipa ta bie a cha piepa zydua cha nathlie awpa ta, eima zydua heta Khazohpa hmiakô liata tahmâ eimâ vaw hmaoh,” tah ta.
Pity cha bie reih ta, “Khazohpa ta chyhsa khokhei eihpa a hnei leizie a siapa ta ei pahno haw.
Phopi to hry liata ahy rai ano a chipa nata hmo dopa a taopa maih cha Khazohpa ta â ly khai ei.
Khazohpa ta Izarei sawzy hnohta bie vaw tlôkhei ta, Zisu Krista hmâpa ta thlalôhna thâtihpha cha ama hnohta vaw tlôkhei tlai ta, châhrasala Zisu cha ato zydua Beipa a châ.
Zawhâna ta bâtina bie a chho khai nahta, Kâlili râh tawhta a thaopa ta, Zudia râh zydua liata hmo a tlôpa kyh kha nâmo chhao ta nama pahno.
Khazohpa ta Nâzari Zisu kha Thlahpa Pathaihpa nata hmotaotheina ta sathawthu ta, Khazohpa a hnohta a ypa vâta, hmopha taopa ta râh chahryh ta, ahripa taolapa zydua a patlâh lymâ.
Keimo he Zu khitawzy liata nata Zerusale khihpi liata Zisu hmotaopa zydua a pahnotuhpa eima châ. Ano cha tho liata pangiehpa ta thie ei ta.
Châhrasala Khazohpa ta ano cha, a noh thôhna noh ta pathyu ta, hmô theipa ta a paluahsa.
Chyhsa zydua hnohta a luah leipa ta, ano pahnokheituhpa châ awpa ta Khazohpa ta a raopa, athihpa hry tawhta a thyuheih tawhta a hnohta nie ta a dohpa, keimo hnoh deita ta â luah.
Ano cha athihpa nata ahrohpa pachia awpa ta Khazohpa ta a raopa a châzie a duakheipa ta, chyhsazy hnohta chho awpa ta bie miah a pie.
Hrohsopa zydua chhao ta, ahy rai ano a ngiapâpa maih cha, ano moh ta moleinazy a ngiahthaipa ama châ aw, tahpa ta ama vaw pahnokhei chhieliepa kha a châ,” tah ta.
Pity ta cha biezy cha a rei hai nota, bie a theituhpa zydua chô liata Thlahpa Pathaihpa vaw tlô ta.
Chopawtaipa sahlao hry liata Pity a vaw zipa ngiapâtuhpazy cha, Zenitaizy chô lia taihta Thlahpa Pathaihpa hmopiepa hrypa a châpa ama hmô nahta, ama noâh ngaita ta.
Reih thei leipazy ta bie reih ei ta, Khazohpa ama reithaipa vâta ama noâh ngaita ta. Pity ta,
“Keimo eima hneipa hawhta Thlahpa Pathaihpa a hneipa chyhsazy he ti ta bâti ama châ lei nawpa ta, ahy a pakhâ thei aw?” tah ta.
Chatanachata Zisu Krista moh ta bâti châ awpa ta biepie ta. Cha khai tawhta, noh khazie tlyma châh chy awpa ta a haw ei ta.
Zudia râh zydua liata lyuhchâpa nata unawh a ypazy ta, Zenitaizy chhao ta Khazohpa bie ama zyh haw tahpa pahno ei ta.
Chatanachata Pity cha Zerusale lâ a khy nahta, chopawtaipa sahlao ta ano cha reipachhie ei ta, a hnohta,
“Chopawtai leipazy o liata a ngia chi ta, ama hnohta pati zy nie chi ta,” tah ei ta.
Pity ta a thaby tawhta pathaopa ta âmo cha chhopasia ta:
“Zôpâ khihpi liata thlahchhâpa ta ei y nota, aluahna hmô na ta, poh lai ngaitapa a lyupa za chô ta, ki palih buhpa ta, avâ tawhta zâ pathliahpa ta, kei lâ a zu ta.
A phapa ta moh na ta, moh pasia na ta, phei palih a hneipa râhsazy, alyhpasazy, avâ pavawzy hmô na ta.
Chatawhcha ao thei na ta, ao chata ei hnoh ta, ‘Pity thyu la, thie la, nie teh,’ na tah ta.
Châhrasala kei ta, ‘Abeipa, châ vei, ânapa nata a pathaih leipa khâpa hmah ei pakah liata a ngia beih vei,’ tah na ta.
Châhrasala ao chata a ei nona ta nâ vaw chhy ta, ‘Khazohpa ta a pathaisa hapa cha, nâma ta âna tah khah y,’ tah ta.
Cha hawhna chata ei thôh vaw y ta, hmo to zydua cha avâ lâ chalo pakhua hapa a châ.
Cha daihti lia tlai chata eima yna o liata chyhsa pathôh vaw tlô ei ta, âmo cha keima dy awpa ta Kaisaria khih tawhta a vypa ama châ.
Thlahpa ta noraih leipa ta âmo cha zi awpa ta na chho ta. He unawh pacharuzy chhao he na sielâh hra ei ta, nâ vaw padysatuhpa chyhsa o liana cha a ngia pi ta.
Ano chata eima hnohta, a o liata vâlyuhchâpa a duahpa a hmônazie nata a hnohta, ‘Zôpâ khih lâ chyhsa tuah la, Saimaw Pity ama tahpa kei padysa mah y.
Ano ta bie cha chho aw ta, cha bie chata nâ nata na chhôhkhazy pachhapa ta nama y aw,’ a vaw tahpa kyh miah chho ta.
Bie cha reih pathao na ta, Thlahpa Pathaihpa eima chô liata a vaw tlô tua no hawhna khata, âmo chô lia chhao ta vaw tlô ta.
Chatawhcha Abeipa ta, ‘Zawhâna ta ti ta bâti pachâsa ta, châhrasala nâmo la Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta bâtipa nama châ aw,’ a tahpa bie kha a vaw thei na ta.

Cha hawhta, keimo Abeipa Zisu Krista eimâ ngiapâ nota Khazohpa ta miah a piepa hmopiepa cha, Khazohpa ta âmo a pie ha hra khiah ei ta cha, Khazohpa lâpi liata chybâlâkhâ châ awpa ta, kei he ahy ma ei châ?” tah ta.
Cha biezy cha ama thei nahta, a chalih ha ei ta. “Chata a châ khiahta cha, Khazohpa ta Zenitaizy chhao, ropa ta hroh awpa a pasai ha ei chuh,” tah ei ta, Khazohpa reithai ei ta.

Stiphana kyh vâta taolana amâ tyh nota a paipatlapazy kha Phônisia râh lâ zy, Kuparâ liahpahlô lâ zy, Antiôkâ khih lâ zy taihta sie ei ta, Zuzy hnoh dei leipa ta cha, ahy hnohta hmah bie chho leipa ei ta.
Ama hry liata thokha cha Kuparâ liahpahlô nata Kurini chyhsazy châ ei ta, cha chyhsazy chata Antiôkâ khih ama tlô nahta, Krikâh mo hnohta chhao bie reih ei ta, Abeipa Zisu thâtih chho ei ta.
Abeipa ku ta âmo cha a châhkhei ta, chyhsa hluhpi ta a ngiapâ ei ta, Abeipa lâ a heih ei ta.
Ama thâtih cha Zerusale liata Awnanopa nakhaoh liata a ngia ta, Bânabâ cha Antiôkâ lâ tuah ei ta.
Bânabâ cha Antiôkâ tlô ta, Khazohpa ngiachhiena raihria a hmô nahta, a ly ngaita ta, achhuahna a ipa hneipa ta, Abeipa châta ngâchhih awpa ta âmo cha pasyu ta.
Bânabâ cha chyhsa phapa châ ta, Thlahpa Pathaihpa nata ngiapâna ta a biepa a châ. Chatanachata chyhsa hluhpi Abeipa lâ baichhapa châ ei ta.
Bânabâ cha Sawla tlua awpa ta Tarsâ lâ sie ta.
A hmô nahta, Antiôkâ lâta a vaw chhi ta. Kô kha chhôh tlai Awnanopa apakhyna liata a hlao ei ta, chyhsa hluhpi ama pachu lymâ. Antiôkâ liana heta pachupazy cha Krizyhpazy tahpa ta aw tuapa ama châ.
Cha nohzy liata, hrohsopa thokha Zerusale tawhta Antiôkâ lâ zu ei ta.
Ama hry liata pakha a moh Akabâ ama tahpa a duah ta, Thlahpa pahnosapa ta khizaw zydua liata chakâh mozoh a tlô awpa kyh chhochhielie ta. Cha chakâhna cha Klaudia â bei nota a vaw tlôpa a châ.
Chatanachata pachupazy cha, ama tao theipa rakha chyu ta, Zudia râh liata unawh a ypazy lâ baona paphao a chhuah ei ta.
Amâ chhuahpa hawhna chata tao ei ta, machâzy lâta Bânabâ nata Sawla ku liata paphao ei ta.
Cha daihti rachhôh liata, Bei Herawda ta Awnanopa sahlao thokha chô liata a ku hypa ta taola ta.
Zawhâna unawhpa Zâmie cha zaozi ta thie ta.
Cha chata Zuzy a palysa tahpa a pahno nahta, Pity chhao patu a chhuah heih ta. Cha cha viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa kyhchhi nohzy liata a châ.
Herawdâ ta Pity cha patu ta, patâhna o liata khô ta, pheisaih papalih lymâ ta pavaisa ta. Zawpakhô khai tawhta zawpi hmiakô liata a thâtih pachia awpa a chhuah ta.
Chavâta Pity cha patâhna o liata paysa chypa châ ta, Awnanopa ta ano châta phahnai khoh ngaitapa ta Khazohpa lâ thlahchhâ ei ta.
Herawda ta a papua chy ta, cha zâ liana tlai chata, Pity cha pheisaih pano likawh ta, bâlia miano pakypa ta a mô ta. Vaituhpazy cha ochhi thaby liata ypa ta, patâhna o cha vaih ei ta.
Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa a kiapâh liata a vaw duah ta, patâhna o chhôh cha vaw khaih ta. Pity kâ liata kei chabaih ta, pahra ta, a hnohta, “Thyu para teh,” tah ta. Bâliazy cha a ku tawhta tla ha ta.
Vâlyuhchâpa ta a hnohta, “Na poh a bu la, na pheiky a ky teh,” tah ta. Pity ta cha hawhta tao ta. Vâlyuhchâpa ta a hnohta, “Na poh kha pakhâta ta a bu la, na zi teh,” tah ta.
Pity cha pua ta, zi ha ta. Vâlyuhchâpa hmotaopa cha a hmeiseihpa a châ tahpa pahno leipa ta, aluahna a hmôpa hawhta pachâ ta.

Vaituhpa tytuapa nata a pazipa ama khô tawhta, khihpi lâ puana thua ochhi kei tlô ei ta. Ochhi cha ama châta ano khota a vaw pahy ta, pua ei ta, khiliah liata ama sie hai nota, vâlyuhchâpa chata siesai ha ta.
Pity cha â vaw thei nahta, “Abeipa ta a vâlyuhchâpa za tuah ta, Herawda ku tawhta nata Zu chyhsazy achhuahna tawhta eina pachha haw, tahpa tahmâ a siapa ta ei pahno haw,” tah ta.
Hmo yzie a pahno pasia tawhta, Mâri o lâ vawh ta. Mâri cha Zawhâna Mâka ama tahpa nô châ ta, cha liata thlahchhâpa ta chyhsa hluhpi vaw ypakhy ei ta.
Aikah chhikao kei chakhyh ta, laihsa pakha, Rôdâ ama tahpa cha ochhi pahy awpa ta vawh ta.
Pity ao a châpa a pahnopa nahta, â ly tupa ta chhikao chhao pahy khao leipa ta, o chhôh lâ a râ ta, chhikao thaby liata Pity â duah thlâh ha tahpa kei reih ta.
Âmo ta a hnohta, “Na hru ha he,” vaw tah ei ta. Laihsa ta a hmeiseihpa a châzie khâchâ a pachyu ta, âmo ta, “A vâlyuhchâpa a châ chuh,” tah heih ei ta.
Châhrasala Pity ta chhikao cha chakhyh ngâ thlâh ha ta, ama pahy nahta, Pity cha hmô ei ta, ama noâh ngaita ta.
A chalih awpa ta a ku ta thliethlâ ta, Khazohpa ta patâhna o tawhta a papuanazie âmo cha chho ta. “Cha biezy cha Zâmie nata unawhzy kei chho teh u,” tah ta. Pity cha pua ta, su hro lâ sie ha ta.
Khih a vaw deipa nahta, pheisaihzy cha Pity khataih liata a y haw, tahpa ta thata a tyhreih ei ta.
Herawda ta Pity cha tlua ta, a hmô thei khao lei nahta, vaituhpazy kyh cha a chu pasiapa ta, âmo cha thie awpa ta biepie ta. Herawda cha Zudia tawhta Kaisaria lâ zu ta, cha liata y thlâh ha ta.

Herawda cha Tyre nata Sidaw mo chô liata a hiehâh kaw ta. Tyre mo nata Sidaw mo ta bei chakaotuhpa Blâstâ cha âmo chhâh a châ awpa ta ama viasa ta tao ei ta, reihkha tlapa ta, abei lâ a vy ei ta, aryhna tao awpa ta a haw ei ta. Ama râh cha niedo kyh liata abei râh chô liata a pahniehpa ama châpa vâta, aryhna cha amâ hawpa a châ.
Noh taipa noh ta, Herawda cha abei poh a bu ta, a beidyuchhai liata a tyuh ta, ama hnohta bie reih ta.
Zawpizy ta, “Khazoh ao a châ, chyhsapa ao châ vei!” tahpa ta awh ei ta.
Herawda cha Khazohpa hnohta palyupalihna a pie leipa vâta, eikhapi ta Abeipa vâlyuhchâpa ta vaw tu ta, alôpa ta nie ta, thi ha ta.
Khazohpa bie cha laiseih via rilipa ta, pôh lymâ ta.
Bânabâ nata Sawla cha chakaona rai ama hria khai tawhta, Zawhâna Mâka ama tahpa a chhi ei ta, Zerusale tawhta a lie ha ei ta.

Antiôkâ Awnanopa sahlaozy hry liata hrohsopazy nata pachutuhpazy y ei ta. Chazy cha Bânabâ zy, Nikâ ama tahpa Simeôna zy, Kurini khihpa Lukia zy, Bei Herawda unawh heihpa Manaina nata Sawla zy ama châ.
Abeipa a chhypa ta kâhvileipa ta ama y hai nota, Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta, “Bânabâ nata Sawla kha âmo ei awna chhâpa rai hria awpa ta na pananopa teh u,” tah ta.
Kâhvileipa ta thlah ama chhâ khai nahta, Bânabâ nata Sawla chô liata ama ku pahnieh ei ta, pasiesa ha ei ta.
Bânabâ nata Sawla cha Thlahpa Pathaihpa tuapa ta sie ei ta, Selukia khih lâ zu ei ta, cha tawhna chata Kuparâ liahpahlô lâ balyh ta sie ei ta.
Salâmi khih ama tlô nahta, Zuzy pakhyna ozy liata Khazohpa bie chho ei ta. Zawhâna chhao âmo bao awpa ta a chhi ei ta.
Liahpahlô zydua chahryh ei ta, Pafawsâ khih tlôna taihta sie ei ta. Cha liata dyuthaipa pakha a tyh ei ta, ano cha Zu chyhsa hrohso pakheipa, a moh Barzisu ama tahpa châ ta,
cha chyhsa cha râhvaotuhpa so kawpa Sâzia Pawla hnohta a ypa a châ. Khazohpa bie a thei khohpa vâta, Sâzia Pawla ta Bânabâ nata Sawla cha aw ta.
Châhrasala dyuthaipa Elaimâ ta râhvaotuhpa cha ngiapâna patleisa a chhuahpa ta, Bânabâ nata Sawla cha pakhâpadie ta. Elaimâ cha dyuthaipa tahna a châ.
Sawla, Pawla ama tah hrapa cha, Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta biepa ta, dyuthaipa cha moh pahroh ta,
a hnohta, “Nâ, ahripa sawchapawpa, nâ, siana khakhaipa, dôveina nata nôchhiena ta a biepa, Abeipa lâpi palâpa na pakosapa he bâh aw va chi mâ?

Chavâta tahmâ moh teh, Abeipa ku na chô liata tla ha ta, na mo chao aw ta, daihti khasâ chhôh ma cha noh khaihpa hmô aw va chi,” tah ta. Ameih nata zohna ta thlai vaw khu ta, chaaotuhpa tluapa ta pathâpazi ta.
Abeipa pachuna bie thei ta, hmo tlôpa a hmô nahta, râhvaotuhpa cha noâh tah kaw ta, â ngiapâ ha ta.
Pawla nata a sielâhpazy cha Pafawsâ tawhta balyh ta sie ei ta, Pamphulia râh liata Perkâ khih tlô ei ta. Zawhâna cha âmo siesaipa ta Zerusale lâ kua ha ta.
Pawla nata Bânabâ deikua cha Perkâ tawhta sie lymâ ei ta, Pisidia râh liata Antiôkâ khih tlô ei ta. Pahânoh ta pakhyna ozy liata a ngia ei ta, a tyuh ei ta.
Ryhpa châbu nata hrohsopazy châbu tawhta ama rei khai nahta, pakhyna o hyutuhpazy ta âmo lâ chyhsa tuah ei ta, “Unawh saih u, zawpi châta pasyuna bie nama hnei khiahta cha, reih teh u,” tah ei ta.
Pawla a kaw duah ta, a ku ta zie ta, bie reih ta, “Izarei chyhsazy nata Khazohpa a chipazy saih u, nathlie teh u.
He Izarei phopi Khazohpa heta miah pathlatuhpazy a tlyh ta, Izi râh liata ama y nona khata phopi rônahpa ta padua ta, cha tawhna chata bâh pazawhpa ta âmo cha chhi papua ta.
Kô sypalih chhôh tlai râhchawhpa liata âmo mohôh ta.
Kâna râh liata phopi mia sari a panawh khai tawhta, Kâna mo râh cha ama ryuto râh châta a pie ei.
Cha taih chata kô 450 a ryu. Cha khai tawhta Khazohpa ta Izarei sawzy cha ryureituhpazy pie tyh ta, Samuela kha ryureituhpa chhâna a châ.
Cha khai tawhta abei hiah ei ta, Khazohpa ta Benzami chi, Kisâ sawchapawpa Sawla cha ama bei ta pie ta, Sawla cha kô sypalih chhôh a bei ta.
Sawla a thy tawhta, Khazohpa ta Dâvi cha ama bei châta padua ta, Khazohpa ta, ‘Zese sawchapawpa Dâvi liata, ei palôh a phaohpa, ei khopa zydua a tao awpa ei hmô haw,’ tah ta.
Khazohpa ta a bietai hawhta, Dâvi chipathla Zisu cha Izarei pachhatuhpa châta padua ta.
Ano â vy hlâta, Zawhâna ta rona bâtina kyh Izarei phopi zydua hnohta vaw chho ha tua ta.

A raihria a patlô chy ta, Zawhâna ta, ‘Ahy châ aw sah la eina pangiasa ei chi? Ano cha châ va na. Moh teh u, ei hnôhlâ ta chyhsa pakha â vy hai, kei la a pheiky ri a pathlâ tlâh chhao châ va na,’” tah ta.
“Unawh saih u, Abarahâ pathla sawzy saih u, nama hry liata Khazohpa a chipa zydua saih u, he pachhana bie he keimo hnohta paphaopa eima châ.

Zerusale liata a ypazy nata ama ryureituhpazy ta ano cha pahno leipa ei ta, Pahânoh maihta rei tyhpa hrohsopazy bie chhao ama pahno leipa vâta, ano cha thailei pachâsapa ta, hrohsopazy bie ama patlôsapa a châ.
Thina tlâh a châpa thaileichâna ano liata ama hmô leipa chhao ta, thie awpa ta Pilâ liata a haw ei ta.
A thâtih ro chhieliepa zydua ama patlôsa khai nahta, tho tawhta la ei ta, thlâ liata pazia ei ta.
Châhrasala Khazohpa ta athihpa hry tawhta a pathyu haw.
Kâlili râh tawhta Zerusale lâ a hnohta a khy hrapazy hnohta noh hluhpi chhôh a luah ta, tahmâ âmo cha Izare phopi lâta a bie a pahnokheituhpazy ama châ.
Pathlatuhpazy hnohta Khazohpa ta bie â taihpa thâtihpha kha eima cha vaw chho hih.
Cha bietai cha Khazohpa ta Zisu a pathyuna liata, keimo ama pathlazy liata a vaw tlôpa a châ. Hlazy nuby mianona lia chhao ta, “‘Ei Sawchapawpa châ chi ta, Tanoh he na paw ei châ,’ tahpa ropa a châ.
Athihpa hry tawhta pathyupa ta, thu theipa lâta â lie heih khao lei awpa kyh liata chhao, Khazohpa ta, “‘Dâvi pathaihna nata byhnâzy Ei cha pie aw,’ tah ta.
Hla hropa liata chhao, “‘Na Mo Pathaihpa cha, A thuzao awpa pasaih aw va chi,’ tahpa ta a reih hra.
“Dâvi cha Khazohpa hmochhuahpazy ano chhâ liata a chakao khai tawhta, a mô ta, a pathlatuhpazy hnohta paziapa châ ta, a thuzao khai haw.
Khazohpa pathyupa deikua cha thuzao vei.
Chavâta unawh saih u, he hmo he pahno teh u, cha chyhsa vâta moleinazy ngiahthaina kyh nama hnohta phuahpa a châ hih.
Ahy rai a ngiapâpa maih cha ato liata thai pachâsapa ta ama y. Mawsi ryhpa ta la, chazy liata thai pachâsapa ta y thei veih ei chi.
Chavâta a hrohrua teh u, chataleipatala, hrohsopazy châbu ta,

“‘Nâmo, mohnaotuhpazy saih u, moh teh u, Nama noâh sala, leidia teh u; Nama hro chhôh ta hmo miakha tao na ta, Cha chho hra ei sala, Zo aw veih ei chi,’ tahpa ta a reipa biezy nama chô liata a vaw tlô pathlei aw na,” tah ta.
Ama pua nahta, cha biezy cha Pahânoh heihpa liata reih heih awpa ta zawpizy ta a haw ei ta.
Pakhyna a pai nahta, Zuzy nata Khazohpa a pachâpa Zu phohlypa hluhpi ta Pawla nata Bânabâ cha zi ei ta, âmo cha bie a chho ei ta, Khazohpa ngiachhiena liata y thlâh ha awpa ta pasyu ei ta.
Pahânoh heihpa liata, a khihpi rô ta Khazohpa bie nathlie awpa ta a vaw pakhy ei ta.
Zuzy ta zawpizy cha ama hmô nahta, hiatliana ta bie ei ta, Pawla bie reipa cha chakhiapa ta, reipachhie ei ta.

Pawla nata Bânabâ ta riahpha ngaitapa ta, “Khazohpa bie he nâmo liata rei tua chai awpa tlai châ ta, châhrasala dytha ei chi ta, chhâzaw hrona to tlâh châ lei awpa ta, nâmosasyh ta namâ tao ha hnohkua cha, pachâ teh u, Zenitaizy lâ eimâ heih ha aw.
Cha hawhta tao awpa ta Abeipa ta, “‘Khizaw kaokih chhâna taihta Pachhana tlôkhei awpa ta, Zenitaizy châta khaihna ta ei cha tao aw,’ tahpa ta bie miah a pie,” tah ei ta.
Cha biezy cha Zenitaizy ta ama thei nahta, a ly ngaita ei ta, Khazohpa bie cha parônahsa ei ta; chhâzaw hrona hnei awpa ta raopa hluhpizy cha a ngiapâ ha ei ta.
Abeipa bie cha cha râh zydua liata pathâh lymâ ta.
Zuzy ta chanô zachhihpa Khazohpa pachâpazy nata khih machâzy pasyu ei ta, Pawla nata Bânabâ cha pataolasa ei ta, ama râh tawhta papua ei ta.
Pawla nata Bânabâ ta âmo cha ama phei buchadoh chatho thlu ei ta, Ikônia khih lâ ama sie haw.
Chatanachata pachupazy cha alyna nata Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta bie ei ta.
Ikônia khih liata Zuzy pakhyna o liata ama pano ta a ngia ei ta, bie reih ei ta, Zu nata Krikâh chyhsa hluhpi ta a ngiapâ ei ta.
Ngiapâ khoh leipa Zuzy ta Zenitaizy pasyu ei ta, unawhzy cha pahaosa ei ta.
Abeipa liata riahpha ngaitapa ta bie reipa ta, cha liata bohpi y ei ta, Abeipa ta ngiana nata hmonoâhpazy ama ku ta pataosapa ta, a ngiachhiena bie ama reipa cha pahnokhei lymâ ta.
Khihpi zawpizy cha py no ta a pachhaih ei ta, py kha ta Zuzy cha a châh ei ta, py kha ta lyuhchâpazy a châh ei ta.
Zenitaizy, Zuzy nata ama ryureituhpazy ta lyuhchâpazy cha taochhiepa ta alô ta vaw a chhuah ei ta.
Cha kyh cha ama pahno nahta, lyuhchâpazy cha Lykônia râh liata Lystâ nata Derbe khihpizy nata a chheipâh khitawzy lâta a râ ei ta,
cha suzy liata thâtihpha chho lymâ ei ta.
Lystâ khih liata pheisypa pakha y ta. Pheisypa ta a pihpa châ ta, phei ta a sie beih leipa a châ.
Cha chyhsa chata Pawla bie reipa cha nathlie ta. Pawla ta ano cha a phapa ta moh ta, tlâh nawpa ta ngiapâna a hneipa pahno ta.
Ao paro ngaitapa ta a hnohta, “Na phei ta a duah teh,” tah ta. Ano cha kaw thyu ta, phei ta sie ha ta.
Zawpizy ta Pawla hmotaopa cha ama hmô nahta, Lykônia reih ta, ao paro ngaitapa ta, “Khazohzy ta chyhsapa hawhta keimo lâ amâ zu hih!” tah ei ta.
Bânabâ cha Zupitâ tah ei ta, Pawla cha bie a reihtuh chaipa a châpa vâta Merkuri tah ei ta.

Zupitâ achhyna o cha khihpi hawka liata y ta, Zupitâ theihthaipa ta viahchao tôhpazy nata pawpi pachhihzy thokhy chhikaozy lâ vaw cheih ta, ano nata zawpizy ta lyuhchâpazy lâ atheihna hlâ a chhuah ei ta.
Cha thâtih cha lyuhchâpa Bânabâ nata Pawla ta ama thei nahta, ama chysiazy hrie ei ta, zawpi lâ a râpa ta, awh ei ta,

“Pupa saih u, he hmozy he khazia nama tao? Keimo he nâmo nôchâ hawhpa a phaohpa chyhsapa eima châ hra. He hmo khâpa hraoleipazy he a heihsaipa ta, avâ nata alei nata tilaipi nata a chhôh liata a ypa zydua a taotuhpa Khazoh hrohpa lâ a heih awpa ta, nama hnohta thâtihpha eima vaw tlôkhei.
Hlâno daihtizy liata cha, phopi to âmo lâpi chyu a chhih awpa ta Khazohpa ta pasaih ta.
Chatahrasala a pahnokheituhpa y leipa ta y beih vei. Hmo phapa tao lymâpa ta, avâ tawhta vâsuazy nata kô pha kôzy cha pie ei ta, niepa nata alyna ta nama palôh a cha pabie tyh ei,” tah ei ta.
Cha biezy chata zawpizy cha âmo lâ atheihna hlâ lei awpa ta pakhâ thei lylia ei ta.
Antiôkâ nata Ikônia tawhta Zuzy vaw tlô ei ta, zawpizy cha pasyu ei ta, Pawla cha alô ta vawh ei ta, a thi hapa ta ama pangiasa vâta khihpi khôtho lâ a daophi ei ta.
Châhrasala pachupazy a kiapâh liata amâ vaw hmaoh nahta, vaw thyu ta, khihpi lâ a ngia heih ta, a mylâ ta Bânabâ nata Derbe khih lâ sie ei ta.
Derbe khihpi liata thâtihpha chho ei ta, pachupa hluhpi ama tao tawhta, Lystâ, Ikônia nata Antiôkâ lâ a lie ei ta.
Riethei hluhpi taopa ta Khazohpa khinarâh eimâ ngia awpa a châ, tahpa ta pachupazy palôh pa-ipa ta, ngiapâna liata y thlâh ha awpa ta thapatlô ei ta.
Awnanopa hlao to liata machâzy raopa ei ta, kâhvileipa ta thlahchhâpa ta, amâ ngiapâpa Abeipa liata ama pavaosa lymâ.
Pisidia râh ama chahryh khai tawhta, Pamphulia râh tlô ei ta.
Perkâ liata bie ama chho khai nahta, Atalia khih lâ zu ei ta.

Atalia tawhta balyh ta Antiôkâ lâ sie ei ta. Antiôkâ khih cha, ama rai hria awpa ta Khazohpa ngiachhiena liata pavaosapa ta ama yna khih kha châ ta, raihria ama patlô tawhta, cha khih lâ cha amâ lie heihpa a châ.
Ama tlô nahta, Awnanopa sahlaozy awpakhy ei ta, Khazohpa ta âmo hmâpa ta hmo a taopa zydua nata Zenitaizy châta ngiapâna ochhi a pahyzie zy chho ei ta.
Pachupazy hnohta bohpi y ei ta.
Chyhsa thokha Zudia râh tawhta a zu ei ta, “Mawsi ryhpa hawhta chopaw namâ tai leipa khiahta la, pachhapa châ thei aw veih ei chi,” tahpa ta unawhzy pachu ei ta.
Pawla nata Bânabâ cha âmo nata a hryupâpa ta thata a ei ei ta. Pawla nata Bânabâ cha unawh thokhazy chhaota, cha bie kyh vâna chata Zerusale liata lyuhchâpazy nata machâzy lâta khy awpa ta rao ei ta.
Awnanopa ta pathlie ei ta, Zenitaizy ama pipathina kyh chho lymâpa ta, Phônisia râh nata Samâri râh chahryh khai ei ta, cha thâtih chata unawh zydua palysa ngaita ta.
Zerusale ama tlô nahta, Awnanopa sahlaozy, lyuhchâpazy nata machâzy ta a vaw ly ei ta, Khazohpa ta âmo hmâpa ta hmo a taopa zydua cha chho ei ta.
Châhrasala Phârisaihzy py liata a ypa ngiapâtuhpa thokha ta a duah ei ta, “Zenitaizy cha ama chopaw tai thlyu awpa châ ta, Mawsi ryhpa zyh awpa ta biepie awpa a châ,” tah ei ta.
Cha bie cha pachâ awpa ta, lyuhchâpazy nata machâzy a hmaohpakhy ei ta.

Thata amâ ei tawhta, Pity a duah ta ama hnohta, “Unawh saih u, Zenitaizy ta keima pakah tawhta thâtihpha bie theipa ta a ngiapâ awpa ta, daihti hmiatuapa liana khata Khazohpa ta nâmo hry liata kei he eina raozie kha nama pahno.
Palôh pahnotuhpa Khazohpa ta Zenitaizy â pyh ei tahpa cha, keimo chô liata a taopa hawhta, âmo chhao Thlahpa Pathaihpa a pie hrapa liana heta a palâsa haw.
Keimo nata âmo likah panano leipa ta, ngiapâna ta ama pathipalôh a pathaisa ha ei.
Chavâta khazia ma, miah pathlatuhpazy nata keimo chhao ta eima pahnie leipa raopakypa cha, tahmâ pachupazy rao liata pahniepa ta Khazohpa chakhia namâ chhuah tly?
Keimo chhao, âmo chhao, Abeipa Zisu ngiachhiena vâta pachhapa ta eima y aw tahpa a ngiapâpa eima châ khai,” tah ta.
Chatanachata zawpi zydua cha a chalih ha ei ta, Bânabâ nata Pawla ta âmo hmâpa ta Khazohpa ta Zenitaizy hry liata ngiana nata hmonoâhpa a taopa kyh ama reipazy cha nathlie ei ta.
Âmo ama rei khai nahta, Zâmie ta reih ta, “Unawh saih u, ei bie nathlie teh u.
Khazohpa ta Zenitaizy hry tawhta ano moh a phaohpa phopi padua awpa ta, âmo lâ a tly tua nota thâtih kha Simeôna ta miah a chho haw.
Cha kyh cha hrohsopazy bie nata chhao a ryh ta, hrohsopazy ta,
“‘Cha khai tawhta kua aw na ta, Dâvi poh o a cho hapa kha Ei sa pathi heih aw; A raonazy sa pathi aw na ta, Ei paduapathi aw.
Chatanachata chyhsapa laibâhpazy ta Abeipa tlua aw ei ta, Ei moh a phaohpa Zenitai zydua ta Abeipa cha ama tlua aw, Abeipa ta a tah; Cha zydua taotuhpa,
Hlâno tawhta pahnopa Abeipa ta a tah,’ tahpa ta ama vaw chho haw.
Chavâta kei ta pha ei tahzie ta la, Khazohpa lâ a heihpa Zenitaizy he ama rie pathei lei awpa ei khoh.
Âmo lâ châ paphao sih la, nothlahpa achhyna hmo pathaih leipa niepa, apatlapa, paaosaopa nata thisaih niepa zy tao khao leipa ta bâhsai awpa ta chho ei sih la, â daihpa ta ei pahno.
Mawsi ryhpa he, hlâno tawhta khi to liata phuah tyhpa châ ta, Pahânoh maihta pakhyna ozy liata rei tyhpa a châpa kha,” tah ta.

Chatawhcha lyuhchâpazy, machâzy nata Awnanopa zydua ta ama hry tawhta chyhsa pano a tlyh ta, Pawla nata Bânabâ hnohta Antiôkâ lâ pasiesa awpa cha pha tah ei ta. Unawhzy hry liata hyutuh viapa Bâsabâ ama tahpa Zudâh nata Sila zy a tlyh ei ta.

Hetana heta châ roh ei ta, ama tuapazy ku liata ama paphao. “Nama unawhpa lyuhchâpazy nata machâzy ta, Antiôkâ khih nata Suria râh nata Silisia râhzy liata a ypa eima unawhpa Zenitai ngiapâtuhpazy eima châ naoh.
“Eima hry liata chyhsa thokha ta keimo biepie leipa ta nâmo lâ a zu ei ta, ama bie reipa ta cha patypamâ ei ta, noraihpa ta ama cha paysapa thâtih eima vaw thei.
Chavâta reihkha tlapa ta a hmaoh pi ta, chyhsazy a tlyh sih la, eima kho ngaitapa Bânabâ nata Pawla hnohta nâmo lâ za tua awpa a phapa ta eima pahno.
Bânabâ nata Pawla cha eima Beipa Zisu Krista moh vâta ama hrona a sokhâhpazy ama châ.
Chavâta Zudâh nata Sila za tuah pi ta, âmo ta hmo yzie pakah ta ama cha chho aw.
He hmo peimawhpazy dei leipa ta cha, phaohri hropa cha pavi lei awpa ta, Thlahpa Pathaihpa nata keimo ta a pha eima tah:
Nothlahpa lâ atheihna sa niepa, sa thisaih niepa, paaosaopa niepa nata apheina zy nama bâhsai awpa a phapa ta eima pahno. Chazy cha nama bâhsai khiahta cha, nama châta a pha aw. Atlâhpa ta.”
Chatanachata pasiesa ei ta. Antiôkâ ama tlô nahta, zawpi awpakhy ei ta, châ cha pie ei ta.
Châ cha reih ei ta, thlapalôhna bie vâta a ly ngaita ei ta.
Hrohsopa Zudâh nata hrohsopa Sila ta bie hluhpi ta unawhzy cha thlah palôhpa ta, thapatlô ei ta.
Cha liata khachâ rakha ma ama y tawhta, âmo a zâ tuahtuhpa lâta a lie awpa ta unawhzy ta thlalôhpa ta pasiesa ha ei ta.
Sila deikua cha, cha liata y chy awpa a phapa ta pahno ta.
Pawla nata Bânabâ chhao Antiôkâ liata y via chy ei ta, mohropa hluhpi chhaota Abeipa bie pachu ei ta, ama chho lymâ.
Noh khazie tlyma a khô tawhta, Pawla ta Bânabâ hnohta, “Sie heih sih la, Abeipa bie eima chhona khi to liata unawhzy kei tly laih sih la, khâpa ma ama lyu tahpa kei moh laih ei suh u,” tah ta.
Bânabâ ta Zawhâna Mâka a chhi khoh ta.
Pawla deikua ta Zawhâna Mâka cha Pamphulia râh tawhta âmo kuasai ta, ama hnohta raihriana lâ a sie khao leipa vâna khata, ano a chhi heih awpa cha pha tah khao leipa ta.
Thata a ei ei ta, amâ chhaih pâ haw. Bânabâ ta Mâka a chhipa ta Kuparâ liahpahlô lâ balyh ta sie ta.
Pawla deikua cha Sila a tlyh ta, unawhzy ta Abeipa ngiachhiena liata ama pavaosa khai nahta sie ei ta.
Suria nata Silisia râhzy chahryh ta, Awnanopazy thapatlô lymâ ta.
Pawla cha Derbe nata Lystâ lâzy chhao sie ta. Cha liata Timawthy ama tahpa pachupa pakha y ta. Timawthy cha Zu chanô ngiapâtuhpa sawchapaw châ ta, a paw deikua cha Krikâh chyhsa a châ.
Lystâ nata Ikônia liata unawhzy ta ano cha reithai kaw ei ta.

Pawla ta Timawthy cha a hnohta sie hra awpa khoh ta. Cha suzy liata a ypa Zuzy ta Timawthy paw cha Krikâh chyhsa a châpa ama pahno khaipa vâta, Zuzy vâna chata Pawla ta Timawthy cha a chhi ta, a chopaw pataisa ta.
Khihpizy chahryh ei ta, Zerusale liata lyuhchâpazy nata machâzy biepathlupa kha zyh awpa ta unawhzy ama chho lymâ.
Chatanachata Awnanopazy cha ngiapâna liata thapatlôpa ta y ei ta, noh charei ta pôh via lymâ ei ta.
Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta Asia râh liata bie chho awpa a pakhâ hapa vâta, Pharuzia nata Kalatia râhzy chahry ei ta.
Mysia râh ama tlô nahta, Bithunia râh liata a ngia a chhuah ei ta, châhrasala Zisu Thlahpa ta pasai leipa ta.
Mysia râh cha siepahlie ei ta, Tarôsa khih lâ zu ei ta.
Zâ ta Pawla ta aluahna hmô ta. Mâsidônia chyhsa pakha a vaw duah thlâh ha ta, ano chata, “Masidônia râh lâ a vy la, miah vaw bao teh,” tahpa ta a haw ta.
Cha aluahna cha Pawla ta a hmô nahta, ama hnohta Thâtihpha chho awpa ta Khazohpa ta miah a aw tahpa pahno pi ta, chatanachata Mâsidônia râh lâ cha thlai sie a chhuah pi ta.
Tarôsa tawhta balyh ta pua pi ta, Samôthe khihpi lâ palâh pi ta, a mylâ ta Nipôli khihpi lâ sie pi ta.
Cha tawhna chata Philipi lâ sie pi ta. Philipi cha Mâsidônia râh liata khihpi peimawhpa châ ta, Rawma a vaopa khihpi a châ. Cha khihpi liata noh khazie tlyma châh pi ta.
Pahânoh ta thokhy chhikao khôtho lâ pua pi ta, chavah kiah liata thlahchhâna su a châ awpa ta eima pangiasapa lâ zu pi ta, a tyuh pi ta, chanô a vy pakhypa sahlaozy hnohta bie reih pi ta.

Eima bie a theipazy hry liata pakha cha, Thiatirâ zuah Lydia ama tahpa a châ. Ano cha poh nohsaihpa a zuahpa châ ta, Khazohpa a chhytuhpa chanô a châ. Pawla bie reipa a phapa ta pachâ awpa ta Abeipa ta a palôh pahy ta.

Ano nata a chhôhkhazy bâti ama châ khai nahta, eima hnohta, “Abeipa châta ngâchhihpa ta eina rao khiah ei chi ta la, ei o lâ a vy u la, vaw tlô teh u,” tahpa ta miah a haw ta. Chatanachata miah thlyu ha ta.
Thlahchhâna su lâ eima sie nota, sei laihsa pakha ta miah a vaw tyh ta. Ano cha pachaothaina thlahpa a hneipa châ ta, pachaona bie a reipazy tawhta a zibeipa châta sôh hluhpi a hmô tyhpa a châ.
Cha chanô chata Pawla nata keimo miah zi ta, “He chyhsazy he Chônôchai Khazohpa chakaotuhpazy ama châ, pachhana lâpi ama cha vaw chho hih,” tahpa ta awh ta.

Cha hawhna chata noh hluhpi tao ta. Pawla cha a palôh châ khao leipa ta, a heih ta, thlahpa hnohna chata, “A chhôh tawhta pua awpa ta, Zisu Krista moh ta bie ei cha pie,” tah ta. Cha dawh lia tlai chata pua ha ta.
A zibeipazy ta ama sôh hmôna a lei haw tahpa ama pahno nahta, Pawla nata Sila cha patu ei ta, sôhdao su liata ryureituhpazy hmiakô lâ a daophi ei ta.
Bie pachiatuhpazy lâ a chhi ei ta, “He chyhsazy he Zuzy châ ei ta, eima khihpi he ama patypamâ ngaita.
Keimo Rawma chyhsazy châta ânapa nata tao pasai leipa ryhpazy ama pachu lymâ,” tah ei ta.
Zawpizy chhao vaw pua ei ta, lyuhchâpazy cha a vaw dyuh hra ei ta. Bie pachiapatuhpazy ta lyuhchâpazy cha ama pohzy hrie ta, sôsi ta tu awpa ta biepie ei ta.
Ei hluhpi ama chhei khai tawhta, patâhna o liata khô ei ta, patâhna o vaituhpa hnohta â bohpa ta vaih awpa ta biepie ei ta.
Cha tlatlu ta ama biepiepa â ipa vâna chata, âmo cha patâhna chhôh chaipa liata khô ta, ama pheizy liata keihrai dai ta.
Zâcho ta Pawla nata Sila cha Khazohpa lâ thlahchhâpa ta hlazy sa ei ta, atâhpazy ta nathlie ei ta.
Eikhapi ta alo thata a vaw sih ta, patâhna o abônazy taihta a vaw chalyu ta. Ochhi zydua thlai a vaw pahy ta, atâhpazy keihrai cha a vaw pathlâ khai ha ta.
Patâhna o vaituhpa cha â môpa a vaw hra ta, patâhna o ochhi a pahypazy cha hmô ta, atâhpazy cha amâ râ ha khiah ma tah ta, a zaozi phia ta a thie a chhuah ta.
Pawla cha ao paro ngaitapa ta awh ta, “Kheihta hmah a pasasa khah y, eima zydua ta eima y khai thlâh haw!” tah ta.
Patâhna o vaituhpa cha meiôh pado ta, thlai a ngia ta, chipa ta a chalyuna chôta Pawla nata Sila hmiakô liata â khu lâta pao ta.
Âmo cha puakhei ta, “Pâpuh saih u, pachha ei châ thei nawpa ta khâpa ei tao aw?” tah ta.
Âmo ta, “Abeipa Zisu a ngiapâ la, pachhapa ta na y aw, nâ nata na chhôhkhazy chhaota,” tah ei ta.
Chatawhcha ano hnohta nata a o liata a ypa zydua hnohta Abeipa bie chho ei ta.
Zâcho ta âmo cha a chhi ta, ama chheina hmahzy cha pasi ta, ano nata a chhôhkhazy cha bâti châ ha ei ta.
Lyuhchâpazy cha a o lâ a chhi ta, âmo châta pati taopa ta, Khazohpa amâ ngiapâ hapa vâta ano nata a chhôhkha zydua ta a ly ngaita ei ta.
Noh a vaw chhi nahta, bie pachiatuhpazy ta, “Kha chyhsazy kha papua teh,” tahpa ta pheisaihzy tuah ei ta.
Cha bie cha patâhna o vaituhpa ta, Pawla chho ta, “Cha papua awpa ta, bie pachiatuhpazy ta chyhsa ama vaw tuah. Chavâta tahmâ vaw pua u la, thlalôhpa ta sie teh u,” tah ta.

Châhrasala Pawla ta pheisaihzy hnohta, “Rawma chyhsa châ pi ta, thailei a châpa chhao châ leipa pi ta, vâtlâh mohmô ta miah chhei ei ta, patâhna o liata miah khô ei ta, tahmâ arulâta papua awpa zua miah amâ chhuah mâ? Châ bao va! Âmo tlai ta a vy ei sala, miah vaw papua mawh ei sy,” tah ta.
Cha biezy cha pheisaihzy ta bie pachiatuhpazy hnohta tlôkhei ei ta, Rawma chyhsa ama châpa ama pahno nahta, chi kaw ei ta.
Vawh ei ta, reihpha cheih ei ta, papua ei ta, khihpi puasai awpa ta a haw ei ta.
Pawla nata Sila cha patâhna o tawhta pua ei ta, Lydia kei tly ei ta. Cha liata unawhzy hmô ei ta, thlah ama palôh khai nahta, sie ha ei ta.
Amphipôli nata Apôlônia khihpizy chapiapa ta Thysalawnika khihpi tlô ei ta, cha liata Zuzy pakhyna o y ta.
Pawla cha a taozietyhpa hawhta a pakhy hra ta, Pahânoh ei thôh Biehrai pakhâta ta âmo a laichadaikhei ta.
Mesia cha riethei a tao awpa a châna nata athihpa hry tawhta a thyu heih awpa kyhzy chhopasiapa ta, pahmô pasiasa tyh ta, “He Zisu, a thâtih ei cha chhopa ei he, Mesia cha a châ,” tah ta.
Chatanachata ama hry liata thokha cha pahniepa châ ei ta, Pawla nata Sila cha a pahlao ha ei ta, Khazohpa a pachâpa Krikâh chyhsa hluhpi nata chanô zachhihpa hluhpi chhao ta a ngiapâ ha ei ta.

Zuzy deikua cha ama hiatlia ta, sôhdaohna su liata moleipa thathipazy pakhy ei ta, zawpi pahmaohpa ta khihpi zydua patypamâ ei ta. Lyuhchâpazy cha zawpi lâ a chhi a chhuahpa ta, Zasaw o liata a ngiahnao ei ta.

Châhrasala lyuhchâpazy cha hmô leipa ei ta, Zasaw nata unawh hropa thokhazy cha khihpi biehneituhpazy lâ a daophi ei ta, “He sahlao, khizaw a palie patheih khai hapazy heta, he lâ chhao vaw tlô ei ta.
Zasaw heta a o liata patlôsa ei ta, ‘Zisu ama tahpa bei hropa a y,’ tah ei ta, ama zydua ta Kaisarâ chakhiapa ta hmo ama tao,” tahpa ta awh ei ta.
Cha biezy cha ama thei nahta, zawpi nata khihpi biehneituhpazy cha a tymâ ngaita ei ta.
Zasaw nata mohropazy tawhta amâ cheikâna sôh ama la khai nahta, pathlie ha ei ta.
Unawhzy ta azo ta Pawla nata Sila cha Beria khih lâ thlai pasiesa ei ta, ama kei tlô nahta, Zuzy pakhyna o liata a ngia ei ta.
Beria mo cha Thysalawnika mo hlâta pha via ei ta, pahâ ngaitapa ta bie cha dao ei ta, ama reipa cha â do nata do lei pasia nawpa ta noh chareih ta Biehrai a chu pasia tyhpa ama châ.
Chavâta chyhsa hluhpi ta a ngiapâ ei ta, Krikâh chanô zachhihpazy nata chapawzy chhao ta amâ ngiapâ ha hra.
Thysalawnika liata Zuzy ta Pawla cha Beria lia chhao ta Khazohpa bie a chho tahpa ama thei nahta, cha lâ chhao cha vawh ei ta, zawpizy hnapaona bie reipa ta pasyu ei ta.
Chavâta Pawla cha pasiesa ha awpa ta unawhzy ta tilaipi lâ thlai siekhei ei ta. Sila nata Timawthy deikua cha, cha liata y pazao ei ta.

A pathlietuhpazy ta Pawla cha Atheni taih kei pathlie ei ta. Sila nata Timawthy cha a chatlie thei chaipa hawhta ano lâ a vy awpa ta Pawla tawhta biepiepa phaopa ta, a vaw pathlietuhpazy cha a lie ha ei ta.
Pawla cha Atheni liata Sila nata Timawthy a hâ chhôhta, khihpi cha khazoh nothlahpa ta a bie thlâh hapa hmô ta, a palôh pasa ngaita ta.
Chatanachata pakhyna o liata Zuzy nata Khazohpa a pachâpazy cha Biehrai a laichadaikhei tyh ta, sôdaohna su liata a ypazy chhao noh chareih ta Biehrai â laichadaikhei tyh ei.

Epikuria nata Stôika chyhsa sopa thokhazy chhao Pawla cha a dyuh ei ta. Thokha ta, “He reih hluhpa heta khâpa ma rei â chhuah?” tah ei ta. Thokha ta Zisu kyh nata thyuheihna kyh a reipa vâta, “Chihropa khazohzy biechhotuhpa a châ ei aw,” tah ei ta.
Pawla cha a chhi ei ta, Areôpaku lâ vawkhei ei ta, a hnohta, “He pachuna thiehpa na rei tyhpa he khâpa ma a châ tahpa miah na chho thei aw ma?
Hmo nano kawpazy eima nakhaoh liata na vaw tlôkhei. Chavâta he hmozy yzie he eima pahno khoh,” tah ei ta.
Atheni mo zydua nata cha liata a ypa chihropazy cha, hmo hropa tao leipa ta, hmo thiehpa reipa nata nathliena liata ama daihtizy a hmâh tyhpa ama châ.
Pawla cha Areôpaku liah khophie liata a duah ta, “Nâmo, Atheni mo saih u, ato liata zyhna kyh a pachâ peimawh ngaitapa nama châ tahpa ei pahno.
Ei chareina liata, namâ chhypazy moh na ta, maisâh miakha, a chô liata, ‘Pahno leipa Khazohpa châta,’ tahpa ropa ei hmô. Pahno leipa ta namâ chhy tyhpa, cha Khazohpa thâtih cha ei cha vaw chho ei.
Khizaw nata a chhôh liata hmo a ypa zydua a taotuhpa Khazohpa cha, alei nata avâ Beipa a châpa vâta, ku ta sapa achhyna ozy liata pahrâ vei.
Hmo a phahlapa hawhta, chyhsapa ku ta chakao a ngiahpa châ hra vei. Ano tlai cha chyhsa zydua hnohta hrona nata husona nata hmo zydua a pietuhpa tlao a châ.
Alei chô zydua liata pahrâ awpa ta, chyhsa pakha tawhta phopi to tao ta, ama châta daihtizy rao ta, ama y nawpa râhrizy a pakhâh.
Khazohpa tluapa ta, a kô daih ei sala, ama hmô lylia thei nawpa ta, cha hawhta a taopa a châ. Ano cha keimo tawhta a hla vei.
“Ano vâta hroh pi ta, A pielyu pi ta, Eima ypa a châ.” Nama hlaphôh phi thaipa thokha chhao ta, “‘Keimo chhao he, A pathlazy eima châ,’ tahpa ta ama reih hra.
“Khazohpa pathla eima châ tlôh khiahta cha, Khazohpa cha ngôh tlyma, tâkâ tlyma, alô tlyma, chyhsa patuapaluapa nata zôthaipa ta taopa nothlahpa hawhpa he khiah ma, tahpa ta eima pachâ awpa châ vei.
Pahno leina daihtizy kha cha Khazohpa ta pahno lei â pachâ tyh, tahmâ deikua cha su to liata chyhsa zydua ro awpa ta bie a pie haw.

Ano ta â tlyhpa hmâpa ta, siana ta khizaw a pachia nawpa noh a rao haw. Â tlyhpa chyhsa cha athihpa hry tawhta a pathyuna liata, pachiana a y tlai awpa a châzie chyhsa zydua hnohta a pa-i haw,” tah ta.
Athihpa thyuheihna kyh ama thei nahta, thokha ta pahneisao ei ta, ahropazy ta, “Cha kyh cha nâma tawhta eima nathlie heih aw,” tah ei ta.
Chatawhcha Pawla cha ama hry tawhta pua ha ta.
Chyhsa thokha cha Pawla a pahlaopa ta a ngiapâ ha ei ta. Chazy hry liata Areôpaku chyhsa Diônesia nata Dâmâri ama tahpa chanô pakha a hlao ei ta, mohropazy chhao amâ hlao.
Cha hmozy hnôhlâ ta, Pawla cha Atheni tawhta pua ta, Kawrini lâ sie ta.

Cha liata Akuilâ ama tahpa Zu chyhsa pakha hmô ta. Cha chyhsa cha Pawntu râh liata a pihpa châ ta, Klaudia ta Zu chyhsa zydua Rawma khih tawhta pua awpa ta bie a piepa vâta, a lapinô Priskilâ nata Itali râh tawhta atlia ta a vaw tlôpa ama châ. Pawla cha âmo a hmô awpa ta vawh ta.
Pawla nata Akuilâ chhôhkha he poh o a taopa châ chyu ei ta, ama raihria â lyupa vâta, Pawla cha Akuilâ nata Priskilâ o liata tlô ta, rai a hriakhei tyh ei.
Pahânoh maihta pakhyna o liata bie reih tyh ta, Zuzy nata Krikâhzy pahnie â chhuah tyh.
