Mâsidônia tawhta Sila nata Timawthy ama vaw tlô nahta, Pawla cha biechho chakaona liata a hmâh hluh via ta, Zisu kha Mesia a châ tahpa ta Zuzy hnohta â châhkhei tyh.

Châhrasala Zuzy ta a dyuh ei ta, ama reipachhie nahta, Pawla cha a poh chatho ta, ama hnohta, “Nama thisaih maoh cha nâmo luh liata y mawh sy! Kei deikua la, ei pathaih. Tahmâ tawhta la, Zenitaizy lâ ei sie aw,” tah ta.
Cha tawhtapa cha pua ta, Titu Zustâ ama tahpa, Khazohpa a chhy tyhpa o liata a ngia ta. A o chhao pakhyna o kiapâh liata a ypa a châ.
Pakhyna o hyutuhpa Krispâ nata a chhôhkha zydua cha Abeipa a ngiapâ ha ei ta. Kawrini mo hluhpi chhao ta, Pawla biereipa ama thei nahta, a ngiapâpa ta, bâti châ ei ta.
Zâ kha cha Pawla ta aluahna hmô ta, Abeipa ta a hnohta, “Chi leipa la, a chalih leipa ta bie reih lymâ mah y.
Na hnohta ei y mâh tâh, cha pasasa awpa ta ahy hmahta na chô liata ama ku hy aw veih ei, he khihpi liata chyhsa hluhpi ei hnei,” tah ta.
Pawla cha ama hry liata Khazohpa bie pachupa ta, cha liata kô kha nata thla charu y ta.
Kâliô cha Akai râhvaotuhpa a châ nota, Zuzy cha a paraohpa ta Pawla tei ei ta, ryureina hmiakô lâ a chhi ei ta.
“He chyhsa heta ryhpa chakhiapa ta, Khazohpa a chhy awpa ta chyhsazy a pasyu ei,” tah ei ta.
Pawla cha bie rei awpa â chhuah hai nota, Kâliô ta Zuzy hnohta, “Zuzy saih u, hmo doleipa kyh tlyma, hmo paraopa kyh tlyma châ sala cha, nama leihna he ei pachâ awpa tlai a châ.
Châhrasala biezy, mohzy nata nama ryhpa kyhzy a châpa vâta, nâmo ta pachia thlâh ha teh u. Kei la, cha hawhpa kyh liata pachiatuhpa châ awpa khoh va na,” tah ta.
Chatanachata ryureina tawhta âmo cha papua ha ta.
Ama zydua ta pakhyna o hyutuhpa Sôsthene cha patu ei ta, ryureina hmiakô liata chhei ei ta. Châhrasala Kâliô ta ama hmotaopa cha uasa a chhuah hlei vei.

Cha hnôhlâ ta, Pawla cha Kawrini liata bohpi y via ta, cha khai tawhta unawhzy cha reih phapa ta a chhaih ta, cha tawhna chata Suria râh lâ balyh ta sie ta. Priskilâ nata Akuilâ chhao a hnohta sie hra ei ta. Pawla cha a bietai a patlô hapa vâta, Kenkaria khih liata a sâ a ngyu ta.
Ephesi khih tlô ei ta, cha liata âmo cha siesai ta. Pawla deikua cha pakhyna o liata a ngia ta, Zuzy cha Biehrai a laichadaikhei ta.
Châh chy awpa ta a haw ei ta, châhrasala paryhsa leipa ta.
“Khazohpa ta a pasaih khiahta cha, nâmo lâ ei vy heih aw,” tahpa ta reih phapa ta âmo cha siesai ta, Ephesi tawhta balyh ta sie ha ta.
Kaisaria liata balyh â pahâ nota, Zerusale lâ Awnanopa a kaw naoh ta, cha khai tawhta Antiôkâ lâ zu ta.
Cha liata khachâ rakha tlyma a y tawhta, sie heih ta, pachupa sahlao zydua thapatlô laihpa ta, Kalatia râh nata Pharuzia râhzy chahryh ta.
Alezandria khihpa Zu chyhsa Apawlôsâ ama tahpa Ephesi lâ a vy ta. Ano cha a pakah paleih a thlâzi kawpa nata Biehrai a pahno kawpa a châ.
Abeipa lâpi kyh pachu hapa chyhsa châ ta. Zawhâna bâtina deita a pahnopa chhao ta, thlahpa thapasana hneipa ta, Zisu thâtih â do kawpa ta a pachu tyh.
Pakhyna o liata riahpha ngaitapa ta bie reih ta. Priskilâ nata Akuilâ ta a biereipa cha ama thei nahta, ama o lâ a chhi ei ta, Khazohpa lâpi a sia viapa ta chhopasia ei ta.
Apawlôsâ cha Akai lâ sie awpa â chhuah nahta, unawhzy ta a thapatlô ei ta, ano a vaw ly awpa ta pachupazy lâ châ ropa ei ta. A tlô nahta, ngiachhiena vâta ngiapâtuhpazy cha thata bao ta.
Vâtlâh pahnopa ta Zuzy cha thatlô ngaitapa ta ama bie padei lymâ ta, Biehrai a tlychakapa ta, Zisu cha Mesia a châ tahpa a chhopasia tyh ei.
Apawlôsâ Kawrini liata a y chhôh ta Pawla cha tlâh râh chahryh ta, Ephesi tlô ta. Cha liata pachupa thokhazy hmô ta.
Ama hnohta, “Namâ ngiapâ tua nona kha Thlahpa Pathaihpa nama to ma?” tah ta. Âmo ta a hnohta, “To ma pi, Thlahpa Pathaihpa a ypa chhao pahno ma pi,” tah ei ta.
Pawla ta, “Cha khiah, khâpa bâtina ta bâti a châpa ma nama châ?” tah ta. Âmo ta, “Zawhâna bâtina ta bâti a châpa eima châ,” tah ei ta.
Pawla ta, “Zawhâna khata rona bâti pachâsa ta, a hnôhlâ ta a vy awpa Zisu a ngiapâ awpa ta chyhsazy a chho ei,” tah ta.
Cha bie cha ama thei nahta, Abeipa Zisu moh ta bâti châ ha ei ta.
Pawla ta ama chô liata a ku a pahnieh nahta, Thlahpa Pathaihpa ama chô liata vaw tlô ta, reih hropazy ta bie reih ei ta, hrohsona biezy phuah ei ta.
Ama zydua ta pawtlohpa sai ta pahrawh hleino rachhôh ama châ.
Pawla cha pakhyna o liata a ngia tyh ta, thla thôh chhôh riahpha ngaitapa ta bie reih ta, Khazohpa khinarâh kyh liata âmo cha Biehrai a laichadaikheipa ta pahnie a chhuah ta.

Châhrasala thokha cha chhorupa ta y ei ta, a ngiapâ khoh leipa ta, zawpi hmiakô liata Lâpi zyhna cha reipachhie ei ta. Chavâta âmo cha siesaipa ta, pachupazy ânano ta a chhi ta, noh chareih ta Tyrânâ pachuna o liata âmo cha Biehrai a laichadaikhei tyh ta.
Cha hawhna chata kô no chhôh tao ta, chatanachata Asia râh liata a ypa Zuzy nata Krikâh zydua ta Abeipa bie thei ei ta.
Khazohpa ta Pawla ku ta hmonoâh ngaitapazy tao lymâ ta.
Pawla pôhpa a hria hapa rumâ nata hruna poh hawhpazy taihta tlâhleipazy lâ cheih ei ta, ama hriiahzy ta âmo cha puasai ta, thlahpa chhiepazy chhao ama chhôh tawhta pua lymâ ei ta.
Dyuthaina zuahpa ta a khiekhâpa Zu chyhsa thokhazy ta, ahripa a hneipazy cha Abeipa Zisu moh ta papua awpa a chhuah hra ei ta, “Pawla a châhkheipa Zisu moh ta, pua awpa ta bie ei cha pie,” tah ei ta.
Cha hmo cha Zuzy theihthai beipa Skevâ sawchapaw pasarizy ta tao tyh ei ta.
Noh kha cha thlahpa chhiepa ta âmo cha a chhy ta, “Zisu ei pahno, Pawla ei pahno hra, nâmo he ahyzy nama châ tly?” tah ta.
Thlahpa chhiepa a hneipa chata âmo cha a vaw zawhnao ta, ama zydua ta taochhie ta, pahnie ha ta, cha o tawhtapa cha thluahruapa nata hmah phaohpa ta a râ ha ei ta.
Ephesi liata a ypa zydua, Zuzy nata Krikâhzy hnohta, cha bie cha pathâh ta. Ama zydua ta chi ngaita ei ta, Abeipa Zisu moh cha parônahsapa ta y ta.
Ngiapâtuhpa hluhpi a vy ei ta, ama hmotaopazy a phuahpa ta palâhâh ei ta.
Dyuthaipa hluhpi ta ama châbuzy vaw cheih ei ta, chyhsa zydua mohmô ta mei ta rao ei ta. A mâ reipati ei ta, tâkâ thy pangawh mâ dua a châ.
Cha hawhna chata Abeipa bie cha pathâh via rilipa ta, a thatlô via lymâ ta.
Cha khai tawhta, Pawla cha Thlahpa chhihthapa ta Mâsidônia râh nata Akai râhzy chahryh ta, Zerusale lâ sie a chhuah ta, “Cha râhzy ei tlô tawhta, Rawma chhao ei tly awpa a châ,” tah ta.
A chakaotuhpa pano, Timawthy nata Erastâ cha Mâsidônia râh lâ pasiesa tua ta, ano cha Asia liata y chy ta.
Cha daihti liata, Lâpi zyhna kyh vâta atymâna lai ngaitapa pua ta.
Chyhsa pakha, Demetia ama tahpa cha tâkâ a daih thaipa châ ta. Tâkâ ta Artemi khazohnô nothlahpa daih ta, zôthaipazy châta athôhna thata a taotuhpa a châ.
Cha chyhsa chata zôthaipazy nata âmo raihria hawhpa hriatuhpazy awpakhy ta, ama hnohta, “Pupa saih u, he rai he eima sôh hnawh a châ tahpa nama pahno.

Ephesi lia dei châ leipa ta, Asia râh zydua rô ta, he Pawla heta ku ta taopa khazohzy cha khazoh châ veih ei, tahpa ta chyhsa hluhpi pahnie ta, a patleisa khaipa kyh cha, nâmo chhao hmô ei chi ta, nama theipa a châ.

Eima rai a chhâ aw tahpa chi â chhihpa dei châ leipa ta, khazohnô rônah ngaitapa Artemi achhyna o chhao he a vaw nawraih ha aw. Asia nata khizaw zydua ta amâ chhypa khazohnô he, a rônahna thypa a châ pathlei aw tahpa chhao chi â chhih ngaita,” tah ta.
Cha biezy cha ama thei nahta, ama pathi ia ngaita ta, “Ephesi mo Artemi khazohnô he rônahpa a châ,” tahpa ta awh ei ta.
Khihpi zydua cha tymâna ta bie ta, Pawla a zituhpa Mâsidônia chyhsa Kaiâ nata Aristaku zy cha patu ei ta, ahmaohna o lâ â raohpa ta a râkhei ei ta.
Pawla cha zawpi lâ pua awpa a chhuah ta, châhrasala pachupazy ta pasaih leipa ei ta.
Asia râh hyutuhpazy hry liata thokha cha Pawla viasazy châ ei ta, âmo chata Pawla lâ chyhsa tuah ei ta, ahmaohna o liata a ngia raruah lei awpa ta a haw ei ta.
Zawpi a hmaohpakhypa sahlaozy cha thata a tyhreih ei ta, thokha ta bie miakha vaw awh ei ta, thokha ta bie hropa vaw awh ei ta, chyhsa hluh via zydua cha amâ hmaohpakhyna chhâpa chhao pahno veih ei.

Alezandâ cha Zuzy ta hmia ama pasahpa vâta, zawpi hry liata thokha ta ano vâta khiah ma tah ei ta. Alezandâ ta zawpi cha a chalih awpa ta a ku thliethlâ ta, a thaichâna bie zawpi hnohta rei a chhuah ta.
Châhrasala ano cha Zu chyhsa a châ tahpa ama pahno nahta, dawh no chhôh tlai ao paro ngaitapa ta, â raohpa ta, “Ephesi mo Artemi khazohnô he rônahpa a châ!” tahpa ta awh ei ta.

Khihpi chârohtuhpa ta zawpi cha a chalihsa khai nahta, “Ephesi mo saih u, Ephesi mo he Artemi rônahpa achhyna o nata avâ tawhta ano nothlahpa zâ tlapa a vaituhpa nama châ tahpa, a pahno leipa ahy ma a y tly?
He hmozy he ei thei awpa rih a châ lei thlaopa cha, a chalih teh u, pachâ pasia ha tua leipa ta khâpa hmah nama tao awpa châ vei.
He chyhsa namâ vaw chhipazy he, achhyna o a papuapaleipa châ leipa ei ta, eima khazohnô a reipachhietuhpa châ hra veih ei.
Demetia nata a viasa zôthaipazy ta ahy liata rai biepeipa ama hnei khiahta cha, ryureina ochhi a pahy thlâh ha ta, râhvaotuhpazy chhao ama y. Ama biepeipazy cha ama vaw tlôkhei thei.
Nama palôh tlâh leipa sala, biepeipa cha rei via awpa nama khoh khiahta cha, ahmaohna hnei tyhpa liata rei pasia awpa a châ.
Tanoh ta atymâna kyh liana heta, eimâ hmaohna chhâpa nata thaichâna bie rei awpa hnei ma pi, chavâta tymâna a taotuhpa ta baipa eima châ tlamaw awpa he chichhih ngaitapa a châ,” tah ta.
Cha biezy cha a rei khai nahta, ahmaohna cha pachhâsa ta.
Atymâna a pai tawhta, Pawla cha pachupazy paawsa ta, ama thlah palôh ta, a phapa ta a pathlie khai tawh ei ta, Mâsidônia râh lâ sie awpa ta pua ha ta.
Cha râhzy cha chahryh ta, pasyuna bie hluhpi a rei khai tawhta Krikâh râh tlô ta.
Cha liata thla thôh a y tawhta Suria râh lâ balyh ta sie a chhuah ta, châhrasala Zuzy ta thie amâ chhuahpa vâta Mâsidônia râh lâ kua awpa ta tlao a chhuah ha ta.
Beria khihpa Pyhu sawchapawpa Sôpate, Thysalawnika khihpa Kristaku nata Sekudu, Derbe khihpa Kaiâ, Timawthy, Asia chyhsa Tykiku nata Tarôphimâ zy ta zi ei ta.
Âmo cha hmia lâta sie ei ta, Tarôsa khih liata miah vaw hâ ei ta.
Keimo deikua cha viahchhâ thinô pahlao leipa kyhchhi a chhâ tawhta Philipi tawhta balyh ta pua pi ta, ama yna Tarôsa khih cha noh pangawh ta tlô pi ta, cha liata noh sari châh pi ta.
Hâta noh hmiatua chaipa liata, viahchhâ eichheih awpa ta eima y pakhy nota, Pawla cha a mylâ sie â chhuahpa vâta, zâcho taihta ama hnohta bie reih ta.
Eimâ hmaohna ochô chhôhpadâhpa liata meiôh hluhpi y ta.
Satlia pakha Utyku ama tahpa cha opy liata a tyuh ta. Pawla biereipa a pasi kawpa vâta, a mokupa ta tlauah pathlah ha ta, o chhâh thôhna tawhta tla ta, a thipa ta a huah ei ta.
Pawla cha chô ta, a chô liata a byu thlu ta, a bâh ta a pyh ta, “Nama thlah a pazo khah u, a hroh thlâh ha aw,” tah ta.
Pawla cha ochô lâ kiah heih ta, viahchhâ cha eichheih ta, ama nie khai nahta, ama hnohta a pasipi bie reih via heih ta, khih vaw deih pâ ha ta, chatanachata sie ha ta.
Satliapa cha a hrohpa ta a chhi ei ta, thlalôh ngaitapa ta y ha ei ta.
Pawla cha phei ta alei lâta sie â chhuahpa vâta, keimo cha balyh lâ zu chhielie pi ta. Asôsa khih pangaipa ta sie pi ta, cha tawhna chata Pawla cha balyh ta a sie hra awpa châ ta.
Asôsa khih liata miah a vaw pahlyh ta, balyh pakiasa pi ta, Mitali khih lâ sie pi ta.
Mitali tawhta balyh ta sie heih pi ta, a mylâ ta Kiôsa liahpahlô dady tlô pi ta. A mylâ ta Samôsa liahpahlô tly pi ta. A mylâ heihpa ta Miletâ khih lâ sie pi ta.
Â thei khiahta cha Zerusale liata Pentikaws noh hmâ awpa ta a sie para khohpa vâta, Pawla cha Asia râh liata bohpi y awpa khoh leipa ta, Ephesi khih cha balyh ta siepakhô a chhuah ta.
Miletâ tawhta Ephesi lâ chyhsa tuah ta, Awnanopa machâzy ano a vaw hmô awpa ta kei paawsa ta.
Ama vaw tlô nahta, ama hnohta, “Asia râh ei tly tua noh tawhta nama hnohta ei y chhôh zydua ta ei hrozie kha nama pahno.
Areisina chôta Abeipa chakao na ta, Zuzy ta eina teipa vâ ei ta mothlih chhaota nata rietheina chôta ei chakao tyh.
Ei bâh pathliah beih leipa na ta, nama châta a phahnai awpa biezy zawpi ahmaohna liata cha pachu ei na ta, o to kiapa ta ei cha pachu tyh ei.
Zuzy hnohta chhao, Krikâh mo hnohta chhao, ropa ta Khazohpa lâ a heih ta, eima Beipa Zisu Krista a ngiapâ awpa ta ei cha chho tyh ei.
“Thlahpa ta eina tuahpa vâta tahmâ he Zerusale lâ ei sie aw. Cha liata ei chô lia khâpa hmo ma a vaw tlô aw tahpa pahno va na.
Khihpi to liata patâhna nata rietheitaonazy ta eina hâ thlâh hapa kyh Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta eina chhopa deita ei pahno.
Châhrasala Khazohpa ngiachhiena thâtihpha a châhkhei awpa ta, Abeipa Zisu tawhta ei daopa chakaona rai he ei patlô thei khiahta la, ei hrona he pasô kaw awpa nata ngiabâh tlâh a châpa ta rao va na.
“Khinarâh bie chhopa ta ei sielâh tyhpa nâmozy hry liana heta, ahy hmahta ei hmia hmô khao aw veih ei chi tahpa ei pahno.
Chavâta chyhsa zydua thisaih liata ei pathaih tahpa tanoh ei cha chho ei.
Khazohpa ryhraona zydua nama hnohta phuah khai awpa kyh liata ei bâh pathliah beih va na.
Khazohpa Awnanopa sahlao, ano thisaih ta a chaleipazy pasa awpa ta, nâmo nata nama sahlao zydua chô liata a chado teh u. Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta ama chô liata hyutuhpa ta a cha tao ei hih.
Ei sie tawhta changie a hrâhpazy nama hry liata a vaw ngia aw ei ta, mietakuzy pahlôh aw vei tahpa ei pahno.
Nama hry tawh cheingei chhao ta, pachupazy âmo lâ pabaisa a chhuahpa ta, haipa bie hmâpa ta chyhsa a pasiesachheipazy ama vaw pua aw.
Chavâta a hrohruapa ta y u la, kô thôh chhôh tlai bâh leipa ta, chhô nah zâ ta mothlih chhaota chyhsa to zikyu ei râ tyhpa kha a thei thlâh ha teh u.
“Tahmâ he Khazohpa nata a ngiachhiena bie liata ei cha pavaosa ei. Cha chata cha palaiseihsa aw ei ta, mopathaihpazy hry liata ryuto a cha pahneisa aw ei.
Ahy tâkâ, ngôh nata chysia hmah uahva beih va na.
He ei kuzy heta kei nata ei hnohta a ypazy a ngiahpa châta ei hria tyhpa nâmo tlai ta nama pahno.

Abeipa Zisu ta, ‘Pietuhpa châpa cha daotuhpa châpa hlâta byhnâ a y via,’ tahpa bie a reipa kha a thei thlâh hapa ta, cha hawhta hriapasapa ta chiehleipazy eima bao awpa a châzie, kao to ta ei cha pamosa tyh ei,” tah ta.
Cha biezy cha a rei khai nahta, a pakhu paneih ta, ama zydua châta thlahchhâ ta.
Ama zydua ta thata cha ei ta, Pawla cha a pyhpahlypa ta, a pahnâ ei ta.
A hmia ama hmô khao lei awpa kyh a reipa vâta ama ngia a chhie pachaipa a châ. Chatanachata balyh taih za pathlie ei ta.
Ephesi machâzy nata eimâ pathlie tawhta, balyh ta pua pi ta, Kôsi liahpahlô lâ palâh pi ta, a mylâ ta Rôde liahpahlô tlô pi ta, cha tawhna chata Pâtarâ khih tlô pi ta.
Cha liata Phônisia lâ a sie awpa balyh miakha hmô pi ta, kiah pi ta, sie heih pi ta.
Kuparâ liahpahlô â vaw lâ nahta, chavei lâta khô pi ta, Suria râh lâ sie lymâ pi ta, Tyre khih liata a pahâ pi ta. Cha liata balyh hmozy pachhi awpa châ ta.
Cha liata pachupazy hmô pi ta, noh sari châh pi ta. Pachupazy chata Thlahpa pahnosana ta, Pawla cha Zerusale lâ sie lei awpa ta chho ei ta.

Cha liata y nawpa daihti a chhâ nahta, pua pi ta, sie heih pi ta. Unawhzy cha ama zydua ta, ama lapi sawzy chhaota, khih eima khô hlâlei miah vaw pathlie ei ta. Raphyu liata eima pakhu paneihpa ta thlah eima chhâ khai tawhta,
atlâhna bie reih pi ta, keimo balyh lâ kiah pi ta, âmo o lâ a di ei ta.
Tyre tawhta balyh ta sie lymâ pi ta, Patôlemai khih tlô pi ta, cha liata unawhzy a naoh pi ta, ama hnohta noh kha châh pi ta.
A mylâ ta pua pi ta, Kaisaria tlô pi ta, biechhotuhpa Phili o liata tlô pi ta. Ano cha pasaripazy hry liata a hlao hrapa a châ.
Sawchanô papalih hnei ta, âmo cha dyhchâ leipa ta hrohsona bie a phuah tyhpa ama châ.
Noh hluhpi châh pi ta, eima châh chhôh ta Zudia râh tawhta hrohsopa pakha, Akabâ ama tahpa a zu ta.

Keimo lâ a vy ta, Pawla chaisaihna la ta, a ku nata a pheizy anosasyh ta a chahry ta, “Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta, ‘He chaisaihna a hneituhpa he Zerusale liata Zuzy ta he hawhta chahry aw ei ta, Zenitaizy ku liata ama hlâ aw,’ a tah,” tah ta.
Cha biezy cha eima thei nahta, keimo nata cha khih liata chyhsazy ta Pawla cha Zerusale lâ sie lei awpa ta a haw pi ta.

Châhrasala Pawla ta, “Khazia cha ei chi ta, ei ngia eina pachhie ei chi? Abeipa Zisu moh vâta Zerusale liata patâhpa ta ei y awpa a mâ chiehpa ta ei ypa dei châ leipa ta, thi chhao ei mâ thlâh haw,” tah ta.
Pahnawhsa thei awpa a châ leipa vâta, “Abeipa rei sai châ mawh sy,” tah pi ta, eimâ chalihsai haw.
Cha nohzy hnôhlâ ta, eima hmozy la pi ta, Zerusale lâ khy pi ta.
Kaisaria khih liata pachupa thokhazy eima hnohta vaw sie hra ei ta, Kuparâ chyhsa Manâsô o lâ miah a chhi ei ta. Manâsô he ngiapâ tuapazy hry liata a hlao hrapa châ ta, a o liata a tlô awpa eima châ.
Zerusale eima tlô nahta, unawhzy ta thapha ngaitapa ta miah a vaw ly ei ta.
A mylâ ta Pawla chhaota Zâmie o lâ charei pi ta, Awnanopa machâ zydua vaw y khai ei ta.
Pawla ta âmo cha â naoh khai nah ei ta, a chakaona hmâpa ta Khazohpa ta Zenitaizy hry liata hmo a taopazy miakha miakha ta reih ta.
Cha bie cha unawhzy ta ama thei nahta, Khazohpa palyupalih ei ta. Pawla hnohta, “Unawh, Zuzy hry liata ngiapâtuhpa ama hluhzie na hmô. Ama zydua ta ryhpa châta phahnai a ngiah ngaitapazy ama châ.
Zenitaizy hry liata Zu a ypa zydua hnohta, ama sawzy chopawtai awpa a byuh leizie pachu chi ta, Mawsi ryhpa a heihsaipa ta, eima phoryhpazy chhao zyh awpa a byuh leizie na pachu ei tahpa ama thei.
Kheihta eima tao aw? Na vaw tlôpa thâtih thei thlyu aw ei ta.
Chavâta eima cha chhopa hawhta tao mah y. Bietai ry liata a y haipa chyhsa papalih hnei pi ta,

âmo cha a chhi la, ama hnohta a pathai hra la, ama sâ angyuna mâ chhao piepa mah y. Chatanachata chyhsa zydua ta chyhsa pakah tawhta na thâtih ama theipa zydua cha hmeiseihpa châ vei tahpa pahno aw ei ta, nâma tlai chhao ryhpa a chhihpa ta na y hra tahpa a siapa ta ama cha pahno aw.

Zenitai ngiapâtuhpazy kyh lia deikua cha, nothlahpa lâ atheihna hlâpa niepa, sa thisaih niepa, sa paaosaopa niepa nata apheina zy ama bâhsai awpa a byuhzie eima biepathlupa cha, châ ropa ta eima paphao haw,” tah ei ta.

A mylâ ta Pawla ta bietai ry liata a ypa chyhsazy cha a chhi ta, ama hnohta a pathai hra ta, Achhyna o liata a ngia ta, amâ pathaina noh â ki nawpa daihti nata ama zydua châta atheihna hlâ nawpa kyhzy kei pahnosa ta.
Noh sari a tloh chy ta, Asia râh liata Zuzy ta Pawla cha Achhyna o liata hmô ei ta, zawpi zydua pasyupa ta Pawla cha patu ei ta.

“Izarei sawzy saih u, miah bao teh u! He chyhsa he râh to liata chyhsa zydua hnohta, Zu chyhsa nata ryhpa nata he Achhyna o chhao he a reipachhietuhpa kha a châ. Cha dei châ vei, Achhyna o liata Krikâh mo a ngiakhei ta, he su pathaihpa he a papuapalei,” tahpa ta awh ei ta.
Cha hlâta khihpi liata Ephesi khihpa Tarôphimâ cha a hnohta hmô ei ta, Pawla ta cha chyhsa cha Achhyna o lâ â ngiakhei na ta ama pangiasa.
A khihpi duata a tymâ ei ta, zawpi a râ pakhy ei ta. Pawla cha patupa ta Achhyna o tawhta a daophi ei ta, ochhizy thlai khaw ei ta.
Pawla thie amâ chhuah hai nota, Zerusale khih chhôh zydua â tyhreih khai hapa kyh pheisaih hyutuhpa kô vaw tlô ta.
Pheisaihzy nata pheisaih zakha hyutuhpazy a chhipa ta zawpi lâ thlai a râ ta. Zawpizy ta pheisaih hyutuhpa nata pheisaihzy ama hmô nahta, Pawla ama chheipa cha a chalih ei ta.
Pheisaih hyutuhpa cha a vaw hnia ta, Pawla patu ta, bâlia miano paky awpa ta biepie ta. Ahy ma a châ, khâpa ma a tao, tahpa patluah ta.
Zawpi hry liata thokha ta bie miakha awh ei ta, thokha ta bie hropa awh ei ta. A palopasah tupa vâta bie siapa pahno thei leipa ta, pheisaih su lâ a chhi awpa ta biepie ta.
Zawpizy ta thata ama teipa vâta, kahmi a tlô nahta, pheisaihzy ta Pawla cha chalo ei ta.
Zawpi a pazipazy ta, “Pahleipadia teh” tahpa ta awh ei ta.
Pheisaih su ama tlô chy ta, Pawla ta pheisaih hyutuhpa hnohta, “Na hnohta bie kawh kha ei reih thei aw ma?” tah ta. Ano ta, “Krikâh reih na thai ma?
Atlia ta chyhsazy pasyupali ta, chyhsa thie a hmâhpa sâh palih râhchawhpa lâ a chhituhpa, Izi chyhsa kha châ va chi mâ?” tah ta.
Pawla ta a chhy ta, “Kei he Zu chyhsa, Silisia râh liata Tarsâ khihpa châ na ta, khitaw chyhsa châ va na. Zawpi hnohta bie rei eina pasai awpa chi ta ei châ haw,” tah ta.
A paryhsa nahta, Pawla cha kahmi liata a duah ta, zawpi a chalih awpa ta a ku ta thliethlâ ta, amâ chalihpa nahta, Hebrai reih ta ama hnohta bie reih ta.
Pawla ta, “Unawhzy nata pawzy saih u, tahmâ nama hnohta ei thaichâna bie ei rei awpa he nathlie teh u,” tah ta.
Hebrai reih ta ama hnohta bie a reipa ama thei nahta, a chalih via pachai ei ta.

“Kei he Zu chyhsa châ na ta, Silisia râh Tarsâ khih liata a pihpa ei châ. Châhrasala Kâmalia phei thaby lia a chu na ta, he khihpi liata a laiseihpa ei châ. Miah pathlatuhpazy ryhpa â i ngaitapa ta pachupa châ na ta, tanoh nâmo zydua hawhna heta Khazohpa châta phahnai a ngiah ngaitapa ei châ tyh.
He Lâpi zyhna chyhsazy he thina taihta taola tyh ei na ta, a chanô chapaw ta chahry na ta, patâhna o liata ei pakhôsa tyh ei.

Theihthai beichaipa nata machâ zydua ta ei bie cha eina pahnokhei ei. Âmo tawhta Dâmaskâ liata ama chiheihzy lâta châ ama ropa a phaopa ta, Dâmaskâ liata Lâpi chyhsazy chahry ta, hrie awpa ta Zerusale lâ a vaw chhi awpa ta ei sie.
“Dâmaskâ ei tlô chy ta, nohchhô lichih ta avâ tawhta khaih ngaitapa ei kiapâh liata eikhapi ta vaw khaih ta.
Alei liata pao na ta, ei hnohta, ‘Sawla, Sawla khazia eina taola chi?’ tahpa ao thei na ta.
Kei ta, ‘Abeipa ahy ma na châ?’ tah na ta. Ano ta ei hnohta, ‘Nâzari Zisu na taolapa kha ei châ,’ tah ta.
Ei hnohta a ypazy ta khaihpa cha hmô ei ta, bie nâ chhotuhpa ao deikua thei veih ei.
Kei ta, ‘Abeipa, khâpa ei tao aw?’ tah na ta. Abeipa ta ei hnohta, ‘Thyu la, Dâmaskâ khihpi liata a ngia teh. Cha liata na tao awpa ta raopa hmo zydua ama cha chho aw,’ tah ta.
Khaihpa cha a pathlie tupa vâta, ei mo ta hmô thei khao leipa ta, ei hnohta a ypazy ta ku ta na chaao ei ta, Dâmaskâ cha a ngia na ta.
“Cha liata chyhsa pakha, Anania ama tahpa y ta. Ano cha ryhpa bie hawhta Khazohpa a pachâpa nata cha liata Zu chyhsa a ypa zydua ta ama reithaipa a châ.
Ano cha kei lâ a vy ta, ei kiapâh liata a vaw duah ta, ei hnohta, ‘Unawh Sawla, na mo pavâ mawh sy,’ na tah ta. Cha dawh lia tlai chata ei mo vaw pavâ ha ta, ano cha hmô thei ha na ta.
Anania ta, ‘Miah pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa ta a khopa pahno awpa nata Mo Siapa hmô ta, a pakah tawhta ao thei awpa ta a cha rao.
Na hmôpa nata na theipazy kha, chyhsa zydua hnohta pahnokheituhpa na châ aw.
Khâpa na hâ khao? Tahmâ thyu la, a moh padopa ta bâti châ la, na moleinazy pasi teh,’ na tah ta.
“Zerusale lâ a vaw lie na ta, Achhyna o liata thlah ei chhâ hai nota, a theihlô khao leipa ta vaw y na ta,
Abeipa hmô na ta, ano ta ei hnohta, ‘A chatliepa ta Zerusale puasai para teh, ei thâtih nâ châhkheipa a pyh aw veih ei,’ na tah ta.
Kei ta, ‘Abeipa, pakhyna o to liata châ ngiapâtuhpazy patâh ei na ta, ei chhei tyhpa kha pahno tlôh ei ta.
Na bie a pahnotuhpa Stiphana thisaih ama palo nota, kei chhao a kiapâh liata a duah na ta, paryhsa na ta, ano a thietuhpazy chysia a vaituhpa ei châ,’ tah na ta.
Châhrasala Abeipa ta, ‘Sie mah y, lâhlapi ta Zenitaizy lâta ei cha tuah aw,’ na tah ta,” tah ta.
Bie a rei khaina taihta nathlie ei ta. Chatawhcha ao paro ngaitapa ta, “He hawhpa chyhsa he leilô tawhta pahleipadia teh u! A hroh tlâh châ vei,” tah ei ta.
Thata awh ei ta, ama pohzy hlaipa ta thy ei ta, buchadoh pathluah ei ta.
Pawla cha pheisaih su lâ a chhi awpa ta, pheisaih hyutuhpa ta biepie ta. Cha tlupo ta ama awh chiena chhâpa pahno awpa ta, Pawla cha chhei ta, hiahri pasia awpa a chhuah ta.
Savo ri ta chhei awpa ta ama chahry khai nahta, Pawla ta a kiapâh liata a duahpa pheisaih za kha hyutuhpa hnohta, “Rawma chyhsa nata thailei pachâsa leipa chhei awpa dâh ta a pasaih ma?” tah ta.
Cha bie cha pheisaih za kha hyutuhpa ta a thei nahta, pheisaih hyutuhpa lâ vawh ta, a hnohta, “Na tao awpa he pachâ pasia mah y. He chyhsa he Rawma chyhsa a châ,” tah ta.
Pheisaih hyutuhpa a vy ta, Pawla hnohta, “Rawma chyhsa na châ ma, na chho teh?” tah ta. Pawla ta, “Ei châ,” tah ta.
Pheisaih hyutuhpa ta, “Kei cha Rawma chyhsa châna he sôh hluhpi ta a chaleipa ei châ,” tah ta. Pawla ta, “Kei la, Rawma chyhsa ta a pihpa na ei châ,” tah ta.
Bie hiahri pasia a chhuahpazy ta Pawla cha thlai a sysai ei ta, pheisaih hyutuhpa chhao ta Rawma chyhsa a châpa a pahno nahta, Rawma chyhsa a chahry hapa cha chi kaw ta.

A mylâ ta, Zuzy ta ama leihna chhâpa hmeiseihpa pahno a chhuahpa ta, pheisaih hyutuhpa ta Pawla chahryna cha pathlâ ta. Theihthai beizy nata ryureituhpa zydua a hmaoh awpa ta biepie ta. Pawla cha a zâ chhi ta, ama hmiakô liata paduasa ta.
Pawla ta ryureituhpazy cha a mo tawpâ ta, ama hnohta, “Unawh saih u, chhie nata pha pahnona hmâpa ta, tanoh taihta Khazohpa mohmô ta a phapa ta ei hroh lymâ,” tah ta.
Theihthai beichaipa Anania ta Pawla kiapâh liata a duahpazy hnohta a pakah liata chabaih awpa ta biepie ta.
Pawla ta a hnohta, “Nâ, pâhchhô hlyu ngyuh hniapa, Khazohpa ta a cha chabaih aw. Ryhpa hawhta na pachia awpa ta a tyuh chi ta, khazia ryhpa chakhiapa ta na chabaih awpa ta bie na pie?” tah ta.
A kiapâh liata a duahpazy ta, “Khazohpa theihthai beichaipa khazia na reipachhie?” tah ei ta.
Pawla ta, “Unawh saih u, theihthai beichaipa a châ tahpa na ei pahno vei, ‘Na phopi ryureituhpa chô liata bie pha leipa rei kha,’ tahpa ropa a châ,” tah ta.

Pawla ta thokha Saduasizy châ ei ta, thokha Phârisaihzy ama châpa a pahno nahta, ryureituhpazy hnohta, “Unawh saih u, kei he Phârisaih châ na ta, Phârisaih sawchapawpa ei châ. Athihpa thyuheihna hnabeiseihna kyh vâta ryureina hmiakô liata a duahpa ei châ hih?” tah ta.
Cha bie cha a rei khai nahta, Phârisaihzy nata Saduasizy likah liata aeichhiana vaw pua ta, ryureituhpazy cha a pachhaih ha ei ta.
Saduasizy cha athihpa thyuheihna nata vâlyuhchâpa nata thlahpa y vei a tahpa châ ei ta, Phârisaihzy deikua cha, athihpa thyuheihna nata vâlyuhchâpa nata thlahpa a y tahpa a ngiapâpa ama châ.

Ryureina cha thata a vaw tyhreih ta, Phârisaihzy lâta ryhpa pachutuhpa thokha a duah ei ta, ama leihna bie cha chakhia ei ta, “He chyhsa he khâpa hmah a moleina hmô ma pi. Thlahpa ta tlyma, vâlyuhchâpa tlyma ta bie a chhopa a châ khiah cha, khâpa eima reih thei aw?” tah ei ta.

Thachahra hmâna taihta amâ eichhia via rilipa vâta, pheisaih hyutuhpa cha Pawla ama hriechheih awpa chi ta. Pheisaihzy tuah ta, pheisaih thatlôna hmâpa ta, ama hry tawhta pheisaih su lâ a kaw chhi awpa ta biepie ta.

A vaw pazipa zâ liata, Abeipa cha Pawla kiapâh liata a vaw duah ta, a hnohta, “Thlalôhpa ta y mah y, Zerusale liata ei thâtih nâ châhkheipa hawhna heta, Rawma liata chhao nâ châhkhei hra awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Khih a dei nahta, Zuzy a paraoh ei ta, Pawla ama thie hlâlei cha khâpa hmah nie leipa nata doh lei awpa ta bie a taih ei ta.
Cha hawhta arulâta Pawla tei a chhuahpazy cha sypalih hlâta ama hluh via.
Theihthai beizy nata machâzy lâ vawh ei ta, “Pawla eima thie hlâlei cha khâpa hmah nie lei awpa ta â i ngaitapa ta bie eimâ taih haw.

Chavâta a thâtih a sia viapa ta pachâ a chhuahpa hawhta nâmo nata ryureituhpazy ta reih u la, Pawla cha nâmo lâ a zâ chhi awpa ta, pheisaih hyutuhpa kaw chho teh u. A su a za tlôh hlâta thie awpa ta eimâ mâ thlâh haw,” tah ei ta.
Pawla sietanô sawchapawpa ta amâ byhpa kyh cha thei ha ta, pheisaih su lâ vawh ta, Pawla kei chho ta.
Pawla ta pheisaih za kha hyutuhpa aw ta, a hnohta, “He satlia he pheisaih hyutuhpa lâ a chhi teh, a hnohta bie rei awpa a hnei,” tah ta.
Satlia cha pheisaih hyutuhpa lâ a chhi ta, a hnohta, “Pawla atâhpa khata na aw ta, he satlia he nâ lâ a chhi awpa ta eina vaw tuah, na hnohta bie rei awpa a hnei ei aw,” tah ta.
Pheisaih hyutuhpa ta a ku ta patu ta, ânano ta a chhi ta, “Khâpa bie na chho awpa ma na hnei?” tah ta, arulâta hiahri ta.
Ano ta, “Pawla thâtih a sia viapa ta pachâ khopa hawhta bie tao ta, mylâ ryureina liata ano cha a zâ chhi awpa ta, Zuzy ta cha hiah awpa amâ paraoh.

Châhrasala ama bie vaw zo khah y. Ama chyhsa sypalih hlâta hluh via ta amâ byh thlâh haw. Cha chyhsazy chata Pawla ama thie hlâlei cha khâpa hmah nie leipa nata doh lei awpa ta bie a taih ei ta, tahmâ he na paryhsana hâpa ta amâ chiehpa ta ama y thlâh haw,” tah ta.
Pheisaih hyutuhpa ta satlia cha pasiesa ta, a hnohta, “Cha biezy cha eina pahnosa chi tahpa ahy hmah chho khah y,” tahpa ta biepie ta.
Pheisaih hyutuhpa ta pheisaih za kha hyutuhpa pano aw ta, ama hnohta, “Tazâ dawh chakipa liata Kaisaria lâ sie awpa ta, pheisaih za no, arâ pheisaih sysari nata asei a chabapa za no a chhuanoh teh u.
Pawla kia awpa arâ pachhuahpanoh u la, râhvaotuhpa Felika lâ â bohpa ta tlôkhei mawh ei sy,” tah ta.
Hetana heta châ roh ta.
“Klaudia Lysia ta râhvaotuhpa zachhihpa Felika a châ naoh.
He chyhsa he Zuzy ta patu ei ta, ama thie chy ta âmo lâta pheisaihzy a chhipa ta sie na ta, Rawma chyhsa a châpa pahno na ta, ei pachhapa a châ.
Ama leihna chhâpa pahno khohpa ta, ama ryureina lâ a chhi na ta.
Ama ryhpa bie kyh liata ama leihpa a châpa pahno na ta, ama leihna cha thina tlyma, patâhna tlyma, â phuhpa ta pahno leipa na ta.
Thie awpa ta amâ byhpa kyh ei pahno nahta, nâ lâ thlai ei cha vaw hlâ. A leihtuhpazy chhao, ama leihna cha na hmiakô liata rei awpa ta bie ei pie ei,” tah ta.
Biepiepa hawhta, pheisaihzy ta Pawla cha azo ta siekhei ei ta, Antipati khih tlôkhei ei ta.
A mylâ ta pheisaih su lâ a vaw lie ei ta, arâ pheisaihzy ta Pawla cha siekhei ei ta.
Kaisaria ama tlô nahta, râhvaotuhpa hnohta châ pie ei ta, Pawla cha a hmiakô liata paduasa ei ta.
Râhvaotuhpa ta châ cha reih ta, Pawla yna râh hiahri ta. Silisia chyhsa a châpa a pahno nahta,
a hnohta, “Châ leihtuhpazy ama vaw tlô tita na thâtih ei pachia aw,” tah ta. Chatanachata Pawla cha Herawda bei o liata vaih awpa ta biepie ta.
Noh pangawh a khô tawhta, theihthai beichaipa Anania cha machâ thokhazy chhaota za tlô ta, Tertula ama tahpa dâhthaipa chhao a hlao ta. Pawla ama leihna cha râhvaotuhpa hmiakô liata reih ei ta.
Pawla cha aw papua ei ta, Tertula ta ama leihna bie cha reih ta: “Felika zachhih chaipa, na zawhzi ta thlalôh ngaitapa ta y pi ta, na hmiasai phapa vâta, he phopi châta taopathinazy y ta,
kyh to nata su to liata na hmotaopazy a ly ngaitapa ta eimâ pyh tyh.
Eima cha pahawhpasâh tu lei nawpa ta, bie chyuta eima reih awpa he nôpha kawpa ta miah na nathlie awpa ta eima châ haw.
He chyhsa he tymâna a taotuhpa, khizaw liata Zu chyhsa zydua a patypahreituhpa nata Nâzari py liata ama hyutuh chaipa pakha a châpa ta eima pahno.
Achhyna o taihta papuapalei a chhuah ta, chavâta eima patupa a châ.
Eima ryhpa hawhta pachia a chhuah pi ta, châhrasala pheisaih hyutuhpa Lysia a vy ta, thachahra hmâpa ta eima ku tawhta la ta, a leihtuhpazy cha na hmiakô liata a duah awpa ta biepiepa a tao.
Nâma tlai ta bie hiahri la, eima leihna zydua ano tawhta na pahno thei aw,” tah ta.
Zuzy chhao ta, ama leihna cha â dopa tlai a châ tahpa a vaw pykhei ei ta.

Bie reih awpa ta râhvaotuhpa ta ano lâ a ku a thliethlâpa a hmô na ta, Pawla ta a chhy ta, “Kô hluhpi chhôh, he phopi chô liata ryureituhpa na châpa ei pahnopa vâta, thathyu ngaitapa ta ei thaichâna bie ei reih aw.
Zerusale liata Khazohpa a chhy awpa ta ei khy tawhta, noh hrawh hleino khô mâh vei, tahpa na pahno thei aw.
Achhyna o liata tlyma, pakhyna ozy liata tlyma, khihpi chhôh liata tlyma, chyhsa ei eichhiapa nata zawpi ei pasyupa ahy hmahta na hmô veih ei.
Tahmâ chhao, eina leihna bie he â do tlai na tahpa pasia thei aw veih ei.

Châhrasala he bie he na hnohta ei phuah aw. Âmo ta py ama tahpa Lâpi zyhna siezie hawhta miah pathlatuhpazy Khazohpa a chhypa châ na ta, ryhpa nata hrohsopazy châbu liata ropa zydua a ngiapâtuhpa ei châ.
Chyhsa siapa nata sia leipazy thyuheihna a y awpa Khazohpa liata hnabeiseihna a hneipa châ na ta, cha bie cha âmo chhao ta amâ ngiapâpa a châ.
Chavâta Khazohpa nata chyhsapa lâta chhie nata pha pahnona pathaihpa hnei awpa khâ ei chhuah tyh.
Kô hluhpi a khô tawhta, ei chiheihzy deichhyna hmo pie awpa nata atheihna hlâ awpa ta a vy na ta.
Cha hmozy ei tao hai nota, Achhyna o chhôh liata pathaihpa ta na hmô ei ta, zawpizy y leipa ei ta, atymâna chhao y vei.
Cha liata Asia râh tawhta Zu chyhsazy y ei ta, eina leih nawpa ei ama hnei khiahta cha, âmo cha he liata ypa ta, na hmiakô liata eina leih awpa ei a châ.
Cha leipa chhao ta, he chyhsazy tlai heta ryureina hmiakô liata ei dua no khata, ei paraopa khâpa ama hmô, reih mawh ei sy.

Ama hmiakô liata ei dua nota ei reipa bie, ‘Athihpa thyuheihna kyh liata tanoh he nama hmiakô liata a duahpa ei châ hih,’ ei tahpa bie hleikhô ta eina leihna awpa hropa ama pahno khiahta cha, reih mawh ei sy,” tah ta.
Felika cha Lâpi zyhna kyh a pahno kawpa vâta, “Pheisaih hyutuhpa Lysia â zu tita nama bie he ei pachâ aw,” tah ta, ama bie cha soh ha chy ta.
Pheisaih za kha hyutuhpa hnohta Pawla cha patâhna o liata khô chy awpa ta biepie ta. Châhrasala khotalaina khazie rakha ma piepa ta, a viasazy ta ama deichhy awpa pakhâ lei awpa ta biepie ta.
Noh khazie tlyma a khô tawhta, Felika cha a lapinô Drusilâ, Zu zuah a vaw chhipa ta vaw tlô ta, Pawla cha paawsa ta, Krista Zisu ngiapâna kyh pareisa ta.
Siana kyh nata asohsina kyh nata ryureina a vaw y awpa kyhzy Pawla ta a reih nahta, Felika cha chi ngaita ta, “Vawh chy la, daihti rypaohpa ei hnei tita ei cha aw heih aw,” tah ta.
Felika cha Pawla ta tâkâ a pie awpa hnabeiseih ta, chavâta khâ paawsa ta, bie â chho tyh.
Kô no a sie tawhta, Felika cha Pôsia Festâ ta a thla ta. Zuzy hry liata moh pha a khohpa vâta, Felika ta Pawla cha patâhna o liata siesai ta.
Festâ cha a bia a vaw tlô tawhta noh thô a châ nahta, Kaisaria tawhta Zerusale lâ khy ta.
Theihthai beizy nata Zu nôpawpazy ta Pawla ama leihna cha a hnohta tlôkhei ei ta.
Pawla cha Zerusale lâ a vaw chhi awpa ta a khokheina a haw ei ta. Lâpi liata a byh ta, thie amâ chhuahpa vâta cha hawhta ama hiapa a châ.
Châhrasala Festâ ta Pawla cha Kaisaria liata patâhpa châ ta, ano chhao Kaisaria lâ thlai a lie awpa a châzie âmo chho ta.
Festâ ta, “Nama hry liata biehneituhpazy ei hnohta a zu ei sala, cha chyhsa cha adoleina a hnei khiahta cha, ama leihna cha za tlôkhei mawh ei sy” tah ta.
Ama hry liata noh charie tlyma, noh hrawh tlyma a châh tawhta, Festâ cha Kaisaria lâ zu ha ta. A mylâ ta ryureina dyuchhai liata a tyuh ta, Pawla cha a vaw chhi awpa ta biepie ta.
A vaw tlô nahta, Zerusale tawhta Zu chyhsa a zupazy cha Pawla kiapâh liata a vaw duah ei ta, biepeipa hluhpi ta leih ei ta, châhrasala â do tlai na tahpa reih pasia thei leipa ei ta.
Pawla ta a thaichâna bie reih ta, “Zuzy ryhpa chakhiapa ta tlyma, Achhyna o ryhpa chakhiapa ta tlyma, Kaisarâ chakhiapa ta tlyma, khâpa hmo hmah parao va na,” tah ta.
Châhrasala Festâ ta Zuzy hry liata moh pha khohpa ta, Pawla hnohta, “Zerusale lâ khy ta, na thâtih he ei hmiakô liata pachia awpa na khoh ma?” tah ta.
Pawla ta, “Kaisarâ ryureina dyuchhai hmiakô liata ei duah hih. He he ei thâtih pachia nawpa su tlai a châ. Zuzy chô liata khâpa hmo hmah parao va na, cha cha nâ chhao ta a siapa ta na pahno.

Hmoparaotuhpa châ ha sah la, thina tlâh a châpa hmo a paraopa ei châ khiahta cha, thina khôkhâh awpa a chhuah va na. He Zu chyhsazy ta eina leihna ei he khâpa hmah a y leipa a châ khiahta deikua cha, ahy hmahta âmo lâ na hlâ thei aw veih ei. Kaisarâ kô ei tlô aw,” tah ta.
Festâ ta a ryureilâhpazy â chhohia khai nahta, Pawla cha a chhy ta, “Kaisarâ kô tlô awpa na khoh ha tawhta cha, Kaisarâ lâ na sie aw,” tah ta.
Noh khazie tlyma a khô tawhta, Bei Akripâ nata Benisi cha Festâ a naoh awpa ta Kaisaria lâ za tlô ei ta.
Cha liata noh hluhpi ama châhpa vâta, Festâ ta Pawla kyh cha abei chho ta, “Felika khata atâhpa pakha siesai ta.
Zerusale liata ei y chhôh kha, theihthai beizy nata Zu machâzy ta ano leihna bie vaw reih ei ta, thailei pachâsa awpa ta amâ haw.
Kei ta ama hnohta, ‘Ama leihpa chyhsa ta a leihtuhpazy hmiakô liata a thaichâna bie hmiadaisâ ta a rei ha tua leipa ta thailei pachâsapa cha, Rawma taozie châ vei,’ tahpa ta ei chhy ei.
Chatanachata he lâ amâ zu nahta, pahawhpasâh leipa ta, a mylâ ta ryureina dyuchhai liata thlai a tyuh na ta, cha chyhsa cha a vaw chhi awpa ta bie ei pie.
A leihtuhpazy a vaw duah ei ta, ei pangiasapa hawhta moleina biepeipa a hneipa khâpa hmah reih tlôh leipa ei ta.
Ama zyhna kyh nata Zisu ama tahpa, a thi hapa, Pawla ta a hrohpa hawhta a reipa kyh liata amâ eina tlao vaw châ ta.
Cha kyh cha a pachâna rai ei pahno leipa vâta, Zerusale lâ khy ta, cha biezy cha, cha liata pachia awpa a khoh nata khoh lei hiahri na ta.
Châhrasala Pawla ta beichaipa ta biepathluna tao awpa ta ano lâ tlôkhei awpa ta â hawpa vâta, Kaisarâ lâ ei paphao thei hlâlei cha patâh chy awpa ta bie ei pie haw,” tah ta.
Akripâ ta Festâ hnohta, “Kei chhao, cha chyhsa bie reipazy nathlie awpa ei khoh kaw,” tah ta. Festâ ta, “A biereipa cha mylâ na nathlie aw,” tah ta.
A mylâ ta Akripâ nata Benisi cha pheisaih hyutuhpazy nata khihpi nôpawzy chhaota rônah ngaitapa ta a vy ei ta, zawpi ahmaohna o liata a ngia ei ta. Festâ bie ta Pawla cha a vaw ngiakhei ei ta.

Festâ ta, “Bei Akripâ nata eima hnohta a ypa zydua saih u, he chyhsa nama hmôpa he, ano kyh liana heta Zerusale nata he liata Zu chyhsa a ypa zydua ta a hroh tlâh châ khao vei tahpa ta thata awh ei ta.
Châhrasala thina tlâh a châpa hmo khâpa hmah a taopa hmô va na. Ano ta beichaipa kô tlô awpa â haw hapa vâta, beichaipa lâ cha paphao awpa ei chhuah.

Châhrasala ano kyh liata ei zibeipa lâ ro hmeiseih awpa chhao hnei va na. Chavâta nama zydua hmiakô liata ei vaw chhi hih, a eih pachaipa ta, Bei Akaripâ, nâma hmiakô liata ei vaw chhi, bie na hiahri khai tawhta khâpa chhâ ma ro awpa ei hnei thei nawpa ta.
Atâhpa paphao tlôh ta, biepeipa a hneipa palâsa leipa cha, yzie a hneipa ta pahno leipa na ta,” tah ta.
Akripâ ta Pawla hnohta, “Na thaichâna bie na reih thei,” tah ta. Pawla cha a ku pazawh ta, a thaichâna bie reih ta.
“Bei Akaripâ y, Zuzy ta eina leihna zydua liata, ei thaichâna bie tanoh na hmiakô liata ei rei thei awpa he nohlao ei tah ngaita.
Nâ cha Zuzy phoryhpa nata aeichhiana kyhzy a pahnotuhpa na châpa he, vâpha ei tah via pachai. Chavâta palôh pasi kawpa ta ei bie eina nathlie awpa chi ta ei châ haw.
“Ei thyutlia tawhta ei chiheihzy hry liata nata Zerusale liata ei hroziezy cha, Zu chyhsa zydua ta âthaona tawhta ama pahno.
Ama rei khoh khiahta cha, eima zyhna liata a i chaipa Phârisaih py ei châpa chhao, hlâno tawhta ama pahno.
Khazohpa ta miah pathlatuhpazy hnohta bie â taihpa liata hnabeiseihna ei hneipa kyh vâta tahmâ he liata pachiapa ta a duahpa ei châ.
Cha bietai cha eima chi hrawh hleinozy ta hmô awpa hnabeiseihpa ta, chhô nah zâ ta phahnai khoh ngaitapa ta Khazohpa ama chakao tyh. Hy abei y, cha hnabeiseihna kyh vâna chata Zuzy ta eina leih ei.
Khazohpa ta athihpa a pathyu tahpa he, khazia zo chhih leipa hmo ta nama rao tly?
“Kei chhao he Nâzari Zisu moh chakhiapa ta hmo hluhpi tao awpa pha a tahpa ei vaw châ hra.

Cha hmozy cha Zerusale liata tao na ta. Theihthai beizy tawhta biehneina ei hmô tawhta, mopathaihpa hluhpi patâhna o liata ei khôpa dei châ leipa ta, ama thie nota chhao, thie awpa a paryhsa tyhpa ei châ.
Pakhyna o zydua liata âmo cha hrie tyh ei na ta, Khazohpa moh reipachhie awpa ta tao ei na ta, ama chô liata nôchhie ngaitapa ta y na ta, râh hropa khihpi lâzy taihta âmo a taola laihpa ei châ.
“Cha hawhta tao awpa ta, theihthai beizy biehneina a chabapa ta, âmo tuapa ta Dâmaskâ lâ sie na ta.
Hy abei y, lâpi liata ei sie hai nota, nohchhô lichih ta avâ tawhta khaihpa, noh hlâta khaih viapa ta kei nata ei sielâhpazy chheipâh liata a vaw khaihpa hmô na ta.
Eima zydua ta alei liata pao pi ta, Hebrai reih ta, ‘Sawla, Sawla, khazia eina taola chi? Chôchahrei pazaopa chapiepa cha na châta a pasa kaw mâh tâh,’ eina tahpa ao thei na ta.
Chatawhcha kei ta, ‘Abeipa, ahy ma na châ?’ tah na ta. Abeipa ta, ‘Zisu na taolapa kha ei châ.
Châhrasala thyu la, na phei ta a duah teh. Nâ chakaotuhpa ta cha tao awpa ta na hnohta ei vaw luah. Kei liata hmo na hmôpazy nata na hnohta ei luahna liata na hmôpazy nâ châhkhei lymâ aw.
Na chiheihzy nata Zenitaizy lâ cha tuah aw na ta, âmo tawhta ei cha pachha aw.

Ama mozy pavâsapa ta, zohna tawhta khaihna lâ paheisa awpa nata Sâtâ hmotaotheina tawhta Khazohpa hmotaotheina lâ paheisa awpa ta ei cha tuah aw. Chatanachata molei ngiahthaina hmô aw ei ta, einâ ngiapâpa vâ ei ta, pathaisapazy hry liata tovyuh ama hnei hra aw,’ tahpa ta eina chho.
“Chavâta Bei Akripâ y, avâ tawhta aluahna cha zyh leipa ta y thei va na.

A hmiatua ta Dâmaskâ mo hnohta phuah na ta, cha khai tawhta Zerusale mo nata Zudia râh to liata chyhsazy hnohta nata Zenitaizy hnoh chhao ta ei phuah lymâ. Ro moh phaoh tlâh châpa ta hmo taopa ta ro ei sala, Khazohpa lâ a heih awpa ta ei chho lymâ ei.
Cha vâna chata Zuzy ta Achhyna o liata na patu ei ta, thie einâ chhuah ei.

Châhrasala Khazohpa tawhta baona ei hmôpa vâta, tanoh taihta a châhkhei lymâ thei na ta, he liata chhao a duah na ta, chyhsa nawhpazy nata molaipazy hmiakô liata ei châhkhei theipa he a châ. Hrohsopazy nata Mawsi ta a vaw tlô awpa ama reipazy dei leipa ta, bie hropa khâpa hmah reih va na.

Hrohsopazy nata Mawsi ta Mesia cha riethei tao aw ta, athihpa thyuheihna hmia a sahtuhpa a châpa vâta, keimo phopi hnohta nata Zenitaizy hnohta khaihna a phuahtuhpa a châ awpa kyh ama reipa dei leipa cha, bie hropa khâpa hmah reih va na,” tah ta.
Cha hawhta a thaichâna bie a rei hai nota, Festâ ta ao paro ngaitapa ta, “Pawla, na palôh â ki khao leipa he! Nâ chu hluhna ta a cha pahrusa ha hih!” tah ta.
Pawla ta, “Festâ zachhih chaipa y, a hrupa châ va na, biedopa nata bie yzie hneipa tlao ei reih.

He bie he abei ta a pahno. Chavâta ano hnohta cha riahphapa ta ei reipa a châ. He hmozy he a chaki chakô liata taopa châ veih ei. Chavâta a abei pahno lei awpa ta phihpa y tlâ vei, tahpa a siapa ta ei pahno.
Bei Akaripâ, hrohsopazy na zo ma? Na zo tahpa ei pahno,” tah ta.
Akripâ ta Pawla hnohta, “Buakhata reipasao ta, Krizyhpa ta tao awpa ma einâ chhuah chi?” tah ta.

Pawla ta, “Buakha chhôh ta tlyma, bohpi tlyma rai châ sala, nâ dei châ leipa ta, tanoh ta ei bie a theipa zydua heta, he bâliazy he na tah leipa ta cha, keima hawhta y awpa ta Khazohpa lâta ei hiah,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha abei cha thyu ta, râhvaotuhpa nata Benisi nata ama hnohta a tyuhpazy chhao thyu ei ta.
Ama pua nahta, a chhohia ei ta, “He chyhsa heta thina tlâh a châpa tlyma, patâh tlâh a châpa tlyma, khâpa hmah tao vei,” tah ei ta.
Akripâ ta Festâ hnohta, “He chyhsa he Kaisarâ kô tlô awpa a haw leipa sala cha, papua theipa a châ,” tah ta.
Itali râh lâ balyh ta eima sie awpa ama pathlu nahta, Pawla nata atâhpa chyhsa thokhazy cha Awkastu py liata pheisaih za kha hyutuhpa Zulia ama tahpa ku liata hlâ ei ta.
Asia râh tilaipi ngiahkâ liata a ypa khihzy chapiapa ta a sie awpa Adarâmatia balyh kiapa ta tilaipi liata sie pi ta. Mâsidônia chyhsa, Thysalawnika khihpa Aristaku chhao eima hnohta vaw sie hra ta.
A mylâ ta Sidaw khih tlô pi ta. Zulia ta Pawla cha ngiachhie kaw ta, a viasazy lâ charei ta, a byuhna hawhta ama vaw mohôh awpa pasaih ta.
Cha su tawhta sie heih pi ta, thlih ta eima hmia lâ tawhta miah a supa vâta, thlih a chalihna Kuparâ liahpahlô lâta chahrih pi ta.
Silisia râh nata Pamphulia râh daih lâ tilaipi eima khô tawhta, Lysia râh liata Myrâ khih tlô pi ta.
Cha liata pheisaih za kha hyutuhpa ta Alezandria khih balyh Itali râh lâ a sie awpa hmô ta, cha liata miah pakiasa ta.
Noh hluhpi dusawta ta sie pi ta, vâsâ ta Knidu khih dady tlô pi ta, thlih ta eima hmia lâ tawhta miah a supa vâta, Salmône dady ta thlih a chalihna Krite lâta chahrih pi ta.
Rairu ngaitapa ta ngiahkâ chhei pi ta, Balyh Apahâna Ngiapa ama tahpa su tlô pi ta, cha su cha Lâsia khih kiapâh liata a ypa a châ.
Noh hluhpi khô ha ta, Kâhvileipa noh chhao a khô hapa vâta, balyh ta siepa cha chichhih ngaita ta. Pawla ta âmo cha pachâna pie ta,

ama hnohta, “Pâpuh saih u, he tawhta eima pua khiahta cha, hmahphaona nata pahleina eimâ tyh aw, tahpa ei pahno. Hmobaoh nata balyh dei châ leipa ta, keimo hrona châ chhao ta chichhihpa a châ,” tah ta.
Châhrasala pheisaih za kha hyutuhpa ta Pawla bie reipa hlâta balyh puhpa nata balyh hneituhpa bie pachâ peimawh via ha ta.

Balyh apahâna su cha chasipaw daihti hmâ nawpa châta â ryh leipa vâta, a hluh via ta sie awpa pha tah ei ta. Phôni khih chhâ ama tlô thei khiahta cha, cha liata chasipaw daihti hmâ awpa a phapa ta pahno ei ta. Phôni khih cha Krite liahpahlô liata balyh apahâna miakha châ ta, chho notla lâ nata maw notla lâ a heihpa a châ.
Chho thlih nai zualuapa a vaw pathli nahta, ama khozie hawhta a châpa ta pachâ ei ta, thua cha-ia chalo ei ta, Krite liahpahlô ngiahkâ chheipa ta sie ei ta.
Châhrasala raphyu lâ tawhta thlih ru ngaitapa, maw nochhi thlih ama tahpa thlai vaw pathli ta.
Balyh cha vaw su ta, eima toh thei khao lei nahta, thlih a paphaosapa ta sie pi ta.
Kawdâ ama tahpa, thlih a chalihna liahpahlô chyhpa lâta chhei pi ta, rairu ngaitapa ta balyh chyhpa cha pabohsa thei lylia pi ta.

Amâ daophi khai tawhta, balyh chyhpa nata balyh laipa cha khawhhri ta chahry pâ ei ta. Syti su liata sadi liata amâ tâh pathlei awpa chipa ta, balyh pohraipa cha pahnai ei ta, thlih siena lâta a paphaosa ei ta.
Tichatlaopa ta thata miah a supa vâta, a mylâ ta balyh hmophaopazy cha thy pathao ei ta.
A noh thôhna noh ta, âmo ku tlai ta balyh hmobaohzy thy heih ei ta.
Noh hluhpi chhôh noh nata awhsizy a lâ leipa ta, thlihpi ru ngaitapa ta miah a chanaoh ngâ thlâh hapa vâta, hro awpa rai a hnabeiseih khao ma pi.

Pati nie leipa ta bohpi ama y tawhta, Pawla cha ama hry liata a duah ta, ama hnohta, “Pupa saih u, ei bie kha zyhpa ta, Krite liahpahlô tawhna khata vaw sie leipa ei sih la cha, he hmahphaona nata pahleina he eimâ tyh lei awpa tlai.
Chatahrasala tahmâ thlalôhpa ta y awpa ta ei cha pasyu ei. Nama hry liata ahy hmah hrona pahlei aw veih ei chi, balyh deikua cha a rao aw.
Tazâ liana tlai khata, ano eih châ na ta, ei chakaopa Khazohpa vâlyuhchâpa ei hmiakô liata a vaw duah ta,
ei hnohta, ‘Pawla, chi khah y, Kaisarâ hmiakô liata nâ duah awpa a châ. Moh teh, na hnohta balyh liata a siepa zydua chhao kha, Khazohpa ta a cha pie,’ eina tah.
Chavâta pupa saih u, thlalôhpa ta y teh u, Khazohpa a ngiapâ na ta, eina chhopa hawh tlai ta a y aw.
Anodeikua kheihawhpa liahpahlô lia ma cha, sadi liata a tâh awpa ta eima tao awpa a châ,” tah ta.
Adaria tilaipi lâta thlih ta miah a phao hai nota, zâ hrawh hleipalih a tloh zâ ta, zâcho rachhôh ta balyh puhpazy ta raphyu miakha amâ hnia hapa pangiasa ei ta.
Ti athuna thlie ei ta, lâh kih a thu ta. A chyhta ama sie nahta, thlie heih ei ta, lâh hrawh hleipangawh a thu ta.
Lôchhô chô liata ama sie awpa chipa ta, balyh chao lâta thua cha-ia miapalih pathla ei ta, khih thlai a pavâ awpa hnabeiseihpa ta hâ ei ta.
Balyh puhpazy cha balyh luh lâta thua cha-iazy pathla awpa hawhta tao pakheipa ta, balyh chyhpa cha tilaipi liata pathla ei ta, balyh laipa cha a râsai a chhuah ei ta.
Pawla ta pheisaih za kha hyutuhpa nata pheisaihzy hnohta, “He sahlao he balyh liata ama y thlâh ha leipa khiahta cha, a boh aw veih ei chi,” tah ta.
Chatanachata pheisaihzy ta balyh chyhpa rizy cha chhawh pachhô ei ta, balyh chyhpa cha ti ama paphao haw.
Khihdei chy ta, Pawla ta chyhsa zydua cha pati nie awpa ta chho ta, ama hnohta, “Tanoh he nôpopa ta nama y tawhta noh hrawh hleipalih châ ha ta, nie leipa ta y ei chi ta, khâpa hmah nie veih ei chi.
Chavâta pati nie awpa ta ei châ haw ei. Nama thatlô nawpa a châ. Nama hry liata ahy hmah a luh liata sâbu miakha chhao leidia aw vei,” tah ta.
Cha bie cha a rei khai nahta, viahchhâ la ta, chyhsa zydua hmiakô liata Khazohpa lâta alyna bie reih ta, pachhaih ta, nie ta.
Chatawhcha ama zydua ta ama thlah vaw lôh ta, pati nie ha hra ei ta.
Balyh liata chyhsazy cha eima zydua ta 276 eima châ.
Ama nie khai nahta, ama sâh phaopazy tilaipi liata thypa ta, balyh cha pahuasa via ei ta.
Khih a vaw pavâ nahta, khâpa râh ma ama tlô tahpa pahno leipa ei ta. Châhrasala raphyu a hneipa lihchakôpa hmô ei ta. A thei khiahta cha, balyh cha ngiahkâ lâ chasô a chhuah ei ta.

Thua cha-ia rizy â pachhô ei ta, tilaipi liata siesai ei ta. Balyh hiana chahry pâna rizy chhao pathlâ ei ta, a hmia lâta pohraipa cha thlih ta a hmô thei nawpa ta pasâh ei ta, raphyu lâ pangai ei ta.

Châhrasala tilaipi miano atyhna su liata a ngia pi ta, balyh cha alei chô liata patâh ha ei ta. Balyh luh lâ a taw ha ta, papie thei leipa ta y ta, a chao lâ deikua cha ti chatlaopa rupa ta parao pathao ta.
Pheisaihzy ta atâhpazy cha, ti a zawpa ta amâ râ pathlei aw tahpa chipa ta thie a chhuah ei ta.
Châhrasala pheisaih za kha hyutuhpa ta Pawla a pachha khohpa vâta, ama hmo a chhuahpa cha pakhâ ha ta. Ti zaw athaipa maih balyh tawhta a zawpa ta raphyu lâ pua tua awpa ta biepie ta.
Ahropazy cha thophia hmâpa ta tlyma, balyh hmobaohzy hmâpa ta tlyma, raphyu lâ pua awpa ta biepie hra ta. Cha hawhna chata ama zydua ta raphyu lâ â bohpa ta pua khai ha ei ta.
Eima pua khai tawhta, liahpahlô moh cha Maltâ a châ tahpa pahno pi ta.
Cha liahpahlô chyhsazy chata miah ngiachhie ngaita ei ta. Avâ suah pathao ha ta a chasi kawpa vâta, mei patih ei ta, eima zydua ta miah a vaw ly ei ta.
Pawla cha tho pakhy ta, mei liata vaw ti ta, a sahpa vâta vâzi vaw pua ta, a ku liata chazei ta.

Cha râh chyhsazy ta parih a ku liata â bangieh thlâh hapa ama hmô nahta, “He chyhsa he lianycheihpa a châ tlai aw. Tilaipi tawhta pua hra sala, ryureina dopa ta a hroh awpa pasaih pyly vei,” tah ei ta.
Châhrasala parih cha mei liata chatho pathlah ta, kheihta hmah y leipa ta.

A vaw thloh aw tlyma, eikhapi ta paopa ta a thi aw tlyma, tahpa ta Pawla cha moh thlâh ha ei ta. Bohpi hâ ei ta, kheihta hmah a y leipa ama hmô nahta, ama palôh anano ta, khazoh a châ hih, tlao tah heih ei ta.
Cha su chheipâh liata liahpahlôzy cha, Bei Publia râh châ ta. Ano chata miah a vaw ly ta, noh thôh chhôh a ly kawpa ta a o liata miah patlôsa ta.
Publia paw cha chasipa nata thisaih chhôhpatlaipa ta pasapa ta a vaw zia thlâh ha ta. Pawla cha a ngia ta, thlahchhâ ta, a chô liata a ku pahnieh ta, patlâh ha ta.
Cha hawhta hmo a ypa cha ama pahno nahta, liahpahlô chyhsa hropa pasana a hneipazy a vy ei ta, patlâhpa ta y ei ta.
Chatanachata Maltâ liahpahlô chyhsazy chata thata miah palyupalih ei ta, eima sie chy ta, eimâ ngiahpazy balyh liata vaw soh ei ta.
Thla thôh a khô tawhta, liahpahlô liata chasipaw daihti a hmâhpa Alezandria balyh, maphieh khazohzy ama tahpa ta sie pi ta.
Syraku khih liata a pahâ pi ta, cha liata noh thôh châh pi ta.
Cha tawhna chata chahlô pi ta, Rezia khih tlô pi ta. Noh kha eima sie tawhta, chho thlih vaw pathli ta, a noh nona liata Putôli khih tlô pi ta.
Cha liata unawhzy hmô pi ta, ama hnohta noh sari châh awpa ta miah thlyu ei ta. Chatawhcha Rawma tlô pi ta.

Unawhzy ta eima thâtih ama thei nahta, a vy ei ta, Apia Daohpi nata Khichhai Bu Miathôh ama tahpa taihta miah vaw dy ei ta. Âmo cha a hmô nahta, Pawla cha Khazohpa lâ alyna bie reih ta, thlalôhpa ta y ha ta.
Rawma eima tlô nahta, Pawla cha vaituhpa pheisaih hneipa ta, ano kho ta y awpa ta pasaipa châ ta.

Noh thôh a châ tawhta, Pawla ta Zu chyhsa hyutuhpazy awpakhy ta, amâ vypakhy nahta, ama hnohta, “Unawh saih u, eima phopi nata miah pathlatuhpazy phoryhpa chakhiapa ta khâpa hmo hmah ei tao leina chôta na patâh ei ta, Zerusale tawhta Rawma mo ku liata hlâpa ei châ.
Bie eina hiahri no ei ta, leihpa ei châna kyh liata, thina ta hrie tlâh awpa khâpa hmah a y leipa vâta, na pathlie awpa ama khoh.
Châhrasala eina pathlie awpa ei cha, Zuzy ta ama ei hapa vâta, ei phopi leih nawpa khâpa hmah ei hnei leipa chhao ta, Kaisarâ kô a tlô lei thei awpa châ khao va na.
Cha kyh vâna chata, nâmo châ hmô awpa nata bie cha reikhei awpa ta ei châ hawpa ei a châ, Izarei hnabeiseihpa vâta, he bâlia he a kypa châ tlôh na ta,” tah ta.
Âmo ta a hnohta, “Nâma kyh liata Zudia râh tawhta châ hmô leipa pi ta, he lâ a khypa unawhzy hry liata ahy hmahta na thâtih chhiepa a phuahpa y leipa ei ta, a reihpa y hra veih ei.
Châhrasala he py he su to liata reipachhiepa châ tlôh ei ta, nâma ta kheihta ma na pachâ tahpa pahno eima khoh,” tah ei ta.

A noh taih ei ta, cha noh liata a tlôna o liata chyhsa hluhpi ta vaw pangai ei ta. My tawhta zâlâ taihta âmo cha chhopasia ta, Khazohpa khinarâh a châhkheipa ta, Mawsi ryhpa nata hrohsopazy châbu liata Zisu kyh reipa ta Zuzy cha pahnie a chhuah ta.
A bie reipa ta thokha cha pahnie ta, ahropazy deikua ta zo leipa ei ta.
Ama bie a hmô thai khao leipa ta, Pawla ta bie miakha a rei khai nahta, ama pua haw. Pawla ta, “Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta hrohsopa Isai pakah ta châ pathlatuhpazy hnohta,
“‘Cha phopi lâ cha sie la, Hetana heta kei reih teh: “Thei cha thei aw ei chi ta, Châhrasala pahno thai aw veih ei chi, Hmô cha hmô aw ei chi ta, Châhrasala nama novâh aw vei.”

Cha phopi palôh cha a kuhchha ha ta, Ama nah ta phiephuh dei thei ta, Ama mozy ama paso haw; Chata châ vei sala cha, Ama mo ta hmôpa ta, Ama nah ta thei aw ei ta, Ama palôh ta pahnopa ta, A vaw lie aw ei ta, Ei patlâh ha awpa ei tlai,’ tahpa ta a reipa kha â vaw do ngaita na.
Chavâta Khazohpa pachhana bie cha Zenitaizy lâta paphaopa a châ haw tahpa pahno teh u. Âmo ta la ama nathlie aw,” tah ta.
Cha biezy cha a rei khai nahta, Zuzy cha âmosasyh ta thata aeichhiana chôta pua ha ei ta.
Pawla cha kô no bohloh ano o a hlâpa liata y ta, ano lâ a chareipa zydua a vaw ly tyh ta.
Riahpha ngaitapa nata pakhâna y leipa ta, Khazohpa khinarâh kyh reih ta, Abeipa Zisu Krista thâtih a pachu lymâ.
Pawla, Zisu Krista chakaotuhpa, lyuhchâpa châ awpa ta awpa nata Khazohpa thâtihpha châta pananopa ta, he châpaphaopa he a roh.
Cha thâtihpha cha, Khazohpa ta a hrohsopazy hmâpa ta hlâno tawhta Biehrai pathaihpa liata bie â vaw taih hapa a châ.
Cha thâtihpha cha a Sawchapawpa, eima Beipa Zisu Krista thâtih châ ta, sapa kyh liata cha Dâvi pathla ta a pihpa a châ.
A Thlahpa pathaihna kyh liata deikua cha, athihpa hry tawhta a thyuheihna ta, eima Beipa Zisu Krista cha hmotaotheina a hneipa Khazohpa Sawchapawpa a châzie a palâsa.
Ano vâta nata ano moh ta phopi to pangiapâsa ta, a bie pazyhsa awpa ta, ngiachhiena nata lyuhchâpa châna eima hmô.
Cha chata nâmo, Rawma khih liata a ypa, Zisu Krista eih châ awpa ta awpa zydua chhao a cha pahly ei.

Rawma khihpi liata Khazohpa kyhpachâpazy nata a mopathaihpazy châ awpa ta a awpa zydua ei châ naoh ei. Khazohpa eima Paw nata Abeipa Zisu Krista tawhta ngiachhiena nata thlalôhna nama hnohta y mawh sy.
A hmiatua chai ta, namâ ngiapâna kyh Khizaw zydua liata a pathâhpa vâta, nama zydua châta Zisu Krista moh ta ei Khazohpa lâ alyna bie ei reih.
Nama moh reipa ta bâh leipa ta thlah ei cha chhâpa tyh ei. Cha kyh liata, a Sawchapawpa thâtihpha raihria liata ei thlahpa ta ei chakaopa Khazohpa cha nâ pahnokheituhpa a châ.
Khazohpa ta â ryh tah sala, tahmâ lia chhâ heta cha, cha vaw tly thei awpa ei ta khâ ei hiah tyh.
Nama pachyu thei nawpa ta Thlahpa hmopiepa cha pahneisa awpa ei ta, nâmo châ hmô awpa ei khoh ngaita.
Chatanachata namâ ngiapâna nata ei ngiapâna hmâpa ta, eimâ ngiapâna tha eimâ patlô raihrie thei aw.
Unawh saih u, nâmo nata Zenitai hropazy hry liata theilâpa hmô awpa ta, cha vaw tly awpa ei a chhuah tyh na ta, châhrasala pakhâna a y chhyh hapa kyh nama pahno lei awpa khoh va na.
Krikâh mo nata mohropazy, asopa nata ahrupazy liata a bâhpa ei hnei.
Chavâta nâmo, Rawma khih liata a ypazy hnoh chhao ta, thâtihpha cha chho awpa a ngiatiah va na.
Thâtihpha cha zakhei tlôh lei khâh na ta. Ahy rai a ngiapâpa maih châta pachha châ nawpa ta Khazohpa hmotaotheina châ tlôh ta, a hmiatua ta Zu chyhsa châta châ ta, Krikâh mo châta chhao a châ.
“Mosiapa cha ngiapâna ta a hroh aw,” tahpa ropa hawhta, thâtihpha liana chata Khazohpa siana a vaw luah ta, cha siana cha âthaona tawhta achhâna taihta ngiapâna vâta a ypa a châ.
Khazohpa a pachâ leipa nata chyhsa sia leipa zydua chô liata Khazohpa pathiiana avâ tawhta a zâ luah. Âmo cha ama sialeina vâta biehmeiseihpa a pakhâtuhpazy ama châ.
Khazohpa thâtih pahno awpa cha âmo liata a sia thlâh haw. Cha cha Khazohpa tlai ta a pahnosa ha ei.
Mo ta hmô thei leipa a châna, a chhâzaw hmotaotheina nata a Khazoh châna zy cha, khizaw tao tua no tawhta hmôpa ta y ta, hmotaopazy liata a siapa ta â lâ. Chavâta rei nawpa hnei veih ei.
Khazohpa cha pahno taraw ei ta, châhrasala Khazohpa hawhta palyupalih leipa ei ta, alyna bie hlâ hra veih ei. Hmo hraoleipa tlao pachâ via ei ta, ama pathipalôh hruna cha a vaw zoh haw.
Chyhsa sopa hawhta a reih ei ta, ahrupa lâta ama pua haw.
Chatanachata thi thei leipa Khazohpa rônahna cha, thi theipa chyhsazy, pavawzy, phei palihpa sazy nata alyhpasa nothlahpazy hawhta ama pachâsa haw.
Chavâta ama pôhpa nozachhih ngaitapa ta a tao raihrie awpa ta, ama pathipalôh aohraohna hawhta hmo puapa tao awpa ta Khazohpa ta â heihsai ha ei.
Khazohpa biehmeiseihpa cha haipa ta pachâsapa ta, Taotuhpa a chhy leipa ei ta, a hmotaopazy a chhypa ta ama chakao. Taotuhpa cha chhâzaw ta reithaipa ta y mawh sy! Amen.
Cha vâna chata Khazohpa ta nozachhih ngaitapa ta sihryh awpa ta âmo cha â heihsai ha ei. Ama chanôzy ta chanô chapaw châna hmâzie tyhpa siesaipa ta, hmâzie lei awpa ta hmâh ei ta.

Chapawzy chhao ta, chanô liata hmâ tyhpa cha siesaipa ta, chapaw nata chapaw a patla ei ta, chapawzy ta nozana châh pahno leipa ta ama chapaw heihzy ykhei ei ta, ama pôhpa lia tlai ta ama moleina ty cha ama hmô.
Khazohpa pahnopa cha hmo phahnai leipa hawhta ama pachâpa vâta, palôh doleipa phaoh ta, tao lei awpazy tao awpa ta Khazohpa ta âmo cha â heihsai ha ei.
Chatanachata sialeina chi to, apatlana, chhoruna, karâyna nata kiaphaona zy ta bie ei ta, hiatliana, lianycheina, ahryuna, dôveina, nôchhiena nata kyhchhie reina zy ta ama bie.
Chyhsa a reipachhiepa, Khazohpa a haopa, a patahsapa, a palaipa, a pahôpahâhpa, moleina khaohvâh a pahnopa, nôpaw rei a ngiah leipa,
ahrupa, ngiapâ leipa, palôh a hnei leipa nata zawngiahna a hnei leipazy ama châ.
Cha hawhpa hmo a taopazy cha, a thi tlâh ama châ tahpa Khazohpa bieraopa pahno thlâh hana chôta, âmo taopa dei châ leipa ta, mohropazy taopa chhao amâ lykhei tyh.

Chavâta Hy chyhsapa, nâ, mohropa a sei thaipa, rei awpa rai hnei va chi. Mohropa na seina liana tlai khata, nâmasasyh ta thailei nâ pachâsa haw, nâ, seituhpa tlai chhao chi kha, cha hawhpa hmozy a tao tyhpa na châ hrapa vâta.
Cha hawhpa hmo a tao tyhpazy chô liata Khazohpa pachiana a tlô thlupa cha, a châ awpa tlai na a châ tahpa eima pahno.
Hy chyhsapa, cha hawhpa hmo a tao tyhpazy a seituhpa y, nâ chhao kha, cha hawhta tao hra tlôh chi ta, Khazohpa pachiana khôkhâh nâ pangiasa ma?
A châ vei khiah, Khazohpa phana cha rona lâ châ chhi awpa a châpa pahno leipa ta, a phana hluhzie nata a nôphazie nata a palôh pasizie zy cha, hraoleipa hawhta ma na pachâ?
Na palôh kuhchhana nata ro khoh leina vâta, hiehâhna noh, Khazohpa pachiana siapa â vaw luahna noh châta, nâmasasyh ta hiehâhna nâ pachôpakhy.
Khazohpa ta chyhsa to ama hmotaopa lymâ hawhta a pachia aw.
Hmopha tao hualuapa ta, rônahna nata palyupalihna nata thi khao leina a tluatuhpazy hnohta chhâzaw hrona a pie aw.
Âmo pha nawpa sai tluapa ta, biehmeiseihpa zyh leipa ta, sialeina a zyhtuhpazy chô lia deikua cha, pathiiana nata hiehâhna a y aw.
Moleina a taopa chyhsa to chô liata rietheipasana nata pachârôhna vaw tlô aw ta, Zu chyhsa chô liata tlô tua aw ta, Krikâh chyhsa chô liata chhao a tlô aw.
Hmopha a taotuhpa chô liata deikua cha, rônahna nata palyupalihna nata thlalôhna zy vaw tlô aw ta, Zu chyhsa chô liata tlô tua aw ta, Krikâh chyhsa chô liata chhao a tlô aw.
Khazohpa cha khokhei viapa hnei vei.
Ryhpa hnei leipa ta hmo a paraopazy cha, ryhpa leipa ta leidia aw ei ta; ryhpa hneina chôta hmo a paraopazy cha, ryhpa ta pachiapa ama châ aw.
Ryhpa bie a theituhpa maihta Khazohpa mohmô ta asiapazy châ hlei leipa ei ta, ryhpa bie a zyhtuhpazy deita thai pachâsapa ama châ aw.
Ryhpa a hnei leipa Zenitaizy ta ama pikheipa chhie nata pha pahnona hmâpa ta, ryhpa ta â hnawpazy ama tao tyh. Chavâta ryhpa ama hnei leipa chhao ta, cha cha âmo châta ryhpa a châ.
Ryhpa raihria cha ama palôh liata ropa a châzie palâsa ei ta, cha cha ama chhie nata pha pahnona ta pahnokhei ta, ama pachâna hmâpa ta a châh ta thailei a pachâ ei ta, a châh ta thai ama pachâ tyh.
Thâtihpha ei reipa hawhna heta, Khazohpa ta Krista Zisu hmâpa ta chyhsapa bieruzy a pachia noh liata, cha hawhna chata a châ aw.
Pachâ teh, nâ Zu chyhsa a tah chi ta, ryhpa a ngâchhâ chi ta, Khazohpa nâ palaikhei.
Ryhpa pachupa na châpa vâta, Khazohpa khopa pahno chi ta, hmo phapa chhao nâ pyh.
Mochaopa a chhihtha awpa nata zohna liata a ypazy châta khaihna na châpa nâ pahno.
Pahnona nata biehmeiseihpa yna ryhpa na hneipa vâta, ahrupazy pasotuhpa nata hawtizy pachutuhpa ta nâ pachâ.
Cha hawhpa na châ hnohkua cha, nâ, mohropazy pachutuhpa, nâmasasyh ta a pachu va chi mâ? Nâ, paru lei awpa biechhotuhpa, na paru tyh ma?
Nâ, aphei awpa châ vei a tahtuhpa, nâ phei tyh ma? Nâ, khazoh nothlahpazy a haotuhpa, khazoh nothlahpa achhyna o liata hmozy na paru tyh ma?
Nâ, ryhpa a palaikheipa, ryhpa paraopa ta Khazohpa moh na pachhie tyh ma?
“Nâmo vâta Khazohpa moh cha Zenitaizy hry liata reipachhiepa ta a y,” tahpa ta ropa hawhna khata a châ.
Ryhpa na zyh khiahta cha, chopawtaipa cha phahnaina a hnei. Ryhpa na parao khiahta deikua cha, na chopawtaipa cha tai leipa hawhta a châ.
Chopawtaileipa chyhsa ta ryhpa bieraopazy a zyh khiahta cha, a chopawtaileipa cha taipa hawhta pachâpa châ aw vei ma?
Chavâta a pôhpa liata chopawtai leipa, châhrasala ryhpa a zyh pakipa chata, nâ, ryhpa bie ropa ta a hneipa nata chopawtaipa, châhrasala ryhpa a paraotuhpa chi cha, thailei a cha pachâ aw.
Chôpho dei ta Zu a châpa cha Zu hmeiseihpa châ leipa ta, chôpho ta sapa dei chopawtaipa chhao chopawtai hmeiseihpa châ vei.

Zu châna cha chyhsa chhôh liata y ta, chopawtaina cha palôh liata a y, châbie ta chopawtaipa châ leipa ta, Thlahpa ta taipa tlao a châ. Cha hawhpa chyhsa cha, chyhsapa reithaina hlao leipa ta, Khazohpa reithaina a hlao tyh.
Cha khiahta la, Zu chyhsa châpa cha phahnaina khâpa a hnei? Chopawtaipa chhao cha khâpa athôhna a hnei?
Kyh to liata a phahnai. A phahnaina chaipa cha, Khazohpa biezy pavaosapa ama châpa he a châ.
Thokha ngâchhih leipa ei sala, kheihta a châ aw? Âmo ngâchhih leina chata Khazohpa ngâchhihna hraoleipa ta a tao aw ma?
Châ bao va! Chyhsa zydua a haihpa châ hra ei sala, Khazohpa cha adopa a châ, Biehrai liata, “Na bie ta thai châ la, Pachiapa ta na y tita, Pahniena to mah y,” tahpa ta ropa hawhna khata.

Châhrasala keimo sialeina ta Khazohpa siana a palâsa khiahta cha, khâpa eima reih khao aw? Eima chô liata a hiehâhna a patlôsana kyh liata, Khazohpa cha sialeipa a châ ma? Cha cha chyhsapa lâ tawhta ei reipa a châ.
Châ bao va! Chata a châ khiahta cha, Khazohpa ta kheihta khizaw a pachia thei aw?
Kei ta haipa bie ei reipa vâta, Khazohpa biehmeiseihpa cha ano parônahsana taihta â lâ khiahta cha, khazia moleipa hawhta thailei pachâsapa ta ei y?

Chyhsa thokha ta, “‘Hmo phapa a vaw pua thei nawpa ta, hmo moleipa tao ei suh u,’ ama tah na,” tahpa ta â doleipa ta miah ama baipa hawhna khata eima tao thlâh ha aw ma? Cha hawhpa chyhsazy cha thailei a châ awpa rai ama châ.
Cha khiahta la, keimo Zuzy pi he Krikâh mo hlâta eima pha via hlei ma? Châ bao va! Zuzy chhao, Krikâh mo chhao, moleina sei liata a ypa eima châ khaizie eima rei hapa kha.
Biehrai liata, “Ahy hmah a siapa y veih ei, Pakha hmah y veih ei;
Ahy hmah a pahno thaipa y veih ei, Ahy hmah Khazohpa a tluapa y veih ei.
Ama zydua ta pavia khai ha ei ta, Phahnai leipa ama châ khai haw; Hmo pha a taopa y veih ei, Pakha hmah y veih ei.
Ama rao cha thlâ a pahypa châ ta, Ama paleih dôna bie reina châta hmâh ei ta, Ama hmao liata parih châmaih a y.
Ama pakah cha chhiesana nata ruchhôna ta a bie.
Thisaih palo awpa ta ama phei chatlie kaw ta,
Ama lâpizy liata raona nata rietheina a y;
Thlalôhna lâpi pahno veih ei.
Ama mo liata Khazohpa china rai y vei,” tahpa ta ropa a châ.
Ryhpa ta a reipa maih cha, ryhpa ry liata a ypazy hnohta reipa a châ tahpa eima pahno. Chatanachata pakah to hmao mopa ta y aw ei ta, khizaw zydua he Khazohpa ryureina ry liata a y thei aw.
Ryhpa vâta moleina pahnona vaw y ta, chavâta chyhsapa ahy hmahta hmotaopa vâta Khazohpa mohmô ta thaichâ thei aw veih ei.
Châhrasala ryhpa nata hrohsopazy reipa hawhta, ryhpa leipa ta Khazohpa siana cha tahmâ paluahsapa ta a y haw.
Cha Khazohpa siana cha, Zisu Krista amâ ngiapâpa vâta ngiapâtuhpa zydua hnohta paluahsapa ta a y. Ananona rai y vei.
Chyhsa zydua ta molei khai ha ei ta, Khazohpa rônahna to thei khao veih ei.
Cha moleipazy cha, Zisu Krista chatlaina vâta, a ngiachhiena ta a saipa ta thai pachâsapa ama châ.

Zisu Krista cha molei reihpha cheina châta a thisaih palo awpa ta Khazohpa ta a raopa châ ta, cha ngiahthaina cha ngiapâna vâta hmô theipa a châ. A nôphana vâta, kha hlâta moleinazy cha, Khazohpa ta pahno lei a pachâ ta, a siana cha a paluahsa haw.
Zisu Krista cha mosiapa a châ thei nawpa nata ano ngiapâtuhpa châta thaipachâsatuhpa a châ thei nawpa ta, Khazohpa ta tahmâhlâ daihti liana heta Zisu Krista siana cha a vaw palâsapa a châ.
Cha khiahta la, eimâ palaikhei kawpa kha khataih liata a y haw? Thypa ta a y haw. Khâpa ryhpa ta maw? Hmotaopa ryhpa ta ma? Châ vei, ngiapâna ryhpa ta tlao a châ.
Ryhpa hmotaopazy vâta châ leipa ta, chyhsapa cha ngiapâna vâta thai a châpa ta eima rao.
Khazohpa cha Zuzy Khazohpa dei ma a châ? Zenitaizy Khazohpa chhao châ hra vei ma? A châ tlaih, Zenitaizy Khazohpa a châ hra.
Khazohpa cha pakha a châpa vâta, chopawtaipa cha ngiapâna vâta thaichâ aw ta, chopawtaileipa chhao, ngiapâna vâta thai a châ hra aw.
Cha khiahta la, ngiapâna vâta ryhpa cha hraoleipa ta eima pachâsa ma? Châ bao va! Ryhpa cha tlao eima pa-ipa a châ.
Cha khiahta la, sapa ryhpa ta miah pathlatuhpa Abarahâ kha, khâpa hmo a hmôpa hawhta ma eima reih aw?
Abarahâ kha hmotaopa vâta thai pachâsapa a châ khiahta cha, a palai nawpa a hnei, Khazohpa hmiakô lia deikua cha hnei vei.
Biehrai ta kheihta ma a reih? “Abarahâ cha Khazohpa a ngiapâ ta, cha ngiapâna cha a siana ta raopa a châ,” a tah.
Raihriatuhpa hlao cha ngiachhiena hawhta pachâpa châ leipa ta, a bâhpa hawhta pachâpa a châ.
Rai a hria leipa chhao ta, moleipazy thai a pachâsatuhpa a ngiapâpa cha, â ngiapâna cha siana ta raopa a châ.
Hmotaopa vâta châ leipa ta, Khazohpa ta mosiapa ta a raopa nohlaona kyh cha, Dâvi chhao ta,
“Ama paraonazy a ngiahthaipa châ ta, Ama moleinazy khupa ta a ypazy cha, Ama nohlao na;
Abeipa ta moleina hnei leipa ta a raopa cha, A nohlao na,” tahpa ta a vaw reih haw.
Abarahâ ngiapâna cha a siana ta raopa a châ, eima tah tlôh khiahta cha, cha nohlaona cha chopawtaipazy châ deita ma, chopawtai leipazy châta chhao maw?
Abarahâ kha khâpa vâta ma mosiapa ta raopa a châ? Chopawtaipa a châ tawhta ma, tai hlâta maw? Chopawtaipa a châ tawhta châ leipa ta, chopawtai hlâ tawhta mosiapa ta rao hapa a châ.

Chopawtaileipa a châ nota, mosiapa a châna pa-i nawpa ta, chopawtaipa ngiana cha ngiapâna ta hmô ta. Cha chata â chhuahpa cha, chopawtaileipa zydua paw ta tao ta, âmo chhao mosiapa ta raopa ama châ thei nawpa ta a châ.

Chopawtaipazy chhao chopawtai thlâhthlipazy châ leipa ta, miah pathlatuhpa Abarahâ chopawtaipa a châ hlâta â ngiapâna pheihnie a pazituhpa ama châ thei nawpa ta, ano cha chopawtaipazy paw ta taopa a châ hra.
Ano cha khizaw ryu a to awpa a châna kyh, Abarahâ nata a pathlazy hnohta a vaw tlôpa bietai kha, ryhpa vâta a vaw tlôpa châ leipa ta, ngiapâna ta siana vâta a vaw tlôpa tlao a châ.
Ryhpa a zyhtuhpazy ta ryutotuhpazy ama châ awpa khiahta cha, ngiapâna cha hraoleipa châ aw ta, bietai chhao aruapa a châ aw.
Ryhpa ta pathiiana tlôkhei tyh ta, ryhpa y leina liata paraona y vei.

Chavâta bietai cha ngiachhiena liata a pahnieh ta, a pathla zydua châta pa-ipa a châ thei nawpa ta, ngiapâna ta a vaw tlôpa a châ. Ryhpa a hneipazy dei châ leipa ta, Abarahâ ngiapâna a hlykheituhpazy chhao ta ama hmô hra aw. Ano cha eima zydua paw a châ.
“Phopi hluhpi paw ta ei cha tao haw,” tahpa ta ropa hawhta, Abarahâ cha athihpa a pahrotuhpa nata hmo a y leipazy a paysatuhpa châ ta, â ngiapâpa Khazohpa mohmô liata eima zydua paw a châ.
“Cha hawhna chata na pathlazy ama y aw,” tahpa ta chhopa a châpa hawhta, phopi hluhpi paw châ awpa ta, hnabeiseih â chhih leipa chhao ta, ngiapâna ta khâchâ hnabeiseih lymâ ta.
Kô za kha châ daihmâ ha ta, a pôhpa pachâpa ta, athipa hawhta a châ ha bâpa chhao ta nata Sârâ chhi a choh hapa chhao ta, ngiapâna kyh liata thachhâpa ta y beih vei.
Ngiapâna a phahla beih leipa ta, Khazohpa bietai a lôh leipa ta y beih vei. Â ngiapâna a thatlô via rili ta, Khazohpa a palyupalih lymâ.
Khazohpa cha a bietai hawhta a tao thei tahpa khâchâ a ngiapâ ta.
Chavâta â ngiapâna cha a siana ta raopa a châ.
“A siana ta raopa a châ,” tahpa biezy cha ano châ dei ropa châ leipa ta,
keimo châta chhao a châ. Athihpa hry tawhta eima Beipa Zisu a pathyutuhpa cha eimâ ngiapâ khiahta cha, keimo chhao mosiapa ta raopa eima châ hra aw.
Cha Zisu cha keimo moleina vâta thie awpa ta patusapa châ ta, thai eima châ nawpa ta pathyupa a châ.
Chavâta ngiapâna vâta thai eima châ ha tawhta cha, eima Beipa Zisu Krista zawhzi ta Khazohpa nata a ryhpa ta eima y haw.
Ano vâ lilaw ta tahmâ ta eimâ duana ngiachhiena liana heta ngiapâna ta a ngia ha pi ta, Khazohpa rônahna hnabeiseihpa ta a lypa ta eima y.
Cha dei châ vei, eima rietheina liata chhao a lypa ta eima y. Rietheina ta tiamana tao ta,
tiamana ta hrozie phapa tao ta, hrozie phapa ta hnabeiseihna a tao tahpa eima pahno.
Thlahpa Pathaihpa miah a piepa khata Khazohpa kyhpachâna eima pathipalôh liata a hry hapa vâta, cha hnabeiseihna chata maophyuhpa ta miah paysa vei.
Eima chiehlei nona khata, Krista cha moleipazy vyuhpa ta a daihtita liata thi ha ta.
Chyhsa siapa châta thi awpa cha chyhsa ta khoh kaw hlei aw vei; chyhsa phapa châta deikua cha, a thi ngâhpa ama y ngyu ma.
Châhrasala Khazohpa ta a kyhpachâna cha keimo châta vaw paluahsa ta, moleipazy eima châ nota, Krista cha eima châta thi ha ta.
Chavâta tahmâ a thisaih ta thai pachâsapa eima châ tawhta chhochhi cha, ano vâta Khazohpa hiehâhna tawhta pachhapa ta eima y via pachai aw.
Khakhaipa eima châ nota hmahta, a Sawchapawpa thina vâta Khazohpa nata a ryhpa ta eima y khiahta cha, tahmâ eimâ ryh ha tawh chhochhi cha, a hrona vâta pachhapa ta eima y via pachai aw.
Cha dei châ vei, tahmâ aryhna miah a pahmôsatuhpa eima Beipa Zisu Krista vâta Khazohpa liata eimâ ly.
Chyhsa pakha vâta moleina khizaw liata a ngia ta, moleina vâta thina a ngia ta, cha hawhna chata, chyhsa zydua ta hmo ama paraopa vâta, thina ta chyhsa zydua cha a chahryh haw.
Ryhpa y hlâta khizaw liata moleina y ha ta, ryhpa a y vei khiahta cha, moleina cha moleina ta pachâpa châ vei.
Châhrasala Âdâh daihti tawhta Mawsi daihti taihta, Âdâh paraona hawhta hmo a parao leipazy chô liata chhao, thina chata ryu a reih lymâ. Âdâh cha a vy awpa pakhona a châ.

Châhrasala hmosaipiepa cha moleina nata a lyu vei. Chyhsa pakha moleina vâta hmahta chyhsa hluhpi ama thi khiahta cha, Khazohpa ngiachhiena nata chyhsa pakha, Zisu Krista ngiachhiena hmosaipiepa chhochhi cha, chyhsa hluhpi chô liata vaoheipa ta a y tlai aw.

Hmosaipiepa cha chyhsa pakha moleina vâta hmo a vaw ypa nata a lyu vei. Thailei pachâsana pachiana cha chyhsa pakha vâta vaw y ta, thai pachâsana hmosaipiepa deikua cha, moleina hluhpi vâta tlao a vaw ypa a châ.

Chyhsa pakha moleina vâta, cha chyhsa pakha vâta hmahta thina ta ryu a reih khiahta cha, chyhsa pakha, Zisu Krista vâta ngiachhiena hluh ngaitapa nata siana hmosaipiepa a daotuhpazy chhochhi ta cha, hrona liata ryu ama reih tlai aw.
Moleina miakha vâta chyhsa zydua thailei pachâsapa ama châpa hawhta, siana hmotaopa miakha vâta chyhsa zydua thai pachâsapa châ ei ta, hrona ama hnei.
Chyhsa pakha reingiah leina vâta chyhsa hluhpi moleipa ama châ hapa hawhta, chyhsa pakha reingiahna vâta chyhsa hluhpi mosiapa ama châ aw.
Moleina pôh nawpa ta ryhpa vaw y ta, châhrasala moleina a pôhna lia maihta ngiachhiena a pôh via rili.
Moleina chata thina ta ryureih ta, ngiachhiena deikua cha, eima Beipa Zisu Krista zawhzi ta chhâzaw hrona a tlôkheipa siana ryureina a châ.
Khâpa eima reih khao aw? Ngiachhiena a pôh thei nawpa ta, moleina eima tao pazao aw ma?
Châ bao va! Keimo moleina a thisai hapazy pi ta cha, kheihta ma moleina liata eima y thei khao aw?
Keimo Krista Zisu liata bâti a châ hapazy pi cha, a thina liata bâti eima châ ha tahpa pahno veih ei chi ma?
A thina liata bâti châpa ta, a hnohta pabupa ta y pi ta, Krista cha Paw rônahna ta athihpa hry tawhta a pathyupa hawhna khata, keimo chhao hrona thiehpa ta eima charei aw.
A thina liata thi hrapa ta, ano nata eimâ zao ha khiahta cha, a thyuheihna liata chhao thyu hrapa ta, ano nata eimâ zao tlai aw.
Moleina a phaohpa pôhpa he pahleipadiapa ta, moleina sei ta eima y khao lei nawpa ta, eima chyhsa parohpa cha a hnohta khaipâpa ta a y haw tahpa eima pahno.
A thi hapa cha moleina tawhta a pua haw.
Krista hnohta eima thi ha khiahta cha, a hnohta eima hroh aw tahpa eimâ ngiapâ.
Krista, athihpa hry tawhta pathyupa cha, thi khao aw vei tahpa eima pahno. Thina ta a chô liata bie hnei khao vei.
A thina cha moleina lâ kyh liata chhâzaw châta ei kha thi ta, a hrona deikua cha, Khazohpa lâ kyh liata a hroh.
Cha hawhna chata nâmo chhao, moleina lâ kyh liata a thi hapa ta a rao u la, Khazohpa lâ kyh liata deikua cha, Krista Zisu liata a hrohpa ta a rao teh u.
Nama sapa khona pipatlohsa awpa ta, nama pôhpa thi theipa chô liata moleina ta ryureih khah sy.

Nama pôhpa pachiahpazy cha, sialeina chhaichhi châta moleina lâta hlâ leipa u la, thina tawhta hrona lâ chhihthapazy nama châpa hawhta, Khazohpa lâta a hlâ u la, nama pôhpa pachiahpazy cha siana chhaichhi châta Khazohpa lâta hlâ teh u.
Ryhpa ry liata y khao leipa ei chi ta, ngiachhiena ry liata nama y hapa vâta, moleina ta nama chô liata biehnei khao aw vei.
Kheihta ma a châ aw? Ryhpa ry liata y leipa pi ta, ngiachhiena ry liata eima ypa vâta, moleina tao awpa a châ ma? Châ bao va!

Ahy lia rai ta ama bie zyh awpa ta sei ta namâ ngia khiahta cha, a bie nama zyhpa sei nama châ tahpa pahno veih ei chi ma? Moleina sei ta namâ ngia khiahta cha, thina lâ châ chhi aw ei ta, reingiahna sei ta namâ ngia khiahta cha, siana lâ a châ chhi aw ei.
Châhrasala Khazohpa cha reithaipa ta y mawh sy! Nâmo, eikhano ta moleina sei a châ tyhpazy chi kha, ama pachunazy palôh hmeiseihpa ta a zyhtuhpazy nama vaw châ haw.
Moleina tawhta pua ei chi ta, siana seizy nama vaw châ haw.

Nama sapa chiehleina pahnopa ta, chyhsapa pachâna lâ tawhta ei reipa a châ. Nama pôhpa pachiahpazy cha, pathaih leina sei ta vaw hlâ tyh ei chi ta, moleina papôh rilina sei ta nama hlâ tyhpa hawhna khata, tahmâ la nama pôhpa pachiahpazy cha pathaihna lâ a chhipa siana seizy châ awpa ta hlâ teh u.
Moleina seizy nama châ nota la, siana ta nama chô liata biehnei vei.
Tahmâ ta nama zakhei kawpa hmo nama vaw tao tyhpazy tawhna khata, khâpa theilâpa ma nama hmô? Kha hmozy chhâna cha thina a châ.
Tahmâ deikua cha, moleina tawhta khotalaipa châ ha ei chi ta, Khazohpa seizy nama châ haw. A theilâpa nama hmôpa cha pathaihna lâta a chhipa châ ta, cha chhâna cha chhâzaw hrona a châ.
Moleina hlao cha thina châ tlôh ta, Khazohpa hmosaipiepa deikua cha, eima Beipa Krista Zisu zawhzi ta chhâzaw hrona a châ.
Unawh saih u, ryhpa cha chyhsapa hro chhôh deita ta a chô liata ryu a reih tyh tahpa pahno veih ei chi mâ? Cha cha ryhpa a pahnopazy hnohta ei reih.
Vahpa a hneipa chanô châta, a vahpa hro chhôh cha, ryhpa ta a vahpa liata a chahry. A vahpa a thi tawh deikua cha, ahneina ryhpa tawhta a pua haw.
A vahpa hro chhôh ta mohropa a hnei khiahta cha, apheinô ama tah aw. A vahpa a thi ha khiah deikua cha, ahneina ryhpa tawhta pua ha ta, chapaw hropa a hneipa chhao ta, apheinô châ vei.

Cha hawhna chata, unawh saih u, nâmo chhao, ryhpa cha Krista pôhpa liata nama thisai haw. Chatanachata mohropa, athihpa hry tawhta pathyupa Krista eih châ ha ei chi ta, Khazohpa châta thei pha eima pathei thei aw.
Sapa ta eima y no kha, ryhpa ta molei khonazy papua tyh ta, eima pôhpa pachiahpazy liata thina thei pathei awpa ta rai a hria tyh.
Tahmâ deikua cha, miah a chahrypa cha thisaipa ta, ryhpa tawhta eima pua haw. Chatanachata châropa parohpa siezie hawhta châ khao leipa ta, Thlahpa hro thiehpa ta eima chakao thei haw.

Khâpa eima reih khao aw? Ryhpa cha moleina ma? Châ bao va! Ryhpa y leipa sala, moleina ei pahno lei awpa tlai. Ryhpa ta, “Na uahva awpa châ vei,” tah leipa sala, uahvana cha khâpa ma a châ tahpa pahno aw va na.
Châhrasala moleina ta biepiepa cha rypaohna ta hmâpa ta, uahvana to kei liata a paysa tyh. Ryhpa y leipa sala, moleina cha a thipa a châ.
Eikhano kha ryhpa hnei leipa ta hroh na ta, châhrasala biepiepa a vaw y nahta, moleina a vaw hra ta, kei cha ei thi haw.
Hro nawpa ta biepiepa cha, thi nawpa tlao a châ tahpa ei vaw pahno haw.
Moleina ta biepiepa cha ryhpaohna ta hmâpa ta, na dôvei ta, biepiepa hmâpa ta eina thie.
Chavâta ryhpa cha pathaih ta, biepiepa chhao pathaih ta, sia ta, a pha.

Cha khiahta la, hmo phapa cha kei châta thina a châ ma? Châ bao va! Hmo phapa cha moleina ta hmâh ta, keima liata thina a tlôkheipa tlao a châ. Chatanachata moleina cha moleina a châ tahpa a lâ aw ta, molei ngaitapa a châzie biepiepa ta a palâsa aw.
Ryhpa cha thlahpa hmo a châ tahpa eima pahno. Kei deikua cha sapa chyhsa, moleina sei ta zua hapa ei châ.
Hmo ei taopa he a pachâna pahno va na. Ei tao khopa tao leipa na ta, ei haopa hmo tlao ei tao tyh.
Ei khoh leipa ei tao tlôh khiahta cha, ryhpa cha pha ei tahkheipa a châ.
Chatanachata ei hmotaopazy cha keima taopa châ leipa ta, keima liata a ypa moleina ta a tao tyhpa a châ.
Ei sapa liata hmo phapa rai y vei tahpa ei pahno. Hmo pha tao khona keima liata y ta, châhrasala tao theina hnei va na.
Ei tao khohpa hmo phapa tao leipa na ta, ei tao khoh leipa hmo chhiepa ei tao tyh.
Ei tao khoh leipa ei tao tlôh khiahta cha, a taotuhpa cha kei châ leipa na ta, keima liata a ypa moleina ta a taopa a châ.
Chatanachata he ryhpa he ei vaw pahno haw: Hmo phapa tao ei khoh nahta, moleina ta einâ vaw hnia ha tyh.
Ei palôh ta Khazohpa ryhpa liata a ly na ta,
ei pôhpa pachiahpazy liata deikua cha, ryhpa nanopa a y tahpa ei pahno. Cha chata ei palôh ryhpa cha a dyuh ta, ei pôhpa pachiahpazy liata moleina ryhpa a ypa lâna chata sei ta einâ chhi tyh.
Chyhsa ngiachhiechhihpa ei châ kaw dia! He thina pôhpa tawhna heta ahy nâ pachha aw?
Zisu Krista eima Beipa vâta Khazohpa cha reithaipa ta y mawh sy! Kei tlai chhao cha, ei palôh ta Khazohpa ryhpa chakao ta, ei sapa ta deikua cha, moleina ryhpa ei vaw chakao ha tyh.
Chavâta tahmâ la Krista Zisu liata a ypa, sapa ta hroh leipa ta, Thlahpa ta a hrohpazy châta cha thailei pachâsana rai y khao vei.
Krista Zisu liata hrona Thlahpa ryhpa chata moleina nata thina ryhpa tawhta a cha papua ha ei.

Sapa chiehleina vâta ryhpa ta a tao thei leipa cha, Khazohpa ta a tao haw. Ano Sawchapawpa tlai cha, molei theipa sapa pôhpa paphaosapa ta, molei atheihna châta vaw tuah ta, sapa liata moleina a ypa cha thailei a pachâsa haw.
Chatanachata keimo, sapa ta hroh khao leipa ta, Thlahpa ta a hroh hapazy liana heta, ryhpa ta â hnawpa siana cha pakipa ta a y aw.
Sapa ta a hrohpazy cha, sapa hmozy liata ama pachâna soh ei ta, Thlahpa ta a hrohpazy deikua cha, Thlahpa hmozy liata ama pachâna ama soh tyh.
Sapa hmo pachâna cha thina châ ta, Thlahpa hmo pachâna deikua cha, hrona nata thlalôhna a châ.
Sapa hmo pachâna cha, Khazohpa ryhpa ry liata a y leipa vâta, Khazohpa a dyuhpa a châ. Hmeiseihta ta, sapa hmo a pachâpa châta cha, Khazohpa ryhpa ry liata y hmeiseih thei awpa châ vei.
Sapa ta a hrohpazy cha Khazohpa palysa thei veih ei.
Châhrasala Khazohpa Thlahpa nâmo liata a y khiahta cha, sapa ta a ypa châ leipa ei chi ta, Thlahpa ta a ypa tlao nama châ. Ahy rai Krista Thlahpa a hnei leipa cha ano chyhsa châ vei.
Châhrasala Krista cha nâmo liata a y khiahta cha, moleina vâta nama pôhpa cha thi hra sala, nama thlahpa deikua cha siana vâta a hroh.

Athihpa hry tawhta Zisu a pathyutuhpa Thlahpa nâmo liata a y khiahta cha, athihpa hry tawhta Krista Zisu a pathyutuhpa chata, nâmo liata a ypa a Thlahpa zawhzi ta, nama pôhpa thi theipazy cha a pahro aw.
Chavâta unawh saih u, a bâhpa eima hnei. Sapa liata leibâh deikua châ vei, sapa khozie hawhta hrona liata leibâh châ hra vei.
Sapa khozie hawhta nama hroh khiahta cha, thi aw ei chi ta, nama pôhpa hmotaopazy Thlahpa ta nama thie lymâ khiahta deikua cha, nama hroh aw.
Khazohpa Thlahpa chhihthapa ta a ypa maih Khazohpa sawzy ama châ.
Chipa ta y heih awpa ta seichâna thlahpa nama topa châ leipa ta, saw châna Thlahpa tlao to ei chi ta, cha Thlahpa vâna chata “Âbâ! Ei paw!” tahpa ta eima aw theipa a châ.
Cha Thlahpa tlai chata keimo thlahpa nata a kaopa ta, Khazohpa sawzy eima châ tahpa miah a pahnokhei.
