Sawzy eima châ khiahta cha, ryutotuhpazy eima châ. Khazohpa ryu totuhpazy châ pi ta, Krista ryutolâhpazy eima châ. A hnohta riethei eima tao khiahta cha, a hnohta palyupalihpa ta eima y hra aw.
Tahmâ nota pasa taonazy he, noh hro ta eima chô liata rônahna palâsa awpa nata pakho khi ta rao va na.
Hmotaopazy ta Khazohpa sawzy aluahna daihti vâpa ta, ngiatiah leipa ta ama hâ thlâh haw.
Hmotaopazy cha hraoleipa ta y awpa ta raopa châ ha ta, âmo khopa vâta châ leipa ta, a paysatuhpa vâta tlao a châ. Châhrasala hnabeiseihna a y.
Hmotaopazy tlai chhao cha thu theina sei tawhta papuapa châ aw ei ta, Khazohpa sawzy khotalaina rônahpa liata amâ ngia hra aw.
Hmotaopa zydua cha sawzeih pasa taopa ta, tahmâ taihta amâ rôh ngâ thlâh ha tahpa eima pahno.
Hmotaopazy dei châ vei, keimo, Thlahpa thei hmiatuapa a hneituhpazy tlai chhao heta, saw châ awpa ta eima pôhpa chatlaina cha ngiatiah leipa ta hâpa ta, palôh ta eimâ rôh ngâ kaw hra.
Cha hnabeiseihna vâna chata pachhapa eima châ. Hmô theipa hnabeiseihpa cha, hnabeiseihna châ vei. Hmô hapa cha, ahy ma hnabeiseihpa ta a hâ khao aw?
Eima hmô leipa eima hnabei a seih khiahta deikua cha, palôh pasi kawpa ta eima hâ lylia tyh.
Cha hawhna chata, Thlahpa ta eima chiehleinazy liata miah a bao tyh. Thlahchhâ nawpa chybia chhao eima pahno lei nota, Thlahpa ta ahrôna rei hlei thei leipa ta thlah miah a chhâpa tyh.
Thlahpa cha Khazohpa khozie hawhta mopathaihpazy châta thlah a chhâ tyhpa a châpa vâta, palôh mohtuhpa Khazohpa ta Thlahpa pachâna cha a pahno.
Khazohpa kyh a pachâtuhpa, ano achhuahna hawhta a awpazy châta, Khazohpa ta ato liata ama pha nawpa ta a hriapa tyh ei tahpa eima pahno.
A pahno chhieliepazy cha, a Sawchapawpa hawhta y awpa ta a rao chhielie ei. Chatanachata a Sawchapawpa cha unawh hluhpi hry liata sawchapaw uhtheipa a châ aw.
A rao chhieliepazy cha aw ta, a awpazy thai pachâsa ta, thai a pachâsapazy cha a palyupalih ei.
Cha kyhzy liana chata khâpa eima reih khao aw? Khazohpa eima chhâh â châ khiahta cha, ahy miah a dyuh thei aw?
A Sawchapawpa tlai chhao pahlôh leipa ta, eima zydua châta a pietuhpa chata, ato a saipa ta miah pie hra aw vei mâ?
Khazohpa a tlyhpazy cha ahy a leih aw? Thai pachâsatuhpa cha Khazohpa châ tlôh ta.
Ahy ma thailei a pachâsa aw? A thipa cha Krista Zisu châ tlôh ta. Cha dei châ vei, ano cha pathyupa ta y ta, Khazohpa chachâh lâta ypa ta, miah reikheituhpa a châ.

Krista kyhpachâna tawhta ahy miah pachhaih thei aw? Rietheina ta tlyma, pachârôhna ta tlyma, taolana ta tlyma, chakâhna ta tlyma, thluahruana ta tlyma, chichhihna ta tlyma, zaozi ta tlyma miah a pachhaih aw ma?
“Nâma vâta noh y ta thiepa ta y pi ta, Mietaku thie awpazy hawhta pachâpa eima châ,” tahpa ta ropa a châ.
Pachhaih bao va! Cha zydua liana chata kyh miah pachâtuhpa vâta, pahnietuhpazy hlâta rônah viapa eima châ.
Thina nata hrona tlyma, vâlyuhchâpazy nata ahripazy tlyma, hmo y haipa nata a vaw y awpazy tlyma, hmotaotheina tlyma,
asâhna nata athuna tlyma, hmotaopa zydua liata hmo hropa khâpa ta hmah eima Beipa Krista Zisu liata a ypa Khazohpa kyhpachâna tawhta miah pachhaih thei aw vei tahpa a sia ngaitapa ta ei pahno.
Krista liata biehmeiseihpa ei reih, haih va na. Ei chhie nata pha pahnona ta Thlahpa Pathaihpa liata eina pahnokhei.
Ei palôh liata rietheina ru ngaitapa nata pachârôhna lei thei leipa ei vao thlâh haw.
Ei unawhzy, sapa lâta ei chiheihzy châna heta, kei he chhiesapa ta ypa ta, Krista tawhta chhawh pathlahpa ta y aw sah la ei tah tyh.
Izarei chyhsa châ ei ta, saw châna, rônahna, biehrai, ryhpa piena, achhyna nata bietai zy âmo eih a châ.
Pathlatuhzy kha ama mapawzy châ ei ta, sapa kyh lâta cha Krista tlai chhao cha, âmo chi tawhta a vaw puapa a châ. Ano cha ato zydua chô liata Khazohpa châ ta, chhâzaw ta reithaipa ta y mawh sy. Amen.
Châhrasala Khazohpa bie cha hraoleipa ta a y tahna châ vei. Izarei pathla zydua Izarei châ khai hlei veih ei.
Abarahâ pathlazy ama châpa vâta, ama zydua ta a sawzy châ khai hra veih ei. “Aisika liana heta na pathlazy a laichadaipa a châ aw,” tahpa tlao a châ.
Cha yzie cha, sapa sawzy cha Khazohpa sawzy châ leipa ei ta, bietai sawzy cha Abarahâ pathla ta raopa tlao ama châ.
“Tahmâ daihti hawhpa liana heta vaw tlô heih aw na ta, Sârâ ta sawchapaw a sa aw,” tahpa ta bietai piepa a châ.
Cha dei châ vei, Rebekâ chhao kha chyhsa pakha liata, miah pathlatuhpa Aisika liata maphieh a phao no kha,
hawsaihzy ama pi hlâta, hmo phapa tlyma, hmo chhiepa tlyma ama tao hlâta, hmotaopa vâta châ leipa ta, atlyhna kyh liata Khazohpa hmochhuahpa cha a sie pazao lymâ thei nawpa ta,
a hnohta, “Uhthei viapa ta seihnai viapa a chakao aw,” tahpa ta chhopa a châpa kha.
“Zakaw kyh pachâ na ta, Esaw deikua ei hao,” tahpa ropa a châ hra.
Cha khiahta cha, khâpa eima reih khao aw? Khazohpa liata sialeina a y ma? Y bao va!
Khazohpa ta Mawsi hnohta, “Ei ngiachhie awpa chyhsa cha ngiachhie aw na ta, zawh ei ngiah awpa chyhsa cha zawh ei ngiah aw,” tahpa ta a vaw reih ha khawh.
Chavâta chyhsapa khotlyna vâta châ leipa ta, hriapasana vâta châ hra vei, a ngiachhietuhpa Khazohpa vâta tlao a châ.
Chavâta Biehrai ta Phiraoh hnohta, “He hmo châta ei cha padua, ei hmotaotheina nâma liata paluahsa ta, khizaw zydua liata ei moh pathâhsapa ta a y thei nawpa ta,” a tahpa a châ.
Chatanachata Khazohpa ta a khopa maih ngiachhie tyh ta, a khopa maih chhorupa ta a tao tyh.
Nâ ta ei hnohta, “Khazohpa ta khazia miah a maochhie thlâh ha chy? Ahy ma a khopa a dyuh thei?” na tah ualua aw.
Châhrasala chyhsapa y, Khazohpa a chakhia hrapa chi cha, ahy ma na châ? Hmotaopa ta a taotuhpa hnohta, “Khazia he hawhta eina tao chi?” a tah aw mâ?
Beihlei tlo kha tawhta, zachhihpa ta hmâ awpa beih sôh viapa nata hmâ chakhyh awpa beih sôh lei viapa zy tao awpa ta, beihvituhpa cha beihlei chô liata bie hnei vei mâ?
Khazohpa ta a hiehâhna palâsa ta, a hmotaotheina pahnosa awpa khoh hra sala, hiehâhna beih a leidia tlâhpazy chô liata palôh pasi ngaitapa ta a dao lylia khiahta cha, khâpa a pei aw?
Ngiachhiena beihzy chô liata a rônahna palâsa nawpa ta, cha hmo cha Khazohpa ta a rônahna châta â chhuanoh chhielie hapa châ sala, khâpa a pei aw?
Cha ngiachhiena beihzy cha, keimo, Zuzy hry tawhta a awpazy dei châ leipa pi ta, Zenitaizy hry tawhta a awpazy chhao eima châ hra.
Khazohpa ta Hôsia châbu liata hetana heta a reipa kha: “Ei phopi a châ beih leipa cha, ‘Ei phopi,’ tah aw na ta; Kyhpachâ beih leipa cha, ‘Kyhpachâpa,’ ei tah aw.”
“‘Ei phopi châ veih ei chi,’ a tahna su liata, ‘Khazohpa hroh sawzy,’ bipa ama châ aw.”
Isai chhao ta Izarei kyh liata, “Izarei sawzy cha tilaipi sadi zie ta hluh hra ei sala, laibâhpa deita pachhapa ama châ aw.
Abeipa ta hawh leipa ta a lei he tlokhuh a hrie aw,” a tahpa kha.
Isai pyly ta, “Pheisaihzy Abeipa ta Chi pathla miah pahlôhpa vei mawh sala, Sawdawmâ hawhna khata châ aw pi ta, Kawmawrâ hawhna khata eima y aw,” tahpa ta a vaw rei chhielie haw.
Khâpa eima reih khao aw? Siana a chadai leipa Zenitaizy ta ngiapâna ta siana tlao to ei ta,
siana ryhpa a chadaituhpa Izarei ta siana to thei vei.
Khâpa vâta maw? Ngiapâna ta a chadai leipa ei ta, hmotaopa ta to thei awpa hawhta amâ chadaipa vâta a châ. Achapiana lô liata amâ chapia haw,
“Pachâ teh, Zaio liata achapiana lô soh na ta, Moleina lôpanô ei soh; Ahy rai ano a ngiapâpa cha, Maophyuh aw vei,” tahpa ta ropa hawhta.
Unawh saih u, Izarei sawzy pachha ama châ awpa cha, ei palôh khopa nata âmo châta Khazohpa lâta ei thlahchhâna a châ.
Khazohpa châta phahnai amâ ngiah tahpa ei pahnokhei ei. Châhrasala pahno pasia leipa ta phahnai a ngiahpa ama châ.
Khazohpa siana pahno leipa ta, âmo siana a duakhei a chhuah ei ta, Khazohpa siana liata a ngiarih veih ei.
Krista cha ngiapâtuhpa zydua ta siana ama hmô thei nawpa ta ryhpa chhâna a châ.
Ryhpa zyhpa vâta siana hmôna kyh liata, Mawsi ta, “Ryhpa a zyhtuhpa cha, ryhpa vâna chata a hroh aw,” tahpa ta roh ta.
Ngiapâna vâta siana deikua ta cha, “Na palôh ta, ‘Vârâh tawhta Krista a zâ chhi awpa ta, ahy ma vârâh lâ a kiah aw?
Athihpa hry tawhta Krista a kaw chhi awpa ta, ahy ma athihkhih lâ a zu aw?’ tah khah sy,” tlao a tah.
Cha bie chata khâpa ma a reih? “Bie ta a châ hnia, na pakah nata na palôh liata a y,” tah ta, cha bie cha ngiapâna bie eima chhopa he a châ.
Na pakah ta, “Zisu cha Abeipa a châ” tahpa ta a châhkhei la, athihpa hry tawhta Khazohpa ta a pathyu tahpa na palôh ta nâ ngiapâ khiahta cha, pachhapa ta na y aw.
Palôh ta a ngiapâpa cha thai pachâsapa ta y ta, pakah ta a châhkheipa cha pachhapa ta a y.
Biehrai ta, “Ahy rai ano a ngiapâpa maih maophyuh aw veih ei,” a tah.
Zu nata Krikâh likah ananona y vei. Abeipa pakha cha ama zydua chô liata Abeipa châ ta, ano a padotuhpa zydua chô liata byhnâ thata a pie tyhpa a châ.
“Ahy rai Abeipa moh a padopa maih pachhapa ama châ aw,” tahpa a châ.
Cha khiahta la, amâ ngiapâ leipa cha kheihta ama pado thei aw? Ama thei beih leipa cha kheihta amâ ngiapâ thei aw? Biechhotuhpa y leipa ta kheihta ama thei thei aw.
Tuapa ama châ vei khiahta cha, kheihta bie ama chho thei aw? “Thatihpha a vaw tlôkheituhpazy phei cha â ngia kaw dia!” tahpa ta ropa a châ.
Isai ta, “Abeipa, eima bie reipa ahy ma a ngiapâ?” a tahpa hawhta, thâtihpha cha ama zydua ta zyh khai veih ei.
Ngiapâna cha theina vâta vaw y ta, theina cha Krista bie vâta a vaw y.
Cha khiahta la, thei ha veih ei ma? tahpa ta hiahrina tao aw sah la, thei cha ama thei haw. “Ama pyu râh to liata pathâh ta, Ama bie kaokih taihta a pathâh,” tahpa ta ropa a châ.

Izarei ta pahno vei ma? tahpa ta hiahri heih aw sah la, he kyh liata Mawsi ta, “Phopi ta rei tlâh leipazy hmâpa ta, Nama hia cha patliasa aw ei na ta; Phopi hrupa hmâpa ta, Nama hie ei cha pahâh aw ei,” tahpa ta vaw reih tuachai ta.
Isai chhao ta riahpha ngaitapa ta, “Nâ tlua leipazy ta na hmô ei ta, Nâ pado leipazy ei pahnosa ei,” tahpa ta a vaw reih haw.
Izarei kyh lia chhao ta Isai ta, “Noh y ta, Reingiah leipa phopi lâta ei ku pazawh na ta, Chhorupa phopi lâta ei bâh ei pazawh,” tahpa ta a vaw reih haw.
Cha khiahta la, hiahrina ei tao. Khazohpa ta ano phopi cha a thy aw ma? Thy bao va! Kei chhao he Izarei chyhsa, Abarahâ pathla, Benzami chi ei châ.
Khazohpa ta a pahno hapa a phopi cha thy aw vei. Biehrai ta Elaizâh kyh a reipa kha pahno veih ei chi ma? Elaizâh ta Izarei kyh Khazohpa lâ tlôkhei ta,
“Abeipa, na hrohsopazy thie ei ta, na maisâhzy pacho ei ta, kei deita y na ta, kei chhao thie einâ chhuah ei,” tah ta.
Khazohpa ta kheihta â chhy? “Bâlâ hmiakô liata pakhu paneih beih leipa chyhsa sâh sari kei châta ei pahlôh thlâh haw,” tahpa ta â chhy.
Cha hawhna chata, tahmâ chhao laibâhpazy ama y. Âmo cha ngiachhiena ta â tlyhpazy ama châ.
Ngiachhiena vâta a châ khiahta cha, hmotaopa vâta châ khao vei. Cha hawhta a châ vei khiahta cha, ngiachhiena cha ngiachhiena châ khao aw vei.
Cha khiahta la, kheihta a châ aw? Izarei ta a tluapa cha hmô leipa ta, atlyhpazy ta hmô ei ta, ahropazy cha kuhchhâpa ta ama y,
“Khazohpa ta âmo cha, Tanoh taihta hruna thlahpa pie ta, A hmô thei leipa mo piepa ta, A thei thei leipa nah a pie ei,” tahpa ropa hawhna khata.
Dâvi chhao ta, “Ama tlâhkhai cha, Ama châta khoheih nata aphyh châ sala, Achapiana nata viarithôna châ mawh sy.
Ama hmô thei lei nawpa ta, Ama mozy zoh sala, Ama zôh chhâzaw ta a ko mawh sy,” tahpa ta a vaw reih ha hra.
Cha khiahta la, amâ chapiana cha ama pao pathlah nawpa a châ ma? Châ bao va! Izarei hia patliasa awpa ta, amâ chapiana vâta Zenitaizy lâ pachhana a vaw tlôpa a châ.
Ama paona hmahta khizaw hneirôna châ sala, ama leina Zenitaizy hneirôna a châ khiahta cha, ama pakina chhochhi cha hneirôna a châ pachai aw dia!
Tahmâ nâmo, Zenitaizy hnohta ei reih. Zenitaizy lyuhchâpa ei châpa he, rônah ei tah ngaita.
Chatanachata ei chiheih Zu chyhsazy hia patliasapa ta, khazie chhâ ma pachha thei aw veih ei na ma ei tah.
Âmo dythana hmahta khizaw aryhna a châ khiahta cha, âmo apyhna chhochhi cha, thina tawhta hrona leipa ta cha, khâpa a châ aw?
Thei hmiatuapa châta viahchhâ eichheihpa hlâpa a pathaih khiahta cha, viahchhâ tlâ pôhpalôhpa a pathaih. A thari a pathaih khiahta cha, a chiahzy a pathaih.
Châhrasala a chiah thokhazy cha thliepa châ ta, nâ, râh liata ôli tho tlai chi cha, ôli tho phapazy liata pazaopa ta, ôli tho phapa thari nâ hly khiahta cha,
a chiahzy chô liata a palai khah y. Nâ vaw palai thlu ha khiah ei ta cha, he he a thei mah y. Thari cha nâ ta chyh leipa chi ta, thari ta nâma tlao a cha chyh.
“Pazaopa ta ei y thei nawpa ta vei ma, a chiahzy cha thliepa a châ vei,” na tah thei.
Â do. Âmo cha ngiapâleina vâta thliepa châ ei ta, nâ deikua cha ngiapâna vâta a duahpa na châ. Chavâta a palai leipa la, tlao chi mah y.
Pikheipa chiahzy hmahta Khazohpa ta a pahlôh vei khiahta cha, nâ, pazaopa chiah chhochhi cha, cha pahlôh tiarâh aw vei.

Chavâta Khazohpa phazie nata chichhihzie he pachâ mah y. A paopazy châta chichhihpa châ ta, nâma châta deikua cha, a phana liata na y thlâh ha khiahta cha, Khazoh phapa a châ. Chataleipatala nâ chhao chhawh pathlahpa na châ aw.
Âmo chhao cha ngiapâleipa ta ama y ngâ thlâh vei khiahta cha, pazaopa ta ama y aw. Khazohpa cha âmo pazao heih theina hmotaotheina a hneipa a châ.

Nâ, râh liata ôli kô tawhta chhawhpa hmahta, pikhei siezie tyhpa chakhiapa ta, sadô liata lopa ôli tho liata pazaopa na châ thei khiahta cha, pikheipa ta ôli chiah a châpazy chhochhi cha, âmo ôli tho liata pazao via pachaipa ama châ aw.
Unawh saih u, he bienyupa he nama pahno lei awpa khoh va na. Chataleipatala namâ palai pathlei aw na. Zenitaizy pakina a vaw tlô hlâta, Izarei chô liata kuhchhana a rakhapa ta a vaw tlô chypa a châ.
Izarei zydua pachhapa ama châ aw, “Zaio tawhta pachhatuhpa vaw pua aw ta, Zakaw tawhta moleina a pahlei aw.
Ama moleinazy ei pahlei khai tita, Cha cha ama hnohta ei biehrai awpa a châ,” tahpa ropa hawhta.
Thâtihpha kyh liata la, nâmo vâta khakhaipa châ ei ta, atlyhna kyh liata deikua cha, pathlatuhpazy vâta kyhpachâpazy ama châ.
Khazohpa hmosaipiepazy nata a awna cha panano heih theipa châ vei.
Eikhano ta cha Khazohpa rei a ngiah leipa châ ei chi ta, tahmâ deikua cha, âmo reingiah leina zawhzi ta ngiachhiena nama to haw.
Cha hawhna chata, âmo chhao tahmâ reingiah leipa ta y chy hra ei sala, nâmo chô liata ngiachhiena palâsapa vâna heta, âmo chhao ngiachhiena ama to thei hra aw.
A ngiachhie khai thei nawpa ei ta, Khazohpa ta chyhsa zydua reingiah leina liata a khô khai ha ei.
Hy â thu kaw dia, Khazohpa hneirôna, Sona nata pahnona zy cha! A ryureinazy pahno thei awpa châ leipa ta, A lâpizy chathô thei awpa châ vei.
Abeipa palôh ahy a pahno? Ahy ma ano ryhraotuhpa ta a y?
Thô awpa hnabeiseihpa ta, Ahy ma Khazohpa lâ hmo a pie?
Ano tawhta, Ano vâta, Ano châta, Hmo to a ypa a châ. A hnohta chhâzaw ta rônahna y mawh sy! Amen.

Chavâta unawh saih u, Khazohpa ngiachhiena vâta, atheihna hrohpa nata pathaihpa nata a pyh tlâh châ awpa ta, nama pôhpa cha Khazohpa lâ hlâ awpa ta ei châ haw ei. Cha cha thlahpa ta Khazohpa namâ chhynazie awpa a châ.

He khizaw ryhpa hawhna heta y leipa u la, nama palôh pathiehpa ta tlao anano lymâ teh u. Chatanachata Khazohpa khopa cha khâpa ma a châ tahpa pahno thei aw ei chi ta, hmo phapa a pyh tlâhpa nata phapakipa cha nama pahno thei aw.

Nama hry liata chyhsa ahy hmahta a châna dopa hlâta a sâh viapa ta a pachâ leipa sala, Khazohpa ta chyhsa to hnohta ngiapâna a piepa rakhapa lymâ hawhta, a châna dopa a pahno thai awpa ta, Khazohpa ta ngiachhiena eina piepa zawhzi ta ei cha chho ei.
Pôhpa miakha liata pachiahpa hluhpi hnei pi ta, pachiahpa zydua hmotaopa deikua a lyu vei.
Cha hawhna chata keimo chhao, a hluhpi châ hra sih la, Krista liata pôhpa miakha châ pi ta, eima zydua ta a zao khaipa eima châ.
Ngiachhiena piepa eima châpa lymâ hawhta, hmopiepa nanopa eima hnei chyu. Hrohsona bie rei awpa a châ khiahta cha, eimâ ngiapâna rakha lymâ hawhta reih sih la,
chakao awpa a châ khiahta cha chakao sih la, pachutuhpa ta pachu sala,
pasyutuhpa ta pasyuna bie reih sala, hmopietuhpa ta riapha ngaitapa ta pie sala, ryureituhpa ta tiamapa ta ryureih sala, ngiachhiena rai hriatuhpa ta a ly ngaitapa ta hria mawh sy.
Kyhpachâna cha haiphiana a hlao leipa châ mawh sy. Moleina a hao u la, hmo phapa khâchâ patu muh vy.
Unawh kyhpachâna ta kyh a pachâ raihrie u la, a palyupalih raihrie muh vy.
Phahnai angiahna kyh liata daopathla leipa u la, palôh thathyu ngaitapa ta Abeipa chakao muh vy.
Hnabeiseihna liata a ly u la, rietheitaona liata tiama u la, thlahchhâ lylia muh vy.
Mopathaihpa a phahlapazy deichhy u la, khichhai pasô muh vy.
Châ taolatuhpazy byhnâ awpa u la, chhiesapa leipa ta, byhnâ awpa teh u.
Alypazy a lykhei u la, achapazy chakhei teh u.
A dyh raihrie u la, a pasâhsa leipa ta, chyhsa nawhpazy a kao u la, apasosa khuh vy.
Ahy moleina rai moleina ta viarithô leipa u la, chyhsa zydua mohmô ta hmo dopa tao awpa ta pachâna tlao hmâh tyh muh vy.
Tao theipa a châ khiahta la, nâmo lâ tawh chhâ ta chyhsa zydua nata a ryhpa ta y teh u.
Kho ngaitapa saih u, nama phuh a la leipa u la, Khazohpa pathiiana tlei hri teh u. “Phuh cha keima la awpa châ ta, kei ta viari ei thô aw, Abeipa ta a tah,” tahpa ta ropa a châ.
Chavâta, “Na chariahpa a nodi khiahta cha, nie awpa pie la, a dâhphi khiahta cha, do awpa pie mah y. Cha hawhta na tao khiahta cha, a luh chô liata meiia beih na khaihpa a châ aw.”
Moleina a patiahsa leipa la, phana ta moleina cha tlao tiah mah y.
Chyhsa to ta ama chô liata ryureituhpazy bie ama zyh awpa a châ. Khazohpa rao leipa ryureituhpa y veih ei. Ryureituhpazy cha Khazohpa raopa ama châ.
Chavâta ryureituhpa a dyuhpa cha Khazohpa raopa a dyuhpa châ ta, a dyuhtuhpazy cha thailei pachâpa ama châ aw.

Ryureituhpazy cha hmo phapa a taotuhpazy châta chichhihpa châ leipa ei ta, hmo chhiepa a taotuhpazy châta deikua cha, chichhihpa ama châ. Ryureituhpa chi leipa ta y na khoh ma? Hmo pha tao la a cha reithai aw.

Ano cha na pha nawpa ta Khazohpa chakaotuhpa a châ. Hmo moleipa na tao khiah deikua cha, chi kaw mah y, zaozi cha a chaba thlâhthli vei. Ano cha Khazohpa chakaotuhpa châ ta, hmo paraotuhpa chô liata Khazohpa hiehâhna phuhlatuhpa a châ.
Chavâta Khazohpa hiehâhna chipa vâ dei châ leipa ta, chhie nata pha pahnona vâta, ryureituhpa bie na zyh awpa a châ.
Ryureituhpazy cha Khazohpa chakaotuhpazy châ ei ta, Khazohpa chakaona rai a hriapazy ama châpa vâta, chhiezy chhao nama pie tyh.
Chyhsa zydua lâta pie awpa maih pie lymâ teh u. Chhie pie awpa lâta chhie pie u la, leimâ chei awpa lâta leimâ cheih u la, za awpa cha za u la, palyupalih awpa cha palyupalih teh u.
Kyh a pachâ raihriena dei leipa ta cha, ahy hmah khâpa hmah a bâh khuh vy. A chyhsa heih kyh pachâtuhpa cha ryhpa a pakipa a châ.

“Nâ phei awpa châ vei; Liany na cheih awpa châ vei; Na paru awpa châ vei; Na uahva awpa châ vei,” tahpa biepiepazy nata biepiepa hropazy chhao, “Nâma kyh nâ pachâpa hawhta na vaih kyh na pachâ awpa a châ,” tahpa heta a syhpahmaoh khai.
Kyhpachâna ta vaih pasasa beih vei. Chavâta kyhpachâna cha ryhpa zyh pakina a châ.
Tahmâhlâ hmo yzie pahno ei chi ta, amôpa thyu â daih haw tahpa nama pahnopa vâta cha cha ei reih. Tahmâ cha eimâ ngiapâ tua no hlâta eima pachhana a hnia via ha tlôh ta.
Zâ he chhâ daihmâ ta, khih a deih daihmâ. Chavâta zohna hmotaopa zydua thy sih la, khaihna chhaichhi ta a tobi suh u.
Nohchhô ta ypa hawhta â ngia ngaitapa ta y sih la, apatlapa nata sahma paripa ta y leipa ta, parâpa nata apheipa ta y hra leipa ta, ahryuchhiapa nata hiatliapa ta y khah ei suh u.
Abeipa Zisu Krista ta tlao a tobi u la, nama sapa khopa pipatlohsa nawpa ta khâpa hmah tao khuh vy.
Ngiapâna liata chiehleipa chyhsa cha a pyh thai u la, â lôhleina kyh liata sei khuh vy.
Chyhsa pakha cha â ngiapâna ta ato nie thei awpa ta pachâ ta, chyhsa chiehleipa deikua cha âhnalasi deita a nie tyh.
Ato a niepa ta a nie leipa mohnao khah sy. A nie leipa chhao ta, a niepa sei khah sy. Khazohpa ta ano cha â pyh ha mâh tâh.
Mohropa chakaotuhpa seituhpa cha ahy ma na châ? Â duah tlyma, a pao tlyma, ano zibeipa hmiakô liata a taopa a châ. Abeipa cha ano a paduasa theipa a châpa vâta, â duah thlâh ha aw.
Chyhsa pakha ta noh kha cha, noh hropa hlâta pasô via ta, chyhsa hropa ta noh zydua he miakha sai ta a pachâ. Chyhsa to ama pachâna chyu liata ama sia awpa a châ.

Noh a chaypa cha Abeipa palyupalih nawpa ta a chaypa a châ. Ato a niepa chhao, Abeipa palyupalih nawpa ta nie ta, Khazohpa lâta alyna bie a hlâ tyh. Nie a taihpa chhao, Abeipa palyupalih nawpa ta a taih ta, Khazohpa lâ alyna bie a hlâ tyh.
Ahy hmah keimosasyh châta a hrohpa châ leipa pi ta, ahy hmah keimosasyh châta a thipa châ hra ma pi.
Eima hroh khiahta cha, Abeipa châta hroh pi ta, eima thipa chhao ta, Abeipa châta a thipa eima châ. Chavâta eima hrohpa chhao ta, eima thipa chhao ta, Abeipa eih eima châ.
Krista cha athihpa nata ahrohpa Beipa châ awpa ta, thi ta a hroh heihpa a châ.
Cha khiahta la, khazia na unawhpa na sei? Khazia na unawhpa na mohnao? Eima zydua heta Khazohpa pachiana dyuchhai hmiakô liata a duah khai awpa eima châ,
“Ei hrona reipa ta ei reih, Abeipa ta a tah; Pakhu to ei hmiakô liata paneih aw ei ta, Paleih to ta Khazohpa ama reithai aw,” tahpa ropa hawhta.
Eima zydua ta Khazohpa hmiakô liata keimo thâtih eima reih chyu aw.
Chavâta a sei raihrie khao leipa ta, unawhpa lâpi liata achapiana lô tlyma, pakhâna tlyma, sokhâh lei awpa a chhuah ei suh u.
Abeipa Zisu liata pathaih leipa khâpa hmah y vei tahpa a siapa ta ei pahno. Pathaih leipa hawhta a pachâpa châta deikua cha, pathaih leipa a châ.
Na niepa ta na unawhpa palôh a patypamâ khiahta cha, kyhpachâna lâpi a chhih khao va chi. Ano thi vyuhpa ta Krista ta a thikâ hapa chyhsa cha, parao khah y.
Hmo phapa ta nama pachâpa cha, moleina hawhta pachâ awpa pasaih khuh vy.
Khazohpa khinarâh cha nie nata do kyh châ vei. Siana nata thlalôhna nata Thlahpa Pathaihpa liata alyna zy tlao a châ.
Cha hawhta Krista chakaotuhpazy cha, Khazohpa ta a pyh ta, chyhsa reithaina chhao ama hlao tyh.
Chavâta thlalôhna a tlôkhei awpa nata tha a patlô raihriena a châ awpa hmozy a chadai lymâ suh u.
Niepa vâta Khazohpa raihria parao khah y. Hmo to a pathaih khai. Châhrasala niepa ta chyhsa a chapiasa khiahta cha, a nietuhpa cha a do vei.
Na unawhpa a chapia nawpa a châ khiahta cha, sa nie leipa nata kresawhti do leipa pha ta, â chapia thei nawpa hmo khâpa hmah tao leipa a pha.
He kyh liata ngiapânazie na hneipa cha, Khazohpa nata nâma likah liata a y awpa châta soh mah y. Ano ta pha a tahpa kyh liata anosasyh thailei a pachâsa leipa chyhsa cha a nohlao na.
A lôh leipa ta a niepa deikua cha, ngiapâna ta a nie leipa vâta thailei a châ. Khâpa rai ngiapâna tawhta a pua leipa cha moleina a châ.
Keimo, thatlôpazy pi heta keimo alyna tlua leipa ta, chiehleipazy ama pachyu leina liata eima bao awpa a châ.
Eima vaihzy thapatlô sih la, ama pha nawpa taopa ta palysa a chhuah chyu suh u.
“Nâma châ pasipasawhtuhpa pasipasawhna cha keima chô liata a tla haw,” tahpa ropa hawhta, Krista chhao khata ano alyna tlua vei.
Hlâno ta bie ropa zydua kha eimâ chu hra awpa ta ropa a châ. Chatanachata Biehrai bie hawhta tiamana nata thatlôna hneipa ta hnabeiseihna eima hnei thei aw.
Tiamana nata thatlôna Khazohpa ta Krista Zisu khozie hawhta nama zydua ta a ryh ngaitapa ta y awpa ta cha bao mawh ei sy.
Chatanachata Khazohpa nata eima Beipa Zisu Krista Paw cha, reihkha tlapa ta nama reithai khoh thei aw.
Chavâta Khazohpa rônah nawpa ta Krista ta a châ pyhpa hawh ei ta, nâmo chhao a pyh raihrie teh u.
Ei cha chho ei, pathlatuhpazy hnohta bietai pa-i ta, Khazohpa adona palâsa nawpa ta, Krista cha chopawtaipazy chakaotuhpa ta a vaw ypa a châ.

Chatanachata Zenitaizy chhao ta Khazohpa cha a ngiachhiena vâta ama reithai thei hra aw, Biehrai liata, “Zenitaizy hry liata cha reithai aw na ta, Na moh reithaipa ta ei sa aw,” tahpa ropa hawhna khata.
“Hy Zenitaizy saih u, A phopi nata a ly khoh teh u,” tah heih ta.
“Zenitai zydua saih u, Abeipa cha reithai teh u; Chyhsa zydua ta, Ano cha reithai mawh ei sy,” a tah heih hra.
Isai chhao ta, “Zese thari kaw pyuh aw ta, Zenitaizy ryureituhpa a vaw pua aw; Ano liata Zenitaizy hnabeiseihna a y aw,” tahpa ta a vaw reih hra.
Thlahpa Pathaihpa hmotaotheina zawhzi ta hnabeiseihna hluhpi nama hnei thei nawpa ta, hnabeiseihna Khazohpa ta, ano nama ngâpa hawhta, alyna nata thlalôhna ta cha pabie mawh ei sy.
Unawh saih u, phana ta bie ei chi ta, sona to hnei ei chi ta, namâ pachu raihrie thei, tahpa keima tlai ta a siapa ta ei pahno.
Kyh thokha liata deikua cha, cha pahnosa heih awpa ei ta, riahpha ngaitapa ta ei roh. Khazohpa ta ngiachhiena eina patosapa zawhzi ta,

Khazohpa thâtihpha châta theihthaina chakaona raihria liata, Zenitaizy hry liata Krista Zisu chakaotuhpa châta raopa ei châ. Chatanachata Zenitaizy hmohlâpa cha Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta pathaisa aw ta, a pyh tlâh a châ aw.
Chavâta Khazohpa chakaona rai ei hriana kyh liata, Krista Zisu vâta a palai thei nawpa ei hnei.
Zenitaizy Khazohpa bie pazyhsa awpa ta Krista ta kei na hmâh ta, cha châta ei biereipa nata ei hmotaopazy dei leipa ta cha, bie hropa rei a chhuah va na.
Krista thâtihpha chakaona rai cha, ngiana nata hmonoâhpa hmotaotheina nata Khazohpa Thlahpa hmotaotheina zy hmâpa ta, Zerusale nata a chheipâhzy tawhta Eliriku râh taihta ei chho khai haw.
Cha hawhna chata, mohropa lôbô bô chiehpa liata o a sapa ei châ lei nawpa ta, Krista moh pado hana su liata cha thâtihpha chho lei awpa ei chhuah,
“A thâtih chho beih leipazy ta hmô aw ei ta, A thei beih leipazy ta ama pahno aw,” tahpa ropa hawhna khata.
Cha vâna tlai chata nâmo lâ a vy awpa pakhâpa ta khâ ei y tyh.
Tahmâ deikua cha, he râhzy liana heta hria nawpa su hropa hnei khao leipa na ta, kô hluhpi chhôh nâmo cha vaw tly khohna ei vaw hnei tyhpa vâta,

Spânia râh lâ ei siena liata nâmo châ vaw hmô pâ awpa ei chhuah. Chatanachata nama hnohta a pahlaopa ta buakha chhôh a lypa ta y aw na ta, cha khai tawhta ei khitlyna liata chhao eina deichhy thei awpa ei chi ta ei hnabei a seih.
Tahmâ deikua cha, mopathaihpazy deichhyna hmo pie awpa ta Zerusale lâ ei sie chy aw.
Mâsidônia nata Akai râhzy ta, a ly kawpa ta Zerusale liata mopathaihpa dyhchhiepazy châta thyupakhy ei ta.

Cha cha a ly kawpa ta ama taopa a châ. Hmeiseih ta la, tao awpa amâ bâhpa rai a châ. Zenitaizy ta thlahpa kyh liata Zuzy amâ hlykhei khiahta cha, khizaw hmozy ta Zuzy ama deichhy hra awpa cha a byuhpa tlai a châ.
Cha hmozy cha tao khaipa ta, thyunazy cha ama ku liata ei hlâ khai tawhta, nâmo cha vaw chapiapa ta Spânia lâ cha ei sie aw.
Nâmo lâ ei vy tita, Krista byhnâ kipa chhaota ei vy aw tahpa ei pahno.
Unawh saih u, tiamapa ta Khazohpa lâ thlah eina chhâkhei awpa ei chi ta, eima Beipa Zisu Krista moh nata Thlahpa kyhpachâna ta ei châ haw ei.
Zudia râh liata ngiapâleipazy tawhta ei boh thei nawpa nata Zerusale liata ei chakaona cha mopathaihpazy châta a pyh tlâh a châ thei nawpa ta thlah na chhâkhei teh u.
Chatanachata Khazohpa khozie hawhta a ly kawpa ta nâmo lâ a vy aw na ta, nama hnohta a pahlaopa ta tha eina patlô thei aw ei chi.
Thlalôhna Khazohpa cha nama zydua hnohta y mawh sy. Amen.
Eima sietanô Phibi, Kenkaria Awnanopa liata chakaotuhpa pahnokheina nâmo lâta ei vaw roh.
Mopathaihpa a châna nata â phuhpa ta Abeipa liata a vaw ly u la, bao â ngiahna maih liata vaw bao lymâ muh vy. Kei nata chyhsa hluhpi miah a deichhy tyhpa a châ.
Priskilâ nata Akuilâ, Krista Zisu liata ei hrialâhpazy kha nâ naohpa muh vy.
Ei hrona pabohsa awpa ta rao a dao ngâhpazy châ ei ta, kei ta ama hnohta alyna bie ei reipa dei châ leipa ta, Zenitai awnanopa zydua ta alyna bie ama hlâ hra.
Ama o liata Awnanopa a pakhypazy chhao kha nâ naohpa muh vy. Ei kho ngaitapa Epenetâ, Asia râh liata Krista a ngiapâ tua chaipa chhao kha nâ naohpa muh vy.
Nâmo châta a hriapasa ngaitapa Mâri chhao kha nâ naohpa hra muh vy.
Ei chiheih Andrônikâ nata Zunia, patâhna o liata ei tâlâhpazy kha nâ naohpa muh vy. Âmo cha lyuhchâpazy ta ama pahno kawpazy châ ei ta, kei Krista liata ei y hlâta a y hapazy ama châ.
Ampaliatâ, Abeipa liata ei kho ngaitapa kha nâ naohpa muh vy.
Krista liata ei hrialâhpa Ubânâ nata ei kho ngaitapa Stâki kha nâ naohpa muh vy.
Krista liata chyhsa hmeiseihpa Apele kha nâ naohpa muh vy. Aristôbulâ chhôhkhazy kha nâ naohpa muh vy.
Ei chiheih Herôdiônâ kha nâ naohpa muh vy. Nâkisâ chhôhkha Abeipa liata a ypazy kha nâ naohpa muh vy.
Taruphanâ nata Tarôphôsâ, Abeipa châta a hriapasa ngaitapazy kha nâ naohpa muh vy. Kyhpachâpa Pâsi, Abeipa châta a hriapasa ngaitapa kha nâ naohpa muh vy.
Abeipa liata atlyhpa Rufu kha nâ naohpa u la, a nô, keima châ chhao ta nô a châpa kha nâ naohpa muh vy.
Asinkritâ, Phalekô, Hame, Patôbâ, Hamâ nata ama hnohta unawh a ypazy chhao kha nâ naohpa muh vy.
Philôkâ, Zulia, Neria nata a sietanô nata Ôlipâ nata ama hnohta mopathaihpa a ypa zydua kha nâ naohpa muh vy.
Apahnâna pathaihpa ta a naoh raihrie tyh muh vy. Krista Awnanopa zydua ta ama châ naoh.
Unawh saih u, biezyhpa eima cha pachupa chakhiapa ta, achhaihna taopa ta, paona châ sokhâhtuhpazy tawhta a vaih awpa ta ei châ haw ei. Âmo cha a kâsai teh u.
Cha hawhpa chyhsazy cha, eima Beipa Zisu Krista chakao leipa ei ta, âmo py a chakaopa tlao châ ei ta, reikah pahniapa nata papyupahly thainazy ta chyhsa pha molopazy ama dôvei tyh.
Khazohpa bie a zyhpa nama châzie cha mo to pahnopa a châ. Chavâta nama chô liata ei ly ngaita. Hmo phapa lâta so u la, moleina lâta deikua cha, a so leipa nama châ awpa ei khoh.
Thlalôhna Khazohpa ta Sâtâ cha nama phei ry liata a tlysao patoh aw. Eima Beipa Zisu Krista ngiachhiena nama hnohta y mawh sy.
Ei hrialâhpa Timawthy ta a châ naoh ei. Ei chiheih Lukia, Zasaw nata Sôsipatâ zy chhao ta ama châ naoh.
Kei Tertia, he châ rohtuhpa heta, Abeipa moh ta ei châ naoh ei.
Ei tlôna paw, Kaiâ, Awnanopa a pakhy tyhna o hneituhpa ta a châ naoh ei. Khihpi sôh avaotuhpa Erastâ nata eima unawhpa Kuatâ ta ama châ naoh.
Eima Beipa Zisu Krista ngiachhiena nama zydua hnohta y mawh sy.
Kô hluhpi nyupa ta a ypa bienyupa liata aluahna zipa ta, ei thâtihpha reipa nata Zisu Krista bie ei chhopa hawhta tha châ patlô theituhpa Khazohpa hnohta rônahna y mawh sy.

Tahmâ deikua cha, bienyupa palâhâhpa ta a y haw. Chyhsazy ta a ngiapâ ei sala, a bie ama zyh thei nawpa ta, chhâzaw Khazohpa ta biepie ta, bienyupa cha hrohsopazy châbu hmâpa ta phopi zydua hnohta pahnosapa ta a y.
Khazohpa sopa a y chhôhpa hnohta, Zisu Krista vâta chhâzaw ta rônahna y mawh sy! Amen.
Pawla, Khazohpa khozie ta Krista Zisu lyuhchâpa ta awpa nata eima unawhpa Sôsthene ta
Kawrini khih liata a ypa, mopathaihpazy châ awpa ta Krista Zisu liata pananopa Khazohpa awnanopa nata su to liata eima Beipa Zisu Krista, âmo Beipa nata keimo Beipa moh a padopa zydua eima châ naoh.
Khazohpa eima Paw nata Abeipa Zisu Krista tawhta ngiachhiena nata thlalôhna nama hnohta y mawh sy.
Krista Zisu liata Khazohpa ngiachhiena piepa nama châpa vâta, Khazohpa hnohta alyna bie khâ ei reih tyh.
Ano vâta biereina kyh nata pahnona kyh zydua liata, kyh to liata pahneirôhsapa ta nama y.
Cha hawhna chata Krista thâtih a pahnotuhpa nama châna cha nâmo liata pa-ipa ta a y.
Chavâta eima Beipa Zisu Krista aluahna nama hâna liata, thlahpa hmopiepa khâpa hmah a phahla veih ei chi.
Eima Beipa Zisu Krista noh liata, seina hnei leipa ta nama y thei nawpa ta, ano ta a chhâna taihta tha a cha patlô aw ei.
A Sawchapawpa eima Beipa Zisu Krista akaona liata nâmo châ awtuhpa Khazohpa cha ngâchhihpa a châ.
Unawh saih u, nama hry liata achhaihna rai a y lei nawpa ta, nama zydua reiraohpa ta, palôh miakha nata pachâna miakha phaopa ta a pôhkha awpa ta, eima Beipa Zisu Krista moh ta ei châ haw ei.
Unawh saih u, nama hry liata aeichhiana a ypa kyh Klôi chhôhkhazy ta na chho ei ta.

Ei rei khohpa cha he he a châ. Pakha ta, “Kei Pawla py ei châ,” tah ta, pakha ta, “Kei Apawlôsâ py ei châ,” tah ta, mohropa ta “Kei Kephâ py ei châ,” tah ta, mohropa heih ta, “Kei Krista py ei châ,” nama tah.
Krista cha pachhaihpa ta a y ma? Pawla cha nama châta khaipâpa ta a y ma? Cha vei khiah, Pawla moh ta bâti nama châ ma?
Krispâ nata Kaiâ dei leipa ta cha, nama hry liata ahy hmah bâti ei cha pachâsa leipa vâ ei ta, Khazohpa hnohta alyna bie ei reih.
Chavâta ei moh ta bâti nama châ tahpa ahy hmah reih thei veih ei.
Stiphanasâ chhôhkha deikua cha bâti ei pachâsa tlai ei. Cha khô lâ cha chyhsa hropa bâti ei pachâsa tlyma pahno khao va na.

Krista ta bâti pachâsa awpa ta na tuah leipa ta, thâtihpha chho awpa ta tlao eina tuah. Chyhsapa sona bie ta chho va na, chataleipatala Krista kraws hmotaotheina cha hraoleipa ama pachâsa pathlei aw na.
Kraws bie cha leidia haipazy châta hruna châ ta, keimo, pachha haipazy châta deikua cha, Khazohpa hmotaotheina a châ.
“Asopazy sona pahleipadia aw na ta, Athaipazy novâhna ei thy aw,” tahpa ropa a châ.
Chyhsa sopa cha khataih liata a y? Châthaipa cha khataih liata a y? He khizaw liata bie ei thaipa cha khataih liata a y? Khazohpa ta khizaw sona cha hruna ta tao ha vei ma?
Khazohpa sona liata cha, khizaw ta sona hmâpa ta Khazohpa a pahno thei vei tawhta cha, biechhona hrupa hmâpa ta a ngiapâpazy pachhapa cha Khazohpa ta pha a tah ngaita.
Zuzy ta ngiana a hnaw ei ta, Krikâhzy ta sona ama tlua tyh.
Keimo deikua cha, Krista khaipâpa thâtih eima chho. Cha cha Zuzy châta achapiana châ ta, Zenitaizy châta hruna a châ.
Zuzy ama châpa chhao ta, Krikâhzy ama châpa chhao ta, awpazy châta cha, Krista cha Khazohpa hmotaotheina nata Khazohpa sona a châ.
Khazohpa hruna cha chyhsapa sona hlâta so via ta, Khazohpa chiehleina cha chyhsapa thatlôna hlâta a thatlô via.
Unawh saih u, a cha awna ei he pachâ tua u. Khizaw lâ tawhta thliepa ta cha, nama hry liata chyhsa sopa hluh veih ei chi. Hmotaotheipa chhao hluh leipa ei chi ta, nôpawpa saw hluh hra veih ei chi.
Châhrasala Khazohpa ta asopazy maoh paphyuh nawpa ta, khizaw hmo hrupazy tlao a tlyh ta, thatlôpazy maoh paphyuh nawpa ta, chiehleipazy tlao â tlyh.
Hmo a ypazy hraoleipa a pachâsa thei nawpa ta, Khazohpa ta khizaw ta nawraihpa nata mohnao chhihpa ta a pachâpazy a tlyh ta, hmo a y leipazy chhao â tlyh.
Chavâta Khazohpa hmiakô liata ahy hmah a palai thei aw veih ei.
Nâmo deikua cha, ano zawhzi ta Krista Zisu liata nama y. Ano cha keimo châta Khazohpa tawhta sona vaw châ ta, eima siana, pathaihna nata chatlaina a châ hra.
Chavâta Biehrai ta a ropa hawhta, “A palaipa maihta Abeipa a palaikhei mawh sy.”
Unawh saih u, Khazohpa bienyupa cha chho awpa ei ta nâmo lâ ei vy no kha, bierei thai kawpa ta tlyma, so kawpa ta tlyma, a vypa châ va na.
Zisu Krista nata khaipâpa ta a ypa kyh dei leipa cha, nama hry liata khâpa hmah pahno a chhuah va na.
Chiehleina, china nata thata achalyuna chôta nama hry liata ei y tyh.
Ei biereipa nata ei biechhopazy kha, chyhsa sona hmâpa ta pahnie a chhuahpa biezy châ leipa ta, Thlahpa nata hmotaotheina palâsapa ta ei reih tyhpa a châ.
Chatanachata namâ ngiapâna cha chyhsa sona liata a pahnieh leipa ta, Khazohpa hmotaotheina liata tlao â pahniehpa thei aw.
Pitlohpazy hry liata deikua cha, biesozy eima pachu tyh. Châhrasala he khizaw biesozy châ leipa ta, he khizaw ryureituhpa a leidia awpazy bieso châ hra vei.
Eima rônah nawpa ta Khazohpa ta khizaw y hlâta a vaw rao chhielie hapa, Khazohpa sona bieru nata bienyupa tlao eima pachu tyh.
Cha cha he khizaw ryureituhpazy ta pahno veih ei. Pahno ha ei sala, rônahna Beipa cha ama khaipâ lei awpa tlai.
“Ano kyh a pachâpazy châta Khazohpa ta â chhuahdypa cha, Mo ta hmô veih ei; Nah ta thei leipa ei ta, Palôh ta pachâ veih ei,” tahpa ropa hawhta ama châ.
Keimo hnohta deikua cha, Khazohpa ta a Thlahpa hmâpa ta a phuah haw. Thlahpa cha ato pahno ta, Khazohpa palôh chhôh chaipazy a pahno.
Chyhsa pachânazy cha, ano liata a ypa a thlahpa dei leipa ta cha, ahy a pahno thei aw? Cha hawhna chata, Khazohpa pachânazy cha, Khazohpa Thlahpa dei leipa ta cha, ahy hmahta pahno thei veih ei.
Khazohpa ta a saipa ta hmo miah a piepazy eima pahno thei nawpa ta, khizaw thlahpa to leipa pi ta, Khazohpa tawhta Thlahpa tlao eima to.
Chyhsapa sona ta pachu tyhpa hawhta biezy pachu leipa pi ta, Thlahpa ta miah a pachupa hawhta pachu pi ta, thlahpa biehmeiseihpazy cha thlahpa chyhsazy châta eima chhopasia tyh.
Khizaw chyhsa ta Khazohpa Thlahpa hmozy a pyh vei. Ano pachâ ta cha hruna châ ta, thlahpa ta pahnopa chi a châpa vâta pahno thei vei.
Thlahpa chyhsa deikua cha, hmo to pahno pasia ta, ano cha sei thei awpa châ vei.
“Ahy ma Abeipa palôh pahno ta, ano cha a pachu thei aw?” Keimo deikua la Krista palôh eima phaoh.
Unawh saih u, thlahpa chyhsazy hnohta bie reipa hawhta nama hnohta bie reih thei leipa na ta, sapa chyhsazy nata Krista liata hawsaihzy hnohta reipa hawhta tlao ei reih tyh.
Pati hmeiseihpa a nie thei awpa nama châ mâh leipa vâta, pati hmeiseihpa châ leipa ta, sâhpiti ta ei cha pasa ei. Tahmâ chhao he a nie thei awpa châ mâh veih ei chi,
sapa chyhsa nama châ chypa vâta. Nama hry liata hiatliana nata aeichhiana zy a y thlâh ha chy khiahta cha, sapa chyhsa châ chy ei chi ta, sapa hro ta a hrohpa châ thlâh ha chy veih ei chi ma?
Pakha ta, “Kei Pawla py ei châ,” tah ta, mohropa ta, “Kei Apawlôsâ py ei châ,” nama tah chhôh ta cha, sapa chyhsa châ thlâh ha chy veih ei chi mâ?
Apawlôsâ cha khâpa ma a châ? Pawla chhao cha khâpa ma a châ? Chakaotuhpa, nâmo châ pangiapâsatuhpa deita ama châ. Cha chhao cha Abeipa ta a piepa lymâ hawhta ama hria chyupa a châ.
Kei ta loh na ta, Apawlôsâ ta ti bao ta, Khazohpa ta a palaiseihsa.
A palaiseihsatuhpa Khazohpa dei leipa ta cha, a lohtuhpa nata ti a baotuhpazy khâpa hmah châ veih ei.
A lohtuhpa nata ti a baotuhpa cha miakha ama châ. Ama hriapasazie hawhta lymâ ama hmô chyu aw.
Keimo he Khazohpa hrialâhpazy châ pi ta, nâmo Khazohpa lyu châ ei chi ta, Khazohpa o sapa nama châ.

Khazohpa ta ngiachhiena eina piepa lymâ hawhta, o satuhpa zôthaipa taozie hawhta, kei ta lôbô bô na ta, mohropa ta a chô liata o ama sa. Chyhsa to ta lôbô chô liata o ama sa awpa kyh liata a sohsi chyu mawh ei sy.
Lôbô bô ha chiehpa dei leipa ta cha, lôbô hropa ahy hmahta bô thei khao veih ei. Cha lôbô cha Zisu Krista a châ.
Châhrasala lôbô chô liana chata ahy rai ta ngôh ta tlyma, tâkâ ta tlyma, lôsôhpa ta tlyma, tho ta tlyma, sibiepa ta tlyma, sawphao ta tlyma, o a sa khiahta cha,
mei ta pasia aw ta, Noh ta a palâhâh awpa vâta, o sapazy cha ama châna dopa â vaw lâ chyu aw. Kheihta ma ama hria tahpa mei ta a pasia aw.
Ahy rai lôbô chô liata o a sapa â duah thlâh ha khiahta cha, cha chyhsa cha lymâ a hmô aw.
Ahy rai a raihriapa a kâ khai khiahta cha, cha chyhsa cha ky aw ta, ano pôhpa deikua cha mei liata a siepahliepa hawhta pachhapa a châ aw.
Khazohpa Achhyna o châ ei chi ta, Khazohpa Thlahpa nâmo liata a pahrâ tahpa pahno veih ei chi mâ?
Ahy rai Khazohpa Achhyna o a parao khiahta cha, cha chyhsa cha Khazohpa ta a parao aw. Khazohpa Achhyna o cha pathaih tlôh ta, cha Achhyna o cha nâmo nama châ.
Ahy hmahta anosasyh ta a dôvei khah sy. Nama hry liata ahy rai, he chhâ liata a so kawpa hawhta â pachâ khiahta cha, a vaw so thei nawpa ta ahrupa lâta a lie mawh sy.
He khizaw sona he, Khazohpa pachâ ta hruna châ tlôh ta. “Khazohpa ta chyhsa sopazy cha, âmo so piehpiena ta a paao tyh,” tahpa ta ropa a châ.
“Abeipa ta asopazy pachâna pahno ta, hraoleipa a châ tahpa a pahno,” tahpa a châ hra.
Chavâta ahy hmahta chyhsazy a palaikhei khah sy. Hmo to zydua nâmo eih a châ.
Pawla ma, Apawlôsâ ma, Kephâ ma, khizaw ma, hrona ma, thina ma, tahmâ daihti ma, hmialâ daihti ma, a zydua ta nâmo eih sai a châ.
Krista eih châ ei chi ta, Krista cha Khazohpa eih a châ.
Keimo he Krista chakaotuhpa nata Khazohpa bienyupa mokhâhtuhpa ta chyhsa ta miah pachâ mawh ei sy.
Cha dei châ vei, mokhâhtuhpa cha chyhsa ngâchhihpa a châ awpa a byuh.
Keima kyh liata deikua la, nâmo ta ei thâtih nama pachia awpa tlyma, chyhsapa ryureina ta a pachia awpa tlyma, hmoh chyhpata ta ei rao. Â dopa ta la, keimasasyh chhao ta a pachia beih va na.
Keimasasyh a maochhie nawpa khâpa hmah pahno va na. Châhrasala cha chata thai na pachâsa hlei vei. Nâ pachiatuhpa cha Abeipa a châ.

Chavâta a daihti a tlô hlâ nata Abeipa â vy hlâta cha, pachiana biepathlupa khâpa hmah tao khuh vy. Ano ta zohna liata hmo nyupazy cha khaihna lâ vaw puakhei aw ta, palôh achhuahnazy a palâsa aw. Cha tita chyhsa to Khazohpa reithaina ama hlao chyu aw.

Unawh saih u, nama pha nawpa ta, cha hmozy cha kei nata Apawlôsâ liata ei vaw hmâ hapa a châ. Chatanachata Biehrai bie khô lei awpa ta, keimo tawhta a chu thei aw ei chi ta, pakha a dyuh nawpa ta mohropa a palaikhei khao aw veih ei chi.
Ahy ma mohropazy nata ananopa ta châ tao? Na dao leipa hmo khâpa na hnei? Na daopa a châ tlôh khiahta cha, khazia daopa a châ leipa hmo hawhta nâ palaikhei?
Namâ ngiahpazy nama hnei khai haw! Nama vaw hneirôh haw! Keimo a hlao leipa ta beizy nama vaw châ haw! Beizy châ hmeiseih u la, keimo chhao nama hnohta a bei hra sih la ei tah kaw dia!
Khizaw nata vâlyuhchâpazy nata chyhsazy mo phapa châ awpa ta, keimo, lyuhchâpazy pi he, thie awpa ta pathlupa chyhsazy hawhta, Khazohpa ta a hnôh chai ta miah a chaluahpa châ khiah ma ei tah tyh.

Keimo la Krista châta ahrupa châ pi ta, nâmo deikua Krista liata asopa nama châ. Keimo la chiehleipa châ pi ta, nâmo deikua thatlôpa nama châ. Nâmo cha chyhsa palyupalihpa ta y ei chi ta, keimo deikua chyhsa mohnaopa ta eima y.
Tahmâ taih chhao heta nodipa ta eima dâhphi ta, chysia miah vao leipa ta, taochhiepa ta y pi ta, o chhao hnei ma pi.
Keimo ku ta hria pi ta, eima hriapasa ngaita. Pasipasawhpa ta eima y nahta, byhnâ awpa pi ta; taolapa ta eima y nahta, eima tao hualua tyh.
Reipachhiepa ta eima y nahta, bie pha eima hlâ tyh. Tanoh taih heta hnaihny hawhta pachâpa châ pi ta, khizaw puapa zydua atohna hawhta pachâpa eima châ.
Nama noza nawpa ta he biezy he ei ropa châ vei, ei saw kho ngaitapazy hawhta cha chhorei nawpa ei ta ei ropa a châ.
Krista liata chhituhpa thy kha hnei hra u la, Paw deikua a hluhpi hnei veih ei chi. Kei he thâtihpha vâta Krista Zisu liata nama paw ei châ.
Chavâta ei hâ nâ latuhpazy châ awpa ta ei châ haw ei.
Cha vâna chata Abeipa liata ei saw kho ngaitapa nata ngâchhihpa Timothy nâmo lâ ei vaw tuah. Ano ta Krista liata ei yzie nata su to nata Awnanopa to liata ei pachu tyhzie zy a cha chho aw ei.
Nâmo lâ a vy khao lei awpa hawhta na pachâpa ta, thokha cha namâ palai kaw ei aw.
Abeipa ta â ryh a tah khiahta cha, nâmo lâ a vy patoh aw na ta, a palai kawpazy chata khâpa biezy ma ama rei tahpa dei châ leipa ta, khâpa hmotaotheina ma ama hnei tahpa pahno ei chhuah aw.
Khazohpa khinarâh cha biereipa liata y vei, hmotaotheina liata tlao a y.
Khâpa nama khoh via? Sôsi chhaota nâmo lâ a vy awpa ma, kyhpachâna nata zawngiahna palôh chhaota a vy awpa maw?
Nama hry liata apatlana a ypa kyh thata a pathâh. Chyhsa pakha ta a paw lapinô ykhei ta, cha hawhpa hmo cha ngiapâleipazy hry lia hmahta a y beih leipa a châ.
Nâmo deikua cha a patahtheisana ta nama hmâh cha! Mâchhiesapa ta tlao y u la, cha hawhpa hmo a taopa cha nama hry tawhta nama papua ha awpa châ vei ma?
Pôhpa ta ei y leipa chhao ta, thlahpa ta nama hnohta ei y. Nama hry liata a hlaopa hawhta a pachâpa ta, cha hawhpa hmo a taopa pachiana bie cha ei phuah haw.
Eima Beipa Zisu moh ta namâ pakhy tita, eima Beipa Zisu hmotaotheina ta, ei thlahpa chhao nama hnohta â hlao tyh hra.
Cha chyhsa cha, Abeipa Noh liata a thlahpa pachhapa a châ nawpa ta, a sapa cha pahleipadia awpa ta Sâtâ hnohta pie muh vy.
Namâ palaina he pha vei. Thinô chyhta ta viahdie zydua a rô khai thei tahpa pahno veih ei chi ma?
Thinô pahlao leipa nama châpa hawhta, viahdie thiehpa nama châ thei nawpa ta, thinô parohpa cha pathai ha muh vy, Krista, Zawpakhô mietakutaw cha, keimo atheihna châta hlâpa châ tlôh ta.
Chavâta Zawpakhô kyhchhi ei suh u. Thinô parohpa, nôchhiena nata moleina thinô ta châ leipa ta, thinô pahlao leipa viahchhâ, palôh dopa nata biehmeiseihpa ta kyhchhi ei suh u.
Ei châpaphaopa liana khata apatlana moleina a taopazy a pahlao lei awpa ta ei roh haw.

Khizaw chyhsa apatlana moleina a taopazy, khohleikhopa nata aparupazy nata nothlahpa a chhypazy a pahlao chachei lei awpa ei tahpa deikua châ vei. Cha hawhpa châ sala, khizaw nama puasai awpa byuh tlôh aw ta.

Tahmâ deikua cha, ahy rai ngiapâna liata unawh moh phaoh tlôh ta, apatlana, khohleikhona, nothlahpa achhyna, chyhsa reipachhiena, sahma parina nata paruna moleinazy a tao thlâh ha khiahta cha, a pahlao lei awpa ta, nâmo lâta châ ei vaw roh. Cha hawhpa chyhsa cha pati chhao nielâh awpa châ vei.
Awnanopa khôtho lâta chyhsazy cha ei pachia awpa chi a châ rai ma? Awnanopa chhôh liata chyhsazy cha nâmo pachia awpa châ vei ma?
Khôtho lâta chyhsazy cha Khazohpa ta a pachia aw. Chyhsa moleipa cha nama hry tawhta papua ha muh vy.
Nama hry liata ahy tlyma, â ngiapâlâhpa chô liata biepeipa hnei sala, mopathaihpazy hmiakô liata tlôkhei leipa ta, kheihtazie ta ngiapâleipazy ryureina liata a tlôkhei ngâh?
Mopathaihpazy ta khizaw ama pachia aw tahpa pahno veih ei chi mâ? Khizaw hmah nama pachia awpa khiahta cha, hmo chynawhpazy nama pachia thei lei nawpa khâpa a y?
Vâlyuhchâpazy hmah eima pachia aw tahpa pahno veih ei chi mâ? He hro chhôh khihsatôhtuna kyh cha khazia eima pachia thei vei aw?
Chavâta hro chhôh khihsatôhtuna kyh liata biepeipa nama hnei tita, khazia Awnanopa chyhsa a châ leipazy nama pachiasa tyh?
He bie he nama noza nawpa ta ei reipa a châ. Unawhzy likah liata biepeipa a pathlâ thei awpa pakha hmah nama hry liata ama y leipa a châ ngyu aw!
Unawhpa ta a unawhpa ryureina liata tlôkhei ta, cha chhao cha ngiapâleipazy hmiakô liata châ heih ta.

Unawh nata unawh likah liata biepeipa nama hnei tyhpa heta, pahnie chhieliepa nama châpa a palâsa. Khazia â do leipa ta ama cha teipa chhao ta, maoh nama oh thlâh vei? Khazia ama cha dôveipa chhao ta, namâ padôveisa thlâh ha vei?
Nâmo chhao â do leipa ta chyhsa tei ei chi ta, nama dôvei tyh. Nama unawhzy taihta tei ei chi ta, nama dôvei tyh.
Moleipazy cha Khazohpa khinarâh to aw veih ei tahpa pahno veih ei chi mâ? Dôpa ta y khuh vy. Apatlapazy, nothlahpa achhypazy, apheipazy, chapaw âzuahpazy, chapaw nata chapaw apatlapazy,
aparupazy, khohleikhopazy, sahma paripazy, chyhsa a reipachhie thaipazy nata avyuhna a taopazy cha Khazohpa khinarâh to aw veih ei.

Nama hry liata thokha chhao, cha hawhpa chyhsa nama châ tyhpa kha. Châhrasala pasipa nata pathaisapa châ ha ei chi ta, Abeipa Zisu Krista moh ta nata eima Khazohpa Thlahpa ta thai pachâsapa nama châ haw.
“Ato taopa ei châta a pathaih,” châhrasala hmo to tao khaipa pha hlei vei. “Ato taopa ei châta a pathaih,” châhrasala khâpa sei ta hmah y aw va na.

“Niepa cha py châta châ ta, py cha niepa châta a châ,” châhrasala Khazohpa ta a pahleipadia raihrie aw. Pôhpa he apatlana moleina châta châ leipa ta, Abeipa châta tlao a châ, Abeipa chhao pôhpa châta a châ.
Khazohpa ta Abeipa cha pathyu ta, keimo chhao a hmotaotheina ta miah a pathyu hra aw.
Nama pôhpa cha Krista pachiahpazy a châ tahpa pahno veih ei chi mâ? Cha khiahta la, Krista pachiahpazy cha lapa ta, âzuahnô pachiahpazy ta ei tao aw ma? Tao beih aw va na!
“Ama pano ta pôhpa miakha ama vaw châ ha aw,” tahpa ta ropa hawhta, âzuahnô a pazaopa cha ano nata pôhpa miakha ama châ haw tahpa pahno veih ei chi mâ?
Abeipa a pazaopa deikua cha, ano nata Thlahpa miakha ama châ.
Apatlana moleina a râsai teh u. Chyhsa ta moleina hropa a taopazy cha pôhpa khôtho lâ a châ, apatlana moleina a taopa deikua cha, ano pôhpa chô lia tlai ta moleina hmo a taopa a châ.
Nama pôhpa cha Khazohpa tawhta nama daopa, nama chhôh liata a ypa Thlahpa Pathaihpa Achhyna o a châ tahpa pahno veih ei chi mâ? Nâmo eih châ khao veih ei chi,
mâ ta chaleipa nama châ haw. Chavâta Khazohpa cha nama pôhpa liata palyupalih teh u.
“Chapaw châta lapinô hnei leipa a pha via,” tahpa ta châ vaw roh ei chi ta.
Châhrasala apatlana moleina khôkhâh nawpa ta, chapaw ta lapinô hnei chyu ei sala, chanô chhao ta vahpa hnei chyu mawh ei sy.
Vahpa ta vahpa tao awpa cha a lapinô liata tao sala, cha hawhna chata lapinô chhao ta, lapinô tao awpa cha a vahpa liata tao hra mawh sy.
Lapinô ta ano pôhpa chô liata bie hnei leipa ta, a vahpa ta bie tlao a hnei. Cha hawhna chata vahpa chhao ta ano pôhpa chô liata bie hnei leipa ta, a lapinô ta bie tlao a hnei.

Thlahchhâ awpa ta namâ pie thei nawpa ta bohpi leipa châta â ryh nama tah raihriepa dei leipa ta cha, nôvah châna kyh liata a paky khuh vy. Thlahchhâ awpa ta bohpi leipa chhôh namâ paky hapa chhao ta, thlah nama chhâ khai tawhta cha, nama yzie tyhpa hawhta y heih tyh muh vy. Chataleipatala namâ sohsi thei leipa vâta Sâtâ ta a cha reipasao pathlei aw ei.
Châhrasala lapinô nata vahpa hnei awpa kyh cha, biepiepa hawhta reih leipa na ta, pasaipa a châna kyh ei reipa a châ.
Chyhsa zydua ta keima hawhta y khai ei sala tahpa ei khoh. Châhrasala chyhsa to Khazohpa tawhta hmopiepa hnei chyu ei ta, pakha ta hmopiepa miakha hnei ta, mohropa ta hmopiepa hropa a hnei.
Dyhchâ leipazy nata nôhmeizy hnohta hetana heta ei tah. Keima hawhta dyhchâ leipa ta y ei sala ama châta a pha.
Amâ kuah thei leipa khiah deikua cha, lapinô nata vahpa ama hnei awpa a pha. Chanô chapaw châna pachâna sai ta bie thlâh hapa hlâta cha, lapinô nata vahpa hnei lâlaopa a pha via.
Nôvah hnohta he bie he ei pie. Kei ta ei piepa châ vei, Abeipa piepa a châ. Lapinô cha a vahpa tawhta â râ awpa châ vei.
Â râ khiahta cha, vahpa a hnei awpa châ khao vei. Cha ta a châ vei khiahta cha, a vahpa â ryh heih awpa a châ. Vahpa chhao ta a lapinô a ma awpa châ vei.

Mohropazy hnohta deikua cha, hetana heta ei tah. Abeipa ta a reipa châ leipa ta, keima ta ei reih. Unawh ahy rai ta ngiapâleipa chyhsa lapinô ta hnei sala, a lapinô ta a hnohta pahrâ awpa a khoh thlâh ha khiahta cha, a ma awpa châ vei.
Chanô ahy rai ta ngiapâleipa chyhsa vahpa ta hnei sala, a vahpa ta a hnohta pahrâ awpa a khoh thlâh ha khiahta cha, â chhaih awpa châ vei.

Vahpa ngiapâleipa cha, a lapinô zawhzi ta pathaisapa ta y ta, lapinô ngiapâleipa chhao, a vahpa zawhzi ta pathaisapa ta a y. Chata châ vei sala, nama sawzy cha pathaih leipa ama châ aw. Tahmâ deikua cha ama pathaih.

Ngiapâleipa ta â kaolâhpa â chhaih khoh khiahta deikua cha, a chhaih thlâh ha mawh sy. Cha hawhpa liata la, ngiapâtuhpa vahpa nata lapinô cha chahrypa châ khao veih ei. Khazohpa ta adyryhpa ta y awpa ta miah a aw.
Hy lapinô y, na vahpa na pachha thei awpa nata pachha thei lei awpa kyh kheihta na pahno? Hy vahpa y, na lapinô na pachha thei awpa nata pachha thei lei awpa kyh kheihta na pahno?
Abeipa ta a raozie hawhta nata Khazohpa ta a awzie hawhta, chyhsa to y mawh ei sy. Cha cha Awnanopa zydua châta ei raopa a châ.
Chopawtai chiehpa ta awpa ama y ma? Chopawtaipa ngiana thy khah sy. Chopawtaileipa a châ nota awpa ama y ma? Chopawtai a chhuah hlei khah sy.
Chopawtaipa cha khâpa hmah châ leipa ta, chopawtaileipa chhao khâpa hmah châ hra vei. A peimawhpa cha Khazohpa biepiepazy zyhpa he a châ.
Chyhsa to ta awpa ama châ nota ama duahmo liata y thlâh mawh ei sy.
Sei na châ nota awpa na châ ma? Cha cha pei tah khah y. Khotalaina rypaohpa na hmô khiahta deikua cha, hmâh phahnai mah y.
Sei a châ nota Abeipa ta a awpa cha, Abeipa liata la khotalaipa a châ. Cha hawhna chata khotalaipa a châ nota awpa chhao, Krista sei a châ.
Mâ ta chaleipa nama châ. Chyhsa sei ta a ngia khuh vy.
Chavâta unawh saih u, kheihawhpa duahmo tawhta awpa nama châpa chhao ta, Khazohpa liata y thlâh ha teh u.
Dyhchâ leipa laihsa kôpazy kyh liata, Abeipa tawhta biepiepa hnei leipa na ta, châhrasala Abeipa ngiachhiena zawhzi ta chyhsa ngâchhihpa ei châna lâ tawhta ei pachâzie ei reih.
Tahmâhlâ riethei rairuna vâta, chyhsa to ama y ualua ta ypa pha ei tah.
Lapinô hneipa na châ ma? Puasai a chhuah khah y. Lapinô hnei leipa na châ ma? Lapinô tlua khoh khah y.

Lapinô na hneipa chhao ta, hmo parao va chi. Laihsa kôpa ta vahpa a hneipa chhao ta, hmo parao hra vei. Châhrasala nôvahzy cha khizaw rairunazy amâ tyh awpa vâta, cha rairunazy cha nama khôkhâh awpa ei khoh.
Unawh saih u, ei rei khohpa cha he he a châ: Daihti chyuta y ta, chavâta tahmâ tawhta la, lapinô a hneipazy ta a hnei leipa hawhta y mawh ei sy.
Mâchhie sapazy ta mâchhie sa leipa hawhta y ei sala, a lypazy ta a ly leipa hawhta y ei sala, hmo a chaleipazy ta a hnei leipa hawhta y mawh ei sy.
Khizaw hmo liata â hmâhpazy chhao, â hmâh leipa hawhta y mawh ei sy. Khizaw yzie he a leidia hai.
Pachâchhiena hnei leipa ta nama y awpa ei cha khokhei ei. Lapinô a hnei leipa cha, Abeipa palysa a chhuahpa ta, Abeipa lâ hmo a pachâ tyh.
Lapinô a hneipa deikua cha, lapinô palysa a chhuahpa ta, khizaw hmo pachâ tyh ta,

a tao khohpazy â chakhia ha tyh. Vahpa a hnei leipa cha a pôhpa nata a thlahpa liata pathaihpa ta a y thei nawpa ta, Abeipa lâ hmo a pachâ tyh. Vahpa a hneipa deikua cha, a vahpa palysa a chhuahpa ta, khizaw hmo a pachâ tyh.
Cha hmo cha nama phana awpa ta ei reipa a châ. Pakhâ ei châ chhuahpa ei châ leipa ta, â dopa ta y u la, Abeipa chakao awpa ta palôh tlokhuh ta namâ pie thei nawpa ta ei reih.

Ahy rai lapinô châta â pahawhpa laihsa kôpa chô liata a hmotaopa â do leipa hawhta a pahno sala, a sapa khona â kuah thei leipa khiahta cha, a lapinô â pahawhpa cha, a khozie hawhta hnei patoh mawh sy. Moleina châ vei. Amâ hneipa a pha.
Châhrasala ahy rai lapinô hnei patoh awpa a byuhna y hlei leipa sala, a sapa khona a kuah thei sala, a pahawh chy awpa ta a palôh ta khâchâ â chhuah ha khiahta cha, cha hawhta tao mawh sy.
Chatanachata lapinô a pahawhpa a hneipa cha, tao pha ta, a pahawhpa a hnei mâh leipa cha a tao pha via heih.
Lapinô cha a vahpa hro chhôh zydua cha chahrypa a châ. A vahpa a thi ha khiahta deikua cha, a khopa maih a hnei thei. Anodeikua cha Abeipa liata a ypa chyhsa a châ awpa a châ.
Châhrasala keima pachâna liata cha, a y tyhpa hawhta y sala, a ly via aw khiah ma ei tah. Kei chhao Khazohpa Thlahpa ei hnei tahpa ei pahno.
Nothlahpazy lâta hlâpa niepa kyh liata, eima zydua ta pahnona eima hnei chyu tahpa eima pahno. Pahnona ta chyhsa liata apalaina tao ta, kyhpachâna deikua ta chyhsa a tao pathi tyh.
Chyhsa ta a pahno kawpa hawhta â pachâ khiahta cha, a pahno awpa hawhpa pahno mâh vei.
Khazohpa kyh a pachâpa deikua cha, Khazohpa ta ano cha a pahno.
Chavâta nothlahpa lâta hmohlâpa niepa kyh liata, khizaw liata nothlahpa cha khâpa hmah a châ leizie nata Khazohpa pakha dei leipa ta cha, Khazoh hropa rai a y leizie eima pahno.
Avâ liata tlyma, alei liata tlyma, khazoh moh phaohpazy y hra ei sala, cha hawhpa khazoh hluhpi nata bei hluhpi cha y tlai ei ta,

keimo châta deikua cha, Paw Khazohpa pakha deita a y. Ano tawhta ato pua ta, keimo chhao ano châta a ypa eima châ. Abeipa pakha deita hnei pi ta, ano cha Zisu Krista a châ. Ano vâta ato y ta, keimo chhao ano vâta a ypa eima châ hra.

Cha pahnona cha chyhsa zydua ta hnei veih ei. Chyhsa thokha cha nothlahpa a chhy tyhpa ama châpa vâta, nothlahpa lâ hlâ hapa hawh tlai ta pachâpa ta nie ei ta, ama chhie nata pha pahnona a thatlô leipa vâta, pathaih leipa hawhta pachâpa ama a châ.
Niepa ta Khazohpa miah pahniasa vei. Eima nie leipa vâta chhie via leipa pi ta, eima niepa vâta pha via hlei ma pi.
Châhrasala a sohsi teh u, chataleipatala nama khotalaina cha chyhsa chiehleipazy châta achapiana a châ pathlei aw.

Nâ, pahnona a hneipa chi ta, nothlahpa achhyna o liata na niepa cha, chhie nata pha pahnona chiehleipa a hneipa chyhsa ta a cha hmô khiahta cha, ano chhao nothlahpa lâta atheihna hlâpa hmozy cha nie ngâhna na pahneisapa châ aw vei ma?
Chatanachata na unawhpa chiehleipa, ano vyuhpa ta Krista a thipa chyhsa cha, na pahnona ta a pahleipadia aw.
Cha hawhta unawhzy chô liata molei ei chi ta, ama chhie nata pha pahnona chiehlei nota hmah nama paphao lao heihpa cha, Krista chô liata hmo a paraopa nama châ.
Chavâta niepa vâta ei unawhpa ei pahluasa khiahta cha, ei unawhpa ei pahluasa pathlei lei nawpa ta, atheihna sa cha nie khao aw va na.
Khotalaipa châ va na mâ? Lyuhchâpa châ va na mâ? Eima Beipa Zisu hmô ha va na mâ? Nâmo cha Abeipa liata ei raihria theilâpa châ veih ei chi mâ?
Mohropazy châta lyuhchâpa châ vei hraw sah la, nâmo châ chhâ ta la ei châ, nâmo tlai he Abeipa liata lyuhchâpa ei châna chahnao pa-ina cha nama châ.
Nâ pasiatuhpazy ei chhyna cha he he a châ.
Nie theina nata do theina biehneina hnei ma pi mâ?
Lyuhchâ hropazy, Abeipa unawhzy nata Kephâ hawhta, ngiapâtuhpa lapinô ta hneipa ta, ano a chhi theina biehneina hnei ma pi ma?
Bânabâ nata kei dei he ma, eima khihsatôhtuna châta raihria leipa ta y thei awpa ta biehneina a hnei leipa a châ pi?
Ahy ma anosasyh a chyhpa ta pheisaih rai a hria beih tly? Ahy ma kre sadô tao ta a thei nie leipa ta a y beih? Ahy ma sahroh zao ta, a sâhpiti do leipa ta y beih?
Cha biezy cha chyhsapa biehneina ta ei reipa dei ma a châ? Ryhpa bie chhao ta, cha biezy tlai cha reih hra vei mâ?
Mawsi ryhpa liata, “Viahchao tôhpa sâh a tly nota a hmao nama hi awpa châ vei,” tahpa ropa a châ. Khazohpa ta viahchao tôhpa kyh ma a rei khoh?
Keimo châta a reipa tlao châ vei ma? Keimo châta ropa a châ. Leipalietuhpa ta hnabeiseihna hneipa ta a palie awpa châ ta, sâh tlytuhpa chhao ta, tovyuh hnabeiseihpa ta a tly awpa a châ.
Thlahpa lâ chizy nama hry liata eima tu ha khiahta cha, sapa lâ theizy nâmo tawhta hria awpa cha, eimâ phuh leipa a châ hlei rai ma?

Mohropazy hmahta chyh awpa ama châ hnaw khiahta cha, keimo chhochhi cha châ hnaw via pachai awpa châ ma pi ma? Châhrasala keimo la, cha tovyuh cha a hnaw ma pi. Krista thâtihpha eima pakhâpadie lei nawpa ta, riethei to tlao eima tao lylia.
Achhyna o rai hriatuhpazy cha, Achhyna o tawhta niepa hmô ei ta, maisâh liata chakaotuhpazy chhao, atheihna hlâpazy liata tovyuh ama hnei hra tahpa pahno veih ei chi mâ?
Cha hawhna chata, thâtihpha chhotuhpazy châta, thâtihpha cha ama nie hmôna châ awpa ta Abeipa ta bie a pie.

Châhrasala kei la cha tovyuhzy cha miakha hmahta hmâh va na. Ei chô liata nama tao hra nawpa ta, he biezy he a rohpa châ hra va na. Chyhsa ta ei palaikheina eina lapa awpa hlâta cha, tlao thi sah la ei châta a pha via.
Thâtihpha ei chhopa chhao heta, a palai nawpa hnei va na. Tao lei thei lei awpa ta ei chô liata a pahnieh tlôh ta. Thâtihpha ei chho vei khiahta la, ei hu a po aw!
Keima khotlyna ta thâtihpha a chhopa ei châ khiahta cha, lymâ ei hnei. Keima khotlyna a châ vei khiah deikua cha, ei hnohta pavaosapa mohôhna rai ei hriapa tlâ a châ.
Cha khiahta la, ei lymâ cha khâpa a châ aw? Thâtihpha ei chhopa vâta tovyuh ei hnaw theipazy a hnaw leipa ta, hlao leipa ta thâtihpha ei chho theipa he ei lymâ cha a châ.
Ahy sei hmah châ vei hraw sah la, chyhsa hluhpi ei pahnie thei nawpa ta, keimasasyh ta chyhsa zydua sei ta ei tao.

Zuzy pahnie thei nawpa ta, Zuzy hnohta Zu hawhta ei y tyh. Kei cha ryhpa ry liata y vei hraw sah la, ryhpa ry liata a ypazy ei pahnie thei nawpa ta, ryhpa ry liata a ypazy hnohta ryhpa ry liata ta ei y tyh.
Khazohpa ryhpazy zyh leipa ta y tlôh leipa ta, Krista ryhpa ry liata a ypa châ hraw sah la, ryhpa hnei leipazy ei pahnie thei nawpa ta, ryhpa hnei leipazy hnohta ryhpa hnei leipa hawhta ei y tyh.
Chiehleipazy ei pahnie thei nawpa ta, chiehleipazy hnohta chiehleipa hawhta ei y tyh. Kheihawhta chhâ ma chyhsa thokha ei pachha thei nawpa ta, chyhsa zydua hnohta ato châpa ta ei y tyh.
Thâtihpha byhnâ ei topa ama to thei nawpa ta, cha hmozy cha ei tao.
Arâpasuana liata ama zydua ta a râ ei ta, châhrasala pakha ngâlâh ta lymâ a hmô tyh tahpa pahno veih ei chi mâ? Lymâ hmô awpa ta a râ teh u.
Ataopasuana liata a hlaopazy cha, kyh toti liata amâ sohsi tyh. Âmo cha lakho rao theipa hmô awpa ta tei ei ta, keimo deikua cha, lakho rao thei leipa hmô awpa ta eima tei.
Anuapa hnei leipa ta a râ chakhyh leipa na ta, chyhsa ta ziza â chôpa hawhta a chôpa châ va na.
Mohropazy thâtihpha ei chho khai tawhta, keima chaipa he lymâ hmô tlâh leipa ei châ pathlei lei nawpa ta, ei pôhpa he a vaopahnie na ta, ei biehneina ry liata ei soh tyh.
Unawh saih u, he hmo he nama pahno lei awpa khoh va na. Miah pathlatuhpa zydua kha meihdo ry liata y khai ei ta, ama zydua ta tilaipi ama chaka khai.
Ama zydua ta meihdo nata tilaipi liata Mawsi hnohta a ngiarihpa ta bâti ama châ.
Ama zydua ta thlahpa pati miakha nie ei ta,
ama zydua ta thlahpa ti miakha ama doh. Âmo a zituhpa thlahpa Lôpanô tawhta ti doh ei ta, cha Lôpanô cha Krista a châ.
Châhrasala ama hry liata chyhsa hluh via chô liata Khazohpa palôh châ leipa ta, ama rizy râhchawhpa liata hiepatlapa ta a y.
Hmo moleipa ama khohpa hawhta eima khoh hra lei nawpa ta, cha hmozy cha keimo châta pamosana a châ.
“Niedoh awpa ta zawpi a tyuh ei ta, lâ awpa ta ama thyu,” tahpa ropa hawhta, âmo hawhta nothlahpa a chhy hra khuh vy.
Ama hry liata thokha ta apatlana moleina tao ei ta, noh kha ta chyhsa 23,000 ama thipa hawhna khata, keimo la apatlana moleina liata eima tlaih awpa châ vei.
Ama hry liata thokha ta Abeipa pasia ei ta, parih ta a pahleipadia hapa hawhna ei khata, keimo la Abeipa pasia khah ei suh u.
Ama hry liata thokha ta paphôh ei ta, pahleipadiatuhpa ta a pahleipadia hapa hawhna ei khata, keimo la paphôh khah ei suh u.
Khazy kha pamosana châta ama chô liata a vaw tlôpa châ ta, keimo, daihti chhâna liata a ypazy pachuna châta ropa a châ.
Chavâta â duahpa ta â pachâpa cha a chado mawh sy, chataleipatala a pao pathlei aw na.

Chyhsa chô liata a tlô tyhpa reipasaonazy dei leipa ta cha, reipasaona hropa nama chô liata tlô beih vei. Khazohpa cha ngâchhihpa châ ta, nama pahnie lei awpa reipasaona namâ tyh awpa pasaih aw vei. Reipasaona nama pahnie thei nawpa ta, reipasaona raohpa ta a râ nawpa lâpi a cha taopa aw ei.
Chavâta kho ngaitapazy saih u, nothlahpa achhyna a râsai teh u.
Chyhsa sopazy hnohta reipa hawhta ei reih. Ei bie reipa he pachâ teh u.
Byhnâ tona nyu châta byhnâ eima aw tyhpa he, Krista thisaih a hlykheina châ vei mâ? Viahchhâ eima pachhaih tyhpa he, Krista pôhpa a hlykheina châ vei mâ?
Viahchhâ cha tlâ kha a châpa hawhta, cha viahchhâ tlâ kha tawhta a niepa keimo, chyhsa hluhpi chhao pi he, pôhpa miakha eima châ.
Izarei phopi kha pachâ tua u. Atheihna sa a niepazy kha maisâh a hlykheipazy châ veih ei ma?
Khâpa ma rei ei chhuah? Nothlahpa lâta atheihna hlâpa cha khâpa hmah châ leipa ta, nothlahpa chhao cha khâpa hmah châ vei, ei tah mâ?
Tah va na. Ngiapâleipazy atheihna cha Khazohpa lâta hlâpa châ leipa ta, ahripazy lâta ama hlâ tyhpa a châna kyh ei reipa a châ. Nâmo la ahripazy namâ hlykhei awpa cha khokhei veih ei na.
Abeipa nyu nata ahripa nyu doh pakaoh thei veih ei chi. Abeipa tlâhkhai nata ahripa tlâhkhai dôh pakaoh thei hra veih ei chi.
Abeipa cha a hia patliasapa ta, a hie pahâh eimâ chhuah mâ? Ano hlâta eima tha a tlô via mâ?
“Ato zydua ei châta tao pasaipa a châ,” châhrasala ato tao khaipa pha hlei vei. “Ato tao pasaipa a châ,” châhrasala ato taopa ta chyhsa taopathi hlei vei.
Chyhsa ta ano pha nawpa tlua leipa sala, mohropa pha nawpa tlao tlua mawh sy.
Sa zuana liata ama zuapa maih cha, chhie nata pha pahnona hmâpa ta, khâpa hmah hiahri leipa ta nie thlâh ha mah y.
“Alei he Abeipa eih châ ta, a chhôh liata hmo zydua chhao Abeipa eih a châ.”
Ngiapâleipa chyhsa pakha ta pati nie cha hrua ei sala, nie awpa namâ chhuah khiahta cha, nama hmiakô liata sopa maih nie u la, nama chhie nata pha pahnona hmâh u la, bie hiahri khuh vy.
Chyhsa ta, “He he atheihna châta hlâpa a châ,” tahpa ta a cha chho khiah ei ta deikua cha, châ chhotuhpa vâta nata chhie nata pha pahnona vâta, nama nie awpa châ vei.
Nâma chhie nata pha pahnona kyh reih leipa na ta, mohropa chhie nata pha pahnona kyh ei reipa tlao a châ. Khazia ei khotalaina cha, chyhsa hropa chhie nata pha pahnona ta a pachia aw?
Alyna chôta ei nie khiahta cha, alyna bie reina chôta ei niepa pati vâta, khazia reipachhiepa ei châ aw?
Chavâta nama nie tlyma, nama doh tlyma, nama taopa maih Khazohpa rônahna châta tao muh vy.
Zuzy chhao, Krikâhzy chhao, Khazohpa Awnanopa chhao, amâ hlua nawpa hmo khâpa hmah tao khuh vy.
Kei chhao ta, chyhsa hluhpi pachha ama châ thei nawpa ta, keima athôhna tlua leipa na ta, chyhsazy athôhna tluapa ta, hmo ei taopa to liata chyhsa to palysa tlao ei chhuah tyh.
Kei ta Krista hâ ei lapa hawhna heta, nâmo chhao ei hâ nâ la hra teh u.
Ato liata nâ thei ei chi ta, pachuna ei cha piepazy nama zyh lymâpa vâta ei cha reithai ei.
He deikua he nama pahno awpa ei khoh: Chapaw luh cha Krista châ ta, chanô luh cha chapaw châ ta, Krista luh cha Khazohpa a châ.
Chapaw ta a luh a khupa ta thlah a chhâ khiahta tlyma, bie a chho khiahta tlyma cha, a luh maoh a paphyuhpa a châ.
Chanô ta a luh a khu leipa ta thlah a chhâ khiahta tlyma, bie a chho khiahta tlyma deikua cha, a luh maoh a paphyuhpa a châ. Chanô châta luh khu leipa nata luh pôlôpa cha miakhapa a châ.
Chanô cha a luh â khu khoh leipa khiahta cha, a sâ ngyu lâlao mawh sy. Châhrasala chanô châta sâ ngyupa nata luh pôlôpa cha nozachhihpa a châpa vâta, a luh a khu mawh sy.
Chapaw cha Khazohpa lyupa nata Khazohpa rônahna a châpa vâta, a luh â khu awpa châ vei. Chanô deikua cha chapaw rônahna a châ.
Chapaw cha chanô tawhta taopa châ leipa ta, chanô deikua cha, chapaw tawhta taopa a châ.
Chapaw cha chanô châta taopa châ leipa ta, chanô deikua cha, chapaw châta taopa a châ.
Cha vâta nata vâlyuhchâpazy vâ chhao rai ta, chanô cha a chô liata biehneituhpa a y tahpa ngiana châta a luh â khu awpa a byuh.
Abeipa liata deikua cha, chanô cha chapaw a hlao leipa ta y thei leipa ta, chapaw chhao chanô a hlao leipa ta y thei vei.
Chanô cha chapaw tawhta a puapa a châpa hawhta, tahmâ cha chapaw chhao chanô tawhta a pihpa a châ hra. Ato zydua deikua cha Khazohpa tawhta a puapa a châ.
Nâmosasyh ta a pachia teh u. Chanô ta luh a khu leipa ta Khazohpa lâta thlahchhâpa cha â ngia ma?
Chapaw cha a sâ â paseih khiahta cha, ano châta nozachhihpa a châ tahpa nama pikheipa palôh chhao ta cha pahnosa veih ei ma?
Chanô châta deikua cha, a sâ â paseih khiahta cha, a rônahna a châ. A sâ cha â khu awpa ta piepa châ tlôh ta.
He kyh liata a paeipa ama y khiahta cha, taozie hropa hnei ma pi, Khazohpa Awnanopa chhao ta hnei hra vei.
He hmozy liata deikua cha, cha reithai thei veih ei na. Nama pha via nawpa lâ châ leipa ta, nama rao via nawpa lâta namâ pakhy tyh.
A hmiatua chai ta, Awnanopa sahlao namâ pakhy nahta, nama hry liata a pachhaihna a y tyh tahpa ei thei. Ei zo pâ thlâh haw.
Nama hry liata a hmeiseihpazy amâ lâ thei nawpa ta, py achhaihna chhao cha a y awpa rai a châ.
Namâ pakhy nahta, Abeipa Zâpati nie awpa ta a pakhypa châ veih ei chi.
Nama nie nahta, chyhsa to nâmo pati chyu nama nie tyh. Chavâta pakha a nodi ta, pakha a pari.

Khazia! Niedo nawpa o hnei veih ei chi ma? Khazia Khazohpa Awnanopa mohnaopa ta, khâpa hmah hnei leipazy maoh nama paphyuhsa? Nama hnohta khâpa ei reih aw? Ei cha reithai aw ei mâ? Cha reithai tiarâh veih ei na.
Nama hnohta ei cha pie pachhuahpa ei he Abeipa tawhta ei hmôpa a châ. Abeipa Zisu cha patusapa ta a y zâ ta, viahchhâ la ta,
alyna bie a rei khai nahta, eichheih ta, “He he ei sapa nama châta piepa a châ. Einâ thei thlâh nawpa ei chi ta, he he tao tyh muh vy,” tah ta.
Cha hawhna chata, zâpati ama nie khai nahta, nyu la ta, “He nyu he ei thisaih liata biehrai thiehpa cha a châ. Nama dona maihta einâ thei thlâh ha nawpa ei chi ta, he he tao tyh muh vy,” tah ta.
He viahchhâ he nama niena maih nata nyu he nama dona maihta, â vy heih hlâlei cha Abeipa thina nama pamosa tyhpa a châ.
Chavâta ahy rai a nie tlâh châ leipa ta viahchhâ a niepa tlyma, Abeipa nyu a dohpa tlyma cha, Abeipa pôhpa nata thisaih chô liata a moleipa vâta thailei a châ aw.
Chavâta chyhsa ta anosasyh a pasia sala, cha khai tawhta, viahchhâ cha niepa ta, nyu cha doh mawh sy.
Abeipa pôhpa a châpa pahno leipa ta, a niepa nata a dohpa maih cha, ano thaileichâ nawpa ta a niepa nata a dohpa a châ.
Chavâta nama hry liata chyhsa hluhpi chiehleipa nata tlâhleipa ta y ei chi ta, thokha chhochhi cha ama thi haw.
Keimosasyh ta eimâ mohpasia ha khiahta cha, thaileichâpa ta y aw ma pi.
Abeipa ta thailei miah a pachâsa nahta deikua cha, chhoreipa ta eima y tyh. Chatanachata khizaw thailei a pachâsa tita, thailei pachâsapa ta y aw ma pi.
Chavâta unawh saih u, nie awpa ta namâ pakhy tita, a hâ pakhy tyh muh vy.
Namâ pakhyna cha thaileichâna a châ pathlei lei nawpa ta, ahy rai a nodi khiahta cha, o liata nie ha mawh sy. Hmo hropa kyhzy cha, ei vy tita ei pasia aw.
Chavâta unawh saih u, thlahpa hmopiepazy kyh liata, nama pahno lei awpa khoh va na.
Ngiapâleipa nama châ no kha, nothlahpa reih pathlie thai leipazy lâta a chhipa ta y ei chi ta, lâpi paviasapa ta nama ypa nama pahno.

Chavâta he he nama pahno awpa ei khoh: Khazohpa Thlahpa chhihthapa ta bie a reihtuhpa ta, “Zisu cha chhiesapa a châ!” tah beih vei. Ahy hmahta Thlahpa Pathaihpa chhihthana dei leipa ta cha, “Zisu cha Abeipa a châ,” tah thei veih ei.
Hmopiepa chi hluhpi y ta, Thlahpa deikua cha pakha a châ.
Chakaona chi hluhpi y ta, Abeipa deikua cha pakha a châ.
Raihria chi hluhpi y ta, Khazohpa deikua cha pakha a châ. Chyhsa to hnohta ama raihria châ chyu ta hmotaotheina a pie ei.
Thlahpa hmopiepazy cha zawpi pha nawpa ta chyhsa to hnohta piepa a châ.
Chyhsa pakha hnohta Thlahpa liata sona bie piepa châ ta, chyhsa hropa hnohta Thlahpa lia lilaw ta pahnona bie piepa a châ.
Mohropa hnohta Thlahpa lia lilaw ta ngiapâna piepa châ ta, ahropa hnohta, cha Thlahpa lilaw ta patlâh theina piepa a châ.

Thokha hnohta hmonoâhpa tao theina piepa châ ta, ahropa hnohta hrohsona bie phuah theina piepa a châ. Chyhsa hropa hnohta thlahpa nanopazy pahrua thaina piepa châ ta, mohropa hnohta reihtheileipa ta bie rei theina piepa châ ta, ahropa hnohta reihtheileipa chhopasia theina piepa a châ.
Cha zydua cha Thlahpa pakha raihria châ ta, chyhsa to hnohta a khozie hawhta a rai chyu ei.
Pôhpa he miakha châ ta, pachiahpa hluhpi a hnei. Pôhpa pachiahpa zydua cha hluh hra sala, pôhpa cha miakha a châpa hawhta, Krista chhao cha hawhpa a châ.
Eima zydua ta, Zuzy chhao, Krikâhzy chhao, sei chhao, khotalaipa chhao, pôhpa miakha châ awpa ta Thlahpa miakha ta bâti pachâsapa châ pi ta, Thlahpa miakha tawhta padosapa eima châ khai.
Pôhpa cha miakha dei châ leipa ta, pachiahpa hluhpi a hnei.
Phei ta, “Ku ei châ leipa vâta pôhpa liata a hlao va na,” tah sala, cha vâna chata pôhpa liata â hlao leipa châ hlei vei.
Nakao ta, “Mo ei châ leipa vâta pôhpa liata a hlao va na,” tah sala, cha vâna chata pôhpa liata â hlao leipa châ hlei vei.
Pôhpa zydua he mo châ khai sala, pyu theina cha khataih liata a y aw? Pôhpa zydua he nakao châ khai sala, roh theina cha khataih liata a y aw?
Khazohpa ta pachiahpa to he, pôhpa liata a khona lia maihta a paysa chyupa a châ.
Cha zydua cha pachiahpa miakha châ ei sala, pôhpa cha khataih liata a y aw?
Pachiahpa hluhpi y ta, pôhpa deikua miakha a châ.
Mo ta ku hnohta, “Châ ngiah va na,” tah thei leipa ta, luh chhao ta phei hnohta, “Châ ngiah va na,” tah thei hra vei.
Cha cha rei leipa ta, pôhpa pachiahpa chiehleipa hawhta a lâpazy cha peimawh via pachaipa ama châ.
Pôhpa pachiahpa palyupalih tlâh leipa ta eima pachâpazy cha palyupalih via pi ta, eima pôhpa pachiahpa a ngia leipazy cha eima tobi via tyh.
Eima pôhpa pachiahpa a ngiapazy cha, pangiasa via byuh hlei vei. Khazohpa ta pôhpa he paryh ta, angiana a hnei leipa pachiahpazy cha palyupalihna a pie via ei.
Chatanachata pôhpa liata achhaihna y leipa aw ta, pachiahpazy ta â khopa ta amâ baokhâ raihrie thei aw.
Pachiahpa miakha pasa a tao tita, pachiahpa zydua ta taokhei ei ta, pachiahpa miakha palyupalihpa ta a y tita, pachiahpa zydua ta amâ lykhei tyh.
Nâmo sahlao he Krista pôhpa châ ei chi ta, a pachiahpa nama châ chyu hra.

Khazohpa ta Awnanopa liata chakaotuhpazy rao ta, miakhana liata lyuhchâpazy, mianona liata hrohsopazy, miathôhna liata pachutuhpazy a rao. Cha khai tawhta hmonoâhpa taotuhpazy, patlâhna hmopiepa a hneipazy, chyhsa bao khohna hmopiepa a hneipazy, ryurei thaina hmopiepa a hneipazy nata reihtheileipa hmopiepa a hneipazy a rao ei.
Chyhsa zydua lyuhchâpa ama châ khai ma? Chyhsa zydua hrohsopa ama châ khai ma? Chyhsa zydua pachutuhpa ama châ khai ma? Chyhsa zydua ta hmonoâhpa ama tao khai ma?
Chyhsa zydua ta patlâh theina hmopiepa ama hnei khai ma? Chyhsa zydua ta reihtheileipa ta bie ama reih khai ma? Chyhsa zydua ta reihtheileipa ama chhopasia thei khai ma?
Khâpa rai châ sala, hmopiepa rônah viapazy cha tlaichhai pachai teh u. Chatanachata lâpi pha viapa ei cha pahmô aw ei.
Chyhsapa nata vâlyuhchâpazy reih ta bie reih hraw sah la, kyhpachâna ei hnei tlôh leipa khiahta la, dawh paro thlâhthlipa tlyma, paotlâ paro thlâhthlipa tlyma ei châ.

Hrohsona hmopiepa hneipa ta, bienyupa zydua nata pahnona zydua hnei khai hraw sah la, tlâhzy pasie theina taihta ngiapâna pakipa hnei hraw sah la, kyhpachâna ei hnei tlôh leipa khiahta la, khâpa hmah châ va na.
Ei hneipa zydua dyhchhiepazy pie khai ha hraw sah la, ei pôhpa mei liata rao awpa ta a pie hraw sah la, kyhpachâna ei hnei tlôh leipa khiahta la, ei châta khâpa hmah phahnai vei.
Kyhpachâna cha dao thei ta, a nô a pha. Kyhpachâna cha a hiatlia leipa ta, anosasyh ta a reithai vei. Kyhpachâna cha a palai leipa ta,
a nôchhie vei. Kyhpachâna cha ano phana dei pachâ leipa ta, a hiehâh khoh hra leipa ta, paraopazy a thei thlâh ha vei.
Kyhpachâna cha sialeina liata a ly leipa ta, bie hmeiseihpa deikua cha â ly tyh.
Kyhpachâna cha ato pasa tao ta, ato a ngiapâ ta, ato hnabeiseih ta, ato liata riethei a tao lylia tyh.
Kyhpachâna cha chhâ beih aw vei. Hrohsona biezy chhâpa ta, reihtheileipazy dia aw ta, novâhnazy a lei aw.
Â ki leipa ta pahno pi ta, â ki leipa ta eima chhochhielie tyh.
Â kipa a vaw tlô tita deikua cha, a ki leipa cha pahleipa a châ ha aw.
Ei hawti nota, hawti reih cheih na ta, hawti pahnona ta pahno na ta, hawti pachâna ta ei pachâ tyh. Ei vaw pitloh tawhta deikua cha, hawti taoziezy cha ei bâhsai haw.

Tahmâ cha thlalâ liata vivâh deita hmô pi ta, cha tita deikua cha hmiachhypa ta eima hmô ha aw. Tahmâ cha â ki leipa ta pahno na ta, cha tita deikua cha, Khazohpa ta eina pahno pakipa hawhna heta, â kipa ta ei pahno ha aw.
Ngiapâna zy, hnabeiseihna zy, kyhpachâna zy he khâ ama y thlâh ha aw. Cha miathôhzy hry liata a rônah chaipa cha kyhpachâna he a châ.
Kyhpachâna a chadai u la, thlahpa hmopiepazy khoh u la, biechho chakaona hmopiepa khoh pachai teh u.
Reihtheileipa ta bie a reihpa cha, chyhsazy hnohta a reihpa châ leipa ta, Khazohpa hnohta a reihpa tlao a châ. Ahy hmahta a reipa cha pahno thei veih ei, Thlahpa ta bienyupa a reihpa a châpa vâta.
Biechhotuhpa deikua cha, chyhsazy hnohta taopathina bie, pasyuna bie nata thlapalôhna biezy a reih tyh.
Reihtheileipa ta bie a reihpa cha, ano deita taopathi ta, biechhotuhpa deikua cha Awnanopa a taopathi.

Nama zydua ta reihtheileipa ta bie reih khai ha u la ei tah kaw, châhrasala biechho thei khai ha u la ei tah pachai. Reihtheileipa cha Awnanopa thapatlô nawpa ta chhopasiatuhpa ama y leipa khiahta cha, biechhotuhpa cha reihtheileipa ta bie a reihpa hlâta a rônah via.

Tahmâ he unawh saih u, reihtheileipa ta bie reipa ta nama hnohta a vy aw sah la, aluahna tlyma, pahnona tlyma, biechhona tlyma, pachuna bie tlyma, nama hnohta reih tlôh leipa aw sah la, kheihta eina phahnaikhei thei aw ei chi?
Hrona hnei leipa hmozy chhao he, siaramo tlyma, totâ tlyma, ao chybia hneipa ta a paro leipa khiahta cha, khâpa hla ma ama pasasa tahpa kheihta chyhsa ta a pahno thei aw?
Chiahmie chhao he chybia hnei leipa ta a paro khiahta cha, ahy ma a dyuh awpa ta a mâ aw?
Cha hawhna chata nâmo chhao, pahno thei leipa bie nama paleih ta nama reih khiahta cha, kheihta ma nama bie reipa cha chyhsa ta a pahno thei aw? Aruapa liata bie a reihpa nama châ aw.
Khizaw liata reih nanopa chi hluhpi y ta, yzie a hnei leipa reih y tlâ vei.
Châhrasala a reih yzie ei pahno tlôh leipa khiahta cha, cha reih a cheihpa châta kei cha chihropa châ aw na ta, ano chhao kei châta chihropa a châ aw.
Cha hawha chara nâmo chhao Thlahpa hmopiepa to awpa nama tlaichhai kawpazy cha, Awnanopa thapatlô nawpa ta tlaichhai u la, tlua muh vy.
Chavâta reihtheileipa ta bie a reihpa ta a chhopasia thei nawpa ta thlahchhâ mawh sy.
Reihtheileipa ta thlah ei chhâ khiahta cha, ei thlahpa cha thlahchhâ tlai ta, ei palôh deikua cha hmâh va na.
Kheihta a châ aw tly? Thlahpa ta thlahchhâ aw na ta, ei palôh chhao ta ei chhâ aw. Thlahpa ta hla sa aw na ta, ei palôh chhao ta ei sa aw.
Na thlahpa ta alyna bie na reih khiahta cha, reihtheileipa hmopiepa a to leipa ta na biereipa pahno leipa aw ta, kheihta ma alyna bie na reipa cha “Amen” a tah thei aw?
Nâ la alyna bie na reih pha kaw ngyu ma, mohropa deikua taopathi hlei vei.
Nâmo zydua hlâta reihtheileipa ta bie ei reih hluh viapa vâta Khazohpa hnohta alyna bie ei reih.
Chtahrasala Awnanopa pakhyna liata la, reihtheileipa ta biesâ thy kha reipa hlâta, mohropazy ei pachu thei nawpa ei ta, reih theipa ta biesâ miapangawh reipa pha ei tah via.
Unawh saih u, hawti palôh phaoh khah u. Moleina kyh liata cha hawsaih hawhta châ u la, palôh lâta deikua cha pitlohpa ta y teh u.
Ryhpa châbu liata, “Reih hro a cheihpa phopi hmâh aw na ta, Chihropa hmaokah hmâpa ta, He phopi hnohta bie ei reih aw; Chatanachôta na nathlie hlei aw veih ei, Abeipa ta a tah,” tahpa ta ropa a châ.
Chavâta reihtheileipazy cha ngiapâtuhpazy châta ngiana châ leipa ta, ngiapâleipazy châta ngiana a châ. Biechhopa deikua cha, ngiapâleipazy châta ngiana châ leipa ta, ngiapâtuhpazy châta ngiana a châ.

Chavâta Awnanopa apakhyna liata, nama zydua ta reihtheileipa ta bie nama rei khiahta cha, khôtho chyhsazy tlyma, ngiapâleipazy tlyma a vaw ngia ei sala, palôh a ki leipa hawhta cha pachâ aw veih ei ma?
Nama zydua ta bie nama chho khiahta deikua cha, ngiapâleipa tlyma, khôtho chyhsa tlyma a vaw ngia sala, a thaileizie nama zydua ta nama palâsapa châ aw ta, nama zydua ta nama pasiapa a châ aw.
A palôh liata nyupazy palâsapa châ aw ta, â khu lâta pao aw ta, Khazohpa a chhypa ta, Khazohpa cha nama hry liata a y hmeiseih tlai tahpa ta a phuah aw.

Cha khiahta la unawh saih u, kheihta a châ aw? Namâ pakhy nahta, chyhsa to ta hla, pachuna bie, aluahna, reihtheileipa nata a chhopasiana zy nama hnei chyu. Hmo to zydua he taopathina châta châ khai mawh sy.
Reihtheileipa ta bie a reihpa ama y khiahta cha, pano tlyma, a hluh chai ta pathôh tlyma châ sala, pakha pakha ta reih ei sala, chhopasiatuhpa y mawh sy.
Chhopasiatuhpa ama y leipa khiahta cha, Awnanopa pakhyna liata cha, a thlih thlâh ha ei sala, âmo nata Khazohpa hnohta reih mawh ei sy.
Hrohsopa pano tlyma, pathôh tlyma ta bie reih ei sala, ama biereipa cha mohropazy ta pakhâta ta pachâ mawh ei sy.
Cha liata a tyuhpa pakha hnohta aluahna a vaw tlô khiahta cha, bie a reih tuapa cha a chalih mawh sy.
Chyhsa zydua ta a chu ei sala, thlahpalôhpa ta ama y thei nawpa ta, nama zydua ta bie reih thei khai ei chi ta, pakha pakha ta rei awpa a châ.
Hrohsopazy thlahpa cha hrohsopazy biehneina ry liata a y.
Khazohpa cha tymâna Khazohpa châ leipa ta, adyhna Khazohpa châ tlôh ta. Mopathaihpazy Awnanopa to liata taozie hawhta,
chanôzy cha Awnanopa pakhynazy liata a chalihpa ta y mawh ei sy. Bie rei pasaipa châ veih ei. Ryhpa ta a reipa hawhta, a ngiarihpa ta ama y awpa a châ.
A chu khohpa ama hnei khiahta cha, o lâta ama vahpazy ama hiahri awpa a châ. Chanô châta Awnanopa pakhyna liata bie reipa cha nozachhihpa châ tlôh ta.
Khazohpa bie cha nâmo tawhta a puapa ma a châ? A châ vei khiah, nâmo hnohta dei ma Khazohpa bie cha a vaw tlô?
Chyhsa ta hrohsopa hawhta tlyma, thlahpa chyhsa hawhta tlyma, â pachâ khiahta cha, nama hnohta bie ei ropazy he Abeipa biepiepa a châ tahpa pahno mawh sy.
Cha cha a pahno vei khiahta cha, ano chhao pahnopa châ aw vei.
Chavâta unawh saih u, bie chho awpa tlaichhai kaw u la, reihtheileipazy ta bie reipa chhao pakhâ khuh vy.
Châhrasala hmo to zachhihpa nata chybia hneipa ta taopa châ mawh sy.
Unawh saih u, thâtihpha cha chho ei na ta, a pyh ei chi ta, a pahniehna ta nama hmâpa thâtihpha kyh cha, cha chho chanei heih awpa ei ei khoh.
Bie ei cha chhopa ei kha, namâ ngiapâ thlâhthlipa châ leipa ta, khâchâ nama patu khiahta cha, cha liana chata pachha haipa ta nama y.
Hezy he bie peimawh chaipa ei daopa nâmo ei cha chho pachhuahpa ei kha a châ: Biehrai bie hawhta Krista cha eima moleina vâta thi ta,
pabupa ta y ta, Biehrai bie hawhta a noh thôhna noh ta pathyupa ta y ta,
Kephâ hnohta a luah ta, cha hnôhlâ ta pahrawh hleino hnohta a luah ta.
Cha khai tawhta unawh za pangawh hlâta hluh via hnohta ei kha tlai ta a luah ta, chazy hry liata thokha cha a mô ha hra ei sala, a hluh via syulyu cha ama hroh thlâh ha chy.
Cha khai tawhta Zâmie hnohta a luah ta, lyuhchâpa zydua hnohta â luah heih.
A chhâ chaina ta, a daihti leipa ta a pihpa keima hnohta chhao â luah.
Kei la lyuhchâpazy hry liata chyh chaipa châ na ta, Khazohpa Awnanopa ei taolapa vâta, lyuhchâpa ta bi tlâh chhao châ va na.
