Châhrasala Khazohpa ngiachhiena vâ deita ta, he ei châna he a to theipa ei châ. A ngiachhiena eina piepa cha hraoleipa châ vei. Cha dei châ leipa ta, lyuhchâpa zydua hlâta hriapasa via na ta, cha chhao cha keima hriapa châ leipa ta, Khazohpa ngiachhiena ei hnohta a ypa ta a hriapa tlao a châ.
Kei chhao, âmo chhao, thâtihpha cha chho pi ta, nâmo chhao ta thâtihpha cha namâ ngiapâ.
Krista cha athihpa hry tawhta pathyupa a châpa kyh phuahpa a châ tlôh khiahta cha, kheihtazieta nama hry liata thokha ta athihpa thyuheihna y vei nama tah thei?
Athihpa thyuheihna a y vei khiahta cha, Krista chhao pathyupa ta y aw vei.
Krista kha pathyupa ta a y vei khiahta cha, eima bie chhopa he hraoleipa châ aw ta, namâ ngiapâna chhao hraoleipa a châ aw.

Athihpazy thyuheihna y vei tahpa bie he, biedopa a châ khiahta cha, Khazohpa ta Krista a pathyu leipa tlai a pathyupa hawhta a duakheipa châ aw pi ta, Khazohpa kyh liata pahnokheituhpa pakheipa eima châ aw.
Athihpazy pathyupa ama châ vei khiahta cha, Krista chhao kha pathyupa châ aw vei.
Krista kha pathyupa a châ vei khiahta cha, namâ ngiapâna cha aruapa châ aw ta, nama moleinazy liata nama y thlâh ha chy tahna a châ.
Krista liata a môpazy ama leidia haw tahna a châ hra aw.
He hro chhôh châ deita ta Krista liata hnabeiseihna a hneipa eima châ khiahta cha, chyhsa zydua liata ngiachhie chhih chaipa eima châ aw.
Châhrasala Krista cha athihpazy hry tawhta pathyupa ta a y hmeiseihpa a châ, a môpazy thyuheihna hmia a sahtuhpa a vaw châ haw.
Chyhsapa vâta thina vaw y ta, chyhsapa vâ lilaw ta athihpa thyuheihna a vaw y.
Âdâh liata chyhsa zydua ama thipa hawhta, Krista liata chyhsa zydua pahropa ta ama y aw.
Châhrasala ama daihti chyu liata a châ aw. Krista cha thyuheihna hmia a sahtuhpa châ ta, â vy heihna liata Krista eihzy pathyupa ama châ aw.
Cha khai tawhta chhâna a vaw tlô aw. Cha tita Krista ta ryureina, biehneina nata hmotaotheina zydua pahnie khai aw ta, Paw Khazohpa hnohta khinarâh a hlâ aw.
A chariahpa zydua a phei ry liata a soh khai hlâlei Krista cha â bei chy aw.
Chariah hnôhchaipa pahnie awpa cha thina a châ,

Biehrai ta, “Khazohpa ta ato a phei ry liata a soh,” a tahpa hawhta. “A ry liata ato sopa a châ,” a tahpa heta, Krista ry liata ato a sohtuhpa Khazohpa cha Krista ry liata sopazy hry liata a hlao vei tahpa a palâsa.
A ry liata ato sopa a châ ti ta, Sawchapawpa tlai chhao cha, ano ry liata ato a sohtuhpa Khazohpa liata a ngiarih aw ta, chatanachata Khazohpa cha ato liata ato a châ ha aw.
Chata châ leipa sala, athihpa vyuhpa ta bâti châpa cha khâpa phahnaina a hnei aw? Athihpazy pathyupa ama châ chachei lei awpa khiahta cha, khazia chyhsazy ta âmo vyuhpa ta bâti ama châ tyh?
Khâpa vâta ma keimo chhao he dawh tato ta hro chichhihpa ta eima y tyh?
Unawh saih u, Krista Zisu eima Beipa liata ei châ palaikhei kaw ei. Chavâta ei reih aw, noh chareih ei thi tyh!

Chyhsapa lâ tawhta reipa ta la, Ephesi khih liata sahrâhpazy nata eimâ tupa kha, ei châta khâpa a phahnai aw? Athihpazy pathyupa ama châ vei khiahta cha, “Mylâ thi tlôh aw pi ta, Chavâta nie sih la, doh suh u.”
Dôpa ta y khah u. “Viasa moleipazy ta viasa nôchâ phapa ama parao tyh.”
Siana lâta a hra u la, molei khao khuh vy. Thokha cha Khazohpa pahnona rai hnei veih ei chi. Nama maophyuh nawpa ta he bie he ei reih.
Thokha ta, “Kheihta ma athihpazy cha pathyupa ama châ aw? Pôhpa kheihawhpa hneipa ta ma amâ vy aw?” nama tah thei ngyu aw.
Nâ, ahrupa! Chi na pabupa cha a thi tua leipa ta cha, pyuh aw vei.
Sâh chi nata chihropazy he, a kô pabu pâ leipa chi ta, a chi deita ta na pabu tyh.
Châhrasala Khazohpa ta ano khozie lymâ hawhta a kô pie ta, chi nanopazy ta kô nanopa ama hnei chyu.
Sapa zydua he sapa chi kha châ veih ei. Chyhsa sapa a nano ta, sahroh sapa a nano ta, pavaw sapa a nano ta, nga sapa chhao â nano.
Avâ hmozy nata alei hmozy y ei ta, châhrasala avâ hmozy rônahna cha a nano ta, alei hmozy rônahna chhao â nano.
Noh rônahna cha a nano ta, thlâpâ rônahna chhao â nano. Awhsizy rônahna a nano ta, awhsi nata awhsi chhao ama rônahna a lyu vei.
Athihpa thyuheihna chhao, cha hawhta a châ. Pabupa cha thu theipa châ ta, pathyupa cha thu thei leipa a châ.
Palyupalih leipa ta pabupa châ ta, rônahpa ta pathyupa a châ. Chiehleipa ta pabupa châ ta, hmotaotheipa ta pathyupa a châ.
Chyhsapa pôhpa ta pabupa châ ta, thlahpa pôhpa ta pathyupa a châ. Chyhsapa pôhpa a y khiahta cha, thlahpa pôhpa chhao a y aw.
Chavâta, “Chyhsa hmiatua chaipa Âdâh cha chyhsa hrohpa a vaw châ,” tahpa ta ropa a châ. Âdâh hnôhchaipa cha hrona pietuhpa thlahpa a vaw châ haw.
Châhrasala thlahpa lâ kyh y tua leipa ta, chyhsapa lâ kyh y tua ta, cha khai tawhta thlahpa lâ kyh cha a vaw ypa a châ.
Âdâh hmiatuapa cha alei tawhtapa châ ta, dohlei ta taopa a châ. Âdâh panona deikua cha vârâh tawhtapa a châ.
Dohlei ta taopa chyhsapa hawhna khata, lei chyhsazy cha châ ei ta; vârâh tawhta chyhsapa hawhna khata, vârâh chyhsazy cha ama châ.
Dohlei ta taopa chyhsapa lyuna eima hneipa hawhta, vârâh tawhta chyhsapa lyuna chhao eima hnei hra aw.
Unawh saih u, he bie he ei cha chho ei. Sapa nata thisaih heta Khazohpa khinarâh to thei leipa aw ta, thi theipa heta thi thei leipa to thei aw vei.
Nathlie teh u, bienyupa ei cha chho ei. Eima zydua ta a mô khai leipa aw pi ta, châhrasala pananopa ta eima y khai aw.
Chiahmie hnôhchaipa a paro tita, sôkha ta, movi hlâta pananopa ta eima y khai aw. Cha tita, athihpazy cha thi khao lei awpa ta pathyupa châ aw ei ta, keimo chhao pananopa ta eima y ha aw.
He thu theipa he thu leipa ta a tobi aw ta, thi theipa he thi thei leipa ta â tobi aw.
Thu theipa cha thu thei leipa ta a tobipa ta, thi theipa cha thi thei leipa ta â tobi tita, “Thina cha pahniena ta a palâ haw.
Hy thina, na pahniena cha khataih liata a y haw? Hy thina, na châmaih cha khataih liata a y haw?” tahpa bie kha a vaw tlô aw.
Thina châmaih cha moleina châ ta, moleina hmotaotheina cha ryhpa bie a châ.
Châhrasala eima Beipa Zisu Krista zawhzi ta pahniena miah pietuhpa Khazohpa cha reithaipa ta y mawh sy.

Chavâta unawh kho ngaitapazy saih u, â ipa ta a duah u la, papie thei lei awpa ta a pachyu teh u. Nama hriapasana cha Abeipa liata hraoleipa châ vei tahpa pahnopa ta, Abeipa raihria cha phahnai ngiah ngaitapa ta hria lymâ teh u.
Mopathaihpazy châta thyuna kyh kha he hawhta a châ. Kalatia râh Awnanopazy hnohta bie ei piepa hawhta, nâmo chhao vaw tao hra teh u.
Ei vy tita thyuna khei chhyhpa a châ lei nawpa ta, hâta noh hmiatuapa lia maihta, chyhsa to byhnâ nama topa lymâ hawhta thyuna sohpakhypa ta nama pachô lymâ aw.
Chatanachata ei vaw tlô tita, nama hmopiepazy cha Zerusale lâ phaoh awpa ta, chyhsa nama ngâpazy cha châ chhaota ei pasiesa aw ei.
Ei sie hra awpa a pha khiahta cha, sie aw na ta, eina zi aw ei.
Mâsidônia râh chahryh a chhuah na ta, Mâsidônia râh ei chahryh khai tawhta, nâmo ei cha vaw tly aw ei.
Ei khitlyna nata ei siena lâ maihta eina deichhy awpa ei chi ta, nama hnohta bohpi ei châh thlâh thei. Chasipaw chhôh zydua a châ thei ngyu aw.
Tahmâ ei sie pâ ta châ hmô awpa ei cha pha tah va na. Abeipa ta a pasaih khiahta cha, nama hnohta khachâ rakha ma y awpa ei chhuah.
Châhrasala Pentikaws noh taih cha Ephesi khih liata ei vaw y chy aw.
Chakaona hlaotloh nawpa ta ei châta ochhi kawh ngaitapa â pahy. Dyuhtuhpazy chhao ama hluh ngaita.
Timawthy a vaw tlô tita, nama hry liata kâchhie leipa ta paysa muh vy. Kei hawhta Abeipa rai a hria haipa a châ.
Unawhzy chhaota kei lâ â vy awpa mokhâh na ta, a phapa ta a vaw tlô thei nawpa ta, a khitlyna liata vaw deichhy muh vy.
Eima unawhpa Apawlôsâ kyh liata cha, unawh hropazy chhaota nâmo lâ a vy awpa ta a haw na ta, châhrasala a vy awpa paryhsa mâh vei. Ryhpaohna daihti a hmô tita â vy aw.
A vaih u la, ngiapâna liata â ipata a duahpa ta, riahphapa ta y u la, thatlôpa ta y teh u.
Nama taopa maih kyhpachâna ta taopa châ mawh sy.
Unawh saih u, Stiphanasâ chhôhkhazy kha Akai râh liata Krizyhpa hmiatuapa châ ei ta, mopathaihpazy chakaona raihria liata â pie pasai ngaitapa ama châzie nama pahno.
Cha hawhpa chyhsazy liata a ngiarih awpa ta châ haw ei na ta, eima hrialâhpa zydua nata a hriapasapa zydua liata chhao a ngiarih awpa ta ei châ haw ei.
Stiphanasâ, Fawtunatâ nata Akaikâ zy amâ vypa he ei ly kaw. Nama y leipa chhao a hno leipa ta eina tao ei.
Ei thlahpa tha na patlô ei ta, nâmo thlahpa tha ama cha patlô hra. Cha hawhpa chyhsazy cha palyupalih teh u.
Asia râh Awnanopazy ta ama châ naoh. Akuilâ nata Priskilâ nata ama o liata Awnanopa a pakhypazy ta Abeipa liata palôh hmeiseihpa ta ama châ naoh.
Unawh zydua ta ama châ naoh. Nâmo chhao apahnâna pathaihpa ta a naoh raihrie teh u.
He anaohna he, kei, Pawla ta keima ku tlai ta ei ropa a châ.
Ahy rai Abeipa kyh a pachâ leipa cha chhiesapa ta y mawh sy. Mârânâthâ! Eima Beipa, a vy mah y!
Abeipa Zisu ngiachhiena nama hnohta y mawh sy.
Krista Zisu liata ei kyhpachâna he nama zydua hnohta y mawh sy. Amen.
Pawla, Khazohpa khozie ta Krista Zisu lyuhchâpa nata eima unawhpa Timawthy ta Kawrini khih liata Khazohpa Awnanopa nata Akai râh liata mopathaihpazy eima châ naoh.
Khazohpa eima Paw nata Abeipa Zisu Krista tawhta ngiachhiena nata thlalôhna nama hnohta y mawh sy.
Eima Beipa Zisu Krista Khazohpa nata Paw a châpa, zawngiahna Paw nata thlalôhna to Khazohpa cha reithaipa ta y mawh sy.

Ano cha eima riethei taona zydua liata thlah miah palôhtuhpa a châ. Chatanachata keimo chhao, Khazohpa ta thlah miah a palôhna cha hmâpa ta, rietheina kheihawhpa rai a taopazy thlah eima palôh thei hra aw.
Krista pasa taona hawhta eima tao hluh via nahta, Krista liata eima thlalôhna a pôh rili.

Pasataopa ta eima y khiahta cha, nâmo thlalôh nawpa nata pachha nawpa châ ta, thlahpalôhpa ta eima y khiahta cha, nâmo thlalôh nawpa a châ. Cha thlalôhna cha keimo pasa taopa hawhta palôh pasi ngaitapa ta pasa nama tao hrana liata nama hmô tyh.
Eima pasa taona miah hlykheipa nama châpa hawhta, eima thlalôhna chhao miah a hlykhei awpa nama châpa eima pahno. Chavâta nâmo châta eima hnabeiseihna â i ngaita.
Unawh saih u, Asia râh liata pasa eima taopa kyh kha nama pahno lei awpa khoh ma pi. Eima tao thei awpa hlâta a hri viapa ta miah vi ta, hro awpa chhao a ngâ khao ma pi.
Hmeiseihta la, thi awpa ta eimâ pachâ hapa a châ. Châhrasala keimo a ngâ leipa ta, athihpa pathyutuhpa Khazohpa eima ngâ thei nawpa ta, kha hmo kha a vaw ypa a châ.
Khazohpa ta thina chichhihpa tawhta miah pachha ha ta, miah pachha heih aw ta, miah a pachha lymâ aw tahpa eima hnabeiseihna ano liata eima pahnieh.
Chyhsa hluhpi thlahchhâna vâta byhnâ to pi ta, chyhsa hluhpi ta keimo vyuhpa ta alyna bie ama rei thei nawpa ta, thlahchhâ miah bao muh vy.

He he eimâ palaikhei: Khizaw sona ta châ leipa ta, Khazohpa ngiachhiena vâta, he khizaw liata nata nâmo liata pathaihna nata Khazohpa liata adona ta eima hro tyhpa kha, eima chhie na pha pahnona ta miah a pahnokhei.
Nama rei thai awpa nata nama pahno thai awpa dei leipa cha, bie hropa nâmo lâ vaw roh ma pi. Chavâta nama pahno thai khai aw tahpa ei hnabei a seih.
A rakhapa ta miah nama pahnopa kha, miah nama pahno pasia ha bâ. Chavâta eima Beipa Zisu noh liata miah a palaikhei aw ei chi ta, keimo chhao eima châ palaikhei hra aw.
Cha kyh liata ei sia thlâh hapa vâta, ngiachhiena a lie no ta nama to thei nawpa ta, nâmo lâ a vy tua awpa ei chhuah.
Mâsidônia lâ ei siena liata cha vaw tly pâ ta, Mâsidônia tawhta nâmo lâ vaw kua heih ta, nâmo ta Zudia lâ eina pathlie awpa ei chi ei chhuah.

Ei chhuahpa pananopa a châ no kha, ei palôh â i leizie a palâsapa ma ei châ? Chyhsapa lâ tawhta achhuahna tao ta, cha nota, “A châpa cha, a châpa” tah ta, “Â châ leipa cha, a châ leipa” a tah thlâhthlipa ma ei châ?
Khazohpa ngâ â chhihpa hawhta, nâmo lâta eima bie chhao, a châh ta “A châ” tah ta, a châh ta “Châ vei” tahpa hawhpa châ vei.
Kei nata Timawthy nata Silvanâ ta, nama hry liata eima phuahpa Khazohpa Sawchapawpa Zisu Krista kha, “A châ” nata “Châ vei” châ pakaoh vei. Ano liata cha khati no rai ta “A châ” tahpa a châ lymâ.
Khazohpa bietai zydua cha Krista liata, “A châ” tahpa ta â vaw ki khai haw. Chavâta ano moh ta nata ano rônah nawpa ta, Khazohpa lâ Amen eima tah tyh.
Krista liata nâmo nata hmaohkha ta miah a paduapa nata sathaw miah a thupa cha, Khazohpa ano tlai a châ.
Ano eih eima châpa miah ngiatuhpa chhao châ ta, bie ataihna châta a Thlahpa eima palôh liata miah pietuhpa a châ hra.
Nâ pahnokheituhpa châta Khazohpa ei aw. Nâmo cha patypamâ awpa ei khoh leipa vâta Kawrini khih lâ kha ei vy leipa a châ.
Namâ ngiapâna chô liata biehnei a chhuah leipa pi ta, namâ ngiapâna liata â ipa ta namâ duapa vâta, namâ ly nawpa ta eima cha hrialâhpa tlao a châ.
Palôh pasana a y heih awpa pachâpa ta, cha vaw tly khao lei awpa ei chhuahpa a châ.
Nâmo palôh ei cha pasasa ha khiah ei ta cha, ahy kei nâ palysa khao aw? Palôh ei pasasapa nâmo pyly cha nâ palysa awpa châ veih ei chi ma?
Ei vy tita, nâ palysa awpazy ta eina pasasa lei nawpa ei chi ta, kha châ kha ei ropa tlai a châ. Keima alyna cha nama zydua alyna a châ hra tahpa nama zydua ta ei cha ngâ ei.

Thlazoh ngaitapa nata palôh rietheipa nata mothlih hluhpi tlana chôta nama hnohta ei vaw ropa a châ. Nama palôh pasasa nawpa châ leipa ta, nama kyh ei cha pachâ ngaitanazie nama pahno thei nawpa ta ei ropa a châ.
Ahy rai pachârôhna a tlôkhei khiahta cha, keima pachâ eina parôhpa dei châ leipa ta, nama zydua pachârôhna a tlôkheituhpa a châ. Ei cha pasi tu leina awpa ei ta, cha bie cha ei reipa a châ.
Cha hawhpa chyhsa châna chata, chyhsa hluh via tawhta hriena â tyhpa cha â daih na.
Hrie via awpa hlâta cha, a ngiahthai u la, a thlah palôh teh u. Chataleipatala pachârôhna ta a vaosao pathlei aw na.
Chavâta a chô liata nama kyhpachâna pa-i awpa ta ei châ haw ei.
Cha kyh vâta châ kha ei cha vaw paphao ei, kyh to liata rei namâ ngiah nata ngiah lei ei cha pasia thei nawpa ei ta.
Namâ ngiahthaipa maih kei chhao ei ngiahthai hra aw. Ei ngiahthai khiahta cha, nâmo vâta Krista hmiakô liata ei ngiahthaipa a châ.
Chataleipatala Sâtâ ta miah a pahnie pathlei aw. Sâtâ hmochhuahpa pahno leipa ta y ma pi.
Krista thâtihpha chho awpa ta Tarôsa khih ei vaw tlô nona kha, Abeipa ta ochhi na pahypa ta.
Châhrasala ei unawhpa Titu ei hmô leipa vâta, ei thlahpa a chhôhmoh thei leipa ta, âmo cha reikah phapa ta a chhaih na ta, Mâsidônia râh lâ ei palâh haw.
Krista liata pahniena ta khâ miah a chhituhpa nata keimo hmâpa ta su to liata ano pahnona ropahâhpa a patheisatuhpa Khazohpa cha reithaipa ta y mawh sy.
Pachha haipazy nata leidia haipazy hry liata Khazohpa châta Krista ropahâhpa châ pi ta,
py kha châta thina tawhta thina lâ ropahâhpa châ pi ta, py hropa châta hrona tawhta hrona lâ ropahâhpa eima châ. Chazy châta ahy a tloh thei aw?
Chyhsa hluhpi ta Khazohpa bie he sôhpaliena ta ama hmâpa hawhta keimo la hmâh ma pi. Keimo la Khazohpa tuapa chyhsa ngâchhihpazy châ pi ta, Khazohpa mohmô ta Krista liata bie eima reih tyh.
Keimosasyh ta a reipapha eimâ thao heih aw ma? A châ vei khiah, thokha taozie hawhta, nâmo lâ tlyma, nâmo tawhta tlyma, pahnokheina châ eimâ ngiah ma?
Nâmo he keimo châta pahnokheina châ, chyhsa zydua pahno thei awpa nata rei thei awpa ta, eima palôh liata ropa châ cha nama châ.

Nâmo he Krista ta keimo miah a parosapa Krista châpaphaopa châ ei chi ta, châti ta ropa châ leipa ta, lôphia liata ropa châ hra leipa ta, Khazohpa hrohpa Thlahpa ta chyhsa palôh phiapa liata ropa nama châzie a siapa ta nama palâsa haw.
Cha hawhta Khazohpa ngâna cha Krista zawhzi ta eima hnei.
Keimo liata tlohna hnei leipa pi ta, keimo tawhta a puapa rei awpa khâpa hmah hnei ma pi. Eima tlohna cha Khazohpa tawhta a châ.
Khazohpa ta biehrai thiehpa chakaotuhpazy châ awpa ta miah patlohsa ta, ryhpa vâta châ leipa ta, Thlahpa vâta a châ. Ryhpa ta thie ta, Thlahpa deikua ta a pahro tyh.
Alô liata khiepa, thina a tlôkheipa châropa zâ phaohtuhpa Mawsi hmia hmahta kha tlatlu ta rônah sala, a lei thlâh ha awpa rônahna hmahta Izarei sawzy ta ama mo ngâh leipa khiahta cha,
Thlahpa chakaona chhochhi cha, rônah pachai aw vei ma?
Thailei pachâsana chakaona hmahta a rônah khiahta cha, thai pachâsana chakaona chhochhi cha, a rônah via syulyu awpa a châ.
Eikhano ta rônah kaw tyhpa chhao, ano hlâta rônah viapa a vaw tlô hapa vâta, tahmâ cha rônahna hnei khao vei.
Chhâna noh a tlô awpa hmahta rônahna chhaota â vy khiahta cha, y zôzaw awpa chhochhi cha khatlu ta ma a rônah via aw tly!
Cha hawhpa hnabeiseihna eima hneipa vâta, keimo la eima riah a pha ngaita.
Mawsi hawhta châ ma pi. Ano cha a hmia khaihpa a dia laihpa Izarei sawzy ta ama hmô lei nawpa ta, khuna ta a hmia â khu.
Châhrasala ama palôh kuh pachhasapa châ ta, tanoh taihta, biehrai parohpa ama rei nota, cha khuna cha pahypa châ vei. Khuna cha Krista vâ deita ta pahypa a châ.
Tanoh taihta, Mawsi châbu ama reina maihta, ama palôh cha khuna ta a khu thlâh ha chy.
Châhrasala chyhsa ta Abeipa lâ â heih nahta, khuna cha pahypa a châ tyh.
Abeipa cha Thlahpa châ ta, Abeipa Thlahpa yna maih liata khotalaina a y.

Chatanachata keimo hmia khu leipa ta a ypa zydua pi heta Abeipa rônahna cha palâsa pi ta, rônahna tawhta rônah via rilipa ta, Abeipa rônahna lyuna lâta pananopa ta eima y lymâ. Cha cha Abeipa tawhta eima hmôpa châ ta, Abeipa cha Thlahpa a châ.
Cha chakaona cha Khazohpa zawngiahna vâta eima hnei theipa a châpa vâta, eima palôh chhâ vei.

Noza chhihpa hmo arulâta tao tyhpazy pahlei pi ta, dôvei hmâh leipa pi ta, Khazohpa bie panano ma pi. Biehmeiseihpa lâhâh ta reih pi ta, Khazohpa mohmô ta chyhsa to chhie nata pha pahnona liata modypa ta eima y tyh.
Eima thâtihpha he khupa a châ khiahta cha, leidia haipazy châ dei ta khupa ta a y.
Krista cha Khazohpa a lyupa châ ta, a rônahna thâtihpha khaihpa ama hmô lei nawpa ta, he khizaw khazoh ta ngiapâleipazy palôh mo a pachao haw.
Keimo thâtih chho leipa pi ta, Zisu Krista cha Abeipa a châ tahpa chho pi ta, keimo chhao Zisu vâta nâmo châ chakaotuhpazy eima châpa eima chho tyh.
“Zohna tawhta khaihna vaw khaih mawh sy,” a tahtuhpa Khazohpa ta, Khazohpa rônahna pahnona khaihna cha miah pie awpa ta, Zisu Krista hmia liata eima palôh a pakhaihsa haw.
Châhrasala hmotaotheina rônah ngaitapa he, keimo tawhta a puapa châ leipa ta, Khazohpa eih a châpa eima palâsa thei nawpa ta, cha ryu cha alei beihzy liata eimâ vao.
Kyh to liata chaiepa ta y pi ta, châhrasala eima hu po vei. Nôpopa ta y pi ta, châhrasala eima hnabeidy vei.
Taolapa ta y pi ta, châhrasala siesaipa ta y ma pi. Chheipa ta y pi ta, châhrasala pahleipadiapa châ ma pi.
Zisu hrona eima pôhpazy liata â lâ thei nawpa ta, eima pôhpa liata Zisu thina cha eima phaoh lymâ.
Eima pôhpa thi theipa liana heta Zisu hrona â lâ thei nawpa ta, keimo ahrohpazy pi he Zisu vâta thina lâta hlâpa ta khâ eima y.
Chatanachata keimo liata thina ta rai hria ta, nâmo lia deikua cha hrona ta rai a hria tyh.
“A ngiapâ na ta, chavâta ei reih,” tahpa ropa hawhta, keimo chhao, cha ngiapâna thlahpa cha hneipa ta, a ngiapâ pi ta, chavâta eima reih.
Abeipa Zisu a pathyutuhpa ta keimo chhao Zisu hnohta miah pathyu hra aw ta, a hmiakô liata nâmo nata miah a paduasa khoh aw tahpa eima pahno.
Cha zydua cha nama pha nawpa châ ta, chatanachata ngiachhiena cha chyhsazy hry liata pôh via lymâ aw ta, Khazohpa rônah nawpa ta alyna bie reina chhao a pôh via rili aw.
Chavâta eima palôh chhâ vei. Eima khôtho lâ chyhsapa he rao lymâ hra sala, eima chhôh lâ chyhsapa cha noh chareih pathiehpa ta a y lymâ.
Bohpi leipa chhôh riethei chyhta eima taopa nata pakho thei rimâ lei awpa chhâzaw rônahna eima to awpa châta miah a pachhuahpanohpa a châ.
Hmô theipazy sai leipa ta, hmô thei leipazy tlao eima sai. Hmô theipazy cha buakha châta châ ta, hmo hmô thei leipazy deikua cha chhâzaw châta a châ.
Eima pahrâna lei byureih he phiepa châ hra sala, vârâh liata chhâzaw o eima hnei tahpa eima pahno. Cha o cha ku ta sa leipa, Khazohpa taopa a châ.
Vâ atobina ta a tobi awpa vâpa ta, he lei byureih liana heta eimâ rôh tyh.
Vâ atobina ta eimâ tobi ha khiahta cha, thluahruapa ta y aw ma pi.

He lei byureih liata eima y chhôh cha phaohripa ta eimâ rôh tyh. A tobi leipa ta y awpa eima khohpa vâta châ leipa ta, a tobi via awpa eima khohpa vâta tlao a châ. Chatanachata he thi theipa he hrona ta a palâ ha aw.
Cha châta miah pachhuapanohtuhpa cha Khazohpa châ ta, a bietai pa-i nawpa ta a Thlahpa miah a pie.
Chavâta riahphapa ta eima y tyh. Pôhpa o liata eima y chhôh deita he Abeipa tawhta eimâ hla chypa pahnopa ta,
hmô theipa ta sie leipa ta, ngiapâna ta eima sie.
Thlalôhpa ta eima y. Pôhpa o liata y leipa ta, eima y nawpa o liata Abeipa hnohta y awpa eima khoh via.
Chavâta pôhpa o liata eima y tlyma, y vei tlyma, ano palysa awpa eimâ chhuah tyh.
Chyhsa to ta pôhpa liata hmotaopazy, a chhiepa tlyma, a phapa tlyma, eima taopa hawhta eima hmô chyu thei nawpa ta, Krista ryureina dyuchhai hmiakô liata paluahsapa eima châ khai aw.

Chavâta Abeipa china phazie pahnopa ta, chyhsazy eima pasyu tyh. Kheihawhpa chyhsa ma eima châ tahpa Khazohpa ta pahno ta, nâmo chhao ta nama chhie nata pha pahnona hmâpa ta, miah nama pahno hra aw tahpa ei hnabei a seih.
Nâmo liata eimâ rei papha heihpa châ vei. Palôh liata a ypa châ leipa ta, chôpho alâna a palaikheipazy a chhy nawpa nata keimo miah namâ palaikhei thei nawpa ta, daihti rypaohpa eima cha piepa a châ.
Eima hru khiah, Khazohpa châta châ ta; eima so khiah, nâmo châta a châ.
Chyhsa zydua châta chyhsa pakha a thi khiahta cha, chyhsa zydua cha a thipa ama châ tahpa cha eima bietluna a châpa vâta, Krista kyhpachâna ta miah a tuah raruah.
Chyhsa zydua châta a thipa vâta, ahrohpazy cha âmo châta hroh khao leipa ta, âmo châta thi ta a thyu heihpa châta ama hroh awpa a châ.
Chavâta tahmâ tawhta la, chyhsapa mo ta ahy hmah moh khao ma pi. Chyhsapa mo ta Krista kha vaw moh ha hra sih la, tahmâ cha cha hawhta moh khao ma pi.
Chavâta ahy rai Krista liata a ypa cha hmotao thiehpa a châ. Hmo parohpazy lei ha ta, moh teh u, athiehpa a vaw châ haw.
Cha zydua cha Khazohpa tawhta a puapa a châ. Krista vâta Khazohpa ta ano nata a ryhpa ta miah tao ta, aryhna chakaona raihria miah a pie.
Krista liana chata Khazohpa ta khizaw he ano nata a ryhpa ta tao ta, ama paraonazy cha paraona ta rao khao vei. Cha aryhna bie chho awpa cha keimo liata a pahnieh.
Chavâta Krista lyuhchâpazy châ pi ta, Khazohpa ta keimo miah hmâpa ta a châ haw ei. Khazohpa nata a ryhpa ta y awpa ta, Krista vyuhpa ta eima châ haw.
Krista zawhzi ta Khazohpa siana eimâ hly thei nawpa ta, moleina rai a hnei leipa cha, Khazohpa ta keimo vâta moleipa ta a tao.
Khazohpa ngiachhiena cha hraoleipa nama pachâsa lei nawpa ta, Khazohpa hrialâhpazy ta eima châ haw.
Khazohpa ta, “Daihti rypaohpa liata cha nathlie na ta, Pachhana noh liata ei cha bao,” a tah. Pachâ teh u, tahmâ he daihti rypaohpa cha châ ta, tahmâ he pachhana noh cha a châ.
Eima chakaona raihria he seipa ta a y lei nawpa ta, ahy lâpi lia hmahta achapiana lô soh ma pi.
Khazohpa chakaotuhpazy eima châpa hawhta, kyh to liata chyhsa modypa ta eima y. Thata pasa taona liata zy, riethei taona liata zy, rairuna liata zy, pachârôhna liata zy;
chheina liata zy, patâhna liata zy, tymâna liata zy, hriapasana liata zy, mokuh saihna liata zy, nodina liata zy;
hro pathaihna liata zy, pahnona liata zy, daotheina liata zy, nôphana liata zy, Thlahpa Pathaihpa liata zy, kyhpachâna hmeiseihpa liata zy;
bie hmeiseihpa reina liata zy, Khazohpa hmotaotheina liata zy, chachâh lâ nata chavei lâta siana chaihrai chabana liata zy;
rônahna nata nozana liata zy, reipachhiena nata reithaina liata zy, modypa ta eima y tyh. Chyhsa dopa châ pi ta, châhrasala chyhsa dôvei thaipa hawhta miah ama pachâ.
Pahno khi leipa ta pachâpa châ pi ta, châhrasala chyhsa to pahnopa eima châ. Thi awpa ta pachâpa châ pi ta, châhrasala moh tua u, eima hro thlâh ha hih. Hriepa châ pi ta, châhrasala thiepa châ ma pi.

Pachârôh awpa ta pachâpa châ pi ta, châhrasala khâ eimâ ly. Dyhchhiepa hawhta pachâpa châ pi ta, châhrasala chyhsa hluhpi a pahneirôhsapa eima châ. Khâpa hmah a hnei leipa hawhta pachâpa châ pi ta, châhrasala ato eima hnei.
Hy Kawrini mo saih u, khotalaipa nata palôh pahy khaipa ta nama hnohta bie eima reih.
Keimo la nâmo liata khâpa hmah phih ma pi, nâmo deikua cha keimo châta a pahy veih ei chi.
Sawzy hnohta bie reipa hawhta nama hnohta ei reih. Nâmo chhao miah nama deichhy thei hra nawpa ta, nama palôh zy a pahy via teh u.
Ngiapâleipazy nata raopaky a ky khoh khuh vy. Siana nata moleina ta khâpa a hly theipa ama hnei? Khaihna nata zohna ta khâpa akaona ama hnei?
Krista nata ahripa ta khâpa aryhna ama hnei? Ngiapâtuhpa nata ngiapâleipa ta khâpa to khohpa ama hnei?

Khazohpa Achhyna o nata nothlahpazy ta khâpa aryhna ama hnei? Keimo he Khazohpa hrohpa Achhyna o cha eima châ, Khazohpa ta, “Ama hry liata pahrâ aw na ta, Ama hnohta ei charei aw; Ama Khazohpa châ aw na ta, Ei phopi ama châ aw,” a tahpa hawhna khata.
“Chavâta ama hry tawhta pua u la, Â nano ta y teh u, Abeipa ta a tah. Hmo pathaih leipa hria khuh vy, Chatanachata ei châ ly aw ei;
Nama paw châ aw na ta, Ei sawchapawzy nata ei sawchanôzy nama châ aw, Abeipa Atotaotheipa ta a tah,” a tahpa hawhna khata.
Kyhpachâ ngaitapa saih u, cha bietaizy cha eima hneipa vâta, pôhpa nata thlahpa a papuapaleipa zydua tawhta a pathai sih la, Khazohpa chipa ta pathaih pakipa ta y suh u.
Nama palôh liata su miah pie teh u. Ahy pei hmah hria leipa pi ta, ahy hmah parao leipa pi ta, ahy hmah dôvei beih ma pi.
Cha bie cha nâmo thailei pachâsa nawpa ta ei reipa châ vei. Thi khiah thi khoh, hro khiah hroh khoh tah awpa ta, eima palôh liata khâ nama ypa kyh cha, kha hlâta ei reih haw.
Nâmo hnohta la, riahpha kawpa ta bie ei reih ngâh. Châ palaikhei ngaita ei na ta, thlalôhna ta ei bie. Eima riethei taona zydua liata alyna ta ei khô pathlah.
Mâsidônia râh eima vaw tlô nota, eima pôhpa a pahâ beih leipa ta, su to liata riethei pataosapa ta eima y. Khôtho lâta miah a dyuh ei ta, chhôh lâta china ta miah a khu.
Châhrasala palôh rietheipazy thlapalôhtuhpa Khazohpa ta Titu vaw tuah ta, thlah miah a palôh haw.

Titu vaw tlôpa vâ dei châ vei. Ano thlah nama palôhpa cha keimo thlah miah a palôhpa nama châ hra. Na vâ ngaita ei chi ta, riethei ei taona liata na taokhei ei chi ta, ei châta phahnai namâ ngiahzie zy miah chho ta, eina palysa via pachai.
Ei châpaphaopa vâta nama pachâ ei cha parôhsa ei tahpa vaw pahno na ta, buakha chhôh pachârôhna a châpa chhao ta, ei ngiapachhi kaw. Châhrasala a ngiapachhi khao va na.
Tahmâ la ei ly kaw, pachâ parôhsapa ta nama ypa vâta châ leipa ta, ro awpa ta pachâ parôhsapa vâta a châ. Khazohpa liata pachârôhna namâ tyhpa châ ta, keimo vâta khâpa hmah pahlei veih ei chi.
Khazohpa liata pachârôhna cha, pachha châ nawpa ta rona tlôkhei ta, angiapachhina y vei. Khizaw pachârôhna deikua cha, thina a tlôkhei tyh.

Khazohpa liata nama pachârôhna ta nâmo liata a sa papuapa hmozy he moh tua u. Phahnai ngiahna, reipasipasua hlao lei awpa khona, adona hrokhei khohna, Khazohpa china, mopathaihpazy vâna, khopasana nata ryureina dopa hmô khohna zy nâmo liata a sa papua. He kyh liata kao to liata nama pathaihzie nâmo tlai ta nama palâsa haw.

Chavâta nama hnohta châpaphaopa vaw roh hraw sah la, moleina hmo a taotuhpa vâta roh leipa na ta, moleina pasa a taotuhpa vâta roh hra va na. Keimo châta phahnai namâ ngiahzie Khazohpa mohmô ta nama hnohta palâsapa ta a y thei nawpa ta ei roh.
Chavâta thlalôhpa ta eima y. Keimo thlalôhpa dei châ vei. Nâmo vâta Titu thlahpa cha pathiehpa ta a ypa vâta, Titu alyna liata eimâ ly pachai.

Ei châ palaikheina ei a hnohta reih tyh na ta, maophyuhpa ta y va na. Nama hnohta bie eima rei tyhpa zydua kha, biedopa a châpa hawhta, Titu hmiakô liata nâmo eima châ palaikheina chhao kha biedopa a châ.
Nama zydua ta reingiah ngaitapa châ ei chi ta, china nata chalyuna chôta namâ vaw lyzie â thei thlâh hapa vâta, a cha tlaichhaina ei a pôh via lymâ.
Kyh to liata tlokhuh ta ei ngâpa nama châpa vâta ei ly ngaita.
Unawh saih u, Mâsidônia Awnanopazy hry liata Khazohpa ngiachhiena ama topa kyh nama pahno awpa eima khoh.
Rietheina hluhpi ta pasiapa ama châpa chhao ta, amâ lyna khô pathlah ta; dyhchhie kawpa ta ama ypa chhao ta, amâ pasaina a bie pakhô.
Ama hneina nata â phuhpa ta pie ei ta, âmo khotlyna tlai ta, ama hneina khô lâ taihta ama pie tahpa ei pahnokhei ei.
Mopathaihpazy deichhy chakaona rai liata a hlao hra awpa ta thata miah amâ haw.
Cha chhao cha eima pangiasa leipa hawhta ama tao. Abeipa liata âmosasyh a hlâ tua ei ta, cha khai tawhta, Khazohpa khozie hawhta keimo liata miah amâ ngiarih.
Chatanachata ngiachhie chakaona sôh thyuna nama hry liata a vaw pathao hapa kha, patlô awpa ta Titu eimâ haw.

Kyh to liata nama tao pha ngaita. Ngiapâna, bie rei thaina, pahnona nata phahnai ngiahna zy liata tao pha kaw ei chi ta, kyh miah nama pachâna zy liata chhao nama tao pha ngaita. Hmopiepa ta ngiachhie chakaona raihria liata chhao tao pha a chhuah teh u.
Biepiepa hawhta reih leipa na ta, mohropazy phahnai ngiahna cha pahnosa ta, nâmo chhao kyhpachâna hmeiseihpa nama hneipa pasia nawpa ta ei reih.
Eima Beipa Zisu Krista ngiachhiena cha, ano dyhchhiena vâta nâmo nama hneirôh thei nawpa ta, hneirôhpa a châpa chhao ta nâmo vâta dyhchhiepa ta â taona liata nama pahno.
He kyh liata nama châta pha awpa ei pahnopa cha he he a châ: Zâkô liata he chakaona rai a hria tua chaipa nama châpa dei châ leipa ta, chakao khohna a hnei tua chaipa nama châ.
Nama chakaona patlô teh u. Chatanachata chakao khohna nâmo liata a ypa cha, nama hneina nata â phuhpa ta nama piena liata â lâ aw.
Pie khohna a y khiahta cha, chyhsa ta a hnei leipa châ leipa ta, a hneipa nata â phuhpa ta a piepa cha a pyh tlâh a châ.
Mohropa tha padâh ta, nâmo phao cha pahri awpa ei chhuahpa châ vei. A deichhy raihrie awpa khona vâta a châ.
Tahmâ he nama hneina ta amâ ngiahna deichhy aw ta, ama hneina ta namâ ngiahna a deichhy hra aw. Chatanachata a deichhy raihriepa a châ aw,
“A hluhpi a huahpa ta laibâhpa hnei leipa ta, a chyhta a huahpa ta a phahla hlei vei,” tahpa ropa hawhna khata.
Kei ta nama châta phahnai ei ngiahpa hawhta, Titu liata phahnai ngiahna a pahneisatuhpa Khazohpa cha reithaipa ta y mawh sy.
Eimâ hawna â pyhpa dei châ leipa ta, ano phahnai ngiahna nata khotlyna tlai ta nâmo lâ â vy.
A hnohta unawh pakha eima vaw tuah. Ano cha thâtihpha chhona kyh liata Awnanopa zydua ta ama reithaipa a châ.
Cha dei châ vei, Abeipa rônah nawpa nata saiheina eima hneipazy palâsa awpa ta, ngiachhie chakaona rai eima hriana liata miah sielâh awpa ta, ano cha Awnanopazy ta ama raopa a châ.
Riapha ngaitapa ta hmopiepazy eima mohôhna kyh liata seina a y lei nawpa ta, he hawhta eima taopa a châ.
Abeipa mohmô lia dei châ leipa ta, chyhsa mohmô liata chhao adona palâsa eimâ chhuah.

Ama hnohta eima unawhpa eima vaw pasiesa. Ano cha ei hluhpi pasia pi ta, kyh hluhpi liata phahnai a ngiah ngaitapa chyhsa châ ta, tahmâ chhochhi cha a cha ngâ kawpa vâ ei ta, nâmo lâ a vy awpa phahnai â ngiah pachai.
Titu cha nama pha nawpa ta ei kaolâhpa nata ei hrialâhpa a châ. Eima unawhzy cha Awnanopazy lyuhchâpa châ ei ta, Krista rônahna ama châ.
Chavâta he chyhsazy kyh nama pachâna cha, Awnanopazy hmiakô liata palâsa u la, eima châ palaikheina â dozie chhao, he chyhsazy chô liata vaw palâsa muh vy.
Mopathaihpazy châta chakaona kyh cha nama hnohta ei roh hluh awpa byuh vei.

Cha chakaona raihria châta a mâ chiehpa ta nama ypa pahno na ta, Akai râh cha zâkô tawh khata a mâh chiehpa ta ama y tahpa ta Mâsidônia mo hmiakô liata ei châ palaikhei kaw ei. Nama phahnai ngiahna ta chyhsa hluhpi palôh a pahra haw.
Cha kyh liata eima châ palaikheina cha aruapa châ leipa sala, ei reipa hawhta namâ chhuanoh thei nawpa ta, unawhzy he nâmo lâ ei vaw tuah.
Chataleipatala Mâsidônia mo ta na vaw zi ei sala, namâ mâ leipa ama cha hmô khiahta cha, eima cha ngâpa hawhta a châ leipa vâta, nâmo maophyuh leipa aw ei chi ta, keimo maophyuhna a châ aw.

Chavâta pie awpa namâ taihpazy kha pasia awpa ta, unawhzy he nâmo lâ pavysa chhielie a byuhpa ta ei pahno. Chatanachata tararuahna ta châ leipa ta, pasai ngaitapa ta piepa châ aw ta, a mâ chiehpa ta a y thei aw.
He he pahno teh u: A chyhta a tupa ta a chyhta hria aw ta, a hluhpi a tupa ta a hluhpi a hria aw.

Chyhsa to pasai leina chôta pie leipa ta, pie lei thei lei awpa hawhta pachâpa ta pie hra leipa ta, ama palôh ta amâ chhuahpa hawhta pie chyu mawh ei sy. Khazohpa ta a ly ngaitapa ta a pietuhpa kyh a pachâ.
Khazohpa ta ngiachhiena hluhpi nama chô liata vaohei thei ta, chatanachata khati no rai ta hmo to namâ ngiahpa hawhta hnei aw ei chi ta, raihria phapa hluhpi nama hria thei aw,
“A saipa ta rai ta, Dyhchhiepazy a pie ei; A siana cha chhâzaw ta a y,” tahpa ropa hawhta.
Chitutuhpa hnohta chi a pietuhpa nata nie awpa châta viahchhâ a pietuhpa ta nama tu awpa chi cha pie aw ei ta, chi cha papôhsa aw ta, nama siana thei hluhpi a patheisa aw.
Kyh to liata riaphapa nama châ thei nawpa ta, kao to liata pahneirôhsapa ta y aw ei chi ta, nama riaphana chata keimo hmâpa ta Khazohpa lâ alyna biereina a sa papua aw.
Cha deichhy chakaona raihria cha, mopathaihpazy phahlana pazaona dei châ leipa ta, Khazohpa lâta alyna biereina hluhpi a paysatuhpa a châ hra.
Cha chakaona cha, Krista thâtihpha namâ pyhpa vâta, Zerusale liata mopathaihpazy châta nata mohropazy châta riapha ngaitapa ta nama thyupa a châzie ama pahno tita, Khazohpa ama palyupalih aw.
Nama chô liata Khazohpa ngiachhiena rônahpa vâta, Zerusale liata mopathaihpazy ta cha vâ kaw aw ei ta, thlah ama chhâpa tyh aw.
A hmosaipiepa rei tiah leipa vâta Khazohpa hnohta alyna bie y mawh sy!
Kei, Pawla ta Krista nôphana nata nônaina ta ei châ haw ei. Nama hnohta ei y nota a reisi kaw tyh na ta, ei sie tawhta deikua cha, nama chô liata ei riah a pha kaw tyh.
Ei vy tita, he khizaw hrozie ta a hrohpa hawhta miah a pachâpa thokhazy chô liata riahpha awpa hawhta ei riah a pha thei awpa ei pangiasa leipa vâta, eina pachâ thai awpa ei chi ta ei châ haw ei.
Khizaw liata y hra sih la, khizaw adyuhna hawhta a dyuh ma pi.
Eima chariah chhaichhizy cha khizaw chariah chhaichhizy châ leipa ei ta, thokhy a i ngaitapazy parao nawpa ta Khazohpa hmotaotheina a châ.
Aeichhiana nata pachâna sâhpa hmâpa ta Khazohpa pahnona pakhâ achhuahnazy parao pi ta, pachâna to rai Krista reingiahna lâta eimâ chhi tyh.
Nama reingiahna pakipa a châ tita, reingiah leina zydua hrie awpa eimâ mâ thlâh haw.
Nama mohmô liata a ypazy kha moh tua u. Ahy rai Krista eih a châpa â lôh khiahta cha, ano Krista eih a châpa hawhta, keimo chhao Krista eih eima châzie pahno chanei heih mawh sy.
Nama rao nawpa châ leipa ta, nâmo taopathi nawpa ta Abeipa ta biehneina eina piepa he ei palaikhei pathlei hapa chhao ta, ei noza aw vei.
Ei châpaphaopazy ta nâmo pachhiparypa hawhta a lâ awpa khoh va na.
Thokha ta, “A châpaphaopazy a hri ta, a tha chhao tlô ta, a pôhpa deikua chiehleipa châ ta, a biereipa chhao khâpa hmah châ vei,” eina tah ei.
Nama hnohta eima y vei nota châropa ta eima reipa cha, nama hnohta eima y nota eima hmotaopa a châzie, cha hawhpa chyhsa chata pahno mawh sy.
Âmosasyh a rei paphapa thokhazy cha a rei pâ ngâh leipa pi ta, a pakho ngâh hra ma pi. Châhrasala a thlie raihrie ei ta, amâ pakho tyhpa deikua he cha, novâhna amâ phahlazie a palâsa.

Keimo la eima hriana su khô lâ a palaikhei aw ma pi. Khazohpa ta chakao nawpa su miah a piepa chhôh liata a ypa deita eimâ palaikhei aw. Nama hnohta thâtihpha cha chho awpa chhao he, Khazohpa ta miah a piepa a châ.
Keimo ta thâtihpha eima chho leina liata eima vaw pakawh laihpa châ vei. Keimo he thâtihpha chho awpa ta nâmo lâ a vaw tlô tua chaipa eima châ.
Eima hriana su khô lâta mohropazy hriapa a palaikhei beih ma pi. Namâ ngiapâna laiseih lymâ aw ta, nama hry liata eima chakaona chhao a kawh via lymâ aw tahpa hnabeiseihna tlao eima hnei.
Chatanachata mohropa chakaona su liata raihria chiehpa a palaikhei leipa ta, nama khô lâ râhzy liata thâtihpha eima chho thei aw.
“A palaipa maihta Abeipa a palaikhei mawh sy.”
Anosasyh a reipaphapa ta reithaina hlao hlei leipa ta, Abeipa ta a reipaphapa ta reithaina a hlao tyh.
Ei vaw hru pâ hapa chhao ta eina chhyh thai awpa ei chi ei khoh kaw. Rie na chhyh thai muh vy!
Vahpa pakha, Krista tlai cha, châ pahawhpa ei na ta, ano châta laihsa kôpa pathaihpa châ awpa ta a hnohta ei hlâ hapa nama châpa vâta, Khazohpa hiatliana ta ei hia ei cha tlia ei.
Parih ta piehpiepa ta Evâ a dôveipa hawhta, Krista châta nama ngâchhihna nata pathaihna tawhta nama palôhzy a chhi chheipa ta y pathlei lah ei chi tahpa ei chi kaw.

Ahy tlyma a vy sala, keimo eima cha chhopa Zisu a châ leipa, Zisu hropa kyh vaw reih sala tlyma; Thlahpa nama topa a châ leipa, thlahpa hropa kyh vaw reih sala tlyma; thâtihpha nama daopa a châ leipa, thâtihpha hropa kyh vaw reih sala tlyma, namâ pyh thlâh ha khiahta cha, a naopa ta dôvei theipa nama châ tahna a châ.
Lyuhchâpa laipa nama tahpazy hlâta nawh viapa hawhta a pachâ va na.
Bie reih thai vei hraw sah la, pahnona liata nawh hlei va na. Cha kyh cha hmo to nata kao to tawhta nama hnohta eima palâsa haw.
Thâtihpha a saipa ta cha chho ei na ta, palyupalihpa ta nama y thei nawpa ta, keimasasyh ta ei panawhpa cha, moleina hmo a taopa ei châ rai ma?
Nâmo chakao awpa ta, Awnanopa hropazy pahryuh na ta, âmo tawhta baona ei dao tyh.

Nama hnohta y na ta, ei phahla nota ahy phaohri hmah châ beih va na. Mâsidônia râh tawhta a vypa unawhzy ta ei phahlanazy liata eina deichhy lymâ ei. Nama phao cha pahri lei awpa a chhuah na ta, cha hawhta ei tao lymâ aw.
Krista biehmeihseihpa keima liata a ypa hawhta, cha ei palaikheina cha Akai râh liata ahy hmahta chalihsa thei aw veih ei.
Khâpa vâta maw? Kyh ei cha pachâ leipa vâ ei ta ma? Khazohpa ta a pahno!
Eima hriapa hawhta a hria hrapa ta a reih ei ta, ama chakaona a palaikhei kawpazy bie ei pachhai thei nawpa ta, ei tao tyhpa hawhta ei tao lymâ aw.
Cha hawhpa chyhsazy cha, chyhsa dôvei hmâhpa hriatuhpa, âmosasyh ta Krista lyuhchâpa ta â taopa, lyuhchâpa pakheipazy ama châ.
Cha cha noâhchhihpa châ vei, Sâtâ chhao ta khaihna vâlyuhchâpa hawhta anosasyh ta â tao tyh.
Chavâta Sâtâ chakaotuhpazy ta siana chakaotuhpazy hawhta âmosasyh amâ tao hrapa cha, noâhchhihpa châ vei. Ama chhâna cha ama hmotaopa hawhta a châ aw.
Ei rei heih aw, ahy hmahta ahrupa ta na rao khah ei sy. Eina rao hapa chhao ei chi ta, ahrupa hawhta na pachâ u la, a chyhta ei vaw palai pâ tua aw.
Ei bie reipa he Abeipa rei awpa chi la châ vei. Ahrupa hawhta apalaina bie ngâh buluhpa ta ei reih.
Chyhsa hluhpi ta ama sapa lâ kyh amâ palaikhei kawpa vâta, kei chhao ei vaw palaikhei hra tua aw.
Nâmo la asopa nama châpa vâta, ahrupazy chhao palôh pha kawpa ta nama chhyh thai!
Chyhsa ta sei ta cha tao ei sala, cha nie khai ha ei sala, cha tlybai ei sala, âmo hmia a pasah ei sala, nama hmia liata cha chabaih ei sala, nâmo la nama chhyh thei.
He kyh liata, keimo la eima chiehlei kaw, a phih va na, ei no chhao a za kaw. Châhrasala chyhsa ta â palaikhei ngâhpa maih cha, ahrupa bie rei ta reih aw sah la, kei chhao ta ei palaikhei ngâh hra.
Hebrai chyhsa ama châ ma? Kei chhao ei châ. Izarei chyhsa ama châ ma? Kei chhao ei châ. Abarahâ pathla ama châ ma? Kei chhao ei châ.

Krista chakaotuhpazy ama châ ma? Âmo hlâta ei châ via. Ahrupa bie rei ta reih aw sah la, âmo hlâta hriapasa via syulyu na ta, patâh hluh viapa châ na ta, a ei rei tiah lei ta chhei hluh viapa châ na ta, thi theina duahmo chhao ei tyh hluh via syulyu.
Zuzy ku liata chheina ei sypalih tloh nawpa ei kha byuhpa ta, cha hawhpa chheina cha ei pangawh tlai ei tyh.
Ei thôh sôsi ta chheipa châ na ta, ei kha alô ta vawhpa ei châ. Ei thôh balyh raona a tyh na ta, zâ kha nata noh kha tilaipi liata phao pahaipa ta ei y.

Ei hluhpi ei khitlynazy liata, chavahzy liata chichhihna, hraotuhpazy liata chichhihna, ei chiheihzy liata chichhihna, Zenitaizy liata chichhihna, khihpi liata chichhihna, khitaw liata chichhihna, tilaipi liata chichhihna nata unawh pakheipazy liata chichhihnazy ei tyh tyh.
Riethei rairunazy thata a tyh na ta, a mô leipa ta zâ hluhpi y na ta, nodi dâhphipa ta ei hluhpi y na ta, kâhvileipa ta y tyh na ta, chasipa nata thluahruapa ta ei hluhpi ei y.
Chazy nata hmo hropazy hleikhô ta, Awnanopa zydua pachâna ta noh chareih eina vi.
Ahy ma chiehleipa ta y ta, chiehleikheipa ta ei y vei tly? Ahy ma pahluasapa ta y ta, hiehâhkhei leipa ta ei y tly?
A palaikhei awpa ei châ khiahta cha, ei chiehleina a palâsatuhpa hmozy ei palaikhei aw.
Abeipa Zisu Krista châta Khazohpa nata Paw a châpa, chhâzaw ta reithaipa Khazohpa ta haipa bie ei rei leizie a pahno.
Dâmaskâ khih liata deikua cha, Bei Aretâ ry liata ryureituhpa ta na patu awpa ta Dâmaskâ khihpi cha pavaisa ta,
châhrasala thokhy opy tawhta hrâbyh ta na pathliah ei ta, a ku tawhta ei boh haw.
Ei palai via heih tua aw. Phahnaina y vei hra sala, Abeipa aluahna nata biephuahpa kyh ei reih tua aw.

Kô hrawh hleipalih a sie hapa liata, vârâh chhâh thôhna lâta a chhipa ta a ypa, Krista liata chyhsa pakha ei pahno. Pôhpa ta a chhipa ma a châ, pôhpa leipa ta ma, tahpa deikua pahno va na. Khazohpa ta a pahno.
Cha chyhsa cha pôhpa ta ma a y, pôhpa leipa ta ma, pahno va na, Khazohpa ta a pahno.
Pârâdi lâ a chhipa ta y ta, reipasia thai awpa a châ leipa bie, chyhsapa châta rei hraoh leipa biezy a thei tahpa ei pahno.
Cha hawhpa chyhsa cha ei palaikhei aw, kei deikua la, ei chiehleina tah leipa ta la, keimasasyh a palaikhei awpa hnei va na.

Keimasasyh a palaikhei khohpa rai châ aw sah la, biehmeiseihpa a reihpa ei châ awpa vâta, ahrupa châ aw va na. Châhrasala chyhsazy ta ei taopa nata ei reipa hlâta rônah viapa ta eina pachâ pathlei lei nawpa ei ta, keimasasyh a palaikhei lei awpa ei chhuah.

Aluahna rônah ngaitapa ei hmôpazy vâta ei palai tu pathlei lei nawpa ta, ei pôhpa liata ahloh piepa ei châ. Cha ahloh cha, ei palai tu pathlei lei nawpa ta, ei pôhpa liata pasana na pie awpa ta Sâtâ lyuhchâpa a châ.
Cha kyh liata, ahloh ta eina puasai thei nawpa ta ei thôh tlai Abeipa hiah na ta.

Châhrasala Abeipa ta, “Ei ngiachhiena na châta â daih na, ei hmotaotheina he chiehleina liata pakipa ta a y tyh,” eina tah haw. Chavâta Krista hmotaotheina ei chô liata a y thei nawpa ta, ei chiehleinazy he a ly ngaitapa ta ei palaikhei via lymâ aw.
Cha vâna tlai chata chiehleina liata zy, mohnaona liata zy, rietheina liata zy, taolana liata zy, nôpona liata zy palôhtlâh ei paoh tyh. Ei chiehleina daihti maihta thatlôpa ei châ tyh.

Ei hru ha hih! Nâmo ta einâ duakhei awpa ei chi châ taraw ta, châhrasala hru lei thei lei awpa ta eina tao ha ei chi. Khâpa hmah châ vei hraw sah la, lyuhchâpa laipa nama tahpazy hlâta nawh via tiarâh va na.
Lyuhchâpa hmeiseihpa châna â lâna, ngianazy nata hmonoâhpazy nata hmotaotheinazy taopa ta, tiama ngaitapa ta nama hry liata eima chakao tyh.
Khâpa kyh liata ma Awnanopa hropazy hlâta nama nawh via? Nama phao ei cha pahri leipa ei liata ma? Ei tao pado leipa khiahta cha, nâ ngiahthai teh u.

Pachâ tua u, tahmâ he nâmo lâ a vy awpa ei chhuahna a ei thôhna a châ. Nama phao cha pahri aw veih ei na. Nama hmo hneipa tlua a chhuah leipa na ta, nâmo tlao ei cha tlua ei. Sawzy ta nôpawzy châta ryu ama pachôpa awpa châ leipa ta, nôpawzy ta sawzy châta ryu ama pachô tyh.

Kei la a ly ngaitapa ta nama thlahpa châta ei hneinazy hmâh a chhuah na ta, ei pôhpa chhao nama thlahpa châta hmâh khai ei chhuah. Thata kyh cha pachâ ei na ta, a chyhta chhâ kyh na pachâ hra aw veih ei chi ma?
Nama phao ei cha pahri leipa kyh liata, chyhsa pasi nawpa tluapa ta, piehpiena ta hmo a taopa hawhta eina pachâ ei chi.
Nâmo lâ ei vaw tuapazy hry liata ahy tlyma hmâpa ta, nâmo tawhta athôhna ei tlua ma?

Namô lâ a vy awpa ta Titu a haw na ta, a hnohta unawh pakha vaw tuah na ta, Titu ta athôhna ta a cha hmâh ei ma? Palôh miakha phaopa ta a hria khohpa châ ma pi mâ? A nuapa miakha hneipa ta a sie khohpa châ ma pi mâ?
Eima thaichâna bie eima cha rei thlupa hawhta ma nama pachâ? Kho ngaitapa saih u, nâmo taopathi nawpa ta Khazohpa mohmô ta Krista liata bie eima reipa a châ.

Ei vy tita, ei pachâpa hawhta ei cha hmô lei awpa ei chi na ta, nâmo chhao ta nama pachâpa hawhta eina hmô lei awpa ei chi ei ngiaroh kaw. Ahryuna, hiatliana, hiehâhna, akhakhaina, areipachhiena, kyh reina, apasâhsana nata tymâna zy a y pathlei aw tahpa ei chi kaw.

Ei vy heih tita, ei Khazohpa ta nama hmiakô liata na panawh aw ta, pualeina, apatlana nata parâna moleinazy liata a vaw tlaih tyhpazy ama ro leipa vâta, ei palôh thata a pasa heih aw tahpa ei ngiaroh ngaita.
He he nâmo lâ ei vy ei thôhna awpa a châ. Leihna biezy cha pahnokheituhpa pano tlyma, pathôh tlyma bie ta pa-i awpa a châ.
Nâmo lâ ei vy ei nona liana khata zikyu ei châ râ ha ei. Tahmâ ei vy hlâta zikyu ei châ râ chanei ei. Ei vy heih tita, kha hlâta moleina a vaw taopazy nata mohropazy pahlôh aw veih ei na.
Keima hmâpa ta Krista ta bie a reih ma tahpa pasiana nama tluapa cha nama hmô aw. Ano cha nama chô liata hmotaona kyh liata chiehleipa châ vei. Hmotaothei ngaitapa ta nama hry liata a ypa a châ.

Chiehleipa ta khaipâpa châ ta, châhrasala Khazohpa hmotaotheina ta a hroh. Keimo chhao ano liata chiehleipa châ pi ta, châhrasala nâmo eima cha chakaopa vâna heta, Khazohpa hmotaotheina topa ta a hnohta eima hroh hra aw.

Ngiapâna liata nama y ma tahpa nâmosasyh ta a mohpasia u la, nâmosasyh ta a pasia teh u. Zisu Krista cha nâmo liata a y tahpa nâmo tlai ta pahno veih ei chi mâ? Pasiana liata a tloh leipa nama châ vei khiahta cha, nâmo ta nama pahno aw.
Keimo deikua cha pasiana tloh leipa ta y ma pi tahpa nama pahno na ta ei hnabei a seih.

Hmo nama parao lei nawpa ta Khazohpa lâ thlah eima cha chhâpa tyh. Pasiana liata a tlohpa hawhta keimo eimâ lâ thei nawpa châ vei. Keimo la a tloh leipa hawhta a lâ hra sih la, nâmo chhâ ta hmo dopa nama tao thei nawpa ta a châ.
Biehmeiseihpa a dyuhpa ta khâpa hmah tao thei ma pi. Biehmeiseihpa châ deita ta hmo to eima tao tyh.
Keimo eima chieh vei no chhao ta, nâmo thatlôpa ta nama ypa cha eimâ ly chaina a châ. Phapakipa ta nama y thei nawpa ta thlah eima chhâ lymâ.

Cha vâna chata nama hnohta ei y vei nota, he biezy he ei ropa a châ. Chatanachata ei vy tita, Abeipa ta biehneina eina piepa ei hmâna kyh liata, pasa kawpa ta hmâh leipa ta ei y thei aw. Parao nawpa châta châ leipa ta, padua nawpa châta Abeipa ta biehneina eina pie.

Achhâna ta, unawh saih u, a lypa ta y teh u. Phapaki a chhuah u la, thlah a palôh raihrie u la, palôh miakha phaohpa ta, adyryh kawpa ta y teh u. Kyhpachâna nata thlalôhna Khazohpa cha nama hnohta y mawh sy.
Apahnâna pathaihpa ta a naoh raihrie teh u.
Mopathaihpa zydua ta ama châ naoh.
Abeipa Zisu Krista ngiachhiena, Khazohpa kyhpachâna nata Thlahpa Pathaihpa akaona cha nama zydua hnohta y mawh sy.
Kei, lyuhchâpa Pawla, chyhsa tuapa châ leipa ta, chyhsa zawhzi ta châ hra leipa ta, Zisu Krista nata thina tawhta Zisu a pathyutuhpa Paw Khazohpa zawhzi ta lyuhchâpa rai a hriapa nata
ei hnohta unawh a ypa zydua ta Kalatia râh liata Awnanopazy eima châ naoh.
Eima Paw Khazohpa nata Abeipa Zisu Krista tawhta ngiachhiena nata thlalôhna nama hnohta y mawh sy.
Ano cha eima Khazohpa nata eima Paw khozie hawhta, tahmâhlâ khizaw moleina tawhta miah pachha awpa ta, eima moleinazy vyuhpa ta anosasyh â hlâpa a châ.
Khazohpa hnohta chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta rônahna y mawh sy! Amen.
Krista ngiachhiena zawhzi ta nâmo châ awtuhpa siesaipa ta, thâtihpha hropa lâta thlai nama tlei thlâhpa he, noâh ei tah ngaita!
Thâtihpha hropa y vei. Krista thâtihpha panano ta, cha patypamâ a chhuahpazy ama châ.
Keimo ta tlyma, vârâh tawhta vâlyuhchâpa tlyma ta eima cha chhopa nata a chakhiapa thâtihpha ama cha vaw chho khiahta cha, cha hawhpa chyhsa cha chhiesapa ta y mawh sy.
Eima rei hapa hawhna khata, tahmâ ei reih chanei heih aw: Nama vaw dao hapa thâtihpha chakhiapa ta, thâtihpha hropa châ vaw chhopa maih cha chhiesapa ta y mawh sy.
Tahmâ he chyhsa apykheina ma ei tlua, Khazohpa apykheina maw? Chyhsa palysa a chhuahpa ma ei châ? Chyhsa palysa ei chhuah khiahta la, Krista chakaotuhpa châ aw va na.
Unawh saih u, thâtihpha ei chhopa kha, chyhsapa thâtihpha châ vei tahpa nama pahno awpa ei khoh.
Chyhsa tawhta ei daopa thâtihpha châ leipa ta, eina pachupa ei thâtihpha châ hra vei, Zisu Krista aluahna ta ei daopa thâtihpha a châ.
Zuzy zyhna liata ei y nota ei hrozie nama pahno. Thachahra ta Khazohpa Awnanopa taola na ta, parao ei chhuah.
Zuzy zyhna kyh liata, ei chiheihzy hry liata ei richâhkha hluhpizy hlâta hmasie viapa châ na ta, nâ pathlatuhpazy taozietyhpa châta phahnai a ngiah ngaitapa ei châ.
Châhrasala Khazohpa ta ei nô chhi liata ei y no tawhta na vaw panano ha ta, a ngiachhiena vâta eina aw haw.
Zenitaizy hry liata a thâtihpha ei chho thei nawpa ta, Khazohpa ta a Sawchapawpa cha palôhtlâh ngaitapa ta kei liata a vaw paluahsa. Kha nona kha ahy hmah a saohiah veih ei na.
Kei hlâta lyuhchâpa a châ tuapazy a hmô awpa ta Zerusale lâ khy hra va na. Arabia râh lâ tlao sie na ta, Dâmaskâ khih lâ ei vaw lie heih.
Kô thôh khai tawhta, Kephâ a hmô awpa ta Zerusale lâ khy na ta, a hnohta noh hrawh hleipangawh châh na ta.
Abeipa unawhpa Zâmie dei leipa cha, lyuhchâpa hropa ahy hmah hmô va na.
Châ ei cha vaw paphaopa ei he haipa bie châ vei tahpa Khazohpa hmiakô liata bie ei taih.
Cha hnôhlâ ta Suria nata Silisia râhzy lâ sie na ta.
Krista liata a ypa Zudia râh Awnanopazy ta cha ei hmia chhao na pahno mâh veih ei.
“Miah a taola tyhpa khata, tahmâ cha parao â chhuah tyhpa ngiapâna bie tlao a chho haw,” tahpa ta chyhsazy reipa rakha dei ama thei.
Chatanachata keima vâta Khazohpa ama palyupalih thei haw.
Kô hrawh hleipalih a khô tawhta, Titu a chhipa ta, Bânabâ chhaota Zerusale lâ khy heih na ta.

Aluahna kyh vâta a khypa châ na ta, hraoleipa liata a vaw râpasuapa tlyma, a râpasua haipa tlyma ei châ lei nawpa ta, Zenitaizy hry liata thâtihpha tlâh ei awkhei tyhpa cha, nôpaw viapazy hnohta ano eih ta ei chho ei.
Ei hnohta a ypa Titu cha, Krikâh chyhsa châ hra sala, chopaw pataisa raruahpa châ vei.
Krista Zisu liata khotalaina eima hneipa mohparu awpa ta, unawh pakheipazy arulâta eima hry liata a vaw ngia ei ta, seichâna lâ miah a chhi awpa amâ chhuahpa vâta, chopawtaina kyh he a vaw ypa a châ.
Châhrasala thâtihpha biehmeiseihpa cha nama hnohta a y thlâh thei nawpa ta, buakha chhao âmo cha a ngiarih ma pi.
Chyhsa peimawhpa hawhta a lâpazy he, ama châna vâta kei liata ananona y hlei vei. Khazohpa cha khôtho lâ alânazie ta pachia vei. Chyhsa peimawhpa hawhta a lâpazy heta na phahnaikhei hlei veih ei.

Âlielâta tlao a châ. Chopawtaipazy hnohta thâtihpha chhona rai Pity hnohta pavaosapa a châpa hawhta, chopawtaileipazy hnohta thâtihpha chhona rai ei hnohta pavaosapa a châzie lyuhchâpazy ta ama pahno.
Chopawtaipazy lyuhchâpa Pity chakaona liata rai a hriapa Khazohpa ta, kei, Zenitaizy lyuhchâpa chakaona liata chhao a hria hra.

Ei hnohta piepa ngiachhiena cha, Awnanopa tôhtlâh ta pachâpa Zâmie nata Kephâ nata Zawhâna zy ta ama pahno nahta, âmo cha chopawtaipazy lâ sie aw ei ta, Bânabâ nata kei cha Zenitaizy lâ sie awpa ta akaona ku chachâh lâ miah ama hlâ.
Dyhchhiepazy a thei awpa deikua miah amâ haw. Cha hmo cha tao ei chhuah tyhpa tlai a châ.
Kephâ cha Antiôkâ khih lâ â vy nota, â doleipa ta a ypa vâta hmiadaisâ tlai ta ei chakhia.
Zâmie tawhta chyhsazy ama vaw tlô hlâta cha, Zenitaizy hnohta pati nie tyh ta, châhrasala ama vaw tlô nahta, chopawtaipa py a chipa vâta, ama hnohta a hlao khoh khao leipa ta â panano haw.
Zu chyhsa hropazy chhao ta ano hâ a lapa ta, phapakheipa ta y hra ei ta, Bânabâ chhao tlai cha ama phapakheina ta a paviasa haw.

Châhrasala ama hro cha thâtihpha biehmeiseihpa nata â hmie leipa ei hmô nahta, ama zydua hmiakô liata Kephâ hnohta, “Nâ, Zu chyhsa ta, Zuzy hrozie hawhta hro leipa ta, Zenitai hrozie hawhta na hro thlâh ha khiahta cha, kheihtazieta Zenitaizy cha Zuzy hawhta paysa raruah nâ chhuah?” tahpa ta ei chho.
Keimo cha Zu chyhsa ta a pihpa châ pi ta, Zenitai moleipazy châ ma pi.

Chatahrasala ryhpa hmotaopazy vâta chyhsa cha thaichâpa ta y leipa ta, Zisu Krista ngiapâna vâ deita ta thaichâpa ta a y, tahpa eima pahno. Chavâta keimo chhao, ryhpa hmotaopazy vâta châ leipa ta, Krista Zisu ngiapâna vâta thaichâpa ta eima y thei nawpa ta, Krista cha eimâ ngiapâ. Ryhpa hmotaopazy vâta ahy hmah thaichâpa ta y thei veih ei.
Châhrasala Krista liata thaichâpa ta y awpa eima chhuah nota, keimo chhao cha moleipazy vaw châ ha sih la, Krista cha moleina chakaotuhpa a châ tahna a châ aw ma? Châ bao va.
Ei phie hapa a sa pathituhpa ei châ khiahta cha, paraotuhpa ei châpa keimasasyh ta a palâsapa ei châ.
Khazohpa lâta ei hroh thei nawpa ta, kei la ryhpa vâta ryhpa liata ei thi haw.

Krista hnohta khaipâpa ta ei y. Châhrasala ei hroh. A hrohpa deikua cha kei châ khao va na, Krista cha kei liata tlao a hroh. Tahmâ pôhpa ta ei hropa he, kyh na pachâ ta, ei châta anosasyh â hlâtuhpa Khazohpa Sawchapawpa ngiapâna liata a hrohpa ei châ.
Khazohpa ngiachhiena cha hraolei pachâsa va na. Ryhpa liata thaichâna a y khiahta cha, Krista cha hraoleipa ta a thipa a châ aw.
Hy Kalatia mo ahrupa saih u! Ahy ma châ dyu ei? Nama mohmô lia tlai ta, Zisu Krista cha khaipâpa ta a ypa a siapa ta palâsapa a châ.
He deita he nâmo tawhta pahno awpa ei khoh: Ryhpa hmotaopazy vâta ma Thlahpa nama to, nama theipa namâ ngiapâpa vâta maw?
Khazia he tlu po ta nama hru tly? Thlahpa ta pathao ei chi ta, sapa ta ma nama pachhâ aw?
Hraoleipa hmo châ tlai sala, hraoleipa liata ma pasa hluhpi nama vaw tao?
Nama hnohta Thlahpa châ pietuhpa nata nama hry liata hmonoâhpa taotuhpa ta, ryhpa hmotaopazy vâta ma chazy cha a tao? Thei ei chi ta namâ ngiapâ vâta maw?
Abarahâ thâtih kha pachâ tua u, “Khazohpa a ngiapâ ta, cha ngiapâna cha a siana ta raopa a châ.”
Chavâta pahno teh u, ngiapâna liata a ypazy, chazy tlai cha Abarahâ sawzy ama châ.

Zenitaizy cha ngiapâna vâta Khazohpa ta thai a pachâsa aw ei tahpa Biehrai ta pahno chhielie ta, “Nâma liata phopi to byhnâ topa ta ama y aw,” tahpa ta Abarahâ hnohta thâtihpha a vaw chho chhielie hapa a châ.
Chavâta ngiapâna liata a ypazy cha, ngiapâpa chyhsa Abarahâ hnohta byhnâ patosapa ama châ.
Ryhpa hmotaopazy liata a pahniehpa zydua cha, chhiesana ry liata ama y, “Ryhpa châbu liata bie ropa zydua a tao leipa nata a zyh leipa maih cha chhiesapa ta y mawh sy,” tahpa ropa châ tlôh ta.
Khazohpa mohmô ta ahy hmah ryhpa vâta thaichâpa y veih ei, tahpa a siapa ta â lâ, “Mosiapa cha ngiapâna ta a hroh aw,” tahpa châ tlôh ta.
Ryhpa cha ngiapâna tawhta a puapa châ vei, “Ryhpa a zyhpa cha, ryhpa vâna chata a hroh aw,” tahpa tlao a châ.
“Tho liata bangiehpa maih cha chhiesapa ama châ,” tahpa ropa hawhta, Krista cha keimo châta chhiesapa ta y ta, ryhpa chhiesana tawhta miah a pachha haw.
Chatanachata Abarahâ châta byhnâ awna cha, Krista Zisu vâta Zenitaizy hnohta vaw tlô aw ta, Thlahpa taihpa cha ngiapâna ta eima hmô thei aw.
Unawh saih u, pamosa nawpa ta, chyhsapa taozie ei reih tua aw: Chyhsa taopa biehrai hmahta pa-i hapa cha, phie beih leipa ei ta, baichha beih hra veih ei.

Bietaizy cha Abarahâ nata a chipathla hnohta taopa a châ. “Chipathlazy hnohta,” tahpa ta chyhsa hluhpi hnohta bie hraipa châ leipa ta, “Na chipathla hnohta,” tahpa ta mopakha a nuapa ta biehraipa châ ta, cha cha Krista a châ.
Rei ei chhuahpa cha he he a châ: Biehrai taopa a châ tawhta kô 430 khô lâta a vaw ypa ryhpa heta, Khazohpa ta a vaw pa-i hapa biehrai kha parao leipa ta, bietai chhao aruapa pachâsa vei.
Ryuto râh cha ryhpa vâta topa a châ khiahta cha, bietai vâta topa châ aw vei. Châhrasala Khazohpa ta bie a taih ta, ryuto râh cha Abarahâ hnohta piepa a châ.
Cha khiahta la, khazia ryhpa he a y? Paraonazy vâta ryhpa he bietaizy liata baichhapa châ ta, bietai chipathla â vy hlâta hmâ awpa a châ. Cha cha vâlyuhchâpazy hmâpa ta lyuhchâpa ku ta pa-ipa a châ.
Lyuhchâpa a y khiahta cha, py kha vyuhpa dei ta lyuhchâna rai hria beih vei. Khazohpa deikua cha pakha a châ.
Cha khiahta la, ryhpa ta Khazohpa bietaizy a chakhia ma? Chakhia bao va! Hrona a pie theipa ryhpa piepa a châ khiahta cha, siana chhao cha ryhpa vâta a y thei aw.
Châhrasala Khazohpa bietai cha, Zisu Krista ngiapâna vâta, ngiapâtuhpazy hnohta piepa a châ thei nawpa ta, khizaw zydua he moleina liata a tâhpa a châzie Biehrai ta a phuah.
Ngiapâna a vaw tlô hlâta cha, ryhpa ry liata patâhpa châ pi ta, ngiapâna a vaw tlô haipa phualuahpa a châ hlâlei patâh chypa eima châ.
Chatanachata ngiapâna vâta thai eima châ thei nawpa ta, ryhpa cha Krista lâta miah chhithatuhpa a châ.
Tahmâ deikua, ngiapâna a vaw tlô hapa vâta, ryhpa chhihthana ry liata y khao ma pi.
Ngiapâna vâta, nama zydua ta Krista Zisu liata Khazohpa sawzy nama châ.
Krista liata bâti a châpazy cha, Krista ta a tobipazy nama châ.
Krista liata cha, Zu tlyma, Krikâh tlyma y leipa ta; sei tlyma, khotalaipa tlyma y hra leipa ta; chapaw tlyma, chanô tlyma y hra vei. Krista Zisu liata cha, nama zydua ta miakha nama châ.
Krista eih nama châ khiahta cha, Abarahâ pathla châ ei chi ta, bietai hawhta ryutotuhpazy nama châ.
Rei ei chhuahpa cha he he a châ: Ryutotuh awpa cha ato ano eih châ hra sala, hawti a châ chhôh cha sei nata a nano hlei vei.
A paw ta ryu a pie nawpa daihti a raopa a tlô hlâlei cha, vaituhpazy nata mohôhtuhpazy ry liata a y chypa a châ.
Cha hawhna chata keimo chhao, hawti eima châ nota cha, khizaw ryhpa ry liata sei ta eima y.
Châhrasala a daihti â vaw ki nahta, Khazohpa ta chanô sapa a Sawchapawpa, ryhpa ry liata a pihpa cha za tuah ta.
Sawchapawpa châna eima to thei nawpa ta, ryhpa ry liata a ypazy chatlai awpa ta a za tuah.
Sawchapaw nama châpa vâta Khazohpa ta a Sawchapawpa Thlahpa cha eima palôh chhôh liata za tuah ta, “Abba! Ei Paw!” tahpa ta a aw tyh.
Chavâta sei châ khao leipa chi ta, sawchapaw tlao na châ haw. Sawchapaw na châ khiahta cha, Krista zawhzi ta Khazohpa ryutotuhpa na châ.
Khazohpa nama pahno vei nona kha, ama pizie rai chhao ta khazoh a châ leipazy sei ta y ei chi ta.

Tahmâ cha Khazohpa nama pahno haw. Khazohpa ta a pahnopa nama châ haw tah awpa tlao a châ. Cha hawhta nama châ tawh hmâchhâh ta, kheihtazieta khizaw ryhpa chiehleipa nata phahnai leipa lâ nama kua thlâh heih tly? Ama sei ta y heih awpa ma nama tlaichhai?
Nohzy, thlazy, daihtizy nata kôzy nama chay tyh!
Nama châta thazâh ei pahryuh thlâhthli aw tahpa ei chi kaw.
Unawh saih u, nâmo hawhta ei ypa hawhna heta, nâmo chhao kei hawhta y awpa ta ei châ haw ei. Ei chô liata khâpa pei hmah hria veih ei chi.
Nama hnohta thâtihpha ei cha vaw chho tua no ei kha, sapa chiehleina vâta a châpa nama pahno.
Ei duahmo kha nâmo châta tymâna châ hra sala, na mohnao leipa ei chi ta, na pasi hra veih ei chi. Khazohpa vâlyuhchâpa hawhta tlao nâ ly ei chi ta, Krista Zisu hawh tlai ta einâ ly ei chi.
Namâ lyna zydua kha kheihta a châ khai haw? Tao theipa châ sala, nama mozy chhao taih thaopa ta eina pie khoh aw ei chi tahpa ei pahno.
Biedopa ei cha chhopa vâ ei ta, nama khakhaipa ei vaw châ ha ma?
Ama cha pahnie thei nawpa ta phahnai a ngiah ngaita ei ta, châhrasala achhuahna phapa châta châ vei. Âmo châta phahnai namâ ngiah thei nawpa ta, miah pachhaih awpa amâ chhuah chaipa a châ.
Achhuahna phapa châta la, nama hnohta ei y nota dei châ leipa ta, khatino rai ta phahnai a ngiahpa a pha.
Ei saw saih u, Krista lyuna nâmo liata a y hlâlei cha, saw zeih ta ei châ zeih ei hih!
Nâmo kyh liata ei nôpo ngaita ta, tahmâ chhao he nama hnohta y ta, ao ki pasâh awpa ei byuh kaw!
Ryhpa ry liata a y khohpa saih u, na chho teh u, ryhpa bie cha nathlie tyh vei ei chi ma?
Hetana heta ropa a châpa kha. Abarahâ ta sawchapaw pano hnei ta, pakha cha seichanô chô liata pih ta, pakha cha khotalaipa chanô chô liata a pihpa a châ.
Seichanô chô liata sawchapaw cha, sapa ryhpa hawhta pih ta, khotalaipa chanô chô liata sawchapaw deikua cha, bietai vâta a pihpa a châ.
Chazy cha pakhona a châ: Cha chanôzy cha biehrai miano châ ei ta, miakha cha Sinai tlâh tawhtapa châ ta, sei châ awpa ta saw satuhpa Hâkarâ a châ.
Hâkarâ cha Arabia râh liata Sinai Tlâh châ ta, a sawzy chhaota sei ta a ypa ama châpa vâta, tahmâno ta Zerusale vyuhpa ta a duahpa a châ.
Chô lâ Zerusale deikua cha, khotalaipa châ ta, ano cha keimo nô a châ,
“Nâ, saw leipa, Saw a sa beih leipa y, Thaphapa ta y mah y; Nâ, saw a zeih beih leipa, Awh la, rahao mah y! Vahpa a hneipa sawzy hlâta, Yrupa chanô sawzy ama hluh via aw,” tahpa ta ropa hawhta.
Chavâta unawh saih u, keimo cha Aisika hawhta, bietai sawzy eima châ.
Kha nota sapa ryhpa ta a pihpa ta Thlahpa ryhpa ta a pihpa a taolapa hawhna khata, tahmâ chhao he, cha hawhta a châ lymâ.
Biehrai ta kheihta a tah? “Seichanô nata a sawchapawpa kha papua teh, seichanô sawchapaw ta khotalaipa chanô sawchapaw ryu a tolâh awpa châ vei,” a tah.
Chavâta unawh saih u, keimo la seichanô chô liata sawzy châ leipa pi ta, khotalaipa chanô chô liata sawzy eima châ.
Khotalaipa ta y awpa ta Krista ta miah papua ha ta, chavâta â ipa ta a duah u la, sei raopaky a ky heih awpa ta a pasaih khao khuh vy.
Pachâ teh u, kei, Pawla heta ei cha chho ei. Chopawtaipa namâ pyh khiahta cha, Krista cha nama châta phahnaina hnei aw vei.
Ahy rai chopawtaipa a pyhpa maih cha, ryhpa bie zydua a zyh paki awpa a châ tahpa ei duakhei heih.
Nâmo, ryhpa ta thaichâ a chhuahpazy saih u, Krista nata a chhaih ha ei chi ta, ngiachhiena nama paosai haw.
Keimo deikua la, Thlahpa zawhzi ta, ngiapâna vâta siana to awpa hnabeiseihpa ta, a ngiatiah leipa ta eima hâ.
Krista Zisu liata la, chopawtaipa tlyma, chopawtaileipa tlyma, phahnaina hnei veih ei. Kyhpachâna ta rai a hriapa ngiapâna dei he a phahnai.
Arâpasuana liata namâ râ pha tyh thlâ bao na ta, biehmeiseihpa zyh lei awpa ta, ahyzy ma châ pakhâ ha ei tly?
Cha pasyuna cha nâmo châ awtuhpa tawhta châ vei.
Thinô chyhta ta viahdie zydua a pathyu tyh.
Saizie nanopa a pyh aw veih ei chi tahpa Abeipa liata ei lôh. Châ patypamâtuhpa cha, ahy rai châ sala, hriena â tyh aw.
Unawh saih u, kei he chopawtaipa aduakheina bie a chhopa cha vaw châ ha sah la, khazia taolapa ta ei y pyly? Cha hawhta châ sala, kraws vâta tymâna he a y lei awpa tlai.
Châ patypamâtuhpazy cha âmosasyh ta a chhawh pathlah lâlao ei sala ei khoh.
Unawh saih u, khotalaina hnei awpa ta awpa nama châ. Châhrasala nama khotalaina cha sapa ryhpaohna châta hmâh leipa u la, kyhpachâna ta tlao a chakao raihrie teh u.
“Nâma kyh nâ pachâpa hawhta, na vaih kyh na pachâ awpa a châ,” tahpa bie miakha liana heta ryhpa zydua â ki.
Nâmo nata nâmo a siepa ta, namâ nie khiahta deikua cha, a vaih teh u. Chataleipatala nâmo nata nâmo ta namâ pahleipadia pathlei aw.
Chavâta he bie he rei awpa ei khoh, Thlahpa liata y teh u. Chatanachata sapa aohraohna cha pipatlohsa aw veih ei chi.
Sapa khona ta Thlahpa a dyuh ta, Thlahpa khona ta sapa â dyuh. Nama tao khohpa hmozy nama tao thei lei nawpa ta, sapa nata Thlahpa cha amâ dyuh tyh.
Thlahpa chhihthapa ta nama y khiah deikua cha, ryhpa ry liata y veih ei chi.
Sapa hmotaopazy cha a lâ thlâh ha ta, hezy he a châ: Apatlana, palôh pathaih leina, parâna,
nothlahpa achhyna, dyuthaina, ahaona, ahryuna, hiatliana, pathichhiena, ateina, apananona, achhaihna,

uahvana, sahma parina, niedona nata cha hawhpa lâchhâh hmozy cha, sapa hmotaopazy a châ. Zikyu ei châ râ hapa hawhna ei khata, zikyu ei châ râ heih ei. Cha hawhpa hmo a taotuhpazy cha Khazohpa khinarâh to aw veih ei.
Thlahpa theilâpa deikua cha, kyhpachâna, thaphana, thlalôhna, daotheina, nôphana, phana, ngâchhihna,
areisina nata asohsina zy a châ. Thlahpa theilâpazy chakhianazie ta ryhpa biepiepa rai y vei.
Krista Zisu liata a ypazy ta sapa cha a aohraohna nata a khonazy chhaota ama khaipâ haw.
Thlahpa ta a hrohpa eima châ khiahta cha, Thlahpa liata y ei suh u.
Keimo nata keimo a pahao leipa ta, keimo nata keimo a uahva hra leipa ta, a pasâhsapa ta y khah suh u.

Unawh saih u, chyhsa ta moleina a tao hai nota pachhaipa a châ khiahta cha, nâmo, thlahpa chyhsazy ta nônai kawpa ta paduapathi heih teh u. A vaih teh u, chataleipatala nâmo chhao reipasaopa ta nama y pathlei aw.
Nama phaohrizy a phaokhei raihriepa ta, Krista ryhpa paki teh u.
Khâpa hmah châ tlôh leipa ta, chyhsa peimawhpa hawhta â pachâpa cha, anosasyh a dôveipa a châ.
Chyhsa to ama hmotaopa chyu mohpasia mawh ei sy. Chatanachata mohropa nata a pakho leipa ta, anosasyh a palaikhei nawpa chhâpa a hnei aw.
Chyhsa to ta âmo phao chyu phaoh tlôh aw ei ta.
Bie pachuna a daopa cha, hmo pha to a hmôpa tawhta a pachutuhpa pie hra mawh sy.
Dôpa ta y khah u. Khazohpa cha pasipasawh awpa rimâ châ vei. Chyhsa ta chi a tupa maih, cha tlai cha a hria aw.
Ano sapa châta chi a tupa cha, sapa thina thei hria aw ta; Thlahpa châta chi a tupa cha, chhâzaw hrona Thlahpa thei a hria aw.
Hmo pha tao ai khah ei suh u. Eima diathlâ leipa khiahta la, a daihtita liata a thei eima hria aw.
Chavâta rypaohna eima hneipa hawhta, chyhsa zydua chô liata hmopha tao sih la, ngiapâtuhpa chhôhkhazy chô liata tao pachai suh u.
Moh tua u, châhnawh laipa hmâpa ta, keima ku tlai ta nama hnohta ei vaw roh hih.
Sapa hmia pha châ khohpazy ta chopaw pataisa raruah ama châ chhuah tyh. Khâpa vâta hmah châ vei, Krista kraws vâta taola ama tao lei nawpa ta a taopa deita ama châ.
Chopawtaipazy chhao tlai ta ryhpa bie zyh tlôh leipa ei ta, nama pôhpa liata a palaikhei awpa ama hnei thei nawpa ta, chopaw cha pataisa awpa ama khohpa a châ.
Kei deikua la, eima Beipa Zisu Krista kraws dei leipa ta cha, a palaikhei awpa hropa hnei va na. Cha kraws liata khizaw he kei châta khaipâpa ta y ta, kei chhao khizaw châta khaipâpa ta ei y.
Chopawtaipa ta phahnaina hnei leipa ta, chopawtaileipa chhao phahnaina hnei hra vei. Taopathina deikua cha phahnaina a hnei.
Cha ryhpa a zyhpa zydua nata Khazohpa Izarei chô liata thlalôhna nata ngiachhiena y mawh sy.
Tahmâ tawhta la ahy hmahta na patypamâ khao khah sy, ei pôhpa liata Zisu eih ei châna ngianazy phaoh tlôh na ta.
Unawh saih u, Abeipa Zisu Krista ngiachhiena cha nama thlahpa hnohta y mawh sy. Amen.
Pawla, Khazohpa khozie hawhta Krista Zisu lyuhchâpa ta Ephesi khih liata mopathaihpazy nata Krista Zisu liata ngâchhihpazy ei châ naoh ei.
Khazohpa eima Paw nata Abeipa Zisu Krista tawhta ngiachhiena nata thlalôhna nama hnohta y mawh sy.
Khazohpa nata eima Beipa Zisu Krista Paw cha reithaipa ta y mawh sy. Ano chata avâ suzy liana khita Krista zawhzi ta thlahpa lâ byhnâ to miah pie ta.
A hmiakô liata pathaihpa nata seina hnei leipa ta eima y thei nawpa ta, leilô y hlâ tawhta Krista liata miah a tlyh ta. Kyhpachâna ta,
ano khozie nata â lyzie hawhta, Zisu Krista liata a sawzy ta tao awpa ta miah a vaw rao chhielie haw.
A ngiachhiena rônahzie reithai awpa ta, saw châna cha a Kyhpachâpa liata a saipa ta miah a pie.
A thisaih vâta ano liata chatlaina hnei pi ta, cha cha a ngiachhiena hneirôhzie lymâ hawhta, eima paraonazy angiahthaina a châ.
Cha ngiachhiena vâna chata sona nata novâhna to ta miah a vaohei.
A hmochhuahpa bienyupa cha, â chhuahpa hawh tlai ta Krista liata a vaw patlôsapa kyh miah a pahnosa haw.
Chatanachata daihti â ki tita, hmo to, avâ liata a ypa nata alei liata a ypa zydua, Krista liata syhpahmaoh khaipa a châ aw.
Keimo cha Khazohpa ryhraopa hawhta rao chhieliepazy châ pi ta, Krista liata Khazohpa ryutozy eima châ. Ano ta a khozie hawhta ryhrao ta, hmo to a tao.
Chatanachata keimo, Krista liata hnabeiseihna a hnei tuapazy pi he a rônahna reithaina eima châ thei aw.
Nâmo chhao, nama pachhana thâtihpha biehmeiseihpa thei ei chi ta, namâ ngiapâ ha tawhta cha, ano liana chata bietai Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta pa-ipa nama châ.
Ano cha Khazohpa rônahna reithai nawpa ta, Khazohpa ta a ryutozy a chatlai hlâ chhao ta, cha ryuto cha eima hmô tlai aw tahpa pa-ina sôhkâ a châ.
Cha vâna chata, Abeipa Zisu liata namâ ngiapâna nata mopathaihpa zydua chô liata nama kyhpachâna zy ei vaw thei nahta,
ei thlahchhânazy liata nama moh reipa ta, nâmo châta alyna bie rei bâh va na.
Krista nama pahno pasia thei nawpa ta, eima Beipa Zisu Krista Khazohpa, rônahna Paw ta sona nata aluahna Thlahpa a cha pie awpa ei ta thlah ei cha chhâpa ei.
Awpa nama châna liata hnabeiseihna pahnopa ta, mopathaihpazy châta a ryuto rônahpa hluhzie nama pahno thei nawpa ta, nama pathipalôh mozy pavâsapa a châ thei nawpa ta thlah ei cha chhâpa hra ei.
Chatanachata a thatlôna rônahpa raihriazie hawhta, keimo ngiapâtuhpazy chô liata a hmotaotheina rônah ngaitapa cha, khâpa ma a châ tahpa nama pahno thei aw.
Cha hmotaotheina cha athihpa hry tawhta Krista a pathyu nota nata avâ suzy liata a chachâh lâta a patyusa nota, Krista liata a hriatuhpa hmotaotheina a châ.
Cha hmotaotheina cha, abeina zydua, biehneina zydua, hmotaotheina zydua nata ryureina zydua chô lâta y ta, he khizaw lia dei châ leipa ta, khizaw vaw y awpa liata chhao, moh bipa to chô lâta a y aw.
Khazohpa ta hmo to zydua Krista phei ry liata soh ta, hmo to chô liata luh châ awpa ta, Krista cha Awnanopa hnohta a pie.
Awnanopa cha Krista pôhpa châ ta, ato pakituhpa pakina a châ.
Nâmo chhao paraona nata moleinazy vâta athipa nama châ.
He khizaw ryhpa hawhta y ei chi ta, avâ ruapa liata ryureituhpa bei, reingiah leipazy chô liata tahmâ chhao a hria haipa thlahpa cha pazipa ta, paraona nata moleinazy liata nama vaw tlaih tyh.

Keimo chhao eikhano cha, reingiah leipazy hry liata eima vaw y hra. Eima sapa aohraohnazy papitlohsapa ta, sapa nata palôh khopazy vaw tao tyh pi ta, chyhsa hropazy hawhta hiehâhna saw ta a vaw pihpa eima châ.
Châhrasala ngiachhiena a hnei hluhpa Khazohpa ta kyhpachâna rônahpa ta kyh miah pachâ ta,
eima paraonazy vâta athipa eima châ no tlai chhao ta, Krista hnohta miah a pahro haw. Ngiachhiena ta pachhapa nama châ.
Krista Zisu hnohta miah pathyu ta, avâ suzy liata ano hnohta miah a patyusa haw.
Chatanachata daihti vaw tlô awpazy liata, Krista liana chata Khazohpa ta eima chô liata a phana palâsa aw ta, panua tiah leipa a ngiachhiena hluhpi eima chô lia a palâsa aw.
Ngiachhiena vâta ngiapâna ta pachhapa nama châ. Cha chhao cha nâmo tawhta a puapa châ leipa ta, Khazohpa hmosaipiepa a châ.
Hmotaopa vâta châ vei, chataleipatala chyhsa ta â palaikhei pathlei aw na.
Hmo pha tao awpa ta, Khazohpa ta Krista Zisu liata miah a tao. Cha hmo pha tao awpa cha, eima chânazie awpa ta Khazohpa ta â vaw chhuanoh chhieliepa a châ.
Chavâta he he a thei thlâh ha teh u. Hlâno ta cha, nâmo, sapa liata Zenitaizy cha chopawtaipazy ta, “Chopawtaileipa” ama cha tah tyh. Chopawtaipa cha pôhpa liata ku ta taopa a châ.
Kha nona kha, Krista a hlao leipa ta y ei chi ta, Izarei râh nata a maniahpa ta, bietai biehraizy liata khichhaipa châpa ta, hnabeiseihna hnei leipa nata Khazohpa hnei leipa ta khizaw liata nama y.
Tahmâ Krista Zisu liata deikua cha, nâmo, eikhano ta lâhlapi ta a y tyhpazy kha, Krista thisaih ta pahniasapa ta nama y haw.
Ano cha eimâ ryhna châ ta, py nozy cha pôhkha ta miah taopa ta, akhakhaina nata apachhaihna pâhchhô cha a sapa ta parao ta,
ryhpa biepiepa nata bieraopazy pahlei ta, panozy cha ano liata chyhsa thiehpa pôhkha pachâsapa ta, aryhna a tao haw.
Kraws zawhzi ta panozy cha pôhpa miakha châpa ta, Khazohpa nata miah paryhsa ta, chatanachata akhakhaina cha a thie haw.
Krista â vy nona khata, nâmo, lâhlapi ta a ypazy hnohta aryhna bie cha chho ei ta, lâhnia liata a ypazy hnohta chhao a cha chho hra ei.
Ano siepahliepa ta Thlahpa miakha ta Paw a hnia theina eima py no ta eima hnei.
Chavâta tahmâ la khichhaipa nata khitlyhpa dei châ khao veih ei chi. Mopathaihpazy nata hmaohkha ta khinarâh sawzy châ ha ei chi ta, Khazohpa chhôhkhazy tlao nama châ haw.
Krista Zisu cha a ki liata alô peimawh chaipa châ ta, lyuhchâpazy nata hrohsopazy lôbôpa chô liata sapa nama châ.
Ano liana chata o sana lôzy paryhpa châ ta, Abeipa liata Achhyna o pathaihpa a vaw châ tyh.
Ano liana chata nâmo chhao Khazohpa pahrâ nawpa ta paryh pakhypa châ ei chi ta, cha liata Khazohpa cha Thlahpa ta a pahrâ.
Cha vâna chata kei, Pawla, nâmo Zenitaizy châta Krista Zisu vâta atâhpa heta ei cha chho ei.
Khazohpa ta nâmo châta ngiachhie chakaona raihria eina piepa kyh nama vaw pahno ha aw.
Aluahna ta bienyupa pahnosapa ei châpa kyh a chyuta ei vaw roh ha khawh.
Kha châpaphaopa kha nama reih khiahta cha, Krista bienyupa ei pahnozie nama pahno thei aw.
Cha thâtihpha bienyupa cha, tahmâ nota a lyuhchâpa pathaihpazy nata a hrohsopa pathaihpazy hnohta Thlahpa ta a pahnosapa hawhna heta, kha hlâta chyhsa sawzy hnohta pahnosapa châ beih vei.
Bienyupa cha he he a châ: Thâtihpha vâta Zenitaizy cha, Krista Zisu liata Izarei sawzy nata ryuto lâhpazy châ ei ta, pôhpa miakha pachiahpa a châ khohpazy nata bietai a hlypazy ama châ.
Khazohpa ngiachhiena hmosaipiepa vâta, cha thâtihpha chakaotuhpa ta taopa châ na ta, cha chakaona rai cha a hmotaotheina hmâpa ta ei hnohta eina pie.
Mopathaihpa chyh chaipa hlâta chyh viapa châ hraw sah la, pahno khai thei leipa Krista hneirôna cha, Zenitaizy hnohta chho awpa ta, cha ngiachhiena cha piepa ei châ.
Khazohpa ato taotuhpa hnohta nyu kôzawpa bienyupa achhuahna cha palâsa awpa ta, cha ngiachhiena cha piepa ei châ hra.
Chatanachata Khazohpa sona hnei hluhzie cha, avâ suzy liata ryureihtuhpazy nata biehneituhpazy hnohta, Awnanopa hmâpa ta pahnosapa ta a y thei aw.
Cha cha Khazohpa chhâzaw hmochhuahpa châ ta, eima Beipa Krista Zisu liata a vaw patlôsa.
Krista eimâ ngiapâpa vâta, riahphapa nata ngâhna chôta Khazohpa eima hnia thei haw.
Chavâta nama châta pasa ei taopa vâta hnabeidy lei awpa ta ei châ haw ei. Nama rônah nawpa ta pasa ei taopa a châ.
Cha vâna chata Paw hmiakô liata pakhu paneihpa ta ei bôh tyh.
Ano cha lei nah vâ liata chhôhkha to moh bi hnâpa a châ.
A rônahna hneirôh ngaitazie hawhta, Khazohpa ta a Thlahpa zawhzi ta nama chhôh lâ hro tha a cha patlô thei nawpa ei ta, thlah ei cha chhâpa ei.
Chatanachata Krista cha ngiapâna vâta nama palôhzy liata pahrâ aw ta, a kyhpachâna liata thari thlapa nata abôna hneipa ta y thei aw ei chi ta,
mopathaihpa zydua chhaota Khazohpa kyhpachâna kawhzie, seihzie, asâhzie nata athuzie zy nama pahno thei aw.
Novâhna hlâta a sâh viapa Krista kyhpachâna pahno aw ei chi ta, Khazohpa pakina ta pabiepa nama châ aw.
Tahmâ keimo liata a hria tyhpa hmotaotheina lymâ hawhta, eima hiapa nata pachâpa zydua hlâta tha via syulyu ta a tao theituhpa Khazohpa hnohta,
Awnanopa liata nata Krista Zisu liata rônahna cha, chhâ zydua hnohta chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta y mawh sy. Amen.
Chavâta a cha awna ei nata â phuhpa ta y awpa ta, kei Abeipa châta atâhpa heta ei châ haw ei.
Tlokhuh apanawhna, areisina nata daotheina zy hneipa ta, kyhpachâna ta a chhyh thai raihrie u la,
Thlahpa apôhkhana a y lymâ thei nawpa ta, adyhna ta a chahrypa ta tei lymâ teh u.
Pôhpa miakha nata Thlahpa pakha dei y ta, cha hawhna chata, awpa nama châ nona kha, hnabeiseihna miakha hnei awpa ta awpa nama châ.
Abeipa pakha, ngiapâna miakha, bâtina miakha nata
Khazohpa pakha deita a y. Ano cha ato Paw châ ta, ato chô liata y ta, ato chahryh khai ta, ato chhôh liata a y.
Châhrasala Krista ta hmosaipiepa a rainazie lymâ hawhta, ngiachhiena cha a saipa ta pie chyupa eima châ.
Chavâta, “Chô lâ a khy nota, Seichâna cha sei ta a chhi ta, Chyhsazy hnohta Hmosaipiepazy a pie ei,” tahpa a châ.
“A kkhy,” tahpa heta, alei su a hnaipa lâ a za chô tuana a palâsapa châ vei ma?
A zâ chôpa tlai kha, avâ zydua chô lâ a khypa cha châ ta, lei nata vâ cha ano ta a bie khai haw.
Chatanachata thokha lyuhchâpa châ awpa ta, thokha hrohsopa châ awpa ta, thokha biechhotuhpa châ awpa ta, thokha mietaku vaituhpa châ awpa nata thokha pachutuhpa châ awpa ta Krista ta a rao ei.
Chazy cha chakaona rai hria awpa ta mopathaihpazy pachhuahpanoh ta, Krista pôhpa pipatlohsa nawpa ta piepa a châ.
Eima zydua ta ngiapâna nata Khazohpa Sawchapawpa pahnona liata pôhkha châpa ta, pitlohna hro hneipa ta, Krista pakina tlu ta pakipa ta eima y thei nawpa ta piepa a châ.
Chatanachata chyhsa so piehpiena nata dôthaina hmotaopa tichatlaopazy ta hao lâ he lâ a chatlaopa nata pachuna ziza to ta a phao pahaipa hawtipa châ khao aw ma pi.
Kyhpachâna ta biedopa reipa ta, kyh to liata ano liata eima laiseih lymâ aw. Ano cha luh châ ta, cha cha Krista a châ.
Ano liana chata pôhpa pachiahpa to a pazaopakhypa ta, pachiahpa to ta ama raihria chyu a phapa ta ama hria nahta, pôhpa cha kyhpachâna liata a laiseih tyh.
He he Abeipa liata reih na ta, ei cha chho ei: Pachâna hraoleipa a hneipa Zenitaizy hawhta nama y khao awpa châ vei.
Ama palôh kuhchhapa vâta pahno leina âmo liata y ta, cha chata ama pahnona pazohsa ta, Khazohpa hrona tawhta pachhaihpa ta ama y.
Nozana châh chhao pahno khao leipa ei ta, parâna liata âmosasyh a hlâ ei ta, karây ngaitapa ta hmo puapa to ama tao.
Nâmo deikua cha, cha hawhta Krista cha a chu veih ei chi!
A thâtih thei ei chi ta, Zisu liata biehmeiseihpa a ypa hawhta, ano liata pachupa nama châ.
Eikhano ta nama hrozie ta a hrohpa, dôveina piehpie aohraohna ta a parao tyhpa, nama chyhsa parohpa kha pahluh u la,
nama palôh pachânazy pathiehpa ta,
siana nata pathaihna hmeiseihpa liata Khazohpa lyupa ta taopa chyhsa thiehpa ta a tobi teh u.
Chavâta haipa bâhsai u la, nama vaih hnohta biedopa reih chyu teh u. Pôhpa miakha tawhta a pachiahpa sai eima châ.
Nama hiehâh sala, molei deikua molei khuh vy. Nama hiehâhna cha noh ta tlakhei leipa sala,
ahripa châta su paruapa khuh vy.
A paru tyhpa ta paru khao leipa sala, phahlapazy pie awpa a hnei thei nawpa ta, ano ku ta hmo phapa hria sala, hriapasa mawh sy.

Bie pha leipa rai nama pakah tawhta pua khah sy. Chyhsa taopathi nawpa bie deita, a daihti nata su a hmiepa ta, nama pakah tawhta pua mawh sy. Chatanachata a theituhpazy châta ngiachhiena ama tona a châ aw.
Khazohpa Thlahpa Pathaihpa pachâ parôh khuh vy, chatlaina noh châta ano ta ngiapa nama châ.
Ruchhôna, pathiiana, hiehâhna, paphôhna nata reipachhiena zydua nâmo tawhta thy khai teh u.
A ngiachhie raihriepa ta, tha a pasa raihrie u la, Khazohpa ta Krista liata a châ ngiahthaipa hawh ei ta, a ngiahthai raihrie teh u.
Chavâta Khazohpa kyhpachâpa sawzy nama châpa hawhta, a hâ a latuhpazy châ teh u.
Krista ta kyh miah pachâ ta, ropahâhpa châta Khazohpa lâta hmohlâpa ta nata atheihna ta keimo châta â piepa hawhna khata, kyhpachâna hro ta nâmo chhao hroh teh u.
Mopathaihpazy nama châ tawhta cha, apatlana, puana zydua nata uahvana zy nama hry liata a rei chhao reipa châ khah sy.
Bie puapa reipa zy, bie hrupa reipa zy, saiso pathaih leipa bie reipa zy a ngia vei. Chazy taopa hlâta cha alyna bie tlao reih tyh muh vy.

He he a siapa ta pahno teh u: Apatlana moleina a taopa tlyma, chyhsa puapa tlyma, uahvana a hneipa tlyma, cha hawhpa chyhsazy chata Krista nata Khazohpa khinarâh liata ryu to hnei aw veih ei. Uahvana a hneipa cha nothlahpa achhypa a châ.
Ahy hmahta hraoleipa bie ta cha dôvei khah ei sy. Cha hmozy vâna chata Khazohpa pathiiana cha ngiapâleipa sawzy chô liata a tlô tyh.
Chavâta âmo cha a hlykhei khuh vy.
Hlâno cha zohpa châ ei chi ta, tahmâ deikua, Abeipa liata khaihpa nama vaw châ haw. Khaihpa sawzy hawhta hroh teh u.
Khaihna theilâpa cha phana nata siana nata biehmeiseihpa to liata â lâ tyh.
Abeipa khopa khâpa ma a châ tahpa pahnopasia a chhuah teh u.
Zohna hmotaopa a pathei beih leipazy liata a hlao leipa u la, zohna hmotaopazy cha tlao palâhâh teh u.
Arulâta ama tao tyhpazy cha, reipa chhao ta nozachhihpa hmo a châ.
Châhrasala hmo kheihawhpa rai, khaihpa ta a palâsa tita cha, hmô theipa ta a y tyh.
Hmô theipa ta a ypa maih cha khaihpa a châ. Chavâta, “Nâ, a môpa, a hra la, Athihpa hry tawhta thyu teh! Krista ta a cha khaipahlie aw,” tahpa a châpa kha.
Chatanachata asoleipazy hawhta y leipa u la, asopazy hawhta ypa ta, nama yzie liata a chado teh u.
Nohzy he a pha leipa vâta, daihti rypaohpa patu thai teh u.
Chavâta hru leipa u la, Abeipa khopa khâpa ma a châ tahpa tlao pahno teh u.
Kresawhti paripa ta y khah u, parina liata a sohsi leina y tlôh ta, Thlahpa ta biepa ta tlao y teh u.
Reithaina hlazy, Khazohpa hlazy, thlahpa hlazy ta bie a chho raihrie u la, nama pathipalôh ta Abeipa lâ hla sapa ta, totâ tô teh u.
Eima Beipa Zisu Krista moh ta, ato liata Paw Khazohpa hnohta alyna bie khâ reih u la,
Krista nama chizana palâsapa ta, a ngiarih raihrie teh u.
Lapinô saih u, Abeipa liata namâ ngiarihpa hawhta, nama vahpazy liata a ngiarih teh u.
Krista cha ano pôhpa Awnanopa luh châ ta, Awnanopa pachhatuhpa a châpa hawhta, vahpa cha lapinô luh a châ.
Awnanopa ta Krista liata â ngiarihpa hawhta, lapinôzy chhao ato liata ama vahpazy liata amâ ngiarih awpa a châ.
Vahpa saih u, Krista ta Awnanopa kyhpachâ ta, Awnanopa châta â pie khaipa hawhta, nâmo chhao nama lapinôzy kyhpachâ teh u.
Awnanopa cha bie nata ti ta pasipa ta, a pathaisa thei nawpa ta, Krista cha Awnanopa châta â pie.

Chatanachata Awnanopa cha a puapa rai a kiah leipa, a vo a dao leipa nata cha hawhpa hmo rai a phaoh leipa châ thei aw ta, pathaihpa nata seina hnei leipa Awnanopa rônahpa châ awpa ta, Krista ano tlai ta a tao aw.
Cha hawhna chata, vahpazy ta ama lapinôzy cha âmo pôhpa hawhta pachâpa ta, ama lapinôzy kyh ama pachâ awpa a châ. A lapinô kyh a pachâpa cha anosasyh kyh a pachâpa a châ.
