Ahy hmahta ano pôhpa a hao beih vei. Krista ta Awnanopa chyh ta, a mohôhpa hawhta, chyhsa ta a pôhpa cha chyh ta a mohôh tyh.
Krista pôhpa pachiahpazy eima châ.
“Chavâta chapaw ta a nô nata paw siesai aw ta, a lapinô a patu aw; chatanachata pôhpa miakha ama vaw châ ha aw.”
He he bienyupa a thu ngaitapa châ ta, châhrasala kei ta la Krista nata Awnanopa thâtih reina a châpa ta ei pahno.
Khâpa rai châ sala, ahy rai ta ano kyh â pachâpa hawhta a lapinô kyhpachâ sala, lapinô chhao ta a vahpa za thai mawh sy.
Saw saih u, Abeipa liata nama nôpawzy rei a ngiah teh u. Cha cha hmo dopa châ tlôh ta.
“Na nô nata na paw palyupalih teh,
na châta pha aw ta, alei liana heta na hro a pareih aw,” tahpa he bietai byhnâ a hneipa biepiepa hmiatuachaipa a châ.
Nâmo, pawzy saih u, nama sawzy ru pachhô leipa u la, Abeipa chhoreina nata pachuna liata tlao mohôh teh u.
Seizy saih u, Krista rei namâ ngiapa hawhta, palôh dopa phaopa ta, chipa nata a chalyupa ta, khizaw liata nama zibeipazy rei a ngiah teh u.
Chyhsa palysa a chhuahpazy hawhta ama hmô nota dei hria leipa ta, Krista seizy hawhta palôh hmeiseihpa ta Khazohpa khopa tao teh u.
Chyhsa chakaopa châ leipa ta, Abeipa chakaopa hawhta pachâpa ta, palôh hmeiseihpa ta chakao muh vy.
Sei rai châ sala, khotalaipa rai châ sala, chyhsa to ta hmo phapa ama taopa maih cha, Abeipa tawhta ama hmô heih aw tahpa pahno teh u.

Nâmo, zibeipazy saih u, cha hawhna chata nâmo chhao nama seizy chô liata tao hra teh u. Âmo chhao, nâmo chhao, avâ liata zibeipa pakha nama hneipa pahnopa ta, ano liata cha khokhei eih viapa y veih ei tahpa pahnopa ta, nama seizy pachhipary khuh vy.
A chhâ chaina ta cha, Abeipa nata a thatlôna liata thatlôpa ta y teh u.
Ahripa reipasaonazy nama pahnie thei nawpa ta, Khazohpa chariah chhaichhi pakipa ta a tobi teh u.
Eimâ piapazy he sapa nata thisaih châ leipa ei ta, abeinazy, biehneinazy, he khizaw zohna chô liata hmotaotheinazy nata avâ suzy liata a ypa thlahpa moleipazy tlao ama châ.
Chavâta noh pha leipa liata namâ dyuh thei nawpa nata nama tao khai tawh chhao ta namâ duah thei nawpa ta, Khazohpa chariah chhaichhi pakipa ta a tobi teh u.
Biehmeiseihpa ta nama chai a saih u la, siana chachôhna vyhphao a kypa ta a duah teh u.
Adyhna thâtihpha châta a mâ chiehpa ta ypa ta, nama phei liata adyhna pheiky a ky teh u.
Chazy thota, ngiapâna vyhphao a chaba u la, cha chata moleipa châtai mei zydua nama pachhai thei aw.
Chatawhcha pachhana lakhu a khu u la, Thlahpa zaozi a chaba teh u. Thlahpa zaozi cha Khazohpa bie a châ.
Thlahchhâna nata hiana to ta khatino rai ta Thlahpa ta thlahchhâ teh u. Cha châna chata a hrohrua u la, mopathaihpa zydua châta bâh leipa ta thlahchhâ teh u.
Pakah âpa ta thâtihpha bienyupa riahpha ngaitapa ta phuah awpa ta, bie rei awpazy piepa ei châ thei nawpa ta, kei châta na hiapa hra teh u.
Thâtihpha ei rei awpa cha riahphapa ta ei rei thei nawpa ta, lyuhchâpa bâlia a kypa ei châ.
Unawh kyhpachâpa nata Abeipa chakaotuhpa ngâchhihpa Tykiku ta hmo to cha chho aw ei ta, kheihta y na ta, khâpa ma ei tao hai tahpazy nama vaw pahno aw.
Eima duahmo vaw pahnopa ta, nama palôh tha a cha patlô thei nawpa ei ta, Tykiku cha nâmo lâ ei vaw tuah.
Paw Khazohpa nata Abeipa Zisu Krista tawhta thlalôhna nata ngiapâna a hlaopa kyhpachâna cha, unawhzy hnohta y mawh sy.
Kyhpachâna dia beih leipa ta eima Beipa Zisu Krista kyh pachâtuhpa zydua hnohta ngiachhiena y mawh sy.
Pawla nata Timawthy, Krista Zisu chakaotuhpazy ta Philipi khih liata a ypa Krista Zisu liata mopathaihpazy, Awnanopa chhituhpazy nata chakaotuhpazy eima châ naoh.
Khazohpa eima Paw nata Abeipa Zisu Krista tawhta ngiachhiena nata thlalôhna nama hnohta y mawh sy.
Ei châ theina maih ei ta ei Khazohpa hnohta alyna bie ei reih tyh.
Nama zydua châta thlah ei chhâna maihta, thapha ngaitapa ta ei chhâ tyh.
Thâtihpha raihria liata, noh khana noh tawhta tahmâ taihta eina hrialâh lymâ ei chi.
Nâmo liata raihria phapa a pathaotuhpa khata, Zisu Krista noh liata a pangoh aw tahpa ei ngiapâ.

Bâlia ei kypa liata nata thâtihpha a duakheipa ta ei pa-ina kyhzy liata Khazohpa ngiachhiena ei tolâhpazy nama châpa vâta, ei palôh liata khâ nama y. Chavâta nama zydua chô liata cha hawhpa palôh ei phaopa cha, kei châta tao awpa dopa a châ.
Zisu Krista liata atlaichhaina ta nama zydua ei cha vânazie ei cha, Khazohpa ta eina pahnokhei.
Nama kyhpachâna pôh via rili sala, novâhna nata pahnona zydua liata nama laiseih thei nawpa ta thlah ei chhâ tyh.
Chatanachata hmo pha chaipa pahnopa ta, Krista noh châta pathaihpa nata seina hnei leipa ta y aw ei chi ta,
Khazohpa rônah nawpa nata reithai nawpa ta, Zisu Krista zawhzi ta a patheipa siana thei ta pabiepa nama châ aw.
Unawh saih u, ei chô liata hmo a vaw tlôpazy kha, thâtihpha râh pakawh nawpa a châ tahpa nama pahno awpa ei khoh.
Bâlia ei kypa he Krista vâta a châ tahpa abei o vaituhpa pheisaihzy nata chyhsa hropazy chhao ta ama pahno.
Bâlia ei kypa heta unawh hluhpi Abeipa liata ama riah paphasa ta, chi khao leipa ta, riahpha viapa ta Khazohpa bie ama chho lymâ.
Thokha cha hiatliana nata aiehkhyhna vâta Krista bie chho ei ta, thokha deikua cha thapasana vâta Krista bie ama chho.
Thapasana vâta Krista bie a chhopazy cha, thâtihpha ei duakheipa vâta patâhpa ei châzie pahnopa ta, kyhpachâna ta Krista bie ama chho lymâ.
Hiatliana nata a iehkhyhna vâta Krista thâtihpha a chhopazy deikua cha, ei tâhna liata pasana baichha a chhuahpa ta, palôh hmeiseihpa ta châ leipa ta, aiehkhyhna vâta Krista bie ama chho.
A peina a y ma? A pakheipa rai châ sala, a hmeiseihpa rai châ sala, a peimawhpa cha, kyh to ta Krista bie chhopa he a châ. Cha vâna chata a ly na ta, ei ly lymâ aw.
Nama thlahchhâna vâta nata Zisu Krista Thlahpa baona vâta, cha hmo cha papuapa ei châ nawpa a châ aw tahpa ei pahno.

Maophyuhpa ta y leipa aw na ta, ei pôhpa liata Krista palyupalihpa ta a y tyhpa hawhta, thina ta tlyma, hrona ta tlyma, Krista cha ei pôhpa liata palyupalihpa ta a y aw tahpa cha, tahmâ chhao riahpha ngaitapa ta ei saduthliepa nata ei hnabeiseihpa a châ.
Kei châta la hro he Krista châ ta, thi chhao athôhna a châ.
Ei hroh chy khiahta cha, chakaona theilâpa hmô awpa ta a hrohpa ei châ. Kheihawhpa ma ei tlyh aw tahpa pahno va na.
A likah liata pachâna pahno leipa ta ei y. Kei la sie ta, Krista hnohta y bâ awpa ei khoh. Cha cha kei châta a pha via syulyu.
Châhrasala ei hroh chy awpa he nâmo châta byuh viapa a châ.
Cha cha ei ngiapâpa vâta, ei hroh chy aw tahpa ei pahno. Ngiapâna liata laiseih u la, namâ ly nawpa ta, nama hnohta ei y chy aw.
Nâmo lâ ei vy heih awpa vâta, Krista Zisu liata namâ lyna keima vâta a pôh rili aw.

Khâpa rai châ sala, nama hro cha Krista thâtihpha nata a hmie tua mawh sy. Chatanachata nâmo ei châ vaw hmô ei tlyma, hmô vei ei tlyma, thlahpa miakha liata â ipa ta a duahpa ta, palôh miakha phaopa ta thâtihpha ngiapâna bie a châhkhei ei chi ta, nama tei lymâ tahpa ei vaw pahno aw.

Khâpa kyh liata hmah châ dyuhtuhpazy chi veih ei chi tahpa chhao ei vaw pahno aw. Cha cha pahleipadia awpa ama châpa ngiana châ ta, nâmo châta deikua cha, pachha awpa nama châpa ngiana a châ. Cha pachhana cha Khazohpa tawhta a châ.
Krista namâ ngiapâpa dei châ leipa ta, ano vâta pasa nama tao awpa chhao pasaipa châ tlôh ta.
Keima liata adyuhna nama hmô tyhpa, tahmâ chhao ei tyh haipa nama theipa, cha adyuhna tlai cha nâmo chhao namâ tyh hra hih.
Krista liata thapatlôna, a kyhpachâna vâta thlalôhna, Thlahpa akaona, thapasana nata ngiachhiena zy nâmo liata a chyhta chhâ a y khiahta cha,
palôh miakha phaoh ta, kyhpachâna miakha hneipa ta, lôraohpa nata reihkha tlapa ta ei lyna paki teh u.
Hlaotlohna hmô ta, moh a lâ awpa khona vâta tlyma, apalaina vâta tlyma, khâpa hmah tao khuh vy. Tlao a panawh u la, nâmo hlâta mohropazy pha viapa ta rao teh u.
Nâmo khopa dei moh leipa u la, mohropazy khopa chhao moh tyh hra muh vy.
He palôh Krista Zisu liata a ypa he nâmo liata chhao y hra mawh sy:
Ano cha Khazohpa châna a hneipa châ ta, châhrasala Khazohpa tlu ta ypa cha tlaichhai awpa ta rao leipa ta,
anosasyh ta a parua khai ta, sei ta a taopa ta, chyhsapa hawhta vaw pih ta.
Chyhsapa hawhta vaw y ta, anosasyh ta a panawh ta, thina taihta reingiahpa ta y ta, kraws liata thina tlai cha.
Chavâta Khazohpa ta ano cha thata palyupalih ta, moh zydua hry liata moh chônôchaipa a pie.
Chatanachata avâ nata alei nata alei ry liata a ypa zydua ta Zisu moh ta ama pakhu paneih aw ei ta,
Paw Khazohpa rônah nawpa ta, paleih to ta Zisu Krista cha Abeipa a châ tahpa ama phuah aw.
Chavâta kho ngaitapazy saih u, bie nama zyh tyhpa hawhna khata, ei y nota dei hria leipa u la, tahmâ ei y vei chhôh ta tlao hria viapa ta, chipa nata chalyupa ta nama pachhana cha hria papua teh u.
Ano alynazie tlaichhai ta, a khopa tao awpa ta, nâmo liata hriatuhpa cha Khazohpa a châ.
Paphôna nata aeichhiana y leipa ta ato tao teh u.
Chatanachata chhâ moleipa nata paviapa hry liana heta, seina hnei leipa nata pathaihpa châ aw ei chi ta, vâ awhsizy hawhta ama hry liata nama khaih aw.
Hrona bie khâchâ patu teh u. Chatanachata hraoleipa ta a râpasuapa nata hraoleipa ta a hriapasapa châ va na tahpa Krista noh liata ei palaikhei thei aw.
Dopa hlâna hawhta, namâ ngiapâna atheihna nata chakaona chô liata patlaipa ta y hraw sah la, a ly pyly na ta, nama zydua ta ei châ lykhei hra ei.
Cha hawhna chata nâmo chhao a ly u la, nâ lykhei hra teh u.
Nama thâtih pahnopa ta, kei chhao thapatlôpa ta ei y thei hra nawpa ta, nâmo lâ Timawthy vaw tuah patoh awpa Abeipa Zisu liata ei hnabei a seih.
Ano palôh hawhpa a phaohpa, nama duahmo châ pachâkhei hmeiseih awpa chyhsa hropa hnei va na.
Mohropa zydua cha, Zisu Krista châta châ leipa ta, âmo pha nawpa a tluapa sai ama châ.
Timawthy deikua cha pasiapa châ ta, saw ta a paw a chakaopa hawhta, thâtihpha chhona kyh liata eina chakaolâh tyhpa nama pahno.
Chavâta ei thâtih awpa ei pahnopa nahta, thlai vaw tuah awpa ei chhuah.
Kei chhao thlai a vy awpa ta Abeipa liata ei hnabei a seih.
Ei ngiahnazy liata na chakao awpa ta kei lâta nama vaw tuapa, ei unawhpa nata ei hrialâhpa nata pheisaih ei châlâhpa Epâpharôditâ he, nâmo lâ vaw pasiesa bâ awpa a byuhpa ta ei pahno.
Nama zydua ta cha vâ ngaita ei ta, a pasapa kyh nama vaw theipa vâta a palôh pha thai khao vei.

Thi daihmâna taihta a pasapa châ tlai ta, châhrasala Khazohpa ta ano cha ngiachhie ta, ano a ngiachhiepa dei châ leipa ta, pachârôhna chôta pachârôh via heihna ei tyh lei nawpa ta, kei eina ngiachhiepa a châ hra.
Chavâta ano nama hmô heih tita namâ ly thei nawpa nata ei pachârôhna a chyh via thei nawpa ta, Epâpharôditâ cha nâmo lâ vaw pasiesa awpa a ngiatiah va na.
Thapha ngaitapa ta Abeipa liata a vaw ly u la, he hawhpa chyhsazy he palyupalih teh u.
Nâmo ta eina deichhy awpa vyuhpa nata namâ phahlanazy pabie awpa ta, a hrona sokhâhpa ta na chakao ta, Krista raihria vâta a thi daihmâpa a châ.
Achhâna ta cha, unawh saih u, Abeipa liata a ly teh u. Bie hmopa nama hnohta ro chaneipa he, namâ boh nawpa a châpa vâta, kei châta noaichhihpa châ vei.
Izy tawhta a vaih teh u. Hmopha leipa a taotuhpazy tawhta a vaih u la, ama sapa a taipazy tawhta a vaih teh u.
Keimo, Thlahpa ta Khazohpa a chhypa, Krista Zisu a palaikheipa nata sapa liata ngâna rai a pahnie leipazy pi he, chopawtaipazy cha eima châ.
Ei khoh khiah la, kei chhao sapa liata ngâna a pahnieh theipa ei châ. Chyhsa ta sapa liata ngâna pahnieh thei nawpa chhâpa a hneipa hawhta â pachâ khiahta cha, kei he ei hnei pachai.
Noh chariena noh ta chopawtaipa, Izarei phopi pathla, Benzami chi, Hebraizy hry liata Hebrai pachaipa ei châ. Ryhpa kyh liata Phârisaih châ na ta,
phahnai ngiahna kyh liata Awnanopa a taolatuhpa ei châ. Ryhpa biezy zyhpa vâta siana kyh liata chhao seina hnei leipa ei châ.
Châhrasala kei châta athôhna a châ awpa maih Krista vâta kyna ta ei rao khai.

Cha dei châ vei, ei Beipa Zisu Krista pahnopa cha hmo hropa zydua hlâta sôh via ta, chavâta hmo to kyna ta ei rao khai. Krista cha ei thôhkhei thei nawpa ta, ano vâta hmo to ky na ta, hmo hropa zydua cha hnaihny hawh dei ta ei rao.

Ryhpa bie zyhpa vâta siana keima liata hnei leipa na ta, Krista ngiapâna vâta siana a hneipa ei châ. Cha siana cha Khazohpa tawhta a puapa châ ta, ngiapâna vâta hnei theipa deita a châ. Chavâta Krista liata ei y thei nawpa ta, hmo to kyna ta ei rao khai haw.
Chatanachata Krista nata a thyuheihna hmotaotheina cha pahno aw na ta, a rietheitaona liata a hlao hrapa ta, a thina liata ano hawhta thi hrapa ta,
athihpa hry tawhta thyuheihna cha, ano hawhta ei to tlai hra aw.
Chazy cha a hmô hapa hawhta a reih leipa na ta, paki hapa hawhta a rao va na. Krista Zisu ta eina patuna chhâpa patu hra awpa ta ei tei lymâ.
Unawh saih u, chazy cha a patu hapa hawhta a pachâ va na. Châhrasala hmo miakha taopa ei hnei: Hnôhlâ hmozy mypa ta, hmialâ hmozy pazapa ta,
Khazohpa ta Krista Zisu liata chô lâ eina awna chhâpa lymâ hmô awpa ta, anuapa lâ pangaipa ta ei sie lylia.
Keimo, pitlohpazy ta cha, cha hawhpa palôh cha phaoh ei suh u. Kheihawhpa kyh liata tlyma, palôh nanopa a phaohpa nama châ khiahta cha, cha chhao cha Khazohpa ta a cha pahnosa aw ei.
Khâpa rai châ sala, eima tlôna rakha liata eima duahmo nata â hmiepa ta hroh sih la, eima tlô pachiena tawhta hmialâ tôh lymâ suh u.
Unawh saih u, ei hâ nâ latuhpazy châ teh u. A mopâ awpa keimo miah hnei ei chi ta, keimo hawhta a ypazy cha a mopâ teh u.
Chyhsa hluhpi cha Krista kraws khakhaipazy ama châ tahpa ei cha chho tyhpa ei kha, tahmâ chhao mothlih chhaota ei cha chho heih ei.
Cha sahlao chhâna cha leidiana châ ta, ama khazoh cha ama py châ ta, ama rônahna cha ama maophyuhna a châ. Khizaw hmozy liata palôh a sohpa ama châ.
Keimo khihsana deikua cha vârâh liata y ta, vârâh tawhta Pachhatuh Abeipa Zisu Krista a zu awpa cha ngiatiah leipa ta eima hâ.
Ato ano rei sai ta a paysa theipa Krista ta eima pôhpa nawh ngaitapazy he ano pôhpa rônahpa hawhta y awpa ta, a hmotaotheina hmâpa ta a taopathi aw.
Chavâta ei kho ngaitapa nata ei vâ ngaitapa ei unawhzy nata ei lyna nata ei lakhozy saih u, Abeipa liata â ipa ta a duah teh u.
Abeipa liata palôh miakha phaoh awpa ta Eudia nata Sytyke zy ei haw ei.

A châ na, raopaky ei kylâhpa chhao chi kha ei châ haw hra. Kha chanôzy kha vaw bao mah y. Âmo kha Klemena nata ei hrialâhpa hropa zydua chhaota thâtihpha vâta ei hriapasana liata nâ hrialâhpazy châ ei ta, hrona châbu liata ama moh a ypazy ama châ.
Abeipa liata khâ a ly teh u; ei tah heih aw, a ly teh u.
Nama nôphana cha chyhsa zydua pahnopa châ mawh sy. Abeipa cha â hnia haw.
Khâpa liata hmah nôpopa ta y leipa u la, ato liata thlahchhâpa nata hiapa ta alyna bie reih u la, nama khopazy cha Khazohpa hnohta pahnosa teh u.
Chatanachata Khazohpa thlalôhna, novâhna zydua hlâta sôh viapa ta nama palôh nata nama pachânazy cha Krista Zisu liata a cha vaipa lymâ aw ei.

Achhâna ta cha, unawh saih u, adopa maih zy, zachhihpa maih zy, asiapa maih zy, pathaihpa maih zy, khochhihpa maih nata pasâhsa a chhihpa maih zy cha, phana hneipa ta, reithai tlâh a châ khiahta cha, chazy cha pachâ teh u.
Keima liata hmo namâ chupa, nama daopa, nama theipa nata nama hmôpa zy kha tao tyh muh vy. Chatanachata thlalôhna Khazohpa ta a cha ypâ aw ei.
Eina pachâna ei chi tahmâ nama pathieh heihpa vâta ei ly ngaita. Na pachâ kaw tyh tlai ei chi ta, châhrasala rypaohna nama hmô leipa vâta a châ.
Ei phahlana kyh a reihpa châ va na. Kei la kheihawhpa duahmo lia rai y aw sah la, palôhtlâh ei pao lymâ.

Phahlapa ta yzie thai na ta, hneirôhpa ta yzie chhao ei thai. Kheihawhpa duahmo rai châ sala, lôhrâtlôpa nata nodipa ta y thaina bieru pahno na ta, hneirôhpa nata phahlapa ta y thaina bieru chhao ei pahno.
Tha nâ patlôtuhpa Krista liata ato ei tao thei.
Chatahrasala ei nôponazy liata nama nô eina pokhei tyhpa ei chi he, nama tao pha na.

Nâmo, Philipi mo saih u, thâtihpha ei chho tua nota Mâsidônia râh tawhta ei pua nona kha, nâmo dei leipa ta cha, Awnanopa miakha hmahta hmopiena nata hmodaona kyh liata na hrialâh veih ei tahpa nâmo tlai ta nama pahno.
Thysalawnika khih liata ei y nona chhao kha, ei phahlana pazao nawpa ta, ei kha dei châ leipa ta, ei no dua eina vaw paphao ei chi.
Hmopiepa a tluapa châ leipa na ta, nama lymâ a papôh awpa theilâpa a tluapa tlao ei châ.

Châhrasala ato hnei na ta, ei hnei hluh ngaita. Epâpharôditâ ku liata hmosaipiepazy eina vaw paphaopa ei chi kha vaw hmô na ta, ei dôkhâ haw. Nama hmosaipiepazy kha atheihna a pyh tlâhpa nata Khazohpa a palysapa, ropahâhpa hmohlâpa a châ.
Ei Khazohpa ta Krista Zisu liata a rônahna hneirôhzie lymâ hawhta namâ phahlana to liata a cha pazao aw ei.
Eima Khazohpa nata Paw hnohta chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta rônahna y mawh sy. Amen.
Krista Zisu liata mopathaihpa zydua kha nâ naohpa muh vy. Ei hnohta unawh a ypazy ta ama châ naoh.
Mopathaihpa zydua ta châ naoh ei ta, Kaisarâ chhôhkha liata a ypazy ta amâ châ naoh pachai.
Abeipa Zisu Krista ngiachhiena cha nama thlahpa hnohta y mawh sy.
Khazohpa khozie hawhta Krista Zisu lyuhchâpa Pawla nata eima unawhpa Timawthy ta
Kaolaosâ khih liata Krista liata mopathaihpazy nata unawh ngâchhihpazy eima châ naoh. Khazohpa eima Paw tawhta ngiachhiena nata thlalôhna nama hnohta y mawh sy.
Nama châta thlah eima chhâna maihta, Khazohpa, eima Beipa Zisu Krista Paw hnohta alyna bie eima reih tyh.
Krista Zisu namâ ngiapâzie nata mopathaihpa zydua chôta kyhpachâna nama hneizie eima vaw theipa vâta nata,
vârâh liata nama châta hnabeiseihna sopa a châpa vâta, nâmo vâta Khazohpa lâta alyna bie khâ eima reih tyh. Cha hnabeiseihna cha thâtihpha biehmeiseihpa tawhta nama theipa kha a châ.

Thâtihpha nâmo lâ a vaw tlô tawhta, Khazohpa ngiachhiena thâtihpha cha thei ei chi ta, a hmeiseihpa ta nama pahno noh tawhta nama hry liata thei patheipa ta a pôh lymâpa hawhta, thâtihpha cha khizaw zydua liata thei pathei ta a pôh lymâ.
Eima chakaolâhpa kho ngaitapa Epâpharâ tawhta thâtihpha thei ei chi ta, ano cha keimo vyuhpa ta Krista chakaotuhpa ngâchhihpa a châ.
Thlahpa liata nama kyhpachâna miah a chho.

Cha vâna chata, nama thâtih eima thei noh tawhta, nâmo châta thlahchhâ bâh beih ma pi. Thlahpa lâ sona nata novâhna zydua hneipa ta, ano khopa pahnona ta pabiepa nama châ thei nawpa ta, eima cha hiapa tyh.
Chatanachata Abeipa hmâ tlâhpa chyhsa châ aw ei chi ta, kyh to liata ano palôh patlâhpa ta, raihria to liata pathei aw ei chi ta, Khazohpa pahnona liata nama laiseih rili aw.
Tiamana nata pasataona liata a ly kawpa ta nama tao thei nawpa ta, a thatlôna rônahpa liata hmotaotheina zydua hmâpa ta tha a cha patlô aw ei.
Chatanachata khaihna khinarâh liata mopathaihpazy ryutolâhpa châ awpa ta châ patlohsatuhpa Paw hnohta alyna bie nama reih thei aw.
Khazohpa ta zohna biehneina tawhta miah pachha ta, a Sawchapawpa kyhpachâ ngaitapa khinarâh lâ miah â chhi haw.
Ano liana chata chatlaina, moleinazy ngiahthaina eima hnei.
Krista cha hmô thei leipa Khazohpa a lyupa, hmotaopa zydua hry liata a pih tua chaipa a châ.

Ano ta ato tao ta, avâ liata a ypazy, alei liata a ypazy, hmô theipazy, hmô thei leipazy, beidyuchhaizy, biehneinazy, ryureituhpazy nata biehneituhpazy a tao. Ato ano vâta taopa châ ta, ano châta taopa a châ.
Ano cha ato y hlâta a ypa châ ta, ano liata ato â syhpahmaoh khai.
Awnanopa cha a pôhpa châ ta, ano cha Awnanopa luh a châ. Ano cha âthaona châ ta, athihpazy hry tawhta a thyu tuachaipa sawchapaw uhtheipa châ ta, ato liata a y tua chaipa a châ.
Khazohpa ta ano cha a pakina to yna châta khoh ta,
a kraws thisaih ta aryhna taopa ta, ato, alei chô liata a ypa nata avâ liata a ypa zydua ano nata a ryhpa ta a tao.
Nâmo chhao eikhano cha, moleinazy taopa ta, Khazohpa nata a maniah ei chi ta, nama palôh ta ano khakhaipazy nama châ.
Tahmâ deikua cha, a hmiakô liata pathaihpa nata seina hnei leipa nata reipasipasua nawpa y leipa ta a cha paduasa thei nawpa ei ta, a sapa pôhpa liata thina ta ano nata a cha paryhsa ei.

Ngiapâna liata y thlâh ha u la, â ipa ta a duah teh u. Thâtihpha hnabeiseihna nama pahnopa tawhna khata nama tleisai leipa khiahta cha, cha hawhta nama châ thei aw. Cha thâtihpha cha avâ ry liata hmotaopa zydua hnohta phuahpa châ ta, kei, Pawla he, cha thâtihpha chakaotuhpa cha ei châ.
Tahmâ cha nama châta pasa ei taonazy liata a ly na ta, a pôhpa, Awnanopa châta Krista pasa tao laibâhpa cha, ei sapa liata ei pazao lymâ.
Khazohpa bie â kipa ta ei cha chho thei nawpa ei ta, nâmo mohôhna raihria Khazohpa ta eina piepa lymâ hawhta, Awnanopa chakaotuhpa ta taopa ei châ.
Cha Khazohpa bie cha, kô hluhpi nata chhâ hluhpi nyu hapa bienyupa châ ta, tahmâ deikua cha a mopathaihpazy hnohta phualuahpa ta a y.
Cha bienyupa rônahpa hneirônazie cha Zenitaizy hry liata pahnosa awpa ta, Khazohpa ta mopathaihpazy a tlyh ta, cha bienyupa cha nâmo liata a ypa Krista cha châ ta, rônahna hnabeiseihpa cha a châ.
Chyhsa to Krista liata phapakipa ta eima paduasa thei nawpa ta, chyhsa to chhoreipa ta, sona to pachupa ta, Krista thâtih eima chho tyh.
Cha châna chata hriapasa na ta, kei liata thatlô ngaitapa ta a hriatuhpa thatlôna zydua hmâpa ta ei tei lymâ.
Nâmo nata Laodisi khih liata a ypazy nata ei hmia nâ hmô leipazy châta kha tlu ta ma ei tei lylia tahpa nama pahno awpa ei khoh.
Chatanachata ama palôhzy thapatlôpa ta y aw ta, kyhpachâna liata a chahry pabaoh aw ei ta, pahnopasiana liata hneirôna zydua topa ta, Khazohpa bienyupa, Krista cha ama pahno thei aw.
Sona nata pahnona hneirôna zydua Krista liata nyupa a châ.
Ahy hmahta reikah thaipa ta ama cha dôvei lei nawpa ta, cha bie cha ei reih.
Nama hnohta ei pôhpa ta y vei hraw sah la, thlahpa ta nama hnohta y tyh na ta, namâ mohôhna siazie nata Krista ngiapâna liata namâ izie zy ei hmôpa ta eina palysa ngaita.
Chavâta Krista Zisu Abeipa namâ pyh ha tawhta cha, ano liata y u la,
ano liata thari thlapa ta a duah u la, pachuna nama daopa hawhna khata ngiapâna liata â i ngaitapa ta ypa ta, alyna bie reih tyh muh vy.

Ahy hmahta Krista bie hawhta châ leipa ta, chyhsapa taozietyhpa nata khizaw siezie hawhta ama châ chhi lei nawpa nata, ama thaisona nata dôveina ruapa hmâpa ta ama cha parao lei nawpa ta, a hrohrua teh u.
Khazohpa châna zydua cha, â kipa nata a pôhpa tlai ta Krista liata a pahrâ.
Ryureina nata biehneina zydua luhpa Krista liana chata nâmo chhao pakipa ta nama y.
Ano liata chopawtaipa châ ei chi ta, cha cha ku ta chopawtaipa châ leipa ta, sapa ryhpa pahluh khaipa ta, Krista liata chopawtaipa nama châ.
Bâtina liata a hnohta pabupa châ ei chi ta, athihpa hry tawhta ano a pathyutuhpa Khazohpa raihria hmotaotheina namâ ngiapâpa vâta, nâmo chhao a hnohta pathyupa nama châ.
Nâmo, nama paraonazy nata nama sapa liata chopawtaileina vâta athipazy ei chi kha, Khazohpa ta Krista hnohta a cha pahro ei. Krista cha eima moleina zydua miah a ngiahthaituhpa a châ.

Ku ta ropa ryhpazy cha miah dyuhtuhpa nata miah chakhiatuhpa châ ei ta, châhrasala zyh awpa ta eimâ bâh tlôhpazy ama châ. Krista deikua cha eimâ bâhpa zydua phie ta, kraws liata khaipâpa ta pahlei ta, eima moleina zydua miah ngiahthaituhpa a châ.
Krista ta ryureituhpazy nata biehneituhpazy cha ama châna pahluh ta, kraws liata âmo cha pahniepa ta, â lâhâhpa ta maophyuhpa ta a tao ha ei.
Chavâta nie kyh ta tlyma, do kyh ta tlyma, chaypi kyh ta tlyma, thla thieh kyh ta tlyma, Pahânoh kyh ta tlyma, ahy hmahta cha sei khah ei sy.
Chazy cha hmo vaw tlô awpazy nohpahlipa châ ta, a hmeiseihpa deikua cha Krista a châ.

Ahy hmahta areisina pakheipa nata vâlyuhchâpazy achhyna a duakheipa ta, nama lymâ hmô thei lei awpa ta cha tao khah ei sy. Cha hawpa chyhsa cha aluahna a hmôpazy kyh â kichopa ta reih tyh ta, a chhâpa y leipa ta sapa palôh ta thata â palai tyh.
Cha hawhpa chyhsa chata Luh cha khâchâ patu vei. Luh ta pôhpa pachiahpa a pazaopakhypazy chyh ta, Khazohpa khozie hawhta ama laiseih lymâ.
Khizaw hroziezy cha Krista liata nama thisai ha khiahta cha, khazia khizaw hrozie ta a hroh chypa hawhta, ryhpazy liata namâ ngiarih thlâh ha chy?
“Tao khah y, padi khah y, hria khah y” tahpa hawhpa ryhpazy liata a ngiarih thlâh chy ei chi ta,
cha hawhpa hmo zydua cha, chyhsapa ryhpa nata pachunazy liata a pahniehpa a châpa vâta, hmâ khai tawhta a leidia thlâh ha awpazy a châ.
Âmo khozie hawhta zyhna â taopa, areisina pakheipa nata sapa riepatheisapa hawhpazy he, sona hawhta a lâ hra sala, sapa aohraohna pakhâ nawpa châta phahnai hlei vei.
Krista hnohta pathyupa nama châ ha tawhta cha, Khazohpa chachâh lâta a tyuhpa Krista yna liata chô lâ hmozy tlua teh u.
Chô lâ hmozy liata nama palôh pachhô u la, alei hmozy liata pachhô khuh vy.
Thi ha ei chi ta, nama hrona cha Khazohpa liata Krista hnohta nyupa ta a y haw.
Krista eima hrona cha â vaw luah tita, nâmo chhao ano hnohta rônahpa ta namâ luah hra aw.
Chavâta khizaw hro nâmo liata a ypa, apatlana, puana, parâna, molei khona nata uahvana zy cha thie teh u. Uahvana cha nothlahpa achhyna a châ.
Cha hmozy vâna chata Khazohpa hiehâhna cha ngiapâleipazy chô liata a tlô hai.
Kha hlâta cha nâmo chhao, cha hmozy liana chata hroh ei chi ta, cha hmozy cha nama tao tyh.
Tahmâ deikua cha, hiehâhna, pathichhiena, ahaona, reipachhiena nata bie puapa zy nama pakah tawhta nama pahlei awpa a châ.
Nama chyhsa parohpa cha a hmotaopazy chhaota nama pahluh hapa vâta, haipa bie a chho raihrie khao khuh vy.
Chyhsa thiehpa ta a tobi ha ei chi ta, cha chyhsa thiehpa cha pahnona hnei awpa ta, ano taotuhpa lyupa ta tao pathipa ta a y lymâ.

Cha chyhsa thiehpa hro liana cha, Krikâh chyhsa nata Zu chyhsa tahpa tlyma, chopawtaipa nata chopawtaileipa tahpa tlyma, chi hnohkhawpa tahpa tlyma, Skythia mo tahpa hawhpa tlyma, sei tahpa tlyma, khotalaipa tahpa tlyma, y khao vei. Krista cha ato châ ta, ato liata a ypa a châ.
Chavâta Khazohpa chyhsa atlyhpa, mopathaihpa nata kho ngaitapazy nama châpa hawhta, thapasana palôh, nôphana, areisina, nônaina nata daotheina zy ta a tobi teh u.
A chhyh thai raihrie u la, nama likah liata biepeipa a y khiahta cha, a ngiahthai raihrie teh u. Abeipa ta a châ ngiahthai hapa hawh ei ta, nâmo chhao namâ ngiahthai hra awpa a châ.
Cha zydua hlâta a peimawh chaipa cha, kyhpachâna ta a tobi teh u. Kyhpachâna cha ato zydua a ryh ngaitapa ta a chahry pabaohtuhpa a châ.
Krista thlalôhna ta nama palôh liata ryureih mawh sy. Cha hawhta châ awpa ta pôhpa miakha liata awpa nama châ. Chavâta a ly teh u.
Krista bie cha nâmo liata biepakhôpa ta y mawh sy. Sona to ta a pachupa ta a chhorei raihrie u la, palôh alyna chôta, reithaina hlazy nata thlahpa hlazy Khazohpa lâ sa teh u.
Nama taopa maih, biereipa rai châ sala, hmotaopa rai châ sala, Abeipa Zisu moh ta ato tao u la, ano zawhzi ta Paw Khazohpa hnohta alyna bie reih tyh muh vy.
Lapinô saih u, Abeipa liata namâ ngiarihpa hawhta, nama vahpazy liata a ngiarih teh u.
Vahpa saih u, nama lapinôzy kyhpachâ u la, ama chô liata a hrâhraoh khuh vy.
Saw saih u, ato liata nama nôpawzy bie zyh teh u, cha cha Abeipa alynazie a châ.
Paw saih u, nama sawzy ru pachhô khuh vy, ama hnabei a dy pathlei aw na.
Sei saih u, ato liata, khizaw liata nama zibeipazy bie zyh teh u. Chyhsa palysa a chhuahpazy hawhta, ama mohmô lia dei ta chakao leipa u la, Abeipa china chôta, palôh hmeiseihpa ta chakao muh vy.
Nama taopa maih, chyhsapa châta taopa hawhta pachâ leipa ta, Abeipa châta taopa hawhta tlao pachâpa ta, palôh pha ngaitapa ta hria lymâ teh u.
Nama lymâ châta Abeipa tawhta ryuto a hmô awpa nama châpa pahnopa ta, Abeipa Krista a chakaopa nama châ.
Hmo doleipa a taopa cha, hmo doleipa a taopa mâ a hmô aw. Khokhei viapa y veih ei.
Zibeipa saih u, nâmo chhao avâ liata Zibeipa nama hnei tahpa pahnopa ta, nama seizy chô liata â do kawpa nata â raohâh kawpa ta tao muh vy.
Thlahchhâ lylia u la, nama thlahchhâna liana chata alyna bie reih u la, a hrohrua teh u.
Bâlia ei kyna chhâpa Krista bienyupa chho awpa ta, Khazohpa ta a bie châta ochhi miah a pahypa thei nawpa ta, thlah miah chhâpa u la,
ei rei awpa hawhta ei reih thei nawpa ta thlah na chhâpa teh u.
Rypaohna patu thai lymâpa ta, khôtho chyhsazy liata so ngaitapa ta y teh u.
Chyhsa to hnohta namâ chhyzie awpa nama pahno thei nawpa ta, nama reikah a puapa cha, khatino rai ta ngiachhiena ta bie sala, alôh hawhta iahpa châ lymâ mawh sy.
Abeipa liata unawh kho ngaitapa, chakaotuhpa ngâchhihpa nata chakaolâhpa Tykiku ta ei thâtih zydua a cha chho aw ei.
Eima duahmo vaw pahnopa ta, thlah a cha palôh thei nawpa ei ta, Tykiku cha nâmo lâ ei vaw tuah.
Ano hnohta nama chyhsa Ônesimâ, eima unawh ngâchhihpa nata kho ngaitapa ei vaw tuah hra. Âmo ta eima yna liata hmo yzie zydua ama cha chho khai aw.
Ei tâlâhpa Aristaku ta a châ naoh ei. Bânabâ tupapa Mâka chhao ta a châ naoh ei. Ano kyh liata pahnosana vaw dao ha ei chi ta, nâmo lâ â vy khiahta cha, a vaw ly muh vy.
Zisu, Zustâ ama tahpa chhao ta a châ naoh ei. Âmo deita he chopawtaipazy hry liata Khazohpa khinarâh châta ei hrialâhpazy châ ei ta, thlah nâ palôhtuhpazy ama châ.

Nama chyhsa Epâpharâ, Krista Zisu chakaotuhpa ta a châ naoh ei. Khazohpa khozie zydua liata pitlohpa nata tlokhuh a lôhpa ta, namâ duah thei nawpa ta, phahnai ngiah ngaitapa ta thlah a cha chhâpa tyh ei.
Nâmo châta nata Laodisi khih liata a ypazy châta nata Hirâpôli khih liata a ypazy châta hriapasa ngaitapa a châzie ei pahnokhei.
Dawhty kho ngaitapa Luka ta châ naoh ei ta, Demâ chhao ta a châ naoh ei.
Laodisi khih liata unawhzy kha nâ naohpa u la, Nypha nata a o liata a pakhypa Awnanopa chhao kha nâ naohpa muh vy.
He châpaphaopa he nama hry liata rei khaipa a châ tawhta, Laodisi Awnanopa chhao pareisa hra u la, nâmo chhao Laodisi mo hnohta ei châpaphaopa kha vaw reih hra muh vy.
Akhipâ kha, “Abeipa liata chakaona na hmôpa kha patlô a chhuah mah y,” tahpa ta vaw chho muh vy.
Kei, Pawla ta, he anaohna he keima ku tlai ta ei ropa a châ. Ei bâlia a kypa he a thei thlâh ha teh u. Ngiachhiena nama hnohta y mawh sy.
Pawla nata Silvanâ nata Timawthy ta Paw Khazohpa nata Abeipa Zisu Krista liata Thysalawnika Awnanopa eima châ naoh. Ngiachhiena nata thlalôhna nama hnohta y mawh sy.
Eima thlahchhânazy liata nama moh reipa ta, nama zydua châta Khazohpa hnohta alyna bie khâ eima reih tyh.
Ngiapâna vâta nama hmotaozie zy, kyhpachâna vâta nama hriapasazie zy, eima Beipa Zisu Krista liata hnabeiseihpa vâta nama tiamazie zy kha, eima Khazohpa nata Paw hmiakô liata khâ eimâ thei tyh.
Unawh kyhpachâ ngaitapa saih u, Khazohpa ta a châ tlyh ei tahpa eima pahno.

Thâtihpha nama hnohta eima vaw tlôkheipa kha, bie dei ta vaw tlôkhei leipa pi ta, hmotaotheina nata Thlahpa Pathaihpa nata ngiapâna a i ngaitapa chhaota eima vaw tlôkheipa a châ. Nama hry liata eima y nona kha, nâmo vâta kheihta ma eima y tahpa nama pahno.
Rietheina hluhpi taona chôta, Thlahpa Pathaihpa liata a lypa ta bie a pyh ei chi ta, keimo nata Abeipa hâ a latuhpazy nama vaw châ haw.
Mâsidônia nata Akai râh liata ngiapâtuhpa zydua châta a mopâ awpa nama vaw châ.
Abeipa bie cha nâmo tawhta Mâsidônia nata Akai râhzy liata a pathâhpa dei châ leipa ta, Khazohpa namâ ngiapâna kyh cha su to liata pathâh ta, chavâta keimo ta khâpa hmah eima rei awpa byuh khao vei.
Eima cha vaw tly nota miah namâ lyzie nata Khazohpa hrohpa nata dopa chakao awpa ta nothlahpazy tawhta Khazohpa lâ namâ heih hapa kyh miah chho ei ta,
vârâh tawhta a Sawchapawpa avyheihna a hâtuhpazy nama châzie miah ama chho. Ano cha Khazohpa ta athihpa hry tawhta a pathyupa Zisu kha châ ta, hiehâhna vaw tlô awpa tawhta miah a pachhatuhpa a châ.
Unawh saih u, eima cha vaw tlypa kha hraoleipa a châ leizie nâmo tlai ta nama pahno.

Nama pahnopa hawhta, Philipi khih liata riethei taopa ta nata maoh paphyuhsapa ta eima ypa chhao khata, eima Khazohpa ta riahphana miah pie ta, pakhâpadiena hluhpi hry liata nama hnohta Khazohpa thâtihpha eima cha vaw chho.
Eima châ hawna kha haiphiana bie tlyma, palôh pathaih leipa tawhta bie a puapa tlyma châ leipa ta, dôvei eima châ chhuahpa châ hra vei.
Thâtihpha pavaosa tlâhpa ta Khazohpa ta miah a raopa hawh tlai ta, chyhsa palysa a chhuah leipa ta, eima pathipalôh a pasiatuhpa Khazohpa palysa a chhuahpa ta, bie eima chho tyh.
Nama pahnopa hawhta, reithai pakheina biezy reih beih leipa pi ta, karâyna khu nawpa biezy reih beih hra ma pi. Khazohpa cha miah pahnokheituhpa a châ.
Krista lyuhchâpa eima châna tawhta palyupalihna a hnaw theipa châ hra sih la, nâmo tawhta tlyma, mohropazy tawhta tlyma, chyhsapa palyupalihna tlua beih ma pi.
Nô ta a sawzy a mohôhpa hawhta, nama hry liata nônaipa ta tlao eima y tyh.
Eima pasôpa nata kho ngaitapa nama vaw châ hapa vâta, Khazohpa thâtihpha dei châ leipa ta, eima hrona chhao taih cha pie awpa ta eimâ mâ thlâh hapa kha.
Unawh saih u, eima hriapasazie nata eima rietheizie zy kha namâ thei aw. Khazohpa thâtihpha eima cha chho nona kha, ahy phaohri hmah eima châ lei nawpa ta, chhô nah zâ ta eima hria tyh.
Nâmo cha ngiapâtuhpazy chô liata pathaihpa nata siapa nata seina hnei leipa ta eima y tyhzie miah pahnokheituhpazy nama châ. Khazohpa chhao ta miah a pahnokhei.
Paw ta a sawzy chô liata a taopa hawhta, nama chô liata eima taopa kha nama pahno.
A khinarâh nata a rônahna lâta nâmo châ awtuhpa Khazohpa chyhsa tlâh nama châ thei nawpa ta, cha pasyu pi ta, nama tha cha patlô pi ta, bie eima cha pie.

Keimo tawhta nama theipa Khazohpa bie namâ pyh nona kha, chyhsapa bie a pyhpa hawhta a pyh leipa ei chi ta, a châna dopa, Khazohpa bie hawhta namâ pyhpa vâta, Khazohpa hnohta alyna bie khâ eima reih tyh. Cha Khazohpa bie cha nâmo, ngiapâtuhpazy chô liata a hriapa cha a châ.

Unawh saih u, nâmo chhao, Zudia râh liata a ypa Krista Zisu liata Khazohpa Awnanopazy hawhta nama châ ha hih. Zuzy ku liata âmo pasa ama taopa hawhta, nâmo chhao nama râh chyhsazy ku liata pasa nama tao hra.
Cha Zuzy cha Abeipa Zisu nata hrohsopazy a thietuhpa châ ei ta, keimo chhao miah papua ei ta, Khazohpa palysa leipa ei ta, chyhsa zydua chakhiatuhpa ama châ.
Zenitaizy pachha ama châ thei nawpa ta ama hnohta bie chho awpa miah pakhâ ei ta, chatanachata ama moleina panuana ama pabie lymâ. Achhâna liata cha Khazohpa hiehâhna ama chô liata a vaw tlô haw.
Unawh saih u, bohpi leipa chhôh nâmo nata a chhaihpa ta y pi ta, palôh liata châ leipa ta, pôhpa ta eimâ chhaih chypa a châpa chhao ta, cha vâ ngaita pi ta, nama hmia hmô awpa eimâ chhuah via rili.
Nâmo lâ a vy awpa khoh kaw pi ta, kei, Pawla tlai chhao he a chhuah tyh na ta, châhrasala Sâtâ ta miah a pakhâ ha tyh.
Eima Beipa Zisu â vy tita a hmiakô liata eima hnabeiseihna, eimâ lyna nata eima rônahna lakho a châ awpazy cha khâpa ma a châ aw? Nâmo châ veih ei chi ma?
Nâmo he eima rônahna nata eimâ lyna awpa cha nama châ.
Eima tiama thei khao leipa vâta, Atheni khih liata miah ama siesai awpa a phapa ta pahno pi ta.
Chatanachata Krista thâtihpha liata eima unawhpa nata Khazohpa eima chakaolâhpa Timawthy cha, namâ ngiapâna pa-i awpa nata tha cha patlô awpa ei ta eima vaw tuah.
Pasa taonazy vâna heta ahy hmah a chalyu khuh vy. He hawhta pasa tao awpa ta raopa eima châ tahpa nâmo chhao ta nama pahno.
Nama hnohta eima y nona kha, pasa a tao awpa eima châzie cha chho tyh pi ta, nama pahnopa hawhta, cha hawhna tlai chata a vaw tlôpa a châ.

Cha vâna chata, reipasaotuhpa reipasaona vâta hmah eima hriapasana kha hraoleipa châ pathlei lah tahpa chi na ta, ei tao thei khao leipa vâta, namâ ngiapâna duahmo pahno awpa ta chyhsa ei vaw tuahpa a châ.

Chatanachata tahmâ Timawthy cha vaw tlô ta, namâ ngiapâna nata kyhpachâna thâtih lychhihpa miah a vaw tlôkhei. Khâ miah a thei ei chi ta, cha hmô awpa eima byuh kawpa hawhta, nâmo chhao miah hmô awpa nama byuh kawna thâtihzy miah a chho.
Cha vâna chata, unawh saih u, eima nôpona nata pasataona zydua hry liata, namâ ngiapâna vâta thlahpalôhpa ta eima y haw.
Abeipa liata â ipa ta namâ duapa vâta, tahmâ cha eima hro a pahâh ha bâ.
Nâmo vâta eima Khazohpa hmiakô liata eimâ lyna zydua vâna heta, Khazohpa lâta alyna bie rei tiah lei eimâ bâh.
Nama hmia hmô heih ta, ngiapâna liata namâ phahlanazy cha pazao awpa ta, chhô nah zâ ta phahnai khoh ngaitapa ta thlah eima chhâ lymâ.
Eima Paw Khazohpa nata eima Beipa Zisu ta nâmo lâ eimâ vy thei nawpa lâpi miah taopa mawh sy.

Kyh eima cha pachâpa hawhna heta, nâmo chhao chyhsa to kyh nama pachâ thei nawpa nata nâmo nata nâmo kyh namâ pachâ raihrie thei nawpa ta, Abeipa ta nama kyhpachâna papôhsa sala, kyhpachâna liata cha pahneirôhsa mawh ei sy.
Chatanachata eima Beipa Zisu cha a mopathaihpa zydua chhaota â vy tita, pathipalôh pathaihna kyh liata seina hnei leipa châ awpa ta, eima Khazohpa nata Paw hmiakô liata a cha paduasa aw ei.
Unawh saih u, achhâna liata cha, nama yzie awpa nata Khazohpa nama palysa nawpa kyh liata, keimo tawhta nama daopa, nama tao lymâpa kha tao via lymâ awpa ta Abeipa Zisu moh ta eima châ haw.
Abeipa Zisu biehneina hmâpa ta biepiepa eima cha piepazy kha nama pahno.
Nama pathaih awpa he Khazohpa khozie a châ. Apatlana moleina bâhsai ha muh vy.
Nama pôhpa cha pathaihpa nata zachhihpa châ awpa ta a vao pahniezie nama pahno chyu awpa a châ.
Khazohpa a pahno leipa Zenitaizy hawhta parâna liata a hmâh khuh vy.

He kyh liata ahy hmah a unawhpa chô liata moleipa ta hmopha leipa a tao awpa châ vei. Cha chho chhielie ha pi ta, a phapa ta zikyu eima châ râ hapa hawhta, Abeipa cha, cha hawhpa hmo a taotuhpa zydua chô liata phuh latuhpa a châ.
Apuapa ta y awpa ta Khazohpa ta miah aw leipa ta, pathaih awpa ta miah a aw.
Chavâta he hmo a papeisa leituhpa cha, chyhsa a papeisa leipa châ leipa ta, a Thlahpa Pathaihpa miah pietuhpa Khazohpa a papeisa leipa a châ.
Unawhzy kyhpachâna kyh liata, nama hnohta châpaphaopa ei ro awpa a ngiah veih ei chi. Kyh a pachâ raihrie awpa ta Khazohpa ta a cha pachu ei.
Cha tlai cha Mâsidônia râh liata unawh zydua chô liata nama taopa kha a châ. Châhrasala unawh saih u, kyhpachâna rai hria via lymâ awpa ta eima châ haw.
Eima cha chho hapa hawhta, a chalihpa ta hro a chhuah u la, nama rai chyu hriapa ta, nama ku tlai ta hria a chhuah teh u.
Chatanachata khôtho chyhsazy hmiakô liata zachhihna hlao aw ei chi ta, ahy hmah a ngâchhâ aw veih ei chi.
Unawh saih u, hnabeiseihna rai a hnei leipa mohropazy hawhta nama pachâ a rôh lei nawpa ta, a môpazy thâtih nama pahno lei awpa khoh ma pi.
Zisu thi ta a thyu heihpa eimâ ngiapâpa vâta, Zisu liata a môpazy cha Khazohpa ta ano hnohta â vaw chhi aw ei tahpa eimâ ngiapâ.
Cha cha Abeipa bie tawhta nama hnohta eima reipa kha a châ. Keimo Abeipa â vyna taihta ahrohpa ta a ypazy pi heta, a môpazy cha chhao cheita aw ma pi.
Abeipa cha rahaopa nata vâlyuhchâpa chônôchaipa ao nata Khazohpa chiahmie pyu chhaota avâ tawhta za chô aw ta, Krista liata athipazy cha ama thyu tua aw.
Cha hnôhlâ ta keimo ahrohpa ta a ypazy pi he, avâ ruapa meihdozy hry liana khita Abeipa dy awpa ta ama hnohta lapa châ aw pi ta, chhâzaw ta Abeipa hnohta eima y ha aw.
Chavâta cha biezy chata thlah a palôh raihrie teh u.
Châhrasala unawh saih u, a daihti nata nohzy kyh ropa awpa a ngiah veih ei chi.
Abeipa Noh cha zâ ta parutuhpa hawhta a vaw tlô aw tahpa nâmo tlai ta a sia kawpa ta nama pahno.
Chyhsazy ta, “Thlalôhna nata abohna,” tahpa ta ama rei hai nota, chanô saw zeihpa hawhta eikhapi ta leidiana ama chô liata vaw tlô aw ta, khôkhâh cheita aw veih ei.
Châhrasala unawh saih u, cha noh liata parutuhpa hawhta pachhai awpa ta, nâmo la zohna liata y veih ei chi.
Nama zydua ta khaihna sawzy nata noh sawzy nama châ. Zâ chyhsa châ leipa pi ta, zohna liata a ypa châ hra ma pi.
Chavâta mohropazy hawhta a mô leipa ta, a hra sih la, palôh pasohpa ta y ei suh u.
A môpazy cha zâ ta a mô tyh ei ta, sahma paripazy chhao zâ ta ama pari tyh.
Keimo deikua cha, noh chyhsazy eima châpa vâta, ngiapâna nata kyhpachâna chachôhna vyhphao a kypa ta, pachhana hnabeiseihna lakhu a khu sih la, palôh pasohpa ta y suh u.
Khazohpa ta hiehâhna pasa tao awpa ta miah rao leipa ta, eima Beipa Zisu Krista zawhzi ta pachhana hmô awpa ta tlao miah a rao.
Eimâ hrapa chhao ta, eimâ môpa chhao ta, a hnohta eima hro thei nawpa ta, Krista cha keimo châta a thipa a châ.
Chavâta nama tao tyhpa hawhta, a pasyu raihrie u la, tha a patlô raihrie tyh muh vy.
Unawh saih u, nama hry liata hriapasapazy nata Abeipa liata nama hyutuhpazy nata châ chhoreituhpazy za awpa ta eima châ haw.
Ama raihria vâta kyhpachâ ta pasô ngaita awpa ta eima châ haw hra. Adyryhpa ta y teh u.
Unawh saih u, thathipazy chhorei u la, palôh chhâpazy thapatlôpa ta, chiehleipazy bao u la, chyhsa zydua chô liata nôpha awpa ta eima châ haw.
Moleina cha moleina ta viarithô leipa u la, hmopha a taopa raihriepa ta, chyhsa to chô liata hmopha tao teh u.
Khâ a ly u la,
bâh leipa ta thlahchhâ u la,
kyh to liata alyna bie reih teh u. Cha cha nama châta Krista Zisu liata Khazohpa khozie a châ.
Thlahpa cha pachhai khuh vy.
Hrohsona biezy mohnao leipa u la,
ato pasiapa ta, a phapa maih a pyh u la,
moleina chi to a heihsai teh u.
Thlalôhna Khazohpa ta tlokhuh cha pathaisa ei sala, nama thlahpa, nama pathipalôh nata nama pôhpa cha, eima Beipa Zisu Krista â vy tita, seina hnei leipa ta cha paysa mawh ei sy.
Châ awtuhpa ei cha ngâ a chhih ta, cha cha a tao tlai aw.
Unawh saih u, thlah miah chhâpa teh u.
Unawh zydua kha apahnâna pathaihpa ta miah a naohpa muh vy.
He châpaphaopa he unawh zydua hnohta rei awpa ta, Abeipa moh ta bie ei cha pie ei.
Eima Beipa Zisu Krista ngiachhiena cha nama hnohta y mawh sy.
Pawla nata Silvanâ nata Timawthy ta Khazohpa eima Paw nata Abeipa Zisu Krista liata Thysalawnika Awnanopa eima châ naoh.
Khazohpa eima Paw nata Abeipa Zisu Krista tawhta ngiachhiena nata thlalôhna nama hnohta y mawh sy.

Unawh saih u, nâmo vâta Khazohpa hnohta alyna bie khâ a reih awpa eima châ. Cha cha eima tao awpa rai a châ. Ngiapâna kyh liata thata laiseih ei chi ta, kyh namâ pachâ raihriena mo to liata a pôh rili.
Chavâta taolana namâ tyhna nata pasa nama taona zydua liata nama pachyuzie nata nama ngiapâna zy kha, Khazohpa Awnanopazy hry liata eima châ palaikhei kaw tyh.
He he Khazohpa pachiana siazie â lâna a châ: Khazohpa khinarâh châta pasa a taopa nama châpa hawhta, Khazohpa khinarâh to tlâhpa ta raopa nama châ aw.
Khazohpa pachiana cha a do ta, nama rie châ patheituhpazy cha rietheina ta viari a thô aw.
Eima Beipa Zisu, a vâlyuhchâpa thatlôpazy chhaota meipaleih hry liata â vaw luah tita, keimo hawhta pasa a taopazy a cha pahâsa aw ei.
Khazohpa a pahno leipazy nata eima Beipa Zisu Krista thâtihpha a zyh leipazy chô liata deikua phuh a la aw.
Chhâzaw leidiana ta hriepa châ aw ei ta, Abeipa mohmô tawhta nata a thatlôna rônahpa tawhta papuapa ama châ aw.
Cha pachiana cha, a mopathaihpazy hry liata palyupalih awpa nata ngiapâtuhpa zydua hry liata noâh tah awpa ta â vyna noh liata a y aw. Nâmo deikua cha eimâ duakheipa bie a ngiapâtuhpazy nama châ.

Khazohpa ta a awpa nama châna a phuhpa ta nama y thei nawpa nata hmopha tao namâ chhuahpazy nata ngiapâna ta hmo nama taopazy cha, a hmotaotheina ta hlao a cha patlohsa thei nawpa ei ta, thlah khâ eima cha chhâpa tyh.
Chatanachata eima Khazohpa nata Abeipa Zisu Krista ngiachhiena lymâ hawhta, eima Beipa Zisu moh cha nâmo liata palyupalihpa ta y aw ta, nâmo chhao ano liata palyupalihpa ta nama y aw.
Unawh saih u, eima Beipa Zisu Krista avyna nata a hnohta lapakhypa ta eima y nawpa kyh liata, nâmo lâta ahawna ei tao.

Abeipa Noh cha a vaw tlô ha na, tahpa ta thlahpa ta reipa tlyma, bie ta reipa tlyma, keimo tawhta châpaphaopa hawhta reipa tlyma a y khiahta cha, nama palôh thlai a chalyu leipa sala, nama thlazoh hra khah sy.
Ahy hmahta kheihawhta hmah cha dôvei khah ei sy. Paosaina a vaw tlô ha tua leipa nata ryhpa paraotuhpa leidia sawchapawpa â vaw luah tua leipa ta cha, cha Noh cha vaw tlô aw vei.
Ano cha khazoh moh bipa nata a chhypa maih a dyuhpa ta, anosasyh â palyupalih aw. Khazohpa hawhta a phuah aw ta, Khazohpa Achhyna o liata a tyuh aw ta, Khazohpa hawhta â chaluah aw.
Nama hnohta ei y nota, he biezy ei cha chho tyhpa ei kha a thei thlâh ha veih ei chi ma?
Ano daihti liata â vaw luah thei nawpa ta, tahmâ cha pakhâpa ta a y chy tahpa nama pahno.
Ryhpa paraona bienyupa cha tahmâ chhao a hria pathao haw. Châhrasala lapa ta a y hlâlei cha, pakhâtuhpa ta a pakhâ chy aw.
Cha khai tawhta, ryhpa paraotuhpa cha a vaw luah aw ta, Abeipa Zisu ta ano cha a pakah hu ta thie aw ta, â vyna khaihna ta a pahleipadia aw.
Ryhpa paraotuhpa cha, hmotaotheina to nata ngiana nata hmonoâhpa ta dôveina to hmâpa ta, Sâtâ hmotaotheina chhaota â vy aw.
Leidia haipazy cha pachha châ nawpa biehmeiseihpa khoh leipa ta ama dythapa vâta, ryhpa paraotuhpa cha dôveina pha leipa to chhaota âmo lâ â vy aw.
Haipa bie ama zo thei nawpa ta, Khazohpa ta dôveina thatlô ngaitapa ama hnohta a vaw patlôsa.
Chatanachata biehmeiseihpa zo leipa ta, sialeina liata a lypa zydua cha, thailei pachâsapa ama châ khai aw.

Abeipa kyhpachâpa unawh kho ngaitapa saih u, Thlahpa Pathaihpa pathaisana nata biehmeiseihpa ngiapâna vâta pachha châna liata thei hmiatuapazy châ awpa ta, Khazohpa ta â tlyhpa nama châpa vâta, nâmo vâta Khazohpa lâ alyna bie khâ a reih awpa eima châ.
Eima Beipa Zisu Krista rônahna nama to thei nawpa ta, Khazohpa ta eima thâtihpha hmâpa ta a cha aw ei.
Chavâta unawh saih u, â ipa ta a duah u la, biereipa ta tlyma, châpaphaopa ta tlyma, hrozie awpa eima cha pachupa zydua kha khâchâ patu ha muh vy.
Eima Beipa Zisu Krista nata Khazohpa eima Paw, kyh miah pachâ ta, ngiachhiena vâta chhâzaw thlalôhna nata hnabeiseihna phapa miah pietuhpa ta
nama palôhzy thlah cha palôh ei sala, raihria phapa nata bie phapa to châta cha padua mawh ei sy.

Achhâna liata cha unawh saih u, Abeipa bie nama hry liata a chatliepa ta pathâh ta, palyupalihpa ta a ypa hawhna khata, pathâh via lymâ sala, palyupalihpa ta a y thei nawpa ta, thlah miah chhâpa muh vy.
Chyhsa zydua ngiapâtuhpa ama châ khai leipa vâta, chyhsa chhorupa nata moleipazy tawhta eimâ boh thei nawpa ta thlah miah chhâpa hra muh vy.
Châhrasala Abeipa cha ngâ a chhih ta, tha cha patlô aw ei ta, moleipa tawhta a cha pabohsa aw ei.
Bie eima cha piepazy zyh lymâ ei chi ta, nama zyh lymâ aw tahpa Abeipa liata eima cha ngâ.
Abeipa ta Khazohpa kyhpachâna nata Krista daotheina lâta nama palôhzy cha chhihtha mawh ei sy.
Unawh saih u, keimo tawhta pachuna bie nama daopa hawhta y leipa ta, thathipa ta a ypa unawh tawhta a panano awpa ta eima Beipa Zisu Krista moh ta bie eima cha pie.
Nama hnohta eima y nona kha, thathipa ta y beih ma pi. Chavâta eima hâ miah namâ lanazie awpa cha nâmo tlai ta nama pahno.
Ahy viahchhâ hmah a saipa ta nie beih leipa pi ta, ahy phaohri hmah eima châ lei nawpa ta, chhô nah zâ ta hria pi ta, riethei taopa nata hriapasapa ta eima y tyh.
Miah chyh awpa ta nâmo châ hnaw theina eima hnei leipa vâta châ leipa ta, eima hâ miah a la awpa eima cha khokheipa vâta rai eima hriapa a châ.
Nama hnohta eima y nona chhao khata, “Rai a hria khoh leipa cha, a nie chhao nie khah sy,” tahpa ta bie eima cha pie khawh.
Nama hry liata thokha cha thathipa ta ama y tahpa thâtih eima thei. Rai hria leipa ta ychakhyh ei ta, chyhsa a patypamâpazy ama châ.
Cha hawhpa chyhsazy cha, a thlih thlâh hapa ta ama rai hria ei sala, ama nie awpa hria papua awpa ta Abeipa Zisu Krista moh ta biepie pi ta, eima pasyu.
Unawh saih u, nâmo deikua cha, hmo pha tao ai khuh vy.
Ahy rai, he châpaphaopa liata eima bie a zyh vei khiahta cha, cha chyhsa cha ngia u la, nozapa ta a y thei nawpa ta, a pahlao khuh vy.
Khakhaipa hawhta deikua moh leipa u la, unawh hawhta zikyu a râ muh vy.
Thlalôhna Beipa ta kyh to liata thlalôhna cha pie lymâ mawh ei sy. Abeipa cha nama zydua hnohta y mawh sy.
Kei, Pawla ta, keima ku tlai ta, he anaohna châ he ei ropa a châ. He he ei châpaphaopa to liata ngiana châ ta, he he ei ro tyhzie a châ.
Eima Beipa Zisu Krista ngiachhiena nama zydua hnohta y mawh sy.
Kei, Pawla, Khazohpa miah Pachhatuhpa nata Krista Zisu eima hnabeiseihna biepiepa hawhta Krista Zisu lyuhchâpa ta
ngiapâna liata ei sawchapaw hmeiseihpa Timawthy ei châ naoh. Paw Khazohpa nata Krista Zisu eima Beipa tawhta ngiachhiena, zawngiahna nata thlalôhna na hnohta y mawh sy.
Mâsidônia râh lâ ei sie nota, nâ cha Ephesi khih liata châh ta, chyhsa thokhazy hnohta biezyhpa nanopa pachu lei awpa ta biepie awpa ta châ haw na ta.

Phôhpa nata thyutôna kyh a laichadai tiah leipazy reina liata ngosiah thlâh lei awpa ta biepie awpa ta ei châ haw hra. Cha hawhpa biezy reipa cha ngiapâna kyh liata Khazohpa raihria thapatlôtuhpa châ leipa ta, aeichhiana a taotuhpa tlao a châ.
Kha hawhta bie eima cha piena chhâpa cha, palôh pathaihpa, chhie nata pha pahnona pathaihpa nata ngiapâna hmeiseihpa tawhta a vaw puapa kyhpachâna ama hnei thei nawpa ta a châ.
Chyhsa thokha cha, chazy vâta pavia ei ta, hraoleipa biezy reina lâta ama tlei tyh.
Pahnopasia tlôh leipa ta bie reih ei ta, riahpha kawpa ta bie a duakheipa ta, ryhpa pachutuhpazy châ awpa ama khoh.
Ryhpa cha, chyhsa ta a phapa ta a hmâh khiahta cha, a pha tahpa eima pahno.

Ryhpa cha chyhsa dopazy châta taopa châ leipa ta, ryhpa â papeisa leipa nata reingiah leipazy, Khazohpa a pachâ leipa nata moleipazy, pathaih leipa nata zyhna kyh a pachâ leipazy, nô nata paw a thiepazy, lianycheihpazy,

apatlana moleina a taopazy, chapaw nata chapaw a patlapazy, sei patupa nata zuapa ta sôhpaliepazy, haihthaipazy, haipa ta bie a taihpazy nata biezyhpa dopa a chakhiapa maih châta taopa a châ tahpa pahno teh u.
Cha ryhpa cha reithai tlâh Khazohpa thâtihpha rônahpa, kei liata pavaosapa nata â hmiepa ta taopa a châ.
Ngâchhihpa ta na pachâ ta, ano chakao awpa ta na rao ta, thatlôna nâ pietuhpa eima Beipa Krista Zisu hnohta alyna bie ei reih.
Kha hlâta reipachhietuhpa, taolatuhpa nata pasipasawhtuhpa vaw châ hraw sah la, ngiapâleina vâta pahno leipa ta a taopa ei châpa vâta, zawngiahna ei hmô.
Chatanachata eima Beipa ngiachhiena cha Krista Zisu liata a ypa ngiapâna nata kyhpachâna chhaota ei chô liata lei thlupa ta a y.
Krista Zisu cha moleipazy pachha awpa ta khizaw lâta â zu tahpa he, bie ngâchhihpa nata a pyh tlâh ngaitapa a châ. Kei he moleipazy hry liata molei chaipa ei châ hih.
Châhrasala cha vâna tlai chata zawngiahna hmô na ta, Krista ta keima molei chaipa chô liata a nôphana pakipa palâsa ta, cha cha chhâzaw hrona hmô awpa ta ano a ngiapâpazy châta pamosana a châ.
Chhâzaw Beipa, thi thei leipa, hmô thei leipa nata Khazohpa a y chhôhpa hnohta chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta palyupalihna nata rônahna y mawh sy. Amen.
Ei saw Timawthy y, nâma kyh liata hrohsona bie phuah chhieliepa hawhna khata, adyuhna phapa ta nâ dyuh thei nawpa ta, he biepiepa he na chô liata ei pahnieh.
Ngiapâna nata chhie nata pha pahnona pathaihpa khâchâ patu mah y. Chyhsa thokha ta chazy cha dytha ei ta, balyh raopa hawhta, amâ ngiapâna ama parao haw.
Chazy hry liata Humenia nata Alezandâ a hlao ei ta, Khazohpa reipachhiepa a peizie amâ chu thei nawpa ta, Sâtâ hnohta ei hlâ ha ei.
A hmiatua ta, hmo hiapa thlahchhânazy, thlahchhâna sôpipazy, chyhsa châta thlahchhâna nata alyna bie reina thlahchhânazy chyhsa zydua châta tao awpa ta ei châ haw ei.
Thlalôhpa nata chhôhmohpa ta ypa ta, Khazohpa a pachâpa nata zachhihpazy eima châ lymâ thei nawpa ta, beizy nata biehneituhpa zydua châta thlahchhâ tyh awpa ta ei châ haw ei.
Cha cha miah Pachhatuhpa Khazohpa mohmô ta pha ta, â lyzie a châ.
Khazohpa ta chyhsa zydua pachha ama châ khai awpa nata biehmeiseihpa ama pahno khai awpa a khoh.
Khazohpa cha pakha deita y ta, Khazohpa nata chyhsazy likah liata lyuhchâpa pakha deita a y. Ano cha chyhsapa ta a pihpa Krista Zisu a châ.
Krista Zisu cha chyhsa zydua chatlai nawpa ta anosasyh ta a pie ta, a daihtita liata chatlaina bie a phuah haw.
Cha châna chata biechhotuhpa nata lyuhchâpa ta raopa châ na ta, biehmeiseihpa nata ngiapâna kyh liata Zenitaizy pachutuhpa ta raopa ei châ. Biedopa ei reih, haih va na.
Chapawzy cha su to liata ku pathaihpa avâ lâ pazawhpa ta, hiehâh leipa nata a eichhia leipa ta thlah ama chhâ tyh awpa ei khoh.

Cha hawhna chata chanôzy chhao â daihpa rakha ta a tobiepa ta, mongiapa nata zachhihpa ta y ei sala ei khoh. Sâ phiehpa ta tlyma, ngôh ta tlyma, taikulô ta tlyma, chysia mâ rupa ta tlyma a tobi leipa ta,
Khazohpa a uasapa chanôzy châta a tobi awpa rakhapa ta a tobipa ta, hmo pha taopa ta tlao amâ tobi awpa ei khoh.
Chanô cha reingiahpa nata a chalihpa ta a chu mawh sy.
Chanô ta a pachu awpa tlyma, chapaw chô liata bie a hnei awpa tlyma pasaih va na. A chalihpa ta a y awpa tlao a châ.
Âdâh kha tao tuapa châ ta, cha hnôhlâ ta Evâ kha taopa a châ.
Âdâh kha dôpa ta y leipa ta, chanô kha dôpa ta y ta, paraona liata a paopa kha a châ.
Châhrasala ngiapâna nata kyhpachâna nata pathaihna hneipa ta, hrozie ngiapa ta ama hroh khiahta cha, saw sana vâta pachhapa ama châ aw.
Ahy rai Awnanopa chhituhpa châ awpa a khoh khiahta cha, raihria phapa a khoh, tahpa cha bie ngâ tlâhpa a châ.
Awnanopa chhituhpa cha seina hnei leipa, lapinô pakha a hneipa, a sohsi theipa, sasyh a vao pahniepa, zachhihpa, chyhsa papyupahly a thaipa, a pachu theipa,
kresawhti pari hmâh leipa, thachahra hmâh leipa chyhsa nônaipa, ahryuchhiana a tao leipa nata tâkâ sôh liata karâ y leipa a châ awpa a châ.
A chhôhkha khihsatôhtu a phapa ta mohôh thei ta, a sawzy ta zapa ta a rei amâ ngiahpa a châ awpa a châ.
Ano chhôhkha khihsatôhtuna hmahta a phapa ta a mohôh thei vei khiahta cha, kheihta ma Khazohpa Awnanopa cha a mohôh thei aw?
Ngiapâ thiehpa chyhsa a châ awpa châ vei. Chataleipatala a palai aw ta, ahripa thailei pachâsana liata a pao pathlei aw.
Cha dei châ vei, khôtho chyhsazy lia chhao ta moh phapa a châ awpa a châ. Chataleipatala reipachhiepa ta y aw ta, ahripa khoheih liata â ao pathlei aw.
Cha hawhna chata chakaotuhpazy chhao chyhsa zachhihpa, haipa bie a reih leipa, kresawhti parâ leipa nata avyuhna ta athôhna a tlua leipa ama châ awpa a châ.
Chhie nata pha pahnona pathaihpa hmâpa ta, ngiapâna bienyupa khâchâ a patupa ama châ awpa a châ.
Pasiapa châ tua ei sala, seina hnei leipa ama châ khiahta cha, chakaotuhpa rai cha hria mawh ei sy.
Cha hawhna chata chanôzy chhao chyhsa zachhihpa, chyhsa kyh a reih leipa, a sohsi theipa nata ato liata ngâchhihpa ama châ awpa a châ.
Chakaotuhpazy cha lapinô pakha dei a hneipa ama châ awpa châ ta, ama sawzy nata ama chhôhkha khihsatôhtuna a phapa ta mohôh theipa ama châ awpa a châ.
Chakaona rai a phapa ta a hriapa chakaotuhpazy cha, moh phana to aw ei ta, Krista Zisu ngiapâna kyh liata riahphana thata ama hnei aw.
Nâ lâ a vy patoh awpa ei chhuah. He hmozy kyh liata châpaphaopa ei vaw rona chhâpa deikua cha,

vaw hawh pathlei mawh sah la, Khazohpa chhôhkha liata kheihta y awpa ma a châ tahpa na pahno thei nawpa ta ei vaw ropa a châ. Khazohpa chhôhkha cha Khazohpa hrohpa Awnanopa châ ta, cha cha bie hmeiseihpa tôh nata abôna a châ.

Khazohpa pahnona bienyupa cha a rônah ngaita, reipasipasua awpa y vei: Sapa ta a vaw luah ta, Thlahpa ta thai pachâsa ta, Vâlyuhchâpazy ta ama hmô. Phopizy hry liata phuahpa châ ta, Khizaw ta a ngiapâ ta, Rônahpa ta chô lâ a chhipa a châ.
Hmialâ daihti vaw tlô awpa liata cha, chyhsa thokhazy ta dôveina thlahpa nata ahripazy pachuna bie zopa ta, ngiapâna ama bâhsai aw tahpa Thlahpa ta a siapa ta a reih.
Cha hawhpa pachunazy cha phapakheipa haihthaipazy tawhta vaw pua ta, ama chhie nata pha pahnona cha thua sahpa ta pakâ hapa hawhta a châ.
Nôvah ahneina pakhâ ei ta, biehmeiseihpa pahnotuhpa nata ngiapâtuhpazy ta alyna bie reina chôta nie awpa Khazohpa ta a taopa niedozy nie lei awpa ta bie ama pie.
Khazohpa hmotaopa to cha pha ta, alyna bie reina chôta daopa a châ khiahta cha, khâpa hmah dytha awpa châ vei.
Khazohpa bie nata thlahchhâna ta pathaisa hapa a châ.
Chazy cha unawhzy na pahnosa khiahta cha, Krista Zisu chakaotuhpa phapa, ngiapâna bie nata biezyhpa phapa pachuna liata a laiseihpa na châ aw.
Khazohpa nata a zao leipa phôhpa thlâhthlipazy nata nôpipazy biephôh liata pahâh leipa la, Khazohpa chyhsa châ awpa ta nâmasasyh ta a hrie mah y.
Pôhpa a hriepa he phahnaina rakha hnei ta, Khazohpa chyhsa châna deikua cha, tahmâ hro nata hro a vaw y awpa châta bietai a hneipa a châpa vâta, kyh to liata a phahnai.
Cha bie cha ngâ a chhih ta, a pyh tlâh a châ ngaita.
Khazohpa hrohpa liata eima hnabeiseihna eima sopa vâta, hriapasa pi ta, eima tei lylia. Ano cha chyhsa zydua Pachhatuhpa châ ta, ano ngiapâtuhpazy Pachhatuhpa a châ pachai.
He biezy he pie la, pachu mah y.

Thyutliapa na châpa vâta ahy hmahta cha mohnao khah ei sy. Bie rei kyh liata zy, yzie kyh liata zy, kyhpachâna kyh liata zy, ngiapâna nata pathaihna kyhzy liata ngiapâtuhpazy a mopâ awpa ta tlao y mah y.
Ei vy hlâlei zawpi hry liata Biehrai reina, pasyuna nata pachuna raizy tiamapa ta vaw hria mah y.
Hmopiepa na hneipa kha uasa leipa ta y khah y. Kha hmopiepa kha, hrohsona bie hawhta, machâzy ta na chô liata ama ku ama pahnieh nota piepa na châ.
Chyhsa zydua ta na hmasiena ama hmô thei nawpa ta, hmopiepazy cha hmâh la, cha chakaona liata a hmâh khai mah y.
Na hro nata na pachuna biezy a phapa ta vaih mah y. Cha hawhta na tao khiahta cha, nâ nata na bie a theituhpazy na pachha aw ei.
Pawhrâhpa cha ra leipa la, paw hawhta pasyu la, chapaw thyutliazy cha unawhzy hawhta moh mah y.
Nôhrâhpazy nô hawhta moh la, chanô thyutliazy cha sietanôzy hawhta pathaih kawpa ta moh mah y.
Nôhmei hmeiseihpazy cha za mah y.

Châhrasala nôhmei cha sawzy tlyma, samohzy tlyma a hnei khiahta cha, Khazohpa chyhsa ama châna cha ama chhôhkha liata palâsa ei sala, ama nôpawzy chyh awpa ta a chu tua mawh ei sy. Cha cha Khazohpa alynazie a châ.
Nôhmei hmeiseihpa, ano dei ta a ypa cha, Khazohpa chô liata hnabeiseihna a sohpa châ ta, chhô nah zâ ta hiapa nata thlahchhâpa ta a y tyh.
Sapa lôhrâtlôna châta a hrohpa nôhmei deikua cha, a hroh thlâhpa chhao ta a thipa a châ.
Seina hnei leipa ta ama y thei nawpa ta, cha biezy cha pie hra mah y.
Sanawh a chyh leipa chyhsa, a eih pachaipa ta a chhôhkhazy a chyh leipa chyhsa cha, ngiapâna a paphasaipa châ ta, ngiapâleipa hlâ chhao ta a chhie via.
Nôhmei cha kô sycharu chô lâ chanô châ sala, vahpa pakha dei a vaw hneipa,

a sawzy a mohôhpa, khichhai a pasôpa, mopathaihpazy phei a pasipa, chyhsa nôpopazy a deichhypa nata hmo pha to taona liata a hmâhpa, hmo pha taona kyh liata reithai a hlaopa a châ khiahta cha, nôhmeizy hry liata pahlaopa châ mawh sy.
Nôhmei hawti viapazy deikua cha, nôhmei hry liata pahlao khah y. Krista châta amâ piena hlâta ama sapa khona a vaw lai via nahta, vahpa hnei awpa ama khoh tyh.
Amâ ngiapâ tuana ama siesaipa vâta thaileichâpa ta ama y tyh.
Cha dei châ vei, thathipa ta y ei ta, o to ta amâ khiekhâ tyh. Ama thathipa dei châ leipa ta, chyhsa kyh reih ei ta, biethâhzy taopa ta, rei lei awpazy ama reih tyh.
Chavâta nôhmei hawti viapazy cha, dyhchâ ei sala, sawzy hneipa ta, ama chhôhkhazy mohôh ei sala, sei nawpa rypaohpa khakhaipa hnohta ama pie lei awpa ei khoh.
Tahmâ tlai chhao he thokha cha Sâtâ lâ ama tlei haw.
Ngiapâtuhpa chanô ta sanawh nôhmeizy a hnei khiahta cha, âmo cha ano ta deichhy mawh sy. Awnanopa phao a pahri awpa châ vei. Chatanachata Awnanopa ta nôhmei hmeiseihpazy a deichhy thei aw.
Awnanopa chhituh phapa, a eih pachaipa ta biechhona nata pachuna liata hriapasapazy cha, a lie no ta palyupalih tlâh ama châ.
Biehrai ta, “Viahchao tôhpa ta sâh a tly nota a hmao nama hi awpa châ vei,” tah ta, “Raihriatuhpa cha hlao hmô tlâh a châ,” a tah hra.
Awnanopa chhituhpa leihna cha, pahnotuhpa pano tlyma, pathôh tlyma ama y leipa khiahta cha, nâ pyh awpa châ vei.
Moleina taotuhpazy cha, zawpi hmiakô liata chhorei la, chatanachata mohropazy chhao ta ama chi aw.
He ryhpazy he thailei pachâsa chhieliena y leipa ta, khokhei eih viapa hnei hra leipa ta hmâh awpa ta, Khazohpa nata Krista Zisu nata vâlyuhchâpa atlyhpazy mohmô liata bie ei cha pie.
Chyhsa chô liata ku pahnieh awpa ta a para leipa la, mohropazy moleina liata a hlao leipa la, pathaihpa ta y mah y.
Ti deita doh khao leipa la, na pavyhpi châta nata na pasa tyhpa vâta, kresawhti chhao a chyhta do tyh mah y.
Chyhsa thokha moleina cha a lâluah ta, ama hmia lâta pachiana lâ sie ta, thokha moleina deikua cha, hnôh lâta â vaw luah tyh.
Cha hawhna chata, hmo phapa cha a lâluah ta, a lâ mah leipazy chhao nyu theipa châ vei.
Khazohpa moh nata a pachunazy reipachhiepa ta a y lei nawpa ta, sei raopaky a kypazy ta ama zibeipazy cha za tlâhpa ta ama pachâ awpa a châ.

Ngiapâtuhpa zibeipa a hneipazy ta, Krista liata unawh ama châpa vâta, ama zibeipazy ama hno awpa châ leipa ta, ama chakaona a thôhkheituhpazy cha ngiapâtuhpa nata kho ngaitapazy ama châpa vâta, a pha viapa ta ama chakao rili awpa a châ. He biezy he pachu la pasyu mah y.
Ahy rai biezyhpa hropa pachupa ta, eima Beipa Zisu Krista biedopa nata Khazohpa khozie hawhta hroh awpa pachunazy â pyh vei khiahta cha,

apalaina ta a biepa châ ta, khâpa hmah a pahno leipa a châ. Aeichhiana nata ahryusina a y thei awpa biezy hrukhei ei ta, chazy chata uahvana, atudaina, reipachhiena nata ngâleina hmo pha leipazy a paysa tyh.

Chyhsa nata chyhsa likah liata bie pha leipa a tu tyhpa châ ei ta, cha hawhpa chyhsazy cha palôh chhiepa, biehmeiseihpa liata a duah leipa, Khazohpa lâ hmo pachâpa cha athôhna khiah ma a tahpazy ama châ.
Khazohpa khozie hawhta hroh ta, hneipa rakha liata palôhtlâh a paohpa he athôhna rônahpa a châ.
Khizaw liata khâpa hmah a ngiakhei leipa pi ta, khizaw tawhta khâpa hmah puakhei thei hra ma pi.
Nie awpa nata chysia a tao awpa eima hnei khiahta cha, chazy liana chata palôhtlâh a paoh ei suh u.

Hneirôh a chhuahpazy ta reipasaona liata a ngia ei ta, khoheih liata amâ ao tyh. Âmo a parao thei awpa hmozy khoh ei ta, hru kawpa ta hmo taopa ta, ama pao tyh. Hneirôh khona ta chyhsazy cha raona nata leidiana liata a pamôh tyh ei.
Tâkâ sôh kyh liata karâyna cha moleina to thabypa a châ. Thokha sôh tlaichhaina vâta ngiapâna paviasai ei ta, pachârôhna hluhpi taopa ta, âmosasyh amâ pasasa tyh.
Nâ, Khazohpa chyhsa y, cha hmozy cha a râsai la, siana, Khazohpa pachâna, ngiapâna, kyhpachâna, daotheina nata nônaina zy a chadai lymâ mah y.
Ngiapâna ta adyuhna phapa a dyuh la, chhâzaw hrona patu mah y. Cha cha to awpa ta awpa châ chi ta, pahnotuhpa hluhpi hmiakô liata a phapa ta nâ duakheipa kha a châ.
Hmo to hrona a pietuhpa Khazohpa nata Pawtia Pilâ hmiakô liata biedopa a duakheituhpa Krista Zisu mohmô liata bie ei cha pie.
Eima Beipa Zisu Krista â vaw luah heih hlâlei cha, biepiepa kha apuapa kiah leipa nata seina hnei leipa ta zyh mah y.
Reithai tlâh Khazohpa nata ato chô liata biehneituhpa a y chhôhpa, beizy Beipa nata zibeizy Zibeipa ta eima Beipa Zisu Krista cha a daihtita liata a vaw paluahsa aw.

Ano deita cha thi thei leina hnei ta, khaihpa a hnia thei rimâ leipa liata a pahrâ. Ano cha ahy hmah hmô beih leipa nata hmô thei leipa a châ. Khazohpa hnohta palyupalihna nata hmotaotheina chhâzaw ta y mawh sy. Amen.

He khizaw liata hneirôhpazy cha a palai lei awpa nata a leidia theipa sôh nata piah liata ama hnabeiseihna pachhô leipa ta, eimâ ly nawpa ta ato miah pietuhpa Khazohpa liata ama hnabeiseihna tlao pachhô awpa ta biepie mah y.
Hmopha ama tao awpa châ ta, hmopha taona liata hneirôhpa ta, riaphapa ta, ama hneina mohropazy amâ chhaih hra awpa a châ.
Chatanachata daihti vaw tlô awpa liata ama ryuto châta lôbô phapa a bô aw ei ta, hrona hmeiseihpa cha ama patu thei aw.

Hy Timawthy, na mohôh awpa ta nâ liata pavaosapa kha a phapa ta vaih mah y. Â doleipa ta “pahnona” ama tahpa Khazohpa a hlao leipa bie sisaw leipa reipa nata saizie a lyu leipa hmozy liata aeichhianazy a hneisai tyh mah y.
Cha cha thokhazy ta zi ei ta, ngiapâna ama paviasai haw. Ngiachhiena na hnohta y mawh sy.
Pawla, Krista Zisu liata hrona a ypa bietai hawhta Khazohpa khozie ta Krista Zisu lyuhchâpa ta
ei saw kho ngaitapa Timawthy ei châ naoh. Khazohpa Paw nata Krista Zisu eima Beipa tawhta ngiachhiena, zawngiahna nata thlalôhna na hnohta y mawh sy.
Ei thlahchhânazy liata chhô nah zâ ta khâ châ thei tyh na ta, nâ pathlatuhpazy taozie hawhta, chhie nata pha pahnona siapa ta ei chakaopa Khazohpa hnohta nâma vâta alyna bie ei reih tyh.
Na mothlihzy kha a thei thlâh ha na ta, alyna ta biepa ta ei y thei nawpa ta, cha hmô awpa ei khoh ngaita.
Ngiapâna hmeiseihpa a hneipa na châzie ei pahno. Cha ngiapâna cha na manô Lôisi liata y tua ta, na nô Unisi liata y heih ta, tahmâ nâma liata chhao a y tahpa a siapa ta ei pahno.
Cha vâna chata na chô liata ei ku pahniehpa ta Khazohpa hmopiepa nâ liata a ypa kha, pa-ia awpa ta ei cha pahnosa heih.
Khazohpa ta china thlahpa miah pie leipa ta, hmotaotheina nata kyhpachâna nata pachâna pasohpa hneina thlahpa tlao miah a pie.
Chavâta eima Beipa bie pahnotuhpa châpa cha zakhei khah y. Kei ano vâta atâhpa chhao he na zakhei hra leipa la, Khazohpa hmotaotheina ta thâtihpha châta pasa tlao na taokhei mah y.

Ano cha eima hmotaopazy vâta châ leipa ta, a hmochhuahpa nata a ngiachhiena vâta miah pachha ta, awna pathaihpa ta miah awtuhpa a châ. Cha ngiachhiena cha khizaw y hlâta Krista Zisu liata miah a pie haw.
Cha ngiachhiena cha miah Pachhatuhpa Krista Zisu â vaw luahna liata tahmâ palâsapa ta a y haw. Krista cha thina pahlei ta, thâtihpha vâta hrona nata thi thei leina a vaw tlôkheituhpa a châ.
Cha thâtihpha châta biechhotuhpa nata lyuhchâpa nata pachutuhpa ta raopa ei châ.
Cha vâna chata he hmozy chhao he pasa ei tao. Châhrasala ei noza vei. Ei ngiapâpa cha pahno na ta, ano ei pavaosapazy cha, cha noh châta â bohpa ta a vaih thei tahpa a siapa ta ei pahno.
Krista Zisu liata a ypa ngiapâna nata kyhpachâna hneipa ta, siezie awpa biedopa kei tawhta na theipazy kha zi mah y.
Keimo liata a pahrâpa Thlahpa Pathaihpa hmâpa ta, na hnohta pavaosapa hmo phapa kha vaih mah y.
Asia râh liata a ypa zydua ta einâ heihsai ha ei tahpa pahno chi ta, ama hry liata Phukelâ nata Hamôkene zy amâ hlao hra.
Abeipa ta Ônesiphôrâ chhôhkhazy hnohta zawngiahna pie mawh sy. Ano cha ei hro na pathieh heih tyh ta, ei bâlia a kypazy he na zakhei vei.
Rawma khih a vaw tlô nona kha, thata na tlua ta, einâ vaw hmô.
Ephesi khih liata kyh to liata eina chakaozie chhao kha a siapa ta nama pahno. Cha noh liata Abeipa tawhta zawngiahna hmô awpa ta, Abeipa ta ano cha pasai mawh sy!
Chavâta nâ, ei saw y, Krista Zisu liata ngiachhiena a ypa liata thatlôpa ta y mah y.
Pahnotuhpa hluhpi hmiakô liata ei bie reipa na theipazy kha, mohropazy a pachu pachhuah thei awpa chyhsa ngâchhihpazy ku liata pavaosa mah y.
Krista Zisu pheisaih phapa hawhta rietheina tao mah y.
Pheisaih ahy hmahta a dyuh nota hrochhôh khihsana a tymâkhei beih leipa ta, pheisaih châ awpa ta a tlyhtuhpa palysa tlao â chhuah.
Ataopasuana liata, chyhsa ta dâh hawhta a tei leipa khiahta cha, pahniena lakho pakho theipa châ vei.
Lyutaopa hriapasapa cha a thei a nie tua awpa a châ.
Ei biereipa he pachâ la, Abeipa ta kyh to liata novâhna a cha pie aw.
Ei thâtihpha reipa hawhta, athihpa hry tawhta a thyu heihpa, Dâvi pathla Zisu Krista a thei thlâh ha mah y.
Cha thâtihpha vâna chata pasa tao na ta, moleipa hawhta bâlia ta chahrypa ei châ. Châhrasala Khazohpa bie cha chahry theipa châ vei.
Chavâta atlyhpazy ta Krista Zisu liata a ypa pachhana cha, chhâzaw rônahna chhaota ama hmô thei nawpa ta, âmo châta ato pasa ei tao lylia.
He bie he ngâ â chhih: A thina liata eima thi khiahta cha, A hrona liata eima hroh hra aw;
Pasa eima tao khiahta cha, A hnohta ryu eima reih hra aw; Ano eimâ paphasai khiahta cha, Ano chhao ta miah â paphasai hra aw;
Keimo ngâchhih vei hra sih la, Ano cha ngâ a chhih ta, Anosasyh a paphasai thei vei.
He biezy he âmo pahnosa heih la, phahnaina hnei tlôh leipa ta nathlietuhpazy a parao tyhpa biezy liata a eichhia lei awpa ta biepie mah y.
Biehmeiseihpa â do ngaitapa ta a siekheipa raihriatuhpa cha, noza awpa a châ leipa hawhta, a pyh tlâhpa ta Khazohpa hmiakô liata nâ duah thei nawpa ta, na theina zydua papua mah y.
Khazohpa a hlao leipa bie sisaw leipa reipazy a hneisai mah y. Cha hawhpa biezy chata chyhsazy Khazohpa pachâ leina lâ a chhi via rili aw ta,
ama bie cha hmahchhiepa hawhta a kawh lymâ aw. Chazy hry liata Humenia nata Philetâ zy amâ hlao hra.
Biehmeiseihpa paviasai ei ta, thyuheihna a y haw tah ei ta, chyhsa thokha ngiapâna ama parao.
Châhrasala, “Abeipa ta ano eihzy a pahno,” tahpa nata “Abeipa moh a padopa maih moleina siesai mawh sy,” tahpa ta chahnao pa-ipa ta, Khazohpa lôbô a ipa cha â duah thlâh haw.
O rônahpa liata tâkâ nata ngôh ta taopa hmobaohzy dei y leipa ta, tho nata beihlei ta taopazy chhao a y. Thokha sôh via ta, thokha a sôh lei via.

Chavâta chyhsa ta hmobaoh sôh lei viapazy tawhta anosasyh â pathaisa khiahta cha, hmobaoh sôhpa vaw châ aw ta, hmobaoh pathaihpa châ awpa ta pananopa, Abeipa hmâ tlâhpa nata raihria phapa to châta a mâ chiehpa ta a ypa a châ aw.
Thyutlia aohraohnazy a râsai la, palôh pathaihpa ta Abeipa padotuhpazy hry liata a hlaopa ta, siana, ngiapâna, kyhpachâna nata thlalôhna zy a chadai lymâ mah y.
Aeichhiana hrupa nata phahnai leipazy cha ahryusina a papua tyh tahpa pahno chi ta, chavâta cha hawhpa liata a hlaohli khah y.
Abeipa chakaotuhpa cha, a chô liata hmo pha leipa a tlôpazy dao thei ta, chyhsa a hryuh leipa ta, chyhsa to chô liata phana palâsa ta, Khazohpa bie a pachu theipa a châ awpa a châ.
Khazohpa ta ano a dyuhtuhpazy chhao parosa thei ta, biehmeiseihpa pahnona lâ â chhi thei ei tahpa a ngiapâpa ta, Abeipa chakaotuhpa cha nônai kawpa ta taopathina rai a hria awpa a châ.
Chatanachata ama chhie nata pha pahnona vaw hroh aw ta, ano khopa tao awpa ta âmo a patu tyhpa ahripa khoheih ama khôkhâh thei aw.
He he pahno mah y. Noh hnôhlâzy liata cha daihti ru ngaitapazy a vaw tlô aw.
Chyhsazy ta âmo kyh dei a pachâ aw ei ta, tâkâ sôh tlaichhaipazy, apalaipazy, apatahsapazy, chyhsa a taochhiepazy, nôpaw reingiah leipazy, alyna châh pahno leipazy, pathaih leipazy,
kyhpachâna a pikhei leipazy, aryhna a tao khoh leipazy, haipa ta chyhsa leih hmâhpazy, a sohsi thei leipazy, nôchhiepazy, hmo pha a khoh leipazy,
piehpiepazy, hmiahnoh rao leipazy, apasâhsapazy nata Khazohpa hlâta khizaw haosai a tlaichhai viapazy ama châ aw.
Khazohpa chyhsa hawhta a lâ aw ei ta, châhrasala a hmotaotheina deikua zo aw veih ei. Cha hawhpa chyhsazy cha a heihsai mah y.
Cha hawhpa chyhsazy cha, ozy liata a ngiapa ta, chanô chiehleipazy patu ei ta, molei phaohri ta âmo cha pavipa ta, aohraohna to ta chyhsa a pasiesachheipazy ama châ.
A chu ngâ thlâh tlôh ta, châhrasala biehmeiseihpa a pahno thei beih leipazy ama châ.
Zane nata Zambare ta Mawsi amâ dyuhpa hawhna khata, cha chyhsazy ta biehmeiseihpa amâ dyuh tyh. Palôh moleipa, ngiapâna kyh liata tloh leipa ama châ.
Châhrasala sie parei aw veih ei. Ama hruzie cha, Zane nata Zambare chô liata hmo a tlôpa hawhna khata, chyhsa zydua hmiakô liata â vaw lâ aw.
Nâ deikua cha, ei pachuna, ei yzie, ei hmochhuahpa, ei ngiapâna, ei daotheina, ei kyhpachâna nata tiamana zy pahno chi ta,

taolana ei tyhpa nata pasa ei taona zydua na pahno. Antiôkâ khih liata zy, Ikônia khih liata zy, Lystâ khih liata zy taolana ei tyhna liata ei taopasana zydua pahno chi ta, cha taolanazy tawhta Abeipa ta eina pachhapa chhao na pahno.
Hmeiseih ta la, Khazohpa khozie hawhta Krista Zisu liata hro a chhuahpa zydua cha taolana amâ tyh aw.
Moleipa nata dôtuhpazy deikua cha, chyhsa dôtuhpa nata dôpa ta a ypazy châ ei ta, chhiena tawhta chhie viana lâ ama pangai lymâ aw.
Nâ deikua cha, ahy tawhta a chupa ma na châ tahpa pahnopa ta, nâ chupa nata â ipa ta nâ ngiapâpa liana khata y lymâ mah y.
Na hawti no tawhta na pahno chiehpa Biehrai pathaihpazy kha zyh lymâ mah y. Cha Biehrai pathaihpazy cha Krista Zisu ngiapâna vâta pachha châ thei nawpa ta, chyhsa sopa châ pachâsa theipa a châ.
Biehrai zydua cha Khazohpa huso thlupa châ ta, pachuna châta zy, thailei pachâsana châta zy, chhoreina châta zy, siana achuna châta zy a phahnai ngaita.
Chatanachata Khazohpa chyhsa cha pakipa ta y aw ta, raihria phapa to châta tobipa ta a y aw.
Khazohpa nata Krista Zisu, ahrohpa nata athihpa a pachiatuh awpa mohmô liata, â vaw luahna nata a khinarâh reipa ta bie ei cha pie.
Bie cha chho teh. A daihti nata a daihti leipa liata chhao chho teh. Dao thei ngaitana chôta nata pachuna chôta ama thaileizie pahnosa la, chhorei la, pasyu teh.
Chyhsazy ta pachuna dopa nathlie hoh leipa ta, ama nah â za hapa vâta, ama thei khohpa biezy a reih awpa pachutuhpazy deita ama hrua khohna daihti a vaw tlô aw.
Ama nahzy cha biehmeiseihpa lâ pahei leipa aw ei ta, phôhpazy lâ ama pahei aw.
Nâ deikua cha, ato liata a sohsi la, riethei tao la, thâtihpha chhotuhpa rai hria la, na chakaona patlô mah y.
Kei la tahmâ chhao he dopa hlâna hawhta hlâ haipa châ na ta, ei sie nawpa daihti a vaw tlô haw.
Adyuhna phapa a dyuh khai ha na ta, ei râpasuana patlô ha na ta, ngiapâna cha ei vao thlâh haw.
Tahmâ cha siana lakho ei châta sopa châ ha ta, cha cha Abeipa, pachiatuhpa sia ngaitapa ta, cha noh liata eina pie aw. Kei dei châ leipa ta, â vaw luahna a mokhâhtuhpa zydua hnohta chhao a pie aw ei.
Kei lâ a vy patoh a chhuah lylia mah y.
Demâ cha tahmâhlâ khizaw he a tlaichhaipa vâta na siesai ta, Thysalawnika lâ sie ha ta, Krekisâ chhao Kalatia lâ sie ha ta, Titu chhao Dalmatia lâ a sie haw.
Luka deita ei hnohta a y. Mâka kha hrua la, a vaw chhi mah y. Ano cha chakaona liata ei châta phahnai ngaitapa a châ.
Tykiku cha Ephesi lâ ei tuah haw.
Nâ vy tita Tarôsa liata Karpâ hnohta viahkao pasipa ei siesaipa kha na vaw phaopa la, châbuzy nata châchatypazy chhao kha na vaw phaopa mah y.
Dawh leih thaipa Alezandâ kha thata nâ pasasapa a châ. Abeipa ta a hmotaopazy lymâ hawhta viari a thô aw.
Nâ chhao ano tawhta a vaih mah y, eima biereipa thata a dyuhtuhpa a châ.
Ei thaichâna bie ei rei tua nota ahy hmahta nâ duakhei leipa ei ta, tlao eina pathlua khai ha ei. Maochhiepa ta y khah ei sy!

Châhrasala keima hmâpa ta thâtihpha chho pakipa ta a y thei nawpa nata Zenitai zydua ta ama thei thei nawpa ta, Abeipa tlai ta nâ duakhei ta, tha eina patlô. Chatanachata chakeibarôhneipa pakah tawhta pachhapa ta ei y haw.
Abeipa ta moleipa zydua tawhta na pachha aw ta, a vâ khinarâh lâ â bohpa ta eina tlôkhei aw. A hnohta chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta rônahna y mawh sy. Amen.
Priskilâ nata Akuilâ nata Ônesiphôrâ chhôhkhazy kha nâ naohpa mah y.
Erastâ cha Kawrini liata y chy ta, Tarôphimâ deikua cha, a tlâh leipa vâta Miletâ khih liata ei siesai haw.
Chasipaw hlâta a vy awpa a chhuah lylia mah y. Ebulâ, Pude, Linâ, Klaudia nata unawh zydua ta ama châ naoh.
Abeipa cha na thlahpa hnohta y mawh sy. Ngiachhiena nama hnohta y mawh sy.
Kei, Pawla he Khazohpa ta â tlyhpa chyhsazy angiapâna châta nata Khazohpa pachâna lâ a chhihthapa biehmeiseihpa pahnona châta Khazohpa chakaotuhpa nata Zisu Krista lyuhchâpa ei châ.
Haipa bie a reih beih leipa nata khizaw y hlâ tawhta chhâzaw hrona bie a vaw taih hapa Khazohpa a ngiapâtuhpa ei châ.
A daihtita liata a vaw luahpa chhâzaw hrona bie cha, Khazohpa miah Pachhatuhpa biepiepa ta pavaosapa châ na ta, cha bie a chhotuhpa, kei, Pawla heta,
ngiapâna miakhapa liata ei saw hmeiseihpa Titu ei châ naoh. Paw Khazohpa nata Krista Zisu miah Pachhatuhpa tawhta ngiachhiena nata thlalôhna na hnohta y mawh sy.
Hmo pasia khai leipazy pasia awpa nata bie ei cha piepa hawhta khi to liata Awnanopa chhituhpazy rao awpa ta, Krite liahpahlô liata ei cha siesaipa kha a châ.
Awnanopa chhituhpa châ awpa ta cha, seina hnei leipa, lapinô pakha a hneipa, a sawzy nôchhiepa nata reingiah leipa châ leipa ta, ngiapâtuhpa ama châ awpa a châ.

Awnanopa chhituhpa cha Khazohpa sôh mokhâhtuhpa a châpa vâta, seina hnei leipa a châ awpa a châ. Chyhsa apalaipa, pathichhiepa, kresawhti pari hmâhpa, thachahra a hmâhpa nata avyuhna ta athôhna a tluapa a châ awpa châ vei.
Khichhai a pasôpa, phana a khohpa, a sohsi theipa, chyhsa siapa, chyhsa pathaihpa, sasyh a vao pahniepa a châ awpa a châ.
Awnanopa chhituhpa cha biezyhpa dopa a pachu thei awpa châ ta, biezyhpa dopa chakhiatuhpazy a padei thei nawpa ta, pachuna dopa â ipa ta a patu awpa a châ.
Ryhpa a zyh khoh leipa, bie a reih chakhyhpa nata chyhsa dôvei hmâhpa hluhpi, a eih pachaipa ta, chopawtaipazy hry liata ama y.
Cha sahlao cha ama pakah chahu awpa a châ. Avyuhna nozachhihpa ama tao thei nawpa ta, pachu lei awpazy pachu ei ta, chhôhkha zydua ama patypamâ.
Krite chyhsa, ama hrohsopa cheingei ta, “Krite chyhsazy cha haihthaipazy, sahrâh moleipazy, thathi rikawhpa zy ama châ zôzaw,” tahpa ta reih ta.
Cha bie cha â do. Chavâta ngiapâna liata â dopa ta ama y thei nawpa ta, a pasa kawpa ta âmo cha chhorei mah y.
Zuzy phôhpa nata biehmeiseihpa a heisaituhpa biepiepazy cha uasa lei awpa ta âmo cha chhorei hra mah y.
Mopathaihpazy châta ato pathaih ta, chyhsa puapa nata ngiapâleipazy châta deikua cha, khâpa hmah pathaih vei. Ama palôh phaozie nata ama chhie nata pha pahnona a pua khai haw.
Khazohpa pahno a tah ei ta, châhrasala ama hmotaopazy ta Khazohpa cha amâ paphasai. Pasichhihpa nata reingiah leipa châ ei ta, hmopha tao awpa ta khâpa kyh liata hmahta a tlâh a châ leipazy ama châ.
Nâ deikua cha, biezyhpa dopa nata a ryhpa ta pachu mah y.
Pawhrâhpazy cha palôh pasohpa, zachhihpa, a sohsi theipa, ngiapâna patapa, kyhpachâna a hneipa nata daotheipa chyhsazy châ awpa ta pachu mah y.
Nôhrâhpazy chhao, ama yzie liata Khazohpa a chizapa, chyhsa kyh a reih leipa nata kresawhti sei ta y leipa ta, hmo phapa pachutuhpazy châ awpa ta pachu mah y.
Nô laihsa viapazy cha ama vahpazy nata ama sawzy kyhpachâ awpa ta pachu la,
Khazohpa bie reipachhiepa ta a y lei nawpa ta, a sohsi theipa, chanô pathaihpa, o mohôhna rai a hriapa, nôphapa nata ama vahpazy rei a ngiahpa châ awpa ta pachu mah y.
Cha hawhna chata chapaw thyutlia viapazy chhao, a sohsi theipa châ awpa ta pachu mah y.
Kyh to liata hmo pha taona liata a mopâ awpa ta y la, na pachuna liata adona nata zachhihna palâsa mah y.
Na bie reipa â dozie reipasipasua thei awpa a châ leizie palâsa la, miah chakhiatuhpazy ta eima moleina rei awpa pahno leipa aw ei ta, maophyuhpa ta ama y aw.
Seizy cha kyh to liata ama zibeipazy rei a ngiahpa ta, ama zibeipazy ama palysa awpa châ ta, ama zibeipazy bie ama ei awpa châ vei.
Kusisuah hnei leipa ta, ngâ tlâhpa ama châna ama palâsa awpa a châ. Chatanachata miah pachhatuhpa Khazohpa biezyhpa cha kho â chhihzie kyh to liata ama palâsa thei aw.
Khazohpa ngiachhiena cha a vaw luah ha ta, chyhsa zydua hnohta pachhana a vaw tlôkhei haw.
Cha chata Khazohpa pachâ leina nata khizaw aohraohnazy bâhsaipa ta, tahmâhlâ khizaw liana heta asohsipa nata asiapa nata Khazohpa pachâna hro hrokhei awpa ta miah pachu ta,
eima Khazohpa rônahpa nata Pachhatuhpa Zisu Krista â vaw luahna hnabeiseihna lychhihpa hâ awpa ta miah a pachu.
Ano cha paraona zydua tawhta miah chatlaituhpa châ ta, hmo pha taona kyh liata phahnai a ngiahpa, a ryuto phopi châta miah pathaisa awpa ta, anosasyh ta keimo châta a hlâpa a châ.
Cha biezy cha pachupa ta, pasyu la, biehneina zydua chhaota chhorei mah y. Ahy hmahta cha mohnao khah ei sy.
Ngiapâtuhpazy cha ryureituhpazy nata biehneituhpazy liata a ngiarih ei sala, reingiahpa ta, hmo pha tao a mâ awpa ta chho chanei mah y.
Ngiapâtuhpazy cha ahy hmah ama reipachhie awpa châ leipa ta, ahryusina amâ hneisai awpa a châ. Nônai kawpa ta y ei sala, chyhsa zydua chô liata areisina dopa ama palâsa awpa a châ.

Kha hlâta cha keimo chhao chyhsa hrupa, chhorupa, dôvei naopa, aohraohna nata phasana to sei ta a ypa, moleina nata hnâchhaona ta a hrohpa, chyhsa ta amâ haopa nata keimo nata keimo a hao raihriepazy eima vaw châ.
Châhrasala miah Pachhatuhpa Khazohpa phana nata kyhpachâna â vaw luah nahta,
siana ta eima hmotaopa vâta châ leipa ta, a zawngiahna vâta miah a pachha. Cha pachhana cha pipathina ta miah pathaisa ta, Thlahpa Pathaihpa taopathina zawhzi ta eima hmôpa a châ.
Miah Pachhatuhpa Zisu Krista zawhzi ta eima chô liata Thlahpa Pathaihpa thata hrypa eima châ.
Chatanachata a ngiachhiena vâta thai pachâsapa ta y aw pi ta, chhâzaw hrona a hnabeiseihpa ryutotuhpazy eima châ thei aw.
Khazohpa a ngiapâpazy cha hmo pha taona liata a hmâh lymâ mawh ei sy, tahpa bie cha ngâ tlâhpa châ ta, cha bie cha na reih lymâ awpa ei khoh. Cha cha hmo phapa châ ta, chyhsazy ta amâ thôkhei aw.
Aeina hrupazy, thyutônazy, achakhianazy nata ryhpa kyh liata ahryunazy a hneisai lymâ mah y. Athôhna a y leipa nata hraoleipa hmozy a châ.
Achhaihna a papuatuhpa cha, ei kha ei no zikyu a râ la, a ro khoh vei khiahta cha, ano nata azaona khâpa hmah hnei khao khah y.
Cha hawhpa chyhsa cha sie chhei ha ta, moleipa châ ta, anosasyh ta thailei â pachâpa a châ tahpa pahno mah y.
Atemâ tlyma, Tykiku tlyma, nâ lâ ei vaw tuah tita, ei yna Nikôpôli khih lâ a vy a chhuah lylia mah y. Cha liata chasipaw daihti hmâ awpa ei chhuah.
Dâhthaipa Zenâ nata Apawlôsâ zy kha, khâpa hmah a phahla lei awpa ta mokhei la, ama khitlyna a palâ thei nawpa ta na theina zydua ta bao mah y.
Eima chyhsazy cha pathei leipa ta ama y lei nawpa ta, bao ngiahpazy bao ei sala, hmo pha taona liata a hmâ lymâ awpa ta a chu mawh ei sy.
Ei hnohta a ypa zydua ta ama châ naoh. Ngiapâna liata kyh miah pachâtuhpazy kha miah a naohpa mah y. Nama zydua hnohta ngiachhiena y mawh sy.
Krista Zisu châta a tâhpa Pawla nata eima unawhpa Timawthy ta eima viasa kho ngaitapa nata eima hrialâhpa Philemaw,
