eima sietanô Aphia, eima pheisaih châ lâhpa Akhipâ nata na o liata Awnanopa a pakhypa zy eima châ naoh.
Khazohpa eima Paw nata Abeipa Zisu Krista tawhta ngiachhiena nata thlalôhna nama hnohta y mawh sy.
Ei thlahchhânazy liata châ thei tyh na ta, na moh reipa ta ei Khazohpa hnohta alyna bie khâ ei reih tyh.
Abeipa Zisu nâ ngiapâna nata mopathaihpa zydua kyh na pachâzie zy vaw thei na ta,
Krista vâta hmo pha to eima hneipa na pahno paki thei nawpa ta, nâ ngiapâna bie cha tiamapa ta chho lymâ awpa ta thlah ei cha chhâpa tyh.
Unawh y, nâma zawhzi ta mopathaihpazy palôh pathiehpa ta y ta, na kyhpachâna ta alyna nata thlalôhna thata eina pie.
Cha vâna chata, â ngiahpa hmo tao awpa bie cha pie awpa ta, Krista liata cha ngâh thlâh hraw sah la,
kyhpachâna vâta, kei, Pawla, pawpipa nata tahmâ Krista Zisu vâta a tâhpa heta, â haw ta ei châ haw.
Ei sawchapawpa Ônesimâ, bâlia ei ky chhôh ta sawchapaw ta ei hneipa châta ei châ haw.
Kha hlâta na châta phahnai leipa ta, tahmâ deikua cha, nâ nata kei châta a phahnai haw.
Cha chyhsa, ei palôh nâ hria chaipa cha, nâ lâ vaw kua awpa ta ei vaw pasiesa.
Thâtihpha vâta patâhpa ei châ chhôh ta ei hnohta y sala, nâma vyuhpa ta na chakao sala tahpa ei khoh kaw.
Châhrasala na hmo pha tao awpa cha, pataosa raruahpa châ leipa ta, nâma lôhthai tlai ta a taopa na châ awpa ei khohpa vâta, na bie leipa ta khâpa hmah tao awpa khoh va na.
Buakhata a châ chhaihpa kha, chhâzaw ta ano na hnei palâh nawpa a châ thei mâh tâh.

Châhrasala sei hawhta châ khao leipa ta, sei hlâta pha viapa, unawh kho ngaitapa hawhta a châ bâ aw. Keima châta unawh kho ngaitapa châ ta, nâma châ chhochhi ta cha, sapa liata nata Abeipa liata unawh kho ngaitapa a châ pachai aw.
Chavâta na hrialâhpa ta eina pachâ khiah chi ta cha, keima einâ ly awpa hawh chi ta ano he a vaw ly mah y.
Na chô liata hmo paraopa kheihawhpa rai a hnei khiahta tlyma, leibâh kheihawhpa rai a hnei khiahta tlyma, kei ta ei châ bâhpa hawhta rao mah y.
He bie he kei Pawla ta, keima ku tlai ta ei ropa a châ, keima ta ei cha thô aw. Nâ ta keima liata a bâhpa na hneipa, na pôhpa tlai chhao einâ bâhpa chi, ei tahna deikua la châ vei.
Chatatlyh, unawh y, Abeipa liata eina phahnaikhei hra awpa chi ei khoh kaw. Krista liata ei palôh na pathieh heih mah y.
Reingiahna na hneipa liata a lôhpa ta, ei reipa hlâ chhao ta a pha viapa ta na tao aw tahpa pahnopa ta, he châpaphaopa he na hnohta ei vaw ropa a châ.
Khâpa rai châ sala, khichhai chhôhpadâhpa nâ vaw chhuanohpa mah y. Nama thlahchhânazy vâta nâmo lâ avyna daihti piepa ei châ aw tahpa ei hnabei a seih.
Krista Zisu vâta ei tâlâhpa Epâpharâ ta a châ naoh.
Ei hrialâhpa Mâka, Aristaku, Demâ nata Luka zy chhao ta ama châ naoh hra.
Eima Beipa Zisu Krista ngiachhiena cha nama thlahpa hnohta y mawh sy.
Hlâno ta hrohsopazy hmâpa ta Khazohpa ta miah pathlatuhpazy hnohta ei hluhpi nata kyh to ta bie vaw reih tyh ta,
he noh hnôhchaipazy lia deikua cha, a Sawchapawpa hmâpa ta eima hnohta bie a reih. A Sawchapawpa cha ato ryutotuhpa ta rao ta, ano hmâpa ta khizaw he a tao.
Ano cha Khazohpa rônahna khaihpaliepa nata Khazohpa chhichâna a hneipa châ ta, a bie hmotaotheina bie ta ato a pabohsa. Moleinazy a pathaisa khai tawhta, chô lâ Beichaipa chachâh lâta a tyuh ha ta.
Vâlyuhchâpazy moh hlâta Sawchapawpa ryuto moh â sâh viapa hawhta, Sawchapawpa cha vâlyuhchâpazy hlâta a sâh via syulyupa a châ.

Vâlyuhchâpazy hry liata ahy hnohta ma Khazohpa ta, “Ei Sawchapawpa châ chi ta, Tanoh he na Paw ei châ,” a tah beih tly? Cha leipa chhao ta, ahy vâlyuhchâpa hnohta ma, “Ano châta Paw châ aw na ta, Ano cha kei châta Sawchapawpa a châ aw,” a tah beih tly?
Sawchapaw uhtheipa khizaw lâ a za tua nona khata, “Khazohpa vâlyuhchâpa zydua ta ano a naoh mawh ei sy,” tah heih ta.
Vâlyuhchâpazy kyh liata, “Vâlyuhchâpazy cha thlih pachâsa ta, A chakaotuhpazy chhao meipaleih a pachâsa tyh,” tah heih ta.
Sawchapawpa kyh liata deikua cha, hetana heta a tah: “Hy Khazohpa, na beidyuchhai cha, Chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta y ta, Siana chôchahrei cha, Na khinarâh chôchahrei a châ.
Siana pasô chi ta, Moleina nâ hao; Chavâta Khazohpa, na Khazohpa ta, Na viasazy hlâta rônah viapa ta, Thaphana sathaw a cha thu.
“Hy Abeipa, nâ cha Âthaona liata leilô abôna a bôtuhpa châ chi ta, Avâzy khi na kuzô a châ.
Chazy cha leidia aw ei ta, Nâ deikua khâ na y aw; Chysia hawhta chy khai aw ei ta,
Poh hawhta âmo cha loh aw chi ta, Chysia hawhta thlapa ama châ aw. Nâ deikua cha na ualua ta khâ y chi ta, Na kôzy chhâ beih aw vei.”
Vâlyuhchâpa ahy hnohta hmah, “Na chariahzy na phei tlyna ta ei tao hlâlei cha, Ei chachâh lâta a tyuh mah y,” tah beih hra vei.
Vâlyuhchâpa zydua cha pachhana ryu a to awpazy chakao awpa ta tuapa chakaona thlahpazy ama châ.
Chavâta bie eima theipazy kha eima pachâ peimawh pachai awpa a châ. Chataleipatala biezy cha eimâ sysai pathlei aw na.
Vâlyuhchâpazy hmâpa ta bie reipa hmahta a i sala, paraona nata reingiah leina tozy ta viarithôna dopa a hmô lymâ khiahta cha,
he tlu ta pachhana rônahpa he diathlâ ei sih la, kheihta e eimâ boh thei aw? Cha pachhana bie cha Abeipa ta phuah tua ta, a theituhpazy ta keimo châta ama pa-i.
Khazohpa chhao ta ngianazy, hmonoâhpazy nata hmotaotheina to ta nata a khozie hawhta Thlahpa Pathaihpa hmopiepazy piepa ta a pahnokhei.
Khizaw vaw y awpa thâtih eima reipa he vâlyuhchâpazy biehneina liata soh vei.
Khataih liata tlyma, “Chyhsapa he khâpa châ ta ma, Pachâ kaw chi ta; Chyhsa sawchapawpa he khâpa châ ta ma, Na mohôh tly?
Bohpi leipa chhôh châta, Vâlyuhchâpazy hlâta a hnai viapa ta tao chi ta, Rônahna nata palyupalihna lakho na pakho; Na ku hmotaopazy chô liata hyutuhpa ta tao chi ta,
A phei ry liata ato na soh khai,” tahpa ta pa-ipa a châ. Chatanachata ato ano ry liata soh ta, ano biehneina khô lâta a sopa khâpa hmah y vei. Tahmâ deikua cha, ato ano ry liata a ypa hmô mâh ma pi.

Châhrasala bohpi leipa chhôh vâlyuhchâpazy hlâta a hnai viapa ta tao chypa Zisu cha, thina pasa a taopa vâta, tahmâ cha rônahna nata palyupalihna lakho pakhopa ta a ypa hmô pi ta, Khazohpa ngiachhiena zawhzi ta chyhsa to châta thina a padi haw.

Ano châta nata ano zawhzi ta ato a ypa Khazohpa ta, saw hluhpi rônahna lâ a chhipa ta ama pachhana a taotuhpa Krista cha, pasa taona siepahliepa ta pakina patosa â chhuahpa cha, a châna awpa rai a châ.
Pathaisatuhpa nata pathaisapazy cha ama zydua ta mopakha tawhta a puapa ama châ. Chavâta Zisu ta âmo cha unawhzy tah awpa a noza vei.
“Ei unawhzy hnohta na moh phuah aw na ta, Apakhypazy hry liata na reithaina hla ei sa aw,” tah ta,
“Ano liata ngâna ei pahnieh aw,” tah heih ta, “Moh tua u, Kei nata Khazohpa ta eina piepa sawzy hih,” a tah.
Sawzy cha sapa nata thisaih azaona a hneipa ama châpa hawhta, ano chhao sapa nata thisaih hnei hra ta, a thina ta thina hmotaotheina a hneipa ahripa cha a pahleipadia haw.
Chatanachata thi riah china sei ta hro chhôh a tâhpa zydua a pachha ha ei.
Hmeiseihta la, vâlyuhchâpazy bao leipa ta, Abarahâ pathlazy tlao a bao ei.

Chavâta chyhsazy châta molei reihpha cheina tao awpa ta, Khazohpa chakaona liata zawngiah theipa nata ngâchhihpa theihthai beichaipa a châ thei nawpa ta, kyh to liata a unawhzy hawhta a y awpa cha a byuhpa rai a châ.
Ano tlai ta reipasaona a tyh ta, pasa a vaw tao hapa vâta, reipasaona a tyhpazy a bao thei ei.
Chavâta unawh pathaihpa, vârâh awna a to hrapazy saih u, eimâ ngiapâna palâhâhna lyuhchâpa nata Theihthai Beichaipa Zisu thâtih pachâ tyh muh vy.
Mawsi cha Khazohpa chhôhkha zydua hry liata ngâchhihpa a châpa hawhta, Zisu cha ano a raotuhpa liata ngâchhihpa â châ.
O hlâta o satuhpa ta palyupalihna a hlao viapa hawhta, Zisu cha Mawsi hlâta rônahna a to tlâh viapa ta raopa a châ.
O to a satuhpa a hnei khaipa hawhta, ato zydua a taotuhpa cha Khazohpa a châ.
Hmialâ daihti liata bie rei awpazy pa-i nawpa ta, Mawsi cha Khazohpa o liata chakaotuhpa ngâchhihpa châ ta,
Krista deikua cha, Khazohpa o chô liata Sawchapawpa ngâchhihpa a châ. Eimâ lôhna nata eima hnabeiseihna liata eimâ palaikheipazy â ipa ta eima patu khiahta cha, keimo he Krista o cha eima châ.
Chavâta Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta, “Tanoh he a ao nama thei khiahta cha,
Râhchawhpa liata pasiapa nama châ nota, Nama chhorupa hawhna khata, Nama palôh kuh pachhasa khuh vy.
Châ pathlatuhpazy khata, Cha liata na pasia ei ta; Ei hmotaopazy kô sypalih chhôh ama hmô.
Kha chhâ khata ei hie na pahâh ei ta, ‘Ama palôh liata viavipa ta, Ei lâpizy pahno veih ei,’ tah na ta.
Pathi iapa ta bie ei taihpa hawhta, ‘Ei pahâna liata a ngia aw veih ei,’” tah ta.
Unawh saih u, a sohsi teh u. Chataleipatala nama hry liata ahy chhôh liata tlyma ngiapâleina palôh moleina vaw y aw ta, Khazoh hrohpa nama paosai pathlei aw na.
Nama hry liata ahy hmah moleina ta dôveina liata kuhchhapa ta nama y lei nawpa ta, “tanoh” tahpa a châ chhôh zydua cha, noh chareih ta a pasyu raihrie teh u.
Âthaona liata eimâ ngiapâna alôhna kha achhâna taihta eima patu khiahta cha, Krista a hneituhpazy eima châ. Chavâta,
“Tanoh he a ao nama thei khiahta cha, Chhorupa ta nama y no hawhna khata, Nama palôh kuh pachhâsa khuh vy,” tahpa a châ.
Cha khiahta la pahno thlâh tlôh ta ano a dyuhpazy kha ahyzy ma ama châ? Mawsi chhihthapa ta Izi râh tawhta a kaw puapa zydua kha châ veih ei ma?
Kô sypalih chhôh a hie a pahâhpazy kha ahyzy ma ama châ? Moleina hmo a taopa, râhchawhpa liata ama ri a zawhpazy kha châ veih ei ma?
Â pahâna liata a ngia lei awpa ta bie â taihpazy kha ahyzy ma ama châ? Reingiah leipazy kha châ veih ei ma?
Amâ ngiapâleipa vâta a ngia thei khao veih ei tahpa eima pahno.
Chavâta â pahâna liata a ngia awpa bietai y thlâh ha tlôhpa ta, nama hry liata a ngia tlâh leipa nama y pathlei lei nawpa ta, chi ei suh u.
Ama hnohta thâtihpha chhopa a châpa hawhta, keimo hnohta chhao chhopa châ ta, châhrasala bie ama theipa cha ngiapâna ta a pa-i leipa vâta, âmo châta phahnaina hnei vei.

Keimo, ngiapâ hapazy pi he, cha apahâna liata a ngiapazy cha eima châ. Leilô bô tua no tawhta raizy paloh hapa a châ tarawpa ta, hetana heta a tah: “Hiehâpa ta bie ei taih hapa hawhta, ‘Ei pahâna liata a ngia aw veih.’”
Khataih su liata tlyma, noh sarina noh kyh liata, “Noh sarina noh liata Khazohpa ta a raihria zydua tawhta â pahâ,” tah ta.
Rei chiehpa liana khata, “Ei pahâna liata a ngia aw veih ei,” tah heih ta.
Thokha cha apahâna liata a ngia aw ei ta, thâtihpha a dao tuapa thokhazy deikua cha, ama reingiah leina vâta a ngia thei aw veih ei.

Bohpi tawhna khata Dâvi hmâpa ta, “Tanoh,” tahpa ta, noh kheihawhpa tlyma rao chanei heih ta, rei chiehpa hawhta, hetana heta a reih chanei heih: “Tanoh he a ao nama thei khiahta cha, Nama palôh kuh pachhasa khuh vy.”
Zawsua ta apahâna a vaw pie ha khiah ei ta cha, cha hnôhlâ ta noh hropa kyh Khazohpa ta reih khao aw vei.
Chavâta Khazohpa phopi châta cha, a pahâ nawpa Pahânoh a y thlâh ha aw.
Khazohpa ta a raihriazy tawhta â pahâpa hawhta, Khazohpa apahâna liata a ngia hapa cha, a raihriazy tawhta â pahâ hra aw.
Chavâta reingiah leina vâta ama paopa hawhna khata ahy hmah ama pao lei nawpa ta, cha apahâna liata a ngia awpa ta tei ei suh u.
Khazohpa bie cha hroh ta, hmo tao thei ta, zaozi hâh nopa hlâta tiah via ta, hrona nata thlahpa, ru nata lathli pachhaih theina taihta chhôpahlie thei ta, palôh pachâna nata achhuahnazy a pahno thei.
A mohmô tawhta a nyu theipa hmotaopa rai y vei. Eima thâtih eima tlôkhei nawpa mohmô liata cha, ato thluahruapa nata pahy chiehpa ta a y khai.
Chatanachata avâzy a siepahliepa theihthai beichaipa rônahpa, Khazohpa Sawchapawpa Zisu eima hneipa vâta, eimâ ngiapâna palâhâhna cha khâchâ patu ei suh u.
Eima chiehleinazy miah a pahnokhei thai leipa theihthai beichaipa a hneipa châ leipa pi ta, keimo hawhta kyh to liata reipasaona a tyh ta, châhrasala a molei leipa theihthai beichaipa eima hnei.
Chavâta zawngiahna eima hmô thei nawpa nata bao eimâ ngiah daihti liata miah bao awpa ta ngiachhiena eima hmô thei nawpa ta, ngiachhiena beidyuchhai cha riahphapa ta a hnia suh u.
Theihthai beichaipa cha, chyhsazy vyuhpa ta Khazohpa nata azaona rai hria awpa ta chyhsazy hry tawhta atlyhpa châ ta, moleinazy châta hmopiepa nata atheihnazy hlâ awpa ta raopa a châ.
Ano chhao chiehleina a hneipa a châpa vâta, pahno leipazy nata lâpi paviapazy cha chado kawpa ta a chhihtha thei ei.
Cha hawhta a châpa vâta, chyhsazy moleina châta atheihna a hlâpa hawhta, ano moleinazy châta chhao atheihna a hlâ tyh.
Cha palyupalihna cha ahy hmahta anosasyh ta a patosa thei vei. Arawna hawhta Khazohpa ta a awpa a châ khiah dei ta a to thei.
Cha hawhna chata Krista chhao ta theihthai beichaipa châ awpa ta anosasyh ta a cheihchalo vei. “Ei Sawchapawpa châ chi ta, Tanoh he na Paw ei châ,” tahpa ta a hnohta a reihtuhpa ta a raopa a châ.
Su hropa liata chhao, ano a raotuhpa ta, “Melkizade theihthaipa châna lâpi a chhihpa ta, Chhâzaw theihthaipa na châ” tahpa ta a reih heih.

Sapa pôhpa ta a hro chhôh ta, Zisu cha thina tawhta a pachha theituhpa lâ ao paro ngaitapa ta mothlih chhaota awh ta, thlahchhânazy nata hianazy hlâ ta, Khazohpa a chizana vâta a thlahchhâna cha nathliepa a châ.
Sawchapawpa a châ tarawpa ta, a pasa taonazy liata reingiahna a chu ta,
chavâta pakipa ta taopa vaw châ ta, a rei a ngiahpa zydua châta chhâzaw pachhana hnawh a vaw châ haw.
Melkizade theihthaipa châna lâpi a chhih ta, Khazohpa ta ano cha theihthai beichaipa ta a tao haw.
Cha kyh liata bie hluhpi rei awpa eima hnei. Nama nah a pâ hapa vâta chhopasia deikua a ru kaw.
A daihti pachâpa ta, pachutuhpa a châ bâ awpa châ ei chi ta, châhrasala Khazohpa bie thabypa pachu namâ ngiah thlâh ha chy. Sâhpiti a ngiah chy ei chi ta, pati hmeiseihpa nie thei mâh veih ei chi.
Sâhpiti ta chyh a ngiahpa maih cha, hawsaih a châpa vâta, siana bie kyh liata pahnona hnei leipa a châ.
Pati hmeiseihpa deikua cha, pitlohpazy châta châ ta, pati hmeiseihpa nie amâ chu lymâpa vâta, chhie nata pha pahrua thaina a hneipa pitlohpazy ama châ.
Chavâta Krista thâtih pachu pathaonazy tawhta laiseih lymâpa ta, pitlohna lâ pangai ei suh u. Hmotao thipazy liata rona lôbôzy bô chanei leipa ta, Khazohpa ngiapâna,
bâtina, ku pahniehna, athihpa thyuheihna nata chhâzaw pachiana thâtih pachu pathaonazy liata y khao khah ei suh u.
Khazohpa ta â ryh a tah khiahta cha, cha cha eima tao aw.
Ei kha nopavâhpa ta y ha ta, vârâh hmopiepa padi ta, Thlahpa Pathaihpa raihria liata a hlao ha ta,
Khazohpa bie phana padi ta, daihti vaw y awpa liata hmotaotheina padi ha tawh chhao ta,

ama paosai heihpa khiahta cha, ama rao nawpa ta Khazohpa Sawchapawpa a khaipâ chanei heihpa nata maoh a paphyuhtuhpazy ama châpa vâta, cha hawhpa chyhsazy rona lâ a chhi heih awpa cha hmo thei leipa a châ.
Khihti a hmô phapa chhaohlei cha, raihriatuhpazy châta niedo papuapa ta, Khazohpa tawhta byhnâ a daopa a châ.
Chhaohlei ta ahloh nata bôbawzy a papua khiahta deikua cha, hnypa ta y ta, chhiesa thlupa châ ta, a chhâ nawpa cha mei ta rao awpa a châ.
Châhrasala kho ngaitapa saih u, cha hawhta reih hra sih la, nâmo kyh liata la, hmo pha viapa, pachhana kyh hmozy nama tao aw tahpa eimâ lôh.
Nama raihria tyhpa nata a moh vâta kyhpachâna palâsapa ta mopathaihpazy nama chakao tyhpa, tahmâ taihta nama taopa he, mopakhô awpa ta Khazohpa cha adoleipa châ vei.
Hnabeiseihna ipa hnei awpa ta nama tiama tyhpa hawhna khata, achhâna taihta tiama papua lymâ awpa ta eima cha khokhei.
Chatanachata diathlâ leipa aw ei chi ta, ngiapâna nata hâ hualuana vâta bietai ryu totuhpazy hâlatuhpa tlao nama châ aw.
Khazohpa ta Abarahâ hnohta bietai a tao nona kha, ano hlâta rônah viapa moh reipa ta bie â taih nawpa a y leipa vâta, anosasyh ta bie a taih ta,
“Byhnâ cha awpa tlai aw na ta, ei cha papôh tlai aw,” tah ta.
Chatanachata Abarahâ cha palôh pasi ngaitapa ta a hâ tawhta bietaipa cha hmô ha ta.
Chyhsazy ta âmo hlâta rônah viapa moh reipa ta bie a taih tyh ei ta, aeichhiana ama hneipa to liata chhao, bietai cha bietluna pa-ina châta ama hmâh tyh.
Khazohpa ta â chhuahna anano beih leipa cha, bietai ryutotuhpazy hnohta tha via ta a pamosa khoh tita, bietai hmâpa ta a pa-i tyh.

Chatanachata hmo anano beih leipa miano vâta, haipa bie rei awpa cha Khazohpa châta hmo thei leipa châ ta, a boh awpa ta ano lâ a râpazy pi heta eima hmiakô liata hnabeiseihna sopa cha thlalôhpa ta eima hnei thei aw.
Cha hnabeiseihna cha eima hro a-ina nata abohna châta eima balyh thuacha-ia ta hnei pi ta, pohraipa chhôhchaipa lâ a ngiatuhpa hnabeiseihna a châ.
Chatanachata Zisu cha eima vyuhpa ta hmia a sah ta, cha liata a ngia ta, Melkizade theihthaipa châna lâpi a chhihpa ta, chhâzaw theihthai beichaipa ta a y haw.
Cha Melkizade, Salem bei nata Khazohpa Chônôchaipa theihthaipa chata, abeizy a thie khai tawhta â vaw liepa Abarahâ cha kei dy ta, byhnâ awpa ta,
Abarahâ ta a hraona sôh zydua tawhta su hrawh su kha a hnohta a pie. Melkizade cha a moh yzie tawhta siana bei châ tua ta, hnôhlâ ta Salem bei tahpa a châ. Salem bei tahpa cha adyhna bei tahna a châ.

Ano cha paw hnei leipa ta, nô hnei hra leipa ta, pathlatuhpa alaichadai awpa hnei vei. Âthaona noh nata a hro chhâna nohzy rei awpa hnei hra leipa ta, Khazohpa Sawchapawpa lyupa ta taopa châ ta, chhâzaw ta theihthaipa ta a ypa a châ.
Cha chyhsa rônahzie cha pachâ tua u! Pathlatuhpa Abarahâ chhao khata hraona sôh tawhta su hrawh su kha a piepa kha a châ.

Livai pathlazy hry liata theihthaipa raihria a topa maih cha, ryhpa hawhta chyhsazy tawhta su hrawh su kha la awpa ta biepiepa ama châ. Cha chyhsazy cha Abarahâ pathla ama unawhzy châ ei ta, âmo tawhta su hrawh su kha ama la tyh.
He chyhsa deikua he cha, ama phoheih a châ hra leipa chhao ta, Abarahâ tawhta su hrawh su kha dao ta, bietaizy a hneituhpa cha byhnâ a awpa.
Rônah viapa ta a nawh viapa châta byhnâ a awpa tyhpa kyh cha, reipasipasua thei rimâ awpa châ vei.
Kyh kha liata cha, chyhsa thi theipazy hnohta su hrawh su kha piepa châ ta, kyh hropa liata deikua cha, hroh thlâhpa a châ tahpa pahnokheipa hnohta su hrawh su kha piepa a châ.
Su hrawh su kha a la tyhpa Livai tlai chhao kha, Abarahâ siepahliepa ta su hrawh su kha a pie hrapa hawhta pachâ theipa a châ.
Melkizade ta Abarahâ a vaw dy nona kha, Livai cha ano pathlatuhpa Abarahâ thisaih liata a y hapa a châ.

Livai pathlazy theihthaina raihria ry liata chyhsazy ta ryhpa dao ei ta, cha Livai pathlazy theihthaipa châna tawhta pakina hmô theipa a châ khiahta cha, Melkizade theihthaipa châna lâpi a chhihpa ta theihthaipa hropa a vaw y awpa cha khazia â ngiah khao aw? Arawna theihthaipa châna lâpi a chhihpa ta rao awpa châ vei ma?
Theihthaipa raihria siezie pananopa a châ khiahta cha, ryhpa chhao panano awpa a byuh tyh.
A thâtih eima reipa he chihropa châ ta, cha chi tawhta ahy hmah maisâh liata chakao beih veih ei.
Eima Beipa cha Zudâh chi tawhta a vaw puapa a châzie pahnopasiapa châ ta, cha chi nata a zaopa ta Mawsi ta theihthaipazy kyh khâpa hmah reih vei.
Melkizade hawhpa theihthai hropa a vaw y nahta, cha kyh cha a sia via rili.
Ano cha sapa chipathla liata a pahniehpa ryhpa hawhta theihthaipa ta raopa châ leipa ta, hro chhâna hnei leipa hmotaotheina hmâpa ta theihthaipa ta raopa a châ.
Chavâta ano kyh liata, “Melkizade theihthaipa châna lâpi a chhihpa ta, Chhâzaw ta theihthaipa na châ,” tahpa ta pahnokheipa a châ.
Biepiepa hmiatuapa cha, chiehleina nata phahnai leina a hneipa vâta hnypa a châ.
Ryhpa bie ta khâpa hmah pakisa thei vei. Hnabeiseihna pha viapa vaw tlô ta, cha hnabeiseihna vâna chata Khazohpa eimâ hnia thei haw.
Melkizade theihthaipa châna lâpi a chhihpa ta theihthaipa a châpa Abeipa cha, bietai a hlao leipa ta theihthaipa ta raopa châ vei.

Kha hlâta theihthaipa a vaw châ tyhpazy kha, bietai tao leipa ta theihthaipa a vaw châ tyhpazy châ ei ta, he theihthaipa deikua he cha, “Abeipa ta bie a taih ha ta, A palôh panano aw vei, ‘Chhâzaw theihthaipa na châ,’” tahpa ta a hnohta bie a reituhpa bietai ta theihthaipa ta raopa a châ.
Cha bietai vâna chata Zisu cha biehrai pha viapa pa-ituhpa a vaw châ haw.
Theihthaipazy cha thina vâta ama raihria ama pazao lymâ thei leipa vâta, theihthai hmiatuapazy maluh ama hluh ngaita.
Zisu deikua cha, chhâzaw ta a hrohpa a châpa vâta, a thla beih leipa, chhâzaw theihthaipa a châ.
Zisu cha chyhsazy châta thlahchhâ awpa ta chhâzaw ta a hroh thlâhpa a châpa vâta, ano siepahliepa ta Khazohpa a pangaipazy cha, khatino rai ta a pachha thei ei.
Cha hawhpa theihthai beichaipa, pathaihpa, palôh phapa, apuapa a bai leipa, moleipazy tawhta pananopa nata avâzy chô lâta cheihchalopa eima hnei awpa cha â ngiahpa rai a châ.

Ano cha theihthai beichaipa hropazy hawhta, noh chareih ta ano moleinazy châta atheihna hlâ tuapa ta, cha khai tawhta chyhsazy moleina châta atheihna a hlâ chanei ngâ thlâh awpa byuh vei. Anosasyh ta chhâzaw châta ei kha â hlâna liata a pangoh khai haw.

Ryhpa ta chiehleina a hneipa chyhsazy cha theihthai beichaipa ta rao tyh ta, ryhpa a y khai tawhta a vaw ypa bietai bie deikua ta cha, chhâzaw châta pakipa ta taopa Sawchapawpa cha theihthai beichaipa ta a rao haw.
Rei eimâ chhuahpa cha he he a châ: Cha hawhpa theihthai beichaipa cha hnei pi ta, ano cha vârâh liata Beichaipa beidyuchhai chachâh lâta a tyuhpa châ ta,
chyhsapa paduapa châ leipa ta, Abeipa paduapa achhyna byureih hmeiseihpa supathaihpazy liata chakaotuhpa a châ.
Theihthai beichaipa maih cha hmopiepa nata atheihnazy hlâ awpa ta raopa ama châ. Chavâta he theihthai beichaipa chhao he, khâpa chhâ tlyma hlâ awpa a hnei awpa a byuh.
Alei liata a ypa châ sala, ryhpa hawhta hmopiepa a hlâ awpa theihthaipazy ama ypa vâta, ano la theihthaipa a châ awpa byuh aw vei.

Theihthaipazy cha vârâh hmo nothlahpa nata nohpahlipazy ama chakao tyh. Mawsi kha achhyna byureih a sa chy ta a hnohta, “Hmo to a taozie awpa tlâh liata ei cha pahmôpa hawhna khata na tao khai awpa a châ,” tahpa ta a taozie chhopa a châ.
Tahmâ deikua, Krista cha biehrai pha viapa lyuhchâpa a châpa hawhta, chakaona rai pha via syulyupa to ha ta, cha biehrai cha bietai pha viapazy chô liata taopa a châ.
Biehrai hmiatuapa kha seina hnei leipa vaw châ ha sala, biehrai hropa tlua a byuh lei awpa tlai.

Sei nawpa ama hneipazy Khazohpa ta hmô ta, hetana heta a tah: “Pachâ teh u, Nohzy a vaw tlô hai, Abeipa ta a tah. Cha nohzy liata, Izarei phopi hnohta biehrai thiehpa tao aw na ta, Zudâh phopi hnohta chhao ei tao aw.

Ama pathlatuhzy Izi râh tawhta a chhi papua awpa ta, Ama ku ta ei patu noh ta, Ama hnohta bie ei hraipa hawhpa kha châ aw vei. Ei biehrai liata ama y thlâh ha leipa vâta, Âmo pachâ khao veih ei na, Abeipa ta a tah.

Cha nohzy hnôhlâ ta, Izarei pathlazy hnohta biehrai ei tao awpa cha he he a châ, Abeipa ta a tah: Ama pachânazy liata ei ryhpa biezy soh aw na ta, Ama palôhzy liata ei roh aw; Ama Khazohpa châ aw na ta, Ei phopi ama châ aw.

‘Abeipa pahno teh,’ tahpa ta, Vaih nata vaih a pachu raihrie khao leipa aw ei ta, Unawh nata unawh a pachu raihrie khao aw veih ei; A chyh chaipa tawhta a lai chaipa taihta, Ama zydua ta eina pahno khai aw ei.
Ama paraopazy liata zawh a ngiah aw na ta, Ama moleinazy a thei khao aw va na.”
Biehrai thiehpa thâtih a reipa liata, a hmiatuapa cha a parohpa ta tao ta, paroh lymâ ta, a vaw machâ hapa cha, a lei patoh awpa a châ.
Biehrai hmiatuapa chhao khata Khazohpa achhyna siekheizie nata lei liata supathaihpazy a hnei.
Achhyna byureih sa ei ta, a chhôh tytuapa liata meiôh sona nata tlâhkhai nata Ypâna Viahchhâ sonazy y ta, cha cha Su Pathaihpa tahpa a châ.
Pohraipa mianona khô liata chhôhpadâhpa cha Su Pathaih Chaipa tahpa a châ.
Cha liata ropahâhpa raona ngôh maisâh nata ngôh ta pahupa biehrai byh y ta, biehrai byh chhôh liata mânâ yna ngôh beih, Arawna chôchahrei chhyh thaopa nata biehrai lôphiazy a y.
A chô lâta cherubi rônahpazy y ei ta, chazy chata zawngiahna dyuchhai ama khu. Cha kyhzy cha tahmâ â kipa ta reih thei mâh ma pi.
Cha hawhta ato pachhuahpanohpa a châ khai tawhta, theihthaipazy cha ama chakaona rai hria awpa ta, byureih tytuapa lâ cha noh chareih amâ ngia tyh.

Byureih chhôh chaipa lâ deikua cha, theihthai beichaipa deita ta kô kha ta ei kha a ngia tyh ta, thisaih a chei leipa ta â ngia awpa châ vei. Cha thisaih cha ano châta nata zawpizy ta pahno leipa ta ama moleinazy atheihna châta a hlâ tyh.
Cha hmo paryhzie tawhna chata Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta he he a pahnosa: Achhyna byureih tytuapa â dua chhôh cha, Su Pathaih Chaipa liata angiana lâpi pahypa châ mâh vei.
Cha cha tahmâhlâ daihti châta pamosana a châ. Cha hmo paryhzie liata cha, hmopiepa nata atheihna hlâ tyhpazy heta achhytuhpa chhie nata pha pahnona pahro thei vei.
Hmopiepa nata atheihnazy cha niedozy nata apasipathaina nanopazy kyh deita châ ei ta, sapa lâ ryhpa, taopathina daihti tlô hlâta hmâ awpa ryhpazy deita ama châ.

Krista deikua cha, hmo phapa a vaw tlôpazy châta theihthai beichaipa ta â vy nota, achhyna byureih rônah viapa nata paki viapa siepahliepa ta a vy ta, cha cha ku ta sa leipa, he hmotaopazy hry liata a hlao leipa a châ.
Su Pathaih Chaipa lâ cha chhâzaw châta ei kha a ngia ta, miezy nata viahchaotawzy thisaih ta châ leipa ta, ano thisaih ta chhâzaw chatlaina a tao haw.
Chyhsa pathaih leipazy chô liata mie nata viahchao tôhpazy thisaih nata viahchao zeinô raona paohpazy thiapa hmahta sapa pathaihna taihta a pathaisa thei khiahta cha,

chhâzaw Thlahpa zawhzi ta, seina hnei leipa ta Khazohpa lâ anosasy ta a hlâtuhpa thisaih chhochhi ta cha, eima chhie nata pha pahnona cha hmotaopa thipa tawhta Khazohpa hrohpa chakaona lâta a pathaisa via pachai aw dia!
Chavâta Krista cha biehrai thiehpa lyuhchâpa a châ. Biehrai hmiatuapa ry liata paraonazy chatlai nawpa ta Krista cha thi ta, chatanachata awpazy ta chhâzaw ryu to awpa bietai cha ama to thei aw.
Bieryuhipa hawhta tao awpa ta, ryuhituhpa cha a thi ha tlai tahpa pasia ha tua awpa a byuh.
Bieryuhipa cha ryuhituhpa a thi tawh deita ta hmâ theipa a châ. Ryuhituhpa a hro chhôh ta cha hmâ theipa châ mâh vei.
Chavâta biehrai hmiatuapa chhao kha, thisaih leipa ta cha pa-i theipa châ vei.
Mawsi ta ryhpa biepiepa to zawpi zydua hnohta a phuah nona kha, viahchaotaw thisaih, mie thisaih, ti, sahmi pala saihdôhpa nata hisaw zy la ta, ryhpa châbu nata zawpi zydua thia ta,
“He he nama zyh awpa ta Khazohpa biepiepa biehrai thisaih a châ,” tah ta.
Cha hawhna chata achhyna byureih nata chakaona hmobaoh zydua chhao thisaih ta a thia khai.
Hmeiseihta ta, ryhpa ry liata cha, ato zydua thisaih ta pathaisapa châ ta, thisaih palo leipa ta molei ngiahthaina rai y vei.
Chavâta vârâh hmo a lyupazy hmahta atheihnazy ta pathaisa awpa a byuh khiahta cha, vârâh hmo hmeiseihpazy chhochhi cha, chazy hlâta atheihna pha via syulyupa ta pathaisapa ta a y awpa rai a châ.
Krista cha a hmeiseihpa a lyupa ta taopa, ku ta sapa Su Pathaih Chaipa liata a ngia leipa ta, eima vyuhpa ta Khazohpa hmiakô liata a luah awpa ta, tahmâ vârâh liata â ngia hapa a châ.
Theihthai beichaipa cha kô chareih ano thisaih a châ leipa thisaih a cheipa ta Su Pathaih Chaipa liata a ngia tyh ta, Krista deikua cha â hlâ chanei ngâ thlâh ha awpa a ngiah vei.

Cha hawhta châ leipa sala, leilô y tua no tawhta pasa a tao chanei ngâ thlâh ha aw. Châhrasala daihti chhâna lâ liata, chhâzaw châta ei kha a vaw luah ta, anosasyh ta atheihna ta a hlâpa ta moleina a pahlei haw.
Chyhsapa châta ei kha thi raopa châ ta, cha hnôhlâ ta pachiana a y aw.

Cha hawhna chata Krista chhao chyhsa hluhpi moleinazy siekhei awpa ta ei kha hlâpa ta y ta, a einona ta â vaw luah tita deikua cha, moleina siekhei awpa châ khao leipa aw ta, ngiatiah lei ta ano hâtuhpazy pachha awpa ta â vaw luah aw.
Ryhpa cha hmo phapa a vaw y awpazy nohpahlipa dei châ ta, a hmeiseihpa a châ leipa vâta, kô chareih ta atheihna hlâ tyhpa a châpa chhao ta, a hlâtuhpazy châta pakina tlôkhei thei beih vei.
Chata châ leipa sala, achhytuhpazy cha ei kha pathaisapa ama châ ha tawhta cha, molei a pahnona hnei khao leipa aw ei ta, atheihna ama hlâ tyhpa cha pachhâsa ha aw veih ei ma?
Châhrasala cha atheihnazy liana chata kô chareih ta moleinazy pahnosa heihna a y tyh.
Viahchao tôhpazy nata miezy thisaih ta moleinazy pahlei thei rimâ awpa châ vei.
Chavâta khizaw lâ â zu nona khata, Krista ta, “Atheihna nata hmohlâpazy khoh leipa chi ta, Pôhpa tlao nâ chhuanohpa chi ta,
Raopa hlâna nata moleina hlânazy liata Alyna rai hnei va chi.
Hy Khazohpa, moh tua, Châbu chatypa liata ei thâtih ropa hawhta Na khopa tao awpa ta ei vy,” tah ta.
“Atheihnazy, hmohlâpazy, raopa hlânazy nata moleina hlânazy khoh leipa chi ta, chazy liata alyna hnei hra va chi,” tah tua ta, chazy cha ryhpa hawhta hlâpa kyhzy a reipa a châ.
Cha khai tawhta, “Moh tua, na khopa tao awpa ta ei vy haw,” tah ta, a vaw y awpa a pa-i thei nawpa ta a hmiatuapa cha a pahlei haw.
Cha hmochhuahpa hawhna chata, chhâzaw châta ei kha hlâpa Zisu Krista pôhpa ta pathaisapa ta eima y haw.
Theihthaipa maihta chakao awpa ta noh chareih a duah ei ta, moleinazy a siekhei thei leipa atheihna ama hlâ tyhpazy cha, a ualua ta ama hlâ chanei ngâ thlâh ha tyh.
Krista deikua cha, moleinazy châta atheihna miakha, chhâzaw châta ei kha a hlâ khai tawhta, Khazohpa chachâh lâta a tyuh ta,
a khakhaipazy a phei tlyna ta taopa ama châ khai hlâlei a hâ thlâh chy.
Ei kha â hlâna ta a pathaisa hapazy cha, chhâzaw châta a pakipa ha ei.
Thlahpa Pathaihpa chhao ta, hetana heta reih ta, miah a pahnokhei,
“Cha nohzy hnôhlâ ta, Ama hnohta biehrai ei tao awpa cha, He he a châ, Abeipa ta a tah: Ama palôh liata ei ryhpa biezy soh aw na ta, Ama pachâna liata ei roh hra aw,” a tah khai tawhta,
“Ama moleinazy nata ama paraonazy A thei khao aw va na,” tah heih ta.
Cha hawhta moleinazy a ngiahthaipa a châ ha khiahta cha, moleina châta atheihna hlâ awpa byuh khao vei.
Chavâta unawh saih u, Zisu thisaih vâta Su Pathaih Chaipa liata eimâ ngia aw tahpa a lôh pi ta,
pohraipa siepahliepa ta lâpi thiehpa nata hrohpa eima châta a pahy haw. He liata pohraipa he Krista pôhpa reina a châ.
Chatanachata Khazohpa chhôhkhazy chô liata theihthai rônahpa eima hneipa vâta,
eima palôh liata chhie nata pha pahnona pha leipazy pathaipa ta, eima pôhpa ti pathaihpa ta pasi sih la, ngiapâna liata alôhna a ipa hneipa ta Khazohpa a hnia ei suh u.
Eima hnabeiseihna palâhâhna cha, a zawvaw leipa ta khâchâ patu ei suh u, bie â taihtuhpa cha ngâchhihpa châ tlôh ta.
Kyhpachâna nata hmo pha taona liata kheihta ma tha eimâ pathyu raihrie thei aw tahpa pachâ tyh ei suh u.
Thokha taozie hawhta, apakhynazy bâhsai leipa ta, tlao a pasyu raihrie ei suh u. Noh â hnia via rilipa nama hmôpa hawhta, thata a pasyu ei suh u.
Biehmeiseihpa pahnona eima hnei ha tawhta eima molei raruah lymâ khiahta cha, moleinazy châta atheihna y khao vei.
Ryureina rarôh ypa nata ano dyuhtuhpazy a kâ patlô awpa hiehâhna mei tlao a y aw.
Mawsi ryhpa a papeisa leipazy cha, pahnokheituhpa pano tlyma, pathôh tlyma bie ta, zawngiahna a hlao leipa ta ama thi tyh.
Khazohpa Sawchapawpa tlypâ ta, ano pathaisana biehrai thisaih papuapaleipa ta, ngiachhiena Thlahpa ru a pachhôpa cha, kha tluta hriena tha viapa to sala nama pangiasa?
“Phuh cha keima la awpa châ ta, kei ta viari ei thô aw,” a tahtuhpa eima pahno. “Abeipa ta a phopi a pachia aw,” a tahtuhpa chhao eima pahno.
Khazoh hrohpa ku liata paopa cha hmo rarôh y ngaitapa a châ.
Châhrasala nama daihti hmiatuapa liata, nopavâhsapa ta nama y khai tawhta thata pasa nama taona nohzy kha a thei tyh muh vy.
A châh ta vâtlâh mohmô ta pasipasawhpa nata taolapa ta y ei chi ta, a châh ta pasipasawhna nata taolana a taopazy namâ duakhei tyh.
Keihrai daipazy thapasa ei chi ta, hmo hneipa pha viapa, a y kôzaw awpa nama hneipa nama pahnopa vâta, nama hmo hneipazy ama cha hrao tita, a ly kawpa ta namâ pyh thei.
Chavâta namâ ngiapâna alôhna, lymâ rônahpa a hneipa cha thy khuh vy.
Khazohpa khopa nama tao khai tawhta, bietaipa nama hmô thei nawpa ta, daotheina namâ ngiahpa rai a châ.
“Bohpi leipa liata, A vy awpa cha â vy aw, Hawh aw vei.
Ei chyhsa siapa cha, Ngiapâna ta a hroh aw; Hnôh a sypa deikua cha, A chô liata alyna rai hnei aw va na.”
Châhrasala keimo la, leidia awpa ta hnôh a sypa sahlao liatapa châ ma pi. Ngiapâna ta hro a pabohsa awpazy tlao eima châ.
Ngiapâna cha hmo hnabeiseihpazy a y tlai tahpa pahnona châ ta, hmo hmô leipazy pahnopasiana a châ.
Cha ngiapâna vâna chata hlâno chyhsazy kha reithai ama hlao tyh.
Ngiapâna ta khizaw he Khazohpa bie ta taopa a châ tahpa pahno pi ta, chavâta hmo eima hmôpazy he hmô theipa hmozy tawhta taopa châ veih ei tahpa eima pahno.

Ngiapâna ta Abela cha Kainâ hlâta atheihna pha viapa Khazohpa lâ hlâ ta, Khazohpa ta a hmopiepazy a pyh ta, ano cha reithai ta, mosiapa ta a rao. Â ngiapâna vâta, Abela cha a thi tawh chhao ta bie a reih lymâ.

Ngiapâna ta Enawka cha thina a tyh lei awpa ta lapa châ ta, Khazohpa ta a la hapa vâta, ano cha hmôpa châ khao vei. Lapa a châ hlâ tawh chhao ta, Khazohpa a palysapa a châpa vâta reithaina a hlaopa a châ.

Ngiapâna leipa ta cha Khazohpa palysa thei rimâ awpa châ vei. Khazohpa a pangaipa maihta, Khazohpa a y tahpa amâ ngiapâ awpa châ ta, ano a tluatuhpa cha Khazohpa ta lymâ a pie tyh tahpa amâ ngiapâ awpa a châ.

Ngiapâna ta Nôah cha hmo a lâ leipazy kyh liata Khazohpa zikyurâna cha pachâ peimawh ta, Khazohpa chizapa ta, a chhôhkhazy pachha nawpa ta balyh a tu. Â ngiapâna ta khizaw thailei pachâsa ta, ngiapâna vâta hmôpa siana ryutotuhpa a vaw châ haw.
Ngiapâna ta Abarahâ cha a ryuto râh lâ sie awpa ta awna zyh ta, khataih lâ ma a sie aw tahpa a pahno leipa chhao ta, a sie lymâ.
Ngiapâna ta bietai râh liata pahrâ awpa ta sie ta, chihropa râh liata ypa hawhta y ta, bietai miakha ryutolâhpa Aisika nata Zakaw zy chhaota poh ozy liata ama pahrâ.
Chatanachata abônazy a hneipa, Khazohpa pachhuahpanohpa nata paduapa khihpi cha a hâ hualua.
Ngiapâna ta Sârâ cha saw phaoh thei ta, ano bie a taihtuhpa cha ngâchhihpa ta a raopa vâta, a nôpi tawhta saw a phaoh theipa a châ.
Chatanachata chapaw pakha, athipa hawhta pachâpa tawhta, avâ liata awhsi zie ta a hluhpa nata tilaipi ngiahkâ liata sadi rei tiah lei zie ta a hluhpa chipathlazy ama vaw pua haw.

Cha zydua cha ngiapâna hneipa ta thi ha ei ta. Ama hnohta bietaipa hmozy ama to mâh leipa chhao ta, lâhlapi tawhta saipa ta a naoh ei ta, alei liata cha khichhaipa nata khitlyhpa dei ama châ tahpa ama pahno.
Cha hawhpa kyh a reihpa chyhsazy cha, ama râh sôhpahlôhpa a tluapazy ama châ tahpa ama palâsa.
Ama puana râh cha saiheipa châ ei sala, kua heihna daihti rypaohpa ama hmô thlâh ha aw.
Châhrasala tahmâ cha, râh pha viapa a saduthliepa châ ei ta, cha cha vârâh liata a ypa a châ. Chavâta Khazohpa ta ama Khazohpa châ awpa a noza vei, ama châta khihpi taih a chhuahdy ha tlôh ta.
Ngiapâna ta Abarahâ cha pasiapa ta a y nota, Aisika hlâ ta, bietaizy a totuhpa ta a sawchapaw matlupa cha a hlâ haw.
“Aisika liata na pathlazy a laichadaipa a châ aw,” tahpa ta chhopa chyhsa ta, a sawchapaw matlupa a hlâ.
Khazohpa cha athihpa chhao a pathyu thei tahpa a ngiapâ ta, Aisika cha a hmô pakhua haw. A hlâ hapa vâta Aisika cha a thi hapa hawhta pachâpa a châ.
Ngiapâna ta Aisika ta hmo a vaw tlô awpazy kyh liata Zakaw nata Esaw byhnâ a awpa ei.
Ngiapâna ta Zakaw ta a thi chy ta, Zawsi sawchapawzy byhnâ awpa chyu ta, a chôchahrei pawhmao a hniehpa ta Khazohpa â chhy.
Ngiapâna ta Zawsi ta a thi chy ta, Izarei sawzy Izi râh tawhta pua awpa kyh reih ta, a ruzy taotia nawpa kyh a chho ei.
Ngiapâna ta Mawsi a pi nona kha, hawsaih hmipha kawpa ta ama hmôpa vâta, a nôpawzy ta thla thôh chhôh nyu ei ta, bei biepiepa chhao chi veih ei.
Ngiapâna ta Mawsi cha a vaw pitloh tawhta, Phiraoh sawchanô sawchapawpa ta bi awpa a dytha haw.
Bohpi leipa chhôh molei phasana liata lôhrâ a patlôpa hlâta cha, Khazohpa chyhsazy hnohta taolana tao awpa tlao a tlyh ta.
Lymâ to awpa a saipa vâta, Krista vâta reipachhiena a tyhpa cha Izi râh ryuzy hlâta ryu sôh viapa ta a rao.
Ngiapâna ta bei hiehâhna chhao chi leipa ta, Izi râh puasai ta, hmô thei leipa a hmôpa vâta pasa a tao hualua.
Sawchapaw uhtheipa pahleipadiatuhpa ta Izarei sawchapaw uhtheipazy a hria lei nawpa ta, ngiapâna ta Zawpakhô chay ta, thisaih a thia.
Ngiapâna ta alei hipa liata siepa hawhta Tilaipi Saihpa ama chaka. Izi mo deikua cha, cha hawhta tao a chhuah hra ei ta, ti ta a vaosao khai ha ei.
Ngiapâna ta Zerikô thokhy cha, noh sari ama chahlô tawhta a cho haw.
Ngiapâna ta âzuahnô Rahâbi cha, mohparutuhpazy a phapa ta â lypa vâta, ngiapâleipazy hry liata leidia vei.
Khâpa eima reih khao aw? Kidia, Bâraka, Sâsawna, Zephathâ, Dâvi, Samuela nata hrohsopazy kyh reih aw sah la, daihti ta nâ daih aw vei.
Âmo cha ngiapâna ta khinarâhzy la ei ta, adona a duakhei ei ta, bietaizy to ei ta, chakeibarôhneipa pakahzy ama pamosa.
Mei hmotaotheina pachhai ei ta, zaozi tiahpa khôkhâh ei ta, chiehleina tawhta thatlôpa ta taopa ama châ. Adyuhna liata pasaipha châ ei ta, chihropa pheisaihzy a chadai ei ta amâ râpai.
Chanôzy ta ama chyhsa athipa thyuheihpazy hmô ei ta. Thokhazy cha taolapa ta y hra ei sala, hro pha viapa lâta ama thyuheih thei nawpa ta, pua awpa khoh hlei veih ei.
Mohropazy chhao pasipasawhna nata tuna zy vâta pasa tao ei ta, bâlia nata patâhna zy amâ tyh.

Alô ta vawhpa châ ei ta, thoâna ta taipachhôpa châ ei ta, reipasaona a tyh ei ta, zaozi ta chhawhsaopa ama châ. Mietaku vo nata mie vo zy a bupa ta viavi ei ta, dyhchhiena, pasataona nata â doleipa ta ama chô liata hmotaopazy amâ tyh.
Chazy châta la, khizaw he yna tlâh châ vei. Râhchawhpa liatazy, tlâh liatazy, lôpu nata khaohtlô liatazy viavipa ta ama y.
Cha chyhsa zydua cha, amâ ngiapâna vâta reithaina hlao tlai ei ta, bietaipa deikua hmô mâh veih ei.
Khazohpa ta keimo châta hmo pha viapa â chhuahdy hapa vâta, âmo nata keimo â raohpa ta pakipa ta y awpa ta â chhuanoh hapa a châ.

Cha ngiapâna bie pahnokheituhpazy ta meihdo ru ngaitapa hawhta miah ama pahlypa vâna heta, miah pahny pakhawpa maih nata moleina keimo liata khâchâ a baipa cha soh sih la, eima hmiakô liata arâpasuana a ypa liata tiama ngaitapa ta a râ lymâ suh u.

Eimâ ngiapâna apahniehna nata pakituhpa Zisu lâ moh lymâ ei suh u. Ano cha a hmiakô liata alyna sopa cha a to thei nawpa ta, maophyuhna chhao papeisa leipa ta, kraws liata pasa tao ta, Khazohpa beidyuchhai chachâh lâta a kaw tyuh ha ta.
Nama palôh thazei leipa ta, nama tha a chhâ lei nawpa ta, moleipazy ta amâ dyuhna vâta pasa a taopa Zisu thâtih pachâ tyh muh vy.
Moleina namâ dyuhna liata, thisaih lona taihta a dyuh mâh veih ei chi.
Sawzy chhoreipa hawhta pasyuna biezy kha nama my ha ma? “Ei saw y, Abeipa chhoreina cha, Papeisa leipa ta y leipa la; A cha ra tita, Na palôh pasa khah sy.
Abeipa ta a kyhpachâpa cha chhorei ta, Saw ta â pyhpa maih a chhei tyh.”
Nama pha nawpa ta chhoreipa nama châ. Sawzy chô liata taopa hawhta Khazohpa ta nama chô liata a tao. Paw chhorei leipa saw ahy ma a y beih?
Saw zydua cha chhorei tyhpa ama châ. Chavâta chhoreipa nama châ vei khiahta cha, saw hmeiseihpa châ leipa ei chi ta, riasawzy nama châ.
Cha dei châ vei, lei liata miah chhoreituhpa pawzy hnei pi ta, âmo cha eima za ngaita. Eima hroh thei nawpa ta, eima thlahpazy Paw cha, cha hlâta tha via ta eima za awpa châ vei ma?
Lei liata eima pawzy ta daihti chyuta chhôh, pha ama tahzie hawhta miah chhorei ei ta, Abeipa deikua cha, eima pha nawpa ta tlao miah a chhorei tyh. Chatanachata a pathaihna eimâ hly thei aw.
Chhoreina zydua he, a tyh nota cha alychhihpa châ leipa ta, a pasa kaw tyh. Pasa tao khai tawhta deikua cha, chhoreipa ta a ypazy châta thei thlalôh chhihpa, siana thei a pathei tyh.
Chavâta nama bâh pathliahpazy chalo u la, nama pakhu thazeipazy thapatlô teh u.
Pheisypa cha a ru a suhlie leipa ta, patlâhpa a châ thei nawpa ta, nama pheizy châta lâpi patlâpazy tao teh u.
Chyhsa zydua nata adyhna chadai u la, pathaihna chadai hra teh u. Pathaihna leipa ta ahy hmahta Abeipa hmô aw veih ei.
Khazohpa ngiachhiena a to leipa ama y lei nawpa ta, pakhâta ta moh u la, palôh chhiepa vaw pua sala, tymâna patlôsapa ta, chyhsa hluhpi papuapaleipa ama châ lei nawpa ta, pakhâta ta moh teh u.
Apatlana moleina a taopa y leipa ta, Esaw hawhta pathaih leipa ama y lei nawpa ta, pakhâta ta moh teh u. Esaw cha pati ei kha nie ta sawchapaw uhtheipa châna a zuahpa kha a châ.
Cha khai tawhta byhnâ to awpa khoh ta, mothlih chhaota a hiapa chhao ta, ro nawpa daihti rypaohpa a hmô khao leipa vâta, dythapa a châpa kha nama pahno.
Ku ta hria theipa tlâh, meipaleih a puapa, zohna nata zoh kaluhna ta a khupa nata thlihpi pathlina tlâh lâ namâ vypa châ leipa ta,
chiahmie tôpa pyu nata a bie reipa ao vâta, a theituhpazy ta ama hnohta bie hropa rai rei khao lei awpa ta amâ hawna tlâh lâ a vypa châ veih ei chi.
“Tlâh cha sa ta hmah a hria khiahta cha, alô ta vawhsao awpa a châ,” tahpa biepiepa ama pahnie leipa vâta a châ.
Ama hmo hmôpa kha chichhih ngaitapa châ tlai ta, chavâta Mawsi chhao ta, “Chipa ta thata ei chalyu,” a tahpa kha.
Nâmo deikua la, Zaio Tlâh, Khazohpa hrohpa khihpi, vâ Zerusale, vâlyuhchâpa rei tiah leizy alyna pakhypi su lâ namâ vy hih.
Vârâh liata moh ropa sawchapaw uhtheipazy yna Awnanopa lâ a vy ei chi ta, mo to pachiatuhpa Khazohpa nata phapakipa ta taopa mosiapa sahlao thlahpazy lâ namâ vy.
Biehrai thiehpa lyuhchâpa Zisu lâ a vy ei chi ta, Abela thisaih hlâta bie pha viapa a reihpa Zisu thisaih thiapa lâ namâ vy hih.

Biereituhpa khoh leipa ta nama y pathlei lei nawpa ta a chado teh u. Alei liata zikyurâtuhpazy khoh leipa hmahta hriena ama khôkhâh vei khiahta cha, vârâh tawhta zikyu miah râtuhpa eima dytha khiahta cha, hriena eima khôkhâh lei pachai aw dia!
Kha daihti liata a ao ta alei he chalyu ta, tahmâ deikua, “Ei kha cha alei dei châ leipa ta, avâ chhao ei chalyu heih aw,” tahpa ta bie â taih.
“Ei kha cha ei chalyu heih aw,” tahpa heta, hmo a chalyu leipazy a y ualua ta a y lymâ thei nawpa ta, hmo a chalyupazy cha, hmotaopazy hawhta pasiepa ta a y aw tahpa a palâsa.
Chatanachata khinarâh a chalyu thei leipa eima topa vâna heta, alyna châh pahno sih la, a pyh tlâhpa achhyna cha, china nata zana chôta Khazohpa lâ hlâ ei suh u,
eima Khazohpa he a kâ patlô theipa mei châ tlôh ta.
Unawh kyhpachâna y lymâ mawh sy.
Khichhai chô liata phana papua awpa my khuh vy. Cha hawhta taopa ta, thokhazy ta pahno leipa ta vâlyuhchâpazy ama o liata ama patlôsa tyh.
Patâhna o liata atâhpazy cha, ama hnohta patâhna o liata y hrapa hawhta a pachâ u la, a thei thlâh ha muh vy. Riethei pataosapazy chhao, sapa ta a ypa nama châ hrapa vâta, a thei thlâh ha teh u.
Nôvah ahneina he chyhsa zydua hry liata palyupalihpa ta y mawh sy. Nôvah rakhô chhao papuapaleipa châ khah sy. Apatlana moleina a taopazy nata apheipazy cha Khazohpa ta a pachia aw.
Nama hro cha tâkâ sôh tlaichhaina a hlao leipa châ sala, nama hneipa rakha liata palôhtlâh a pao muh vy. Abeipa ta, “Cha pathlua beih leipa aw ei na ta, cha siesai beih aw veih ei na,” a tah.
Chavâta riahphapa ta, “Abeipa cha nâ baotuhpa châ ta, Chi aw va na; Chyhsa ta kheihta eina tao thei aw?” Eima tah ngâh.
Khazohpa bie châ chhotuhpa nama hyutuhpazy a thei thlâh ha u la, ama hro liata hmo phapazy pachâ u la, amâ ngiapâna hâ a la teh u.
Zisu Krista cha zâhia nata tanoh nata chhâzaw ta a ualua ta a y thlâhpa a châ.

Pachuna nanopa nata noâhchhihpazy ta paviasapa ta y khuh vy. Palôh he niedo ta thapatlô awpa châ leipa ta, ngiachhiena ta thapatlô awpa tlao a châ. Niedo kyh sai ta a tymâkheipazy châta niedo ta athôhna tlôkhei hlei vei.
Keimo cha maisâh hnei pi ta, keimo maisâh liata deikua cha, achhyna byureih chakaotuhpazy nie thei veih ei.
Theihthai beichaipa ta moleina atheihna châta Su Pathaih Chaipa lâ a thisaih â ngiakheipa sahroh pôhpazy cha, riehmo khôtho lâta rao tyhpa a châ.
Cha hawhna chata Zisu chhao ta ano thisaih tlai ta chyhsazy a pathaisa thei nawpa ta, khihpi thokhy khôtho liata pasa a vaw tao.
Chavâta riehmo khôtho liata ano yna lâ pua sih la, reipachhiena a phaopazy cha phaokhei suh u.
He liata khihpi sôhpahlôhpa hnei tlôh lei khâh pi ta, khihpi a vaw y awpa cha tlao eima tlua.
Chatanachata ano zawhzi ta reithaina atheihna cha Khazohpa hnohta khâ hlâ suh vy. Cha cha a moh achâhkheina hmaozy theilâpa a châ.
Hmo pha tao my leipa u la, nama hneipazy a chhaih awpa my khuh vy. Cha hawhpa atheihnazy ta Khazohpa a palysa.

Nama hyutuhpazy rei a ngiah u la, ama biehneina liata a ngiarih teh u. Khazohpa hmiakô liata nama thâtih a reih awpazy châ ei ta, pachârôhna chôta châ leipa ta, a ly kawpa ta nama thâtih ama rei thei nawpa ta nama thlahpa a vaituhpazy ama châ. Pachârôhna chôta nama thâtih reipa cha, nama châta phahnai aw vei.
Thlah miah chhâpa teh u. Kyh to liata zachhihpa ta y a chhuah pi ta, chhie nata pha pahnona pasohpa eima hnei tahpa a siapa ta eima pahno.
A chatlie viapa ta nâmo lâ ei vy heih thei nawpa ta, a eih viapa ta thlah eina chhâkhei awpa ei chi ta ei châ haw ei.
Tahmâ he thlalôhna Khazohpa, eima Beipa Zisu athihpa hry tawhta a pahro heihpa, chhâzaw biehrai thisaih vâta mietaku vaituhpa rônahpa ta

a khopa nama tao thei nawpa ta hmo pha to ta cha tobi ei sala, a mohmô liata â lynazie ta nama y lymâ thei nawpa ta, Zisu Krista zawhzi ta nâmo liata hria lymâ sala, Zisu Krista hnohta chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta rônahna y mawh sy. Amen.
Unawh saih u, nama hnohta pasyuna bie chyuta ei vaw ropa he nama pahno thai awpa ta ei châ haw ei.
Eima unawhpa Timawthy cha, patâhna o tawhta ama papua haw tahpa vaw pahno muh vy. A vaw tlô patoh khiahta cha, ano nata eima châ vaw hmô aw.
Nama hyutuhpa zydua nata mopathaihpa zydua nâ naohpa muh vy. Itali râh tawhta a vypazy ta ama châ naoh.
Nama zydua hnohta ngiachhiena y mawh sy. Amen.
Khazohpa nata Abeipa Zisu Krista chakaotuhpa Zâmie ta chi hrawh hleino paipatlapazy ei châ naoh ei.
Unawh saih u, kao to liata pasiana namâ tyh tita alyna ta rao khai teh u.
Namâ ngiapâna pasiana ta tiamana a tao tahpa nama pahno.
Khâpa hmah phahla leipa ta, pitlohna lâ pangai u la, phapakipa nama châ thei nawpa ta, tiamana chata a rai patlô mawh sy.

Nama hry liata ahy rai sona â phahla khiahta cha, Khazohpa lâ hiah mawh sy. Khazohpa cha chyhsa zydua hnohta riaphapa nata maochhie leipa ta sona a pietuhpa châ ta, sona a phahlapa hnohta sona piepa a châ aw.
Châhrasala alôhleina hnei leipa ta, ngiapâna ta hiah mawh sy. A lôh leipa chyhsa cha tilaipi chatlaopa hawhta châ ta, thlih ta phao ta, a pathluahpa hawhta a châ.
Cha hawhpa chyhsa cha khâpa hmah Abeipa tawhta hmô awpa a pangiasa khah sy.
Ano cha palôh miano a hneipa, a hmotaopa zydua liata a i leipa a châ.
Unawh areisipa cha cheihchalopa a châ tita, a ly mawh sy.
Hneirôhpa chhao, sibie paw hawhta a lo awpa châ ta, chavâta panawhpa a châ tita a ly mawh sy.
Noh vaw chhi ta, thata palo ta, sibiepa cha uah ta, a paw zô ta, â ngiana a lei tyh. Cha hawhna chata chyhsa hneirôhpa chhao, hneirôna a tluana lâpi liata a uah aw.
Pasiana liata â ipa ta a duahpa cha a nohlao na. Pasiana a pahnie tita, Khazohpa ta ano kyh a pachâtuhpazy hnohta bie â taihpa hrona lakho a to aw.
Ahy hmahta reipasaona â tyh tita, “Khazohpa ta eina reipasao,” tah khah sy. Khazohpa cha moleina ta reipasao thei rimâ awpa châ leipa ta, ano chhao ta ahy hmah reipasao beih vei.
Chyhsa to aohraohna lâta sydiepa nata a chhipa ama châ tita, reipasaona amâ tyh tyhpa tlao a châ.
Aohraohna ta saw phaoh ta, moleina sa ta, moleina cha a vaw pitloh nahta, thina a tlôkhei tyh.
Unawh kho ngaitapa saih u, dôveipa ta y khah u.
Hmosaipiepa phapa nata hmosaipiepa pakipa zydua cha chô lâ tawhta a zupa châ ta, khaihpazy Paw tawhta a zupa a châ. Ano liata ananona nata nohpahlipa y vei.
A hmotaopazy hry liata hmia a sahpa eima châ thei nawpa ta, ano khozie hawhta biehmeiseihpa liata a sapa eima châ.
Unawh kho ngaitapa saih u, he he pahno teh u. Chyhsa to ta bie rei a chhu leipa ta, nathlie tlao a chhu ei sala, hiehâh rupa châ mawh ei sy.
Chyhsapa hiehâhna ta Khazohpa siana palâsa vei.
Chavâta apuapa zydua nata moleina to pahlei khai u la, nama thlahpa a pachha theipa, bie chi tupa cha a reisi ngaitapa ta a pyh muh vy.
Nâmosasyh ta a dôveipa ta, bie nathlietuhpa dei châ leipa ta, bie zyhtuhpa tlao châ muh vy.
Ahy rai bie thei ta, a tao tlôh vei khiahta cha, thlalâ liata a pikheipa hmia a mohpakiapa chyhsa hawhta a châ.
Pakhâta ta a moh ta, sie ta, kheihawhpa chyhsa ma a châ tahpa thlai a my ha tyh.
Khotalaina ryhpa pakipa cha moh ta, cha hawhta hroh ta, ryhpa cha thei ta, thlai a mypa châ leipa ta, zyh ta, ryhpa hawhta a taopa chyhsa cha, a hmotaopa liata thlaochhipa ta a y aw.
Ahy rai zyhna pachâ kawpa hawhta â pachâ ta, a paleih a vaih tlôh leipa cha, anosasyh ta â dôveipa châ ta, cha hawhpa zyhna cha phahnaina hnei leipa zyhna a châ.
Khazohpa nata Paw mohmô liata zyhna pathaihpa nata papuapalei leipa cha, Hâra nata nôhmeizy ama riethei pasataona liata deichhypa nata khizaw puapa kia leipa ta ypa he a châ.
Unawh saih u, eima Beipa Zisu Krista, rônahna Beipa ngiapâtuhpa nama châpa hawhta, khokhei viapa hnei khuh vy.
Namâ pakhyna o liata ngôh kusadizy a kypa nata chysia phapa a tobipa chyhsa a vaw ngia ta, chysia chhiepa a tobipa dyhchhiepa a vaw ngia hra ta,

chysia phapa a tobipa cha pachâ peimawh viapa ta, a hnohta, “Atyuna phapa liana he a tyuh mah y,” tah ei chi ta, dyhchhiepa hnohta, “Hao liata a kei duah teh,” tlyma, “Ei phei thaby siphiah liata a tyuh teh,” tlyma nama tah khiahta cha,
nâmo nata nâmo a pathluapa châ ei chi ta, palôh moleipa a phaohpa pachiatuhpazy châ aw veih ei chi mâ?

Unawh kho ngaitapa saih u, pachâ tua u! Khizaw pachâ ta dyhchhiepazy cha, ngiapâna liata hneirôh awpa nata ano kyh pachâtuhpazy hnohta bie â taihpa khinarâh ryutotuhpazy châ awpa ta, Khazohpa ta â tlyhpazy châ veih ei ma?
Nâmo deikua cha, dyhchhiepa nama mohnao. Châ tlybaipa nata pachiana lâ châ daophituhpazy cha hneirôhpazy châ tyh veih ei ma?
Âmo cha moh zachhihpa nama phaopa a reipachhietuhpazy châ veih ei mâ?
Biehrai ta, “Nâma kyh nâ pachâpa hawhta na vaih kyh na pachâ awpa a châ,” tahpa abeina ryhpa he nama zyh khiahta cha, nama tao pha na.
Khokhei viapa nama hnei khiahta deikua cha, moleina hmo a taopa châ ei chi ta, hmoparaotuhpa nama châ tahpa ta ryhpa ta thailei a cha pachâsa ei.
Ahy rai ryhpa zydua zyh paki hra sala, kyh kha a parao khiahta cha, a zydua liata thaileipa a châ.
“Aphei kha,” a tahtuhpa cha, “Liany cheih kha,” a tahtuhpa a châ hra. Chavâta nâ phei leipa chhao ta, liany a cheihpa na châ khiahta cha, ryhpa a paraotuhpa na châ.
Khotalaina ryhpa hmâpa ta ama thâtih pachia awpazy hawhta bie reih u la, hmo tao muh vy.
Zawngiahna a hnei leipa chyhsa cha, pachiana ta ano cha zawh a ngiah hra aw vei. Zawngiahna cha pachiana hlâta a rônah via.
Unawh saih u, chyhsa ta, “Ngiapâna ei hnei,” tah sala, hmotaopa a hnei tlôh leipa khiahta cha, khâpa phahnaina a hnei? Cha hawhpa ngiapâna chata ano a pachha thei aw ma?
Unawhpa tlyma, sietanô tlyma, chysia hnei leipa nata noh chareih nie awpa phahlapa ta y sala,
nama hry liata ahy tlyma ta a hnohta, “Thlalôhpa ta sie la, a lalôhpa ta y la, rihbiepa ta y mah y,” tah sala, pôhpa châta â ngiahpa a pie tlôh leipa khiahta cha, khâpa a phahnai aw?
Cha hawhna chata, ngiapâna cha hmotaopa hnei leipa ta ano dei ta a y khiahta cha athipa a châ.
Chyhsa ahy tlyma ta, “Nâ ta ngiapâna hnei chi ta, kei ta hmotaopa ei hnei,” a tah thei. Hmotaopa a hlao leipa nâ ngiapâna cha na pahmô tua, kei ta ei ngiapâna cha ei hmotaopa ta ei cha pahmô aw.
Khazohpa cha pakha dei a y tahpa a ngiapâ chi ta, a pha na. Ahripazy chhao ta cha cha a ngiapâ ei ta, amâ chalyu tyh mâh tâh!
Hy chyhsa hrupa y, hmotaopa a hlao leipa ngiapâna cha khâpa hmah châ vei tahpa pahmô awpa na khoh ma?
Miah pathlatuhpa Abarahâ ta a sawchapawpa Aisika maisâh chô liata a hlâ nona kha, hmotaopa vâta thai pachâsapa châ vei mâ?
Â ngiapâna cha a hmotaopa nata hria khoh ta, ngiapâna cha hmotaopa ta a paki tahpa na hmô.
Chatanachata Biehrai ta, “Abarahâ cha Khazohpa a ngiapâ ta, cha ngiapâna cha a siana ta raopa a châ,” a tahpa bie kha vaw tlô ta, Abarahâ cha Khazohpa viasa ta bipa a châ.
Ngiapâna vâ dei châ leipa ta, hmotaopa vâta chyhsa ta thai tlao a châ tyh tahpa nama pahno.
Cha hawhna chata âzuahnô Rahâbi chhao kha, lyuhchâpazy a vaw ly ta, lâpi hropa lâta a pasiesapa liana khata, hmotaopa vâta thai pachâsapa a châ!
Thlahpa a hlao leipa pôhpa cha athipa a châ. Cha hawhna chata hmotaopa a hlao leipa ngiapâna chhao athipa a châ hra.
Unawh saih u, nama hry liata chyhsa hluhpi la pachutuhpa châ khoh hlei khuh vy. Keimo pachutuhpazy pi cha pachiana a sâh viapa ta pachia awpa eima châpa nama pahno.
Eima zydua ta kyh hluhpi liata eimâ chapia tyh. Chyhsa ta a biereipa liata â chapia beih vei khiahta cha, cha chyhsa cha chyhsa pakipa châ ta, a pôhpa zydua chhao a vaih theipa a châ.
Pachâ tua u, eima rei amâ ngiah thei nawpa ta arâ pakah liata chhâri pabaw pi ta, arâ pôhpa zydua eima khona lâ eima pasiesa thei.
Balyhzy chhao he pachâ tua u, lai ngaita ta, thlih rupa ta a pasiesapa a châ tarawpa ta, haohtuhpa ta pahiehna chyhpata hmâpa ta a khona lâ maih a pasiesa thei.
Cha hawhna chata paleih chhao he pôhpa pachiapa chyhpata châ ta, a palai ngaitapa a châ. Meihlih dipa ta râh kawh pi a pakâ theizie chhao pachâ tua u!

Paleih he mei châ ta, moleina khizaw a châ. Eima pôhpa pachiahpazy hry liata mei tlu ta chichhihpa châ ta, moleina tao awpa ta thatlô ngaitapa a châ. Paleih chata pôhpa zydua papuapalei ta, hro chhôh khihsatôhtuna zydua mei ta pakâ ta, hriena su mei tipo lâ a chhituhpa a châ.
Râhsa chi to, pavaw chi to, alyhpasa chi to nata tilaipi liata hmohrohneipa to he pangâh theipa châ ei ta, chyhsapa ta a pangâh tyh.
Paleih deikua cha ahy hmah ama pangâh thei leipa châ ta, thina châmaih ta a biepa, moleina a y molo thei leipa a châ.
Cha paleih chata eima Beipa nata Paw reithai pi ta, cha paleih lilaw chata Khazohpa lyupa ta taopa chyhsazy chô liata chhie eima sa tyh.
Pakah miakha tawhta reithaina nata chhiesana a pua tyh. Unawh saih u, cha hmozy cha, cha hawhta a châ awpa châ vei.
Tihnawh miakha tawhta ti pahâhpa nata ti iahpa a papua beih ma?
Unawh saih u, theiku kô liata ôli thei a pathei beih ma? Cha leipa chhao ta, kre zôh liata theiku a pathei thei ma? Cha hawhna chata ti iahpa khaoh ta ti pahâhpa papua thei hra vei.
Nama hry liata ahy ma asopa nata novâhpa a y? A reisi ngaitapa nata so ngaitapa ta, a hmotaopazy cha hrozie phapa ta pamosa mawh sy.
Nama palôh liata hiatlia pasa kawpa nata khohlei khona a hneipa nama châ khiahta deikua cha, nama sona cha a palaikhei leipa u la, biedopa a dyuhpa ta haipa bie reih khuh vy.
Cha sona cha chô lâ tawhta a za tlôpa sona châ leipa ta, khizaw sona châ ta, thlahpa tawhta châ leipa ta, ahripa tawhtapa tlao a châ.
Hiatliana nata khohlei khona a yna lia maihta, tymâna nata paraona pasichhihpa to a y tyh.

Chô lâ tawhta sona a za tlôpa deikua cha, a hmiatua ta pathaih ta, thlalôhna ta pazi ta, a nônai ta, hmo yzie pahno thai ta, zawngiahna nata thei phapa ta bie ta, khokhei viapa hnei leipa ta, so piehpiepa châ vei.
Siana thei cha adyryhna taotuhpazy ta adyryhna liata chi ama tupa patheipa a châ.
Nama hry liata adyuhna nata ahryunazy he khâpa tawhta a pua tyhpa ma a châ? Nama aohraohnazy vâta nama pôhpa pachiahpazy liata adyuhna a tao tyhpa châ vei ma?

Khopa hnei ei chi ta, hnei thei tlôh leipa ei chi ta, chavâta liany nama cheih tyh. Uahva ei chi ta, hnei thei tlôh leipa ei chi ta, chavâta a dyuh ei chi ta, namâ hryuh tyh. Nama hia leipa vâta nama hmô leipa a châ.
Hiah ei chi ta, nama hiapa su leipa ta, nama aohraohna châta hmâ awpa ta nama hiapa vâta, hmô veih ei chi.
Nâmo, apheipa saih u, khizaw viasa châpa he Khazohpa nata akhakhaina a châ tahpa pahno veih ei chi ma? Chavâta ahy rai khizaw viasa châ a khohpa maih, Khazohpa khakhaipa ta â tao tyh.
Biehrai ta, “Keimo liata pahrâ awpa ta a taopa thlahpa cha tlaichhai ta a hiatlia ngaita,” a tahpa he achhuahna y leipa ta a reipa a châ na ta nama pangiasa ma?
Châhrasala ngiachhiena hluh via ta tlao a vaohei tyh. Chavâta Biehrai ta, “Khazohpa ta apalaipazy a dyuh ta, areisipazy deikua a ngiachhie tyh,” a tahpa a châ.
Chavâta Khazohpa liata a ngiarih teh u. Ahripa a dyuh u la, a châ râsai aw ei.
Khazohpa a hnia u la, ano chhao a châ hnia aw ei. Nâmo, moleipa saih u, nama kuzy a si u la, palôh a zawvawpa saih u, nama palôhzy pathai teh u.
Pachârôhpa ta y u la, mâchhiesa u la, cha teh u. Nama pahneina cha mâchhiesana lâta a lie sala, namâ lyna chhao hnabeidyna lâta a lie mawh sy.
Abeipa hmiakô liata a panawh u la, Abeipa ta a cha palyupalih aw ei.

Unawh saih u, nâmo nata nâmo a reipachhie khuh vy. Ahy rai unawhpa a reipachhiepa tlyma, unawhpa a seipa tlyma cha, ryhpa a reipachhiepa nata a seipa a châ. Ryhpa na sei khiahta cha, ryhpa a zyhtuhpa châ leipa chi ta, ryhpa a pachiatuhpa tlao na châ.
Ryhpa pietuhpa nata a pachiatuhpa pakha deita a y. Ano cha a pachha theipa nata a pahlei theipa a châ. Na vaih a seituhpa chi cha ahy ma na châ tly?
Tahmâ pachâ tua u, nâmo, “Tanoh tlyma, mylâ tlyma, cha khihpi lâ sie aw pi ta, cha liata kô kha y aw pi ta, sôh palie aw pi ta, athôhna eima hmô aw,” a tahtuhpazy saih u,
mylâ khâpa hmo ma a y aw tahpa pahno tlôh ei chi va. Nama hrona cha khâpa ma a châ? Tihu buakha a vaw lâ ta, a lei heihpa hawh dei mah nama châ tâh.
Cha hawhta reih leipa u la, “Abeipa ta â ryh a tah khiahta cha, hroh aw pi ta, he hmo he tao aw pi ta, cha hmo cha eima tao aw,” tlao nama tah awpa a châ.
Châhrasala a pasâhsapa ta, a palai ei chi ta, cha hawhpa apalaina zydua cha moleina a châ.
Chavâta ahy rai hmo pha tao awpa pahno thlâh ha ta, a tao tlôh leipa cha, ano châta moleina a châ.
Nâmo, hneirôhpa saih u, a vy u la, nama chô liata rietheina vaw tlô haipazy vâta cha u la, thata sâh teh u.
Nama hneirônazy hmy ha ta, nama chysiazy chhoma-u ta a chaih khai haw.
Nama ngôh nata tâkâzy a saiie khai ha ta, a saiiepa cha nama thaileizie pahnosana châ aw ta, nama sapa mei hawhta a kâ aw. Noh hnôhchaipazy liata ryu a pachôpa nama châ.
Nathlie tua u, nama lyu rai a hriapazy hlao â doleipa ta nama patâhpazy khata nâmo leihpa ta awh ei ta, hriatuhpazy chana pyu cha, Pheisaihzy Abeipa nakhaoh liata â ngia haw.
Khizaw liana heta sapa palysapa ta phasapa ta hroh ei chi ta, thina noh zy lia taihta nama palôh namâ palysa.
Chyhsa siapazy thailei pachâsa ei chi ta, châ dyuh leipazy nama thie haw.
Chavâta unawh saih u, Abeipa a vy hlâlei palôh pasipa ta y teh u. Pachâ tua u, lyuhneituhpa cha vâsua hmiatuapa nata vâsua hnôh viapa a hmô hlâlei alei thei sôhpa a hâ hualua tyh.
Nâmo chhao palôh pasipa ta y u la, Abeipa avyna a hnia ha tlôh ta, chavâta palôh a ipa ta y teh u.
Unawh saih u, seipa ta nama y lei nawpa ta, nâmo nata nâmo a paphôh thlu khuh vy. Moh tua u, Ryureituhpa cha ochhi thaby liata â duah thlâh haw.
Unawh saih u, Abeipa moh ta bie a reihpa hrohsopazy kha, pasataona nata palôh pasina kyh liata a mopâ awpa ta hmâh teh u.
Pachâ teh u, pasataotuhpazy cha nohlaopa tah pi ta, Zawbâ palôh pasizie kha thei ei chi ta, Abeipa hmochhuahpa chhao hmô ei chi ta, Abeipa cha ngiachhietuhpa nata zawngiahtuhpa a châpa nama hmô haw.

Châhrasala unawh saih u, cha zydua hlâta peimawh chaipa cha, chhiesa lei awpa a châ. Avâ reipa ta tlyma, alei reipa ta tlyma, hmo hropa kheihawhpa reipa ta tlyma, chhiesapa ta bie a taih leipa u la, thailei pachâsapa ta nama y lei nawpa ta, a châpa cha “a châ” tah u la, a châ leipa cha, “châ vei” tah lymâ teh u.
Nama hry liata pasataopa ama y ma? Thlahchhâ mawh sy. Alypa ama y ma? Reithaina hla sa mawh sy.
Nama hry liata tlâhleipa ama y ma? Awnanopa machâzy aw sala, âmo ta Abeipa moh ta sathaw thupa ta, ano châta thlahchhâ mawh ei sy.
Ngiapâna ta thlahchhâna ta tlâhleipa cha pachha aw ta, Abeipa ta ano cha a pathyu aw. Moleina hmo a taopa a châ khiahta cha, a ngiahthaipa a châ aw.
Chavâta patlâhpa ta nama y thei nawpa ta, nama moleinazy reihpha a cheih raihrie u la, thlah a chhâkhei raihrie teh u. Chyhsa siapa thlahchhâna ta hmo rônahpa a tao tyh.
Elaizâh kha keimo hawhpa nôchâ a phaohpa chyhsapa châ ta, avâ suah lei awpa ta phahnai khoh ngaitapa ta thlahchhâ ta, kô thôh nata thla charu chhôh zydua alei chô liata avâ suah khao vei.
Chatawhcha thlahchhâ heih ta, avâ ta avâ pasuasa ta, alei ta thei a pathei heih.
Unawh saih u, nama hry liata biehmeiseihpa tawhta pavia sala, ahy tlyma ta â vaw chhi heih khiahta cha,
a paviana lâpi tawhta moleipa a chhi pakhuatuhpa cha, thina tawhta a thlahpa a pachhapa châ aw ta, a moleina hluhpi a khupa haw tahpa a pahno mawh sy.
Zisu Krista lyuhchâpa Pity ta Pawntu, Kalatia, Kâpadôkia, Asia nata Bithunia râhzy liata paipatlapa ta a ypa atlyhpa sahlao,

Paw Khazohpa pahno chhieliepa hawhta atlyhpazy, Zisu Krista rei a ngiah awpa nata a thisaih ta thia awpa ta Thlahpa ta pathaisapazy ei cha naoh ei. Nama chô liata ngiachhiena nata thlalôhna papôhsapa ta y mawh sy.

Eima Beipa Zisu Krista Khazohpa nata Paw cha reithaipa ta y mawh sy! Ano cha zawngiahna rônah ngaitapa a hneipa a châpa hawhta, athihpa hry tawhta Zisu Krista thyuheihna zawhzi ta hnabeiseihna hrohpa hnei awpa ta miah papihpathisa ta,
ryuto rao thei leipa, apuapa a hlao leipa nata lo beih leipa vârâh liata a cha sopa ei.
Daihti hnôhchaipa liata palâhâh awpa ta a mâ chiehpa ta a ypa ngiapâna vâta pachhana nama hmô thei nawpa ta, Khazohpa hmotaotheina ta vaipa nama châ.
Cha hnabeiseihna liata thata a ly ei chi ta, pasiana to ta tahmâ buakha chhôh pachârôhpa ta nama y chy.

Chatanachata pasiapa ta a ypa namâ ngiapâna cha, mei ta pasiapa ngôh hlâta sôh viapa ngiapâna hmeiseihpa a châzie a lâ aw ta, Zisu Krista â vaw luah tita reithaina nata palyupalihna nata rônahna zy nama to aw.
Krista cha nama hmô leipa chhao ta a kyh pachâ ei chi ta, tahmâ hmô hra vei u la, a ngiapâ ei chi ta, pakah ta rei khai thei leipa alyna nata rônahna ta biepa ta,
namâ ngiapâna chhâpa nama thlahpa pachhana cha nama hmô haw.
Cha pachhana kyh cha, nama chô liata ngiachhiena a vaw tlô awpa a chhochhielietuhpa hrohsopazy ta pakhâta ta tluapa ta a laichadai ei ta,

âmo liata a ypa Krista Thlahpa ta Krista pasa tao awpa nata cha khai tawhta palyupalihna a vaw pazi awpazy kyh ama rei chhielie nona khata, khati ta ma vaw tlô aw ta, kheihawh ta a vaw tlô awpa ma a châ tahpa zy amâ laichadai tyh.

Cha biezy cha hrohsopazy ta ama rei nota, âmosasyh â chakaopa châ leipa ei ta, nâmo châ chakaopa ama châzie ama hnohta pahnosapa ama châ. Cha hmozy cha vârâh tawhta tuapa Thlahpa Pathaihpa baona ta thâtihpha châ chhotuhpazy ta tahmâ nota ama cha chhopa hmozy he a châ. Cha hmozy cha vâlyuhchâpazy chhao ta hmô awpa ama khoh kaw tyh.
Chavâta nama palôh chai a saihpa ta a hrohrua u la, Zisu Krista â vaw luah tita ngiachhiena a cha vaw phaopa awpa ei cha khâchâ hnabeiseihpa ta y teh u.
Saw phapazy hawhta y u la, kha hlâta nama pahno lei nota nama aohraohnazy hawh khata y khao khuh vy.
Châ awtuhpa ei a pathaihpa hawhta, nâmo chhao nama yzie zydua liata pathaihpa ta y teh u.
“Kei ei pathaihpa hawhta, nâmo chhao nama pathaih awpa a châ,” tahpa ropa a châ.
Khokhei viapa hnei leipa ta, chyhsa to ama hmotaopa chyu hawhta pachiatuhpa cha Paw hawhta nama pado khiahta cha, khizaw liata nama y chhôh cha khitlyhpa hawhta y u la, Paw Khazohpa cha chiza muh vy.
Châ pathlatuhpazy tawhta nama to pachhuahpa nama yzie hraoleipa tawhta a rao theipa tâkâ nata ngôh ta chatlaipa châ leipa ei chi ta,
mietakutaw seina hnei leipa nata apuapa a bai leipa thisaih hawhta Krista thisaih sôhpa ta chatlaipa nama châpa nama pahno.
Ano cha leilô y hlâ tawhta pahno chhieliepa châ ta, nâmo châ deikua ta cha daihti hnôhchaipazy liata palâhâhpa a châ.

Khazohpa ta Krista cha athihpa hry tawhta pathyupa ta rônahna patosa ta, Krista zawhzi ta Khazohpa ngiapâtuhpazy nama vaw châ haw. Chatanachata namâ ngiapâna nata hnabeiseihna cha Khazohpa liata a y thlâh ha aw.
Unawhzy kyhpachâna hmeiseihpa hnei awpa ta biehmeiseihpa zyh ei chi ta, nama thlahpa nama pathaisa ha tawhta cha, palôh pathaihpa nata hmeiseihpa ta kyh a pachâ raihrie muh vy.
Chi rao theipa liata pihpathipa châ leipa ei chi ta, chi rao thei leipa, Khazohpa bie hroh thlâhpa nata a y thlâh hapa liata a pihpathipazy nama châ.
“Chyhsa zydua sibiepa hawhta châ ei ta, Ama rônahna zydua chhao, Sibiepa paw hawh dei a châ. Sibiepa cha uah ta, Pawpi chhao a lo tyh.
Abeipa bie deikua cha, Chhâzaw ta a y thlâh ha aw.” Cha bie cha thâtihpha ama cha chhopa cha a châ.
Chavâta ahaona, haidihaiduana, phapakheina, hiatliana nata reipachhiena zydua bâhsai teh u.
Hawsaih pih thiehpazy hawhta, thlahpa sâhpiti patapa vâ u la, chatanachata nama pachhana liata nama laiseih lymâ aw.
Abeipa phana nama padi ha hih.
Ano cha chyhsazy kho leipa châ ta, Khazohpa mohmô liata deikua cha, atlyhpa nata sôh ngaitapa alô hrohpa a châ. Abeipa nama pangai hapa vâta,
Zisu Krista zawhzi ta Khazohpa a pyh tlâhpa thlahpa atheihna hlâtuhpa theihthai pathaihpazy châ awpa ta, alô hrohpa hawhta paduapa thlahpa o nama châ.
Chavâta Biehrai liata, “Moh teh u, Zaio liata alô paryh na ta, Ano cha a ki liata alô sôhpa nata atlyhpa châ ta; Ahy rai ano a ngiapâpa cha, Maophyuh aw vei,” tahpa ta ropa a châ.
Chavâta Krista cha nâmo, ngiapâtuhpazy châta hmo sôh ngaitapa châ ta, ngiapâleipazy châta deikua cha, “O satuhpazy kho leipa alô cha, A ki liata alô phahnai chaipa a vaw châ haw;
Achapiana lô vaw châ ta, Moleina lôpanô a vaw châ haw.” Bie ama zyh leipa vâta a chapia ei ta, cha hawhta y awpa ta raopa rai ama châ.

Nâmo deikua la, zohna tawhta puapa ta khaihna noâhpa liata a ngia awpa ta châ awtuhpa ei phana cha nama phuah thei nawpa ta, phopi atlyhpa, abei chi theihthaipa, phopi pathaihpa, Khazohpa ryuto phopi nama châ.
Hlâno ta cha phopi châ leipa ei chi ta, tahmâ deikua cha Khazohpa phopi nama châ haw. Hlâno ta cha zawngiahna hmô leipa ei chi ta, tahmâ deikua cha zawngiahna nama hmô haw.
Kho ngaitapa saih u, khichhaipa nata khitlyhpa nama châpa vâta, thlahpa a dyuhtuhpa sapa aohraohnazy bâhsai awpa ta ei châ haw ei.

Zenitaizy hry liata zachhihpa ta y teh u. Chatanachata moleina hmo a taopazy hawhta ama cha reipachhiepa chhao ta, nama hmo pha taopazy hmô aw ei ta, Khazohpa ta miah a vaw tly noh ta ano cha ama palyupalih thei aw.
Ryureih awpa ta raopazy cha, Abeipa vâta ama rei a ngiah teh u. Biehnei chaipa bei rai châ sala,
moleina hmo a taopazy hrie awpa nata hmo pha a taopazy palyupalih awpa ta bei ta a tuapa râhvaotuhpa rai châ sala, ryureituhpazy rei a ngiah khai awpa a châ.
Cha cha Khazohpa khozie châ ta, ahrupazy ta pahno leina vâta bie ama reipazy cha, nama hmo pha taopa ta nama chalihsa thei aw.
Khotalaipa châ ei chi ta, châhrasala nama khotalaina cha moleina khu nawpa ta nama hmâ awpa châ leipa ta, Khazohpa chakaotuhpazy hawhta tlao nama y awpa a châ.
Chyhsa zydua za u la, unawhzy kyhpachâ u la, Khazohpa chi u la, abei cha za teh u.
Sei saih u, kyh to liata nama zibeipazy rei a ngiah teh u. Zibeipa phapa nata nônaipazy dei châ leipa ta, zibeipa nôchhiepazy rei chhao namâ ngiah awpa a châ.
Chyhsa ta Khazohpa a pachâpa vâta pasa tao lei awpa taopa ta, pachârôhna a tao hualuapa cha, palyupalihna a to tlâh a châ.

Tuna pasataona namâ tyh tita, tiama kawpa ta dao thei hra u la, moleina hmo nama taopa vâta namâ tyhpa a châ khiahta cha, khâpa phahnaina a hnei? Hmo pha taopa vâta pasa tao ei chi ta, tiama kawpa ta nama dao thei khiahta deikua cha, cha cha Khazohpa hmiakô liata palyupalihna a to tlâh a châ.
Krista kha nâmo châta pasa a taopa vâta, nâmo chhao pasa tao awpa ta awpa châ ei chi ta, a pheihnie nama pazi thei nawpa ta a mopâ awpa a cha sopa ei.
Ano cha hmo a parao beih leipa, a pakah liata haidihaiduana a y leipa a châ.
Reipachhiepa ta a y nota, reipachhie hri leipa ta, pasa taopa ta a y nota, pachhipary hra vei. Â dopa ta pachiatuhpa hnohta tlao â hlâ tyh.
Moleina thisaipa ta siana lâta eima hroh thei nawpa ta, eima moleinazy cha ano ta a pôhpa tlai ta tho liata phaoh ta, Krista hmahzy ta patlâhpa ta nama y haw.
Mietakuzy hawhta lâpi pavia ei chi ta, tahmâ deikua cha nama thlahpa Chhituhpa nata Mietaku Vaituhpa lâ nama kua ha hih.

Cha hawhna chata nâmo, lapinô saih u, nama vahpazy rei a ngiah teh u. Chatanachata Khazohpa bie a zyh leipa vahpazy ama y khiahta cha, bie ta chho cheingei hlei leipa chhao ta, ama lapinôzy hrozie ta pahniepa ta ama y thei aw.
Nama zachhihna nata pathaihna hro nama vahpazy ta ama hmô tita, âmo cha nama pahnie thei aw.
Namâ tobina cha khôtho lâ atobina, sâ phiehpa, ngôh ta a tobipa, chysia ta a tobipa zy châ leipa sala,
chhôh lâta atobina, chhithaina a tleih beih leipa, nônaina nata achalihna palôh ta tlao a tobipa châ mawh sy. Cha cha Khazohpa mohmô ta a sôh ngaita.
Cha hawhna chata hlâno ta chanô pathaihpa, Khazohpa ngiapâtuhpazy chhao khata, ama vahpazy rei a ngiahpa ta, chhôh lâta atobina ta amâ vaw tobi tyh.
Sârâ chhao khata Abarahâ cha ei zibeipa tahpa ta aw ta, a rei â ngiahpa kha. Hmo pha nama tao khiahta cha, khâpa hmah chi leipa aw ei chi ta, chatanachata Sârâ sawzy nama châ aw.

Cha hawhna chata, nâmo, vahpa saih u, chanô cha hmobaoh rao nao viapa a châ hleikhô ta, nama lapinôzy cha ngiachhiena hro liata ryu nama to lâhpazy ama châpa vâta, nama thlahchhânazy pakhâpa ta a y lei nawpa ta, nama lapinôzy palyupalih u la, pahnothai kawpa ta pahrâ khoh teh u.
A chhâ chaina ta cha, nama zydua ta palôh miakha phaohpa ta y u la, tha a pasa raihrie teh u. Unawh hawhta kyh a pachâ u la, a ngiachhie raihriepa ta, areisipa ta y teh u.
Moleina cha moleina ta viarithô leipa u la, reipachhiena chhao reipachhiena ta viarithô hra leipa u la, byhnâ tlao awpa teh u. Cha hawhta taopa ta byhnâ to awpa ta awpa nama châ.
“Kyhpachâna hro tlaichhai ta, Noh pha a hmô khohpa cha, Moleina liata a paleih vaih sala, Dôveina liata a hmao vaih mawh sy.
Moleina a heihsai sala, Hmo pha tao mawh sy; Thlalôhna tlua sala, A chadai lymâ mawh sy.
Abeipa mo cha mosiapazy chô liata y ta, Ama thlahchhâna lâ nah a pachôh tyh. Moleipazy deikua cha, Abeipa hmia ta â dyuh tyh ei.”
Hmo pha taona liata phahnai namâ ngiah khiahta cha, ahy châ parao thei aw ei?
Siana vâta pasa a taopa nama châ khiahta cha, vânoh nama to aw. Ama cha pachhiparyna chi leipa u la, nôpopa ta y hra khuh vy.

Nama palôh liata deikua cha, Krista cha Abeipa ta hnei u la, hnabeiseihna nama hneina chhâpa châ hiahripa maih a chhy awpa ta khatino rai ta a mâ chiehpa ta y teh u. Cha hawhta nama tao tita deikua, nônaina, zana nata
chhie nata pha pahnona pathaihpa hmâpa ta nama tao awpa a châ. Chatanachata Krista liata nama hrozie phapa a reipachhie tyhpazy cha maophyuhpa ta ama y aw.
Moleina hmo taopa vâta pasa taopa hlâta cha, Khazohpa khozie a châ khiahta cha, hmo pha taopa vâta pasa taopa a pha via.
Khazohpa lâ miah â chhi thei nawpa ta, Krista cha moleinazy châta chhâzaw châta ei kha thi ta, mosiapa cha moleipa vyuhpa ta thi ta, sapa liata thiepa ta y ta, thlahpa liata deikua pahropa ta a y.
Cha hawhta a thina liana chata patâhna o liata thlahpa a ypazy hnohta bie chho ta,

âmo cha Nôah hro nota balyh tao chhôh zydua Khazohpa ta dao thei ngaitapa ta a hâ chhôh ta reingiahleipa thlahpazy kha ama châ. Balyh liana cha chyhsa chyhta, pacharie deita, ti tawhta ta pachhapa ama châ.

Cha taozie nata a lyupa bâtina ta nâmo chhao tahmâ pachhapa nama châ. Pôhpa tawhta apuapa pathaipa hawhta châ leipa ta, chhie nata pha pahnona pathaihpa hmâpa ta Khazohpa nama padopa vâta, Zisu Krista thyuheihna zawhzi ta pachhapazy nama châ.
Zisu Krista cha vârâh lâ kiah ta, Khazohpa chachâh lâta y ta, vâlyuhchâpazy, biehneinazy nata hmotaotheinazy cha ano rei sai ta y awpa ta taopa ama châ.
Krista cha sapa ta pasa a taopa a châpa vâta, nâmo chhao, cha hawhpa pachâna chata a tobi hra teh u. Sapa ta pasa a tao hapa cha moleina a bâhsaipa a châ.
Chatanachata sapa ta nama hro chhôh zydua chyhsapa aohraohnazy liata hroh khao leipa aw ei chi ta, Khazohpa khozie hawhta nama hroh thei aw.
Zenitaizy khopa taopa ta, parâna, aohraohna, paripangana, a hlao ta apatlana, sahma do pahmaohna nata nothlahpa achhyna pasichhihpa zy liata nama vaw tlaih tyhpa kha â daih ha bâ.
Cha kyh liata phasa ngaitapa ta ama y tyhpa liata namâ hlao khao leipa ama noâh kaw ta, ama cha reipachhie tyh.
Ahrohpa nata athihpa pachia awpa ta a mâ chiehpa ta a y thlâh hapa hnohta ama thâtih âmo tlai ta amâ reih aw.
Cha vâna chata athihpa hnoh chhao ta thâtihpha chhopa a châ. Sapa ta a ypa chyhsazy hawhta pachiapa ama châpa chhao ta, Khazohpa hawhta thlahpa ta ama hroh ha aw.
Hmo zydua chhâna â hnia haw. Chavâta thlah nama chhâ thei nawpa ta palôh pasohpa nata a sohsi ngaitapa ta y teh u.
Kyhpachâna ta moleina hluhpi khu ta, chavâta ato zydua hlâta kyhpachâna pachâ peimawh viapa ta, palôh hmeiseihpa ta kyh khâ a pachâ teh u.
A pasô raihrie u la, paphôh khuh vy.
Chyhsa to hmopiepa to chyu ei chi ta, Khazohpa ngiachhiena nanopa nama topazy a châpa pahnopa ta, hmopiepa nama topazy cha a chakao raihrie nawpa châta hmâh teh u.

Ahy rai bie a reihpa maih Khazohpa bie hawhta reih sala, a chakaopa maih Khazohpa ta thatlôna a piepa lymâ hawhta chakao mawh sy. Chatanachata Zisu Krista vâta Khazohpa cha kyh to liata palyupalihpa ta a y thei aw. Rônahna nata hmotaotheina cha chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta ano eih châ tlôh ta. Amen.
Kho ngaitapa saih u, pasiana ru ngaitapa a tyhpa ta pasa nama tao tita, nama chô liata hmo a tlôpa cha noâh tah khuh vy.
Krista rônahna â vaw luah tita, thaphapa ta namâ ly thei nawpa ta, Krista pasataona a hlykheituhpazy nama châ.
Krista moh vâta pasipasawhpa nama châ khiahta cha, rônahna Thlahpa nata Khazohpa Thlahpa cha nama chô liata y ta, chavâta nama nohlao aw.
Lianycheina vâta tlyma, paruna vâta tlyma, paraona vâta tlyma, hohiahna vâta tlyma deikua cha, nama hry liata ahy hmah pasa tao khah sy.
Krizyhpa a châpa vâta pasa a taopa cha, a noza leipa sala, Krista moh ta Khazohpa tlao palyupalih mawh sy.
Pachiana cha Khazohpa chhôhkhazy liata pathao a daih ha ta, keimo lia hmahta pachiana a pathao khiahta cha, Khazohpa thâtihpha bie a zyh leipazy chhâna awpa chhochhi cha kheihta ma a châ aw tly?
“Mosiapa hmahta pachha lyliapa a châ khiahta cha, Khazohpa a uasa leipa nata moleipa chhochhi cha, Kheihta rimâ ma ama châ aw tly?”
Chavâta Khazohpa khozie hawhta pasa a taopazy cha, hmo pha taona chôta, Taotuhpa ngâchhihpa liata ama thlahpa pavaosa mawh ei sy.
Nama hry liata Awnanopa chhituhpazy kha, kei, nama chhituh heihpa, Krista pasa taonazy a pahnotuhpa nata rônahna a vaw luah awpa a to hra awpa heta ei cha pasyu ei.

Nama hry liata Khazohpa mietaku zaw kha vaih u la, mohôh teh u. Tao awpa a châpa vâta tao leipa ta, Khazohpa bie hawhta byuh ngaitapa ta taopa châ mawh sy. Avyuhna puapa khopa vâta châ leipa sala, chakaona rai hria khohpa vâta châ mawh sy.
Nama mohôhpa mietakuzy chô liata a pabeisa leipa u la, mietaku zaw châta a mopâ tlâhpa ta tlao y muh vy.
Chatanachata Mietaku Vaituhpa Beichaipa â vaw luah tita, rônahna beilakho rao thei leipa nama hmô aw.

Cha hawhna chata nâmo, hawti viapazy saih u, uhthei viapazy liata a ngiarih teh u. Nama zydua ta areisina chysia ta a tobi u la, a chakao raihrie teh u. “Khazohpa ta apalaipazy a dyuh ta, areisipazy deikua cha a ngiachhie tyh.”
Chavâta Khazohpa ku thatlôpa ry liata a panawh teh u. Chatanachata a daihtita liata a cha palyupalih aw ei.
Khazohpa ta cha pachâ ngaita ei ta, chavâta nama nôpona zydua a chô liata pahnieh teh u.
Palôh pasohpa ta y u la, a hrohrua teh u. Nama khakhaipa ahripa cha chakeibarôhneipa a rôhpa hawhta a rôh ta, a nie thei awpa tluapa ta â khie tyh.
Khizaw zydua liata nama unawhzy chô liata chhao, cha hawhta pasataona cha a tlô hra tahpa pahnopa ta, ngiapâna liata â ipa ta y u la, ahripa a dyuh teh u.

Ngiachhiena zydua Khazohpa, a chhâzaw rônahna to awpa ta Krista liata châ awtuhpa ei chata, bohpi leipa pasa nama tao khai tawhta, cha paduapathi aw ei ta, cha pa-ipa ta tha cha patlô aw ei ta, a cha padua aw ei.
Hmotaotheina cha a hnohta chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta y mawh sy. Amen.
Unawh ngâchhihpa ta ei pachâpa Silvanâ baona ta nâmo lâ pasyuna châ chyuta vaw roh na ta, cha cha Khazohpa ngiachhiena hmeiseihpa a châ tahpa ei reih. Cha liana chata â ipa ta a duah muh vy.
Babylaw khih liata a ypa, nâmo hawhta atlyhpa chanô ta a châ naoh ei. Cha hawhna chata ei sawchapawpa Mâka chhao ta a châ naoh ei.
Kyhpachâna ta a pahnâpa ta a naoh raihrie teh u. Krista liata a ypa nama zydua hnohta thlalôhna y mawh sy.
Zisu Krista chakaotuhpa nata lyuhchâpa Saimaw Pity ta Zisu Krista eima Khazohpa nata Pachhatuhpa siana vâta keimo topa hawhpa ngiapâna sôh ngaitapa a to hrapazy ei châ naoh ei.
Khazohpa nata eima Beipa Zisu pahnona liata ngiachhiena nata thlalôhna nama chô liata pôh rili mawh sy.
Ano eima pahnona zawhzi ta, ano rônahna nata phana vâta miah awtuhpa Khazohpa hmotaotheina chata hrona nata Khazohpa pachâna hmo zydua miah a patosa.
Chatanachata a bietai sôh ngaitapa nata rônah ngaitapazy miah pie ta, chazy zawhzi ta moleina aohraohna vâta khizaw liata paraona a ypa cha a râsaipa ta, Khazohpa nôchâ a hlytuhpazy nama vaw châ haw.
Cha vâna tlai chata nama theina zydua papua u la, namâ ngiapâna liata adona a hlao sala, adona liata pahnona a hlao sala,
pahnona liata asohsina a hlao sala, asohsina liata tiamana a hlao sala, tiamana liata Khazohpa pachâna a hlao sala,
Khazohpa pachâna liata unawhzy atlaichhaina a hlao sala, unawhzy atlaichhaina liata kyhpachâna a hlao mawh sy.
Cha chânazy cha hnei u la, a pôh lymâ khiahta cha, eima Beipa Zisu Krista pahnona kyh liata hmotaotheina hnei leipa nata pathei leipa ta y aw veih ei chi.
Ahy rai, cha chânazy a hnei leipa cha mochaopa châ ta, lâhniapa dei hmô thei ta, kha hlâta moleina a vaw taopazy pathaisa hapa a châzie a my haw.
Chavâta unawh saih u, a cha awna ei nata a châ tlyhna ei cha, pa-i awpa ta tiama papua rili teh u. Chazy nama tao khiahta cha pao beih aw veih ei chi.
Chatanachata eima Beipa nata Pachhatuhpa Zisu Krista chhâzaw khinarâh liata a ngia theina cha, pasai ngaitapa ta piepa nama châ aw.
Chavâta cha hmozy cha pahnopa ta, biehmeiseihpa nama hneipa liata namâ i ha tarawpa ta, cha chânazy cha cha pahnosa chanei tyh awpa ei, ei chhuah.
Sapa pôhpa ta ei y chhôh zydua cha, cha pahnosa chanei tyh ta, nama tha cha pathyu awpa cha, hmo phapa a châpa ta ei pahno.
Eima Beipa Zisu Krista ta eina pahnosapa hawhta, ei pôhpa paso nawpa daihti a tlô patoh aw tahpa ei pahno.
Ei sie tawh chhao ta, cha hmozy cha khâ namâ thei thlâh nawpa ta ei tei lylia aw.
Eima Beipa Zisu Krista hmotaotheina nata â vy heih awpa kyh eima cha pahnosa nona kha, phôhpa phichhyhpazy cha chho ma pi. Keimo cha a rônahna a hmôtuhpazy eima châ.
Rônahna Beichaipa tawhta, “He he ei Sawchapawpa kho ngaitapa, a chô liata ei ly ngaitapa a châ,” tahpa ta ao vaw pua ta, Krista cha Paw Khazohpa tawhta palyupalihna nata rônahna a to nona kha,
a hnohta tlâh pathaihpa liata y pi ta, avâ tawhta a zâ puapa ao cha keimo tlai ta eima thei.

Hrohsona bie a i via pachaipa hnei pi ta, khih vaw deih ta deiva awhsi nama palôh liata a vaw pua hlâlei zohna liata meiôh a khaih chypa hawhta, cha hrohsona biezy cha nama pachâ khiahta cha, nama châta a pha aw.
Biehrai liata hrohsona bie kheihawhpa rai, chyhsapa tawhta a puapa bie châ vei tahpa pahno tua awpa a byuh.
Hrohsona bie kheihawhpa rai, chyhsapa pachâna tawhta a puapa châ leipa ta, Khazohpa tawhta a puapa bie cha, chyhsazy ta Thlahpa Pathaihpa chhihthapa ta ama reih tyhpa tlao a châ.

Chyhsazy hry liata hrohso pakheipazy ama vaw pua tyhpa hawhta, pachutuh pakheipazy chhao nama hry liata ama vaw pua aw. Âmo chatlaituhpa Abeipa tlai cha a paphasaipa ta, chyhsa a parao theipa pachuna do leipazy arulâta a vaw ngiakhei aw ei ta, âmosasyh ta ama chô liata raona thlai ama patlôsa aw.
Ama hrozie nozachhihpa cha chyhsa hluhpi ta a mopâ aw ei ta, âmo vâta biehmeiseihpa lâpi reipachhiepa a châ aw.
Sôh tlaichhaina vâta haipa biezy reih aw ei ta, sôhpalie nawpa ta ama cha hmâh aw. Ama thaileichâna cha hlâno tawhta y chakhyh thlâh ha leipa ta, ama leidiana chhao a mô vei.
Vâlyuhchâpazy moleina hmo ama tao nona kha, Khazohpa ta âmo cha pahlôh leipa ta, hriena su liata thy ta, pachiana daihti a tlô hlâlei khaohtlô zohpa liata a khô chy ei.
Ano a uasa leipazy yna khizaw liata tipa-ua a patlôsa nona kha, Khazohpa ta hlâno khizaw kha pahlôh leipa ta, siana bie a chhotuhpa Nôah nata mohropa pasari deita a pahlôh ei.
Sawdawmâ nata Kawmawrâ khihpizy kha ano a uasa leipazy pakhona châta hmâh ta, Khazohpa ta khihpizy cha buchâh lâta pachâsa ta a pamua ha ei.
Moleipazy parâ aohraohna vâta a pachâ thata a rôh tyhpa mosiapa Lawta kha, Khazohpa ta a pachha haw.
Kha chyhsa siapa kha ama hry liata y ta, chyhsazy ta ryhpa rai zyh khoh leipa ei ta, âmo khozie hawhta noh chareih ama hropa a hmôpa nata a theipazy ta a siana palôh a pasasa ngaita tyh.
Cha hawhna chata Abeipa ta ano a pachâtuhpazy cha reipasaona tawhta a pachha nawpazie pahno ta, sialeipazy cha pachiana noh a tlô hlâlei hriena ry liata soh chy nawpazie chhao a pahno.

Sapa aohraohna lôhrâ a patlô tyhpa nata biehneina a mohnaopazy hrie nawpa chhochhi a pahno via pachai. Hru riahphapazy châ ei ta, a palai ngaita ei ta, vâ liata rônahpazy reipachhie awpa hmah a chi leipazy ama châ.
Thatlôna nata hmotaotheina a hnei viapa vâlyuhchâpazy hmahta, chazy reipachhiena bie Abeipa hmiakô liata reih veih ei.
