Âmo deikua cha, pachâna a hmâh thai leipa râhsa, patuapaluana a hnei leipa hmohrohneipazy hawhta châ ei ta, patu awpa nata pahleipadia awpa ta a pihpazy ama châ. Ama pahno leipa kyhzy reipachhie ei ta, râhsazy hawhta âmo chhao pahleipadiapa ama châ hra aw.

Chyhsa ama pasasapa ty hmôpa ta âmo chhao pasasapa ama châ aw. Nohchhô sawhvaw pi ta haosai daihti a hmâh tyhpazy châ ei ta, nama kyhchhi ama châ hlao nota chhao, haosai sai pachâ ei ta, apuapa a kiapa nata seina a hneipazy ama châ.
Ama mokhaoh cha apheina ta bie ta, moleina hmo taona liata ama rih a bie beih leipa ama châ. Chyhsa a i leipazy sydie ei ta, karâhneina palôh phaoh ei ta, chhiesapa sawzy ama châ.
Lâpi dopa tleisai ei ta, ama pavia haw. Hmo doleipa taopa tawhta athôhna hmô a tlaichhaipa Beô sawchapawpa Bâlâma lâpi amâ chhih.
Châhrasala Bâlâma cha a moleina vâta rapa châ ta, alâ reih pathlie thei leipa cha chyhsapa hawhta bie vaw reih ta, hrohsopa hruna cha a pakhâ haw.
Cha chyhsazy cha ti a y leipa vahtiezy châ ei ta, thlihpipa ta a phao pahaipa ameihzy ama châ. Zohna chhakaluhpa nôpona cha âmo châta sopa a châ.
A patahtheisa kawpa ta bie hraoleipazy reih ei ta, moleipa chyhsazy tawhta a râ dyupazy cha, sapa aohraohna moleina liata ama pahluasa tyh.
Chyhsazy hnohta khotalaina bie a taih ei ta, âmo chaipa deikua cha avyuhna sei ta ama y. Kheihawhpa hmo rai ta a pahniepa chyhsa cha, cha hmo sei ta a ypa a châ.

Eima Beipa nata Pachhatuhpa Zisu Krista ama pahnopa vâta, khizaw puanazy amâ râsai ha tawhta, cha lilaw liata a tâh heihpa ta, pahniepa ta ama y heih khiahta cha, hnôhlâ ta ama yzie cha hmialâ ta ama yzie hlâta a chhie via ha tyh.
Siana lâpi pahno ha tlôh ta, ama hnohta biepiepa pathaihpa pavaosapa a heihsai heihpa hlâta cha, siana lâpi pahno leipa ta vaw y lâlao ei sala ama châta a pha via awpa tlai.
“I ta a palipa a nie heih tyh,” tahpa nata “Vao panô cha a ngai â si khai tawhta chiatlao liata â ny heih tyh,” tahpa bieso dopa ama chô liata a vaw tlô.
Kho ngaitapa saih u, he he nama hnohta châpaphaopa ei no ei vaw rona a châ haw. A miano ta, nama pahno chiehpa pahno heih ta, nama palôh pathaihpa tha pathyu nawpa ta ei ropa a châ.
Chatanachata hrohsopa pathaihpazy biereipa nata nama lyuhchâpazy hmâpa ta Abeipa nata Pachhatuhpa biepiepa cha namâ thei thlâh ha aw.
He he pahno tua awpa a byuh. Daihti chhâna nohzy liata cha, mohnaotuhpazy ta ama moleina hmo khopazy chadaipa ta, chyhsazy mohnaona chôta a vy aw ei ta,
“Â vy heihna bietai cha khataih liata a y haw? Pathlatuhzy amâ mô tawh chhao ta, hmotaopazy tao tua nota ama yzie ualua ta hmo to zydua ama y thlâh he zaw” ama tah aw.
Avâzy he Khazohpa bie ta hlâno tawhta a ypa a châzie nata alei chhao ti tawhta nata ti hry liata a vaw ypa a châzie pahno lei a pachâ raruah ei ta,
cha tizy ta cha daihti liata khizaw cha vao ta, a pahleipadia hapa kyh chhao pahno lei amâ pachâ raruah.
Châhrasala cha bie lilaw chata tahmâno ta avâ nata alei a ypazy he mei châta pachô ta, Khazohpa a uasa leipazy pachiana nata leidiana noh a tlô hlâlei â pakhei chy ei.
Kho ngaitapa saih u, he hmo miakha he my khuh vy: Abeipa pachâ ta cha, noh kha he kô sâh kha hawhta châ ta, kô sâh kha chhao noh kha hawhta a châ.

Thokha ta Abeipa cha a bietai patlôna kyh liata nainôsôpa hawhta pachâ ei ta, châhrasala a nainôsô vei. Abeipa cha nâmo châta palôh pasi ngaitapa châ ta, ahy hmah ama leidia awpa khoh leipa ta, chyhsa zydua ama ro khai awpa tlao a khoh.

Abeipa Noh cha parutuhpa hawhta vaw tlô aw ta, cha noh liata avâzy cha thata arôhna chôta leidia aw ei ta, avâ liata hmo a ypazy cha mei ta pakâpa ta pahleipadiapa châ aw ta, alei nata a chhôh liata a ypa zydua chhao a leidia khai aw.
Cha hawhta hmo to zydua pahleipadia khai awpa a châpa vâta, pathaihna nata Khazohpa pachâna hro ta a hrohpa chyhsazy nama châ awpa a byuh.

Cha hawhta yna chôta Khazohpa Noh cha hâ aw ei chi ta, a vaw tlô nawpa daihti nama chatliesa aw. Cha Noh a vaw tlôpa chata avâzy khi kâpa ta pahleipadia aw ta, avâ liata a ypazy cha mei ta a pazao khai aw.
Châhrasala a bietaipa hawhta, keimo la mosiapazy pahrâna avâ thiehpa nata alei thiehpa a hâtuhpazy eima châ.
Chavâta kho ngaitapa saih u, cha hmozy a hâtuhpa nama châpa vâta, apuapa a bai leipa nata seina hnei leipa ta, thlalôhpa ta nama ypa a cha hmô thei nawpa ei ta, tiama papua teh u.
Eima unawh kho ngaitapa Pawla chhao ta, a hnohta sona piepa lymâ hawhta nâmo lâ châ a ropa hawhna khata, eima Beipa daotheizie he pachhana ta rao teh u.

A châpaphaopa zydua liata, cha biezy cha reih ta, cha hawhta a roh tyh. A bie ropazy liata thokha cha pahno ru ngaitapazy châ ei ta, chazy cha chyhsa so leipa nata a i leipazy ta, Biehrai bie hropazy ama chhopasiazie hawhta, pako pakâ ei ta, âmosasyh ta amâ pahleipadia tyh.

Chavâta kho ngaitapa saih u, nâmo la, cha bie cha nama pahno hapa vâta a vaih teh u. Chataleipatala ryhpa papeisaleituhpazy paraona liata a chhipa châ aw ei chi ta, nama duahmo a ipa nama paosai pathlei aw.
Eima Beipa nata Pachhatuhpa Zisu Krista ngiachhiena nata pahnona liata laiseih lymâ teh u. Tahmâ nata chhâzaw ta Abeipa hnohta rônahna y mawh sy. Amen.
Hrona bie, âthaona liata a ypa, eima nah ta thei pi ta, eima mo ta eima hmôpa, moh thlâh ha pi ta, eima ku ta eima hriapa thâtih cha he he a châ.
Hrona cha a vaw luah ta, hmô pi ta, eima pahnokhei. Cha chhâzaw hrona, Paw hnohta a ypa cha eima hnohta a vaw luah ta, cha thâtih cha nama hnohta eima phuah.
Nâmo chhao ta miah namâ kao thei hra nawpa ta, eima hmôpa nata eima theipa cha nama hnohta eima phuah. Eimâ kaona cha Paw nata a Sawchapawpa Zisu Krista liata a châ.
Eimâ lyna â ki thei nawpa ta, he biezy he eima roh.
He he ano tawhta bietapa eima theipa nata nama hnohta eima phuahpa cha a châ: Khazohpa cha khaihna châ ta, ano liata zohna rai y vei.
Zohna liata y thlâh ha tlôhpa ta ano ei kao eima tah khiahta cha, haipa bie eima reih, biehmeiseihpa liata hroh ma pi.
Khaihna liata eima y khiahta deikua cha, ano cha khaihna liata a ypa hawhta, a kao raihrie thei pi ta, a Sawchapawpa Zisu thisaih ta eima moleina zydua tawhta miah a pathaisa tyh.
Moleina hnei ma pi eima tah khiahta cha, keimosasyh ta eimâ dô, biehmeiseihpa keimo liata y vei.
Eima moleinazy palâhâh sih la, reihpha eima chei khiahta cha, eima moleinazy a ngiahthai awpa nata eima sialeina zydua pasia awpa ta, ano cha ngâchhihpa nata a siapa a châ.
Molei ma pi eima tah khiahta cha, ano cha a haihpa ta tao pi ta, a bie keimo liata y vei.
Ei saw saih u, nama molei lei nawpa ta, he biezy he nâmo lâ ei vaw roh. Chatanachôta chyhsa ta a molei khiahta cha, Paw lâta miah reikheituhpa mosiapa Zisu Krista eima hnei.
Ano cha eima moleinazy reihpha cheina châ ta, keimo moleina dei châ leipa ta, khizaw zydua moleina reihpha cheina chhao a châ.
A biepiepazy eima zyh khiahta cha, ano pahnotuhpazy eima châ tahpa eima pahno.
A biepiepazy zyh tlôh leipa ta, “Ano ei pahno,” a tahtuhpa cha a haihpa a châ. Biehmeiseihpa ano liata y vei.
A bie a zyhpa deikua cha, Khazohpa kyhpachâna cha ano liata a paki hmeiseihpa a châ. He liana heta ano liata eima y tahpa eima pahno:
Ano liata ei y a tahtuhpa cha, ano hrozie hawhta a hroh hra awpa a châ.
Kho ngaitapa saih u, biepie thiehpa nâmo lâ vaw roh leipa na ta, biepie parohpa, kha hlâ tawhta nama hneipa kha tlao ei vaw roh. Cha biepie parohpa cha, bie nama thei hapa kha a châ.
Kao kha lâ tawhta la, biepie thiehpa nâmo lâ a vaw rohpa ei châna kao a y. Cha cha ano liata nata nâmo liata â do, zohna cha lei hai ta, khaihna hmeiseihpa a vaw khaih hapa vâta.
Khaihna liata a ypa hawhta a reih tlôh ta, a unawhpa a haopa cha, zohna liata a y thlâh ha chy.
A unawhpa kyh a pachâtuhpa cha khaihna liata a ypa châ ta, a hluah aw vei.
A unawhpa, a haotuhpa deikua cha zohna liata y ta, zohna liata a charei. Zohna ta a mo a pachaosapa vâta khataih lâ ma a sie tahpa chhao pahno vei.
Sawzy saih u, ano moh ta nama moleinazy a ngiahthaipa a châpa vâta, nâmo lâ ei vaw roh.

Pawzy saih u, âthaona tawhta a y thlâhpa ano cha nama pahnopa vâta, nâmo lâ ei vaw roh. Satliazy saih u, moleina nama tiah hapa vâta, nâmo lâ ei vaw roh. Sawzy saih u, Paw nama pahnopa vâta, nâmo lâ ei vaw roh.
Pawzy saih u, âthaona tawhta a y thlâhpa ano cha nama pahnopa vâta, nâmo lâ ei vaw roh. Satliazy saih u, nama thatlô ta, Khazohpa bie nâmo liata y ta, moleipa nama tiah hapa vâta, nâmo lâ ei vaw roh.
Khizaw he kyhpachâ leipa u la, khizaw liata hmo a ypazy kyhpachâ hra khah u. Chyhsa ta khizaw kyh a pachâ khiahta cha, Paw kyhpachâna ano liata y vei.
Khizaw liata hmo a ypa zydua, sapa aohraohna, mokhaoh aohraohna nata hro chhôh hneirôna a palaikheina zy he Paw tawhta a puapa châ leipa ta, khizaw tawhta a puapa a châ.
Khizaw he a aohraohna chhaota a leidia hai. Khazohpa khopa a taotuhpa deikua cha, chhâzaw ta a y thlâh ha aw.

Sawzy saih u, daihti hnôhchaipa a châ haw. Krista dyuhtuhpa â vy aw tahpa nama theipa hawhna khata, tahmâ chhao Krista dyuhtuhpa hluhpi ama vaw pua haw. Chavâta daihti hnôhchaipa a châ haw tahpa eima pahno.

Âmo cha eima hry tawhta pua ei ta, châhrasala eima chyhsa hmeiseihpa châ veih ei. Eima chyhsa hmeiseihpa châ ei sala, eima hnohta ama y lymâ aw. Châhrasala ama zydua ta eima chyhsa hmeiseihpa châ veih ei tahpa a lâ pasia nawpa ta, miah ama puasai haw.
Nâmo deikua la, Mo Pathaihpa ta sathaw a thupa châ ei chi ta, nama zydua ta biehmeiseihpa nama pahno.
Biehmeiseihpa nama pahno leipa vâta, nâmo lâ châ a vaw rohpa châ leipa na ta, biehmeiseihpa pahno ei chi ta, biehmeiseihpa tawhta haipa a pua beih leipa vâta ei vaw ropa a châ.
Zisu cha Krista a châ tahpa a pyh leipa hleikhô ta a haihpa ahy ma a y? Paw nata Sawchapawpa a pyh leipa cha Krista dyuhtuhpa a châ.
Sawchapawpa a pyh leipa cha Paw hnei vei. Sawchapawpa a pyhpa cha Paw chhao a hnei.

Nâmo la, âthaona tawhta nama pahnopa kha, nama palôh liata y thlâh ha mawh sy. Âthaona tawhta nama pahnopa kha nama palôh liata a y thlâh ha khiahta cha, nâmo chhao Sawchapawpa nata Paw liata nama y thlâh ha aw.
Chhâzaw hrona to awpa ta ano tlai ta bie miah â taih.
Cha paviasa a chhuahpazy vâta, chazy cha nâmo lâ ei vaw roh.

Nâmo la, ano tawhta sathawthuna nama hmôpa kha nâmo liata y thlâh ha ta, ahy hmah pachu a ngiah veih ei chi. A sathawthuna ta kyh toti cha pachu ei ta, cha cha a do ta, haipa bie châ vei. A sathawthuna ta a cha pachupa hawhna ei khata, ano liata y thlâh ha teh u.
Chavâta sawzy saih u, ano liata y thlâh ha muh vy. Chatanachata â vaw luah tita hnangâhpa ta y aw pi ta, â vy tita a hmiakô liata noza leipa ta eima y thei aw.
Ano cha mosiapa a châ tahpa nama pahno khiahta cha, siana a hrokheipa maih cha ano sapa a châ tahpa nama pahno aw.

Pachâ teh u, Paw ta kyh miah pachâna cha thata a châ kaw dia! Khazohpa sawzy ta miah a bie ha hih. Cha hawhpa cha eima châ tlai na. Khizaw ta Khazohpa a pahno leipa vâta, keimo chhao miah pahno veih ei.

Kho ngaitapa saih u, Khazohpa sawzy eima châ haw. Kheihta ma eima y aw tahpa deikua a lâ mâh vei. Châhrasala ano â vaw luah tita, ano hawhta eima y aw tahpa eima pahno. Ano cha a châna ualua ta eima hmô aw.
Ahy rai ano liata hnabeiseihna a hneipa maih cha, ano a pathaihpa hawhta, anosasyh ta â pathaisa tyh.
Moleina hmo a taopa maih ryhpa a paraopa ama châ. Moleina cha ryhpa paraona châ tlôh ta.
Krista cha moleinazy siekhei awpa ta â vaw luah tahpa nama pahno. Ano liata la moleina rai y vei.
Ano liata a ypa chyhsa cha molei ngâ thlâh aw vei. A molei ngâ thlâh hapa cha, Krista a hmô leipa tlyma, a pahno leipa tlyma a châ.
Sawzy saih u, ahy hmah a padôveisa khuh vy. Krista cha mosiapa a châpa hawhta, siana a hrokheituhpa cha mosiapa a châ hra.

Ahripa cha âthaona tawhta a molei ngâ thlâh hapa châ ta, chavâta a molei ngâ thlâh hapa chyhsa cha ahripa tawhta a puapa a châ. Ahripa raihria pahleipadia awpa cha, Khazohpa Sawchapawpa â vaw luahna chhâpa a châ.
Ahy rai Khazohpa tawhta a pihpa cha, Khazohpa chi ano liata a ypa vâta, molei ngâ thlâh aw vei. Khazohpa tawhta a pihpa a châpa vâta, molei ngâ thlâh thei vei.

He liana heta ahyzy ma Khazohpa sawzy châ ei ta, ahyzy ma ahripa sawzy a châ ei tahpa â hno: Ahy rai siana a hrokhei leipa cha, Khazohpa tawhta a puapa châ vei. A unawhpa kyh a pachâ leipa chhao Khazohpa tawhta a puapa châ vei.
He he âthaona tawhta bietapa nama theipa kha a châ: Kyh eimâ pachâ raihrie awpa a châ tahpa hih.

Moleipa tawhta a puapa, ano unawhpa a thietuhpa Kainâ hawhna khata eima y awpa châ vei. Khâpa vâta ma a unawhpa kha a thie? A hmotaopazy kha moleina hmo châ ta, a unawhpa hmotaopazy kha a siapa a châpa vâta a châ.
Unawhzy saih u, khizaw ta a châ haopa vâ ei ta nama noâh khah sy.
Unawhzy kyh eima pachâpa vâta thina tawhta pua pi ta, hrona liata eimâ ngia haw tahpa eima pahno. Ahy rai kyhpachâna a hnei leipa cha thina liata a y thlâh haw.
Ahy rai a unawhpa a haopa cha lianycheihpa châ ta, lianycheihpa ahy hmah chhâzaw hrona a chakaihpa y veih ei tahpa nama pahno.
He liana heta kyhpachâna cha khâpa ma a châ tahpa eima pahno: Krista ta keimo châta a hrona a piepa hawhta, keimo chhao unawhzy châta eima hrona eima pie hra awpa a châ.
Chyhsa ta khizaw sôh hnei thlâh ha tlôh ta, a unawhpa a phahlapa hmô sala, thapasana a hnei leipa khiahta cha, Khazohpa kyhpachâna cha ano liata kheihta a y thai aw?
Sawzy saih u, bie nata reikah deita ta kyh a pachâ leipa sih la, hmotaopa nata biehmeiseihpa ta kyh a pachâ ei suh u.
Cha liana chata biehmeiseihpa liata eima y tahpa pahno pi ta, palôh liata alôhna hneipa ta a hmiakô liata eima y theipa a châ.
Eima palôh ta thailei miah a pachâsana maihta, Khazohpa cha keimo palôh hlâta a lai viapa châ ta, ato pahnotuhpa a châ tahpa eima pahno.
Kho ngaitapa saih u, eima palôh ta thailei miah a pachâsa leipa khiahta cha, Khazohpa liata alôhna eima hnei tahna a châ.
A biepiepazy zyh pi ta, â lyna hmo eima taopa vâta, eima hiapa maih ano tawhta eima hmô tyh.
A biepipa cha he he a châ: A Sawchapawpa Zisu Krista moh a ngiapâ ta, bie miah a piepa hawhta kyh a pachâ raihriepa he a châ.
A biepiepazy a zyhpa cha Khazohpa liata y ta, Khazohpa chhao ano liata a y. Thlahpa miah a piepa liana heta, Khazohpa cha keimo liata a y tahpa eima pahno.
Kho ngaitapa saih u, thlahpa momaih zo khuh vy. Hrohso pakheipa hluhpi khizaw liata ama vaw pua hapa vâta, thlahpazy cha Khazohpa tawhta a châ ma, châ vei ma tahpa pasia tyh muh vy.
He liana heta Khazohpa Thlahpa cha nama pahno aw: Zisu Krista cha sapa ta â vy tahpa a châkheipa thlahpa maih cha, Khazohpa tawhta châ ta,
Zisu a châhkhei leipa thlahpa maih cha Khazohpa tawhta châ vei. Cha cha Krista dyuhtuhpa thlahpa, a vy awpa nama theipa nata tahmâ chhao khizaw liata a y hapa he a châ.
Sawzy saih u, nâmo la, Khazohpa tawhtapa châ ei chi ta, nâmo liata a ypa cha khizaw liata a ypa hlâta a rônah viapa vâta, chazy cha nama tiah haw.
Âmo cha khizaw tawhtapa châ ei ta, chavâta khizaw saizie ta bie reih ei ta, khizaw ta ama bie a nathlie.

Keimo cha Khazohpa tawhtapa châ pi ta, Khazohpa a pahnopa maihta eima bie nathlie ei ta, Khazohpa tawhtapa a châ leipazy deikua cha, eima bie nathlie veih ei. Cha liana chata Thlahpa dopa nata thlahpa doleipa eima pahno.
Kho ngaitapa saih u, kyh a pachâ raihrie ei suh u. Kyhpachâna cha Khazohpa tawhta a puapa châ ta, kyhpachâna a hneipa maih Khazohpa sapa châ ei ta, Khazohpa a pahnopa ama châ.
Khazohpa cha kyhpachâna châ tlôh ta, kyhpachâna a hnei leipa cha Khazohpa pahno vei.
Ano vâta eima hroh thei nawpa ta, Khazohpa ta a Sawchapaw matlupa khizaw lâ a vaw tuapa liana heta, Khazohpa kyhpachâna cha eima hry liata palâsapa ta a y.
He he kyhpachâna cha a châ: Keimo ta Khazohpa kyh eima pachâpa vâta châ leipa ta, ano ta kyh miah pachâ ta, eima moleinazy reihpha chei nawpa ta a Sawchapawpa a vaw tuapa hih.
Kho ngaitapa saih u, Khazohpa ta cha tlatlu ta kyh miah a pachâ khiahta cha, keimo chhao kyh eimâ pachâ raihrie awpa a châ.
Ahy hmahta Khazohpa hmô beih veih ei. Kyh eimâ pachâ raihrie khiahta cha, Khazohpa cha keimo liata pahrâ aw ta, a kyhpachâna cha keimo liata pakipa ta a y aw.
A Thlahpa miah a piepa liana heta, ano liata y pi ta, ano chhao keimo liata a y tahpa eima pahno.
Chatanachata Paw ta a Sawchapawpa cha khizaw Pachhatuhpa châ awpa ta a vaw tuah tahpa hmô pi ta, eimâ duakhei.
Ahy rai Zisu cha Khazohpa Sawchapawpa a châ tahpa a châkheipa maih cha, ano liata Khazohpa y thlâh ha ta, ano chhao Khazohpa liata a y thlâh ha hra.
Chatanachata Khazohpa ta kyh miah a pachâ tahpa pahno pi ta, eimâ ngiapâ. Khazohpa cha kyhpachâna a châ. Chavâta kyhpachâna liata a ypa cha Khazohpa liata a ypa châ ta, Khazohpa chhao ano liata a y.
Cha hawhna chata kyhpachâna cha keimo liata pakipa ta y ta, he khizaw liata ano lyupa ta eima ypa vâta, ryureina noh châta thlalôhna eima hnei thei haw.
Kyhpachâna liata la china rai y vei. Kyhpachâna pakipa ta china a papai tyh. Hriena a ypa vâta china y ta, china a hnei thlâh chypazy cha, kyhpachâna liata pakipa ta y mâh veih ei.
Ano ta kyh miah a pachâ tuapa vâta a kyh eima pachâ hra.

Chyhsa ta, “Khazohpa kyh ei pachâ,” tah sala, a unawhpa â hao tlôh khiahta cha, a haihpa a châ. A unawhpa a hmô thlâh hapa hmahta kyh a pachâ vei khiahta cha, a hmô leipa Khazohpa chhochhi cha kheihta ma kyh a pachâ thei aw?
He biepiepa he Khazohpa tawhta eima daopa a châ: Khazohpa kyh a pachâpa cha, a unawhpa chhao kyhpachâ hra mawh sy.
Ahy rai Zisu cha Krista a châ tahpa a ngiapâpa maih cha Khazohpa sapa châ ta, ahy rai a satuhpa kyh a pachâpa cha a sapa chhao kyh a pachâ.
Khazohpa kyhpachâ pi ta, a biepiepazy eima zyhpa liana heta, Khazohpa sawzy kyh eima pachâ tahpa eima pahno.
A biepiepazy eima zyhpa he Khazohpa kyh eima pachâna cha a châ. A biepiepazy cha a hri tlôh lei khâh ta.
Khazohpa sapa maihta khizaw ama tiah tyh. He he khizaw pahniepa ta eima tiahna cha a châ, eimâ ngiapâna hih.
Zisu he Khazohpa Sawchapawpa a châ tahpa a ngiapâtuhpa dei leipa ta cha, ahy ma khizaw a tiah thei tly?
Zisu Krista cha ti nata thisaih ta a vypa châ ta, ti dei ta châ leipa ta, ti nata thisaih ta â vy. Thlahpa cha biehmeiseihpa a châpa vâta, Thlahpa ta ano cha a pahnokhei.
Pahnokheituhpa pathôh ama y.
Chazy cha Thlahpa nata ti nata thisaih zy châ ei ta, ama pathôh ta amâ paraoh.
Chyhsa pahnokheina hmah eimâ pyh khiahta cha, Khazohpa pahnokheina cha a rônah via. Cha cha a Sawchapawpa kyh liata Khazohpa pahnokheina a châ.
Khazohpa Sawchapawpa a ngiapâpa maih ano liata a pahnona a hnei. Khazohpa a ngiapâ leipa deikua cha, Khazohpa ta a Sawchapawpa a pahnokheina â ngiapâ leipa vâta, Khazohpa cha a haihpa ta a tao.
Pahnokheina cha he he a châ: Khazohpa ta chhâzaw hrona miah pie ta, cha hrona cha a Sawchapawpa liata a y.
Sawchapawpa a hneipa maihta hrona hnei ta, Khazohpa Sawchapawpa a hnei leipa cha hrona hnei vei.
Chhâzaw hrona nama hnei tahpa nama pahno thei nawpa ta, nâmo, Khazohpa Sawchapawpa moh a ngiapâtuhpazy hnohta, he biezy he ei roh.
He he ano liata eima thlalôhna a châ: Khâpa rai a khozie hawhta eima hiah khiahta cha, miah a nathlie tyh.
Eima hiapa maih miah a nathlie tahpa eima pahno khiahta cha, ano lâta eima hmo hiapa cha eima hmô haw tahpa eima pahno.

Chyhsa ta thina taih a châ leipa moleina a unawhpa taopa a hmô khiahta cha, thlah a chhâpa awpa a châ. Chatanachata thina taih a châ leipa moleina a taotuhpazy cha Khazohpa ta hrona a pie aw ei. Thina taih a châpa moleina y ta, cha hawhpa châta thlahchhâpa awpa ei tahpa châ vei.
Paraona zydua cha moleina châ ta, thina taih a châ leipa moleina a y hra.
Khazohpa sapa maihta molei ngâ thlâh ha veih ei tahpa eima pahno. Khazohpa sapa a châna ta ano cha hrôbieh ta, Sâtâ ta hria thei vei.
Keimo cha Khazohpa tawhtapa châ pi ta, khizaw pôhpalôhpa he Sâtâ rei sai ta a y tahpa eima pahno.

A hmeiseihpa cha ahy ma a châ tahpa eima pahno thei nawpa ta, Khazohpa Sawchapawpa cha a vy ta, novâhna miah a pie tahpa eima pahno. Keimo cha a hmeiseihpa, a Sawchapawpa Zisu Krista liata a ypazy eima châ. Ano cha Khazohpa hmeiseihpa châ ta, chhâzaw hrona a châ.
Sawzy saih u, khazoh nothlahpa tawhta a panano teh u.
Awnanopa chhituhpa ta biehmeiseihpa liata kyh ei pachâpa chanô atlyhpa nata a sawzy ei châ naoh ei. Keima dei châ leipa ta, biehmeiseihpa a pahnopa zydua ta ama châ naoh hra.
Biehmeiseihpa cha keimo liata y ta, chhâzaw ta eima hnohta a y aw.
Biehmeiseihpa nata kyhpachâna liata Paw Khazohpa nata Paw Sawchapawpa Zisu Krista tawhta ngiachhiena, zawngiahna nata thlalôhna eima hnohta y mawh sy.
Paw ta bie miah a piepa hawhta, na saw thokhazy biehmeiseihpa liata ama ypa hmô na ta, eina palysa ngaita.
Chanô phapa y, na hnohta biepie thiehpa vaw roh leipa na ta, athaohta tawhta eima hneipa biepiepa kha ei vaw roh heih. Kyh a pachâ raihrie suh u.
He he kyhpachâna cha a châ, a biepiepazy eima zyhpa hih. Kyh a pachâ raihrie awpa cha athaohta tawhta nama theipa nata nama zyh awpa ta biepiepa a châ.
Dôveituhpa hluhpi khizaw liata ama vaw pua haw. Âmo cha Zisu Krista sapa ta â vypa a pyh leipazy ama châ. Cha hawhpa chyhsazy cha dôveituhpa nata Krista dyuhtuhpazy ama châ.
Nama hria chiehpazy pahlei leipa ta, lymâ â kipa ta nama hmô thei nawpa ta, a hrohrua teh u.
Ahy rai Krista pachuna bie liata y leipa ta, ano kho ta a siepa cha Khazohpa a hnei leipa a châ. Krista pachuna bie liata a ypa deikua cha, Paw nata Sawchapawpa a hnei pakaoh.
Ahy rai Krista pachuna bie a phao leipa ta nâmo lâ â vy khiahta cha, nama o liata patlôsa leipa u la, reikah phapa chhao hlâ khuh vy.
Reikah phapa a hlâtuhpa maih cha, ano moleina hmotaopazy liata a hlao hrapa a châ.
Nama hnohta bie hluhpi ro awpa hnei hraw sah la, châhna nata châti hmâpa ta roh hlei aw va na. Eimâ lyna â ki thei nawpa ta, nâmo lâ a vy ta, hmiachhypa ta bie cha chho awpa ei tlao ei chhuah.
Atlyhpa na narônô sawzy ta ama châ naoh.
Awnanopa chhituhpa ta biehmeiseihpa liata kyh ei pachâpa, kho ngaitapa Kaiâ ei châ naoh.
Kho ngaitapa y, na thlahpa ta byhnâ a topa hawhta, ato liata byhnâ topa ta, hnatlâna phapa na hnei thei nawpa ta thlah ei cha chhâpa tyh.
Unawhzy vaw tlô ei ta, biehmeiseihpa châta ngâ nâ chhihzie nata biehmeiseihpa liata na y lymâzie ama vaw reipa ta eina palysa ngaita.
Ei sawzy bie hmeiseihpa liata ama y tahpa ei theipa hlâta nâ palysa viapa y vei.
Kho ngaitapa y, unawhzy kha na châta hmia pahno leipa châ hra ei sala, ngâchhih ngaitapa ta ama chô liata hmo vaw tao chi ta,
âmo chata na kyhpachâna cha Awnanopa ama pahnosa haw. Khazohpa chyhsa ama châpa hawhta ama khitlyna liata deichhy tyh la, na tao pha kaw aw.
Ano moh vâta a sie tyhpa châ ei ta, Zenitaizy tawhta khâpa hmah la veih ei.
Chavâta cha hawhpa chyhsazy cha eima deichhy awpa a châ. Chatanachata biehmeiseihpa châta hrialâhpazy eima châ thei aw.
Awnanopa hnohta châ vaw roh ha na ta, châhrasala ama hry liata chôchai ta y a khohpa Diôtarephe ta eima biehneina a pyh khoh vei.

Chavâta ei vy khiahta cha, a hmotaopa, eima kyh miah reih ta, thâ miah a pachhiena kyh kha ei pasia aw. Cha chhao cha a daih tah leipa ta, unawhzy a ly khoh leipa ta, a ly khohpazy pakhâ ta, Awnanopa tawhta a papua ei.
Kho ngaitapa y, moleina hâ a la leipa la, hmo phapa hâ a la mah y. Hmo pha a taotuhpa cha Khazohpa tawhtapa châ ta, moleina hmo a taotuhpa cha Khazohpa a hmô leipa a châ.
Demetia cha chyhsa to palyupalihna hlao ta, biehmeiseihpa chhao ta a palyupalih. Keimo chhao ta palyupalih pi ta, keimo palyupalihna cha â do tahpa na pahno.
Na hnohta bie hluhpi ro awpa ei hnei. Châhrasala châsôh nata châti ta roh hlei aw va na.
Cha hmô patoh awpa hnabeiseih na ta, cha tina chata hmiachhypa ta bie eima reih khoh aw.
Thlalôhna na hnohta y mawh sy. Viasazy ta ama châ naoh. Viasazy kha ama moh reipa ta nâ vaw naohpa chyu mah y.
Zisu Krista chakaotuhpa nata Zâmie unawhpa Zudâh ta Paw Khazohpa liata kyhpachâpa nata Zisu Krista châta awpa nata vaipa sahlaozy ei châ naoh ei.
Zawngiahna zy, thlalôhna zy, kyhpachâna zy nama chô liata pôh rili mawh sy.

Kho ngaitapa saih u, mo to ta pachhana eima topa thâtih nama hnohta ro awpa ei kho kaw nota, mopathaihpazy hnohta chhâzaw châta ei kha piepa ngiapâna a duakhei lymâ awpa ta, nâmo lâ ahawna tao awpa â ngiahpa ta ei pahno.

Chyhsa thokha, kha hlâ tawhta thaileichâ awpa ta rao chiehpazy arulâta amâ vaw ngia. Cha chyhsazy cha Khazohpa a uasa leipazy châ ei ta, eima Khazohpa ngiachhiena cha parâna châta hmâh ei ta, eima Hyutuhpa nata eima Beipa hnei chhôhpa Zisu Krista a paphasaipazy ama châ.
Nama pahno chiehpa a châ tarawpa ta, he bie he ei cha chho chanei khoh heih ei. Phopi miakha cha Zisu ta Izi râh tawhta pachha papua ta, a hnôhlâ ta a ngiapâleipazy a pahleipadia lilaw ei.
Vâlyuhchâpazy chhao ama biehneina nata ama pahrâna su a siesaipazy cha, noh rônahpa pachiana noh tlôna taihta zohna hnabeidyna ry liata chhâzaw bâlia ta chahrypa ta y awpa ta Abeipa ta a soh chy ei.

Sawdawmâ nata Kawmawrâ nata ama chheipâh khihpizy chhao kha, apatlana moleinazy thata tao ei ta, chanô chapaw châna hmâzie tyhpa a châ leipa, chapaw nata chapaw apatlanazy taihta ama taopa vâta, chhâzaw mei ta hriepa châ ei ta, pakhona châta hmâpa ama vaw châ haw.
Cha chyhsazy chhao, cha hawhta y ei ta, ama mâzy liata a pahnieh ei ta, ama pôhpa papuapalei ei ta, biehneina mopakhô ei ta, chyhsa rônahpazy ama reipachhie tyh.

Vâlyuhchâpa chônôchaipa Mikaila tlai chhao khata, Mawsi ri kyh liata ahripa nata a chhu ei ta, ahripa â dyuh nona kha, reipachhiena pachiana bie phuah leipa ta, “Abeipa ta cha ra mawh sy,” tlao a tah.

Cha chyhsazy deikua chata ama pahno leipa maih reipachhie ei ta, pachâna a hnei leipa sazy ta ama pikheipa pahnona ama zi thlâhpa hawhta, âmo chhao ama pikheipa pahnona zi hra ei ta, cha chata a pahleipadia ha ei.
Ama hu a po na! Kaina lâpi a chhih ei ta, athôhna hmô awpa ta Bâlâma moleina lâpi liata a râ ei ta, Kôrâ adyuhna liata ama leidia.

Chazy chata china châh rai pahno leipa ta, nama kyhpachâna kyhchhi patizy niepa ta papuapalei ei ta, ti hnei leipa meihdo, thlih ta a phao pahaipa, châhvâ tho a pathei leipa, ei no a thi hapa nata a thari phia hapazy ama châ.
Tilaipi chatlaopa a pathluahpa, âmo maophyuhna buchaphy a papuapazy châ ei ta, awhsi viavipa, zoh kaluhpa liata chhâzaw ta a y awpazy ama châ.
Cha hawhpa chyhsazy thâtih cha, Âdâh tawhta chhâ sarina Enawka chhao ta, “Moh teh u, Abeipa cha a vâlyuhchâpa pathaihpa thy kha chhaota â vy.

Chyhsa zydua pachia aw ta, Khazohpa a uasa leipazy cha, Khazohpa kho leipa hmo ama taopa zydua vâta thailei a pachâsa aw ei. Khazohpa uasa leipa ta, Khazohpa chô liata bie pachyupa a reihpazy chhao thailei a pachâsa aw ei,” tahpa ta a vaw chhochhielie.

Cha hawhpa chyhsazy cha, ama moleina hmo khopazy chadaipa ta, paphôhpalyuh thaipa nata reipasipasua a hmâhpazy châ ei ta, athôhna hmô khoh vâta khokhei viapa hneipa ta, pakah kawhpa ta a palaipazy ama châ.
Kho ngaitapa saih u, nâmo deikua la, eima Beipa Zisu Krista lyuhchâpazy bie chhochhieliepa kha a thei thlâh ha muh vy.
Lyuhchâpazy ta, “Daihti hnôhchaipa liata cha, pasipasawh a hmâhpa, Khazohpa uasa leipa ta ama aohraohnazy a chadaipa ama y aw,” tahpa ta ama cha vaw chho haw.
Cha chyhsazy cha achhaihna a patlôsatuhpa, khizawpa chyhsa, Thlahpa a hnei leipazy ama châ.
Kho ngaitapa saih u, nâmo deikua la, namâ ngiapâna pathaih ngaitapa liata nâmosasyh tha a patlô u la, Thlahpa Pathaihpa ta thlahchhâ muh vy.
Khazohpa kyhpachâna liata a pabohsa u la, eima Beipa Zisu Krista ngiachhiena, chhâzaw hrona lâ a chhi theipa cha hâ muh vy.
Alôhleipazy thapasa u la,
mohropazy mei tawhta chhu u la, pachha teh u. Ahropazy chhao china chôta thapasa u la, sapa moleina a baipa chyhsiazy taih a hao teh u.
Tahmâ he nama pao lei nawpa ta châ hrôbieh theipa ei nata a rônahna hmiakô liata seina hnei leipa ta, a ly ngaitapa ta châ soh theipa ei,

eima Beipa Zisu Krista zawhzi ta miah Pachhatuhpa Khazohpa a y chhôhpa hnohna chata rônahna zy, abeina zy, ryureina zy, biehneina zy cha, daihti khô chiehpa zydua nata tahmâ nata tlyzaw ta y thlâh ha mawh sy. Amen.

He he Zisu Krista ta a chakaotuhpazy hnohta hmo thlai a vaw tlô awpazy a pahnosa thei nawpa ta, Khazohpa ta a hnoh ta a piepa biephuah a châ. Cha biezy cha Krista ta a vâlyuhchâpa tuah ta, a chakaotuhpa Zawhâna hnohta a vaw pahnosa.
Cha Zawhâna cha Khazohpa bie nata Zisu Krista bie pahnotuhpa châ ta, ano mo tlai ta hmôpa ta a pahnokheituhpa a châ.
He chhochhieliena bie he reih ta, nathlie ta, a chhôh liata bie ropa a pyhtuhpa cha a nohlao na, a daihti a hnia ha tlôh ta.

Kei, Zawhâna ta Asia râh liata awnanopa hlao sarizy ei châ naoh ei. Khazohpa a y haipa, a y hapa nata a vaw y awpa tawhta nata a beidyuchhai hmiakô liata thlahpa miasari a ypazy tawhta ngiachhiena nata thlalôhna nama hnohta y sala,

Zisu Krista, pahnokheituhpa ngâchhihpa, athihpa hry liata a thyu heih tua chaipa nata lei beizy chô liata ryureituhpa tawhta ngiachhiena nata thlalôhna nama hnohta y mawh sy. Kyh miah pachâ ta, a thisaih ta eima moleinazy tawhta miah papuapa ta,
khinarâh ta miah padua ta, a Khazohpa nata a Paw lâta theihthaipa ta miah taotuhpa Zisu Krista hnohta, ano hnohna tlai chata rônahna nata biehneina chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta y mawh sy! Amen.

Nathlie teh u, Krista cha meihdo hry liata a zu aw ta, mokhaoh to ta ano cha ama hmô aw. Ano a chôtuhpazy chhao khata hmô aw ei ta, khizaw phopi zydua ano vâta mâchhiesapa ta ama y aw. Châ tlai mawh sy. Amen.
Abeipa Khazohpa ta, “Kei he Alphâ nata Ômekâ châ na ta, a y haipa, a y hapa nata a vaw y awpa, Atotaotheipa ei châ,” a tah.

Kei, Zawhâna, nama unawhpa nata Zisu liata rietheina nata khinarâh nata tao hualuana kyh liata châ taokheituhpa ei he, Khazohpa bie nata Zisu pahnokheina bie vâta Pâtamô liahpahlô ama tahpa liata y na ta.
Abeipa noh liata Thlahpa ta vaw y na ta, chatawhcha ei hnôhky lâta chiahmie pyu hawhta ao paro ngaitapa thei na ta, ao chata,

“Kei he Alphâ nata Ômekâ, âthaona nata achhâna ei châ. Na hmo hmôpa kha châbu liata roh la, Awnanopa hlao sarizy, Ephesi, Smynâ, Pekamu, Thiatirâ, Sadisâ, Philadelphia nata Laodisi Awnanopazy lâ paphao mah y,” a tahpa thei na ta.
Ei hnohta biereituhpa ao cha hmô a chhuahpa ta a kaw heih na ta. Ei kaw heih nahta, ngôh meiôh patyuna miasari hmô na ta.
Meiôh patyunazy hry liata chyhsa sawchapawpa a lyupa, a phei pazah taihta poh a bu ta, a chachôhna liata ngôh chaisaihna a saihpa hmô na ta.
A luh nata a sâ cha mietaku hmi nata dâhaw hawhta ngyuh ta, a mokhaoh cha meipaleih a lyu.
A pheizy cha patisana mei liata pathaisapa dawh patliepa lyu ta, a ao cha tisaozy paropa pyu hawhta a châ.
A ku chachâh lâta awhsi miasari chaba ta, a pakah tawhta zaozi hâh nopa vaw pua ta, a hmia cha nohchhô locho no hawhta a khaih.
Ano cha ei hmô nahta, athihpa hawhta a phei thaby liata pao na ta. Châhrasala ano ta a ku chachâh lâ ei chô liata vaw pahnieh ta, ei hnohta, “Chi khah y, kei he âthaona nata achhâna châ na ta,
ahrohpa ei châ. Thi ha na ta, châhrasala moh tua, chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta ahrohpa ei châ hih. Thina nata Athihkhih châhbizy ei hnei.
Chavâta na hmo hmôpa, hmo a y haipazy nata tahmâ tawhta a vaw y awpazy cha roh teh.

Ei ku chachâh lâta awhsi miasari na hmôpazy nata ngôh meiôh patyuna miasari na hmôpazy kyh liata bienyupa cha he he a châ: Awhsi miasarizy cha awnanopa hlao sarizy châta vâlyuhchâpazy châ ei ta, meiôh patyuna miasarizy cha awnanopa hlao sarizy ama châ,” tah ta.
“Ephesi Awnanopa vâlyuhchâpa hnohta hetana heta roh teh: ‘A ku chachâh lâta awhsi miasari chaba ta, ngôh meiôh patyuna miasarizy hry liata a hlai ngâpa khata he biezy he a reih.
“‘Na hmotaopa, na hriapasazie, na tao hualuazie nata chyhsa moleipa na chhyh thai leizie zy ei pahno. Lyuhchâpa châ tlôh leipa ta lyuhchâpa â tahpazy pasia chi ta, a haihpa ama châ tahpa na pahno.
Tao hualua chi ta, ei moh vâta pasa tao chi ta, châhrasala panao va chi tahpa chhao ei pahno.
Châhrasala pasina ei cha hnei, na kyhpachâ hmiatuapa na bâhsaipa vâta.
Chavâta na paosai hapa kha a thei la, ro la, hmiatua ta na tao tyhpa hmozy kha tao heih mah y. Chataleipatala nâ lâ a vy aw na ta, na ro vei khiahta cha, na meiôh patyuna kha a su tawhta ei pasie aw.
Nikôla py hmotaopazy nâ haopa kyh liata deikua cha, na tao pha kaw. Cha cha kei chhao ta ei hao hra.
Thlahpa ta Awnanopazy hnohta bie a reipa he, nakhaoh a hneipa ta cha thei mawh sy. Pahnietuhpa cha Khazohpa pârâdi liata hrona tho theilâpa nie awpa ei pasai aw,’ a tah na,” tahpa ta.
“Smynâ Awnanopa vâlyuhchâpa hnohta hetana heta roh teh: ‘Âthaona nata achhâna, thi ha ta, a vaw hroh heihpa khata he biezy he a reih.
“‘Na pasataozie nata na dyhchhiezie zy ei pahno. Châhrasala hneirôhpa na châ. Zu hmeiseihpa châ tlôh leipa ta Zu â tahpa, Sâtâ pakhyna o a châpazy ta ama cha reipachhiena chhao ei pahno.

Pasa na tao awpazy chi khah y. Pachâ tua, ahripa ta nama hry liata chyhsa thokha patâhna o liata a cha khô aw ei. Pasiapa ta y aw ei chi ta, noh hrawh chhôh rietheipasa nama tao aw. Thina taihta ngâchhihpa ta y mah y, hrona lakho ei cha pie aw.
Thlahpa ta Awnanopazy hnohta bie a reipa he nakhaoh a hneipa ta cha thei mawh sy. Pahnietuhpa cha thina einona ta pasasa aw vei,’ a tah na,” tahpa ta.
“Pekamu Awnanopa vâlyuhchâpa hnohta hetana heta roh teh: ‘Zaozi hâh no tiahpa a hneipa khata he biezy he a reih.

“‘Na pahrâna, Sâtâ beidyuchhai yna ei pahno. Châhrasala ei moh khâchâ patu chi ta, ei bie pahnotuhpa ei chyhsa ngâchhihpa Antipâ kha, Sâtâ pahrâna liata nama hry liata ama thie nona khata, einâ ngiapâna chi a paphasai va chi.

Châhrasala pasina chyhta ei cha hnei. Nama hry liata chyhsa thokha Bâlâma pachuna khâchâ a patupazy y ei ta. Bâlâma cha Izarei sawzy hmiakô liata achapiana lô so awpa ta Bâlâka a pachutuhpa châ ta, Izarei sawzy cha nothlahpa lâta hlâpa niedozy paniesa ta, apatlana moleina pataosa a chhuahpa kha a châ.
Nâ chhao Nikôla py pachuna a pyhtuhpazy na ylâh hra.
Chavâta ro mah y. Chataleipatala nâ lâ a vy patoh aw na ta, ei pakah zaozi ta âmo cha ei vaw dyuh aw ei.

Thlahpa ta Awnanopazy hnohta bie a reipa he nakhaoh a hneipa ta cha thei mawh sy. Pahnietuhpa hnohta mânâ nyupa pie aw na ta, lô ngyuhpa chhao ei pie aw. Cha alô chô liata moh thiehpa ropa châ ta, cha cha a totuhpa dei leipa ta cha ahy hmahta pahno veih ei,’ a tah na,” tahpa ta.
“Thiatirâ Awnanopa vâlyuhchâpa hnohta hetana heta roh teh: ‘Khazohpa Sawchapawpa, meipaleih hawhpa mokhaoh a hneipa, a pheipazah dawh patliepa a lyupa khata he biezy he a reih.
“‘Na hmotaopa, na kyhpachâna, nâ ngiapâna, na chakaona nata na tao hualuana zy ei pahno. Hnôhlâ ta na taopa hmozy cha na tao tuapazy hlâta a pha via tahpa chhao ei pahno.

Châhrasala pasina ei cha hnei, Zezebel ama tahpa, anosasyh ta hrohsonô ta â reihpa chanô na chhyh thaipa vâta. Ano cha sihryh awpa nata nothlahpa atheihna pati nie awpa ta nâ chakaotuhpazy pachu ta, a no leipa lâta a paviasa tyhpa a châ.
A ro nawpa ta daihti pie na ta, châhrasala a sihryhna cha ro khoh vei.
Moh teh, ano cha tlâhleipa rakhô liata thy aw na ta, ano a pheikheituhpazy chhao, ama hmotaopazy ama ro vei khiahta cha, riethei pasataona rarôh ypa liata ei thy hra aw ei.
A sawzy tusao aw na ta, chatanachata kei cha pachâna nata palôh mohtuhpa ei châ tahpa Awnanopa zydua ta ama pahno aw. Nama hmotaopazy lymâ hawhta ei cha pie aw ei.

Nâmo, Thiatirâ liata a ypa mohropazy, Zezebel pachuna a pyh leipa ta, Sâtâ hmo athupa ama tahpa kyh a chu leipazy deikua cha, ei cha chho ei. Nâmo la phaohri hropa khâpa hmah cha pahnieh thlu aw veih ei na.
Nama hnei chiehpa deikua kha, ei vy hlâlei khâchâ patu ha muh vy.
Pahnietuhpa nata ei hmotaopazy a chhâna taihta a pyhtuhpa cha phopizy chô liata biehneina ei pie aw.
Ei paw tawhta biehneina ei hmôpa hawhna heta, biehneina ei piepa chyhsa chata thua chôchahrei ta ama chô liata ryureih aw ta, alei beihzy pakeichheihpa hawhta a pakeichheih aw ei.
Deiva awhsi cha ano ei pie aw.
Thlahpa ta Awnanopazy hnohta bie a reipa he, nakhaoh a hneipa ta cha thei mawh sy,’ a tah na,” tahpa ta.

“Sadisâ Awnanopa vâlyuhchâpa hnohta hetana heta roh teh: ‘Khazohpa Thlahpa pasari nata awhsi miasari a hneipa khata he biezy he a reih. “‘Na hmotaopazy ei pahno. Ahrohpa moh phaoh chi ta, châhrasala athipa na châ.
A hra la, na hnei tlakaihpa a thi daihmâpazy kha pahro heih mah y. Na hmotaopazy kha ei Khazohpa hmiakô liata paki hapa ta hmô va na.
Na topa nata na theipazy kha a thei la, zyh la, ro teh. Nâ hra vei khiahta la, parutuhpa hawhta a vy aw na ta, khati dawh ta ma ei cha vaw pachhai aw tahpa pahno aw va chi.
Châhrasala Sadisâ liata chyhsa chyhta ama y chy. Âmo cha ama poh a papuapalei leipazy châ ei ta, poh diehpa a bupa ta ei hnohta ama charei aw. Cha hawhta a y thei awpazy tlai ama châ.
Pahnietuhpa cha, cha hawhta poh diehpa pabusapa châ aw ta, hrona châbu tawhta a moh phie beih leipa aw na ta, ei Paw hmiakô liata nata a vâlyuhchâpazy hmiakô liata a moh ei châhkhei aw.
Thlahpa ta Awnanopazy hnohta bie a reipa he, nakhaoh a hneipa ta cha thei mawh sy,’ a tah na,” tahpa ta.

“Philadelphia Awnanopa vâlyuhchâpa hnohta hetana heta roh teh: ‘Mopathaihpa, a hmeiseihpa, Dâvi châhbi hnei ta, ahy hmahta khaw thei lei awpa ta a pahytuhpa, ahy hmahta pahy thei lei awpa ta a khawtuhpa ta he biezy he a reih.
“‘Na hmotaopazy ei pahno. Moh teh, ahy hmahta khaw thei leipa ochhi na hmiakô liata ei pahy. Hmotaotheina chyhta hnei chi ta, chatanachôta ei bie a pyh chi ta, ei moh a paphasai va chi.
Moh teh, Sâtâ pakhyna o liata chyhsazy, Zu chyhsa hmeiseihpa châ tlôh leipa ta, haipa ta Zu chyhsa â tahpazy cha na phei thaby liata vaw pabôhsa aw ei na ta, kyh ei cha pachâ tahpa ama pahno aw.
Tao hualuana kyh liata ei bie nâ pyhpa vâta, alei liata a pahrâpazy pasia awpa ta khizaw zydua liata pasiana daihti a vaw tlô awpa tawhta ei cha pabohsa aw.
Ei vy patoh aw. Ahy hmahta na lakho ama cha lapa lei nawpa ta, na hnei chiehpa kha khâchâ patu mah y.

Pahnietuhpa cha ei Khazohpa Achhyna o liata otôh ta tao aw na ta, cha su tawhta pua khao aw vei. Ano liata ei Khazohpa moh nata ei Khazohpa khihpi, Zerusale thiehpa moh roh aw na ta, cha cha ei Khazohpa tawhta a za chôpa moh châ aw ta, vârâh tawhta a za chô awpa moh a châ. Cha cha ei moh thiehpa a châ aw.
Thlahpa ta Awnanopazy hnohta bie a reipa he, nakhaoh a hneipa ta cha thei mawh sy,’ a tah na,” tahpa ta.
“Laodisi Awnanopa vâlyuhchâpa hnohta hetana heta roh teh: ‘Ngâchhihpa nata pahnokheituh dopa nata Khazohpa hmotaopazy âthaona Amen ta he biezy he a reih.
“‘Na hmotaopazy ei pahno. Chakua leipa chi ta, sah hra va chi. Na chakua khiah chakua lâlao la, na sah khiah sah lâlao la, na châta a pha awpa tlai!
Sah lâlao lei, chakua lâlao lei, phiephuh lalôhpa dei na châpa vâta, ei pakah tawhta ei cha pachhao aw.
“Sôh hluhpi a pachô ha na ta, ei hneirôh haw, khâpa hmah a phahla va na,” tah chi ta, châhrasala rietheipa, ngiachhiechhihpa, dyhchhiepa, mochaopa nata thluahruapa na châ tahpa a pahno va chi.

Na hneirôh thei nawpa ta mei liata pathaisapa ngôh zy, na thluahrua maophyuh chhiepa â lâ lei nawpa ta poh diehpa a bu awpa zy, na hmô thei nawpa ta na mo liata hnia awpa mo pasana thohna zy kei tawhta chalei awpa ta ei cha chhosie.
Kyh ei pachâpa cha pasipaao na ta, ei chhorei tyh. Chavâta phahnai a ngiah la, ro mah y.
Nathlie teh, ochhi thaby liata a duah na ta ei chakhyh. Ahy rai ei ao thei ta, ochhi a pahy khiahta cha, ano liata a ngia aw na ta, a hnohta pati nie aw na ta, ano chhao ei hnohta a nie hra aw.
Pahniena to na ta, ei Paw hnohta a beidyuchhai liata ei tyupa hawhna heta, pahnietuhpa cha ei beidyuchhai liata ei hnohta ei patyusa aw.
Thlahpa ta Awnanopazy hnohta bie a reipa he, nakhaoh a hneipa ta thei mawh sy,’ a tah na,” tahpa ta.

Cha khai tawhta kaw sai na ta, vârâh ochhi a pahypa hmô na ta. Ao ei thei tuapa, chiahmie pyu hawhta ei hnohta bie a reihpa khata, “He lâ a khy teh, he khai tawhta hmo a vaw tlô awpazy ei cha pahmô aw,” tah ta.
Sôkha ta Thlahpa ta vaw y na ta. Vârâh liata beidyuchhai a vaw patyuh ta, cha liata chyhsa pakha a vaw tyuh ta.
Beidyuchhai liata a tyuhpa alânazie cha zaspi nata kânelia lôsôhpa hawhta châ ta, beidyuchhai cha meisaku ta chadô ta, â lânazie cha emerâ lôsôhpa hawhta a châ.
Beidyuchhai chadôpa ta beidyuchhai hropa miakih nata miapalih y ta, cha liata machâ paki nata papalih poh diehpa a bupa ta a tyuhpa hmô na ta, ama luh liata ngôh lakhozy a kho ei ta.
Beidyuchhai tawhna chata dôhlazy, aozy nata tôkalôhpa a thuapa pyuzy vaw pua hôlô ta. Beidyuchhai hmiakô liana cha meirei iapa miasari y ta, chazy cha Khazohpa thlahpa pasarizy ama châ.

Beidyuchhai hmiakô liana cha tilaipi hawhta thlalâ vaw y ta, cha cha dâhaw hawhta a ngyuhpa lôsôhpa a châ. Beidyuchhai chadôpa ta, chavei chachâh, a hmia nata a hnôh ta hmohrohneipa miapalih y ei ta, chazy cha ama hmia nata ama hnôh ta mokhaoh ta a biepazy ama châ.
Hmohrohneipa miakhana cha chakeibarôhneipa hawhta châ ta, a mianona cha viahchaotaw hawhta châ ta, a miathôhna cha chyhsapa hmia phaoh ta, a miapalihna cha pahmôhpi a zaw ngâpa a lyu.

Hmohrohneipa miapalihzy cha mathlaw miacharu hnei chyu ei ta, ama pôhpa chô lâ nata chhôh lâ mokhaoh ta a biepa ama châ. Chatanachata, “Atotaotheipa Abeipa Khazohpa, A y hapa, a y haipa nata a vaw y awpa cha, A pathaih na, a pathaih na, a pathaih na,” tahpa ta a chalih beih leipa ta, chhô nah zâ ta ama reithai.
Hmohrohneipazy ta beidyuchhai liata atyuhpa, chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta a hroh thlâhpa cha parônahsapa ta palyupalih ei ta, alyna bie ama reina maihta,
machâ pakih nata papalihzy cha beidyuchhai liata a tyuhpa hmiakô liata a bôh ei ta, chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta a hroh thlâhpa cha amâ chhy tyh. Beidyuchhai hmiakô liata ama lakhozy soh ei ta,

“Hy Eima Beipa nata Khazohpa, Nâ cha rônahna zy, palyupalihna zy, hmotaotheina zy A to tlâh na châ na; Hmo to tao chi ta, Na bie hawhta vaw y ei ta, Na bie hawhta paysapa ama châ,” tahpa ta chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta a hroh thlâhpa cha amâ chhy.
Chatawhcha beidyuchhai liata a tyuhpa ku chachâh lâta châ chatypa, a hmia a hnôh ta ropa, chahnaona miasari ta chahnaopa hmô na ta.
Vâlyuhchâpa thatlôpa ta ao paro ngaitapa ta, “Châ chatypa he pahy ta a chahnaonazy a pathlâ tlâhpa ahy ma a y?” tahpa ta tlâh a awpa hmô na ta.
Châbu chatypa a pathlâ awpa tlyma, a chhôh lâ a moh awpa tlyma, vârâh liata pakha hmah y leipa ei ta, alei liata y hra leipa ei ta, alei ry liata chhao pakha hmah y veih ei.
Châbu chatypa a pahy tlâhpa tlyma, a chhôh lâ a moh tlâhpa tlyma, pakha hmah ama y leipa vâta thata cha na ta.
Chatawhcha machâ pakha ta ei hnohta, “Cha khao khah y, moh teh, Zudâh chi chakeibarôhneipa, Dâvi Thari ta, châbu chatypa pahy awpa nata a chahnaona miasari pathlâ awpa ta a pahnie haw,” tah ta.

Chatawhcha beidyuchhai nata hmohrohneipa miapalihzy likawh liata machâzy hry liata Mietakutaw a duahpa hmô na ta, Mietakutaw cha thie chiehpa lyu ta, ki miasari nata mokhaoh miasari a hnei. Mokhaoh miasarizy cha, alei chô zydua liata tuapa Khazohpa Thlahpa pasarizy ama châ.
Mietakutaw cha vawh ta, beidyuchhai liata a tyuhpa ku chachâh lâta châbu chatypa cha kei la ta.

Châbu chatypa a lapa nahta, hmohrohneipa miapalih nata machâ pakih nata papalihzy cha, totâ nata ngôh ropahâhpa ta a biepa ngôh biebuh a chaba chyupa ta, Mietakutaw hmiakô liata pao ei ta. Cha ropahâhpazy cha mopathaihpazy thlahchhâna a châ.

Chatawhcha âmo chata, “Nâ cha châbu chatypa a la tlâhpa châ chi ta, A chahnaonazy a pathlâ tlâhpa na châ. Thiepa ta y chi ta, Na thisaih ta, Chi to nata reih to, Phopi to nata râh to zy cha, Khazohpa châta na chatlai ha ei.
Âmo cha eima Khazohpa châta khinarâh ta padua chi ta, Theihthaipazy ta na tao ei; Alei liata ryu ama reih aw,” tahpa ta hla thiehpa ma sa ei ta.
Chatawhcha kaw moh na ta, beidyuchhai nata hmohrohneipazy nata machâzy chheipâh liata vâlyuhchâpa hluhpi ao thei na ta, ama hluhzie cha thysâh hluhpi ama châ.

Chazy chata ao paro ngaitapa ta, “Mietakutaw thie chiehpa cha, Hmotaotheina nata hneirôna zy, Sona nata thatlôna zy, Palyupalihna nata rônahna zy, A to tlâh châ ta, Reithaina a to tlâh chhao a châ!” tahpa ta reithai ei ta.

Chatawhcha avâ nata alei nata alei ry nata tilaipi liata a ypa hmotaopa to nata ama chhôh liata a ypa zydua ta, “Beidyuchhai liata a tyuhpa nata Mietakutaw hnohta, Reithaina nata palyupalihna zy, Rônahna nata thatlôna zy, Chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta y mawh sy,” tahpa ta ama reithaipa thei na ta.
Hmohrohneipa miapalihzy ta, “Amen!” tah ei ta, machâzy cha a khu ei ta, Mietakutaw cha a chhy ei ta.
Chatawhcha Mietakutaw ta chahnaona miasari hry liata miakha a pathlâ nota hmô na ta, hmohrohneipa miapalihzy hry liata miakha ta tôkalôhpa a thuapa hawhta, “A vy teh!” a tahpa thei na ta.
Kaw moh na ta, arâ râhpa hmô na ta. A chô liata a kiahpa cha libaw a chaba ta, a hnohta lakho piepa châ ta, pahnietuhpa châ awpa nata pahnie lymâ awpa ta pua ha ta.
Chahnaona mianona a pathlâpa nahta, hmohrohneipa mianona ta, “A vy teh!” a tahpa thei na ta.
Arâ hropa, asaihpa vaw pua ta. A chô liata a kiahpa cha, chyhsazy âmo nata âmo pathiesa ta, khizaw tawhta adyhna lapapua awpa ta pasaina piepa châ ta, a hnohta zaozi laipa piepa a châ.
Chahnaona miathôhna a pathlâpa nahta, hmohrohneipa miathôhna ta, “A vy teh!” a tahpa thei na ta. Kaw moh na ta, arâ vyhpa hmô na ta. A chô liata a kiahpa cha khopathliahna bao kha a chaba ta.

Hmohrohneipa miapalihzy hry tawhta ao a lyupa vaw pua ta, “Âtâ sâh saikhua kha mâ cha dinâri tlaw kha châ ta, bâli sâh saikhua thôh mâ cha dinâri tlaw kha a châ. Sathaw nata kresawhti deikua parao khah y!” tahpa ta a reipa thei na ta.
Chahnaona miapalihna a pathlâpa nahta, hmohrohneipa miapalihna ao ta, “A vy teh!” a tahpa thei na ta.

Kaw moh na ta, arâ peipa hmô na ta, a chô liata a kiahpa moh cha Thina châ ta, a hnôh lâta Athihkhih ta vaw pazi ta. Khizaw zydua he su palih ta pachhaih ta su kha cha, zaozi, chakâhna, hri nata alei liata sahrâhpazy hmâpa ta thie awpa ta, ama hnohta biehneina piepa a châ.
Chahnaona miapangawhna a pathlâpa nahta, Khazohpa bie vâta nata pahnokheina bie amâ duakheipa vâta ama thiepazy thlahpa maisâh ry liata hmô na ta.

Âmo chata, “Hy Abeipa Chônôchaipa, pathaihpa nata adopa, khachâ ma alei chô liata a pahrâpazy chô liata eima thisaih phuh la leipa ta y aw chi ta, âmo cha pachia leipa ta na y aw tly?” tahpa ta ao paro ngaitapa ta awh ei ta.
Ama hnohta poh diehpa pie chyu ei ta, ama chakaolâhpazy nata ama unawhzy âmo hawhta thie khaipa ama châ hlâlei, bohpi leipa chhôh a pahâ chy awpa ta chhopa ama châ.
Chahnaona miacharuna a pathlâ nahta, kaw moh na ta, alo thata a vaw sih ta. Noh cha latho poh hawhta vaw vyh ta, thlâpâ chhao thisaih hawhta saih khai ha ta.
Avâ liata awhsizy chhao, theiku kô thlihpi ta chanaoh ta, a thei heipazy a zôpa hawhta, alei lâ za tla ei ta.
Avâ cha châbu chatypa hawh tlai ta vaw lei ha ta, tlâhpi nata liahpahlô to chhao ama yna tawhta pasiepa ta y khai ha ei ta.
Chatanachata lei beizy, molaipazy, pheisaih hyutuh chaipazy, hneirôhpazy, thatlôpazy, sei nata khotalaipazy, chyhsa to cha lôpuzy liata nata tlâhpi liata lôpanôzy liata a nyu ei ta,
tlâhpizy nata lôpanôzy hnohta, “Miah vi u la, beidyuchhai liata atyuhpa hmiakô tawhta nata Mietakutaw hiehâhna tawhta miah nyu teh u.
Ama hiehâhna noh rarôh y ngaitapa vaw tlô ha ta, ahy ma a duah thei aw?” tah ei ta.

Cha hnôhlâ ta alei ki palih liata vâlyuhchâpa papalih a duahpa hmô na ta. Alei chô liata tlyma, tilaipi chô liata tlyma, thokô chô liata tlyma, thlih a pathli lei nawpa ta, alei thlih miapalihpazy cha patu ei ta.

Vâlyuhchâpa hropa pakha, Khazoh hrohpa chahnaona a chabapa nochhi lâ tawhta a vaw puapa hmô na ta. Ano chata vâlyuhchâpa papalih, alei nata tilaipi parao theina biehneina piepazy hnohta ao paro ngaitapa ta,
“Eima Khazohpa chakaotuhpazy ama khi liata eima chahnao hlâlei cha, alei nata tilaipi nata thokô zy parao mâh khuh vy,” tahpa ta awh ta.
Chatawhcha chahnaopa zie ama reipa kyh thei na ta, Izarei saw chi to tawhta 144,000 chahnaopa ama châ:
Zudâh chi 12,000, Rubena chi 12,000, Kâdâ chi 12,000,
Asera chi 12,000, Nâthalai chi 12,000, Manase chi 12,000,
Simeôna chi 12,000, Livai chi 12,000, Iskâra chi 12,000,
Zebulawna chi 12,000, Zawsi chi 12,000 nata Benzami chi 12,000 chahnaopa ama châ.

Cha hnôhlâ ta kaw moh na ta, râh to, chi to, phopi to nata reih to tawhta zawpi hluh ngaitapa, ahy hmahta rei tiah leipazy cha poh diehpa a bupa nata thiahrâ kuah chabapa ta, beidyuchhai hmiakô liata nata Mietakutaw hmiakô liata amâ duapa hmô na ta.
Chazy chata ao paro ngaitapa ta, “Pachhana cha Beidyuchhai liata a tyuhpa eima Khazohpa nata Mietakutaw eih a châ!” tahpa ta awh ei ta.
Vâlyuhchâpa zydua cha beidyuchhai nata machâzy nata hmohrohneipa miapalihzy chadôpa ta a duah ei ta, beidyuchhai hmiakô liata â khu lâta pao ei ta,
“Amen! Reithaina, rônahna, sona, alyna biereina, palyupalihna, hmotaotheina nata thatlôna zy cha chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta eima Khazohpa hnohta y mawh sy! Amen,” tahpa ta Khazohpa a chhy ei ta.
Machâ hry liata pakha ta ei hnohta, “He poh diehpa a bupazy he ahyzy ma ama châ, khataih tawhta a vypa ma ama châ?” tahpa ta na hiahri ta.

Kei ta a hnohta, “Pâpuh, pahno va na, nâ ta tlao na pahno,” tah na ta. Ano ta ei hnohta, “Hezy he rietheipasana ru ngaitapa tawhta a vaw puapazy ama châ hih. Ama pohzy Mietakutaw thisaih ta pasupa ta ama padiehsa haw.
“Chavâta âmo cha, Khazohpa beidyuchhai hmiakô liata y ei ta, Chhô nah zâ ta ano Achhyna o liata ama chakao tyh; Beidyuchhai liata a tyuh aw ei ta, A ypâna ta a khu aw ei.
Ama nodi khao leipa aw ta, Ama dâhphi khao aw vei; Noh ta âmo vawh leipa aw ta, Noh lona ta ama rie pathei khao aw vei.
Beidyuchhai liah liata a tyuhpa cha, Âmo vaituhpa a châ aw; Hrona tihnawhzy lâ âmo a chhi aw ta, Ama mo liata mothlih zydua Khazohpa ta a hru khai aw,” tah ta.
Mietakutaw ta chahnaona miasarina a vaw pathlâ nahta, dawh khophie rachhôh avâ liata a chalihna y ta.
Chatawhcha Khazohpa hmiakô liata a duah tyhpa vâlyuhchâpa pasarizy hmô na ta, ama hnohta chiahmie miasari piepa châ ei ta.

Vâlyuhchâpa hropa a vy ta, ngôh ropahâhpa raona byh chhaota maisâh kiapâh liata a vaw duah ta. Ropahâhpa hluhpi a hnohta piepa châ ta, cha cha mopathaihpa zydua thlahchhânazy chhaota beidyuchhai hmiakô ta ngôh maisâh chô liata hlâ awpa a châ.
Ropahâhpa khuh cha mopathaihpazy thlahchhâna chhaota, vâlyuhchâpa ku tawhta Khazohpa hmiakô lâ khy ta.
Vâlyuhchâpa ta ropahâhpa raona byh cha la ta, maisâh liata mei ta pabie ta, alei liata thy ta. Chatanachata tôkalôhpazy a vaw thua ta, aozy vaw pua ta, dôhlazy vaw pathlie ta, alozy thata a sih ta.
Chatawhcha vâlyuhchâpa pasarizy ta chiahmie miasari amâ chabapazy tô awpa ta a pachyh ei ta.

Vâlyuhchâpa pakhana ta a chiahmie vaw tô ta, thisaih nata a pahlaopa pareih nata mei ta vaw pazi ta, chazy cha alei liata thypa a châ. Alei su thôh su kha kâ khai ta, thozy chhao su thôh su kha kâ ta, sibie hrohpa zydua a kâ khai haw.
Vâlyuhchâpa panona ta a chiahmie vaw tô ta, tlâh laipa a lyupa, mei ta a kâ haipa cha tilaipi liata thypa châ ta, chatanachata tilaipi su thôh su kha cha thisaih lâta a vaw lie ha ta.
Tilaipi liata hrona a hneipazy su thôh su kha thi ei ta, balyhzy chhao su thôh su kha paraopa a châ.
Vâlyuhchâpa pathôhna ta a chiahmie vaw tô ta, meirei hawhta a iapa awhsi laipa avâ tawhta za tla ta, chavahzy su thôh su kha nata tihnawhzy vi ta.
Awhsi moh cha Khapa a châ. Tizy su thôh su kha cha ti khapa lâta a vaw lie ta, ti khapa ta taopa a châpa vâta, a ti a dohpa hluhpi thi ei ta.

Vâlyuhchâpa papalihna ta a chiahmie vaw tô ta, noh su thôh su kha, thlâpâ su thôh su kha, awhsizy su thôh su kha paraopa a châ. Ama khaihna su thôh su kha pazohsapa châ ta, chhô daihti su thôh su kha cha khaih khao leipa ta, zâ daihti su thôh su kha chhao khaih khao vei.

Chatawhcha kaw moh na ta, avâ liata a zawpa pahmôhpi ta ao paro ngaitapa ta, “Vâlyuhchâpa pathôh ta chiahmie ama vaw tô awpa pyuzy vâta, alei liata a pahrâpazy cha ama hu a po na, ama hu a po na, ama hu a po na!” a tahpa thei na ta.
Chatawhcha vâlyuhchâpa papangawhna ta a chiahmie vaw tô ta, awhsi avâ tawhta alei lâ a tlapa hmô na ta, leichiepa khaohtlô pahyna châhbi a hnohta piepa châ ta.
Leichiepa khaohtlô cha pahy ta, leichiepa khaohtlô tawhna chata patisana meikhuh ru ngaitapa a lyupa meikhuh kaw pua ta, leichiepa khaohtlô meikhuh vâna chata noh nata aruapa cha vaw zoh ha ta.
Meikhuh hry tawhna chata khawsuzy alei lâ vaw pua ei ta, alei liata râhcha-iazy hmotaotheina hawhpa hmotaotheina ama hnohta piepa a châ.
Ama khi liata Khazohpa chahnaona a hnei leipa chyhsazy tah leipa ta cha, alei liata sibiepazy, tho hrohpa kheihawhpa rai nata thokô kheihawhpa rai parao lei awpa ta chhopa ama châ.

Ama khi liata Khazohpa chahnaona a hnei leipazy cha thla pangawh chhôh pasa pataosa awpa ta khawsuzy cha pasaipa châ ei ta, ama thie awpa deikua pasaipa châ veih ei. Ama pasasanazie cha râhcha-ia ta chyhsa sie ta a pasasapa hawhta a châ.
Cha nohzy liata chyhsazy ta thina tlua aw ei ta, châhrasala hmô aw veih ei. Thi khoh ngaita aw ei ta, châhrasala thina ta a râsai aw ei.
Khawsuzy alânazie cha adyuhna châta pachhuahpanohpa arâzy hawhta ama châ. Ama luhzy liata ngôh lakho lyupa a kho ei ta, ama hmia cha chyhsapa hmia a lyu.
Ama sâ cha chanô sâ lyu ta, ama hâhzy cha chakeibarôhneipa hâh a lyu.
Thua chachôhna vyhphao a lyupa chachôhna vyhphao hnei ei ta, ama mathlaw chakhypa pyu cha, adyuhna lâ a râ ngâpa talailih hluhpi nata arâ hluhpi pyu hawhta a châ.
Râhcha-iazy hawhta chaolahmei nata azâpa hnei ei ta, thla pangawh chhôh chyhsazy pasasa theina ama chaolahmei liata a y.
Leichiepa khaohtlô vâlyuhchâpa cha ama bei ta hnei ei ta, a moh cha Hebrai reih ta Abadô châ ta, Krikâh reih ta Apôliô a châ.
Hupona hmiatua chaipa khô ha ta, nathlie teh, hupona a vaw tlô awpa miano a y chy.
Chatawhcha vâlyuhchapa pacharuna ta a chiahmie vaw tô ta, Khazohpa hmiakô liata ngôh maisâh ki palihzy tawhta ao thei na ta.
Ao chata chiahmie a chabapa vâlyuhchâpa pacharuna hnohta, “Ufrâti chavah liata vâlyuhchâpa papalih chahrypazy kha pathlâ teh,” tah ta.
Cha dawh, cha noh, cha thla nata cha kô châta rao chiehpa vâlyuhchâpa papalihzy cha, chyhsa su thôh su kha thie awpa ta pathliepa châ ei ta.
Arâ pheisaihzy maluh zie ama reipa ei theipa cha, thy kha nata thy kha papôhsapa lie no a châ.

He he arâzy nata a kiahtuhpazy kyh liata aluahna ta ei hmôpazy a châ: Mei nata saphai lô nata kaih hawhpa chachôhna vyhphaozy hnei ei ta, arâ luhzy cha chakeibarôhneipa luhzy lyu ta, ama pakah tawhta mei nata meikhuh nata kaihzy a pua.
Ama pakah tawhta a puapa mei nata meikhuh nata kaih potlana miathôh ta khizaw chyhsa su thôh su kha a thie haw.
Arâzy hmotaotheina cha ama pakah liata nata ama chaolahmei liata y ta, ama chaolahmeizy cha parihzy hawhta châ ta, luhzy hnei ei ta, cha chata chyhsa ama pasasa tyh.

Khizaw chyhsa hropa, cha potlanazy ta a thie leipazy ta ama ku ta taopazy amâ chhypa tawhta ro khoh to veih ei. A hmô thei leipa, a thei thei leipa nata a sie thei leipa ngôh nothlahpa, tâkâ nothlahpa, dawh nothlahpa, alô nothlahpa nata tho nothlahpa achhyna nata ahripazy achhyna bâsai hlei veih ei.
Ama lianycheinazy, ama dyuthainazy, amâ patlana moleinazy nata ama parunazy chhao ro hlei veih ei.

Chatawhcha vâlyuhchâpa hropa thatlô ngaitapa avâ tawhta a za chôpa hmô na ta. Meihdo ta a tobi ta, a luh chô liata meisaku a zawh ta, a hmia cha noh hawhta khaih ta, a pheizy cha mei tôh hawhta a châ.
A ku liata châbu chatypa chyhpa cha pahy chiehpa ta chaba ta. A phei chachâh lâ tilaipi chô liata tlypa ta, a chavei lâ alei liata tly ta.
Chakeibarôhneipa a rôhpa hawhta ao paro ngaitapa ta awh ta, a awh khai nahta, tôkalôhpa miasari a vaw thua ta.
Tôkalôhpa miasari â vaw thua nahta, châ ro awpa a chhuah na ta, châhrasala avâ tawhta ao ta, “Tôkalôhpa miasarizy bie reipa kha phih la, roh khah y,” a tahpa thei na ta.
Tilaipi nata alei liata a duahpa vâlyuhchâpa ei hmôpa khata a ku chachâh lâ avâ lâ pazawh ta,

chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta a hroh thlâhpa, avâ nata a chhôh liata a ypazy, alei nata a chhôh liata a ypazy, tilaipi nata a chhôh liata a ypazy a paysatuhpa moh reipa ta bie a taih ta, “Bohpi châ khao aw vei.
Vâlyuhchâpa pasarina ta chiahmie ta a awna noh liata deikua cha, a chakaotuhpa hrohsopazy hnohta a phuahpa hawhna khata, Khazohpa bienyupa cha pakipa a châ aw,” tah ta.
Avâ tawhta ao ei theipa khata bie na chho heih ta, ei hnohta, “Sie la, tilaipi nata alei liata a duahpa vâlyuhchâpa ku liata châbu chatypa pahy chiehpa hao kei la teh,” a tahpa thei na ta.

Vâlyuhchâpa lâ cha vawh na ta, châbu chatypa chyhpa cha na pie awpa ta chho na ta. Ano ta ei hnohta, “La la, nie teh, na chhôh pakhasa aw ta, na pakah liata deikua cha, kheihti hawhta a thlôh aw,” na tah ta.
Vâlyuhchâpa ku tawhta châbu chatypa chyhpa cha la na ta, nie na ta. Ei pakah liata kheihti hawhta thlôh ta, châhrasala ei nie khai nahta, ei chhôh vaw pakhasa ha ta.
Chatawhcha ei hnohta, “Phopi hluhpizy, râh hluhpizy, reih hluhpizy nata bei hluhpizy kyh na chhochhielie heih awpa a châ,” tahpa ta na chho ta.
Chatawhcha lohthi chôchahrei hawhpa thliena na pie ta, ei hnohta, “Thyu la, Khazohpa Achhyna o nata maisâh zy thlie la, a chhôh liata achhytuhpazy chhao reih teh.
Achhyna o khôtho lâ dôhpachhôh tlyhmia deikua thlie leipa la, siesai mah y. Cha cha Zenitaizy hnohta piepa châ ha ta, âmo ta khihpi pathaihpa cha thla sypalih nata thla no ama tlypâ aw.
Chatawhcha bie nâ pahnokheituhpa pano hnohta biepie aw na ta, latho poh a bupa ta, noh 1,260 chhôh bie ama chhochhielie aw,” tah ta.
Âmo cha ôli tho miano nata meiôh patyuna alei Beipa hmiakô liata a duah tyhpazy ama châ.
Ahy rai ta âmo cha pasasa amâ chhuah khiahta cha, ama pakah tawhta mei vaw pua aw ta, ama khakhaipazy cha a kâ khai aw. Âmo pasasa a chhuahpa maih cha, cha hawhta thiepa ama châ aw.

Hrohsona bie ama rei chhôh noh zydua avâ suah lei awpa ta avâ khaw theina hmotaotheina ama hnei. Ama khona daihti maihta thisaih lâta pachâsa awpa ta tizy chô liata chhao biehnei ei ta, khizaw he potlana to ta hrie awpa ta bie ama hnei hra.
Pahnokheina bie ama rei khai nahta, aleichiepa khaohtlô tawhta sahrâhpa a vaw pua awpa ta âmo cha a dyuh aw ta, pahnie aw ta, a thie aw ei.
Ama rizy cha khihpi rônahpa khiliah liata â zawh aw. Cha khihpi rônahpa cha thlahpa kyh lâta Sawdawmâ nata Izi moh bipa châ ta, ama Beipa ama khaipâna su kha a châ.
Phopizy, chizy, reihzy nata râhzy tawhta chyhsa thokhazy ta ama rizy cha noh thôh nata khophie chhôh moh aw ei ta, thlâ liata pabu pasaih aw veih ei.
Lei chyhsazy rie a patheipa hrohsopa panozy thiepa ama châpa cha, lei chyhsazy a ly kaw aw ei ta, alynazy tao aw ei ta, hmosaipiepazy amâ pie raihrie aw.
Noh thôh nata khophie a châ tawhta, Khazohpa tawhta hrona hu ama chhôh liata a vaw ngia ta, ama phei ta a kaw duah ei ta, a hmôtuhpazy ta ama chi ngaita.
Chatawhcha ama hnohta, “He lâ a khy teh u,” tahpa ta avâ tawhta ao paro ngaitapa thei ei ta. Meihdo hry liata avâ lâ khy ei ta, ama khakhaipazy ta moh thlâh ha ei ta.

Cha daihti lia tlai chata alo thata a vaw sih ta, khihpi su hrawh su kha cha cho ha ta. Alo sihpa liana chata chyhsa sâh sari thi ei ta, a laibâhpazy cha chi ngaita ei ta, vârâh Khazohpa cha palyupalih ei ta.
Hupona einona cha khô ta, hupona eithôhna thlai a vaw tlô aw.

Chatawhcha vâlyuhchâpa pasarina ta a chiahmie tô ta, “Khizaw khinarâh cha eima Beipa nata a Krista khinarâh a vaw châ haw. Ano ta chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta ryu a reih aw,” tahpa ta ao paro ngaitapazy avâ liata vaw y ta.
Chatawhcha Khazohpa hmiakô ta ama beidyuchhai chyu liata a tyuhpa machâ pakih nata papalihzy cha â khu lâta pao ei ta, Khazohpa a chhy ei ta,
“Hy Abeipa Khazohpa Atotaotheipa, A y haipa nata a y hapa y, Na hmotaotheina rônahpa ta ryureih chi ta, Alyna bie eima cha hlâ.

Phopizy ama hiehâh ta, Na pathiiana a vaw tlô; Cha cha athihpazy pachiana daihti châ ta, Châ chakaotuhpa hrohsopazy nata mopathaihpazy Lymâ piena daihti a châ. Na moh a chituhpa a lai a chyh ta Lymâ piena daihti châ ta, Leilô paraotuhpazy paraona daihti a châ,” tahpa ta Khazohpa a chhy ei ta.

Chatawhcha avâ liata Khazohpa Achhyna o cha pahypa châ ta, Achhyna o chhôh liata a biehrai byh a vaw lâ ta. Dôhlazy vaw pathlie ta, aozy vaw pua ta, tôkalôhpazy a vaw thua ta, alo a sih ta, pareih thata a tla.
Chatawhcha ngiana rônahpa avâ liata a vaw lâ ta. Chanô pakha, noh ta a tobi ta, a phei ry liata thlâpâ y ta, awhsi miahrawh hleino ta taopa lakho a khopa vaw y ta.
Chanô cha saw phaoh ta, saw zeih pasapa nata saw sa riethei taopa vâta thata cha ta.
Ngiana hropa avâ liata a vaw lâ heih ta. Drâkao saihpa lai ngaitapa, luh miasari nata ki hrawh a hneipa, a luhzy liata lakho miasari a khopa vaw y ta.

A chaolahmei ta avâ liata awhsi su thôh su kha a daophi pathlah ta, alei lâ za thy ta. Chanô saw cha a vaw pihpata nahta a palâ thei nawpa ta, drâkao cha chanô nawh a zeihpa hmiakô liana cha a duah thlâh ha ta.
Chanô chata sawchapawpa, phopi zydua chô liata thua chôchahrei ta ryu a reih awpa sa ta. Châhrasala a saw cha Khazohpa nata a beidyuchhai lâta a chhipa ta y ha ta.
Chanô cha Khazohpa ta ano châta â chhuahdypa su, râhchawhpa lâ a râ syulyu ha ta. Cha liata noh 1,260 chhôh pasapa a châ aw.
Chatawhcha vârâh liata adyuhna vaw y ta. Mikaila nata a vâlyuhchâpazy ta drâkao cha a dyuh ei ta. Drâkao nata a vâlyuhchâpazy chhaota a vaw dyuh palie hra ei ta.
Châhrasala drâkao cha pahniepa châ ha ta, vârâh liata ama châta su y khao vei.

Chatawhcha drâkao lai ngaitapa, parih hlôpa, ahripa nata Sâtâ tahpa ta moh bipa, khizaw zydua a dôtuhpa cha za thy pathlah ei ta. Alei lâ za thy ei ta, a vâlyuhchâpazy chhao a hnohta za thy pâ hra ei ta.

Chatawhcha avâ liata ao paro ngaitapa thei na ta, ao chata, “Tahmâ cha eima Khazohpa pachhana, hmotaotheina, khinarâh nata a Krista biehneina zy a vaw tlô haw. Eima unawhzy a leihtuhpa, eima Khazohpa hmiakô liata chhô nah zâ ta âmo a leih tyhtuhpa cha, za thy pathlahpa a châ haw.
Mietakutaw thisaih nata ama pahnokheina bie vâta ano cha ama pahnie haw. Ama hrona kyh chhao pachâ thei khao leipa ta thina taihta a dyuhpazy ama châ.

Chavâta Hy avâzy nata a chhôh liata a pahrâpazy saih u, a ly teh u! Nâmo, alei nata tilaipi deikua cha, nama hu a po na! Ahripa ta daihti chyuta dei a hnei tahpa a pahnopa vâta, hiehâh ngaitapa ta nâmo lâ za chô ha tlôh ta,” tah ta.
Drâkao ta alei lâ thy pathlahpa a châpa a hmô nahta, sawchapaw a satuhpa chanô cha a chadai ta.

Châhrasala chanô cha râhchawhpa liata a y nawpa su lâ â zaw thei nawpa ta, pahmôhpi lai ngaitapa mathlaw miano piepa châ ta, cha liata, parih ta a hmô thei khao leina liata kô thôh nata khophie chhôh pasapa a châ aw.
Parih ta chanô cha ti ta a paphaosa thei nawpa ta, chavah hawhta a pakah tawhta ti pachhao ta.
Châhrasala chanô bao awpa ta alei vaw pua ta, alei ta a pakah â ta, drâkao ta a pakah tawhta a pachhaopa chavah cha palâ khai ha ta.
Chavâta drâkao cha chanô chô liata a hiehâh ngaita ta, chanô pathla laibâhpa, Khazohpa biepiepazy a zyhpa nata Zisu bie a pyhpazy a dyuh awpa ta pua ta.
Tilaipi raphyu liata a duah ta.
Chatawhcha sahrâhpa, ki hrawh nata luh sari a hneipa, tilaipi tawhta a kaw puapa hmô na ta. A kizy liata beilakho miahrawh y ta, a luhzy liata Khazohpa reipachhiena mohzy a y.

Sahrâhpa ei hmôpa cha keichhoh lyu ta, a pheizy chavyh phei lyu ta, a pakah cha chakeibarôhneipa pakah a lyu. Sahrâhpa hnohna chata Drâkao ta a hmotaotheina, a beidyuchhai nata biehneina lai ngaitapa pie ta.
A luh miakha cha thikhei thei awpa taihta hmah phaohpa hawhta y ta, châhrasala thikhei thei awpa taihta a hmah phaopa cha tlâh ha ta, alei chyhsa zydua ta noâh tah ei ta, sahrâhpa cha pazi ei ta.
Sahrâhpa hnohta a biehneina a piepa vâta, drâkao cha a chhy ei ta. Sahrâhpa chhao cha a chhy ei ta, “Sahrâhpa hawhpa he ahy y, ahy a dyuh thei aw?” tah ei ta.
Chatawhcha apalaina nata Khazohpa reipachhiena pakah a hnohta piepa châ ta, thla sypalih nata thla no chhôh biehnei awpa ta pasaipa a châ.
Khazohpa reipachhie awpa ta a pakah â ta, Khazohpa moh nata a pahrâna su nata vârâh liata a pahrâpazy reipachhie ta.
Mopathaihpazy a dyuh ta pahnie awpa ta pasaipa châ ta, chi to, phopi to, reih to nata râh to chô liata biehneina a hnohta piepa a châ.
Alei chô liata a pahrâpa zydua, khizaw â thao tua no tawhta thie chiehpa Mietakutaw hrona châbu liata moh ro leipa maihta ano cha amâ chhy aw.
Nakhaoh a hneipa ta cha thei mawh sy:
Seichâna lâ a sie awpa chyhsa cha, Seichâna lâ sie aw ta; Zaozi ta thie awpa chyhsa cha, Zaozi ta thiepa a châ aw. Cha chata mopathaihpazy cha tao hualuana nata ngiapâna hnei awpa a byuhzie a palâsa.
Chatawhcha sahrâhpa hropa alei tawhta a vaw puapa hmô na ta. Mietakutaw hawhta ki no hnei ta, drâkao reih pathliezie hawhta a reih a pathlie.
Sahrâhpa hmiatuapa biehneina zydua kha a mohmô liata hmâh ta, alei nata a chhôh liata a pahrâpa zydua cha sahrâhpa hmiatuapa, thikhei thei awpa taihta hmah phaoh ta a tlâh hapa kha a pachhysa.
Ngiana nata hmonoâhpa rônah ngaitapazy tao ta, chyhsa mohmô liata avâ tawhta alei lâ mei patlasa theina taihta a tao theipa a châ.
Sahrâhpa hmiatuapa moh ta hmonoâhpa taotheina hmotaotheina piepa a châpa hmâpa ta, alei liata a pahrâpazy dôvei ta, zaozi hmah phaoh ta a hroh heihpa sahrâhpa nothlahpa padua awpa ta a chho ei.

Sahrâhpa nothlahpa cha husona pahneisa awpa ta, sahrâhpa mianona hnohta hmotaotheina piepa châ ta, chatanachata sahrâhpa nothlahpa cha reih pathlie thei aw ta, sahrâhpa nothlahpa a chhy khoh leipa maih a pathiesa aw.
Chyhsa zydua, molaipa nata mochyhpa, hneirôhpa nata dyhchhiepa, sei nata khotalaipazy cha ama ku chachâh lâ tlyma, ama khi liata tlyma, ngiana hnei khai awpa ta tao ta.
Chatanachata ngiana, sahrâhpa moh tlyma, a moh nuby tlyma a hnei leipazy cha, hmo chalei thei leipa aw ei ta, zuah thei hra aw veih ei.
Cha chata sona hnei awpa a byuhzie a palâsa. Pahnona a hneipa ta sahrâhpa nuby cha a laichadai mawh sy. Chyhsapa nuby châ ta, a nuby cha 666 a châ.
Chatawhcha kaw moh na ta, Mietakutaw Zaio Tlâh liata a duahpa nata ama khi liata ano moh nata a Paw moh ârohpa, chyhsa 144,000 a hnohta a ypazy hmô na ta.
Avâ tawhta ao vaw pua ta, tisao lai ngaitapa pyu hawhta nata tôkalôhpa thata a thuapa pyu hawhta thei na ta. Ao ei theipa cha totâ tôthaipazy ta ama totâ ama tôpa pyu hawhta a châ.
Beidyuchhai hmiakô nata hmohrohneipa miapalih nata machâzy hmiakô liata hla thiehpa sa ei ta. Alei tawhta chatlaipa chyhsa 144,000 zy dei leipa ta cha, ahy hmahta cha hla cha sa thei veih ei.

Cha chyhsazy cha chanô liata a papua leipa, chapaw kôpazy ama châ. Mietakutaw siena lâ maih a zituhpazy châ ei ta, Khazohpa châta nata Mietakutaw châta a pathei tua chaipazy châ awpa ta, chyhsa hry tawhta chatlaipazy ama châ.
Ama pakah tawhta haipa bie thei awpa rai y leipa ta, seina hnei leipazy ama châ.
Chatawhcha vâlyuhchâpa hropa avâ liata a zaw ngâpa hmô na ta. Ano cha alei liata a pahrâpa râh to, chi to, reih to nata phopi to hnohta phuah awpa tlyzaw thâtihpha a hneipa a châ.
Ano chata ao paro ngaitapa ta, “Khazohpa chi u la, ano cha palyupalih teh u, a pachiana daihti a vaw tlô haw. Avâ nata alei, tilaipi nata tihnawh a taotuhpa cha a chhy teh u,” tah ta.
Vâlyuhchâpa hropa, panona ta vaw pazi ta, “A pao haw, Babylaw khihpi rônahpa cha a pao haw. Sihryhna vâta phopi to hiehâhna kresawhti a padosatuhpa cha a pao haw,” tah ta.
Vâlyuhchâpa hropa, pathôhna ta âmo cha vaw pazi ta, ao paro ngaitapa ta, “Ahy rai sahrâhpa nata a nothlahpa a chhypa ta, a khi liata tlyma, a ku liata tlyma, ngiana a hnei khiahta cha,

Khazohpa hiehâhna kresawhti patapa, a hiehâhna nyu liata khâpa hmah pahlao leipa ta patlaipa cha doh aw ei ta, vâlyuhchâpa pathaihpazy mohmô ta nata Mietakutaw mohmô liata mei nata kaih ta pasa pataosapa ama châ aw.
Cha chyhsazy pasataona meikhuh cha chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta pua aw ta, sahrâhpa nata a nothlahpa achhytuhpazy nata a moh ngiana a hneipa maihzy cha, chhô nah zâ ta apahâna rai hnei aw veih ei,” tah ta.
Cha chata mopathaihpa, Khazohpa biepiepazy nata Zisu angiapâna bie a zyhtuhpazy cha tao hualua awpa a byuhzie a palâsa.

Chatawhcha avâ tawhta ao ta, “Hetana heta roh teh: Tahmâ tawhta la, Abeipa liata athipazy ama nohlao aw,” a tahpa thei na ta. Thlahpa ta, “A châ na, ama hriapasanazy a pahâsai aw ei ta, ama hmotaopazy ta a zi aw ei!” tah ta.
Chatawhcha kaw moh na ta, meihdo râhpa hmô na ta. Meihdo chô liana chata chyhsa sawchapawpa a lyupa, a luh liata ngôh lakho a kho ta, a ku liata savâ tiah ngaitapa a chabapa ta a tyuhpa hmô na ta.

Achhyna o tawhta vâlyuhchâpa hropa vaw pua ta, meihdo chô liata a tyuhpa hnohna chata ao paro ngaitapa ta, “Na savâ kha hmâh la, sâh kha tai teh. Tai daihti a tlô haw, lei sâhzy liahsa ama maih haw,” tah ta.
Chatanachata meihdo chô liata a tyuhpa chata a savâ cha alei lâ za pathla ta, alei sâh cha taipa châ ha ta.
Chatawhcha avâ liata Achhyna o tawhta vâlyuhchâpa hropa vaw pua heih ta. Ano chhao savâ tiah ngaitapa hnei ta.

Vâlyuhchâpa hropa, mei chô liata biehneituhpa maisâh tawhta vaw pua ta, savâ tiahpa a hneipa hnohta ao paro ngaitapa ta, “Na savâ tiahpa kha hmâh la, alei liata kre zôh tawhta kre saozy za tai teh, kre theizy liahsa ama hmoh haw,” tah ta.
Chatanachata vâlyuhchâpa ta a savâ cha alei lâ za pathla ta, alei liata kre thei cha tai ta, kre saohna khaoh lai ngaitapa, Khazohpa hiehâhna kre saohna khaoh liata thy ta.
Khihpi khôtho lâta kre saohna khaoh liata kre cha tlypa ta saoh ei ta, kre saohna khaoh tawhna chata thisaih vaw pua ta, thisaih cha arâ chhâri taih a thu ta, lyu 1,600 a seih.

Chatawhcha avâ liata ngiana hropa, ngiana rônahpa nata noâhchhihpa hmô na ta. Cha cha vâlyuhchâpa pasari nata potlana miasari a châ. Cha potlanazy cha potlana hnôhchaipazy a châ. Cha potlanazy liata Khazohpa hiehâhna cha a chhâ haw.
Chatawhcha thlalâ tilaipi, mei nata a pahlaopa hmô na ta. Sahrâhpa nata a nothlahpa nata a moh nuby a pahnietuhpazy cha, Khazohpa totâzy chabapa ta thlalâ tilaipi kiah liata a duah ei ta.

Khazohpa chakaotuhpa Mawsi hla nata Mietakutaw hlazy hetana heta ama sa: “Hy Atotaotheipa Abeipa Khazohpa, Na hmotaopazy rônah ta, Noâh â chhih kaw dia! Hy phopizy Beichaipa, Na lâpizy sia ta, Â do kaw dia!

Hy Abeipa, ahy ma cha chi leipa ta y aw ta, Na moh palyupalih leipa ta a y aw? Pathaihpa cha nâ dei na châ. Na pachiana siaziezy palâhâhpa a châ hapa vâta, Phopi zydua a vy aw ei ta, Ama châ vaw chhy aw.”
Cha khai tawhta kaw moh na ta, avâ liata pahnokheituhpa achhyna byureih cha a vaw pahy ta.
Vâlyuhchâpa pasari cha potlana miasari chhaota achhyna byureih tawhta vaw pua ei ta. Vâlyuhchâpazy cha poh rih dipa pathaihpa nata diehpazy a bu ei ta, ama chachôhna liata ngôh chairi a zei ei ta.
Hmohrohneipa miapalihzy hry liata miakha ta vâlyuhchâpa pasarizy hnohta, chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta hroh thlâhpa Khazohpa hiehâhna ta a biepa ngôh biebuh miasari vaw pie ta.
Achhyna byureih cha Khazohpa rônahna nata hmotaotheina khuh ta bie ha ta. Vâlyuhchâpa pasarizy tawhta potlana miasarizy a chhâ hlâlei cha, achhyna byureih liata ahy hmah a ngia thei veih ei.
Chatawhcha Achhyna o tawhta ao paro ngaitapa thei na ta, ao chata vâlyuhchâpa pasarizy hnohta, “Sie u la, Khazohpa hiehâhna biebuh miasari alei liata patlai teh u,” tah ta.
Vâlyuhchâpa pakhana cha sie ta, a biebuh cha alei liata patlai ta. Sahrâhpa ngiana a hneipa chyhsazy nata a nothlahpa a chhypazy chô liata hmahchhiepa nata pasana lâta a vaw lie ta.
Vâlyuhchâpa panona ta a biebuh cha tilaipi liata patlai ta. Athihpa thisaih lâta a vaw lie ta, tilaipi liata hmohrohneipa zydua thi khai ei ta.
Vâlyuhchâpa pathôhna ta a biebuh cha chavahzy nata tihnawhzy liata patlai ta. Thisaih lâta a vaw lie ta.
Ti vâlyuhchâpa ta, “Hy Mo Pathaihpa y, Nâ cha adopa châ chi ta, A y haipa nata a y hapa na châ; Pachiana dopa na vaw tlôkhei haw.
Mopathaihpazy nata hrohsopazy thisaih palo ei ta, Thisaih lilaw na padosa ha ei; Amâ phuhpa rai a châ!” a tahpa thei na ta.
Chatawhcha Maisâh tawhta ao vaw pua ta, “A châ na, Hy Atotaotheipa Abeipa Khazoh, Na pachianazy cha a do ta a sia!” tahpa ta â chhypa thei na ta.
Vâlyuhchâpa papalihna ta a biebuh cha noh liata patlai ta. Mei ta chyhsazy pakâh awpa ta, noh cha hmotaotheina piepa a châ.

Chatanachata chyhsazy cha ama u khaina taihta noh sah ngaitapa ta pakâhpa châ ei ta, potlana chô liata biehneituhpa Khazohpa moh cha chhiesapa ei ta. Châhrasala ro khoh hlei leipa ei ta, Khazohpa palyupalih veih ei.
Vâlyuhchâpa papangawhna ta a biebuh cha sahrâhpa beidyuchhai liata patlai ta. Sahrâhpa khinarâh cha vaw zoh khai ha ta. Pasa taopa ta ama paleihzy sie ei ta,
ama pasana nata hmahzy vâta vârâh Khazohpa cha chhiesapa ei ta. Châhrasala ama hmotaopazy ro khoh hlei veih ei.
Vâlyuhchâpa pacharuna ta a biebuh cha Ufrâti vahpi liata patlai ta. Nochhi beizy châta lâpi a chhuahdy awpa ta, a ti cha kua ha ta.
Chatawhcha drâkao nata sahrâhpa nata hrohso pakheipa pakahzy tawhta cha-u a lyupa thlahpa puapa pathôh ama vaw puapa hmô na ta.
Chazy cha ahripa thlahpazy châ ei ta, hmonoâhpa a tao tyhpazy ama châ. Khizaw bei zydua lâta sie ei ta, Khazohpa Atotaotheipa noh rônahpa liata adyuhna châta beizy cha ama awpakhy.
“Moh teh u, parutuhpa hawhta ei vy hai! A hrohrua ta, chysia a tobi chiehpa ta a ypa cha a nohlao na. Chataleipatala thluahruapa ta a khie aw ta, chyhsa ta a thluahruana ama hmô pathlei aw!”
Chatanachata ahripa thlahpazy ta khizaw bei zydua cha Hebrai reih ta Harmakedaw ama tahpa su liata awpakhy ei ta.
Vâlyuhchâpa pasarina ta a biebuh cha aruapa liata patlai ta. Achhyna o liata beidyuchhai tawhta ao paro ngaitapa vaw pua ta, ao chata, “A ngoh haw!” tah ta.
Dôhlazy vaw patlie ta, aozy vaw pua ta, tôkalôhpazy a vaw thua ta, alo thata a vaw sih ta. Alei liata chyhsa y tua rakha tawhta, cha tlu ta a rupa alosihpa y beih vei. Alosihpa rarôh y ngaipa a châ.
Khihpi rônahpa cha su thôh ta a vaw patlaw ta, phopi to khihpizy cha pao ta. Khazohpa ta Babylaw rônahpa cha a thei thlâh ha ta. Chatanachata a hiehâhna ru ngaitapa kresawhti nyu cha a hnohta pie ta.
Liahpahlô zydua a râpai ei ta, tlâhzy hmô awpa y khao vei.
Chatawhcha pareih lai ngaitapa, talent miakha hlei a hripazy chyhsa chô liata za tla ta. Potlana cha a rarôh y ngaitapa vâta, pareih potlana vâta Khazohpa chô liata chhiesa ei ta.
Chatawhcha vâlyuhchâpa pasari hry liata pakha, biebuh miasari a hneipa a vy ta, ei hnohta, “A vy tua, ti hluhpi chô liata a tyuhpa âzuahnô rônahpa pachiana ei cha pamosa aw.
Ano cha lei beizy ta amâ pheikheipa châ ta, a sihryhna kresawhti ta lei chyhsazy a parisapa a châ,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha Thlahpa ta râhchawhpa lâ na siekhei ta, Khazohpa reipachhiena mohzy ta a biepa, luh sari nata ki hrawh a hneipa sahrâhpa saihlawpa chô liata a kiahpa chanô hmô na ta.
Chanô cha poh nohsaihpa nata saihlawpa a bu ta, ngôh nata lôsôhpa nata taikulô ta a tobi ta, a ku liata hmo pasichhihpa nata sihryhna moleina ta a biepa ngôh nyu a chaba ta.
A khi liata bienyupa, “Babylaw khihpi rônahpa, sihryhpazy nata lei hmo pasichhihpazy nô,” tahpa ta moh ropa y ta.
Cha chanô cha mopathaihpazy thisaih nata Zisu mâtyzy thisaih a paripa ta hmô na ta. Ei hmô nahta, ei noâh ngaita ta.
Châhrasala vâlyuhchâpa ta ei hnohta, “Khazia na no a âh? Kha chanô nata a phaohtuhpa sahrâhpa, luh sari nata ki hrawh a hneipa kyh bienyupa ei cha chho aw.

Sahrâhpa na hmôpa kha vaw y ta, y khao heih leipa ta, aleichiepa khaohtlô tawhta kaw pua aw ta, leidiana lâ a sie aw. Chatawhcha lei liata a pahrâpazy, leilô tao tua no tawhta hrona châbu liata moh ro leipazy ta, y ha ta, a y khao heih leipa, a vy heih awpa sahrâhpa cha ama hmô tita, noâh ama tah ngaita aw.
Cha chata sona palôh hnei awpa a byuhzie a palâsa: Luh saripazy kha chanô atyuna tlâh sarizy a châ.
Bei pasari chhao châ ei ta, papangawhzy pao ha ei ta, pakha y ta, pakha hropa cha vaw y mâh leipa ta, a vaw y tita bohpi leipa chhôh a y awpa a châ.
Sahrâhpa vaw y ta, a y khao leipa kha a pachariena châ ta, châhrasala pasarizy hry liata a hlao hrapa a châ. Leidiana lâ a sie aw.
Ki hrawh na hmôpazy kha bei pahrawh châ ei ta, anodeikua khinarâh a hnei mâh leipazy ama châ. Châhrasala beizy hawhta dawh kha chhôh sahrâhpa nata hmaohkha ta biehneina ama to aw.
Palôh miakha phaohpa ta, ama hmotaotheina nata biehneina cha sahrâhpa ama pie aw.

Mietakutaw a dyuh aw ei ta, châhrasala Mietakutaw ta âmo cha a pahnie aw. Mietakutaw cha hyutuhzy Hyutuhpa nata beizy Beipa châ ta, a hnohta a ypazy cha, awpazy, atlyhpazy nata ngâchhihpazy ama châ,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha vâlyuhchâpa ta ei hnohta, “Âzuahnô atyuna ti na hmôpazy kha, phopizy, zawpizy, râhzy nata reihzy ama châ.
Sahrâhpa nata ki hrawh na hmôpazy khata âzuahnô cha amâ hao aw. Roryhrapa nata thluahruapa ta tao aw ei ta, a sa nie aw ei ta, mei ta ama raosao aw.
Khazohpa biezy pakipa a châ hlâlei a hmochhuahpa ama hria thei nawpa ta, Khazohpa ta âmo cha palôh miakha phaoh awpa ta tao ta, amâ beinarâh chhao sahrâhpa hnohta pie khohna palôh a pahneisa ei.
Chanô na hmôpa kha khihpi rônahpa, lei beizy chô liata ryureituhpa a châ,” tah ta.
Cha khai tawhta vâlyuhchâpa hropa avâ tawhta a zâ chôpa hmô na ta. Biehneina lai ngaitapa hnei ta, a rônahna ta alei pakhaihsa khai ha ta.

Vâlyuhchâpa chata ao thatlô ngaitapa ta, “A pao haw, Babylaw rônahpa a pao haw! Ahripazy pahrâna, Thlahpa puapa to ahrâhna, Pavaw puapa to pahrâna, Hmo puapa nata pasichhihpa to atohna Khihpi lâta â lie haw.
A sihryhna kresawhti doh ei ta, Phopi zydua ama pari khai haw; Lei beizy ta sihryhkhei ei ta, Lei liata sôhpalietuhpazy ta hneirôhkhei ei ta, A phasana hro ama hneirôhkhei,” tahpa ta awh ta.
Chatawhcha avâ tawhta ao hropa thei na ta, ao chata, “Hy ei phopi, Ano tawhta vaw pua teh u; Chataleipatala a moleinazy liata a hlao pathlei aw ei chi ta, A potlana liata namâ hlao pathlei aw na.
A moleinazy avâ taihta a pacho ta, A paraonazy Khazohpa ta â thei thlâh haw.
Chyhsazy viari a thô tyhpa hawhta, Ano chhao viarithô u la, A hmotaopazy a lie no ta viarithô teh u; A do awpa pahlaona nyu cha, A lie no ta pahlaopa teh u.

Anosasyh ta a parônahsa ta, Phasapa ta a y tyhpa kha, Â phuhpa ta pasa pataosa u la, Mâchhie pasasa teh u; A palôh ta, ‘Beinô ta ei tyuh, Nôhmei châ va na, Mâchhiesa beih aw va na,’ Tahpa ta reih tlôh ta.

Chavâta noh kha chhôh tlai ta, Potlanazy ta a vaw tlô thlu aw; Thina nata mâchhiesana chakâhna vaw tlô thlu aw ta, Mei ta pakâ khaipa a châ aw; Ano a pachiatuhpa Abeipa cha, Khazohpa thatlôpa châ tlôh ta,” tah ta.
A sihryhkhei tyhpa nata phasana ta a hrolâh tyhpa lei beizy ta Babylaw khihpi mei ta a kâpa khuh ama hmô nahta, chakhei aw ei ta, chaphôh ama tupa aw.

A pasataona chipa ta, lâhlapi ta a duah aw ei ta, hetana heta ama tah aw: “Cha rimâ cha! Cha rimâ cha! Nâ, khihpi rônahpa, Nâ, khihpi thatlôpa, Hy Babylaw khihpi! Dawh kha chhôh ta, Na rao khai ha he zaw.”
Lei liata sôhpalietuhpazy cha, ahy hmah ama hmo ama chalei khao leipa vâta, Babylaw cha chakheipa ta mâchhiesa ei ta.

Ama hmo zuapa ngôh, tâkâ, lôsôhpa, taikulô, poh rihdipa, poh nohsaihpa, pu pala, poh saihlawpa, tho ropahâhpa to, sianaoh ta taopa hmobaoh to, tho sôhpa, dawh, thua nata awhlôteihpa ta taopa hmobaoh to,

lôiasohpa, ia-ô, ropahâhpa raopa, myrâ, sathaw ropahâhpa, kresawhti, sathaw, viahdie dipa, âtâ sâh, viahchao nata mietaku, arâ nata talailih zy nata sei ta chyhsa hrona ama zuapazy a chalei awpa y khao veih ei.
“Na tlaichhaipa theilâpa ta cha siesai ha ta, Na hneirôna nata na laiphanazy a lei khai haw; Hmô heih khao aw va chi!”
Cha hmozy ta sôhpalie ei ta, ano vâta a hneirôhpa sôhpalietuhpazy cha, a pasataona chipa ta lâhlapi ta a duah aw ei ta, hetana heta ao paro ngaitapa ta cha aw ei ta, chaphôh ama tu aw:
“Cha rimâ cha! Cha rimâ cha! Khihpi rônahpa, Poh rihdipa a bu ta, Poh nohsaipapa nata poh saihlawpa a bupa ta, Ngôh nata lôsôhpa ta a tobi ta, Taikulô ta a tobipa khihpi!
Dawh kha chhôh ta, A hneirôna zydua a lei khai ha he zaw!” Balyh hyutuhpa zydua nata balyh ta khitlyhpa zydua, balyh puhpazy nata tilaipi chô liata sôhpalietuhpa zydua cha Lâhlapi ta a duah ei ta,
Babylaw kâpa khuh cha saina chôta, “He hawhta khihpi rônahpa he, Khâpa khih ma a y aw?” tahpa ta awh ei ta.

Ama luh liata buchadoh a mia ei ta, awh ei ta, hetana heta chapa ta mâchhie ama sâ: “Cha rimâ cha! Cha rimâ cha! Khihpi rônahpa, A hneirôna hmâpa ta, Tilaipi balyh hneituhpazy A pahneirôhsapa khihpi! Dawh kha chhôh ta, A lei khai ha he zaw!
“Hy avâ, ano vâta a ly la, Nâmo, mopathaihpazy, Nâmo, lyuhchâpazy, Nâmo, hrohsopazy, Ano vâta a ly teh u; Khazohpa ta a chô liata Viari a cha thôpa ha ei hih.”

Chatawhcha vâlyuhchâpa thatlô ngaitapa ta sâhchariehna lô lai ngaitapa a lyupa alô la ta, tilaipi liata thy ta, hetana heta a tah: “Kha hawhna khata, Babylaw khihpi rônahpa chhao, Pasa kawpa ta thypa châ aw ta, Hmô heihpa châ khao aw vei.

Totâ pyu nata pyungiapa pyuzy, Ramo pyu nata chiahmie pyuzy, Na chhôh liata theipa châ khao leipa aw ta, Zôthaipa zôthaina kheihawhpa rai, Na chhôh liata hmôpa châ khao aw vei. Sâh chariehna pyuzy Na chhôh liata theipa châ khao leipa aw ta,

Meiôh khaihna chhao, Na chhôh liata khaih khao aw vei. Myuhneituhpa ao nata myuh aozy chhao, Na chhôh liata theipa châ khao aw vei. Na sôhpalietuhpazy cha, Lei chyhsa rônahpazy châ ei ta, Na dyuthaina ta phopi zydua dôveipa ta ama y.
A chhôh liata hrohsopazy thisaih y ta, Mopathaihpazy thisaih chhao y ta, Lei liata thiepa zydua thisaih a y.”
