Cha khai tawhta vârâh liata zawpi hluhpi ao paro ngaitapa a lyupa thei na ta, ao chata, “Haleluia! Pachhana zy, rônahna zy, hmotaotheina zy cha, Eima Khazohpa eih a châ.
A pachiana a do ta a sia; A sihryhna ta leilô a papuapa âzuahnô rônahpa cha, Khazohpa ta pachia ta; A chakaotuhpazy thisaih phuh cha, Âzuahnô chô liata a la haw,” tah ei ta.
“Haleluia! Chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta, A meikhuh a kiah lymâ aw,” tahpa ta awh via heih ei ta.
Machâ pakih nata papalih nata hmohrohneipa miapalihzy cha a khu ei ta, “Amen! Haleluia!” tahpa ta, beidyuchhai liata a tyuhpa Khazohpa cha a chhy ei ta.
Chatawhcha beidyuchhai tawhta ao vaw pua ta, “Nâmo, Khazohpa chakaotuhpa zydua, Nâmo, ano a chituhpazy, Molaipa nata mochyhpazy saih u, Eima Khazohpa cha reithai teh u,” vaw tah ta.
Chatawhcha zawpi hluhpi ao a lyupa thei na ta. Ti hluhpi pyu hawhta nata tôkalôhpa thata a thuapa pyu hawhta châ ta, ao chata, “Haleluia! Abeipa eima Khazohpa, Atotaotheipa ta ryu a reih.
Alypa nata thaphapa ta y sih la, Ano palyupalih suh u; Mietakutaw myuh hneina vaw tlô ha ta, A myuh chhao â mâ haw.
Poh rih dipa pathliepa nata pathaihpa A bu awpa pasaipa a châ,” vaw tah ta. Poh rih dipa cha mopathaihpazy siana hmotaopa a palâsa.

Vâlyuhchâpa chata ei hnohta, “Mietakutaw myuh hneina kyhchhi liata hruapazy cha ama nohlao na, tahpa ta roh teh,” na tah ta. Chatawhcha ei hnohta, “Hezy he Khazohpa biehmeiseihpazy a châ,” tahpa ta na chho ta.

Ano a chhy awpa ta a phei thaby liata kei pao na ta. Châhrasala ano ta ei hnohta, “Khata tao khah y! Kei cha nâ nata na unawhpa, Zisu bie a pyhtuhpazy chakaolâhpa ei châ. Khazohpa tlao a chhy teh. Zisu bie cha hrohsona thlahpa châ tlôh ta,” tah ta.
Chatawhcha vârâh a vaw pahy ta, arâ râhpa hmô na ta. A chô liata a kiahpa cha Ngâchhihpa nata Hmeiseihpa moh bipa châ ta, siana ta ryureih ta, chariah a dyuhpa a châ.
A mokhaohzy cha meipaleih lyu ta, a luh liata lakho hluhpi a kho ta, moh ropa, ano dei leipa ta ahy hmah ama pahno leipa a hnei.
Thisaih liata nypa poh a bu ta, a moh cha, “Khazohpa Bie,” tahpa ta bipa a châ.
Vâ pheisaihzy ta poh rih dipa diehpa nata pathaihpa a bupa ta arâ râhpa a kiahpa cha pazi ei ta.
A pakah tawhta zaozi tiah ngaitapa vaw pua ta, cha chata phopizy chhawh aw ta, thua chôchahrei ta ama chô liata ryureih aw ta, Khazohpa Atotaotheipa hiehâhna ru ngaitapa kre saohna khaoh a tly aw.
A poh liata nata a byhpi liata, “Beizy Beipa nata hyutuhpazy Hyutuhpa,” tahpa moh ropa a hnei.
Chatawhcha vâlyuhchâpa pakha, noh liata a duah thlâh hapa hmô na ta. Ano chata avâ liata pavaw a zawpa zydua hnohta ao paro ngaitapa ta, “A vy u la, Khazohpa zâpati rônahpa châta a vaw hmaoh u la,
beizy, pheisaih hyutuhpazy, pasaiphazy, arâ nata a kiahtuhpazy, chyhsa zydua, sei nata khotalaipazy, mochyhpa nata molaipa sapazy vaw nie teh u,” tahpa ta awh ta.
Chatawhcha arâ a kiahpa nata a pheisaih a dyuh awpa ta, sahrâhpa nata lei beizy nata ama pheisaihzy amâ hmaohpa hmô na ta.

Sahrâhpa cha patupa châ ta. Sahrâhpa ngiana a hneipa nata sahrâhpa nothlahpa a chhytuhpazy dôveina hmonoâhpa a mohmô liata a tao tyhpa hrohso pakheipa chhao, a hnohta patu pâpa châ ta, kaih ta a kâ ngâpa mei tipo liata ama pano ta ahrohpa ta thypa ama châ.
Ahropazy cha arâ a kiahpa pakah tawhta zaozi a vaw puapa ta chhawhsaopa châ ei ta, ama sapa cha pavaw zydua ta nie ei ta, rihbiepa ta ama y.
Chatawhcha vârâh tawhta vâlyuhchâpa pakha a za chôpa hmô na ta. Leichiepa khaohtlô châhbi nata bâlia laipa a ku liata a chaba ta.
Drâkao parih hlôpa, ahripa nata Sâtâ cha patu ta, kô sâh kha châta chahry ta.
Leichiepa khaohtlô liata za thy ta, kô sâh kha a tloh hlâlei phopizy a dôvei khao lei nawpa ta, khaohtlô cha khawhlôh ta, pachawhpâ ha ta. Cha khai tawhta bohpi leipa chhôh pathlie chypa a châ aw.

Chatawhcha beidyuchhaizy hmô na ta, a chô liata a tyuhpazy cha ryurei awpa ta biehneina piepa châ ei ta. Zisu bie nata Khazohpa bie vâta luh taipazy thlahpa, sahrâhpa nata a nothlahpa a chhy leipa nata ama khi liata tlyma, ama ku liata tlyma, ngiana a hnei leipazy thlahpa chhao hmô na ta. Cha sahlao cha vaw hroh ei ta, kô sâh kha chhôh Krista ryureilâh ei ta.
Athihpa hropazy deikua kô sâh kha a tloh hlâlei cha hroh mâh veih ei. Cha cha thyuheihna eikhana a châ.

Thyuheihna eikhana liata a hlaopazy cha nohlao ei ta, ama pathaih. Thina einona ta ama chô liata biehnei khao aw vei. Khazohpa nata Krista theihthaipazy châ aw ei ta, a hnohta kô sâh kha ryu ama reih aw.
Kô sâh kha a lei tawhta, Sâtâ cha patâhna tawhta pathliepa châ aw ta,
alei ki palih liata phopizy dôvei awpa ta pua aw ta, Kawkâ nata Makawkâ zy cha adyuhna châta a awpakhy aw. Ama maluh hluhzie cha tilaipi liata sadi hawhta a châ.
Alei chô zydua hrâsie ei ta, mopathaihpazy riehmo nata khihpi kho ngaitapa cha chadô ei ta. Châhrasala avâ tawhta mei za tla ta, a kâ khai ha ei.
Âmo dôveituhpa ahripa cha, sahrâhpa nata hrohso pakheipa yna mei nata kaih tipo liata thypa châ ta, chhô nah zâ ta chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta pasa pataosapa a châ aw.
Chatawhcha beidyuchhai diehpa rônahpa nata a chô liata a tyuhpa hmô na ta. A hmiakô tawhta alei nata avâ a râ ei ta, âmo châta su rai y khao vei.

Beidyuchhai hmiakô liata molaipa nata mochyhpa athipazy a duahpa hmô na ta, châbuzy pahypa a châ. Châbu hropa, hrona châbu chhao pahypa châ ta. Athihpazy cha châbuzy liata ropa hawhta, ama hmotaozie lymâ hawhta pachiapa ama châ.
Tilaipi ta a chhôh liata athihpa a ypazy papuasa ta, Thina nata Athihkhih ta ama chhôh liata athihpa a ypazy papuasa hra ei ta, chyhsa to ama hmotaopa lymâ hawhta pachiapa ama châ.
Chatawhcha Thina nata Athihkhih cha mei tipo liata thypa châ ta. Cha mei tipo cha thina einona a châ.
Ahy rai hrona châbu liata a moh ropa hmô awpa a y leipa cha, mei tipo liata thypa a châ.
Chatawhcha avâ thiehpa nata alei thiehpa hmô na ta. Avâ hmiatuapa nata alei hmiatuapa cha lei ha ta, tilaipi chhao y khao vei.
Chatawhcha khihpi pathaihpa, Zerusale thiehpa hmô na ta. Myuhthieh ta a vahpa châta a tobi ta, a mâ chiehpa ta a ypa hawhta, avâ liata Khazohpa tawhta za chô ta.

Beidyuchhai tawhta ao paro ngaitapa ta, “Moh teh u, Khazohpa pahrâna cha chyhsa hry liata a vaw y haw. Ama hnohta pahrâ aw ta, a chyhsazy ama châ aw. Khazohpa tlai cha ama hnohta y aw ta, ama Khazohpa a châ aw.
Ama mo liata mothlih zydua a hru khai aw. Hmo parohpazy a lei hapa vâta, thina y khao leipa aw ta, mâchhiesana, chana nata pasana zy y khao aw vei,” tahpa ta a reipa thei na ta.
Beidyuchhai liata a tyuhpa ta, “Moh tua, hmo to a thiehpa ta ei tao haw,” tah ta. “Roh teh, he biezy he ngâ a chhih ta â do,” tah heih ta.
Chatawhcha ei hnohta, “A ngoh haw! Kei he Alphâ nata Ômekâ châ na ta, âthaona nata achhâna ei châ. Dâhphipa hnohta hrona tihnawh tawhta ti a saipa ta ei pie aw.
Pahnietuhpa cha he ryu he a to aw. A Khazohpa châ aw na ta, ei saw a châ aw.

Riahchhiepazy, ngiapâleipazy, pasichhihpazy, lianycheihpazy, sihryhpazy, dyuthaipazy, nothlahpa achhypazy nata haiphiahpa zydua to awpa deikua cha, mei nata kaih ta a kâ ngâpa tipo châ aw ta, cha cha thina einona a châ,” tah ta.

Chatawhcha vâlyuhchâpa pasari hry liata pakha, potlana hnôhchaipa miasari ta a biepa biebuh miasari a chabapa vâlyuhchâpa a vy ta, ei hnohta, “A vy teh, myuhthieh, Mietakutaw lapinô cha ei cha pahmô aw,” na tah ta.
Thlahpa ta tlâh laipa nata a sâhpa lâ nâ chhi ta, khihpi pathaihpa Zerusale cha vârâh liata Khazohpa tawhta a za chô haipa na pahmô ta.
Khazohpa rônahna hnei ta, a khaihnazie cha lôsôh ngaitapa zaspi lô hawhta châ ta, lôsôhpa pasohpa hawhta patliepa a châ.
Thokhy rônahpa nata a sâhpa hnei ta, chhikao miahrawh hleino hnei ta, chhikao thabyzy liata vâlyuhchâpa pahrawh hleino y ei ta, chhikaozy liana cha Izarei pathla chi hrawh hleinopazy moh ropa a châ.
Nochhi lâ chhikao miathôh, maw lâ chhikao miathôh, chho lâ chhikao miathôh, notla lâ chhikao miathôh y ta.
Khihpi thokhy cha lôbô miahrawh hleino hnei ta, chazy liata Mietakutaw lyuhchâpa pahrawh hleino mohzy a choh ta.
Bie nâ chhotuhpa vâlyuhchâpa cha khihpi nata a chhikaozy nata a thokhy cha thlie nawpa ngôh lohthi hnei ta.
Khihpi cha ki palih hnei ta, a doh nata a hâ a khopa a châ. Khihpi cha lohthi ta thlie ta, lyu 12,000 châ ta, a doh, a hâ nata â sâhna lâ â kho khai.
A thokhy dôhpa cha thlie heih ta, chyhsapa thliezie ta dy 144 châ ta, cha cha vâlyuhchâpa thliezie a châ hra.
A thokhy cha zaspi lô ta dôhpa châ ta, khihpi cha thlalâ pasohpa hawhta ngôh suapa ta taopa a châ.
Khihpi thokhy abônazy cha lôsôhpa chi to ta tobipa a châ. Abôna miakhana cha zaspi châ ta, mianona saphai, miathôhna kalisidôni, miapalihna emerâ,
miapangawhna sadôni, miacharuna sâdi, miasarina krisôlite, miachariena beri, miachakina tôpazi, miahrawhna krisôparase, hleikhana zasi nata hleinona amethi lôzy ta tobipa a châ.

Chhikao miahrawh hleino cha taikulô miahrawh hleino ta taopa châ ta, chhikao to cha taikulô miakha hmâpa ta taopa a châ. Khihpi lâlai cha ngôh suapa ta taopa châ ta, thlalâ mopahlie theipa hawhta a châ.
Achhyna o deikua khihpi chhôh liata hmô va na, Abeipa Khazohpa Atotaotheipa nata Mietakutaw cha khihpi Achhyna o a châpa vâta.
Khihpi pakhaihsa awpa ta noh a ngiah leipa ta, thlâpâ chhao a ngiah hra vei, Khazohpa rônahna ta pakhaihsa ta, Mietakutaw cha a meiôh a châ.
A khaihna liata phopizy charei aw ei ta, lei beizy ta ama rônahna amâ ngiakhei aw.
Nohchhô ta a chhikaozy khawpa châ beih leipa aw ta, cha liata zâ y aw vei.
Phopizy ta ama rônahna nata zachhihna cha khihpi liata amâ ngiakhei aw.

Hmo puapa deikua cha kheihawhpa hmah a ngia thei aw vei. Hmo pasichhihpa a taopa nata haipa bie a reihpa ahy hmah a ngia thei hra aw veih vei. Mietakutaw hrona châbu liata moh ropazy deita ta amâ ngia thei aw.
Chatawhcha vâlyuhchâpa ta hrona ti chavah, lôsôhpa pasohpa hawhta a patliepa, Khazohpa nata Mietakutaw beidyuchhai tawhta a vaw lohpa na pahmô ta.
Khihpi lâlai liah liata loh ta. Chavah ngiahkâ chavei chachâh ta, thei chi hrawh hleino a hneipa, thla chareih ta a patheipa hrona tho pyuh ta. Thohnazy cha phopizy tlâh nawpa a châ.
Cha khihpi liana cha chhiesana rai y khao leipa aw ta, Khazohpa nata Mietakutaw beidyuchhai tlao y aw ta, a chakaotuhpazy ta ano cha amâ chhy aw.
A hmia hmô aw ei ta, ama khi liata a moh â choh aw.
Zâ y khao leipa aw ta, meiôh khaihpa nata noh khaihpa a ngiah khao aw veih ei. Abeipa Khazohpa cha ama khaihpa châ aw ta, chhâzaw nata tlyzaw ta ryu ama reih aw.

Chatawhcha vâlyuhchâpa ta, “He biezy he ngâchhih ta â do. Abeipa, hrohsopazy thlahpa Khazohpa ta hmo thlai a vaw tlô awpazy cha a chakaotuhpazy pahmô awpa ta a vâlyuhchâpa a vaw tuah,” tahpa ta na chho ta.
Abeipa Zisu ta, “Nathlie teh, ei vy patoh aw. He châbu chhôh liata hrohsona biezy a pyhpa cha a nohlao na,” tah ta.
Kei, Zawhâna he, cha hmozy a theituhpa nata a hmôtuhpa ei châ. Cha hmozy cha theipa ta ei hmô nahta, nâ pahmôtuhpa vâlyuhchâpa cha a chhy awpa ta, a phei thaby liata kei pao na ta.
Châhrasala ano ta ei hnohta, “Khata tao khah y! Kei cha nâ nata na unawhpa hrohsopazy nata he châbu biezy a pyhtuhpazy chakaolâhpa mah ei châ tâh. Khazohpa tlao a chhy teh,” na tah ta.
Chatawhcha vâlyuhchâpa ta, “He châbu liata hrohsona biezy he phih khah y, a daihti â hnia haw.
Moleipa cha moleina hmo tao lymâ sala, chyhsa puapa cha a puapa ta y lymâ sala, mosiapa cha a siapa ta y lymâ sala, mopathaihpa cha pathaihpa ta y lymâ mawh sy,” tahpa ta na chho ta.
Abeipa Zisu ta, “Nathlie teh, ei vy patoh aw. Chyhsa to ama hmotaopa lymâ hawhta pie awpa lymâ ei hnohta a y.
Kei he Alphâ nata Ômekâ, hmiatuapa nata hnôhchaipa, âthaona nata achhâna ei châ.
“Ama chysiazy a pasupa cha ama nohlao na. Hrona tho chô liata biehnei thei aw ei ta, chhikaozy lâ tawhta khihpi chhôh lâ amâ ngia thei aw.
Izy, dyuthaipazy, sihryhpazy, lianycheihpazy, nothlahpa a chhypazy nata haipa bie rei a pahâhpazy deikua cha, khihpi khôtho liata ama y aw.
“Kei, Zisu ta, he biezy he Awnanopazy pahnosa awpa ta ei vâlyuhchâpa nâmo lâ ei vaw tuah. Dâvi thari nata a pathla, deiva awhsi khaih ngaitapa ei châ,” tah ta.
Thlahpa nata Myuhthieh ta, “A vy mah y,” tah ei ta. A theipa maihta, “A vy mah y,” tah mawh ei sy. Dâhphipa maih a vy sala, a khohpa maihta hrona ti he a saipa ta doh mawh sy.
He châbu liata hrohsona biezy a theipa maih zikyu ei râ ei. Ahy rai ta he biezy he a baichha khiahta cha, he châbu liata potlana palâsapazy he Khazohpa ta a chô liata a baichha aw.
Ahy rai ta he hrohsona châbu liata biezy he a thy bâ khiahta cha, he châbu liata palâsapa hrona tho nata khihpi pathaihpa liata a tovyuh cha Khazohpa ta a lapa aw.
He biezy a reihtuhpa ta, “Ei vy patoh tlai aw,” a tah. Amen. A vy mah y, Beipa Zisu!
Abeipa Zisu ngiachhiena cha mopathaihpa zydua hnohta y mawh sy. Amen.
